23Wa yaa tulisi ba ayen, <<Ku meena a nala kama, ni kaa chali yɔgsummoa. Ka ni Wenni, ni koma Wenni ale te ŋanta ni boorisaŋa po. M be tuesi ni kpanaŋa.>> Ate wa yaa ta Simeyon a nyini a te ba.
24Yenni nyaarɔwa yaa jam ta nuruma a kuli Josefi yenni a te ba nyiam a te ba sugri ba naŋsaŋa ale yaali ŋandiinta a te bonsaŋa. 25Ba jam gomsi ba tiiritaŋa a magsi Josefi ale cheen kantueŋ ka la dii nyiŋla ba wom kama ayen ba a yaali ayen ba dɛ ka dula.
26Josefi ale jam yeri la, ba yaa pai tiiritaŋa ate ba ta jam wa yenni la a te wa ale koori tɛŋ wa niŋ. 27Wa yaa jam bek ba nyiŋ po ale weeni ba ayen, <<Ni ko kpakka ate ni weeni mu wa wie la a diem vua?>>
28Ate ba yaa tulisi ayen, <<Fi tomteerɔwa tama kowa a diem vua kama ale ŋman ta nyiŋyɔgsa.>> Ate ba koori tɛŋ a te wa zula.
29Wa le nya wa suoku Benjamin wa mawa biika la, wa yaa bek ayen, <<Ka ni yoa baaŋka waai ate ni weeni mi wa wie la ale la?>> Ate wa weeni ayen, <<M biiga, Wen abe niak fu.>> 30Josefi ale weeni dila la, wa yoa baaŋka jiirim yaa dari wa ate wa boro a yaali wa kum. Ate wa yaa nye mwuli a jo dɔk yoŋ po a kum dula.
31Wa le puuri wa ninaŋa la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, wa yaa yik wadek a nyini peelim ayen, <<Ba chari ŋandiintaŋa.>>
32Ba yaa te Josefi ŋandiintaŋa wa tɔga ale te wa suataŋa mɛ ba tɔga. Ate Ejipiti demma a dɛ ale Josefi. Dii nyiŋla Ejipiti demma an jaa yaali Yiburu demma wari ya ate ba an poom a dɛ ale ba a nya ya. 33Josefi suataŋa a jam kala ka wa niŋ a ta va ba benaŋa ale ka diila a nyini kpagni a ga paari baaŋka. Ku jam cha ba kama ate ba kala a nya chaab. 34Ba le nye ŋandiintaŋa Josefi jigi a te ba la, Benjamin ŋantaŋa a jam a lab mbala ŋantaŋa ka naŋtuok nɔi bunu. Ate ba dɛ ale nyu ale wa.

Title: PIILIMKA 44
Content:
1Josefi yaa weeni wieŋa de a te waai ale a nya wa yenni zuk la ayen, <<Nye ŋandiinta a sueri nuruma boorisaŋa a paari dii ate ba baga a ji la, abe fi pai nuru meena kpana a nyo wa boorika po. 2Abe fi pai m kpana beerika a nyo baaŋka boorika po a gum chaab ale wa kpanaŋa.
3Vari ale moata veentika la, ba yaa basi nuruma suik po ale ba bonsaŋa. 4Ba an diem a basi tɛŋka a ga niŋŋa ate Josefi yaa weeni waai ale a nya wa yenni zuk la ayen, <<Saŋ nuruma de ŋaaŋ, fi dan paari ba weeni ba ayen, <Ka boa ate nama a pai biem a tuni nalimmoa? 5Daa beeri kaai ate ni zu pai la ale m kpagni a ta a nyu ale a porisi la? Ni nye ka biem nna yegayega.>>>
6Wa ale jam a paari ba la wa yaa ŋman weeni wie ŋala dek a te ba. 7Alege ba yaa weeni wa ayen, ka boa ate m nyɔnɔwa a biisi wieŋa de? Kude abe yalima ale fi tomteerɔma ate ti nye wanni de choa. 8Ti be pilim ta kpanaŋa ate ti nya ti boorisaŋa po Keenan la, a jam te fu kama. Ka boa ale soa ate tama ale zu kpana yaase ligmɔniŋ a nyini fi kpagni yenni po? 9Ase fi dan nya ka fi tomteerɔma wanyi, wa le kpi. Ate tama baai ale tali la a chim m nyɔnɔwa yɔm.>>
10Ate wa tulisi ayen, <<Ku nala ku abe nye ase fi ale weeni diila. Waai ate ta a nya ale wa ta ka la ale chim m yɔma. Nama baai ale tali la, m kan ŋma ni.>>
11Ba meena yaa tuili ba boorisaŋa nwuli a lak si. 12Ate waai ale a nya yenni zuk la yaa piilim gisika, a nyini kpagni a ta ga paari baaŋka. Ba jam nya beerika ka Benjamin boorika po. 13Kude nyiŋ ba meena yaa jam cheeri ba gattaŋa. Ba meena yaa jam pai ba ŋantaŋa a do ba bonsaŋa a ŋman cheŋ tɛŋka po.
14Josefi a jam diem bo ka yenni po ate Juda ale wa suataŋa a jam jo la, ba jam lo ka tɛŋ wa niŋ. 15Josefi yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ka boa ale la ate ni nye? Nama a zɛ ayen nuru ase mi la a baga a miŋ wasusuga?>>
16Juda yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ti le weeni m nyɔnɔwa ayen ka boa? Ti le weeni ayen ka boa? Ti le nye ka sɛ a sak ayen ti an nye a kaasi ya? Wen a lak wa tomteerɔma a zaani. Ti yaa ka m nyɔnɔwa yɔm, tama dek ale waai ate ba yik ale beerika la.>>
17Alege Josefi a weeni ayen, <<Kude abe yalima ale mi ate m nye wanni de choa. Ka nuru waai nyiini ate ba nya beerika wa jigi la ale wa chim m yɔma. Nama baai ale tali la, a ŋman cheŋ ni kowa jigi ale suiyɔgni.>>
18Ase Juda ale ŋman cheŋ wa jigi ayen, <<Mi a saalim, m nyɔnɔ basi ate fi yɔmawa a biisi. Kan te fi sui a puuri ale fi tomteerɔwa, fi ale Faaro dek ka bunyi. 19M nyɔnɔwa a bek wa tomteerɔma kama ayen, <Ni ta koa yaase suokwa?> 20Ate ti tulisi ayen, <Ti ta ko kpak ale yoa baaŋ ate ba biak a te wa, wa kpaŋsaŋa po. Wa suoku a kpi kama, wa la nyiini ale wa mawa biik a tali ate wa kowa a yaali wa.>
21<<Ate fi yaa weeni fi tomteerɔma ayen, <Ni ta wa a jam ate m nya wa.> 22Ate ti yaa weeni m nyɔnɔwa ayen, <Nidoabinni a kan baga a basi wa kowa, wa dan basi wa, wa kowa le kpi.> 23Alege fi weeni fi tomteerɔma ayen, <Nin ka ni yoa baaŋka a nin va ni jam, ni kan te m nya ni dela.> 24Ase ti ale ŋman kuli fi tomteerɔwa m kowa jigi la, ti weeni wa m nyɔnɔwa ale weeni diila kama.
25<<Ate ti kowa a weeni ayen, <Ni ŋman cheŋ a ga da ŋandiinta maga.> 26Ate tama a weeni wa ayen, <Ti kan baga a cheŋŋi. Nin ka ti yoa baaŋka a nin va ti cheŋ. Ti kan baga a nya nuruwa nina, nin ka ti yoa baaŋka a nin va ti.>
27<<Fi tomteerɔwa m kowa a weeni ti ayen, <Ni seba kama ayen m powa a biak ka bisa baye a te mu. 28Ba wanyi yaa cheŋ alege mu, ate m weeni ayen, <<Ba sum dari wa a passi kama bunabuna.>> Di nna mi an diem a nya wa. 29Ni dan ta wade mɛ a cheŋ ate wari a nye wa, ni ale gu mi zuk peelukku nyɔnɔ ale niniga.>
30Ase nidoabinni a dan kan va ti ate ti ŋman kuli fi tomteerɔwa m kowa jigi, waai chiik ale kasim a jo nidoabinni la, 31a nya ale nidoabinni a karo, wa ale kpi. Fi tomteerɔma ale gu m kowa zuk peelukku nyɔnɔ ale niniga. 32Fi tomteerɔwa a zaani ka m kowa niŋ a weeni ayen m za nidoabinni ŋaaŋ. M weeni ayen, <M dan kan ta wa a ŋman jam te fu, pai kude a ji mu m koa m boka po meena.>
33<<Yɔgyɔgla de mi a saalim basi ate fi tomteerɔwa a wari dela ase m nyɔnɔwa yɔma la a zaani nidoabinni naŋkula po, abe fi basi ate nidoabinni a va wa suataŋa a kuli. 34Mi ale nye ka sɛ a kuli m kowa jigi ase nidoabinni a nin kan va mu? Aaya, kan basi ate m nya niniŋŋa ale ŋa jam m kowa zuk la.>>

Title: PIILIMKA 45
Content:
1Josefi an jam baga a yik wadek wa tuimtomdisaŋa meena niŋŋa a yaa kaari ayen, <<Waai meena a cheŋ abe ba ge mu.>> Waai a ŋman karo ale Josefi ate wa yaa basi ate wa suataŋa a miŋ wa. 2Wa jam kum ate ku jueli ka nna yegayega ate Ejipiti demma ale Faaro yenni meena jam a wom wa.
3Josefi yaa weeni wa suataŋa ayen, <<Mi ka Josefi, m kowa a diem vua?>> Alege wa suataŋa an jam baga a tulisi wa, dii nyiŋla ba kpaziita ale jam a nak wa niŋ.
4Josefi jam weeni wa suataŋa ayen, <<Ni jam a moata mu.>> Ba le cheŋ paari wa la, wa weeni ba ayen, <<Mi ka ni suoku Josefi waai ate ni yik da te Ejipiti tɛŋka la. 5Yɔgyɔgla ni kan te ku a daani ni abe ni kan basi ate ni sue a puuri ale ni dega ni ale pai mi a da dela la, dii nyiŋla ka nyuvoa varibasika nyiŋ ate Wen a tom ayen m de ni niŋ. 6Bena ŋaye ale nna kɔm ale bo tɛŋka po, bena ŋanu ale bo ŋaaŋ a cheen la kpari ale cheka a kan boro. 7Alege Wen a dɛ niŋ a tom mu ayen m gomsi ate ni buuni a tali a bo tɛŋka zuk, abe m vari ni nyuvooŋa a basi.
8Dila nyiŋla, daa nama ale tom mi dela ka Wen. Wa nye kama ate mi chim Faaro ko, a chim nyɔnɔ a te wa yenni meena abe mu a nya Ejipiti tɛŋka meena zuk. 9Yɔgyɔgla de ni kpabi nwuli a cheŋ m kowa jigi a weeni wa ayen, <Fi nidoabinni Josefi ale weeni diila ale nna. Wen a basi kama ate m chim kpagi Ejipiti tɛŋka meena po. Jam m jigi kan beni. 10Ni ale kali ka Gosen po a moata mi, nama ale ni bisaŋa ale ni ŋaaŋ bisaŋa ale ni piisaŋa ale ni duŋsaŋa meena ate ni ta la. 11M le te ni ŋandiinta dula dii nyiŋla kɔm bena ŋanu ale diem bo ŋaaŋ a cheena, Dan kan daa di nama ale ni yenni demma ale baai meena ale bo ale ni la ale viiri.>
12Nama dek baga a nya kama, m suoku Benjamin mɛ ayen ku sum ka mi ale a biisi ale ni la. 13Ni weeni m kowa zula ŋaai ate ba te mu Ejipiti tɛŋka po la ale dii meena ate ni nya la. Abe ni ta m kowa a jam dela nwuli.>>
14Wa yaa gbaari wa suoku Benjamin ale a kum, ate Benjamin mɛ a gbaari wa ale a kum. 15Wa jam gbaari wa suataŋa meena kama ale a kum. Ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ wa suataŋa yaa biisi ale wa.
16Faaro ale jam wom ayen Josefi suataŋa a jam la, Faaro ale wa kpaŋŋa meena sue yaa jam peenti. 17Faaro yaa weeni Josefi ayen, <<Weeni fi suataŋa ayen, <Ni nye nna. Ni pai ni jimmu a vi ni duŋsaŋa zuk a ŋman cheŋ Keenan tɛŋka, 18ga ta ni kowa ale ni dɔkdemma a jam mi jigi, m le pai Ejipiti tɛŋ maŋ a te ni, ate nama ale de tɛŋka masim.>
19<<Fi abe magsi fi ŋman weeni ba kama ayen, <Ba nye nna, ni pai torokoba a ta nyini Ejipiti ate ni pai a pai ba bisaŋa ale ni pooma ale ni kowa ate ba jam. 20Ni kan te ni niŋ a bo ni ŋantaŋa po, dii nyiŋla Ejipiti ŋanmaŋsaŋa meena ale chim ka nama ŋanta.>>>
21Ate Izirali nidoabilisaŋa a sum a nye dila. Josefi a jam te ba torokoba kama ase Faaro ale weeni wa ayen wa nye diila, a ŋman te ba ŋanta a magsi ba suiku chelimu. 22Wa jam te waai meena ka garuk paaluk alege wa jam te Benjamin ka kpana kobsita ale gatta joka a paari bunu. 23Wa ale jam te wa kowa ŋan baai la ale nna. Wa jam te ka bonsa pi ate si ji Ejipiti ŋan maŋsa ale bon saari pi ate si ji ŋanbie ale boroborok ale ŋanta gela a magsi suiku chelimu. 24Ate wa yaa basi wa suataŋa suik, ba ale a cheŋ la, wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni kan kpaliŋ chaab suiku po.>>
25Ate ba yaa cheŋ nyini Ejipiti po a ga paari ba kowa Jekob Keenan tɛŋka po.
26Ba jam weeni wa kama ayen, <<Josefi a diem vua kama. Wensie nyiŋ wa ka kpagi Ejipiti meena zuk.>> Jekob yaa jam cha vuusum. Wa jam ka siaka ale ba ale weeni wa diila. 27Alege ba ale jam a weeni dii meena ate Josefi a weeni ba la, ate wa ŋman nya torokoma ate Josefi a te ayen ba pai a pai wa a ta jam la, ba kowa vuusumu a yaa ŋman pilim a jam wa jigi. 28Ate Izirali yaa weeni ayen, <<Mi sum a siak kama ayen, m nidoabinni Josefi a diem vua kama, m le cheŋ a ga nya wa abe m ge a kpi.>>

Title: PIILIMKA 46
Content:
1Dila nyiŋ Izirali yaa jam nyini ayen wa cheŋ ale wa ŋantaŋa meena, ate wa ale jam ga paari Beerseba la, wa yaa jam nye kaabka a te wa kowa Aizik Wenni. 2Ate Wen yaa biisi ale Jekob gɔdaasima po yok a weeni ayen, <<Jekob, Jekob.>> Ate wa tulisi ayen, <<Mi ale nna.>>
3Wen yaa weeni ayen, <<Mi ka Wen, ni kowa Wenni. Kan chali yɔgsum ale Ejipiti cheŋka, diila m le basi ate fi chim tɛŋ kpieŋ dula. 4M le cheŋ Ejipiti ale fu, abe m sum ta fu a pilim ŋmani. Ate Josefi dek ale yik fu ate fi kpi.
5Jekob yaa basi Beerseba, ate Izirali nidoabilisaŋa a pai ba kowa Jekob ale ba bisaŋa ale ba pooma a nyo torokoma po ate Faaro a tom ayen ba pai a pai ba la. 6Ba jam maa pai ba duŋsaŋa ale ba ŋantaŋa meena ate ba jam nya Keenan la kama, ate Jekob ale wa buuni meena a jam cheŋ Ejipiti. 7Wa jam ta ka wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa liema ale wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale wa buuni meena a cheŋ Ejipiti.
8Izirali nidoabilisaŋa ale jam cheŋ Ejipiti la yue ale nna wa ale wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale jam cheŋ. Aruben wa bikpagni. 9Aruben nidoabilisaŋa ale nna: Yanok ale Pallu ale Ayeziron ale Karmi. 10Simeyon nidoabilisaŋa ale nna: Jemuel ale Jamin ale Oyad ale Jakin ale Zoyar ale Sɛyaul ale ka Keenan nipok biik la. 11Livai nidoabilisaŋa ale nna: Gerson ale Koyat ale Merari. 12Juda nidoabilisaŋa ale nna: Ɛri ale Onan ale Sɛla ale Perezi ale Zera alege Ɛri ale Onan a jam kpi ka Keenan tɛŋka po. Perezi nidoabilisaŋa ale nna: Ayeziron ale Yamul. 13Isaka nidoabilisaŋa ale nna: Tola ale Pua ale Jasub ale Simron. 14Zebulun nidoabilisaŋa ale nna: Sered ale Elon ale Jaleel. 15Nidoabili sii ate Leya a jam biak a te Jekob Paddan Araam po la ale la. Wa liewa Daina an maa gum du. Wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa liema meena a jam ka pisita ale bata.
16Gad nidoabilisaŋa ale nna: Zefon ale Aggi ale Suni ale Ezbon ale Eri ale Arodi ale Areli. 17Asɛ nidoabilisaŋa ale nna. Imnaya ale Isva ale Isvi ale Beriya. Ba toawa a jam le Seraya. Beriya nidoabilisaŋa ale nna: Ɛba ale Malkiel.
18Zilpa ale biak bi sii a te Jekob la ale nna, waai ate Laban a pai te wa liewa Leya la. Ba meena a jam ka pi ale bayuebi.
19Jekob powa Arekel nidoabilisaŋa ale nna: Josefi ale Benjamin. 20Ejipiti po ate Josefi ale Potifera kaabteerɔwa ate wa bo On tɛŋka la liewa Asenat a jam biak Manasa ale Ɛfraim. 21Benjamin nidoabilisaŋa ale nna: Bela ale Beker ale Asbel ale Gera ale Naaman ale Eyi ale Aros ale Muppim ale Yuppim ale Ard.
22Arekel nidoabilisaŋa ate wa biak a te Jekob la ale nna: Ba meena a jam ka pi ale banaansi. 23Dan nidoabinni ale Yusim. 24Nafitali nidoabilisaŋa ale nna: Jaziel ale Guni ale Jezer ale Sillem.
25Bilya waai ate Laban a pai te wa liewa Arekel ate wa biak nidoabili sii a te Jekob la ale nna. Ba meena a jam ka bayopɔi.
26Baai meena ale cheŋ Ejipiti ale Jekob ate ba chim wadek ŋaaŋsa la ale nna, ba jam ka nuruba pisiyuebi ale bayuebi. Ba an jam maa chiini wa sampooma nidoabilisaŋa a gum du. 27A jam pai nidoabilisaŋa bayewa ate ba biak a te Josefi Ejipiti tɛŋka po la, Jekob dɔkdemma baai ale jam cheŋ Ejipiti la meena a jam ka pisiyopɔi.
28Jekob a jam de ka niŋ a tom Juda ayen wade wa niŋ a cheŋ Josefi jigi ate wa sak Gosen ale bo juijui la. Ba ale ga paari Gosen tɛŋka la, 29Josefi a jam poom gomsi wa wusuma torokoma a yaa cheŋ Gosen a ga tu wa kowa Izirali. Josefi ale ga na nyini wa niŋ la, wa yaa pai wa nisa a vi wa kowa zuk ale kum ate ku beni nna yegayega.
30Izirali yaa weeni Josefi ayen, <<Yɔgyɔgla de mi yaa gomsi a magsi m kpi kama, mi ale toalim a nya fu ayen fi diem vua la.>>
31Josefi yaa weeni wa suataŋa ale wa kowa yenni demma ayen, <<M le cheŋ jueli ga weeni Faaro ayen, <M suataŋa ale m kowa yenni demma baai ale jam bo Keenan tɛŋka po la, a jam ka m jigi. 32Nuruma abe ka naapeerisa ba be jam ale ka ba ale wuug ŋan baai la. Ba ta ba piisaŋa ale ba niiŋa ale ŋan baai meena ate ba soa la a jam kama. 33Faaro a dan wi ni a ta ni jo a bek ni ayen, <Ni a tom ka boan tuima?> 34Ni tulisi wa ayen, <Fi tomteerɔma a nya ka duŋsa zuk a nyini diipo ate ti chim nidoabilisa la, ase ti kowa ale jam a nye diila.> Ate wa ale siak ate ni kali Gosen tɛŋka po. Diila naapeerisa meena a chim ka kisuk a te Ejipiti demma.

Title: PIILIMKA 47
Content:
1Josefi yaa cheŋ a ga weeni sak Faaro ayen, <<M kowa ale m suataŋa a jam ale ka ba piisaŋa ale ba duŋsaŋa ale jaab meena ate ba soa la, ba abe nyini ka Keenan tɛŋka po, ba abe bo ka Gosen tɛŋka po yɔgyɔgla de.>> 2Wa jam lueri ka wa suataŋa banu a ta ba a ga sak Faaro.
3Faaro yaa bek wa suataŋa ayen, <<Nama a tom ka boan tuima?>> Ba yaa tulisi Faaro ayen, <<Fi tomteerɔma ka naapeerisa ase ti koma ale jam ka diila.>> 4Ba ŋman jam weeni wa ayen, <<Ti jam ayen ti kali dela ka nna maga, dii nyiŋla kɔmmu a pagra kama Keenan ate fi tomteerɔma duŋsaŋa a kan nya wuuk a ŋɔbi. Dila nyiŋ ti a saalim fu ayen fi basi ate ti kali Gosen tɛŋka po.>>
5Faaro yaa weeni Josefi ayen, <<Fi kowa ale fi suataŋa a jam ka fi jigi, 6Ejipiti tɛŋka abe dua ka fi niŋ. Basi ate fi kowa ale fi suataŋa a kali tɛŋka juijui ale nala la. Basi ate ba bo Gosen. Fi abe dan seba ayen ba waai a seba wari nyeka, te ate wa a nya mi dek duŋsaŋa zuk.
7Ate Josefi yaa ta wa kowa Jekob a ga sak Faaro. Ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ Jekob yaa niak Faaro, 8Faaro yaa bek wa ayen, <<Fi ta ka bena ŋa dina?>>
9Ate Jekob yaa weeni Faaro ayen, <<M nyeerimu po benaŋa ka bena kook ale pisita. M benaŋa ka nna maga dega ale tua, ŋa le m koma nyeerimu benaŋa abe daa bunyi.>> 10Ate Jekob yaa niak Faaro ale cheŋ alege wa.
11Dila Josefi yaa jam te wa kowa ale wa suataŋa a kali ale pai tɛŋka nitalim maŋka a te ba, Arameses kabini ase Faaro ale poom a dak diila. 12Josefi a jam te wa kowa ale wa suataŋa ale wa kowa yenni demma meena ka ŋandiinta a ta va chaab ale ba bisaŋa ale piisi a soa diila.
13Ŋandiinta a jam ka, tɛŋka meena po dii nyiŋla kɔmmu a jam pagra kama. Dila yaa basi ate Keenan ale Ejipiti demma a wobsa kɔmmu nyiŋ. 14Josefi a jam tuesi ligraŋa meena ate ba jam nya Ejipiti ale Keenan po la ate ba pai a tuni ŋandiinta ate ba jam a da la, a yaa ta jam Faaro yenni po. 15Ejipiti ale Keenan demma ligraŋa ale ga nueri la, Ejipiti demma meena a jam ka Josefi jigi a weeni wa ayen, <<Te ti ŋandiinta. Boan nyiŋ ate tama a baga a kpi fi nimbie po? Ti ligraŋa a nueri kama. >>
16Josefi yaa weeni ayen, <<Ni abe ta ni duŋsaŋa a jam, m le pai ŋandiinta a te ni abe m tuesi ni duŋsaŋa, ni ligraŋa ale nueri la nyiŋ.>> 17Dila ba yaa ta ba duŋsaŋa a jam te Josefi, ate wa te ba ŋandiinta ale tuesi ba wusumaŋa ale ba piisaŋa ale ba booŋa ale ba niiŋa ale ba bonsaŋa. Ate wa te ba ŋandiinta ben dila meena po, ba ale pai ba duŋsaŋa a te a magsi chaab ale ŋandiinta nyiŋla.
18Ben dila ale ga nueri la, ba ŋman jam wa jigi kama ben dii ale pai a saŋ la a weeni wa ayen, <<Ti kan pai wensieŋa a suk ti nyɔnɔwa diila ti ligraŋa a nueri, ate fi yaa soa ti duŋsaŋa la, jabuui nyiini ale tali a boro la ale ti nyiŋsaŋa ale ti tɛŋka.>> 19Ka boan nyiŋ ate tama ale ti tɛŋka a kpi fi niŋŋa? Da ti ale ti tɛŋka abe fi te ti ŋandiinta, ate tama ale ti tɛŋka ale bo Faaro nisima po. Te ti ŋandiinta ate ti vuugi alege ti kan kpi, ate tɛŋka a kan doa jassi.
20Ate Josefi yaa da tɛŋka meena a te Faaro. Ejipiti demma ba wanyi wanyi meena, a pai ba laŋsaŋa a jam da kama, diila kɔmmu a jam pagra kama a te ba. Faaro ale jam soa tɛŋka, 21ate Josefi yaa jam nye ate nuruma a chim yɔm Ejipiti tɛŋka banaŋa meena. 22Alege wa an jam maa da kaabteerɔma tɛŋsaŋa, diila ba jam nya ba charuku a nyini ka Faaro jigi, ate ba jam ta ŋandiinta a magsi chaab ale ba charuku ate Faaro a jam te ba la. Dila ale soa ate ba an pai ba tɛŋka a da ya.
23Josefi yaa weeni nuruma ayen, <<Yɔgyɔgla de ate m da ni ale ni tɛŋka jinla a te Faaro la, ŋanbie ale nna ni baga a bori ŋa tɛŋka zuk kama. 24Alege ni dan che ni ŋankpaantaŋa a ta jo dɔk, ni lab puula bunu a pai bunyi a te Faaro, abe ni pai puula bunaansiwa ase ŋanbuura la a bori ni laŋsaŋa po ale nidek ale ni yenni demma ale ni bisaŋa dɛka.>>
25Ba yaa weeni ayen, <<Fi vari ti nyuvoa a basi. Ti abe nya ŋmanteka a nyini ti nyɔnɔwa jigi. Ti ale bo Faaro nisa po.>> 26Ate Josefi yaa jam nye ate ku chim wari a bo Ejipiti tɛŋka zuk a jam paari jinla de ayen ba ŋankpaantaŋa ate ba a che la, ba lab puula bunu ate puuni dinyi a chim Faaro jaab. Ka kaabteerɔma tɛŋsaŋa nyiini ate Faaro an maa soa.
27Yɔgyɔgla de Izirali demma a jam kali ka Gosen tɛŋka zuk. Ba jam nya ka paaruŋ dula ale jam biak bisa a piisi nna yegayega.
28Jekob a jam bo Ejipiti a paari ka bena pi ale ŋayopɔi, ate wa bena ŋaai ate wa pai bo tɛŋzuk de la, a jam ka bena kook ale pisinaansi ale ŋayopɔi. 29Ku ale jam moata diipo ayen Izirali a kpi la, wa yaa wi wa biika Josefi a weeni wa ayen, <<Ase m dan nya ŋmanteka a nyini fi jigi, pai fi nisa a tabri m kɔsukku tɛŋ abe fi puulim ayen fi ale sak nyemagsika ale wensie ale mu. Kan gu mu Ejipiti tɛŋka po, 30alege m dan vuusi ale m koma, ji mu a ta nyini Ejipiti tɛŋka po a ta a ga gu juijui ate ba gu ba la.>> Wa weeni ayen, <<M le nye fi ale weeni diila.>>
31Wa weeni wa ayen, <<Wa nye pɛka ale wa.>> Ate Josefi a nye pɛka ale wa, ate Izirali ale doa wa gaduokku zuk la, wa yaa puusi Wen.

Title: PIILIMKA 48
Content:
1Ku ale ga nye magadek la ba yaa weeni Josefi ayen, <<Fi kowa a yuak kama.>> Ate wa yaa pai wa nidoabilisaŋa bayewa Manasa ale Ɛfraim ate ba cheŋ ale wa. 2Ba ale weeni Jekob ayen, <<Fi biika Josefi a jam ka fi jigi la,>> Izirali yaa yik wadek a nya nyiŋ pagra a yiti kali wa gaduokku zuk.
3Jekob yaa weeni Josefi ayen, <<Wen Dii Ale A Niak La a jan jam mi jigi Luz ale bo Keenan tɛŋka po la, ate dula wa jam a niak mi 4ale weeni mi ayen, <M le te ate fi biak bisa abe m nye ate ni piisi. M le nye ate ni chim tɛŋ dem, ate m le pai tɛŋka de a te ase taam wuu nitalim la ate nama ŋaaŋnyiŋ ni ŋaaŋbisa a jam soa.>
5<<Yɔgyɔgla de fi nidoabilisaŋa bayewa ate fi biak Ejipiti po alege ate mi a jam la, Ɛfraim ale Manasa ka mi ale soa ba, ase m le soa Aruben ale Simeyon diila. 6Bi sii meena ate fi a biak ba ŋaaŋ nyiŋla, ka fi ale soa ba. Tɛŋ sii ate ba za ba soa la ale nyini ka ba suataŋa Ɛfraim ale Manasa jigi. 7Ase m le ŋmani nyini Paddan a cheŋ la, Arekel a jam kpi kama Keenan tɛŋka po ate ku jam chim niniga wari a te mu suiku po. Juijui ate wa kpi la an jam yalima ale Efrat. Ate m gu wa suiku ale a cheŋ Efrat la nakpiak>> Betiliyem ale la.
8Ase Izirali ale ga nya Josefi nidoabilisaŋa la, wa yaa bek ayen, <<Bade ka bana?>>
9Josefi yaa weeni wa kowa ayen, <<Ba ka nidoabilisa ate Wen a pai ba a te mu dela.>> Ate Izirali yaa weeni ayen, <<Ta ba jam te mu ate m niak ba.>>
10Yɔgyɔgla de Izirali an ŋman jam nya a paari, dii nyiŋla wa jam kpaŋ kama ate nyaasim a tua a te wa. Dila nyiŋ Josefi yaa ta wa nidoabilisaŋa a cheŋ paari wa, ate wa kowa a gbaari ba.
11Izirali yaa weeni Josefi ayen, <<Mi kan yiili ayen m le nya fi nimbidiaka ŋmana, alege Wen a basi kama ate m poom nya fi bisa.>>
12Ate Josefi yaa pai ba nyini Izirali dunaŋa zuk ale pai wa zuk a su tɛŋ. 13Ate Josefi a pai ba nɔi bayewa ate Ɛfraim a bo wa juga a tuaga Izirali gala nisa geŋ, ale ta Manasa wa gala a tuaga Izirali juga nisa geŋ a ta ba a ga moata wa. 14Alege Izirali yaa yik wa nisaŋa a bari ate wa juga nisaŋa a ga vi Ɛfraim zukku zuk waai ale ka baaŋ la. Alege te wa gala nisaŋa a ga vi Manasa zukku zuk waai ate wade niŋ a biak la.
15Ate wa niak Josefi ale weeni ayen, <<Wen dii ate m koma Abrayam ale Aizik a cheŋ wa niŋ la, Wen dii ale chim m naapeerik m boka po meena la, 16Wen maarɔwa waai ale yeeri mi a nyini daanika po meena la, abe niak nidoabilisaŋa de. Ba abe te ate m yuenni ale m koma Abrayam ale Aizik yueŋa a kan bɛ, ba abe piisi nna yegayega tɛŋka de zuk.>>
17Ase Josefi ale ga nya ayen wa kowa a pai wa nisa a vi Ɛfraim zukku zuk la, wa sui an jam peenti ya. Ate wa pai wa kowa nisaŋa a nyini Ɛfraim zukku zuk a ta ga vi Manasa zukku zuk. 18Josefi yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Aaya, m koa wade ale bikpagni. Pai fi juga nisaŋa a vi wala zuk.>>
19Alege wa kowa a jam zɛri kama ale weeni ayen, <<M seba kama, m biiga, m seba kama. Wa mɛ ale chim nuruba, wa mɛ le chim tɛŋ kpieŋ. Alege wa yoawa ale chim nuru kpioŋ a gaam wa, ate wa ŋaaŋ bisaŋa ale chim tɛŋ kpieŋsa.>> 20Wa yaa niak ba da dila danni ale weeni ayen, <<Fi yuenni nyiŋ ate Izirali ale mooli niauŋku de. <Wen abe nye fu ase Ɛfraim ale Manasa la.> >> Dila wa yaa te Ɛfraim a de Manasa niŋ.
21Ate Izirali yaa weeni Josefi ayen, <<M tuaka kum, alege Wen ale bo ale fu a ŋman ta fu a cheŋ fi koma tɛŋka. 22Ate fi waai ale ŋman gaam fi suataŋa la, m pai tɛŋ kaai ale ka guuk ate m pai m gebik woŋka ale m tommu a vari nyini Amori demma jigi la a te fu.>>

Title: PIILIMKA 49
Content:
1Ate Jekob a wi wa nidoabilisaŋa a weeni ba ayen, <<Ni tigsi jam jigi yeŋ ate m weeni ni dii ale za di nye da ŋaai ale cheen la. 2<<Jekob nidoabilisaŋa, ni tigsi a wom. Ni wom ni kowa Izirali.
3<<Aruben fi ale m bi kpagi, m zuaka, waai ale dɛ niŋ a sak m pagrimu, fi ale m zula ale m pagrim. 4Fi a nye ase ka nyiam la, fi an za jigi yeŋŋa, fi a kan ŋman baga wari a nye cheŋ niŋŋa, diila fi goa ale ka m pok a taŋ m gaduokku.
5Simeyon ale Livai ka suata, ba gebisaŋa ka wɔkwɔk kpaliŋ kɔlima. 6Kan te m ta m dek a ga gum ba po, diila ba ko ka nuruba ale suipuurum ale a baliŋ lalisa a pai a nye dii ale a yɔk ba sue la. 7Kikaasa abe va ba, ba suipuurumu ale ba gaasaŋa nyiŋ, diila ku bie ka nna yegayega. M le kati ba ŋaaŋbisaŋa a waaŋ Izirali tɛŋka meena, abe m kati ba a waaŋ ba le bo juijui meena ate Izirali buuni a bo la.
8Juda, fi suataŋa ale pak fu. Fi nisa ale yik fi dachaasaŋa ŋie. Fi kowa bisaŋa ale koori tɛŋ fi niŋ. 9Juda, fi a nye ase ka gbeŋli la, fi a nyini peelim kama a ŋman jam a jo fi goomu jigini, m dek biiga. Ase gbeŋli la, fi nyiem tienti fidek kama a duagi, ase gbeŋ sari la, ka wana ale wa baga a daani wa? 10Juda ale kasim yik naam dachekka a tara. Ate wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale kasim a dɛ naam. Tɛŋsa ale jam a puusi wa. Abe ba koori tɛŋ wa niŋ. 11Wa le bobi wa bonika tiimu nyiŋ. Wa le a yaali tiib naŋ kaai la ate wa le bobi wa bonpaalika. Wa ale pai daam a chim nyiam a sugri wa kɔlima, wa garuk woŋtaŋa ale bo da buui ale muni ase ziim la po. 12Wa ninaŋa ale sobri a gaam daam, ate wa nyinaŋa ale peenti a gaam biisim.
13<<Zebulun ale kali nyakpiemu nɔi la, wa jigini ale chim ŋaaruŋta zaani ka jigi. Wa banaŋa ale teeri cheŋ paari Saidon.
14Isaka a nye ase ka boniŋ pagrik ale dua piisa ŋaye suŋsuŋ po ale ka jibta la. 15Wa ale nya ayen vuusumu jigini a nala la, ate tɛŋka mɛ nalimu ale ka diila, wa yaa siak a te jibta ale siak a te fifiok tuima.
16<<Dan ale ta wensie boteka a te wa nuruma, ase Izirali buuni po wanyi la. 17Dan ale chim ka waab a bo suiku nɔi ate waapiik a bo suiku po, ate ŋa ale dom wusumaŋa naŋkpaaŋa, ate baai ale do ŋa la a lɔ ŋaaŋnyiŋ. 18<<Naawen yaa, m zak zuk a nya ka fi varibasika.
19<<Zueba ale vi Gad, alege wa ale viriŋ a vi ba.
20<<Asɛ ŋandiinta ale chim ŋandiin maŋsa. Wa ale nye ŋandiinta a magsi naab dɛka.
21<<Nafitali a nye ase ka kab ate ba foli bu a basi, ate bu a biak bi naliŋsa la.
22<<Josefi a nye ase ka tiib buui ale ta yɔna la, tiib buui ale a yɔni a moata beli naŋ la, ate bu naŋsaŋa teeri a jueli parik zuk la. 23Wa dachaasaŋa a kisi wa kama nna tuatuaga. Ba a tɔŋ wa peema. 24Alege wa tommu a kan yeeri. Wa nisaŋa a ta pagrim ale valima. Waai Ale Ka Jekob Pagrim Nyɔnɔwa La ale Naapeerika waai ale ka Izirali Piuŋku la nyiŋ, 25fi kowa Wen dii ale a maari fu la nyiŋ ale Wen Dii Ale A Niak La, waai ale a niak fu la nyiŋ ale wenŋmazukku niauŋku ale niauŋ kuui ale bo tɛŋka liuŋku po la, abe wa niak fi bisaŋa ale fi biamu luikku. 26Fi kowa niauŋku a gaam dipodipo guutaŋa ale gu kpagsaŋa meena kama. Te ate ŋade meena a jam Josefi zuk waai ale ka nabiik a bo wa suataŋa po la.
27<<Benjamin a nye ase ka piuk la. Saluik wa nyiem yik ka wa dachaasaŋa a nɛ, ate junɔi wa lab ŋan baai ale tali la.>>
28Izirali buuni pi ale ŋayewa meena ale nna, ale ba kowa ale weeni dii a niak ba la ale nna, wa te waai meena ka niauŋ kuui ale magsi la.
29Ate wa weeni ba wanni de ayen, <<M za m ga gum ka m nuruma po. Ni abe gu mu ale m koma vɔrup buui ale bo Efron Yit denɔwa talimu po la, 30vɔrup buui ale bo Makpela laŋka po, a moata Mamre a bo Keenan tɛŋka po la, ate Abrayam a jam da a magsi chaab ale nuruba guka, a nyini Efron ale ka Yit denɔ jigi la, wa jam da talimu mɛ a gum du kama. 31Dula ate ba gu Abrayam ale wa powa Saara, dula mɛ ate ba gu Aizik ale wa powa Aribeka, dula ate m gu Leya. 32Ba jam da talimu ale vɔrumu a nyini ka Yit denɔwa jigi.>>
33Ase Jekob ale pai sinsaŋŋa a te wa bisaŋa a nueri la, wa yaa vuuri wa naŋsaŋa a vi wa gaduokku zuk a yaa vuusi a kpeglim ale gum wa nuruma po.

Title: PIILIMKA 50
Content:
1Josefi yaa lɔ wa kowa zuk ale kum wa nyiŋ ale gbaari wa. 2Josefi yaa weeni tiim nyama ayen ba pai tiim a nye wa kowa Izirali nyiŋka ate ka kan poagi. Dila tiim nyama a yaa pai tiim a nye wa nyiŋka, 3ba jam pai ka da puma pisinaansi a gomsi wa nyiŋka ayen ka kan poagi. Ate Ejipiti demma a pai daa pisiyopɔi a kum wa.
4Kumsaŋa daaŋa ale taam la, Josefi yaa weeni Faaro nisɔmma ayen, <<Ase m dan sum nya ka ŋmanteka a nyini ni jigi, ni abe weeni Faaro a te mu, ni weeni wa ayen, 5<M kowa a jam nye kama ate m pɛ ale wa ayen, <<M moata ka kum. Be gu mu vɔrup buui ate m tu Keenan tɛŋka po a magsi ayen ba gu mu la.>> Yɔgyɔgla de te mu suik ate m cheŋ a ga gu m kowa abe ŋman pilim jam.>> >
6Faaro yaa weeni ayen, <<Cheŋ a ga gu fi kowa wa ale nye ate fi pɛ la nyiŋ.>>
7Ate Josefi yaa jam cheŋ ayen wa gu wa kowa. Faaro kpaŋŋa ale wa nisɔmma ale Ejipiti kpaŋŋa meena 8ale Josefi yenni dem ale wa suataŋa ale wa kowa yenni dem. Ka ba bisaŋa ale ba duŋsaŋa ale ba naapeerisaŋa nyiini ale jam tali a bo Gosen. 9Wusuma ale ŋa torokoba ale wusum duerɔba ale jam cheŋ ale wa. Ba jam piisi ka nna yegayega.
10Ase ba le ga paari juijui ate ba a fɔbi ba ŋankpaantaŋa Atad po, a moata Jodan la, ba yaa jam kum ate ku jueli nna tuatuaga. Dula jigini ate Josefi yaa jam pai daa ŋayopɔi a kum wa kowa. 11Ase Keenan dem baai ale bo dula jigini la, ale ga nya ayen ba bo Atad juijui ate ba a fɔb ŋanta a kum la, ba yaa weeni ayen, <<Ninmuna kumsa ale nna ate Ejipiti demma a tara.>> Dila ale soa ate ba a wi jigi dila ale moata Jodan la ayen, Abel Mizraim la.
12Ate Jekob bisaŋa a jam sum nye dii dek ate wa weeni ba la. 13Ba jam ji wa kama a ta cheŋ Keenan tɛŋka a ga gu wa vɔrup po ale bo Makpela talimu po la, a moata Mamre, ate Abrayam jam da bu ale talimu a magsi nuruba guka a nyini Efron Yit denɔwa jigi la, wa jam maa da talimu a gum du kama. 14Wa ale ga gu wa kowa a nueri la, Josefi yaa jam ŋman pilim cheŋ Ejipiti ale wa suataŋa ale baai meena ale jam va wa a cheŋ ayen wa gu wa kowa la.
15Josefi suataŋa ale ga nya ayen ba kowa a kpi kama la, ba yaa weeni ayen, <<Josefi abe nin jam ta chaab ale ti ayen wa tuni ti a magsi chaab ale kaasuŋ kuui meena ate tama a pai nye wa la ti le nye ka sɛ?>> 16Dila ba yaa tom a weeni Josefi ayen, <<Alege ate fi kowa a kpi la, wa jam weeni ka wanni de ayen. 17<Kude ale dii ate nama ale weeni Josefi, mi a yaali kama ayen fi vɔŋ fi suataŋa wabaataŋa ate ba nye kaasi fu la a te ba.> Yɔgyɔgla de ti a saalim fu ayen fi vɔŋ fi kowa Wenni tomteerɔma wabaataŋa a te ba.>> Ase ba tontomiŋka ale ga paari Josefi la, Josefi yaa jam kum.
18Wa suataŋa yaa jam lo wa niŋ a weeni ayen, <<Tama ka fi yɔm.>>
19Alege Josefi a jam weeni ba kama ayen, <<Ni kan chali yɔgsummoa. Mi ka Wen ya? 20Nama poli ayen ni nye mi ka biem, alege Wen a basi ate ku chim nalim ayen dii meena ale nye la, ku jam vari nuruba nyuvoa a basi. 21Dila, ni be kan yɔgsa. M ale pai jaab meena ate nama ale ni bisaŋa a yaali la a te ni.>> Ale biisi bi masik a te ba ale ŋman te ate ba miŋ ayen wa ale weeni diila, wa ale sum a nye a te ba.
22Josefi a jam kali Ejipiti ale wa kowa dɔkdemma meena kama. Wa jam boro paari ka bena kook ale pi 23a nya Ɛfraim bisa gaŋsa buta. Wa jam maa nya Makir ale ka Manasa biik la bisa biam kama, ate ba pai ba a vi wa naŋsa zuk.
24Ate Josefi yaa weeni wa suataŋa ayen, <<M moata ka kum. Alege Wen dek ale maari ni a ta ni a nyini tɛŋka de po, a ta ni a cheŋ tɛŋ kaai dek ate wa puulim a pɛ ale Abrayam ale Aizik ale Jekob la.>> 25Ate Josefi a jam basi ate Izirali nidoabinni a nye pɛka ayen, <<Wen dek ale jam maa maari ni, ate ni ji m kobaŋa a ta nyini dela.>>
26Josefi yaa jam ta ka bena kook ale pi ale kpi. Ate ba ale jam pai tiim a nye wa nyiŋka ayen ka kan poagi la, ba yaa jam pai wa a nyo dakari po Ejipiti tɛŋka po.

Title: NYINIKA 1
Content:
1Izirali nidoabilisaŋa ale jam cheŋ Ejipiti ale Jekob la ale nna. Ba wanyi meena ale wa dɔkdem. 2Aruben ale Simeyon ale Livai ale Juda, 3ale Isaka ale Zebulun ale Benjamin, 4ale Dan ale Nafitali ale Gad ale Asɛ. 5Jekob ŋaaŋsaŋa meena jam ka pisiyopɔi. Josefi poom jam bo ka Ejipiti.
6Yɔgyɔgla de Josefi ale wa suataŋa meena ale gaŋ kala meena a jam kpi kama, 7alege Izirali demma jam kasim a biak kama ale a piisi nna yegayega, a sueri tɛŋka meena.
8Naab paalik waai ale kan jam seba Josefi la ale jam dɛ naamu Ejipiti tɛŋka po. 9Naawa yaa weeni wa nuruma ayen, <<Nya Izirali demma yaa piisi ka nna yegayega a gaam ti. 10Ni jam ate ti nye ale ba dan kan daa di ba le ŋmasi piisi a gaam dila, ate kpaliŋ a dan yiti abe ba gum ti dachaasaŋa po a nye kpaliŋ ale ti abe ba basi tɛŋka.>>
11Dila la, ba yaa yaali yɔm kpaga ate ba a nya ba zuk ale a namsi ba ale fifiok tuima, ate ba sɛ Pitom ale Arameses ase geruŋ diina tɛŋsa la a te Faaro. 12Alege ba le jam namsi ba dii yegayega la, ba jaa piisi ka dila a waaŋ tɛŋka po. Ejipiti demma yaa jam basi ate yɔgsum a yik ba alege 13ate ba a tom a kan sak jiirim ale ba. 14Ba jam basi kama ate ba boka a tua ale tuim pagra ase peela nakka ale tanta damka ale tuima tɔgatɔga laŋsaŋa po. Ba tuim pagra meena po Ejipiti demma a basi kama ate ba a tom a kan sak jiirimmoa.
15Ejipiti naawa yaa weeni Yiburu nipok baai ate ba a wi ba ayen Sifra ale Pua ate ba yik ate nipooba a biak la, ayen. 16<<Ni dan boro a yik Yiburu nipooba ayen ba a biak ate ni nya ale ka nidoabili, ni ko wa alege dan ka nipokbili ni basi wa.>> 17Nipok baai ale yik ate nipooba a biak la a yaa chali Wen yɔgsum an nye Ejipiti naawa ale weeni ayen ba nye diila. Ba basi kama ate nidoabilisaŋa a boro. 18Ate Ejipiti naawa yaa wi nipooma a bek ba ayen, <<Ka boa ale soa ate nama nye nna? Ka boa ale soa ate nama a basi ate nidoabilisaŋa a boro?
19Nipok baai ale yik ate nipooba a biak la yaa tulisi Faaro ayen, <<Yiburu nipooma a kan nye ase Ejipiti nipooma la, ba ta pagrim kama a nyiem biak alege ate tama a paari.>>
20Dila la Wen jam ta jiirim ale nipok baai ale yik ate nipooba a biak la kama ate nuruma a piisi nna yegayega a gum du. 21Nipooma abe le a chali Wen yɔgsum la, wa yaa te ba dɔkdem.
22Faaro yaa te wanni de wa nuruma meena ayen, <<Nidoabili meena ate ba a biak la, ku a fɛ ate ni yuk wa a basi Nile benni po, alege nipokbili meena ni basi ate wa boro.>>

Title: NYINIKA 2
Content:
1Yɔgyɔgla de nuru ale nyini Livai yenni a faari Livai denɔ lie, 2ate wa yik puuk a biak nidoabili. Wa le nya ale wa ka biik naliŋ la, wa yaa pai wa suk chiisa sita. 3Alege wa le nya ale wa an ŋman baga a suk wa la, wa yaa yaali busik a magsi wa a pai kotaali a lik. Wa yaa pai biika a dueni du a pai su wuuk tii ale woŋŋa po Nile benni nɔi. 4Wa tuawa yaa zaani niŋ ayen wa nya dii ale di nye wa la.
5Faaro liewa yaa cheŋ Nile benni ayen wa so, ate baai ale tom a te wa la a nyiem a cheŋ benni nɔi. Wa yaa nya busika wuuk woŋtaŋa po a yaa tom wa nipokbili yɔmma wanyi ayen wa ga pai. 6Wa yaa lak a nya biika du. Wa jaa kaari kama, ate ku daani wa. Wa yaa weeni ayen, <<Yiburu bisaŋa wanyi ale nna>>.
7Wa tuawa yaa bek Faaro liewa ayen, <<M ga yaali Yiburu nipooma wanyi ate wa a nya biika zuk a te fu?>>
8Wa yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ŋuu cheŋ.>> Ate nipokbinni yaa ga yaali biika mawa ate wa jam. 9Faaro liewa yaa weeni ayen, <<Pai biika de a wuuk a te mu, ate m tuni fu>>. Nipowa yaa tuesi biika a wuuk wa. 10Biika ale pak la, wa yaa ta wa cheŋ Faaro liewa jigi ate wa chim wa biik. Wa yaa te wa yuei ayen Moosis, ku kiri ale, <<M yeeri wa ka nyiam po.>>
11Moosis yaa le chim pak la, dai yeŋ wa yaa cheŋ wadek nuruma ale bo juijui la a nya ba le a tom ba tuim pagra la. Wa nya ale ka Ejipiti denɔ ale boro a nak Yiburu denɔ, wadek nuruma po wanyi. 12Wa yaa gisi dɛ gisi dɛ wa an nya waai ya a yaa ko Ejipiti denɔwa a pa gu tintain busuŋku po. 13Vari ale veenti la wa yaa ŋman cheŋ ga nya ale ka Yiburu dem baye ale ta chaab. Wa yaa bek waai ale nye kaasi la, ayen, <<Ka boa ale soa ate fi a nak fi Yiburu denɔ choawa?>>
14Nuruwa yaa weeni ayen, <<Ka wana ale nye fi kpagi ale boteerɔ tama zuwa? Fi a poli ayen fi ko mi mɛ ase ka fi deem ale ko Ejipiti denɔwa diila.>> Moosis yaa jam a chali yɔgsum a yaa poli ayen, <<Mi ale nye diila da dii dai ba seba kama.>>
15Faaro le ga wom kude la, wa yaa yaali ayen wa ko Moosis, alege Moosis a chali cheŋ ga bo Midian. Dula wa jam kali ka vili tɛŋ. 16Midian kaabteerɔ jam ta ka lieba bayopɔi. Ba yaa jam ba ŋari nyiam a sueri ŋanta a te ba kowa piisa. 17Naapeerisa yaa jam yiak ba ate ba cheŋ, alege Moosis yaa yiti vari ba a basi ale te ba piisaŋa nyiam ate ŋa nyu.
18Nipokbilisaŋa ale ŋmani ba kowa Areuel jigi la, wa yaa bek ba ayen, <<Ka boa ate ni jinla a kpabi ŋmani?>>
19Ba yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ejipiti denɔ ale vari ti naapeerisaŋa jigi a basi. Wa poom ŋari ka nyiam a te ti ale te piisaŋa nyiam mɛ>>.
20Wa yaa bek wa liema ayen, <<Wa boka bɛ? Ka boa ale soa ate nama pai wa a basi? Ni wi wa ate wa jam dɛ ŋandiinta.>>
21Moosis yaa siak bo ale nuruwa, ate wa te wa wa liewa Zippora ate wa faari. 22Zippora yaa biak nidoabili ate Moosis a te wa yuei ayen, Gersom, yaa a weeni ayen, <<Mi chim ka nichaanɔ tɛŋ chaŋ po.>>
23Da ŋala po meena Ejipiti naawa a kpi kama. Ate Izirali demma a kum ba puusa po ba yɔntini po ale kaari a yaali maarika dii nyiŋla ba yɔntini a jueli paari Wen kama. 24Wen yaa wom ba kumsaŋa a teeri wa nɔiyeŋka ale Abrayam ale Aizik ale Jekob. 25Wen yaa nya Izirali demma ate wa niŋ a bo le ba.

Title: NYINIKA 3
Content:
1Yɔgyɔgla de Moosis jam a nya ka wa ŋachobwa Midian kaabteerɔwa Jetro piisa zuk. Wa yaa ta piisaŋa a cheŋ niŋniŋ gɔnni po a ga paari Yoreb Wen guuku. 2Dula jigini Naawen maarɔwa a yaa pai wadek a sak wa bolim ŋiak ale jam a dɛ tiib fiik po. Moosis yaa nya ayen bolim a bo tiib fiika po alege bu kan dɛ tiimu. 3Moosis yaa poli ayen, <<Mi ale ga nya wa chaŋka dɛ, jabuui ale soa ate tiimu a kan dɛ la.>>
4Naawen ale nya ayen wa cheŋ wa nya la, Wen yaa wi wa tiimu po ayen, <<Moosis! Moosis! Ate Moosis yaa siak ayen, <<Nya mi ale nna.>>
5Wen yaa weeni ayen, <<Kan cheŋ a moata, yeeri fi nuesaŋa, dii nyiŋla, fi ale za juijui la, ka tuilum tɛŋ.>> 6Wa yaa weeni ayen, <<Mi ka fi kowa Wenni, Abrayam Wenni ale Aizik Wenni ale Jekob Wenni. Moosis ale wom nna la, wa yaa suk wa nimbidiaka dii nyiŋla wa jam a chali ka yɔgsum ale wa le nya Wen la.
7Naawen yaa weeni ayen, <<M sum nya m nuruma niniga Ejipiti tɛŋka po kama. M wom ba le kasim a kaari yɔmma kpaŋŋa ale a nye diila kama. M niŋ be bo ba ninammu po kama. 8Dila la m siŋ kama ayen m vari ba Ejipiti demma nisima po a basi abe m ta ba jam tɛŋ kaai ale nala ale lagri ale tɛŋ kaai ate biisim ale siita a boro la. Keenan demma, ale Yit demma, ale Amori demma, ale Perizzi demma, ale Yivi demma, ale Jebus demma boka jigi ale la. 9Yɔgyɔgla de Izirali demma kumsaŋa a paari mu kama. M be nya Ejipiti demma ale a namsi ba diila kama. 10Dila nyiŋ yɔgyɔgla de, cheŋ. Mi a tom fu ka Faaro jigi ayen fi ta m nuruma Izirali demma a nyini Ejipiti a nyini.
11Alege Moosis a weeni Wen ayen, <<Mi ka wana, a cheŋ Faaro jigi a ta Izirali demma a nyini Ejipiti a nyini?>>
12Wen yaa weeni ayen, <<M le bo ale fu. Dii ale di sak ayen mi ale a tom fu la ale nna. Fi dan ta nuruma a nyini Ejipiti tɛŋka a nyini, ni le puusi Wen guuku de zuk>>.
13Moosis yaa weeni Wen ayen, <<Ase m nin cheŋ Izirali demma jigi a weeni ba ayen, <Ni koma Wenni ale tom mi ni jigi>, ate ba bek mu ayen, Wa yuei ale boa? M weeni ba ayen boa?>>
14Wen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Mi ka Waai Ale Ka Mi la. Fi le fi weeni Izirali demma diila ale nna: <Ka M Dekka ale tom fu ni jigi.> >>
15Wen a ŋman weeni Moosis ayen, <<Weeni Izirali demma ayen, Naawen, ni koma Wenni, Abrayam Wenni ale Aizik Wenni ale Jekob Wenni ale tom mi ni jigi. Mi yuenni ale taam wuu, yuei dii ate ba ale teeri m wari a zaani gaŋ kinka a ga paari gaŋ ka choa.
16<<Cheŋ a ga tigsi Izirali niŋdeerɔma a weeni ba ayen, <Naawen, ni koma Wenni, wa waai ale ka Abrayam ale Aizik ale Jekob Wenni la pai wadek a sak mi a weeni ayen, mi nya ni kama a nya dii ate ba nye ni Ejipiti la. 17Mi be puulim kama ayen m ta ni nyini ni niniŋŋa po Ejipiti po a nyini cheŋ Keenan ale Yit ale Amori ale Perizzi ale Yivi ale Jebus demma tɛŋka ale tɛŋ kaai ate biisim ale siita a bo ka po la.>
18<<Izirali niŋdeerɔma ale wom fu. Ate fi ale niŋdeerɔma yaa cheŋ Ejipiti naawa jigi a ga weeni wa ayen, <Naawen, Yiburu demma Wenni ale tu ti. Te ti cheŋ suik da ŋata gɔnni po a nye kaabka a te Naawen ti Wenni>. 19Alege mi seba ayen Ejipiti naawa a kan te ni cheŋ se ka ni kpieŋsa a nin fɛ wa. 20Dila nyiŋ m le teeri m nisaŋa a nak Ejipiti demma ale wakinkagla ŋaai ate mi ale tom ba suŋsuŋ la. Kula ŋaaŋnyiŋ wa le te ate ni cheŋ.
21<<Mi le basi ate Ejipiti demma a lak badek a te ni ale jiirim ate ni daa basi tɛŋka abe ni kan cheŋ ale ni koruta. 22Nipok meena a bek wa le moata waai ale nipok waai ale bo wa yeri po a tuesi kpana ŋanta ale ligmɔniŋ ŋanta ale gatta ate ni pai a jo ni nidoabilisaŋa ale ni liema. Dila la ni le tuesi Ejipiti demma ŋanta ale fifiok.>>

Title: NYINIKA 4
Content:
1Moosis yaa tulisi ayen, <<Alege ba nin kan ta siaka ale mu yaase ba nin kan wom mi, ale weeni ayen, <Naawen an pai wadek a sak fu?> >>
2Naawen yaa weeni ayen, <<Ka boan ni la a bo fi nisaŋa po?>> Wa yaa tulisi wa ayen, <<Ka doari.>>
3Naawen yaa weeni ayen, <<Pai lɔnsi tɛŋ.>> Moosis yaa pai lɔnsi tɛŋ ate di chim waab, ate wa chali ale ge bu. 4Naawen yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Laari fi nisaŋa a yik bu juiku a pai.>> Moosis yaa laari a pai waamu ate bu tagri a chim doari wa nisaŋa po. 5Naawen yaa weeni ayen, <<Kude ate ba le ta siaka ayen Naawen, ba koma Wenni, wa waai ale Abrayam ale Aizik ale Jekob Wen la ale pai wadek a sak fu.>>
6Naawen yaa ŋman weeni ayen, <<Pai fi nisaŋa a su fi garukku po>> Moosis yaa pai wa nisaŋa a su wa garukku po. Wa le yeeri si la, si deri peenti nna tektek a chim gami.
7Wa ŋman weeni wa ayen, <<Yɔgyɔgla de ŋman pai su garukku po. Dila Moosis yaa pai wa nisaŋa su wa garukku po. Wa le yeeri si la si ŋman nye si denni, ase wa nyiŋka kab tintila ale ka diila.
8Naawen yaa weeni ayen, <<Ba dan kan ta siaka ale fu yaase ba popola a ka wakinkagli dii ale dɛ niŋka la jigiya, ba le ta siaka ale dii ale pa a saŋ la. 9Alege ba dan kan ta siaka ale wakinkagla ŋayewa yaase ba an wom fu, nye Nile benni nyiamu a kpiiri basi tɛŋ kosikka zuk. Nyiamu ate fi nye benni po la ale chim ziim tɛŋka zuk.>>
10Moosis yaa weeni Naawen ayen, <<M Nyɔnɔ, mi an maa baga a kpabi a biisi, a nyini ku le nyini ya, yaase diipo ate fi a biisi ale fi yɔmawa la. Mi an baga a kpabi a biisi, m giŋgeluŋku mɛ a dobra kama.>>
11Naawen yaa weeni ayen, <<Ka wana ale te nuru wa giŋgeluŋŋoa? Ka wana ale basi ate wa chim gauŋŋoa? Ka wana ale basi ate wa a nya ale basi ate wa a yi? Daa mi, Naawen ya? 12Yɔgyɔgla de cheŋ, M le maari fu ate fi biisi abe m sak fu dii ate fi le weeni la.>>
13Alege Moosis weeni ayen, <<M Nyɔnɔ, mi a saalim tom nuru yoŋ ate wa ga nye dila.>>
14Naawen sui yaa dɛ nna pɔkpɔk ale Moosis ate wa yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Alege fi suoku Aaron Livaiwa? Mi seba wa a biisi kama nalimnyiini. Wa poom deri bo ka suik a cheena ayen wa tu fu, wa sui ale peenti ase wa nin nya fu. 15Fi ale biisi a te wa abe fi a pai wie a nyo wa nɔi po, m le maari ni nɔi niyewa ate ni biisi abe m sak ni ni le ni nye diila. 16Wa le biisi a te nuruma a te fu ate ku nye ase ka fi ale a biisi la, ate ku a nye ase fi ka Wen a te wa la. 17Alege pai doani de a ta fi nisa po ate fi a tom wakinkagla ale di.>>
18Moosis yaa ŋman cheŋ Jetro wa ŋachobwa jigi a weeni wa ayen, <<Basi ate m ŋmani a cheŋ m dek nuruma jigi Ejipiti a ga nya ase ba waai a diem vua ya>>.
19Yɔgyɔgla de Naawen a poom weeni Moosis Midian tɛŋka po kama ayen, <<Ŋman cheŋ Ejipiti ale nuru baai meena ale a yaali ayen ba ko fu la a kpi kama.>> 20Moosis yaa pai wa powa ale wa nidoabilisaŋa a kali boniŋ zuk a piilim Ejipiti chelim. Wa jam pai Wen doani a ta ka wa nisa po.
21Naawen a weeni Moosis ayen, <<Fi dan ŋmani Ejipiti, nya ti fi tom Faaro niŋ wakinkagla ŋaai meena ate m te fu pagrim ayen fi tom la. Alege m le basi ate wa suinummu a pagra ate wa kan basi ate nuruma a cheŋ. 22Fi yaa weeni Faaro ayen, <Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna. Izirali ka nidoabi dii ate mi liŋ biak, 23ate mi weeni fu, <<Basi ate m nidoabinni a cheŋ, ate wa baga a ga puusi mu>> Alege fi zɛri kama an te ate wa cheŋ ya, dila nyiŋ m be le ko fi nidoabi dii ate fi liŋ biak la.> >>
24Naawen yaa tu Moosis goom jigi suiku po ate wa jam boro a yaali ayen wa ko wa. 25Alege Zippora yaa pai gebi fiik a gebi wa biika yoanni gbauŋku a pai tiri Moosis naŋsaŋa. Wa yaa weeni ayen, <<Wensie fi ka ziim nipok fiak chora a te mi>>. 26Naawen yaa basi wa. Dila po wa weeni ayen, <<Ziim nipok fiak chora, a sak ka yoari gebika.
27Naawen yaa weeni Aaron ayen, <<Cheŋ jo gɔnni po a tu Moosis.>> Wa yaa tu Moosis Wen guuku jigini a gbaari wa. 28Moosis yaa weeni Aaron dii meena ate Naawen a tom wa ayen wa weeni la, ale wakinkaglaŋa ate wa weeni wa ayen wa nye la.
29Moosis ale Aaron yaa ta Izirali niŋdeerɔma meena a jam jigi yeŋ, 30ate Aaron a weeni ba dii meena ate Naawen a weeni Moosis la. Wa jam tom wakinkaglaŋa mɛ nuruma niŋ, 31ate ba ta siaka. Ba be le wom ayen Naawen niŋ bo ale ba ale nya ba niniŋŋa la, ba yaa koori tɛŋ a puusi wa.

Title: NYINIKA 5
Content:
1Dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ Moosis ale Aaron yaa cheŋ Faaro jigi a weeni wa ayen, <<Naawen, waai ale ka Izirali Wen la a weeni kama ayen, <Basi ate m nuruma a cheŋ a ga nye tigi a te mu gɔnni po.> >>
2Faaro yaa weeni ayen, <<Ka wana ale Naawen ate mi ale ta tuewomma a te wa a basi ate Izirali demma a cheŋ? Mi zɛ Naawen ate m le basi ate Izirali demma a cheŋ.>>
3Ate ba yaa weeni ayen, <<Yiburu demma Wenni a tu ti kama. Yɔgyɔgla de basi ate ti cheŋ suik daa ŋata gɔnni po a nye kaabka a te Naawen ti Wenni, dan kan daa di wa le te nyiŋtuila yik ti yaase wa ko ti ale gebik.
4Alege Ejipiti naawa a weeni ayen, <<Moosis ale Aaron ka boa ale soa ate fi ta nuruma a cheŋ ale a ge ba tuimaŋa? Ni ŋman cheŋ ni tuimaŋa jigi.>> 5Faaro yaa weeni ayen, <<Nya, tɛŋka nuruma yaa piisi kama, ate fi a kasi ba tomka.>>
6Da dila danni Faaro yaa weeni baai ale a fɛ yɔmma ate ba a tom la, ale kpaŋŋa ale a nya nuruma zuk la ayen. 7<<Ni kan ŋman te nuruma wukosa a magsi peela nakka, ni basi ate ba ga yaali badek wukosa. 8Alege ni basi ate ba nak peelaŋa a soa se ba le liŋ a nak diila, ni kan yeeri ŋa nɔi basi. Ba ka nyiŋwotta nyam, dila ale soa ate ba a kaari ayen, <Basi ate ti ga nye kaabka a te ti Wenni la.> 9Ni basi ate tuimaŋa a pagra a te nuruma a gaam ku le poom ka diila ate ba kasim a tom abe ni kaa wom venta.>>
10Baai ale a fɛ yɔmma ate ba a tom la ale kpaŋŋa yaa cheŋ ga weeni nuruma ayen, <<Faaro ale weeni diila ale nna. <M kan ŋmaa te wukosa. 11Ni cheŋ ga yaali nidek wukosa juijui meena ate ni a nya la, alege ni tuimaŋa kan yeeri a basi.> >> 12Nuruma yaa waaŋ Ejipiti tɛŋka meena ayen ba tigsi wukosa. 13Baai ale a fɛ yɔmma la a kasim a fɛ ba a weeni ayen, <<Ni nueri tuim ŋaai ate ba a yaali ayen ni tom dai yeŋ la a magsi diipo ate ni jam ta wukosa la. 14Faaro nuru baai ale a fɛ yɔmma la ale lueri Izirali kpaga ŋaai la, ba kasim a nak ba kama ale a bek ba ayen, <<Ka boa ale soa ate ni an nak peela jinla ale deemwa a soa ase ni nyiem ale a nak diila?>>
15Ate Izirali kpaŋŋa yaa cheŋ ga bek Faaro ayen, <<Ka boa ale soa ate fi a nye fi tomteerɔma nna? 16Ba an te fi tomteerɔma wukosa, alege a weeni ti ayen, <Ni nak peela> Ate ba a nak fi tomteerɔma, alege ka fidek nuruma ale nye kaasi.>>
17Faaro yaa weeni ayen, <<Nyiŋwotta nyam, ni le ka diila ale la, nyiŋwotta nyam. Dila ale soa ate ni kasim a weeni ayen, basi ate ti cheŋ a ga nye kaabka a te Naawen la.> 18Yɔgyɔgla de ni cheŋ tuima. Ba kan te ni wukosa, alege se ni nak peelaŋa a paari ŋa nɔnni.>>
19Izirali kpaŋŋa yaa nya ayen ba bo ka daanika po wa le weeni ba ayen, <<Ni le magsi ni nak peela dai yeŋ meena diila, ni an magsi ayen ni yeeri ku po kauk a basi.>> 20Ba le basi Faaro la ba yaa nya Moosis ale Aaron a limisi ayen ba tu ba. 21Ba yaa weeni Moosis ale Aaron ayen, <<Naawen abe nya abe wa bo ni buusa. Ni basi kama ate ti a nyuŋ Faaro ale wa kpaŋŋa nyue po ale pai gebika nyo ba nisa po ayen ba ko ti.>>
22Moosis yaa ŋman cheŋ Naawen jigi ayen, <<M Nyɔnɔ, ka boa ate fi ta daanika a jam nuruma de zuwa? Ka dii nyiŋ ate fi tom mi la ale la? 23Mi ni din cheŋ Faaro jigi ayen m biisi fi yuenni nyiŋla, wa ta ka daanika a jam nuruma zuk, ate fi an bola vari fi nuruma a basi ya.>>

Title: NYINIKA 6
Content:
1Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Yɔgyɔgla de fi le nya mi le za m nye Faaro diila. Mi ni kpieŋsaŋa nyiŋ wa le basi ate ba cheŋ. Mi ni kpieŋsaŋa nyiŋ wa le yiak ba ate ba nyini wa tɛŋka po.>>
2Wen a weeni Moosis ayen, <<Mi ale Naawen. 3Mi pai m dek a sak Abrayam ale Aizik ale Jekob kama ase Wen Dii Ale A Niak La, alege m yuenni Naawen mi an pai m dek a sak ba. 4M nye nɔiyeŋ ale ba mɛ ayen m te ba Keenan tɛŋka, juijui ate ba jam boro ase nicham la. 5Alege m be wom Izirali demma kumsaŋa kama, baai ate Ejipiti demma a tom yɔntidi la, m be teeri m nɔiyeŋka kama.
6<<Dila be weeni Izirali demma ayen, <Mi ale Naawen, m be le ta ni nyini Ejipiti demma namsika po a nyini. M le vari ni basi ate ni kan chim ba yɔm. M le teeri nisa a da tuesi ni basi abe m bo ba buusa ŋaai ale pagra la. 7M le pai ni ase m dek nuruba la, abe m chim ni Wen. Ate ni seba ayen Mi ale Naawen ni Wenni, waai ale ta ni nyini Ejipiti demma namsika po a nyini. 8M le ta ni jam tɛŋ kaai ate mi zak nisa a pɛ ayen m le pai te Abrayam ale Aizik ale Jekob la. M le pai te ni ate ni soa. Mi ale Naawen.> >>
9Moosis yaa weeni nna a sak Izirali demma, alege ba an wom wa ba le jɔk nyiŋbiiri ale ŋman bo ninammu po la nyiŋ.
10Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 11<<Cheŋ ga weeni Faaro Ejipiti naawa ayen wa basi ate Izirali demma a nyini wa tɛŋka po a nyini.>>
12Alege Moosis yaa weeni Naawen ayen, <<Izirali demma dan kaa wom mi, Faaro ale nye ka sɛ a wom mi, mi daa waai ale baga a biisi nalimnyiini la?>>
13Yɔgyɔgla de Naawen yaa biisi te Moosis ale Aaron a weeni ba Izirali demma ale Faaro Ejipiti naawa wie, ate wa yaa te suik ayen wa ta Izirali demma nyini Ejipiti tɛŋka po.
14Ba dɔkdemma ale ba koma jam ale nna. Izirali bikpagni Aruben nidoabilisaŋa jam le Yanok ale Pallu ale Ayeziron ale Karmi. Aruben diinaŋa jam le la.
15Simeyon nidoabilisaŋa jam le Jemuel ale Jamin ale Oyad ale Jakin ale Zoyar ale Sɛyaul Keenan nipowa biika. Simeyon diinaŋa jam le la.
16Livai nidoabilisaŋa yueŋa ale nna a va chaab ale ba ale ŋmarisi dii dueni a va ba nyiŋla. Gerson ale Koyat ale Merari. Livai a jam ka bena kook ale pisita ale ŋayopɔi.
17Gerson nidoabilisaŋa a va chaab ale ba diinaŋa jam le Libni ale Simei.
18Koyat nidoabilisaŋa jam le Amram ale Izyar ale Yebron ale Uzziel. Koyat jam goa ka bena kook ale pisita ale ŋata.
19Merari nidoabilisaŋa jam le Mayali ale Musi. Livai diinaŋa jam le nna a va chaab ale dii ale ŋmarisi dua la.
20Amram jam faari ka wa kowa tua Jochebed ate wa biak Aaron ale Moosis a te wa. Amram jam goa ka bena kook ale pisita ale ŋayopɔi.
21Izyar nidoabilisaŋa jam ka Koora ale Nefeg ale Zikri.
22Uzziel nidoabilisaŋa jam ka Misael ale Elzafan ale Sitri.
23Aaron jam faari ka Eliseba Amminadab lie. Wa jam ka Nayson tua. Wa jam biak ka Nadab ale Abiyu ale Eleaza ale Itamar a te wa.
24Koora nidoabilisaŋa jam ka Assir ale Elkana ale Abiasap. Koora diinaŋa jam le nna.
25Aaron nidoabinni Eleaza a jam faari ka Putiel liema wanyi ate wa biak Fineyas a te wa. Livai buuni dɔk dɔk koma jam le nna.
26Ku jam ka Aaron ale Moosis ate Naawen a jam weeni ba ayen, <<Ta Izirali demma ba beŋ, ba beŋ a nyini Ejipiti a nyini. 27Ka bala ale jam biisi ale Faaro, Ejipiti naawa a magsi chaab ale Izirali demma ta nyinika wari la. Ku jam ka Moosis ale Aaron.
28Yɔgyɔgla de Naawen ale jam biisi ale Moosis Ejipiti la, 29Wa jam weeni wa kama ayen, <<Mi ale Naawen. Weeni Faaro Ejipiti naawa dii meena ate mi a weeni fu la.
30Alege Moosis a weeni Naawen ayen, <<Mi daa waai ale baga a biisi nalimnyiini la, Faaro ale nye ka sɛ a wom mi?>>

Title: NYINIKA 7
Content:
1Ate Naawen a weeni Moosis ayen, <<Nya m nye fu ase ka Wen la a te Faaro, abe fi suoku Aaron a chim fi biisiteerɔ. 2Se fi weeni dii meena ate mi a weeni fu la, abe fi suoku Aaron a weeni Faaro ayen wa basi ate Izirali demma a nyini wa tɛŋka po. 3Alege m le basi ate Faaro suinummu a pagra, m le poom basi ate m wakinkaglaŋa ale wakperikaliisaŋa a piisi Ejipiti po, 4alege wa kan wom fu. Ate m le pai m nisa a vi Ejipiti zuk a tom tuim kpiema ale buusa m le ta m nuruma Izirali demma ba beŋ, ba beŋ a nyini. 5M dan teeri nisa a ta chaab ale Ejipiti demma a ta Izirali demma a nyini, Ejipiti demma ale seba ayen mi ka Naawen.>> 6Moosis ale Aaron yaa nye dii dek ate Naawen a weeni ba la. 7Moosis a jam ka bena pinaanuŋ alege Aaron a ta bena pinaanuŋ ale ŋata diipo ate ba biisi ale Faaro la.
8Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ale Aaron ayen, 9<<Faaro a dan weeni ni ayen, <Nye wakinkagli,> be weeni Aaron ayen, <Pai doani a lɔnsi tɛŋ Faaro niŋ,> ate di chim waab.>>
10Moosis ale Aaron yaa cheŋ Faaro jigi a nye dii dek ate Naawen a weeni la. Aaron yaa yuk doani a lɔnsi Faaro ale wa nisɔmma niŋ, ate di chim waab. 11Faaro yaa wi yam nyam ale sampoporisa, ate Ejipiti sampoporisaŋa mɛ a nye dila dek ale ba kperisaŋa. 12Ba wanyi meena a yuk wa doari a lɔnsi tɛŋ ate di chim waab. Alege Aaron doani a nɛ ba doaŋa. 13Ku meena ŋaaŋnyiŋ Faaro suinummu a pagra kama ate wa kan wom ba ase Naawen ale poom weeni diila.
14Ate Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Faaro a kan siak a nyini wa suinum po. Wa zɛri kama ayen nuruma kan cheŋ. 15Cheŋ Faaro jigi saluik diipo ate wa nyini a cheŋ benni la. Limisi Nile benni nɔi ate fi tu wa. Pai fi doa dii ale tagri a chim waamu la a nyo fi nisa po. 16Weeni wa ayen, <Naawen dii ale ka Yiburu demma Wen la, ale tom mu ayen m weeni fu ayen, basi ate m nuruma a cheŋ a ga puusi mu gɔnni po. Alege fi kan wom a jam paari yɔgyɔgla de. 17Dii ate Naawen a weeni la ale nna. Kude ale basi ate fi seba ayen Mi ale Naawen. Doani ale bo m nisaŋa po la m le pai nak Nile benni nyiamu, ate bu tagri a chim ziim. 18Jumaŋa ale bo Nile benni po la ale kpi, ate benni a nyuŋ, ate Ejipiti demma a kan baga a nyu di nyiamu.> >>
19Naawen a weeni Moosis ayen, <<Weeni Aaron ayen, <Pai fi doani a teeri fi nisaŋa Ejipiti nyaataŋa zuk ale beli naŋsaŋa zuk ale nyiam vuutaŋa zuk ale beli gilimaŋa zuk ale ŋan baai meena ate ba pai nyiam a nyo du la,> ate ba tagri chim ziim. Ziim ale bo jigi meena Ejipiti tɛŋka po. Bu le maa bo daata bogtiba ale tintain liisa po.
20Moosis ale Aaron yaa nye dii dek ate Naawen a weeni la. Wa zak wa doani ka Faaro ale wa nisɔmma niŋ a nak Nile benni nyiamu, ate nyiamu meena a tagri a chim ziim. 21Jumaŋa ale bo Nile benni po la a kpi, ate benni a nyuŋ nna biokbiokwa ate Ejipiti demma an baga a nyu di nyiamu. Ziim ale jam bo jigi meena Ejipiti tɛŋka po.
22Alege Ejipiti sampoporisaŋa mɛ a nye dila dek ale ba kperisaŋa, ate Faaro suinummu a ŋmasi pagra. Wa kan wom Moosis ale Aaron ase Naawen ale poom ŋaam weeni diila. 23Wa goanti cheem kama a cheŋ jo wa yenni po ale an poom pai nyo wa suinum po. 24Ate Ejipiti demma meena a tu bulisa Nile benni nɔi ayen ba nyu nyiam, dii nyiŋla ba an jam baga a nyu benni nyiamu.
25Daa ŋayopɔi ale jam taam ate Naawen a nak Nile benni nyiamu.

Title: NYINIKA 8
Content:
1Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Cheŋ Faaro jigi a ga weeni wa ayen, <Naawen ale weeni ayen, basi ate m nuruma a cheŋ a ga puusi mu. 2Fi dan zɛri an te ate ba cheŋ ya, m le namsi fi tɛŋka meena ale baŋuuna. 3Nile benni ale sueri ale baŋuuna. Ŋa le jueli a jam jo fi yenni po ale dɔk kuui ate fi a goa la ale fi gaduokku zuk ale fi nisɔmma yeeŋa po ale fi nuruma zuk ale fi borobottaŋa se ka jiŋŋa ale ba le a bilisi borobottaŋa ŋan baai zuk la. 4Baŋuunaŋa ale jueli fi ale fi nuruma ale fi nisɔmma zuk.> >>
5Ate Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Weeni Aaron ayen, <Teeri fi nisaŋa ale doani beli naŋsaŋa zuk ale nyiam vuutaŋa zuk ale beli gilimaŋa zuk a nye ate baŋuuna a jam Ejipiti tɛŋka zuk.> >>
6Aaron yaa teeri wa nisaŋa Ejipiti nyaataŋa zuk ate baŋuunaŋa a jueli a lik tɛŋka. 7Alege sampoporisaŋa mɛ a nye dila dek ale ba kperisaŋa. Ba mɛ nye ate baŋuuna a jueli jam Ejipiti tɛŋka.
8Faaro yaa wi Moosis ale Aaron a weeni ba ayen, <<Puusi a te Naawen ate wa yeeri baŋuunaŋa a ta cheŋ abe wa ge mi ale m nuruma ate m te ate ni nuruma a ga nye kaabka a te Naawen.
9Moosis yaa weeni Faaro ayen, <<Mi pai zula a te fi ayen fi dak diipo ale magsi ayen m puusi a te fi ale fi nisɔmma ale fi nuruma ate baŋuunaŋa basi nama ale ni yeeŋa, abe ŋa tali ŋaai ale bo Nile benni po la nyiini.>>
10Faaro yaa weeni ayen, <<Chum.>> Moosis yaa weeni ayen, <<Ku le nye ase ka fi le weeni diila ate fi miŋ ayen waai karo a nye ase Naawen ti Wenni la. 11Baŋuunaŋa ale basi fu ale ni yeeŋa ale fi nisɔmma ale fi nuruma. Ŋa le tali bo ka Nile benni po nyiini.>>
12Moosis ale Aaron ale basi Faaro la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, Moosis yaa kaari weeni Naawen baŋuunaŋa ate wa ta jam Faaro zuk la wari. 13Ate Naawen a nye dii ate Moosis a bek la. Baŋuunaŋa a kpi yeeŋa po ale dabaasaŋa po ale laŋsaŋa po. 14Ba yaa tigsi ŋa dueni nna berr, berr, ate tɛŋka a nyuŋ ale ŋa. 15Alege Faaro ale nya ayen wa vuusi ale baŋuunaŋa la, wa ŋman basi ate wa suinummu a pagra a kan wom Moosis ale Aaron ase Naawen ale poom liŋ a weeni la.
16Ate Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Weeni Aaron ayen, <Teeri doani a nak tɛŋka tantaŋa,> ate Ejipiti tɛŋka meena tantaŋa a chim bunbuma.>> 17Ba le nye nna ate Aaron a teeri wa nisaŋa ale doani a nak tɛŋka tantaŋa la, bunbuma a deri jam nuruba ale duŋsa nyiŋsa. Ejipiti tɛŋka tantaŋa meena a chim ka bunbuma. 18Alege sampoporisaŋa ale yen ba a nye bunbuma ale ba kperisaŋa la ba an baga nye ya. Ate bunbuma a bo nuruba ale duŋsa nyiŋsa.
19Sampoporisaŋa a weeni Faaro ayen, <<Ka Wen nisa ale nna.>> Alege Faaro suinummu a pagra wa kan wom ase Naawen ale poom liŋ a weeni la.
20Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Yiti saluik yokyokwa a tu Faaro diipo ate wa cheŋ nyiamu jigini la a weeni wa ayen, <Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna. Basi ate m nuruma a cheŋ a ga puusi mu. 21Fi dan kan basi ate m nuruma a cheŋ ya, m le basi ate nanjuŋsa a jam si beŋ fi jigi ale fi nisɔmma jigi ale fi nuruma jigi ale ni yeeŋa po. Nanjuŋsaŋa ale sueri Ejipiti demma yeeŋa ale ba le bo juijui la tɛŋka meena.
22<< <Alege da dila danni mi le nye Gosen tɛŋka ka ku tɔga juijui ate m nuruma a boro la. Nanjuŋsa a kan bo dula ate fi seba ayen mi Naawen a bo tɛŋka de. 23M le basi ate ku chim ku tɔga mi nuruma ale fi nuruma suŋsuŋ. Wakinkagni de ale nye chum.> >>
24Ate Naawen yaa nye nna. Nanjuŋsa si beŋ, si beŋ a jam jo Faaro yenni ale wa nisɔmma yeeŋa ale Ejipiti tɛŋka meena nanjuŋsaŋa a jam kaasi kama.
25Faaro yaa wi Moosis ale Aaron a weeni ayen, <<Ni cheŋ a ga nye kaabka a te ni Wenni tɛŋka po dela.>>
26Alege Moosis a weeni ayen, <<Kula kan magsi. Kaab kaai ate tama a nye a te Naawen ti Wenni Ejipiti demma a kan yaali. Ti be dan nye kaab kaai ate ba kan yaali la ba nina po, ba kan yuk ti ale tana? 27Ti le cheŋ suik daa ŋata a jo gɔnni po a nye kaabka a te Naawen ti Wenni ase wa le weeni ti diila.>>
28Faaro yaa weeni ayen, <<M le te ni cheŋ a ga nye kaabka a te Naawen ni Wenni gɔnni po, alege ni kan cheŋ niŋniŋŋa. Ni abe puusi a te mu yɔgyɔgla.>>
29Moosis yaa tulisi ayen, <<M dan ga basi fu, m le puusi a te Naawen, ate chum nanjuŋsaŋa a basi Faaro ale wa nisɔmma ale wa nuruma. Be seba ate fi kan paasi ti ate fi nye ate nuruma kan baga a ga nye kaabka a te Naawen.>>
30Ate Moosis yaa basi Faaro ale puusi a te Naawen, 31ate Naawen a nye Moosis ale bek diila. Ate nanjuŋsaŋa a basi Faaro ale wa nisɔmma ale wa nuruma, nanjuŋ yeŋ mɛ la an tali ya. 32Alege yɔgyɔgla de mɛ Faaro a basi ate wa suinummu a pagra ate wa kan te nuruma a cheŋ.

Title: NYINIKA 9
Content:
1Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Cheŋ Faaro jigi a weeni wa ayen, <Naawen, Yiburu demma Wenni a weeni ayen, <<Basi ate m nuruma a cheŋ a ga puusi mu.>> 2Fi dan zɛri an te ti ba cheŋ ya alege kasim peri ba tara, 3Naawen nisa ale ta nyiŋtuila a jam ni duŋsaŋa ale bo laŋsaŋa po la. Wa le ta jam ni wusumaŋa ale bonsaŋa ale laalaakomima ale niiŋa ale piisaŋa ale buaŋa zuk. 4Alege Naawen ale basi ate ku chim ku tɔga Ejipiti ale Izirali duŋsaŋa suŋsuŋ, ate Izirali demma duŋ mɛ la a kan kpi.> >>
5Naawen yaa te diipo ate wa le nye la a weeni ayen, <<Chum Naawen ale nye kude tɛŋka po.>> 6Vari ale jam veenti la Naawen yaa nye dila. Ejipiti demma duŋsaŋa meena a kpi kama, alege Izirali demma duŋ yeŋ mɛ la an kpi ya. 7Faaro yaa tom nuruma ayen ba ga kpesi nya ate ba nya ayen Izirali demma duŋ yeŋ mɛ an kpi ya. Alege wa suinummu po wa an siak a te ba, wa be kan te ti ba cheŋ.>>
8Ate Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ale Aaron ayen, <<Nye kaalim nisa nɔi a yuk basi wen Faaro niŋ. 9Bu le chim nyuŋ maŋ Ejipiti meena ate nirisa ale moari nuruba ale duŋsa tɛŋka meena po.>>
10Ba yaa nye kaalim daaniŋ a zaani Faaro niŋ. Moosis yaa yuk kaalimu a basi wen ate nirisa a moari nuruba ale duŋsa. 11Sampoporisaŋa an baga a zaani Moosis niŋŋa dii nyiŋla nirisaŋa a jam moari ba kama ale Ejipiti demma meena. 12Alege Naawen a basi ate Faaro suinummu pagra ate wa kan wom Moosis ale Aaron, ase Naawen ale weeni Moosis diila.
13Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Yiti saluik yokyokwa a ga tu chaab ale Faaro a weeni wa ayen, <Naawen, Yiburu demma Wenni ale weeni ayen basi ate m nuruma a cheŋ a ga puusi mu, 14dan kan daa di yɔgyɔgla de m le basi ate daanika a jam fi zuk ale fi nisɔmma ale fi nuruma, ate fi seba ayen waai a karo a nye ase mi la tɛŋka meena zuwa. 15Nna po dɛ m ti teeri ka nisa a nak fi nuruma ale nyiŋtuila ate ŋa nueri ni tɛŋka zuk. 16Alege mi zak ni a zaani kama kude nyiŋ, ayen m baga a sak ni m pagrimu ate m yuenni mɛ ba mooli ate di cheŋ tɛŋka meena. 17Alege ni diem a ta chaab ale m nuruma a kan te ti ba a cheŋ. 18Dila nyiŋ, chum nna po de m le basi ate viok ale ŋmoruk tana le bie la a jam. Viok kuui ale kan jam Ejipiti a nya la, a zaani tɛŋka piilimka a jam paari yɔgyɔgla de. 19Be te nɔi yɔgyɔgla de ate ba ta duŋsaŋa ale jaabuuri meena ate ni ta ŋa ni talimu po la a jam yeri po, dii nyiŋla ŋmoruk tanaŋa a za ŋa lo nuru meena ale duŋ sii meena ale diem bo laŋka po an jam jo yeri po la kama, ate si kpi.> >>
20Faaro nisɔm baai ale a chali Naawen wanni yɔgsum la, a nye nwuli a ta ba yɔmma ale ba duŋsaŋa a jam jo. 21Alege baai ale zɛri Naawen wanni la, a basi ba yɔmma ale ba duŋsaŋa laŋka po.
22Ate Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Zak fi nisa a tuk wen ate ŋmoruk tana a siŋ Ejipiti zuk ale nuruba ale duŋsa ale ŋan baai meena ale a chim Ejipiti laŋsaŋa po la. 23Moosis ale zak wa doani a tuk wen la, Naawen yaa basi ate nanpansa ale ŋmoruk tana ale nyaksika a siŋ tɛŋka. Naawen a basi ate ŋmoruk tana a siŋ Ejipiti tɛŋka zuk. 24Ŋmoruk tanaŋa ale nyaksika a siŋ ate ku a nyaksi niŋ ale ŋaaŋ. Kula ale va pagrik a bie Ejipiti tɛŋka meena po a nyini diipo ate ka chim tɛŋ la. 25Ejipiti tɛŋka meena ŋmoruk tanaŋa a fɔbi jaab meena laŋsaŋa po ka tɛŋ ale nuruba ale duŋsa meena. A fɔbi jaab meena ale a chim laŋsaŋa po ale ŋasi tiisaŋa meena. 26Kauk kuui nyiini ate ku an fɔbi la, ale Gosen tɛŋka juijui ate Izirali demma a boro la.
27Faaro yaa wi Moosis ale Aaron a weeni ba ayen, <<Yɔgyɔgla de mi tom kaasi kama. Naawen nye magsi kama, ka mi ale m nuruma ale kaasi. 28Puusi a te Naawen nanpansaŋa ale ŋmoruk tanaŋa ale siŋ ti zuk la a magsi kama. M le basi ate ni cheŋ. Ni kan ni ŋman boro.>>
29Moosis yaa tulisi ayen. <<M dan nyini tɛŋka po a nyini m le zak nisa a puusi a te Naawen. Nanpansaŋa ale basi, ŋmoruk tana a kan ŋman boro, ate fi seba ayen tɛŋka ka Naawen ale soa. 30Alege mi seba ayen fi ale fi nisɔmma an diem a chali Naawen, dii ale ka Wen la yɔgsummoa.>>
31Ŋankpaantaŋa ŋaai ale bɛ yaase ŋaai ale jam boro a biak la a jam kaasi kama, 32alege ŋankpaan tii ale wari ŋaaŋ la an jam a kaasi ya.
33Moosis yaa basi Faaro ale nyini tɛŋka po a nyini. Wa zak nisa tuk Naawen nyiŋ, ate nanpansa ale ŋmoruk tanaŋa a basi, ate ŋmoruk an ŋman chuiri tɛŋka zuwa. 34Faaro ale nya ale ŋmoruk tana ale nanpansaŋa a basi la, wa ŋman nye kaasi. Wa le wa nisɔmma a basi ate ba suiniimaŋa a pagra. 35Faaro suinummu yaa jam pagra ate wa kan te ate Izirali demma a cheŋ ase Naawen ale biisi va Moosis zuk diila.

Title: NYINIKA 10
Content:
1Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Cheŋ Faaro jigi ale mi basi ate wa ale wa nisɔmma suiniima a pagra kama ate m baga a tom m wakinkaglaŋa ba suŋsuŋ. 2Ate ni weeni ni bisaŋa ale ni ŋaaŋbisaŋa mi ale nye dii tuotuok ale Ejipiti demma la, ale mi ale tom wakinkagla dii ba suŋsuŋ la, ate ni seba ayen Mi ale Naawen.>>
3Moosis ale Aaron yaa cheŋ Faaro jigi a weeni wa ayen, <<Naawen, Yiburu demma Wenni a weeni ayen, <Fi tin kan siak fi zaab fidek mi niŋ a paari ka dimpo? Basi ate m nuruma a cheŋ a ga puusi mu. 4Fi dan zɛri an te ba cheŋ ya, m le ta tintue a jam fi tɛŋka po chum. 5Ŋa le lik tɛŋka meena ate waai a kan nya tɛŋka. Ŋa le dɛ ŋan baai magadek kaai ale tali ŋmoruk tanaŋa ŋaaŋ nyiŋla, a maa dɛ tiib meena ale diem a chim laŋsaŋa po la. 6Ŋa le sueri ni yeeŋa ale ni nisɔmma yeeŋa ale Ejipiti demma meena yeeŋa. Wa dii ate ni koma yaase ni kokpieŋsaŋa an maa nya a zaani diipo ate ba piilim kali tɛŋka de la a jam paari yɔgyɔgla de la.> >> Ate Moosis a cheem cheŋ ale basi Faaro.
7Faaro nisɔmma yaa weeni Faaro ayen, <<Nuruwa de ale chim baruk a te tama a paari ka dimpo? Basi ate nuruma a ga puusi Naawen, ba Wenni. Fi an diem miŋ ayen Ejipiti tɛŋka a kaasi ya?>>
8Ate ba ta Moosis ale Aaron a jam Faaro jigi. Faaro yaa weeni ayen, <<Ni ga puusi Naawen, ni Wenni, alege ka bana ate fi ale ta ba cheŋ?>>
9Moosis yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ti le cheŋ ale bimbaan paaluk ale ŋankpagsa ale nidoabilisa ale lieba ale piisa ale duŋsa, dii nyiŋla ti a yaali ayen ti nye ka tigi a te Naawen.>>
10Faaro a weeni ayen, <<Naawen a bo ale ni. M dan te ni cheŋ ale ni nipooma ale ni bisaŋa, ku kan nna jassi ayen ni ta ka biem popola. 11Aaya, ni te nidoama nyiini a cheŋ a ga puusi Naawen, ni poom kasim a bek ka dila.>> Ba yaa yiak Moosis ale Aaron ate ba nyini Faaro jigi a nyini.
12Ate Naawen a weeni Moosis ayen, <<Zak nisa Ejipiti zuk ate tintue a jam lik tɛŋka a dɛ jaab meena ale a chim laŋsaŋa po la, jaab meena ale tali ŋmoruk tanaŋa ŋaaŋ nyiŋla.>>
13Moosis yaa zak wa doani Ejipiti zuk, ate Naawen a basi ate kori viok a fuk tɛŋka meena dai dila danni ale yok kula meena. Ate ku le ga paari saluik la ate vioku a ta tintueŋa a jam. 14Ŋa tuesi Ejipiti tɛŋka meena a yaa bo jigi meena tɛŋka po nna yegayega. Tintue daani kala an maa jam tɛŋka po a nya ya, ŋa be kan maa jam dila ŋmana. 15Ŋa lik tɛŋka meena ate tɛŋka sob nna timtim. Ŋa jam dɛ ka jaab meena ale tali ŋmoruk tanaŋa ŋaaŋ nyiŋla. Jaab meena ale a chim laŋsaŋa po la ale yɔnaŋa ale bo tiisaŋa zuk la. Viok mɛ la an tali tiib zuk yaase jaab zuwa Ejipiti tɛŋka po.
16Faaro yaa nye nwuli a wi Moosis ale Aaron a weeni ba ayen, <<Mi tom kaasi Naawen, ni Wenni ale nama kama. 17Yɔgyɔgla ni ŋman vɔŋ m kaasuŋku a te mu abe ni puusi a te Naawen, ni Wenni ate wa yeeri daani bioku de m jigi.>>
18Moosis yaa basi Faaro ale ga puusi a te Naawen. 19Ate Naawen a tagri vioku ate ku chim yeniŋ va pagrik, ate ku fuk a ji tintueŋa a ta ga basi Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku po. Tintuiri mɛ la an tali Ejipiti tɛŋka po. 20Alege Naawen a basi ate Faaro suinummu a pagra, ate wa kan basi ate Izirali demma a cheŋ.
21Ate Naawen a weeni Moosis ayen, <<Zak fi nisaŋa a tuk wen ate legi a jam lik Ejipiti tɛŋka. Legi dii ale di jo nuruma nyiŋ.>> 22Moosis yaa zak nisa a tuk wen ate legi nna kpitɔ a lik Ejipiti a paari daa ŋata. 23Nuru waai an jam nya wa choa yaase wa basi wa jigi a paari daa ŋata. Alege Izirali demma ale bo juijui meena la ku a nya.
24Faaro yaa wi Moosis a weeni wa ayen, <<Ni cheŋ a ga puusi Naawen. Ni nipooma ale ni bisaŋa a baga a cheŋ ale ni kama. Ka ni tin basi ni piisaŋa ale ni duŋsaŋa ŋaaŋ.>>
25Alege Moosis a weeni wa ayen, <<Ku a fɛ ate fi basi ate ti ta ti duŋsaŋa ale juka tiiritaŋa ate ti pai te Naawen, ti Wenni. 26Ku a fɛ ate ti duŋsaŋa a cheŋ ale ti. Ti kan basi naŋsabi mɛ la ŋaaŋŋa. Ti le pai ba gela a nye puusa a te Naawen ti Wenni. Ti be dan kan paari dula ti kan seba ti le ti pai jabuui a nye puusa a te Naawen.>>
27Alege Naawen a basi ate Faaro suinummu a pagra, ate wa kan yaali ayen ba cheŋ. 28Faaro yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Cheŋ du mi niŋ. Seba ate fi kan ŋman jam mi niŋŋa. Dai dii dai ate fi a nya mi nina la fi le kpi.>>
29Moosis yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ase fi le weeni diila, m kan ŋman jam fi niŋ diipo diipo.

Title: NYINIKA 11
Content:
1Yɔgyɔgla de Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<M le ta ka daanika bunyi a jam Faaro ale Ejipiti zuk. Kula ŋaaŋnyiŋ wa le te ate ni nyini dela cheŋ. Wa dan nye dila wa le yiak ni meena ate ni nyini. 2Weeni Izirali nidoama ale nipooma ayen ba bek ba le Ejipiti dem baai ale moata chaab la a tuesi kpana ale ligmɔniŋ ŋanta a nyini ba jigi.>> 3Naawen a basi kama ate Ejipiti demma a pai badek a te Izirali ate Moosis dek mɛ Faaro nisɔmma ale nuruma jaa zuli wa kama.
4Moosis yaa weeni ayen, <<Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <Yɔk suŋsuŋ m le cheŋ Ejipiti tɛŋka meena. 5Bi kpagi meena Ejipiti tɛŋka po ale kpi, a zaani Faaro bikpagni waai ale wa kali naamu zukpaglika zuk la, a ga paari nipok yɔmawa waai ale a num zom la bikpagni ale niiga bi kpaga mɛ. 6Kaarik nna yegayega le za ku bo Ejipiti a bie a gaam kaarik sii ate ba kaari a nya la, yaase kaari ka choa ale ŋman jam ase dila la. 7Alege Izirali demma po biak mɛ la a kan wosi nuru yaase duŋŋa.> Ate ni miŋ ayen Naawen a nye kama ate pooruŋ a bo Ejipiti ale Izirali suŋsuŋ. 8Fi nisɔmma de meena ale jam mi jigi a koori tɛŋ mi niŋ a weeni ayen, <Ni cheŋ, fi ale fi nuruma meena ale va fu la.> Dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ m le cheŋ.>> Moosis yaa basi Faaro ale suipuurum nna yegayega.
9Naawen a poom weeni Moosis kama ayen, Faaro ale zɛri wa kan wom fu ate m wakinkaglaŋa a tom piisi Ejipiti.>> 10Moosis ale Aaron a tom wakinkaglaŋa de meena kama Faaro niŋ, alege Naawen a basi ate Faaro suinummu a pagra, ate wa kan basi ate Izirali demma a nyini wa tɛŋka po a nyini.

Title: NYINIKA 12
Content:
1Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ale Aaron Ejipiti tɛŋka po ayen, 2<<Chiika de ale ka chim ni piilimka chiik, chiik kaai ale a chim ni benni piilimka chiik la. 3Weeni Izirali demma ayen chiika da pi dai, nuru meena a yaali pabiik a magsi wa dɔkdem, kanyi a magsi yeri meena. 4Yeri dii a dan fiisa ale pabiik, ba chari ka ale yeri dii ale moata a magsi chaab ale nuruma nɔi ale ka dii a boro la. Ni kpesi pabiika lammu ale a soa dii a magsi nuru yeŋ ŋɔbika la. 5Duŋ sii ate ni a lueri la a chim ben yeŋ duŋsa. Ŋandoa tii ale kan ta jomi ya. Ni yeeri ŋa piisaŋa yaase booŋa po. 6Nya si zuk a ga paari chiika daa pi ale ŋanaansi dai ku junɔi ate Izirali demma meena ale tɔgri si la. 7Ba yaa pai ziimu gela a sa yeeŋa tuataŋa ganaŋa ale ŋmazuimaŋa juijui ate ba kali a ŋɔbi pabisaŋa lantaŋa la.
8<<Yok kula ba se lammu bolim po a ŋɔbi ale tinaŋ tuasa ale boroborok ate dabinta a ka ku po. 9Ni kan ŋɔbi lammu bein ya yaase ni dik bu ale nyiamoa, alege ni se bu bolim po. Ni se zukku ale naŋsaŋa ale puuka po ŋantaŋa. 10Ni kan tali bu gela a ta paari saluiwa, bu gela a dan tali a paari saluik, ni ju bu. 11Ni ale magsi ni ŋɔbi lammu diila ale nna. Ni pai chiak gbana a bobi ni gattaŋa a paari, abe ni su ni nuesaŋa, abe ni ta ni doaŋa ni nisima po. Ni ŋɔbi bu nwuli. Ku ka Naawen Gaambasika.
12<<Yok kula dek m le va Ejipiti po a nak nuru ale jaabuuri meena ate ba dɛ niŋ a biak la a lɔnsi tɛŋ. Ate m yaa ta buusa boka a jam Ejipiti wenaŋa meena zuk. Mi ale Naawen. 13Ziimu ale bu sak yie ŋaai ate ni bo ŋa po la. M dan nya ziimu m le gaam ni a taam. Biem a kan maa paari ni ase m nin boro a kaasi Ejipiti.
14<<Ni magsi ni dɛ masim danni de nyiŋ kama. Gaŋsa ale bo ŋaaŋ a cheena la, ni dɛ tigi ku nyiŋ a te Naawen. Di abe kasim chim ŋmarisi kaai ale ka kasim boro a cheŋ. 15Daa ŋayopɔi ni ŋɔbi boroborok kuui ale kan ta dabinta la. Da dii dai ale a dɛ niŋ la ni yeeri dabintaŋa ni yeeŋa po a basi. Waai a dan dɛ jaab ate dabinta a boro a nyini piilimka danni a ta ga paari daa ŋayopɔiwa danni, ba yeeri a nyini Izirali po. 16Piilim ka danni ni nye tuilum tigsuŋ ale daa ŋayopɔiwa danni mɛ ni ŋman nye tuilum tigsuŋ. Ni kan tom tuin pagri. Dii nyiini ale magsi ayen ni nye la ale ni dik ŋandiinta a dɛ.
17<<Ni ŋɔbi Boroborok Ate Dabinta A Ka Ku Po La Tigini, dii nyiŋla ka da dila danni ate ni beŋsaŋa meena a nyini Ejipiti tɛŋka. Ni te ŋmarisika de a kasim boro a cheŋ gaŋsa buuri meena zuk. 18Chiik kaai ale a dɛ niŋ la, ni ŋɔbi boroborok kuui ate dabinta a ka ku po, a zaani daa pi ale ŋanaansiwa danni ku junɔi, a ga paari daa pisiye ale dinyi. 19Dabinta a kan bo waai yeri po daa ŋayopɔi. Ate waai a dan dɛ ŋandiinta ate dabinta a bo ti po, wa poom ka Izirali dek denɔ yaase nichaanɔ, ba yeeri wa a nyini Izirali nuruma po. 20Kan dɛ jaab ate ba pai dabinta a nye. Juijui meena ate fi boro la ŋɔbi boroborok kuui ate ba an pai dabinta a nye la.>>
21Ate Moosis yaa tigsi nuruma a yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni cheŋ nwuli a ga luk duŋsa a te ni dɔkdemma a magsi chaab ale Gaambasika. 22Ni pai kpaliok a su ziimu ale bo taasi kpienni po la a pai ziimu gela a sa tuataŋa ganaŋa meena. Ni wanyi mɛ la a kan gaam yenni tuoku a nyini peelim ate ku ga paari saluik. 23Naawen a dan va Ejipiti tɛŋka ayen wa ko Ejipiti demma a lɔnsi, wa le nya ziimu tuataŋa ŋmaaŋa ale ganaŋa ate wa le gaam tua tila, wa kan te kaasirɔwa suik ate wa ko ni lɔnsi.
24<<Ni nye tuewomma a te sinsaŋŋa de ase wari dii ale doa a te ni ale ni ŋaaŋsaŋa la. 25Ni dan jo tɛŋ kaai ate Naawen ayen wa te ni a magsi chaab ale wa le puulim la, ni kpesi a va wanni de. 26Ate ni bisaŋa a dan bek ni ayen, <Tigini de kiri ale boa a te ni?> 27Ni yaa weeni ba ayen, <Ka Gaambasika kaabka a te Naawen dii ale gaam Izirali demma yeeŋa a basi ale vari ti yeeŋa a basi wa le jam ko Ejipiti demma a lɔnsi la.> >> Ate nuruma a koori tɛŋ a puusi wa. 28Izirali demma a jam nye ka dii dek ate Naawen a weeni Moosis ale Aaron la.
29Yɔk suŋsuŋ Naawen a ko bi kpaŋŋa meena a dueni, a zaan Faaro bikpagni waai ale wa kali naam zukpaglika zuk la, a ga paari waai ate ba lik likka dɔk po la bikpagni ale duŋsa bi kpaga mɛ. 30Faaro ale wa nisɔmma ale Ejipiti demma yaa yiti yokku a kasim a kaari nna yegayega Ejipiti po diila yeri karo ate waai an kpi ya.
31Yɔkku Faaro yaa wi Moosis ale Aaron a weeni ba ayen, <<Ni yiti. Ni basi m nuruma, fi ale Izirali demma. Ni cheŋ a ga puusi Naawen ase ni ale bek diila. 32Ni ta ni piisaŋa ale ni duŋsaŋa, ase ni ale weeni diila a cheŋ. Abe ni niak mu mɛ.>>
33Ejipiti demma a yaa va nuruma ayen ba nye nwuli a basi tɛŋka. Ba weeni ayen, <<Kan daa di ti meena ale kpi.>> 34Nuruma yaa pai ba boroboroku alege ate ba gum dabinta du, a yaa pai vi ŋmankpala ale taasi tanlaŋ sii ate ba bilisi boroborok du la a pai gatta a pobi. 35Izirali demma yaa nye Moosis ale weeni diila. Ba yaa bek Izirali demma a tuesi kpana ale ligmɔniŋ ale gatta. 36Naawen a basi kama ate Ejipiti demma a ta ŋman teka ale siak teka ale nuruma ate ba te ba jabuui meena ate ba bek a yaali la. Ba yaa vari Ejipiti demma.
37Izirali yaa piilim ba chelimu a nyini Arameses a ga paari Sukkot. Nidoama a jam ka nuruba tusa kobsiyuebi (600,000) a cheŋ naŋta. Nipooba ale bimbaansa an gum du. 38Nuru boari ate ba an chim Izirali dem la ale piisa ale bua ale niiga nna yegayega ale jam maa cheŋ ale ba. 39Ba le ta zom buui a nyini Ejipiti jam la, ba yaa pai nye maasa. Ba an jam nyo dabinta du. Zommu a jam ka dabinta dii nyiŋla ba yiak ba kama ate ba nyini Ejipiti nyini, ba an nya suik a nye ŋandiinta.
40Izirali demma a jam goa Ejipiti ka bena kobsinaansi ale pisita. 41Bena kobsinaansi ale pisitawa nueri ka danni, a jam paari da dila danni dek, Naawen nuruma ale poori, poori la meena a basi Ejipiti kama. 42Naawen ale kpesi a nya yokku ayen wa ta ba nyini Ejipiti nyini la nyiŋ, Izirali demma meena a kpesi ate ba a zuli Naawen a magsi ba ŋaaŋsaŋa ale cheen la.
43Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ale Aaron ayen, <<Ŋmarisika ale nna a magsi Gaambasika. Nichaanɔ a kan dɛ Gaambasika. 44Fi dan ta yɔma wa baga dɛ kama, wa yoanni gebika ŋaaŋnyiŋ, 45alege waai ale kan boro a beni yaase waai ate fi pai wa ate wa a tom a te fu ate fu a tuni wa la an baga a dɛ.
46<<Waai dan ayen wa ŋɔbi lammu wa be ŋɔbi yenni po. Kan ta lammu a nyini peelimmoa. Kan wɛ kobini dinyi mɛ. 47Izirali demma meena a magsi ba dɛ tigini kama.
48<<Nichaanɔ waai ale maa bo ale ni la a daa yaali ayen wa dɛ Naawen Gaambasika ku a fɛ ate wa gebi nidoama ale bo wa yenni po la yoaŋa. Ate wa yaa maa baga a dɛ ase waai ate ba biak wa tɛŋka po la. Nidoa waai ale kan gebi la a kan dɛ. 49Sinsaŋŋa ka dila degadega ale tɛŋ biik ale nichaanɔ waai ale bo ale ni la.>>
50Izirali demma meena yaa nye dii ate Naawen a weeni Moosis ale Aaron la. 51Dai dila danni dek ate Naawen a ta Izirali demma a nyini Ejipiti nyini a va chaab ale ba ale poori diila.

Title: NYINIKA 13
Content:
1Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 2<<Gaari ba le liŋ biak jaduok kuui meena a te mu ase tuilum jaab la. Luik meena ale liŋ biak jabuui Izirali demma po la, nuru yaase duŋ ka mi ale soa.>>
3Moosis yaa weeni nuruma ayen, <<Ni kan baŋ jinla danni de. Di ka da dii dai ate ni basi Ejipiti ale ka yɔntidi tɛŋ la. Danni de ate Naawen a pai wa pagrimu a ta ni nyini dula. Dila nyiŋla ku an magsi ayen ni ŋɔbi boroborok kuui ate dabinta a bo ku po la. 4Jinla Abib chiika po ate ni a basi dela. 5Naawen a dan ta ni a ga jo Keenan demma ale Yit demma ale Amori demma ale Yivi demma ale Jebus demma tɛŋka, tɛŋ kaai ate wa puulim ale ni kokpieŋsaŋa ayen wa te ni la, tɛŋ kaai ale ta biisim ale siita la, ni a teeri tigini de chiika de po. 6Daa ŋayopɔi ni ŋɔbi boroborok kuui ate dabinta a ka ku po la, abe daa ŋayopɔiwa danni ni nye tigi a te Naawen.
7<<Ni ŋɔbi boroborok kuui ate dabinta a ka ku po la daa ŋayopɔiwa po. Jaabuui ale ta dabinta la a kan bo ni suŋsuŋŋa yaase dabinta a bo ni tɛŋ banaŋa. 8Dai dila danni weeni fi nidoabinni ayen, <Mi nye nna ka Naawen ale nye dii a te mi la nyiŋ, diipo ate mi a jam nyini Ejipiti tɛŋka po a nyini la.> 9Kpesi teerika de ale chim ka daana a bo ni nisa po ale teerika ni deeŋa nyiŋ ate Naawen sinsaŋŋa abe bo ni noaŋa po. Ale Naawen a ta ni nyini Ejipiti nyini kama ale wa ni pagrisa. 10Ni be magsi kama ayen ni ta ŋmarisika de diipo ale magsi la, ale ben ben meena po.
11<<Naawen a dan ta ni jam jo Keenan demma tɛŋka a pai ka a te ni, ase wa le puulim a pɛ ale nama ale ni kokpieŋsaŋa la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, 12jabuui ale liŋ a nyini luik po a nyini la ni pai te Naawen. Ni duŋ wuunsa ale liŋ a biak ŋan doa tii la, Naawen ale soa. 13Pai pabiik a da tuesi boniŋ ale liŋ biak kaai la, alege fi dan kan da tuesi ya, wɛ ka ŋinni. Ni da tuesi biik kaai meena ate ba liŋ biak ni bisaŋa po la.
14<<Chum po fi bisaŋa a dan bek fu ayen, <Ka kude kiri ale boa?> Weeni wa ayen, <Naawen ale pai wa pagrimu a ta ti a nyini Ejipiti ale ka yɔntidi tɛŋ po la nyiŋ. 15Faaro ale ta tukpari a zɛri a kan te ti a cheŋ la, ate Naawen yaa ko bi kpaŋŋa Ejipiti po, nuruba ale duŋsa meena. Ka dila ale soa ate mi a nye kaabka ale ŋandoa tii ate ba liŋ biak la ayen m da tuesi ba a basi.> 16Ate ku chim magsa fi nisa nyiŋ ale magsa fi diri nyiŋ ayen Naawen ale ta ti nyini Ejipiti nyini ale wa pagrim.>>
17Faaro ale te nuruma a cheŋ la, Wen an basi ate ba va suik kuui ale va Filistia tɛŋka la. Suik kula abe jam gela kama. Wen jam weeni kama ayen, <<Ba dan tu kpaliŋ, ba le tagri ba popolaŋa a ŋman cheŋ Ejipiti.>> 18Dila Wen yaa ta ba gilim va goa kosikka suiku ale a cheŋ Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku la. Izirali demma a jam basi Ejipiti kama a gomsi badek a magsi kpaliŋ.
19Moosis a jam pai Josefi kobaŋa kama dii nyiŋla Josefi a jam basi kama ate Izirali bisaŋa a pɛ. Wa jam weeni kama ayen, <<Wen za wa sum jam maari ni kama, ate ni yaa pai m kobaŋa dela a ji a ta cheŋ.>>
20Ba le basi Sukkot ŋaaŋ nyiŋla, ba ga kali ka Etam goa kosikka nɔi. 21Kantueŋ Naawen nyiem a de ba niŋ ale ka chiŋmari a maari ba a dak suiku alege yokku wa a de ba niŋ ale ka bolim a maari ba ate ku a nya, ate ba baga a cheŋ kantueŋ ale yok. 22Kantueŋ chiŋmanni yaase yokku bolimu an basi ba niŋ dɛka.

Title: NYINIKA 14
Content:
1Ate Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 2<<Weeni Izirali demma ayen ba cheem ŋaaŋ a ga kali a moata Pi Yayirot, Migdol ale nyakpiemu suŋsuŋ. Ba yaa kali moata nyakpiemu, a tuk Baal Zefon. 3Faaro ale poli ayen, <Izirali demma a tuim kama a cheŋ a gilim goa kosikka suŋsuŋ.> 4M le basi ate Faaro suinummu a pagra, ate wa chali vi ba. Alege m le nya zula a te m dek Faaro ale wa kpaliŋ nyeerisaŋa nyiŋ. Ate Ejipiti demma a seba ayen Mi ale Naawen.>> Ate Izirali demma a nye kude.
5Ba le weeni Ejipiti naawa ayen nuruma a chali kama la, Faaro ale wa nisɔmma yaa tagri ba popolaŋa a weeni ayen, <<Ti tin nye ka sɛ? Ti basi ate Izirali demma a cheŋ alege jɔgi ba tuimaŋa.>> 6Wa yaa gomsi wusum ale toroko a magsi a ta wa kpaliŋ nyeerisaŋa a cheŋ. 7Wa jam ta wusuma ale toroko maŋsa kobsiyuebi ale Ejipiti wusuma ale toroko yonta, ate kpaga a nya ba meena zuk. 8Naawen a basi ate Faaro Ejipiti naawa suinummu a pagra ate wa vi Izirali demma ale jam gɔk santiri a nyini ale suinum pagrisa la ŋaaŋ. 9Ejipiti demma ale Faaro wusumaŋa ale torokoma ale wusum duerisa ale kpaliŋ nyeerisaŋa meena a vi Izirali a ga paari ba, ba le kali a moata nyakpiemu a moata Pi Yayirot a tuk Baal Zefon nyiŋla.
10Faaro ale ga tuak la, Izirali demma yaa zak nya ale Ejipiti demma a gɔk santiri a vi ba. Yɔgsum yaa yik ba ate ba kaari a wi Naawen. 11Ba yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Ka vie ale kan bo Ejipiti ate fi yaa ta ti jam gɔi kosikka po ayen ti kpi yaa? Ka boan le la ate fi nye a ta ti nyini Ejipiti nyini? 12Tama an weeni fu Ejipiti ayen, <Basi tidek ti nyiini, basi ate ti tom a te Ejipiti demma?> Ku ti le zunchoŋ ase ti nin tom a te Ejipiti demma a gaam ti nin kpi gɔnni po!>>
13Moosis yaa tulisi nuruma ayen, <<Ni kan chali yɔgsummoa. Ni zaani giŋgiŋ ate ni ale nya varibasika kaai ate Naawen a za wa ta jam jinla la. Ejipiti demma ate ni a nya ba jinla la ni kan ŋman nya ba. 14Naawen ale kpaliŋ a te ni. Ni tin nye diki.>>
15Ate Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Ka boa ate fi kaari a wi mi? Weeni Izirali demma ayen ba a cheŋ. 16Zak fi doani a teeri fi nisaŋa nyakpiemu zuk a poori nyiamu ate Izirali demma a va nyakpiemu po tɛŋ kosik zuk a taam. 17M le basi ate Ejipiti demma suiniima a pagra ate ba siŋ a vi ni.
