Ate m nya zula Faaro ale wa kpaliŋ nyeerisaŋa ale wa wusum duerisaŋa nyiŋ. 18Ejipiti demma ale seba ayen mi ka Naawen ase m nin va Faaro ale wa torokoma ale wa wusum duerisaŋa nyiŋ a nya zula.>>
19Ate Wen maarɔwa ale dɛ Izirali kpaliŋ nyeerisaŋa niŋ a cheŋ la yaa yeeri wadek a taam ba ŋaaŋ. Chiŋmanni ale a maari ba la a yeeri di dek ba niŋ a taam zaani ba ŋaaŋ, 20a yaa bo Ejipiti kpaliŋ nyeerisaŋa ale Izirali suŋsuŋ. Yɔkku meena chiŋmanni a ta ka legi a jam kauk kunyi ale ta bolim a jam kauk kunkula. Ba waai an moata wa choa yokku meena.
21Ate Moosis yaa teeri wa nisaŋa nyakpiemu zuk, ate yok kula meena Naawen a basi ate kori geŋ va pagrik a fuk nyakpiemu ate ku chim tɛŋ kosik. Ate nyaataŋa a poori, 22ate Izirali demma a cheŋ va nyakpiemu po tɛŋ kosik zuk a taam ate nyiam parik a bo ba juga ale ba gala.
23Ate Ejipiti demma a va ba, ate Faaro wusumaŋa ale wa torokoma ale wa wusum duerisaŋa a va siŋ nyakpiemu po. 24Yɔkku suŋsuŋ Naawen a yaa nya nyini bolimu ale chiŋmanni a nya Ejipiti kpaliŋ nyeerisaŋa a yaa basi ate butimka a jam. 25Wa nye kama ate ba torokoma wiilima a yeeri ate ba damka a tua. Ate Ejipiti demma a weeni ayen, <<Ni te ti cheŋ abe ti ge Izirali demma. Naawen ale kpaliŋ a maari ba a ta chaab ale Ejipiti.>>
26Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Teeri fi nisaŋa nyakpiemu zuk ate nyiamu a ŋmani a lik Ejipiti demma ale ba torokoma ale ba wusum duerisaŋa.>> 27Moosis a teeri wa doani nyakpiemu zuk, ate vari ale veenti la nyakpiemu a pilim ŋman bu jigini, Ejipiti demma a chali a cheŋ bu jigi, ate Naawen a chuiri ba a basi nyakpiemu po. 28Nyiamu a chali a ŋmani ŋaaŋ a lik torokoma ale wusum duerisaŋa, Faaro kpaliŋ nyeerisaŋa ale va Izirali demma a siŋ nyakpiemu po la. Ba wanyi mɛ la an vuugi ya.
29Alege Izirali demma a va nyakpiemu tɛŋ kosik zuk ate nyiam pagrik a bo ba juga ate m kala mɛ a bo ba gala. 30Dai dila danni Naawen yaa vari Izirali demma Ejipiti demma nisa po a basi, ate Izirali demma a nya Ejipiti demma ale kpi doa kunkɔŋni la. 31Izirali demma ale nya Naawen ale sak pagrim kpiemu ale Ejipiti demma la, nuruma yaa chali Naawen yɔgsum ale ta mariŋka ale wa ale Moosis wa tomteerɔwa.

Title: NYINIKA 15
Content:
1Moosis ale Izirali demma yaa yi yiini de a pak Naawen ayen. <<M le yi yiili a pak Naawen, diila wa zuak ka yegayega. Wusummu ale bu duerɔwa wa yuk basi nyakpiemu po. 2Naawen ka m pagrɔ ale m yiili, wa chim ka m varibasika. Wa ka m Wen, m be le pak wa, m kowa Wen, m be le zak wa yuenni a zaani. 3Naawen ka tugurik tɔŋdɔ, Naawen ale wa yuenni. 4Faaro torokoma ale wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma wa yuk ba basi nyakpiemu po. Faaro kpagi maŋsaŋa a siŋ ka Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku po. 5Nya liuŋtaŋa a lim ba. Ba siŋ liuŋku po ase tintain la.
6<<Naawen yaa, fi naamu zuaka bo fi juga nisaŋa po. Naawen yaa, fi juga nisaŋa a lik dachiaka nɔi. 7Fi naamu zuaka po, fi yuk baai ale kisi fu la a lɔnsi. Fi basi ate fi suipuurumu ale a de nna pɔkpɔk la a nyini a dɛ baai ale a zɛri fi wie ase wuuk la a basi. 8Fi nyueŋa vuusika a basi ate nyaataŋa a tigsi a vi chaab zuk. Nya tii ale a chali la a zaani giŋgiŋ ase parik la. Nya liuŋtaŋa a nye diki nyakpiemu suŋsuŋ.
9<<Dachiaka yaa nak suinum ayen, <Mi le vi a yik ba m le pai ba ŋantaŋa. M le gomsi a kɔlim ba meena. M le yeeri m gebik woŋka ate m nisaŋa a ko ba meena.> 10Alege fi peeri ale fi vuusumu ate nyakpiemu a lik ba. Ate ba siŋ tɛŋ ase nanlik la nyakpientaŋa po.
11<<Ka wana ale bo wenaŋa po a nye ase fi la, Naawen yaa? Ba waai a kan magsi chaab ale fu, diila fi ta tuilum kama a gaam ba meena. Nuru meena ale ta yɔgsum chala ale fu, abe ba pak fu, diila fi a tom ka wakinkagla? 12Fi teeri fi juga nisaŋa ate tɛŋka a nɛ ba.
13<<Fi ŋmanteka nyiŋ, fi le dɛ nuru baai ate fi da tuesi la niŋ. Fi pagrimu nyiŋ fi le gani ba ta cheŋ fi tuilum boka jigini. 14Tɛŋsaŋa nuruma ale wom ate ba nyiŋsa a gɔk, yɔgsum ale yik Filistia demma. 15Edom nalimaŋa yɔgsum ale yik ba, Moab niŋdeerɔma nyiŋsa ale kasim a gɔk, Keenan demma ale nyaliŋ a bɛ. 16Yɔgsum ale siŋ ba zuk. Fi nisa pagrimu nyiŋ ba le nye diki ase tintain la, Naawen yaa, ate fi nuruma ate fi da la a ga taamu. 17Fi le ta ba jam jo a vuk ba guuk kuui ate fidek soa la zuk, juijui ate fi Naawen a nye magsi fi boka la, jigi weleŋka ate fi Nyɔnɔwa a nye ale fi nisa la. 18Naawen ale dɛ wa naamu a kasim a cheŋ wuu.>>
19Faaro wusumaŋa ale torokoma ale wusum duerɔma a yaa siŋ nyiamu po, ate Naawen a ta nyakpiemu nyaataŋa a jam lik ba, alege Izirali demma a cheŋ tɛŋ kosik zuk a taam. 20Ate Miriam, Naawen biisiteerɔwa, Aaron tuawa a pai sinyak a nyo nisa po, ate nipooma meena a va wa ale sinyaksa a gɔk. 21Miriam yaa yi yiili a te ba ayen, <<Yi yiili a pak Naawen, diila wa yuenni a zuak kama. Wusum ale bu duerɔ wa yuk a basi nyakpiemu po.>>
22Ate Moosis yaa dɛ Izirali demma niŋ a ta ba nyini Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku jigini ate ba cheŋ a jo Sur Gɔnni po daa ŋata alege ba an nya nyiamoa. 23Ba le jam paari Mara la, ba an baga a nyu nyiamu diila bu tua kama. Dila ale soa ate ba a wi dula jigini ayen Mara la. 24Dila nyiŋ nuruma yaa jaa ŋuuni a ta chaab ale Moosis, a weeni ayen, <<Ti le nyu ka boa?>>
25Moosis yaa kaari wi Naawen, ate Naawen yaa dak diok a sak wa. Moosis yaa pai yuk a basi nyiamu po ate bu tagri a masa. Dula jigini Naawen yaa te ba sinsaga ale chamsi ba a nya. 26Wa weeni ayen, <<Ni dan kpesi a wom Naawen ni Wenni lueluk ale a nye dii ale nala wa nina po la ale kpesi a wom wa sinsaŋŋa ale a va ŋa meena, m kan ta nyiŋtuilaŋa dɛ ŋaai ate m ta jam Ejipiti demma zuk la a jam ni zuwa, diila ka Mi ale Naawen dii ale a tebi ni la.
27Ate ba yaa jam Elim, kauk kuui ate bulisa pi ale siye ale kpinkpatta tiisa pisiyopɔi, ate ba wari kali dula a moata nyiamu.

Title: NYINIKA 16
Content:
1Izirali naakuuni meena yaa nyini Elim a jam Sin Gɔi kosikka ale bo Elim ale Sinai suŋsuŋ la. Ku jam ka benni po chi kaai ale a saari siyewa la, ka daa pi ale ŋanu dai ba le basi Ejipiti la ŋaaŋnyiŋ. 2Gɔi kosikka po Izirali demma meena jam a ŋuuni kama a ta chaab ale Moosis ale Aaron. 3Izirali demma yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ku ti le zunchoŋŋa ase Naawen a nin poom ko ti Ejipiti tɛŋka po. Dula ti nyiem kali kama a gilim samɔnsa ale lanta a dɛ ŋandiintaŋa meena ate ti a yaali la, alege fi ta ti jam gɔnni de po ayen nuruma de meena a viiri.>>
4Ate Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<M le basi ate ŋandiinta nyini wenŋmazuk a siŋ a te ni. Nuruma a nyini daa meena a tigsi a zuak a magsi dai dila danni. Suik kude po m le nye ba a nya ase ba le va m sinsaŋŋa ya. 5Daa ŋayuebiwa danni ba tigsi ku paari naŋtuok nɔi buye a ta jam jo a dik daa ŋaye.>>
6Dila la Moosis ale Aaron yaa weeni Izirali demma meena ayen, <<Junɔi ni le seba ayen ka Naawen ale ta ni nyini Ejipiti a nyini. 7Abe saluik ni le nya Naawen zulaŋa, dii nyiŋla wa wom ni le ŋuuni a te wa la kama. Tama ka bana, ate ni ŋuuni a ta chaab ale ti?>> 8Moosis mɛ yaa weeni ayen, <<Ni le seba ayen ka Naawen ale te ni lanta ate ni ŋɔbi junɔinni ale ŋandiinta meena ate ni a yaali saluiku la, dii nyiŋla wa wom ni le a ŋuuni a ta chaab ale wa la kama. Tama ka bana? Ni kan ŋuuni a ta chaab ale ka tama, alege ka Naawen.>>
9Moosis yaa weeni Aaron ayen, <<Weeni Izirali demma meena ayen, <Ni jam Naawen niŋ, diila wa wom ni ŋuunika kama.>>
10Aaron ale boro a biisi a te Izirali demma meena la, ba yaa nya gɔnni geŋka, ate Naawen zulaŋa nyaksi a nyini chiŋmari po a nyini.
11Naawen a weeni Moosis ayen, 12<<M wom Izirali demma ŋuunika kama. Weeni ba ayen, <Junɔi ba le ŋɔbi lanta, abe saluik ba dɛ ŋandiinta a chak. Ate ni seba ayen Mi ale Naawen ni Wenni.
13Junɔi dila yeŋsa yaa jam sueri ba boka jigini, ate saluiku maglim yaa lo gilim ba boka jigini. 14Maglimu ale kpaanti la, ŋanta ase ŋmoruk tana la kabsa kabsa yaa doa tɛŋ gɔnni po. 15Izirali demma ale nya ŋantaŋa la, ba yaa bek chaab ayen, <<Ka boa ale nna?>> Diila ba zɛ le ka ŋan baai la. Moosis yaa weeni ba ayen, ka ŋandiin tii ate Naawen a te ni ayen ni dɛ la. 16Naawen abe le weeni diila ale nna. <Waai meena a tigsi a magsi wa le a yaali diila. Pai chin nɔi a magsi nuru meena ale bo viuku po la.
17Izirali demma yaa nye ba le weeni ba diila, ba gela tigsi yega, ba gela tigsi maga. 18Ba le magsi ale chinni la, waai ale tigsi yega an ta zuak gaam ya, waai mɛ ale tigsi maga la an ŋmasi ta fii fiiga. Waai meena a tigsi ka wa le a yaali diila.
19Moosis yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Waai a kan tali ŋantaŋa gela ate ku paari chum saluiwa.>>
20Alege ba gela an wom Moosis ale weeni diila, ale tali gela a ta paari saluik, ate nanzue a sueri ba po a nyuŋ. Moosis sui yaa jam a puuri ale ba.
21Saluik meena waai meena a tigsi ka wa le yaali diila, wenbinni a dan a nak ate ku tuila, ŋa nyaliŋ a bɛ. 22Daa ŋayuebiwa danni ba a tigsi ka buye, china ŋaye a magsi nuru yeŋ ate niŋdeerɔma a jam weeni a sak Moosis. 23Moosis yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna. <Chum ka vuusum dai, vuusum dai dii ale ta tuilum a te Naawen. Dila nyiŋ ni sɛ ni le a yaali ayen ni sɛ ŋan baai la abe ni dik ni le a yaali ayen ni dik ŋan baai la. Ŋan baai ale a tali la ni pai zaani ate ku paari saluik.> >>
24Ba yaa pai zaani ate ku paari saluik ase Moosis ale weeni diila alege ba an nyuŋ ya yaase nanzue a jo ba. 25Moosis yaa weeni ayen, <<Ni dɛ jinla, dii nyiŋla jinla ka Vuusum dai a te Naawen. Ni kan nya ŋandiinta tɛŋka jinla. 26Daa ŋayuebi ni tigsi ŋandiintaŋa alege daa ŋayopɔiwa, Vuusum danni, ŋandiinta kan boro.>>
27Alege dila meena nuruma gela a diem nyini kama daa ŋayopɔiwa danni ayen ba tigsi, alege ba an nya jaaboa. 28Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Nama taa ni zɛri m wieŋa ale m sinsaŋŋa vaka a paari ka dimpo? 29Ni ta ni popola po ayen Naawen a te ni Vuusum danni kama, dila ale soa ate daa ŋayuebiwa danni wa te ni ŋandiinta a magsi daa ŋaye la. Waai meena a bo wa le bo juijui la daa ŋayopɔiwa danni, waai a kan nyini peelim. 30Nuruma yaa vuusi daa ŋayopɔiwa danni.
31Izirali demma a jam a wi wenzuk ŋandiintaŋa ayen, ka manna. Ŋa jam peenti kama ase ŋanta bie la. A masa nna se boroborok faasiŋ ate ba nye ale siita la. 32Moosis a weeni ayen, <<Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna. <Pai wenzuk ŋandiinta chin nɔi a zaani magsi ni gaŋ sii ale za ba yiti la, ate ba nya ŋandiin tii ate mi te ayen ni dɛ gɔnni po diipo ate mi jam ta ni nyini Ejipiti a nyini la.> >>
33Moosis yaa weeni Aaron ayen, <<Pai jaab a pai wenzuk ŋandiinta chin nɔi a nyo du. Yaa pai zaani Naawen niŋ ate ti za a magsi ni gaŋ sii meena ale za ba yiti la.>>
34Naawen ale weeni Moosis la, Aaron yaa pai wenzuk ŋandiintaŋa a zaani Nɔiyeŋ Dakanni niŋ, ayen ba za. 35Izirali demma a dɛ ka wenzuk ŋandiinta a ga paari bena pisinaansi, ga paari tɛŋ kaai ale magsi kalik la. Ba dɛ ka wenzuk ŋandiinta ate ba yaa ga paari Keenan tɛŋ banni.
36Ŋanbie chin nɔi pisiye ale a chim boorik geli.

Title: NYINIKA 17
Content:
1Izirali demma tigsuŋku meena yaa basi Sin Gɔi Kosikka ale a nyiem ga de a ga de ase Naawen ale weeni diila. Ba ga kali ka Arefidim alege nyiam a ka du ate nuruma a nyu. 2Ba yaa nye kpaliŋ ale Moosis ayen, <<Te ti nyiam ate ti nyu.>> Moosis yaa tulisi ba ayen, >> Ka boa ate ni a nye kpaliŋ ale mu? Ka boa ate ni nye Naawen a nya?>>
3Alege nyanyuila a ta nuruma dula, ate ba a ŋuuni a ta chaab ale Moosis. Ba yaa weeni ayen, <<Ka boa ale soa ate fi ta ti nyini Ejipiti nyini ayen fi basi ate tama ale ti bisaŋa ale ti duŋsaŋa a kpi ale nyanyuila?>>
4Moosis yaa kaari wi Naawen ayen, <<Mi ale nye ka sɛ ale nuruma de? Ba gomsi kama ayen ba yuk mu ale tana.>>
5Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Cheŋ nuruma niŋ. Basi ate Izirali nisɔmma gela a va fu ate fi pai doa dii ate fi pai nak Nile benni nyiamu la a nyo fi nisa po a cheŋ. 6M le zaani dula fi niŋ Yoreb piuŋku tɛŋ. Nak piuŋku ate nyiam a nyini ku po a nyini ate nuruma a nyu.>> Moosis yaa nye nna Izirali niŋdeerɔma niŋ. 7Ate wa yaa wi dula jigini ayen Massaya ale Meriba dii nyiŋla Izirali demma a kpaliŋ kama ale nye Naawen nya a weeni ayen, <<Naawen tin bo le ti yaa wa ka?>>
8Amalek demma yaa jam nye kpaliŋ ale Izirali demma Arefidim. 9Moosis yaa weeni Josua ayen, <<Lueri ti nuruma gela a cheŋ ga nye kpaliŋ ale Amalek demma. Chum mi le zaani guuku zuk ale Naawen doani m nisa po.>>
10Josua yaa kpaliŋ ale Amalek demma ase Moosis ale weeni diila. Moosis ale Aaron ale Yur a jam jueli ka guuku zuk. 11Moosis ale zak wa nisaŋa wen diila, Izirali demma a nak a dɛ kama, alege diipo ate wa nisaŋa a siŋ tɛŋ la Amalek demma a nya nakdeka Izirali demma zuk. 12Moosis nisaŋa ale jiak la, ba yaa pai tain a dueni wa tɛŋ ate wa kali di zuk. Aaron ale Yur yaa zak wa nisaŋa ŋmai, wanyi bo kauk ate wanyi mɛ a bo kauk kunkula, ate wa nisaŋa a bo jigi yeŋ a ga siŋ wenni. 13Josua yaa nak dɛ Amalek tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale gebik woŋ.
14Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Ŋmarisi wanni de a dueni gbaŋ po ate ba a teeri abe fi seba ate fi te ti Josua wom, dii nyiŋla m le yeeri Amalek wie tɛŋka zuk ate ba kan teeri ba wari tɛŋka zuwa.>>
15Moosis yaa sɛ kuŋkuŋ a wi ku ayen nakdeka ku kiri, ale Naawen A Te Nakdeka. 16Wa weeni ayen, <<Nisima ale zak wen tuk Naawen naamu zukpaglika nyiŋ. Naawen ale kasim ta ka tugurik ale Amalek demma a ta cheŋ ba gaŋsa po meena.>>

Title: NYINIKA 18
Content:
1Yɔgyɔgla de Jetro, Midian kaabteerɔwa ale ka Moosis ŋachoba la, a wom dii meena ate Wen a nye te Moosis ale wa nuruma Izirali demma la, ale Naawen ale nye dii ta Izirali demma a nyini Ejipiti a nyini la.
2Moosis ale te ti wa powa Zippora a cheŋ la, wa ŋachobwa Jetro a tuesi wa kama 3ale wa nidoabilisa bayewa. Nidoabinni wanyi wa te wa yuei ayen ka Gersom, Moosis ayen, <<Mi chim ka nichaanɔ tɛŋ chaŋ po. 4Nwala yuei wa te ayen Ɛlieza, wa weeni ayen, <<Mi kowa Wenni ale jam chim mi maarɔ, wa vari mi a basi ate Faaro gebik woŋka an nye mu wari ya.>>
5Jetro, Moosis ŋachobwa ale Moosis bisaŋa ale wa powa a yaa va chaab a jam Moosis jigi gɔnni po, juijui ate ba tigsi boro a moata Wen guuku la. 6Jetro a poom te tomtomiŋ kama ayen, <<Mi fi ŋachobwa, ale fi powa ale wa bisa bayewa a cheen fi jigi.>>
7Moosis yaa nyini a tu wa ŋachobwa a koori tɛŋ a gbaari wa. Ba yaa puusi chaab ale jo viuku po. 8Moosis yaa weeni wa ŋachobwa dii meena ate Naawen a nye Faaro ale Ejipiti demma Izirali nyiŋla. Wa weeni wa mɛ ninam buui meena ate ba tu suiku po ate Naawen a nye dii a vari ba a basi la.
9Jetro sui jam peenti kama wa le wom wamaŋ sii meena ate Naawen a nye te Izirali demma a vari ba Ejipiti demma nisa po a basi la. 10Jetro weeni ayen, <<Mi a te Naawen pimpauk, waai ale vari fu Ejipiti demma ale Faaro nisima po a basi ale vari nuruma Ejipiti demma nisima po a basi la. 11Yɔgyɔgla de mi seba kama ayen Naawen a zuak gaam wen yona meena kama, wa nye nnala ale ka baai ale a nye Izirali demma gaasa la.>> 12Moosis ŋachobwa Jetro yaa ta juka tiirim ale kaab yonta jam te Wen, ate Aaron a jam ale Izirali nisɔmma ate ba dɛ ŋandiinta ale Moosis ŋachobwa Wen niŋ.
13Vari ale veenti la Moosis a yaa kali chim nuruma boteerɔ, ate nuruma a zaani gilim wa a nyini saluik a ga paari junɔi. 14Wa ŋachobwa ale nya Moosis a nye dii a te nuruma la, wa yaa weeni ayen, <<Ka boa ale nna ate fi nye a te nuruma? Ka boa ate fidek fi nyiini a kali ase boteerɔ la, alege ate nuruma de meena a za gilim fu a nyini saluik a ga paari junɔi ya?>>
15Moosis yaa tulisi wa ayen, <<Dii nyiŋla nuruma ale jam mi jigi ayen ba gisi Wen yaalika. 16Ase diipo meena ba dan ta chaab, ba ta a jam ka mi jigi, ate mi yaa nya bayewa wanni a weeni ba Wen le a weeni dii ale wa ŋmarisika ale wa sinsaŋŋa la.
17Moosis ŋachobwa yaa tulisi ayen, <<Fi le a nye diila an nala. 18Fi ale nuruma de ale a jam fi jigi la ale yoariŋ kama. Tuimaŋa a zuak kama a te fu, fi an baga a tom ŋa fidek fi nyiini. 19Be wom mi yɔgyɔgla de ate m sak fu, ate Wen a bo ale fu. Fi le magsi fi tagri nuruma a za Wen niŋ a ta ba wieŋa a jam wa jigi. 20Sak ba Wen sinsaŋŋa ale wa wieŋa, abe fi sak ba le ba boro dii ale tuim ŋaai ale magsi ba tomka la. 21Lueri nuru baai ale baga a nya wie zuk nuruma meena po, nuru baai ale a chali Wen, wensie nuruba baai ale kisi ba yaali ŋanta a te badek ate ba chim kpaga a nya tusa ale kobsa ale pisinuba ale piisa zuk. 22Basi ate ba chim nuruma boteerɔba diipo meena, alege ba ta wie ŋaai ale tua la a jam fi jigi, wie ŋaai ale kan tua la badek nya ŋa zuk. Kula ale basi ate fi tuimaŋa a valima a te fu, dii nyiŋla ni chari tuimaŋa kama. 23Fi dan nye dila a va chaab ale Wen sinsaŋŋa, fi le baga a zaani ale jiantaŋa de meena ate nuruma de mɛ meena a nya ba le a yaali diila abe ba kuli ale suipeentik.>>
24Moosis yaa wom wa ŋachobwa ale biisi diila a yaa nye wari meena ate wa weeni la. 25Wa lueri nuru baai ale baga wie zuk a nya la Izirali demma meena po, a basi ate ba chim kpaga nuruma zuk. Ba chim kpaga tusa ale kobsa ale pisinuba ale piisa zuk. 26Ba jam a tom ase ka boteerɔba la a te nuruba diipo meena. Wie ŋaai ale pagra la ba nyiem yaa ta jam ka Moosis jigi, alege wie ŋaai ale kan pagra la, badek a nya ŋa zuk.
27Ate Moosis yaa ta wa ŋachobwa Jetro a ga basi suik ate wa ŋman cheŋ wa tɛŋka.

Title: NYINIKA 19
Content:
1Izirali demma ale basi Ejipiti tɛŋka la, chiisa sitawa po dai dila danni dek ate ba jam Sinai Gɔi Kosikka po. 2Ba le basi Arefidim la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, ba jo ka Sinai Gɔi Kosik po ate Izirali demma yaa tigsi gɔnni guuku niŋ.
3Moosis yaa jueli Wen jigi, ate Naawen yaa wi wa guuk zuk a weeni ayen, <<Fi le fi weeni dii a te Izirali demma ale Jekob ŋaaŋ bisaŋa la ale nna. 4<Nama dek a nya mi le nye dii ale Ejipiti demma la kama ale mi ale ji ni ale jiiruk kinkaŋŋa a ta ni jam m dek jigi la kama. 5Yɔgyɔgla de ni dan wom ale ta m nɔiyeŋka, tɛŋsa meena po ni le chim m tuilum nuruba. Tɛŋka meena poom ka mi ale soa, 6ni le chim ka m kaabteerɔba ale tɛŋ weleŋ. Wie ŋaai ate fi le biisi a te Izirali demma la ale nna.>>
7Moosis yaa ŋman ga wi nuruma niŋdeerɔma a pai wie ŋaai meena ate Naawen a weeni ayen wa biisi la a dueni ba niŋ. 8Nuruma yaa maa chaab a siak ayen, <<Ti le nye dii meena ate Naawen a weeni la.>> Moosis yaa ta ba le tulisi diila a jam Naawen jigi.
9Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Mi le jam fi jigi ale chiŋmai sobluk, ate nuruma a wom mi le a biisi ale fu la ate ba kasim ta mariŋka ale fu.>> Moosis yaa weeni Naawen nuruma ale weeni diila.
10Ate Naawen a weeni Moosis ayen, <<Cheŋ nuruma jigi a gaari a magsi jinla ale chum. Basi ate ba sugri ba gattaŋa 11abe ni gomsi magsi daa ŋatawa danni, dii nyiŋla dai dila danni Naawen ale nyini Sinai Guuku zuk a siŋ nuruma meena niŋ. 12Te nuruma bana a gilim guuku abe fi weeni ba ayen, <Ni kpesi ate ni kan jueli guuku yaase ni tiri guuku kinni. Waai dek ale a tiri guuku la se ba ko wa. 13Ku a fɛ ate ba yuk wa ale tana yaase ba tɔŋ wa ale peema, ba kan pai nisa a tiri wa. Nurubiik yaase duŋ ba kan te wa boro yaase ka boro.> Ka ba nin peeri padiaka nyiini a mooli di ate ba yaa jueli guuku.>>
14Moosis ale nyini guuku zuk a siŋ nuruma jigi la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, wa yaa gomsi nuruma, ate ba sugri ba gattaŋa. 15Wa yaa weeni nuruma ayen, <<Ni gomsi nidek a magsi daa ŋatawa danni. Ni yeeri nidek chaab bobi goom po.>>
16Daa ŋatawa danni saluiku nanpansa ale nyaksika ale chiŋma sobluk a yaa bo guuku zuk ate damuniŋ a peeri ate ku jueli. Waai meena ale bo dula la nyiŋsa a gɔk. 17Moosis yaa dɛ nuruma niŋ a ta ba nyini ba boka jigini a nyini ayen ba tu Wen. Ate ba zaani guuku kiri. 18Sinai Guuku jam lik ale ka nyuisa, dii nyiŋla Naawen ale siŋ ku zuk ale bolim. Nyuisaŋa kasim a jueli wen ase bolim ŋiak nyuisa la. Guuku meena jam kasim a choa ka nna girigiri. 19Damuniŋka mɛ kasim kum a jueli nna yegayega. Moosis yaa biisi ate Wen a tulisi wa.
20Naawen yaa siŋ Sinai Guuku zuk a wi Moosis ayen wa jueli guuku zuk. Moosis yaa jueli 21ate Naawen a weeni wa ayen, <<Siŋ ga kaam nuruma ate ba kan fɛ jam ayen ba nya Naawen ate ba yega a kpi. 22Dan poom ka kaabteerɔma ale a jam Naawen jigi la, ku a fɛ ate ba gomsi badek a welema, dan kan daa di Naawen ale yik sui ale ba.>>
23Moosis yaa weeni Naawen ayen, <<Nuruma a kan baga a jueli Sinai Guuku, dii nyiŋla fidek ale kaam ti ayen, <<Te bana a gilim guuku abe fi gaari ku.>>
24Naawen yaa tulisi ayen, <<Siŋ tɛŋ a ta Aaron a jueli a jam ale fu. Alege kaabteerɔma ale nuruma kan fɛ jueli jam Naawen jigi ya, dan kan daa di wa le namsi ba.>>
25Moosis yaa siŋ nuruma jigi a weeni ba.

Title: NYINIKA 20
Content:
1Ate Naawen yaa biisi wieŋa de meena, 2<<Mi ale Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la, waai ale ta ni nyini Ejipiti a nyini yɔntidi tɛŋka po a nyini la.
3<<Kan ta wen yona a gum mi po.
4<<Kan nye bɔgluk ate ku a neesi jaab wenŋmazuk yaase tɛŋzuk yaase nyiam po a te fi dega. 5Kan koori tɛŋ a zuli ba yaase fi puusi ba, diila mi Naawen dii ale ka fi Wen la, ka nyuri Wen, a namsi bimbaansa ba koba biem nyiŋ a ta ga paari ba gaŋ sii ale a saari buta ale bunaansi la baai ale kisi mi la. 6Alege a sak ŋmanteka ale gaŋ sii ale saari tusidi a yaali mi ale ŋman ta m wieŋa la.
7<<Kan wi Naawen dii ale ka fi Wen la yuenni kinla, diila Naawen a kan basi waai ale a wi Wa yuenni kinla la.
8<<Kpesi Vuusum Danni abe fi basi ate di ta tuilum. 9Daa ŋayuebi pai tom fi tuimaŋa meena, 10alege daa ŋayopɔiwa danni ka Vuusum dai a te Naawen dii ale ka fi Wen la. Dai dila danni kan tom tuin yoŋŋoa. Fi dek kan tom yaase fi nidoabili yaase fi lie yaase tomteerɔ yaase dɔklie yaase niiga yaase nichaanɔ ale bo ale fu la. 11Diila ka daa ŋayuebi ate Naawen a pai nye wenzukku ale tɛŋka ale nyakpiemu ale ŋan baai ale bo bu po la, alege a vuusi daa ŋayopɔiwa danni. Dila nyiŋ Naawen yaa niak Vuusum danni ale basi ate di chim tuilum dai.
12<<A zuli fi ko ale fi ma ate fi goa tɛŋ kaai ate Naawen dii ale ka fi Wen la a pai a te fi la a benni.
13<<Kan ko nuru.
14<<Kan nye kaboŋŋa.
15<<Kan zu.
16<<Kan chim venta seerɔ a velim te fi vaanchoa.
17<<Kan ta kɔrisa ale fi vaanchoa yeri ya. Kan ta kɔrisa ale fi vaanchoa powa yaase wa tomteerɔ yaase wa dɔklie ale wa naab yaase wa boniŋa yaase jabuui ate fi vaanchoa a soa la.>>
18Nuruma ale wom nanpansaŋa ale nya nyaksika ale wom damuniŋka peeka ale nya guuku ale ta nyuisaŋa la, ba nyiŋsaŋa yaa gɔk ate yɔgsum a ta ba. Ba yaa wari za niŋ 19ale weeni Moosis ayen, <<Fidek a biisi a te ti, ate ti wom kan te Wen a biisi a te ti, kan daa di ti le kpi.>>
20Moosis yaa weeni nuruma ayen, <<Ni kan chali yɔgsum. Wen jam kama ayen wa nye ni nya, ate Wen yɔgsum a bo le ni ate ku kasi ni biem tomka.>>
21Nuruma a jam za ka niŋniŋŋa, ate Moosis a cheŋ legini po nna kpitɔ juijui ate Wen a boro la.
22Ate Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Weeni sak Izirali demma ayen. <Nidek nya kama ayen m biisi ale ni a nyini ka wenŋmazuk. 23Ni kan nye wena gela a gum mi po. Ni kan pai kpana yaase ligmɔniŋ a nye wena a te ni dega.
24<< <Ni pai tanta a nye kuŋkuŋ a kaab ni juka tiiritaŋa ale ni suiyɔgni tiiritaŋa ale ni piisaŋa ale ni booŋa ale ni niiŋa a te mi. Juijui meena ate mi a nye ate m yuenni a nya zula la, m le jam ni jigi a jam niak ni. 25Ni dan nye tana kuŋkuŋ a te mi, ni kan pai tana ŋaai ate ba a gomsi ŋa la a sɛ, diila ni ale taŋ ku kama ase ni a nin pai sɛka tana a sɛ ku. 26Abe ni kan jueli m kuŋkuŋku zuwa, dan kan daa di ba ale nya ni chaboala ku zuk.>

Title: NYINIKA 21
Content:
1<<Sinsaŋŋa de ale a magsi fi pai dueni ba niŋ.
2<<Ase fi dan da Yiburu tomteerɔ, wa magsi wa tom te fu ka bena ŋayuebi. Alege bena ŋayopɔiwa po basi wa fasiyaa, wa kan tuni jaaboa. 3Ase wa dan jam ka wadek wa nyiini, ku a magsi ka wa ŋman cheŋ wadek wa nyiini. Alege wa dan ta ka nipok diipo ate wa jam la, nipowa a va wa cheŋ. 4Ase wa kpagni a dan faari nipok a te wa ate wa biak nidoa yaase lie a te wa, nipowa ale wa bisaŋa ka wa kpagni ale soa, ka nidoawa nyiini ale wa cheŋ fasiyaa.
5<<Alege ase tomteerɔwa a dan weeni ayen, <Mi a yaali m kpagni ale m powa ale bisaŋa, m kan yaali m cheŋ m dek nyiini fasiyaa,> 6ate wa kpagni a ta wa cheŋ boteerɔma jigi. Wa yaa ta wa a cheŋ tuoku ate ba yaa vuri wa tuiri. Wa yaa le kasim chim ka wa kpagni tomteerɔ wa boka po meena.
7<<Ase nuru a dan yik wa lie a da ase tomteerɔ la, wa kan boro fasiyaa ase nidoa tomteerɔba ale ka diila. 8Ase wa dan kan nye ate wa kpagni waai ale lueri wa a te wadek la sui a yɔk ya, ku a fɛ ate wa kowa a da tuesi wa. Wa ka suik a pai wa da a te nichamma, wa ale kan ŋman ta siaka ale wa la nyiŋŋa. 9Ase wa dan lueri wa a te wa biik, ku a fɛ ate wa te wa suik ase lie la. 10Ase wa dan faari nipok wa choa, ku a fɛ ate wa kan mini pok kpagni ŋandiinta ale kɔlima yaase wa kan goa ale wa. 11Ase wa dan kan te nipowa ŋantaŋa de butawa, nipowa a baga a cheŋ fasiyaa kama a kan tuni ligri ku nyiŋŋa.
12<<Ase waai a dan kpaliŋ a ko nuru, ku a fɛ ate ba ko wa mɛ. 13Alege wa dan kan potim seba ale nye ya, alege ka Wen ale basi ate ku nye wa chali cheŋ juijui ate mi ale dak la. 14Alege nuru a dan potim seba ale ko waai, ni ta wa a nyini m kuŋkuŋku zuk a nyini a ko wa.
15<<Nuru waai a dan nye kpaliŋ ale wa ko yaase wa ma, ku a fɛ ate ba ko wa.
16<<Nuru waai a dan zu nuru a da, yaase wa ta nuruwa ate ba yik wa, ku a fɛ ate ba ko wa.
17<<Nuru waai a dan ka te wa ko yaase wa ma, ku a fɛ ate ba ko wa.
18<<Ase nuruba a dan kpaliŋ chaab ate wanyi a zak tintain a yuk wanyi yaase wa gurum nisa alege ate wa an kpi ya alege a ta doa a yuak, 19nuru waai ale chubi la ba kan nye wa wari ya ase nwala a nin yiti boro a cheŋ ale wa tachekka, ku a fɛ ate nuru waai ale chubi la a tuni waai ale koani la, wa le nye ate wa nya nyiŋyɔgsa a paari.
20<<Ase nuru a dan nak wa yɔma waai ale ka nidoa yaase nipok la ale doari, ate yɔmawa a deri kpi dila nyiŋ, ku a fɛ ate ba te waai ale nye dila la namsika, 21alege ba kan dari wa turi ase yɔmawa a nin yiti da dila danni yaase ku daa ŋaye po a boro a cheŋ dii nyiŋla, ka wa ale soa yɔmawa.
22<<Ase nuruba a dan kpaliŋ a nak nipok puuk ate wa biak diipo ale kan magsi la alege a potim nya tuemoa, waai ale nye dila la ku a fɛ ate wa tuni nipowa chorɔwa ale a weeni diila ate buusa boka dɔkku a te suik. 23Alege wa dan nya tuem yega, ni ko wa, 24wa dan kaasi ka wa num, ni kaasi wa mɛ num, dan ka nyin ni voori wa mɛ nyin, be dan ka nisa ni gebi wa mɛ nisa ku be dan ka naŋ ate wa gebi ni gebi wa mɛ naŋka. 25Fi dan ju waai ba ju fi mɛ, fi dan koani waai ba koani fu, fi bɛ dan te waai tuem ba te fi mɛ tuem.
26<<Ase nuru a dan nak nidoa yaase nipok tomteerɔ num a kaasi, ku a fɛ ate wa basi ate tomteerɔwa a cheŋ fasiyaa wa nummu ate wa kpagni a kaasi la nyiŋ, 27Ase wa be a dan nak nidoa yaase nipok tomteerɔ nyin a voori, ku a fɛ ate wa basi ate tomteerɔwa a cheŋ fasiyaa wa le voori wa nyini la nyiŋ.
28<<Ase lalik a dan chub nidoa yaase nipok a ko, ku a fɛ ate ba yuk lalikka ale tintana a ko, ni kan ŋɔbi ka lammu. Alege waai ale soa lalikka la, ni kan nye wa wari ya. 29Alege lalikka a daa chub ate ba kaam ka nyɔnɔwa alege ate wa an yik ka, ate ka ko nidoa yaase nipok, ku a fɛ ate ba yuk lalikka ale ka nyɔnɔwa a ko. 30Alege ku dan magsi wa tunika, wa baga tuni dii ale magsi la kama a vari wa nyuvunni a basi. 31Sinsaŋŋa de dek ale a tom tuima ase lalik a nin chub nidoabili yaase nipokbili. 32Ase lalikka a dan chub nidoa yaase nipok yɔma, lalikka nyɔnɔwa a tuni ligra a paari pisita a te yɔmawa kpagni abe ba yuk lalikka a ko.
33<<Ase nuru a dan lak goluk yaase wa tu goluk ale an si ku ate naab yaase boniŋ a lo du, 34golukku nyɔnɔwa ale wa tuni pamini. Ku a fɛ ate wa tuni ku nyɔnɔwa abe wa tanla duŋ kpiuku.
35<<Ase waai lalik kpaaŋ a dan kɔni a waai lalik kpaaŋ ate ka kpi, ku a magsi ka ba yik javukku a da a lab ligraŋa ale duŋ kpiuku a soa ase chaab la a te chaab. 36Alege ba dan seba ayen ka lalikka nyeka ale duŋsa chubika alege ka nyɔnɔwa an yik ka, ku a fɛ ate ka nyɔnɔwa a tuni, wa yik duŋ a tuni duŋka nyiŋ abe wa tanla duŋ kpiuku.

Title: NYINIKA 22
Content:
1<<Ase nuru a dan zu lalik kpaaŋ yaase posuk a tɔgri yaase wa pai da, ku a fɛ ate wa tuni niiga ŋanu lalik kpaaŋka nyiŋ abe wa tuni piisa ŋanaansi pa yeoŋku nyiŋ.
2<<Ase ba dan yik zue ale wa boro a zu ate ba ko wa, waai ale nye dila la an kaasi wariya ku nyɔnɔwa ziimu ale nyini la nyiŋŋa. 3Alege ku dan nye dila ka wenbinni ale pusi la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, kula nyɔnɔwa a kaasi kama, wa le ko nuruwa la nyiŋ. Ku a fɛ ate zue a pai jabuui ate wa zu la a te, alege wa dan kan ta jaaboa, ku a fɛ ate ba yik wa da a tuni pamini.
4<<Ase ba dan nya duŋ kaai ate wa zu la vuta wa jigi, duŋka yaase lalik kpaaŋka yaase boniŋ yaase posuk yoo, ku a fɛ ate wa tuni a vi.
5<<Ase nuru a dan ta wa duŋsa a nyini si dɛ wuuk a basi ate duŋsaŋa a jo waai laŋ yaase kaduk po, ku a fɛ ate wa pai wadek laŋ maŋ ale kaduk maŋ a te tuni.
6<<Ase bolim a daa dɛ kapeok ale za yaase laŋ meena waai ale beeri bolimu la, ku a fɛ ate wa tuni.
7<<Ase nuru a dan pai wa kpana yaase ŋanta a te wa vaanchoa ayen wa dueni a te wa, ate ba zu ŋa wa yenni po ate ba dan yik zuewa, ku a fɛ kama ate wa tuni ŋa ku nɔi buye. 8Alege ba dan kan nya zuewa, yenni nyɔnɔwa a jam buusa boorɔwa niŋ a pagsi wa nɔi ase ka wa ale pai wa vaanchoawa nitalimu yaa daa wa. 9Suik kuui meena po ate nuru a va a ta jaab ase boniŋ yaase lalik kpaaŋ yaase posuk yaase garuk yaase jabuui meena ale bei a bo fi jigi la, ate waai a dan yen wa lo kama, ku a fɛ ate wa tuni a te wa vaanchoawa ku nɔi buye.
10<<Ase nuru a dan pai wa boniŋ yaase lalik kpaaŋ yaase posuk yaa duŋ kaai meena a te wa vaanchoa ayen wa nya a te wa, ate ka kpi yaase ka koani yaa ba yik ka ate waai an nya ya, 11nanpaŋŋa ale bo baai bayema suŋsuŋ la, a nya wanni zuk ale pɛka Naawen niŋ ayen wa vaanchoawa an pai nisa a tiri wa nitalimu. Duŋka nyɔnɔwa ale siak kude ate tutuna a kan boro. 12Alege ba dan zu duŋka fi vaanchoawa jigi, ku a fɛ ate wa tuni ka nyɔnɔwa. 13Be dan ka duŋ waarik ka choa ale yik ka, wa ta lamboanaŋa a jam ate ba nya ate dila ale basi ate wa kan tuni ka nyiŋŋa.
14<<Ase nuru a dan piem duŋ wa vaanchoa jigi ate ka koani yaase ka kpi alege ka nyɔnɔwa an moata, ku a fɛ ate wa tuni. 15Alege ka nyɔnɔwa a dan moata duŋka, waai ale piem duŋka la a kan tuni jaaboa. Alege wa dan te ka ligra ale tuesi duŋka, wa le te lig dii ale tuesi ka la, a deri magsi duŋka ale bɛ la nyiŋ.
16<<Ase nuru a dan fɛ goa ale nipok kaliak kaai ale kan ta yoŋ la, ku a fɛ ate wa nye a kaa yaali ate wa chim wa pok. 17Ase nipok kaliaka kowa a dan zɛri an pai wa a te nidoawa, ku a fɛ ate fi diem tuni fi le magsi fi tuni dii a te waai ale kan seba nidoa la.
18<<Kan basi ate chichirik wiirik a vua.
19<<Nuru waai a dan goa ale duŋ, ku a fɛ ate ni ko wa.
20<<Waai a dan kaabi wen yoŋ alege daa Naawen ku a fɛ ate ba kaasi wa.
21<<Ni kan nye nichaanɔ viesiviesiga ate ku jo wa nyiŋŋa, diila nama a jam ka nicham Ejipiti tɛŋka po.
22<<Ni kan nya pukɔgi yaase kpiŋ a nueri. 23Ni dan nye dila ate ba kaari a te mu, m le wom ba kaarika. 24Mi sui ale puuri ate m ko ni ale gebik. Ni pooma ale chim pukɔga ate ni bisaŋa ale chim kpiŋsa.
25<<Ase ni dan peem ligra a te m nuruma baai ale bo ni po ate ku a silim wa la wanyi, ni kan nye ase baai ale peem ligra a te a yaali viila la. 26Ase fi dan tuesi fi vaanchoa gattiak ase peemka la, wenbinni ale di siŋka, ta cheŋ ga te wa, 27dii nyiŋla wa gattiaka meena ale la, ate wa ta a pili wa nyiŋka. Wa le pili ka boa a goa? Ase wa dan kaari a te mi, m le wom, mi ka waai ale ta jiirim.
28<<Kan nye dii ate Wen a kisi la yaase fi ka a te baai ale a nya fi nuruma zuk la.
29<<Kan peri ŋandiinta ale daamu tiiritaŋa ate ni te mi la. <<Ku a fɛ ate ni te mi ni bi kpaŋŋa. 30Ni nye dila dekdega a te mu ni niiŋa ale piisaŋa. Ni basi ate ŋa bo ale ŋa mama a paari daa ŋayopɔi, alege ni pai ŋa a te mi da naanika danni.
31<<Ni ale chim ka nuru baai ale ta tuilum. Dila nyiŋ ni kan ŋɔbi duŋ waarik ale yik duŋ kaai la lammoa. Ni yuk te baasa.

Title: NYINIKA 23
Content:
1<<Kan mooli venta wie a cheŋ. Be kan weeni venta wie a maari gaasa nyɔnɔ ate wa chim seerɔ waai ale a namsi nuruba.
2<<Kan va nuru boanni a nye a kaasi. Ni daa bo buusa, ni kan basi wensieŋa abe ni va nuru boanni, 3abe ni kan ŋman te jajak buusa boka po.
4<<Ase fi dan nya fi dachiak lalik kpaaŋ yaase wa boniŋ ale ka cheŋ a bɛ, yik ta ga te wa. 5Fi dan nya waai ale kisi fu la boniŋ ale ka ji ŋanta a lo, kan basi ka dula. Seba ate fi maari wa ate ka zaani.
6<<Ku a fɛ ate ni bo wensie buusa a te nuru waai ale jaŋ la. 7Ku a fɛ ate ni kan velimu ase nama ale a ŋma waai buusa dɔkku po la. Ni kan basi ate nuru waai ale kan seba wari nɔi po la yaase wensie nyɔnɔ a kpi, dii nyiŋla mi a kan nya waai ale nye kaasi la ase waai ale kan seba wari nɔi po la.
8<<Kan tuesi ligri a nyini waai ale a yaali fi velim buusa boka dɔkku po la, dii nyiŋla lig ŋala chaab a kan basi ate fi a biisi wensie. Dila a basi ate ka nuru maŋsa a velim.
9<<Kan namsi nichaanɔ. Nama dek seba nicham chimka ale ka diila kama, diila ni le jam chim ka nicham a bo Ejipiti tɛŋka po.
10<<Bena ŋayuebi ale a magsi ni pai bori ni tattaŋa a che ni ŋandiintaŋa, 11alege bena ŋayopɔiwa po ni kan kpa. Ate dila ale basi ate ŋanjaksaŋa ale bo ni po la a nya ŋandiinta a dɛ, ate duŋ waarisa a dɛ bala. Ni kaduksaŋa ale bo yeeŋa po la ni kan kpa, ni yɔna tiisaŋa mɛ ni kan nya si zuwa.
12<<Ni pai daa ŋayuebi a tom nidek tuima, alege daa ŋayopɔiwa danni ni kan tom, ate dila ale basi ate ni lalik kpaansaŋa ale bonsaŋa ale ni yɔmma ate ba biak ba ni yieŋa po la, ale nichamma a vuusi a nya nyiŋ pagra.
13<<Ni kpesi nidek a nye dii meena ate m weeni ni la. Ni kaa wi wen yona yue. Ni kan basi ate waai wom dila ni noaŋa po.
14<<Ben meena po ni dɛ tigi buta a te mu.
15<<Ni dɛ Tigi Dii Ŋandiinta Ate Dabinta a ka ti po la. Ni pai daa ŋayopɔi a dɛ ŋandiin tii ate dabinta a ka ti po la, ase m le weeni ni la. Ni nye kude diipo ate m dak la Abib chiika po ale ka dila po ate ni nyini Ejipiti tɛŋka po a nyini la. Waai a kan jam mi niŋ ale nikotta.
16<<Ni dɛ Ŋandiinta Tigini Ale Yɔna Ŋaai Ale Dɛ Niŋ a bɛ ni tattaŋa po la. Ni dɛ Ŋandiintaŋa Tigini Benni Kpeglimka Po, ase nama a nin tigsi ni ŋantaŋa ni tattaŋa po a ta jo.
17<<Buta meena benni po nidoama a magsi ba jam Nyɔnɔwa waai ale ka Naawen la niŋ kama.
18<<Kan te mi ziim ase kaabka la ate dabinta a bo bu po. Mi tigini kpapalaŋa tiiritaŋa ku a fɛ ate fi kan basi ate vari veenti ŋa.
19<<Ta ŋandiin tii ale dɛ niŋ a bɛ fi kaduksaŋa po la a jam Naawen fi Wenni yenni po. Be kan dik bu poali ku ma biisim po.>>
20<<Nya mi a tom ka Wen maarɔ ayen wa dɛ ni niŋ a nya ni zuk abe wa ta ni a jam juijui ate m gomsi la. 21Ni zaan nalimnyiini abe ni wom wa le a weeni diila. Ni kan nye tukpari ale wa. Wa kan vɔŋ te ni tukpanni, ayen mi Yuenni ale bo wa po la nyiŋŋa. 22Ni dan kpesi wom dii ate wa weeni la nalimnyiini ale nye dii meena ate m weeni la, mi ale chim dachiak a te ni dachaasaŋa abe m kan siak a te baai ale kan siak a te ni la. 23Mi maarɔwa ale dɛ ni niŋ a ta ni jam Amori ale Yit ale Perizzi ale Keenan ale Yivi ale Jebus demma tɛŋka po, ate mi ale ko ba. 24Ni kan koori tɛŋ ba wenaŋa niŋŋa yaase ni puusi ŋa yaase ni va ŋa nyeelaŋa. Ku a fɛ ate ni kaasi ŋa a bugsi ba tintanaŋa nna bunabuna. 25Ni puusi Naawen ni Wenni, ate wa niauŋku ale bo ni ŋandiintaŋa ale ni nyiamu zuk. M le yiak yuem ni jigi a basi, 26ate waai a kan biak a kaasi yaase wa chim kirik ni tɛŋka po. M le te ni nyuvuri woŋ.
27Mi ale basi ate mi yɔgsum a dɛ ni niŋ a basi ate tɛŋ meena ate ni le tu la a butim. M le basi ate ni dachaasaŋa meena a ŋman ba ŋaaŋ a yiti chali. 28Mi le tom waai ate ba a chali wa yɔgsum la, a dɛ ni niŋ a yiak Yivi ale Keenan ale Yit demma a basi nakpiak a te ni. 29Alege m kan yiak ba ka ben yeŋ po, dii nyiŋla tɛŋka ale doa ate gɔi duŋsa ale bo ka po a gilim ni. 30Mi ale yiak ba ka maga maga a te ni ate ku paari diipo ate ni le piisi a soa tɛŋka.
31<<Mi ale basi ate ni tɛŋ banni a nyini Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku a ga paari Filistia Nyakpiemu a nyini gɔnni a ta cheŋ ga paari Benni. M le pai nuruma ale bo tɛŋka po la a nyo ni nisima po ate ni yiak ba a basi. 32Ni kan nye nɔiyeŋ ale ba yaase ba wenaŋa. 33Ni kan basi ate ba bo ni tɛŋka po, ni dan basi ate ba boro, ba le basi ate ni nye biem a kaasi mi, dii nyiŋla ba wenaŋa puusika ale chim baruk a te ni.>>

Title: NYINIKA 24
Content:
1Ate wa yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Jueli jam Naawen jigi fi ale Aaron ale Nadab ale Abiyu ale Izirali nisɔm pisiyopɔiwa. Ni yalima ale mi a puusi, 2alege Moosis nyiini ale wa jam Naawen jigi. Mbala meena ku a fɛ ate ni kan moata. Nuruma mɛ a kan va wa a jam.>>
3Moosis ale jam ga weeni nuruma Naawen wieŋa ale wa sinsaŋŋa la, ba jam tulisi ale lueluk yeŋ ayen, <<Dii meena ate Naawen a weeni la ti le nye.>> 4Moosis yaa ŋmarisi dii meena ate Naawen a weeni la a dueni. Dai dii ale paasaŋ la, saluik yokyokwa wa yaa yiti a sɛ kuŋkuŋ guuku chiak, a feri tintana pi ale ŋaye a sɛ zaŋŋa la, ate ŋa tagri za Izirali buuni pi ale ŋayewa nankula po. 5Ate wa yaa tom Izirali nidoa paalukku, ate ba nye tiirim juka a kaab lalik paalisa ase suiyɔgni tiirita la a te Naawen. 6Moosis yaa pai ziimu geli a nyo kuta china po, ale pai geli ndila a misi basi kuŋkuŋku zuk. 7Wa yaa pai Nɔiyeŋka Gbaŋka a kariŋ te nuruma. Ate ba tulisi ayen, <<Ti le nye dii meena ate Naawen a weeni la. Ti le siak a te wa.>>
8Moosis yaa pai ziimu a misi basi nuruma nyiŋ ale weeni ayen, <<Kude ka nɔiyeŋka ziimu ale la ate Naawen a nye ale ni a magsi chaab ale wieŋa de.>>
9Moosis ale Aaron ale Nadab ale Abiyu ale Izirali nisɔm pisiyopɔiwa yaa jueli nya Izirali Wenni. 10Wa naŋtaataŋa po a jam a nye ase ka suik ate ba pai tintain sobta a nye la, ku jam ka nna cheri ase chiŋmanni dek la. 11Alege Wen sui an jam puuri ale Izirali niŋdeerɔma dɛ. Ba jam nya Wen kama ale jam dɛ ale nyu.
12Naawen a weeni Moosis ayen, <<Jueli mi jigi guuku zuk a bo dela, ate m pai tintain paglaksaŋa ale m sinsaŋŋa ale m wieŋa ate m ŋmarisi la a te fu a magsi ba sakka.>>
13Moosis yaa cheŋ ale Josua wa pasaŋdoawa, Moosis a jam jueli ka guuku zuk Wen jigi. 14Wa weeni nisɔmma ayen, <<Ni limisi ti dela ate ku paari diipo ate ti le ŋman jam ni jigi la. Aaron ale Yur a bo ale ni kama, nuru waai a dan ta wari, wa cheŋ ba jigi.>>
15Moosis ale jam jueli guuku zuk la, chiŋmari a yaa lik, 16ate Naawen zulaŋa nyaksika a jam Sinai Guuku zuk. Chiŋmanni a jam bo dula ka daa ŋayuebi, daa ŋayopɔiwa danni Naawen yaa wi Moosis a nyini chiŋmanni po. 17Izirali demma jigi Naawen zulaŋa a jam a nye ase ka bolim ale a dɛ la guuku zuk. 18Moosis yaa ga jo chiŋmanni po, ase wa le a jueli guuku zuk la. Wa jam bo guuku zuk ka daa pisinaansi ale yɔkta pisinaansi.

Title: NYINIKA 25
Content:
1Naawen a yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 2<<Weeni Izirali demma ate ba ta tiirita a jam te mu. Fi magsi fi tuesi tiirimu a te mu a nyini ka nuru waai meena suinum ale a weeni wa ayen wa te la. 3Tiirim tii ate fi le tuesi ba jigi la ale nna. Ligmɔniŋ ale kpana ale kutuk mɔnuŋ 4garuk miik sobluk ale garuk miik ŋmiŋmiruk ale garuk miik mɔnuŋ ale gattiak peelik kaai diak ale pagra la ale buuk kɔbta. 5Tuesi piisa gbaŋ sii ate ba tak ale muni si la ale gbaŋ maŋsa ale siik daata 6ale kpaam a magsi bolimu ale tinaŋsa a magsi naam bobika kpaamu ale ŋanti baai nyum ale masa la. 7Ale tintain ŋaai ale gamisi ale tintain yona ŋaai ale a nyaksi a pai ŋa a maŋ garuk genni ale jabuui ale a lik suinummu la nyiŋ.
8<<Abe fi yaa basi ate ba nye weleŋsa boka jigi a te mu ate m bo ba suŋsuŋ. 9Nye viuku de ale ku ponni ŋantaŋa meena ale a zaani du la a magsi chaab ale m le za m sak fu diila.
10<<Basi ate ba pai siik daata a nye nɔiyeŋka dakanni ate di magsika woglimmu a paari anamagib bunu abe labsimu a chim anamagib buta ate ku juelika a paari anamagib buta. 11Pai cheri ligmɔniŋ a taari di ponni po ale di ŋaaŋka meena, ale pai ligmɔniŋ a gebiri a gilim di noawaaŋa. 12Nye ligmɔniŋ baŋsa sinaansi a maŋ di naŋsa sinaansiwa, baŋsa siye meena a bo ganaŋa. 13Abe fi yaali siik daata a pai ligmɔniŋ a taari ti zuk. 14Pai daataŋa a su baŋsaŋa ale bo dakanni ganaŋa la a magsi yik jika. 15Da woŋtaŋa abe kasim bo dakanni baŋsaŋa nyiŋ po, ni kan yeeri ti. 16Abe fi pai m sinsaŋŋa piwa ale ŋmarisi doa tintain paglaksa siyewa nyiŋla a nyo dakanni po.
17<<Nye biem duisi basika nanlikka ale cheri ligmɔniŋ. Ka woglimmu a paari anamagib bunu ate labsimu a paari anamagib buta. 18Abe fi pai ligmɔniŋ mɛ ŋanta ase ŋanvuta baye ate ba ta kinkaŋŋa a za nanlikka zuk ate ba tuk chaab. 19Ŋanvutaŋa wanyi a zaani nanlikka nɔi abe m wala mɛ a zaani kpeglimka. Nye ba meena a basi nanlik yeŋka nɔi, ŋayewa nɔi waaŋa zuk. 20Ŋanvutaŋa kinkaŋŋa a zak wen a lagri a lik nanlikka. Ŋanvutaŋa a zaani a tuk chaab a nya nanlikka geŋsa. 21Pai nanlikka a vi dakanni zuk a pai nɔiyeŋka a nyo di po. Nɔiyeŋ kaai ate mi ale te fu la. 22Dula jigini nanlikka zuk, ŋanvutaŋa de bayewa suŋsuŋ, ale bo nɔiyeŋka dakanni zuk la, m le tu fu a te fu m sinsaŋŋa meena a magsi Izirali demma.
23<<Pai siik daata a nye jazaanimu. Ku woglimmu a chim anamagib bunaansi abe labsimu a chim anamagib buye abe ku juelika anamagib buta. 24Pai cheri ligmɔniŋ a taari ku abe fi pai ligmɔniŋka a gebiri gilim ku. 25Abe fi nye jagigiluk ate ku labsa ase nitali la a gilim ku a pai ligmɔniŋ a gebiri ku a gilim noawaaŋa. 26Pai ligmɔniŋ a nye baŋsa sinaansi a magsi jazaanimu gugotta tinaansiwa juijui ate naŋsaŋa sinaansiwa a boro la. 27Baŋsaŋa a magsi si moata ka noawaaŋa a yik daataŋa ate ba pai a ji jazaanimu la a tara. 28Abe fi yaali siik daata pai ligmɔniŋka a taari ti, abe ni yik jazaanimu ale daata. 29Pai cheri ligmɔniŋ a nye ku taasi tanlaŋsaŋa ale chinaŋa a magsi ŋan baai nyum ale masa la, ale ku leŋsaŋa ale taasaŋa ate ba ta a kpiiri daam tiiritaŋa la. 30Ni pai mi niŋ boroboroku a dueni jazaanimu zuk ate ku kasim bo mi niŋ daa meena.
31<<Kuri cheri ligmɔniŋ a nye zeuŋ jazaanim ku kinni ale nyiŋka ale ŋan baai ale nye ase puuta beerisa la ale naŋsaŋa ate ba meena a bo jigi yeŋ. 32Zeuŋku naŋsaŋa a chim siyuebi, sita a bo kaukku kunyi, sita mɛ a bo kauk kunkula. 33Nye beerisa sita ate si a niesi almond puuta a bo naŋ kanyi zuk, sita a bo naŋ kinkala zuk, nye dila dek a basi naŋsa siyuebiwa zuk meena ale tom zeuŋ jazaanimu nyiŋla. 34Be nye zeuŋ jazaanimu zuk beerisa sinaansi ate si a niesi almond puuta. 35Puuk fiik kunyi ale magsi ku bo naŋsa siyewa ale dɛ niŋ ka a teeri nyini zeuŋ jazaanimu nyiŋla, ate buyewa po, puuk fiik a bo naŋsa siyewa nyiŋ, ate butawa po, puuk fiik a bo naŋsa sitawa nyiŋ, si meena ka naŋsa siyuebi. 36Puuk fiisaŋa ale naŋsaŋa meena a bo ka jigi yeŋ ale zeuŋ jazaanimu, ka cheri ligmɔniŋ ate ba le kuri a nye ŋantaŋa de.
37<<Yaa nye zeuŋta tiyopɔiwa a pai ti a zaan du ate bu a nya peelimmu po meena. 38Pai cheri ligmɔniŋ a nye boom ŋangebinta ale taasi tanlaŋsaŋa. 39Ka cheri ligmɔniŋ dobrim ase boorik yeŋ la ate ba pai nye zeuŋ jazaanimu ale ŋantaŋa de meena. 40Seba ate fi nye kude a va chaab ale dii meena ate m sak fu guuku zuk la.

Title: NYINIKA 26
Content:
1<<Nye viuku garuk palaŋa pi, ale gattiak peelik kaai diak ale pagra la ale garuk miik sobluk ale garuk miik ŋmiŋmiruk ale garuk miik mɔnuŋ. Basi ate nuru a yɔk ŋanta ase ŋanvuta garuk palaŋa nyiŋ. 2Garuk palaŋa meena a soa ase chaab la, ŋa magsika woglimmu a paari anamagib pisinu ale buyuebi ate ŋa labsimu a paari anamagib naaniŋ. 3Pa garuk pala ŋanu a baali maŋ chaab abe fi nye nŋala ŋanuwa mɛ dila. 4Pai garuk pali sobluk a nye ŋanyiŋta garuk panni kpeglimka, nye ndila mɛ dila degadega. 5Nye ŋanyiŋta pisinu, garuk yeŋ nyiŋ abe fi ŋman nye ŋanyiŋta pisinu a basi ndila kpeglimka ate ŋanyiŋtaŋa a tuk chaab. 6Nye ligmɔniŋ ŋanta pisinu a kpi garuk pala buyewa a maŋ chaab ate viuku a chim bunyi.
7<<Pai buuk kɔbta a nye garuk pala pi ale dinyi a lik viuku. 8Garuk pala pi ale dinyiwa meena a soa ase chaab la. Ŋa magsika woglimmu a paari anamagib pisiyuebi abe ŋa labsimu a paari naaniŋ. 9Pai garuk pala ŋanu a maŋ chaab abe fi pai ŋayuebiwa mɛ a maŋ chaab. Kpamsi ŋayuebiwa buye a yik viuku niŋ. 10Nye ŋanyiŋta pisinu a kpi garuk palaŋa kpeglimka abe fi nye ndila kpeglimka mɛ dila ate fi baali maŋ chaab la kpeglimka. 11Nye kutuk mɔnuŋ ŋanyiŋta pisinu abe fi pai ŋanyiŋta a tuiri kpi garuk palaŋa kpeglimka a maŋ chaab. 12Alege viuku garuk palaŋa, garuk pali genni ale tali la a magsi di yik ka viuku ŋaaŋ. 13Viuku garuk panni magsika woglimmu a chim anamagib buye kabtaŋa meena. Dii ale tali la a yaa le yik a lik ka viuku ganaŋa. 14Be pai padiak gbana a mun si lik viuku abe fi pai gbaŋ maŋsa a lik ŋmani.
15<<Pai siik zaŋŋa ŋaai ale teenti la a magsi viuku. 16Zaŋŋi dinyi meena magsika woglimmu a paari anamagib pisiye abe di labsimu a paari anamagib buta, 17abe kpaasa ŋaye meena a feri ŋa ate ŋa kan tu chaaba. Nye viuku zaŋŋa meena wayeŋ. 18Yaali zaŋŋa pisiye a zaani viuku yeseoku geŋsa 19abe fi yaali kpana gola pisinaansi a chɔgsi ŋa, zaŋi yeŋ meena a su gola ŋaye po, dinyi meena a bo goluk yeŋ po. 20Alege kauk kunkula viuku wiilukku geŋsa zaani zaŋŋa pisiye 21ale kpana gola pisinaansi, nye gola ŋaye meena a magsi zaŋi yeŋ. 22Yaali zaŋŋa ŋayuebi a zaani viuku yeniŋ geŋsa. 23Yaali zaŋŋa ŋaye zaani viuku kpeglimka gugotta tiyewa po. 24Gugotta tiyewa de po, zaŋŋa a chim ŋaye a nyini tɛŋ a jueli ŋmai a jo voan yeŋ po. Zaŋŋa buyewa mɛ a chim dila. 25Ku yaa le chim ka zaŋŋa naaniŋ ale kpana gola pi ale ŋayuebi ate zaŋi yeŋ a soa gola ŋaye.
26<<Ŋman yaali siik chibsa. Sinu meena a magsi viuku kauk kunyi zaŋŋa, 27sinu mɛ a bo kauk kunkula, sinu mɛ a vi zaŋŋa ale bo viuku yeniŋka kpeglimka la. 28Suŋsuŋka chimmu a magsi bu vi zaŋŋa zuk a nyini ka kpeglimka a ga paari kpegli kinkala. 29Nye ligmɔniŋ a taari zaŋŋa zuk, nye ligmɔniŋ baŋsa a su zaŋŋa ate si yik chibsaŋa abe fi nye ligmɔniŋ mɛ a taari chibsaŋa zuk.
30<<Ti viuku a magsi chaab ale fi ale nya dii a nyini guuku zuk la.
31Yɔk garuk pali ale garuk miik ase sobluk la ale ŋmiŋmiruk ale mɔnuŋ ale gattiak peelik ate ka diak a pagra la; ate nuru a yɔk ŋanta ase ŋanvuta la a kali garuk panni nyiŋ. 32Pai garuk panni ale ligmɔniŋ ŋanyiŋta a yik siik daata tinaansi nyiŋ, ate ligmɔniŋ a taari ti zuk a za kpana gola ŋanaansi po la. 33Pai garuk panni a yik ŋanyiŋtaŋa nyiŋ a pai nɔiyeŋka dakanni a zaani garuk panni ŋaaŋ. Garuk panni ale labi jigi dii ale ta tuilum la a nyini jigi dii ale ŋmasi ta tuilum la. 34Pai biem duisi basika nanlikka a vi nɔiyeŋka dakanni zuk jigi dii ale ŋmasi ta tuilum la. 35Ta jazaanimu a nyini garuk panni jigini a zaani viuku wiilukku geŋsa a pai zeuŋtaŋa ale a zaani jabuui zuk la a zaani yeseoku geŋ a tuk ku.
36<<Nansuiŋku ale a jo viuku po la, yɔk garuk pali ale garuk miik sobluk ale garuk miik ŋmiŋmiruk ale garuk miik mɔnuŋ ale gattiak peelik ate ka diak a pagra la, ate nuru a yɔk garuk panni nyiŋ. 37Nye ligmɔniŋ ŋanyiŋta a magsi garuk panni de ale zauŋ zaŋŋa ŋanu a pai ligmɔniŋ taari du. Pai zaŋŋa a zaani kutuk mɔnta zuk.

Title: NYINIKA 27
Content:
1<<Pai siik daata a nye kuŋkuŋ ate ku juelika magsika a chim anamagib buyuebi abe ku nye ŋmɔgluk, ate ku woglimmu magsika a chim anamagib pi abe ku labsimu magsika mɛ a chim anamagib pi. 2Nye nyiila a basi gugotta tinaansiwa meena po, ate nyiilaŋa ale kuŋkuŋku meena a chim bunyi, pai kutuk mɔnuŋ a taari kuŋkuŋku. 3Pai kutuk mɔnuŋ a nye ŋantaŋa de meena, ku samɔnsaŋa ate ba ta a vaari buntuemmu la ale ku saabulutaŋa ale chin ŋaai ate ba ta a misi la ale duisuk nyinaŋa ate ba ta a yeeri lam la ale bolim chinaŋa. 4Pai kutuk mɔnuŋ a nye jaab ase ŋoari la, pai kutuk mɔnuŋ a nye baŋsa a basi gugotta tinaansiwa meena po. 5Pai ku a nyo kuŋkuŋku po ate ku nyini kinni po a jueli bo ku suŋsuŋsa po. 6Yaali siik dawoŋta a feri kuŋkuŋ a pai kutuk mɔnuŋ a taari ti zuk. 7Daataŋa a magsi ti su ka baŋsaŋa po a bo kuŋkuŋku ganaŋa ŋayewa ase ba nin zak ku a ji. 8Pai tapaga a nye kuŋkuŋku ate ku lak. Nye ku dila dekdega ase fi ale nya dii guuku zuk la.
9<<Nye dabiak a te viuku. Yeseoku geŋka nye garuk palaŋa ate woglimmu magsika a chim anamagib kobsiye abe ku ta gattiak peelik kaai diak ale pagra 10ale zaŋŋa pisiye ale kutuk mɔnuŋ gola pisiye ale kpana ŋanyiŋta a su yik zaŋŋa nyiŋ. 11Wiilukku geŋsaŋa nye garuk pala ate woglimmu magsika a chim anamagib kobsiye abe ku ta garuk pala ale zaŋŋa pisiye ale kutuk mɔnta gola pisiye ale kpana ŋanyiŋta.
12<<Yeniŋka geŋsa nye garuk pala ate labsimu magsika a chim anamagib kook abe ka ta garuk pala ale zaŋŋa pi ale gola pi. 13Kori geŋka nye dabiaka labsimu magsika ate ku chim anamagib kook. 14Garuk palaŋa magsika woglimmu a chim anamagib pisita a bo nansuiŋku kauk yeŋ ale zaŋŋa ŋata ale kutuk mɔnuŋ gola ŋata ale 15garuk pala ate ŋa magsika woglimmu a paari anamagib pisita ale magsi ŋa bo kauk kunkula ale zaŋŋa ŋata ale gola ŋata.
16<<Nansuiŋku ale a jo dabiaka po la, yaali garuk miik sobluk ale garuk miik ŋmiŋmiruk ale garuk miik mɔnuŋ ale gattiak peelik ate ka diak a pagra la, ate di woglimmu magsika a paari anamagib pisinaansi. Nuru waai ale seba yokka la a nye dila a su daata tinaansi ale gola ŋanaansi nyiŋ. 17Zaŋŋa meena ale gilim dabiaka la a taari ale ka kpana ale magsi ti ta kpana ŋanyiŋta a bobi a su kutuk mɔnuŋ golaŋa po. 18Dabiaka magsika woglimmu a chim anamagib kobsiye abe ka magsika labsimu mɛ a paari anamagib kook abe garuk pali peelik kaai ate ka diak a pagra la juelika magsika a chim anamagib pi ale kutuk mɔnuŋ gola. 19Ŋanta mbala meena ate ba ta a tom viuku tuima la, a maa pai viuku kpaasa piika ale dabiaka kpaasa piika, a magsi ŋa chim ka kutuk mɔnuŋ.
20<<Weeni ate Izirali demma a ta kpaam buui ale nye cheri ate ba ŋmiak a ta nyini kpaam tiib yɔna po a magsi bolim zeuŋtaŋa la a jam, ate dila ale basi ate bolimu a kasim a de. 21Tuka viuku po, garuk panni peelim, juijui ale bo nɔiyeŋka dakanni niŋ la, Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa a magsi ba ta bolimu ate bu a dɛ Naawen niŋ, a nyini junɔi a ta ga paari saluik. Kude ale chim ka ŋmarisi kaai ale ka boro a te Izirali demma gaŋsaŋa.

Title: NYINIKA 28
Content:
1<<Aaron fi suoku a maa ta wa nidoabilisaŋa Nadab ale Abiyu ale Eleaza ale Itamar ale bo Izirali demma po la a jam te fu ayen ba tom a te ase kaabteerɔba la. 2Nye gattaŋa ate ti ta tuilum a te fi suoku Aaron, ate ku te wa yuei ale zula. 3Weeni nuru baai meena ale seba tuima ate m te ba yam ate suiku de po ba a nye gattaŋa a te Aaron a gaari wa ate wa tom a te mi ase kaabteerɔ la. 4Gattaŋa de ate ba kala ayen ba nye la. Ka kuui ale a lik suinum ale garuk geli ale garuk woŋ ale garuk kuui ate ba yɔk la, ale zutɔk ale chiak gbain. Ba magsi ba nye gattaŋa de ate ti ta tuilum a te fi suoku Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ate ba tom a te mi ase kaabteerɔba la. 5Pai ligmɔniŋ garuk miik ale garuk miik sobluk ale garuk miik ŋmiŋmiruk ale garuk miik mɔnuŋ ale gattiak peelik kaai diak ale pagra la a nye gattaŋa de.
6<<Waai ale seba tuima la pai ŋantaŋa de a nye garuk genni, ligmɔniŋ garuk miik ale garuk miik sobluk ale garuk miik ŋmiŋmiruk ale garuk miik mɔnuŋ ale gattiak peelik kaai diak ale pagra la. 7Nye ŋmankpala ŋaye ate garuk genni ate ŋa maŋ di gugottaŋa tiyewa nyiŋ, ate dila ale basi ate di yik wa a magsi. 8Ku chiak gbainni ate ba yɔk nalimnyiini la, a magsi di nye ase ka garuk genni dek la, a bo garuk genni nyiŋ ate ba yɔk ligmɔniŋka garuk miik ale garuk miik sobluk ale garuk miik ŋmiŋmiruk ale garuk miik mɔnuŋ ale gattiak peelik kaai diak ale pagra la.
9<<Pai tintain ŋaai ale gamisi ŋaye a maŋ du a ŋmarisi Izirali nidoabilisaŋa yue ŋa nyiŋ, 10a ta va ba biamu ale ka diila. Ŋmarisi yue ŋayuebi tanni dinyi nyiŋ, abe fi ŋmarisi nŋala ŋayuebiwa mɛ tintain ndila nyiŋ. 11Ŋmarisi Izirali nidoabilisaŋa yue a nyo tanaŋa ŋayewa de nyiŋ ase baai ale a ŋmarisi tana po diila. Pai tanaŋa a vi ligmɔniŋ zuk. 12Pai tana ŋaye ate ŋa yik ŋa a tanla garuk genni ŋmankpalaŋa zuk ase tintain ŋaai ale ŋa chim teerika a te Izirali nidoabilisaŋa. Aaron ale wa ta yueŋa de wa ŋmankpalaŋa zuk ase teerika la Naawen niŋ. 13Nye ligmɔniŋ ŋanta baye ate ba yik tanaŋa a tanla 14ale cheri ligmɔniŋ chɔrima ŋaye ase miik la a tuiri chɔrimaŋa a maŋ chaab ale yueŋa ale ŋmarisi juijui la.
15<<Nye jabuui ale a lik suinum la ate ku maari ate wa a zɔk zɔga. Baai ale seba yɔkka la pai ligmɔniŋ garuk miik ale garuk miik sobluk ale garuk miik ŋmiŋmiruk ale garuk miik mɔnuŋ ale gattiak peelik, kaai diak ale pagra la a nye suinum jaligimmu ase garuk genni la. 16Ku a magsi ka di nye ŋmɔgluk ate di magsika woglimmu a paari anamagib bunyi abe di labsimu mɛ a chim anamagib bunyi a kpamsi buye. 17Pai tintana dueni vuuta tinaansi ku nyiŋ. Vuuk kuui ale dɛ niŋka la, ku a magsi ka tintain munta ale tintain ŋaai ale a nye ase dubuulim la ale tintain paata. 18Vuuk kuui ale saari tiyewa ka tintain ŋmiŋmirita ale tintain sobta ale tintain ŋaai ale a nye ase gunungoona la. 19Vuuta titawa ka tintain bibituk ale tintain paasa ale tintain ŋaai ale a nye ase busumbooŋ la. 20Vuuta tinaansiwa po ka tintain salima ale tintain ŋaai ale gamisi ale tintain mɔnta. Pai ligmɔniŋ a vi ŋa zuk ate ŋa yik ŋa a maŋ chaab. 21Ku a magsika ŋa chim tintana pi ale ŋaye, dinyi meena zuk a magsi Izirali nidoabilisaŋa wanyi wanyi meena yuei a ŋmarisi du, dinyi meena zuk a ŋmarisi Izirali buuni wanyi wanyi yuei a dueni du.
22<<Alege suinum jaligimmu pai cheri ligmɔniŋ a nye chɔrima ase miik la. 23Nye ligmɔniŋ baŋsa siye a magsi di a pai si a maŋ garuk genni ŋmankpala ŋayewa gugottaŋa po. 24Pai ligmɔniŋ chɔrima ŋayewa a tuiri baŋsaŋa ale bo suinummu jaligimmu gugottaŋa po la, 25Abe chɔrimaŋa ŋayewa kpeglimka ale a su vie ŋayewa po la, a maŋ chaab garuk genni ŋmankpalaŋa niŋka. 26Nye ligmɔniŋ baŋsa siye a maŋ nsila siyema ale bo suinum jaligimmu gugottaŋa po a moata garuk genni la. 27Ŋman nye ligmɔniŋ baŋsa siye a pai si a maŋ suinummu jaligimmu tɛŋka garuk genni niŋka, a moata vuurisa siyewa ale tu chaab a bo garuk genni chiak gbainni ŋmai la. 28Bobi suinum jaligimmu baŋsaŋa a maŋ garuk genni baŋsaŋa ale garuk miik sobluk, a tom chaab ale chiak gbainni, ate suinum jaligimmu a kan cheŋ nyini peelim abe ku ge garuk genni.
29<<Diipo meena Aaron a daa jo jigi dii ale ta tuilum la, wa nyiem pai Izirali nidoabilisaŋa yueŋa a yik ka wa kuusini nyiŋ suinum jaligimmu ale a zɔk la ase teerika la Naawen niŋ. 30Maa pai Urim ale Tummim a nyo suinum jaligimmu po, ate ba bo Aaron kuusini zuk diipo meena ate wa a jo Naawen niŋ la. Ate Aaron ale kasim a nye popola a te Izirali nidoabilisaŋa wa suinum po Naawen niŋ.
31<<Pai garuk pali sobluk a nye garuk genni garuk woŋku, 32a nye voan suŋsuŋka a magsi zukku. Ku a magsika ba yɔk ku ŋinni ate ku kan cheeri. 33Pai garuk miik sobluk ale garuk miik ŋmiŋmiruk ale garuk miik mɔnuŋ a yɔk ŋangilima ase yɔna a basi garukku nyiŋ, a nye ligmɔniŋ lɔŋŋa suŋsuŋka po. 34Pai ligmɔniŋ lɔŋi ale ŋan baai ale a nye ase yɔn gigiluta la, wanyi wanyi a maŋ chaab a piisi a baali basi garukku nyiŋ. 35Ku a fɛ ate Aaron a jo ku ase wa ale a tom wa tuimaŋa. Ba le wom lɔŋni kumsaŋa ase wa nin jo jigi dii ale ta tuilum la Naawen niŋ ale a nyini peelim, ate wa kan kpi.
36<<Pai cheri ligmɔniŋ a nye jatanlaŋ, tuilum zutɔk ate ba ŋmarisi ka zuk ayen, <<Ta tuilum a te Naawen.>> 37Yaali garuk miik sobluk a bobi jatanlaŋka a maŋ zutɔkka, ku a magsi ku bo ka zutɔkka niŋ. 38Ku le bo ka Aaron dinni nyiŋ, ate wa ale ta kaasuŋ kuui ate Izirali demma a nye kaasi tiirim tii ale ta tuilum la. Ba tiiritaŋa a dan poom ka dii ya, ti le kasim bo ka Aaron dinni nyiŋ, ate dila ale basi ate Naawen tuesi tiiritaŋa.
39<<Pai gattiak kaai diak ale pagra la, a nye garuk kuui ate ba yɔk la ale zutɔk. Waai ale seba tuima la a nye chiak gbain. 40Yɔk gatta a nye chiak gbana ale zuk bobsa a te Aaron nidoabilisaŋa ate ku te ba yue ale zula. 41Ase fi dan te fi suoku Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa gattaŋa a nueri, bobi ba a kpiiri kpaam ba zuk ase kaabteerɔba la. Nye ba ate ba ta tuilum a magsi ate ba tom a te mi ase kaabteerɔba la.
42<<Nye garuk peeluk faasiŋsa a basi tɛŋ ate ku a lik ba nyiŋka a nyini chiak a ga paari koasitaŋa. 43Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ku a fɛ ate ba a jo ti diipo meena ate ba a jo viuku po la, yaase ba nin moata kuŋkuŋku jigi dii ale ta tuilum la, ate dila ale basi ate ba kan kpi. Kude ale chim ka ŋmarisi kaai ale ka beni a te Aaron ale wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa.

Title: NYINIKA 29
Content:
1<<Kude ale dii ate fi le nye a gaari ba a magsi la, ate dila ale basi ate ba tom a te mi ase kaabteerɔba la. Yik lalik paalik ale pada paalisa siye sii ale kan ta jomi la. 2Pai fi zom naliŋka gela buui ale kan ta dabinta la a nye boroborok, a pai gela a dam kpaam du a nye maasa paglaksa, a pai mbula meena a nye maasa fiisa a pai kpaam a sa. 3Pai ba a nyo kpanjɔk po a te a gum chaab ale lalikka ale padaasa siyewa. 4Ta Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa a jam Viuku nansuiŋku nɔi a so ba ale nyiam. 5Pai gattaŋa a jo Aaron ale garuk peelukku, ale garuk genni garuk woŋku, garuk genni dek ale suinum jaligimmu. Pai garuk genni a jo wa ale chiak gbain dii ate ba yɔk di nalimnyiini la. 6Pai zutɔkka a vuk wa zukku a pai ligmɔniŋka jatanlaŋka a vuk zutɔkka zuk. 7Pai bobika kpaamu a kpiiri wa zuk a bobi wa ase kaabteerɔ la. 8Be ta wa nidoabilisaŋa a jam a jo ba garuk woŋta, 9a pai zutɔksa a vuk ba. Yaali garuk pala a bobi Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa, kaab teka naamu ka ŋmarisi kaai ale ka a nueri. Suiku de po be bobi Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa.
10<<Ta lalik a jam Tuka Viuku niŋ, ate Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa a pai nisa a vi ka zuk. 11Be tɔgri ka Naawen niŋ Tuka Viuku nansuiŋku nɔi. 12Pai nandub a tiak lalikka ziimu a nyo kuŋkuŋku nyiilaŋa niŋ, abe fi pai buui ale tali la a kpiiri basi kuŋkuŋku tɛŋka. 13Pai kpapalaŋa meena ale bo ponni po la, ju ale paŋni kauk ale yiimaŋa ŋayema ale kpapalaŋa a ju kuŋkuŋku zuk. 14Alege lalikka ale ka gbainni ale lammu ale puutaŋa wa ta nyini ba boka jigini peelim a ju. Ku ka biem tiirim.
15<<Yik padaasaŋa kanyi ate Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa a pai nisa a vi ka zukku zuk. 16Ba tɔgri ka a pai ziimu a misi kuŋkuŋku ganaŋa meena. 17Boanni padiaka bunabuna a sugri ka ponni po ŋantaŋa ale naŋsaŋa a pa ba a gum zukku ale gela nŋala po. 18Ju padiaka meena kuŋkuŋku zuk. Ku ka juka tiirim a te Naawen, nyum buui ale masa la, tiirim ate ba nye ale bolim a te Naawen.
19<<Yik padiak m kala ale Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ate ba le pai nisa a vi ka zuk. 20Ba le tɔgri ka, a tiak ziimu gela a sa Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa juga tueŋa kie ale ba juga nandub doataŋa ale ba nandub doataŋa. Pai ziimu a misi kuŋkuŋku ganaŋa meena. 21Yaa pai ziimu gela a nyini kuŋkuŋku zuk ale bobika kpaamu gela a misi Aaron ale wa gattaŋa nyiŋ abe fi misi wa nidoabilisaŋa ale ba gattaŋa mɛ nyiŋ. Ate wa ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale ba gattaŋa a gaari magsi tuima.
22<<Pai kpapalaŋa ale bo padiaka de po la, juiku kpapalaŋa ale kpapalaŋa meena ale bo ponni po, ale paŋni kauk ale yiimaŋa ŋayema ale kpapalaŋa ale juga kɔsukku. Padiaka ale nna a magsi kaabteerɔwa bobika. 23A nyini ŋandiintaŋa ale bo kpanjɔkku po ate dabinta a ka ti po la, tii ale bo Naawen niŋ la, pai boroborok ale maasa paglaksa ate ba pai kpaam a nye la ale maasa fiisa. 24Pai bade meena a nyo Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa nisima po a yulum Naawen niŋ ase yulumka tiirim la. 25Yaa tuesi ŋantaŋa ba jigi a ju ba kuŋkuŋku zuk a gum chaab ale juka tiirimu ase nyum buui ale masa a te Naawen ale tiirim buui ate ba nye ale bolim a te Naawen. 26Ase fi le pai padiak kuusini a magsi fi bobi Aaron ase kaabteerɔ la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, yulum di Naawen niŋ ase yulumka tiirim la, ate di yaa chim fi charuk.
27Padiaka kuusini ale kɔsukku ate fi pai gaari Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ase kaabteerɔba la, pai dueni nakpiak. Kabtaŋa de ka bala ale soa. 28Kabtaŋa de ale kasim chim ka ba charuk a nyini Izirali demma jigi a te Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa. Ku ka cheesika ate Izirali demma a nye a te Naawen a nyini ba suiyɔgni tiiritaŋa po.
29<<Aaron tuilum gattaŋa ka wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale soa ti a jo diipo meena ale magsi ayen ba kpiiri kpaam ba zuk a bobi ba ase kaabteerɔba la. 30Nidoabili dii ale wa zaani wa nankula po ase kaabteerɔ ale a jam Tuka Viuku po a tom jigi dii ale ta tuilum la po la, a magsi wa jo ti ka daa ŋayopɔi.
31<<Pai padiaka ale magsi kaabteerɔwa bobika la a dik ka lammu jigi weleŋ. 32Tuka Viuku nansuiŋku nɔi, Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa a yaa ŋɔbi padiaka lammu ale boroboroku ale bo kpanjɔkku po la. 33Ba yaa de tiiritaŋa de, dii nyiŋ ate biem duisi basika a nye ba a magsi ayen ba bobi ba kaabteerɔba a gaari ba la. Alege nuru yoŋ a kan maa de ti, dii nyiŋla ti ta tuilum kama. 34Ase padiaka lammu yaase boroboroku ate ba pai nye kaabteerɔwa bobika la a dan tali paari saluik, ju bu a basi. Ka a fɛ ate ni kan de, dii nyiŋla ti ta tuilum kama.
35<<Nye dii meena ate m weeni fu la a te Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa, a pai daa ŋayopɔi a bobi ba kaabteerɔba. 36Pai lalik a nye kaabka dai meena ase biem tiirim la, a nye biem duisi basika. Nye biem duisi basika kaabka kuŋkuŋku zuk ate ku nye cheri, a kpiiri kpaam ku zuk a gaari ku. 37Daa ŋayopɔi nye biem duisi basika a te kuŋkuŋku a gaari ku. Ate kuŋkuŋku ale ŋmasi ta tuilum, ate jabuui meena ale a tiri ku la a ta tuilum.
38<<Dii ate fi ale kasim a nye dai meena kuŋkuŋku zuk la ale fi ko pabisa siye sii ale ta ben yeŋ dekki la. 39Ko kanyi saluik abe fi ko m kala mɛ junɔi. 40Pabiik kaai ale dɛ niŋ la te zom naliŋ kuruba nɔi a nyini pi po a dam kpaam kolini dinyi du ale daam kolini ase nyuka tiirim la. 41Kaab pabiik m kala junɔi ale ŋandiinta tiirim bula dek ale bu nyuka tiirimu ase saluik la. Bu ka nyum masik, tiirim buui ate ba ju ale bolim a te Naawen.
42<<A te ŋaaŋbiik sii ale cheen la, juka tiirimu de ale kasim a nye kama Tuka Viuku nansuiŋ Naawen niŋ. Dula mi Naawen ale tu fu a biisi ale fu. 43Dula jigini mi dek ale tu Izirali demma, ate dula jigini ale chim tuilum jigi m zulaŋa niŋ.
44<<Dila m le gaari Tuka Viuku ale kuŋkuŋku, abe m nye Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ate ba gaari badek a tom a te mi ase kaabteerɔba la. 45Ate m bo Izirali demma po a chim ba Wen. 46Ba le seba ayen m ka ba Naawen ba Wen dii ale ta ba a nyini Ejipiti tɛŋka po a nyini la, ate m le bo ba po. Ka mi Naawen ba Wenni.

Title: NYINIKA 30
Content:
1<<Yaali siik daata a nye kuŋkuŋ a magsi ŋan baai nyum ale masa la juka. 2Nye ku ŋmɔgluk ŋmɔgluga, ate ku woglimmu a paari anamagib buye ate ku labsimu a paari anamagib buye, ku juelika a paari anamagib bunaansi. Nye ku nyiilaŋa mɛ ale daataŋa. 3Pa cheri ligmɔniŋ a taari ku ŋmanni ale ku ganaŋa ale nyiilaŋa abe fi pai ligmɔniŋ a gebiri gilim ku. 4Nye ligmɔniŋ baŋsa siye a basi ba le gebiri juijui ale ligmɔniŋka la kinni po ate siye a bo gauŋ kunyi meena a yik dawoŋtaŋa ate ba yik a ji la. 5Nye siik dawoŋta a pai ligmɔniŋ a taari ti. 6Pai kuŋkuŋku a zaani garuk panni niŋ ale moata nɔiyeŋka dakanni la biem duisi basika nanlikka niŋ ale lik nɔiyeŋka dakanni nɔi la, juijui ate m le tu fu la.
7<<Ku a fɛ ate Aaron a ju ŋan baai nyum ale masa la kuŋkuŋku zuk saluik meena ase wa nin jam wa nya zeuŋtaŋa zuk. 8Ku a fɛ ate wa ju ŋan baai nyum ale masa la ase wa nin jo wa tɔti zeuŋtaŋa junɔi, ate ŋan baai nyum ale masa la a kasim a de Naawen niŋ a te ŋaaŋbiik sii ale cheen la. 9Kuŋkuŋku de zuk kan ju nyum yoŋ yaase juka tiirim yoŋ yaase ŋandiinta tiirim yoŋŋoa, abe fi kan kpiiri nyuka tiirim ku zuwa. 10Benni po bunyi ate Aaron a nye biem duisi basika kaabka kuŋkuŋku nyiilaŋa zuk. Benni po biem duisi basika de, ku a fɛ ate ba pai biem tiirim ziimu a nye biem duisi basika a te Naawen a te ŋaaŋbiik sii ale cheen la. Bu ŋmasi ta tuilum kama a te Naawen.>>
11Ate Naawen a yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 12<<Ase fi dan chiini Izirali demma, ku a fɛ nuru yeŋ meena a tuni wa nyuvuri a nyini diipo ate fi chiini wa la. Ate nyiŋtuila a kan jam ba jigi diipo ate fi chiini ba la. 13Nuru waai a dan gaam cheŋ baai ate ba chiini la po, wa tuni Puusika Yenni ligni geli, a magsi chaab ale Puusika Yenni ligraŋa ate ŋa dobrimu a magsi chaab ale ligbie pisiye la. Tiirimu de ka Naawen ale Soa. 14Baai meena ale gaam taam la, baai ale paari bena pisiye yaase ba gaam dila la, a te Naawen ka tiirim. 15Jigsirɔma a kan te a gaam dila, ŋanjaksaŋa mɛ abe kan te pɔsimu ase nama a nin boro a te Naawen ayen wa nye biem duisi basika ni nyuvooŋa nyiŋ. 16Tuesi biem duisi basika tiirimu a nyini Izirali demma jigi a tom Tuka Viuku tuimaŋa. Ku le chim ka teerika a te Izirali demma Naawen niŋ, a nye biem duisi basika ni nyuvooŋa nyiŋ.>>
17Naawen a weeni Moosis ayen, 18<<Nye kutuk mɔnuŋ chin kpienni ale kutuk mɔnuŋ jazaanim a magsi sugrika. Pai jaamu a zaani tuka viuku ale kuŋkuŋku suŋsuŋ a ŋari nyiam a nyo du. 19Aaron ale wa bisaŋa a sugri ba nisaŋa ale ba naŋsaŋa ale nyiam dula. 20Diipo meena ate ba a jo Tuka Viuku po la, ba sugri ate ba kan kpi. Ba dan forisi moata kuŋkuŋku mɛ ayen ba te tiirim buui ate ba nye ale bolim a te Naawen la, 21ba yaa le sugri ba nisaŋa ale ba naŋsaŋa ate dila ale basi ate ba kan kpi. Kude ale chim ka wa dii ale di beni a te Aaron ale wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale cheena la.
22Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 23<<Pai ŋantaŋa de ate ba nyummu a masa la. Tiib sim ate dobrimu a nye ase ligbie kobsinu la, tiib ŋaaŋ pagta ate dobrimu a nye ase ligbie kobsiye ale pisinu la, kinkalama ate ŋa dobrimu a nye ase ligbie kobsiye ale pisinu la, 24tiib pagta ate dobrimu a nye ase ligbie kobsinu la, ba meena a magsi chaab ale Puusika Yenni ligraŋa ale kpaam kɔlima ŋayopɔi. 25Nye ŋantaŋa de meena ase naam bobika tuilum kpaam la. Waai ale seba kpaam tuima la, a gum ba chaab ate ba nyummu a masa. 26Pai bu kpiiri Tuka Viuku ale nɔiyeŋka dakanni nyiŋ a puusi te ba ale 27jazaanimu ale ŋanta meena ale zeuŋku ale a zaani jabuui zuk la ale kuŋkuŋku ate ba a ju ŋanta du la ale 28tiirim juka kuŋkuŋku ale ŋan baai meena ate ba ta a tom ku tuima la, chin kpienni ale di jazaanimu. 29Fi gaari ba a magsi ate ba ŋmasi ta tuilum ate jabuui meena ale a tiri ba mɛ la ale ta tuilum.
30<<Bobi Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa a gaari ba a magsi ate ba tom a te mi ase kaabteerɔba la. 31Weeni a sak Izirali demma ayen, <Kude ale chim ka tuilum kpaam a te gaŋ sii ale cheen la. 32Kan pai bu a kpiiri nyo nuruba nyiŋsa be kan nye kpaam ase bu de la. Bu ta tuilum kama, fi mɛ a nya bu ase tuilum kpaam la. 33Waai dek ale a nye kpaam ase bu de la, waai dek ale pai bu a nyo nuru nyiŋ alege wa daa kaabteerɔ la, ku a fɛ ate ba yeeri wa nuruma po a nyini.> >>
34Naawen a weeni Moosis ayen, <<Pai ŋan baai nyum ale masa ase zauŋ kuŋ la ale kanbieŋsa ale chambakuurik ale ŋan baai nyum ale masa, ba meena a soa si chaab la, 35Waai ale seba kpaam tuima la a gum ba chaab a ju. Ku a magsi yesa a boro abe bu nye cheri a ta tuilum. 36Num ŋan nyuntisaŋa lɔklɔk ase zom la a nyo nɔiyeŋka dakanni ale Tuka Viuku niŋka, juijui ate mi ale tu fu la. Ku a fɛ ate fi pai ŋantaŋa de a nye ba le magsi ba nye diila. Bu ŋmasi ta tuilum kama a te fu. 37Kan nye ŋan baai nyum ale masa la a ju a te fidek ase fi le nye bade diila. Nya ba ase ba ka tuilum ŋanta la a te Naawen. 38Waai ale a nye ŋan baai nyum ale masa ase bade la, a de masim ba nyummu nyiŋla, ku a fɛ ate ba yeeri wa a nyini wa nuruma po.>>

Title: NYINIKA 31
Content:
1Naawen yaa jam weeni Moosis ayen, 2<<Nya mi lueri ka Bezalel Uri nidoabinni ate wa kokpieŋka a chim Yur a nyini Juda dɔkku la, 3ate mi sueri wa ale Wen Chiika ale tuima sebika ale wie miŋka yam a bo nisa tuima meena po la 4ate wa baga a pai ligmɔniŋ ale kpana ale kutuk mɔnuŋ a ŋmirisi ŋa a magsi tuima meena po 5wa baga a gebi tintana, wa ale baga a tom daata tuima ale nisa tuima meena. 6Mi ŋman yeeri ka Oyoliab Ayisamak nidoabinni ale nyini Dan dɔkku la ayen wa maari wa. Mi ŋman te sebika baai meena ale ta nisa tuima la ayen ba nye dii meena ate mi weeni fi la. 7Tuka viuku ale nɔiyeŋka dakanni ale biem duisi basika nanlikka ale viuku ŋanta mbala meena 8ale jazaanimu ale ku ŋantaŋa ale cheri ligmɔniŋ jazaanimu ale ku ŋantaŋa meena kuŋkuŋku ate ba a ju nyum masik du la, 9ale kuŋkuŋku ate ba a nye juka tiirimu la ale ku ŋantomtaŋa ale chin kpienni ale di jazaanimu 10ale garuk tii ate ba yɔk la tuilum gatta buyewa ale magsi Aaron ase kaabteerɔ la ale wa nidoabilisaŋa gattaŋa ase ba nin boro a tom ase kaabteerɔba la 11ale bobika kpaam ŋan baai nyum ale masa la a magsi jigi dii ale ta tuilum la. Ba a magsi ba nye ba ase ka dii dek ate m weeni fu la.>>
12Ate Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 13<<Biisi a te Izirali demma ayen, <Ku a fɛ ate ni kpesi ta Vuusum Daaŋa. Kude ale chim ka daana mi ale nama suŋsuŋ a te gaŋ sii ale cheen la, ate nama ale seba ayen ka Mi ale Naawen dii ale gaari ni la.
14<< <Ni kpesi Vuusum Danni, dii nyiŋla di ta tuilum kama a te ni. Nuru waai ale a zɛri ku la, ni ko wa. Nuru waai ale a tom tuini di danni la, ku a fɛ ate ni yiak wa wa nuruma po a basi. 15Daa ŋayuebi, ni pai a tom tuima, alege daa ŋayopɔiwa danni ka Vuusum Dai a ta tuilum a te Naawen. Nuru waai ale a tom tuima Vuusum Danni la, ku a fɛ ate ba ko wa. 16Izirali demma a kpesi Vuusum Danni, a dɛ tigini ate gaŋ sii ale cheen la ku chim wa dii ale di boro a benni ase nɔiyeŋ la. 17Ku le chim ka daana mi ale Izirali demma suŋsuŋ taam wuu, ka daa ŋayuebi ate Naawen a pai nye wenŋmazukku ale tɛŋzuk de, daa ŋayopɔiwa danni wa basi tuima kama ale vuusi.>>>
18Ase Naawen ale jam biisi ale Moosis Sinai Guuku zuk a ga nueri la, wa yaa te wa tintain paglaksa siyewa ate wa wanni a bo ŋa zuk la, tintain paglaksaŋa ate Wen a pai wa nandub a ŋmarisi la.

Title: NYINIKA 32
Content:
1Ase nuruma ale nya ale Moosis a beni ale guuku zuk siŋka la, ba yaa tigsi gilim Aaron ayen, <<Jam nye wen a te ti dii ale di de ti niŋ la. Dan ka Moosiswa de, waai ale ta ti nyini Ejipiti po a nyini la, ti zɛ jabuui ale nye wa.>>
2Aaron yaa tulisi ba ayen, <<Ni yeeri ligmɔniŋ tukpanaŋa ate ni pooma ale ni nidoabilisaŋa ale ni liema a su la a ta jam te mu.>> 3Dila nyiŋla, nuruma meena a yaa jam yeeri ba tukpanaŋa a ta jam te Aaron. 4Wa yaa jam tuesi ŋan baai ate ba te wa la a nye bɔgluk ase naabiik la, a salisi ku. Ate ba yaa weeni ayen, <<Ŋade ale ni wenaŋa Izirali demma, dii ale ta ni nyini Ejipiti po a nyini la.>>
5Ase Aaron ale jam nya kude la, wa yaa sɛ kuŋkuŋ naabiika niŋ ale mooli ayen, <<Chum tigi ale boro a te Naawen.>> 6Daa ŋayewa danni nuruma yaa daŋsi yiti a nye juka tiirita kaabka ale suiyɔgni tiirita. Dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ ba yaa kali dɛ ale nyu ale yiti boro a gɔk.
7Ate Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Siŋ tɛŋ dii nyiŋla, fi nuruma baai ate fi ta a nyini Ejipiti po a nyini la a taŋ kama. 8Ba nye ka nwuli a basi dii ate mi a weeni ba la ale nye bɔgluk ase naabiik la a te badek. Ba koori ka tɛŋ a te ku ale a kaabi a te ku ale weeni ayen, <Ŋade ale ni wenaŋa Izirali demma waai ale ta ni a nyini Ejipiti po a nyini la.>
9Naawen weeni Moosis ayen, <<Mi nya nuruma de kama ba ka tukpari nyam. 10Yɔgyɔgla de basi mi m dek m nyiini ate m sui a puuri ale ba ate m kaasi ba. Mi ale basi ate fi chim tɛŋ kpieŋ.>>
11Alege Moosis yaa saalim Naawen wa Wenni ayen, <<M Naawen yaa, ka boa ate fi sui a puuri ale fi nuruma baai ate fi ta nyini Ejipiti po a nyini ale pagrim kpiem ale ni kpieŋsaŋa la? 12Ejipiti demma ale weeni ayen, <Ka popoli baata nyiŋ ate wa ta ba a nyini ayen wa ko ba guutaŋa po abe wa nueri ale ba tɛŋzuk de?> Basi fi suipuurumu yegayega, poli di zuk abe fi kan ta kaasuŋ a jam fi nuruma zuwa. 13Teeri fi tomteerɔma Abrayam ale Aizik ale Izirali wie, baai nyiŋ ate fi jam pɛ fidek nyiŋ ayen, <Mi ale nye ate ni ŋaaŋ bisaŋa a piisi ase chiŋmarisaŋa ale bo chiŋmaaŋa po la, abe m te ni ŋaaŋ bisaŋa meena tɛŋ kaai ate m puulim ale ba la ate ka chim ba nitalim taam wuu.> >> 14Ate Naawen yaa poli di zuk an ta kaasuŋ a jam wa nuruma jigi ya ase wa le jam poli wa nye diila.
15Moosis ŋman nyini guuku zuk a siŋ ale tintain paglaksa siyewa ate Naawen wanni a ŋmarisi ŋa zuk a bo wa nisaŋa po la. Ba jam ŋmarisi kabtaŋa meena kama, niŋ ale ŋaaŋ meena. 16Tintain paglaksaŋa jam ka Wen ale nye. Ŋmarisika jam ka Wen ŋmarisika a maŋ tintain paglaksaŋa nyiŋ.
17Ase Josua ale jam wom nuruma nuemka la, wa yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Ku a nye ase ka kpaliŋ nuemka ale bo nuruma boka jigini la.>>
18Ate Moosis a tulisi ayen, <<Ku kan nuem ase nak dɛka la, ku daa nak yiaka nuemka. Ku a nuem ase ka yiila lennika mi jigi la.>>
19Ase Moosis ale forisi moata nuruma boka jigini la, wa yaa nya naabiika ale gɔgta, ate wa sui yaa puuri ate wa yuk tintain paglaksaŋa wa nisaŋa po a basi ate ŋa mobi yisayisa guuku chiak. 20Wa jam pai naabiika ate ba nye la a ju ka ale bolim, a num ka nna lɔklɔk ase zom la a yulum nyiam zuk a basi ate Izirali demma a nyu bu.
21Wa weeni Aaron ayen, <<Nuruma de a nye fu ka sɛ ate fi de ba niŋ ate ba nye biem kpiemu de?>>
22Aaron yaa tulisi ayen, <<Kan te ate fi sui a puuri m nyɔnɔ, fi seba nuruma de ale a yaali biem nyeka diila kama. 23Ba weeni mi kama ayen, <Nye wena te ti ŋaai ale ŋa de ti niŋ, ti zɛ jabuui ale nye Moosis waai ale ta ti nyini Ejipiti la.> 24Dila ate mi yaa weeni ba ayen, <Nuru waai meena ale ta ligmɔniŋ tukpan la wa yeeri.> Ate ba yaa te mi ligmɔniŋka ate mi pai nyo bolim po, ate naabiika a nyini du a nyini.>>
25Moosis nya kama ayen nuruma nyiŋsa a toariŋ kama ate Aaron a basi ate ba ŋman ka yikka a yaa chim laata a te ba dachaasaŋa. 26Dila nyiŋ Moosis yaa zaani ba boka jigini nansuiŋku nɔi ayen, <<Baai ale va Naawen la a jam mi jigi,>> Ate Livaima meena a cheŋ wa jigi.
27Wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Naawen, Izirali Wenni ale weeni diila ale nna, <Nidoa meena a su gebik wa gauŋ. A cheŋ ŋaaŋ ale niŋ nuruma viuku po a nyini kpeglimka kanyi a ga paari m kala, waai meena a ko wa suok ale wa doa ale wa somoa.> >> 28Livai ma a jam nye dii ate Moosis a weeni ba la kama, dai dila danni nuruba ale paari ase tusa ŋata (3,000) la ale jam kpi. 29Ate Moosis ayen, <<Nama a gaari ka ni tɔga a te Naawen jinla ale ni ale nye ka kpaliŋ ale nidek bisa ale ni suata ate wa niak ni jinla danni.>>
30Daa ŋayewa danni Moosis yaa weeni nuruma ayen, <<Ni nye ka biem kpiem. Alege yɔgyɔgla de mi ale jueli Naawen jigi. Dai dii dai m le nye biem duisi basika a te ni, ni biemu nyiŋ.>>
31Dila nyiŋ Moosis yaa ŋman cheŋ Naawen jigi ayen, <<Biem kpiem ale nna ate nuruma de a nye! Ba nye ka ligmɔniŋ wena a te badek. 32Alege yɔgyɔgla de mi a saalim ayen fi vɔŋ ba biemu a te ba alege fi be dan kan vɔŋ a te ba, be yeeri m yuenni gbaŋka ate fi ŋmarisi la po a basi.>>
33Ate Naawen yaa tulisi Moosis ayen, <<Waai ale nye biem a kaasi mi la yuenni ale mi a yeeri a nyini m gbaŋka po a basi. 34Yɔgyɔgla de cheŋ ga de nuruma niŋ a ta ba cheŋ juijui ate mi a biisi ku wie la, m maarɔwa ale de fi niŋ. Alege danni a dan paari ayen m namsi ba, m le namsi ba, ba biemu nyiŋ.>>
35Naawen yaa basi ate nyiŋtuila a yik nuruma ba le nye dii ale naabiika ate Aaron a nye te ba la nyiŋ.

Title: NYINIKA 33
Content:
1Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Basi dela jigini, fi ale nuruma ate fi ta ba nyini Ejipiti po a nyini la, abe ni cheŋ tɛŋ kaai ate mi a puulim a te Abrayam ale Aizik ale Jekob ayen, <M le pai ka a te ni ŋaaŋbisaŋa la.> 2Mi ale tom Wen maarɔ ate wade ni niŋ a yiak Keenan ale Amori ale Yit ale Perizzi ale Yivi ale Jebus demma a basi te ni. 3Ni cheŋ tɛŋ kaai ate biisim ale siita a sueri ka po la. Alege mi Naawen a kan va ni a cheŋ, dii nyiŋla ni ka tukpari nyam. Dai dii dai m le ko ni suiku po.>>
4Ase nuruma ale jam wom daanika wieŋa de la, ba yaa piilim a kum ba wanyi mɛ la an jam su nifelima ale baŋsa. 5Dii nyiŋla Naawen a weeni Moosis kama ayen, <<Weeni Izirali demma ayen, <Ni ka tukpari nyam. Mi a dan poom va ni a cheŋ magdega, m te ko ni kama. Yɔgyɔgla de ni yeeri ni nifelimaŋa ale baŋsaŋa ate m poli m le a yaali ayen nye ni diila.> >> 6Dila Izirali demma yaa yeeri ba nifelimaŋa ale baŋsaŋa Yoreb Guuku zuk.
7Moosis nyiem ta viuku a nyini ba boka jigini kama a ga nakpiak a ga ti ate ku yalima, a wi ku ayen, <<tuka viuk.>> Waai a dan ta wari a yaa wa miŋ di a nyini Naawen jigi, wa a basi ba boka jigini kama ale a cheŋ tuka viuku po. 8Diipo meena Moosis a dan cheŋ jo viuku po, nuruma meena nyiem jam yiti za kama ba viitaŋa nansuiŋtaŋa noa a nya Moosis ate wa ga jo viuku po. 9Ase Moosis ale ga jo viuku po la chiŋmanni ale jam bo ku nansuiŋku nɔi alege ate Naawen a biisi ale Moosis. 10Diipo meena ate nuruma a nya ale chiŋmanni ale di za viuku nansuiŋku nɔi, ba meena nyiem yiti zaani kama a puusi, waai meena a jam boka wa viuk nɔi. 11Naawen a jam a biisi ale Moosis ase ka nuru ale a biisi ale wa doa diila. Ate Moosis nyiem yaa ŋman pilim cheŋ nuruma ale bo juijui la. Alege wa maarɔ paalika Nun nidoabinni Josua an jam basi viuku.
12Moosis yaa weeni Naawen ayen, <<Fi kasim a weeni mi kama ayen, <Dɛ nuruma de niŋ,> alege fi an basi ate m seba waai ate fi tom ayen wa cheŋ ale mi la. Fi weeni ayen, <Mi seba fi yue kama ale ta ŋmanteka ale fu.> 13Fi sui a dan peenti ale mu, sak mu fi suitaŋa ate dila ale basi ate m seba fu abe m diem gum du a nya ŋmanteka a nyini fi jigi. Teeri ayen tɛŋka de demma ka fi nuruba.>> 14Ate Naawen a tulisi ayen, <<Mi ale cheŋ ale fu, abe m basi ate fi vuusi.>>
15Ate Moosis a weeni wa ayen, <<Fi a dan kan va ti a cheŋ, kan basi ate ti nyini dela. 16Nuru yoŋ ale nye ka sɛ a seba ayen fi sui a yɔk ale mi ale fi nuruma ase fi nin kan va ti cheŋ yaa? Ka boa ale ku a sak ayen mi ale fi nuruma ka ti tɔga ale nuru mbala meena tɛŋzuk de?>>
17Ate Naawen a weeni Moosis ayen, <<Mi ale nye wanni de dek ate fi a bek la, dii nyiŋla mi sui a yɔk ale fu kama ate m seba fi yuei.>>
18Moosis ayen, <<Yɔgyɔgla de be sak mu fi zulaŋa.>>
19Ate Naawen ayen, <<Mi ale nye ate m wamaŋsaŋa meena a va fi niŋ a taam, abe m mooli m yuenni, Naawen fi niŋ. Mi ale ta jiirim ale waai ate m le ta jiirim la, abe waai niniga ale jo mu la m le nya wa niniŋŋa zuk.>> 20Wa weeni ayen, <<Alege, fi a kan nya m nimbidiaka, nuru a kan nya mi ale a boro.>>
21Naawen ayen, <<Jigi ale boro a moata mi juijui ate fi ale zaani piuŋ zuk. 22Ase mi zulaŋa a daa taam, m le pai fu a nyo piuŋ muulik po a lik fu ale m nisaŋa ate m ga taam nueri. 23Mi yaa le yeeri m nisaŋa ate fi nya m ŋaaŋka, alege mi nimbidiaka ku a fɛ ate fi kan nya.>>

Title: NYINIKA 34
Content:
1Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Peesi tintain paglaksa siye ase ŋaai ate fi liŋ ta la, ate m le ŋmarisi wie ŋaai ate m daam ŋmarisi ate fi mobi ŋa la. 2Gomsi saluik a jueli jam Sinai Guuku zuk. Ta fidek a jam mi jigi guuku zuk. 3Waai a kan va fu a jam yaase m nya waai guuku zuk kauk kuui ya. Ni duŋsaŋa a poom kan dɛ guuku zuwa.>>
4Moosis yaa peesi tintain paglaksa siye ase nŋala la, a jueli Sinai Guuku zuk saluik yokyokwa, ase Naawen ale jam weeni wa diila. Ate wa yaa ta tintain paglaksa siyewa wa nisa po. 5Ate Naawen yaa siŋ jam chiŋmanni po a za ale wa a mooli wa yuenni ayen Naawen. 6Wa yaa va Moosis niŋ a taam ale a mooli ayen, <<Naawen, Naawen, jiirim ale yaalika Wen. Waai sui ale kan kpabi a puuri, wa ŋmanteka ale wa wensieŋa mɛ a zuak a tom nalimnyiini ale 7diem ta ŋmanteka ale tusa, a vɔŋ a te gaasa ale tukpari ale biem nyam. Alege wa kan basi baai ale kaasi la tue darika. Wa le dari bisa ale ba mɛ ale biak baai la tue ba koma biemu nyiŋ a ta ga paari ŋaaŋbisa buta ale bunaansiwa po.>>
8Moosis yaa jam koori tɛŋ a puusi ale weeni ayen, 9<<Nyɔnɔ, ase m dan ta ŋmantiik fi nina po basi ate Nyɔnɔwa a va ti a cheŋ. Nuruma de ka tukpari nyam, vɔŋ ti gaasaŋa ale ti biemu a te ti, abe fi ta ti ase fi nitalim la.>>
10Ate Naawen ayen, <<Mi a nyeka nɔiyeŋ ale fu. Fi nuruma meena niŋ mi ale nye ka wakinkagla ŋaai ale kan nye tɛŋ kaai po tɛŋzuk de a nya la. Nuru baai po ate fi bo la ale nya tuin dii ate mi, Naawen ale nye a te fu la. 11Ni nye tuewomma a te dii ate mi a weeni ni jinla de la. Mi ale yiak Amori ale Keenan ale Yit ale Perizzi ale Yivi ale Jebus demma a basi a te ni. 12Ni be kpesi nidek ate ni kan nye nɔiyeŋ ale baai ale bo tɛŋ kaai po ate ni a cheŋ ka po la, ni dan nye dila ba le chim baruk a bo ni po. 13Ni kpiti ba kuŋkuŋtaŋa a ŋɔriŋ ba tintain weleŋsaŋa a che ba Asera dawoŋtaŋa a lɔnsi. 14Ni kan puusi wen yona ale Naawen, waai yuei ale ka a Anyuri la, ka nyuri dɛka Wen.
15<<Ni kpesi nidek ate ni kan nye nɔiyeŋ ale baai ale bo tɛŋka po la, diila ba dan pai badek a te ba wenaŋa ase taabuksa la, a kaab ŋa, ba le wi ni ate ni dɛ ba kaabka ŋandiintaŋa. 16Ase nama a dan lueri ba liema gela ase pooba la a te ni nidoabilisaŋa ate ba lie bala a pai badek a te ba wenaŋa ase taabuksa la, ba le sak ni nidoabilisaŋa ka dila degadega.
17<<Ni kan nyaliŋ ŋanta a mɛ bɔgta a te ni dega.
18<<Ni a ŋɔbi Boroborok Kuui Ate Dabinta Ka Ku Po La Tigini. Daa ŋayopɔi ni a dɛ boroborok kuui ale kan ta dabinta la ase mi ale weeni ni diila. Ni nye kude diipo ate mi a dak Abib chiika po la ale ka chiik kala ate ni basi Ejipiti tɛŋka.
19<<Ba le dɛ niŋ a biak baai meena la ka mi ale soa a gum chaab ale duŋsaŋa ale dɛ niŋ a biak ŋandoa tiila, ŋa dan poom chim niiga yaase piisa. 20Pai pabiik a da tuesi boniŋ ale liŋ biak kaai la, alege fi dan kan da tuesi ka, wɛ ka ŋinni. Ni da tuesi biik kaai meena ate ba liŋ biak ni bisaŋa po la. Ni waai a kan jam mi jigi ale nisim koruta.
21<<Daa ŋayuebi ni pai a tom tuima, alege daa ŋayopɔiwa danni ni vuusi. Ku dan poom ka kpari wen yaase cheka wen ku a fɛ ate ni vuusi.
22<<Ni dɛ Bakoa Tigini ale ŋandiin tii ale dɛ niŋ ka a bɛ la ale Tigsi Tajoka Tigini benni kpeglimka po. 23Buta meena benni po ni nidoama a magsi ba jam Nyɔnɔwa waai ale ka Naawen niŋ, dii ale ka Izirali Wenni la. 24Mi ale yiak tɛŋsa a basi te ni abe m basi ate ni tɛŋka a lagri, ate waai a kan vari ni tɛŋka ase nama a nin jueli buta meena benni po Naawen ni Wenni niŋ.
