Te nuru meena tuin dii dek chekki ate wa ale tom la. 33Tuini de ate Merari yezuimaŋa ale tom ase ba ale bo Tuka Viuku po la, ka kaabteerɔwa Aaron nidoabinni Itamar ale jam a nya ba ate ba a tom.>>
34Moosis ale Aaron ale tigsuŋku niŋdeerɔma a yaa jam chiini Koyat yezuimaŋa ale ba dɔkdemma meena. 35Nidoama meena a nyini bena pisita a ta ga paari bena pisinu baai ale jam ba tom tuimaŋa Tuka Viuku po la, 36ate ba jam chiini ba yezuimaŋa la jam ka tusa ŋaye ale kobsiyopɔi ale pisinu (2,750). 37Bade meena ale jam gum chaab a nyini Koyat yezuimaŋa a jam a tom Tuka Viuku po la. Moosis ale Aaron a jam chiini ba ase ka Naawen ale jam weeni Moosis diila.
38Gerson kabini ba jam chiini ba yezuimaŋa ale ba dɔkdemma kama. 39Nidoama meena a nyini bena pisita a ta ga paari bena pisinu, baai ale jam ba tom tuimaŋa Tuka Viuku po, 40ate ba chiini ba yezuimaŋa ale ba dɔkdemma la, jam ka tusa ŋaye ale kobsa pisiyuebi ale pisita (2,630). 41Bade ma nɔi ale jam ka dii a nyini Gerson yezuimaŋa a jam ba tom Tuka Viuku po la. Moosis ale Aaron a jam chiini ba a magsi chaab ale ka Naawen ale jam weeni diila.
42Merari kabini ba jam chiini ba yezuimaŋa ale ba dɔkdemma ale ka diila kama. 43Nidoama meena a nyini bena pisita a cheŋ bena pisinu, baai ale jam ba tom Tuka Viuku tuimaŋa, 44ate ba jam chiini ba yezuimaŋa la jam ka tusa ŋata ale kobsiye (3,200). 45Merari kabini nɔi ale jam ka diila ale la. Moosis ale Aaron a jam chiini ba ase ka Naawen ale jam weeni Moosis diila.
46Dila Moosis ale Aaron ale Izirali niŋdeerɔma a jam chiini Livaima ale ba yezuimaŋa ale ba dɔkdemma meena. 47Nidoama meena a nyini bena pisita a ga paari bena pisinu, baai ale jam ba tom abe ba a ji Tuka Viuku la, 48jam ka tusa naaniŋ ale kobsinu ale pinaanuŋ (8,580). 49Ase Naawen ale jam weeni Moosis diila, waai meena a jam nya tuini kama ate ba weeni wa, wa le wa a tom diila. Ba jam chiini ba kama ase Naawen ale jam weeni Moosis diila.

Title: CHIINIKA 5
Content:
1Naawen a jam weeni Moosis ayen, 2<<Weeni Izirali demma ayen ba yiak nuru waai ale bo ba po a ta nyiŋ gbaŋ tuem yaase sim a nyini wa niŋka yaase wa taŋ wadek ale jakpiuk la a basi. 3Jaduok ale jasari meena, ni yeeri ba a ta nyini ni boka jigini ate ba kan taŋ ba boka jigini, juijui ate mi ale boro ale ba la.>> 4Izirali demma a jam nye kude kama, ba jam yeeri ba kama ba boka jigini. Ba jam nye ka dii dek ate Naawen a jam weeni Moosis la.
5Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 6<<Biisi a te Izirali demma ayen, <Ase nidoa yaase nipok a dan nye biem buui ate wa choa a nye la, ate dila a basi ate wa nye tukpari ale Naawen, kula nyɔnɔwa a nye biem kama. 7Ku a fɛ ate wa lak wa nɔi a weeni biemu ate wa nye la. Ku a fɛ ate wa tuni wa kaasuŋku nyiŋ, wa lab wa ale a tuni diila bunu a pai bunyi a gum ku meena po a te nuru waai ate wa nye kaasi la. 8Alege ase nuru wala a dan kan ta mabiik ate wa moata wa ate ba tuni a te wa kaasuŋku nyiŋŋa tutunaŋa ka Naawen ale soa, ku a fɛ ate ba pai a te kaabteerɔwa a gum chaab ale padiak kaai ate ba ale pai nye biem duisi basika a te wa la. 9Tuilum tiiritaŋa meena ate Izirali demma a ta jam te kaabteerɔwa la ka kaabteerɔwa dek ale soa. 10Nuru meena tuilum tiirim ka wadek ale soa, alege jabuui ate wa pai te kaabteerɔwa la ka kaabteerɔwa ale soa.> >>
11Naawen a jam weeni Moosis ayen, 12<<Biisi a te Izirali demma a weeni ba ayen, <Ase nuru pok a dan nye be a ka wensie ale wa 13a goa ale nidoa yoŋ, ate kude a chim wasusugi ate wa chorɔwa a zɛ. Ba an miŋ nipowa ale taŋ wadek la, ase nuru ale kan weeni wari a te nipowa alege ba an yik wa ale wa boro a nye wari la. 14Ase nyuri dɛka a dan jam wa chorɔwa jigi ate wa a poli ayen wa powa a taŋ wadek yaase wa poli biem a te wa alege wa an taŋ wa dega. 15Wa ale ta wa powa a cheŋ ka kaabteerɔwa jigi. Ku a fɛ ate wa te zaa zom kuruba wa nyiŋ. Ku a fɛ ate wa kan nyo kpaam du yaase wa nyo ŋan baai nyum ale masa la du, dii nyiŋla bu ka ŋandiinta tiirim a magsi nyuri dɛka, teerika tiirim a basi ba ate ba a teeri nye kaasuŋ wie.
16<< <Kaabteerɔwa yaa le ta nipowa a nyini a basi ate wa zaani Naawen niŋ. 17Wa yaa le ŋari nyanaliŋ a nyo samɔniŋ po a nye viuku tɛŋka tantaŋa a nyo nyiamu po. 18Kaabteerɔwa ale basi ate nipowa a zaani Naawen niŋ la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, wa yaa le vɔssi wa zuisaŋa a nyo wa nisima po teerika tiirimu ale ŋandiinta tiirim a magsi nyuri dɛka alege kaabteerɔwa dek a ta nya tuaka ale ta kikaasa a jam la. 19Kaabteerɔwa yaa le basi ate nipowa a pɛ abe wa weeni wa ayen, <<Ase nidoa yoŋ a dan kan goa ale fu ate fi an nye kaasi a taŋ fidek ale diem bo ale fi chorɔwa, nyatuaka de ale ta kikaasa a jam la a kan nye fu wari ya. 20Alege fi dan nye kaasi ale diem bo ale fi chorɔwa a taŋ fidek a basi ate nidoa yoŋ a goa ale fu alege daa fi chorɔwa.>> 21Dela kaabteerɔwa ale pai nipowa a nyo kikaasaŋa de po ayen, <<Naawen a ka kikaasa a te fi nuruma abe wa zɛri fu ate fi chim kirik. 22Nyiamu de ale ta kikaasa a jam a jo fi nyiŋka po ate fi chim kirik.>> Ate nipowa ale weeni ayen, <<Ku be nye dila.>>
23<< <Kaabteerɔwa ale ŋmarisi kikaasaŋa de gbaŋ po a sugri a basi nyatuaka po. 24Wa le basi ate nipowa a nyu nyiamu ale toa a ta kikaasa a jam la, ate nyiamu de ale jo wa nyiŋka po a basi ate wa a nam yegayega. 25Kaabteerɔwa yaa le tuesi ŋandiinta tiirimu ale magsi nyuri dɛka la wa nisa po, a yulum Naawen niŋ abe wa yaa ta jam kuŋkuŋku zuk. 26Kaabteerɔwa ale nye ŋandiinta tiirimu nisa nɔi ase teerika tiirim la a ju kuŋkuŋku zuk. Dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ wa yaa le basi ate nipowa nyu nyiamu. 27Ase wa dan taŋ wadek a ka wensie ale wa chorɔwa, wa dan nyu nyiamu ale ta kikaasa a jam la, bu le jo wa nyiŋka po ate wa paariŋka ale ji abe wa kositaŋa a mɛta, wa ale chim kirik, abe wa chim kikaasa a te wa nuruma. 28Alege ase nipowa a dan kan taŋ wadega wa nala kama wa le biak bisa.
29<< <Sinsaŋŋa ale nna a magsi chaab ale nyuri dɛka ase nipok a nin cheŋ bɛ a taŋ wadek ale diem bo wa chorɔwa jigi, 30yaase nidoawa a dɛ nyuri a poli ayen nidoa yoŋ a goa ale wa powa. Kaabteerɔwa ale basi ate nipowa a zaani Naawen niŋ a weeni wa sinsaŋŋa de meena. 31Chorɔwa a kan nya namsika, alege nipowa ale nya wa biemu tutuna.> >>

Title: CHIINIKA 6
Content:
1Naawen a jam weeni Moosis ayen, 2<<Biisi a te Izirali demma ayen, <Ase nidoa yaase nipok a daa yaali wa nye pɛ kaai ale chim ka tɔga, pɛ kaai ate wa le gaari wadek a te Naawen ase Naziri la, 3Wa a magsi wa gaari wadek a nyini jaab meena ate ba pai chicheba a nye la. Bala ale daam yaase yɔn yɔgsa yaase yɔn kosa. 4Da ŋaai meena ate wa gaari wadek la po, wa an magsi wa dɛ chicheba jaab boa.
5<< <Diipo meena ate wa pɛ ayen wa gaari wadek la poniŋ a kan tiri wa zukku. Ku a fɛ ate wa chim nuru weleŋ ate ku paari diipo ate wa ale gaari wadek a te Naawen la a ga taam. Ku a fɛ ate wa basi ate wa zukku zuisaŋa a chim woŋŋa. 6Diipo meena ate wa gaari wadek a te Naawen la, ku a fɛ ate wa kan cheŋ moata kpio. 7Dan poom ka wadek ko yaase wa ma yaase wa suok yaase wa toa ale kpi wa kan va bala nyiŋ a taŋ wadega, dii nyiŋla daana ŋaai ale sak ayen wa gaari wadek a te Wen la a bo ka wa zukku nyiŋ. 8Diipo meena ate wa gaari wadek la, wa welema kama a te Naawen.
9<< <Ase nuru waai a dan kpi diiri wa ale wa bo dula, dila a taŋ wa zuisaŋa ate wa pai nyo Naawen nisa po la kama, a nyini dai dila danni, ku daa ŋayopɔiwa danni ku a fɛ ate wa chiiri wa zukku wa sugrika danni. 10Dai naanika danni wa ta nangbaŋsa siye yaase kawuta tiye a jam te kaabteerɔwa Tuka Viuku nansuiŋku nɔi. 11Kaabteerɔwa yaa le pai kanyi a kaab ase biem tiirim la abe m kala mɛ a kaab ase juka tiirim la a nye biem duisi basika a te wa, dii nyiŋla wa nye ka biem wa le moata kpiewa la nyiŋ. Dai dila danni dek wa ŋman basi ate wa zuisaŋa a chim. 12Ku a fɛ ate wa ŋman pai wadek a nyo Naawen nisa po diipo ate wa gaari wadek la, abe wa ta padiak kaai ale paari ben a jam ase nyemagsika tiirim la. Da ŋaai ale taam la kan chiini ŋa, dii nyiŋla, wa taŋ wadek kama wa le gaari wadek da ŋaai po la.
13<< <Sinsaŋŋa de ale boro a magsi Naziriwa ase diipo ate wa gaari wadek a te la a nin taam. Ba le ta wa a jam ka Tuka Viuku nansuiŋku nɔi. 14Dula jigini wa yaa le pai tiiritaŋa a te Naawen, padiak kaai ale ta bein yeŋ ale kan ta jomi la a magsi juka tiirim ale pasari dii ale ta bein yeŋ dekki a ka jomi la a magsi biem tiirim, ale padiak kaai ale kan ta jomi la a magsi suiyɔgni tiirim, 15a gum chaab ale ba ŋan bieŋa tiiritaŋa ale nyuka tiiritaŋa ale boroborok kuui ate dabinta ka ku po la ale kpanjɔk. Ŋan bala ale nna maasa ate ba pai zom naliŋ a nye a sa ŋa ale kpaam ale boroborok fiik a sa ale kpaam.
16<< <Kaabteerɔwa ale pai ba a te Naawen a nye biem tiirim ale juka tiirim. 17Wa ale pai kpanjɔkku ale boroboroku ate dabinta a ka ku po la a te, abe wa kaab padiaka ase suiyɔgni tiirim la a te Naawen a gum chaab ale ŋandiinta tiirim ale nyuka tiirim.
18<< <Tuka Viuku nansuiŋku nɔi, Naziriwa a yaa le che wa zuisaŋa ate wa pai nyo Naawen nisa po la. Wa ale pai zuisaŋa a nyo bolimu ate suiyɔgni tiiritaŋa kaabka a doa bu zuk la.
19<< <Naziriwa a dan che wa zuisaŋa ate wa pai nyo Naawen nisa po la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, kaabteerɔwa ale pai padiaka ate ba dik bɔgini la a nyo wa nisa po ale maasidi ale boroboroku ate ba sa ale kpaam la a ta nyini kpanjɔkku po, ŋanta buyewa de dabinta kan bo ba po. 20Kaabteerɔwa yaa le yulum ba Naawen niŋ ase yulumka tiirim la. Ba ka tuilum ŋanta a te kaabteerɔwa, a gum chaab ale kuusini ale kɔsukku ate ba pai a yulum te la. Dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ Naziriwa a yaa nyu daamu.
21<< <Sinsaŋŋa ale la a magsi Naziri waai ale pɛ wa tiirimu a te Naawen a ta va wa ale gaari wadek la, a gum chaab ale jabuui meena ate wa baga a te la. Ku a fɛ ate wa nye dii ate wa pɛ la a ta va Naziri sinsaŋŋa ale ka diila.> >>
22Naawen a jam weeni Moosis ayen, 23<<Weeni Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ayen, <Fi ale fi niak Izirali demma diila ale nna. Weeni ba ayen, 24<<Naawen a niak ni abe wa ta ni. 25Naawen basi ate wa nimbidiaka a nyaksi ni zuk abe wa ŋman a te ni. 26Naawen a tulim wa nina a tuk ni nyiŋ abe wa te ni suiyɔgni.>> >
27<<Dila ba le pa m yuenni a basi Izirali demma zuk ate mi ale niak ba.>>

Title: CHIINIKA 8
Content:
1Naawen a jam weeni Moosis ayen, 2<<Biisi ale Aaron a weeni wa ayen, <Ase fi dan pai zeuŋta tiyopɔiwa a zaani, ti a magsi ti a nya ka zeuŋku jazaanimu niŋka meena.> >>
3Aaron yaa nye dila. Wa yaa pai zeuŋtaŋa a zaani ate ti tuk niŋ geŋ jazaanimu zuk, ase Naawen ale weeni Moosis diila. 4Ba le jam nye zeuŋ jazaanimu diila ale nna. Ka ligmɔniŋ ate ba jam pai kuri nye, a nyini kinni a ta jueli ku puutaŋa. Zeuŋ jazaanimu ba jam nye ka dii dek ate Naawen a jam pai sak Moosis la.
5Naawen a jam weeni Moosis ayen, 6<<Yeeri Livaima a ta nyini Izirali dem mbala po a gomsi ba ate ba nala. 7Ate ba nye cheri la, nye nna. Misi nya buui ale basi ate nuru a nye cheri la a basi ba nyiŋsaŋa. Basi ate ba chiiri ba nyiŋsaŋa meena zuisaŋa abe ba sugri ba gattaŋa, ate dila ale basi ate ba nala. 8Basi ate ba yik lalik paalik ale ka ŋandiinta tiirimu ale zom naliŋ a dam kpaam du. Abe fi ŋman yik lalik paalik a nye buye a magsi biem tiirim. 9Ta Livaima a jam Tuka Viuku nansuiŋku niŋka a tigsi Izirali naakuuni meena. 10Fi magsi fi ta Livaima a jam ka Naawen niŋ, ate Izirali demma a pai ba nisaŋa a vi ba zuk. 11Aaron yaa ta Livaima a jam Naawen niŋ ase zak sakka tiirim la a nyini Izirali demma jigi, ate dila ale basi ate ba gomsi a magsi a tom Naawen tuimaŋa.
12<<Livaima ale pai ba nisaŋa a vi lalisaŋa zuk la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, yaa pai kanyi wa ale magsi biem tiirim la a te Naawen abe m kala mɛ a magsi juka tiirimu. A nye biem duisi basika a te Livaima. 13Basi ate Livaima a zaani Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa niŋ a pai ba ase zak sakka tiirim la a te Naawen. 14Suiku de po fi ale gaari Livaima ka ba tɔga a ta nyini Izirali dem mbala po ate ba chim mi nuruba.
15<<Ase fi le nye ate Livaima a nye cheri, ale pai ba a te ase zak sakka tiirim la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, ba a magsi ba jam a tom ba tuimaŋa ka Tuka Viuku po. 16Bala ale Izirali demma baai ale ba pai badek meena a te mi la. Mi a pai ba ase ka m dek nuruba la ate ba tagri za ba le dɛ niŋ a biak baai la naŋkula po, Izirali nipooma ale dɛ niŋ a biak nidoabili sii la. 17Jaduok meena ate ba dɛ niŋ biak Izirali po la, ka nurubiik yaase duŋ ka mi ale soa. Ase m daam le ko ba le dɛ niŋka a biak baai Ejipiti po la, mi jam gaari ba a te ka m dek. 18Mi abe pai Livaima ate ba tagri za ka Izirali demma ale dɛ niŋ a biak nidoabili sii la meena naŋkula po. 19Izirali demma meena po, mi pai Livaima ase ka tiirim la a te Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ayen ba a tom Tuka Viuku po a te Izirali demma abe ba nye biem duisi basika ate nyiŋtuila a kan yik Izirali demma ase ba nin cheŋ moata Wen yenni.>>
20Moosis ale Aaron ale Izirali naakuuni meena a jam nye ale Livaima ka dii dek ate Naawen a jam weeni Moosis la. 21Livaima a jam nye badek ka cheri ale sugri ba gattaŋa. Aaron a jam pai ba ase ka zak sakka tiirim la a te Naawen ale nye biem duisi basika a te ba ayen ba nala. 22Kula ŋaaŋnyiŋ, Livaima a yaa jam ba tom ba tuimaŋa Tuka Viuku po, ka Aaron ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale jam a nya ba zuk ate ba a tom. Ba jam a nye ale Livaima ase ka Naawen ale jam weeni Moosis diila.
23Naawen a jam weeni Moosis ayen, 24<<Kude a cheŋ ka Livaima jigi. Nidoama ale paari bena pisiye ale ŋanu yaase ba gaam di la, a jam maa tom tuimaŋa Tuka Viuku po, 25alege baai a dan paari bena pisinu, ku a fɛ kama ate ba basi ba le a tom veruveruk la abe ba kuli a ga vuusi, ba kan ŋman tom tuini. 26Ba diem baga a maari ba suataŋa kama ate ba a tom ba tuimaŋa Tuka Viuku po, alege badek ku a fɛ ate ba kan ŋman tom tuini. Kude ale magsi ni nye ate Livaima a seba ba tuimaŋa ale ka diila>>.

Title: CHIINIKA 9
Content:
1Naawen a jam biisi ale Moosis Sinai Gɔi Kosikka po chiik kaai ale dɛ niŋka la bena ŋayewa po ate ba jam basi Ejipiti tɛŋka la ŋaaŋnyiŋ. Wa jam weeni ayen, 2<<Basi ate Izirali demma a dɛ Gaambasika Tigini diipo ale magsi la. 3Ni de di diipo ale magsi la junɔi chiika de daa pi ale ŋanaansiwa danni a ta va di ŋmarisika ale di buusaŋa ale ka diila.>>
4Dila nyiŋ Moosis yaa jam weeni Izirali demma ayen ba dɛ Gaambasika Tigini, 5ate ba nye dila Sinai Gɔi Kosikka po junɔi chiik kaai ale piilim la, ka daa pi ale ŋanaansiwa danni. Izirali demma a jam nye ka dii meena ate Naawen a jam weeni Moosis la.
6Alege ba gela an jam bag a dɛ Gaambasika Tigini dai dila danni, dii nyiŋla ba jam taŋ ka badek ale kpio. Ba yaa jam Moosis ale Aaron jigi dai dila danni 7a weeni Moosis ayen, <<Tama a taŋ kama dii nyiŋla ti tiri ka kpio, alege ka boa ale a kasi tama ate ti an baga a te Naawen ti tiirimu ale Izirali dem mbala diipo ale magsi la?>>
8Moosis yaa tulisi ba ayen, <<Ni limisi ate m bek Naawen a wom wa le ta dii wa weeni ni la.>>
9Ate Naawen a jam weeni Moosis ayen, 10<<Weeni Izirali demma ayen, <Ase ni wanyi yaase ni ŋaaŋbisa a dan daŋ badek ba le tiri kpio la nyiŋ, yaase ba bo nyeerim po, ba diem baga dɛ Naawen Gaambasika Tigini kama. 11Ba magsi ba dɛ tigini ka daa pi ale ŋanaansiwa danni chiisa siyewa po junɔi. Ba a magsi ba ŋɔbi pabiika a gum chaab ale ŋandiin tii ate ba an nyo dabinta du la ale tinaŋ tuasa. 12Ku a fɛ ate ba kan tali lammu ate vari veenti bu yaase ba ŋɔbi ka kobaŋa. Ase ba daa dɛ Gaambasika Tigini, ku a fɛ ate ba va ŋmarisika meena. 13Alege nuru waai a dan nala, ale an bo nyeerim po, a zɛri an dɛ Gaambasika Tigini, kula nyɔnɔwa ku a fɛ ate ba yiak wa, wa nuruma po a basi dii nyiŋla wa an te Naawen tiirim diipo ale magsi la. Nuru wala ale nya wa biemu tutuna.
14<< <Nichaanɔ a dan bo ni po a yaali wa dɛ Naawen Gaambasika Tigini, ku a fɛ ate wa mɛ a nye dila a ta va di ŋmarisika ale di buusaŋa ale ka diila. Ku a fɛ ate ni ta ŋmarisi yena a te nicham ale tɛŋ bisaŋa.> >>
15Dai dii danni ate viuku, viuku kuui ate Naawen wanni a boro ate ba jam ti ku la, chiŋmari ale jam lik ku. A nyini junɔi a ta ga paari saluik, chiŋmanni a jam bo viuku zuk ase ka bolim la. 16Ku le jam ka dii a tom du a cheŋ la ale la. Chiŋmanni a jam lik ku kama, tɛŋka a dan sobiri di a nya ase ka bolim la. 17Diipo meena ate chiŋmanni a zagri ale a ge viuku la, Izirali demma a basi dula kama. Diipo ate chiŋmanni a zaani la, Izirali demma mɛ a kali ka dula. 18Naawen a nyiem le biisi ate Izirali demma a cheŋ, wa dan ŋman weeni ayen ba zaani ba nyiem a bo ka dula. Chiŋmanni ale bo viuku zuk a beni diila, ba a bo ka dula. 19Ase chiŋmanni a dan bo viuku zuk ate ku beni, Izirali demma a nyiem siak a te Naawen wanni kama a kan cheŋŋi. 20Dai dii dai chiŋmanni a bo viuku zuk ka daa maga, ate Naawen a dan biisi, ba wari bo dula jigini, ate wa dan ŋman biisi ayen ba cheŋ, ba yaa basi dula ale cheŋ. 21Dai dii dai chiŋmanni a boro a nyini ka junɔi a ga paari saluik, ase di dan ga zagri saluiku ba a basi dula kama. Ku dan poom ka kantueŋ yaase yok, chiŋmanni a dan ga zagri ba a cheŋ kama. 22Chiŋmanni a dan bo viuku zuk a paari daa ŋaye yaase chiik yaase ben, Izirali demma a bo ka dula ba kan cheŋ, alege di dan zagri, ba a cheŋ kama. 23Naawen a dan biisi, ba nyiem tigsi a bo ka jigi yeŋ, ate wa nyiem ŋman biisi ate ba basi dula ale cheŋ. Ba jam a wom Naawen wanni kama, a ta va wa wanni ate wa jam biisi a ta va Moosis zuk la.

Title: CHIINIKA 10
Content:
1Naawen a yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 2<<Kuri kpana a nye damunsa siye a ta peeri a wi naakuuni ate ba a jam jigi yeŋ. 3Ase siyewa a dan peeri, naakuuni meena ale tigsi fi niŋ Tuka Viuku nansuiŋku nɔi. 4Ase kanyi dekki a dan kum, niŋdeerɔma ale yezuimaŋa nyam a yaa le tigsi fi niŋ. 5Ase damuniŋka a dan kumu, diin ŋaai ale bo kori geŋsa la a yaa le nyini a cheŋ. 6Damuniŋka a dan kum saari buye, baai ale bo yeseoku geŋsa la mɛ ale nyini. Damuniŋka kumsaŋa ale ku sak ayen ku magsika ba nyini a cheŋ. 7Ate fi tigsi tigsuŋku la, peeri damunsaŋa, alege si kumsaŋa a chim ku tɔga ale nyinika kumsaŋa.
8<<Kaabteerɔwa Aaron nidoabilisaŋa ale magsi ba peeri damunsaŋa. Kude ale chim ka ŋmarisi kaai ale ka beni a te fi ale fi gaŋsaŋa. 9Ase nama a dan cheŋ ni nye kpaliŋ nidek tɛŋka po ale ni dachiak waai ale a namsi ni la, ni peeri ni damunsaŋa. Naawen ni Wenni ale teeri ni wari a vari ni ni dachaasaŋa nisa po a basi. 10Ate diipo ate ni mariŋ nidek a dɛ Chiik Paalika tigini la, ni yaa peeri damunsaŋa a basi ni juka ale ni suiyɔgni tiiritaŋa zuk ate ku la chim teerika a te ni, ni Wen niŋ. Mi ale Naawen ni Wenni.>>
11Daa pisiyewa danni chiisa siyewa, bena ŋayewa po, chiŋmanni a yaa basi viuku ate Naawen Wanni a boro la. 12Ate Izirali demma a yaa basi Sinai Gɔnni a taam dɛ, a ga dɛ ate ku ga paari diipo ate chiŋmanni a ga bo Paran Gɔnni zuk la. 13Ba yaa jam piilim nyini a cheŋ ase Naawen ale jam weeni Moosis la.
14Juda nidoabilisaŋa tiktiwa a va chaab ale ba tugurik tommu yueŋa ale dɛ niŋ a nyini, ate Amminadab nidoabinni Naason, a nya tommu zuk. 15Zuar nidoabinni Netanel ale jam chim Isaka dɔkku niŋdeerɔ, 16alege ate Yelon nidoabinni Eliab a chim Zebulun dɔkku niŋdeerɔ. 17Ate Livaima yaa kpiti viuku, ate Gerson ale Merari kabini a ji nyini a cheŋ.
18Aruben dɔkku ale jam pai a saŋ ale ba tiktiwa a ta va ba ale ka diila. Ka Sedeur nidoabinni Elizur ale jam dɛ ba niŋ. 19Zurisaddai nidoabinni Selumiel ale jam dɛ Simeyon dɔkku niŋ, 20alege ate Deuel nidoabinni Eliasaf a chim Gad dɔkku niŋdeerɔ. 21Koyat kabini a yaa nyini a ji ŋan weleŋsaŋa. Viuku a jam magsi ka ku ti alege jigi ate ba paari du.
22Ɛfraim dɔkku ale jam pai saŋ ale ba tiktiwa a ta va ba ale ka diila. Ka Ammiyud nidoabinni Elisama ale jam dɛ ba niŋ. 23Pedazur nidoabinni Gamaliil ale jam dɛ Manasa dɔkku niŋ, 24alege ate Abidan nidoabinni Abidan a jam dɛ Benjamin dɔkku niŋ.
25Kpeglimka po ase baai ale jam potim a nya labika zuk la, ka Dan dɔkku ale jam wari ŋaaŋ a nyini ale ba tikti wa a ta va ba mɛ ale ka diila. Ammisaddai nidoabinni Ayiezer ale jam dɛ ba mɛ niŋ. 26Okran nidoabinni Pagiel ale jam a nya Asɛ dɔkku zuk, 27alege ate Enan nidoabinni Ayira a nya Nafitali dɔkku zuk. 28Izirali demma ale jam labi dii a cheŋ la ale la.
29Moosis yaa weeni Areuel nidoabinni Yobab, Midian denɔwa, wa ŋachobwa ayen, <<Ti a yaali ti nyini cheŋ ka juijui ate Naawen a weeni ayen, <M le pai dula a te ni la.> Cheŋ ale ti, tama ale nye fu a magsi, Naawen a puulim ka wamaŋsa ale Izirali demma.>>
30Alege ate wa tulisi ayen, <<Aaya, m kan cheŋŋi. Mi a yaa m ŋman kuli ka m dek tɛŋka ale m nuruma jigi.>>
31Alege Moosis a weeni ayen, <<Jenje kan basi ti. Fi seba kauk kuui ale magsi ti tigsi gɔnni de po la kama, fi a baga a chim tama nina kama. 32Fi a dan cheŋ ale ti, tama ale chari ale fu jamaŋ kaai ate Naawen a te tama la.>>
33Ate ba yaa basi Naawen guuku ale nyini cheŋ daa ŋata meena. Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni ale jam dɛ ba niŋ daa ŋatawa meena po a gisi jigi a te ba ayen ba vuusi. 34Naawen chiŋmanni a nyiem le dɛ ba niŋ danni meena po ase ba nin nyini ba cheŋ.
35Diipo meena nɔiyeŋka dakanni a dan ga nyini, Moosis nyiem jam weeni kama ayen, <<M Naawen, yiti zaani, ate fi dachaasaŋa a waaŋ chaab. Fi dachaasaŋa a chali bɛ fi niŋ.>>
36Ase di dan jam zaani, wa nyiem weeni kama ayen, <<Ŋman jam m Naawen Izirali demma baai ale kan ta chiina la jigi.>>

Title: CHIINIKA 11
Content:
1Nuruma a yaa jam fɔbili a ta va wapagra ŋaai ate ba bo ŋa po la Naawen tue po, ase wa le ga wom ba la, wa sui yaa puuri. Ate bolim a nyini Naawen jigi a dɛ ba alege a kaasi ba boka jigini nakpiaka gela. 2Ase nuruma ale jam kum te Moosis la, wa yaa puusi a te Naawen ate bolimu a kpi. 3Ba jam a wi dula jigini ayen ka Tabera, dii nyiŋla bolimu ale nyini Naawen jigi a dɛ ba.
4Nicham baai ale jam va ba a nyini Ejipiti la, kɔrisa a yaa jam bo ŋandiin yonta jigi, ate Izirali demma a ŋman piilim kum a weeni ayen, <<Ase ti dan poom taka lam a ŋɔbi, 5tama a teeri jumaŋa ate ti jam bo Ejipiti a ŋɔbi ale kan tuni ŋa nyiŋla kama, ti jam maari a dɛ yɔna tɔgatɔga mɛ ale alabasa ale galik kama. 6Alege yɔgyɔgla de ti jɔk koarisila kama. Tama an ŋman nya jaaboa ka Nyɔnɔwa ŋandiintaŋa nyiini.>>
7Naawen ŋandiintaŋa a jam a nye ase ka ŋan bie fiisa la alege a mak. 8Nuruma a yaa cheŋ gilim a pisi ŋa, a num ŋa niri po yaase ba gariŋ tuik po. Ba jam dik ŋa ka samɔniŋ po yaase ba nye maasa. Ŋa jam a ŋɔbi ka nna ase kpaam ale bo ŋa po la. 9Ase maglim a dan ga lo ba boka jigini yok, Naawen ŋandiintaŋa mɛ nyiem lo kama.
10Moosis a yaa wom ale dɔkdem meena nuruba a bo ba viuk nɔi a kum. Ate Naawen sui yaa ŋmasi puuri nna yegayega, ate ku daani Moosis. 11Ate wa bek Naawen ayen, <<Ka boa ate fi a ta daanika dɛ a jam fi yɔmawa jigi ya? Ka boa ate mi nye a kaasi fi, ate fi pai nuruma de daanika a seeri mi? 12Ka mi puuka po ate nuruma de meena a nyini? Ka mi ale biak ba? Ka boa ate fi weeni ayen mi ta ba m nigoruk po ase buluek ma ale ta wa biluak diila, a cheŋ tɛŋ kaai po ate fi puulim ale ba kokpieŋsaŋa la? 13Ka bɛ ate mi ale nya lam a te nuruma de meena? Ba kasim a kum a te mu kama ayen, <Te ti lam ate ti ŋɔbi. 14Mi a kan baga a ta nuruma de meena m dega, wanni a ŋmasi pagra a gaam mu kama. 15Fi a daa fi nye mi kan nnala, be ko mu yɔgyɔgla de ase ku nin yɔk fi sui. Kan basi ate mi kpi mi dek kummoa.>>
16Naawen a yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Ta Izirali demma nisɔm pisiyopɔi baai ate fi seba ayen ba ka niŋdeerɔba ale kpaga nuruma po la a jam te mu. Basi ate ba jam Tuka Viuku po a zaani ale fu. 17M le siŋ jam biisi ale fu dula jigini, mi ale pai Chiik kaai ale bo fi po la, a nyo ba po. Ba le maari fu ate fi baga a nya nuruma zuk, dii le ku basi ate ku kan chim fi nyiini wari ya.
18<<Weeni nuruma ayen, <Ni gomsi nidek a magsi chum, ale ni a ni ŋɔbi ka lam, Naawen a wom ni kama diipo ate ni kum ayen, ase tama a dan poom ta ka lam a ŋɔbi, ti jam zunchoŋ kama diipo ate ti jam bo Ejipiti po la. Yɔgyɔgla de Naawen ale te ni lam ate ni ŋɔbi. 19Ni kan ŋɔbi ti ka dai yeŋ yaase daa ŋaye yaase daa ŋanu yaase daa pi yaase daa pisiye nyiini, 20alege ni le ŋɔbi a paari ka chiik pumi ate ti va ni nyueŋa nyini dii nyiŋla ni zɛri Naawen dii ale bo ale ni la kama a kum wa niŋ a weeni ayen, ka boa ate tama a basi Ejipiti tɛŋka?> >>
21Alege Moosis a weeni ayen, <<Dela mi bo ka nidoaba tusa kobsiyuebi (600,000) po a cheŋ naŋta, ate fi weeni ayen, <Mi ale te ba lam ate ba ŋɔbi chiika meena.> 22Ba le nya yega ase ba nin poom tɔgri duŋsa a te ba? Ba le chagi ase ba nin yik jumaŋa meena nyakpiemu po a te ba?>>
23Naawen a yaa tulisi Moosis ayen, <<Naawen nisaŋa a ŋmasi gela kama? Fi yaa le nya ase m le weeni diila ale nye wensie a te fu ya.>>
24Moosis yaa nyini peelim a weeni nuruma dii ate Naawen a weeni la. Wa yaa ta ba niŋdeerɔba pisiyopɔi a jam jigi yeŋ a gilim Viuku. 25Ate Naawen a yaa siŋ jam chiŋmanni po a biisi ale wa ale pai Chiik kaai ale bo wa po la a nyo niŋdeerɔba pisiyopɔiwa po. Ase Chiika ale jo ba po la, ba yaa biisi Naawen wie, ba an ŋman biisi dila diipo diipo.
26Alege nuruba baye, ba yue jam le Eldad ale Medad ale jam tali bo ba boka jigini. Ba jam chiini ba a gum nisɔmma po kama alege ba an jam nyini cheŋ Viuku po. Alege Chiika a diem jam bo ba po kama ate ba biisi Naawen wie. 27Nuru paalik a yaa chali cheŋ Moosis jigi a ga weeni ayen, <<Eldad ale Medad a biisi ka Wen wie ba boka jigini.>>
28Nun nidoabinni Josua waai ale jam a maari Moosis wa paalimu po la, a yaa biisi ayen, <<Moosis m nyɔnɔwa, kasi ba!>>
29Alege Moosis yaa tulisi ayen, <<Fi a dɛka nyuri mi nyiŋŋa? Mi a yaali ayen Naawen nuruma meena ate ka biisiteerɔba ate Naawen a pai wa Chiika a nyo ba po.>> 30Ate Moosis ale Izirali nisɔmma a yaa ŋman cheŋ ba boka jigini.
31Viok a yaa nyini Naawen jigi a ta yeŋsa nyini nyakpiemu geŋsa a jam te ba. Ku ta jam gilim ba boka jigini meena kama ate si vi chaab a jueli paari duna a yalima ase danni po meena chelim la. 32Dai dila meena ale yok kula ale dai dii ale paasaŋ la meena, nuruma a jam nyini a tigsi ka yeŋsa. Waai an jam tigsi boorisa ate si an paari pi. Ba jam kati si a waaŋ gilim ba boka jigini meena kama. 33Alege lammu ale diem jam bo ba nyinaŋa po la, alege jigi ate ba nɛ bu la, Naawen sui yaa puuri ale nuruma, ate wa yaa basi ate nyiŋtuila a yik ba. 34Dila nyiŋla ba yaa te dula yuei ayen Kibrot Yattaava dii nyiŋla, dula jigini ate ba gu nuru baai ale dɛ ŋandiin yonta la.
35A nyini Kibrot Yattaava nuruma a jam cheŋ ka Yazerot a ga bo dula jigini.

Title: CHIINIKA 12
Content:
1Miriam ale Aaron a yaa piilim a biisi Moosis a kaasi Kus tɛŋka liewa ate wa jam faari la nyiŋ. 2Ba bek ayen, <<Naawen a biisi ale ka Moosis nyiini? Wa kan biisi a ta va tama mɛ zuwa?>> Ate Naawen a wom kude.
3Moosis a jam ka nuru waai ale a yik wadek la, wa jam ŋmasi yik wadek a gaam waai meena kama tɛŋzuk de.
4Ate Naawen yaa deri weeni Moosis ale Aaron ale Miriam ayen, <<Ni nyini jam Tuka Viuku po ni nɔi ni tama meena.>> Ate ba nɔi ba tama a yaa nyini. 5Ate Naawen a yaa siŋ jam ba jigi ase chiŋmari la. Wa jam za ka Viuku nansuiŋku nɔi a wi Aaron ale Miriam. Ase ba nɔi bayema ale jam niŋ la. 6Wa yaa weeni ayen, <<Ni wom mi wieŋa. Ase Naawen biisiteerɔ a dan bo ni po, m te pai m dek sak wa kama, m le biisi ale wa gɔdaasima po. 7Alege kude a daa wensie a ta va mi tomteerɔwa Moosis jigi ya, wa ta siaka ale m yenni meena kama. 8Mi a biisi le wa ka wa nina po nalimnyiini, daa sunsuelima, wa a nya mi ase ka mi ale ka diila. Ka boa ate nama a kan chali yɔgsum ale biisi m tomteerɔwa Moosis a kaasi?>>
9Ate Naawen sui yaa puuri ale ba ate wa basi ba.
10Ase chiŋmanni ale basi Viuku la, Miriam yaa deri za a peenti nna tektek. Aaron a yaa viriŋ tuk wa a nya ale wa nyiŋka a kaasi, 11ate wa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Jenje m nyɔnɔ, kan pai tuni ti, tama le nye betta nyeka a tom biem buui la nyiŋŋa. 12Kan fi basi ate wa nye ase biluak kpiuk ale nyini wa ma popo a nyini ate wa nyiŋka kabta a ka diila.>>
13Dila nyiŋla Moosis yaa kaari a te Naawen ayen, <<Wen yaa, tebi wa.>>
14Ate Naawen a yaa tulisi Moosis ayen, <<Ase wa kowa a dan chesi tuntueta a nyo wa ninaŋa po, wa ti le bo chivie po a paari daa ŋayopɔi. Basi ate wa jam ni boka jigini.>> 15Dila nyiŋ Miriam yaa jam boka peelim a paari daa ŋayopɔi, nuruma an jam ga jigi ya ate ku paari diipo ate ba ta wa ŋman jam la.
16Kula ŋaaŋnyiŋ, nuruma a basi Yazerot kama ale cheŋ ga bo Paran Gɔnni po.

Title: CHIINIKA 13
Content:
1Naawen a yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 2<<Tom nuruba ate ba ga kpesi nya Keenan tɛŋka, kaai ate mi ale pai te Izirali demma la. A nyini ba ŋiaka dɔkku po tom ku niŋdeerɔma wanyi meena.>>
3Ase Naawen ale weeni la, Moosis yaa tom ba ate ba nyini Paran Gɔnni. Ba meena a jam ka Izirali niŋdeerɔba.
4Ba yueŋa ale nna. A nyini Aruben dɔkku po, ba tom ka Zakkur nidoabili Sammua. 5A nyini Simeyon dɔkku, ba jam tom ka Yori nidoabili Safat. 6A nyini Juda dɔkku, ba jam tom ka Jefunne nidoabili Kaleb. 7A nyini Isaka dɔkku, ba jam tom ka Josefi nidoabili Igal. 8A nyini Ɛfraim dɔkku, ba jam tom ka Nun nidoabili Yoseya. 9A nyini Benjamin dɔkku, ba jam tom ka Arafu nidoabili Palti. 10A nyini Zebulun dɔkku, ba jam tom ka Sodi nidoabili Gaddiel. 11A nyini Josefi dɔkku Manasa, ba jam tom ka Susi nidoabili Gaddi. 12A nyini Dan dɔkku, ba jam tom ka Gemalli nidoabili Ammiel. 13A nyini Asɛ dɔkku, ba jam tom ka Maakil nidoabili Setur. 14A nyini Nafitali dɔkku, ba jam tom ka Vofsi nidoabili Nabi. 15A nyini Gad dɔkku, ba jam tom ka Maki nidoabili Geuel. 16Nuruma de yueŋa ale nna, ate Moosis a jam tom ayen ba ga kpesi nya tɛŋka la. Moosis ale jam tagri Nun nidoabili Yoseya yuenni ale te wa yue ayen Josua.
17Ase Moosis ale tom ba ayen ba ga kpesi nya Keenan tɛŋka la, wa weeni ayen, <<Ni va Negev tɛŋka po ale tɛŋ kaai ate guuta a bo ka po la. 18Ni nya ase tɛŋka a nye ase ka se la, nuru baai ale bo ka po la a ta pagrim yaase ba wobsa kama, ba piisi yaase ba an piisi ya. 19Ba bo ka tɛŋ boan choa po? Ka nala yaase ka lɔrima? Tɛŋ sin chaab po ate ba boro? Ba an se parik a gilim si yaase ba se parik a gilim si? 20Ka tantaŋa ka sɛ? Poosuk a bo ka po yaase poosuk a ka? Tiisa a bo ka po yaase tiisa ka? Ni nye dii ate ni ale baga a ta tɛŋka tiisaŋa yɔnaŋa gela a jam la.>> Ku jam ka diipo ale magsi yɔn fi gilima ŋaai ale dɛ niŋ a muni la.
21Ba yaa jam cheŋ a ga kpesi nya tɛŋka a nyini Zin Gɔnni po a ta ga paari Areyob a tuk Lebo Yamat tɛŋsaŋa nyiŋ. 22Ba yaa va Negev tɛŋka po a jam paari Yebron tɛŋka, kauk kuui ate Anak ŋaaŋbisaŋa Ayiman ale Sesai ale Talmai a boro la. Ba le jam se Yebron la ku paari ka bena ŋayopɔi alege ate ba se Zoan ale bo Ejipiti po la. 23Ase ba le jam paari Eskol Viaka la, ba yaa jam che tiib naŋ ale yɔn fi gilima sagi. Nuruba baye ale jam pai yɔn fi gilima a yik diok nyiŋ a ji ate di bo ba suŋsuŋ ale yɔn kpieŋ gilima ale kiŋkama. 24Ba jaa wi dula ayen ka Eskol Viak dii nyiŋla, Izirali demma ale jam gbesi yɔn fi gilima sagni dula la nyiŋ. 25Ba ale kpesi a nya tɛŋka a nueri daa pisinaansiwa ŋaaŋ nyiŋla, ba yaa ŋman jam.
26Ba yaa ŋman jam Moosis ale Aaron ale Izirali naakuuni ale jam bo Kades, Paran Gɔnni po la jigi. Dula jigini ate ba yaa jam weeni dii ate ba nya la sak Moosis ale Aaron Izirali tigsuŋku meena ale pai tɛŋka yɔnaŋa a sak ba. 27Ba yaa jam weeni Moosis wieŋa de ayen, <<Ti cheŋ tɛŋ kaai ate fi a tom ti la kama, siita ale biisim ale sueri ka po ka yɔnaŋa abe le nna. 28Alege nuru baai ale bo ka po la a pagra kama, ate ba se parik a gilim ka ale ŋmasi zuak mɛ. Ti nya Anak ŋaaŋbisaŋa mɛ ale ba bo dula. 29Amalek demma a bo ka Negev tɛŋka. Yit demma ale Jebus demma ale Amori demma a bo ka guuku zuk tɛŋka, alege ate Keenan demma a jam moata ka nyakpiemu ale sali Jodan Benni la.>>
30Kaleb a yaa basi ate nuruma a nye chorototo Moosis niŋ ale weeni ayen, <<Ti cheŋ a ga tuesi tɛŋka, tama ale baga a nye dila kama.>>
31Alege nuru baai ale va wa cheŋ la a weeni ayen, <<Tama an baga a nye kpaliŋ ale nuru bala. Ba pagra a gaam tama ale ka diila kama.>> 32Ate ba yaa basi ate wanni de a waaŋ paari Izirali demma meena ba le nya dii tɛŋka po la. Ba weeni ayen, <<Tɛŋ kaai ate tama cheŋ ga kpesi nya la, a nɛ baai ale bo ka po la kama. Nuru baai meena ate tama a nya la ka ganduata. 33Ti nya Anak ŋaaŋbisaŋa Nefilim demma mɛ a boka dula. Tama a nye ase ka nanchoŋta la tama dek nina po, ti ka dila a te ba.>>

Title: CHIINIKA 14
Content:
1Yok kula naakuuni nuruma meena a yaa kaari nna bɔgbɔg. 2Izirali demma meena a yaa fɔbili te Moosis ale Aaron, ate tigsuŋku a weeni ba ayen, <<Ti dan poom kpi Ejipiti tɛŋka yaase gɔnni po a zunchoŋŋa. 3Ka boa ate Naawen a ta ti jam tɛŋka de po ayen ba tɔgri ti? Ti pooma ale ti bisaŋa ale chim ka ŋan koaliŋta. Ku kan zunchoŋŋa ase ti ale ŋman cheŋ Ejipiti tɛŋka?>> 4Ate ba yaa weeni chaab ayen, <<Ti lueri niŋdeerɔ a ŋman cheŋ Ejipiti.>>
5Ate Moosis ale Aaron yaa lo pai nina a vuk tɛŋ Izirali tigsuŋku meena niŋ dula jigini. 6Nun nidoabinni Josua ale Jefunne nidoabinni Kaleb baai ale jam bo nuru baai ale ga kpesi nya tɛŋka la, a yaa jam dari ba gattaŋa a cheeri 7ale weeni Izirali tigsuŋka meena ayen, <<Tɛŋka ate ti jam va ka po a taam a kpesi nya la a nala kama a gaam taam. 8Naawen sui a dan yɔk ale ti, wa le de ti niŋ a ta ti jo tɛŋ kala po, kaai ate biisim ale siita sueri ka po la, abe wa pai ka a te ti. 9Ka nama tin kan nye tukpari ale Naawen ya. Abe ni kan chali tɛŋka nuruma yɔgsummoa, dii nyiŋla ti le zak ba a nɛ. Waai a kan nya ba zuwa, alege Naawen a bo ale ti kama. Ni kan chali ba yɔgsum.>>
10Alege tigsuŋku meena a jam a biisi ayen ba yuk ba ale tana. Ate Naawen zulaŋa a yaa jam Tuka Viuku zuk Izirali demma meena jigi. 11Naawen a jam weeni Moosis ayen, <<Nuruma de ale zɛri mi zula te ka a paari ka dimpo? Ka dimpo ate ba ale kasim a zɛri a kan ta siaka ale mi, wakinkagla ŋaai meena ate mi a nye ba suŋsuŋ la? 12Mi ale nak ba dueni tɛŋ ale nyiŋtuila a kaasi ba, alege m le basi ate nama a chim tɛŋ kpieŋ a ta pagrim a gaam ba ale ka diila.>>
13Moosis yaa weeni Naawen ayen, <<Ejipiti demma ale wom dila wari ayen, fi pagrimu nyiŋ, fi ta nuruma de a nyini ba po. 14Ate ba le weeni nuruma ale bo tɛŋka de po la ku wari. Ba poom ŋaam wom kama ayen, Naawen yaa, fi bo ale nuruma de kama, Naawen yaa, ba nya fu kama ale nimbie, fi chiŋmanni ale jam bo ba zuk la diipo ate fi a jam de ba niŋ a cheŋ ase chiŋmari la danni po ale de ba niŋ ase chiŋmari ale bolim la yokku po. 15Fi dan ko nuruma de meena bunyi, tɛŋ sii ale ba wom fi wanni de la ale weeni ayen, 16<Naawen an baga a ta nuruma de a jam tɛŋ kaai ate wa puulim a pɛ ale ba la po. Wa ko ba kama gɔnni po.>
17<<Naawen abe sak wa pagrimu, ase fi le weeni dii dek la. 18<Naawen sui a kan kpabi a puuri, wa ta ŋmanteka nna yegayega a vɔŋ tukpari nyam biem a te ba. Alege wa kan basi baai ale nye kaasi la namsika, wa a namsi bimbaansa ba koma biemu nyiŋ, a nyini gaŋsa butawa a ta ga paari bunaansiwa po.> 19A ta va fi ŋmante kpieŋka nyiŋ, vɔŋ nuruma de biemu a te ba ase fi le jam vɔŋ te ba diipo ate ba basi Ejipiti tɛŋka a ta jam paari jinla la.>>
20Ate Naawen a tulisi ayen, <<Mi vɔŋ te ba kama ase fi ale bek diila. 21Alege ase mi ale vua la nyiŋ, ase Naawen zulaŋa ale sum a sueri tɛŋ zuk de meena la, 22nuruma de wanyi baai ale jam nya m zulaŋa ale wakinkaglaŋa ate mi nye Ejipiti ale gɔnni po la, alege baai ale zɛri mi ale nye mi nya a paari naŋtuok nɔi pi la, 23ba wanyi mɛ la a kan nya tɛŋ kaai ate m puulim ale ba kokpieŋsaŋa la. Ba wanyi mɛ la waai ale nye mi a kaasi la kan nya ka. 24Alege mi tomteerɔwa Kaleb a ta ka chiik katɔga ale va mi ale wa suinum meena, m le ta wa jam tɛŋ kaai ate wa a yaali wa jo la po, ate wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale soa ka. 25Ase Amalek ale Keenan demma ale bo vaasaŋa po la nyiŋ, chum ni viriŋ ŋaaŋ a duŋ gɔnni nyiŋ a va suik kuui ale a cheŋ Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku jigini la.>>
26Naawen yaa jam weeni Moosis ale Aaron ayen, 27<<Gaasa nyama de ale ŋuuni a te mi a paari ka dimpo? Mi wom Izirali naakuuni de funfɔblaŋa ale ŋuunika kama. 28Dila weeni ba ayen, <Ka mi Naawen ale a weeni ayen, ase mi ale vua la, mi le nye wie ŋaai dek ate m wom ale ni a weeni ayen, 29Gɔnni de ni ale kpi, nama baai ale paari bena pisiye yaase ba gaam di ate ba jam chiini ba, ate ba ŋuuni a te mi la. 30Ni wanyi mɛ la a kan jo tɛŋ kaai ate m pɛ ayen m te ni ase ni yeri la po, ka Jefunne nidoabili Kaleb ale Nun nidoabili Josua nyiini ale ba jo ka po. 31Dan ka ni bisaŋa ate ni weeni ayen ba ale koaliŋ ba la, m le ta ba a jam ate ba dɛ masim tɛŋ kaai ate ni zɛri la po. 32Alege nama, ni ale kpi a wari gɔnni de po. 33Ni bisaŋa ale chim naapeerisa dela a paari bena pisinaansi, a nam nama ale kan ta wensie la nyiŋ, ate ku paari diipo ate ni po waai ale wari ŋaaŋ a kpi gɔnni po la. 34Bena pisinaansi, bein yeŋ a magsi daa pisinaansiwa ate ni ga kpesi nya tɛŋka la, ni ale nam ni biemu nyiŋ ate ni seba ku ale ka dii ase nama a nin ta chaab ale mi.> 35Mi Naawen ale biisi, m be le sum nye wieŋa de a te gaasa naakuuni de meena, baai ale jam jigi yeŋ a ta chaab ale mi la. Ba le nya ba kpeglimka jigi gɔnni de po. Dela jigini ba le kpi.>>
36Dila nuru baai ate Moosis a jam tom ayen ba ga kpesi nya tɛŋka la, baai ale ŋman jam nye ate naakuuni meena a ŋuuni a te wa, ase ba le jam velim tɛŋka wie diila. 37Nuruma de baai ale jam velim tɛŋka wie la, nyiŋtuila ale jam ko ba Naawen niŋ. 38Nuru baai ale jam ga kpesi nya tɛŋka la, ka Nun nidoabinni Josua ale Jefunne nidoabinni Kaleb nyiini ale tali vua.
39Ase Moosis ale jam weeni kude a te Izirali demma meena la, ba yaa kum nna tuotuowa. 40Dai dii ale pa saŋ la saluik yokyokwa ba yaa cheŋ a duŋ gu kpioŋku tɛŋka nyiŋ ayen, <<Ti nye ka biem ti ale jueli juijui ate Naawen a puulim la.>>
41Alege Moosis ayen, <<Ka boa ate nama a zɛri Naawen wanni? Kude a kan nye niagi. 42Ni kan jueli, dii nyiŋla Naawen an bo ale ni. Ni dachaasaŋa ale nak a yik ni. 43Amalek demma ale Keenan demma ale tu chaab ale ni dula. Ni ale basi Naawen vaka la nyiŋ, wa kan bo ale ni ate ba le ko ni.>>
44Ba le a poli ayen ba nya badek a chak kama la ba cheŋ a duŋ guuk kpioŋku tɛŋka nyiŋ, Moosis yaase Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni an jam va ba. 45Ate Amalek demma ale Keenan demma baai ale jam bo tɛŋ kaai ate guuku a bo ka po la a siŋ jam nye kpaliŋ ale ba a nak ba a ta ga va suiku ale cheŋ Yorma tɛŋka la.

Title: CHIINIKA 15
Content:
1Naawen a weeni Moosis ayen, 2<<Biisi a te Izirali demma a weeni ba ayen, <Ase ni dan ga jo tɛŋka po ate mi a te ni ase yeri la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, 3a pai ni juka tiirita a te Naawen a ta nyini ni duŋsaŋa po ase ŋan baai nyum ale masa la, ba ka juka tiirita yaase kaabka, a magsi chaab ale pumpuulima yaase suiyɔgni tiirita diipo meena ale magsi la. 4Waai ale ta wa tiirimu jam la yaa le pai ŋandiinta tiirimu a te Naawen, zom naliŋ chin nɔi ale kpaam ale leŋ a lab bunaansi a pai bunyi a dam du. 5Waai ale ta pabiika a cheena ase juka tiirim la yaase kaabka la, a ta daam leŋ a lab bunaansi a pai bunyi a gum du ase nyuka tiirim la.
6<< <Ale padiak gomsi ŋandiinta tiirim, pai zonaliŋ chin nɔi a lab pi a pai buye, a pai kpaam leŋ a lab buta a pai bunyi a dam du, 7ale daam leŋ a lab buta a pai bunyi ase nyuka tiirim la a te Naawen ase nyum buui ale masa la.
8<< <Ase ni dan gomsi lalik paalik ase juka tiirim yaase kaabka, a magsi pumpuulima yaase suiyɔgni tiirita a te Naawen, 9ale lalik ta ŋandiinta tiirim zonaliŋ chin a lab pi a pai buta a dam kpaam leŋ geli du. 10Maa ta daam liŋ geli a jam ase nyuka tiirim la. Ku le chim ka tiirim ate ba nye ale bolim, nyum buui ale masa a te Naawen. 11Lalik kanyi meena yaase padiak, pabiik kanyi meena yaase buuk paaluk meena a magsi ni gomsi si nnala. 12Ni nye a te waai meena ase ni le gomsi a piisi diila.
13<< <Waai meena ale ka tɛŋ biik la, ku a fɛ ate wa nye wieŋa de suiku de po, ase wa dan ta tiirim ate ba nye ale bolim ase nyum buui ale masa la a jam te Naawen. 14Kude a cheŋ buuri ŋaai ale bo ŋaaŋ cheena la jigi, ase diipo meena ate nichaanɔ yaase waai meena ale bo ale ni la a dan te tiirim ate ba nye ale bolim ase nyum ale masa la a te Naawen, ku a fɛ ate wa nye ase nama ale nye diila degadega. 15Naakuuni ale ta ka ŋmarisi yena a te nama ale nichamma ale bo ale ni la. Kude ka ŋmarisi kaai ale ka beni a te gaŋ sii ale bo ŋaaŋ cheena la. Nama ale nichamma a magsi ka ni chim bunyi a te Naawen. 16Sinsak yena ale buusa yena ale magsi nama ale nichamma ale bo ale ni la a va.> >>
17Naawen a weeni Moosis ayen, 18<<Biisi a te Izirali demma a weeni ayen, <Ase ni dan jo tɛŋ kaai ate m ta ni a cheŋ la po, 19ate ni dɛ tɛŋka ŋandiintaŋa, Ni pai kauk a te Naawen ase tiirim la. 20Ni te maasidi a ta nyini ŋandiin tii ate ni dɛ niŋ nya tɛŋka po la ase tiirim la a ta nyini fɔbika jigini. 21A nyini ni gaŋsaŋa meena ale cheen la, ku a magsi ka ni te tiirimu de Naawen a ta nyini ŋandiin tii ate ni dɛ niŋ a nya la.
22<< <Yɔgyɔgla de, fi dan potim seba ale an ta wieŋa de ate Naawen a te Moosis la, 23Naawen wieŋa dinyi ate wa te ni a ta va wa zuk la, a nyini da dii danni ate Naawen a te ni la a ta ga paari gaŋ sii ale bo ŋaaŋ cheen la, 24ase ni dan kan seba ale nye ate naakuuni a zɛ ku nɔi po, naakuuni meena a magsi ba te ka lalik paalik a magsi juka tiirim ase nyum buui ale masa a te Naawen, a va chaab ale ŋandiinta tiirim ale nyuka tiirim ale buduk a magsi biem tiirim. 25Kaabteerɔwa ale wa nye biem duisi basika kaabka a te Izirali naakuuni meena ate ba nya vɔŋteka. Diila ba an potim seba ale nye ya, ba abe ta ba kaasuŋku a jam Naawen jigi kama ale juka tiirim ale biem tiirim. 26Izirali naakuuni meena ale nichamma ale bo ale ba la ale nya vɔŋteka dii nyiŋla nuruma meena a bo kaasuŋ kuui ate ba an potim seba ale nye kaasi la po kama.
27<< <Alege nuru yeŋ a dan kan potim seba ale nye kaasi, ku a fɛ ate wa te busari dii ale paari bein la a magsi biem tiirim. 28Kaabteerɔwa ale wa nye biem duisi basika a te Naawen dii ale kan seba ale nye biemu la nyin, ase ba dan nye biem duisi basika a te wala, wa yaa le nya vɔŋteka. 29Ku be ka sinsak yena a te waai meena ale kan potim seba ale tom a kaasi la, ku nyɔnɔwa dan ka tɛŋ biik yaase nichaanɔ ka sinsak yenaŋa.
30<< <Alege waai ale seba ale nye biem, wa dan ka tɛŋ biik yaase nichaanɔ a biisi kaasi Naawen, ku a fɛ ate ba yeeri wa a ta nyini wa nuruma po a nyini. 31Dii nyiŋla wa le zɛri Naawen wanni an va ŋa la, nuru wala ba yeeri wa, wa nuruma po a basi, wa kaasuŋku a va wa.> >>
32Ase Izirali demma ale diem jam bo gɔnni po la, ba yaa nya nuru ale wa boro yaali daata Vuusum Danni. 33Baai ale nya wa ale wa boro a yaa daataŋa la yaa ta wa jam Moosis ale Aaron ale tigsuŋku meena jigi, 34a yaa lik wa dii nyiŋla, ba potim jam diem zɛ ba le a ba nye wa ka diila. 35Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Ku a fɛ ate nuruwa kpi. Tigsuŋku meena a ta wa nyini peelim a yuk wa ale tana.>> 36Dila tigsuŋku yaa ta wa nyini ba tuka jigini a nyini peelim a yuk wa ale tana a ko, ase Naawen ale weeni Moosis diila.
37Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 38<<Biisi a te Izirali demma a weeni ba ayen, <Ni gaŋsaŋa meena ale kala ba jam la ni nye zuesa ni gattaŋa noaŋa ate garuk miik sobluk a bo zuesaŋa kunyi meena nyiŋ. 39Ni le ta zuesaŋa dɛ kama nya ate ni a teeri Naawen wieŋa meena ate dila ale basi ate ni a va ŋa ate ni kan taŋ nidek a va ni suiniima ale ni nina kɔrisa. 40Ate ni yaa le teeri a va m wieŋa meena a gaari nidek a te ni Wenni. 41Mi ale Naawen ni Wenni, waai ale ta ni a nyini Ejipiti po a nyini ayen m chim ni Wen la. Mi ale Naawen ni Wenni.> >>

Title: CHIINIKA 16
Content:
1Livai nidoabili jam le Koyat, Koyat nidoabili jam le Izyar, Izyar nidoabili jam le Koora, ale Aruben dɔkku dem gela, Eliab nidoabilisaŋa Datan ale Abiram, ale Pelet nidoabinni On a jam ka zula, 2a yaa yiti ta chaab ale Moosis. Izirali nuruba kobsiye ale pisinu baai ale ka naakuuni niŋdeerɔba ate ba seba a paari la ale jam maa boro, baai ate ba lueri ayen ba dɛ ba niŋ la. 3Ba yaa jam ase tigsuŋ la a yaa zɛri Moosis ale Aaron nɔi ale weeni ba ayen, <<Nama nye cheŋ ka niŋ, naakuuni meena a welema kama waai meena ate Naawen a bo le ba. Ka boa ate nama a zak nidek ŋmai gaam Naawen tigsuŋku?>>
4Ase Moosis ale ga wom di dɛ la, wa yaa lo pai nina a vuk tɛŋ. 5Wa yaa weeni Koora ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma meena ayen, <<Saluik Naawen ale sak waai ate wa soa la ale waai ale welema la, abe wa basi ate nuru wala a jam moata wa. Nuru waai ate wa lueri la wa le basi ate wa moata wa. 6Fi Koora ale fi ŋaaŋviirɔma meena ku a magsi ni nye ka nna, pai ŋan baai ate ba pai a ju ŋan baai nyum ale masa la, 7ate chum fi pai bolim ale ŋan baai nyum ale masa la a nyo ba po a te Naawen. Nuru waai ate Naawen a lueri la ale chim waai ale welema la. Nama Livaima a nye cheŋ ka niŋ.>>
8Moosis a ŋman weeni Koora ayen, <<Yɔgyɔgla de ni wom nama Livaima. 9Ku an diem magsi a te nama, ase Izirali Wenni ale gaari nama a ta nyini Izirali naakuuni meena po a ta ni jam moata wadek ayen ni tom Naawen tuimaŋa wa viuku po, abe ni zaani naakuuni niŋ a sak ba ya? 10Wa ta ni ale ni Livai mbala meena a jam moata ka wadek, alege yɔgyɔgla de nama a yaali ni tuesi kaabka kpaŋtaŋa kama. 11Ku kan va Naawen yaalika ase fi ale fi ŋaaŋviirɔma meena ale jam jigi yeŋ la. Ka wana ale Aaron ate nama a ŋma wa?>>
12Moosis yaa tigsi Eliab nidoabilisaŋa, Datan ale Abiram alege ba weeni ayen, <<Ti kan jamu. 13Fi an ta ti a nyini tɛŋ kaai ate biisim ale siita a bo ka po la ayen fi ko ti kama gɔnni po la? Ate yɔgyɔgla de fi a yaali ayen fi chim naab tama zuwa? 14Fi an ta ti jam tɛŋ kaai ate biisim ale siita a bo ka po la yaase fi te ti tata yaase kaduksa. Fi ale baga yeeri nuruma de nina? Aaya, ti kan jamu.>>
15Moosis sui yaa ŋmasi puuri ate wa weeni Naawen ayen, <<Fi kan tuesi ba tiirimu. Mi an tuesi boniŋ ba jigi ya, yaa m nye ba kaasi ya.>>
16Moosis yaa weeni Koora ayen, <<Fi ale fi ŋaaŋviirɔma meena ale jam Naawen niŋ chum, fi ale ba ale Aaron. 17Nuru yeŋ a pai jabuui ate ba ta a ju ŋan baai nyum ale masa la a nyoro. Ŋantaŋa ate ba le pai ju bolimu la a paari ka kobsiye ale pisinu ate ba pai te Naawen. Nama ale Aaron mɛ a te.>> 18Dila nyiŋla nuru meena yaa pai wa jaamu ate wa ju bolim wa po la a nyo bolim ale ŋan baai nyum ale masa la du a yaa za ale Moosis ale Aaron Tuka Viuku nansuiŋku nɔi. 19Ase Koora ale jam tigsi wa ŋaaŋviirɔma meena ayen ba kan siak te ba Tuka Viuku nansuiŋku nɔi la. Naawen zulaŋa a yaa jam tigsuŋku meena jigi. 20Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ale Aaron ayen, 21<<Ni gaari nidek a nyini tigsuŋku po ate mi ale basi ate ba kpi a kpeglim.>>
22Alege Moosis ale Aaron yaa lo pai nina a vuk tɛŋ a yaa kaari ayen, <<Wen yaa, nurubisa meena chiisa Wen, fi sui ale puuri ale tigsuŋku meena ale nuru yeŋ biem nyiŋŋa?>>
23Naawen yaa biisi te Moosis ayen, 24<<Weeni tigsuŋku ayen ba cheŋ nakpiak ba kan moata Koora ale Datan ale Abiram viitaŋa.>>
25Moosis yaa yiti cheŋ Datan ale Abiram jigi. Izirali nisɔmma a jam va wa cheŋ kama. 26Wa yaa kaam tigsuŋku ayen, <<Ni forisi ga ŋaaŋ abe le ge nuru baataŋa de viitaŋa. Ni kan tiri jabuui meena ate ba soa la, ni kan tiri ba ŋantaŋa, kan daa di wa ale ko ni ba wabaataŋa nyiŋ.>> 27Dila nyiŋ ba yaa forisi cheŋ ale basi Koora ale Datan ale Abiram viitaŋa. Datan ale Abiram a yaa nyini peelim a za ale ba pooma ale ba bisaŋa ale ŋan fiisaŋa ba viitaŋa nansuiŋtaŋa nɔi.
28Ate Moosis yaa weeni ayen, <<Kude ale ku basi ate ni seba ayen ka Naawen ale tom mu ayen m nye wieŋa de meena ku daa mi dek popola. 29Ase nuruma de a dan kpi waai meena ale a kpi diila, dan ka di Naawen an tom mi. 30Alege ase Naawen a dan ta wapaali jam ate tɛŋka a lagri a nɛ ba ale jabuui meena ate ba soa la, ate ba siŋ vɔrumu po vuta dila ale basi ate ni seba ayen Nuruma de an nye Naawen magsi ya.>>
31Wa le biisi wieŋa de meena a ga nueri la tɛŋka kauk kuui ate ba za la a yaa na lagri 32a nɛ ba ale ba yeeŋa demma ale Koora nuruma meena ale ba ŋantaŋa meena. 33Ba jam siŋ vɔrumu po ka vuta ale ŋantaŋa meena. Tɛŋka a jam lik ba a basi du kama ate ba kpi cheŋ alege naakuuni. 34Ba le kaari la Izirali demma meena ale za gilim ba la a yaa chali ga nakpiak ale na nna yegayega ayen, <<Tɛŋka a yaa ka nɛ tama kama.>>
35Ate bolim yaa jam nyini Naawen jigi a dɛ nuruba kobsiye ale pisinu baai ale jam boro a nye ŋan baai nyum ale masa tiirim la a ko.
36Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 37<<Weeni Aaron nidoabinni Eleaza, kaabteerɔwa ate wa yeeri ŋan baai ate ba ta a ju bolim wa po la a ta nyini bolimu po a nyini a kati bolim kaalaŋa a waaŋ, ŋantaŋa ate ba a ju bolim ba po la a ta tuilum kama. 38Nuru baai ale tom kaasi la ŋan baai ate baa ju bolim ba po la, ni jaŋsi ba a mati a pai ba pati lik juka kuŋkuŋku zuk diila ba jam pai ba ta ka Naawen niŋ ate ba ta tuilum. Basi ate ba chim daana a te Izirali demma.>>
39Kaabteerɔwa Eleaza a yaa tuesi kutuk mɔnuŋ ŋan baai ate ba cheem bolim ba po, ate baai ate bolimu a dɛ ba ko la a ta jam la, wa jam basi ate ba jaŋsi ba a mati kama a vi juka kuŋkuŋku zuk, 40ase Naawen ale sak wa a ta va Moosis zuk la. Kude yaa ku a teeri ka Izirali demma ayen waai an magsi ya, ka Aaron dɔkku po nyiini ale magsi ba ju ŋan baai nyum ale masa la Naawen niŋ, kan daa di wa le kpi ase Koora ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma la.
41Dai dii ale pai saŋ la Izirali naakuuni meena yaa jaa ŋma Moosis ale Aaron ayen, <<Ni ko Naawen nuruma.>>
42Alege ase tigsuŋku ale tigsi chaab a ŋma Moosis ale Aaron ale tulim a tuk Tuka Viuku nyiŋla, ku an beni ya, chiŋmari yaa lik dula jigini ate Naawen zulaŋa a yaa jam dula. 43Moosis ale Aaron a yaa cheŋ Tuka Viuku nɔi, 44ate Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 45<<Nyini tigsuŋku po a ga nakpiak ate m basi ate ba kpeglim bunyi.>> Ate ba yaa jam lo pai nina a vuk tɛŋ.
46Moosis yaa weeni Aaron ayen, <<Pa fi jabuui ate fi ta a ju bolim la a nyo ŋan baai nyum ale masa la du, a moak bolim juka kuŋkuŋku zuk a nyoro a nye nwuli a ga tigsuŋku jigi a nye biem duisi basika a te ba. Suipuurum ale nyini Naawen jigi a jam, nyiŋtuilaŋa a piilim kama.>> 47Aaron yaa nye dii ate Moosis a weeni wa la, a yaa chali jo tigsuŋku suŋsuŋ. Nyiŋtuilaŋa a poom ŋaam piilim kama alege Aaron a pai ŋan baai nyum ale masa la a te a nye biem duisi basika a te ba. 48Wa jam za ka ŋanvutaŋa ale kpiema suŋsuŋ ate nyiŋtuilaŋa a basi. 49Alege nuruba tusa pi ale ŋanaansi ale kobsiyopɔi (14,700) ale jam kpi nyiŋtuilaŋa nyiŋ a gum baai ale jam kpi Koora nyiŋla. 50Aaron yaa ŋman cheŋ Moosis jigi Tuka Viuku nansuiŋku nɔi dii nyiŋla nyiŋtuilaŋa a jam basi kama.

Title: CHIINIKA 17
Content:
1Naawen yaa biisi te Moosis ayen, 2<<Biisi a te Izirali demma abe fi yaali tacheksa pi ale siye a ta nyini ba jigi, kanyi a ta nyini ba ŋiak dɔk meena niŋdeerɔ jigi. Ŋmarisi nuru meena yuei a dueni wa tachek nyiŋ. 3Livaima tachekka nyiŋ ŋmarisi Aaron yuei a dueni du, ku a fɛ ate tachek yeŋ a magsi ŋiak dɔk meena niŋdeerɔ. 4Pa si a zaani Tuka Viuku po nɔiyeŋka dakanni niŋ kauk kuui ate mi a tu ni la. 5Tachekka ate nuru waai soa ate mi lueri la ale pusi vaata ate mi dek ale basi ate Izirali demma ale a ŋma fi diila a kpeglim?>>
6Moosis yaa biisi te Izirali demma ate ba niŋdeerɔma a te wa tacheksa pi ale siye, kanyi a magsi ŋiak dɔk meena niŋdeerɔ, Aaron tachekka a jam maa bo si po kama. 7Moosis yaa pai tacheksaŋa a zaani Naawen niŋ nɔiyeŋka Dakanni Viuku po.
8Dai dii ale pai a saŋ la Moosis yaa jo nɔiyeŋka Dakanni Viuku po a yaa nya ale Aaron tachekka kaai ale za Livaima naŋkula po la a pusi vaata a yɔni yɔna. 9Moosis yaa ta tacheksaŋa meena a nyini Naawen niŋ a jam te Izirali demma meena. Ba le nya si la, nuru meena yaa pai wadek tachek.
10Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Ta Aaron tachekka a ŋman cheŋ ga dueni Nɔiyeŋka dakanni niŋ ate ka bo dula ase daana la a te tukpari nyama. Kude ale basi ate ba le a ŋma mi diila a kpeglim, ate dila ale basi ate ba kan kpi?>> 11Moosis yaa nye dii dek ate Naawen a weeni wa la.
12Izirali demma yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Ti le kpi tama bɛ kama, tama meena a bɛ kama. 13Waai ale cheŋ a moata Naawen viuku la ale kpi. Tama meena za ti kpi kama?>>

Title: CHIINIKA 18
Content:
1Naawen a weeni Aaron ayen, <<Fi ale fi nidoabilisaŋa ale fi Kowa dɔkku ale ni a nya Naawen yenni tuimaŋa zuk, a ni ba nin nye a kaasi di, ka fi ale fi nidoabilisaŋa nyiini ale ni a nya ase ba nin nye wari a kaasi kaabteerɔma. 2Ta fi Livai chaama a bo ni ŋiaka buuni po la ate ba gum fi po a maari fi ase fi ale fi nidoabilisaŋa a nin boro a yaa ni tom tuima nɔiyeŋka dakanni niŋ viuku po. 3Fi ale fi a nya ba zuk ate ba a tom tuka Viuku po tuimaŋa meena, alege ku a fɛ ate ba kan cheŋ moata ŋan baai ate ba ta tom Wen yenni po la yaase kuŋkuŋku. Ba dan nye dila, ba le fi meena ale kpi. 4Ba ale gum fi po a nya Tuka Viuku po tuimaŋa meena, waai a kan cheŋ moata fi ale bo juijui la.
5<<Fi ale magsi fi a nya Wen yenni tuimaŋa ale juka kuŋkuŋku tuimaŋa zuk ate suipuurum a kan ŋman jam Izirali demma jigi ya. 6Mi dek ale lueri fidek Livai chaama a ta nyini Izirali demma po ase tiirim la a te fu, baai ale pai badek a te Naawen ayen ba tom tuima tuka viuku po. 7Alege ka fi ale fi nidoabilisaŋa nyiini ale magsi ni a tom ase kaabteerɔba la a magsi chaab ale wa dii meena ale nye juka kuŋkuŋku zuk ate garuk panni a kasi la po. Mi ale a te fu kaabteerɔ tuini ase tiirim la. Nuru waai meena ale cheŋ a moata Naawen yenni la ku a fɛ ate ni ko wa.>>
8Naawen yaa weeni Aaron ayen, <<Mi dek ale te fu suik ayen fi a nya m tiiritaŋa zuk poom daa Izirali nidoabilisaŋa tuilum tiiritaŋa ate mi a te ni la m pai te fi ale fi nidoabilisaŋa ase ka ni dɛka jigi la ase ku ale poom ka ni charuk la. 9Nama ale ni soa tiiritaŋa kab tii ale ŋmasi ta tuilum la, tii ale kan nyo bolim po la. A nyini tiiritaŋa meena ate ba ta jam te mi ase tiirim tii ale ŋmasi ta tuilum la, ka ŋandiinta tiirim yaase biem tiirim yaase nyemagsika tiirim, kauk kula ka fi ale fi nidoabilisaŋa ale soa. 10Ni dɛ ti ase ŋan baai ale ŋmasi ta tuilum la, nidoa meena a dɛ ti. Ku a fɛ ate ni a nya ti ase tuilum ŋanta la.
11<<Ba dɛ mɛ ka fi ale soa, jabuui ate ba gaari a ta nyini tiirim tii meena ate ba zak sak a nyini Izirali demma jigi la. Mi a pai a te ka fi ale fi nidoabilisaŋa ale fi liema ase ni charuku ale poom ka diila. Waai meena ale bo fi yenni po a nala la a baga a dɛ ti kama.
12<<M te fu kpa naliŋka meena ale da paalik naliŋka meena ale ŋandiintaŋa ate ba te Naawen ase yɔna ŋaai ate ba dɛ niŋ a nya a nyini ba kpari ŋantaŋa po la. 13Tɛŋka meena yɔnaŋa ale dɛ niŋ bɛ la ate ba ta jam te Naawen la ka fi ale soa. Waai meena ale bo fi yenni po, a nala la a baga a dɛ ti kama.
14<<Jaabuui meena ale bo Izirali Tɛŋka po ate ba gaari wa a te Naawen la ka fi ale soa. 15Ba ni dɛ niŋ biak jabuui la, nuru yaase duŋ ate ba te Naawen la ka fi ale soa. Alege ku a fɛ ate fi da tuesi nidoabili sii meena ate ba dɛ niŋ a biak la ale duŋ kaai ale daŋ a dɛ niŋ a biak ja diok kuui la. 16Ase ba dan ta chiik yeŋ dekki, ku a fɛ ate ni tuni ka daka ligraŋa ale ka diila ase kpana ligbie dobrim bunu (5) la a magsi chaab ale Wen yenni magsika ale ka diila, kuui dobrim ale paari pisiye la.
17<<Alege ku a fɛ ate ni kan da tuesi naab yaase posuk yaase buuk ale dɛ niŋ a biak jabuui la, si ta tuilum kama ni misi si ziimu kuŋkuŋku zuk abe fi ju si kpaamu ase tiirim ate ba ju ale bolim la, ka nyum buui ale masa a te Naawen. 18Si lantaŋa ka nama ale soa ase kuusini ate ba zak a sak ase tiirim la ale kɔsukku ka fi ale soa. 19Jaabuui meena ate ba gaari a ta nyini tuilum tiiritaŋa ate Izirali demma a te Naawen la, m pai ba a te fi ale fi nidoabilisaŋa ale fi liema ase ni charuku ale ka diila. Ku ka nɔiyeŋ kaai ale a ben Naawen jigi nna ase yesa la a te fi ale fi ŋaaŋbisaŋa.>>
20Naawen yaa weeni Aaron ayen, <<Fi a kan nya nitalim ba tɛŋka po yaase fi nya charuk ba po, Mi ale fi nitalimu ale fi charuk Izirali demma po.
21<<Mi te Livaima piika meena Izirali tɛŋka po ase ba nitalim tuim ŋaai ate ba tom la nyiŋ diipo ate ba diem a tom Tuka Viuku po la. 22A nyini yɔgyɔgla de a cheŋ ku a fɛ ate Izirali demma waai a kan cheŋ moata Tuka Viuku, ba dan nye dila, ba le nya ba biemu ninam abe ba kpi. 23Ka Livaima ale magsi ba a tom tuimaŋa Tuka Viuku po, abe ba nya ku tutuna ase waai a nin nye kaasi ku. Ku ka ŋmarisi kaai ale ka beni a te gaŋ sii ale cheen la. Ba kan nya nitalim a ta nyini Izirali demma po. 24Mi te Livaima ka piika ate Izirali demma a te Naawen ase tiirim la ase ba nitalim la. Dila nyiŋ ate mi weeni ba ayen, <Ba kan nya nitalim a nyini Izirali demma po la.> >>
25Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 26<<Biisi a te Livaima a weeni ba ayen, <Ni dan tuesi piika a nyini Izirali demma jigi ate mi te ni ase ni nitalim la, ku a fɛ ate nama mɛ a tuni piik nitalim bula po a te Naawen ase tiirim la. 27Ni tiirimu ale nye ase ka ŋandiinta tiirim la a nyini ŋandiinta fɔbika jigi yaase da masik la a nyini daam ŋmiaka jigi. 28Suik kula po nama mɛ ale ta tiirim tii ate ni tuesi a ta nyini Izirali demma jigi ase piik la a jam Naawen niŋ. A nyini piika dɛ po, ku a fɛ ate ni pai Naawen dɛka jigini a te kaabteerɔwa Aaron. 29Ku a fɛ ate ni te Naawen wa dɛka jigini kauk kuui ale nala ale welema la a nyini jabuui meena po ate ba te ni la.>
30<<Weeni Livaima ayen, <Ase ni dan te kauk kuui ale nala la meena, ku le nye ni jigi ase ka ŋan baai ate ni ta nyini ŋandiinta fɔbika jigi yaase daam ŋmiaka jigi la. 31Nama ale ni yeeŋa demma a baga a dɛ tila meena kama kauk kuui meena, ku ka ni tutuna a magsi ni tuimaŋa Tuka Viuku po. 32Ase ni dan pai kauk kuui ale nala la a te ni an nye kaasi wanni de po, ate dila ale basi ate ni kan taŋ Izirali demma tuilum tiiritaŋa ate ni kan kpi.> >>

Title: CHIINIKA 19
Content:
1Naawen a weeni Moosis ale Aaron ayen, 2<<Kude ale magsi ni nye a ta va ŋmarisika sinsaŋŋa ate Naawen a weeni la, weeni Izirali demma ate ba ta naasari mɔnuŋ dii ale kan ta jomi yaase wari ate niiga diok an vi di ŋiri nya la a jam. 3Pa di a te kaabteerɔwa Eleaza, ni ta di a nyini ni boka jigini a nyini peelim a tɔgri di wa niŋ. 4Eleaza yaa tiak ziimu gela ale nandub a misi buyopɔi a tuk Tuka Viuku nansuiŋku nɔi geŋsa. 5Ase wa le kpesi a nya la, ba yaa ju naasanni gbanni ale di lammu ale di ziimu ale di poni po ŋantaŋa. 6Kaabteerɔwa a yaa pai nyunyoŋ diok ale kpaliok ale kɔb mɔnta a yuk ba vi naasanni ate ba ju la zuk. 7Kula ŋaaŋnyiŋ kaabteerɔwa a yaa sugri wa gattaŋa abe wa so wa nyiŋka ale nyiam. Wa yaa baga jam ba boka jigini kama, alege wa daŋ kama a ga paari wen siŋka. 8Nuru waai ale ju la ku a fɛ ate wa mɛ sugri wa gattaŋa abe wa so wa nyiŋka ale nyiam, wa mɛ a daŋ kama a ga paari wen siŋka.
9<<Nuru waai ale nala la yaa tigsi naasanni ate ba ju la buntuemmu a ta nyini ba boka jigini a dueni peelim kauk kuui ale nala la. Izirali naakuuni a dueni bu a magsi nya buui ale basi ate ba a nye cheri la tuima, dila ale ku basi ate ni nye cheri a nyini biem po. 10Nuru waai ale tigsi naasanni ate ba ju la buntuemmu la, ku a fɛ ate wa mɛ a sugri wa gattaŋa, wa mɛ a daŋ kama a ga paari wen siŋka. Kude ale chim ka ŋmarisi kaai ale ka beni a te Izirali demma ale nichamma ale bo ale ni la.
11<<Waai meena ale a tiri kpio la ale daŋka wadek a ta ga a paari daa ŋayopɔi. 12Ku a fɛ ate wa so wadek ale nyiamu daa ŋatawa danni ale daa ŋayopɔiwa danni, ate wa yaa nye cheri. Alege wa dan kan so wadek daa ŋatawa danni ale daa ŋayopɔiwa danni, wa kan nye cheri. 13Waai a dan tiri kpio ale zɛri an so wadega wa taŋ Naawen viuku kama. Nuru wala ba yeeri wa a ta nyini Izirali demma po a nyini. Dii nyiŋla ba an misi nya buui ale basi ate wa a nye cheri la a basi wa nyiŋŋa, wa daŋ kama, wa daŋka a va wadek.
14<<Sinsaga ale nna magsi chaab ale nuru kum viuk po. Nuru waai a dan jo viuku de po yaase waai a bo ku po wa daŋ ka wadek a ga a paari daa ŋayopɔi. 15Jaab meena ale bo ku po ate nanlik an lik wa nɔi la a daŋ kama.
16<<Nuru waai ale bo peelim la a dan tiri nuru waai ate ba ko ale gebik yaase waai ale kpi wen kum, yaase wa tiri nurubiik kobi yaa boosuk la a daŋ kama a ga paari daa ŋayopɔi.
17<<Ate nuru waai ale daŋ la a nye cheri la, nye buntuem a ta nyini cheri juka tiirimu jigini a nyo leŋ po a kpeeri nyanaliŋ a vi bu zuk. 18Nuru waai ale nala la ale wa pai kpaliok a lusi nyiamu po a misi viuku ale ŋantaŋa meena ale nuruma ale bo dula la. Ku a fɛ ate wa maa misi nuru waai ale tiri nurubiik kobi yaase boosuk yaase waai ate ba ko yaa wa kpi wen kum la mɛ. 19Nuru waai ale nala la ale wa misi waai ale daŋ la daa ŋata dai abe wa ŋman misi wa daa ŋayopɔiwa danni, daa ŋayopɔiwa danni wa yaa le nye cheri a nyini daŋta po. Nuru waai yaa le wa nye cheri la, ku a fɛ ate wa sugri wa gattaŋa abe wa so ale nyiam, junɔi dila wa le nala. 20Alege nuru waai ale daŋ la a dan zɛri an nye wadek cheri, ku a fɛ ate ni yeeri wa a ta nyini naakuuni po a nyini, dii nyiŋla wa taŋ Naawen yenni kama. Nya buui ale bu basi ate wa nye cheri la ba an pai bu misi wa, wa daŋ kama. 21Kude ka ŋmarisi kaai ale ka beni a te ba. Nuru waai ale a misi nya buui ale basi ate nuru a nye cheri la, ku a fɛ ate wa mɛ sugri wa gattaŋa. Nuru waai ale a tiri nya buui ale basi ate nuru nye cheri la ale daŋ kama a ga paari wen siŋka. 22Jaabuui meena ate nuru waai ale daŋ la a tiri la mɛ a daŋ kama, nuru waai ale a tiri wa la mɛ a daŋ ka wadek a ga a paari wen siŋka.>>

Title: CHIINIKA 20
Content:
1Piilimka chiika po, Izirali tigsuŋku meena a yaa paari Zin Gɔnni po, ba yaa jam bo Kades. Dula jigini ate Miriam a jam kpi ate ba gu wa.
2Nyiam a jam ka dula a te tigsuŋku, ate nuruma a yaa tigsi a ta chaab ale Moosis ale Aaron. 3Ba yaa nye kpaliŋ ale Moosis a weeni wa ayen, <<Tama mɛ daam a dan kpi kama ase te suataŋa ale lo kpi Naawen niŋ la! 4Ka boa ate fi ta Naawen tigsuŋ a jam gɔnni dɛ po ayen tama ale ti duŋsaŋa a kpi dela? 5Ka boa ate fi a ta ti nyini Ejipiti po a nyini jam jigi pagrika dɛ? Ka ka ŋanbie yaase kiŋkama yaase yɔna. Nyiam a karo a nyu.>>
6Moosis ale Aaron a yaa basi tigsuŋku ale cheŋ Tuka Viuku nansuiŋku nɔi a lo pai nina a vuk tɛŋ, ate Naawen zulaŋa a jam ba jigi. 7Naawen a yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 8<<Pa doani ate fi ale fi suoku Aaron a tigsi tigsuŋku jigi yeŋ. Biisi a te piuŋku ate ba nya la ate ku nyiamu ale nyini. Fi le ta nyiam a nyini piuŋku po a nyini a te naakuuni ate ba ale ba duŋsaŋa a nyu.>>
9Moosis yaa pai tachekka Naawen niŋ, ase wa le weeni wa diila. 10Wa ale Aaron a yaa tigsi tigsuŋku meena jigi yeŋ piuŋku niŋ ate Moosis a weeni ba ayen, <<Ni wom dɛ tukpari nyama, ku a fɛ kama ayen tama a ta nyiam a nyini piuŋku dɛ po a nyini te ni?>> 11Moosis yaa zak wa nisaŋa ŋmai a nak piuŋku buye ale wa doani. Nyiam a yaa na nyini a te naakuuni ale ba duŋsaŋa a nyu.
12Alege Naawen a yaa weeni Moosis ale Aaron ayen, <<Nama ale kan ta sebchakka mi la ate ni an zuli mi ase weleŋsa nyɔnɔ Izirali demma nina po la nyiŋ, ni kan ta tigsuŋku dɛ a jam tɛŋka ate mi a te ba la po.>>
13Meriba nyaataŋa jam ale nna juijui ate Izirali demma a jam kpaliŋ ale Naawen, dula jigini ate wa jam pai wadek a sak ba ase waai ale ta tuilum la.
14Moosis a yaa tom nuruba ate ba nyini Kades a cheŋ Edom Naawa jigi, a weeni wa ayen, <<Dii ate fi suoku Izirali a weeni la ale nna: fi seba wapagri ŋaai ale jam tama jigi la kama. 15Tama kokpieŋsaŋa a jam cheŋ ka Ejipiti tɛŋka, ti jam bo dula ka ben boari. Ejipiti demma a jam namisi tama ale ti koma kama, 16alege tama ale jam kaari a te Naawen la, wa wom ti kaarika a tom maarɔ ate wa ta ti a nyini Ejipiti po a nyini. Yɔgyɔgla de ti bo ka dela Kades, tɛŋ kaai ale moata fi tɛŋ banni la.
17<<Ti a saalim basi ate ti va fi tɛŋka po a taam. Ti kan jo talim yaase kaduk po yaase ti nyu nyiam vili po. Ti le vaka Naawa Suik Duoku po a taam ti kan viriŋ juga yaase gala ate ti ga nyini fi tɛŋka po a nyini.>>
18Edom a yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ni kan va dela ni dan zɛri ale jam, ti le nyini ale gebisa a siti ni.>>
19Izirali demma a yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ti le va ka suik duoku a taam ase tama yaase ti duŋsaŋa a dan nyu ni nyaataŋa ti le tuni bu nyiŋ. Tama a yaa ti cheŋ ka naŋta a va du a taam wari a karo.>>
20Ba yaa ŋman tulisi ayen, <<Ni kan bag a va dela.>> Edom demma a yaa nyini a tu chaab ale ba ale tugurik tɔŋdɔba nna yegayega. 21Ase Edom demma ale zɛri ayen ba kan va ba tɛŋka po a taam la Izirali demma a yaa cheem va suik yoŋ.
22Izirali naakuuni meena a yaa basi Kades ale jam Yor Guuku. 23Yor Guuku ale moata Edom tɛŋka banni la dula jigini Naawen a yaa weeni Moosis ale Aaron ayen, 24<<Aaron kala wa kpi a cheŋ ka wa nuruma jigi. Wa kan jo tɛŋ kaai ate mi a te Izirali demma la dii nyiŋla, ni nɔi niyema a nye kaasi m wanni kama diipo ate ni bo Meriba nyaataŋa jigini la. 25Yik Aaron ale wa nidoabinni Eleaza a ta ba jueli Yor Guuku zuk. 26Yeeri Aaron gattaŋa a pai ti jo wa nidoabinni Eleaza ale Aaron a kala wa kpi a cheŋ ka wa nuruma jigi. Wa le kpi ka dela.>>
27Moosis yaa nye dii ate Naawen a weeni wa la. Ba yaa jam jueli Yor Guuku zuk alege naakuuni meena. 28Moosis a yaa yeeri Aaron gattaŋa a pai ti jo wa nidoabinni Eleaza. Aaron a yaa jam kpi guuku zuk. Moosis ale Eleaza a yaa nyini guuku zuk a siŋ, 29ase naakuuni meena ale ga wom ayen Aaron kpi la, Izirali yenni meena a yaa kum wa nyiŋ a paari daa pisita.

Title: CHIINIKA 21
Content:
1Keenan demma naawa Arad waai ale jam bo Negev tɛŋka po la ale wom ayen Izirali demma a bo Atarim suiku po a cheen la, wa yaa siti Izirali demma a yik ba gela. 2Izirali demma a yaa puulim a te Naawen ayen, <<Ase fi a dan pai nuruma de a nyo ti nisima po, ti le kaasi ba tɛŋsaŋa meena.>> 3Naawen a yaa wom Izirali demma saalimka a yaa pai Keenan demma a te ba. Ba yaa kaasi ba ale ba tɛŋsaŋa meena dila nyiŋla jigini yuei a jam le Yorma.
4Ba yaa jam nyini Yor Guuku a va suik kuui ale a cheŋ Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku geŋsa la, a gilim Edom. Alege nuruma sue yaa jam kaasi suiku po. 5Ba yaa jam biisi kaasi Wen ale Moosis ayen, <<Ka boa ate fi ta ti nyini Ejipiti po a nyini ayen ti kpi gɔnni dɛ po? Ŋandiinta ka! Nyiam ka! Ti be kan yaali niniga ŋandiintaŋa de!>>
6Naawen a yaa tom ate waapiisa a jam ba po a dom ba ate Izirali demma yega a kpi. 7Nuruma a yaa jam Moosis jigi ayen, <<Ti nye ka biem ti le biisi kaasi Naawen ale fi la. Puusi a te Naawen ate wa te wiiŋa a cheŋ abe ŋa ge ti.>> Moosis a yaa puusi a te nuruma.
8Naawen a yaa biisi ale Moosis ayen, <<Wa nye waab a pai bu a yik diok nyiŋ, nuru waai ate waab dom wa la a dan zak nya bu wa kan kpi.>> 9Dila nyiŋla Moosis a yaa nye kutuk mɔnuŋ waab a pai bu a yik diok nyiŋ. Waai meena ate waab a dom ate wa zak nya kutuk mɔnuŋ waamu la a yaa vuuk.
10Izirali demma a yaa ŋman basi dula ale cheŋ Obot. 11Ba ŋman nyini Obot a cheŋ ka Iye Abarim gɔnni ale tuk Moab la wenbinni ale pusi kauk kuui la geŋ. 12A nyini dula ba ŋman cheŋ ka Zered Viaka. 13Ba basi dula ale cheŋ ga kali ka Arnon Benaŋka nɔi juijui ale bo gɔnni po a ta ga paari Amori demma tɛŋ banni. Arnon ka bain a bo Moab ale Amori demma suŋsuŋ. 14Dila ale soa ate Naawen Kpaliŋsa Gbaŋka a weeni ayen, <<Waheb tɛŋka ale bo Sufa la ale vooliŋsa ale Arnon Benaŋka, 15ale vooliŋsaŋa ale churinti, a tuak Ar geŋsa la a doa a nye bain ale Moab la.>>
16A nyini dula ba jam cheŋ ka Beer vili dii ate Naawen a weeni Moosis ayen, <<Tigsi nuruma jigi yeŋ ate mi ale te ba nyiam.>> 17Izirali demma a yaa lenni yiini dɛ ayen, <<Tɔŋ jueli vili yaa, ni pai di a lenni yiili, 18a magsi chaab ale vili dii ate nabisaŋa a jam tu la, dii ate nuruma kpaŋŋa a jam tu la, kpaŋŋa ale ba tacheksaŋa.>> Ba yaa basi gɔnni ale cheŋ Mattana, 19a nyini Mattana ba cheŋ ka Nayaliel a nyini Nayaliel ba cheŋ ka Bamot. 20Ba ŋman nyini Bamot a cheŋ ka Moab viaka kauk kuui ate fi dan zaani Pisga guuku zuk fi nya tɛŋ kaai ale doa jassi la.
21Izirali demma a yaa tom nuruba ayen ba weeni Siyon Amori naawa ayen, 22<<Basi ate ti va fi tɛŋka po a taam. Ti kan mobi jo laŋ yaase kaduk po yaase ti nyu nyiam vili po. Ti le vaka naawa suik duoku ate tama a ga gaam fi tɛŋka meena a taam.>>
23Alege Siyon an siak ayen Izirali demma a va wa tɛŋka po a taamu. Wa jam ta ka wa tugurik tommu meena a nyini cheŋ gɔnni po a tu chaab ale Izirali demma. Ase wa le paari Jayaz la, wa yaa nye kpaliŋ ale Izirali demma 24Izirali demma a yaa ko wa ale tuesi wa tɛŋka a zaani Arnon benaŋka a ga paari Jabbok benaŋka alege paarika Ammon demma tɛŋka nyiini, dii nyiŋla ba tɛŋka bani ka parik ale gilim ka. 25Izirali demma a yaa nak tuesi Amori demma tɛŋsaŋa meena a bo si po. Ba jam maa bo Yesbon ale tɛŋ sii meena ale gilim ka la po kama. 26Yesbon ale kauk kuui ate Amori demma naawa Siyon a nyini la, waai ale jam liŋ nye kpaliŋ ale Moab nakpaka ale tuesi wa tɛŋka meena a ta ga paari Arnon benaŋka la.
27Dila ale soa ate wamagsima nyɔnɔwa a weeni ayen, <<Ni jam Yesbon a ŋman pilim sɛ ka. Basi ate Siyon a pilim nya wa tɛŋka.
28<<Bolim ale jam chɔgsi Yesbon tɛŋka, bolim ŋiak a yiti Siyon tɛŋka. Bu dɛ Ar ale bo Moab po la ale Arnon guutaŋa. 29Ku le bie a te Moab demma! Ni kaasi kama, Chemos demma! Wa pai wa nidoabilisaŋa a tagri te kama ale pai wa liema mɛ a te naab Siyon Amori denɔwa ase yɔm la.
30<<Alege ti yiak ba basi kama. Ti kaasi Yesbon tɛŋka meena kama a ta ga paari Dibon. Ti ŋɔriŋ ba kama a ta ga paari Nofa kaai ale teeri ga paari Medeba la.>>
31Izirali demma a yaa jam bo Amori demma tɛŋka po. 32Moosis ale jam tom nuruba ayen ba ga kpesi nya Jazer la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, Izirali demma a yaa jam nak yik ka tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa a yaa yiak Amori demma baai ale bo dula la a basi.
33Ba yaa jam viriŋ a jueli va Basan suiku ate Basan naawa Og ale wa tugurik tommu meena a yaa nyini a tu ba suik ayen ba nye kpaliŋ Edrei. 34Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Kan chali wa yɔgsummoa, ale mi pai wa ale wa tugurik tommu ale wa tɛŋka meena a nyo ka fi nisima po. Nye wa ase fi le nye Siyon Amori demma naawa diila waai ale jam a nya Yesbon la.>> 35Ba yaa jam chub wa lɔnsi ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa tugurik tommu meena an tali javuwa. Ale jam tuesi wa tɛŋka a tara.

Title: CHIINIKA 22
Content:
1Ate Izirali demma a yaa ŋman cheŋ ga kala Moab tɛŋka a moata Jodan benni ale tuk Jeriko la.
2Zippor nidoabinni Belak ale jam nya dii meena ate Izirali demma a nye Amori demma la, 3ate yɔgsum a jam yik Moab demma dii nyiŋla nuruma a jam piisi ka nna yegayega. Wensie Moab demma a sum jam yɔgsa kama Izirali demma nyiŋ.
4Moab demma a yaa biisi ale Midian nisɔmma ayen, <<Nuru boanni a za ba dɛ ka jabuui meena ale gilim ti la ase naab ale dɛ wuuk meena diila.>> Dila nyiŋla Zippor nidoabinni Belak, waai ale jam ka Moab naab da ŋala po la, 5a yaa tom nuruba ayen ba weeni Biio nidoabinni Balaam waai ale jam bo Petor ate ka moata Benni wadek tɛŋka po la. Belak a weeni ayen, <<Nuruba ale nyini Ejipiti a jam, ba lik tɛŋka meena kama a kala moata mi. 6Yɔgyɔgla de jam ka kikaasa a basi nuruma de zuk dii nyiŋla ba ŋmasi pagra kama a te mu. Dila ale basi ate m baga nya pagrim ba zuk a yiak ba ate ba nyini tɛŋka po a nyini. Mi seba kama ayen baai ate fi niak la a nya niaka kama, baai ate fi ka te la a nya ka kikaasa.>>
7Moab ale Midian nisɔmma a yaa basi dula a yaa ta chuei a magsi bɔkka. Ba le jam Balaam jigi la, ba yaa weeni wa Belak ale weeni diila.
8Balaam yaa tulisi ba ayen, <<Ni goa dela yokku de, ate m ta Naawen ale tulisi mu diila a ŋman jam te ni.>> Ate Moab nabisaŋa a yaa jam goa dula ale wa.
9Wen yaa jam Balaam jigi a bek wa ayen, <<Ka nuru boa ale bo ale fi la?
10Balaam yaa tulisi Wen ayen, <<Zippor nidoabinni Belak, Moab naawa ale tom ba mi jigi, 11<Nuruba ale nyini Ejipiti a lik tɛŋka meena. Jam ka kikaasa a basi ba zuk a te mu. Dila ale basi ate m baga kpaliŋ ale ba a yiak ba a basi.> >>
12Alege Wen a yaa weeni Balaam ayen, <<Kan cheŋ ale ba. Ku a fɛ ate fi kan ka kikaasa a te nuru bala dii nyiŋla Wen a niak ba kama.>>
13Vari ale veenti la Balaam a yaa weeni Belak nabisaŋa ayen, <<Ni ŋman cheŋ nidek tɛŋka, ale Naawen a zɛri kama ayen m kan va ni a cheŋ.>>
14Dila nyiŋla Moab nabisaŋa a yaa ŋman cheŋ Belak jigi a weeni wa ayen, <<Balaam a zɛri kama ayen wa kan va ti a jamu.>>
15Ate Belak yaa ŋman tom nabisa ba chaab ate ba piisi ale ŋman chim ba tɔga ale baai ale poom dɛ niŋka la. 16Ba yaa jam Balaam jigi ayen, <<Zippor nidoabinni Belak ale weeni diila ale nna. Kan basi ate wari a kasi fu ate fi kan jam m jigi ya, 17dii nyiŋ la mi ale te fu tiirim maŋ, abe nye dii meena ate fi a weeni la. Jam ka kikaasa a basi nuruma de zuk a te mu.>>
18Alege Balaam a yaa tulisi ba ayen, <<Ase Belak a dam poom pai wa yenni ate kpana ale ligmɔniŋ a sueri di la a te mi, mi a kan baga a nye wakpien yaase wa fiik a kaasi Naawen m Wenni wanni. 19Bo dela yokku de ase mbala ale nye diila, ate mi ale nya dii ate Naawen ale weeni mi la.>>
20Yok kula Wen a yaa jam Balaam jigi a weeni wa ayen, <<Ase nuruma de ale jam ayen ba ta fu cheŋ la, va ba a cheŋ alege nye dii ate mi a weeni fi la nyiini.>>
21Balaam yaa yiti saluiku a do wa bonika a va Moab nabisaŋa a cheŋ. 22Alege Wen sui yaa jam puuri nna yegayega wa le cheŋ la nyiŋ, ate Naawen maarɔ a yaa za suiku niŋ ayen wa kasi wa. Balaam jam kala ka wa bonika zuk alege ate wa tomteerɔma bayewa mɛ a bo dula ale wa. 23Ase boniŋka ale ga nya Naawen maarɔwa ale wa za suiku po a ta gebik wa nisaŋa po la, ka yaa mobi jo kapeoku po ale basi suiku. Balaam a jam a nak ka kama ayen ka ŋman lo suiku po.
24Ate Naawen maarɔwa a yaa za suik miglik po talita tiye suŋsuŋsa po ate parisa a bo ganaŋa ŋayewa meena. 25Ase boniŋka ale ga nya Naawen maarɔwa la, ka yaa cheŋ maŋ parika ate wa naŋsaŋa a kpiiri parika. Dila a basi kama ate wa ŋman nak ka.
26Naawen maarɔwa a yaa dɛ niŋ a ga zaani suik miglika po kauk kuui ate suik a karo a mobi a va juga yaase gala la. 27Ase boniŋka ale ga nya Naawen maarɔwa la, ka yaa duek Balaam tɛŋ, wa sui yaa jam puuri ate wa nak ka ale wa tachekka. 28Naawen a yaa lak boniŋka nɔnni ate ka weeni Balaam ayen, <<Mi nye fu ka sɛ ate dila basi ate fi a nak mu buta meena?>>
29Balaam yaa tulisi boniŋka ayen, <<Fi koosi mi a la kama, m dan ta ka gebik m nisa po, m te le ko fu.>>
30Boniŋka mɛ a ŋman weeni Balaam ayen mi daa fidek boniŋa, kaai ate fi kasim a do daa meena a paari jinla? Mi diem nye fi nnala nya ya?>> Ate wa weeni ayen, <<Aaya.>>
31Naawen yaa lak Balaam ninaŋa ate wa nya Naawen maarɔwa ale wa za suiku po a yeeri wa gebik. Ate wa yaa koori tɛŋ a lo pai nina vuk tɛŋ.
32Naawen maarɔwa a bek wa ayen, <<Ka boa ate fi nak fi boniŋka buta meena? Mi jam dela ayen m kan siak a te fu dii nyiŋla fi suiku ka suik kaasuŋ a te mi. 33Boniŋka a nya mi kama a ŋmani buta meena. Ase ka dan poom kan ŋmani ya, yɔgyɔgla de m te ko fu kama alege basi ka.>>
34Balaam a yaa weeni Naawen maarɔwa ayen, <<Mi nye ka biem. Mi an kpesi ayen fi za suiku po ayen fi zɛri mu. Yɔgyɔgla de fi sui a dan kaasi m le pilim ŋmani.>>
35Naawen maarɔwa a yaa weeni Balaam ayen, <<Cheŋ ale nuruma alege biisi dii ate mi a weeni fu la nyiini.>> Ate Balaam va nabisaŋa a cheŋ Belak jigi.
36Ase Belak ale wom ayen Balaam a cheena la, wa yaa nyini peelim ayen wa tu wa Moab tɛŋ banni ale bo Arnon la wa tɛŋka kpeglimka jigini a ni la. 37Belak a yaa bek Balaam ayen, <<Mi an tom wi fi tuilituili? Ka boa ate fi an jamu m jigi ya? Mi an baga te fu tiirim ku nyiŋŋa?>>
38Aa, m jam fi jigi kama yɔgyɔgla de, <<Balaam ale tulisi diila ale la. Alege mi bag a biisi wayoŋŋoa? Ku a fɛ ate m biisi dii nyiini ate Wen a pai nyo m nɔnni po la.>>
39Balaam yaa va Belak a cheŋ Kiriat Yuzot. 40Belak yaa nye kaabka ale niiga ale piisa a yaa pai gela te Balaam ale nabisaŋa baai ale jam va wa la. 41Vari ale veenti la saluik Belak yaa ta Balaam cheŋ Bamot Baal jigi. A nyini dula wa yaa nya nuruma gela.

Title: CHIINIKA 23
Content:
1Balaam weeni ayen, <<Se kuŋkuŋta tiyopɔi dela a te mu, gomsi lalisa siyopɔi ale padaasa siyopɔi a te mu.>> 2Belak yaa nye dii ate Balaam a weeni la, ate ba nɔi bayema a yaa pai lalik ale padiak a nye kaabka kuŋkuŋ meena zuk.
3Balaam yaa weeni Belak ayen, <<Bo dela fi tiirimu gauŋ abe fi ge ate mi cheŋ nakpiak. Da dii dai Naawen ale jam tu chaab ale mu. Wa le pai wa dii a sak mu la m le weeni fu.>> Ate wa yaa basi dula ale jueli guutaŋa zuk.
4Wen a yaa tu wa ate Balaam a weeni ayen, <<Mi nye ka kuŋkuŋta tiyopɔi, kunyi meena zuk m teka lalik ale padiak.>>
5Naawen yaa pai wari nyo Balaam nɔnni po ale weeni wa ayen, <<Ŋman cheŋ Belak jigi a te wa wanni de.>>
6Ate wa yaa ŋman cheŋ ga nya ale wa za wa tiirimu gauŋ ale Moab nabisaŋa meena. 7Balaam yaa biisi wa wasusugni ayen, <<Belak ale ta mu nyini Araam tɛŋka. Moab naawa ale bo guutaŋa ale bo konni po la a jam weeni ayen, <Jam ka kikaasa a te Jekob te mu jam zɛri Izirali demma.> 8Mi a yaa m nyeka se ka te baai ate Wen an ka te la? Mi a yaa m nyeka se a zɛri baai ate Naawen an zɛri ba la? 9Piuŋku zuk mi nya ba kama, a nyini kauk kuui ale jueli la mi nya ba kama. Mi nya nuru baai ale gaari bo dula la kama baai ale kan pai badek ase ba ka tɛŋsaŋa de kanyi la. 10Ka wana ale baga a chiini Jekob bisaŋa yaase wa chiini Izirali bisa bunaansiwa po? Basi ate mi kpi ase wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ ale kpi la abe m kpeglimka a nye ase bala la!>>
11Belak yaa weeni Balaam ayen, <<Boa ate fi nye mi di? Mi ta fi jam ayen fi ka te m dachaasaŋa alege fi an nye wari ya, fi gonti niak ba kama!>>
12Wa yaa tulisi ayen, <<M kan biisi Naawen ale pai dii a nyo m nɔnni po la?>>
13Ate Belak yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Va mu a cheŋ jigi di choa dula jigini fi le nya ba, fi le nyaka kauk alege daa ba meena. A nyini dula ka te ba a te mu.>> 14Wa yaa ta wa a cheŋ Zofim peelim po Pisga guuku zuk, dula jigini wa yaa se kuŋkuŋta tiyopɔi a yaa kaab lalik ale padiak kunyi meena zuk.
15Balaam a yaa weeni Belak ayen, <<Bo dela fi tiirimu gauŋ abe fi ge ate mi tu Naawen dula.>>
16Naawen a yaa jam tu Balaam a pai wari a nyo wa nɔnni po ayen, <<Ŋman cheŋ Belak jigi a pai wanni de a te wa.>>
17Wa yaa ŋman ga nya wa ale wa za wa tiirimu gauŋ ale Moab nabisaŋa. Belak yaa bek wa ayen, <<Naawen ayen ka boa?>>
18Wa yaa biisi wa wasusugni ayen, <<Belak yiti a wom, wom mi Zippor nidoabili yaa. 19Wen daa nuru ayen wa velimu yaase saalɔbiik ayen wa tagri wa popolaŋa. Wa le biisi ale kan nye? Wa le puulim ale kan nye wa le puulim diila? 20Mi tuesi ka wari ayen m niak, Wa be niak ba kama mi a ŋman bag a tagri di.
21<<Naŋbiak a ka Jekob buuni po. Ti an nya niniga Izirali demma po. Naawen ba Wenni a bo le ba kama. Naawa kaarika a bo ba suŋsuŋ kama. 22Wen ni ta ba nyini Ejipiti po a nyini. Ba ta ka lalik waarik pagrim. 23Bɔkka tuima an baga a nye Jekob wari ya, porisika an baga a nye Izirali demma wari ya. Ba yaa le weeni ka nna a te Jekob ale Izirali demma ayen, <Nya Naawen ale nye diila!> 24Nuruma a yaa yiti ase gbeŋ sari la a nuem ase gbeŋli a nyiem ale nya lam a ŋuuni dii a kan vuusi la, ka di ni ga ŋɔbi ale nyu jabuui ate di yik la ziimu.>>
25Ate Belak a yaa weeni Balaam ayen, <<Kan ka a te ba yaase fi niak ba mɛ!>>
26Balaam yaa tulisi ayen, <<Mi an weeni fu ayen ku a fɛ ate m nye dii meena ate Naawen a weeni la?>>
27Belak a ŋman weeni Balaam ayen, <<Jam basi ate m ta fu cheŋ jigi yoŋ. Da dii dai dila ale yɔk Wen sui ate wa basi ate fi ka te ba a te mi dula.>> 28Belak yaa ta Balaam a jueli Peor guuku zuk ale chuiri a nya tɛŋka kauk kuui ale doa jassi la.
29Balaam mɛ a yaa ŋman weeni ayen, <<Sɛ kuŋkuŋta tiyopɔi (7) dela a te mu, gomsi lalisa siyopɔi (7) ale padaasa siyopɔi (7) a te mu.>> 30Belak a yaa jam nye dii ate Balaam a weeni wa la ale kaab lalik ale padiak kuŋkuŋ meena zuk.

Title: CHIINIKA 24
Content:
1Yɔgyɔgla de ase Balaam ale nya ale ku yɔk Naawen sui ayen wa niak Izirali la, wa an bek chichirisa ase da ŋaai ale taam la, alege wa tulim wa ninaŋa a tuk ka gɔnni geŋsa. 2Balaam ale nya ale Izirali bisaŋa a lab kali ba dɔk ba dɔk la, Naawen Chiika a yaa jam wa jigi 3ate wa yaa biisi wa wasusugni ayen, <<Biio nidoabinni Balaam wasusugni, wasusugni waai nina ale a nya nalimnyiini la. 4Wasusugni nyɔnɔ waai ale a wom Wen wieŋa la, waai ale nya gɔdaasini a nyini Wen Dii Ale A Niak La, waai ale lo poi nyiŋ ale waai nina ale lagri la.
5<<Nya fi viitaŋa ale nala dii yaa Jekob. Nya fi boka jigini Izirali,
6<<Ase viak la ba teeri nyini peelim, ase talim ale moata benaŋ la, ase ŋan baai ate ba ayen alos te ba vuk ba moata Naawen la, ase nyunyoŋ ale vuk nyiam nɔi diila. 7Nyiam ale nyini ba liisaŋa po a nyini, ba ŋan bieŋa ale ta nyiam yega. Ba naawa ale gaam Agag, ba naamu ale ta zula.
8<<Wen ale ta ba a nyini Ejipiti po a nyini, ba taka lalik waarik pagrim. Ba nya pagrim tɛŋ sii ale kaa yaa ba wari la zuk a wɛ ba kobaŋa bunabuna, ale ba pieŋa ba lu ba. 9Ase gbeŋli la ba a goosi ale a duek tɛŋ, ase gbeŋ niima la ka wana ale baga a nye ba wari ya? Mi a yaali baai ale niak ni la, abe nya niaka abe baai ale ka a te ni la a nya kikaasa.>>
10Ate Belak sui a puuri ale Balaam nna yegayega. Wa yaa nak nichaala ale weeni ayen, <<M wi fu kama ayen fi ka te m dachaasaŋa alege fi gonti niak ba ku nɔi buta meena. 11Nye nwuli a kuli yeri, m le te fu tiirim dek, alege Naawen a zɛri kama ayen fi kan nya tiirim.>>
12Balaam a yaa tulisi Belak ayen. <<Mi an weeni baai ate fi tom ba mi jigi la ayen, 13<Ase Belak a dan poom pai kpana ale ligmɔniŋ a sueri wa yenni a te mi, mi kan baga a nye wari mi dek yeŋka nalim yaase biemmoa, a gaam Naawen ale weeni diila. Ku a fɛ ate m weeni dii nyiini ate Naawen a weeni la?> 14Yɔgyɔgla de mi ŋman a cheŋ ka m nuruma jigi, alege jam ate m kaam fu nuruma de ale ba nye fi nuruma dii da ŋaai ale cheen la.>>
15Ate wa yaa biisi wa wasusugni, <<Biio nidoabinni Balaam wasusugni, wasusugni ate waai a nya di ale nina cheri la, 16wasusugni ate waai a wom Wen wieŋa la, waai nya sebika a nyini Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La jigi, waai ale nya gɔdaasini Wen Dii Ale A Niak La, waai ni lo pai ninaŋa a vuk tɛŋ ale waai nina ale lagri la.
