17<<Mi nya wa kama, alege daa yɔgyɔgla. M nya wa kama alege wa an moata. Chiŋmarik ale nyini Jekob buuni po. Tachek ale yiti Izirali po. Wa le ŋɔriŋ Moab deeŋa ale Sɛyɛt nidoabinni meena zukottaŋa. 18Ba le nya pagrim Edom tɛŋka zuk. Seir, wa dachaasaŋa ale jo wa nisa po alege ate Izirali ale kasim pagra a gum du. 19Niŋdeerɔ ale nyini Jekob buuni po a ko baai ale vuuk la tɛŋka po.>>
20Balaam jam nya Amalek a yaa biisi wa wasusugni ayen, <<Amalek demma ale jam dɛ buura meena niŋ alege wa le jam kaasuŋ jigi kpeglimka.>>
21Wa yaa ga nya Ken demma tɛŋka a biisi wa wasusugni ayen, <<Fi boka jigini ka jigi maŋ, ni yeeŋa mɛ se piuŋ zuk, 22alege nama Ken demma ale kaasi ase Assur demma a ni jam nak yik ni.>>
23Wa ŋman biisi wa wasusugni ayen, <<Ka wana ale wa vua ase Wen a ni nye kude? 24Ŋaaruŋta ale nyini Kittim a jam kaasi Assur ale Eber tɛŋsaŋa alege ba mɛ ale jam kaasuŋ jigi.>>
25Balaam a yaa yiti ŋman kuli yeri alege ate Belak mɛ a va wadek suik.

Title: CHIINIKA 25
Content:
1Ase Izirali demma ale diem jam bo Sittim la, nidoama a yaa jam bobi Moab tɛŋka nipooma a goa, 2baai ale jam wi ba ayen ba jam nya ba wenaŋa kaabka la. Nuruma a yaa jam dɛ ale koori tɛŋ a zuli wenaŋa de. 3Dila Izirali demma a yaa jam gum ba po a zuli Baal ale bo Peor la. Ate Naawen sui a yaa puuri ale ba.
4Naawen a yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Ta nuruma niŋdeerɔma meena a ga ko ba a jalisi ba kantueŋ Naawen niŋ, dila Naawen suinni ale yɔk ale Izirali demma.>>
5Dila Moosis a yaa biisi te Izirali boteerɔma ayen, <<Ku a fɛ ate ni wanyi meena a ko ni nuru baai ale gum ba po a zuli Baal ale bo Peor tɛŋka po la.>>
6Izirali nidoa a yaa ta Midian tɛŋka lie a jam wa dɔkdemma jigi Moosis ale Izirali tigsuŋku meena nimbie po diipo ate ba diem a kum Tuka Viuku nɔi la. 7Ase Fineyas Eleaza nidoabinni ate kaabteerɔwa Aaron a chim wa kokpieŋ la ale ga nya kude la, wa yaa basi tigsuŋku, ale pai gbaluk, 8a va Izirali demma a jo viuku po. Wa jam pai gbaluku chub ba nɔi bayema a vuri a va Izirali denɔwa po a taam paari nipowa nyiŋka. Nyiŋtuilaŋa ale jam bo Izirali demma po la a jam basi kama, 9alege baai ale kpi ale nyiŋtuilaŋa la a paari ka tusa pisiye ale ŋanaansi (24,000).
10Naawen a yaa biisi ale Moosis ayen, 11<<Fineyas Eleaza nidoabinni ate kaabteerɔwa Aaron a chim wa kokpieŋ la a nye ate m sui a yɔk kama ale Izirali demma, dii nyiŋla, wa jam ta ka nyiŋ zeentika ase mi ale ka dii m zulaŋa nyiŋ a te ba la, mi nyiŋ zeentika nyiŋ mi an basi ate ba kpi nueri ya. 12Dila nyiŋ weeni wa ayen mi a nye ka suiyɔgni nɔiyeŋ ale wa. 13Wa ale wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale taka nɔiyeŋ kaabteka tuin dii ale di beni, dii nyiŋla wa nyiŋ jam a zeenti kama ale wa Naawen zulaŋa ale nye biem duisi basika a te Izirali demma.>>
14Izirali denɔ waai ate ba jam ko wa ale Midian tɛŋka nipowa la yuei ale Zimri, wa kowa yuei jam le Salu a chim Simeyon dɔkdem niŋdeerɔ. 15Midian tɛŋka nipok waai ate ba jam ko la yue jam le Kozbi, Zur lie, wa jam ka Midian dɔkdemma naab.
16Naawen a yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 17<<Nye Midian demma ase dachaasa la a ko ba, 18dii nyiŋla ba nye ni ase ka dachaasa la a va Peor ale ba toawa Kozbi Midian niŋdeerɔwa liewa a paasi ni, nipok waai ate ba jam ko ase nyiŋtuilaŋa ale jam va Peor nyiŋ a jam la>>

Title: CHIINIKA 26
Content:
1Nyiŋtuilaŋa ŋaaŋnyiŋ Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ale Eleaza kaabteerɔwa Aaron nidoabinni ayen, 2<<Chiini Izirali naakuuni meena ba dɔkdemma, baai meena ale paari bena pisiye yaase ba gaam dila a baga a tom Izirali tugurik nyam tuima la.>> 3Dila Moab tɛŋka peelim po a bo Jodan benni kauk kuui ale tuk Jeriko la, Moosis ale Eleaza kaabteerɔwa a yaa biisi ale ba ayen, 4<<Chiini nidoama baai ale paari bena pisiye yaase ba gaam dila la, ase Naawen ale weeni Moosis diila.>> Izirali demma dɛ ale jam nyini Ejipiti po a nyini la.
5Aruben dɔkku, Aruben jam le Izirali bikpagi, wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam nyini ka Yanok ale ka Yanok yezuk la ale Pallu ale ka Pallu yezuk la 6Ayeziron ale ka Ayeziron yezuk la ale Karmi ale ka Karmi yezuk la. 7A Aruben yezukku jam le bade, ba jam paari ka tusa pisinaansi ale ŋata ale kobsiyopɔi ale pisita (43,730).
8Pallu nidoabili a jam le Eliab, 9ate Eliab nidoabilisa a nye Nemuel ale Datan ale Abiram. Ka Datan wade ale Abiram a jam le naakuuni kpaŋŋa an jam siak te Moosis ale Aaron a maa bo Koora ŋaaŋviirɔma po ate ba an siak a te Naawen la. 10Tɛŋka a jam lak ka nɔnni a nɛ ba ale Koora, waai ŋaaŋviirɔba ale jam kpi ase bolimu ale dɛ nidoaba kobsiye ale pisinuwa la (250). Ate bala a chim kaamka daana a te ba. 11Koora tomini an jam kpi meena.
12Simeyon ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale ba yezuimaŋa a jam le nna. Nemuel ale ka Nemuel yezuk la ale Jamin ale ka Jamin yezuk la ale Jakin ale ka Jakin yezuk la 13ale Zera ale ka Zera yezuk la ale Sɛyaul ale ka Sɛyaul yezuk la. 14Bade a jam le Simeyon yezuimaŋa. Ba jam ka nidoaba tusa pisiye ale ŋaye ale kobsiye (22,200).
15Gad ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale ba yezuimaŋa ale nna. Zefon ale ka Zefon yezuk la ale Aggi ale ka Aggi yezuk la ale Suni ale ka Suni yezuk la ale 16Ozni ale ka Ozni yezuk la ale Eri ale ka Eri yezuk la 17ale Arodi ale ka Arodi yezuk la ale Areli ale ka Areli yezuk la. 18Bade a jam le Gad yezuimaŋa. Ba jam ka nuruba tusa pisinaansi ale kobsinu (40,500).
19Ɛri ale Onan jam ka Juda nidoabilisa, alege ba jam kpi ka Keenan tɛŋka po. 20Juda ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale ba yezuimaŋa ale nna. Sɛla ale ka Sɛla yezuk la ale Perezi ale ka Perezi yezuk la ale Zera ale ka Zera yezuk la. 21Perezi ŋaaŋbisaŋa a jam le Ayeziron ale ka Ayeziron yezuk la ale Yamul ale ka Yamul yezuk la. 22Bade a jam le Juda yezuimaŋa. Ba jam ka nuruba tusa pisiyopɔi ale ŋayuebi ale kobsinu (76,500).
23Isaka ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale ba yezuimaŋa ale nna. Tola ale ka Tola yezuk la ale Pua ale ka Pua yezuk la. 24Jasub ale ka Jasub yezuk la ale Simron ale ka Simron yezuk la. 25Bade a jam le Isaka yezuimaŋa. Ba jam ka nuruba tusa pisiyuebi ale ŋanaansi ale kobsita (64,300).
26Zebulun ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale ba yezuimaŋa ale nna. Sered ale ka Sered yezuk la ale Elon ale ka Elon yezuk la ale Jaleel ale ka Jaleel yezuk la. 27Bade a jam le Zebulun yezuimaŋa. Ba jam ka nuruba tusa pisiyuebi ale kobsinu (60,500).
28Josefi ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale ba yezuimaŋa ale nna a nyini Manasa ale Ɛfraim.
29Manasa ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale ba yezuimaŋa ale nna. Makir ale ka Makir yezuk la. Makir jam ka Gilead ko. Gilead ale ka Gilead yezuk la. 30Gilead ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale ba yezuimaŋa ale nna. Iezer ale ka Iezer yezuk la ale Yelek ale ka Yelek yezuk la 31ale Asriel ale ka Asriel yezuk la ale Sikiim ale ka Sikiim yezuk la 32ale Sɛmida ale ka Sɛmida yezuk la ale Yefer ale ka Yefer yezuk la 33Zelofehad Yefer nidoabinni a jam ka nidoabilisa, wa jam ta ka lieba nyiini, ba yueŋa ale nna. Mala ale Nowa ale Yogla ale Milka ale Tirza. 34Bade a jam le Manasa yezuimaŋa. Ba jam ka tusa pisinu ale ŋaye ale kobsiyopɔi (52,700).
35Ɛfraim ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale ba yezuimaŋa ale nna. Sutela ale ka Sutela yezuk la ale Beker ale ka Beker yezuk la ale Tayan ale ka Tayan yezuk la. 36Bade ale Sutela yezuimaŋa. Eran ale ka Eran yezuk la. 37Bade a jam le Ɛfraim yezuimaŋa. Ba jam ka tusa pisita ale ŋaye ale kobsinu (32,500). Bade a jam le Josefi ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale ba yezuimaŋa.
38Benjamin ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale ba yezuimaŋa ale nna. Bela ale ka Bela yezuk la ale Asbel ale ka Asbel yezuk la ale Ayiram ale ka Ayiram yezuk la 39ale Sufam ale ka Sufam yezuk la ale Yufam ale ka Yufam yezuk la. 40Bela ŋaaŋbisaŋa a nyini Ard ale Naaman jam le Ard ale ka Ard yezuk la ale Naaman ale ka Naaman yezuk la. 41Bade a jam le Benjamin yezuimaŋa. Ba jam ka tusa pisinaansi ale ŋanu ale kobsiyuebi (45,600).
42Dan ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale ba yezuimaŋa ale nna. Suyam ale ka Suyam yezuk la. Dan yezuimaŋa a jam le nna. 43Ba meena a jam ka Suyam yezuima. Ba jam ka tusa pisiyuebi ale ŋanaansi ale kobsinaansi (64,400).
44Asɛ ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale ba yezuimaŋa ale nna. Imnaya ale ka Imnaya yezuk la ale Isvi ale ka Isvi yezuk la ale Beriya ale ka Beriya yezuk la 45a nyini Beriya ŋaaŋbisaŋa po ka Ɛba ale ka Ɛba yezuk la ale Malkiel ale ka Malkiel yezuk la. 46Asɛ jam taka lie, wa yuei jam le Seraya. 47Bade a jam le Asɛ yezuimaŋa. Ba jam ka tusa pisinu ale ŋata ale kobsinaansi (53,400).
48Nafitali ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale ba yezuimaŋa ale nna. Jazeel ale ka Jazeel yezuk la ale Guni ale ka Guni yezuk la. 49Ale Jezer ale ka Jezer yezuk la ale Sillem ale ka Sillem yezuk la. 50Bade a jam le Nafitali yezuimaŋa. Ba jam ka tusa pisinaansi ale ŋanu ale kobsinaansi (45,400). 51Izirali nidoama meena a jam ka tusa kobsiyuebi ale dinyi ale kobsiyopɔi ale pisita (601,730).
52Naawen a yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 53<<Chari ba tɛŋka ase ba nitalim la a ta va ba yueŋa ale soa diila. 54Baai ale zuak la basi ate ba nitalimu mɛ a zuak, abe baai ale kan soa diila te ba fii fiiga, waai meena a magsi wa nya nitalim kama a magsi chaab ale wa nuruma ale ka diila. 55Be seba chak ayen ni nak ka gbaŋ alege chari tɛŋka. Tigsuŋ meena ale a tuesi juijui ase ba nitalim la ale ba va chaab ale ka ba kokpieŋka yuei ale ka diila. 56Nitalim meena ni nak gbaŋ a chari te tigsuŋ tii ale zuak ale tii ale pɔsima la.>>
57Livaima ale nna ate ba jam chiini ba ale ba ŋaaŋbisaŋa la, a nyini Gerson ale ka Gerson yezuk la ale Koyat ale ka Koyat yezuk la ale Merari ale ka Merari yezuk la.
58Bade me a jam ka Livai yezukku ale Libni yezukku ale Yebron yezukku ale Mayali yezukku ale Musi yezukku ale Koora yezukku. Koyat a jam ka Amram ko kpieŋ, 59Amram powa yuei jam le Jochebed Livai ŋaaŋbiik waai ate Livaima a biak wa Ejipiti po la. Wa jam biak ka Aaron ale Moosis ale ba toawa Miriam a te Amram. 60Aaron nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Nadab ale Abiyu ale Eleaza ale Itamar. 61Alege Nadab ale Abiyu a jam kpi kama diipo ate ba nye kaabka Naawen niŋ ale bolim buui, ate wa an te ba suik la.
62Livaima meena ale paari chiik yaase ba gaam dila ate ba jam chiini ba la ka tusa pisiye ale ŋata (23,000). Ba an jam chiini ba a gum Izirali dem mbala po, dii nyiŋla ba an jam nya nitalimoa.
63Bade ale Moosis ale Eleaza kaabteerɔwa a chiini diipo ate ba jam chiini Izirali demma Moab tɛŋka peelim ale bo Jodan benni kauk kuui ale tuk Jeriko tɛŋka la. 64Ba wanyi an jam gum baai ate Moosis ale kaabteerɔwa Aaron a jam chiini Sinai Gɔnni po la. 65Diila Naawen a jam weeni Izirali kama ayen ba kala ba kpi kama gɔnni po, ba meena a sum jam kpi kama ka Kaleb Jefunne nidoabinni ale Nun nidoabinni Josua nyiini ale jam tali.

Title: CHIINIKA 27
Content:
1Liema de ate ba kowa a chim Zelofehad ate wa chim Yefer nidoabili ate wa mɛ a chim Gilead nidoabili ate wa mɛ a chim Makir nidoabili ate wa mɛ a chim Manasa nidoabili, a nyini Manasa yezuimaŋa la ate wa mɛ a chim Josefi nidoabili. Liema de yue a jam le Mala ale Nowa ale Yogla ale Milka ale Tirza. 2Ba yaa jam cheŋ Tuka Viuku nansuiŋku nɔi a zaani Moosis ale Eleaza kaabteerɔwa ale niŋdeerɔma ale tigsuŋku meena niŋ a weeni ayen, 3<<Ti kowa a kpi ka gɔnni po. Wa jam maa ka Koora ŋaaŋviirɔma po baai ale jam jigi yeŋ an siak te Naawen la, alege wa jam kpi ka wadek biem nyiŋ wa an biak nidoa. 4Ka boa ate tama kowa yuei a muriŋ a bɛ wa dɔkku po ayen wa ka nidoabili nyiŋŋa? Ni te ti nitalim a nyini ti koma jigi.>>
5Moosis yaa ta ba wanni a jam Naawen niŋ 6ate Naawen a weeni wa ayen, 7<<Zelofehad liema ale a weeni diila, ka wensie. Ku a fɛ ate ni te ba ba dɛka jigini ase ba mɛ nitalim la a pai ba koma nitalimu a te ba.
8<<Weeni Izirali demma ayen, <Ase nuru a dan kpi ale ka nidoabili ya, ni pai wa nitalimu a te wa liewa. 9Ase wa dan kan ta lie, ni pai wa nitalimu a te wa suataŋa. 10Wa bɛ dan kan ta suata, pai wa nitalimu a te wa kowa suataŋa. 11Ase wa kowa me a dan kan ta suata, pai wa nitalimu a te wa dɔkku po waai ale moata wa la ate wa tanla. Ku ka ŋmarisika buusa a magsi ayen Izirali demma a va ase Naawen ale weeni Moosis diila.> >>
12Naawen a yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Jueli guuku de ale bo Abarim po la a nya tɛŋka a ti m te Izirali demma la. 13Fi dan nya a nueri, fi mɛ ale kpi kama ase fi suoku Aaron ale jam kpi diila. 14Dii nyiŋla tigsuŋku ale jam nye tukpari nyaataŋa ale bo Zin Gɔnni po la, nama jam a zɛri m wanni kama an zuli mu ase weleŋsa nyɔnɔwa la ba nimbie po.>> Dela jam ka Meriba Kades nyaataŋa ale bo Zin Gɔnni po la.
15Moosis a yaa weeni Naawen ayen, 16<<Naawen, nurubiik meena chiisa Wenni, a lueri nuru ate wa a nya naakuuni de zuk 17waai ale wa dɛ ba niŋ a ta ba nyini peelim abe wa ŋman ta ba jo, ate Naawen nuruma a kaa nye ase piisa ale kan ta naapeerik diila.>>
18Ate Naawen a yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Yik Nun nidoabinni Josua, wa ka nuru waai ate Naawen chiik a bo wa po la, pai fi nisaŋa a vi wa zuk a puusi te wa. 19Basi ate wa zaani Eleaza kaabteerɔwa ale tigsuŋku meena niŋ ate fi nye dila ale ba boro. 20Te wa fi pagrimu gela, dila ale basi ate Izirali naakuuni meena a zuli wa. 21Wa le zaani ka Eleaza kaabteerɔwa niŋ waai ale wa pai Urim a bek wie a sak wa Naawen ale a yaa diila. Naawen ale a weeni diila wa ale Izirali naakuuni meena ale nyini peelim, wa le ŋman weeni ba ate ba jo.>>
22Moosis a yaa nye dii ate Naawen a weeni wa la. Wa yik Josua a basi ate wa zaani Eleaza kaabteerɔwa ale tigsuŋku meena niŋ. 23Ate wa yaa pai wa nisaŋa a vi wa zuk a puusi te wa ase Naawen ale weeni Moosis diila.

Title: CHIINIKA 28
Content:
1Naawen a biisi te Moosis ayen, 2<<Pa wanni de a te Izirali demma a weeni ba ayen, <Ni nya ku zuk diipo ale magsi ni te mu ŋandiinta a ta nyini m tiirimu ate ni nye ale bolim ase nyum buui ale masa a te mi la.> 3Weeni ba ayen, <Tiirimu de ate ba nye ale bolim ayen ni pai a te Naawen la, ni yik pabisa siye, sii ale ta bein yeŋ dekki ale ka jomi la a nye ase ni nyiem ale a nye juka tiirim daa meena diila. 4Gomsi pabiik kanyi saluik abe kanyi wa mɛ junɔi, 5ale ŋandiinta tiirim ase zom naliŋ kuruba nɔi a pai kpaam kolini dinyi a dam du. 6Juka tiirimu de ate ni a nye daa meena ase ku le jam ka dii a nyini Sinai Guuku, ase mariŋka nyum buui ale masa, tiirim buui ate ba nye ale bolim a te Naawen la. 7Daamu tiirimu ale paasaŋ la a chim da kum chin geli ale pabiik kanyi meena. Kpiiri daamu tiirimu a te Naawen yenni po. 8Gomsi pabiik kaai ale saari siyewa la junɔi ale ŋandiinta tiirimu ale daam tiirim tii dek ate ni gomsi saluiku la. Bu de ka tiirim buui ate ba nye ale bolim, nyum buui ale masa a te Naawen la.
9<< <Vuusumu danni, ni nye tiirim ale pabisa siye, sii ale ta bein yeŋ dekki a ka jomi la, a gum chaab ale ka nyuka tiirimu ale ŋandiinta tiirim taasi kpien nɔi a lab pi a pai buye ale zonaliŋ a dam le kpaam. 10Kude ka juka tiirim a te Vuusum dai meena a gum chaab ale juka tiirimu ale daamu tiirimu ate ni kasim a nye la.
11<< <Chiik meena piilimka dai, ni yik lalik paalisa siye ale padiak kanyi ale padabilisa siyopɔi, sii ale ta bein yeŋ ale ka jomi la a nye juka tiirim a te Naawen. 12Ale lalik kanyi meena ku a magsi ka ŋandiinta tiirim ale zonaliŋ taasi kpien nɔi a lab pi a pai buta a dam ale kpaam ale padiaka, ale ŋandiinta tiirim ale zom taasi kpien nɔi a lab pi a pai buye a dam ale kpaam. 13Ale padiak kanyi ale ŋandiinta tiirim taasi kpien nɔi a lab pi a pai dinyi a dam ale kpaam. Kude a magsika juka tiirim, buui nyum ale masa, tiirim buuni ate ba nye ale bolim a te Naawen. 14Ale lalik kanyi meena ku a magsika nyuka tiirim ale damasik kɔlima ŋaye ale padiak ale kolini abe kolini a magsi pabiika mɛ. Kude ale chiik meena juka tiirimu a magsi ni a nye chiik paalik meena beni po. 15Alege ni le kasim a nye juka tiirimu ale daam tiirimu la, Buuk kunyi ale ni a te Naawen ase biem tiirim la.
16<< <Piilimka chiika ka daa pi ale ŋanaansiwa danni ni teeri Naawen Gaambasika Tigini a dɛ di. 17Chiika de ka daa pi ale ŋanuwa danni a magsi ka ni de tigi a paari daa ŋayopɔi a ŋɔbi boroborok kuui ate dabinta a ka ku po. 18Piilim ka danni ni nye tuilum tigsuŋ. Ni kan tom tuin pagri. 19Ni te Naawen tiirim buui ate ni nye ale bolim la, ni yik lalik paalisa siye ale padiak kanyi ale padabilisa siyopɔi, sii ale ta bein yeŋ dekki ale ka jomi la a nye juka tiirimu. 20Ni dan ta lalikka cheena ni maa ta ŋandiinta tiirim taasi kpien nɔi a lab pi a pa buta ale zonaliŋ a dam kpaam du ale padiaka mɛ ni ta zom taasi kpien nɔi a lab pi a pai buye a jam, 21padabilisa siyopɔiwa meena ni ta zom taasi kpien nɔi a lab pi a ta bunyi a jam. 22Ni ta buduk kunyi a maa jam ase biem tiirim la a nye biem duisi basika. 23Ni gomsi ŋantaŋa de a gum chaab ase saluik meena ate ni a nye juka tiirimu diila. 24Suiku de po gomsi ŋan bieŋa tiirimu ate ni a nye ale bolim daa meena la ate ku paari daa ŋayopɔi ase nyum buui ale masa a te Naawen la, ku magsi ni gomsi a gum chaab ale ni nyiem ale a nye juka tiirimu ale daamu tiirimu diila. 25Daa ŋayopɔiwa danni ni nye tuilum tigsuŋ, ni kan tom tuin pagri.
26<< <Yɔna ŋaai ale dɛ niŋ a bɛ la, ase ni dan te Naawen tiirim ale ŋanbie paala Bakoa Tigini danni, ni tu chaab ale weleŋsa abe ni kan tom tuini ase ni nyiem ale a tom diila. 27Ni nye juka tiirim ale lalik paalisa siye ale padiak kanyi ale padabilisa siyopɔi, sii ale ta bein yeŋ dekki la ase nyum buui ale masa a te Naawen la. 28A gum chaab ale lalik kanyi meena ku a magsi ka ni ta ŋandiinta tiirim taasi kpien nɔi a lab pi a pai buta ale zonaliŋ a dam kpaam du, ale padiaka ni ta taasi kpien nɔi a lab pi a ta buye a jam, 29ale padabilisa siyopɔiwa kanyi meena ni ta taasi kpien nɔi a lab pi a pai bunyi a gum du a jam. 30Ni maa ta buduk kunyi a gum du a magsi ate ba nye biem duisi basika a te ni. 31Gomsi ŋantaŋa de a gum chaab ale ba daamu tiirimu a gum ba nyiem ale nye juka tiirimu ale ŋandiinta tiirimu la po. Kpesi nya chak ayen duŋsaŋa a ka jomi ya.

Title: CHIINIKA 29
Content:
1<< <Chiisa siyopɔiwa piilimka danni ni tu chaab ale weleŋsa abe ni kan tom tuini ase ni nyiem ale tom diila. Ku ka dai dii ale magsi ni peeri damunsaŋa la. 2Ase nyum buui ale masa a te Naawen la, ni gomsi juka tiirim ale lalikbili dinyi ale padiak kanyi ale padabilisa siyopɔi, sii ale ta bein yeŋ dekki ale ka jomi la. 3A gum chaab ale lalikka, gomsi ŋandiinta tiirim ale taasi kpien nɔi lab pi a pai buta ale zonaliŋ a dam kpaam du, ni ta taasi kpien nɔi lab pi a pai buye a gum padiaka po, 4abe pabisa siyopɔiwa kanyi meena ni te taasi kpien nɔi a lab pi a pai bunyi. 5Ni ta buduk kunyi ase biem tiirim la ate ba nye biem duisi basika a te ni. 6Ŋade a gum chaab ale ka chiika ale danni po juka tiiritaŋa ale ba ŋan bieŋa ale nyuka tiiritaŋa ase ku le poom ka diila. Ti ka tiirim tii ate ba nye a te Naawen ale bolim ase nyum buui ale masa la.
7<< <Chiisa siyopɔiwa po ka daa piwa danni ni tu chaab ale weleŋsa. Ku a fɛ ate ni zɛri nidek abe ni kan tom tuini. 8Ni yik lalikbili dinyi ale padiak kanyi ale padabilisa siyopɔi sii ale ta bein yeŋ dekki ale ka jomi la a nye juka tiirim ase nyum buui ale masa la a te Naawen. 9A gum chaab ale lalikka, gomsi ŋandiinta tiirim taasi kpien nɔi a lab pi a pai buta ale zonaliŋ a dam kpaam du, ale padiaka mɛ ni gum zom taasi kpien nɔi a lab pi a pai buye, 10abe padabilisa siyopɔiwa kanyi meena gum zom taasi kpien nɔi a lab pi a pai bunyi. 11Ni maa ta buduk kunyi a jam ase biem tiirim la, a gum chaab ale biem tiirimu a magsi biem duisi basika ale ni nyiem ale a nye juka tiirimu la ale ba ŋandiinta tiirimu ale ba nyuka tiiritaŋa.
12<<Chiisa siyopɔiwa ka daa pi ale ŋanuwa danni, ni nye tuilum tigsuŋ, ni kan tom tuin pagri. Ni nye tigi te Naawen daa ŋayopɔi. 13Ni nye tiirim ale bolim ase nyum buui ale masa a te Naawen. Ni yik lalik paalisa pi ale sita ale padaasa siye ale padabilisa pi ale sinaansi, sii ale ta bein yeŋ dekki ale ka jomi la, a jam nye juka tiirim buui nyum ale masa a te Naawen. 14A gum chaab ale lalisa pi ale sitawa kanyi meena ni gomsi ŋandiinta tiirim ale taasi kpien nɔi a lab pi a pai buta ale zom naliŋ a dam kpaam du. Ni ta zom taasi kpien nɔi a lab pi a pai buye a gum padaasa siye du, 15abe padabilisa pi ale sinaansiwa kanyi meena ni gum taasi kpien nɔi a lab pi a pai bunyi. 16Ni maa ta buduk kunyi ase biem tiirim la a gum daa meena juka tiirimu ale ku ŋandiinta tiirimu ale nyuka tiirimu po.
17<< <Daa ŋayewa danni ni gomsi lalik paalisa pi ale siye ale padaasa siye ale padabilisa pi ale sinaansi, sii ale ta bein yeŋ dekki ale ka jomi la. 18A gum chaab ale lalisaŋa ale padaasaŋa ale pabisaŋa ni gomsi ba ŋandiinta tiirimu ale nyuka tiiritaŋa a magsi chaab ale ba nɔi ale ka diila. 19Ni maa yik buduk a gum du ase biem tiirim la a gum daa meena juka tiirimu po ale ba ŋandiinta tiirimu ale ba nyuka tiiritaŋa po.
20<< <Daa ŋatawa danni ni gomsi lalisa pi ale kanyi, padaasa siye ale padabilisa pi ale sinaansi a ta bein yeŋ dekki la, sii ale kan ta jomi la. 21A gum chaab ale lalisaŋa ale padaasaŋa ale pabisaŋa gomsi ba ŋan bieŋa tiiritaŋa ale nyuka tiiritaŋa a magsi chaab ale ŋantaŋa nɔi ale ka diila. 22Ni maa ta buduk a jam magsi biem tiirim a gum ni nyiem le a nye juka tiirimu ale ku ŋandiinta tiirimu ale nyuka tiirimu diila.
23<< <Daa ŋanaansiwa danni gomsi lalisa pi ale padaasa siye ale padabilisa pi ale sinaansi, sii ale ta bein yeŋ dekki ale ka jomi la. 24A gum chaab ale lalisaŋa ale padaasaŋa ale pabisaŋa gomsi ba ŋandiinta tiiritaŋa ale nyuka tiiritaŋa a magsi chaab ale ba nɔi ale ka diila. 25Ni maa ta buduk a jam magsi biem tiirim a gum chaab ale ni nyiem ale a nye juka tiirimu ale ŋandiinta tiirimu ale nyuka tiirimu diila.
26<< <Daa ŋanuwa danni gomsi lalisa neok ale padaasa siye ale padabilisa pi ale sinaansi, sii ale ta bein yeŋ dekki, ale ka jomi ya. 27A gum chaab ale lalisaŋa ale padaasaŋa ale pabisaŋa gomsi ba ŋan bieŋa tiiritaŋa ale ba nyuka tiiritaŋa a magsi chaab ale ba nɔi ale ka diila. 28Ni maa ta buduk a jam magsi biem tiirim a gum chaab ale daa meena juka tiirimu ale ba ŋandiinta tiirimu ale nyuka tiirimu ale ka diila.
29<< <Daa ŋayuebiwa danni gomsi lalisa naaniŋ ale padaasa siye ale padabilisa pi ale sinaansi, sii ale ta bein yeŋ dekki ale ka jomi la. 30A gum chaab ale lalisaŋa ale padaasaŋa ale pabisaŋa, gomsi ba ŋan bieŋa tiiritaŋa ale ba nyuka tiiritaŋa a magsi chaab ale ba nɔi ale ka diila. 31Ni maa ta buduk a jam ase biem tiirim la, a gum ni nyiem ale a nye juka tiirimu ale ŋandiinta tiirimu ale nyuka tiirimu diila.
32<< <Daa ŋayopɔiwa danni ni gomsi lalisa siyopɔi ale padaasa siye ale padabilisa pi ale sinaansi, sii ale ta bein yeŋ dekki ale ka jomi la. 33A gum chaab ale lalisaŋa ale padaasaŋa ale pabisaŋa, gomsi ba ŋan bieŋa tiiritaŋa ale nyuka tiiritaŋa a magsi chaab ale ba nɔi ale ka diila. 34Ni maa gum buduk kunyi du ase biem tiirim la, a gum chaab ale ni nyiem ale a nye juka tiirim ale ba ŋandiinta tiirimu ale nyuka tiirimu diila.
35<< <Daa naanika danni ni tu chaab abe ni kan tom tuini ase ni nyiem ale a tom diila. 36Ni yik lalik yeŋ ale padiak yeŋ ale padabilisa siyopɔi, sii ale ta bein yeŋ dekki ale ka jomi la, a nye juka tiirim buui nyum ale masa a te Naawen. 37A gum chaab ale lalikka ale padiaka ale pabisaŋa siyopɔiwa gomsi ba ŋan bieŋa tiiritaŋa ale ba nyuka tiiritaŋa a magsi chaab ale ba nɔi ale ka diila. 38Ni maa gum buduk kunyi du ase biem tiirim la, a gum chaab ale ni nyiem ale nye ba juka tiirimu ale ba ŋandiinta tiirimu ale nyuka tiirimu diila.
39<< <A gum chaab ale dii ate ni pɛ ayen ni nye ale nidek yaalika tiiritaŋa la, ni gomsi ba dɛ a te Naawen diipo ate ni a dɛ feoku la, ni nye juka tiirita ale ŋandiin tiirita ale nyuka tiirita ale suiyɔgni tiirita.> >>
40Ate Moosis a yaa weeni Izirali demma dii meena ate Naawen a biisi ale wa la.

Title: CHIINIKA 30
Content:
1Moosis a biisi te Izirali diinaŋa niŋdeerɔma ayen, <<Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna, 2Ase nuru a dan pɛ ale Naawen yaase wa dueni nɔi a pai wadek a nyo pumpuulima po, ku a fɛ ate wa kan basi wa le weeni diila alege ku a fɛ ate wa nye dii meena ate wa weeni la.
3<<Ase nipok paalik a dan diem bo wa ko yeri a nye pɛka a te Naawen yaase wa pai wadek a nyo pumpuulima wari nyiŋ, 4ate wa kowa a wom wa pɛka yaase pumpuulimaŋa alege an weeni wa wari ya, wa pɛka ale pumpuulima ŋaai meena ate wa pai wadek a nyoro la a diem va wa kama. 5Alege wa kowa a dan seba ku nɔi po ale kpalimu, pɛka yaase pumpuulimaŋa ŋaai ate wa pai wadek a nyoro la an ŋman va wa. Naawen ale yeeri wa du dii nyiŋla wa kowa a kpaliŋ kama.
6<<Ase wa dan yali wa le pɛ la ŋaaŋnyiŋ yaase wa nɔnni a nye betta a pai wadek a nyo pumpuulima po 7ate wa chorɔwa a wom alege an biisi wari a te wa, wa pɛka yaase pumpuulima ŋaai ate wa pai wadek a nyoro la va wa kama. 8Alege wa chorɔwa a dan seba ku nɔi po wa ale kasi pumpuulima ŋaai ale a te wa suik yaase yeentika pumpuulima ŋaai ate wa pa wadek a nyo ŋa po la ate Naawen ale yeeri wa ŋa po.
9<<Ase pukɔgi yaase nipok waai ale basi wa chorɔ la a dan pɛ yaase wa puulim ku va wa kama.
10<<Ase nipok a dan bo ale wa chorɔ a nye pɛka a pai wadek a nyo pumpuulima po a dueni nɔi 11ate wa chorɔwa a wom alege an weeni wa wari ya alege an kasi wa, wa pɛka meena yaase wa pumpuulimaŋa ate wa pai wadek a nyoro la ale va wa. 12Alege wa chorɔwa a dan wom ale zɛri ŋa, pɛka yaase pumpuulimaŋa ale nyini wa nɔnni po la a kan tom tuima. Wa chorɔwa a kaasi ŋa kama, ate Naawen ale yeeri wa. 13Wa chorɔwa ale maa weeni yaase wa kaasi pɛ kaai ate wa nye yaase wa puulim wa zɛri wadek la. 14Alege wa chorɔwa a dan kan weeni wari a te wa, a nyini di danni, ku a sak ayen wa siak pɛka ale pumpuulimaŋa meena ale bobi wa la kama. Wa siak kama wa ale kan weeni wa wari diipo ate wa wom ŋa la nyiŋ. 15Ase wa dan wom ale an nye wari ya, wa womka ŋaaŋnyiŋ wa an baga a kaasi ŋa, wa le soa nipowa kaasuŋku.>>
16Sinsaŋŋa de ate Naawen a te Moosis a magsi chaab ale nuru ale wa pok suŋsuŋ po, ale ko ale wa lie paalik waai ale diem vua a bo wa yeri po la.

Title: CHIINIKA 31
Content:
1Naawen a yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 2<<Nye kpaliŋ ale Midian demma a te Izirali demma, dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ fi yaa le paari fi nyama.>>
3Dila nyiŋla Moosis a yaa biisi a te nuruma ayen, <<Ni gomsi nidoama gela ate ni nye kpaliŋ ale Midian demma a ta Naawen suipuurumu a paari ba. 4Ta nidoaba tusidi a nyini Izirali dɔk kunyi meena po a cheŋ kpaliŋka.>> 5Nidoaba tusa pi ale ŋaye (12,000) ale jam gomsi badek a magsi kpaliŋ, tusidi a nyini Izirali yezuimaŋa meena a jam te. 6Moosis yaa jam ta ba cheŋ kpaliŋka, nuruba tusidi ale jam nyini dɔk meena po a gum chaab ale Fineyas kaabteerɔwa Eleaza nidoabinni po, waai ale jam pai ŋan baai ale bo Naawen yenni po la ale damunsa a magsi magsa la.
7Ba yaa nye kpaliŋ ale Midian demma ase Naawen ale weeni Moosis diila a ko nidoa meena. 8Baai ate ba jam ko la po ale Evi ale Arekem ale Zur ale Yur ale Areba. Ba nɔi banuwa ka Midian nalima. Ba jam maa ko Balaam, Biio nidoabinni ale gebik woŋ. 9Izirali demma a yaa nak yik Midian nipooma ale ba bisaŋa ale ba duŋsaŋa ale ŋan baai meena ate ba ta la. 10Ba jam ju Midian demma ale jam kala juijui la kama ale bolim. 11Ba jam pai ŋan maŋsaŋa meena kama ale ŋan baai ale ŋmasi nala la ale nuruma ale duŋsaŋa, 12a ta baai ate ba yik la ale ŋantaŋa a jam te Moosis ale kaabteerɔwa Eleaza ale Izirali demma ale bo juijui la Moab tɛŋka peelimmu po, a moata Jodan kauk kuui ale tuk Jeriko la.
13Moosis ale kaabteerɔwa Eleaza ale naakuuni niŋdeerɔma meena a yaa basi ba boka jigini ale cheŋ ayen ba tu ba. 14Moosis sui yaa jam puuri ale tugurik tɔŋdɔma niŋdeerɔma ale kpag ŋaai ale a nya tusa ale kpaga ŋaai ale a nya kobsa zuk la, baai ale nyini kpaliŋka po a jam la.
15Wa yaa bek ayen, <<Ni basi ate nipooma meena a boro kama?>> 16<<Bala ale baai ale va Balaam sinsaŋŋa a tulim Izirali demma ate ba basi Naawen vaka dii ale jam nye Peor la, ate nyiŋtuila a nak Naawen nuruma. 17Yɔgyɔgla de ni ko nidoabilisaŋa meena. Abe ni ko nipok waai meena ale goa ale nidoa la, 18alege ni tali nipokbili meena ale kan goa ale nidoa a nya la a te nidek.
19<<Nama baai meena ale ko nuru yaase ni tiri waai ate ba ko la, ku a fɛ ate ni bo peelim a paari daa ŋayopɔi. Daa ŋatawa ale daa ŋayopɔiwa daaŋa, nama ale baai ate ni nak yik la a nye cheri. 20Ni basi ate ni gattaŋa meena a nye cheri ale ŋan baai ate ba pai gbana yaase buuk kɔbta yaase daata a nye la.>>
21Kaabteerɔwa Eleaza yaa biisi te tugurik tɔŋdɔma baai ale cheŋ kpaliŋka po la ayen, <<Ŋmarisika sinsaŋŋa ale nna ate Naawen a te Moosis la. 22Ligmɔniŋ ale kpana ale kutuk mɔnuŋ ale kutuk ale kutuk peeluk ale kutuk kuui ale baasa la 23ale jabuui meena ale kaa chali bolim la, ku a fɛ ate ba pai a nyo bolim po ate wa nala alege ku a fɛ ate sugrika nyiamu ale bu basi ate ba nala. Ate jabuui ale a chali bolim la ku a fɛ ate ba pai jabula a nyo nyiam bula mɛ po. 24Daa ŋayopɔiwa danni ni sugri ni gattaŋa ate ni nala. Dila ni baga jam ni boka jigini kama.>>
25Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 26<<Fi ale kaabteerɔwa Eleaza ale yeeŋa nyama naakuuni po ale ni chiini nuruma meena ale duŋsaŋa ate ni nak yik la. 27Ni lab ŋan bala buye a chari tugurik tɔŋdɔma baai ale maa nye kpaliŋka la ale naakuuni meena. 28A nyini tugurik tɔŋdɔma baai ale ga nye kpaliŋka la po, gaari wanyi a ta nyini kobsinu meena po a te Naawen ase zula la, ka nuruba yaase ka niiga yaase ka bonsa yaase, ka piisa yaase ka bua. 29Ni nye zulaŋa de a ta nyini ba charuku genni po a te kaabteerɔwa Eleaza ase Naawen dɛka jigi la. 30A nyini Izirali demma po geli, lueri wanyi a ta nyini pisinu meena po, dan poom ka nuruba yaase niiga yaase bonsa yaase piisa yaase boa yaa duŋ yoŋsa. Pai si te Livaima baai ale a nya Naawen viuku zuk la.>> 31Moosis ale kaabteerɔwa Eleaza yaa nye dii ate Naawen a weeni Moosis la.
32Ŋan baai ate tugurik tɔŋdɔma a jam pai ate ba tali la ale nna, piisaŋa a jam ka tusa kobsiyuebi ale pisiyopɔi ale ŋanu (675,000), 33niiga tusa pisiyopɔi ale ŋaye (72,000), 34bonsa tusa pisiyuebi ale dinyi (61,000), 35nipok baai ale kan seba nidoaba la mɛ a paari tusa pisita ale ŋaye (32,000).
36Baai ale jam cheŋ kpaliŋka po la charuku genni a jam ka piisa tusa kobsita ale pisita ale ŋayopɔi ale kobsinu (337,500), 37alege ate Naawen zulaŋa tiirimu a paari piisa kobsiyuebi ale pisiyopɔi ale ŋanu, 38niiga tusa pisita ale ŋayuebi (36,000) ate Naawen a soa pisiyopɔi ale ŋaye, 39bonsaŋa me a jam ka tusa pisita ale kobsinu (30,500) ate Naawen a soa pisiyuebi ale kanyi, 40alege nuruma a paari tusa pi ale ŋayuebi (16,000) ate Naawen a soa pisita ale baye.
41Moosis a jam pai Naawen zulaŋa tiirimu a te ka kaabteerɔwa Eleaza ase Naawen ale jam weeni Moosis diila.
42Geli dii ate Izirali demma a soa ate Moosis a jam gaari ba ba tɔga a ta nyini tugurik tɔŋdɔma po la, 43naakuuni genni a jam ka piisa tusa kobsita ale pisita ale ŋayopɔi ale kobsinu (337,500), 44niiga tusa pisita ale ŋayuebi (36,000), 45bonsa tusa pisita ale kobsinu (30,500), 46nuruma me a jam ka tusa pi ale ŋayuebi (16,000). 47A nyini Izirali demma genni po, Moosis a lueri ka nuru yeŋ pisinu po ale duŋ yeŋ duŋsa pisinu po ase Naawen ale weeni wa diila a yaa pai ba a te Livaima baai ale a nya Naawen viuku zuk la.
48Kpaŋŋa baai ale a nya tugurik tommu labka zuk la, kpaga ŋaai ale nya tusa ale kobsa zuk la a yaa cheŋ Moosis jigi 49a weeni wa ayen, <<Fi tomteerɔma a chiini tugurik tɔŋdɔma ate tama a nya ba zuk la kama, ba wanyi me la an bɛ ya. 50Tama meena a ta ka tiirim a jam ti te Naawen, ŋantaŋa abe le ligmɔniŋ ale nigiri baŋsa ale nisɔgi baŋsa ale nifelima ale tukpana ale ŋiri baŋsa ayen ti nye biem duisi basika tiirim a te tidek Naawen niŋ.>>
51Moosis ale Eleaza kaabteerɔwa a yaa siak tuesi ligmɔniŋka ŋantaŋa meena ate ba te la ba jigi. 52Ligmɔniŋka meena ale nyini kpaŋŋa baai ale a nya tusa ale kobsa la ate Moosis ale kaabteerɔwa Eleaza a jam pai te Naawen ase tiirim la, ba magsika dobrimu a jam ka ligbie tusa pi ale ŋayuebi ale kobsiyopɔi ale pisinu (16,750). 53Tugurik tɔŋdɔ meena a poom jam pai ŋanta a te wadek kama. 54Moosis ale kaabteerɔwa Eleaza a yaa jam siak tuesi ligmɔniŋka kpaga ŋaai ale nya tusa ale kobsa zuk la jigi, a yaa ta ba jam Tuka Viuku po ase teerika la te Izirali demma Naawen niŋ.

Title: CHIINIKA 32
Content:
1Aruben dɔkdemma ale Gad dɔkdemma baai ale jam ta duŋsa piisi la a yaa nya ale Jazer ale Gilead tɛŋsaŋa a nala magsi duŋsa wuuka. 2Ba yaa jam Moosis ale kaabteerɔwa Eleaza ale naakuuni niŋdeerɔma jigi ayen, 3<<Atarot ale Dibon ale Jazer ale Nimra ale Yesbon ale Elealeya ale Sebam ale Nebo ale Beon 4tɛŋ kaai ate Naawen a nya pagrim ba zuk Izirali demma niŋ la a nala kama a magsi duŋsa wuuka, fi tomteerɔma mɛ abe taka duŋsa.>> 5Ba weeni ayen, <<Ase ni nina a dan sueri ale tama, ni be te ni tomteerɔma tɛŋka ase ti nitalim la, kan basi ate ti lo Jodan benni a jueli.>>
6Moosis yaa biisi a te Gad dɔkdemma ale Aruben dɔkdemma ayen, <<Ni tɛŋka demma a magsi ba cheŋ kpaliŋ alege ate nama a kala dela? 7Ka boa ate nama a nye ate Izirali demma a jɔk nyiŋbiiri ayen ba kan cheŋ tɛŋ kaai ate Naawen a te ba la? 8Ni koma ale jam nye diila ale nna ase mi ale jam tom ba ayen ba basi Kades Barnea abe ba ga kpesi nya tɛŋka la. 9Ase ba le ga paari Eskol Viaka a nya tɛŋka la ŋaaŋnyiŋ ba yaa jam nye ate Izirali demma a jɔk nyiŋbiiri ate dila a basi ate ba an jo tɛŋ kaai ate Naawen a te ba la po. 10Naawen sui yaa puuri dai dila danni ate wa yaa pɛ pɛka de ayen, 11<Dii nyiŋla ba an va mi ale ba suiniima meena, nuruma de baai ale paari bena pisiye yaase ba gaam dila a nyini Ejipiti po a nyini la, ba wanyi mɛ la a kan nya tɛŋ kaai ate mi a puulim ale Abrayam ale Aizik ale Jekob la. 12Ba wanyi mɛ la a kan nya ka, ka Jefunne nidoabinni Kaleb ate wa nyini Kenizzi dɔkdemma po la ale Nun nidoabinni Josua, dii nyiŋla ba jam va Naawen ale ka ba suiniima meena.> 13Ate Naawen sui yaa jam a dɛ ale Izirali demma ate wa nye ate ba bo gɔnni po cheŋ a gilim a paari bena pisinaansi ate ku ga paari diipo ate gaŋ kala baai meena ale nye biem la a kpi cheŋ.
14<<Ni abe le nna dela wabaata nyama jilli, za ni koma naŋkula po a ŋmasi nye ate Naawen sui a puuri ale Izirali demma nna yegayega. 15Ni dan basi wa vaka, wa le ŋman basi nuruma de meena ka gɔnni po, ku be le sak ayen ka nama ale soa ba kaasuŋku.>>
16Ba yaa jam wa jigi ayen, <<Ti a yaali ti se zoŋta a magsi ti duŋsaŋa abe ti se tɛŋsa me a magsi ti pooma ale bisaŋa. 17Alege tama gomsi tidek kama ale kpaliŋ kɔlima ayen ti bo Izirali demma niŋ ate ku ga paari diipo ate tama ale ta ba jam ba jigini la. Alege ti pooma ale bisaŋa ale bo tɛŋ sii ate parik pagrik a gilim la, ate wari a kan nyini tɛŋka po a paari ba. 18Ti kan ŋmani kuli ti yeeŋa, ka ti ni nya ale Izirali demma a tuesi ba nitalimu. 19Tama a kan ŋman tuesi nitalim ale bo Jodan Benni kauk kunkula, dii nyiŋla tama nitalimu a nyinika Jodan Benni kori geŋsa.>>
20Moosis a yaa biisi ale ba ayen, <<Ase ni dan nye kude, ase ni dan gomsi nidek Naawen niŋ a magsi kpaliŋ, 21ase ni meena a dan gomsi nidek a magsi kpaliŋ lo Jodan benni a jueli Naawen niŋ a ta ga paari diipo ate wa le yiak wa dachaasaŋa a basi te ni la 22ate ni dan nya pagrim tɛŋka zuk Naawen niŋ, ni yaa baga ŋmani kama, ni ŋman ka pami ale Naawen ale Izirali demma waai ya. Ate tɛŋka de a yaa le chim ka ni nitalim Naawen nimbie po.
23<<Alege ni dan zɛri an nye wieŋa de, ni nye ka biem a kaasi Naawen, ni be seba ayen ni biemu ale ta ni nyini peelim. 24Ni be se tɛŋsa a te ni nipooma ale bisaŋa, abe ni se zoŋta a te ni duŋsaŋa, alege ni nye dii ate ni puulim la.>>
25Gad dɔkdemma ale Aruben dɔkdemma a yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Tama fi tomteerɔma ale nye ase ti nyɔnɔwa ale weeni diila. 26Ti bisaŋa ale ti pooma ale ti duŋsaŋa ale wari dela Gilead tɛŋka po. 27Alege ni tomteerɔma, nuru meena ale gomsi a magsi kpaliŋ la, ale lo jueli a kpaliŋ Naawen niŋ, ase ti nyɔnɔwa ale weeni diila.>>
28Moosis a yaa weeni ba wie a te kaabteerɔwa Eleaza ale Nun nidoabinni Josua ale Izirali diinaŋa niŋdeerɔma. 29Wa weeni ba ayen, <<Ase Gad dɔkdemma ale Aruben dɔkdemma meena ale gomsi badek a magsi kpaliŋ, a lo Jodan Benni a jueli Naawen niŋ la, ate ni nya pagrim tɛŋka zuk, ni te ba Gilead tɛŋka ase ba nitalim la. 30Alege ba dan kan gomsi badek a magsi kpaliŋ a lo beni a jueli ale fu, ku a fɛ ate ba maa siak tuesi ba nitalimu ale fu Keenan tɛŋka po.>>
31Gad dɔkdemma ale Aruben dɔkdemma yaa tulisi ayen, <<Fi tomteerɔma ale nye dii ate Naawen a weeni la. 32Ti le gomsi tidek a magsi kpaliŋ Naawen niŋ a lo jueli Keenan, alege ti nitalimu ale boka Jodan benni kauk kude.>>
33Ate Moosis a yaa pai Amori Naawa Siyon naamu ale Basan Naawa Og naamu ale tɛŋka ale yeeŋa ale gilim ba la a te Gad dɔkdemma ale Aruben dɔkdemma ale Josefi nidoabinni Manasa dɔkdemma geli.
34Gad dɔkdemma ale jam ŋman se Dibon ale Atarot ale Aroer, 35ale Atrot Sofan ale Jazer ale Jogbeya, 36ale Bet Nimra ale Bet Yaran ase tɛŋ sii ate parik pagrisa a gilim la, ale se zoŋta a te ba duŋsaŋa. 37Aruben dɔkdemma ale ŋman se Yesbon Elealeya ale Kiriataim tɛŋsaŋa, 38ale Nebo ale Baal Meon (yueŋa de ba jam tagri ŋa kama) ale Sibma. Ba jam te tɛŋsaŋa ate ba ŋman se la ka yue.
39Makir Manasa nidoabinni ŋaaŋbisaŋa a yaa jam cheŋ Gilead a nak yik ba, a yiak Amori demma baai ale jam bo dula la ate ba nyini. 40Ate Moosis a yaa jam pai Gilead tɛŋka a te Makir dɔkdemma, Manasa ŋaaŋbiika ate ba kali dula. 41Jair ale ka Manasa ŋaaŋbiik la, a yaa jam nak tuesi ba kalisaŋa jiŋŋa ale a wi ba ayen Yavvot Jair. 42Ate Noba me a nak yik Kenat ale tɛŋ sii ale kali gilim ka la, a yaa pai wadek yuenni a te tɛŋka yue ayen Noba.

Title: CHIINIKA 33
Content:
1Dela ale Izirali demma chelimu ale ba kalisaŋa ba le jam nyini Ejipiti ale poori ate Moosis ale Aaron a de ba niŋ la. 2Naawen yaa weeni Moosis ate wa ŋmarisi ba kalisaŋa jiŋŋa ba chelimu po. Ba chelimu kalisaŋa jiŋŋa ale nna.
3Izirali demma a jam basi Arameses tɛŋka ale bo Ejipiti po la ka piilimka chiika ka daa pi ale ŋanuwa danni, dai dii ale pai a saŋ Gaambasika Tigini danni la. Ba jam gɔk ka santiri ale suinum pagri a nyini ate Ejipiti demma meena a nya ba, 4baai ale jam boro a gu ba biik sii ate ba dɛ niŋ a biak la, baai ate Naawen a jam ko ba a lɔnsi ba po la, Naawen a jam taka buusa a jam ba wenaŋa zuk. 5Izirali demma a jam basi Arameses ale ga kali ka Sukkot. 6Ba le jam basi Sukkot la ba ga kali ka Etam gɔnni nakpiak.
7Ba jam basi Etam ale ŋman ka ŋaaŋ a cheŋ Pi Yayirot, Baal Zefon kori geŋsa a kali moata Migdol. 8Ba ŋman basi Pi Yayirot a va nyakpiemu po a jo gɔnni po, ase ba le jam bo Etam Gɔnni po cheŋ daa ŋata la, ba jam ga kali ka Mara tɛŋka.
9Ba ŋman basi Mara ale cheŋ ka Elim tɛŋka kauk kuui ate vila pi ale ŋaye ale kpinkpatta tiisa pisiyopɔi boro la a kali dula. 10Ba le jam basi Elim la, ba ga kali ka Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku nakpiak.
11Ba be jam ŋman basi Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku ale ga kali ka Sin Gɔnni po. 12Ba nyini Sin Gɔnni po ale ga kali ka Dofka. 13A nyini Dofka ba ga kali ka Alus. 14Ba basi Alus ale cheŋ ga kali ka Arefidim kauk kuui ate nyiam a karo ate nuruma a nyu la.
15Ba basi Arefidim ale ga kali ka Sinai Gɔnni po. 16Ba ŋman basi Sinai Gɔnni ale ga kali ka Kibrot Yattaava. 17A nyini Kibrot Yattaava ba ga kali ka Yazerot. 18Ba basi Yazerot ale ga kali ka Aritma. 19Ba ŋman basi Aritma ale ga kali ka Arimmon Perezi.
20A nyini Arimmon Perezi ba ga kali ka Libna. 21Ba nyini Libna a ga kali ka Arisaya. 22Ba le nyini Arisaya la ba ga kali ka Keyelata. 23A nyini Keyelata ba ga kali ka Sefer Guuku. 24Ba basi Sefer Guuku a ga kali ka Yaradaya.
25Ba basi Yaradaya la ba ga kali ka Makelot. 26Ba le basi Makelot la ba ga kali ka Tayat. 27Ba le basi Tayat la ba ga kali ka Tɛra. 28Ba le basi Tɛra la ba ga kali ka Mitka. 29Ba le basi Mitka la ba ga kali ka Yasmona.
30Ba le basi Yasmona la ba ga kali ka Moserot. 31Ba le basi Moserot la ba ga kali ka Bene Jaakan. 32Ba le basi Bene Jaakan la ba ga kali ka Yor Yaggidgad. 33Ba le basi Yor Yaggidgad la ba ga kali ka Jotbata. 34Ba le basi Jotbata la ba ga kali ka Abrona.
35Ba le basi Abrona la ba ga kali ka Ezion Geber. 36Ba le basi Ezion Geber la ba ga kali ka Kades, Zin Gɔnni po. 37Ba le basi Kades la ba ga kali ka Yor Guuku, Edom tɛŋka banni ale la. 38Ase Naawen ale biisi la, kaabteerɔwa Aaron a yaa jueli Yor Guuku zuk, dula ate wa kpi chiisa sinuwa piilimka danni bena pisinaansiwa po ase ba le jam nyini Ejipiti tɛŋka po a nyini la. 39Aaron a jam taka bena kook ale pisiye ale ŋata alege kpi Yor Guuku zuk la.
40Keenan naawa ale nyini Arad, waai ale jam bo Negev tɛŋka po la ale ga wom ayen Izirali demma a cheena la. 41Ba yaa jam basi Yor Guuku ale ga kali Zalmona. 42Ba basi Zalmona ale ga kali ka Punon. 43Ba le basi Punon la ba ga kali ka Obot. 44Ba le basi Obot la ba ga kali ka Iye Abarim Moab tɛŋ banni.
45Ba le basi Iyim la ba ga kali ka Dibon Gad. 46Ba le basi Dibon Gad la ba ga kali ka Almon Diblataim. 47Ba le basi Almon Diblataim la ba ga kali ka Abarim guutaŋa zuk ale moata Nebo la.
48Ba le basi Abarim guutaŋa la ba ga kali ka Moab peelimmu Jodan benni nɔi a tuk Jeriko la. 49Dula Moab peelimmu po, ba ga kali ka Jodan benni nɔi a nyini Bet Jesimot a ta ga paari Abel Sittim.
50Moab peelimmu ale maŋ Jodan a tuk Jeriko la, Naawen a yaa biisi ale Moosis ayen, 51<<Biisi a te Izirali demma a weeni ba ayen, <Ase ni dan lo Jodan benni a jueli Keenan po, 52ni yiak baai meena ale bo tɛŋka po la a basi. Ni kaasi ba ŋan baai ate ba peesi la ale ba bɔgtaŋa, abe ni ŋɔriŋ ba kuŋkuŋtaŋa meena. 53Ni tuesi tɛŋka a kali ka po, diila mi te ni tɛŋka kama ayen ni soa ka. 54Ni nak gbaŋ a chari tɛŋka a te chaab ta va ni yezuimaŋa ale ka diila. Baai ale piisi la ni te ba a zuak, baai ale kan piisi la ni te ba maga. Gbaŋka ale nak ate jabuui a lo ba zuk la, ka bala ale soa. Ni chari a ta va ni ŋiaka buuni ale ka diila.
55<< <Alege ni dan kan yiak baai ale bo tɛŋka po la a basi ya, baai ate ni basi ate ba tali boro la ale chim ka peema a lu ni nina abe ba chim munsa a lu ni gana. Ba le kasim a te ni daanika tɛŋ kaai po ate ni boro la. 56Ate mi ale nye ni dii ate m gomsi ayen m nye ba la.> >>

Title: CHIINIKA 34
Content:
1Ate Naawen a yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 2<<Weeni Izirali demma ayen, <Ase ni dan jo Keenan tɛŋka po, tɛŋka ate ba le te ni ase ni nitalim ate ka ta banaŋa de. 3<< <Ni yeseoku geŋ ale gum ka Zin Gɔnni kauk du a sali va Edom tɛŋ banni. Kori geŋka mɛ, ni yeseok banni ale piilim a nyini ka Yesa Nyakpiemu kpeglimka, 4a lo jueli Nueoŋ Suik Miglika yeseoku geŋ a ga va Zin a cheŋ paari Kades Barnea yeseok geŋ. A zaan dula di le va ka Yazar Addar a ga paari Azmon, 5dula jigini di le viriŋ a ga tom Ejipiti Viaka a yaa ga kpeglim Nyakpiemu.
6<< <Ni yeniŋka banni ale chim ka Nyakpiemu nɔnni. Di de ale chim ka ni yeniŋka banni.
7<< <Alege wiilukku geŋsa ni tɛŋ banni ale nyini ka Nyakpiemu a ga paari Yor Guuku, 8a nyini Yor Guuku a cheŋ Lebo Yamat. Tɛŋ banni ale paari Zedad, 9a nyini a ga va Zipron a ga kpeglim Yazar Enan. Dila ale ku chim ni tɛŋ banni wiilukku geŋsa.
10<< <Ni kori geŋsaŋa tɛŋ banni ale nyini ka Yazar Enan a cheŋ Sefam. 11Tɛŋ banni ale zaani Sefam a cheŋ Aribla kori geŋ a moata Ain a churinti siŋ va Kinneret Nyakpiemu ale bo kori geŋsa la. 12Tɛŋ banni ale nyini dula a siŋ va Jodan benni a ga kpeglim Yesa Nyakpiemu. <<Ni tɛŋka a ni la, ate ka banaŋa a bo gauŋ meena.> >>
13Moosis a weeni Izirali demma ayen, <<Ni nak gbaŋ a chari tɛŋka ase nitalim la. Ka Naawen ale weeni ayen ni te Izirali dɔkdem neok ale geli, 14dii nyiŋla Aruben dɔkdemma ale Gad dɔkdemma ale Manasa dɔkdemma geli a poom tuesi ba nitalimu kama. 15Buuraŋa ŋaye ale genni dɛ a tuesi ba nitalimu kama Jodan ale bo Jeriko la kori geŋsa a tuak wenbinni pusika jigini.>>
16Naawen a biisi te Moosis ayen, 17<<Nuruma de yueŋa ale nna, baai ale ba chari tɛŋka a te ni ase nitalim la. Kaabteerɔwa Eleaza ale Josua Nun nidoabinni. 18Maa lueri niŋdeerɔ wanyi a ta nyini dɔkdem meena po ate ba maa a chari tɛŋka. 19Ba yueŋa ale nna: Jefunne nidoabinni Kaleb ale nyini Juda dɔkku la, 20ale Ammiyud nidoabinni Sɛmuel ale nyini Simeyon dɔkku la, 21ale Kislon nidoabinni Elidad ate wa nyini Benjamin dɔkku la, 22ale Jogli nidoabinni Bukki ale ka niŋdeerɔ a nyini Dan dɔkku niŋdeerɔ la, 23ale Efod nidoabinni Yanniel Efod ale ka niŋdeerɔ a nyini Josefi nidoabinni Manasa dɔkku la, 24ale Siftan nidoabinni Kemuel ale ka niŋdeerɔ a nyini Josefi nidoabinni Ɛfraim dɔkku la, 25ale Parnak nidoabinni Elizafan nidoabinni ale ka niŋdeerɔ a nyini Zebulun dɔkku la, 26ale Azzan nidoabinni Paltiel ale ka niŋdeerɔ nyini Isaka dɔkku la, 27ale Selomi nidoabinni Ayiyud ale ka niŋdeerɔ a nyini Asɛ dɔkku la, 28ale Ammiyud nidoabinni Pedayel ale ka niŋdeerɔ a nyini Nafitali dɔkku la.>>
29Nidoama de ale Naawen a weeni ayen ba chari nitalimu a te Izirali demma Keenan tɛŋka po la.

Title: CHIINIKA 35
Content:
1Moab peelim kpiemu ale moata Jodan benni kauk kuui ale tuk Jeriko la, Naawen a yaa biisi ale Moosis ayen, 2<<Weeni Izirali demma ayen ba te Livaima tɛŋsa a ta nyini ba nitalimu po ate ba mɛ a boro. Abe ni te ba tɛŋ sii ale ta wuuk a gilim ba boka jigini la. 3Ate dila ale basi ate ba ta tɛŋsa a bo si po abe si ta wuuk a te ba niiŋa ale ba duŋ buulimu ale duŋ yoŋsa meena.
4<<Tɛŋ sii ale ta wuuk a gilim tɛŋsaŋa ate ni te Livaima ale teeri a cheŋ paari anamagib tusa ŋaye (2,000) zaani tɛŋka parisaŋa a ta cheŋ. 5Tɛŋka peelim geŋsa magsi anamagib tusa ŋanaansi (4,000) a nyini kori geŋsa, abe anamagib tusa ŋanaansi (4,000) a nyini yeseoku geŋsa abe anamagib tusa ŋanaansi (4,000) me yeniŋka abe anamagib tusa ŋanaansi (4,000) a nyini wiilukku geŋsa ate tɛŋka a bo suŋsuŋ. Ba le ta si dɛ kama ase tɛŋ sii ale ta wuuk ba tɛŋsaŋa po la.
6<<Tɛŋsaŋa ate ni te Livaima la po siyuebi ale si chim sukka jigi, kauk kuui ate waai a dan ko nuru abe wa chali cheŋ dula. Ni maa gum tɛŋsa pisinaansi ale siye du a te ba. 7Fi dan pai si meena a gum chaab, ku a fɛ ate ni te Livaima ka tɛŋsa pisinaansi ale naaniŋ a gum chaab ale tɛŋ sii ale ta wuuk a magsi ba tɛŋsaŋa la. 8Tɛŋsaŋa ate ni te Livaima la a ta nyini tɛŋka ate Izirali demma a ta la a magsi ni lab chari dɔkdemma meena ase nitalim la. Tuesi tɛŋ boari a ta nyini buuri dii ale ta tɛŋsa nna yegayega la jigi, abe fi tuesi maga a nyini baai tɛŋsa ale kan soa diila jigi.>>
9Naawen a yaa weeni Moosis ayen, 10<<Biisi a te Izirali demma a weeni ba ayen, <Ase ni dan lo Jodan benni a jueli Keenan tɛŋka po, 11ni lueri tɛŋsa gela ate sila a chim sukka jigi ate waai a dan kan potim seba ale ko nuru a chali ga dula. 12Tɛŋ sila ale chim ka suka jigi ate kotundɔ a kan nya wa, ate dila basi ate waai ale kan potim seba ale ko la kan kpi, ka wa nin zaani tigsuŋku niŋ ate ba nya wa wanni zuk. 13Tɛŋsa siyuebiwa ate ni a te la ale chim ka sukka jigi a te ni. 14Jodan benni kauk kude ni te ba tɛŋsa sita abe ni te ba sita me Keenan tɛŋka po ase sukka jigi la. 15Tɛŋsa siyuebiwa de ale chim ka sukka jigi a te Izirali demma ale nichamma ale nuru yontaŋa ale maa bo ale ba la, ate waai ale kan seba ale ko nuru la a chali cheŋ dula.
16<< <Alege nuru a dan nak waai ale kutuk ate wa kpi, wa ka nuru koorik, nuru koorika ku a fɛ ate ba ko wa mɛ. 17Yaase nuru a ta tintain wa nisima po ate di baga a ko, ate wa pai di a ko nuru, wa ka nuru koorik ku a fɛ ate ba ko nuru wala me. 18Yaase nuru waai a dan ta diok wa nisima po ate ku baga a ko nuru, ate wa nak waai ate wa kpi, wa ka nuru koorik, ku a fɛ ate ba ko nuru koorika. 19Kotundɔ a baga a ko nuru koorika de ase wa nin nya wa, ku a fɛ ate wa ko wa. 20Ase waai a dan potim seba ale pai jaab a chub nuru yaase wa pai jaab a yuk nuru ate wa kpi 21yaase fi dan ka a yaali waai wari ya a nak wa ate wa kpi, nuru wala ku a fɛ ate ba ko wa, wa ka nuru koorik. Kotundɔwa ku a fɛ ate wa ko nuru koorika ase wa nin tu wa.
22<< <Alege waai a dan kan kisi nuru a chub wa yaase wa an potim seba ale yuk wa ko ya 23yaase wa an nya wa a pai tain a lɔnsi wa zuk ate di baga a ko wa, ase wa le kan da wa dachiak alege wa bi an poli ka biem la, 24tigsuŋku a bo koorɔwa ale kotundɔ buusa a nya ase ka ba wana ale kaasi a ta va sinsaŋŋa de. 25Ku a fɛ ate tigsuŋku a vari waai ale kan potim seba ale ko la kotundɔwa nisa po a basi, ate tigsuŋku ta wa cheŋ sukka jigini ate wa chali cheŋ la. Ku a fɛ ate wa bo dula jigini a ta ga paari diipo ate kaabteerɔ kpioŋku ale kpi la, waai ate ba pai tuilum kpaam a kpiiri wa zuk a bobi wa la.
26<< <Ase waai ale kan potim seba ale ko la a dan nyini tɛŋ kaai ate wa chali a ga suk ka po la a nyini 27ate kotundɔwa a nya wa peelim, kotundɔwa a baga a ko waai ale kan potim seba ale ko la kama, wa an nye a kaasi ase nuru koorik la. 28Waai ale kan potim seba ale ko la a magsi wa bo sukka jigini kama ate ku paari diipo ate kaabteerɔ kpioŋku ale kpi la, kaabteerɔ kpioŋku kummu ŋaaŋnyiŋ wa baga ŋmani a cheŋ wadek nitalimu jigi kama.
29<< <Ŋade ka ŋmarisika buusa a magsi ni a va ŋa ni gaŋsaŋa meena ale bo ŋaaŋ cheen la kauk kuui meena ate ni boro la.
30<< <Nuru waai ale a ko nuru la, ba le ko wa ase ka nuru koorik la, ase seerɔba a nin biisi. Alege ni kan ko waai ate nuru yeŋ a chim wa seerɔ la.
31<< <Kan tuesi ligra abe fi basi nuru koorika waai ale magsi wa kpi la, ku a fɛ ate ni ko wa.
32<< <Kan tuesi ligra a ta nyini waai ale chali cheŋ tɛŋ kaai ate ba a suk la abe fi basi ate wa ŋman cheŋ wadek tɛŋka a boro a paari diipo ate kaabteerɔ kpioŋku a kpi la.
33<< <Kan taŋ tɛŋ kaai ate ni boro la, ziim a taŋ ka tɛŋ, biem duisi basika abe kan baga a nye a te tɛŋ kaai ate ziim a nyini ka zuk la, se ka waai dek ale basi ate ziimu a nyini la ziimu. 34Kan taŋ tɛŋ kaai ate fi boro la ale kauk kuui ate mi a boro la, ale Mi Naawen a bo ale ka Izirali demma.> >>

Title: CHIINIKA 36
Content:
1Dɔkdem kpaga ŋaai ale nyini Gilead yezukku la, ate Gilead a chim Makir nidoabili la ate Makir a chim Manasa nidoabili la, ate ba nyini Josefi ŋaaŋbisaŋa yezuimaŋa la, a yaa jam biisi ale Moosis ale niŋdeerɔma Izirali dɔkdemma kpaŋŋa. 2Ba weeni ayen, <<Ase Naawen ale weeni m nyɔnɔwa ayen wa nak gbaŋ la, wa weeni fu ayen fi pai ti suoku Zelofehad nitalimu a te wa liema. 3Yɔgyɔgla de ase ba nin yali nidoaba Izirali dɔkdem yoŋta, ba nitalimu ba le pai bu a ta nyini ti ŋiaka nitalimu po kama a ta ga gum dɔkdem baai ate ba yali la po. Ate nitalim buui ate tama soa la geli ale cheŋ jigi yoŋ. 4Ase Izirali demma Ŋmanpateka Beinni a dan paari, ba nitalimu ale gum chaab ale ka buui dii ate ba le yali la po ate ba ŋantaŋa ba le yeeri ba a ta nyini ba kokpieŋsaŋa buuni nitalimu po.>>
5Naawen ale weeni la, Moosis a yaa te Izirali demma wanni de ayen, <<Dii ate Josefi ŋaaŋbisaŋa a weeni la ka wensie. 6Di de ale Naawen a weeni te Zelofehad liema. Ba bag a yaali nuru waai meena ale a yɔk ba sue la kama ase ba nin yali ba kowa buuni po. 7Nitalim ka Izirali tɛŋka po a nyini dɔkdem mba jigi a taam mba jigi ya, Izirali denɔ meena a ta wa buuni po tɛŋka nitalimu ate wa kokpieŋsaŋa a soa la kama. 8Lie meena waai ale ta tɛŋ a nyini Izirali buuni po ase nitalim la, ku a fɛ ate wa yali nuru a nyini wa kowa buuni po, ate dila ale basi ate Izirali denɔ meena a tuesi wa koma nitalimu. 9Ni kan ta a nyini dɔkdemma de a ga dɔkdemma de, Izirali dɔk denɔ waai meena a ta tɛŋ kaai ate wa tuesi la.>>
10Dila nyiŋla Zelofehad liema a yaa nye dii ate Naawen a weeni Moosis la. 11Zelofehad liema Mala ale Tirza ale Yogla ale Milka ale Nowa a yaa yali ba kowa suok bisa. 12Ba jam yali ka Manasa Josefi dɔkku po, ate ba nitalimu a wari ba kowa dɔkku po.
13Suitaŋa de ale Naawen a ta va Moosis zuk a te Izirali demma Moab tɛŋka peelim kpiemu a moata Jodan benni kauk kuui ale tuk Jeriko la.

Title: TEERIKA 1
Content:
1Wieŋa de ate Moosis a jam biisi a te Izirali demma meena ale jam bo gɔnni ale jam bo Jodan kori geŋsa la, ate di bo Araba ale moata Suf, Paran ale Tofel ale Laban suŋsuŋsaŋa po a moata Yazerot ale Dizahab la. 2Ku ale pai ka daa pi ale dinyi ase fi ale nyini Yoreb a va Seir guuku suiku a cheŋ Kades Barnea.
3A nyini diipo ate Izirali demma a basi Ejipiti la, bena pisinaansi wa po, chiisa pi ale kanyi wa piilimka danni, Moosis a yaa weeni Izirali demma meena dii ate Naawen a weeni wa a ta va chaab ale ba la. 4Wa le jam nak yik Amori demma naawa Siyon la ŋaaŋnyiŋ ate kude a nye. Siyon ale jam a nya Yesbon zuk. Edrei tɛŋka mɛ wa nak dɛ Basan naawa Og. Og a jam bo ka Astarot a nya si zuk.
5Jodan benni kori geŋka a moata Moab tɛŋka, Moosis a yaa ŋman weeni sinsaŋŋa wie a gum du ayen, 6Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la weeni ti kama Yoreb ayen. <<Ni bo guuku de zuk a beni kama. 7Ni basi dula jigini abe le cheŋ Amori demma tɛŋka ale bo guutaŋa zuk la, ni cheŋ nuru baai meena ale bo Araba la, ate si bo guutaŋa zuima ate si bo yeniŋ geŋka la ale yeseok geŋsa ale vaasaŋa noa a ta ga paari Keenan ale Lebanon tɛŋsaŋa ale Yufiretis beli kpienni. 8Nya, mi a te ni tɛŋka de kama. Cheŋ ka po a ga ta tɛŋka ate Naawen a pɛ ayen wa ale te ni kokpieŋsaŋa Abrayam ale Aizik ale Jekob ale ba ŋaaŋbisaŋa la.>>
9Dila po wa m jam weeni ayen, <<Ni ŋmasi dobra kama ate mi an baga a ji ni m dek m nyiini. 10Ni nya jinla danni Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a basi ate ni piisi kama a gum du ase chiŋmarisaŋa ale bo chiŋmaaŋa po la. 11Naawen dii ale ka ni kokpieŋsaŋa Wen la, a basi kama ate ni chim paari tusidi a gum du ale niak ni ase wa ale puulim diila. 12Alege mi ale nye ka sɛ tu ni wie ŋaai ale a daani ni ale wie ŋaai ale tua a te ni ale wie ŋaai ate ni ta chaab ŋa nyiŋla m dega? 13Ni lueri nuru baai ale ta yam ale zula a ta nyini ni buuri meena po ate m le basi ate ba a nya ni zuk.>>
14Ate ni tulisi mu ayen, <<Dii ate mi a yaali ayen ni nye la a nala kama.>>
15Dila nyiŋla ate mi yaa a pai ni buuraŋa po niŋdeerɔma, baai ale ta yam ale zula la, a yaa basi ate ba ta pagrim ni zuk ase baai ale a nya nuruba tusa ale kobsa ale pisinuba ale piisa ase kpaga la. 16Ate m yaa weeni ni boteerɔma dila po ayen: Ba wom ba suataŋa kaasuŋku abe ba bo buusa nalimnyiini, ase wanni bo, ka badek kobirinni po yaase ka ba ale nichamma. 17Kan lugi a bo mini waai ya; wom nyini bisa ale ŋankpagsa meena jigi. Kan chali nuru yɔgsum, ale buusa boka, ka Wen ale soa. Ta wa dii ale pagra a te fu la a jam, m le wom di. 18A nyini dila po m jam weeni fu dii meena ale magsi ayen fi nye la kama.
19Ase Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la ale weeni ti la, ti yaa nyini Yoreb a yaa jam tuaga Amori tɛŋka ate ka bo guutaŋa zuk la a ga va gɔi kpienni ale bie la ate ni nya la a ga paari Kades Barnea. 20Ate mi yaa weeni ni, <<Ni paari Amori tɛŋka ale bo guuku zuk la kama, kaai ate Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la a te ti la. 21Nya Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a te ni tɛŋka kama. Cheŋ a ga tuesi ka ase Naawen dii ale ka ti kokpieŋsaŋa Wen la ale weeni diila. Ni kan chali yɔgsummoa. Ni be kan jɔk nyiŋbiiri.>>
22Nama meena a jam mi jigi kama ayen, <<Ti tom nuruba ate ba dɛ niŋ a ga nya tɛŋka a te ti abe ba ŋman jam weeni ti ti ale ti va suik kuui ale tɛŋ sii ate tama ale paari la.>>
23Popola ŋala a nala kama a te mu, ate mi a lueri ni po nuruba pi ale baye, nuru yeŋ a ta nyini ni kobisaŋa po. 24Ba yaa basi dula alege cheŋ tɛŋ kaai ale bo guutaŋa zuk la, a yaa jam Eskol Viaka a nya ka po. 25Ba yaa jam ta tɛŋka tiisaŋa yona gela a ŋman jam weeni ti ayen, <<Tɛŋ kaai ate Naawen ti Wenni a te ti la a nala kama.>>
26Alege ni kan yaali ayen ni cheŋ; ni zɛri Naawen ni Wenni ale weeni ni diila kama. 27Ni bo ni viitaŋa po a ŋuuni kama ayen, <<Naawen a kisi ti kama, dila nyiŋla wa ta ti a nyini Ejipiti a pai te Amori demma ayen ba kaasi ti. 28Ka bɛ ate tama ale cheŋ? Ti suataŋa a nye ate ka ti sue a kaasi. Ba weeni ayen, <Nuruma a pagra kama ale wɔŋa a gaam tama ale ka diila; Tɛŋsaŋa a zuak kama ale pari wɔŋsa ate si paari chiŋmaaŋa. Ti poom maa nya Anak bisaŋa kama dula jigini.> >>
29Ate mi a weeni ayen, <<Ni kan chali ba yɔgsummoa. 30Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la, ale bo ni niŋ la ale kpaliŋ a te ni ase wa ale jam nye dii a te ni Ejipiti ate waai meena a nya la, diipo ate ni jam bo gɔnni po la. 31Dula ni jam nya Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la ale ta ni dii ase ko ale ta wa bisa diila kama a ta jam paari dela.>>
32Kude meena a te mi a nye la nama a diem ka siaka ale Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la. 33Wa ale dɛ ni niŋ yokku ase bolim la, ale ŋman chim chiŋmari danni po, a sak ni ale magsi ni va suik kuui la.
34Ase Naawen ale wom dii ate ni weeni la, wa sui yaa jam puuri ate wa pɛ ayen, 35<<Buuni de po nuru yeŋ mɛ la a kan nya tɛŋ naliŋka kaai ate m pɛ ayen m te ba koma la, 36ka Kaleb Jefunne biika nyiini. Wa ale nya ka ate mi ale pai tɛŋ kaai ate wa pai wa naŋ ka a tabi du la a te wa ale wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa, dii nyiŋla wa va Naawen kama ale wa suinum meena.>>
37Nama nyiŋ Naawen sui a puuri ale mi mɛ kama ale weeni ayen, <<Fi mɛ a kan jo ka po. 38Alege fi maarɔwa, Nun nidoabinni Josua, ale jo ka po. Bi te wa nyiŋbiiri, dii nyiŋ, la wala ale wa dɛ ba niŋ ate ba jo tɛŋka po. 39Ale bi fiisaŋa baai ate fi a weeni ayen ba ale cheŋ yontidi po la, ni bi sii baai ale kan diem seba nalim ale biem la, bala ale jo tɛŋka po. Mi ale m te ba ate ba ale soa ka. 40Alege fi, cheŋ gɔnni po, va suik kuui ale a cheŋ Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku la.>>
41Ate ni yaa tulisi ayen, <<Tama a tom kaasi Naawen kama. Ti ale cheŋ a ga kpaliŋ, ase Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la ale weeni ti diila.>> Dila nyiŋla waai meena pai wa kpaliŋ kɔlima a cheŋ tɛŋ kaai ale bo guutaŋa zuk la, a poli ayen guutaŋa zuk jueli kpaliŋka ka moali. 42Alege Naawen a weeni mi, ayen, <<Weeni ba, <Ni kan cheŋ a ga kpalimu, dii nyiŋla m kan yaali ayen, m bo ale ni. Ni dachaasaŋa ale nya pagrim ni zuk.> >>
43Dila nyiŋ m weeni kama, alege nama, an wom ya. Ni zɛri Naawen ale weeni diila kama ale nye tukpari a cheŋ tɛŋ kaai ale bo guuku zuk la. 44Ate Amori demma baai ale bo guutaŋa zuima la a yaa jam a tu chaab ale ni; Ba jam a vi ni kama ase sewuruk la ale nak ni a ta nyini Seir a ta ga paari Yorma. 45Ate ni ŋman jam a kum a te Naawen, alege wa a wom ni kumsaŋa ale nye ase wa kan wom la. 46Ate ni yaa jam bo Kades paari da boari, ni kasim jam bo ka dula.

Title: TEERIKA 2
Content:
1Ate ti yaa ŋmani ŋaaŋ a va gɔnni suiku ale a cheŋ Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku la, a va Naawen ale dak mu la. Ti kasim cheŋ gilim tɛŋ kaai le bo guutaŋa zuk ti ba a wi ayen Seir la kama.
2Ate Naawen yaa weeni mi ayen, 3<<Ni cheŋ gilim tɛŋ kaai ale bo guutaŋa zuk la ate ku beni ka yega, yɔgyɔgla de ni ŋman va wiiluk geŋ. 4Te nuruma wieŋa de, <Ni boro a yaali ni va ka ni suataŋa Iisɔ ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale bo Seir la tɛŋ banni. Ba le chali yɔgsum ale ni, alege ni kpesi nidek. 5Ni kan daani ba ale kpaliŋ ŋa, mi a kan pai ba tɛŋka kanyi mɛ la a te ni, ni poom kan pai ni naŋ a tabi du. Mi pai guuku zuk tɛŋka Seir a te ka Iisɔ ayen wa tanla. 6Ku magsi kama ayen ni tuni ba kpana a magsi ŋandiintaŋa ate ni dɛ la ale nyiamu ate ni nyu la.> >>
7Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a niak ni kama ni nisima tuima meena po. Wa nya ni chelimu zuk kama gɔi kpienni po. Bena pisinaansi wa de Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a kasim bo ale ni kama ate ni an jam a yaali jaaboa.
8Ti yaa jam gaam ti suataŋa Iisɔ buuni, baai ale bo Seir tɛŋka la a taamu. Tama viriŋ kama a va Araba suiku, kuui ale nyini Elat ale Ezion Geber a ga va Moab gɔnni po la.
9Ate Naawen a yaa weeni a sak mi ayen, <<Kan fi daani Moab demma yaase fi nye ate ba nye kpaliŋŋa, ale mi a kan yaali ayen m te ni ba tɛŋka kauk wa. M te Lɔti buuni ka Ar tɛŋka ayen ba tanla.>>
10Emi demma a jam bo ka dula, ba jam ka nuru baai ale pagra ale piisi mɛ ale wɔŋa ase Anak demma la. 11Ase ba ale jam a nye ase Anak demma la, ba jam pai ba chim ka Arefa demma po, alege Moab demma a jam a wi ba ayen ka Emi dem. 12Yori demma ale jam bo Seir tɛŋka, alege Iisɔ buuni a jam yiak ba kama ate ba basi dula. Ba jam kaasi Yori demma kama alege kali dula ase Izirali demma ale nye dii tɛŋ kaai po ate Naawen a pai te ba la.
13Ate Naawen a yaa weeni ayen, <<Yɔgyɔgla de ni yiti ga lo Zered Viaka jueli.>> Ate ti yaa lo viak a jueli.
14Bena pisita ale naaniŋ ale taam la, a zaani diipo ate ti basi Kades Barnea a jam paari diipo ate ti lo Zered Viaka jueli la, dila po gaŋ sii meena ale jam ka tugurik tɔŋdɔba la a kpi kama ase Naawen ale pɛ ayen wa le nye diila. 15Naawen a jam ta ka chaab ale ba ate wa ga yeeri ba meena ba suŋsuŋ.
16Ase tugurik tɔŋdɔma de ale jam kpi la, 17Naawen a yaa weeni mi ayen, 18<<Jinla ku magsi kama ayen ni ga va Moab ale bo Ar po la a taam. 19Ase ni dan paari Ammon demma tɛŋka, ni ka m daani ba yaase ni daani ba ale kpaliŋ ŋa, ale mi a kan yaali ayen m pai Ammon tɛŋka jaab a te ni. Mi pai ka a te ka Lɔti ŋaaŋbisaŋa.>>
20Ba jam a wi dula jigini ayen ka Arefa demma tɛŋ, ba la ale jam bo dula, alege Ammon demma a jam a wi ba ayen ka Zamzum dem. 21Ba jam ka nuru baai ale pagra ale piisi mɛ ale wɔŋa ase Anak demma la. Naawen a jam ko ba kama ate Ammon demma, baai ale jam yiak ba a bo ba boka jigini. 22Wa a nye ka dila dek mɛ ate Iisɔ ŋaaŋbisaŋa baai ale bo Seir tɛŋka po la ase wa ale jam kaasi Yor demma ba nimbie po diila. Ba jam yiak ba kama alege bo ba tɛŋka po a ta jam paari jinla. 23Alege Avvi demma baai ale bo tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa po a ga paari Gaza tɛŋka la, Kaftor demma a jam nyini ka Kaftor a kaasi ba alege bo ba boka jigini.
24Naawen a yaa weeni mi ayen, <<Ni cheŋ a ga lo Arnon benni a jueli. Nya de m pai Siyon Amori denɔwa Yesbon Naawa ale, wa tɛŋka meena a nyo ka ni nisima po. Ni nye ate ni jo ka po a nye kpaliŋ ale wa. 25Jinla danni m le basi ate tɛŋsa meena ale bo tɛŋzuk a chali ni yɔgsum. Ba ale wom le wie ate ba nyiŋsaŋa a gɔk ate ba ale yɔgsa ale ni.>>
26A nyini Kedemot gɔnni po m jam tom ka nuruba Yesbon Naawa Siyon jigi ale suiyɔgni ayen, 27<<Basi ate ti va ni tɛŋka po a taam. Ti ale ga zaani ka suik kpioŋku po. Ti kan viriŋ juga yaase gala. 28Ni pai ŋandiinta a da a te ti ate ti dɛ abe ni pai nyiam mɛ a te ti ate ti nyu abe ti tuni ni kpana. Ka ni tin basi ate ti cheŋ naŋta a taam. 29Ase Iisɔ ŋaaŋbisaŋa baai ale bo Seir la ale Moab demma baai ale bo Ar, ale jam nye dii a te ti suik ayen ti ga lo Jodan a jueli a cheŋ tɛŋ kaai ate Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la a yaali ayen wa pai a te ti la.>> 30Alege Siyon Yesbon Naawa a zɛri an basi ate tama a taam ya. Dii nyiŋla la Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la basi kama ate wa ta tukpari ale suinum pagrik ayen wa pai wa a nyo ni nisima po, ase wa ale nye dii yɔgyɔgla de la.
31Naawen a yaa weeni mi ayen, <<Nya, mi a yaali ayen m pai Siyon ale wa tɛŋka a nyo ka ni nisa po. Yɔgyɔgla de m nak a tuesi ka a tara.>>
32Ase Siyon ale wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma meena ale jam nyini ayen ba nye kpaliŋka Jayaz la, 33Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la a pai wa nyo ka ti nisima po ate ti nak lɔnsi wa ale wa bisaŋa ale wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma meena tɛŋ. 34A nyini dila po ti tuesi ba tɛŋsaŋa kama ale ko nidoama ale nipooma ale ba bisaŋa meena. Ti an jam tali javuk wa. 35Alege ba duŋsaŋa ale ba ŋanmaŋsaŋa ti jam pai kama ba tɛŋka po a tara. 36A nyini Aroer ale bo Arnon benni la ale tɛŋ kaai ale bo benni jigini la a ta ga paari Gilead, tɛŋ yeŋ mɛ la a jam karo a pagra. Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la a pai ba meena a te ti kama. 37Alege a magsi chaab ale Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la sinsaŋŋa, ni an gaam a taam Ammon demma tɛŋka, yaase tɛŋ kaai ale bo Jabbok benni la yaase tɛŋ sii ale bo guutaŋa zuima la.

Title: TEERIKA 3
Content:
1Ti ŋman a viriŋ a jueli va Basan suiku ate Basan naawa Og ale wa tugurik tommu meena a yaa nyini a tu chaab ale ti ayen ti nye kpaliŋ Edrei. 2Ate Naawen a weeni mi ayen, <<Kan chali wa yɔgsummoa ale mi a pai wa ale wa tugurik tommu meena ale wa tɛŋka a nyo fi nisa po kama. Nye wa ase fi ale nye Siyon Amori demma naawa diila waai ale jam a nya Yesbon la.>>
3Ate Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la a pai Basan Naawa Og ale wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma meena a nyo ti nisima po. Ate ti ko ba meena nuru vuk mɛ la an tali ya. 4Dila po wa, ti jam tuesi wa tɛŋsaŋa meena kama. Tɛŋsa pisiyuebi wa po kanyi mɛ la karo ate tama an tuesi ya a ta nyini ba jigi ya. Argob tɛŋka meena ale Og tɛŋ kpieŋka ale bo Basan la. 5Tɛŋsaŋa de meena ba jam se si parisaŋa ate si pagra kama ale wɔŋa ale nye nansuiŋta ale da biga alege tɛŋsa gela a jam piisi kama ate parisa an gilim si. 6Ti jam kaasi ba kama ase ti ale jam nye Yesbon Naawa Siyon diila ale kaasi tɛŋ meena nidoaba, nipooba ale bisa diila. 7Alege ba duŋsa meena ale ba ŋanmaŋsaŋa ale bo ba tɛŋsaŋa po la tama a jam pai ba kama a tara.
8A zaani dila po ti yaa tuesi Jodan kori geŋsaŋa ale Arnon Buboalika geŋsaŋa a ta ga paari Yermon Guuku nalima ŋaye wa dɛ jigi. 9Saidon demma a jam a wi Yermon Guuku ayen ka Sirion alege ate Amori demma a wi ku ayen Senir. 10Ti yaa jam tuesi tɛŋsaŋa meena a ta ga paari Gilead ale Basan a ta va dula ga paari Saleka ale Edrei tɛŋsaŋa ale tɛŋ kpieŋka Basan ate Og a bo du la. 11Ka Og Basan Naawa ale jam tali Arefa buuni po. Wa gaduokku a jam ka kutuk ale jam woŋŋa ase naŋtuok nɔi pi ale buta la alege ku labsimu mɛ a nye ase naŋtuok nɔi buyuebi la. Ku diem bo ka Arabba Ammon demma tɛŋka.
12Tɛŋka ate ti jam tuesi dila po la, m pai ka Aroer wiiluk geŋka kauk ale maŋ Arnon benni la, ale Gilead tɛŋka ale bo guutaŋa zuk la geli ale ka tɛŋsaŋa a te Aruben ale Gad ŋaaŋbisaŋa. 13Gilead tɛŋka meena ale Basan, Og ale jam bo juijui la meena, mi a jam pai a te ka Manasa dɔkku geli. Ale Argob ate ka bo Basan po la ate ba jam a wi ka ayen Arefa demma tɛŋ la. 14Jair Manasa ŋaaŋbiik ale la, wa ale jam soa Argob tɛŋka meena a ta ga va Gesur ale Maaka demma tɛŋsaŋa, Ba ale jam a wi wa diila tɛŋka mɛ yuei a jam ale la. Dila ale soa ate ba diem a wi ka ayen Yavvot Jair la.
15Ate mi yaa pai Gilead a te Makir. 16Alege Aruben ale Gad ŋaaŋbisaŋa m pai ka Gilead ale Arnon Benni geŋsaŋa ate ba gum chaab ale Jabbok Benaŋka geŋsa kauk kuui ale moata Ammon demma la. 17Ka yeniŋ geŋsaŋa Jodan ale bo Araba la, a ta ga Kinneret ga va nyakpiemu ale bo Araba, Yesa Nyakpiem ale la, a churinti a siŋ Pisga.
18M weeni ni kama dila po ayen, <<Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a pai tɛŋka de a te ni kama ayen ni tanla. Alege ni nuru pagrisaŋa baai ale gomsi magsi kpaliŋka la a gaam taam ni suataŋa Izirali demma jigi. 19Alege, nipooma ale ni bisaŋa ale ni duŋsaŋa, m seba kama ni duŋsaŋa a piisi kama, ale wari ka tɛŋ sii ate m te ni la po, 20ate ku ga paari diipo ate Naawen ale te ni suataŋa vuusum ase wa ale te nama mɛ diila, ase Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la ale weeni ayen wa ale te ba Jodan Benni kunkɔŋni din dila la. Ate kula ŋaaŋnyiŋ ni wanyi wanyi ale ŋman cheŋ kauk kuui ate m te ni la.>>
21Dila po mi weeni Josua kama ayen, <<Fi nya kama ale fidek nina dii meena ate Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a nye nalimaŋa ŋayewa la. Naawen ale nye tɛŋ sii meena ate ni a cheŋ la ka dila dekdega. 22Kan chali ba yɔgsummoa. Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la dek ale kpaliŋ a te fu.>>
23A zaani dila po m saalim Naawen kama ayen, 24<<Nyɔnɔwa waai ale ka Naawen la, fi piilim boro a sak fi tomteerɔwa fi zuaka ale fi pagrimu ale ka diila kama. A nyini wenŋmazuk ale tɛŋzuk de wen a karo a tom wakpiema ŋaai ate fi a tom la? 25Basi ate m cheŋ a ga nya tɛŋ maŋka ale gaam Jodan a taam la, kaai ale bo guuta zuk la ale Lebanon tɛŋka.>>
26Alege nama nyiŋ Naawen sui a jam puuri ale mu kama ate wa an wom m puusaŋa. <<Ku magsi ya.>> Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna, <<Kan ŋman biisi wanni de wie ale mu. 27Jueli Pisga guuku zuk a nya yeniŋ geŋ ale yeseoku geŋ ale wiiluk geŋ ale kori geŋsaŋa. Nya tɛŋka ale fidek nimbie dii nyiŋla fi a kan yaali fi gaam Jodan benni a taamu. 28Alege sak Josua abe fi maari a te wa nyiŋbiiri ate wa ale dɛ nuruma dɛ niŋ a ta ba gaam a taam a tuesi tɛŋ kaai ate fi a nya la.>> 29Ate tama a yaa jam bo viaka po a moata Bet Peor.

Title: TEERIKA 4
Content:
1Ni wom de, Izirali demma, sinsaŋŋa ate m boro a yaali ayen m sak ni la ale wie ŋaai ate ni a va la. Ni va ŋa ate ni vua ate ni jo tɛŋka po a tuesi ka, kaai ate Naawen dii ale ka ni kokpieŋsaŋa Wen la ale te ni la. 2Ni kan yaali wari a gum dii ate mi a weeni la po abe ni kan yeeri wari dii ate mi a weeni ni la po mɛ a basi alege ni tanla Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la sinsaŋŋa ate mi a te ni la.
3Ni nya kama ale nidek nina dii ate Naawen a nye Baal Peor la kama. Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a jam ko waai meena ale va Peor bɔglukku Baal la, 4Alege nama baai meena ale chiib va Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a diem vua kama jinla.
5Nya de m jam a sak ni wie ale sinsaga ase Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la ale weeni mu diila, ayen tɛŋ kaai po ate nama a jo ni tuesi la ni va ŋa. 6Ni kpesi a va ŋa nalimnyiini, ale ka dila ale ku sak ni yam ale miŋ chakka tɛŋsaŋa de jigi, waai meena ale wa wom wieŋa de meena la a yaa le weeni ayen, <<Wensie tɛŋ kpieŋka de ka yam ale miŋ chakka nuruba nyiini.>> 7Ka tɛŋ boa ale zuak a ta ka wena ate ŋa moata ba ase Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la ale moata ti diipo meena ate tama a puusi a te wa? 8Ka tɛŋ kana ale zuak a ta ŋmarisika ale buusa ase sinsaŋŋa de meena ate mi a pai a te ni jinla nna la?
9Ni kpesi yik nidek, a moata chaab ate ni kan baŋ dii ate ni nya ale ni ninaŋa la yaase ni basi ate ŋa sati a nyini ni suiniimaŋa po a nyini ase ni le diem vua la. Ni pai ŋa a sak ni bisaŋa ale ni ŋaaŋsaŋa mɛ. 10Ni teeri dai dii danni ate ni jam zaani Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la niŋ Yoreb guuku zuk la diipo ate wa weeni mi ayen, <<Tigsi nuruma m niŋ ate ba wom m wieŋa ate ba zamsi ate ba va mi diipo meena ate ba vua a bo tɛŋka po la, abe ba pai ŋa a sak ba bisaŋa.>> 11Ni jam torisi moata kama ale za guuku zuk alege ate ku jam a nyaksi ase bolim la a jueli wenŋmazuk ale chiŋma sobta ate ku jam nye legi, 12Ate Naawen a yaa jam biisi bolimu po ale ni. Ni wom ka wieŋa nuemka alege ni an jam nya jaaboa ku jam ka lueluk nyiini. 13Wa yaa weeni ni wa nɔiyeŋka, Wie Piika ŋaai ate wa weeni ni ayen ni va ŋa abe ni ŋmarisiŋa a dueni tintain paglaksa siye zuk. 14Ate Naawen a yaa weeni mi dipo ayen m sak ni wa wieŋa ale sinsaŋŋa ate ni va ŋa tɛŋ kaai ate ni a yaali ni gaam Jodan benni a taam soaka la.
15Ni an jam nya wari ya da dii danni ate Naawen a biisi ale ni bolimu po Yoreb guuku zuk la. Dila nyiŋla ni be kpesi nidek nalimnyiini, 16dii ale ku nye ate ni kan taŋ nidek ale bɔgta, yaali ŋan mɛɛnta, baai ale a nye ase nidoa yaase nipok la. 17Yaase duŋ tɛŋka po yaase nuim ale a yiri wenzuk la, 18yaase ŋanta baai ale a cheŋ tɛŋka zuk la yaase ŋan baai ale bo nyaataŋa po la. 19Ase ni dan zak nya chiŋmaaŋa po a nya wenbinni ale chiika ale chiŋmarisaŋa ale wenŋmazuk ŋantaŋa meena ni kan koori tɛŋ a zuli ŋan baai ate Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a pai te tɛŋ meena tɛŋzuk de la. 20Alege nama, Naawen a jam yeeri ni kama a ta ni nyini Ejipiti bolimu po a nyini ayen ni chim nuru baai ale ba soa wa ŋantaŋa la ase ni yaa le ka dii yɔgyɔgla de la.
21Naawen sui ale jam puuri ale mu nama nyiŋ, ate wa yaa pɛ ayen m kan gaam Jodan benni a jo wenŋmazuk kuui ate Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a yaali wa te ni ate ni ta la. 22M le kpi kama tɛŋka de po; m kan gaam Jodan benni a taamu, alege nama boro a yaali ni gaam kama abe le tuesi tɛŋ naliŋka. 23Ni be kpesi nidek ate ni kan baŋ Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la ale nye nɔiyeŋ kaai ale ni la; ni kan nye bɔgta a te ni dega a ta va dii ate Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a kisi la. 24Ale Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a nye ase ka bolim buui ale dɛ la, wa ka Naawen dii ale a dɛ nyuri.
25Ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ ni yaa dan ta bisa ale ŋaaŋsa a bo tɛŋka po ate ku beni ate ni yaa taŋ nidek a basi a yaa se bɔgta, a nye biem Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la nimbie po a nye ate wa sui a puuri, 26mi ale wi ka wenŋmazuk ale tɛŋ ate ba chim m seerɔba a ta va ni jigi ate daaŋa de po ate nama ale kpi nwuli tɛŋ kaai po ate nama a yaali ni gaam Jodan benni a taam a ta la. Ni kan bo dula a beni ni ale kpi kama. 27Naawen ale kati ni a waaŋ kama nuruma po, ka ni maga ale ni vuuk a bo tɛŋ sii ate Naawen a ta ni a cheŋ la. 28Dula jigini ni yaa ale kaab bɔgluk tii ate nuruba a pai nisa a nye ale daata ale tintana la, tii ale kaa nya yaase ti a wom yaase ti a dɛ yaase ti a wom nyum la. 29Alege a nyini dula ni gisi Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la, ni ale nya wa ase ni ale a gisi wa ale ni suinum ale ni chiik meena. 30Ase ni dan bo watuasa po ate wieŋa de meena a nye ni ku kan beni ale ni ale tulim Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la jigi a wom wa. 31Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la ka jiirim Wen. Wa kan zɛri ni yaase wa kaasi ni yaa wa baŋ nɔiyeŋka ate wa nye ale ni kokpieŋsaŋa kaai la.
32Yɔgyɔgla de ni bek da ŋaai ale taam alege ate nama daaŋa a paari la wie. A nyini diipo ate Wen a nye nuru tɛŋka zuk la, ni bek jigi meena ase wa kpienni de choa a nye yaase wanni de choa ba wom di? 33Nuru yonta a wom Wen lueluk ale ku a biisi bolim po ale boro ase nama ale wom diila? 34Bɔgluk kuui a diem baga a tuesi tɛŋ a tara a ta va nyenyaka yaase wakperikaliisa yaase wakinkagla yaase zuaka ale nyeka ase wie ŋaai meena ate Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a nye ni nimbie po a te ni diipo ate ni jam bo Ejipiti po la?
35Ni jam nya wieŋa de kama ate ku basi ate ni seba ayen Naawen ka Wen; kan daa wala waai a ŋman karo. 36A nyini wenŋmazuk wa basi ate ni wom wa lueluku ayen wa namsi ni. Tɛŋzuk de sak ni wa bolim kpiemu ale ka diila kama, ate ni wom wa wieŋa bolimu po. 37Wa ale jam a yaali ni kokpieŋsaŋa ale lueri ba ŋaaŋbisaŋa la nyiŋ ate wa yaa ta ni a nyini Ejipiti po nyini ale wa pagrim kpiemu, 38ale yiak tɛŋ sii ale pagra a gaam ni la ate si nyini ale ta ni a jam ba tɛŋsaŋa po ayen ni tanla se ku ale ka dii jinla de la.
39Ni be seba, abe le basi ate ku bo ni suiniima po jinla danni ayen, Naawen ka Wen wenŋmazuk po ale tɛŋzuk de mɛ. Waai a ŋman karo. 40Ni be ta wa wieŋa ale wa sinsaŋŋa, ŋaai ate mi a te ni jinla de la, ate ku ale cheŋ nalimnyiini ale nama ale ni bisaŋa ate ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ ate ni ale goa tɛŋ kaai ate Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a pai a te ni la po a beni.
41Ate Moosis a yaa lueri tɛŋsa sita Jodan benni kori geŋsa. 42Kauk kuui ate waai a dan ko nuru abe wa chali a cheŋ ase wa dan kan ta waai ale wa a potim seba ale ko wa. Wa baga a chali a cheŋ tɛŋsaŋa de kanyi kama a vari wa nyuvunni a basi. 43Tɛŋ sila abe le nna: Bezer, Aruben dɔkku ale soa dula, Aramat ate ka bo Gilead la ate Gad demma soa la ale Golan ale bo Basan po la Manasa dɔkku mɛ ale soa dula.
44Sinsaŋŋa ale nna ate Moosis a weeni Izirali demma la. 45Sinsaŋŋa de ate Moosis a jam te ba diipo ate ba nyini Ejipiti po a nyini la 46ale diipo ate ba jam bo Bet Peor viaka po Jodan kori geŋka la, tɛŋ kaai ate ba a wi ayen Amori la, ate Siyon a jam chim ka naab la waai ale jam a nya Yesbon ate Moosis ale Izirali demma nak yik ba diipo ate ba jam nyini Ejipiti po a nyini la. 47Ba jam tuesi wa tɛŋka kama ale Basan Naawa Og tɛŋka, nalima ŋayewa ale jam bo Amori tɛŋsaŋa ale bo Jodan benni kori geŋsa la. 48Tɛŋka de a jam zaani ka Aroer a ga nye ban ale Arnon Buboalika a ta ga va Sirion guuku (Yermon ale la), 49a ga pai Araba ale bo Jodan benni kori geŋsa la meena a gum du a ta ga paari nyakpiemu ale bo Araba la a ta jueli tuak Pisga.

Title: TEERIKA 5
Content:
1Moosis a tigsi Izirali demma meena a weeni ba ayen. Izirali demma, ni wom sinsaŋŋa ale wieŋa ate mi a weeni jinla de la. Ni zamsi ŋa abe ni seba a chak ayen ni va ŋa kama. 2Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la a jam nye ka nɔiyeŋ ale ti Yoreb guuku. 3Ku be daa ti koma ate Naawen a jam nye nɔiyeŋka ale ba alege ka tama, baai meena ale vua a bo dela jinla de la. 4Naawen a jam biisi bolimu po ale ni ka nidek nimbie po guuku zuk. 5Diipo ate mi a jam zaani Naawen ale nama suŋsuŋ a pai wa wanni a te ni la dii nyiŋla ni jam yɔgsa kama ale bolimu ate ni an jueli guuku zuwa. Ate wa yaa weeni ayen. 6<<Mi ale Naawen dii ale ka fi Wen la, waai ale ta fu nyini Ejipiti a nyini yɔntidi tɛŋka po a nyini la. 7<<Kan ta wen yona a gum mi po. 8<<Kan nye bɔgluk ate ku a neesi jaab wenŋmazuk yaase tɛŋzuk yaase nyiam po a te fi dega. 9<<Kan koori tɛŋ a zuli ba yaase fi puusi ba, diila mi Naawen dii ale ka fi Wen la, ka nyuri Wen, a namsi bimbaansa ba koba biem nyiŋ a ta ga paari ba gaŋ sii ale a saari buta ale bunaansi la baai ale kisi mi la. 10Alege a sak ŋmanteka ale gaŋ sii ale saari tusidi a yaali mi ale ŋman ta m wieŋa la. 11<<Kan wi Naawen dii ale ka fi Wen la yuenni kinla, diila Naawen a kan basi waai ale a wi Wa yuenni kinla la. 12Kpesi Vuusum Danni abe fi basi ate di ta tuilum, ase Naawen dii ale ka fi Wen la ale weeni diila. 13Daa ŋayuebi fi pai tom fi tuimaŋa meena, 14alege daa ŋayopɔiwa danni ka Vuusum dai a te Naawen dii ale ka fi Wen la. Dai dila danni kan tom tuin yoŋŋoa. Fi dek kan tom yaase fi nidoabili yaase fi lie yaase tomteerɔ yaase dɔklie yaase fi lalik yaase boniŋ yaase fi duŋsaŋa kaai yaase nichaanɔ ale bo ale fi la. Dila ale ku basi ate fi tomteerɔwa ale dɔkliewa a vuusi ase fi la. 15Fi abe a teeri ayen fi jam ka yɔma a bo Ejipiti po ate Naawen dii ale ka fi Wen la a ta fi nyini ale wa nisima pagrim. Dila nyiŋla Naawen dii ale ka fi Wen la a weeni kama ayen fi a kpesi Vuusum Danni. 16<<A zuli fi ko ale fi ma ase Naawen dii ale ka fi Wen la ale weeni fi diila, ate fi goa a benni ate wari meena ale nye nalimnyiini a te fu tɛŋ kaai ate Naawen dii ale ka fi Wen la a te fu la. 17Kan ko nuru. 18Kan nye kaboŋŋa. 19Kan zu. 20Kan chim venta seerɔ a velim te fi vaanchoa. 21Kan ta kɔrisa ale fi vaanchoa powa, be kan ta kɔrisa ale fi vaanchoa yeri ya, yaase wa tɛŋŋa yaase wa tomteerɔ yaase wa dɔklie yaase wa lalik yaase wa boniŋa yaase jaabuuri meena ate fi vaanchoa a ta la.
22Sinsaŋŋa de ate Naawen weeni ale lueluk kpioŋ a nyini bolimu po ate tigsuŋku meena ale jam bo guuku zuk la a nyini chiŋmaaŋa ale legini po ale an ŋman gum wari du. Ate wa yaa ŋmarisi ŋa a dueni tintain paglaksa siye zuk a te mu.
23Ase nama ale ga wom lueluku legini po la, alege ate guuku zuk a dɛ ale bolim la, ni buuni po niŋdeerɔma meena a jam jam ka mi jigi. 24Ate ni yaa weeni ayen, <<Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la a sak ti wa zulaŋa ale wa pagrimu kama ate tama me a wom wa lueluk bolimu po. Jinla ti nya kama ayen nuru a baga a boro kama ase Wen a nin poom a biisi ale wa. 25Alege yɔgyɔgla de, ka boa ale soa ate tama a kpi? Bolim kpiemu dɛ ale dɛ ti, ate ti kpi ase tama ale a wom Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la lueluku ŋmana. 26Ka nuru wana ale diem wom Wen dii ale vua la lueluk ale ku a biisi bolim po ase tama la ale vua? 27Forisi moata ate fi wom dii meena ate Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la a weeni la. Ate fi a yaa le weeni ti dii ate Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la a weeni fu la. Tama ale wom abe ti va ŋa.>>
28Naawen a wom kama diipo ate nama a biisi ale mu la ate Naawen a yaa weeni mu ayen, <<M wom dii ate nuruma de a weeni fu la kama. Dii meena ate ba weeni la a nala kama. 29Mi dek a yaali kama ayen ba le chali mu yɔgsum ale ba suiniima meena abe ba ta m sinsaŋŋa diipo meena ate ku ale cheŋ nalimnyiini a te ba ale ba bisaŋa taam wuu!
30<<Cheŋ a ga weeni ba ate ba pilim a ŋman cheŋ ba viitaŋa po. 31Alege fi bo dela ale mi ate mi ale te fu wieŋa ale sinsaŋŋa meena ate fi ale sak ba ate ba ale va ŋa tɛŋ kaai po ate mi ale te ba la.>>
32Dila nyiŋla ni kpesi nidek ate ni nye dii ate Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a weeni ni la; ni kan viriŋ gala yaase juga. 33Cheŋ kauk kuui meena ate Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a weeni ni la, dii ale ku nye ate ni boro ale niaka ate nama a goa tɛŋ kaai ate nama ni tuesi la po a beni.

Title: TEERIKA 6
Content:
1Sinsaŋŋa ale wieŋa de ate Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a weeni ayen mi a sak ni ate ni kpesi a va ŋa tɛŋ kaai po ate ni za ni gaam Jodan benni a taam ka po la; 2dila ale ku basi ate nama ale ni bisaŋa ale ni ŋaaŋsaŋa a chali Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la yɔgsum diipo meena ate ni vua ale ta wa ŋmarisika ale wa wieŋa meena ate mi a te ni la ate ni goa tɛŋka zuk a beni. 3Ni wom de Izirali demma, abe ni kpesi nidek ate ni wom dii ale ku nye ate wari meena a cheŋ nalimnyiini ate ni piisi tɛŋ kaai po ate biisim ale siita a boro la, ase Naawen ni kokpieŋsaŋa Wenni ale jam puulim ale ni la.
4Ni wom de Izirali demma: Naawen ka ti Wen. Naawen ka dinyi. 5Yaali Naawen dii ale ka fi Wen la ale fi suinum meena ale fi chiik meena ale fi pagrim meena. 6Sinsaŋŋa de ate mi a te ni jinla de la a magsi ŋa bo ka ni suiniimaŋa po. 7Ni pai ŋa a te ni bisaŋa. Ni a biisi ŋa wie ase ni ale bo yeri yaase nama a nin bo suitaŋa po a cheŋ yaase ni doa yaase ni yiti. 8Ni bobi ŋa ni nisimaŋa nyiŋ ase daana la abe ni pai ŋa a mag ni deeŋa nyiŋ. 9Ni ŋmarisiŋa a dueni ni tuataŋa nyiŋ ale ni nansuiŋtaŋa nyiŋ.
10Ase Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la ale ta ni a jam tɛŋka po la wa pɛ kama ale ni kokpieŋsaŋa Abrayam ale Aizik ale Jekob ayen wa te ni tɛŋ kaai ale zuak ate daa nama ale se ya, 11Yie ŋaai ate ŋanmaŋsa meena a sueri ŋa ale daa nama ale pai ba a nyoro, vili ŋaai ate mama an tu ŋa, tali tii ate nama an bori jaab ti po ate nama a yaa dan dɛ a chak, 12Ni be kpesi nidek ate ni kan baŋ Naawen, waai ale ta ni a nyini Ejipiti yontini tɛŋka po a nyini la wari ya.
13Chali Naawen dii ale ka fi Wen la nyiini, puusi te wala nyiini abe fi nye ni pɛka wa yuenni nyiŋ. 14Kan va wen yona, nuru baai ale bo ale ni la wenaŋa, 15ale Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la, waai ale bo ale ni la, ka nyuri dɛka Wen ate ni dan va wen yona wa sui ale puuri ale ni ate wa le kaasi ni tɛŋka de po. 16Be kan nye Naawen ni Wenni a nya ase ni ale jam a nye dii Massaya la. 17Ni be seba ate ni ta sinsaŋŋa abe ni a teeri wie ŋaai ate Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a te ni la. 18Ni nye dii ale magsi ale nala mɛ la ate Naawen a basi ate wari meena cheŋ nalimnyiini a te ni ate ni cheŋ a ga tuesi tɛŋ maŋ kaai ate Naawen a puulim ale pɛ ale ni kokpieŋsaŋa la, 19ale yiak ni dachaasaŋa meena, ase Naawen ale weeni ni la?>>
