Kɔm ale nyanyuila ale kasim ta ni, ni le nya jaŋsa nna yegayega ale chaboala mɛ. Ba le namsi ni ka nna yegayega a ta ga paari diipo ate wa le kaasi ni la.
49Naawen ale basi ate tɛŋ a nyini niŋniŋa a jam nye kpaliŋ ale ni, ba le nye ka nna nwuli ase jiiruk la ni kan miŋ tɛŋ kala biika mɛ, 50tɛŋ kaai ate ni dan nya ka nuruma abe yɔgsum a yik ni la, ba kan zuli ŋankpagsaŋa yaase ba ta jiirim ale bi paalukku. 51Ba le ŋɔbi ni duŋsaŋa abe ba dɛ ni ŋandiintaŋa meena ate ni viiri a kpi. Ba kan tali zaa yaase damasik yaase kpaam yaase niiga ale piisa a te ni ate dila ale basi ate ni kpi. 52Ba le nye kpaliŋ ale tɛŋ sii meena ale bo ni tɛŋka po la a ta ga paari diipo ate parik kaai ate ni ta sebchakka la a lo tɛŋ. Ba le tuesi tɛŋka meena ate Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a yaa wa pai te ni la.
53Ninammu ate ni dachaasaŋa a basi ate ni a namu la nyiŋ kɔm ale yik ni ate nama ale yik ni bisaŋa ate Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a te ni la a ŋɔbi. 54Waai ale a yik wadek ale ta yam a bo ni po la a kan poom ta jiirim ale wadek suok yaase wa pok waai ate wa a yaali nna yegayega la yaase wa bisaŋa, 55wa poom kan nye bisaŋa lammu ate wa bi sii ale diem tali a boro la kude meena ale nye kama dii nyiŋla ni dachaasaŋa ale basi ate ninammu de a jam ni jigi. 56Nipok waai ale a zuli wadek ale ta yam ni po la ale kan yaali wa poom pai naŋtuok a tabi tɛŋ la ale cheem ta chaab ale wa chorɔ waai ate wa a yaali la, ale bisaŋa ale wa liema. 57Wa le a biak waai ŋaaŋnyiŋ la ale zanni wa le suk a ŋɔbi dii nyiŋla, wa le kan ta jaab a dɛ la, ale ninam buui ate ni dachaasaŋa ale ta jam ni jigi ni tɛŋsaŋa po la.
58Ni dan kan kpesi a va sinsaŋŋa wieŋa meena, ŋaai ale ŋmarisi gbaŋka de po la, ale zɛri a kan zuli Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la yuenni, 59Naawen ale basi ate kpazinagsuk wie a jam nama ale ŋaaŋbisaŋa zuk. Wa le basi ate kaasuŋ ale nyiŋtui pagrisa a jam ni jigi ate ku beni. 60Wa le basi ate nyiŋtuila ŋaai ale jam yik ni Ejipiti tɛŋka po la a jam ni jigi. Ŋa le bo ni jigi ka dila taam wuu. 61Naawen ale basi ate nyiŋtuila ale tueta tɔgatɔga a yik ni, ŋaai ale kan maa ŋmarisi a bo sinsaŋŋa gbaŋka de po la a ta ga paari diipo ate ni le kpi la. 62Nama baai ale piisi ase chiŋmarisaŋa ale bo chiŋmaaŋa po la ni magadega ale tali dii nyiŋla ni ale zɛri an va Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la yaalika la nyiŋ. 63Ase ku le yɔk Naawen sui ate wa niak ni ale basi ate ni piisi a gum du la, ku le yɔk wa suinni ka dila dekdega ase wa nin kaasi ni. Ba le voori ni kama a ta nyini tɛŋ kaai po ate ni a jo ni tuesi la po.
64Ate Naawen ale basi ate ni waaŋ a bo tɛŋsaŋa meena po a nyini tɛŋka kpeglimka a ta ga paari kauk kunkula. Dula jigini ni yaa le kaab bɔgluk yonta, tii ate ba pai daata ale tana a nye ti la. Tii ate nama yaa ni koma a zɛ ti wie la. 65Tɛŋ sila po ni kan nya suiyɔgni, ni be kan ta jigi a vuusi. Naawen le basi ate ku a daani ni abe ni jɔk yiila ate ni sueŋa mɛ a kaasi. 66Ni le kasim ta ka yiila ni nyuvooŋa nyiŋ yok ale kantueŋ meena ni le kasim a tu ka daanika, ate ni le yɔgsa ba ni a yaali ba ko ni la nyiŋ. 67Ni kpaziim ale kasim a nak ate ni le kasim a chali yɔgsum ale wa dii meena ate ni a nya la. Saluik meena ni le kasim a yaali kama ayen ku chim junɔi abe junɔi meena ni kasim a yaali ayen ku chim saluik. 68Naawen ale ta ni ŋman cheŋ Ejipiti ale ŋaaruŋta. Wa le ta ni va suik kuui ate mi a weeni ayen ni kan ŋman nya ku. Ni le yaali ni pai nidek da te ni dachaasaŋa ase yɔm la alege waai a kan da ni.

Title: TEERIKA 29
Content:
1Wieŋa de ale nɔiyeŋka wieŋa ate Naawen a weeni Moosis ayen wa nye ale Izirali demma Moab tɛŋka la. Nɔiyeŋ kala a gum chaab ale ka kaai ate wa liŋ jam nye ale ba Yoreb guuku la.
2Moosis a yaa tigsi Izirali demma meena a yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni nya kama ale nidek nina dii meena ate Naawen a nye Faaro ale wa niŋdeerɔma ale Ejipiti tɛŋka meena po la kama. 3Ni nya kama ale nidek nina nye nya kaai ale zuak ale wakperikaliisaŋa ale wakinkaglaŋa ate Naawen a nye la kama. 4A ta jam paari jinla de Naawen an te ni popola ŋaai ale a miŋi wie yaase nina ŋaai ale nya wie yaase tue ŋaai ale wom la. 5Bena pisinaansi wade meena ate mi a te ni va gɔnni po la, ni kɔlimaŋa yaase ni nuensaŋa an kaasi ya. 6Nama an ŋɔbi boroborok yaase damasik yaase ni nyu da buui ale kumu la. Mi nye dila kama ayen ni seba ayen Mi ale Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la.
7<<Ase ni dan paari dela jigini, Naab Siyon Yesbon Naawa ale Naab Og Basan Naawa a yaa jam a nye kpaliŋ ale ti, alege ti nak yiak ba. 8Ti jam tuesi ba tɛŋka kama a poori ka a te Aruben ale Gad ale Manasa dɔkku geli.
9<<Ni kpesi a va nɔiyeŋ wieŋa de ate dila ale basi ate ni nya niaka dii meena ate ni a nye la po. 10Nama ale ni nisɔmma ale kpaŋŋa ale nuruma meena Izirali tɛŋka po a za ka Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la niŋ jinla de, 11ale ni bisaŋa ale nipooma ale nichamma baai ale bo ni tɛŋka po a che daata ale ŋari nyiam a te ni la. 12Ni za dela kama ayen ni nye nɔiyeŋ ale Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la, ku ka pumpuulima ŋaai ate Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a nye ale ni jinla de ale pɛka, 13ate kula ale sak jinla de ayen ni ka wa nuruba la, ate wa mɛ ale chim ni Wen ase wa le puulim ale nuruma ale pɛ ale ni koma Abrayam ale Aizik ale Jekob diila. 14Mi kan nye nɔiyeŋ pumpuulimaŋa ale pɛka ale ka nama nyiini, 15ale za dela jinla de Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la niŋŋa, alege ale baai ale kan bo dela jinla la.
16<<Nama dek a seba ti le jam bo Ejipiti tɛŋka po diila kama ale ti le gaam tɛŋ sii meena suiku po a basi alege a paari dela la kama. 17Ni jam nya biem wieŋa ŋaai ate ba jam nye a ta va ba le sɛ daata ale tintana ale kpana ale ligmɔniŋ bɔgta a kaab la kama. 18Ni be a seba a chak ayen nidoa yaase nipok yaase ni dɔkku po jinla de a nye wa suinum po ayen wa kan va Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la abe wa cheŋ a ga a kaab tɛŋ yoŋta bɔgta; ni be kan te suik ate choŋ kula choa a jam ni po.
19<<Ni be a seba ayen ni po waai a dan wom wieŋa de alege a poli a te wadek ayen wari meena ale nye nalimnyiini a te wa kama ase wa ni poom a nye wadek ale a yaali diila. Kula ale ta kaasuŋ a jam tɛŋka meena zuk. 20Naawen a kan vɔŋ a te kula choa nyɔnɔwa. Naawen sui ale goanti a puuri kama ale wa ate wieŋa ale ŋmarisi gbaŋka de po la meena ale jam wa jigi a ta ga paari diipo ate Naawen a yaa wa kaasi wa la. 21Naawen ale yeeri wadek wa nyiini a ta nyini Izirali buuni po a nyini a basi ate kaasuŋ a jam wa jigi a ta va nɔiyeŋka kika sii meena ale ŋmarisi bo sinsaŋŋa gbaŋka de po la.
22<<Ate chum po ni ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale nichamma baai ale nyini niŋniŋ a jam bo ale ni la ale nya kaasuŋku ale ninam buui ate Naawen a ta jam ni tɛŋka po la. 23Ni tɛŋka a kan nala ate ni a kpa, ka le nye ase ka yesa ale bo ka po la. Ni kan bori Jaab ka po, wuuta a poom kan nyini du mɛ. Ni tɛŋka ale nye ase ka Sodom ale Gomora ale Adma ale Zeboiim tɛŋsaŋa ate Naawen a jam kaasi si meena diipo ate wa suinni a jam puuri ale ba la. 24Ate tɛŋka meena demma a yaa bek ayen, <Ka boa ate Naawen a nye ba tɛŋka dila? Ka boa ate wa sui a domu?>
25<<Tulisaŋa abe nna, <Dii nyiŋla nuruma de a zɛri Naawen, ba koma Wen nɔiyeŋ kaai ate ba nye diipo ate wa jam ta ba a nyini Ejipiti tɛŋka po a nyini la kama. 26Ba jam a kaabka bɔgluk yoŋta ale koori tɛŋ a zuli bɔgluk tii ate ba zɛ, bɔgluk tii ate wa an pai a te ba. 27Dila nyiŋ ate Naawen sui a yaa jam puuri ale ba ate wa yaa basi ate kika sii meena ale ŋmarisi gbaŋka de po la a jam ba jigi. 28Naawen suinni a ŋmasi jam a puuri kama, suipuurum bula nyiŋ wa yaa yeeri ba a ta nyini badek tɛŋka po ate a cheŋ tɛŋ yoŋ. Ba bo ka dula jinla de.>
29<<Wasusuga meena ka Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la ale soa. Alege wie ŋaai ale kan daa wasusuga la, ka tama ale ti bisaŋa ale soa ŋa taam wuu, dila ale ku basi ate ti a va sinsaŋŋa wieŋa de.>>

Title: TEERIKA 30
Content:
1<<Mi a te ni ka suik ayen ni lueri a ta nyini niaka ale kikaasa po. Ase wieŋa de meena a dan nye ni alege ate ni dan bo ale tɛŋ sii ate Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a basi ate ni waaŋ a bo si po la, ni le teeri mi ale weeni ayen ni lueri diila. 2Ase nama ale ni ŋaaŋbisaŋa a dan ŋman a jam Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la jigi ale a zuli wa ale ni suiniima meena ale ni chiisa meena ale va wa wieŋa ate mi a te ni jinla de la. 3Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la ale ta jiirim ale ni. Wa le ta ni a ŋman nyini tɛŋ sii po ate wa basi ate ni bo si po la a ŋman kuli abe wa basi ate maarika a ŋman jam ni jigi. 4Ni dan poom a yalima diidii ya, Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la ale tigsi ni a basi jigi yeŋ a ta ni ŋman jam. 5Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la, ale ŋman pilim a tuesi tɛŋ kaai ate ni koma a daam bo ka po la. Ate wa yaa le basi ate ni nya niaka abe ni piisi a gaam ni koma a daam ale ka diila. 6Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la, dek ale te ni ale ni ŋaaŋbisaŋa suiniima ŋaai ate ni a zuli, dii ale ku basi ate ni a yaali Naawen ale ni suiniima meena ale ni chiisa meena ate ni boro. 7Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la, ale tulim kikaasaŋa de meena a te ka ni dachaasaŋa baai ale kisi ni ale a namsi ni la. 8Ate nama ale ŋman a zuli Naawen abe ni va wa sinsaŋŋa meena ate mi a te ni jinla de la. 9Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la ale niak ni wa dii meena ate ni a nye la po. Ni bisaŋa ale piisi abe wa niak ni duŋsaŋa mɛ. Ni tattaŋa ale nye ŋandiinta nalimnyiini. Naawen sui ale peenti ate wa basi ate ni jigsi ase wa le jam a basi ate ni koma a jigsi diila. 10Alege ku a magsi ka ni a wom Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la nɔi abe ni ta wa wieŋa ale wa ŋmarisika ale ŋmarisi a bo wa sinsaŋŋa gbaŋka de po la. Ku a magsi kama ayen ni ŋmani a va Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la ale ni suiniima meena ale ni chiisa meena.
11<<Wie ŋaai ate mi a te ni jinla de la vaka an toa yaase ŋa pagra a gaam vaka. 12Ŋa an bo daa chiŋmaaŋa po ate ni bek ayen, <Ka wana ale wa jueli a ta ŋa a jam ate ti wom abe ti va ŋa?> 13Yaa ŋa boka nyakpiemu kauk kunkula ate ti bek ayen ka wana ale wa lo beni a jueli a mooli a sak ti ate ti va ŋa? 14Aaya, wanni a moata ni kama, a bo ni noa po ale ni suiniima po. Dila nyiŋla ku a magsi kama ayen ni va ŋa.
15<<Ni nya jinla de m te ni ka nyuvuri ale niaka, kum ale kaasuŋ 16M weeni ni kama jinla de ayen ni a yaali Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la abe ni a cheŋ wa suiku po abe ni ta wa wieŋa ale wa ŋmarisika ale wa buusaŋa ate ni boro abe ni piisi mɛ, ate Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la ale niak ni tɛŋ kaai ate ni a jo ni tuesi la po.
17<<Alege ni dan tagri ni popolaŋa a zɛri ale nye tukpari nyeka, alege cheŋ a ga boro a koori tɛŋ a zuli bɔgluk yoŋta. 18Mi a weeni kama jinla de m le kaasi ni. Ni kan bo tɛŋ kaai ate ni lo le Jodan benni a jueli ayen ni tuesi la po a beni.
19<<Jinla mi a wi ka wenŋmazuk ale tɛŋ ate ba chim mi seerɔba ayen ni lueri nyuvuri ale niaka yaase kum ale kikaasa. Yɔgyɔgla de ni be lueri nyuvuri dii ale ku basi ate nama ale ni bisaŋa a vua. 20Yaali Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la, wom wa lueluku abe ni va wa nalimnyiini. Ale ka wa ale ni nyuvunni, wala ale wa te ni bena piisi tɛŋka ate Naawen puulim ayen wa le te ni koma, Abrayam ale Aizik ale Jekob la.>>

Title: TEERIKA 31
Content:
1Ate Moosis a yaa nyini peelim a weeni wieŋa de meena a te Izirali demma ayen, 2<<Mi yaa ta ka bena kook ale pisiye, m kpaŋ kama m kan ŋman baga a dɛ ni niŋŋa. Naawen a weeni mu kama ayen m kan lo Jodan benni a jueli. 3Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la dek ale dɛ niŋ a lo beni a jueli. Wa le kaasi tɛŋ sila a te ni ate nama ale tuesi ba tɛŋka, Josua mɛ ale dɛ niŋ a lo beni a jueli ase Naawen ale weeni diila. 4Naawen ale nye ba dii dek dek ate wa jam nye Siyon ale Og la. Amori nalima a jam ni la ate wa jam kaasi ba ale ba tɛŋka. 5Naawen ale pai ba a nyo ni nisima po ate nama ale nye ba dii meena ate mi a weeni ni la. 6Ni pagra abe ni chiib a zaani. Ni kan chali yɔgsummoa yaase ni nyiŋsa a gɔgi ale Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la a cheŋ ale ni kama, wa kan basi ni yaase wa zɛri ni mɛ.>>
7Ate Moosis a yaa wi Josua a weeni wa Izirali demma meena niŋ ayen, <<Be a pagra abe fi chiib a zaani, fi ale nuruma ale magsi ni ga jo tɛŋ kaai ate Naawen a puulim ale ba kokpieŋsaŋa ayen wa te ba la, abe fi poori tɛŋka a chari ba ase ba tiirim la. 8Naawen dek a dɛ ka ni niŋ a cheŋ wa le bo ale ni, wa kan basi ni yaase wa zɛri ni. Kan chali yɔgsummoa; kan jɔgi nyiŋbiiri.>>
9Moosis a yaa jam ŋmarisi sinsaŋŋa de a yaa pai ŋa a te kaabteerɔma Livai bisaŋa baai ale a ji Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni la ale Izirali nisɔmma meena. 10Ate Moosis a yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Bena ŋayopɔi meena kpeglimka po ben diipo ate ni ko pama a basi la, viitaŋa tigini daaŋa po. 11Ase Izirali demma meena a dan jam Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la niŋ kauk kuui ate wa lueri ayen ni a puusi wa la, fi yaa kariŋ sinsaŋŋa de a te ba wom. 12Tigsi nuruma nidoaba ale nipooba ale bisa ale nichamma ale bo ni tɛŋsaŋa po la ate ba wom abe ba zamsi dii ale ku nye ate ba a chali Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la abe ba kpesi a va sinsaŋŋa wieŋa meena. 13Ba bisaŋa baai ale kan seba sinsaŋŋa de la a magsi ba wom abe ba zamsi di ate ba a chali Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la diipo meena ate ni bo tɛŋ kaai po ate ni lo Jodan benni a jueli ka po la.>>
14Naawen a weeni Moosis ayen, <<Yɔgyɔgla de fi kummu danni a moata kama. Wi Josua a pai fidek a sak wa viuku po, kauk kuui ate mi ale gomsi wa a magsi la,>> ate Moosis ale Josua a yaa ta badek a jam viuku po ba tuka jigini.
15Ate Naawen a yaa jam viuku po ase chiŋmari la ate chiŋmanni a yaa za viuku nansuiŋku nɔi. 16Ate Naawen a yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Fi a yaa fi cheŋ a ga vuusi ale ka fi koma, ate nuruma de ale cheŋ a ga pai badek a te bɔgluk chaŋsa a se jentirisa la tɛŋ kaai po ate ba a cheŋ ba jo ka po la. Ba le zɛri mu abe ba kaasi nɔiyeŋ kaai ate mi a jam nye ale ba la. 17Dai dila danni m sui ale puuri ale ba ate m zɛri ba; m le viriŋ, m ninaŋa a basi nakpiak abe m kaasi ba. Kaasuŋ ale wa pagrisa ale piisi a jam ni jigi, ate dai dila danni ba le bek ayen, <<Kaasuŋku de ale jam tama jigi la ti Wenni a ka ale ti? 18Ate m le viriŋ m ninaŋa a basi nakpiak dai dila danni gaasa wie ŋaai ate ba nye a ta va chaab ale bɔgluk yoŋta kaabka la nyiŋ.
19<<Yɔgyɔgla de ni ŋmarisi yiini de a dueni. Sak Izirali demma ate ba sebi di ate dila ale kasim a teeri ba ayen: 20M le ta ba a cheŋ tɛŋ kaai ale jigsi ale poagi a magsi kpari la po, ase m le puulim ale ba kokpieŋsaŋa diila. Dula jigini ba le ta ŋandiin tii meena ate ba a yaali la abe ba boro nalimnyiini wari a kan daani ba. Alege ba le tulim a kaabi bɔgluk yoŋta. Ba le zɛri mu abe ba kaasi nɔiyeŋ kaai ate m nye ale ba la. 21Ate kaasuŋ m na yegayega ale jam ba jigi. Alege ba dan lenni yiini dɛ di le teeri ba. Yɔgyɔgla de alege jigi ate mi a poom ta ba a cheŋ tɛŋ kaai po ate mi a puulim ayen m le te ba la, m seba dii ate ba a poli la kama.>> 22Dai dila danni dek Moosis a ŋmarisi yiini kama ale sak Izirali demma di lennika.
23Ate Naawen a yaa biisi ale Josua Nun biika a weeni wa ayen, <Be pagra abe fi chiib a zaani. Fi ale dɛ Izirali demma niŋ a ta ba jo tɛŋ kaai ate m puulim ayen m te ba la po, m le bo ale fu.>>
24Moosis a jam ŋmarisi Naawen sinsaŋŋa a nyo ka gbaŋ po ale kpesi wadek nalimnyiini an tali wari a basi ya. 25Moosis le jam nueri la, wa yaa a weeni Livaima baai ale jam a ji Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni la ayen, 26<<Ni pai Naawen sinsaŋŋa de a magi Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la nɔiyeŋka dakanni nyiŋ ate ku le, kasim a bo dula a teeri wa nuruma. 27Mi a seba tukpari dii ate ba ta la nɔi po kama. Ba jam zɛri Naawen kama diipo ate mi jam vua la, ba be za ba diem a zɛri wa kama mi kummu ŋaaŋnyiŋ. 28Tigsi ni dɔkku po niŋdeerɔma ale kpaŋŋa meena m niŋ ate m weeni ba wieŋa de; m le wi ka wenŋmazuk ale tɛŋ ate ba chim mi seerɔba mi ale nama suŋsuŋ. 29Mi a seba kama ayen mi kummu ŋaaŋnyiŋ nuruma ale ta ka gaasa abe ba zɛri dii ate mi a sak ba la. Ku be kan beni ba le nya kaasuŋ dii nyiŋla ba le nye ate Naawen sui a puuri, a ta va wie ŋaai ate wa kisa la.>>
30Moosis a yaa biisi yiini wie meena ate Izirali demma meena a ŋman wom,

Title: TEERIKA 32
Content:
1Wom wenŋmazuk wa, mi a yaa m biisi kama; wom tɛŋŋa, wieŋa m nɔnni po. 2Basi ate m sinsaŋŋa a lo ase ŋmoruk, ale a ni la abe m wieŋa mɛ a siŋ ase maglim, ale a lo diila, ase ŋmoruk ale a ni wuuk paaluk zuk la. Ase ŋmoruk kpioŋ ale a ni ŋan bula zuk la. 3M le mooli Naawen yuenni, ate wa nuruma a weeni wa zuaka ale ka diila. 4Wa ka piuŋ wa tuimaŋa kaasuŋ a ka du wa suitaŋa a nye cheri. Naawen dii ale ta wensie la, waai ale kan nye wari a kaasi. Wa ka waai ale ta wayɔrisima ale nye a magsi. 5Ba an nye dii ate wa a yaali ayen ba nye la; chivie a yik ba kama dii nyiŋla ba ŋman daa wa bisa. Ba ka wabaata nyam ale nuru baai ale kan ta wensie. 6Ka ku le magsi ni nye Naawen diila ale la? Ni ka betta, nuru baai ale kan ta yammoa. Wa daa nama Ko ale ni Nyeerɔ? Daa wa ale nye ni a basi ate ni boro? 7Ni teeri dila po wieŋa bena ŋaai ale taam la. Ni bek ni nyama ate ba weeni dii ale jam nye la. Ni bek nuru kpagsa ate ba weeni wieŋa a sak ni. 8Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La ale a te tɛŋsa ba le magsi ba soa juijui la; Wa le poori nuru bisa la, Wa te ba ka bana a magsi Izirali bisaŋa nɔi ale ka diila. 9Naawen nuruma ka wa a le soa, Jekob ŋaaŋbisaŋa ka wadek ale soa. 10Wa jam nya ba zuk kama diipo ate ba jam bo gɔnni po a ka jigi la. Wa jam a nya ba zuk kama ale ta jiirim ale ba ase wa le a nya wadek zuk diila. 11Ase jiiruk ale a sak ku bisa yiri ka dii ale chɔgsi si dii ale ku kinkaŋŋa ate si kan lo tɛŋ diila, Naawen mɛ a nya Izirali demma zuk ka dila ate ba kan lo. 12Naawen dek wa nyiini ale dɛ wa nuruma niŋ, wa jam kan yaali bɔgluk chaŋsa maarika. 13Wa jam basi kama ate ni nya pagrim tɛŋsaŋa zuk. Ni tattaŋa mɛ a jam ta ŋandiinta. Olivi tiisaŋa mɛ a jam a chim tɛŋ kaai ale ta tintana la po, alege basi ate siita a bo pinaŋa po ate ni a dɛ. 14Ba niiŋa ale ba booŋa a jam a te ba ka biisim nna yegayega; ba jam ta ka pa ŋaai ale bo ŋaai ale naa ŋaai ale chim duŋ maŋsa la. Ba jam maa ta ka za ale daam. 15Naawen nuruma a jam jigsi kama alege ta tukpari; ba jam kasim a biik kama ba le ta ŋandiintaŋa la nyiŋ ate dila a nye ate ba baŋ ba Wenni, waai ale nye ba la wari ale zɛri ba Varibasidɔwa, waai ale ka Piuŋ la. 16Ba bɔgtaŋa a jam basi kama ate Wen a dɛ nyuri alege ba biemu mɛ a nye ate wa sui a puuri. 17Ba jam a kaab a te ka chichirik sii ale kan daa Wen yaa, bɔgluk tii ate badek a zɛ ti, bɔgluk chaŋsa tii ale boro daaŋa dɛ la tii ate ba koma an jam a chali ti yɔgsummoa. 18Ba baŋ ba Wen dii ale ka Piuŋ la kama ba varibasidɔ kpioŋku waai ale te ba nyuvuri la. 19Ase Naawen ale nya kude la wa sui a yaa puuri ate wa zɛri wa bisaŋa ale wa liema. 20Mi a kan ŋman a maari ni diipo diipo wa ale weeni diila a ni la m le nya dii ale ku nye tukpari nyama ale nuru baai ale kan ta siaka la. 21Ba basi kama ate mi a dɛ nyuri ale jabuui ale kan daa wen ya. A basi ate m sui a puuri ale bɔgluk kayaata. M le basi ate baai ale kan daa nuruba a nye ate ba a dɛ nyuri. M le basi ate tɛŋ kaai ale kan ta miŋka la a nye ate ba sue a puuri. 22M suipuurumu ale nye ase bolim la a dɛ jaab meena tɛŋka zuk bu le paari tɛŋka meena a dɛ jaab meena. 23M le ta kaasuŋ kuui ale ka maara kpeglim la a jam ba jigi abe m tɔŋ ba ale m peemaŋa. 24Ba le kpi ale kɔm ale nyiŋtui baata. Ba le kpi ale nyiŋtuila ŋaai ate ŋa wie a pagra la m le basi ate duŋ sii nyeka ale tua la a yik ba abe waapiisa mɛ a dom ba. 25Kpaliŋ ale ta kum a jam tɛŋka po. Zueba ale jo ni yeeŋa po a vari ni. Nidoabilisa ale nipokbilisa baai ale paala la ale kpi. Bi fiisa ale ŋankpagsa meena ale kpi. 26M weeni kama ayen m ti waaŋ ba kama ale yeeri ba nurubisa suŋsuŋ, 27alege mi chali ka dachaasaŋa suiniima nakka, ba kan miŋi a weeni ayen, ba nya ka pagrim, daa Naawen ale nye nnawa meena. 28Izirali tɛŋka demma ka baai ale kan ta popola; ba bola ka yam ale magadek mɛ la. 29Ba an miŋi jabuui nyiŋ ate ba nak a yik ba la; ba kan miŋ wa dii ale nye la. 30Ka boa ale soa ate nuru yeŋ a baga a nya pagrim nuruba tusidi zuwa yaase nuruba tusa ŋaye (2,000) a baga a nya pagrim tusa pi (10,000) zuwa? Ka ba Piuŋku a nin pai ba da, ka Naawen a nin pai ba a te. 31Ba dachaasaŋa a seba kama ayen badek bɔgtaŋa a wobsa kama, ti an pagra ase Izirali Wenni la. 32Ba dachaasaŋa a bie kama ase Sodom ale Gomora demma la alege a nye ase tiib sii yɔna ale tua ase choŋ la. 33Ba a nye ase ka daam ate ba pai waapiik sim a nyoro la. 34Naawen a teeri dii ate ba dachaasaŋa a nye ba la kama; wa a limisi kama ayen di danni a paari ate wa namsi ba. 35Ku ka mi wari ate m nye wari tuni baai ale a tom biem tuima la. M be le nye kama. Dai a cheena ate ba kan nya suik a nye ba le a yaali diila; ba ninammu daaŋa a moata kama. 36Naawen ale bo wa nuruma buusa. Wa le ta jiirim ale ba ase wa nin nya ale ba pagrimu a nueri ya, ate waai an tali ya, baai ale ka yɔm ale baai ale kan daa yɔm la. 37Ate Naawen a yaa le bek wa nuruma ayen, <Bɔgluk kpieŋ tii ate ni ta siaka ale ti la a boka bɛ? 38Ni jam kasim a kaab ti ale ka duŋ sii ale biik a ta kpaam mɛ la ale a te ti daam ate ti a nyu; ni basi ate ti jam maari ni yɔgyɔgla de ni basi ate ti chali a jam vari ni a basi. 39Mi dek nyiini ale Naawen. Wen yoŋ a ŋman karo a gum mi po. Mi ale a ko ale a te nyuvuri mɛ. Mi ale a te nuruba tuem mɛ abe le ŋmaa tebi ba mɛ ate waai a karo a zɛri dii ate mi a nye la. 40Ase mi ale ka Naawen dii ale vua la, mi zak ka m nisaŋa ale pɛ ayen, 41m le saasi ka m gebika kaai ale a nyaksi la a nye dii ale magsi la. Mi ale nye a tuni m dachaasaŋa ale nye diila abe m namsi baai ale kisi mu la. 42Mi peeŋa ale feri ba ziimu po abe m gebika mɛ ko baai meena ale a zɛri mu la, baai ale kɔni la ale baai ate ba yik lik likka diina po meena la ale kpi. 43Tɛŋsa ku a fɛ kama ayen ni pak Naawen ale wa nuruma. Wa nye tuni wa dachaasaŋa ale nye wa diila kama alege a vɔŋ wa nuruma biemu a te ba.>>
44Moosis ale Josua Nun biika a yaa pilim kariŋ yiini de a sak ba ate Izirali demma a wom di. 45Ase Moosis ale jam sak Naawen nuruma a ga nueri la, 46Wa weeni ayen, <<Ni seba a chak ayen ni a va sinsaŋŋa de meena ate mi a te ni jinla de la. Ni ŋman pai ŋa a sak ni bisaŋa, dii ale ku basi ate ba va Naawen sinsaŋŋa meena. 47Sinsaŋŋa de a daa sinsak koruta; ŋa ka ni nyuvooŋa. Ni va ŋa ate ni goa a beni tɛŋ kaai ate ni le lo Jodan benni jueli a bo ka po la.>>
48Da dila danni dek ate Naawen a weeni Moosis ayen, 49<<Cheŋ Abarim guutaŋa zuk Moab tɛŋka po ate ka le Jeriko a kala a tuk chaab la; jueli Nebo guuku zuk a nya Keenan tɛŋka a te mi a yaali m pai ate Izirali demma la. 50Fi ale kpi ka guuk kula zuk ase fi suoku Aaron ale jam Yor Guuku zuk a kpi la, 51dii nyiŋla ni nɔi niyema a jam ka siaka ale mi Izirali demma niŋŋa. Ni le jam Meriba nyaataŋa jigini ate ku moata Kades Zin gɔnni po la, ni an jam a nye mi ase waai ale ta tuilum la. 52Fi le zaani ka niŋ a nya tɛŋka, alege fi kan jo tɛŋ kaai ate mi a yaa m pai te Izirali demma la.>>

Title: TEERIKA 33
Content:
1Niaka de Moosis Naawen nuruwa a biisi te Izirali demma alege kpi, 2Naawen a yaa jam Sinai guuku zuk; wa jam a yiti ase wenbinni ale bo Seir tɛŋka zuk diila a yaa jam a nyaksi diipo ate wa nuruma a jam bo Paran guuku zuk la. Maarɔba tusa pi ale jam bo ale wa, ate bolim ŋiak a jam bo wa juga nisaŋa po. 3Naawen a yaali wa nuruma kama ale a kasi baai ate wa soa la. Dila nyiŋ ti a koori ka wa niŋ abe ti wom wa sinsaŋŋa. 4Ti le va sinsaŋŋa ŋaai ate Moosis a te la, ti tɛŋka tuilum jaab a magsi ta ka. 5Naawen a jam chim ka wa nuruma Izirali demma Naab diipo ate ba dɔkku ale niŋdeerɔma a jam tigsi chaab la.
6Moosis a yaa jam weeni Aruben ayen, Aruben dɔkku a kan kpi meena, ba an soa diiya alege ba le boro.
7Juda dɔkku mɛ wa weeni ayen, Naawen a wom ba kaarika abe wa maari ba; basi ate ba ta nɔiyeŋ ale buura m ŋala. Naawen, kpaliŋ a te ba.
8Wa weeni Livai dɔkku ayen, Fi, Naawen pai dii ate fi a yaali la a sak ba a ta va Urim ale Tummim zuk fi tomteerɔwa waai ale ta siaka ale fu la. Fi jam nye ba kama a nya diipo ate ba jam bo Massaya la ale weeni ba fi wensieŋa Meriba nyiamu jigini. 9Ba jam sak ba yaali kpieŋka ale fu kama a gaam ba nyam ale ba suata ale bisaŋa ate ba ta yaalika ale ba diila. Ba an jam zɛri fi wieŋa. Ba jam ta siaka ale fi nɔiyeŋka kama. 10Ba le sak fi nuruma ate ba kan zɛri fi sinsaŋŋa; ba le nye kaabka fi yenni po a te fu. 11Naawen maari ba buuni po ate ba chim abe ba ta pagrim. Ta suipeentik ale dii meena ate ba a nye la. Ko ba dachaasaŋa meena kan basi ate ba ŋman yiti.
12Wa le weeni Benjamin dɔkku mɛ diila ale nna. Dɔkku de ka buui dii ate Naawen a yaali ale a kasi ba la; wa kasim a nya ba zuk ka dila daa meena ale kasim a bo ale ba mɛ.
13Wa weeni Josefi dɔkku mɛ ayen, Naawen a niak ba tɛŋka ale ŋmoruk abe nyiam mɛ a bo tɛŋ a yɔk tɛŋka. 14Basi ate kantueŋ a nak ba tɛŋka po ate ba tiisaŋa yɔnaŋa a bɛ. Diipo meena ba kasim a ta yɔn maŋsa. 15Ba guutaŋa zuk a kasim a ta ka yɔna ŋaai ate ba a yaali la. 16Ba tɛŋka a kasim a sueri ale ka ŋan maŋsa meena ale niaka a nyini Naawen jigi, waai ale jam bo bolimu ale a dɛ gɔnni po a biisi la. Niaka de abe jam Josefi dɔkku jigi dii nyiŋla wala ale niŋdeerɔ wa suataŋa zuk. 17Josefi pagrimu a jam a nye ase ka lalik ale a kpa la ate wa pagra ase ka Ɛfraim dɔkku tugurik tɔŋdɔba tusa pi la, alege a nye ase Manasa dɔkku tugurik tɔŋdɔba tusa la.
18Wa weeni Zebulun dɔkku ayen, Ni ta suipeentik ase nama ale a nyini peelim alege a weeni Isaka dɔkku ayen nama mɛ ale jigsi ni yeeŋa po. 19Ba le wi nuruba ate ba jam guuku zuk ate ba nye kaab maŋ dula jigini. Ba le nya ba ŋanta ka nyakpiemu po ale tintain busuŋ bu po.
20Gad dɔkku mɛ wa weeni ba ayen, Pak Naawen waai ale nye ate Gad dɔkku a piisi la. Gad a bo dula kama ase gbeŋli la ayen wa kaasi. 21Ba jam lueri ka tɛŋ kaai ale nala la a te badek, Niŋdeerɔma mɛ a jam nya ka tɛŋ maŋ a te ba dɔkku. Ba jam zuli Naawen kama a maari buuri yɔnaŋa.
22Dan dɔkku mɛ wa weeni ba ayen, Fi ka gbeŋ paali; fi nyini ka Basan.
23Nafitali dɔkku wa weeni ba mɛ ayen, Naawen a niak fu kama ale wa jiirim maŋka; Ba tɛŋka paari Galili nyakpiemu kama.
24Asɛ dɔkku wa weeni ba ayen, Asɛ a nya niaka a gaam buura m ŋala meena kama. Wa nyeka abe masa a te wa suataŋa abe wa tɛŋka po kpaam tiisa a kasim a boro. 25Wa tɛŋka a nye ase ka kuta tuok ale lik la ate wa le kasim boro ale suiyɔgni.
26Wen a karo ase Izirali Wenni la, waai ale nyini wenŋmazuk a maari ni la. 27Wen ale kasim a maari ni; wa nisaŋa a kasim a maari ni kama. Wa ale yiak ni dachaasaŋa a basi, ni ale weeni ayen ni ko ba meena. 28Dila nyiŋ Jekob ŋaaŋbisa ni boro ale suiyɔgni wari a kan daani ni. Tɛŋka ka za ale damasik ale bo ka po, dula jigini maglim ale nyini chiŋmaaŋa po a lo tɛŋka. 29Izirali demma nya suipeentik kaai ate ni ta la! Waai a karo a nye ase nama la. Ni ka tɛŋ kaai ate Naawen a vari basi. Wadek ale ni kasidɔ ale ni maarɔ ale ni gebik a nya ni zuk. Ni dachaasaŋa ale jam a saalim ayen ni ta jiirim ale ba ate ni le ko ba.

Title: TEERIKA 34
Content: 1Ate Moosis a yaa jam nyini Moab tɛŋka a ga jueli Nebo guuku ale Pisga guuku ale bo Jeriko kori geŋsa la, dula jigini ate Naawen a pai tɛŋka meena a sak wa. Wa jam nya Gilead tɛŋka a ta ga paari tɛŋ kaai ate ba a wi ayen Dan la; 2Nafitali tɛŋka meena ale Ɛfraim ale Manasa ale Juda tɛŋka meena a ta ga paari nyakpiemu yeniŋ geŋsa, 3Juda yeseok geŋka ale Zoar ale Jeriko tɛŋsaŋa tɛŋ kaai ate kpinkpatta a bo ka po la, wa jam nya si meena kama. 4Ate Naawen a yaa weeni Moosis ayen, <<Tɛŋka de ate m puulim ale Abrayam ale Aizik ale Jekob ayen m le pai ka a te ba ŋaaŋbisaŋa la. Mi basi ate fi a nya ka kama alege m kan basi ate fi jo ka po. 5Moosis Naawen tomteerɔwa a yaa jam kpi Moab tɛŋka po ase Naawen ale weeni diila. 6Ate wa yaa jam gu wa viak po Moab tɛŋka po ate ka le Bet Peor tɛŋka a kala a tuk chaab la. A zaani dai dila danni a ta jam paari jinla waai a karo a seba wa guka jigini. 7Moosis a jam ta ka bena kook ale pisiye alege kpi la. Wa jam diem pagra kama ase wa le jam ka diila, wa ninaŋa mɛ a nya nalimnyiini. 8Izirali demma a jam kum wa nyiŋ a paari ka daa pisita Moab tɛŋka po. 9Josua Nun biika Naawen chiika a yaa jam sueri wa dii nyiŋla Moosis a jam lueri wa kama ayen wa zaani wa nankula po. Ate Izirali demma a yaa va Josua ale ta sinsaŋŋa ate Naawen a jam ta va Moosis zuk a te ba la. 10Biisiteerɔ a jam ka Izirali tɛŋka po ase Moosis la, a jam paari jinla. Naawen a jam a nya wa kama ate ba a biisi ale chaab. 11Biisiteerɔ a jam karo a nye wakinkagla ale wakperikaliisa ase ŋaai ate Naawen a jam basi ate Moosis a nye Ejipiti Naawa ale wa niŋdeerɔma nyiŋ diila Ejipiti tɛŋka po. 12Biisiteerɔ waai an jam baga a nye wakpiema ŋaai ate Moosis a jam nye a te Izirali demma meena la a nya.

Title: JOSUA 1
Content:
1Naawen tomteerɔwa Moosis kummu ŋaaŋnyiŋ ate Naawen a yaa weeni Nun nidoabinni Josua waai ale pai a vi Moosis ŋaaŋ la ayen, 2<<Moosis m tomteerɔwa a kpi kama. Yɔgyɔgla de fi ale Izirali demma meena a gomsi ate ni lo Jodan Benni a jueli a jo tɛŋ kaai ate mi a yaali m te Izirali demma la po. 3Mi ale pai kauk kuui meena ate ni pai naŋ a tabi du la ase mi ale puulim ale Moosis diila. 4Ni tɛŋka ale zaani ka gɔnni ale bo yeseoku la, a ta ga paari tɛŋ kaai ate ba a wi ka ayen Lebanon ale bo wiilukku geŋsa la a ta ga va Yufiretis beli kpienni ale bo Yit demma tɛŋka po kori geŋsa la a ta ga paari Nyakpiemu ale bo yeniŋ geŋsa la. 5Waai a kan boro a baga a zaani ale fu daa ŋaai meena ate fu vua la po. Ase mi ale jam bo ale Moosis diila m le bo ale fu ka dila mɛ. M kan basi fu yaase m zɛri fu.
6<<Bi pagra abe fi chiib a zaani dii nyiŋla fi ale fi dɛ nuruma niŋ ate ba jo tɛŋ kaai ate mi pɛ ale ba kokpieŋsaŋa ayen m te ba la po. 7Bi pagra abe fi ŋmasi chiib zaani. Bi kpesi fidek ate fi va sinsaŋŋa meena ate m tomteerɔwa Moosis a te fu la. Kan basi di a be fi viriŋ a va juga yaase gala geŋsa. Dila ale ku basi ate wari meena ale cheŋ nalimnyiini ate kauk kuui meena ate fi a cheŋ la. 8Bi basi ate gbaŋka de kaai ate sinsaŋŋa a bo ka po la a kasim bo fi nɔnni po. A teeri di kantueŋ ale yok meena. Ka dila ale ku basi ate fi a nye wa dii meena ale ŋmarisi ka po la. Ate dila ale nye ate fi jigsi ate wari meena ale cheŋ nalimnyiini a te fu. 9Daa mi ale weeni fu yaa? Bi pagra abe fi chiib zaani. Kan basi ate fi nyiŋka a gɔgi, kan jɔk nyiŋbiiri mɛ, ale Naawen fi Wenni ale bo ale fu kauk kuui meena ate fi a cheŋ la.>>
10Ate Josua a yaa weeni kpaŋŋa baai ale a nya nuruma zuk la ayen, 11<<Ni cheŋ nuruma ale tigsi chaab juijui la meena a weeni ba ayen, <Ni gomsi wari meena a magsi. Daa ŋata ale tali ni le lo Jodan benni a jueli a ga tuesi tɛŋka ate Naawen ni Wenni a yaa wa pai te ni ate ni tanla la.> >>
12Alege Aruben dɔkku ale Gad dɔkku ale Manasa dɔkku geli Josua a weeni ba ayen, 13<<Ba teeri wanni ate Naawen tomteerɔwa Moosis a weeni ni la. <Naawen ni Wenni a te ni ka vuusum ale pai tɛŋka mɛ a te ni.> 14Ni pooma ale ni bisaŋa ale ni duŋsaŋa a baga bo tɛŋ kaai ate Moosis a te ni ate ka bo Jodan benni kori geŋsa la po, alege ni tugurik tɔŋdɔma meena a gomsi a dɛ ni suataŋa niŋ a lo beni a jueli. Ku a magsi kama ayen ni maari ni suataŋa, 15a ta ga paari diipo ate Naawen ale te ba vuusum, ase wa le nye dii a te nama la, ate ba mɛ ale tuesi tɛŋka ate Naawen ni Wenni ale te ba la. Kula ŋaaŋnyiŋ ni baga ŋman ga bo tɛŋka po kama, sii ate Naawen tomteerɔwa Moosis a te ni, ate si bo Jodan benni kori geŋsa kauk kuui ate wenbinni a pusi la.>>
16Ate ba yaa tulisi Josua ayen, <<Dii meena ate fi a weeni ti la ti le nye. Kauk kuui meena mɛ ate fi a tom ti la ti le cheŋ. 17Ase ti le jam wom Moosis diila, ti le wom fi mɛ ka dila. Ka Naawen fi Wenni dek abe bo ale fu ase wa le jam bo ale Moosis diila. 18Waai ale a zɛri fi wanni ale kan va fi wanni la, dii meena ate fi a weeni ba la ti le ko wa. Ka fi a tin pagra a bɛ fi chiib zaani!>>

Title: JOSUA 2
Content:
1Josua Nun nidoabinni a yaa jam basi nidoaba baye ate ba nyini Sittim ayen ba ga kpesi nya tɛŋka. Wa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni cheŋ a ga kpesi nya Jeriko tɛŋka tɛŋ kaai dek ate ba a wi ayen Jeriko la.>> Ba yaa cheŋ a ga jo nidoa yaalik yeri po wa yuei a jam le Arayab.
2Nuruma yaa jam weeni Jeriko naawa ayen, <<Nya dɛ Izirali demma gela ale jam dela yokku de ayen ba kpesi nya ti tɛŋka.>> 3Ate Jeriko naawa a yaa tom nuruba Arayab jigi ayen, <<Ta nuru baai ale jam bo fi yenni po la a jam, dii nyiŋla ba jam kama ayen ba kpesi a nya ti tɛŋka meena.>>
4Alege nipowa dɛ a jam pai nidoama de bayewa a suk kama. Wa jam weeni ba kama ayen, <<Mm, nuruma a jam ka mi jigi, alege mi zɛ ba le nyini ka kauk kuui la. 5Ase tɛŋka ale sobi la, diipo ate ba lik tuoku la nuruma a nyini kama. Mi zɛ ba le va suik kuui la. Ni saŋ ba ŋaaŋ nwuli da dii dai ni le paari ba suik.>> 6Alege Arayab a jam pai nidoama de bayema a suk ka sampok zuk. 7Ate nuruma a yaa jam gisi nidoama de bayema a va suik kuui ale a cheŋ Jodan benni la. Ase nuruma de ale bo gisika po la ba yaa lik tuataŋa.
8Alege ate nidoama de bayema duek tɛŋ yok kula la, Arayab a yaa jueli ba jigi 9a yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Mi seba kama ayen Naawen a pai tɛŋka de ate ni kama ate tama a chali ni yɔgsum, ate nuru baai meena ale bo tɛŋka de po la nyiŋsaŋa a gɔk nama nyiŋ. 10Ti wom Naawen ale basi ate Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku a kpeeri ate ni lo jueli, diipo ate ni jam nyini Ejipiti po a nyini la, ale ni le jam nye Amori nalima ŋaye Siyon ale Og ale jam bo Jodan benni kori geŋsa baai ate nama kaasi ba la. 11Tama ale jam wom diila, ti nyiŋsaŋa a jam a gɔk kama ate waai meena a jɔk nyiŋbiiri nama nyiŋ, dii nyiŋla Naawen ni Wenni ka Wen a bo wenŋmazuk ale tɛŋzuk de. 12Yɔgyɔgla de ni be pɛ a te mu Naawen yuenni nyiŋ ayen ni le sak jiirim ale m dɔkdemma dii nyiŋla, mi ale sak jiirim ale ni la nyiŋ. Ni nye wari ate ku a sak ayen, 13ni kan ko m kowa ale m mawa ale m suataŋa ale m toama ale ba nuruma ale baai meena ale moata ba la ate ni basi ate ti kan kpi.>>
14Ate nidoama bayema a yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Wen a ko ti ase tama dan zɛri an nye dii ate tama a weeni fu la. Fi mɛ a dan kan weeni a sak waai tama ale a yaali ti nye diila. Ti a puulim kama ayen Naawen a dan pai tɛŋka de a te ti, ti le nye fu a magsi.>>
15Arayab a jam bo ka yeri dii ate ba jam sɛ di tɛŋka parika zuk. Wa jam pai ka miik ate nuruma yik ka a va wa dɔkku tuokparuku a zi. 16Wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni jueli guutaŋa zuk ate baai ale a gisi ni la a kan nya ni. Ni suk dula jigini a paari daa ŋata ate ba yaa dan ŋman kuli a bi ni yaa cheŋ.>>
17Nidoama de bayema yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Pɛka dɛ ate fi basi ate ti nye la, a kan nye ti wari ya, 18nin ka diipo ate tama ale ŋman pilim jam tɛŋka po, a nya ale fi pai miik mɔnuŋ a bobi tuokparuk kuui ate fi a basi ate tama a va du a nyini la nyiŋ. Maa basi ate fi kowa ale fi mawa ale fi suataŋa ale fi kowa yenni demma meena a bo fi yenni po. 19Ase waai a dan nyini fi yenni po a nyini peelim wa ziimu a va wadek, dila an nya tama, alege waai a dan bo yenni po ale fu alege kpi wa ziimu a va tama. 20Alege fi dan weeni a sak waai tama ale nye diila, pɛka a kan nye tama wari ya.>>
21Wa yaa siak ale basi ate ba cheŋ. Ase ba le cheŋ a ga nueri la, wa yaa pai miik mɔnuŋka a bobi tuokparuku nyiŋ.
22Ase ba le cheŋ la, ba yaa jam boka guutaŋa zuk a paari daa ŋata, ate baai ale bo suiku po a gisi ba la a ŋman kuli ale an nya ba. 23Ate nidoama bayewa a yaa jam ŋman kuli. Ba jam basi guutaŋa, a lo Jodan benni a jueli jam Nun nidoabinni Josua jigi a weeni wa dii meena ale jam nye ba la. 24Ba yaa weeni Josua ayen, <<Naawen a sum pai tɛŋka meena a nyo ka ti nisa po. Nuruma meena nyiŋsaŋa a gɔk kama tama nyiŋ.>>

Title: JOSUA 3
Content:
1Saluik yokyok ate Josua ale Izirali demma meena a yaa jam basi Sittim ale cheŋ Jodan benni nɔi. Dula jigini ba jam goa kama alege a lo di a jueli. 2Daa ŋata ale taam la ŋaaŋnyiŋ kpaŋŋa a yaa cheŋ ba le tigsi chaab juijui la meena, 3a weeni nuruma ayen, <<Ase ni dan nya Naawen ni Wenni nɔiyeŋka dakanni ale Livaima ale ka kaabteerɔma la a ji di, ku a magsi ka ni basi ni le tigsi chaab juijui la abe ni va di. 4Ate ni seba ku ale magsi ni va suik kuui la, dii nyiŋla nama an diem va suiku de a nya ya. Ni yalima ale dakanni ate pari a bo ni suŋsuŋ, ni kan moata di.>>
5Josua a weeni nuruma ayen, <<Ni gomsi nidek ase tuilum nuruba la ale chum Naawen a yaa wa nyeka wakperikaliisa ni po.>>
6Josua a weeni kaabteerɔma me ayen, <<Ni pai Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a dɛ nuruma niŋ.>> Ate ba yaa pai di a dɛ ba niŋ.
7Ate Naawen a weeni Josua ayen, <<Jinla m le piilim a pak fu kama Izirali demma meena nina po ate ba le seba ayen mi a bo ale fu kama ase m le jam bo ale Moosis diila. 8Weeni kaabteerɔma baai ale ji Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni la ayen ase ni dan paari Jodan nyiamu nɔi, ba siŋ a zaani benni po.>>
9Ate Josua a yaa weeni Izirali demma ayen, << Ni jam de a wom wieŋa ate Naawen ni Wenni a yaa wa weeni ni la. 10Kude ale basi ate ni seba ayen Wen dii ale vua la a bo le ni kama wa le yiak Keenan ale Yit ale Yivi ale Perizzi ale Girgas ale Amori ale Jebus demma meena ate ni. 11Nya, tɛŋka meena Nyɔnɔwa nɔiyeŋka dakanni ale dɛ ni niŋ a siŋ Jodan benni po. 12Yɔgyɔgla de lueri nidoaba pi ale baye a nyini Izirali buuni po, wanyi a nyini dɔk meena po. 13Ase kaabteerɔma baai ale ji Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni la, tɛŋka meena Nyɔnɔwa, dan tabi Jodan benni po, di nyiamu ale mobi sueri a nyini la ale lab buye a za ase guuk la.>>
14Ase nuruma ale basi ba le tigsi chaab juijui la ale cheŋ ayen ba lo Jodan benni a jueli la, kaabteerɔma ale ji nɔiyeŋka dakanni la a yaa dɛ ba niŋ. 15Kude nye ka diipo ate ba a che ŋanta la, Jodan benni a jam mobi sueri kama. Alege kaabteerɔma baai ale ji nɔiyeŋka dakanni la ale ga paari Jodan benni ate ba naŋsaŋa a tiri nyiamu nɔi la, 16nyiamu ale mobi la a deri gebiri. Bu jam vi ka chaab a jueli a yalima nna niŋniŋa a cheŋ, tɛŋ kaai ate ba wi ka ayen Adam la a moata Zaretan. Alege nyiam a nyiem ale mobi a siŋ Araba Nyakpiem buui ale ka Yesa Nyakpiemu po la, a jam gebiri. Ate nuruma a yaa jam lo jueli Jeriko tɛŋka po. 17Kaabteerɔma baai ale jam ji Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni la a yaa zaani giŋgiŋ tɛŋ kosik zuk Jodan benni suŋsuŋ, alege ate Izirali demma meena a ate ku paari diipo, ate tɛŋka meena demma a cheŋ tɛŋ kosik zuk a taam jueli la.

Title: JOSUA 4
Content:
1Ase tɛŋka meena demma ale ga lo Jodan benni a jueli nueri la, Naawen a yaa weeni Josua ayen, 2<<Lueri nidoaba pi ale baye a ta nyini nuruma po, nuru yeŋ a nyini dɔk meena po, 3abe fi weeni ba ate ba pisi tintana kpiema pi ale ŋaye Jodan benni suŋsuŋ kauk kuui ate kaabteerɔma a za la a ta ŋa a cheŋ kauk kuui ate ni a ni boro yokku de la.>>
4Ate Josua yaa wi nidoaba pi ale bayewa ate wa lueri a ta nyini Izirali demma po, nuru yeŋ a nyini dɔk meena po, 5a yaa weeni ba ayen, << Ni ŋman cheŋ Naawen ni Wenni nɔiyeŋka dakanni niŋ Jodan benni suŋsuŋ. Nuru yeŋ meena a pai tintain a vi wa ŋmankpaluk zuk a ta va chaab ale Izirali buuni ale soa diila. 6Ate dila ale teeri nuruma chum po dii ate Wen a jam nye la. Ase ni bisaŋa a dan bek ni ayen tintain kpiemaŋa de kiri ale boa, 7ate nama ale weeni ba ayen Jodan benni nyiamu ale jam chali a taam la a jam gebiri kama, diipo ate ba jam ji Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a siŋ di po la. Jodan benni nyiamu a jam gebiri kama. Tintanaŋa de a yaa ŋa a teeri Izirali demma ka dila wie taam wuu.>>
8Izirali demma a yaa nye dii ate Josua a weeni ba la. Ba jam pai ka tintain kpiema pi ale ŋaye Jodan benni suŋsuŋ a magsi chaab ale Izirali buuni ale ka diila, ase Naawen ale weeni Josua diila. Ba jam ji ŋa kama ta cheŋ ba boka jigini a ga dueni. 9Josua mɛ a jam pai ka tintain kpiema pi ale ŋaye Jodan benni po kauk kuui ate kaabteerɔma nɔiyeŋka dakanni a za la. Tintain kpiemaŋa de a dem boro kama a paari jinla.
10Kaabteerɔma baai ale jam ji dakanni la a jam za ka Jodan benni suŋsuŋ, ate nuruma a nye dii meena ate Naawen a weeni Josua, ase Moosis ale sak Josua ayen wa nye diila. Nuruma a jam nye ka nwuli a lo jueli. 11Ase ba meena ale ga lo jueli a ga nueri la, Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni ale kaabteerɔma a yaa cheŋ kauk kunkula, alege ate nuruma a nya di. 12Aruben ale Gad ale Manasa dɔkku geli nidoama a jam lo jueli, a gomsi badek a magsi a dɛ Izirali demma niŋ ase Moosis ale sak ba diila. 13Nuruba ale jam paari tusa pisinaansi (40,000) a gomsi badek a magsi kpaliŋ Naawen niŋ a lo jueli Jeriko tɛŋka po.
14Da dila danni Naawen a jam pak Josua kama Izirali demma nimbie po, ate ba yaa jam a zuli wa ase ba le jam a zuli Moosis diila.
15Ate Naawen a yaa weeni Josua ayen, 16<<Basi ate kaabteerɔma baai ale ji Nɔiyeŋka dakanni la a nyini Jodan benni po a jueli.>>
17Ate Josua a yaa weeni kaabteerɔma ayen, <<Ni nyini Jodan benni po a jueli.>>
18Kaabteerɔma a yaa ji Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a nyini beni po a jueli. Ba le ga nyini nyiamu po a ga jueli la Jodan benni nyiamu a ŋman pilim sueri waaŋ a nyini ase bu le poom jam ka diila.
19Chiik kaai ale dɛ niŋka la ka daa piika danni nuruma yaa jam nyini Jodan benni a jueli a cheŋ a ga bo Gilgal tɛŋka ale bo Jeriko kori geŋsa la. 20Josua a yaa feri tintana pi ale ŋayewa ate ba pisi Jodan benni po la Gilgal po. 21Wa weeni Izirali demma ayen, <<Chum po ni ŋaaŋbisaŋa a dan bek ba koma ayen tintanaŋa de kiri ale boa, 22ni weeni ba ayen Izirali demma a jam cheŋ ka tɛŋ kosik zuk a lo Jodan benni a jueli. 23Ka Naawen ni Wenni ale basi ate Jodan benni a kpeeri ate ni lo jueli. Naawen ni Wenni a nye Jodan benni ase ka wa le jam nye ate Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku a kpeeri ate ti lo jueli diila. 24Wa nye kude kama ayen nuruma meena tɛŋka po a nya a bi ba seba ayen, Naawen nisaŋa a pagra kama, ate dila ale basi ate nama ale kasim a chali Naawen ni Wenni.>>

Title: JOSUA 5
Content:
1Ase Amori demma nalimaŋa meena baai ale jam bo Jodan benni yeniŋ geŋ la ale Keenan demma nalimaŋa meena baai ale jam kala moata nyakpiemu nɔi la, ale wom ayen Naawen a basi ate Jodan benni nyiamu a kpeeri alege ate tama Izirali demma a lo di jueli la ba kpaziita a yaa jam a nak ate ba nyiŋsaŋa mɛ a kpi nna mina mina.
2Va ŋala po Naawen a yaa weeni Josua ayen, <<Pa tintana a nye gebisa a gebi Izirali nidoama meena yoaŋa.>> 3Josua yaa nye tintana gebisa a yaa pai gebi Izirali nidoama meena yoaŋa tɛŋ kaai ate ba wi ayen Gibeat Yaaralot la po.
4Josua ale nye dila dii nyiŋla ale nna, baai meena ale jam nyini Ejipiti po a nyini la, kpaliŋ nyeerisaŋa meena a kpi ka gɔnni po ba le basi Ejipiti la ŋaaŋnyiŋ. 5Nidoama meena ale jam a nyini Ejipiti po a nyini la a gebi ba yoaŋa kama. Alege baai ate ba biak ŋaaŋnyiŋ la, diipo ate ba jam bo gɔi kosikka po a nyiem a cheŋ la an jam gebi ba yoaŋa. 6Izirali demma a jam bo gɔnni po cheŋ gilim a paari ka bena pisinaansi, ate ba nidoa baai meena ale jam chim tugurik tɔŋdɔba la a va nyini Ejipiti po a nyini la a kpi. Dii nyiŋla ba jam zɛri Naawen nɔi kama, ate Naawen a yaa pɛ ayen wa kan basi ate ba jo tɛŋ kaai ate wa puulim ale ba koma ayen wa pai a te ti la ka ka tɛŋ kaai ate biisim ale siita a bo ka po. 7Dila nyin la Josua a yaali gebi ba bisaŋa yoa gbantaŋa baai ate ba an diem jam gebi ba yoaŋa la ase ba ale jam bo suiku po a cheŋ tɛŋ kaai ate Naawen a puulim ayen wa ale pai a te ba la. Baai meena ale jam pak la wa jam gebi ba yoaŋa kama ate ba yaa zaani ba koma nankula po. 8Ase wa ale jam a gebi nidoama bunni meena yoaŋa la, Ba jam boka ba boka jigini ate ku paari diipo ate ba niraŋa a nueri la.
9Naawen a yaa weeni Josua ayen, <<Jinla mi a yeeri ni yɔntini ate ni jam bo di po Ejipiti la a basi kama.>> Ba yaa te jigi dila yuei ayen Gilgal, ba a wi ka ka dila a jam paari jinla.
10Ase Izirali demma ale jam tigsi chaab Gilgal tɛŋka ate ka bo Jeriko tɛŋka peelimmu po la, ba yaa dɛ ba Gaambasika Tigini chiik kaai ale piilim la ka da pi ale ŋanaansiwa danni junɔi. 11Gaambasika Tigini ŋaaŋnyiŋ, dai dila danni dek, ba jam dɛ ka tɛŋka ŋandiintaŋa gela, boroborok kuui ate ba an nyo dabinta du la, ale za seema. 12A zaani da dila danni a ta cheŋ wenŋmazuk ŋandiinta an ŋman lo ya. Izirali demma a yaa dɛ ka kpari ŋandiinta.
13Ase Josua ale moata Jeriko tɛŋka la, wa yaa zak zuk a nya ale nidoa a za wa niŋ ale gebik woŋ wa nisima po. Josua a yaa cheŋ wa jigi a yaa bek wa ayen, <<Fi bo ka tama po yaa fi bo ka ti dachaasaŋa po?>>
14Nidoawa a yaa tulisi ayen, <<Mi ka ni waai po. Mi ka Naawen Tugurik Tommu meena kpagi.>> Josua yaa domsi kali tɛŋ a zuli wa a weeni ayen, <<Ka boan wari ate mi nyɔnɔwa a ta a wa te wa tomteerɔwa?>>
15Naawen Tugurik Tommu kpagni a yaa tulisi wa ayen, << Yeeri fi nuensaŋa ate fi su la, ale fi ale za tɛŋ kaai zuk la ka tuilum tɛŋ.>> Ate Josua a nye di la.

Title: JOSUA 6
Content:
1Jeriko demma a jam lik ba tɛŋka nansuiŋtaŋa ka nna kpapi dii nyiŋla ba jam a chali ka Izirali demma yɔgsum. Ba jam kan siak ate nuru a jo tɛŋka po yaase nuru nyini ka po nyini.
2Alege Naawen a yaa weeni Josua ayen, <<M pai Jeriko tɛŋka ale ka naawa ale ka tugurik tɔŋdɔma meena a nyo fi nisima po. 3Fi ale fi tugurik tɔŋdɔma meena a cheŋ gilim tɛŋka bunyi dai yeŋ po. Ni nye dila ate ku paari daa ŋayuebi. 4Basi ate kaabteerɔba bayopɔi wanyi wanyi a pai damuniŋ a dɛ dakanni niŋ. Da dii danni ale a saari ŋayopɔiwa la ni cheŋ gilim tɛŋka ku nɔi buyopɔi abe kaabteerɔma a peeri damunsaŋa. 5Ni dan ga wom ale kaabteerɔma a peeri ba damunsaŋa yegayega basi ate nuruma meena a yaa kaari nna bɔgbɔg, tɛŋka parika a yaa le lo ate fi nuruma a yaa chali jo ka po a nak nuruma ale bo ka po la.>>
6Ate Nun nidoabinni Josua a yaa wi kaabteerɔma ate ba jam jigi yeŋ ale wa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni pai Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a yaa kaabteerɔba bayopɔi ate ba dɛ di niŋ ale damunsa.>> 7Ate wa yaa weeni nuruma ayen, <<Ni cheŋ gilim tɛŋka tugurik tɔŋdɔma le dɛ Naawen dakanni niŋ a dak suiku a sak ni.>>
8Josua ale biisi ale nuruma a ga nueri la kaabteerɔma bayopɔiwa yaa pai damunsa a dɛ Naawen dakanni niŋ a cheŋ a gilim tɛŋka ale a peeri ba damunsaŋa. Ate kaabteerɔ baai ale ji Naawen dakanni la a vi ba ŋaaŋ. 9Tugurik tɔŋdɔba ale jam dɛ kaabteerɔma baai ale jam ji dakanni la niŋ ate mba mɛ a bo di ŋaaŋ a vi alege te kaabteerɔma a kasim a peeri ba damunsaŋa. 10Josua yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Waai kan kaari, waai kan poom biisi mɛ. Mi dan kan te ni suik ayen ni kaari waai kan choa chiowa, ate mi yaa dan weeni ayen ni kaari, abe ni yaa kaari.>> 11Ba yaa pai Naawen dakanni a ji cheŋ gilim tɛŋka bunyi dekki ate waai meena a ŋman pilim cheŋ ba le diem bo juijui a goa la ayen ba goa.
12Josua a yaa yiti saluik yokyokwa da dindila danni a basi ate kaabteerɔma a ŋman ji Naawen dakanni. 13Kaabteerɔba bayopɔiwa baai ale ta damunsaŋa la a yaa dɛ Naawen dakanni niŋ a cheŋ ale a peeri ba damunsaŋa. Tugurik tɔŋdɔba ale jam dɛ kaabteerɔma baai ale ta damunsaŋa la niŋ a cheŋ alege ate mba me a bo ŋaaŋ a vi di. Dila powa meena kaabteerɔma a kasim a jam a peeri ba damunsaŋa kama. 14Dai dila danni dek ba cheŋ gilim tɛŋka ka bunyi ale ŋman pilim cheŋ ba goomu jigini. Ba jam a nye ka dila a ga paari daa ŋayuebi.
15Daa ŋayopɔiwa danni Izirali demma a yaa yiti saluik yokyokwa a cheŋ gilim tɛŋka ase ba ale jam a nye diila. Alege da dila danni ba yaa cheŋ gilim ka ku nɔi buyopɔi. 16Ba ale cheŋ gilim dii a saari buyopɔiwa la, kaabteerɔma a yaa peeri ba damunsaŋa yegayega ate Josua a yaa weeni nuruma ayen, <<Ni kaari. Ale Naawen a pai tɛŋka a nyo ka ni nisima po. 17Ni kaasi tɛŋka ale ka jaab meena ale ka Naawen ale soa ba meena. Alege ni basi Arayab waai ale ka taabuk la ale wa yenni demma meena dii nyiŋla wa jam pai nuru baai ale jam ba kpesi nya tɛŋka la a suk kama ate ba an ko bo. 18Ni kan pai ŋan baai ate ni ale kaasi la a tara, dii nyiŋla ba ka Naawen ŋanta. Waai a dan zɛri alege pai jaab wa ta ka kaasuŋ a cheŋ wadek zuk ale Izirali bisaŋa meena zuk. 19Jaabuui meena ate ba pai kpana ale ligmɔniŋ ale kutuk mɔnta ale kutuk a nye la ka tuilum ŋanta a te Naawen. Waai a dan pai bala wa ta jam ate ti pai a dueni jigi maŋ a te Naawen.>>
20Nuruma ale ga wom damunsaŋa peeri ka la, ba yaa kaari nna zigzig, ate Jeriko tɛŋka parika ale se gilim ka la a yaa deri lo meena a paari tɛŋ. Izirali bisaŋa a yaa deri chali jo tɛŋka po a nak nuruma a vari ka. 21Ba jam kaasi jaab meena kama ka po nidoaba ale nipooba ale paalisa ale nisɔm ale niiga ale piisa ale bonsa jaab meena ba jam kaasi kama.
22Josua yaa weeni barinyarɔma bayema ate wa jam tom la ayen, <<Ni cheŋ taabuka yenni a ga ta wa ale wa yenni demma meena a jam ase ni le puulim dii ale wa la.>> 23Nidoa paalukku bayema a yaa cheŋ a ga ta Arayab ale wa kowa ale wa mawa ale wa toama ale wa yenni demma meena ale bo le wa la a jam. Ba yaa ta ba a cheŋ jigi yeŋ ate ku moata Izirali bisaŋa dek ale diem jaa goa juijui la ate nuruba a kan daani ba.
24Izirali bisaŋa a yaa ju tɛŋka ale ka jaab meena ka ŋan baai nyini ate ba jam pai kpana ale ligmɔniŋ ale kutuk kuui ale a nyaliŋ la ale kuta ŋantaŋa ale ba jam pai a ta ga dueni Naawen yenni po. Juijui ate jaab a kan baga a daani ba la. 25Josua yaa jam pai Arayab ale wa koyeni demma meena a basi. Wa an jam ko ba dii nyiŋla wa le jam tom ate ba cheŋ Jeriko a suk la nyiŋ. Wa ale wa dɔkku a jam bo ale ka Izirali bisaŋa a jam paari jinla.
26Va ŋala po Josua a jam pɛ a basi Jeriko tɛŋka nyiŋ ayen, <<Naawen ka te waai ale nye wa popola ayen wa ŋman se Jeriko tɛŋka la. Dai dii danni ate wa a piilim ka nyubini la wa bikpagni kpi. Wa ale a su tɛŋka nansuiŋtaŋa dai dii danni la wa nisa po biika me kpi.>>
27Naawen a yaa jam bo ale Josua ate wa yuei a yiti tɛŋ kala meena po.

Title: JOSUA 7
Content:
1Alege Izirali bisaŋa a ta va ŋan baai ale kan magsi ayen ba pai ba la. Achan ate wa kowa a jam chim Karmi la ate Zabdi a chim wa ko kpieŋ ate ba nyini Zera. Juda dɔkku ale la. Ate Naawen sui yaa jam puuri ale ba.
2Josua yaa jam tom nuruba ate ba nyini Jeriko a cheŋ Ai tɛŋka kaai ale moata Bet Aven ate ka bo Betel kori geŋsa la a yaa weeni ba ayen. <<Ni cheŋ a ga kpesi nya tɛŋka.>> Ate nuruma yaa cheŋ ga kpesi nya Ai tɛŋka.
3Ase ba ale ŋman cheŋ Josua jigi la ba yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Daa nuruma meena ale magsi ayen ba cheŋ a ga kpaliŋ ale Ai tɛŋka. Basi ate nuruba tusa ŋaye (2,000) yaase tusa ŋata (3,000) a ga tuesi ka. Kan daani fidek a basi ate nuruma meena a cheŋŋi, ale ka nuruba maga dega ale bo ka po.>> 4Nuruba tusa ŋata (3,000) ale jam cheŋ alege ate Ai demma a jam basi ate ba pilim ŋmani. 5Ba jam ko ka Izirali bisaŋa po ka nuruba pisita ale bayuebi. Ba jam vi Izirali bisaŋa ka dila ate nyini ba tɛŋka nansuiŋku a ta ga va kauk kuui ate ba num tintanaŋa la a churinti a siŋ a ga ko ba dula jigini ate Izirali demma kpaziim yaa jam a nak.
6Josua yaa cheeri wa kɔlimaŋa ale lo tɛŋ Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni niŋ a doa dula a ta ga paari wenbalinni. Izirali nisɔmma mɛ a jam nye ka di la dekdega ale nye paasuk a basi ba zuimaŋa po. 7Ate Josua yaa weeni ayen, <<Aa! Nyɔnɔwa waai ale ka Naawen la, ka boa ale soa ate fi ta nuruma de a lo Jodan benni a jueli ayen fi pai ti a nyo Amori demma nisima po ate ba kaasi ti? Tama a dan poom bo Jodan benni kauk kunkula ku ti le zunchoŋŋa. 8Nyɔnɔ, mi a yaa ayen m weeni ayen ka boa, yɔgyɔgla de dachaasaŋa ale vi Izirali ate ba chali la? 9Keenan ale nuru mbala tɛŋka po ale wom di la ate ba ale jam gilim ti a basi suŋsuŋ a ko ti ate tama yuei a kan ŋman bo tɛŋka po fi ale nye fi yuei kpienni ka sɛ?>>
10Naawen a yaa weeni Josua ayen, <<Yiti zaani fi pai fi ninaŋa a vuk tɛŋ a nye ka boa? 11Izirali demma nye ka biem ba zɛri m nɔiyeŋka ate nye ale ba la kama, dii ate mi a weeni ba ayen ba tara la. Ba pai ŋan baai ale kan magsi ayen ba pai la kama, ba zu kama ale ŋman velim mɛ ba pai ba a gum ka badek ŋantaŋa po. 12Dila ale soa ate Izirali demma a kan baga a zaani ale ba dachaasaŋa la. Ba viriŋ ba ŋaaŋ a chali dii nyiŋla ba seba ayen ba ale ko ba kama. Mi a kan ŋman bo ale ni ka nama a nin kaasi ŋan baai ale magsi ni kaasi ba la.
13Cheŋ ga gaari nuruma a magsi, weeni ba ayen ba gaari badek a magsi chum ale Naawen, Izirali Wenni ale weeni diila ale nna, <<Ŋan baai ale kan magsi ayen ni ta la a bo ni po kama, Izirali demma, ni kan baga a zaani ale ni dachaasaŋa ka nama a nin yeeri ba ni po.
14<<Saluik buuri meena zaani di beŋ di beŋ. Buui dii ate Naawen a lueri la a jam niŋ yeri zuk yeri zuk. Yeri zuk kuui ate Naawen a lueri la a jam niŋ dɔk ku buuri dɔk ku buuri; ate dɔk buuri dii ate Naawen a lueri la nuru yeŋ meena a jam niŋ. 15Waai ate ti le yik ale ŋanta baai ale kan daa wa ŋanta la ti ale ju wa ale bolim ale ŋan baai meena ate wa soa la. Wa zɛri Naawen nɔiyeŋka kama alege ta chivie a jam Izirali po.>>
16Dai dii ale pai a saŋ la saluik yokyokwa Josua a basi ate Izirali dɔkku a jam niŋ ate ba lueri Juda dɔkku. 17Juda ŋaaŋbisaŋa meena a jam niŋ, ate wa yeeri Zera dɔkku. Zera dɔkku ale jam la ba ŋman yeeri ka Zimri. 18Josua a yaa basi ate wa dɔkku po yeri meena nidoa a jam niŋ. Ate Achan, ale ka Karmi biika. Karmi Zimri biika. Zimri Zera biika, Zera biika ate wa nyini Juda dɔkku po la a jam.
19Josua a yaa weeni wa ayen m biiga pai pimpauk a te Naawen, Izirali Wenni. Weeni mu fi ale nye diila. Kan suk di m jigi ya.
20Achan yaa tulisa ayen, <<Ka wensie mi nyeka biem a kaasi Naawen, Izirali Wenni. Mi abe le nye diila ale nna. 21Ase mi ale nya ŋantaŋa po la m nyaka Sinar tɛŋka garuk ate ku nala ale kpana ale paari kobsiye ale ligmɔniŋ ate ka dobrimu a dan magsi bu paari pisinu. Ate mi a yaa pai ba. Mi a tu ŋa a gu ka m viuku tɛŋ.>>
22Ate Josua a yaa tom nuruba ate ba chali a jo wa viuku po a nya ale ŋa bo dula wa jam pai ŋa a suk kama wa viuku tɛŋ. 23Ba yaa yeeri ŋantaŋa a ta nyini viuku po a nyini a yaa ta ba a jam Josua ale Izirali demma meena niŋ a pai ba a dueni Naawen niŋ.
24Ate Josua ale Izirali demma meena a gum chaab a yik Achan Zera biika ale kpanaŋa ale garukku ale ligmɔniŋka ale wa bisaŋa ale wa liema ale wa niiŋa ale wa bonsaŋa ale wa piisaŋa ale ŋan baai meena ate wa ta la a ta ba cheŋ Akor Viaka po. 25Ate Josua a yaa bek wa ayen, <<Ka boa ate fi ta kaasuŋ kude a jam ti jigi ya? Naawen ale ta wari a jam fi jigi jinla de.>> A ta Izirali demma meena a yaa yuk wa ale tana a ko, ase ba le yuk naŋta mbala a ko la ŋaaŋnyiŋ ba yaa ju ba ale bolim. 26Achan zuk ba jam tigsi ka pina a ji wa ate ŋa diem boro a ta pai jinla de. Ate Naawen suinni a yaa yɔk. Dila nyiŋ ba a wi dula ayen ka Akor Viak.

Title: JOSUA 8
Content:
1Ate Naawen a yaa weeni Josua ayen, <<Kan chali yɔgsummoa. Kan basi ate fi nyiŋka mɛ a gɔgi. Basi ate tugurik tommu meena ale fu a cheŋ a ga nye kpaliŋ ale Ai tɛŋka. Dii nyiŋla m pai Ai naawa ale wa nuruma ale wa tɛŋka a nyo ka ni nisima po. 2Ku a magsi kama ayen fi nye Ai ale ka naawa ase fi ale nye Jeriko ale ka naawa diila abe ni pai ba ŋantaŋa ale ba duŋsaŋa a tanla. Ni suk a paari ate ni baga a nye dila.>>
3Ate Josua ale tugurik tommu meena a yaa cheŋ a ga nye kpaliŋ ale Ai tɛŋka demma. Wa jam lueri ka tugurik tɔŋdɔba tusa pisita (30,000) ate ba cheŋ yok, 4ale wa wieŋa de ayen, <<Ni wom nalimnyiini, ku a magsi kama ayen ni suk a moata tɛŋka. Ni kan yalima ale ka. Ni meena ni gomsi a magsi. 5Mi ale baai meena ale bo dela ale mu la ale dɛ niŋ a jo tɛŋka po ate nuruma a yaa dan jam ba nye kpaliŋ ale ti ase ba le liŋ jam nye diila, ti le yiti chali abe te basi ba, ase ba le nya ale tama a chali la. 6Ba yaa le chali a vi ti ate tama ale ta ba a cheŋ niŋniŋŋa, ba le weeni ayen ba le la yiti a chali. 7Nama mɛ a yaa basi ni le suk a doa kauk kuui la a jo tɛŋka po. Naawen ni Wenni dek ale pai tɛŋka a nyo ni nisima po. 8Ase ni dan tuesi tɛŋka a ga nueri ni ju ka ale bolim. Ni nye dii ate Naawen a weeni la. Ni ŋmasi kpesi a tara m wieŋa.>>
9Ate Josua a yaa basi ate ba cheŋ a ga suk doa Betel ale Ai suŋsuŋka po a limisi, ba jam boka Ai tɛŋka yeniŋ geŋsa alege ate Josua jam bo ale nuruma yokku meena.
10Vari ale veenti la saluik yokyokwa, Josua a sak nuruma ate wa ale Izirali niŋdeerɔma a dɛ nuruma niŋ ate ba cheŋ Ai tɛŋka. 11Tugurik tommu meena ale jam bo ale wa la a yaa jam cheŋ tɛŋka po. Ba jam ga boka Ai wiilukku geŋsa ate viak kpieŋ a bo ba ale tɛŋka suŋsuŋ. 12Josua a jam lueri ka nuruba ate ba a paari ase tusa ŋanu (5,000) la ate ba ga suk doa Betel ale Ai suŋsuŋka po Ai yeniŋ geŋsa. 13Tugurik tɔŋdɔma meena jam boka ba le magsi ba bo kauk kuui la. Baai ale jam bo yeri la a bo tɛŋka yeseoku geŋ ale baai ale suk bo gɔnni po la a bo tɛŋka yeniŋ geŋsa. Yok kula Josua a yaa jam cheŋŋi viaka po.
14Ase Ai naawa ale jam nya kude la, wa ale wa nuruma meena a yaa nye nwuli a basi ba tɛŋka ale nyini saluik yokyokwa ayen ba ga tu chaab ale Izirali demma nye kpaliŋ kauk kuui ale moata Araba la. Wa jam zɛ ayen nuruba a suk doa ayen ba jo ba tɛŋka po. 15Josua ale Izirali demma meena a yaa jam basi badek ate ba a chali ŋmani a jo gɔnni po. 16Ba yaa jam wi Ai nuruma meena ate ba nyini a vi ba. Ba jam vi Josua ale wa nuruma a ta nyini tɛŋka po a nyini. 17Nuru a jam tali a wari Ai yaase Betel tɛŋsaŋa po an nyini peelim a vi Izirali demma. Ba meena a jam basi ba tɛŋka kama alege a saŋ Izirali demma ŋaaŋ.
18Ate Naawen a yaa weeni Josua ayen, <<Yik fi gbaluku ale bo fi nisimaŋa po la ale mi ale pai tɛŋka a nyo ka fi nisa po.>> Josua a yaa pari wa dachoruku a cheŋ Ai tɛŋka. 19Ase wa le ga nye dela a ga nueri la, nuru baai ale jam suk doa la a yaa jam nye nwuli a jo tɛŋka po. Ba jam jo ka po kama a tuesi ka ale ju ka ale bolim.
20Ate Ai demma a yaa cheem nya ba ŋaaŋ ale nyuisa ale kasim nyini tɛŋka po a jueli chiŋmaaŋa po ale ge ba a jam baga a chali va sui yoŋ a bɛ. Dii nyiŋla Izirali demma baai ale chali a jo gɔnni po la a pilim ŋmani kama a tu chaab ale baai ale a vi ba la. 21Ase Josua ale Izirali demma meena ale nya ale baai ale jam suk doa a moata tɛŋka la a nak yik Ai tɛŋka ale ju ka ale bolim ate nyuisaŋ a yiti ka po la, ba yaa viriŋ a nye kpaliŋ ale Ai demma. 22Baai ale jam suk a doa la me a yaa nyini tɛŋka po a tu ba suik ate ba gilim ba a basi suŋsuŋ. Izirali demma jam ko ba meena kama. 23Alege ba jam ta Ai Naawa ka vuta a ga te Josua.
24Ase Izirali demma ale jam ko Ai nuru baai meena ale nyini ba nye kpaliŋka ale ba gɔnni po la a ga nueri la, ba le togri waai meena la, Izirali demma meena a yaa ŋman jo Ai tɛŋka po a ko nuru baai meena ale tali bo ka po la. 25Ba jam ko ka nidoaba ale nipooba tusa pi ale ŋaye (12,000) dai dila danni. Ai demma meena ba jam ko ba kama. 26Josua an jam pai wa gbaluku a dueni tɛŋa a ta ga paari diipo ate wa jam ko baai meena ale jam bo Ai tɛŋka po la. 27Izirali demma a jam yik ka ba duŋsaŋa ale ba ŋan baai ate ba ta la a tara ase Naawen ale jam weeni ba diila.
28Josua a jam ju Ai tɛŋka kama ale bolim ate ka chim guuk a ta jam paari jinla danni. 29Wa jam pai Ai naawa a yik ka tiib nyiŋ ate wa yiga dula jigini a ta ga paari wenbalinni. Wenni ale siŋ la Josua a yaa weeni ate ba pai wa nyiŋka a ta nyini tiimu zuk a ga dueni tɛŋka nansuiŋku nɔi. Ba jam pai ka pina a vi ka zuk ate ku doa a paari jinla danni.
30Josua yaa jam sɛ kuŋkuŋ Ebal Guuku zuk ate Naawen, Izirali Wenni, 31Ase Naawen tomteerɔwa Moosis ale jam weeni Izirali demma diila. Wa jam sɛ ku kama a ta va chaab ale dii ale ŋmarisi a bo Moosis Sinsaŋŋa gbaŋka po la. Tintana nyini ate ba pai a sɛ ku ba an jam pai kuta a maa nye ya. Ba yaa jam nye juka kaabka a te Naawen a dueni tintana zuk ale nye suiyɔgni tiirita kaabka. 32Dula jigini Izirali demma niŋ ate Josua yaa ŋmarisi Moosis sinsaŋŋa a dueni tintana zuk. 33Izirali demma meena ale nichamma ale ba nisɔmma ale kpaŋŋa ale baai ale a bo buusa la a jam za ka Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni gana ate ba ninaŋa a bo kaabteerɔma ale Livaima baai ale ji di la geŋsa. Nuruma gela a jam za kama a pai ba ŋaaŋ te Gerizim Guuku ba gela mɛ za a pai ba ŋaaŋ a te Ebal Guuku, Naawen tomteerɔwa Moosis ale jam weeni ba ayen ba nye dila ase ku nin paari diipo ale magsi ba tuesi niaka la.
34Dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ ate Josua a kariŋ Sinsaŋŋa wieŋa meena a ta va niaka ale kikaasa ase ku le ŋmarisi dii Sinsaŋŋa gbaŋka po la. 35Wie ŋaai meena ate Moosis a jam weeni Josua la, wa jam an tali dinyi mɛ la a basi ya. Wa jam kariŋa kama ate Izirali demma tigsuŋku meena. Nipooma ale bisaŋa ale nichamma ale baai meena ale jam gum ba po la a jam wom ŋa kama.

Title: JOSUA 9
Content:
1Yɔgyɔgla de ase nalima ŋaai meena ale bo Jodan benni yeniŋ geŋsa la ale jam wom wie ŋaai ale jam nye tɛŋ sii ale bo guutaŋa zuk la ale dii ale nye tɛŋ sii ale bo Nyakpiemu nɔi la a ta ga paari Lebanon tɛŋka la. Nalimaŋa de jam ka Yit demma ale Amori demma ale Keenan demma ale Perizzi demma ale Yivi demma ale Jebus demma nalimaŋa, 2Ba meena a yaa jam jigi yeŋ ayen ba nye kpaliŋ ale Josua ale Izirali demma.
3Ase Gibeon demma ale ga wom dii ate Josua a nye Jeriko ale Ai tɛŋsaŋa la, 4Ba yaa poli ayen ba paasi ba. Ba yaa cheŋ ga yaali ŋandiinta a yaa ji ale ba bonsaŋa ale boorik kpagsa ale daam bunlɔk kpagsa ate ba laŋ ti. 5Nuruma a jam su nuesi kpagsa ale jo garuk tii ale cheeri la mɛ. Ŋandiin tii meena ate ba jam ta la a jam ko kama alege koali mɛ. 6Ba yaa jam cheŋ Josua jigi Gilgal tɛŋka po a weeni wa ale Izirali demma ayen, <<Tama a nyini ka tɛŋ kaai ale yalima bi nye nɔiyeŋ ale ti.>>
7Izirali demma a yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Dai dii dai nama a kala moata tama kama ka boan nyiŋ ate ti a nye nɔiyeŋ ale ni?>> 8<<Tama ka ni tomteerɔba>> ba ale weeni Josua diila ni la. Alege Josua a yaa bek ba ayen, <<Nama ka bana nama abe nyini ka be?>> 9Ba yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ni tomteerɔma a nyini ka tɛŋ kaai ale yaalima dii nyiŋla ti wom ayen Naawen ni Wenni wie kama. Tama wom wa le nye dii Ejipiti tɛŋka po la kama, 10ale dii meena ate wa nye Amori demma nalima ŋayewa ale jam bo Jodan benni kori geŋsa la. Ba jam ka naab Siyon ate wa nyini Yesbon la ale naab Og ate wa mɛ a nyini Basan la waai ale jam a nya Astarot la. 11Ate tama niŋdeerɔma ale baai meena ale bo ti tɛŋka po la yaa weeni ti ayen, <Ti pai ŋanta a ga tu ba suik a weeni ba ayen, <<Tama ka ni tomteerɔba. Ni nye nɔiyeŋ ale ti.>> > 12Ŋandiintaŋa de a kaasi ka suiku po a zaani dai dii danni ate tama a nyini yeeri a cheena nama jigi la. Alege m yɔgla de ni be nya ti le koi ale koali diila. 13Leŋsaŋa de diipo ate ti pai daamu a nyo si po la si jam nala kama, alege nya si le na diila. Ate ti kɔlimaŋa ale ti nuensaŋa a cheeri ti le bo chelimu po ate ku beni la nyiŋ.>> 14Izirali demma a yaa tuesi ŋandiintaŋa alege an beki Naawen a nya ya. 15Josua a yaa jam nye suiyɔgni nɔiyeŋ ale ba ayen ba boro alege ate niŋdeerɔma me a yaa nye pɛka ayen ba le ta nɔiyeŋka ale ba.
16Ase ba ale ga nye nɔiyeŋka ale ba a ga nueri la ŋaaŋnyiŋ ku daa ŋata dai Izirali demma a yaa wom ayen ba jam kala moata ba kama. 17Ate Izirali demma a yaa nyini a paari tɛŋsaŋa daa ŋata dai. Tɛŋ sila abe le Gibeon ale Kefira ale Beerot ale Kiriat Jearim. 18Alege Izirali demma an jam nye kpaliŋ ale ba dii nyiŋla niŋdeerɔma a jam nyeka pɛka ale Naawen, Izirali Wenni nyiŋ. Tigsuŋku meena sui a yaa kaasi ale niŋdeerɔma ale nye diila, 19alege ate niŋdeerɔma meena a yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ti nyeka pɛka ale Naawen, Izirali Wenni yuenni nyin ti kan baga a tiri ba m yɔgla de. 20Ti le ti nye ba diila ale nna. Ti le basi ate ba boro ate suipuurum a kan jam tama jigi ya ayen ti le kan va pɛka ate ti nye ale ba la nyiŋŋa.>> 21Ba ŋman weeni gum du ayen, <<Ni basi ba ate ba boro bi ni basi ate ba chim dacheerisa ale nyiaŋadisa ate tigsuŋku meena.>> Niŋdeerɔma ale puulim dii ale ba la a sum jam nye kama.
22Josua a yaa weeni Gibeon demma ayen ka boa ate ni paasi ti ayen, <<Tama a yalima kama ale ni,>> alege a kala moata tama? 23Ni yaa boka kikaasa po. Ni le kasim ka dacheerisa ale nyiaŋadisa mi Wen yenni po. 24Ba yaa tulisi Josua ayen, <<Ku jo fi tomteerɔma tue kama dii ate Naawen ni Wenni a weeni ayen wa tomteerɔwa Moosis ayen wa le pai tɛŋka meena ate ni abe wa yiak ba meena ate ba yaa jigi abe ba te ni suik la. Dila nyiŋ tama yaa jam a chali yɔgsum ti nyuvooŋa nyiŋ dila ale soa ate ti nye dila. 25Tama yaa boka fi nisima po. Bi nye ti dii ale nala ate fi la.>> 26Ate Josua a yaa maari ba ate Izirali demma an jam ko ba. 27Dai dila danni wa yaa basi ate Gibeon demma a chim dacheerisa ale nyiaŋadisa ate Izirali demma meena Naawen kuŋkuŋku kauk kuui ate Naawen ale lueri la. Ba abe le ka dii a ta jam paari jinla dɛ la abe le la.

Title: JOSUA 10
Content:
1Adoni Zedek, Jerusalem naawa ale wom ayen Josua a nak yik Ai tɛŋka ale kaasi ka meena alege a nye Ai ale ka naawa ase wa le jam nye Jeriko ale ka naawa diila ate Gibeon demma me a nye nɔiyeŋ ale Izirali demma ale bo ale ba la. 2Wa ale wa nuruma nyiŋsa a yaa jam a gɔk dii nyiŋla Gibeon jam ka tɛŋ maŋ ase tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa kanyi la, ka jam zuak gaam Ai tɛŋka kama ate ka nuruma meena a seba kpaliŋ nyeka. 3Adoni Zedek Jerusalem naawa ayen weeni Yebron naawa Yoyam ale Jarmut naawa Piram ale Lachis naawa Jafia ale Eglon naawa Debir ayen, 4<<Ba jam maari wa ate wa nye kpaliŋ ale Gibeon demma, dii nyiŋla ba nyeka nɔiyeŋ ale Josua ale Izirali demma.>> 5Ate nalimaŋa de ŋanuwa ale nyini Amori demma tɛŋka ale la Jerusalem naawa ale Yebron naawa ale Jarmut naawa ale Lachis naawa ale Eglon naawa tugurik tɔŋdɔma a yaa gum chaab. Ba le ba tugurik tɔŋdɔma meena a yaa cheŋ ba nye kpaliŋ ale Gibeon tɛŋka.
6Ate Gibeon demma a yaa tom weeni Josua ale jam bo Gilgal ayen, <<Kan baŋ fi tomteerɔma wari ya. Jamu nwuli a vari ti a basi maari ti dii nyiŋla Amori demma nalimaŋa meena ale bo guutaŋa zuima la a gum ka chaab ayen ba nye kpaliŋ ale ti.>> 7Ate Josua ale wa tugurik tommu meena a yaa basi Gilgal a cheŋ ale nuru baai meena ale seba kpaliŋ nyeka la. 8Naawen a yaa weeni Josua ayen, <<Kan chali ba yɔgsummoa m pai ba a nyo fi nisima po kama. Ba wanyi mɛ la a kan baga a zaani ale fu.>> 9Josua yaa basi Gilgal ale cheŋ yokku meena a ga diiri ba. 10Naawen a yaa basi ate butimka a jam ba po ate Izirali demma a yaa nya pagrim ba zuk Gibeon tɛŋka po. Izirali demma a jam vi ba ka dila suik kuui ale a cheŋ Bet Yoron la po a yaa ga yik ba Azeka ale Makkeda tɛŋsaŋa po. 11Ase Izirali demma ale jam a vi ate ba chali va suiku a nyini Bet Yoron a cheŋ Azeka la, Naawen a yaa basi ate tintain kpiema a lo ba zuk. Tintain kpiemaŋa ale jam ko baai la a piisi gaam baai ate Izirali demma a jam ko la kama.
12Ase Izirali demma ale jam a vi ba nna kparikpari la, Josua a yaa puusi Naawen ate ku jueli ayen, <<Wenbinni a zaani jigi yeŋ Gibeon tɛŋka zuk abe chiika me a zaani Aijalon Viaka zuk.>> 13Ate wenbinni a za di kan cheŋŋi chiika me a za ate Izirali demma a nya pagrim ba dachaasaŋa zuk. Ase ku le ŋmarisi Jasar gbaŋka po la. Wenbinni a jam boka wenzuk suŋsuŋ chiŋmaaŋa po a beni ale siŋka ase dai pumi la. 14Dai a jam karo ase danni dɛ la alege ate kude a nye la. Dai mɛ abe ŋman karo ate wanni de choa a nye ya. Chekki ka Naawen ale jam kpaliŋ a te Izirali demma.
15Josua a yaa ŋman pilim cheŋ Gilgal tɛŋka.
16Nalima ŋanuwa de a jam chali a ga suk ka piuŋ vɔrup po Makkeda tɛŋka po. 17Ase Josua ale ga wom ayen nalima ŋanuwa de a jam suk ka piuŋ vɔrup ale jam bo Makkeda tɛŋka po la, 18wa yaa weeni ayen, <<Ni bilim piuŋ kpioŋ a lik vɔrumu nɔnni abe ni basi nuruba gela ate ba a limisi bu. 19Alege ni kan basi ni dachaasaŋa vika, ni yik ba suik ni kan basi ate ba paari ba tɛŋsaŋa ale Naawen ni Wenni a pai ba a nyoka ni nisima po.>> 20Josua ale Izirali demma a jam ko ka ba yega ka ba magadek nyiini ale jam chali paari ba tɛŋsaŋa po. 21Ate tugurik tommu meena a yaa jam pilim ŋmani nalimnyiini a cheŋ. Josua ale jam bo Makkeda tɛŋka la jigi.
22Josua a weeni ba ayen, <<Ni lagri vɔrumu nɔnni abe ni ta nalima ŋanuwa a jam te mu.>> 23Ba yaa jam ta nalima ŋanuwa a nyini vɔrumu po a nyini. Ba be jam ka Jerusalem ale Yebron ale Yarmuk ale Lachis ale Eglon nalimaŋa. 24Ase ba le ta nalimaŋa de a jam Josua jigi la, wa yaa tigsi Izirali demma meena ale weeni tugurik tommu kpaŋŋa baai ale jam va wa a jam la ayen, <<Ba jam de, ni pai ni naŋsaŋa a tabi nalimaŋa de ŋeeŋa.>> Ba yaa jam niŋ nyiŋ a tabi ba ŋeeŋa. 25Josua a yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni kan chali yɔgsummoa. Ni kan jɔk nyiŋbiiri. Ni pagra abe ni chiib a zaani. Naawen ale wa nye dii ale dachaasa meena ate ni a kpaliŋ ale ba la ale la.>> 26Josua yaa ko nalima ŋanuwa a pari ba nyiŋsaŋa a yik tiisa sinu nyiŋ, ate ba yik tiisaŋa nyiŋ a ta ga paari wenbalinni. 27Vari ale ga veenti la Josua yaa basi ate ba yaa ta ba nyini tiisaŋa zuk a siŋ tɛŋ a pai ba nyo vɔrup buui po ate ba liŋ suk bu po la. Piuŋ kpioŋ ate ba ba jam pa lik vɔrumu nɔnni, ku diem lik du kama a ta jam paari jinla de.
28Dai dila danni Josua a jam nak yik Makkeda kama. Wa jam togri tɛŋka naawa kama ale ko waai meena ale bo ka po la. Wa an jam tali nuru a basi ya. Wa jam nye Makkeda naawa ase ka wa le jam nye Jeriko naawa diila.
29Josua ale Izirali demma meena a yaa basi Makkeda tɛŋka alege cheŋ Libna tɛŋka a ga nye kpaliŋ ale ba. 30Naawen a jam pai tɛŋ kala ale ka naawa mɛ a nyo Izirali demma nisima po kama. Nuru baai meena ale jam bo tɛŋka po la Josua a jam tɔgri ba kama. Wa an jam tali nuru vuk a basi du. Wa jam nye tɛŋ kala naawa mɛ ase ka wa le jam nye Jeriko naawa diila.
31Ate Josua ale Izirali demma meena a yaa ŋman basi Libna alege cheŋ Lachis tɛŋka, a nye kpaliŋ ale ka me. 32Naawen a jam pai Lachis tɛŋka a te Izirali demma kama ate Josua a nak yik ka daa ŋayewa danni. Tɛŋka demma meena wa jam ko ba kama ase wa le jam nye Libna tɛŋka diila.
33Alege Gezer naawa Yoram a jan jam kama ayen wa maari Lachis alege Josua a jam nak yik ba kama ale ba tugurik tommu nuru vuk a jam tali ya.
34Ate Josua ale Izirali demma meena a yaa jam basi Lachis ale cheŋ Eglon tɛŋka a nye kpaliŋ ale ba. 35Ba jam nak yik ba ka dai dila danni dek a tɔgri ba meena ase ba le nye Lachis tɛŋka diila.
36Josua ale Izirali demma meena a yaa jam nyini Eglon tɛŋka ale ŋman cheŋ ga nye kpaliŋ ale Yebron tɛŋka. 37Ba jam nak yik tɛŋka kama a tɔgri nuruma ale ka naawa ale tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa meena nuruma. Ba tali nuru vuk a basi ya. Ase ba le jam nye Eglon diila, ba jam ko waai meena tɛŋ kala po kama.
38Josua ale Izirali demma meena a yaa ŋman viriŋ a nye kpaliŋ ale Debir tɛŋka. 39Ba jam nya pagrim tɛŋka ale ka naawa ale tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa meena zuk kama ale tɔgri ba meena. Ba jam ko waai meena kama. Ba an jam tali javuk a basi ya. Ba nye Debir tɛŋka ale ka naawa ase ka ba le jam nye Libna ale Yebron tɛŋsaŋa ale si nalimaŋa diila.
40Josua ale wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma a yaa jam nak yik tɛŋsaŋa meena ale nalim ŋaai meena ale jam bo tɛŋ sii ale bo guutaŋa zuima ale vaasaŋa po ale tɛŋ sii meena ale bo guutaŋa chaasa la. Ba jam ko nuru meena kama ase Naawen, Izirali Wenni ale weeni ayen ba nye diila. 41Josua a jam tɔgri ba ka dila a nyini Kades Barnea a ga paari Gaza ale ŋman zaani Gosen a tɔgri dila a ta ga paari Gibeon tɛŋka. 42Nalimaŋa de ale ŋa tɛŋsaŋa Josua a jam nak yik si ka vayeŋ po dii nyiŋla Naawen, Izirali Wenni ale jam kpaliŋ te ba. 43Kpaliŋka ale nueri la ŋaaŋnyiŋ Josua ale Izirali demma meena a yaa ŋman pilim cheŋ Gilgal tɛŋka.

Title: JOSUA 11
Content:
1Ase Yazor naawa Jabin ale ga wom kude la wa yaa tom weeni Madon naawa Jobab ale Simron naawa ale Aksap naawa 2ale nalima ŋaai ale bo wiilukku geŋsa guutaŋa zuima la ale Araba ate ka bo Kinneret yeniŋ geŋsa la ale yeniŋ tɛŋsaŋa meena 3ale Keenan demma ale bo kori ale yeniŋ geŋsa la a ta ga paari Amori demma ale Yit demma ale Perizzi demma ale Jebus demma tɛŋsaŋa ale bo guutaŋa zuima la ale Yivi demma ale bo Yermon ate ka bo Mizpa tɛŋka po la. 4Ba jam nyini ka meena ale ba tugurik tommu ale wusuma ale torokoba a piisi nna ase beli tintain busuŋ la. 5Nalimaŋa de meena a jam tigsi ka chaab Merom Benni geŋsa ayen ba nye kpaliŋ ale Izirali demma.
6Naawen a yaa weeni Josua ayen, <<Kan fi a chali ba yɔgsummoa, dii nyiŋla chum nna po de m le pai ba meena a nyo Izirali demma nisima po. Ni tuesi ba wusumaŋa abe ni ju ba torokoma ale bolim.>>
7Josua ale wa tugurik tommu meena a yaa jam Merom Benni a nye kpaliŋ ale ba, 8ate Naawen a yaa pai ba a nyo Izirali demma nisima po. Ba jam vi ba ka dila a ga nya pagrim ba meena zuk Saidon ale Misrefot ale Maim tɛŋsaŋa ale viak kaai ale bo Mizpa tɛŋka kori geŋsa la. Ba an jam tali nuru ate wa vua. 9Josua a yaa nye ba ase Naawen ale weeni wa nye dii a. Ba jam wɛ wusuma naŋsaŋa kama ale a ju torokoma ale bolim.
10Va ŋala po mɛ Josua a ŋmani ŋaaŋ a nye kpaliŋ ale Yazor tɛŋka a ko ka naawa, Yazor ale jam chim tɛŋsaŋa de meena tɛŋ kpieŋ. 11Ba jam tɔgri nuru meena kama. Ba dim bola jam kaasi ba kama. Jaabuui meena ale a vuusi la ba jam ko kama alege ju Yazor tɛŋka ale bolim.
12Josua a jam yik tɛŋsaŋa de nalimaŋa meena a tɔgri ba ase Naawen tomteerɔwa Moosis ale weeni diila. 13Izirali demma an jam ju tɛŋ sii ale bo guutaŋa zuk la ka Yazor nyiini ate Josua a jam ju. 14Izirali demma a yaa jam pai ŋan baai meena ate ba ta la ale ba duŋsaŋa meena tɛŋka po a tara, alege a tɔgri nuruma meena, ba an jam tali waai ate wa vua. 15Ase Naawen ale weeni wa tomteerɔwa Moosis la, Moosis mɛ a jam weeni Josua ka dila ate Josua a nye di; wa an jam tali dii meena ate Naawen a weeni Moosis la a basi ya.
16Josua a jam tuesi tɛŋka de meena kama, tɛŋ kaai ale bo guuku zuk la ale Negev meena ale Gosen tɛŋka meena ale tɛŋ sii ale bo yeniŋ la ale Araba ale Izirali guutaŋa zuima meena, 17A nyini Yalak Guuku kauk kuui ale moata Seir a bo Baal Gad, Lebanon Viaka po Yermon Guuku chiak. Wa jam nak yik ba nalimaŋa meena kama a ko ba. 18Josua a jam nyeka kpaliŋ ale nalimaŋa de meena kama ate ku beni. 19Ka Yivi demma ale jam bo Gibeon la, ale jam nye suiyɔgni nɔiyeŋ ale Izirali demma, baai ale jam diiri ba kpaliŋka po la. 20Ka Naawen dek ale basi ate ba suiniima a pagra ate ba nye kpaliŋ ale Izirali demma dii le ku nye ate wa ko ba meena ase Naawen ale weeni Moosis diila.
21A nyini va ŋala po Josua a jam ga kaasi Anak tɛŋka ale bo guuku zuk la; a nyini Yebron ale Debir ale Anab a ta nyini tɛŋ sii meena ale bo guuku zuk Izirali ale Juda tɛŋsaŋa po la. Josua a jam kaasi ba kama ale ba tɛŋsaŋa meena 22Anak demma waai an jam tali bo Izirali tɛŋsaŋa po ka Gaza nyiini, Gat ale Asdod demma wanyi mɛ la an jam vua. 23Josua a yaa jam tuesi tɛŋka meena ase Naawen ale jam weeni Moosis diila. Wa jam pai ka kama ate Izirali demma ate ba tara a magsi chaab ale ba buuni ale ka diila ate tɛŋka a yaa vuusi ale kpaliŋ.

Title: JOSUA 12
Content:
1Nalimaŋa de ka baai ate Izirali demma a jam nya pagrim ba zuk ale tuesi ba tɛŋsaŋa ale Jodan benni kori geŋsa la, a nyini Arnon Buboalika a ta ga va Yermon Guuku a ta ga va Araba ale bo kori geŋsa la meena.
2Siyon Amori demma naawa waai ale jam a nya Yesbon tɛŋka la jam a nya kama a nyini Aroer ale bo Arnon Buboalika la a ta va Jabbok Benaŋka kaai ale nye bain ale Ammon demma tɛŋka la. Gilead tɛŋka geli a jam gum du kama. 3Wa ŋman jam nya ka Araba ale bo kori geŋsa a moata nyakpiemu la a ta ga paari Araba beli dii ate yisiŋa a bo di po la a ta ga paari Bet Jesimot a ta ga churinti a siŋ Pisga ale bo yeseoku la.
4Naab Og ale nyini Basan la ate wa chim Arefa biik baaŋ la waai ale jam ka naab Astarot ale Edrei tɛŋsaŋa po la. 5Wa jam a nya ka tɛŋ sii meena ale bo Yermon Guuku jigini la, Saleka a ga va Basan a ga nye bain ale Gesur ale Maaka ale Gilead tɛŋka kauk ale ŋman nye bain ale naab Siyon tɛŋka Yesbon.
6Naawen tomteerɔwa Moosis ale Izirali demma a jam nak yik ba kama. Ate Naawen tomteerɔwa Moosis a yaa pai ba tɛŋka ate Aruben ale Gad ale Manasa dɔkku geli ayen ba tanla.
7Nalimaŋa de ate Josua ale Izirali demma a jam nak yik ba Jodan benni yeniŋ geŋsa la. A zaani Baal Gad ale bo Lebanon Viaka la a ta ga va Yalak Guuku, kuui ale moata Seir la. Bala tɛŋka Josua a pai te ka Izirali demma ayen ba tara ase ba dɔkku ale ka diila. 8Tɛŋ sii ale bo guuku zuk yeniŋ geŋsa la Araba baai ale bo guuku zuk la ale tintain busuŋ tɛŋsaŋa Yit demma ale Amori demma ale Keenan demma ale Perizzi demma ale Yivi demma ale Jebus demma, 9nalimaŋa tɛŋsaŋa, Jeriko naawa ale Ai ate ka moata Betel la naawa ale 10Jerusalem naawa ale Yebron naawa ale 11Jarmut naawa ale Lachis naawa ale 12Eglon naawa ale Gezer naawa ale 13Debir naawa ale Geder naawa ale 14Yorma naawa ale Arad naawa ale 15Libna naawa ale Adullam naawa ale 16Makkeda naawa ale Betel naawa ale 17Tappua naawa ale Yefer naawa ale 18Afek naawa ale Lasaron naawa ale 19Madon naawa ale Yazor naawa ale 20Simron naawa Meron ale Aksap naawa ale 21Taanak naawa ale Megiddo naawa ale 22Kedes naawa ale Jokneam naawa ate ka bo Karmel la, ale 23Dor naawa ale bo Nafot Dor po la, ale Goyim naawa ale bo Gilgal po la, ale 24Tirza naawa. Ba jam ka nalima pisita ale wanyi.

Title: JOSUA 13
Content:
1Ase Josua ale jam kpaŋ ate wa benaŋa mɛ a piisi la, Naawen a yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Fi kpaŋ kama alege tɛŋka a diem zuak kama a magsi ni tuesi. 2Tɛŋ sii ale tali la ale nna: Filistia ale Gesur demma tɛŋsaŋa 3a zaani Siyor Benaŋka ale Ejipiti kori geŋsa la a ta ga paari Ekron ale bo yeseoku geŋsa la. Ba wi dula meena ayen ka Keenan dem. Filistia tɛŋsa sinuwa ale jam a nya du la meena tɛŋ sila abe le Gaza ale Asdod ale Askelon ale Gat ale Ekron tɛŋsaŋa ale bo Avvi demma la. 4A nyini sagi geŋsaŋa tɛŋka meena ale bo Keenan la a ta nyini Afek Amori demma tɛŋka 5ale Lebanon tɛŋka meena ale bo kori geŋ la a ta nyini Baal Gad ale bo Yermon Guuku chiak la a ta ga paari Lebo Yamat tɛŋka.
6<<Alege tɛŋ sii meena ale bo guutaŋa zuk la a ta nyini Lebanon a ta ga paari Misrefot Maim, di la a bi le Saidon kabini meena ka mi dek ale m yiak ate ba nyini ate Izirali demma. Bi seba ate fi pai tɛŋka a te Izirali demma ase m le weeni fu diila, 7abe fi labi ka a chari diina neokku ale Manasa dɔkku ale poori a maa bo dula la.>>
8Manasa dɔkku ale teeri la Aruben ale Gad diina a jam tuesi ka kauk kuui ate Moosis a jam pai te ba ate ku bo Jodan benni kori geŋsa la, ase wa Naawen tomteerɔ ale te ba dula.
9Ku lagri ka dila a ta nyini Aroer ale bo Arnon Buboalika geŋsa la ale ŋman nyini tɛŋ kaai ale bo suŋsuŋsaŋa po la a maa pai guuk labsiku ale bo Medeba la, a ta ga Dibon 10ale tɛŋ sii meena ale bo Naab Siyon tɛŋka a ti ba a wi ayen Amori demma la, waai ale jam a nya Yesbon a ta ga paari Ammon demma tɛŋka banni. 11Gilead a jam maa gum du kama ale Gesur nuruma ale Maaka ale Yermon Guuku geŋsa meena ale Basan a ta ga paari Saleka meena. 12Dula abe le Og ale bo Basan tɛŋka la meena. Wa ka waai mɛ ale jam a nya Astarot ale Edrei ale ŋman chim Aruben dɔkku po waai ale wari ŋaaŋ a diem vua a boro. Moosis a jam nak yik ba kama ale tuesi ba tɛŋka. 13Alege Izirali demma an jam yiak Gesur ale Maaka a basi ya, ate ba yaa bo ale Izirali demma a ta jam paari jinla danni.
14Alege Livai dɔkku wa an jam te ba jigi ya, ase ba le jam pai ka bolim a nye kaabka tiirim a te Naawen, Izirali Wenni la, dila ale ba ŋanta ase wa le puulim ba la.
15Dii ate Moosis a te Aruben ŋaaŋbisaŋa yezuk meena la ale nna.
16A zaani Aroer a ta ga va Arnon Buboalika, a ta ga va tɛŋ kaai ale bo suŋsuŋka po tɛŋsaŋa ale guuk labsiku ale bo Medeba la meena, 17a ga pai Yesbon ale ka tɛŋsaŋa meena ale bo guuk labsiku zuk la ale Dibon ale Bamot Baal ale Bet Baal Meon ale 18Jayaz ale Kedemot ale Mefaat ale 19Kiriataim ale Sibma ale Zeret ale Sayar ale bo guuku zuk ale viaka po me la, ale 20Bet Peor a siŋ Pisga ale Bet Jesimot ale 21tɛŋ sii meena ale bo guuk labsiku zuk la ale Naab Siyon ale jam bo Amori demma tɛŋka la, waai ale jam a nya Yesbon la. Moosis a jam nak yik wa ale Midian naawa kama. Evi ale Arekem ale Zur ale Yur ale Areba nabisaŋa a yaa jam nye nɔiyeŋ ale Siyon waai ale jam bo tɛŋka po la. 22Ale baai ale kpi kpaliŋka po la, Izirali demma a jam ko Balaam Biio nidoabinni waai ale jam a porisi la kama. 23Aruben tɛŋka bani a jam kpeglimka Jodan benni nɔi. Tɛŋsaŋa de ale si tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa ka Aruben ale wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale soa.
24Dii ate Moosis a jam te Gad ŋaaŋbisaŋa la ale nna: 25Jazer tɛŋka ale tɛŋ sii meena ale bo Gilead ale Ammon tɛŋka geli, a ta ga paari Aroer ate ka moata Arabba la, 26ale ŋman nyini Yesbon a cheŋ Aramat Mizpa ale Betonim, a zaani Mayanaim a cheŋ Debir tɛŋka, 27Viaka po mɛ ka Bet Yaram, ale Bet Nimra ale Sukkot ale Zafon ale Naab Siyon ale bo Yesbon tɛŋka ale bo Jodan benni ale bo kori geŋsa la meena kauk kuui meena ale moata Kinneret Nyakpiemu la. 28Tɛŋsaŋa de ale si tɛŋ fiisaŋa ka Gad dɔkku ale jam soa.
29Dii ate Moosis a jam te Manasa dɔkku kauk ale jam tali la ale nna. Dɔkku kauk ale Manasa dɔkku yeri zuk yeri zuk.
30Tɛŋka bani a jam nyinika Mayanaim a pai Basan tɛŋka meena a gum du, Naab Og ale bo Basan ale Jair ale bo Basan la meena ale ka tɛŋsa pisiyuebi wa, 31Gilead tɛŋka geli ale Astarot ale Edrei, Naab Og ale bo Basan la tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa ale la. Si dɛ a jam ka Makir ate wa kowa a chiim Manasa la. Tɛŋka geli ka Makir Manasa biika ale jam soa.
32Moosis ale jam labi tɛŋka dii Jodan benni kori geŋsa kauk kuui ate nuruma a jam boro a yaali ba gaam taam Jeriko tɛŋka la. 33Alege Moosis an jam te Livai dɔkku teŋŋa ase wa le jam a biisi dii ale ba la. Naawen, Izirali Wen a jam le ba tiirim. Wala a jam le waai ate ba a yaali la. Wa le nya ba zuk suita po meena.

Title: JOSUA 14
Content:
1Kabtaŋa de ale Izirali demma a jam soa Keenan tɛŋka po. Ka Eleaza kaabteerɔwa ale Nun nidoabinni Josua ale Izirali yeeŋa nyama ale te ba. 2Ba jam nak ka gbaŋ ate buura bunaansi ale genni de a lueri ba tɛŋsaŋa ase Naawen ale weeni Moosis diila. 3Moosis a poom ŋaam pai tɛŋka ale bo Jodan benni kori geŋsa la a te ka buura ŋaye ale genni ale tali la ase ba tiirim la alege Livaima wa an jam te ba jaaboa. 4Dii nyiŋla Josefi bisaŋa a jam labi ka buye ale geli, Manasa ale Ɛfraim ale la.
