Moosis an jam te Livaima tɛŋsaŋa jaab ka tɛŋka nyiini ate wa jam te ba ayen ba boro ale ba duŋsaŋa. 5Izirali demma a jam labi tɛŋka a te chaab ase ka Naawen ale weeni Moosis ayen ba nye diila.
6Dai yen ate nuruba gela a nyini Juda tɛŋka a jam Josua jigi Gilgal tɛŋka po. Ba po wanyi jam le Jefunne nidoabinni Kaleb Kenizzi denɔwa a yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Fi seba kama Kades Barnea tɛŋka po Naawen a jam weeni ka fi ale mi wie a sak Wen nuruwa Moosis. 7Mi jam ta ka bena pisinaansi alege ate Naawen tomteerɔwa Moosis a tom mu ayen m basi Kades Barnea abe m ga kpesi nya tɛŋka la. M jam taka wa maŋ a jam weeni wa. 8Nuru baai ale jam va mi cheŋ la a gonti nye kama ate nuruma a chali yɔgsum. Alege mi a jam wom Naawen m Wenni kama. 9Ase mi ale nye dila la, Moosis a yaa puulim ayen mi ale m bisaŋa ale nya ti dɛka jigini tɛŋ kaai po ate m boro a cheŋ la taam wuu, dii nyiŋla fi va Naawen mi Wenni ale ka fi suinum meena.
10<<Ni be nya yɔgyɔgla de ku yaa paari ka bena pisinaansi ale ŋanu ate Naawen a weeni Moosis diila. Ka diipo ate Izirali demma a jam bo gɔnni po a cheŋ la, ate Naawen a basi ate m vua ase wa le puulim dii ale mu la. Ni abe zak nya mi m ta ka bena pinaanuŋ ale ŋanu. 11Alege jinla de m diem pagra kama ase m le jam ka dii ate Moosis a tom mu la. Mi diem pagra kama a baga a nye kpaliŋ yaase wa dii meena. 12Yɔgyɔgla de be te mu tɛŋ kaai ale bo guuku zuk ate Naawen a puulim dai dila danni ayen wa le pai ka a te mu ase mi ale jam weeni fu tɛŋka wie la. Tama a weeni fu kama ayen tɛŋ kala demma ka ganduata ale bo ba tɛŋka po a se parik woŋ a gilim ka. Ba jam ka Anak bisa. Dai dii dai Naawen ale bo ale mu ate m yiak ba ate ba nyini tɛŋka po a nyini ase Naawen ale weeni diila.>>
13Josua yaa jam niak Jefunne nidoabinni Kaleb ale te wa Yebron tɛŋka. 14Yebron tɛŋka diem boka Kaleb Jefunne denɔwa ŋaaŋbisaŋa nisima po dii nyiŋla wa jam va Naawen, Izirali Wenni ka nalimnyiini. 15Alege ate kude meena a nye la, Yebron yuei a jam le Kiriat Arba. Arba a jam le Anak demma tɛŋ kpieŋ. Suiyɔgni a yaa le jam bo tɛŋka po.

Title: JOSUA 15
Content:
1Juda dɔkku ale jam bo tɛŋka kabi tii la ale nna: A nyini yeseoku geŋsa tɛŋka a doa a ta ga paari ka Zin Sagi a ta ga nye bain ale Edom tɛŋka.
2Tɛŋka de a jam doa ka dila a ta ga paari Yesa Nyakpiemu, 3a zaani Akrabbim a gilim taam paari Zin. A zaani Kades Barnea a ta ga paari Ayeziron ale Addar a ta cheŋ Karka, 4a ŋman zaani Azmon a va buboalika a nye bain ale Ejipiti beli a ga paari Nyakpiemu la, banni ale kpeglim juijui la a ni la. Bain dii ale bo Juda yeseoku geŋsa la a ni la.
5Kori geŋsa tɛŋ banni jam boka Yesa Nyakpiemu a ga paari Jodan benni nyiamu chali a siŋ du la. Yeseoku me tɛŋ banni a nyini ka dula, 6a ga va Bet Yogla pimpitiŋku ale bo Jodan viaka jigini la. A ŋman zaani a va Boyan Piuŋku. Boyan jam ka Aruben nidoabili. 7Tɛŋbain dii Debir la a taam ga va ka Achor Viaka a ta ga paari Gilgal tɛŋka kauk kuui ale tuk Adummim buboalika nyiŋla. Ka jam va ka dula a ga paari En Sɛmes a taam ga nyini En Arogel. 8A ga va Ben Yinnom Viaka kauk kuui ate Jebus demma tɛŋka Jerusalem a jam bo la. Tɛŋka bani a jam ga va ka guuku zuk yeniŋ geŋsa Yinnom Viaka ale va yeseoku geŋsa me a cheŋ Arefaim Viaka. 9A zaani dula bani a jam cheŋ paari ka Neftoa belaŋa ale tɛŋ sii ale moata Efron guuku la a yaa ba cheŋ Baalaya yaase, Kiriat Jearim. 10A ŋman nyini Baalaya yeniŋ geŋsa a cheŋ Edom tɛŋka ale bo guuku zuk la, a ŋman zaani yeseoku a duŋ Jearim yaase, Kesalon Guuku a siŋ Bet Sɛmes a ga paari Timnaya. 11Tɛŋ banni a ŋman zaan dula Ekron guuku ale bo yeseoku la, a viriŋ va Baalaya Guuku a ta ga paari Jabneel. Tɛŋ banni a jam kpeglim ka nyakpiemu.
12Kuui ale chim yeniŋka ban. Dula jigini me ale Juda dɔkku a boro la Kaleb a nak yik Yebron ale Debir tɛŋsaŋa
13Ase Naawen ale weeni Josua diila, Juda tɛŋka kauk ba jam pai te ka Kaleb Jefunne biika, wa jam tuesi ka Yebron tɛŋka. Yebron yuei a jam le Kiriat Arba. Anak a jam le ba ko. 14Kaleb a jam yiak Anak ŋaaŋbisaŋa kama ate ba nyini tɛŋka po a nyini. Ba buuni abe le Sesai ale Ayiman ale Talmai. 15A nyini dula wa yaa ŋman cheŋ ga nye kpaliŋ ale nuru baai ale bo Debir tɛŋka po la. Tɛŋka dɛ ba jam a wi ka ayen ka Kiriat Sefer. 16Kaleb a weeni ayen, <<Mi ale pai m liewa Aksa a yalisi nuru waai ale a nya pagrim Kiriat Sefer tɛŋka zuk la.>> 17Kenaz nidoabinni Otniel, Kaleb yuawa a yaa nak yik ka, ate Kaleb a pai wa liewa Aksa a yalisi wa.
18Yalika danni Otniel a yaa weeni liewa ayen wa bek wa kowa ate wa te wa tɛŋ. Wa yaa nyini wa bonika zuk a siŋ, ate Kaleb a yaa bek wa ayen, <<Ka boa ate fi a yaali?>> 19Ate liewa a tulisi ayen, <<Sak jiirim ale mu, ase fi ale te mu tɛŋ Negev po la, bu te mu bulik kaai ale ta nyiam la mɛ.>> Kaleb yaa te wa bulik sii ale bo pimpitini zuk ale viaka po la.
20Tɛŋ sii ate Juda dɔkku a jam so a ale nna.
21Tɛŋ sii ale yalima a bo sagi geŋsa ate ba soa ate si moata Edom la ale nna Kabzeel ale Eder ale Jagur, 22ale Kina ale Dimona ale Adada 23ale Kedes ale Yazor ale Itnan 24ale Zif ale Telem ale Bealot 25ale Yazor Yadatta ale Keriot Ayeziron, yaase Yazor 26ale Amam ale Sɛma ale Molada 27m sila me ale Yazar Gadda ale Yesmon ale Bet Pelet 28ale Yazar Sual ale Beerseba ale Biziotia 29ale Baalaya ale Iim a ga pai Ezem 30ale Eltolad ale Kesil ale Yorma 31ale Ziklag ale Madmanna ale Sansanna 32ale Lebaot ale Silyim ale Ain ale Arimmon. Si le tɛŋ sii meena ale jam kala moata si la meena a jam gum chaab a paari ka tɛŋsa pisiye ale neok.
33Tɛŋ sii ale bo guuku zuk la ale nna. Estaol ale Zoraya ale Asna 34ale Zanoaya ale En Gannim ale Tappua ale Enam 35ale Jarmut ale Adullam ale Soko ale Azeka 36ale Saaraim ale Aditaim ale Gedera, yaase Gederotaim. Si jam ka tɛŋsa pi ale sinaansi a gum chaab ale sii ale kala moata ba la.
37Nsila me ale Zenan ale Yadasa ale Migdal Gad 38ale Dilean ale Mizpa ale Jokteel 39ale Lachis ale Bozkat ale Eglon 40ale Kabbon ale Lamas ale Kitlis 41ale Gederot ale Bet Dagon ale Naama ale Makkeda. Si meena a jam gum chaab ale tɛŋ sii ale kala moata ba la a paari ka pi ale siyuebi.
42Si gela me ale Libna ale Eter ale Asan 43ale Ipta ale Asna ale Nezib 44ale Keila ale Akzib ale Maresa. Sila me a jam ka tɛŋsa neok a gum chaab ale tɛŋ sii ale kala moata ba la.
45Ekron ale ka tɛŋ fiiksaŋa 46ale tɛŋ sii meena ale moata Asdod a ta nyini Ekron a ta ga paari nyakpiemu. 47Asdod ale Gaza ale ba tɛŋ fiiksaŋa me a jam kala paari ka buboali kaai ale moata Ejipiti la a cheŋ nyakpiemu nɔi.
48Guuku zuk tɛŋsaŋa ale Samir ale Jattir ale Soko 49ale Dannaya ale Kiriat Sannaya, yaase Debir, 50ale Anab ale Estemo ale Anim. 51Gosen ale Yolon a yaa pai Gilo a gum du a nye tɛŋsa pi ale kanyi ale tɛŋ fiik sii meena ale kala moata ba la.
52Nsila me abe le Arab ale Duma ale Esan 53ale Janim ale Bet Tappua ale Afeka 54ale Yumta ale Kiriat Arba, yaase Yebron, ale Zior. Si ka tɛŋsa neok a gum chaab ale tɛŋ sii ale kali moata ba la.
55Si gela me ale Maon ale Karmel ale Zif ale Jutta 56ale Jezreel ale Jokdeam ale Zanoaya 57ale Keen ale Gibea ale Timnaya. Si me a jam ka tɛŋsa pi ale gu chaab ale tɛŋ sii ale kali moata ba la.
58Si chaab me ale Yalyul ale Bet Zur ale Gedor 59ale Maarat ale Bet Anot ale Eltekon. Tɛŋsa siyuebi ale si me a gum chaab ale tɛŋ fiik sii ale kala moata ba la.
60Kiriat Baal, yaase Kiriat Jearim, ale Arabba, tɛŋ kpiensa siye ale si tɛŋ kpaŋsa a gilim ba.
61Gɔnni po me tɛŋsaŋa ale Bet Araba ale Middin ale Sekaka 62ale Nibsan ale tɛŋ kaai ale ta yesaŋa la ale En Gedi. Si me ka siyuebi a gum chaab ale tɛŋ sii ale kala gilim ba la.
63Alege Juda demma an jam baga a yiak ate Jebus demma baai ale bo Jerusalem po la a nyini ya. Jebus demma a diem boro ale Juda demma kama.

Title: JOSUA 16
Content:
1Josefi charuku a piilim nyini ka Jodan ale bo Jeriko la, Jeriko nyaataŋa kori geŋsa a nyini dula a cheŋ gɔnni po a jo Betel tɛŋka ate guuta a bo ka po la. 2A zaani Betel a ga paari Luz tɛŋka a ga va Atarot Addar Arki demma tɛŋsaŋa, 3a churinti a siŋ Jaflet demma tɛŋsaŋa yeniŋ geŋsa a ta a siŋ Bet Yoron tɛŋka. Ale ŋman nyini Gezer a ga kpeglim Nyakpiemu.
4Josefi ŋaaŋbisaŋa Ɛfraim ale Manasa dɔkku ale bo yeniŋ geŋ la a jam tuesi tɛŋka de kama a tara. 5Ɛfraim dɔkku ale jam bo kabi tii la ale nna: Ba tɛŋka bani a jam nyinika Atarot Addar tɛŋka kori geŋsa a jueli va Bet Yoron tɛŋka. 6A zaani dula a cheŋ nyakpiemu. Mikmetat a ale bo Wiilukku geŋsa la, di viriŋ kori geŋsa a ga paari Taanat Siilo tɛŋka a va di tɛŋ a cheŋ Janoa ale bo kori geŋ la. 7A nyini Janoa a ga va Atarot ale Naaraya a taam paari Jeriko a yaa ga kpeglim Jodan benni. 8Tɛŋka banni a nyini Tappua yeniŋ geŋsa a ga va Kanaya Vooliŋka a yaa ga kpeglim Nyakpiemu. Tɛŋka de ale ba jam pai te Ɛfraim dɔkku yezuk yezuk ate ba tara. 9Di jam maa gum chaab ale ka tɛŋ fiik sii ale maa bo Manasa tɛŋka po la alege Ɛfraim demma a soa si la.
10Alege ba an jam a yiak Keenan demma baai ale jam bo Gezer la ate ba nyini ya, ate Keenan demma a bo ale Ɛfraim demma a paari jinla de, Ɛfraim demma jam fɛ ba kama ate ba a tom fifiok tuima.

Title: JOSUA 17
Content:
1Kude a jam le charuk a te Manasa ase Josefi bikpagi la, dila abe le Makir, Manasa bikpagni a soa. Makir jam ka Gilead demma ko kpieŋ, baai ale jam tuesi Gilead ale Basan la dii nyiŋla, Makir demma jam ka tugurik tɔŋdɔ kpienta. 2Dila charuku de jam ka Manasa nuru mbala ale soa, yezuimaŋa ale Abiezer ale Yelek ale Asriel ale Sikiim ale Yefer ale Sɛmida. Manasa, Josefi nidoabinni ŋaaŋbisa ba chaama ale jam ka nidoabilisa la yezuimaŋa ale nna.
3Manasa nidoabinni Makir ate wa mɛ nidoabili a chim Gilead la, ate wa mɛ nidoabili a chim Yefer la te wa mɛ nidoabili a chim Zelofehad la. Zelofehad wade a jam ka nidoabilisa ka lieba nyiini, ba yue jam le Mala ale Nowa ale Yogla ale Milka ale Tirza. 4Liema de yaa jam cheŋ kaabteerɔwa Eleaza ale Josua Nun nidoabinni ale niŋdeerɔma jigi a weeni ba ayen, <<Naawen a weeni Moosis kama ayen wa te tama mɛ nitalim ate tama a tanla ase wa le te nidoama nitalim diila.>> Ase Naawen ale jam weeni diila ba mɛ a jam nya nitalim kama ase nidoama la. 5Manasa charuku jam ka tɛŋsa pi a gum chaab ale Gilead ale Basan Jodan benni kori geŋka la, 6dii nyiŋla Manasa dɔkku liema a tuesi nitalim kama a ta nyini nidoabilisaŋa po. Gilead tɛŋka jam ka Manasa ŋaaŋbi sinsila ale soa.
7Manasa jigini a jam paari ka Asɛ ale Mikmetat Sikiim kori geŋsa. Tɛŋ banni yaa va yeseok geŋsa a ga paari nuru baai ale bo En Tappua la a gum du. 8Manasa ale jam soa Tappua tɛŋka, alege Tappua dek ale jam bo Manasa tɛŋ banni po la ka Ɛfraim demma ale soa. 9Tɛŋka banni yaa va yeseok geŋ a ga paari Kanaya Vooliŋka. Tɛŋsa ale jam boro ate Ɛfraim a soa ate si bo Manasa tɛŋsaŋa suŋsuŋ, alege Manasa tɛŋ banni jam le vooliŋka Wiiluk geŋ a ga kpeglim Nyakpiemu nɔi. 10Yeseoku geŋ tɛŋka ka Ɛfraim ale soa, wiilukku geŋ ka Manasa ale soa. Manasa tɛŋka a jam paari ka nyakpiemu a nye bain ale Asɛ dɔkku wiiluk geŋ ale nye bain ale Isaka dɔkku kori geŋ.
11Isaka ale Asɛ po, Manasa a jam maa soa ka Bet San ale Ibleam ale nuruma ale bo Dor ale Endor ale Taanak ale Megiddo la a gum chaab ale ba tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa ale kali gilim ba la. Buta nyɔnɔwa a nyini Nafot po.
12Manasa demma an jam taari lik tɛŋsaŋa de, ate Keenan demma a diem bo dula. 13Alege Izirali demma ale ga nya pagrim la, ba yaa basi ate Keenan demma a tom fifiok tuima ale an yiak ba a basi ya.
14Josefi ŋaaŋbisaŋa yaa weeni Josua ayen, <<Ka boa ate fi a te tama charuk yeŋ ale nitalim yeŋ nyiini? Tama a piisi kama dii nyiŋla Naawen a niak ti kama nna yegayega.>> 15Josua a yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ase nama a dan piisi a te Ɛfraim tɛŋka ate guuta a bo ka po la a pɔsima a te ni, ni ga che peelim a te nidek Perizzi ale Arefa demma tɛŋsaŋa sagni po a tanla.>>
16Josefi ŋaaŋbisaŋa a yaa tulisi ayen, <<Tɛŋ kaai ate guutaŋa a bo ka po la an soa dii a te tama, Keenan demma meena baai ale bo Bet San ale ka tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa po la ale baai ale bo Jezreel Viaka po la a ta ka kuta torokoba.>>
17Alege Josua a yaa weeni Josefi yenni demma Ɛfraim ale Manasa ayen, <<Nama a piisi kama ale pagra. Ni kan ta charuk yeŋ dekki 18alege sagni tɛŋka kaai ate guutaŋa a bo ka po la ka nama ale ni soa. Ni che tiisaŋa meena ate ka le lagri a soa diila meena ka nama ale soa. Keenan demma a ta ka kuta torokoba ale pagra, nama baga a yiak ba kama.>>

Title: JOSUA 18
Content:
1Izirali tigsuŋku meena a jam tigsi Siilo tɛŋka a ti Tuka Viuku dula. Izirali demma a jam nya pagrim tɛŋka zuk kama 2alege Izirali buuni diina buyopɔi ale jam tali an diem nya charukwa.
3Dila Josua yaa weeni Izirali demma ayen, <<Nama a yaa ayen ni limisi a paari ka disa po a bi ni ga tuesi tɛŋ kaai ate Naawen ni koma Wenni a te ni la? 4Ni lueri nuruba bata a ta nyini dɔk meena po. Mi ale tom ba ate ba cheŋ ga kpesi nya tɛŋka abe ba ŋmarisi a magsi ka wie ale ka diila, a ta va waai meena charuk ale ka diila. Ba le ŋman pilim jam mi jigi. 5Nama ale labi tɛŋka ka buyopɔi. Juda ale wari ka wa tɛŋka yeseoku geŋsa abe Josefi yenni demma a bo ba tɛŋka wiilukku geŋsa. 6Ase ni dan ŋmarisi a magsi tɛŋka labika buyopɔiwa dɛ wie, dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ, ni ta ba a jam te mu ate m nak gbaŋ a te Naawen ti Wenni niŋ. 7Livaima a kan nya jigiya a nyini ni po, dii nyiŋla kaabteka tuini ate ba tom a te Naawen la ale ba charuku. Gad ale Aruben ale Manasa dɔkku geli a poom nya ba charuku ka Jodan benni kori geŋsa. Ka Moosis Naawen tomteerɔwa ale te ba.>>
8Ase nuruma ale piilim a bo ba suiku po ayen ba kpesi nya tɛŋka la, Josua a jam sak ba kama ayen, <<Ga kpesi nya tɛŋka a ŋmarisi a magsi ka wie, abe ni ŋman jam mi jigi, ate mi ale nak gbaŋsa dela Siilo po Naawen niŋ.>> 9Dila nuruma a yaa basi dula ale cheŋ tɛŋka meena. Ba jam ŋmarisi ka wie a basi ka gbaŋ po, tɛŋ kpieŋ meena wie ba jam ŋmarisi a paari ka buyopɔi ale ŋmani pilim cheŋ Josua jigi Siilo. 10Josua yaa nak gbaŋ Naawen niŋ, dula jigini wa yaa chari tɛŋka a te Izirali diinaŋa labka ale ka diila.
11Gbaŋka yaa jam lo Benjamin dɔkku, yezuk yezuk meena zuk. Ba charuku tɛŋka banni a jam bo ka Juda ale Josefi diinaŋa suŋsuŋka po.
12A nyini wiilukku geŋ tɛŋka banni a piilim nyini ka Jodan benni a churinti va Jeriko wiilukku geŋsa a ga va tɛŋ kaai ate guuta a bo ka po la yeniŋ geŋsa a ga paari Bet Aven gɔnni po. 13A nyini dula di jam va ka Luz a cheŋ Betel a ga va Atarot Addar guuku zuk yeseok geŋ a siŋ Bet Yoron.
14A nyini guuku ale tuk Bet Yoron la yeseoku geŋ tɛŋ banni a tulim va ka yeseok a cheŋ yeniŋ geŋ a ga vuri nyini Kiriat Baal yaase Kiriat Jearim. Ka de ka Juda demma tɛŋ. Kude a jam ka yeniŋ geŋsa.
15Yeseoku geŋsaŋa a piilim nyini ka Kiriat Jearim nakpiaka yeniŋ geŋ, ate tɛŋ banni a jam nyini bulik sii ale bo Neftoa tɛŋka la. 16Tɛŋ banni a va ka guuku zuk a tuk Bet Yinnom Viaka, Arefaim Viaka wiiluk geŋ. Di zaan dula a va ka Yinnom Viaka yeseok geŋsa Jebus tɛŋ kpieŋka a ga paari En Arogel. 17Di ŋman tulim wiilukku geŋ a va ka En Sɛmes a tom du a cheŋ Gelilot ale tuk Adummim la, a ga va Boyan Piuŋku jigini la. Boyan jam ka Aruben nidoabili. 18Di ga va ka wiilukku geŋ Bet Araba churinti a cheŋ Araba. 19Di jam ga va ka Bet Yogla wiilukku geŋsa churintika a jam nyini Yesa Nyakpiemu wiiluk geŋ, a ga kpeglim Jodan benni nɔi yeseoku geŋ. Kude a jam le yeseoku geŋsa tɛŋ banni.
20Jodan benni ale jam chim kori geŋsa tɛŋ banni. Ŋade a jam le tɛŋ banaŋa a labi Benjamin yezuimaŋa kabitaŋa meena la.
21Benjamin dɔkku yezuk yezuk ale jam soa tɛŋ sii la ale nna. Jeriko ale Bet Yogla ale Emek Keziz, 22ale Bet Araba ale Zemaraim ale Betel ale 23Avvim ale Para ale Ofra ale 24Kefar Ammoni ale Ofni ale Geba. Si jam ka tɛŋsa pi ale siye ale si tɛŋ kpaŋsa.
25Gibeon ale Arama ale Beerot ale 26Mizpa ale Kefira ale Mozaya ale 27Arekem ale Irpeel ale Tarala ale 28Zela ale Ya Elef ale Jebus demma tɛŋka Jerusalem ale Gibea ale Kiriat Jearim. Tɛŋsa pi ale sinaansi ale si tɛŋ kpaŋsa ale kala gilim ba. Si de a jam le Benjamin charuku a te wa yezuimaŋa.

Title: JOSUA 19
Content:
1Gbaŋsa buye po a jam lo ka Simeyon dɔkku yezuk yezuk zuk. Ba charuku a jam bo ka Juda tɛŋka po. 2Tɛŋsaŋa de abe jam gum du kama sila abe le Beerseba yaase Siiba ale Molada ale 3Yazar Sual ale Balaya ale Ezem ale 4Eltolad ale Betul ale Yorma ale 5Ziklag ale Bet Markabot ale Yazar Susaya 6ale Bet Lebaot ale Saruyen, tɛŋsa pi ale sita ale si tɛŋ kpaŋsa. 7Ain ale Arimmon ale Eter ale Asan si mɛ ka sinaansi ale si tɛŋ kpaŋsa. 8Side meena a gum chaab ale ka tɛŋ fi sii ale gilim ba la a ta ga paari Baalat Beer yaase Arama, ale bo Negev tɛŋka la. Side a jam le Simeyon dɔkku yezuk yezuk charuk la. 9Ba jam pai Simeyon demma charuku a ta nyini Juda charuku po kama dii nyiŋla, Juda charuku a poom zuak gaam ba ale a silim diila kama. Dila Simeyon demma a jam nya ba charuku a nyini ka Juda po.
10Gbaŋsa butawa a jam lo ka Zebulun dɔkku yezuk yezuk zuk. Ba tɛŋ banni charuku a jam cheŋ paarika Sarid. 11A cheŋ yeniŋ geŋ, di ga va ka Marala, a cheŋ Dabbeset a ta ti paari vooliŋ ale moata Jokneam la. 12Di viriŋ nyini Sarid kori geŋ a duŋ wenbinni pusika jigini a cheŋ Kislot Tabor a ga va Daberat a ga paari Jafia. 13Di ŋman nyini kori geŋsa a cheŋ Gat Yefer ale Et Kazin tɛŋsaŋa, di jam nyini ka Arimmon a viriŋ a duŋ Nea nyiŋ. 14A nyini dula tɛŋ banni a cheŋ gilim va ka wiilukku geŋsa a cheŋ Yannaton a ga kpeglim Ipta El Viaka. 15Tɛŋ sii ale jam maa gum du la ale nna. Kattat ale Nayalal ale Simron ale Idala ale Betiliyem. Si jam ka tɛŋ kpieŋsa pi ale siye ale si tɛŋ kpaŋsa. 16Tɛŋ kpieŋsa ale si tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa a jam le Zebulun dɔkku yezuk yezuk charuk.
17Gbaŋ Kaai ale saari bunaansiwa la a lo ka Isaka dɔkku yezuk yezuk zuk. 18Ba tɛŋsaŋa a jam maa gum ka side du, Jezreel ale Kesullot ale Sunem ale 19Yaparaim ale Siyion ale Anayarat ale 20Arabbit ale Kision ale Ebez ale 21Aremet ale En Gannim ale En Yadda ale Bet Pazzez. 22Tɛŋ banni a jam paari Tabor ale Sayazuma ale Bet Sɛmes a ga kpeglim Jodan benni. Si jam ka tɛŋ kpieŋsa pi ale siyuebi ale si tɛŋ kpaŋsa. 23Tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa de ale si tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa a jam ka charuk a te Isaka dɔkku yezuk yezuk.
24Bunuwa gbaŋka a jam lo ka Asɛ dɔkku yezuk yezuk zuk. 25Ba tɛŋsaŋa a jam maa gum ka si de du, Yelkat ale Ali ale Beten ale Aksap ale 26Alamelek ale Amad ale Misal. Yeniŋ geŋsa tɛŋ banni a cheŋ ka Karmel ale Siyor Libnat. 27Di yaa viriŋ kori geŋsa a duŋ Bet Dagon, a ga paari Zebulun dɔkku ale Ipta El Viaka, a cheŋ wiilukku geŋ a paari Bet Emek ale Neiel, a gaam Kabul basi gala. 28Di jam cheŋ ka Ebron ale Areyob ale Yammon ale Kanaya a ga paari Saidon. 29Tɛŋ banni a yaa viriŋ va ŋaaŋ a duŋ Arama nyiŋ a ga va Taaya tɛŋka ate pari pagrika a gilim la a viriŋ a duŋ Yosa nyiŋ a jam nyini nyakpiemu ale bo Akzib tɛŋ kpieŋka la, 30ale Umma ale Afek ale Areyob. Si jam ka tɛŋ kpieŋsa pisiye ale siye ale si tɛŋ kpaŋsa. 31Tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa de ale si tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa a jam ka charuk a te Asɛ dɔkku yezuk yezuk.
32Buyuebiwa gbaŋka a jam lo ka Nafitali dɔkku yezuk yezuk zuk. 33Ba tɛŋ banni a jam nyini ka Yelep ale tiib kpiemu ale bo Zaanannim la, a gaam Adami Nekeb ale Jabneel taam a ga paari Lakkum a ga kpeglim Jodan benni. 34Tɛŋ banni a jam va ka Aznot Tabor yeniŋ geŋ a jam nyini Yukkok. Di jam paari ka Zebulun dɔkku yeseok geŋsa, ate Asɛ dɔkku a bo yeniŋ geŋsa ate Jodan benni a bo kori geŋsa. 35Tɛŋ sii ate pari pagrisa a gilim si la ale Ziddim ale Zer ale Yammat ale Arakkat ale Kinneret 36ale Adama ale Arama ale 37Kedes ale Edrei ale En Yazor 38ale Iron ale Migdal El ale Yorem ale Bet Anat ale Bet Sɛmes. Si jam ka tɛŋ kpieŋsa pi ale neok ale si tɛŋ kpaŋsa. 39Tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa de ale si tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa a jam ka charuk a te Nafitali dɔkku yezuk yezuk.
40Buyopɔiwa gbaŋka a jam lo ka Dan dɔkku yezuk yezuk zuk. 41Ba charuku tɛŋsaŋa a jam maa gum ka side du, Zoraya ale Estaol ale Ir Sɛmes 42ale Saalabbin ale Aijalon ale Itla 43ale Elon ale Timnaya ale Ekron ale 44Elteke ale Gibbeton ale Baalat ale 45Jeyud ale Bene Berak ale Gat Arimmon ale 46Me Jarkon ale Arakkon, ale kabi dii ale tuk Jopa geŋsa la. 47Alege Dan dɔkku ku jam pagra kama a te ba ate ba tuesi ba charuku jigini, dila ba yaa jam nye kpaliŋ ale Lesem a tuesi ka, a ko ba ale bo ka po. Ba jam kali Lesem po kama ale te ka yuei ayen Dan. Ba kokpieŋka yuei a jam ni la. 48Tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa de ale si tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa a jam ka charuk a te Dan dɔkku yezuk yezuk.
49Ase ba le jam labi tɛŋka a ga nueri la, Izirali demma a yaa jam te Josua Nun nidoabinni mɛ wa charuk, 50ase Naawen ale jam weeni la. Ba jam te wa ka tɛŋ kaai ate wa bek la. Kala abe le Timnat Seraya ale bo Ɛfraim po ate guutaŋa a boro la. Ate wa jam se tɛŋ kpieŋ a kala dula.
51Tɛŋsaŋa de ale kaabteerɔwa Eleaza ale Josua Nun nidoabinni ale Izirali dɔkku yezuimaŋa nyama a jam nak gbaŋ Siilo tɛŋka Naawen niŋ, Tuka Viuku nansuiŋku nɔi la. Ba jam labi tɛŋka a te chaab a nueri kama.

Title: JOSUA 20
Content:
1Naawen a yaa weeni Josua ayen, 2<<Weeni Izirali demma ayen ba lueri tɛŋsa a magsi sukka jigi ase mi ale biisi a ta va Moosis zuk ate wa weeni fu diila, 3ate dila ale basi ate waai dan kan seba ale ko nuru, wa chali a ga suk dula ate kotundɔwa a kan baga a ko wa.
4<<Ase wa dan chali paari tɛŋ sila kanyi, wa a magsi ka wa zaani tɛŋka nansuiŋku nɔi a weeni wa le nye diila a sak tɛŋ kala nisɔmma. Ate ba yaa te wa suik ate wa jo ba tɛŋka po a te wa jigi ate wa boro ale ba. 5Ase kotundɔwa a daa vi wa, ku a fɛ ate ba kan pai waai ate ba a ŋma la a te, dii nyiŋla wa an potim seba ale ko nuruwa. 6Wa a magsi ka wa bo tɛŋ kala po, ka wa nin zaani tigsuŋku niŋ ate ba kpesi nya wa wanni zuk, abe ku paari diipo ate kaabteerɔ kpioŋku waai ale boro alege ate kude nye la kum. Dila wa baga a ŋmani a kuli wadek yenni kama, tɛŋ kaai ate wa jam chali ale ge ka la.>>
7Dila ba yaa jam lueri Kedes ale bo Galili ate ka bo Nafitali ate guutaŋa a bo ka po la ale Sikiim ale bo Ɛfraim ate guutaŋa a bo ka po la ale Kiriat Arba yaase Yebron ate ka bo Juda ate guutaŋa a bo ka po la. 8Jodan benni ale bo Jeriko la kori geŋsa, ba jam lueri ka Bezer ale bo gɔnni po la, tɛŋ kaai ale doa jassi la a nyini Aruben dɔkku po ale Aramot ale bo Gilead po la a nyini Gad dɔkku po ale Golan ale bo Basan po la a nyini Manasa dɔkku po. 9Izirali demma waai yaase nichamma ale bo ale ba la waai a dan kan potim seba ale ko nuru a bag chali ga suk tɛŋsaŋa de po kama ate kotundɔwa a kan ko wa ate ku paari diipo ate tigsuŋku ale nya wanni zuk la.

Title: JOSUA 21
Content:
1Livaima diinaŋa kpaŋŋa a yaa cheŋ kaabteerɔwa Eleaza ale Nun nidoabinni Josua ale Izirali buura m ŋala diinaŋa kpaŋŋa jigi. 2Siilo ale bo Keenan tɛŋka po la a weeni ba ayen, <<Naawen a jam biisi kama ale Moosis ayen ni te ti tɛŋsa ate si ta wuuk ate tama a bo dula ale ti duŋsaŋa.>> 3Dila ase Naawen ale weeni diila Izirali demma a yaa jam te Livaima tɛŋsaŋa de ase wuuk jigi la a ta nyini ba charuku po.
4Gbaŋ kaai ale dɛ niŋ la a jam lo ka Koyat dɔkku yezuk yezuk zuk. Livaima baai ale ka kaabteerɔwa Aaron ŋaaŋbisa la a jam nya ka tɛŋsa pi ale sita a nyini Juda ale Simeyon ale Benjamin diinaŋa jigi. 5Koyat ŋaaŋbi sinsila a jam nya ka tɛŋsa pi a ta nyini Ɛfraim ale Dan dɔkku yezuimaŋa ale Manasa dɔkku yezuimaŋa kauk.
6Gerson ŋaaŋbisaŋa a jam nya ka tɛŋsa pi ale sita a ta nyini Isaka ale Asɛ ale Nafitali diinaŋa yezuk yezuk jigi ale Manasa dɔkku yezuk geli ale bo Basan po la.
7Merari ŋaaŋbisaŋa yezuk yezuk a jam nya ka tɛŋsa pi ale siye a ta nyini Aruben ale Gad ale Zebulun diinaŋa jigi.
8Dila Izirali demma a jam te Livaima ka tɛŋsaŋa de ale si wuuku ase Naawen ale jam weeni Moosis diila.
9A nyini Juda ale Simeyon diinaŋa, ba jam te ka tɛŋsaŋa de, sila yue abe le nna, 10tɛŋsaŋa de ba jam pai te ka Aaron ŋaaŋbisaŋa baai ale nyini Koyat yezuimaŋa ale ka Livaima la jigi, dii nyiŋla gbaŋ kaai ale dɛ niŋka a nak la a lo ka ba zuk. 11Ba jam te ba ka Kiriat Arba yaase Yebron ate wuuk a gilim ka la, Juda ate guutaŋa a bo ka po la. Arba jam ka Anak ko kpieŋ. 12Alege tattaŋa ale tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa ale gilim tɛŋ kpieŋka la, ba jam pai dula a te ka Kaleb Jefunne nidoabinni ayen wa mɛ a tanla. 13Dila kaabteerɔwa Aaron ŋaaŋbisaŋa, ba jam te ba ka Yebron sukka tɛŋ ate waai a dan ko nuru ate ba a ŋma wa abe wa chali ga bo dula, sila abe le Libna 14ale Jattir ale Estemoa 15ale Yolon ale Debir ale 16Ain ale Jutta ale Bet Sɛmes a gum chaab ale si wuuku tɛŋsaŋa meena ka neok a nyini diina buyewa de jigi. 17Benjamin dɔkku a jam te ba ka Gibeon ale Geba ale 18Anatot ale Almon, si meena ka tɛŋsa sinaansi ate wuuk a bo si po. 19Tɛŋ sii meena ate ba jam te kaabteerɔma, Aaron ŋaaŋbisaŋa la, ka pi ale sita ate si ta wuuk a magsi ba duŋsaŋa dɛka.
20Koyat yezuima m ŋala baai ale ka Livaima la a jam nya tɛŋsa a nyini ka Ɛfraim dɔkku. 21Ɛfraim tɛŋka ate guutaŋa a bo ka po la, ba jam te ba ka Sikiim sukka tɛŋ ate waai ate ba a ŋma ayen wa ko nuru la ale Gezer ale 22Kibzaim ale Bet Yoron. Si jam ka tɛŋsa sinaansi ale ta wuuk a magsi ba duŋsaŋa dɛka.
23A ŋman nyini Dan dɔkku ba jam nya ka Elteke ale Gibbeton ale 24Aijalon ale Gat Arimmon. Si jam ka tɛŋsa sinaansi ale wuuk a magsi ba duŋsaŋa dɛka. 25A nyini Manasa dɔkku kauk ba jam te ba ka, Taanak ale Gat Arimmon. Si ka tɛŋsa siye ale ta wuuk a magsi ba duŋsaŋa dɛka. 26Tɛŋsa piika de ale si wuuku ba jam pai te ka Koyat yezuimaŋa.
27Livai yezuimaŋa ale nyini Gerson dɔkku la ba jam te ba kama. A nyini Manasa dɔkku kauk ba te ba ka Golan ale bo Basan po la, sukka tɛŋ a te waai ate ba a ŋma ayen wa ko nuru la, ale Be Estara. Si jam ka tɛŋsa siye ale ta wuuk a magsi ba duŋsaŋa dɛka. 28Isaka dɔkku ba jam te ba ka Kision ale Daberat ale 29Jarmut ale En Gannim. Si jam ka tɛŋsa sinaansi ale ta wuuk a magsi ba duŋsaŋa dɛka. 30Asɛ dɔkku ba jam te ba ka Misal ale Abdon ale 31Yelkat ale Areyob. Si ka tɛŋsa sinaansi ale ta wuuk a magsi ba duŋsaŋa dɛka. 32A nyini Nafitali dɔkku ba jam te ba ka Kedes ale bo Galili tɛŋka po la, sukka tɛŋ ate waai ate ba a ŋma ayen wa ko nuru la, ale Yammot Dor ale Kartan. Tɛŋsaŋa de sitawa a jam taka wuuk a magsi ba duŋsaŋa dɛka. 33Gerson kabini tɛŋsaŋa meena a jam ka tɛŋsa pi ale sita ale wuuk a magsi ba duŋsaŋa dɛka.
34Merari yezuimaŋa yaase Livaima mbala ba jam te ba kama. A nyini Zebulun dɔkku ba jam te ba ka Jokneam ale Karta ale 35Dimna ale Nayalal. Si ka tɛŋsa sinaansi ale wuuk a magsi ba duŋsaŋa dɛka. 36A nyini Aruben dɔkku ba jam te ba ka Bezer ale Jayaz ale 37Kedemot ale Mefaat. Tɛŋsa sinaansi ale wuuk a magsi ba duŋsaŋa dɛka. 38A nyini Gad dɔkku ba jam te ba ka Aramat ale bo Gilead tɛŋka po la, sukka tɛŋ a te waai ate ba a ŋma ayen wa ko nuru la, ale Mayanaim 39ale Yesbon ale Jazer. Si ka sinaansi a ta wuuk a magsi ba duŋsaŋa dɛka. 40Tɛŋ sii meena ate ba jam te Merari yezuimaŋa la yaase Livaima mbala la, jam ka pi ale siye. 41Livaima tɛŋsaŋa ale jam bo Izirali demma tɛŋsaŋa po ate ba ta la, a jam ka tɛŋsa pisinaansi ale naaniŋ a ta wuuk a magsi ba duŋsaŋa dɛka. 42Tɛŋsaŋa de kanyi kanyi meena a jam taka wuuk a gilim si. Dii meena ate ti wom a ta va tɛŋsaŋa de la ka wensie.
43Dila Naawen a te Izirali demma tɛŋka meena ate wa jam pɛ ayen wa pai te ba kokpieŋsaŋa la, ate ba tuesi a kala dula. 44Naawen a yaa jam te ba vuusum jigi meena, ase wa le jam pɛ dii ale ba kokpieŋsaŋa la. Ba dachaasaŋa an jam baga a zaani ale ba. Naawen a jam pai ba dachaasaŋa meena a te ba kama. 45Naawen an jam gaam pumpuulim maŋsaŋa ŋaai ate wa jam nye ale Izirali yenni demma la a basi ya, wa jam nye ŋa meena kama.

Title: JOSUA 22
Content:
1Ate Josua a tigsi Aruben demma ale Gad demma ale Manasa dɔkku kauk 2a yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Nama a nye dii meena ate Naawen tomteerɔwa Moosis a weeni ni la kama ale siak dii meena ate mi mɛ a weeni ni la 3ku beni kama yɔgyɔgla de nama an zɛri ni suataŋa, alege ni nye dii ate Naawen ni Wenni weeni la kama. 4Ase Naawen ni Wenni ale basi ate ni suataŋa a vuusi ase wa le jam puulim dii ale ni la, ni ŋmani a kuli ni yeeŋa tɛŋ kaai po ate Naawen tomteerɔwa Moosis a pai te ni ate ka bo Jodan benni kauk m kula la. 5Alege ni abe kpesi nidek a ta wieŋa ale sinsaŋŋa ŋaai ate Naawen tomteerɔwa Moosis a te ni la, ate ni a yaali Naawen ni Wenni, abe ni a va wa suitaŋa meena abe ni va wa wieŋa abe ni chiib va wa nalimnyiini a tom a te wa ale ni suiniima meena ale ni chiisa meena.>>
6Josua a yaa niak ba ale basi ba ate ba a cheŋ ba yeeŋa 7Manasa dɔkku kauk Moosis a jam te ba ka tɛŋ Basan po alege dɔkku kauk m kula Josua a jam te ba mɛ ka tɛŋ ate ka bo Jodan benni yeniŋ geŋsa ale ba suataŋa, ase Josua ale jam basi ate ba kuli la, wa yaa niak ba, 8ayen, <<Ni cheŋ ni yeeŋa ale ni jigsika ale ni duŋsaŋa ale ni kpanaŋa ale ni ligmɔniŋka ale ni kutuk mɔnuŋku ale ni kutaŋa ale gattaŋa ale piisi la, a lab ŋan baai ate ni nya a ta nyini ni dachaasaŋa jigi la a chari ni suataŋa.>>
9Dila Aruben demma ale Gad demma ale Manasa dɔkku geli a yaa basi Izirali demma Siilo ale bo Keenan po la a ŋmani cheŋ Gilead badek tɛŋka, kauk kuui ate ba jam soa ase Naawen ale weeni Moosis diila.
10Ase ba le jam paari Gelilot ale moata Jodan benni ale bo Keenan po la, Aruben demma ale Gad demma ale Manasa dɔkku geli a yaa jam sɛ kuŋkuŋ kpioŋ dula a moata Jodan benni. 11Ase Izirali demma ale ga wom ayen ba sɛka kuŋkuŋ Keenan tɛŋ banni ale bo Gelilot a moata Jodan benni Izirali demma geŋka la, 12Izirali tigsuŋku meena a yaa tigsi jigi yeŋ Siilo tɛŋka po ayen ba ga nye kpaliŋ ale ba.
13Dila Izirali demma a yaa jam tom kaabteerɔwa Eleaza nidoabinni Fineyas Gilead tɛŋka, Aruben demma ale Gad demma ale Manasa dɔkku genni jigi. 14Baai ale jam va wa cheŋ la ka nuru zuima pi. Izirali buuni diina piwa meena a jam te ka nuru yeŋ waai ale ka yeri nyɔnɔ Izirali labika yezuimaŋa po la. 15Ase ba le jam cheŋ Gilead tɛŋka po, Aruben dɔkku ale Gad dɔkku ale Manasa dɔkku genni jigi la, ba yaa weeni ba ayen, 16<<Naawen tigsuŋku meena ayen, ku le nye kase ate ni basi siaka ale Izirali Wenni ase nna la la? Ni le nye kase a ŋmani Naawen ŋaaŋ a sɛ kuŋkuŋ a te nidek abe ni zɛri wa? 17A ta jam paari jinla de tama a diem nye cheri a nyini biem bula po, nyiŋtuilaŋa ale a jam Naawen naakuuni po la meena. 18Ate nama a yaali ni basi Naawen vaka? <<Ni dan zɛri Naawen jinla, chum wa sui ale puuri ale Izirali naakuuni meena. 19Ase tɛŋ kaai ate nama a tuesi la a dan taŋ, ni jam Naawen tɛŋka po. Kauk kuui ate Naawen viuku a za la a maa boro ale tama. Alege ni abe kan ni zɛri Naawen yaase tama nɔi abe ni sɛ kuŋkuŋ a te ni dega a ŋman gum Naawen ti Wenni kuŋkuŋku po. 20Ase Zera nidoabinni Achan ale jam kan ta wensie a pai ŋan baai ate Wen ayen ba kaasi la, suipuurum an jam Izirali naakuuni meena jigi ya? Daa wala nyiini ale jam kpi wa biemu nyiŋŋa.>>
21Ate Aruben dɔkku ale Gad dɔkku ale Manasa dɔkku geli a yaa tulisi Izirali yezuimaŋa nyama ayen, 22<<Tanjaŋini Wen, Naawen! Tanjaŋini Wen, Naawen! Wa ale seba, ale basi ate Izirali a seba. Ase kude a dan ka tukpari yaase zɛrika a te Naawen, kan basi ti jinla de. 23Ase tama a dan sɛ tidek kuŋkuŋ ayen ti basi Naawen vaka, ayen ti nye juka tiirim yaase ŋandiinta tiirim yaase ti nye suiyɔgni tiirita kaabka ku zuk, Naawen dek abe dari ti tue.
24<<Aaya! Ti nye kude ale ka yɔgsum ayen dai dii dai ni ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale weeni tama ŋaaŋbisaŋa ayen, <Boan jaa wari ate nama a ta a nye ale Naawen Izirali Wenni? 25Naawen a basi ate ka Jodan benni a chim ban a bo tama ale nama Aruben demma ale Gad demma suŋsuŋ po. Ni ka charuk a nyini Naawen jigi ya.> Ni ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale nye ate tama ŋaaŋbisaŋa a basi Naawen yɔgsum chalika.
26<<Dila ale soa ate tama a weeni ayen, <Ni basi ate ti gomsi a sɛ kuŋkuŋ alege daa juka tiirim yaase kaabka kuŋkuŋoa.> 27Ku abe le chim ka seerɔ a te tama ale nama ale gaŋ sii ale bo ŋaaŋ a vi ti la, ayen ti le kasim a puusi Naawen ka wa viuku po ale ti juka tiiritaŋa ale kaabsaŋa ale suiyɔgni tiiritaŋa, ate chum po ni ŋaaŋbisaŋa a kan baga a weeni tama ŋaaŋbisaŋa ayen, Ni ka wari a nye ale Naawen ya.
28<<Ate tama weeni ayen, <Ase ba dan weeni kude a te tama yaase ti ŋaaŋbisaŋa, ti le tulisi ayen, <<Ni nya Naawen kuŋkuŋku, kuui ate tama koma a sɛ la, a daa juka tiirita yaase kaabsa, alege ku ka seerɔ tama ale nama suŋsuŋ.
29Ku abe yalima ale tama ate tama a kan nye tukpari ale Naawen a basi wa vaka abe ti sɛ kuŋkuŋ a magsi juka tiirita yaase ŋanbie tiirita ale kaabsa a gum Naawen ti Wenni kuŋkuŋku ale za viuku po la.>>
30Ase kaabteerɔwa Fineyas ale niŋdeerɔma naakuuni po, Izirali yezuimaŋa nyama ale ga wom dii ate Aruben demma ale Gad demma ale Manasa demma a weeni la, ba sue yaa jam peenti. 31Kaabteerɔwa Eleaza nidoabinni Fineyas a yaa weeni Aruben ale Gad ale Manasa ayen, <<Jinla de tama seba ayen Naawen a bo le ti kama, dii nyiŋla nama an zɛri wensie ale Naawen vaka kude nyiŋŋa. Yɔgyɔgla de ni vari Izirali demma Naawen nisima po a basi kama.>>
32Kaabteerɔwa Eleaza nidoabinni Fineyas ale niŋdeerɔma a yaa ŋmani cheŋ Keenan tɛŋka ba le ga tu chaab ale Aruben demma ale Gad demma Gilead po, a weeni sak Izirali demma ba ale zɔk diila. 33Ba sue a jam peenti kama ase ba le jam wom dii ale nye la a yaa pak Naawen ku nyiŋ. Ba an jam ŋman biisi kpaliŋ wie ayen ba ga kaasi ba tɛŋka juijui ate Aruben demma ale Gad demma a jam boro la.
34Aruben demma ale Gad demma a jam te kuŋkuŋku ka yuenni de, ayen Seerɔ Tama Suŋsuŋ ayen Naawen ka Wen.

Title: JOSUA 23
Content:
1Ku le jam beni alege ate Naawen a basi ate Izirali demma a nya vuusum a ta nyini ba dachaasaŋa meena ale gilim ba jigi la, Josua a jam kpaŋ kama ate wa benaŋa mɛ a piisi. 2Josua yaa tigsi Izirali demma meena, ba nisɔmma ale niŋdeerɔma ale buusa boorisaŋa ale kpaŋŋa a weeni ba ayen, <<Mi yaa kpaŋ kama ate m benaŋa mɛ a piisi. 3Nama dek a nya dii meena ate Naawen ni Wenni a nye tɛŋsaŋa de meena ni nyiŋla kama, ku jam ka Naawen ni Wenni ale kpaliŋ te ni. 4Ni teeri m le nye dii a chari tɛŋ kaai ale tali la a te ni buuni po meena la, tɛŋ sii ate mi a nya pagri si zuk Jodan Benni ale Nyakpiemu suŋsuŋ yeniŋ geŋ la. 5Naawen ni Wenni dek ale yiak ba a basi te ni, wa le namsi ba a te ni, ate nama ale tuesi ba tɛŋka ase Naawen ni Wenni ale puulim diila.>>
6<<Ni be pagra, abe ni kpesi a siak dii meena ale ŋmarisi Moosis Sinsaŋŋa Gbaŋka po la, abe ni kan viriŋ juga yaase gala. 7Ni kan pai nidek a gum chaab ale tɛŋsaŋa de ale tali a bo ni po la. Ni kan wi ba wenaŋa yue yaase ni a pɛ ŋa nyiŋŋa. Ku a fɛ ate ni kan kaab ŋa yaase ni koori tɛŋ a zuli ŋa. 8Alege ku a magsi ka ni ŋmasi va Naawen ni Wenni ase ni le nye dii a jam paari yɔgyɔgla de la.
9<<Naawen a yiak ka tɛŋ sii ale zuek ale pagra la a basi te ni; a ta jam paari jinla de tɛŋ karo a baga a zaani ale ni. 10Ni wanyi a nya pagrim tusidi zuk, dii nyiŋla ka Naawen ni Wenni ale kpaliŋ a te ni ase wa le puulim diila. 11Dila ni abe kpesi nidek a yaali Naawen ni Wenni. 12Alege ni dan viriŋ a pai nidek a maŋ baai ale tali vua a bo tɛŋsaŋa de po la ale a faari chaab lieba ale pai nidek a maŋ ba, 13ni abe seba chak ayen Naawen ni Wenni a kan ŋman yiak nuruma de a basi te ni. Alege ba le chim ka barukta a te ni, ba le chim finsa a bo ni ŋaaŋsaŋa abe ba chim munsa ni nimbieŋa po a ta ga paari diipo ate nama ale kpi tɛŋ maŋka de po, kaai ate Naawen ni Wenni a te ni la po.
14<<Yɔgyɔgla de mi a yaa moata ka kum. Ni seba kama ale ni suiniima ale ni chiisa meena ayen pumpuulim maŋ sii meena ate Naawen ni Wenni a weeni la wa an jam tali dinyi mɛ la a basi ya. 15Alege ase pumpuulim maŋ sii ate Naawen ni Wenni a weeni la ale jam chim wensie la, dila Naawen ale ta biem buui meena ate wa nyigsi ayen wa le ta jam ni zuk la, ate wa ga kaasi ni meena tɛŋ maŋka de po ate wa te ni la. 16Ase nama a dan zɛri Naawen ni Wenni nɔiyeŋka, kaai ate wa weeni la ale ga kaab wen yona a koori tɛŋ ŋa niŋ, Naawen sui ale puuri ale ni ate ni le kpi nwuli tɛŋ maŋ kaai ate wa te ni la po.>>

Title: JOSUA 24
Content:
1Josua a yaa jam tigsi Izirali buuni meena Sikiim po. Wa weeni nisɔmma ale niŋdeerɔma ale baai ale a bo buusa la ale kpaŋŋa ate ba ta badek jam Wen niŋ.
2Josua a weeni nuruma meena ayen, <<Dii ate Naawen, Izirali Wenni a weeni la ale nna. Ku beni kama ni kokpieŋsaŋa, a maa gum Tɛra Abrayam ale Nayo kowa a jam gaam Benni a taam kama a kala a kaab wen yona. 3Alege mi Wen a jam yeeri ni kowa Abrayam a ta nyini tɛŋka ale gaam Benaŋka la a ta cheŋ Keenan a te wa ŋaaŋbi boari. Mi te wa Aizik, 4a te Aizik mɛ Jekob ale Iisɔ. Mi yaa pai Seir tɛŋka ale ta guuta la a te Iisɔ, alege Jekob ale wa nidoabilisaŋa a jam cheŋ ka Ejipiti.
5<<Mi yaa tom Moosis ale Aaron, ate mi a basi ate ku jo Ejipiti demma nyiŋ ale dii ate mi nye dula la, ale ta ni a nyini. 6Ase mi ale ta ni koma a nyini Ejipiti po a nyini la, nama a jam paari ka nyakpiemu ate Ejipiti demma a jam a vi ba ale kpaliŋ torokoba ale wusum duerisa a ga paari Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku. 7Alege ba jam kaari a te Naawen a yaali maarika ate wa yaa basi ate legi a bo nama ale Ejipiti demma suŋsuŋ, wa jam basi ate ba wari nyiamu po. Nama nya kama ale nidek nina m le nye Ejipiti demma diila. Ni jam bo gɔnni po ate ku beni kama.
8<<Mi ta ni jam Amori demma tɛŋka po baai ale bo Jodan benni kori geŋsa la. Ba jam kpaliŋ ale ni alege mi pai ba a nyo ka ni nisima po. Mi jam ko ba kama ate ni tuesi ba tɛŋka. 9Ase Zippor nidoabinni Belak, Moab naawa ale jam gomsi ayen wa nye kpaliŋ ale Izirali demma la, wa jam tom weeni ka Biio nidoabinni Balaam ayen wa ka kikaasa a te ni. 10Alege mi an jam wom Balaam ale a weeni diila, wa goanti jam a niak ni kama m jam vari ni a ta nyini wa nisima po a nyini kama.
11<<Ni lo Jodan benni a jueli kama a jam Jeriko tɛŋka po. Ate Jeriko demma a nye kpaliŋ ale ni ase Amori ale Perizzi ale Keenan ale Yit ale Girgas ale Yivi ale Jebus demma ale jam kpaliŋ ale ni dii alege ate mi a jam pai ba a nyo ni nisima po la. 12Mi jam tom zirima ate ŋa de ni niŋ, ŋaai ale jam yiak ba a basi te ni la. Amori demma nalima ŋayewa mɛ a jam boro kama. Nama an jam nye kude ale ka nidek gebik ale tommoa. 13Dila mi te ni ka tɛŋ kaai ate nama an namu ka nyiŋŋa ale tɛŋ kpieŋsa ate nama an sɛ si la, ate ni bo si po a dɛ ŋan baai ate nama an bori ba la.>
14<<Yɔgyɔgla de ni abe a chali Naawen abe ni puusi a te wa ale wensie. Ni yuk wena ŋaai ate ni kokpieŋsaŋa a jam a kaab ate ŋa gaam Benaŋka taam la ale ŋaai ale bo Ejipiti po la abe ni puusi a te Naawen. 15Alege Naawen puusi teka a dan kan nala a te ni, bi lueri a te nidek jinla danni waai ate ni a yaali ni puusi a te la, ka wen ŋaai ate ni kokpieŋsaŋa a jam a kaab ate ŋa gaam Benaŋka a taam la yaase ka Amori demma wenaŋa baai tɛŋka po ate ni boro la. Alege mi ale m yenni demma meena, tama ale puusi a te ka Naawen.>>
16Ate nuruma a yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ku abe yalima ale ti ate tama a zɛri Naawen abe ti kaab wen yona. 17Ku ka Naawen ti Wenni dek ale ta tama ale ti koma a nyini Ejipiti po, a nyini tɛŋ kaai ale ka yɔntidi la po, a tom wakinkaglaŋa de tama dek nina po. Wa jam kasi ti kama ti chelimu meena po ale tɛŋ sii meena po ate tama va si po a taam la. 18Naawen ale yiak tɛŋsaŋa de meena a basi a te ti a maa gum Amori demma baai ale jam bo tɛŋka po la. Tama mɛ ale puusi a te Naawen dii nyiŋla wa ka ti Wen.>>
19Josua a yaa weeni nuruma ayen, <<Nama an baga a puusi a te Naawen ya. Wa ka weleŋsa Naawen. Wa ka nyuri dɛka Wen. Wa kan vɔŋ a te ni, ni tukpanni ale ni biemu nyiŋŋa. 20Ase ni dan zɛri Naawen ale kaab tɛŋ yoŋta wena, wa le basi ate kaasuŋ jam ni jigi ate dila a basi ate ni kpeglim, wa le jam chim Naawen maŋ ate ni la ŋaaŋnyiŋ.>>
21Alege nuruma a yaa weeni Josua ayen, <<Aaya, ti le puusi a te ka Naawen.>> 22Ate Josua a yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Nama dek ka seerɔba a te nidek ayen ni a yaali ni puusi a te ka Naawen.>> Ba yaa tulisa ayen, <<Mm ti le weeni diila a ni la.>> 23Josua a yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni yuk ni wen yonaŋa ate ni ta la a basi abe ni pai ni suiniimaŋa a te Naawen, Izirali Wenni.>> 24Ate nuruma a yaa weeni Josua ayen, <<Ti le puusi a te Naawen ti Wenni abe ti a wom wa.>>
25A nyini dai dila danni Josua a jam nye ka nɔiyeŋ pumpuulima a te nuruma, dula jigini Sikiim tɛŋka po wa yaa ŋmarisi sinsaga ale wie te ba. 26Ate Josua yaa jam ŋmarisi wieŋa de meena a nyo Wen sinsaŋŋa gbaŋka po. Wa jam pai ka tintain kpienni a feri kinkaŋ peruk tɛŋ a moata Naawen weleŋsa jigini. 27Wa ya weeni nuruma meena ayen, <<Nya de, tintanni de ale chim ka seerɔ a te ni. Di wom dii meena ate Naawen a weeni ti la kama. Di le chim ka seerɔ a bo mini ni ase ni dan kan ta wensie ale ni Wenni.>> 28Josua a yaa jam basi ate nuruma meena a kuli ba yeeŋa.
29Wieŋa de meena ŋaaŋnyiŋ Naawen tomteerɔwa Nun nidoabinni Josua a yaa kpi. Wa jam taka bena kook ale pi. 30Ate ba yaa gu wa kauk kuui ate wa jam boro la, Timnat Seraya po Ɛfraim tɛŋka ate guutaŋa a bo ka po Gaas guuku wiiluk geŋsa. 31Izirali demma a puusi a te Naawen kama diipo ate Josua ale nisɔmma a jam vua la ale baai ale jam kpiem wa ale nya dii meena ate Naawen a jam nye te Izirali demma la.
32Ate Josefi kobaŋa ŋaai ate Izirali demma a ta nyini Ejipiti a jam la ba yaa jam gu ŋa tɛŋ kala po kaa ate Jekob a jam da ale ligbie kook a nyini Ayaamo nidoabilisaŋa jigi, Sikiim ko a jam le la. Kude a yaa jam chim ka Josefi ŋaaŋbisaŋa nitalim.
33Ate Aaron nidoabinni Eleaza a yaa jam kpi ate ba gu wa Gibea tɛŋka po, dula jigini ka wa nidoabinni Fineyas ale jam soa. Ka jam boka Ɛfraim tɛŋka ate guutaŋa a bo ka po la.

Title: NIŊDEERƆBA 1
Content:
1Josua kummu ŋaaŋnyiŋ, Izirali demma a yaa bek Naawen ayen, <<Ka wana ale wa dɛ niŋ a ga kpaliŋ ale Keenan demma a te ti?>>
2Naawen a yaa tulisi ayen, <<Juda ale wa cheŋ, M pai tɛŋka a nyo ba nisima po kama.>>
3Juda demma a yaa weeni Simeyon demma ba suataŋa ayen, <<Ni jueli jam de ale ti, tɛŋka kauk kuui ate ba pai a te la, ate ti nye kpaliŋ ale Keenan demma. Tama mɛ ale va ni a cheŋ juijui ate ba le pai a te ni la.>> Simeyon demma a yaa jam va ba cheŋ.
4Juda demma ale jam nye kpaliŋka la, Naawen a yaa pai Keenan ale Perizzi a nyo ba nisima po ate ba ko nuruba tusa pi (10,000) Bezek tɛŋka po. 5Ka dula jigini ate ba jam nya Adoni Bezek a nye kpaliŋ ale wa a nya pagrim Keenan ale Perizzi demma zuk. 6Adoni Bezek a jam yiti chali kama, alege ba vi yik wa kama a gebi wa naŋsaŋa ale wa nisimaŋa nandub doataŋa a basi.
7Ate Adoni Bezek a weeni ayen, <<Yɔgyɔgla de Naawen a tuni mu mi ale jam nye mbala diila kama ate nalima pisiyopɔiwa naŋsa ale nisima nandub doata ba gebi a le pai ŋandiin tala mi jazaanimu tɛŋ a dɛ.>> Ba jam ta wa jam ka Jerusalem ate wa kpi dula.
8Juda demma a jam siti Jerusalem mɛ a tuesi ka. Ba jam ko tɛŋka demma kama ale juka ale bolim.
9Dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ, Juda demma a yaa cheŋ ayen ba nye kpaliŋ ale Keenan demma ale bo guuku zuk la Negev ale guutaŋa chiak yeniŋ geŋ la. 10Ba jam nya pagrim Keenan demma ale bo Yebron ate ba jam a te ka yuei ayen Kiriat Arba la ale nak yiak Sesai ale Ayiman ale Talmai.
11A nyini dula ba jam kasim nya ka pagrim nuru baai ale jam bo Debir po ate ba jam a te ka yuei ayen Kiriat Sefer la. 12Ate Kaleb weeni ayen, <<M le pai m liewa Aksa a te nuru waai ale wa nye kpaliŋ a nya pagrim Kiriat Sefer zuk la.>> 13Kenaz nidoabinni Otniel, Kaleb yuawa a yaa nak yik ka, ate Kaleb a pai wa liewa Aksa a yalisi wa.
14Yalika danni Otniel a yaa weeni liewa ayen wa bek wa kowa ate wa te wa tɛŋ. Wa yaa nyini wa bonika zuk a siŋ, ate Kaleb a yaa bek wa ayen, <<Ka boa ate fi a yaali?>> 15Ate liewa a tulisi ayen, <<Sak jiirim ale mu, ase fi ale te mu tɛŋ Negev po la, be te mu bulik kaai ale ta nyiam la mɛ.>> Kaleb yaa te wa bulik sii ale bo pimpitini zuk ale viaka po la.
16Moosis ŋachobwa Ken denɔwa ŋaaŋbisaŋa yaa basi Kpinkpatta Tɛŋka ale Juda nuruma a ga bo ale Juda Gɔnni nuruma Negev po a moata Arad.
17Juda nuruma a jam va Simeyon demma ba suataŋa a ga nye kpaliŋ ale Keenan demma ale bo Zefat la ale kaasi tɛŋka meena. Dila nyiŋla ka yuei jam le Yorma. 18Juda demma a jam maa tuesi ka Gaza ale Askelon ale Ekron, tɛŋ meena ale ka tɛŋbain.
19Naawen a jam bo ale Juda demma kama. Ba jam tuesi tɛŋ kaai ale bo guuku zuk la kama, alege ba an jam baga a yiak nuru baai ale bo peelimmu po la a basi ya, dii nyiŋla ba jam ta ka kuta torokoba. 20Ase Moosis ale puulim la, ba jam pai Yebron tɛŋka te ka Kaleb waai ale yiak Anak bisa batawa a basi la. 21Benjamin buuni an jam baga yiak Jebus demma baai ale jam bo Jerusalem po la a basi kama, ale jinla de Jebus demma a diem bo ale ka Benjamin demma.
22Josefi yenni demma mɛ a jam nye kpaliŋ ale Betel tɛŋka ate Naawen a bo ale ba. 23Ba le jam tom nuruba ayen ba ga kpesi nya Betel ate ka yuei a chim Luz la, 24kpesi nyaarɔma yaa nya nuru ale wa nyini tɛŋka po a nyini ate ba yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Sak ti tama ale ti nye dii a jo tɛŋka po la, ti le nya fi zuk nalimnyiini.>> 25Ate wa yaa sak ba, ate ba ko tɛŋka nuruma ale gebik alege basi nuruwa ale wa dɔkdemma meena. 26Ate wa yaa cheŋ Yit demma tɛŋka po, dula jigini wa jam sɛ ka tɛŋ ka yuei jam le Luz, ka yuei diem ale la a ta jam paari jinla danni.
27Alege Manasa demma an jam yiak Bet San yaase Taanak yaase Dor yaase Ibleam yaase Megiddo tɛŋsaŋa ale baai ale kali gilim ba la a basi ya, dii nyiŋla Keenan demma a jaa yaali ba bo ka tɛŋ kala po. 28Ase Izirali demma ale jam nya pagrim la, ba yaa namsi Keenan demma ale fifiok tuima alege an yiak ba a basi ya. 29Ɛfraim demma mɛ an jam yiak Keenan demma ale jam bo Gaza la, Keenan demma a diem jam bo ka dula ale ba. 30Zebulun demma an jam yiak Keenan demma ale bo Kitron yaase Nayalol po la, baai ale tali bo ale ba la a basi ya, alege ba an jam a basi ate ba a tom fifiok tuima. 31Yaase Asɛ demma a yiak baai ale bo Akko la yaase Saidon la yaase Alab la yaase Akzib la yaase Yelba yaase Afek la yaase Areyob la a basi ya, 32dila nyiŋla Asɛ demma a yaa jam bo ale Keenan demma. 33Nafitali demma mɛ an jam yiak baai ale bo Bet Sɛmes la yaase Bet Anat la a basi ya, alege Nafitali demma mɛ a jam bo Keenan demma tɛŋka po, ate baai ale bo Bet Sɛmes ale Bet Anat la a yaa jam chim fifiok tomteerɔba a te ba. 34Amori demma a jam kasi Dan demma a basi ka tɛŋ kaai ale ta guutaŋa la po, a kan basi ate ba siŋ jam tɛŋka peelimmu po. 35Amori demma mɛ a jam a yaali ba nyini Yeres Guuku ale Aijalon ale Saalbim a siŋ kama, alege Josefi yenni pagrimu ale jam gum du la, ba jam fɛ ba mɛ kama a te ba fifiok tuima. 36Amori demma tɛŋ banni a jam nyini ka Nueoŋ Guuku a ga va Sela a siŋ a cheŋ.

Title: NIŊDEERƆBA 2
Content:
1Naawen maarɔwa a yaa nyini Gilgal a cheŋ Bokim ayen, <<Mi ale ta ni nyini Ejipiti po a jam a ta ni jo tɛŋ kaai po ate m pɛ ayen m te ni kokpieŋsaŋa la. M weeni ayen, <M kan kaasi m nɔiyeŋka ate m nye ale ni la, 2ate nama a kan nye nɔiyeŋ ale tɛŋka de nuruma, alege ni kpiti ba kuŋkuŋtaŋa a basi. Alege ni an wom m nɔi ya, ka boa ate ni nye nna? 3Dila nyiŋ mi a weeni ni kama ayen m kan yiak ba a basi te ni, ba le chim ka munsa ni ganaŋa abe ba bɔgtaŋa a chim baruk a te ni.>>
4Ase Naawen maarɔwa ale jam biisi wieŋa de a te Izirali demma meena la, nuruma a yaa kum nna yegayega, 5ale wi jigini yuei ayen Bokim. Dula jigini ba yaa nye kaabka a te Naawen.
6Josua ale basi Izirali demma ate ba cheŋ la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, ba yaa cheŋ ba tuesi tɛŋka, waai meena ale wadek nitalim. 7Nuruma a jam va Naawen kama nalimnyiini diipo ate Josua a diem vua la ale nisɔm baai ale jam goa beni gaam wa la, baai meena ale nya wakpiema ŋaai ate Naawen a nye te Izirali demma la.
8Naawen tomteerɔwa Josua waai ale ka Nun nidoabinni a jam ta ka bena kook ale pi ale kpi. 9Ate ba gu wa tɛŋ kaai ale ka wa nitalim la po, Timnat Yeres ale bo guuku ale bo Ɛfraim la, Gaas Guuku wiilukku geŋsa.
10Gaŋ kala meena ale kpi la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, gaŋ ka choa ale yiti a zɛ Naawen yaase wa le nye dii a te Izirali demma la. 11Izirali demma a yaa nye biem Naawen nimbie po a tom a te Baal bɔgtaŋa. 12Ba yaa zɛri Naawen, ba koma Wen dii ale ta ba nyini Ejipiti po a nyini la. Ba jam va ale a puusi nuruba tɔgatɔga wenaŋa ale gilim ba la. Ba jam nye kama ate Naawen sui a puuri, 13dii nyiŋla ba zɛri wa kama ale tom a te Baal ale Astoret wenaŋa. 14Wa suipuurumu po wa yaa ta chaab ale Izirali demma ate Naawen yaa pai ba a te baai ale siti ba la ate ba vari ba. Wa yaa pai ba a da te ba dachaasaŋa ale gilim ba la, baai ate ba an ŋman jam baga a zɛri. 15Diipo meena Izirali demma a dan nyini peelim ba nye kpaliŋ Naawen ale namsi ba ate ba nak dɛ ba ase Wa le pɛ a te ba la. Ba jam bo ka ninam kpiem po.
16Naawen a yaa lueri niŋdeerɔba baai ale vari ba a ta nyini baai ale siti ba la nisima po a basi. 17Alege ba an diem a wom ba niŋdeerɔma nɔi ale pai badek a te bɔgluk yoŋta a puusi ti. Ba an jam a nye ase ba koma la, ba deri kpabi pai ba koma suiku a basi kama, suik kuui ale a te Naawen sinsaŋŋa zula la. 18Diipo meena Naawen a dan te ba niŋdeerɔ, wa bo ale ba ka di a tom vari ba a ta nyini ba dachaasaŋa nisima po a basi ase niŋdeerɔwa ale vua a paari diipo la. Dii nyiŋla Naawen a ta jiirim ale ba kama ase ba le bo baai ale a namsi ba la jigi a kum la. 19Alege niŋdeerɔwa a dan kpi, nuruma a nyiem pilim ŋmani kama a ŋmasi tom kaasi a gaam ba kokpieŋsaŋa, a va bɔgluk yoŋta a tom a te ale a puusi ti. Ba jam zɛri ba biem nyeelaŋa ale ba tukpari suitaŋa basika kama.
20Dila nyiŋ Naawen sui yaa puuri nna yegayega ale Izirali demma ate wa weeni ba ayen, <<Dii nyiŋla tɛŋka de a zɛri nɔiyeŋka ate m dueni ale ba kokpieŋsaŋa la kama ale an wom mi, 21Mi a kan ŋman yiak tɛŋsaŋa de kanyi a te ba, sii ate Josua a kpi alege la. 22M le pai si kama a nye Izirali demma a nya ase ba ta Naawen suiku ale a cheŋ ku po ase ba kokpieŋsaŋa la ya.>> 23Naawen a basi tɛŋ sila ayen si tali boro kama, Wa an jam yiak si a basi bunyi dekki a pai si a nyo Josua nisima po.

Title: NIŊDEERƆBA 3
Content:
1Tɛŋsaŋa de ale Naawen a tali basi ayen wa nye Izirali dem baai meena ale kan tu kpaliŋsa Keenan tɛŋka po la a nya. 2Wa nye kude ayen wa sak ba ka Izirali ŋaaŋbisaŋa baai ale kan seba kpaliŋ sii ale liŋ nye la wie. 3Filistia niŋdeerɔba banuwa, Keenan demma meena ale Saidon demma ale Yivi demma ale bo Lebanon guutaŋa ale nyini Baal Yermon Guuku a cheŋ Lebo Yamat la. 4Ba tali boro ayen ba nye ka Izirali demma a nya ase ba le siak te Naawen wieŋa, ŋaai ate wa ta va Moosis zuk a te ba kokpieŋsaŋa la.
5Izirali demma a yaa jam bo Keenan ale Yit ale Amori ale Perizzi ale Yivi ale Jebus demma po. 6Ba jam a faari ka ba liema ale pai badek liema a yalisi tɛŋ sila bisaŋa ale a va ba bɔgtaŋa.
7Izirali demma a yaa nye biem Naawen nimbie po, ba jam baŋ Naawen ba Wenni wari kama ale a va Baal ale Asera bɔgtaŋa. 8Ate Naawen sui a yaa puuri ale Izirali demma ate wa pai ba a nyo Kusan Arisataim, Araam Nayaraim tɛŋka naawa nisima po, waai ate Izirali demma a jam bo wa jigi a paari bena naaniŋ la. 9Alege ase ba le jam kum te Naawen la, Wa yaa yeeri varibasidɔ a ta nyini badek po. Wa yuei ale Otniel Kenaz biik, Kaleb yoa ale nye wa, wala ale jam vari ba a basi. 10Naawen Chiika yaa jam wa zuk, ate wa chim Izirali niŋdeerɔ a cheŋ kpaliŋ. Naawen a pai Kusan Arisataim, Araam naawa a nyo Otniel nisima po, wala ale jam nya pagrim wa zuk. 11Tɛŋka a yaa jam nya suiyɔgni bena pisinaansi a paari diipo ate Otniel Kenaz biika a kpi la.
12Izirali demma a ŋman nye biem Naawen nimbie po, ba le nye biemu de la nyiŋ Naawen a te Eglon Moab naawa ka pagrim Izirali demma zuk. 13Wa jam wi ka Ammon ale Amalek demma ate ba gum wa po, Eglon yaa nye kpaliŋ ale Izirali demma a tuesi Tɛŋka ale ta Kpinkpatta Tiisaŋa la. 14Izirali demma a jam bo ka Eglon Moab naawa jigi a paari bena pi ale naaniŋ.
15Ate Izirali demma a ŋman kum te Naawen ate wa te ba varibasidɔ, wa yuei ale Eyud, wa jam ka galik, Gera Benjamin denɔwa biik. Izirali demma a jam tom wa ale ka zula tiirim Eglon Moab naawa jigi. 16Eyud yaa nye gebik noa ŋaye ate ka woglimmu a paari anamagib buta, a pai ka su wa juga kɔsukku nyiŋ ate wa gattaŋa a lik ka. 17Wa yaa pai zula tiirimu a te Eglon Moab naawa waai ale jam biigi nna yegayega la. 18Eyud ale jam te zula tiirimu a nueri la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, wa yaa basi nuru baai ale ji tiirimu la suik po. 19Bɔgtaŋa ale moata Gilgal jigini la wa yaa ŋman cheŋ a weeni ayen, <<M ta ka wasusugi m weeni sak fu naaba.>> Ate naawa a yaa weeni ayen, <<Ni goori de.>> Ate baai ale tom a te wa la a yaa basi wa.
20Eyud yaa forisi paari wa ase wa le kala wadek wa nyiini wa naam yeri gboŋku zuk la a weeni ayen, <<M ta ka wari a nyini Wen jigi m te fu.>> Ase naawa ale yiti wa zukpaglika zuk la, 21Eyud yaa pai wa gala nisaŋa a yeeri gebik a ta nyini wa juga kɔsukku nyiŋ a chub naawa lɔgni. 22Gebika yikka jigini a maa feri jo kama a taam na nyini wa ŋaaŋka. Eyud an dari gebika a voori ya, ate wa nyiŋka kpaamu a lik gebika meena. 23Eyud yaa nyini peelim ale kpari dɔkku tuataŋa.
24Wa le cheŋ la ŋaaŋnyiŋ naawa tomteerɔma a yaa jam nya ŋmazuk dɔkku tuataŋa a kpari. Ba yaa weeni ayen, <<Da dii dai wa boro a basi ka yaata yenni niŋ dɔkku po.>> 25Ba yaa limisi ate chivie a ga yik ba, alege wa an diem a lak dɔkku tuataŋa, ba yaa pai saari fiik a lak ti. Dula baa yaa nya ale ba nyɔnɔwa a lo doa tɛŋ a kpi.
26Ase ba le a limisi la, Eyud yaa cheŋ. Wa jam va ka bɔgtaŋa tɛŋ a cheŋ Seira. 27Ase wa le paari dula la, wa yaa peeri damuniŋka Ɛfraim tɛŋka ate guutaŋa a bo ka po la, ate Izirali demma a va wa a nyini guuku zuk a siŋ. Wa ale jam de ba niŋ.
28Wa weeni ayen, <<Ni va mi,>> ale Naawen a pai Moab ni dachaasaŋa a nyo ni nisima po kama.>> Ba yaa va wa a siŋ a tuesi kauk kuui meena ale va Jodan benni a cheŋ Moab la, ba an jam siak ate waai a lo jueli ya. 29Dila powa ba jam ko Moab demma ase ka nuruba tusa pi (10,000) la, baai meena ale pagra la, nuru yeŋ mɛ la an jam a bɛ ya. 30Dai dila danni Moab jam siak te Izirali demma kama, ate tɛŋka a nya suiyɔgni a paari bena pinaanuŋ.
31Eyud ŋaaŋnyiŋ ka Samgar Anat biika, waai ale jam ko Filistia demma kobsiyuebi ale diok kuui nɔi ale chɔrisi la. Wa mɛ a jam vari Izirali demma a basi kama.

Title: NIŊDEERƆBA 4
Content:
1Eyud ale kpi la ŋaaŋnyiŋ Izirali demma a ŋman nye biem Naawen nimbie po. 2Ate Naawen a pai ba nyo Jabin nisima po Keenan naawa waai ale a nya Yazor tɛŋka la. Wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma kpagni a jam le Sisera, waai ale jam bo Yaroset Yaggoyim la. 3Dii nyiŋla wa jam ta ka kuta torokoba kobsaneok ale namsi Izirali demma a paari bena pisiye, ate ba kum a te Naawen a yaali maarika.
4Debora nipok biisiteerɔwa, Lappidot powa ale jam dɛ Izirali demma niŋ dipo. 5Wa jam a bo buusa ka Debora kpinkparukku ale bo Arama ale Betel suŋsuŋ, Ɛfraim po ate guuta a bo ka po la tɛŋ, ate Izirali demma a jam wa jigi ate wa a biisi ba biisaŋa a te ba. 6Wa yaa jam wi Barak Abinoam biika ate wa nyini Kades ale bo Nafitali po la a weeni wa ayen. <<Naawen Izirali Wenni Naawen a weeni fu ayen, cheŋ ta nuruba tusa pi (10,000) a nyini Nafitali ale Zebulun a de ba niŋ a cheŋ Tabor Guuku. 7Mi ale bari yik Sisera Jabin tugurik tɔŋdɔma niŋdeerɔwa ale wa torokoma ale wa tommu Kison Benaŋka a pai nyo fi nisima po.>>
8Barak yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Fi dan va mi a cheŋ, m le cheŋ alege fi dan kan va mi a cheŋ, m kan cheŋ.>>
9Debora a yaa weeni ayen, << Ku nala.>> Mi ale cheŋ ale fu. Alege fi le a nye dii wanni de zuk la, zulaŋa a kan chim fi zula, Naawen ale pai Sisera a nyo ka nipok nisima po.>> Dila nyiŋla Debora yaa cheŋ Kades ale Barak, 10kauk kuui ate wa tigsi Zebulun ale Nafitali nuruba la. Nuruba tusa pi (10,000) ale jam va wa. Debora mɛ a jam maa va wa cheŋ kama.
11Ɛba Ken denɔwa a jam basi wa Ken dem chaama kama, Yobab waai ale ka Moosis chee la ŋaaŋbisaŋa, ale ti wa viuku a moata ti kpiemu ale bo Zaanannim a moata Kedes la.
12Ase ba le ga weeni Sisera ayen Barak Abinoam biika a jueli Tabor Guuku zuk la, 13Sisera yaa tigsi wa kuta torokoba kobsaneok ale nuruma meena ale bo ale wa a nyini Yaroset Yaggoyim a ta ga paari Kison Benaŋka.
14Debora yaa weeni Barak ayen, <<Cheŋ danni ale nna ate Naawen ale pai Sisera a nyo fi nisima po. Yaa Naawen an dɛ fi niŋŋa?>> Ate Barak a yaa nyini Tabor Guuku zuk a siŋ ate nuruba tusa pi (10,000) a vi wa ŋaaŋ. 15Ase Barak ale kasim a jueli ba zuk la, Naawen yaa basi ate yɔgsum a yik Sisera ale wa tugurik tɔŋdɔba ate Sisera a basi ba torokowa ale chali naŋtabie. 16Alege Barak a vi ba torokoma ale tugurik tɔŋdɔma a paari Yaroset Yaggoyim. Sisera tommu meena ba jam ko ba kama ale gebik, nuru yeŋ mɛ la an tali ya.
17Sisera a jam chali ka naŋtabie a cheŋ Jael viuku Ken denɔwa Ɛba pok ale la, dii nyiŋla nyemagsika ale jam bo Jabin Yazor naawa ale Ken denɔwa buuni suŋsuŋ.
18Jael yaa nyini tu Sisera a weeni wa ayen, <<Jam m nyɔnɔ, jam jo. Kan chali yɔgsummoa.>> Ate wa yaa jo nipowa viuku po ate nipowa a pai wa suk.
19Wa weeni ayen, <<Nyanyuila ale ta mu.>> Mi a saalim te mu nyiam.>> Wa yaa lak bunlɔk ale biisim a te ate wa nyu ale ŋman pai wa a suk.
20Sisera yaa weeni nipowa ayen, <<Zaani viuku nansuiŋku nɔi.>> <<Ase waai a dan jam bek fu ayen, nuru a bo dela?>> Weeni ayen, <<Aaya.>>
21Alege Jael Ɛba powa a yaa pai viuku kpaasini le janakferim a cheŋ wa jigi nna diki alege wa jiak a doa. Nipowa pai kpaasini a nak feri wa ponni a vuri paari tɛŋka ate wa kpi.
22Barak yaa jam vi Sisera ŋaaŋ ate Jael yaa tu wa. Wa weeni ayen, <<Jam.>> <<M le dak nuru waai ate fi a gisi la a sak fu.>> Wa yaa va wa jo ga a paari la ale ka viuk kpaasiri ale feri wa ponni ate wa kpi doa.
23Dai dila danni Wen a pai Jabin Keenan naawa a te Izirali demma. 24Izirali demma a yaa ŋmasi nya pagrim nna yegayega Jabin Keenan naawa zuk a ga paari diipo ate ba ko wa la.

Title: NIŊDEERƆBA 5
Content:
1Dai dila danni Debora ale Abinoam biika Barak a lenni ka yiini dɛ.
2<<Ase Izirali nabisaŋa a dan dɛ niŋ, ase nuruma a nin pai badek a te ale yaalika, pak Naawen. 3<<Ni wom kude nalima! Ni wom niŋdeerɔba! M le lenni yiili a te Naawen, m le lenni. Mi ale lenni yiila a te Naawen Izirali Wenni.
4<<Naawen, ase fi ale nyini Seir a nyini la, fi ale gɔk santiri a nyini Edom tɛŋka la, tɛŋka a choa kama, ate ŋmorukku a ni, chiŋmaaŋa a kpiiri nyiam. 5Guutaŋa meena a jam choa kama Naawen niŋ, Waai ale soa Sinai la, Naawen niŋ, Izirali Wenni.
6<<Samgar Anat biika ale Jael daaŋa po suik doataŋa a jam ka vaka, baai ale jaa nyiem la a vaka suik vuvɔgsaŋŋa. 7Tɛŋ fiisaŋa ale bo Izirali po la boka an jam masa ate ku paari diipo ate mi Debora a vaari yiti ase ma la Izirali tɛŋka po. 8Ase ba le jam lueri bɔgluk paalita la, kpaliŋ ale jam tɛŋka nansuiŋtaŋa nɔi, nina an tu gbaluk yaase jachɔgsim Izirali nuruma ale paari tusa pisinaansiwa (40,000) la jigi ya. 9Mi suinummu a bo ale ka Izirali nabisaŋa jigi ale baai ale nye badek popola ayen ba tom a maa bo nuruma po la. Pak Naawen.
10Nama baai ale a do bon peelita la a kala kuntuŋta zuk la ale nama baai ale a cheŋ suiku po la, ni 11poli yilendisaŋa wari kab tii ate ni nyu nyiamu la. Ba pilim teeri Naawen wayɔrisima tuimaŋa kama. Wa wayɔrisima tuimaŋa ate wa tugurik tɔŋdɔba a bo Izirali po a nye la, <<Ate Naawen nuruma a yaa cheŋ tɛŋka nansuiŋtaŋa noa. 12Yiti ŋmai! Yiti ŋmai Debora! Yiti ŋmai! Yiti ŋman a lenni yiili. Vaari yiti Barak. Nya nakdeka fi ni a nak de baai la zuk Abinoam biiga.
13Nidoa baai ate ba tali basi la a yaa jam kpaŋŋa jigi. Naawen nuruma a jam m jigi ale pagrim. 14Ba gela a nyini Ɛfraim tɛŋka a jam baai naŋsa ale nyini Amalek la. Benjamin a jam bo ale nuruma baai ale va fu la kama. A nyini Makir, kpaga ale nyini dula a siŋ jam, a nyini Zebulun waai ale ta kpagi tachek la.
15Isaka nabisaŋa a jam bo ale ka Debora, Isaka a jam bo ale ka Barak, a kpabi vi wa ŋaaŋ a siŋ viaka po. Aruben tɛŋka po ba jam kpesi a nya suiniima po ka nna yegayega. 16Ka boa ale soa ate fi maa bo tuka bottaŋa suŋsuŋŋa a wom piisaŋa fiili wika? Aruben tɛŋka po ba jam kpesi a nya suiniima po ka nna yegayega. 17Gilead jam bo ka Jodan Benni ŋmai alege Dan, ka boa ate fi a bo ŋaaruŋtaŋa tɛŋ a beni? Asɛ a wari ka nyiamu nɔi wa kan cheŋ. 18Zebulun demma nyuvooŋa a jam bo ka kum po. Ku ka dila ate Nafitali demma a bo guutaŋa zuk.
19Nalima a jam. Ba kpaliŋ. Keenan nalimaŋa a jam nye kpaliŋ Taanak po Megiddo nyaataŋa noa, alege ba an ji kpana a ta cheŋ ya, ba an kɔlim jaaboa. 20A nyini wenŋmazukku chiŋmarisaŋa a jam kpaliŋ, a nyini ba boka jigini ba jam nye kpaliŋ ale Sisera. 21Kison Benni a ji ba a ta cheŋ, beli kpakka, Kison Benni. Mi ale gɔk santiri a cheŋ ale pagrim. 22Ate wusuma naŋsaba a na, ate ŋa a laari a tabi ale ŋa naŋsabaŋa. 23Naawen maarɔwa yaa weeni ayen, <<Ka te Meroz. Ka te ka nuruma, dii nyiŋla ba an jam a maari Naawen, ba an jam a maari Naawen a ta chaab ale pagrɔma.
24Jael ale nya niaka a gaam nipooba meena, Ɛba Ken denɔwa powa, waai ale nya niaka a gaam nipok baai meena ale bo viita po la. 25Wa bek nyiam, ate wa te wa biisim, taasi dii ale magsi kpaga la wa nyo naabiisim goam du a ta jam. 26Nipowa nisaŋa a laari yik viuku kpaasini, wa juga nisaŋa a laari yik tuimtomdɔwa janakferimmu. Nipowa a jam nak Sisera a ŋɔriŋ wa zukku, ale nak vuri wa zukku nakpiak. 27Nipowa naŋta a po wa jam lo, wa jam lo kama dula ate wa jam doa. Nipowa naŋta a po ate wa jam lo, wa jam lo kama. Juijui ate wa lo la wa kpi ka dula.
28<<Sisera mawa a jam va ka tuokparuk a nya peelim. Sisera mawa a jam va ka tuokparuk a kpesi a nya ase wa cheena ya ale a weeni ayen ka boa ate wa torokoma a beni ale jam ka? Ka boa ate tama a kan wom torokoma naŋsa nuem ka? 29Wa liema po waai ale ta yam a gaam ba meena la yaa tulisi wa ayen, wa kasim jam ta ka wayeŋka a weeni a tulim ayen, 30<<Ba boro a labi ka ŋan baai ate ba kɔlim la, nidoa yeŋ a soa nipokbili yeŋ yaase baye, garuk naliŋsa ase kɔlim ka la a te Sisera, garuk ŋmiŋmiruk yoŋta, garuk yoŋ naliŋta a magsi m ŋinni, ŋade meena ase ŋan baai ate ba kɔlim la.
31Dila fi dachaasaŋa meena abe kpi Naawen yaa. Alege baai ale a yaali fu la abe nye ase wenbinni a nin pusi ale di pagrimu. Ate tɛŋka yaa jam nya suiyɔgni bena pisinaansi.

Title: NIŊDEERƆBA 6
Content:
1Izirali demma yaa ŋman nye biem Naawen nimbie po, ate wa pai ba a nyo Midian demma nisima po bena ŋayopɔi. 2Dii nyiŋla Midian demma ale ta ninam buui a jam ba jigi la a pagra kama, Izirali demma yaa jam a ti kusuŋta a te badek, a suk pina muulisa po ale pina vie po ale ba pagrimu ale bo juijui la. 3Diipo meena Izirali demma a dan bori ba ŋantaŋa, Midian ale Amalek ale kori geŋsa nuruma a ga fɛ jo ba tɛŋka po. 4Ba jam kali tɛŋka po a kaasi ŋankpaantaŋa meena a ga paari Gaza ale an tali javuk a te Izirali demma, piisa yaase niiga yaase bonsa ba an jam tali jaaboa. 5Ba jan jam ale ka ba duŋsaŋa ale viita ase tintue la. Ku jam daa moali ate fi baga a chiini nidoama ale ba laalaakomima. Ba jam fɛ jo tɛŋka po kama a kaasi ka. 6Midian demma a jam nye Izirali demma kama ate ba daanika po ate ba kaari te Naawen ayen wa maari ba.
7Ase Izirali demma ale kaari a te Naawen Midian demma nyiŋla, 8Naawen yaa te ba biisiteerɔ, waai ale jam weeni ayen, <<Ka nnala ate Naawen, Izirali Wenni a weeni la, Mi ta ni a nyini Ejipiti, yɔntidi tɛŋka po a nyini. 9Mi chiak ni a nyini Ejipiti pagrimu po a ta nyini, ale ta ni a nyini ni namsidɔma meena nisa po a nyini. Mi yiak ba a basi ale te ni ba tɛŋka. 10Mi weeni ni ayen, <<Mi ale Naawen ni Wenni, ni kaa kaab Amori demma bɔgtaŋa baai tɛŋ po ate ni boro la.> Alege nama an wom mi.>>
11Naawen maarɔwa yaa jam a kali kinkaŋ peruk tɛŋ Ofra po dula ka Joas Abiezer denɔwa ale jam soa, juijui ate wa biika Gidiyon a jam a fɔb za daam nyeka jigini ayen Midian demma a kan nya ŋa. 12Ase Naawen maarɔwa ale jam Gidiyon jigi la, wa weeni ayen, <<Naawen a bo ale fu tanjaŋini tugurik tɔŋdɔ.>> 13Gidiyon yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ase Naawen a dam bo ale ti kama ka boa ate kude meena a nye ti? Wa wakinkaglaŋa meena ate ti koma a weeni ti ŋa wari ase ba ale weeni ayen, <<Daa Naawen ale ta ti a nyini Ejipiti po? Yɔgyɔgla de Naawen a zɛri ti kama a pai ti a nyo Midian demma nisa po.>>
14Naawen viriŋ wa jigi ayen, <<Cheŋ ale pagrim buui ate fi ta la a ga vari Izirali demma a ta nyini Midian demma nisa po. Daa mi ale a tom fu?>> 15Gidiyon yaa weeni ayen, <<Alege M Nyɔnɔ, mi ale nye ka sɛ a vari Izirali a basi? Mi dɔkdemma ale wobsa Manasa demma po, mi abe le pɔsima m yenni demma po.>> 16Ate Naawen a tulisi ayen, <<Mi ale bo ale fu ate fi nak Midian demma meena.>> 17Gidiyon yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ase yɔgyɔgla de m dan nya ŋmanteka fi nina po, te mu daana ŋaai ale ŋa sak ayen ka fi ale sum a biisi ale mu la. 18Mi a saalim kan cheŋ ate ku paari diipo ate mi ale ŋman jam a ta m tiirimu a jam fi niŋ.>> Ate Naawen a weeni ayen, <<Mi ale limisi ate fi ŋman jam.>>
19Gidiyon yaa jo gomsi buuk paaluk, a pai zom china pi a nye boroborok, dabinta a jam ka ku po. Wa jam pai lammu a nyo ka busik po ale pai ku jentaŋa a nyo binbili po, wa ta ti a nyini peelim a pai ti a te wa kinkaŋ peruk tɛŋ.
20Wen maarɔwa a weeni wa ayen, <<Pai lammu ale boroboroku ate dabinta a karo la a vi piuŋku zuk a kpiiri jentaŋa du.>> Ate Gidiyon a nye dila. 21Ate Naawen maarɔwa a yaa pai doanni ale bo wa nisaŋa po la a tiri lammu ale boroboroku ate dabinta a ka ku po la. Ate bolim a nyini piuŋku po a dɛ lammu ale boroboroku. Ate Naawen maarɔwa a yaa muriŋ bɛ. 22Ase Gidiyon ale ga miŋ ayen ka Naawen maarɔ la, wa yaa nuem ayen, <<M Nyɔnɔ Naawen yaa, mi nya Naawen maarɔwa kama.
23Alege Naawen a weeni wa ayen, <<Ka suiyɔgni, kan chali yɔgsum, fi kan kpi.>> 24Dila Gidiyon yaa sɛ kuŋkuŋ a te Naawen dula a wi ku ayen Naawen Ka Suiyɔgni. A ta jam paari jinla de, ku za ka Ofra ale bo Abiezer demma po la.
25Yok kula dek Naawen a jam weeni wa kama ayen, <<Yik lalik kaai ale saari siyewa la a nyini fi kowa duŋsaŋa po, kaai ale paari bena ŋayopɔi la. Kpiti fi kowa ale nye kuŋkuŋ tii a te Baal la abe fi che Asera zaŋni ale bo ku gauŋ la a lɔnsi. 26Abe fi sɛ kuŋkuŋ dek a te Naawen fi Wenni guuku de zuk. Pai Asera zaŋni ate fi che lɔnsi la, pai lalik kaai ale saari siyewa a nye juka tiirimu.>>
27Dila Gidiyon yaa ta wa tomteerɔma pi a nye dii dek ate Naawen a jam weeni wa la. Alege wa le jam yɔgsa ale wa dɔkdemma ale tɛŋka nuruma la nyiŋ, wa jam nye ku ka yok daa kantueŋŋa.
28Saluiku ase tɛŋka nuruma ale yiti la, ba nya ka Baal kuŋkuŋ ale ŋɔriŋ ale Asera zaŋni a che doa ku gauŋ ate lalik kaai ale saari siyewa la a kaab kuŋkuŋ paalukku ale sɛ la zuk.
29Ba yaa bek chaab ayen, <<Ka wana ale nye nnala?>> Ba le kpesi badek a gisi la, ba wom ayen ka, <<Gidiyon Joas biika ale nye dila.>> 30Tɛŋka nuruma yaa weeni Joas ayen, <<Ta fi nidoabinni a jam. Ku a fɛ ate wa kpi, dii nyiŋla wa kpiti Baal kuŋkuŋku kama ale che Asera zaŋni a lɔnsi ku gauŋ.>>
31Alege Joas a tulisi nuru boanni ale gilim wa la ayen, <<Nama a yaali ni kpaliŋ a te Baal kama? Waai ale a kpaliŋ a te ku la, ti le ko wa saluik. Ase Baal a dan sum ka wen, wa le zɛri wadek nyiŋ ase nuru, waai a nin kpiti wa kuŋkuŋku.>> 32Dila, dai dila danni ba jam a wi Gidiyon ayen ka, <<Jerub Baal,>> a weeni ayen, <<Basi ate Baal a tu chaab ale wa,>> dii nyiŋla wa kpiti ka Baal kuŋkuŋku.
33Midian demma ale Amalek demma ale konni po nuruma a yaa gum chaab a lo Jodan Benni a jueli a kali Jezreel Viaka po. 34Ate Naawen Chiika yaa jam Gidiyon po ate wa peeri damuniŋ a weeni Abiezer demma ayen ba va wa. 35Wa jam tom ka nuruba Manasa tɛŋka meena po, a wi ba ayen ba gomsi a magsi kpaliŋ, ale Asɛ mɛ ale Zebulun ale Nafitali demma ate ba mɛ yaa jam cheŋ a ga tu ba. 36Gidiyon yaa weeni Wen ayen, <<Ase fi a daa fi vari Izirali a basi ale mi nisaŋa ase fi ale puulim diila, 37Nya mi ale pai duŋ gbaŋ ale ta kɔbta la a dueni ŋanta fɔbika jigini. Ase maglim a dan lo duŋ ka gbaŋka ale bo juijui la nyiini alege ate tɛŋka meena a ko, mi yaa le seba ayen fi ale pai ka mi nisa a vari Izirali demma a basi ase fi ale weeni diila. 38Dila abe le jam nye. Gidiyon yaa yiti saluik yokyokwa dai dii ale paasaŋ la, wa yaa ŋmiak duŋka gbaŋka ate maglimu nyiamu a sueri chin.
39Ate Gidiyon yaa weeni Wen ayen, <<Kan te fi sui a puuri ale mu. Basi ate m bek bega bunyi ŋmana. Basi ate m chamsi bunyi a nya ale duŋka gbaŋka. Basi ate duŋka gbaŋka a kosa abe tɛŋka yɔk ale maglim.>> 40Yok kula Wen a nye dila. Ka duŋka gbaŋka nyiini ale jam ko, tɛŋka meena a jam lik ale ka maglim.

Title: NIŊDEERƆBA 7
Content:
1Saluik yokyokwa, Jerub Baal yaase Gidiyon ale la ale wa nuruma meena a yaa ga kali Yarod vinni. Midian demma boka jigini a jam boka bala wiilukku geŋsa a viaka ale moata More guuku la. 2Naawen a weeni Gidiyon ayen, <<Fi nidoama a ŋmasi piisi kama ale mi ale pai Midian demma a nyo ba nisima po. Ate Izirali demma a kan kuulim ale mi ayen badek pagrim ale vari ba a basi, 3mooli a te nuruma ayen, <<Nuru waai nyiŋ a dan gɔk ate yɔgsum a yik wa, wa baga a ŋmani kama a basi Gilead guuku.>> Dila nidoaba tusa pisiye ale ŋaye (22,000) ale jam ŋmani alege tusa pi (10,000) a tali wari.
4Alege Naawen a weeni Gidiyon ayen, <<Nidoama a diem ŋmasi piisi kama. Ta ba a cheŋ nyiam jigi, ate mi ale poori ba dula a te fu. Ase mi a dan weeni ayen, <Wade ale va fu a cheŋ,> wa a cheŋ, alege mi a dan weeni ayen, <Wade a kan va fu a cheŋ,> wa kan cheŋ.>>
5Dila Gidiyon yaa ta nidoama a siŋ nyiam jigi. Dula Naawen a weeni wa ayen, <<Poori baai ale pai nɔi a nyu nyiamu ase biak la a ta nyini baai ale pai duna a kpi tɛŋ ale a nyu la.>> 6Nidoaba kobsita ale jam pai ba nisa a ŋari nyiamu a nyu. Mbala meena a jam kpi ka duna tɛŋ ayen ba nyu.
7Naawen a jam weeni Gidiyon ayen, <<Ale nidoaba kobsitawa ale jam a lak nyiamu la mi ale vari fu a basi a pai Midian demma a nyo fi nisima po. Basi ate nidoa mbala meena a ŋman kuli wa le nyini juijui la.>> 8Dila Gidiyon yaa basi ate Izirali dem mbala meena a ŋmani kali ba viitaŋa alege a ta nidoaba kobsitawa baai ale jam tuesi nidoa mbala ŋantaŋa ale damunsaŋa la. Midian demma boka jigini a jam boka wa tɛŋ viaka po. 9Yok kula po Naawen a weeni Gidiyon ayen, <<Yiti ŋmai, cheŋ Midian demma boka jigini a nye kpaliŋ ale ba dii nyiŋla m za m pai ba a nyo ka fi nisima po. 10Ase fi a dan yɔgsa ale fi le nye kpaliŋ ale ba, cheŋ ba boka jigini ale fi tomteerɔwa Pura 11a wom ba le a weeni diila. Dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ fi nya nyiŋbiiri a kpaliŋ ale ba.>> Dila ate wa ale Pura wa tomteerɔwa a yaa jam cheŋ ba boka jigini nakpiak. 12Midian demma ale Amalek demma ale nuru baai ale bo kori geŋsaŋa la meena a jam kala ka viak po a sobri nna ase tintue la. Ba laalaakomima a jam ka chiina ase nyakpiemu tintain busuŋ la.
13Gidiyon yaa jam paari ale nuru a boro a weeni wa doa wa gɔdaasima ayen, <<Boroborok gilin fiik ale jam gɔk nna zekzek a jo Midian demma boka jigini. Ku jam nak viuku ale fifiok ate viuku a tulim a lɔ tɛŋ.>> 14Wa doawa yaa tulisi ayen, <<Kude daa wayoŋ a ŋman gaam gebik woŋ kaai ate Joas Izirali denɔwa biika Gidiyon a ta la, Wen a pai Midian demma ale ba boka jigini meena a nyo ka ba nisima po.>>
15Ase Gidiyon ale ga wom gɔdaasimaŋa ale ŋa kiri ale ka diila, wa yaa nye Naawen jiam. Wa yaa ŋman cheŋ Izirali demma boka jigini a wi ayen, <<Ba yiti ŋmai Naawen a pai Midian demma boka jigini a nyo ka ti nisima po.>> 16Wa labi nidoaba kobsitawa buta, wa pai damunsa ale leŋ koruta a nyo ba meena nisima po ate botta a bo leŋsaŋa po.
17Wa jam weeni ba ayen, <<Ni kpesi a nya mi ale a nye diila. Ase mi a dan paari ba boka jigini nakpiaka, ni nye dii dek ate mi a nye la. 18Ase mi ale baai meena ale bo ale mi la a dan peeri ti damunsaŋa, a nyini ni boka jigini meena nama mɛ a peeri ni damunsaŋa abe ni kaari a te Naawen ale Gidiyon.>>
19Gidiyon ale nidoaba kooku ale wa a yaa paari Midian demma boka jigini nakpiaka goota suŋsuŋ, ba le tagri limisidɔwa la ŋaaŋnyiŋ. Ba yaa peeri ba damunsaŋa ale mobi ba leŋsaŋa ale bo ba nisaŋa po la. 20Labika butawa a jam peeri ba damunsaŋa kama ale ŋɔriŋ ba leŋsaŋa. A ta botta ba gala nisaŋa po ale ta damunsaŋa ate ba jam a peeri la ba juga nisaŋa po. Ba jam kaari ayen, <<Gebik woŋ a te Naawen ale Gidiyon.>> 21Nuru meena ale jam za wa zaana jigi a gilim ba boka jigini la, Midian demma meena yaa yiti a chali ale a kaari ase ba ale yiti a chali la.
22Ase damunsa kobsitawa ale jam peeri la, Naawen yaa basi ate nidoama ale bo ba boka jigini la yaa tulim a chub chaab ale ba gebik woŋsaŋa. Tugurik tɔŋdɔma yaa yiti chali cheŋ Bet Sitta a duŋ Zerera ate ku yalima a paari Abel Meyola tɛŋ banni a moata Tabbat. 23Izirali demma ale nyini Nafitali ale Asɛ ale Manasa meena la ba jam wi ba kama ate ba nyini, ate ba vi Midian demma. 24Gidiyon yaa tom nuruba Ɛfraim tɛŋka ate guuta a bo ka po la meena ayen, <<Ni jam a nye kpaliŋ ale Midian demma a de ba niŋ a kasi Jodan benni a ta ga paari Bet Baraya.>> Dila ba jam wi Ɛfraim nidoama meena ate ba nyini a ga tuesi Jodan nyaataŋa a ta ga paari Bet Baraya. 25Ba jam maa nak yik ka Midian demma niŋdeerɔba baye. Oreb ale Zeeb ale la. Ba jam ko Oreb ka Oreb piuŋku zuk ale ko Zeeb wadek daamu nyeka jigini. Ba jam vi Midian demma kama a ta Oreb ale Zeeb Zuimaŋa a jam te Gidiyon, waai ale jam bo Jodan benni nɔi la.

Title: NIŊDEERƆBA 8
Content:
1Ɛfraim demma a yaa bek Gidiyon ayen, <<Ka boa ate fi a nye tama nna? Ka boa ate fi an wi tama fi ale a yaali fi nye kpaliŋ ale Midian demma la?>> Ate ba yaa ŋma wa nna tuotuowa.
2Ate wa tulisi ba ayen, <<Mi nya ka boa ase fi nin pa magsi chaab ale nama? Ɛfraim kpari ŋan yisuŋtaŋa zunchoŋ ŋan baai meena ate Abiezer a nya la? 3Wen a pai Oreb ale Zeeb Midian niŋdeerɔma a nyo ka ni nisima po. Mi jam baga a nyeka ka boa a magsi chaab ale fi?>> Kude nyiŋ ba sueŋa ale jam a puuri ale wa la a yaa yɔk.
4Gidiyon nidoaba kobsitawa a jam jiak kama ale pik vi ba a paari Jodan Benni a lo di jueli. 5Wa jam weeni Sukkot nidoama ayen, <<Ni te m tugurik tommu ŋandiinta, ba jiak kama, alege m diem a vi Zeba ale Zalmunna Midian nalimaŋa>>
6Alege Sukkot kpaŋŋa ayen, <<Fi poom ŋaam yik Zeba ale Zalmunna nisima a tara? Boa ni soa ate tama a te fi tugurik tommu ŋandiinta?>> 7Gidiyon yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ka dila, ase Naawen a dan pai Zeba ale Zalmunna a nyo m nisa po m le cheeri ni nyiŋsaŋa ale kpiluŋbaoŋ ale pok ta chari jam.>>
8A nyini dula wa jam cheŋ ka Peniel a bek ba dila degadega alege ba mɛ a tulisi wa ase Sukkot nidoama ale tulisi diila. 9Dila wa yaa weeni Peniel nidoama ayen, <<Mi a dan ŋmani ale nakdeka, m le nak yewɔŋku de a lɔnsi.>>
10Zeba ale Zalmunna a jam bo ka Karkor ale tugurik tɔŋdɔba ase tusa pi ale ŋanu (15,000) la, tugurik tɔŋdɔ baai meena ale jam tali la, ka konni nuruma po, ka nidoaba tusa kook ale pisiye (120,000) ale jam kpi. 11Gidiyon a jam va ka Noba ale Jogbeya kori geŋ a ga diiri tugurik tɔŋdɔ baai ate ba zɛ ba wari la. 12Zeba ale Zalmunna, Midian nalima ŋayewa a jam chali kama alege wa jam vi ba kama a yik ba a nya pagrim ba tugurik tɔŋdɔma zuk.
13Gidiyon Joas biika yaa nyini kpaliŋ ka po a va Yeres Guuku a ŋmani. 14Wa jam yik ka Sukkot nuru paalik a bek wa, ate nuru paalika a ŋmarisi Sukkot kpaga pisiyopɔi ale ŋayopɔiwa tɛŋka nisɔmma yueŋa a te wa. 15Gidiyon yaa jam weeni Sukkot nidoama ayen, <<Zeba ale Zalmunna baai nyiŋ ate ni a na mi ayen, <<Fi poom ŋaam ta Zeba ale Zalmunna nisa kama la? Boa ni soa ate tama a te fi nidoama ale jiak la ŋandiinta?>> 16Wa jam yik tɛŋka nisɔmma ale nidoama Sukkot po a sak ba yam ate ku jo ba nyiŋ ale kpiluŋbaoŋ ale pok ta chari jam. 17Wa maa jam nak Peniel yewɔŋku a lɔnsi kama ale ko tɛŋka nidoama.
18Wa jam bek Zeba ale Zalmunna ayen, <<Ka nuru boan chaab ate nama a ko Tabor po la?>> Ate ba tulisi ayen, nuruba ase fi la, ba wanyi meena a jam a nya ase ka nabiik la.>> 19Gidiyon yaa tulisi ayen, <<Bala a jam ka mi suata, midek mawa bisa. Ase Naawen ale vua la, ase ni daam a dan kan ko ba, mi ate kan ko ni.>> 20Wa yaa viriŋ weeni Jeter wa nidoabili kpagni ayen, <<Ko ba.>> Alege Jeter an jam yeeri wa gebika dii nyiŋla wa jam ka bi fiik a chali yɔgsum.
21Zeba ale Zelmunna ayen, <<Jam, a nye fidek, ase nidoa la wa pagrimu ka dila.>> Dila Gidiyon yaa jam niŋ nyiŋ a ko ba ale yeeri baŋsaŋa ba laalaakomima ŋieŋa po. 22Ate Izirali demma a weeni Gidiyon ayen, <<A nya ti zuk fi ale fi biika ale fi ŋaaŋbiika dii nyiŋla, fi ale vari ti a ta nyini Midian demma nisa po.>> 23Alege Gidiyon a jam weeni ba ayen, <<Mi a kan nya ni zuwa yaase mi biika a nya ni zuwa. Naawen ale wa a nya ni zuk.>> 24Wa weeni ayen, <<Mi ta ka bega bunyi, ayen ni wanyi meena a te mu tukpan a nyini ŋan baai ate ni kɔlim la charuku po.>> Ku jam ka ŋiak wari ayen Ismael demma a su ligmɔniŋ tukpana.
25Ba yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ti sue ale peenti ate ti pai ŋa a te.>> Dila ba yaa lati garuk ate waai meena a pai tukpan a ta nyini wa kɔlim ka po la a nyoro. 26Ligmɔniŋ tukpanaŋa ate wa jam bek ate ba te wa la ka ligbie dobrim kobsa pi ale ŋayopɔi, ba an jam chiini baŋsaŋa ale ŋiri chɔrimaŋa ale garuk ŋmiŋmiruk tii ate nalima a su la yaase chɔrimaŋa ale jam bo ba laalaakomima ŋieŋa po la a gum du. 27Gidiyon jam pai ka ligmɔniŋka a nye garuk geli, kuui ate wa pai dueni Ofra tɛŋka po, wa tɛŋka la. Izirali demma meena a jam pai ka badek a da te a kaab ku dula, ate ku chim baruk a te Gidiyon ale wa dɔkdemma.
28Midian demma a jam kpi kama Izirali demma niŋ, ba zuk an jam zak ŋmana. Gidiyon vummu daaŋa po tɛŋka a jam nya suiyɔgni a paari ka bena pisinaansi.
29Jerub Baal Joas biika yaa jam ŋman kuli yeri a ga boro. 30Wa jam ta ka nidoabilisa pisiyopɔi, diila wa jam ta ka nipok boari. 31Wa nɔŋku, waai ale jam bo Sikiim la, mɛ a jam biak ka nidoabili a te wa, ate wa te wa yuei ayen Abimelek. 32Gidiyon Joas biika a jam kpaŋ kama nalimnyiini ale kpi ate ba gu wa Joas wa kowa boosuku po Ofra ale bo Abiezer demma tɛŋka po la.
33Gidiyon ale kpi la ku an beni ya ate Izirali demma a ŋman pai badek a da a te Baal. Ba jam ti Baal Berit a zaani kama ase ba bɔgluk la, 34ale an ŋman teeri Naawen ba Wenni, waai ale vari ba a ta nyini ba dachaasaŋa meena nisa po a basi la. 35Ba an jam sak jiirim ale Jerub Baal dɔkdemma, Gidiyon ale la, wamaŋ sii meena ate wa jam nye te ba la.

Title: NIŊDEERƆBA 9
Content:
1Abimelek Jerub Baal biika yaa cheŋ wa mawa suataŋa ale bo Sikiim la jigi a weeni ba ale wa mawa yezukku meena, ayen, 2<<Bek Sikiim demma meena ayen, <<Ka din ale zunchoŋ a te fu. Ka Jerub Baal nidoabilisa pisiyopɔiwa a nya ni zuk yaase nuru yeŋ a nya ni zuwa? Ni teeri mi ka ni nyiŋ lam ale ni ziim.>>
3Ase wa suataŋa ale ŋman pilim weeni kude meena a te Sikiim demma meena la, ba yaa jam siak ayen ba va Abimelek, ba weeni ayen wa ka ti suok. 4Ba jam te wa ka kpana ligbie dobrim a paari pisiyopɔi a ta nyini Baal Berit puusika yenni po, ate Abimelek a pai a da tugurik tɔŋdɔba, baai yaa le jam chim wa ŋaaŋviirɔba. 5Wa jam cheŋ wa kowa yenni ale bo Ofra la po, a ko wa suataŋa Jerub Baal bisa pisiyopɔiwa tintain yeŋ zuk. Alege Jotam Jerub Baal bi baaŋka a jam suk kama wa an nya wala. 6Ate Sikiim demma ale Bet Millo demma meena a yaa tigsi chaab a bo tiib kpiemu ale bo Sikiim la ayen ba bobi Abimelek naab.
7Ase Jotam ale jam wom kude la, wa yaa jueli Gerizim Guuku zuk a na ba ayen, <<Ni wom mi Sikiim demma, ate Wen a wom ni. 8Dai yeŋ ate tiisa a cheŋ si bobi naab a te sidek. Si yaa jam weeni kpaam tiimu ayen, <<Chim ti naab.>>
9<<Alege ate kpaam tiimu a tulisi ayen, <<Mi a basi m kpaamu buui nyiŋ ate wena ale nuruba a ta zula la abe m bo tiisa zuk a yugi?>> 10<<Tiisaŋa a yaa ŋman weeni kiŋkaŋka ayen, <<Jam chim ti naab.>>
11Alege ate kiŋkaŋka a tulisi ayen, <<Mi a basi m yɔnaŋa ŋaai ale masa la abe m bo tiisa zuk a yugi?>> 12Ate tiisaŋa yaa weeni tunuku ayen, <<Jam chim ti naab.>>
13Alege ate tunuku a tulisi ayen, <<Mi a basi m daamu, buui nyiŋ ate wena ale nuruba a mariŋ badek la abe m bo tiisa zuk a yugi?>>
14Kpeglimka tiisaŋa meena a yaa weeni kangbegini ayen, <<Jam a chim ti naab.>>
15<<Kangbegini a yaa weeni tiisaŋa ayen, <Ase ni dan sum a yaali ayen ni bobi mi naab ate mi a nya ni zuk, ni be jam a suk mi yɔgsummu po, alege kan daa di, bolim abe nyini kangbegini po a de Lebanon nyunyoŋtaŋa meena.>>
16<<Yɔgyɔgla de ase nama a dan nye ka zula nyeela ale wensie maŋsa a bobi Abimelek naab, ale nye Jerub Baal ale wa dɔkdemma a magsi, ase ni dan poom nye wa ka dii ale magsi wa la, 17ale poli ayen m kowa a jam kpaliŋ a te ni, wa an kpaliŋ wa nyuvunni nyiŋŋa, a vari ni a ta nyini Midian demma nisima po a basi, 18alege jinla ni ta ka chaab ale mi kowa dɔkdemma, a ko wa nidoabilisa pisiyopɔiwa tintain yeŋ zuk ale bobi Abimelek wa nipokbili yɔmawa biika, naab ate wa nya Sikiim demma zuk dii nyiŋla wa ka ni suok la nyiŋ, 19ase ni dam poom nye ka zula ale wensie nyeela a te Jerub Baal ale wa dɔkdemma jinla, Abimelek ate le chim ni mariŋka abe nama mɛ a chim wa mariŋka. 20Alege ni a dan kan nye dila, basi ate bolim a nyini Abimelek jigi a dɛ nama Sikiim demma ale Bet Millo demma abe bu dɛ Abimelek.>>
21Jotam yaa chali ga suk Beer tɛŋka po, dii nyiŋla wa jam a chali ka yɔgsum ale wa suoku Abimelek.
22Abimelek ale jam nya Izirali tɛŋka zuk a paari bena ŋata la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, 23Wen yaa tom chichirik biok Abimelek ale Sikiim demma jigi, kaai nyeka ale jam ŋmasi toa a te Abimelek la. 24Naawen a jam nye kude kama ayen kaasuŋ kuui ate ba nye Jerub Baal a ko nidoabilisa pisiyopɔiwa la, ba ziimu ale nyini la, ayen ku chim tutuna a bo ba suoku Abimelek ale Sikiim demma zuk, baai ale jam maari wa ate wa ko wa suataŋa la. 25Ate ba zɛri wa nɔi la, Sikiim demma de yaa basi ate ka nidoaba a ga suk guuku zuk ayen ba zu waai meena ale va dula a taam la, ate kude a jo Abimelek turi.
26Gaal Ebed biika yaa va wa suoku a cheŋ Sikiim po, ate ka nuruma a pai ba sebchakka meena a basi wa jigi. 27Ba ale jam cheŋ tattaŋa po a tigsi ba yɔnaŋa a pai da la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, ba yaa jam dɛ tigi ba wenni dɔkku po.
