18Eli ale wom dii ale nye nɔiyeŋka dakanni la, wa deri lo ŋaaŋnyiŋ tɛŋka nansuiŋku nɔi. Wa le lo la wa ŋinni yaa wɛ ate wa kpi, diila wa jam kpaŋ kama ale biigi. Wa jam chim Izirali niŋdeerɔ a paari ka bena pisinaansi.
19Eli sampowa, Fineyas powa a jam maa bo ka tɛŋka po. Wa jam ta ka lɔgi a moata biam. Wa le wom dii ale nye nɔiyeŋka dakanni la ale wa chorɔwa ate wa ŋiak nidoawa a kpi la, wa deri a dom. Wa deri biak diila domka jam pagra ka yega. 20Wa jaa kpi kama alege nipok baai ale jam yik ate wa biak la a weeni ayen wa kan te ku daani wa biak ka nidoabili. Alege wa an jam tulisi yaa.
21Wa jam te wa yuei ayen ka Ichabod. Di kiri ale Naawen zulaŋa a basi Izirali kama. Wa jam weeni dila kama dii nyiŋla ba tuesi nɔiyeŋka dakanni kama ate wa chorɔwa ale wa ŋiak nidoawa mɛ a kpi. 22Wa weeni ayen, <<Naawen zulaŋa a basi Izirali kama diila nɔiyeŋka dakanni ba tuesi kama.>>

Title: 1 SAMUEL 5
Content:
1Filistia demma ale tuesi Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni Izirali demma jigi la, ba pai ta nyini Ebenezer a cheŋ ka ba tɛŋka Asdod. 2Ba yaa ta di jo ba wenni Dagon yenni po a yaa pai zaani di gauŋ. 3Asdod demma yaa yiti saluik yokyokwa. Ba le cheŋ wenni yenni la ba yaa nya wenni Dagon lo kama pai nyue vuk tɛŋ nɔiyeŋka, dakanni niŋ. Ba yaa ŋman zak Dagon zaani di zaanaŋa. 4Saluik yokyokwa Asdod demma ŋman yiti a nya wenni Dagon lo kama po nyiŋ a dua nɔiyeŋka dakanni niŋ. Yɔgyɔgla de luetaŋa ku zukku ale di nisimaŋa a wɛ kama a dua tuoku nɔi. Di nyiŋka nyiini ale kan wɛ ya. 5Kude nyiŋ, a nyini dila po a cheŋ baai ale a kaab Dagon la a daa jo wenni yenni po ba kan tabi juijui ate wenni jam lo dua la. Ba nyiem gaam tabi kama taam.
6Naawen jam namsi Asdod demma kama ale baai meena ale bo gilagilawa la. Wa jam basi ate ba nam ka nna yegayega. A basi ate ŋan pagra a moari ba nyiŋsaŋa. 7Asdod demma ale nya dii ale a nye la, ba yaa weeni chaab ayen, <<Ti jɔgi ta nɔiyeŋka dakanni ale ka Izirali demma wen la a ga te ya. Ba wenni a namsi tama ale ti wenni Dagon kama.>> 8Ba yaa tom nuruba ate ba wi Filistia nalima ŋanuwa a bek ba ayen, <<Ti ta Izirali demma Wenni nɔiyeŋka dakanni a ga ka bɛ?>> Ba yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ti ta di cheŋ Gat.>> Ba yaa te di cheŋ Filistia tɛŋka kanyi ate ba wi ayen Gat la.
9Alege ba le te di ga Gat la, Naawen basi ate ninam a paari ba ate ku daani ba nna yegayega. Wa basi ate ba nyiŋsaŋa a moari, bimbaansa ale ŋankpagsa meena. 10Nuruma dula jigini a basi ate di cheŋ Ekron, Filistia tɛŋ mɛ ale la. Alege ba le ta a jo Ekron la, nuruma deri a kaari ayen, <<Ba ta Izirali Wenni nɔiyeŋka dakanni a cheen ka dela ba ko ti ale ti nuruma meena.>> 11Ba yaa wi Filistia nalimaŋa a weeni ayen, <<Ni te di cheŋ Izirali. Ni te di cheŋ di nyama jigi, dan kan daa di di le ko ti meena.>> Dii nyiŋla ku jam a jo ba nyiŋ ka yegayega ate nuruba poom kpi. 12Baai ale kan jam kpi la jam a yuak kama ale ba nyiŋsaŋa ŋanmɔrintaŋa. Nuruma yaa kaari a wi ba wenaŋa.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 6
Content:
1Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni ale bo Filistia paari chiisa siyopɔi la, 2nuruma yaa wi kaabteerɔma ale sampoporisaŋa a weeni ba ayen, <<Ti a ti nye nɔiyeŋka dakanni ka sɛ? Ni weeni ti le ti nye dii ate di cheŋ Izirali la.>>
3Ba yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ti daa yaali ayen ti te nɔiyeŋka dakanni a cheŋ Izirali, ti kan te di cheŋ kinla ti gum nyemagsika tiirim du a saalim ba wenni ti le kaasi la. Ni dan nye dila, wa le tebi ni. Ni dan te tiirimu wa le basi ni namsika.>>
4Filistia demma yaa bek ayen, <<Ti tin ti te ka boan tiirim a magsi ti kaasuŋku?>> Ba yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ti pai ligmɔniŋ a nye ŋanta ase ŋanmɔrinta la banu abe ni pai ligmɔniŋ mɛ a nye dawuita tinu a magsi Filistia nalima ŋanuwa. Dii nyiŋla tuemu a yik ka nama ale nalimaŋa. 5Ni pai ŋanmɔrintaŋa ale dawuitaŋa ale a kaasi tɛŋka la, a te Izirali Wenni a saalim wa. Da dii dai wa le basi tama ale ti wenaŋa ale ti tɛŋka namsika. 6Ni nye tama ale a weeni diila abe ni kan basi ate ni tue a kpari ase Ejipiti demma ale ba naawa la. Wen jam namsi ba ka nna yegayega ate ba yaa siak ate Izirali demma a cheŋ.
7<<Ni be yaali toroko paalik a yaa yaali naa ŋaai ale ta naabisa an diem a dari toroko a nya ya. A yaa bobi toroko a maŋ niiŋa ate ŋa ta cheŋ. Ni gaari ŋa bisaŋa a bobi zaani. 8Ni dan nye dila ni yaa pai Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a zaani toroko zuk. A yaali dakari mɛ a pai ŋanmɔrintaŋa ale dawuitaŋa ate ni nye la a nyoro a te ase nyemagsika tiirim la. Ni kan te nuru a dari. 9Abe ni a nya ŋa, ŋa daŋ ga paari ŋa dek jigini tuak Bet Sɛmes abe ku sak ayen ka Naawen ale ta ninammu a jam ti zuk. Alege ŋa dan kan ta cheŋ du ti yaa le seba ayen ka ninam kama ale jam ti zuk daa Naawen ale ta jam.>>
10Ba yaa siak sinsaŋŋa de a yaa niiga ŋaye ŋaai ale ta naab bisa a bobi toroko a maŋ ŋa, ale bobi naabisaŋa. 11A yaa pai Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a zaani toroko zuk. A pai dakari di choa a pai ŋanmɔrintaŋa ale dawuitaŋa ate ba nye la a nyoro. 12Ate niiŋa a cheŋ a duŋ Bet Sɛmes nyiŋ. Ŋa le a cheŋ ale a ŋuuni la ŋa an mobi gala yaase juga. Nalimaŋa yaa va ŋa a ga paari Bet Sɛmes banni.
13Dila po Bet Sɛmes demma a jam boro a che ka za viaka po. Ba le zak zuima nya nɔiyeŋka dakanni la, ba sue yaa jam peenti. 14Niiŋa yaa ga wari zaani Josua talim po Bet Sɛmes tɛŋka. Ŋa jam ga za ka piuŋ kpieŋ tɛŋ. Nuruma yaa che toroko wa daataŋa a ko niiŋa mɛ a ju ŋa a te Naawen. 15Livaima yaa yeeri Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni ale ŋanmɔrintaŋa ale dawuitaŋa ate ba nye la, a zaani piuŋ kpioŋku zuk. Da dila danni mɛ dek Bet Sɛmes demma a jam ko ka duŋsa si chaab ale ŋanta ba chaab a te Naawen. 16Filistia nalima ŋanuwa yaa zaani niŋ a nya dii meena ale nye la ate ba yaa ŋman cheŋ Ekron dai dila danni.
17Filistia demma a te ka ŋanmɔrinta banu ate ba nye ale ligmɔniŋ la a magsi ba nyemagsika tiirim. Dinyi meena a magsi ba tɛŋsaŋa Asdod ale Gaza ale Askelon ale Gat ale Ekron. 18Ba jam pai ka ligmɔniŋka mɛ dawuita a magsi chaab ale Filistia tɛŋsaŋa, sii ale sɛ parisa a gilim ale sii ale kan sɛ parisa ate nalima ŋanuwa a nya si zuk la. Piuŋ kpioŋku ate ba pai nɔiyeŋka dakanni a zaani ku zuk Josua talimu po Bet Sɛmes po la a chim ka seerɔ dai dila danni ate dii nye la.
19Alege Naawen a ko ka Bet Sɛmes nuruba pisiyopɔi ba le chuiri nya nɔiyeŋka dakanni po la. Nuruma sui jam kaasi kama wa le ko nuruma soa diila ate ba jam a kum. 20Bet Sɛmes demma yaa bek chaab ayen, <<Ka wana ale baga a zaani Naawen, Wen weleŋka dɛ niŋŋa? Ti a ti ta dakanni ga te ka wana?>>
21Ba yaa tom nuruba ate ba cheŋ Kiriat Jearim a ga weeni ayen, <<Filistia demma a ta Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a jam ti jigi kama. Ni jam pai ta cheŋ ni jigini.>>

Title: 1 SAMUEL 7
Content:
1Kiriat Jearim demma yaa ga pai Naawen nɔiyeŋ dakanni a ta jam Abinadab yenni. Di jam za ka guuk zuk. Ba yaa jam gaari Abinadab nidoabinni Eleaza ayen wa a nya dakanni zuk.
2Nɔiyeŋ dakanni a jam Kiriat Jearim a beni kama a paari bena pisiye. Ate Izirali demma yaa kaari a saalim Naawen ayen wa maari ba.
3Ate Samuel yaa weeni Izirali demma ayen, <<Ni daa yaali ayen ni ŋmani Naawen jigi ale ni suiniima meena ni basi tɛŋ yonsa wena vaka. Abe ni maa basi bɔgluk nipowa ate ba a wi ayen Astarot la. Ni pai nidek a te Naawen abe ni a puusi wa. Ni dan nye dila, wa le vari ni Filistia demma jigi basi.>> 4Izirali demma yaa basi Baal ale Astarot bɔgtaŋa vaka ale va Naawen nyiini.
5Samuel yaa weeni niŋdeerɔma ayen, <<Ni wi Izirali demma meena ate ba tu Mizpa ate m puusi a te ni.>> 6Ba le tu Mizpa la, ba yaa ŋari nyiam a kpiiri a basi ase tiirim la a te Naawen. Da dila danni ba bobi ka nɔi a puusi a weeni ayen, <<Ba tom kaasi Naawen kama.>> Samuel jam le ba niŋdeerɔ Mizpa po.
7Filistia demma yaa wom ayen Izirali demma a tu chaab Mizpa. Nalima ŋanuwa yaa dɛ ba tugurik tɔŋdɔma niŋ ayen ba siti Izirali demma. Izirali demma ale wom ayen Filistia demma a cheen ba jigi la ba yaa chali yɔgsum. 8Ba yaa weeni Samuel ayen, <<Wa kasim puusi a te Naawen ti Wenni ate wa vari ti Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma nisa po basi.>> 9Samuel yaali pabiik a nye kaabka ase juka tiirim la a te Naawen. Wa yaa puusi a te Naawen ayen wa vari Izirali basi ate Naawen a tulisi wa.
10Diipo ate Samuel boro a nye kaabka la, ale Filistia demma a poom cheŋ moata kama ayen ba nye kpaliŋ. Naawen yaa basi ate wenni a na nyigsi Filistia demma, ate ba nyiŋsa a gɔk ate ba a chali. 11Izirali tugurik tɔŋdɔma yaa chali Mizpa tɛŋka po a vi Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma a ko ba Bet Kar suiku po.
12Samuel yaa pai tintain a ti Mizpa ale Sen suŋsuŋ a yaa te jigini yuei ayen, Ebenezer, <<Naawen a maari ti ate ti nak dɛ.>> 13Ba jam nak dɛ Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma kama. Naawen an ŋman jam basi ate ba soa Izirali tɛŋka kauk kuui ya Samuel daaŋa po. 14Izirali tɛŋ sii ale jam bo Ekron ale Gat suŋsuŋ ate Filistia demma jam tuesi soa la, a ŋman jam chim ka Izirali tɛŋsa. Daa dila nyiini Amori demma a jam basi kpaliŋ nyeka ale Izirali kama.
15Samuel kasim a nya Izirali tɛŋka zuk kama ase niŋdeerɔ la wa boka meena po. 16Ben meena wa nyiem nyini ka Arama a gilim va Betel ale Gilgal ale Mizpa a bo Izirali demma buusa jiŋŋa de meena. 17Wa dan nueri wa tuimaŋa wa nyiem ŋman kuli ka wa tɛŋka Arama. Wa jam sɛ ka kaabka kuŋkuŋ dula jigini a te Naawen.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 8
Content:
1Samuel yaa le jam kpaŋ la wa yaa lueri wa bisa baye ayen ba chim Izirali niŋdeerɔba. 2Wa bikpagni yuei jam le Joel, waai ale pai saŋ la yuei ale Abaija. Ba jam a tom ka Beerseba. 3Alege wa bisaŋa an jam va wa nye maŋka. Ba jam a gebi ka nuruma ŋanta a nya ba ŋantaŋa. Ba jam basi ate ka nuruba a da ba ale ligra ate ba kan bo buusa a magsi. Ba jam ŋmani a te ka baai ale a da bala.
4Izirali nisɔmma yaa jam jigi yeŋ ayen ba nya Samuel Arama tɛŋka. 5Ba yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Yɔgyɔgla de fi kpaŋ kama alege fi bisaŋa a kan va fi nyeka, dila nyiŋ lueri naab ate wa a nya ti zuk ate tama mɛ ta naab ase tɛŋ yonsa la.>>
6Samuel ale wom ayen ba a yaali naab la wa sui an peenti ya. Wa yaa puusi te Naawen ayen wa sak wa. 7Alege Naawen yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Nye nuruma ale a yaali diila. Lueri naab a te ba. Fi a poli ayen ba zɛri ka fi, ka mi ate ba zɛri. 8A zaani diipo ate mi ta ba nyini Ejipiti tɛŋka po nyini la, ba kasim a zɛri mi kama alege a va wena. Dila dek ate ba a nye fi mɛ. 9Wom ba le a weeni diila, alege chiib kpaam ba naawa ale za wa yaali ayen ba nye dii te wa la.>>
10Samuel yaa jam weeni Naawen wieŋa meena a te nuru baai ale jam bek a yaali naab la. 11Wa weeni ba ayen, <<Dii ate naab waai a za wa a nya ni zuk la ale nye la ale nna. Wa le basi ate ni bisaŋa a tom a te wa, abe ba a dam kpaliŋ torokoba ale wusuma abe ba chali dɛ kpaliŋ torokoma niŋ a mooli juijui meena ate wa a cheŋ la. 12Wa le lueri ni gela ate ba a nya tugurik tɔŋdɔba tusidi tusidi zuk ate ba gela a nya tugurik tɔŋdɔba pisinu pisinu zuk. Wa le basi ate ba gela a kpa wa tattaŋa abe ba che wa ŋantaŋa. Wa le basi ate ba gela a nye gbatta ale gebik woŋsa, ale ŋanta a magsi kpaliŋ torokoba. 13Ni liema wa le basi ate ba a nye kpa buui nyum ale masa, abe ba gela a dik a te wa nuruma. Abe ba gela a nye boroborok a te ba. 14Wa le tuesi ni laŋsaŋa po ŋan baai ale zunchoŋ la, ale ni kaduksaŋa yɔn maŋsaŋa a te baai ale tom a te wa la. 15Ni kpanni ŋantaŋa ale ni daamu meena piika po wa le yeeri bunyi bunyi a te wa kpaŋŋa ale wa yɔmma. 16Wa le lueri ni nuruma gela nidoaba ale nipooba ate ba a tom wa yenni. Wa le lueri ni naab maŋsaŋa ale ni bon maŋsaŋa a te wadek. 17Daa dila nyiini piisa ale bua meena piik po wa le lueri kunyi. Di kpeglimka meena ni le chim ni naawa yɔm. 18Kula dan nye ni le kum a wi Naawen ayen wa basi ate ni naawa a ta jiirim ale ni. Alege Naawen a kan wom ni. Samuel ale weeni diila ale la.>>
19Alege nuruma a zɛri ba an wom Samuel. Ayen, <<Aaya, ti a yaali ka naab. 20Ti a yaali ka naab ayen wa a dɛ ti niŋ ate ti a cheŋ kpaliŋsa ate tama mɛ a nye ase tɛŋ yonsa ale ta nalima diila.>>
21Samuel ale wom dii meena ate nuruma weeni la, wa yaa ŋman weeni sak Naawen. 22Ate Naawen yaa tulisi ayen, <<Wom ba le weeni diila abe fi te ba naab.>> Samuel yaa weeni Izirali demma ayen waai meena a kuli.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 9
Content:
1Nuru ale jam boro wa yuei ale Kis. Wa nyini ka Benjamin buuni po. Wa jam jigsi kama alege ta yuei. Wa kowa yuei jam le Abiel, wa kokpieŋka yuei jam le Zeror. Wa ko kpieŋ kpieŋka yuei jam le Bekorat. Ba meena jam ka Apia ŋaaŋ tulisa. 2Kis jam ta ka biik wa yuei ale Sɔɔl. Sɔɔl jam diem ka biik a chim duerɔ a nala. Wa jam ka choa. Wa jam wɔŋŋa a gaam waai meena kama.
3Sɔɔl kowa Kis jam ta ka bonsa. Dai yeŋ si yaa cheŋ bɛ. Kis yaa weeni wa biika Sɔɔl ayen, <<Nyiem gisi bonsaŋa. Basi ate tomteerɔ wanyi a va fu.>> 4Sɔɔl yaa cheŋ va Ɛfraim juijui ate guuta a gilim la ale Salisa tɛŋsaŋa alege ba an nya si. Ba cheŋ va Saalim tɛŋka alege si ka dula. A va Benjamin geŋsaŋa meena alege ba an nya si.
5Ba le ŋman cheŋ ga moata Zuf la ate Sɔɔl yaa weeni wa tomteerɔwa ayen, <<Ti dan kuli a zunchoŋŋa dan kan daa di m kowa ale kasim a yiili ti wari kama alege daa bonsaŋa ŋmana.>>
6Tomteerɔwa yaa tulisi ayen, <<Naawen nuru ale bo tɛŋka de. Wa ka waai ate nuruba a zuli. Dii meena ate wa a weeni la ka wensie. Ku nala kama ase ti nin nya wa. Wa baga kama a weeni juijui ate ti a nya si la.>>
7Sɔɔl yaa weeni tomteerɔwa ayen, <<Ti dan ga nya wa ti ti te wa ka boa? Ti abe dɛ ti ŋandiintaŋa meena alege ŋan koruta tara. Ti ka jaaboa a te wa. Ti ta jaaboa?>>
8Tomteerɔwa yaa weeni ayen, <<Mi ta ligbiri. Ti pai dila a te wa ate wa weeni ti juijui ate ti a nya si la.>> 9Dipo wa Izirali po, nuru a dan cheŋ ayen wa bek nyini Wen jigi, wa le weeni kama ayen, <<Jam, te ti cheŋ waai ale a nya wie la jigi,>> dii nyiŋla jinla biisiteerɔwa ba jam a wi wa ayen ka waai ale a nya wie. 10Sɔɔl yaa weeni wa tomteerɔwa ayen, <<Ku nala ti cheŋ.>> Ate ba yaa cheŋ tɛŋka Wen nuruwa ale bo juijui la.
11Ba le jam a cheŋ jueli guuku a tuak tɛŋka la ba yaa tu nipokbilisa ale ba nyini tɛŋka po a nyini ba ŋari nyiam. Ba yaa bek nipokbilisaŋa ayen, <<Biisiteerɔwa a bo dela?>>
12Ba yaa tulisi ayen, <<Wa boro. Wa bo tɛŋka po ni niŋ geŋ. Wa jam dela ka jinla ayen wa nye kaabka a te nuruma guuku zuk. 13Ni daa yaali ayen ni nya wa ni kpabi. Wa le nyini tɛŋka po a jueli guuku a dɛ ale nuruma. Nuruma a limisi kama ba kan dɛ se wa nin jam niak kaabka. Ate baai ate ba wi ate ba jam la yaa dɛ. Ni nye nwuli a jo tɛŋka po, dai dii dai ni le nya wa alege ate wa cheŋ.>>
14Sɔɔl ale tomteerɔwa le a jo tɛŋka po la ba yaa nya Samuel a cheŋ guuku kaabka jigi a tu ba.
15Dai dii danni ale pai te dii ate Sɔɔl jam la, Naawen a biisi ale Samuel kama ayen, 16<<Chum nna po de m le tom nuru ate wa nyini Benjamin tɛŋka a jam fi jigi. Kpiiri kpaam a basi wa zukku po ate ku sak ayen wala ate mi lueri ayen wa chim Izirali naab. Wa le vari m nuruma Filistia demma nisa po a basi. M nya m nuruma kama a wom ba le kum a yaali maarika la.>>
17Samuel ale nya Sɔɔl la, Naawen yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Nuru waai ate m weeni wa wie la ale nna. Wa le wa a nya m nuruma zuk.>>
18Sɔɔl yaa tu Samuel tɛŋka dek nɔi a yaa bek wa ayen, <<Mi a yaali ka biisiteerɔwa ale bo juijui la.>>
19Samuel yaa tulisi ayen, <<Mi ale biisiteerɔwa. De niŋ a jueli juijui ate ba a nye kaabka la. Jinla fi le dɛ ale mu. Abe chum saluik m weeni fu dii meena ate fi a poli la abe m basi ate fi kuli. 20Kan te bonsaŋa ale bɛ daa ŋata ale taam la a daani fu ba nya si kama. Daa fi ale fi kowa dɔkdemma ate Izirali demma a nya a yaali ayen fi chim niŋdeerɔ? 21Sɔɔl yaa tulisi Samuel ayen, <<Alege mi ka Benjamin ŋaaŋbiik. Tama buuni ale fiisa Izirali meena po. Tama dɔkku abe le fiisa Benjamin buuni po. Ka boa ate fi baga a weeni mi dila?>>
22Ba le jueli guuku la Samuel yaa ta Sɔɔl ale wa tomteerɔwa a jo dɔk kpioŋ po ate ba kali niŋ juijui ate nichamma paari pisita a kali la. 23Samuel yaa weeni dikrɔwa ayen, <<Ta lam buui ate m weeni ate fi pai zaani butɔga la a ta jam.>> 24Dikrɔwa yaa ta naŋ a jam dueni Sɔɔl niŋ. Lammu jam ka kpaam nyiini. Samuel yaa weeni ayen bu dua ka ni niŋ. Ŋɔbi ale mi ale wi nichamma diipo meena la ale bu de a dua magsi ka nama. Sɔɔl ale Samuel yaa dɛ ale chaab da dila danni.
25Ba le dɛ nueri la ba yaa nyini guuku zuk a siŋ a cheŋ tɛŋka po. Samuel yaa ta Sɔɔl a jueli wa gboŋku zuk ate ba biisi ale chaab. 26Vari ale veenti la saluik yokyokwa Samuel yaa wi Sɔɔl gboŋku zuk ayen yiti ate m te ate fi kuli. Sɔɔl yaa gomsi ate wa ale Samuel yaa nyini. 27Ba le ga paari tɛŋka nɔi la Samuel yaa weeni Sɔɔl ayen, <<Weeni fi tomteerɔwa ate wa dɛ niŋ a cheŋ.>> Ate tomteerɔwa a yaa cheŋ. Samuel yaa weeni Sɔɔl ayen, <<Limisi dela magadega ate m weeni dii ate Wen weeni fi wie la.>>

Title: 1 SAMUEL 10
Content:
1Samuel yaa pai kolini ale kpaam a kpiiri Sɔɔl zukku a gbaari wa ale weeni ayen, <<Naawen ale lueri fu ayen fi a nya wa nuruma Izirali demma zuk. 2Fi dan basi mi ale a kuli a ga paari Zelza Benjamin tɛŋka banni fi le tu nuruba baye a moata Arekel guka jigini. Ba le weeni fu ayen bonsaŋa ale bɛ la ba nya si kama. Bonsaŋa wari an ŋmaa daani ni kowa alege ka nama. Nuruma bayewa le weeni ayen, <Wa kasim a bek kama ayen wa le nya wa biika ka bɛ?>
3<<Ase ni le a cheŋ la, ni le ga paari tiib kpioŋ Tabor. Dula jigini ni le tu nuruba bata ale ba a cheŋ Betel ayen ba nye kaabka a te Wen. Ba wanyi a ta ka bua ŋata, nwala ta borobotta tita, wa choa mɛ a ta bunlɔk ale daam. 4Ba le puusi ni abe ba pai borobotta tiye a te ni. Ni tuesi.
5<<Kula ŋaaŋnyiŋ jueli Wen guuku ale bo Gibea po la. Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔba limisi nyaka jigi ale moata dula. Ni dan paari ni cheŋ moata tɛŋka, ni le tu biisiteerɔba ale ba nyini guuku zuk ate ba a nye kaabka la a ŋmani. Nuruba ale dɛ ba niŋ a nak kpanta, ale paampuuŋta ale sinyaksa. Biisiteerɔma ale a cheŋ la ba za ba a biisi ka wie ŋaai ate Naawen Chiika a pai a sak ba la. 6Naawen Chiika ale jam sueri fu ale pagrim ate fi mɛ a biisi ase bala la ate fi chim fi tɔga. 7Wieŋa de a dan nye, yaa be a nye dii meena ate fi a poli ayen Naawen a yaali ayen fi nye la, ale Wen a bo le fu kama.
8<<Be dɛ niŋ a cheŋ Gilgal. M le jam dula a tu fu a nye kaabka a ju te Naawen ale suiyɔgni tiirim tii ate ti le kali dɛ ale chaab la. Kan nye wari ya ate ku ga paari daa ŋayopɔi ate m yaa jam weeni dii ale magsi fi nye la.>>
9Sɔɔl ale cheem basi Samuel la, Wen deri tagri wa suinummu. Wieŋa de meena a jam chim ka wensie da dila danni. 10Sɔɔl ale wa yɔmawa ale ga paari Gibea la, ba yaa tu biisiteerɔba suiku po. Wen Chiika deri sueri wa ale pagrim ate wa deri a biisi wie ale mbala. 11Nuru baai ale seba Sɔɔl la ale nya ale wa biisi wie ale biisiteerɔma la, ba yaa bek chaab ayen, <<Ka boa ale nye Kis biika? Sɔɔl mɛ ka biisiteerɔma po wanyi?>>
12Nuru ale jam bo dula a yaa bek ayen, <<Ka wana ale bo koa?>> Ku yaa deri chim sinsii ayen, <<Sɔɔl mɛ ka biisiteerɔma po wanyi?>> 13Sɔɔl ale nueri biika la, wa deri jueli pimpitini zuk.
14Sɔɔl kowa suok yaa bek wa ale wa tomteerɔwa wa ayen, <<Ni tin ga ka be?>> Sɔɔl yaa weeni ayen, <<Tama a gisi ka bonsaŋa alege ti le kan nya si la, ti yaa cheŋ ti biisi ale Samuel.>>
15Sɔɔl kowa suoku a ŋman bek ayen, <<Ni weeni mu, Samuel weeni nama ayen ka boa?>>
16Sɔɔl yaa tulisi ayen, <<Wa weeni ti kama ayen bonsaŋa ba nya si kama.>> Alege Sɔɔl an weeni wa kowa suoku Samuel ale weeni ayen wa le chim naab la.
17Samuel yaa wi Izirali demma meena ayen ba tu Naawen Mizpa. 18Wa weeni ayen, <<Naawen, Izirali Wenni ale weeni diila ale nna, <Mi ale ta ni a nyini Ejipiti nyini. M vari ni Ejipiti demma nisa po a basi, a vari ni mɛ tɛŋ sii ale a fɛ ni la nisa po a basi.> 19Alege yɔgyɔgla de ni zɛri ni Wenni. Wa vari ni kama a basi ni daani ka yegayega po meena, alege ni weeni ayen, <Aaya! Tama a yaali ka naab ayen wa a nya ti zuk.> Yɔgyɔgla de ni jam zaani Naawen niŋ. Dɔk meena ale yezuk meena a jam zaani.>>
20Samuel ale tigsi Izirali yenni meena la. Naawen yaa lueri Benjamin dɔkku. 21Samuel a jam basi ate ba a zaani ka yezuk yezuk ate Naawen a lueri Matri yezukku. Ate wa basi ate nuru meena Matri dɔkku po a taam ate wa lueri Kis biika Sɔɔl. Ba le a gisi Sɔɔl la ba an nya wa. 22Ba yaa bek Naawen ayen, <<Sɔɔl an diem jam de wa?>> Naawen yaa weeni ayen, <<Wa jam kama. Wa suk ka kɔlimaŋa ŋaaŋ.>>
23Ba yaa chali ga ta wa nyini. Sɔɔl ale jam zaani nuruma po la wa jam wɔŋŋa a gaam ba meena kama. 24Samuel yaa weeni nuruma ayen, <<Ni nya nuruwa de ate Naawen lueri la. Nuru karo a nye se wa la nuruma meena po.>> Nuruma deri a kaari zik zik ayen, <<Naawa goa benni.>>
25Samuel yaa basi ate ba miŋ tuin ŋaai ale magsi naawa a tom la ale ŋmarisi ŋa a nyo gbaŋ po a pai dueni Naawen niŋ. Ate Samuel yaa weeni nuruma ayen ba kuli ba yeeŋa.
26Sɔɔl mɛ yaa kuli wa yenni Gibea. Wen yaa biisi nuru tuasa gela suiniima po ate ba maa va wa. 27Alege nuruba gela ale potim a daani la ayen, <<Nuruwa de ale nye ka sɛ a vari tama a basi?>> Ba an siak ayen Sɔɔl a magsi naab chimka, ale zɛri ba an ta tiirita a jam te Sɔɔl. Alege Sɔɔl a nye diki.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 11
Content:
1Ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ naab Nayas Ammon denɔwa a yaa dɛ wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma niŋ ate ba ga gilim Jabes ale bo Gilead la. Jabes nidoama meena yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Fi dan siak nɔiyeŋka ayen fi kan ko ti, ti le siak te fu.>>
2Nayas yaa tulisi ayen, <<M siak ya, alege nama mɛ a dan siak ayen m kpeti waai meena juga ninaŋa a basi ate chivie yik Izirali demma meena.>>
3Jabes nisɔmma ale wom la, ba yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Basi ate ti tom nuruba ate ba cheŋ Izirali tɛŋka meena a nya nuruba ate ba dan kan jam vari ti a basi abe ti yaa siak te ni.>> Nayas yaa siak.
4Ba le tom baai la yaa cheŋ. Ba le paari Gibea juijui ate Sɔɔl boro la ba yaa weeni nuruma dii ate naawa a yaali ba jigi la. Nuruma meena deri a kum.
5Dila po ale Sɔɔl a nyini ka talim a vi naakpaama ŋaaŋ a kuli a yaa wom nuruma Kumsaŋa. Wa yaa bek ayen, <<Ka boa? Ka boa ate nuruma a kum?>> Ba yaa weeni dii ate nuruma a ta nyini Jabes a jam weeni la.
6Sɔɔl ale wom dii ate ba weeni la, Wen Chiika a deri sueri wa ate wa sui a puuri ale Nayas ale weeni diila. 7Wa yaa ko naakpaama ŋaye a boani. Wa yaa chari lanta a te nuruma ale weeni ba ayen ba cheŋ tɛŋsaŋa meena Izirali po ale moolika de, <<M le nye ni naab kpaamaŋa ka nna ase ni nin zɛri an va mi Sɔɔl ale Samuel.>> Ate Naawen basi ate yɔgsum yega yik nuruma ate ba meena a chim bunyi a nyini. 8Sɔɔl yaa tigsi wa nuruma meena Bezek. Izirali nuruma meena jam ka tusa kobsita (300,000), Juda nuruma mɛ meena tusa pisita (30,000).
9Ba yaa weeni nuru baai ale jam la ayen, <<Ni weeni Jabes Gilead demma ayen, <Wenni ale di jueli ka ti le vari ni basi.> >> Baai ate ba tom la ale ga weeni Jabes demma la, ba sue yaa peenti nna yegayega. 10Jabes demma yaa weeni Nayas ayen, <<Chum ti le siak te ni ate ni nye dii meena ate ni a yaali la.>>
11Yok kula Sɔɔl yaa poori wa nuruma buta. A nyini vari veentidi ba yaa siti Ammon demma a ko ba. Ba jam ko ba ka dila a paari kantueŋ. Baai ale vua la jam chali waaŋ ka tɛŋ kala meena. Ba jam waaŋ ka wanyi wanyi.
12Kpaliŋka ŋaaŋnyiŋ, Izirali demma yaa bek Samuel ayen, <<Alege baai ale zɛri ayen Sɔɔl kan chim ba naab, la? Ta ba jam ate ti ko ba.>> 13Sɔɔl me yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ti kan ko waai jinla, jinla daani ale Naawen a vari Izirali ba dachaasaŋa nisa po basi.>>
14Samuel yaa ŋman weeni nuruma dula jigini ayen, <<Ni te ti ŋman cheŋ Gilgal a ŋman ga mooli ayen Sɔɔl ale tama naab.>> 15Ba yaa cheŋ Gilgal. Dula jigini, Naawen niŋ ba yaa siak ayen Sɔɔl ale ba naab. Ba yaa nye suiyɔgni tiirita kaabka a te Naawen alege pai lantaŋa chari chaab. Sɔɔl ale Izirali demma yaa dɛ masim ale chaab.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 12
Content:
1Samuel yaa weeni Izirali demma meena ayen, <<Ni le weeni ayen ni a yaali naab la, m te ni kama ayen wa a nya ni zuk. 2Wa ale ni niŋdeerɔ. Mi yaa kpaŋ kama ate zuk peenti. M bisaŋa abe bo ale ni. Mi chim ni niŋdeerɔ a nyini ka biik po a jam paari yɔgyɔgla. 3Ni sebi mi Samuel. Ti ni za Naawen ale naab waai ate wa lueri la niŋ la, ni waai baga a dak ayen, wanni de ate mi nye kaasi. Mi vari ni waai naab yaase wa boniŋa? M be gebi waai jaab dɛ? M fɛ ka wana? Waai a bo dela a baga a weeni ayen m basi ate nuruba a da mu? Waai a dan baga a dak ayen m nye wieŋa de dinyi, m le tuni.>>
4Nuruma yaa tulisi ayen, <<Fi an gebi ti jaaboa, fi be an fɛ ti. Fi an tuesi ti waai jaaboa.>>
5Samuel yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Jinla Naawen dek ale naawa ate wa lueri la ka seerɔ ba a wom dii ate ni weeni la kama. Mi an tuesi ni waai jaaboa.>> Ba yaa weeni ayen, <<Naawen ka seerɔ ayen fi an nye wari a kaasi ya.>>
6Ate Samuel yaa weeni nuruma ayen, <<Ka Naawen ale lueri Moosis ale Aaron ate ba ta ti kokpieŋsaŋa a nyini Ejipiti tɛŋka a nyini ate ba jam tɛŋka de. 7Yɔgyɔgla de ni zaani. M a yaali m weeni ni kama, Naawen niŋ, wayɔrisima ŋaai meena ate Naawen tom a te nama ale ni koma la.
8<<Ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ ate Jekob a jo Ejipiti, ate wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa a jam a tu ninam la ba kum kama a te Naawen a yaali maarika ate wa tom Moosis ale Aaron ayen ba vari ba basi. Ba dɛ ni kokpieŋsaŋa niŋ kama a ta ba nyini Ejipiti nyini a jam juijui ate ba boro nna.
9<<Alege ti kokpieŋsaŋa a baŋ Naawen, ba Wenni wari ate wa basi ate ba dachaasaŋa a nye kpaliŋ a nak dɛ ba. Dachaasaŋa de po a jam ka Sisera. Ba tugurik tɔŋdɔma kpagni a nyini Yazor. Dachiak ka choa ale Filistia demma. Moab naawa mɛ ale wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma jam nak dɛ ba. 10Ba yaa kum a te Naawen ayen, <Ti tom a kaasi fu kama ale zɛri Naawen abe tom a te Baal ale Astarot wenaŋa. Alege yɔgyɔgla de vari ti a ta nyini ti dachaasaŋa nisama po a basi ate ti tom a te fu ya.> 11Ate Naawen a tom Jerub Baal ale Barak ale Jepeta ale Samuel a vari ni ni dachaasaŋa nisa po jigi meena basi ate ni boro nalimnyiini.
12<<Alege ni le jam nya ayen naab Nayas ale nyini Ammon la a jam cheena ayen wa nye kpaliŋ ale ni la. Ni zɛri Naawen ni wenni kama ase ni naab la ale bek ayen ni a yaali nidek naab. 13Wa be le nna. Wa le naab waai ate ni bek ayen wa a nya ni zuk la. Ate Naawen a pai te ni. 14Nama a daa chali Naawen yɔgsum a tom a te wa ale siak a te wa ale ka tukpari ale wa wieŋa, nama ale ni naawa ale a nya ni zuk la a dan va Naawen ni Wenni, ku nala, 15alege ni dan kan siak a te Naawen, ni dan ta tukpari ale wa wieŋa wa le namsi ni le ni naawa meena, ase wa le nye ni kokpieŋsaŋa diila.
16<<Ni be kpesi a nya Naawen ale za wa nye wakperik kaai ni nimbie po la. 17Yɔgyɔgla de ba an boro a ŋari daa ŋanta? Ni seba ayen ŋmoruk a kan ni ŋanta ŋarika wen ya alege m le puusi ate ŋmoruk a jam ale nanpansa. Ate ni miŋ biem buui ate ni nye Naawen nina po ni le bek a yaali naab la.>>
18Ate Samuel yaa weeni Naawen ayen wa basi ate ŋmoruk a jam ale nanpansa. Da dila danni ate wa basi ate ŋmoruk a jam ale nanpansa. Ate ku cha nuruma nna yegayega Naawen ale Samuel ale nye diila.
19Ba yaa saalim Samuel ayen, <<Puusi te Naawen, fi Wenni ate wa kan ko ti. Ti a chali ka yɔgsum dii nyiŋla ti le weeni ayen ti a yaali naab ayen wa a nya ti zuk la a gum biem buui ate ti poom nye la kama.>>
20Samuel yaa weeni ayen, <<Ni kan chali yɔgsummoa. Ka wensie ayen ni nye wieŋa de meena a kaasi, alege ni kan ŋman basi Naawen vaka. Ni tom a te wa ale ni suiniima meena. 21Ni kan basi Naawen abe ni va bɔgta. Ti ka kiriya. Ti an baga a maari ni, ti bɛ an baga a vari ni ni dachaasaŋa nisa po a basi. 22Naawen sui a peenti kama ate wa basi ate ni chim wadek nuruba. Ni kan poli ayen wa le zɛri. Wa kan nye dila wa yuenni nyiŋ. 23Dan ka mi tɔga, m kan basi ni puusi te ka. M dan basi ni puusi te ka, ka Naawen ate m nye kaasi. M le kasim a sak ni ka dii ale magsi ale nala ayen ni a va la. 24Alege ni zuli Naawen abe ni tom ale ni suiniima meena a te wa. Ni poli wakperikaliik sii meena ate wa nye te ni la. 25Ni be dan kasim a nye biem, nama ale ni naawa meena ni dachaasaŋa ale nak yik ni ta cheŋ.>>

Title: 1 SAMUEL 13
Content:
1Sɔɔl a jam ta ka bena pisita alege chim naab la. Wa jam nya Izirali zuk ka bena pisinaansi ale ŋaye.
2Dai yeŋ Sɔɔl yaa lueri Izirali demma po tugurik tɔŋdɔba tusa ŋata (3,000). Wa yaa weeni ayen tugurik tɔŋdɔba tusa ŋaye (2,000) a bo le wa Mikmas ale Betel ate guuta a bo ka po la. Ale tom tusidi ayen ba ale wa nidoabinni Jonatan a ga bo Gibea ale bo Benjamin po la. Ale tom nuru baai ale tali la ayen ba ŋman ga ba yeeŋa.
3Dai yeŋ Jonatan yaa siti Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale bo Geba a limisi a nya la, ate Filistia dem mbala meena wom. Sɔɔl mɛ yaa wom a yaa te nɔi ayen wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma a peeri damunsa Izirali tɛŋka meena ate ba tigsi a nye kpaliŋka. 4Izirali demma meena yaa wom ayen Sɔɔl a nak Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma gela a dɛ kama ate Filistia nuruma meena a kisi Izirali demma yɔgla. Ba yaa wi Sɔɔl tugurik tɔŋdɔba mbala ayen ba jam wa jigi Gilgal.
5Filistia demma mɛ tigsi ayen ba kpaliŋ ale Izirali demma. Ba jam ta ka kpaliŋ torokoba tusa ŋata (3,000) ate tugurik tɔŋdɔba baye a bo toroko yeŋ po. Ba meena jam ka tusa ŋayuebi (6,000). Ba tugurik tɔŋdɔma a jam ka chiina ase beli po tintain busuŋ la. Ate Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma yaa jueli a tu Mikmas, Bet Aven kori geŋ. 6Izirali tugurik tɔŋdɔma yaa nya ayen ba bo ka wari po dii nyiŋla Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma a piisi kama a gaam ba. Ba gela yaa suk pina vie po, ba gela suk tiisa po, ba gela suk pina ale vila po. 7Izirali demma gela poom chali a lo Jodan benni jueli cheŋ Gad ale Gilead. Alege Sɔɔl ale wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma a wari bo ka Gilgal ate ba nyiŋsa a gɔk.
8Samuel jam weeni Sɔɔl kama ayen ku daa ŋayopɔi dai wa le jam. Daaŋa taam alege wa an jam Gilgal. Sɔɔl tugurik tɔŋdɔma deri a waaŋ chaab. 9Sɔɔl ale nya wa an ŋman baga a limisi la wa yaa weeni ayen, ba ta juka kaabka tiirim ale suiyɔgni tiirita kaabka duŋsaŋa a jam. Ate Sɔɔl a nye juka kaabka tiirimu wadek a te Naawen. 10Wa le nueri juka kaabka la Samuel deri jaa zaani. Sɔɔl yaa nyini ayen wa puusi wa.
11Samuel yaa bek wa ayen, <<Ka boa ale la ate fi nye?>> Sɔɔl yaa tulisi ayen, <<Mi ale nya ale m nuruma a waaŋ alege ate fi an jam diipo ate fi yen fi le jam la ate mi nye. Daa dila nyiini Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma mɛ kasim a tigsi Mikmas. 12Mi poli kama ase Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma a cheen kama ayen ba nye kpaliŋ ale mu Gilgal. M be seba mɛ ayen mi an bek maarika nyini Naawen jigi ya. Mi yaa fɛ nye kaabka.
13Samuel yaa weeni ayen, <<Boan jaab betta nna ate fi nye. Ka boa ale soa ate fi an va Naawen fi Wenni ale weeni ayen fi nye diila? Fi dan va kama wa ti le basi ate fi ale fi ŋaaŋsa meena a kasim a nya Izirali zuk. 14Alege ku kan ŋman nye. Fi ale fi ŋaaŋsa a kan ŋman nya Izirali zuwa. Naawen a yaali ka nuru waai ale a nye wa suinum ale a yaali dii la, dii nyiŋla fi an va Naawen ale weeni ayen fi nye diila.>>
15Samuel yaa basi Gilgal ale cheŋ Gibea ale bo Benjamin tɛŋka po la. Sɔɔl jam chiini tugurik tɔŋdɔ baai ale tali bo ale wa la ka kobsiyuebi.
16Sɔɔl ale wa biika Benjamin ale wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma a jam bo ka Geba ale bo Benjamin tɛŋka po la. Alege Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma a jam bo ka Mikmas. 17Ku dan paari diipo Filistia demma nyiem yeeri ka tugurik tɔŋdɔba beŋsa buta ate ba cheŋ tɛŋsa tɔgatɔga a ga nak nuruma vari ba ŋanta ta cheŋ. Beŋka kanyi ale cheŋ ka Ofra ale bo Sual po la. 18M ka mɛ a cheŋ Bet Yoron. Ate m kala mɛ a cheŋ Zeboim Viaka ale tuak tɛŋ banni ale tuk gɔnni nyiŋla.
19Izirali demma a jam ka kpaliŋ jaaboa a nye kpaliŋŋa dii nyiŋla Izirali tɛŋka meena a jam ka choabiiga. Filistia demma a jam kan siak ate Izirali demma a tom tuim ŋala diila ba dan te ba suik ba le kuri gebisa ale gbatta. 20Izirali demma nyiem dan jam a yaali ayen ba saasi ba niiga kua nɔi, ale laasa ale gɔtita ale kua ba ta a cheŋ ka Filistia tɛŋsaŋa ate ba a saasi. 21Ba daa yaali ba saasi laasa ale kutuk chɔrisa ate ba pai a yiak niiga la ba nyiem tuesi ka ligbiri Izirali demma jigi. Alege ba daa yaali ba saasi niiga kua nɔi yaase kua kpaama ba a tuesi ka ligbie ŋaye.
22Dila nyiŋ ba dan cheŋ ayen ba nye kpaliŋ ale Filistia demma Sɔɔl nyiini ale wa biika Jonatan ale a ta gebisa ale gbatta.
23Filistia demma a tom ka tugurik tɔŋdɔba gela ayen ba cheŋ Mikmas a ga a kasi vuuku ale va guutaŋa po a taam la.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 14
Content:
1Dai yeŋ Jonatan yaa weeni waai ale a yik wa kpaliŋ kɔlimaŋa la ayen, <<Te ti gaam taam Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale za juijui limisi a nya la.>> Alege wa an jam weeni wa kowa.
2Dila po, Sɔɔl jam bo ka gaab tɛŋ Migron ale bo Gibea nakpiak geŋ la. Tugurik tɔŋdɔba kobsiyuebi ale jam bo ale wa. 3Ba po jam ka Ayija waai ale jam jo garuk geli la. Wa jam ka Ichabod suoku Ayitub nidoabili. Ayitub jam ka Fineyas nidoabili. Fineyas be jam ka Eli waai le jam ka Naawen kaabteerɔ a bo Siilo la nidoabili. Jonatan tɔga nuru jam zɛ diipo ate wa basi Izirali demma tuka jigini.
4Vuuku ale va guutaŋa po a taam ate Jonatan a jam a poli ayen wa va paari Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale za a limisi a nya la a ta ka pina ŋaye nakpaasaŋa, kunyi ba a wi ayen ka Bozez m kula ba a wi ayen Sene. 5Piuŋku kunyi a jam tuk ka wiiluk geŋ a tuak Mikmas. M kula mɛ a tuk yeseok geŋ a tuak Geba.
6Jonatan yaa weeni waai ale a yik wa kpaliŋ kɔlimaŋa la ayen, <<Jam ti ti cheŋ Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma baai ale kaa va Naawen la jigini. Da dii dai Naawen ale maari ate ti nak dɛ ba. Ti piisi yoo ti an piisi yoo jaab karo a kasi Naawen ate ti kan nak a dɛ.>>
7Waai ale a yik Jonatan kpaliŋ kɔlimaŋa la a weeni ayen dɛ niŋ, <<Fi ale a yaali ayen fi nye diila, m siak te fu ka meena.>>
8Jonatan yaa weeni ayen, <<Mi ale a poli diila ale nna. Ti le basi ate Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma a nya ti ase ti le a jueli guuku. 9Ba dan weeni ti ayen, <Ti limisi ate ba jam ti jigi,> ti le zaani kauk kula abe ti kan jueli cheŋ ba jigi ya. 10Alege ba dan weeni ti ayen ti jueli a jam ba jigi, ku ka wa dii ale a sak ayen Naawen le basi ate ti nak a dɛ ba.>>
11Ba yaa zaani ayen Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma a baga a nya ba. Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma yaa weeni ayen, <<Nya! Izirali demma ale la kuug nyini vie ŋaai po ate ba suk la a nyini.>> 12Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma yaa zaani ba tuka jigini a kaari a weeni Jonatan ale wa maarɔwa ayen, <<Ni jam dela ate ti sak ni yam.>> Jonatan yaa weeni wa maarɔwa ayen, <<Va mu jueli. Naawen ale maari tama Izirali demma ate ti nak ba dɛ.>>
13Jonatan yaa kuug jueli ŋmazukku ate wa maarɔwa mɛ a vi. Jonatan a che ba ale wa gebi kpieŋka a lɔnsi ate wa maarɔwa a vi a ko ba. 14Piilim sitika Jonatan ale waai ale a yik wa kpaliŋ kɔlimaŋa la, a ko ka nuruba pisiye yinki geli peelim po.
15Ate Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma meena ale tigsi bo juijui la ale baai ale diem a limisi a nya la jigini la ale baai ale cheŋ tɛŋsaŋa a vari la yɔgsum yik ba. Tɛŋka a choa ate ba nyiŋsa a gɔk. Naawen dek ale jam basi ate yɔgsum a yik ba.
16Sɔɔl ale wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale diem jam bo Gibea ale bo Benjamin po la, wa tugurik tɔŋdɔba baai ale a limisi la yaa nya Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale ba a chali a waaŋ jigi meena. 17Sɔɔl yaa weeni tugurik tɔŋdɔba baai ale bo dula ale wa la ayen, <<Ni tigsi tugurik tɔŋdɔma a kpesi waai ale kan bo ti po la.>> Ba yaa nya ayen Jonatan ale wa maarɔwa a ka ba po.
18Sɔɔl a jam weeni Ayija ayen, <<Ta Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a jam.>> Dila po di jam bo ale ka Izirali demma. 19Sɔɔl ale a biisi ale kaabteerɔwa Ayija la, nuemka Filistia demma po kasim a jueli. Sɔɔl yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Basi ale suik karo yɔgyɔgla ate fi bek a seba Naawen yaalika.>>
20Sɔɔl ale wa nuruma yaa tigsi chaab a siti Filistia demma. Ba le ga paari kpaliŋka jigini la, ba yaa nya ayen Filistia demma popola tulim kama ate ba a ko chaab ale ba gebisaŋa. 21Izirali dem baai nyiem ale gum Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma po la ale ga nya ku ale ka diila, ba deri gum Izirali demma po a va Sɔɔl ale Jonatan. 22Izirali demma gela ale jam suk bo Ɛfraim ate guutaŋa a gilim la, ba le wom ayen Filistia demma a chali la, ba deri gum kpaliŋka po. 23Ba jam nak Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma dɛ kama, ale tusi ba ta gaam Bet Aven a basi. Naawen ale jam vari Izirali demma dii a basi la ale nna.
24Izirali tugurik tɔŋdɔma a jam jiak kama dii nyiŋla Sɔɔl a jam pɛ kama ayen waai a kan dɛ jaaboa se ka wa a nin nak yiak wa dachaasaŋa. Waai a dan zɛri ale dɛ jaab alege ate junɔi a paari kikaasa a va ku nyɔnɔ. Dila nyiŋ tugurik tɔŋdɔma waai an dɛ jaaboa.
25Tugurik tɔŋdɔma meena a jam jo tiisaŋa po ate siita jam bo tɛŋka. 26Ba le ga jo tiisaŋa po la, ba nya siita kama alege ba waai an dɛ ya. Ba jam a chali ka yɔgsum dii nyiŋla Sɔɔl ale pɛ la, wari nin zaan nye ba. 27Alege Jonatan a jam karo diipo ate wa kowa a jam pɛ la, dila nyiŋ wa jam zɛ. Wa le nya siitaŋa la wa yaa pai wa tachekka a lusi ti po. Wa yaa dɛ a nya nyiŋ pagra. 28Alege tugurik tɔŋdɔma wanyi yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Ti an magsi ti dɛ ŋandiinta jinla diila fi kowa a ka kama. Wa ka kama ayen waai ale a dɛ ŋandiinta jinla la kikaasa a va wa. Dila ale soa ate ti jiak a wobsa.>>
29Jonatan ale wom la wa yaa weeni ayen, <<Mi kowa ale nye diila an nala te nuruma, ku le daani ba. Nama kan nya mi ale dɛ siitaŋa maga a zunchoŋ la. 30Ba le pai ŋandiin tii ba dachaasaŋa jigi la ba dan dɛ ka maga ku ti zunchoŋ kama. Ba ti ta pagrim a nak ba dachaasaŋa a ko ba a gaam di.>>
31Dai dila danni ate Izirali demma a nak dɛ Filistia demma a zaani Mikmas a ga paari Aijalon la ba kasim jam jiak ka meena. 32Duŋ sii ate ba jam tuesi Filistia demma jigi kpaliŋka po la, ba jam ko si kama a boani deri a ŋɔbi benaŋa ale ziimu. 33Waai yaa weeni Sɔɔl ayen nuruma ale a ŋɔbi lammu ale ziimu la, ba nye a kaasi Naawen kama. Sɔɔl yaa weeni ayen, <<Wensie ni nye kaasi kama, ni bilim tintain kpieŋ ta jam dela.>> 34Wa yaa weeni ayen, <<Nyiem weeni ba ayen, <Ni ta ni niiŋa ale ni piisaŋa a jam dela a ko a ŋɔbi. Ni ka suik a ŋɔbi lammu ale ziimu. Dila ni nye a kaasi ka Naawen.> >> Ba meena yok kula yaa ta ba niiŋa ale ba piisaŋa jam ko Sɔɔl nimbie po. 35Yok kula Sɔɔl yaa se kuŋkuŋ a te Naawen. Ku piilimka ni la ate Sɔɔl a nye dila.
36Sɔɔl yaa weeni ayen, <<Ni basi ate ti cheŋ a ga ko Filistia demma meena yokku de a ga paari saluik. Ate ti baga a pai ba ŋantaŋa yokku meena.>> Ba yaa tulisi ayen, <<Fi le poli diila a nala kama.>> Alege Wen kaabteerɔwa yaa weeni ayen, <<Basi ate ti dɛ niŋ bek Wen ase ka wa yaalika.>>
37Sɔɔl yaa bek Wen ayen, <<M ga siti Filistia demma? Fi le basi ate tama Izirali demma a nak dɛ?>> Alege Wen an tulisi Sɔɔl.
38Sɔɔl yaa weeni ayen, <<Da dii dai waai ale tom kaasi. Tugurik tɔŋdɔma niŋdeerɔma meena jam dela ate ti nya waai ale tom biemu jinla la. 39Naawen dii ale vari tama Izirali demma a basi la nyiŋ, waai ale tom biemu dɛ la, dan poom ka mi biika Jonatan se wa kpi.>> Alege waai an weeni wari ya.
40Sɔɔl yaa weeni Izirali demma, <<Ni zaani dela mi ale Jonatan mɛ ale zaani dela.>> Nuruma mɛ yaa weeni ayen, <<Fi ale poli diila a nala kama.>>
41Sɔɔl yaa puusi te Naawen, Izirali Wenni ayen, <<Tulisi ti a magsi. Ate ba yaa nak gbaŋ ate Wen dak Sɔɔl ale Jonatan. 42Sɔɔl yaa weeni ayen, ti be nya ase ka mi yaase Jonatan ale kaasi. Ate ba yaa nak gbaŋ ate Wen dak Jonatan.
43Sɔɔl yaa weeni Jonatan ayen, <<Weeni mu fi le nye diila.>> Jonatan yaa weeni Sɔɔl, <<Ka mi tachekka nɔnni ate mi a pai lusi siita po a dɛ maga. M bɛ kpi yɔgyɔgla de dila nyiŋŋa?>>
44Sɔɔl yaa weeni ayen, <<Jonatan fi dan kan kpi dila nyiŋŋa, Wen bɛ nye ale mi chekki.>>
45Alege tugurik tɔŋdɔma yaa weeni Sɔɔl ayen, <<Jonatan magsi wa kpi kama? Dila kan nye. Wala ale vari Izirali jinla basi. Naawen ale vua la nyiŋ wa zuik yeŋ mɛ la kan lo tɛŋŋa. Wen maarika ale soa ate Jonatan a kpaliŋ ale Filistia demma jinla.>> Tugurik tɔŋdɔma yaa vari Jonatan basi ate wa an kpi ya.
46Sɔɔl yaa basi Filistia demma vika alege ate ba ŋman kuli ba tɛŋka.
47Sɔɔl ale chim Izirali naab la wa kpaliŋ kama ale Izirali dachaasaŋa meena gilim. Wa kpaliŋ ale Moab ale Ammon ale Edom ale Zoba naawa ale Filistia demma. Jigi meena ate Sɔɔl a cheŋ la wa nak a dɛ ba kama. 48Wa jam kpaliŋ kama ale suinum pagrik a nak dɛ Amalek demma. Wa vari Izirali demma ba dachiak sii ale jam a vari ba la nisa po kama basi.
49Sɔɔl nidoabilisaŋa jam le Jonatan ale Isvi ale Malki Sua. Wa lie kpagni yuei jam le Merab. Wa lie baaŋka yuei jam le Michal. 50Sɔɔl powa yuei jam le Ayinoam. Wa jam ka Ayimaaz lie. Sɔɔl tugurik tɔŋdɔma kpagni yuei jam le Abner. Abner jam ka Ner biik. Ner abe jam ka Sɔɔl kowa suok. 51Sɔɔl kowa Kis ale Abner kowa Ner jam ka Abiel bisa.
52Sɔɔl boka po meena wa chiib kpaliŋ kama ale Filistia demma. Wa dan nya nuru pagrisa yaase nuru tuasa Izirali demma po wa nyiem pai basi ka wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma po.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 15
Content:
1Samuel yaa weeni Sɔɔl ayen, <<Naawen ale tom mi ayen m bobi fi naab ate fi a nya Izirali zuk. Yɔgyɔgla de wom wa le ta dii ayen wa weeni fu la. 2Naawen dii ale ta pagrim meena la ale weeni diila ale nna. <Izirali demma ale nyini Ejipiti nyini la, Amalek demma a jam kasi ba kama ayen ba kan cheŋ Keenan. Dila nyiŋ m le namsi ba. 3Ni cheŋ a ga siti Amalek demma a kaasi jaab meena ate ba ta la. Ni kan basi jaaboa ate wa boro. Ni ko nidoaba ale nipooba, bimbaansa ale buluata, niiga ale piisa, laalaakomiba ale bonsa.> >>
4Sɔɔl yaa wi wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma ate ba tu Telaim. Tugurik tɔŋdɔma a jam ka tusa kobsiye (200,000) ale nidoaba tusa pi (10,000) a nyini Juda. 5Sɔɔl yaa cheŋ Amalek tɛŋka a ga gu dua viaka po. 6Wa yaa weeni Ken demma ayen, <<Ni basi Amalek demma ate ti kan maa ko ni ale ba, dii nyiŋla ni jam sak jiirim ale Izirali demma kama diipo ate ba jam nyini Ejipiti a nyini la.>> Ken demma yaa yiti dula alege Amalek demma.
7Sɔɔl yaa nak dɛ Amalek demma. Wa jam nak ba kama nyini Yavila a ga paari Sur a moata Ejipiti. 8Wa jam yik Amalek naawa Agag kama alege an ko wa. Wa jam ko Agag nuruma ka meena ale gebik. 9Sɔɔl ale wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma an jam ko Agag, ale pai ŋan naliŋsaŋa ale naa ŋaai ale biigi ale piisa. Duŋ naliŋsaŋa meena ba an jam ko ya alege duŋ gbaaliŋsaŋa buuni ba jam ko kama.
10Naawen yaa biisi ale Samuel ayen, 11<<Mi a ŋma ka m dek m le basi ate Sɔɔl a chim naab la, dii nyiŋla wa basi m vaka kama alege an zuli mu.>> Ate ku yaa daani Samuel ate wa kum yok meena a te Naawen.
12Vari ale veenti la saluik Samuel yaa yiti a cheŋ ayen wa tu Sɔɔl. Alege nuruma yaa weeni Samuel ayen, <<Sɔɔl a cheŋ ka Karmel kauk kuui ate wa se wadek jaab ayen wa nya yuei la. Yɔgyɔgla de wa cheŋ ka Gilgal.>> 13Samuel ale jam Sɔɔl jigi la, Sɔɔl yaa weeni ayen, <<Naawen niak fu. Mi va Naawen nɔi kama a nye wa yaalika.>>
14Alege Samuel yaa weeni ayen, <<Ka boa abe le soa ate mi a wom niiga ale piisa kumsa?>>
15Sɔɔl yaa tulisi ayen, <<Tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale tuesi Amalek demma jigi. Niiga ale piisa ŋaai ale nala la ti ta jam ayen ti nye kaabka a te fi Naawen fi Wenni alege duŋ yonsaŋa ti ko kama.>>
16Samuel yaa weeni Sɔɔl ayen, <<Limisi ate m weeni fu Naawen ale weeni mi dii deemwa yokku la.>> Sɔɔl yaa weeni ayen, <<Weeni mu.>>
17Samuel weeni ayen, <<Fi an jam pai fidek a chim nuru, alege yɔgyɔgla de fi chim Izirali buuni niŋdeerɔ. Naawen ale lueri fu ate fi chim naab a nya Izirali zuk. 18A yaa tom fu wari nyiŋ. Wa weeni ayen, <Cheŋ a ga ko Amalek demma ŋanbaataŋa. Nye kpaliŋ ale ba a ko ba meena.> 19Ka boa ale soa ate fi an va Naawen nɔi yaa? Ka boa ale soa ate fi wuuri lueri ŋanmaŋsaŋa? Ka boa ate fi nye dii ate Naawen ayen ku an nala la?>>
20Sɔɔl yaa weeni ayen, <<Alege mi va Naawen nɔi kama? Mi nye Naawen ale weeni ayen mi nye diila kama. Mi ko Amalek demma ka meena ale ta ba naawa Agag jam. 21Tugurik tɔŋdɔma a lueri ka naa maŋsaŋa ale pai maŋsaŋa ayen ti nye kaabka a te Naawen fi Wenni Gilgal tɛŋa po.>> 22Alege Samuel yaa tulisi wa ayen, Ka boa ale a peenti Naawen sui ya, kaabka yaa wa nɔi vaka? Wa nɔi vaka a zunchoŋ fi le pai pada naliŋsa a kaab te wa. 23Kan wom Naawen nɔi a bie ase ka sampoporinni la. Kanjanta a bie ase ka bɔgta kaabka la. Wa zɛri fu kama ase naab la, fi le zɛri wa wanni la nyiŋ.
24Sɔɔl yaa weeni Samuel ayen, <<Mi tom kaasi kama. Mi an va Naawen nɔi ale fi le weeni diila. Mi chali ka nuruma yɔgsum a nye ba le weeni diila. 25Yɔgyɔgla de, mi a saalim fu, vɔŋ a te mu. Va mu a jam dɛ ate ti puusi Naawen.>> 26Alege Samuel a weeni Sɔɔl, <<Mi kan va fu. Fi zɛri Naawen nɔi kama ate wa yaa zɛri fu ase Izirali naab la.
27Samuel ale cheen wa cheŋ la, Sɔɔl yaa yik wa garukku tɛŋka ate ku cheeri. 28Samuel yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Naawen a cheeri Izirali naamu fi jigi kama jinla a pai te nuru yoŋ waai ale zunchoŋ fu. 29Waai a Ale Ka Izirali Zulaŋa La a kan velimu yaase wa tagri wa popola. Wa daa nuru biiga dila nyiŋ wa kan tagri wa popolaŋa.>>
30Sɔɔl yaa weeni ayen, <<M tom kaasi kama. Alege zuli mu ŋankpagsaŋa ale Izirali demma niŋ. Va mu jam ate m puusi Naawen fi Wenni,>> 31Samuel yaa va Sɔɔl a cheŋ, ate Sɔɔl a puusi Naawen.
32Samuel yaa ŋman weeni ayen, <<Ta Amalek demma naawa Agag jam te mu.>> Alege Agag yaa poli ayen wa nyini kum po nyini kama. 33Samuel yaa weeni Agag ayen, Fi gebika basi kama ate maba a jɔg ba bisa. Yɔgyɔgla de fi mawa a kan ta bisa. Samuel yaa che Agag munamuna Naawen niŋ Gilgal tɛŋka po.
34Samuel yaa basi dula ale cheŋ Arama alege ate Sɔɔl mɛ a kuli Gibea. 35Samuel an ŋman jam nya Sɔɔl wa boka po meena alege Sɔɔl wie jam a daani wa kama. Naawen jam a ŋma ka wadek wa le basi ate Sɔɔl a chim Izirali naab la.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 16
Content:
1Naawen yaa weeni Samuel ayen, <<Sɔɔl wie ale daani fi a paari ka dimpo? Mi zɛri wa kama, wa ŋman daa Izirali naaba. Pa kpaam a sueri nyiini a cheŋ. Mi a tom fu ka Jese jigi Betiliyem, dii nyiŋla mi lueri ka wa nidoabilisaŋa wanyi ayen wa chim naab.>>
2Alege Samuel yaa weeni ayen, <<M dan cheŋ Sɔɔl ale wom a ko mu.>> Naawen yaa weeni ayen, <<Yaali naab paalik a ta cheŋ. Weeni ayen, <M jam kama ayen m nye kaabka a te Naawen.> 3Wi Jese ate wa jam kaabka jigini. Ate m yaa weeni dii ate fi le nye la. Waai ate mi a dak la, kpiiri kpaamu basi wa zukku po a lueri wa.>>
4Samuel yaa nye dii ate Naawen weeni la. Wa le ga paari Betiliyem la nisɔmma nyiŋsa deri a gɔk. Ba yaa tu wa a bek wa ayen, <<Fidek ti fi cheena?>>
5Samuel yaa weeni ayen, <<Ka m dek. M jam kama ayen m nye kaabka a te Naawen. Ni be gomsi nidek magsi a jam.>> Ate wa yaa poori Jese ale wa bisaŋa a yaa wi ba ayen ba jam kaabka.
6Ba le jam la, Samuel yaa nya Jese biika Eliab a poli ayen Naawen a lueri ka waai ale za nna.
7Alege Naawen yaa weeni Samuel, <<Kan nya Eliab ale ka diila yaase wa le wɔŋŋa la, mi an lueri wa. Naawen kan nya wie ase nuruba ale a nya ŋa diila. Nuruba a nya ka peelim alege Naawen a nya suinummu po.>>
8Jese yaa wi Abinadab a weeni wa ayen wa taam ate Samuel nya wa. Alege Samuel weeni ayen, <<Naawen an lueri nuruwa de mɛ.>> 9Jese a ŋman basi ate Sammaya a taam. Alege Samuel a weeni ayen, <<Aaya, Naawen an lueri wa de.>> 10Jese yaa basi ate wa bisaŋa bayopɔi a taam. Alege Samuel a weeni ayen, <<Naawen an lueri ba de.>> 11Samuel yaa bek Jese, <<Ka fi bisaŋa meena ale nna.>> Jese yaa tulisi ayen, <<M ta bi baaŋ. Wa ta ka piisa nyini a nya.>> Samuel yaa weeni ayen, <<Tom wi wa ate wa jam ti kan kali ka wa nin jam.>>
12Jese yaa tom ate ba ta wa bi baaŋka a jam. Wa jam ka bi kaai ale nala a chim duerɔ. Naawen yaa weeni Samuel ayen, <<Ga bobi wa dii nyiŋla wala ate mi a lueri.>>
13Samuel yaa pai kpaamu ale nyiini a kpiiri basi Jese bi baaŋka zuk po a lueri wa wa suataŋa niŋ. A zaani da dila danni Naawen chiika jam sueri Deevid ale pagrim. Samuel yaa basi dula ale ŋman cheŋ Arama.
14Alege Naawen Chiika yaa basi Sɔɔl ate chiik biok a nyini Naawen jigi a jam namsi Sɔɔl nna yegayega.
15Sɔɔl tomteerɔma yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Nya, Naawen basi ate ka chiik biok a daani fu nna yegayega. 16Te ti suik ate ti yaali nuru waai ale baga a nak kpanuŋ. Ate Naawen a dan basi ate chiik biok jam a daani fu, abe wa a nak ate ku zunchoŋ fi jigi.>>
17Sɔɔl yaa weeni wa tomteerɔma ayen, <<Ni gisi ta waai ale baga a nak nalimnyiini a jam te mu.>>
18Tomteerɔma wanyi yaa weeni ayen, <<Wa nya Betiliyem denɔwa Jese. Wala nidoabinni ale a nak kpanuŋ. Wa ka waai ale ka tugurik tɔŋdɔ tuak. Wa biik nala ale chim nuru maŋ ate Naawen mɛ bo ale wa.>>
19Sɔɔl yaa tom wa tomteerɔma a weeni Jese ayen, <<Te ti fi biika Deevid waai ale a nya piisaŋa zuk la a jam.>> 20Jese yaa yaali boroborok ale bunlɔk ale daam ale buuk a vi boniŋ zuk a tom Deevid ate wa cheŋ Sɔɔl jigi.
21Deevid ale cheŋ Sɔɔl jigi la, wa yaa tom a te wa. Sɔɔl jam a yaali Deevid ka nna yegayega a yaa basi ate wa a yik wa kpaliŋ kɔlimaŋa. 22Sɔɔl yaa tom weeni Jese ayen, <<Basi ate Deevid a bo ale mu a tom a te mu diila mi a yaali wa ka nna yegayega.>>
23Chiik bioku a dan nyini Naawen jigi jam a daani Sɔɔl, Deevid nyiem pai ka wa kpanuŋku a nak ate chiik bioku a basi Sɔɔl ate ku zunchoŋ wa jigi.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 17
Content:
1Filistia demma yaa tigsi ba tugurik tɔŋdɔma a magsi kpaliŋ. Ba jam tu chaab ka Sokoyo ale bo Juda po la. A yaa nye goomu jigini Efes Dammim, Sokoyo ale Azeka suŋsuŋ po. 2Sɔɔl ale Izirali demma a jam tu ka Elaya Viaka a nye ba goomu jigini dula ayen ba kpaliŋ Filistia demma. 3Filistia demma a jam soa ka guuk kunyi, Izirali demma mɛ a soa kunyi ate viaka yaa bo suŋsuŋ.
4Filistia demma a jam ta ka ganduok, wa yuei jam le Goliat a nyini Gat. Wa yaa nyini Filistia demma tuka jigini a nyini. Wa jam wɔŋa ase ka anamagib pi ale buta la. 5Wa jam vuk ka kutuk mɔnuŋ zukchin, ale kutuk mɔnuŋ garuk ate ku dobra ase ligbie dobrim tusa ŋanu (5,000). 6Wa jam jo ka kuta ŋanta lik wa naŋsaŋa ale ta kuta gbaluk wa ŋaaŋ. 7Wa gbaluku dueku a jam zuak ase ka chib la, ate gbaluku kutukku nɔnni a dobra ase ligbie dobrim kobsiyuebi la. Waai ale jam yik jaab buuni ate wa pai a chɔgsi ŋanta la jam bo ka wa niŋ.
8Goliat yaa nyini zaani a kaari weeni Izirali demma, <<Ka boa ate ni tu ayen ni nye kpaliŋŋa? Mi ka Filistia denɔ nama Sɔɔl tomteerɔba? Ni lueri waai ate wa jam kpaliŋ ale mi. 9Wa dan baga a ko mi tama ale chim ni yɔm. Mi abe dan baga a ko wa nama chim tama tomteerɔba.>> 10Wa yaa weeni ayen, <<Jinla mi za a nak nanpaga ale Izirali demma, ni lueri waai ate ti kpaliŋ chaab.>> 11Sɔɔl ale Izirali demma ale wom Filistia denɔwa biika la yɔgsum yaa yik ba nna yegayega.
12Deevid jam ka Jese biik Jese jam ka Efrat denɔ a nyini Betiliyem ale bo Juda po la. Jese a jam ta ka bisa naaniŋ. Sɔɔl daaŋa po Jese a jam kpaŋ kama yɔgla. 13Wa bi kpaŋŋa batawa jam va Sɔɔl kama a cheŋ kpaliŋka. Wa bikpagni yuei jam le Eliab, waai ale pai saŋ la yuei jam le Abinadab, nwala yuei jam le Sammaya. 14Deevid jam le baaŋka. Jese bi kpaga ŋatawa a jam va Sɔɔl kama cheŋ 15alege Deevid a nyini Sɔɔl jigi a cheŋ Betiliyem a kasim a nya wa kowa piisaŋa ale a ŋmani.
16Daa pisinaansi meena saluik ale junɔi Goliat a nyiem nyini kama a zaani a nak nanpaga ale Izirali tugurik tɔŋdɔma.
17Jese yaa weeni wa biika Deevid ayen, <<Pa ŋandiintaŋa de boorik genni ale borobotta pi a kpabi ga te fi suataŋa kpaliŋka jigini. 18Pa maasa piwa de a ga te tugurik tɔŋdɔma kpagni ale fi suataŋa abe fi nya ase ba ka se abe fi jam weeni mu. 19Fi suataŋa a bo ale ka Sɔɔl ale tugurik tɔŋdɔma Elaya Viaka po ayen ba kpaliŋ ale Filistia demma.>>
20Saluik yokyok Deevid yaa basi piisaŋa a te naapeerik ka choa. Wa yaa ta ŋandiintaŋa a cheŋ ase wa kowa ale weeni diila. Deevid ale paari du la ale tugurik tɔŋdɔma a nyini kama a cheŋ ba zaanaŋa jigi ale a kaari kpaliŋ kaarik. 21Izirali demma ale Filistia demma a yik ba tugurik tɔŋdɔma zaani a tuk chaab. 22Deevid yaa basi ŋandiintaŋa ate nuru waai ale a nya ba ŋandiintaŋa zuk la ale cheŋ kpaliŋka jigini ayen wa puusi wa suataŋa. 23Wa le diem boro a biisi ale ba la, Goliat Filistia demma ganduoku ale nyini Gat la, a yaa nyini za a na a le Izirali demma ase wa le poom a nye diila ate Deevid wom. 24Izirali demma ale nya Goliat la, yɔgsum yik ba nna yegayega ate ba chali.
25Izirali demma a yaa weeni chaab ayen, <<Nya nuruwa de ale kasim a nyini diila? Wa nyini kama a nak nanpaga ale Izirali. Waai ale a ko nuruwa de la naawa ale basi ate wa jigsi. Naawa ale pai wa liewa te wa mɛ abe wa basi ate wa dɔkdemma meena a kaa tuni lampoo Izirali po.>>
26Deevid yaa bek nuru baai ale za moata wala ayen, <<Ba le nye ka boa a te nuru waai ale baga a ko Filistia denɔwa de la a yeeri chivieŋa de Izirali jigiya? Filistia denɔwa de waai ale kaa a te Naawen la ate a poli wa baga a nak nanpaga ale Naawen dii ale vua la tugurik tɔŋdɔma kama yaa?>>
27Izirali demma yaa weeni Deevid naawa le wa nye dii a te waai ale a ko Goliat la.
28Deevid suok kpagni Eliab ale wom Deevid ale a biisi ale tugurik tɔŋdɔma la, wa sui yaa puuri ale Deevid, wa yaa bek Deevid, <<Ka boan ti fi jam dela? Ka wana ale a nya piisaŋa magadekka zuwa gɔnni po? Mi seba fi le ta kanjanta la kama. Mi seba fi nyeka tuemu kama. Fi jam kama ayen fi nya kpaliŋka.>>
29Deevid yaa bek ayen, <<M nye ka boan wari kaasi? M kan ŋman biisi?>> 30Wa le cheen nuru mbala jigi la, wa ŋman bek ayen ba le nye ka boa a te waai ale a ko nuruwa de la? Ate ba tulisi wa naawa le wa nye diila. 31Deevid ale jam weeni diila, ba jam weeni Sɔɔl kama. Ate Sɔɔl tom wi wa.
32Deevid yaa weeni Sɔɔl, <<Kan te waai jɔgi nyiŋbiiri. Mi, fi tomteerɔwa ale cheŋ a ga kpaliŋ ale Filistia denɔwa de.>>
33Sɔɔl yaa weeni ayen, <<Fi an baga a ga a nye kpaliŋ ale Filistia denɔwa de. Fi ka biik. Goliat abe nye kpaliŋ a nyini ka wa biik po.>>
34Alege Deevid a weeni Sɔɔl ayen, <<Mi fi tomteerɔwa a nya ka m kowa piisa zuk. Ase gbeŋli yaase piuk a dan jam yik piisaŋa kunyi, 35Mi nyiem vi di kama a vari posuku a basi. Gbeŋli yaase piuk a dan siti mi, mi nyiem yik ka di zukku a nak ko. 36Mi waai ale ka fi tomteerɔ la, a ko gbeŋli ale piuk kama. Filistia denɔwa de bɔgluk kaarika m le ko wa ase ka gbeŋli yaase piuku la, dii nyiŋla wa biisi a kaasi Naawen dii ale vua la tugurik tɔŋdɔma kama. 37Naawen ale vari mi gbeŋli ale piuku jigi a basi la ale vari mi Filistia denɔwa de jigi a basi.>> Sɔɔl yaa weeni Deevid, <<Cheŋ ale Naawen ale bo ale fu.>>
38Sɔɔl yaa pai wadek kɔlimaŋa a jo Deevid. Wa jam pai wa kuta zuk chinni a vuk wa ale pai kpaliŋ kɔlimaŋa a jo wa. 39Deevid yaa pai Sɔɔl gebika a cheŋ gilim alege wa an pai ŋan baai ate Sɔɔl a pai jo wa la a nye wari nya ya. Wa yaa weeni Sɔɔl ayen, <<Mi an baga a ta ba a cheŋ, dii nyiŋla mi an pai ba nye wari nya ya.>> Deevid yaa yeeri ŋantaŋa meena. 40Deevid yaa pai wa doani a nyo nisa po ale pisi tana ŋanu beli naŋka po. A yaa pai nyo wa naapeerik foruku po ale pai wa visiŋka. Wa yaa cheŋ ayen wa tu chaab ale ganduoku.
41Filistia denɔwa yaa cheŋ a ga tu wa. Nuru waai ale jam yik wa jakasimu la a dɛ ka wa niŋ. 42Goliat ale nya Deevid ale wa ka biik ale nala la, wa deri kisi wa. 43Wa yaa weeni Deevid ayen, <<Fi pai mi a chim ka biaga ate fi cheen mi jigi ale doari ya.>> Wa yaa wi ba bɔgtaŋa wie a ka a te Deevid. 44Wa yaa weeni Deevid ayen, <<Jam dela. M le ko fu a te wenzuk nuinsa ale duŋsa.>>
45Alege Deevid yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Fi cheen ale ka gebik ale gbatta tiye. Mi bɛ cheena ale ka Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, Izirali tugurik tɔŋdɔma Wenni yuenni nyiŋ. Fi biisi kaasi Wen dila kama. 46Jinla Naawen dii ale ta pagrim la ale pai fu nyo m nisa po ate m ko fu a gebi fi zukku. Jinla m le ko Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma ate nuinsa ale duŋsa a de ba. Ate tɛŋka meena seba ayen Wen a bo ale Izirali. 47Waai meena ale tigsi dela la ale seba ayen Naawen dii ale ta pagrim la a kan pai daa gebisa ale gbatta a vari wa nuruba a basi. Kpaliŋka ka Naawen ale soa, wa bɛ le pai fu te mu.>>
48Goliat ale torisi moata wa la, Deevid yaa chali nwuli a tu wa. 49Wa yaa yeeri tain wa foruku po, a pai nyo wa visiŋka po a nak. Tintanni yaa ga yik dinni a vuri jo, ate Goliat a lo nyue nyiŋ.
50Deevid a pai ka visiŋ ale tain a nak dɛ Goliat. Wa jam nak kama a ko wa. Wa jam ka gebik wa nisa po.
51Deevid yaa chali ga zaani wa tɛŋ. Wa yaa yeeri Goliat dek gebik ka fook po a gebi wa zukku. Filistia demma ale nya ayen ba ganduok a kpi la, ba deri cheen pai chala choa. 52Izirali ale Juda nuruma yaa kaari zik zik a vi Filistia demma a ga paari viaka ale Ekron tɛŋka nɔi. Filistia demma a jam kpi dua ka nna bilabila Saaraim suiku po a ga paari Gat ale Ekron. 53Izirali demma yaa vi ba pilim ŋmani Filistia demma tuka jigini a pai ba ŋantaŋa. 54Deevid yaa pai Goliat zukku a ta cheŋ Jerusalem. Wa jam pai Goliat kpaliŋ kɔlimaŋa a dueni ka wadek viuku po.
55Sɔɔl ale nya Deevid ale wa cheŋ ayen wa tu Goliat la, wa yaa bek Abner, Tugurik tɔŋdɔma kpagni ayen, <<Abner biika nna ko ale wana?>> Abner yaa tulisi ayen, <<Mi zɛ.>>
56Naawa yaa weeni ayen, <<Bek wom ase ka wana biik.>>
57Deevid ale ko Goliat a ŋmani la, Abner yaa ta wa jam Sɔɔl jigi. Deevid jam diem yik ka Goliat zukku tara.
58Sɔɔl yaa bek wa ayen, <<Biiga, fi ko ale wana?>> Deevid yaa tulisi ayen, <<Mi ka fi tomteerɔwa Jese ate wa nyini Betiliyem la biik.>>

Title: 1 SAMUEL 18
Content:
1Deevid ale biisi ale Sɔɔl a nueri la, Jonatan a jam mariŋ Deevid ka nna yegayega. Wa jam a yaali wa ase ka wadek la. 2Sɔɔl jam basi ate Deevid bo ale wa kama a nyini dai dila danni a kan siak ate wa a ga wa kowa yenni. 3Sɔɔl biika Jonatan ale Deevid yaa jam nye nɔiyeŋ dii nyiŋla wa jam a yaali Deevid ase ka wadek la. 4Wa jam yeeri wa garukku kama a te Deevid, ale wa kpaliŋ kɔlimaŋa ale wa gebika ale wa tommu ale wa chiak gbanni.
5Sɔɔl a jam tom Deevid kama ate wa ga nye kpaliŋ yonsa. Deevid jam nak kama dɛ. Ate Sɔɔl jam basi ate Deevid a chim tugurik tɔŋdɔma kpagi. Ku jam peenti Sɔɔl kpaŋŋa ale nuruma meena sui kama.
6Deevid ale ko Filistia denɔwa la, wa le nuruma meena ale jam ŋman kuli la, nipooma yaa nyini tɛŋsaŋa meena ale bo Izirali po la a nyini a tu naab Sɔɔl. Ba jam a yi ka yiila ale suipeentik a gɔk ale a yegsi ŋanta ale a nak kpanta. 7Ba le a nak la, ba yaa yi yiila ayen, Sɔɔl ko ka dachaasa tusa, alege Deevid a ko tusa piisa.
8Nipooma yiini a yaa daani Sɔɔl, ate wa sui a puuri. Wa yaa poli, <<Nipooma a weeni ayen Deevid a ko tusa piisa, alege a weeni ayen mi ko ka tusidi nyiini. Dii yaa le tali la ale wa tuesi naamu.>> 9A zaani dila Sɔɔl yaa jam dueni ka num tɛŋ a nya Deevid, dii nyiŋla wa jam a dɛ ka nyuri.
10Vari ale veenti la chiik biok yaa nyini Wen jigi a jam jo Sɔɔl, ate wa a porisi wie yenni po. Ate Deevid a jam pai kpanuŋ a nak ase wa nyiem le poom a nye diila. Sɔɔl abe jam ta ka gbaluk nisa po. 11Wa yaa yuk gbaluku ale poli ayen, <<M le yuk wa a maŋ ka siaka.>> Alege Deevid a nyini du nyini buye meena.
12Naawen dii ale ta pagrim la a jam bo le Deevid kama alege basi Sɔɔl. Dila nyiŋ Sɔɔl yaa jam a chali Deevid ka yɔgsum. 13Wa yaa basi ate Deevid a chim tugurik tɔŋdɔba tusidi kpagi, ate wa ta ba a cheŋ kpaliŋ. 14Wa jam nya nakdeka kama ale dii meena dii nyiŋla Naawen a jam bo le wa kama. 15Sɔɔl ale nya ale Deevid kasim a nya nakdeka la, wa yaa kasim a chali Deevid yɔgsum nna yegayega. 16Alege Izirali ale Juda nuruma meena a jam a yaali Deevid ka nna yegayega dii nyiŋla wa jam a dɛ ba niŋ kama nalimnyiini kpaliŋ po.
17Sɔɔl yaa weeni Deevid ayen, <<M lie kpagni Merab ale nna. M le basi ate fi faari wa. Mi a yaali ka fi tin tua abe fi a kpaliŋ Naawen kpaliŋsaŋa.>> Sɔɔl a jam poli kama ayen, <<Mi kan ko Deevid ka Filistia demma ale ba ko wa.>>
18Alege Deevid yaa tulisi ayen, <<Mi ka wana? Mi ale nyini dɔkdem baai po la an magsi mi chim naawa chicham biiga.>> 19Ku le jam paari diipo ate Sɔɔl liewa Merab a magsi wa yali Deevid la, Sɔɔl a gɔnti pai wa te Adriel ale nyini Meyola la.
20Sɔɔl liewa wa choawa, Michal a jam yaali Deevid kama. Ba le weeni Sɔɔl la, wa sui jam peenti kama. 21Sɔɔl yaa poli ayen, <<M le basi ate wa yali Deevid. Ate wa yaa chim wa baruk ate Filistia, demma a baga a ko wa.>> Sɔɔl yaa ŋman weeni Deevid nye buye ayen, <<Fi baga a chim m chicham biik kama.>>
22Sɔɔl yaa weeni wa tomteerɔwa ayen, <<Ni weeni Deevid dek wa nyiini ayen, <Nya, naawa sui a peenti kama ale fi ate wa tomteerɔma meena a yaali fu. Dila la yɔgyɔgla de chim wa chicham biik.> >>
23Ba weeni dila meena a te Deevid. Alege Deevid yaa weeni ayen, <<Nama a poli ayen ku ka wa fiik ate fi chim naawa chicham biiga? Mi ka jajak nuruba abe zɛ mu piisi ya.>>
24Sɔɔl tomteerɔma le weeni wa dii ate Deevid a weeni la, 25Sɔɔl yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ni weeni Deevid ayen, <Naawa a kan yaali jaab nipok fiaka nyiŋ a gaam fi ale ko Filistia demma kook a gebi ba yua gbantaŋa ate ku chim tutuna a te wa dachaasaŋa la.> >> Sɔɔl zɔŋŋa jam le Filistia demma a ko Deevid.
26Tomteerɔma ale weeni Deevid wieŋa de la, wa sui yaa peenti ayen wa chim naawa chichambiik. Abe daaŋa a paari la, 27Deevid ale wa nuruma yaa nyini a ga ko Filistia demma kobsiye. A yaa ta ba yua gbantaŋa meena a jam te naawa ayen wa chim naawa chicham biik. Sɔɔl yaa pai wa liewa Michal a yalisi wa.
28Sɔɔl ale miŋ ayen Naawen dii ale ta pagrim la a bo ale Deevid la ate wa liewa Michal mɛ a yaali wa la, 29yɔgsum yaa ŋmasi ta Sɔɔl nna yegayega ate Deevid yaa kasim chim wa dachiak a cheŋ.
30Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔba kpaŋŋa a jam kasim a cheŋ kpaliŋka ka dila. Ba bɛ le a cheŋ diila Deevid a nya nakdeka mɛ ka dila a gaam Sɔɔl tugurik tɔŋdɔba kpaŋŋa. Deevid yuenni a yaa jam a yiti ate waai meena a sebi wa.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 19
Content:
1Sɔɔl yaa weeni wa biika Jonatan ale wa nuruma meena ayen ba ko Deevid, alege Jonatan jam a yaali Deevid ka nna yegayega. 2Wa yaa kaam Deevid ayen, <<M kowa a gisi ka suik ayen wa ko fu. Saluik kpesi a nya abe fi yaali jigi a suk. 3M le nyini ga za ale m kowa juijui ate fi suk la abe m yaa biisi fi wie ale wa. Dii meena ale boro la m le basi ate fi seba.>>
4Jonatan ale biisi ale wa kowa la wa yaa biisi wa maŋsa nyiini a ta va Deevid jigi. Jonatan yaa weeni ayen, <<Naawa kan nye wa yɔmawa Deevid wari kaasi diila Deevid an nye wari kaasi wa. Wa le nye diila a maari fu ka nna yegayega. 5Deevid a pai wadek nyuvuri a da ate Naawen basi ate Izirali meena nya nak dekka. Fi nya ku kama ate fi sui jam peenti. Ka boa ate fi le nye Deevid kaasi? Wa an kaasi wari ya. Wari karo a magsi wa ko ka.>>
6Sɔɔl yaa wom Jonatan ale biisi diila a yaa puulim ayen, <<Naawen ale vua la nyiŋ, m kan ko Deevid.>>
7Jonatan yaa wi Deevid a weeni wa dii meena ate Sɔɔl a biisi la. Wa yaa ta Deevid a jam Sɔɔl jigi ate Deevid a ŋman bo le Sɔɔl ase piilimka la.
8Kpaliŋ ale ŋman jam yiti ate Deevid nyini ga kpaliŋka ale Filistia demma. Wa jam nak dɛ ba kama ale ko ba yega ate ba gela a chali.
9Dai yeŋ ate Sɔɔl a jam kali wa yenni ate gbaluk a bo wa nisa po ate chichirik biok a yaa nyini Naawen pagrim Nyɔnɔwa jigi a jam jo Sɔɔl. Deevid jam kali ka wa tɛŋ a nak kpanuŋ. 10Sɔɔl yaa nye nyiŋbiiri ayen wa yuk Deevid a maŋ siaka ale gbaluku ale bo wa nisaŋa po la, alege Deevid yɔk ga nakpiak. Sɔɔl gbaluku jam vuri ka siaka alege ate Deevid chali bɛ yok kula.
11Sɔɔl yaa tom nuruba ayen ba ga Deevid yenni a kpesi nya abe ba ko wa saluiku. Alege Deevid powa Michal yaa kaam wa ayen, <<Yɔkku de se fi chali ti vummu nyiŋ. Fi dan kan chali ya, fi le kpi saluik.>> 12Wa yaa basi ate Deevid va tuokparuk a siŋ chali bɛ. 13Deevid powa Michal yaa pai bɔgluk a dueni gaduokku zuk, a pai buuk kɔbta a lik ku nyiŋka a ŋman pai buuku kɔbta mɛ a dueni zukku geŋ.
14Sɔɔl yaa tom nuruba ayen ba ga yik Deevid, ale ge Michal yaa weeni ayen, <<Wa a yuak kama.>>
15Sɔɔl a ŋman tom nuruma ayen ba ŋman ga nya Deevid, a weeni ba ayen, <<Ni pai wa le gaduokku meena a ta jam ate m ko wa.>> 16Nuruma ale ga jo Deevid dɔkku po la, ba yaa nya bɔgluk ale dua gaduokku zuk ate kɔbta lik ku zukku.
17Sɔɔl yaa weeni Michal ayen, <<Ka boa ale soa ate fi paasi mu nna? Fi basi ate m dachiaka a nyini ayen wa chali bɛ.>> Michal yaa tulisi Sɔɔl, <<Deevid weeni mi kama ayen m dan kan maa wa ate wa chali bɛ ya, wa le ko mu.>>
18Deevid ale nyini Sɔɔl jigi a chali bɛ la, wa yaa cheŋ Samuel jigi Arama tɛŋka a ga weeni wa dii meena ate Sɔɔl a nye wa la. Deevid ale Samuel yaa cheŋ Naiot a bo dula. 19Sɔɔl yaa wom ayen Deevid a bo ka Naiot ale bo Arama tɛŋka la. 20Wa yaa tom nuruba ayen ba ga yik wa. Alege ba yaa ga zik biisiteerɔba ale ba tigsi za a mooli wie, ate Samuel a dɛ ba niŋ. Naawen chiika yaa jo Sɔɔl nuruma ate ba maari a mooli wieŋa. 21Sɔɔl ale wom dii meena ale nye la, wa yaa tom nuruba yega, alege ba mɛ a maa mooli. Wa ŋman tom nuruba nye buta, alege ba mɛ mooli. 22Sɔɔl dek yaa cheŋ Arama, a paari vili kpienni ale bo Seku la a yaa bek ayen, <<Samuel ale Deevid a bo ka bɛ?>> Ba yaa weeni ayen, <<Ba bo ka Naiot ale bo Arama la.>>
23Sɔɔl ale cheŋ Naiot ale bo Arama la, Wen Chiika yaa jo wa. Ate wa yaa mooli a cheŋ a ga paari Naiot ale bo Arama la. 24Wa yaa yeeri wa gattaŋa alege za Samuel niŋ a mooli. Wa duak ka dila yokku ale kantueŋka meena. Dila ale soa ate nuruba a bek ayen, <<Sɔɔl mɛ maa ka biisiteerɔma po wanyi yaa?>>

Title: 1 SAMUEL 20
Content:
1Deevid yaa basi Naiot ale bo Arama po la ale chali cheŋ Jonatan jigi. Wa yaa bek Jonatan ayen, <<M nye ka sɛ? M kaasuŋku ale boa? M tin nye ka sɛ a kaasi fi kowa? Ka boa ate wa yaali ayen wa ko mu?>>
2Jonatan yaa tulisi ayen, <<Aaya, fi kan kpi. Nya, mi kowa kan nye wa kpienni yaase wa fiik alege kan weeni mi. Boan le soa ate wa a suk kude mi jigiya? Ku daa wensie.>>
3Alege Deevid yaa pɛ, a weeni ayen, <<Fi kowa seba kama nalimnyiini ayen fi a yaali mi kama. Wa le weeni wadek ayen, <Jonatan an magsi wa seba kan daa di wa sui ale kaasi.> Deevid, Naawen ale vua ate fi mɛ vua la mi an yalima ale kum.>>
4Jonatan yaa weeni Deevid ayen, <<M le nye dii meena ate fi a yaali ayen m nye la.>>
5Deevid yaa weeni ayen, <<Nya, chum ale Chiik Paalika tigini. Ku magsi ka m dɛ ŋandiinta ale naawa, alege basi ate m suk peelim a paari daa ŋata junɔi. 6Fi kowa a dan kan nya mu weeni wa ayen m cheŋ ka Betiliyem. Ben meena ase nna po de la wa dɔkdemma a tigsi ka chaab a nye kaabka. 7Fi kowa dan weeni ayen, <ku nala>, m soa m dek kama. Alege wa sui a dan puuri, fi seba ayen wa le nye mu wari. 8Jonatan ta wensie ale mi fi tomteerɔwa. Fi nye ka nɔiyeŋ ale mu Naawen niŋ. M dan nye kaasi fu ko mu fidek! Boan nyiŋ ate fi a pai mu a te fi kowa?>>
9Jonatan yaa tulisi ayen, <<Aaya, kula kan nye! Mi dan seba ayen m kowa a zɔk ayen wa nye fu biem, m le kaam fu.>>
10Deevid yaa bek wa ayen, <<Fi kowa a dan kan tulisi fu magsi ya, ka wana le wa basi ate mi seba?>>
11Jonatan yaa weeni Deevid ayen, <<Basi ate ti cheŋ wuuku po.>> Ba nɔi bayewa yaa cheŋ wuuku po.
12Jonatan yaa weeni Deevid ayen, <<Mi a puulim kama Naawen, Izirali Wenni niŋ. Vɔnuŋ nna po dɛ m le nya m kowa popola ale ka diila. Mi dan biisi fi wari ate wa ta popola maŋsa m le basi ate fi seba. 13Alege wa daa poli ayen wa nye fu biem m le basi ate fi seba abe m basi ate fi chali bɛ. M dan kan nye ya Naawen namsi mu nna yegayega. Naawen a bo ale fu ase wa le bo ale mi kowa diila. 14Alege mi ale vua la nyiŋ sak Naawen ŋmanteka ale mu ate m kan kpi. 15Kan basi ŋmanteka sakka ale m dɔkdemma, ase Naawen a nin poom kaasi fi dachaasaŋa meena tɛŋka.>>
16Dila la Jonatan yaa nye nɔiyeŋ ale Deevid. Wa weeni ayen, <<Naawen ate ti ku jo Deevid dachaasaŋa nyiŋ.>> 17Ate Jonatan a weeni Deevid ayen wa pilim weeni pumpuulimaŋa ayen wa le kasim a yaali wa, dii nyiŋla wa a yaali Deevid ka nna yegayega ase wa ale a yaali wadek diila.
18Jonatan yaa weeni Deevid ayen, <<Chum ale Chiik Paalika Tigini. Fi kalika jigini za ku dua kama. M kowa za wa jɔk fu kama. 19Daa ŋatawa danni nye nwuli cheŋ juijui ate daanika de daam piilim ate fi suk la. Limisi Ezel piuŋku tɛŋ. 20Daa ŋatawa danni m le tɔŋ pee ŋata a basi piuŋku geŋ ase mi a tuk ka jaab nyiŋ a tɔŋ la. 21M dan nye dila m yaa le tom biik ate wa gisi peeŋa. M dan weeni wa ayen, <Peeŋa a moata fu kama, ta ŋa jam de,> fi baga a nyini fi sukka jigini kama. Wari kan nye fu. Naawen ale tɔlim vua la biem ka. 22Alege m dan weeni biika ayen, <Nya, peeŋa bo ka niŋ,> ku a fɛ ate fi cheŋ, dii nyiŋla Naawen a weeni fu kama ayen fi chali bɛ. 23Teeri dii ate ti biisi la wari. Naawen ka seerɔ mi ale fi suŋsuŋ taa cheŋ.>>
24Deevid yaa suk wuutaŋa po. Chiik paalika Tigini ale paari la, naawa yaa kali ayen wa dɛ ŋandiinta. 25Wa kali ka wa nyiem ale a kali juijui la a moata siaka. Jonatan yaa za tuk naawa alege Abner kali naawa gauŋ nyiŋ. Deevid jigini doa koruk. 26Dai dila danni Sɔɔl an weeni wari ya. Wa poli kama ayen, <<Dai dii dai wari ale nye Deevid ate wa an nala.>> 27Alege dai dii ale paasaŋ la ka chiika daa ŋaye dai alege Deevid jigini a diem doa koruk. Sɔɔl yaa bek Jonatan ayen, <<Ka boa ale soa ate Jese nidoabinni deemwa ale jinla an jam tigini?>>
28Jonatan yaa tulisi ayen, <<Deevid a saalim mi kama ayen m basi ate wa cheŋ Betiliyem. 29Wa weeni ayen, <Ba a yaali ba nye ka kaabka tɛŋka po, ate m suoku a yaa tom ayen m jam. Yɔgyɔgla de mi dan ka fi doa, be basi ate m ga nya m suataŋa.> Dila ale soa ate wa an jam wa dɛ ale naawa.>>
30Ate Sɔɔl sui yaa puuri nna yegayega ale Jonatan. Sɔɔl yaa weeni Jonatan ayen, <<Fi ka nipok waai nyeka ale tua ale ka kiri la biik. Mi seba ayen fi za ka Jese biika Deevid ŋaaŋ a maari wa. Fi a te tidek ale fi mawa ale biak fu la ka chivie. 31Jese biika ale tɔlim vua a boro la, fi kan chim naaba yaase fi nya naammoa. Yɔgyɔgla tom ate ba ta Deevid jam te mu. Se m ko wa.>>
32Jonatan yaa bek wa kowa ayen, <<Ka boa ale soa ate fi ayen fi ko Deevid? Ka boan jaab wari ate wa kaasi?>> 33Sɔɔl yaa pai wa gbaluku a yuk Jonatan ayen wa ko wa. Jonatan jam seba kama ayen wa kowa a yaali ayen wa ko Deevid kama.
34Jonatan sui yaa puuri nna yegayega ate wa basi kalika jigini. Daa ŋayewa danni Jonatan jam zɛri ŋandiintaŋa dɛka kama. Chivie ale jam yik wa ale wa kowa ale a nye Deevid diila.
35Vari ale veenti la saluik Jonatan yaa cheŋ Deevid jigi ase ba le poom nye nɔiyeŋka diila. Wa jam te ti ka biik a va wa cheŋ. 36Jonatan yaa weeni biika ayen, <<M dan tɔŋ peeŋa fi chali ga gisi pai ta jam.>> Biika ale chali a cheŋ la. Jonatan yaa tɔŋ peeŋa a basi wa niŋ. 37Biika yaa chali cheŋ Jonatan ale tɔŋ peeŋa ate ŋa lo juijui la. Jonatan yaa wi weeni ayen, <<Penni a bo ka fi niŋ.>> 38Wa yaa na weeni ayen, <<Mwuli, cheŋ nwuli, kan zaani.>> Biika yaa pai penni a ta jam wa kpagni jigi. 39Biika jam zɛ ku kiri ya, ka Deevid ale Jonatan nyiini ale seba. 40Jonatan yaa pai wa tommu ale wa peeŋa a te biika ayen, <<Ta ŋman cheŋ tɛŋka po.>>
41Biika ale cheŋ la, Deevid yaa nyini wuuku po yeseok geŋ a nyini. Wa yaa koori tɛŋ buta a puusi Jonatan. Jonatan ale Deevid a gbaari chaab ale a kum, alege Deevid ale jam kum yega.
42Jonatan yaa weeni Deevid ayen, <<Cheŋ ale suiyɔgni. Ti puulim kama ale Naawen ayen ti ka doaba. Ti weeni kama ayen, Naawen ale wa chim seerɔ fi ale mi suŋsuŋ, ale ti ŋaaŋbisaŋa po a cheŋ.>> Deevid yaa cheŋ alege ate Jonatan ŋman cheŋ tɛŋka po.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 21
Content:
1Deevid yaa cheŋ Nob ayen wa nya kaabteerɔwa Ayimelek. Ayimelek ale nya Deevid la yɔgsum yaa yik wa ate wa nyiŋ a gɔk. Wa yaa bek Deevid ayen, <<Ka boa ate fi cheen fidek fi nyiini? Ka boa ate nuru an va fu?>>
2Deevid yaa tulisi wa ayen, <<Naawa ale tom mu ayen m nye wari a te wa. Wa bɛ weeni kama ayen m kan weeni waai wa le weeni ayen m nye diila. M weeni m nidoama kama ba le ba tu mu juijui la. 3Yɔgyɔgla de, ka boan ŋandiinta ate fi ta? Te mu borobotta tinu yaase jabuui meena ate fi ta la.>>
4Kaabteerɔwa yaa weeni Deevid ayen, <<Mi ka boroborok kuui ate nuru meena a ŋɔbi la, alege ka tuilum boroborok. Ni baga a ŋɔbi kama ase fi nuruma a nin kan goa ale nipooba.>>
5Deevid yaa tulisi ayen, <<Mi nidoama a nyiem kasim a yik badek kama a ta tuilum ase ti ni poom cheŋ tuima tomka. Alege ka yɔgyɔgla de ate ti bo tuin dii ale chim di tɔga po.>> 6Kaabteerɔwa yaa te Deevid tuilum boroborok Naawen niŋ dii nyiŋla ku choa a jam karo. Daa meena ba nyiem pai Wen niŋ boroboroku kama ale pai boroborok tuiluk a dueni du.
7Sɔɔl tomteerɔma wanyi ate ba a wi ayen, Doeg ate wa nyini Edom la a yaa jam dula jigini diila wa jam ayen wa puusi Naawen. Wa jam ka Sɔɔl tomteerɔma po wanyi waai ale chim naapeenaab la.
8Deevid yaa bek Ayimelek, <<Fi ta gbaluk yaase gebik dela? Naawa tuntomika a nye wari ka nna yegayega ate mi an baga a pai gbaluk yaase gebika.>>
9Kaabteerɔwa yaa tulisi ayen, <<Goliat Filistia denɔwa ate fi ko Elaya Viaka po la gebika a bo dela. Ka pɔbi ale ka garuk a dua kaabteerɔwa garuk genni ŋaaŋ. Fi daa yaali fi baga a, pai kama. Gebik ka choa karo a gum kala po.>> Deevid yaa weeni ayen, <<Gebik karo ase ka la la. Pa te mu.>>
10Dai dila danni Deevid yaa chali cheŋ Gat naawa Akis jigi Sɔɔl nyiŋ. 11Alege Akis tomteerɔwa a weeni wa ayen, <<Daa Izirali tɛŋka naawa Deevid ale nna yaa? Daa wala ate ba jam lenni yiini ayen Sɔɔl a ko ka wa tusa ate Deevid a ko wa tusa piisa la yaa?>>
12Deevid a jam wom ba le a biisi la kama a yaa chali yɔgsum ale Gat naawa Akis. 13Wa yaa jam potim a nye ase wa a yesim la Akis ale wa tomteerɔma niŋ. Wa le jam diem bo le ba la, wa jam a nye ase ka yesiŋ la, a pai wa ninyeensaŋa a kpaari tuataŋa, ale basi ate tintueta a chali va wa teeŋka a siŋ.
14Akis yaa weeni wa tomteerɔma ayen, <<Ni nya nuruwa. Wa a yesim kama ka boan ti ni ta wa jam mi jigiya? 15Mi ta yesiŋsa piisi kama. Mi kan yaali ni ta wa jam ate wa a nye nna mi niŋŋa. Ni kan te wa jo mi yeri po.>>

Title: 1 SAMUEL 22
Content:
1Deevid yaa basi Gat ale ga Adullam a suk piuŋ vɔrup po. Wa suataŋa ale wa mabisaŋa ale wom ayen wa bo du la la, ba yaa cheŋ ayen ba nya wa. 2Baai meena ale jam bo daanika po ale ta pama ale baai nina ale kan sueri ale ba boka la a yaa gum Deevid ŋaaŋviirɔma po ate wa chim ba niŋdeerɔ. Nuru baai ale jam bo ale wa la a paari ase ka kobsinaansi.
3Deevid yaa zaani dula a cheŋ Mizpa tɛŋka ale bo Moab po la a yaa biisi ale Moab naawa. Wa weeni wa ayen, <<Mi a saalim ayen fi basi ate m kowa ale m mawa a jam bo ale fu ate mi yaa baga miŋ Wen ale a yaali ayen wa nye dii a te mu la.>> 4Wa yaa basi ba ate ba bo le Moab naawa, alege ate Deevid a suk bo juijui ate wari a kan nye wa la.
5Alege biisiteerɔwa Gad yaa weeni Deevid ayen, <<Kan bo juijui ate fi boro nna. Cheŋ Juda tɛŋka.>> Deevid yaa cheŋ Yeret tiisaŋa po.
6Dai yeŋ ate Sɔɔl a yaa kali tiib tɛŋ guuk zuk a moata Gibea. Wa jam ta ka gbaluk wa nisa po alege ate wa tugurik tɔŋdɔba kpaŋŋa a za gilim wa. Ba jam weeni Sɔɔl kama ayen waai seba Deevid ale wa nuruma ale suk kauk kuui la kama. 7Sɔɔl yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni wom de, nama Benjamin buuni. Nama taa poli ayen ni nye ka sɛ? Ni a poli ayen ni basi mi kama abe ni cheŋ Deevid jigi yaa? Wa le te ni meena tɛŋsa ate ni a kpa? Wa le basi ate ni chim kpaga tugurik tɔŋdɔba tusa zuwa yaase tugurik tɔŋdɔba kook zuwa? 8Chichama karo ni meena a zɔk kama ayen ni yeeri mi naamu po. Midek biik a nye ka nɔiyeŋ ale Deevid alege ni waai an weeni mi. Waai an weeni ayen mi biika a te Deevid ka nyiŋbiiri ayen wa mak a ko mi.>>
9Doeg waai ale ka Edom denɔ a jam za dula ale tomteerɔma ate wa a nya ba zuk la a yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Mi nya Deevid. Wa jam kama ayen wa nya Ayimelek, Ayitub biika ale bo Nob la. 10Ayimelek yaa puusi te Deevid ale te wa ŋandiinta a ŋman pai Goliat Filistia denɔwa gebika te wa.>>
11Sɔɔl yaa tom ayen ba ta kaabteerɔwa Ayimelek waai ale ka Ayitub biik la ale Ayimelek dɔkdemma meena ale kaabteerɔba ale bo Nob la a jam. Ate ba meena jam naawa jigi. 12Sɔɔl yaa weeni Ayimelek ayen, <<Ayitub biika wom yɔgyɔgla de.>> Ayimelek yaa weeni ayen, <<Mm m nyɔnɔ.>>
13Sɔɔl yaa weeni ayen, <<Ka boa ale soa ate fi ale Jese biika a ta chaab ale mi? Fi te wa boroborok ale gebik. Fi bek Wen te wa mɛ. Deevid basi mi kama ale ta chaab ale mi a limisi ayen wa siti yɔgyɔgla de.>>
14Ayimelek yaa weeni ayen, <<Fi ka tomteerɔ ŋmana ate wa ta wensie ase Deevid fidek chicham biika a ŋman chim fi tugurik tɔŋdɔma kpagi la. Waai meena ale bo fi yenni po la a zuli wa kama. 15Daa mi piilimka ale la ate m bek Wen a te wa la. Kaa ŋma mi yaase mi dɔkdemma. Mi, fi tomteerɔwa zɛ dii meena ale a nye la.>>
16Alege naawa weeni ayen, <<Ayimelek, se fi ale fi dɔkdemma a kpi.>>
17Wa yaa weeni tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale za wa gauŋ la ayen, <<Ni cheŋ ga ko Naawen kaabteerɔma, dii nyiŋla ba a maari ka Deevid. Ba jam seba wa le chali a bɛ la kama alege an weeni sak mu.>> Alege tugurik tɔŋdɔma zɛri ba an ko Naawen kaabteerɔma.
18Naawa yaa weeni Doeg ayen, <<Cheŋ a ga ko kaabteerɔma.>> Ate Doeg Edom denɔwa yaa cheŋ ga ko kaabteerɔma. Dai dila danni wa ko kaabteerɔ baai ale jo ba garuk gela la ka pinaanuŋ ale banu. 19Wa maa ko Nob demma mɛ juijui ate kaabteerɔma a nyini la. Wa jam ko nidoaba ale nipooba ale bisa ale buluata ale niiga ale bonsa ale piisa meena.
20Alege Ayimelek biika Abiata jam chali bɛ kama. Wa jam chali cheŋ a ga gum ka Deevid ale wa nuruma po. 21Wa yaa weeni Deevid ayen Sɔɔl a ko Naawen kaabteerɔma kama. 22Deevid yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Doeg Edom denɔwa ale bo Nob ku danni. Mi seba ayen ka wala ale sum weeni Sɔɔl. Mi ale soa fi kowa dɔkdemma kummu. 23Bo dela ale mu. Kan chali yɔgsum. Nuru waai ale a yaali ayen wa ko fu la a yaali ayen wa ko ka mi. Jaab kan nye fi ale mi.>>

Title: 1 SAMUEL 23
Content:
1Nuru yaa weeni Deevid ayen, <<Nya, Filistia demma a kpaliŋ kama ale Keila demma ale a zu ba kpanni ŋantaŋa ate ba fɔbi dueni la.>> 2Deevid yaa bek Naawen ayen, <<M cheŋ a ga nye kpaliŋ ale Filistia demma?>> Naawen yaa tulisi wa ayen, <<Cheŋ ga siti ba a vari Keila demma basi.>>
3Alege Deevid nuruma yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Yɔgsum ale ta ti dela Juda tɛŋka po. Yɔgsum ale yik ti gaam di ase ti nin cheŋ Keila juijui ate Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma a boro la.>>
4Deevid yaa ŋman bek Naawen ate Naawen tulisi wa ayen, <<Cheŋ Keila tɛŋka. M le maari fu ate fi nak dɛ Filistia demma.>> 5Deevid yaa cheŋ Keila a ga nye kpaliŋ ale Filistia demma a tuesi ba niiŋa. Deevid a jam ko Filistia demma ka nna yegayega a vari Keila demma a basi. 6Ayimelek nidoabinni Abiata a jam ta ka garuk geli a jam diipo ate wa jam Deevid jigi Keila tɛŋka po la.
7Waai yaa weeni Sɔɔl ayen, <<Deevid yɔgyɔgla de a boka Keila.>> Sɔɔl yaa weeni ayen, <<Wen pai Deevid a nyo m nisa po kama. Wa bari yik ka wadek dii nyiŋla wa jo ka tɛŋ kaai ale ta kuta tuata.>> 8Sɔɔl yaa wi wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma meena ate ba jam jigi ayen ba ga nye kpaliŋ. Ba yaa gomsi ayen ba cheŋ Keila a ga siti Deevid ale wa nuruma.
9Deevid mɛ yaa wom ayen Sɔɔl a ta ka popola baata zɔga a yaa wa siti wa. Dila nyiŋ wa yaa weeni kaabteerɔwa Abiata ayen ta garuk genni a jam. 10Deevid yaa puusi ayen, <<Naawen, Izirali Wen yaa, mi wom kama ayen Sɔɔl a zɔk kama ayen wa jam kaasi Keila tɛŋka mi nyiŋ. 11Keila tɛŋka niŋdeerɔma ale pai mi a te Sɔɔl? Sɔɔl ale jam Keila ase mi ale wom diila? M Naawenni, Izirali Wen yaa, weeni a sak mi fi tomteerɔwa.>> Naawen yaa tulisi ayen, <<Sɔɔl ale jam.>>
12Deevid yaa ŋman bek ayen, <<Keila niŋdeerɔma ale pai mi ale m nuruma a nyo Sɔɔl nisima po?>> Naawen yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ba le pai te.>>
13Deevid ale wa nuruba kobsiyuebiwa yaa basi Keila alege a nyiem a diak tɛŋsaŋa. Sɔɔl ale wom ayen Deevid a basi Keila la, wa an cheŋ du la.
14Deevid jam suk bo ka pinaŋa po guuk zuk Zif gɔnni po. Sɔɔl jam kasim a gisi Deevid ka daaŋa meena alege Wen an pai Deevid a te wa.
15Deevid ale jam bo Yores Zif gɔnni po la, wa jam wom kama ayen Sɔɔl a cheen wa ko wa. 16Alege Sɔɔl biika Jonatan yaa cheŋ Deevid jigi Yores a te wa nyiŋbiiri ate wa siaka a pagra ale Wen. 17Jonatan yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Kan chali yɔgsum, dii nyiŋla mi kowa kan tiri fu. Fi le chim Izirali naab ate mi pai a vi fu. Mi kowa Sɔɔl dek poom seba kude kama.>> 18Ba nɔi bayewa yaa nye nɔiyeŋ Naawen niŋ. Ate Jonatan yaa kuli alege Deevid a bo Yores tɛŋka.
19Zif demma yaa cheŋ Sɔɔl jigi Gibea tɛŋka a weeni wa ayen, <<Deevid a suk bo ka tama tɛŋka po. Wa bo ka Yores pinaŋa po, Yachila guuku zuk, Jesimon yeseok geŋ. 20Yɔgyɔgla de, naaba, jam diipo ate fi a yaali la. Ku ka tama tuini ayen ti pai Deevid a te fu.>>
21Sɔɔl yaa tulisi wa ayen, <<Naawen a niak fu fi le ta jiirim ale mu la nyiŋ. 22Cheŋ a ga kpesi nya chak. Nya ase wa bo ka be dek chekki abe fi bek ase ka wana ale nya wa. Mi wom ayen wa seba ka nna yegayega. 23Kpesi bek wom wa sukka jiŋŋa meena abe fi ŋman jam weeni mu wari meena. Ate m yaa cheŋ ale fu. Deevid a dan bo dula dan poom ka m gisi Juda buuni po meena m le nye.>>
24Ba yaa dɛ Sɔɔl niŋ a cheŋ Zif. Yɔgyɔgla de Deevid nuruma jam ga bo ka Maon gɔnni po, Jesimon yeseok geŋ. 25Sɔɔl ale wa nuruma yaa cheŋ ba gisi Deevid, alege Deevid a wom ba wari a yaa cheŋ siŋ piuŋ po Maon gɔnni po. Sɔɔl ale wom la, wa yaa va Deevid naŋsa a jam Maon gɔnni po.
26Sɔɔl a jam sali va ka piuŋku gauŋ nyiŋ alege Deevid ale wa nuruma mɛ a bo gauŋ kunkula. Ba jam a kpabi kama ayen ba chali bɛ Sɔɔl, dii nyiŋla Sɔɔl ale wa nuruma a jam moata ba kama. 27Alege ba yaa tom waai Sɔɔl jigi ate wa weeni ayen, <<Nye nwuli a jam. Filistia demma a jam siti ti tɛŋka kama.>> 28Sɔɔl yaa basi Deevid vi ka ale cheŋ ayen wa tu chaab ale Filistia demma. Dila ale soa ate ba a wi dela ayen piuŋ kuui jigi ate ti chali bɛ ti dachaasaŋa la. 29Deevid yaa basi Maon gɔnni ale cheŋ ga bo En Gedi pinaŋa po.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 24
Content:
1Sɔɔl ale nye kpaliŋka ale Filistia demma ale pilim ŋman la, waai yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Deevid a bo ka En Gedi Pinaŋa po.>> 2Wa yaa lueri nuruba tusa ŋata (3,000) Izirali tɛŋka meena ate ba ga a gisi Deevid ale wa nuruma, Gɔi Bua Pinaŋa niŋ.
3Sɔɔl yaa jam piisa geruku ale moata manpanni la piuŋ vɔrup ale jam bo dula, ate wa jo ayen wa basi yaata. Deevid ale wa nuruma abe jam boka vɔrup bula dek po niŋniŋŋa. 4Nuruma yaa weeni Deevid ayen, <<Jinla ale dai dii dai ate Nyɔnɔwa a biisi di wari la, wa weeni ayen, <M le pai fi dachiaka a te fu. Nye wa fi ale a yaali diila.> >> Deevid yaa mak a kuuk a ga gebi Sɔɔl garukku nɔnni.
