Dɔkku de ka nyunyoŋ daata ate ba jam pa nye ku tɛŋka a ta jueli ŋmani meena. 8Juijui ate Solomon a jam boro la a jaa nye ase ka Nyemagsika Dɔkku la. Solomon a jam maa sɛ ka naam yie dila choa a te wa powa, waai ale jam ka Ejipiti naawa lie la.
9Yeeŋa de meena ka tintana ate ba jam pa sɛ. Ba jam kpesi a gebi ŋa kama. Ba jam pa ka gebik nyina a gebi ŋa puusaŋa po ale ŋa ganaŋa meena a magsi. Tintain naliŋsaŋa de a jam piilim sɛ ka nyubini a ta jueli parisaŋa zuk. Dabiaka mɛ ka tana ate ba pa nye. 10Nyubini ka tintain maŋ kpiema ate ba jam pa dueni, ŋa gela zuaka magsika woglimmu a paari ka anamagib pisiye, ŋa gela a paari pi ale buyuebi. 11Nyubaŋa de zuima ka tintain naliŋsa ate ba gebi ŋa a magsi ale nyunyoŋ chibsa ale jam vi du. 12Naam yenni dabiaka ale Naawen Yenni dabiaka ale bo Naawen Yenni po la, ale Naawen Yenni pɔsuku ba jam sɛ ka parisa a gilim. Parisaŋa de meena a jam ta ka tintain peesima vuuta tita ale nyunyoŋ daata vuuk kunyi.
13Naab Solomon a jam tom ate ba wi Yuram ate wa nyini Taaya a jam 14waai mawa ale jam ka pukɔgi a nyini Nafitali dɔkku buuni po la, ate wa kowa a chim Taaya tɛŋka denɔ a chim choabiik la. Yuram abe jam seba wa choabiika tuimaŋa ka nna yegayega ale kutuk mɔnuŋ buuri meena tuima. Wa jan jam naab Solomon jigi kama a tom dii meena ate wa te wa ayen wa tom la.
15Wa jam nye ka kutuk mɔnuŋ zaŋŋa ŋaye ate dinyi meena jueli ka a paari anamagib pisita ale buyuebi ate ŋa gilim ka a chim anamagib pisiye ale bunaansi. 16Wa jam nye ka kutuk mɔnta tulisa siye a vi zaŋŋa zukparuk. Kanyi meena magsika juelika jam ka anamagib pi. 17Wa nye chɔrima ŋaye a bobi tulisaŋa a maŋ chaab zaŋŋa zukparuk, ŋayopɔi a magsi dinyi. 18Wa jam nye ka yɔn fi gilima vuuta tiye a gilim tulisaŋa meena a ŋmirisi si zaŋŋa zukparuk. Wa jam nye ka dila dekdega a te jaab meena. 19Tulisaŋa meena ale jam bo zaŋŋa zukparuk pɔsuku po la a jam a nye ase ka vaata la a paari anamagib naaniŋ. 20Tulisaŋa ale vi zaŋŋa buyewa zuk la, jabuui ale a nye ase taasidi la ŋmazuk geŋ a paasaŋ ŋan yontaŋa la, jam ka yɔn fi gilima kobsiye ale jam bo vuuta po a gilim. 21Wa jam ti Wen yenni pɔsuku zaŋ ŋala. Zaŋ dii ale bo yeseoku geŋsa la wa te di yuei ayen Jakin ale te dii ale bo wiilukku geŋsa la yuei ayen Boazi. 22Ŋan baai ale bo ŋmani la a jam a nye ase ka vaata la. Dila tuini zaŋŋa zuk a yaa jam nueri.
23Wa jam pa ka kutuk mɔnuŋ a nye taasi kpienni ate ba a wi ayen Nyakpiem, di ka beli gilinni, a nyini noawari a ta ga paari noawari, di magsika jam ka anamagib pisiye, ate di juelika a chim anamagib pi. Ka miik ale paari anamagib pisiyuebi ate ba pai a magsi gilim di. 24Noawanni tɛŋka kutuk mɔnuŋ china ale jam gilim di. China ŋanu a magsi anamagib bunyi. Chinaŋa a jam bo ka vuuta tiye po ale Nyakpiemu.
25Nyakpiemu a jam za ka ŋanta ase kutuk mɔnuŋ lalisa pi ale siye la zuk, sita a nya wiiluk geŋsa, sita a nya yeniŋ geŋsa, sita a nya yeseok geŋsa ate sita mɛ a nya kori geŋsa. Nyakpiemu a jam za ka si zuk, ate si gbinaŋa a tuak suŋsuŋka. 26Di biglimu a jam a nye ase ka anamagib bunyi la ate di noawanni a nye ase beerik noawari la, ase gum veok ale a pusi la. Di jam a jo nyiam a paari ka samɔnsa tusa ŋaye (2,000).
27Wa maa nye ka kutuk mɔnuŋ ŋan zaan tii ale a pai la pi, wanyi meena woglimmu a jam ka anamagib naaniŋ, labsimu anamagib naaniŋ ate juelika a chim anamagib buyuebi. 28Ba ale jam nye jazaanimu diila ale nna. Ba jam nye ŋa ka ŋan ŋmogluta ale naŋsa. 29Ŋan ŋmoglutaŋa zuk jam ka kutuk mɔnuŋ ate ba pa nye gbeŋma ale lalisa ale ŋanta ase ŋanvuta la ale kiŋkaŋŋa. Naŋsaŋa suŋsuŋ jam ka gbeŋmaŋa ale lalisaŋa ale ŋanvutaŋa, naŋsaŋa zuk mɛ ŋmai ale tɛŋ jam ka puuta ate ba kuri ale kutuk mɔnuŋ a ŋmirisi. 30Jazaanim meena a jam ta ka kutuk mɔnuŋ wiiliba banaansi ale kutuk mɔnuŋ bigi ate wanyi meena a ta taasi kpien ate di za naŋsa sinaansi zuk ate ba pa puuta a nye kauk meena. 31Jazaanimu ponni po voan ale jam boro a nye gigiluk ase anamagib buye la a limisa. Voanni de jam ka gigiluk ŋmirisi. Ti di magsika a paari anamagib buta. A gilim voanni, ba jam yɔk ka ŋanta. Jazaanimu tapaŋŋa jam ka ŋmɔgluta daa gilima. 32Wiiliba banaansima a jam bo ka naŋsaŋa tɛŋka ate wiiliwa kutuk bigini a jam maŋ jazaanimu. Suŋsuŋka kutukku ate wiili meena a ta la jam ka anamagib buta. 33Wiilima a jam a nye ase ka toroko wiiliba la. Kutuk biŋŋa ale wiilima ale kasatisaŋa ale kunkolutaŋa meena ka kutuk mɔnuŋ ate ba jam pa nye.
34Jazaanim wanyi meena a jam ta ka ŋanyiŋta banaansi a magsi yikka, wanyi a bo gugoruk meena po a tom jazaanimu nyiŋ. 35Jazaanimu ŋmazuk geŋsa ka ŋan baai ale nye ate ŋanta a maŋ chaab la ale jam boro a limisa a paari anamagib bunyi. Naŋsaŋa ale tapaŋŋa a jam maŋ ka chaab jazaanimu ŋmazuk. 36Ba jam nye ka ŋanta ase ŋanvuta la ale ba kinkaŋŋa ale gbeŋma ale kpinkpatta a ŋmirisi naŋsaŋa ale tapaŋŋa nyiŋ ale peelim buui meena ale boro la wa jam nye ka vaata a gilim. 37Wa ale jam nye ŋanzaanita piwa diila ale nna. Ba meena jam ka wayeŋ, a jam a neesi chaab, a soa ase chaab la.
38Wa jam nye ka kutuk mɔnuŋ taasi kpiema pi, dinyi meena a jo samɔnsa pisinaansi ate ŋa magsika a paari anamagib naaniŋ, ate taasi yeŋ a bo jazaanim wanyi zuk. 39Wa jam pa ka ŋanzaanita banu a zaani Wen yenni yeseoku geŋsa ate ba banu mɛ a bo wiilukku geŋsa. Wa jam pa Nyakpiemu a zaani ka yeseoku geŋsa, yeseok kori geŋsa gugoruku Wen yenni po.
40Wa jam maa nye ka liisa ale saabuluta ale chin misima mɛ. Dila Yiram a jam tom Naawen yenni tuini ate Naab Solomon a jam te wa ayen wa tom la a nueri kama: 41Wa nye zaŋŋa ŋayewa ale taasa ŋayewa ale tulisaŋa siyewa ale bo zaŋŋa zukparuk la, ŋanta bayewa ale ŋmirisi la, ŋanta bayewa ale a nye ase taasa ŋaye zaŋŋa zuk la ale 42yɔn fi gilima kobsinaansiwa ale ŋanta bayewa ale ŋmirisi la ale yɔn fi gilimaŋa ale bo vuuta tiyewa a ŋmirisi la ŋanta bayewa ale tulisaŋa taasa ŋayewa zaŋŋa zukparuk la. 43Wa nye ŋanzaanitaŋa pi ale ŋa taasi kpiemaŋa pi ale 44nyakpiemu ale lalisa pi ale siyewa ale za bu kiri la ale 45liisaŋa ale saabulutaŋa ale chin misimaŋa. Ŋantaŋa de meena ate Yiram a jam nye a te Naab Solomon a magsi Naawen Yenni la, jam ka kutuk mɔnuŋ. 46Yakka tɛŋka ale bo Jodan Benni peelimmu po Sukkot ale Zaretan suŋsuŋ po la naawa yaa nye kutuk mɔnuŋ ŋantaŋa de. 47Solomon an jam basi ate ba magsi ŋantaŋa de dii nyiŋla ba jam ŋmasi piisi kama, ba an jam baga a miŋ kutuk mɔnuŋku dobrimu ale ka diila.
48Ŋan baai meena ate Solomon a jam nye ate ba bo Naawen Yenni po la ale nna. Bala ale ligmɔniŋ kuŋkuŋku ale ligmɔniŋ jazaanim buui zuk ate boroborok kuui ate ba ta a jam Wen niŋ la, 49ale zeuŋ ŋanzaanitaŋa ate ba pa cheri ligmɔniŋ a nye ate banu a bo juga ate banu a bo gala a za Jigi Dii Ale Ŋmasi Ta Tuilum La niŋ, ligmɔniŋ puutaŋa ale ligmɔniŋ zeuŋtaŋa ale ligmɔniŋ duisuk nyina. 50Cheri ligmɔniŋ beerisa ale boom jaŋmienimmu ale taasa ale ŋan baai ate ba a ju ŋan baai nyum ale masa du la ale bolim taasa ale Wen yenni ligmɔniŋ golaŋa a magsi ponni po tuataŋa ale bo Jigi Dii Ale Ŋmasi Ta Tuilum La ale Wen yenni dɔk wɔglukku tuataŋa.
51Dila tuini meena ate Naab Solomon a jam tom Naawen Yenni po la ale ga nueri la, wa yaa ta ŋan baai ate wa kowa Deevid a gaari ba a te Wen tuimaŋa la a jo. Kpanaŋa ale ligmɔniŋka ale ŋan yoŋ tii meena ate ba ta a tom la. Wa jam pai ba a nyo ka Naawen Yenni ligra duenika jigini.

Title: 1 NALIMA 8
Content:
1Naab Solomon yaa jam tigsi Izirali nisɔmma ale diinaŋa nyam ate ba jam wa niŋ Jerusalem po ayen ba ta Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a nyini Zayon Deevid Tɛŋka a jam Jerusalem. 2Izirali nidoama meena yaa tigsi jam jigi yeŋ Naab Solomon niŋ tigini daaŋa po Etanim chiika po, chiisa siyopɔiwa po.
3Ase Izirali nisɔmma meena ale ga jam la, kaabteerɔma a yaa pa dakanni, 4ba yaa ta Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a jam ale Tuka Viuku ale tuilum ŋantaŋa meena ale bo ku po la, kaabteerɔma ale Livaima ale jam ji ba, 5ate Naab Solomon ale Izirali tigsuŋku meena a jam tigsi dakanni niŋ a nye kaabka ale piisa ale niiga nna yegayega ba an baga a chiini ŋa.
6Kaabteerɔma a yaa ta Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a jam di jigini Wen yenni niŋ dɔkku po, Jigi Dii Ale Ŋmasi Ta Tuilum La, a pai di a zaani ŋan baai ale a nye ase ŋanvuta la kiŋkaŋŋa kiri. 7Ŋanvutaŋa a jam lagri ba kinkaŋŋa a lik juijui ate dakanni a za la kama, ate kinkaŋŋa a lik dakanni ale di da yik jiintaŋa. 8Da yik jiintaŋa de a ŋmasi woŋŋa kama ate waai a dan za jigi dii ale ta tuilum la wa a nya ti kpeglimka, alege waai an baga a zaani peelim a nya ti jigi dii ale ŋmasi ta tuilum la. Da yik jiintaŋa a diem bo dula kama jinla de. 9Jaab a jam ka dakanni po ka tintain paglaksa siyewa ate Moosis a jam pa Yoreb tɛŋka po a nyo du la nyiini, Juijui ate Naawen a jam nye nɔiyeŋ ale Izirali demma ba le nyini Ejipiti po a nyini la ŋaaŋnyiŋ.
10Ase kaabteerɔma ale jam basi jigi dii ale ta tuilum la, chiŋmari yaa jam sueri Naawen Yenni. 11Ate kaabteerɔma an jam baga a tom ba tuini chiŋmanni nyiŋ, diila Naawen zulaŋa a sueri wa Yenni kama.
12Ate Solomon ayen, <<Naawen ayen wa le bo chiŋmari sobluku po. 13M sɛka Naawen yie naliŋ a te fu, jigi ayen fi boro taam wuu.>> 14Ase Izirali tigsuŋku meena ale diem jam za dula la, naawa yaa viriŋ niak ba. 15Wa yaa weeni ayen, <<Pimpauk a cheŋ Naawen dii ale ka Izirali Wen la jigi, waai ale pai wa nisa a nye dii ate wa lak wa nɔi a puulim ale m kowa Deevid la. Wa weeni kama ayen, 16<A nyini dai dii danni ate m ta m nuruma Izirali a nyini Ejipiti po a nyini la, Mi an jam lueri tɛŋ kpieŋ a nyini Izirali dɔk kuui ya ayen ba sɛ Yeri a magsi mi Yuenni boka, alege mi lueri ka Deevid ayen wa a nya m nuruma Izirali demma zuk.>
17<<Mi kowa Deevid a jam ta ku kama wa suinum po ayen wa sɛ Yeri a te Naawen Yuenni, Izirali Wenni. 18Alege Naawen a yaa weeni mi kowa Deevid ayen, <Fi ale ta ku fi suinum po ayen fi sɛ Yeri a te mi Yuenni la nyiŋ, fi nye magsi kama ale fi ale ta kude fi suinum po la. 19Alege daa fi ale waai ale wa sɛ Yenni la, alege ka fi nidoabinni, waai ale ka fidek nyiŋlam ale fi ziim la, wa ale waai ale wa sɛ Yeri a te mi Yuenni la.>
20<<Naawen a ta wa pumpuulimaŋa ate wa jam nye la kama. Mi tagri a zaani mi kowa naŋkula po yɔgyɔgla de a kala Izirali naam zukpaglika zuk, ase dii dek ate Naawen a puulim la, ate mi a sɛ Yeri a te Naawen Yuenni, Izirali Wenni. 21Mi gomsi ka jigi dula a magsi dakanni, diipo ate Naawen a nye nɔiyeŋ ale ti koma diipo ate wa ta ba a nyini Ejipiti po a nyini la.>>
22Solomon yaa jam zaani Naawen kuŋkuŋku niŋ Izirali tigsuŋku meena niŋ, a zak wa nisaŋa a basi wenŋmazuk 23a weeni ayen, <<Naawen yaa, Izirali Wenni, Wen a karo ase fi la wenŋmazuk yaase tɛŋzuk de. Fi ta fi nɔiyeŋka ale a sak ŋmanteka ale fi tomteerɔma baai ale a yaali fi ale ba suinum meena a gum du fi suiku po la. 24Fi a ta fi pumpuulimaŋa ale fi tomteerɔwa Deevid mi kowa kama. Ka fi nɔnni ate fi a lak puulim ale pa fi nisaŋa a nye ŋa ase ku le ka dii jinla de la.
25<<Yɔgyɔgla de Naawen, Izirali Wen yaa, ta fi pumpuulimaŋa ale fi tomteerɔwa Deevid m kowa ate fi jam nye la, waai ate fi jam weeni ayen, <Fi a kan jɔk nidoa ate wa kali m niŋ Izirali naam zukpaglika zuwa, ase fi nidoabilisaŋa a nin kpesi dii meena ate ba a nye la a cheŋ mi niŋ, ase fi ale jam nye diila.> 26Yɔgyɔgla de Izirali Wen yaa, basi ate fi wanni ate fi puulim ale fi tomteerɔwa Deevid mi kowa la a chim wensie.
27<<Alege Wen a sum bo ka tɛŋzuk de? Ŋmazukku, wenŋmazuk an poom soa dii ate fi a boro alege ka yie fiika de ate mi a sɛ la! 28Wom fi tomteerɔwa puusaŋa ale wa le a saalim a yaali jiirim la, Naawen mi Wen yaa. Wom kaarika ale puusaŋa ate fi tomteerɔwa a puusi fi niŋ jinla de la. 29Mi a yaali ayen fi a limisi fi Yenni yok ale kantueŋ meena, dela jigini juijui ate fi weeni ayen, <Mi Yuenni ale bo ka dula,> ate dila ale basi ate fi wom puusaŋa ate fi tomteerɔwa a puusi a tuk dela jigini la. 30Wom fi tomteerɔwa ale a saalim la ale fi nuruma Izirali ase ba niŋ tuk dela nyiŋ a puusi. Wom a nyini wenŋmazuk fi boka jigini, fi be dan wom, vɔŋ a te ti.
31<<Ase nidoa a dan nye kaasi wa vaanchoa ate ku magsi wa nye pɛka, ate wa jam a nye pɛka fi kuŋkuŋku niŋ yenni de po 32be wom a nyini wenŋmazuk a nye wari. Bo fi tomteerɔma buusa, ŋma waai ale kaasi la abe fi basi ate wa ale nye diila a jam wa zuk. Weeni waai ale kan seba wari nɔi po la ayen wa an kaasi wari ya a tuni wa a va chaab ale wa wayɔrisimaŋa.
33<<Ase fi nuruma Izirali dachiaka a dan nak yik ba, ba le nye biem a kaasi fi la nyiŋ, ase ba dan ŋmani ŋaaŋ fi jigi a puusi a pak fi yuenni a te fu Yenni de po, 34wom a nyini wenŋmazuk a vɔŋ fi nuruma Izirali biemu a te ba a ta ba a jam tɛŋ kaai ate fi te ba koma la po.
35<<Ase wenŋmazukku a dan lik ate ŋmoruk an ni ya, dii nyiŋla fi nuruma ale nye biem a kaasi fi la nyiŋ, ba dan tuk dela a puusi a pak fi yuenni a basi ba biemu fi ale namsi ba la nyiŋ, 36be wom a nyini wenŋmazuk a vɔŋ fi tomteerɔma fi nuruma Izirali demma biemu a te ba. Sak ba suik maŋka ate ba boro, a basi ate ŋmoruk a ni tɛŋ kaai ate fi a te fi nuruma ase nitalim la po.
37<<Ase kɔm yaase nyiŋtuila a dan jam tɛŋka po, yaase chutika yaase kɔlika yaase tintue yaase nanchoŋta a kaasi ŋandiintaŋa, yaase dachiak a jueli ba zuk ba tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa kanyi po, kaasuŋ kuui yaase nyiŋtuila ŋaai ale cheen la, 38ase puusa yaase saalimka a dan nye a ta nyini fi nuruma Izirali demma wanyi jigi, waai meena ale seba wadek suinum po daani kaai ale boro la, a zak wa nisima wenŋmazuk a tuk Yenni de nyiŋ, 39be wom a nyini wenŋmazuk fi boka jigini. Vɔŋ a te abe fi nye nuru meena a magsi chaab ale dii meena ate wa nye la, fi ale seba wa suinum la nyiŋ. Ka fi nyiini ale seba nuru meena suinum. 40Dila ale basi ate ba a chali fi diipo meena ate ba le bo tɛŋ kaai po ate fi a te ti koma la.
41<<Dan ka nichamma baai ale kan daa fi nuruma Izirali demma po alege a nyini ka niŋniŋ a jam fi yuenni nyiŋla 42nuruba ale wom fi yuei kpienni ale fi ni kpieŋsaŋa ale fi nisaŋa ale a paari jigi meena la wie ase wa nin tuk Yenni de nyiŋ a puusi, 43be wom a nyini wenŋmazuk, fi boka jigini, a nye dii meena ate nichamma a bek a nyini fi jigi la, dila nuruma meena tɛŋzuk de ale seba fi yuenni a chali fu ase fidek nuruma Izirali demma ale a chali fu diila, abe ba seba ayen Yenni de ate mi sɛ la a ta ka fi Yuenni.
44<<Ase fi nuruma a dan nyini peelim ba nye kpaliŋ ale ba dachaasaŋa, juijui meena ate fi a tom ba la, ase ba dan puusi a te Naawen a tuk tɛŋ kpieŋka ate fi a lueri la ale Yenni ate mi a sɛ fi Yuenni nyiŋ la, 45be wom ba puusaŋa ale ba saalimka a nyini wenŋmazuk a tulisi ba.
46<<Ase ba dan nye biem a kaasi fi, waai a karo a kan nye biem, ate fi sui a puuri ale ba ate fi pa ba a te dachiak, waai ale ta ba ase yɔm a cheŋ wadek tɛŋka ate ku yalima yaase ku moata, 47ase ba dan tagri ba suiniimaŋa tɛŋ kaai po ate ba ta ba la a tagri a saalim fu ba nak yigrɔma tɛŋka po a weeni ayen, <Tama a nye ka biem, tama a nye kaasi kama, tama nye ka gaasa,> 48ase ba dan tulim fi jigi ale ba suinum ale ba chiik meena ba dachaasaŋa tɛŋka po baai ale yik ba ase yɔm la, a puusi a te fu a tuk tɛŋka ate fi te ba koma la, a tuk tɛŋ kpieŋka ate fi lueri la ale Yenni ate mi a se fi Yuenni nyiŋla, 49a nyini wenŋmazuk fi boka jigini, wom ba puusaŋa ale ba saalimka a tulisi ba. 50Vɔŋ te fi nuruma baai ale nye biem a kaasi fu la. Vɔŋ kaasuŋ tii meena ate ba nye a kaasi fi la, abe fi nye ate ba nak yigrɔma sak jiirim ale ba, 51ale ba ka fi nuruba ale fi nitalim, baai ate fi ta ba a nyini Ejipiti po, ase kutuk ale a nyaliŋ bolim po ate fi yeeri ku la.
52<<Mi a yaali ayen fi lak nina a nya fi tomteerɔwa ale fi nuruma Izirali demma saalimka, be wom ba diipo meena ate ba kaari a te fi la. 53Fi lueri ba a nyini tɛŋsa meena po tɛŋzuk de ayen ba chim ka fidek nitalim, ase fi ale weeni dii a ta va fi tomteerɔwa Moosis zuk ayen fi Nyɔnɔwa waai ale ka Naawen la ale jam ta ti kokpieŋsaŋa a nyini Ejipiti po a nyini.>>
54Ase Solomon ale jam nye puusaŋa ale saalimka de a te Naawen a nueri la, wa yaa yiti Naawen kuŋkuŋku niŋ juijui ate wa poom kpi duna tɛŋ a zak nisa a tuk wenŋmazuk la. 55Wa jam zaani a niak Izirali tigsuŋku meena ate ku jueli ayen, 56<<Pimpauk a cheŋ Naawen jigi, waai ale te wa nuruma Izirali demma vuusum ase wa ale jam puulim diila. Wayeŋ mɛ la an jam tali basi a nyini pumpuulim maŋ sii ate wa te a ta va wa tomteerɔwa Moosis zuk la. 57Mi a yaali ayen ka Naawen ti Wenni abe bo ale ti ase wa le jam bo ale ti koma diila, wa be kan basi ti yaase wa je ti basi diipo diipo.
58<<Wa be tulim ti suiniimaŋa a te wadek, ate tama a cheŋ wa suitaŋa meena po abe ti ta wa wieŋa ale wa ŋmarisika ale wa buusaŋa ate wa jam te ti koma la. 59Mi wieŋa de, ŋaai ate mi a puusi Naawen niŋ la, a be moata Naawen ti Wenni kantueŋ ale yok meena, ate wa tulisi wa tomteerɔwa ale nuruma Izirali demma a magsi chaab ale dai meena ŋan yaalinta, 60dila ate nuruma meena tɛŋzuk de ale seba ayen Naawen ka Wen, Wen yoŋ a ŋman karo. 61Alege ni suiniimaŋa ku a fɛ ate ni pa ŋa meena a te Naawen ti Wenni, a boro wa ŋmarisika nyiŋ abe ti a va wa wieŋa, ase ku ale ka dii vaaŋa de la.>>
62Ate naawa ale Izirali demma meena yaa jam nye kaabka Naawen niŋ. 63Solomon a jam ko ka niiga tusa pisiye ale ŋaye (22,000) ale piisa ale bua tusa kook ale pisiye (120,000) ase suiyɔgni tiirita kaabka la a te Naawen. Naawa ale Izirali demma meena yaa jam pa Yenni a nyo Naawen nisa po.
64Dai dila danni dek naawa a jam nye ate dabiaka suŋsuŋ a ta tuilum kama, kaai ale jam bo Naawen Yenni niŋ la, dula jigini wa jam nye ka juka tiirim ale ŋandiinta tiirim ale suiyɔgni tiirita kpapalaŋa dii nyiŋla kutuk mɔnuŋ kuŋkuŋku Naawen niŋ a jam ŋmasi pɔsima kama ale juka tiirim ale ŋandiinta tiirim ale suiyɔgni kpapala tiirita nyeka.
65Solomon ale Izirali demma meena yaa jam dɛ tigi dii ale jam boro va ŋala po la. Nuruba ale jam nyini niŋniŋ ase Yamat ale Ejipiti Vooliŋka kabtaŋa a jam. Ba jam dɛ tigini Naawen ti Wenni niŋ ka daa ŋayopɔi a ŋman pa daa ŋayopɔi a vi du ate ŋa meena a chim daa pi ale ŋanaansi. 66Dai dii ale pasaŋ la wa yaa basi nuruma ate ba kuli. Ba jam niak naawa kama ale kuli yeri ale suipeentik ale mariŋka ba suiniimaŋa po wamaŋ sii meena ate Naawen a nye te wa tomteerɔwa Deevid ale wa nuruma Izirali demma la nyiŋ.

Title: 1 NALIMA 9
Content:
1Ase Solomon ale jam sɛ Naawen Yenni ale wa naam yenni a nueri, ale nye dii meena ate wa jam a yaali wa nye la, 2Naawen a yaa jan jam wa jigi a nye buye ase wa le poom jan jam wa jigi Gibeon tɛŋka po la. 3Naawen yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Mi wom puusaŋa ale saalimka ate fi nye mi niŋ la kama. Mi nye ate Yenni de a welema kama, dii ate fi sɛ a pai m Yuenni a basi du taam wuu la. Mi nina ale mi suinum ale kasim boka dula.
4<<Dan ka fi, fi a dan bo mi niŋ ale nyemagsika suinum ale za ale wensie ase Deevid fi kowa ale jam nye diila ale nye dii meena ate mi a weeni la a kpesi va m ŋmarisika ale m buusaŋa, 5Mi ale basi ate fi naamu zukpaglika ale kasim bo Izirali po taam wuu, ase mi le jam puulim Deevid fi kowa ase mi ale jam weeni ayen, <Fi a kan jɔk nuru ate wa kali Izirali naam zukpaglika zuwa.>
6<<Alege fi yaase fi nidoabilisaŋa a dan basi mi ale an kpesi va mi wieŋa ale mi ŋmarisika ate mi te ni la ale cheŋ bɛ a tom a te wen yona ale a kaab ŋa, 7mi ale gebi Izirali wari a basi tɛŋ kaai ate mi a te ba la po, abe mi zɛri Yenni de ate mi nye ate di welema mi Yuenni nyiŋla. Izirali yaa ale chim ka laata a te tɛŋsa meena ate ba kasim a biisi biem wie a te ba. 8Ase Yenni a dan kaasi, waai meena ale va dula a taam la ku ale cha wa. Ba le koosi a la ni ale a bek ayen, <Ka boa ate Naawen a nye wa gbenti ka tɛŋka de ale Wen yenni?> 9Nuruba yaa le tulisi ayen, <Dii nyiŋla ba zɛri ka Naawen ba Wenni, waai ale ta ba koma a nyin Ejipiti po la, ale kpari maŋ wen yona a kaab ale tom a te ŋa, dila ale soa ate Naawen a ta kaasuŋku de meena a jam ba zuk.> >>
10Bena pisiye ale taam la, diipo ate Solomon a sɛ yie buyewa de la, Naawen Yenni ale naab yenni la, 11Naab Solomon a jam pa ka tɛŋ kpieŋsa pisiye Galili po a te Yiram Taaya naawa, dii nyiŋla Yiram a jam te wa ka daata ale ligmɔniŋ ate wa jam a yaali la. 12Alege Yiram ale jam nyini Taaya a cheŋ ayen wa nya tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa ate Solomon a te wa la, wa sui an jam peenti ale si. 13Wa yaa bek ayen, <<Ka tɛŋ kpieŋ boan chaab ale nna ate fi a te mi m suowa?>> Ate wa a wi si ayen Kabul Tɛŋ, si yue ale la ale jinla. 14Yiram a jam tom ka ligmɔniŋ kook ale pisiye a te naawa.
15Fifiok tuimaŋa ate Naab Solomon a basi ate wa yɔmma a tom la, ba sɛ Naawen Yenni ale wadek yenni ale tɛŋka suerika ale Jerusalem parika sɛka ale Yazor ale Megiddo ale Gezer. 16Faaro Ejipiti naawa a jam nye ka kpaliŋ a nak yik Gezer tɛŋka. Wa jam juka ale ka bolim. Wa jam ko Keenan demma kama ale pa ka a te wa liewa Solomon powa ase yalika tiirim la. 17Solomon a ŋman pilim sɛ Gezer. Wa le sɛ Bet Yoron ale 18Baalat ale Tadmor sagni po wa tɛŋka po, 19ale tɛŋ kpieŋsa a magsi ŋanta duenika ale torokoma ale wa wusumaŋa. Wa sɛ jabuui meena ate wa a yaali wa sɛ Jerusalem po la ale Lebanon ale jigi meena ate wa a nya la.
20Nuru baai meena ale tali Amori demma po ale Yit demma ale Perizzi demma ale Yivi demma ale Jebus demma la a jam daa Izirali demma. 21Ba jam ka nuru baai ate Izirali demma an jam ko la ŋaaŋbisa. Bade ate Solomon a jam basi ate ba a tom fifiok tuima ase yɔm la ase ku le ka dii jinla la. 22Alege Solomon an basi Izirali demma waai a chim yɔma. Ba jam ka wa tugurik tɔŋdɔba, ale wa naamu nisɔm, ale wa kpaga ale tugurik tɔŋdɔba kpaga ale torokoba ale ba duerɔba kpaga. 23Ba ale jam chim wa kpaga a nya tuimaŋa zuk. Ba jam ka nuruba kobsinu ale pisinu a nya nuruma ate ba tom tuimaŋa.
24Faaro liewa ale jam nyini Deevid Tɛŋka a cheŋ naab yenni ate Solomon a se te wa la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, wa jam sueri ka tɛŋka ale tana.
25Buta meena benni po Solomon a nyiem jam nye ka juka tiirita ale suiyɔgni tiirita kaabka kuŋkuŋku ate wa sɛ te Naawen la zuk, a ju ŋan baai nyum ale masa la Naawen niŋ, a nye dii ale magsi wa nye Naawen Yenni po la.
26Naab Solomon a jam maa nye ka ŋaaruŋta Ezion Geber tɛŋka po, kaai ale moata Elat Edom la, Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku kunkɔŋni. 27Naab Yiram a jam tom ka wa nuru baai ale seba nyakpiemu la ayen ba ga tom ale Solomon nuruma. 28Ba jam lo jueli ka Ofir a ta ligmɔniŋ boorik dobrim kobsinaansi ale pisiye jam, a pa ŋa a te naab Solomon.

Title: 1 NALIMA 10
Content:
1Ase Siiba nipok naawa ale jam wom Solomon wari ale wa bo ka po ale Naawen yuenni la, wa jam wa chamsi wa nya ale bek pagra. 2Wa yaa paari Jerusalem ale tomteerɔ boari ale laalaakomiba a ji ŋan baai nyum ale masa ale ligmɔniŋ nna yegayega ale tintain ŋaai diak ale pagra la. Wa yaa biisi ale Solomon wa dii meena ate wa ta wa popolaŋa po la. 3Solomon yaa jam tulisi wa beŋŋa meena. Wari an jam ŋmasi pagra ate naawa ate wa an baga a weeni di kiri a sak wa. 4Ase Siiba nipok naawa ale jam nya Solomon yammu meena ale naab yenni ate wa jam sɛ la ale 5ŋandiintaŋa wa jazaanimu zuk ale wa kpaŋŋa ale kali diila ale wa tomteerɔma ale jo ba gattaŋa la ale baai ale a te wa daam la ale juka tiiritaŋa ate wa jam nye Naawen Yenni po la, ku yaa cha wa.
6Wa yaa weeni naawa ayen, <<Mi ale wom midek tɛŋka po fi ale nye dii ale fi yammu wie la ka wensie. 7Alege mi a jam ka siaka ale wieŋa de meena, ka mi a yaa le jam a nya ale midek nina la. Dii ate fi nye la ba an poom weeni mi di geli ya, yam ale jigsika, fi nye a gaam mi ale wom diila kama. 8Nya fi nuruma sue ale peenti dii yaa, nya fi kpaŋŋa sue ale peenti dii yaa, baai ale kasim za fi niŋ a wom fi yam wieŋa la. 9Pimpauk a cheŋ Naawen fi Wenni jigi, waai ale mariŋ fi a pa fu a kali Izirali naam zukpaglika zuk la. Naawen yaali kaai ale kaa kpeglim ale Izirali demma la nyiŋ, wa nye fu ka naab ayen fi ta wensie ale wayɔrisima nyeka.>>
10Ate wa yaa te naawa ligmɔniŋ boorisa dobrim kook ale pisiye ale ŋan baai nyum ale masa la nna yegayega ale tintain ŋaai ligra ale pagra la. Waai an ŋman ta ŋan baai nyum ale masa la a jam piisi ase Siiba nipok naawa ale jam te Naab Solomon diila.
11Diipo ate Solomon a jam boro a sɛ la, Yiram ŋaaruŋtaŋa a jam taka ligmɔniŋ a nyini Ofir a jam, a nyini dula ba jam taka ŋaaruŋ tanjaŋini ale daata ale tintain ŋaai diak ale pagra la a jam. 12Naawa jam pa daataŋa a chɔgsi ka Naawen Yenni ale naam yenni, ale pa nye kpanta ale bagansa a te yi lendisaŋa. Ba an jam ta daataŋa de chaab a jam nya ya yaase ba nya ti chaaba, ka dai dila danni nyiini.
13Naab Solomon a jam te Siiba nipok naawa ka dii meena ate wa jam a yaali ale bek wa la, dila ku tɔga wa poom ŋaam te wa ŋanta a ta nyini wa naamu jigsika po kama. Ate nipok naawa a ŋman ale wa nuruma a cheŋ wadek tɛŋka.
14Ligmɔniŋka magsika dobrimu ate Solomon a jam a tuesi ben po la jam ka kobsiyuebi ale pisiyuebi ale ŋayuebi. 15Cheesuŋku ate ba jam a nya a nyini geruŋdɔma ale Arabia nalimaŋa meena ale tɛŋka kpaŋŋa jigi la an jam maa gum du.
16Naab Solomon a jam pai ka ligmɔniŋ a kuri nye kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsin kpienta kobsiye. Wanyi meena ka ligmɔniŋ ligbie dobrim ale paari kobsiyuebi ate ba kuri nye. 17Wa ŋman jam kuri ka ligmɔniŋ a nye kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsin fiisa kobsita, ate wanyi meena a ta ligmɔniŋ magsika dobrim kook ale pisinu. Naawa a jam pai ba a basi ka wa yenni po dii ate wa a wi ayen Lebanon Sagni Naam Yenni la po.
18Naawa a jam nyeka naam zukpaglik kpieŋ, yauk nyina ale ligmɔniŋ naliŋ ate wa jam pa nye a lik ka nyiŋka. 19Zukpaglika a jam taka tiili nina ŋayuebi. Ka ŋaaŋka a jam nyeka gigiluk ŋmanni. Nisima vika jigi ale jam bo gauŋ meena, ate ba mɛ gbeŋli ate di za gauŋ meena. 20Gbeŋma pi ale ŋaye ale jam za tiini nina ŋayuebiwa zuk, ate dinyi a bo num meena kpeglimka. Wa dila choa an jam nye tɛŋ yoŋ naam po a nya ya. 21Naab Solomon beerisaŋa ka ligmɔniŋ ate ba jam pai nye si ale wa yenni po dii ate wa a wi ayen Lebanon Sagni Naam Yenni po ŋantomtaŋa, ka ligmɔniŋ maŋ ate ba pai nye. Ba an jam nye jaab ale kpana dii nyiŋla ba an jam a nya kpana ase ŋa ta tuilum la Solomon daaŋa po. 22Naab Solomon jam ta ka geruŋ ŋaaruŋta nna yegayega. Wa jam a te ti bo ka nyakpiemu po, a gum chaab ale Yiram ŋaaruŋtaŋa. Bunyi bena ŋata meena po, ti ale ŋmani ale ligmɔniŋ ale kpana ale yauk nyina ale wiima ale faata.
23Naab Solomon a jam jigsi kama ale ta yam a gaam nalima meena tɛŋka zuk. 24Nuru biik meena tɛŋzuk de a jam a yaali ba nya naab Solomon kama abe ba wom yammu ate Wen a te wa la. 25Bena meena baai meena ale jam la a jam a te wa ka tiirita ase kpana ale ligmɔniŋ ale gatta ale tugurik kɔlima ale ŋan baai nyum ale masa ale wusuma ale wusumbonsa. 26Solomon a jam tigsi ka torokoba ale wusuma, wa jam ta ka torokoba tusidi ale kobsinaansi (1,400) ale wusuma tusa pi ale ŋaye (12,000), ŋaai ate wa jam pai basi torokoba tɛŋsaŋa po, gela mɛ a bo ale wa Jerusalem po. 27Naawa a jam basi ate kpana a ka kɔm Jerusalem po ase ka tintana la ate nyunyoŋta a piisi ase kinkaŋsa la guutaŋa zuima. 28Solomon wusumaŋa ba jam da ŋa a ta nyini ka Ejipiti ale Kue. Wa geruŋdɔma ale jam da ŋa Kue. 29Ba jam da toroko yeŋ Ejipiti ka kpana dobrim kobsiyuebi, ate wusum yeŋ a da kpana dobrim kook ale pisinu. Wa geruŋdɔma a jam maa pai ŋa a da te Yit ale Araam nalimaŋa kama.

Title: 1 NALIMA 11
Content:
1Naab Solomon a jam a yaalika nipooba nna yegayega baai ale kan nyini Izirali tɛŋka po. A gum Faaro liewa po, wa jam faari nipooba a nyini Moab ale Ammon ale Edom ale Saidon ale Yit tɛŋsaŋa. 2Ba nyini ka tɛŋ sii ate Naawen a weeni Izirali demma ayen, <<Ku a fɛ ate ni kaa de chaab lieba, dii nyiŋ la, ba ale tulim ni suiniimaŋa a te ba wenaŋa.>> Alege dila Solomon a diem jam a yaali ba kama. 3Wa jam taka pooba kobsiyopɔi ale nɔi pooba kobsita, ate wa pooma a ta wa a cheŋ bɛ. 4Ase Solomon ale ga kpaŋ la, wa pooma a yaa tulim wa suinummu a te wen yona, ate wa suinum meena a jam ka Naawen wa Wenni jigi ya. Wa an jam va Naawen ale wa suinum meena ase wa kowa Deevid la. 5Wa jam va ka Saidon demma nipok wenni Astoret ale Ammon demma wenni Milkom ate Wen a kisa la. 6Dila Solomon yaa jam nye biem Naawen nimbie po, wa an jam va Naawen ale wa suinum meena ase wa kowa Deevid la.
7Pimpitini zuk Jerusalem kori geŋsa, Solomon a jam sɛ ka kuŋkuŋ a magsi Moab demma wenni Chemos dii ate Wen a kisa la, ale Ammon demma wenni Molek dii ate Wen a kisa la kaabka. 8Wa jam nye ka dila dek a te wa pok nichamma meena baai ale jam a ju ŋan baai nyum ale masa la ale a kaab a te ba wenaŋa.
9Naawen sui yaa jam puuri ale Solomon dii nyiŋla wa suinum a jam ka ale Naawen, Izirali Wenni, waai ale jan jam wa jigi buyewa la. 10Wa jam weeni Solomon kama ayen wa kan va wen yona, Solomon an jam ta Naawen wanni. 11Dila Naawen yaa weeni Solomon ayen, <<Ase kude ale ka fi nyeela, ate fi an ta mi nɔiyeŋka ale mi ŋmarisika kaai ate mi a te fu la mi ale tuesi naamu fi jigi a pa bu a te fi tomteerɔma wanyi. 12Alege fi kowa Deevid nyiŋ, mi a kan nye dila diipo ate fi diem vua la. Mi ale tuesi bu ka fi nidoabinni nisa po. 13Mi a kan tuesi naamu meena wa jigi ya, alege mi ale te wa ka buuni dinyi Deevid mi tomteerɔwa nyiŋ ale Jerusalem kaai ate mi a lueri la nyiŋ.>>
14Naawen yaa basi ate Edom denɔwa Yadad ate wa nyini Edom naab yenni la, a chim Solomon dachiak. 15Piilimka ase Deevid ale jam boro a nye kpaliŋ ale Edom tɛŋka la, Joab tugurik tommu kpagni, waai ale jam cheŋ wa gu kpiema la, a jam ko nidoama meena kama Edom po. 16Joab ale Izirali demma meena a jam bo dula ka chiisa siyuebi, ate ku paari diipo ate ba ko nidoama meena Edom po la. 17Alege Yadad ale diem jam ka nidoabili fiik la, a chali cheŋ ka Ejipiti ale Edom demma kpaga gela baai ale jam tom a te wa kowa la jigi. 18Ba jam nyini ka Midian tɛŋka a cheŋ Paran tɛŋka. Ba jam ta ka nidoaba Paran po a gum ba po a cheŋ Ejipiti naawa Faaro jigi, waai ale jam te Yadad yeri ale tɛŋ ale yaali ŋandiinta a te wa la.
19Faaro a jam mariŋ Yadad kama a pa wadek powa suok Tapenes a yalisi wa. 20Tapenes suoku a jam biak ka nidoabili a te wa, wa yuei a jam le Genubat, waai ate Tapenes a jam wuuk wa naab yenni po la. Dula Genubat a jam boro ale ka Faaro dek bisaŋa.
21Ase wa le diem jam bo Ejipiti po la, Yadad yaa wom ayen Deevid a kpi cheŋ wa koma jigi ate Joab tugurik tommu kpagni mɛ a kpi. Yadad yaa weeni Faaro ayen, <<Basi ate mi cheŋ, m ŋman cheŋ m dek tɛŋka.>>
22Faaro yaa bek wa ayen, <<Ka boa ate fi a silim dela ate fi a yaali ayen fi cheŋ fidek tɛŋka?>> Ate Yadad a tulisi ayen, daa jaaboa, <<Alege basi ate mi cheŋ.>>
23Wen yaa jam basi ate nuru wa choa a chim Solomon dachiak, wa yuei jam le Arezon Eliada biik. Arezon a jam chali ale basi ka wa kpagi Zoba naawa Yadadezer. 24Wa jam tigsi ka nidoaba tukpari nyam a gilim wadek a chim ba niŋdeerɔ diipo ate Deevid a jam ko Zoba tugurik nyama la. Tukpari nyama de a jam cheŋ ka Damasikus, dula ate ba jam ga kali a nya ka zuk. 25Arezon a jam chim ka Izirali dachiak diipo meena ate Solomon a boro la, a gum chaab ale wɔkwɔkka ate Yadad a jam siti la. Dila Arezon a jam a nya ka Araam zuk ale ta chaab ale Izirali.
26Nebat nidoabinni Jeroboam an jam siak a te naawa. Wa jam ka Solomon kpaŋŋa dinyi a nyini Ɛfraim dɔkku Zereda, wa mawa jam ka pukɔgi, wa yuei ale Zerua.
27Dii ate Jeroboam jam tulim a ta chaab ale naawa la ale nna. Solomon a jam a sueri tɛŋka golaŋa ale tana ale a lik wa kowa Deevid tɛŋka parika muulisaŋa. 28Jeroboam jam ka nuru maŋ, ase Solomon ale jam nya nuru paalika de ale tom wa tuini diila, wa yaa basi ate wa a nya baai meena ale a tom tuimaŋa la zuk Josefi yezukku meena po.
29Dai yeŋ ate Jeroboam a jam nyini Jerusalem po a nyini, ate biisiteerɔwa Ayija ale nyini Siilo a jam jo garuk paaluk la a yaa tu wa suiku po, ba nɔi bayema nyiin ale jam nyini tɛŋka po a nyini, 30ate Ayija yaa yik wa garuk paalukku ate wa jo la a cheeri pi ale buye. 31Wa yaa weeni Jeroboam ayen, <<Pa gela pi a ta fidek, ale ka nnala ate Naawen, Izirali Wenni a weeni ayen, <Nya mi a yaali m tuesi naamu Solomon nisima po a te fu diina pi. 32Alege mi tomteerɔwa Deevid ale tɛŋ kpieŋka Jerusalem nyiŋ, kaai ate mi a lueri a nyini Izirali buuni meena po la, mi le te wa ka dɔk ate wa a nya ba zuk. 33Mi ale nye kude dii nyiŋla, ba zɛri mi kama ale a kaab Saidon demma nipok wenni Astoret ale Moab demma wenni Chemos ale Ammon demma wenni Milkom ale kan va mi suitaŋa yaase ba nye dii ale nala mi nina po yaase ba ta ŋmarisika ale mi buusaŋa ase Deevid Solomon kowa ale jam nye diila.
34<< <Alege mi a kan tuesi naamu meena Solomon nisima po. Mi a nye wa ka niŋdeerɔ wa vum daaŋa meena po mi tomteerɔwa Deevid nyiŋ, waai ate mi a lueri, waai ale kpesi va mi wieŋa ale mi ŋmarisika la. 35Mi ale tuesi naamu a ta nyini wa biika nisima po a te fu diina pi. 36Mi ale te wa nidoabinni dɔk yeŋ ate dila ale basi ate Deevid mi tomteerɔwa a kasim ta pabiik a te mi Jerusalem po, tɛŋ kpieŋ kaai ate mi a lueri ayen m Yuenni a boro la po. 37Alege dan ka fi mi ale pa fi ate fi a nya jabuui meena ate fi suinum yaalika a boro la zuk, fi ale chim naab a nya Izirali zuk. 38Fi a dan nye dii meena ate mi a weeni fu la a cheŋ mi suitaŋa po a nye dii ale nala mi nina po la a ta mi ŋmarisika ale mi wieŋa ase Deevid mi tomteerɔwa ale jam a nye diila, mi ale bo ale fu. Mi ale basi ate fi buuni a dɛ naam taam wuu ase mi ale nye dii a te Deevid la abe m pa Izirali a te fu. 39Mi ale dari Deevid ŋaaŋbisaŋa tue kude nyiŋ, alege mi kan dari ba tue taam wuu.> >>
40Solomon a jam a yaali wa ko Jeroboam kama, alege Jeroboam a jam chali cheŋ Ejipiti naab Sisak jigi. Wa jam boka dula ate ku paari diipo ate Solomon a kpi la.
41Dan ka Solomon wieŋa gela ate wa nye wa naamu daaŋa po la, dii meena ate wa jam nye ale yammu ate wa jam sak la, ŋala a ŋmarisi doa Solomon wie gbaŋka po kama. 42Solomon a jam dɛ naam Jerusalem po Izirali demma meena zuk ka bena pisinaansi. 43Wa jam kpi kama a gum wa koma po ate ba gu wa Deevid wa kowa tɛŋka po. Wa nidoabinni Areyoboam ale jam zaani wa naŋkula po ase naab la.

Title: 1 NALIMA 12
Content:
1Areyoboam yaa jam cheŋ Sikiim, diila Izirali demma meena a jam cheŋ ka dula ba bobi wa naab. 2Ase Nebat nidoabinni Jeroboam ale wom kude la, wa jam diem bo ka Ejipiti, wa jam chali nyini ka Solomon jigi, wa yaa pilim ŋmani. 3Dila ba yaa tom wi Jeroboam ate wa ale Izirali tigsuŋku meena a yaa cheŋ Areyoboam jigi a weeni wa ayen, 4<<Fi kowa a jam basi ate tama a tom ka tuim pagra, yɔgyɔgla de basi ate ku valima a te ti, kan basi ate tama a tom tuim pagra ase wa daam ale a nye diila ate tama ale tom a te fu.>> 5Areyoboam yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ni cheŋ daa ŋata dai abe ni ŋman jam m jigi.>> Dila nuruma a yaa jam cheŋ.
6Naab Areyoboam a yaa bek nisɔmma baai ale jam tom a te wa kowa Solomon diipo ate wa diem vua la ayen, <<Nama ale sak mu ka sɛ ate mi tulisi nuruma de?>> 7Ba yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ase jinla fi a dan chim tomteerɔ a te nuruma de a tom a te ba ale tulisi ba a magsi, ba ale kasim chim ka fi tomteerɔba.>>
8Alege Areyoboam a jam zɛri nisɔmma ale te wa sinsaŋŋa la kama ale bek nuru paalukku ale yiti ale wa a tom a te wa la. 9Wa jam bek ba kama ayen, <<Nama ale sak mi ka sɛ ate m tulisi nuruma de ale a yaali ayen mi nye ate ku valima a te ba a gaam mi kowa ale jam nye diila?>>
10Nuru paalukku baai ale chim ale wa la yaa tulisi ayen, <<Weeni nuruma de baai ale weeni fu ayen, <Fi kowa a jam te ti ka tuim pagra, alege basi ate ti tuimaŋa a valima la,> Weeni ba ayen, <Mi nandub fiika a zuak a gaam mi kowa chiaka kama. 11Mi kowa a jam basi ate ni a tom ka tuim pagra, alege mi ale basi ate ni ŋmasi tom tuim pagra a gaam dila. Mi kowa a jam a miiri ni ale ka fiŋsa, mi ale miiri ni ale ka muŋsa.> >>
12Daa ŋata ale taam la ŋaaŋnyiŋ Jeroboam ale nuruma meena a yaa ŋman jam Areyoboam jigi, ase naawa ale jam weeni ayen, <<Ni ŋman jam mi jigi daa ŋata po la.>> 13Naawa yaa jam tulisi nuruma nna kasɔ. Naab Areyoboam zɛri sinsaŋŋa ate nisɔmma a jam sak wa la, 14Wa jam va ka sinsak ŋaai ate nuru paalukku a sak wa la ayen, <<Mi kowa a jam te ni ka tuim pagra, mi ale basi ate ni ŋmasi a tom tuim pagra a gaam dila. Mi kowa a jam miiri ni ale ka fiŋsa, mi ale basi ate ka nuenta a dom ni.>> 15Dila naawa an jam wom nuruma, kude a jam nyini ka Naawen jigi ayen wanni ate Naawen a jam biisi a te Nebat nidoabinni Jeroboam a ta va Ayija Siilo tɛŋka denɔwa zuk la a chim wensie.
16Ase Izirali demma meena ale ga nya ale naawa a zɛri kama a kan yaali wa wom ba la, ba yaa tulisi naawa ayen, <<Ka boan jaab charuk ate tama a ta ale Deevid, kabi dina ate tama a ta ale Jese nidoabinni? Ni viitaŋa po, Izirali demma, ni a nya nidek yeeŋa zuk ni basi ate Deevid biika a nya wadek nuruma zuk.>> Dila Izirali demma a yaa jam kuli. 17Alege Izirali demma baai ale jam bo Juda tɛŋsaŋa po la, Areyoboam ale diem jam a nya ba zuk.
18Naab Areyoboam a yaa jam tom Adoram waai ale jam a nya fifiok tuimaŋa zuk la, alege Izirali demma meena a jam yuk wa ale tana a ko. Naab Areyoboam a jam nyeka nyiŋbiiri a jo wa torokowa po a chali bɛ cheŋ Jerusalem. 19Dila nyiŋ Izirali an jam siak a te Deevid yenni demma a ta paari jinla de.
20Ase Izirali demma meena ale ga wom ayen Jeroboam a ŋman jam la, ba yaa tom wi wa ate wa jam tigsuŋku po a bobi wa naab ate wa a nya Izirali meena zuk. Ka Juda dɔkku buuni ale jam va Deevid buuni.
21Ase Areyoboam ale jam paari Jerusalem la, wa yaa tigsi Juda yenni demma meena ale Benjamin dɔkku buuni meena tugurik tɔŋdɔba tusa kook ale pinaanuŋ (180,000) ayen ba nye kpaliŋ ale Izirali yenni meena ate ba ŋman tuesi naamu a te Areyoboam Solomon nidoabinni.
22Alege Wen wanni de a yaa jam Wen nuruwa Sɛmaiya jigi ayen, 23<<Weeni Solomon nidoabinni Areyoboam, Juda naawa, ale Juda yenni meena ale Benjamin nuruma meena ayen, 24<Dii ate Naawen a weeni la ale nna, Ni kan cheŋ ayen ni nye kpaliŋ ale ni suataŋa Izirali demma. Ni kuli yeri ni wanyi wanyi meena. Ale kude ka mi nyeela.> >> Dila ba yaa wom Naawen wanni a pilim ŋmani kuli ase Naawen ale weeni diila.
25Jeroboam yaa jam sɛ parik pagrik a gilim Sikiim ale bo Ɛfraim tɛŋka a te guuta a bo ka po la a bo dula. A nyini dula wa jam cheŋ ga sɛ ka Penuel.
26Jeroboam yaa jam a poli ayen, <<Dai dii dai naamu ale ŋman cheŋ Deevid dɔkdemma jigi. 27Ase nuruma de a dan jueli ba nye kaabka Naawen Yenni Jerusalem po, ba ale ŋman a yaali Areyoboam a nya ba zuk. Ba ale ko mu abe ba va Juda naawa Areyoboam.>>
28Wa ale jam biisi ale wa sagrɔma la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, naawa a jam mɛ ka naabisa siye. Wa jam weeni nuruma ayen, <<Ku ŋmasi yalima kama ate ni cheŋ Jerusalem. Ni wenaŋa ale nna Izirali demma, ŋaai ale ta ni a nyini Ejipiti po a nyini la.>> 29Dinyi a jam bo ka Betel alege ndila a bo Dan tɛŋka po. 30Ate kude a jam chim wabiok. Nuruma a poom jam cheŋ a paari ka Dan tɛŋka a nye kaabka dula.
31Jeroboam yaa sɛ kaabka jiga pimpitima zuima ale lueri kaabteerɔba a nyini nuruba tɔgatɔga po, baai ale poom kan daa Livaiba. 32Wa yaa dueni tigi chiisa naanika ka daa pi ale ŋanu dai, ase tigi dii ate ba a dɛ Juda po la, a nye kaabka kuŋkuŋku zuk. Wa nye nna ka Betel, a kaab a te naabisaŋa ate wa nye la. Betel po mɛ wa lueri kaabteerɔba a magsi kaabka jiŋŋa ate wa sɛ la pimpitimaŋa zuima. 33Chiisa naanika ka daa pi ale ŋanuwa danni, chi kaai ate wadek a jam lueri la, wa yaa nye kaabka kuŋkuŋku ate wa sɛ Betel la zuk. Suiku de po wa yaa dueni tigini a te Izirali demma a yaa le cheŋ kuŋkuŋku jigi ayen wa nye tiirita kaabta.

Title: 1 NALIMA 13
Content:
1Naawen yaa jam tom Wen nuru ate wa nyini Juda a cheŋ Betel. Ase wa ale gaa paari la, Jeroboam a jam za ka kuŋkuŋku tɛŋ ayen wa nye kaabka. 2Naawen wanni yaa jam wa jigi ate wa kaari a ta chaab ale kuŋkuŋku ayen, <<Kuŋkuŋoa! Kuŋkuŋoa! Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna, <Ba le biak biik Deevid yenni po ate ba a wi wa ayen Josia. Fi zuk ba le kaab pimpitimaŋa zuk kaabteerɔma baai ale a nye kaabka yɔgyɔgla de dela, abe ba ju nurubiik koba fi zuk.> >> 3Dai dila danni dek Wen nuruwa a jam sak ka daana ayen, <<Daanaŋa ale nna ate Naawen a weeni. Kuŋkuŋku ale na muulik ate buntuemmu ale waaŋ tɛŋka.>>
4Ase naab Jeroboam ale jam wom dii ate Wen nuruwa a biisi a te kuŋkuŋku ale bo Betel po la, wa yaa teeri wa nisaŋa a nyini kuŋkuŋku jigi ale weeni ayen, <<Ni yik wa.>> Alege nisaŋa ate wa pa si a tuk nuruwa nyiŋla a deri kpi a kan ŋmani a siŋ si jigini. 5Kuŋkuŋku a jam na muulika kama ate buntuemmu a waaŋ tɛŋka ase Wen nuruwa ale weeni dii a ta nyini Naawen wanni po la.
6Naawa yaa weeni Wen nuruwa ayen, <<Biisi ale Naawen fi Wenni a puusi te mu ayen m nisaŋa abe ŋman nye si denni.>> Wen nuruwa yaa jam biisi ale Naawen, ate naawa nisaŋa a ŋman nye si denni ase si daam ale ka diila.
7Naawa yaa weeni Wen nuruwa ayen, <<Va mu a kuli yeri a de ŋandiinta ate mi ale te fu tiirim.>>
8Alege Wen nuruwa a tulisi naawa ayen, <<Ase fi dan pooma fi te mi fi paaruŋku geli, mi a kan va fu a kuli yaase mi dɛ ŋandiinta yaase mi nyu nyiam dela. 9Diila Naawen wanni a weeni mu kama ayen, <Ku a fɛ ate fi kan dɛ ŋandiinta yaase fi nyu nyiam yaase fi ŋman va suik kuui ate fi va jam la.> >> 10Dila wa yaa va suik yoŋ ale basi suik kuui ate wa va jam Betel la.
11Biisiteerɔ kpak ale jam bo Betel tɛŋka, waai nidoabilisa ale jan jam weeni wa dii meena ate Wen nuruwa a jam nye dula dai dila danni la. Ba jam maa weeni ba kowa dii ate wa jam weeni naawa la kama. 12Ba kowa yaa bek ba ayen, <<Ka suik kuna ate wa va a cheŋ?>> Ate wa nidoabilisaŋa a jam dak suik kuui ate Wen nuruwa ale nyini Juda la a jam va la. 13Wa yaa weeni wa nidoabilisaŋa ayen, <<Ni gomsi boniŋka a te mu.>> Ase ba ale gomsi boniŋka a te wa la, wa yaa dɔ ka 14a saŋ Wen nuruwa ŋaaŋ. Wa jam nya wa kama ale wa kala kinkaŋ peruk tɛŋ a bek wa ayen, <<Ka fi ale Wen nuruwa a nyini Juda la?>> Ate wa tulisi ayen, <<Mm.>> 15Biisiteerɔwa yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Va mu a kuli yeri a dɛ ŋandiinta.>>
16Wen nuruwa yaa tulisi ayen, <<Mi a kan ŋman a ŋmani ŋaaŋ a va fu a cheŋ, yaase mi dɛ ŋandiinta yaase mi nyu nyiam ale fu dela. 17Naawen wanni a weeni mi kama ayen, <Ku a fɛ ate fi kan dɛ ŋandiinta yaase fi nyu nyiam yaase fi ŋman va suik kuui ate fi va jam la.> >>
18Biisiteerɔ kpakka yaa tulisi ayen, <<Mi mɛ ka biisiteerɔ ase fi mɛ la. Ate Wen maarɔ a weeni mi a ta nyini Naawen wanni po ayen, <Ta wa a ŋman jam fi yenni ate wa dɛ ŋandiinta abe wa nyu nyiam.> >> Wa jam a velim kama. 19Dila Wen nuruwa yaa va wa a ŋmani a dɛ ale nyu nyiam wa yenni po.
20Ase ba ale jam kala la, Naawen wanni yaa jam biisiteerɔ kpakka jigi waai ale ta wa a ŋmani la. 21Wa yaa kaari a te Wen nuruwa waai ale nyini Juda a jam la ayen, <<Dii ate Naawen a weeni la ale nna, <Fi a zɛri Naawen wanni kama ale an ta wieŋa ate Naawen fi Wenni a te fu la. 22Fi ŋman jam a dɛ ŋandiinta ale nyu nyiam juijui ate mi jam weeni fu ayen fi kan dɛ yaase fi nyu la kama. Dila nyiŋ fi nyiŋka a kan gu boosuk kuui po ate ba gu fi koma la.> >>
23Ase Wen nuruwa ale jam dɛ ale nyu a ga nueri la, biisiteerɔ waai ale jam ta wa a jam la a yaa gomsi wa boniŋka a te wa. 24Ase wa ale jam bo suiku po la, gbeŋli yaa tu wa suiku po a ko wa, ate wa nyiŋka a doa suiku po, ate boniŋka ale gbeŋli a za ka gauŋ. 25Nuruba gela ale jam va dula a taam a nya ale nyiŋka a doa ate gbeŋli a za nyiŋka gauŋ, ate ba yaa ga weeni a sak tɛŋ kpieŋka po juijui ate biisiteerɔ kpakka a boro la.
26Ase biisiteerɔ kpakka waai ale jam ta wa a jam la ale ga wom la, weeni kama ayen, <<Ka Wen nuru waai ale zɛri Naawen wanni la ale la. Naawen ale pa wa a te gbeŋli, dii ale siti wa a ko wa ase Naawen wanni ale kaam wa la.>>
27Biisiteerɔwa yaa weeni wa nidoabilisaŋa ayen, <<Ni gomsi boniŋka a te mu.>> Ate ba nye dila. 28Ate nuruwa yaa ga nya ale nyiŋka a doa suiku po, ate boniŋka ale gbeŋli a za ka gauŋ. Gbeŋli an jam ŋɔbi nyiŋka yaase di dom boniŋka. 29Biisiteerɔwa yaa pa Wen nuruwa nyiŋka a vi boniŋka zuk, a ta ka a jam wadek tɛŋ kpieŋka po ayen wa kum abe wa gu wa. 30Wa yaa gu nyiŋka wadek boosuk po, ate ba kum wa ale a weeni ayen, <<M suowa.>>
31Ba ale gu wa la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, wa yaa weeni wa nidoabilisaŋa ayen, <<Ase mi a dan kpi ni gu mu boosuk kuui po ate ba gu Wen nuruwa la, ni pa mi kobaŋa a dueni wa kobaŋa gauŋ. 32Ale Naawen wanni ate wa jam biisi a te kuŋkuŋku Betel po la ale kaabka jiŋŋa pimpitimaŋa zuima Samaria tɛŋsaŋa po la ale sum chim ka wensie.>>
33Kude ŋaaŋnyiŋ, Jeroboam an tagri wa biem nyeelaŋa, wa diem jam lueri ka kaabteerɔba nna tɔgatɔga, baai ale kan daa Livaiba la. Nuru waai a daa yaali wa chim kaabteerɔ wa basi ate wa a chim kama. 34Jeroboam yenni biemu a jam le nna dila ale jam ta wa luetaŋa ale wa kaasuŋku a jam tɛŋzuk de la.

Title: 1 NALIMA 14
Content:
1Ku yaa jam paari diipo ate Jeroboam nidoabinni Abaija a jam a yuak. 2Jeroboam yaa weeni wa powa ayen, <<Cheŋ ga potim seba abe fi nye fidek ase nuru yoŋ la ate ba kan miŋ ayen fi ka Jeroboam powa. Cheŋ Siilo tɛŋka. Biisiteerɔwa Ayija a bo ka dula waai ale weeni mi ayen mi ale chim naab a nya nuruma de zuk la. 3Ta borobotta pi ale maasa maga ale leŋ ale siita a cheŋ wa jigi. Wa le weeni fu dii ale ku nye fi biika la.>> 4Jeroboam powa yaa nye dii ate wa weeni wa la a cheŋ Ayija yenni Siilo po. Yɔgyɔgla de Ayija an jaa nya, wa jam yi kama dii nyiŋla wa benaŋa a jam piisi kama. 5Alege Naawen a poom jam weeni Ayija kama ayen, <<Jeroboam powa a cheŋ kama ayen wa bek fu wa nidoabinni wie, dii nyiŋla wa a yuak kama, ku a magsi ka fi te wa tulisaŋa de. Ase wa dan jam paari, wa ale potim seba kama abe wa nye ase nuru yoŋ la.>>
6Ase Ayija ale ga wom wa naŋkimaŋa tuoku nɔi la. Ayija yaa weeni ayen, <<Jo jam Jeroboam powa. Boa ate fi nye ase daa fi la? Mi taka tomtomiŋ kaai ale kan ta wom ka la m te fu. 7Ga weeni Jeroboam ayen dii ate Naawen, Izirali Wenni a weeni la ale nna, <Mi a lueri fu a ta nyini nuruma po kama a nye fu niŋdeerɔ mi nuruma zuk. 8Mi tuesi naamu a ta nyini Deevid dɔkdemma jigi a pa bu a te fu. Alege fi a kan nye ase mi tomteerɔwa Deevid la, waai ale kasim a wom mi wieŋa ale a va mi ale wa suinum meena la. Wa jam a nye ka dii nyiini ate mi a weeni ayen ku nala la. 9Alege fi a nye biem a gaam waai meena ale dɛ naam alege fu la kama. Fi basi kama ate mi sui a puuri nna yegayega ale fi le nye kuta wena ale bɔgta a te fidek la. Fi niŋ a ka mi po.
10<< <Kude nyiŋ mi a yaali mi ta ka kaasuŋ a jam Jeroboam yenni po. Mi ale ko nidoama meena fi dɔkdemma po, yɔm ale baai ale kan daa yɔm la. Mi ale kaasi fi dɔkdemma pasa pasa ase ba ale a vaari tampoi diila, ate ba meena a kpi cheŋ. 11Baasa ale ŋɔbi baai ate Jeroboam a soa la baai ale kpi tɛŋ kpieŋka po la, ate duinsa a dɛ baai ale kpi tɛŋka nakpiak la. Ka Naawen ale biisi.>
12<<Alege dan ka fi, ŋman a kuli yeri. Ase fi a dan pa naŋ a tabi fi tɛŋ kpieŋka po, nidoabinni ale kpi. 13Izirali demma meena ale kum wa abe ba gu wa. Wala nyiini ale Jeroboam a soa waai ate ba le gu, dii nyiŋla wa nyiini ale bo Jeroboam yenni po waai ate Naawen, Izirali Wenni a nya wamaŋ wa po.
14<<Naawen ale lueri naab a te wadek ate wa nya Izirali zuk waai ale wa ko Jeroboam dɔkdemma la. Danni de dek! Mm, poom ka yɔgyɔgla de. 15Naawen ale namsi Izirali ate ba nye ase wobi ale a yuk viok nyiam po diila. Wa ale yiak Izirali ate ba nyini tɛŋ maŋ ka de po ate wa pa a te ba kokpieŋsaŋa la abe wa kati ba a waaŋ Benni kauk kunkula, dii nyiŋla ba jam nye ate ka Naawen sui a puuri ba ale jam a kaabi Asera bɔglukku la. 16Wa ale je Izirali demma basi dii nyiŋla Jeroboam a nye ka biem ate dila a basi ate Izirali demma a nye biem.>>
17Ate Jeroboam powa yaa vaari yiti a cheŋ Tirza. Wa ale gaa paari yeri la ale nidoabinni a kpi. 18Ba yaa gu wa ate Izirali demma meena a kum wa ase Naawen ale jam biisi dii a ta va wa tomteerɔwa Ayija biisiteerɔwa zuk la.
19Wayoŋ tii ate Jeroboam a nye wa naamu po la, wa kpaliŋsaŋa ale wa ale jam a nya nuruma zuk diila, a ŋmarisi bo Izirali nalima gbaŋka po kama. 20Wa jam dɛ naamu ka bena pisiye ale ŋaye alege kpi. Ate wa nidoabinni Nadab a jam zaani wa naŋkula po ase naab la.
21Solomon nidoabinni Areyoboam ale jam chim naab Juda po. Wa jam taka bena pisinaansi ale dinyi ale chim naab a dɛ naamu a paari bena pi ale ŋayopɔi Jerusalem po, tɛŋ kpieŋka ate Naawen a lueri a ta nyin Izirali buuni meena po ayen wa Yuenni a boro la. Wa mawa yuei a jam le Naama wa jam ka Ammon tɛŋka lie.
22Juda tɛŋka a jam nyeka biem Naawen nimbie po. A ta va biem buui ate ba nye la ba siti wa nyuri dɛka suipuurumu a gaam ba koma ale jam nye diila kama. 23Ba jam maa nye ka pimpitima ale tintain ferima ale Asera bɔglukku zaŋŋa guuk meena zuk ale tiib meena kiri a te badek. 24Nidoa yaalik geruŋ tuima tangbana ale jam bo tɛŋka po. Nuruma a jam pa badek meena a te ka kisuk nyeela ŋaai ate tɛŋ sila a jam a nye ate Naawen a yiak ba ate ba nyini a te Izirali demma la.
25Jeroboam ale jam dɛ naamu a paari bena ŋanu la, Ejipiti naawa Sisak a yaa nye kpaliŋ ale Jerusalem tɛŋka. 26Wa yaa pai Naawen yenni ligraŋa ale naab yeri ligraŋa a ta cheŋ. Wa jam pai jaab meena kama ale ligmɔniŋ kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsinta meena ate Solomon a jam nye la. 27Dila naab Areyoboam yaa jam nye kutuk mɔnuŋ kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsinta ate bala a tagri mbala zuk a pa bade a nyo kpaga ŋaai ale a nya baai ale jam bo naab yeri nansuiŋku nɔi a limisi la nisa po. 28Diipo meena ate naawa a cheŋ Naawen yenni la, limisidɔma a nyiem a pa kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsinta a yik tara, dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ ba ŋman ta ba a jo limisidɔma dɔkku po.
29Dan ka Areyoboam wayoŋ ti ntila ale dii meena ate wa jam nye la, ŋala ŋmarisi doa Juda nalima gbaŋsaŋa po kama. 30Kpaliŋ ale kasim jam bo Areyoboam ale Jeroboam suŋsuŋ va ŋala po meena. 31Areyoboam yaa jam kpi a gum wa koma po ate ba gu wa ba le jam gu bala juijui la Deevid Tɛŋka po. Wa mawa yuei jam le Naama wa jam ka Ammon tɛŋka lie. Ate Abaija wa nidoabinni a zaani wa naŋkula po a chim naab.

Title: 1 NALIMA 15
Content:
1Bena pi ale naaniŋ po ate Nebat nidoabinni Jeroboam a dɛ naamu la, Abaija ale jam chim naab Juda po, 2wa jam dɛ naamu Jerusalem po ka bena ŋata. Wa mawa yuei jam le Maaka. Wa jam ka Abisalom lie.
3Wa jam nye biem buui meena ate wa kowa a jam nye la kama, wa suinum meena a jam ka Naawen wa Wenni jigi ase wa kokpieŋka Deevid suinummu ale jam ka diila. 4Alege Deevid nyiŋ Naawen wa Wenni a jam te wa ka zeuŋ Jerusalem po, a lueri nidoabili ayen wa zaani wa nankula po abe wa nye ate Jerusalem a pagra. 5Deevid a jam nye ka dii ale nala Naawen nimbie po ale an zɛri Naawen wieŋa wa vum daaŋa po meena. Ka Yuraya Yit denɔwa wanni nyiini.
6Areyoboam ale Jeroboam a jam ta ka chaab diipo ate Abaija a diem vua la. 7Dan ka Abaija wayoŋ ti ntila ale dii meena ate wa jam nye la, ŋala a ŋmarisi doa Juda nalima gbaŋsaŋa po kama. Kpaliŋ ale jam bo Abaija ale Jeroboam suŋsuŋ. 8Abaija yaa jam kpi a gum wa koma po ate ba gu wa Deevid Tɛŋka po. Ate Asa wa nidoabinni a zaani wa nankula po a chim naab.
9Bena pisiyewa po ate Jeroboam Izirali naawa a dɛ naamu la, Asa ale jam chim Juda naab, 10a dɛ naamu Jerusalem po bena pisinaansi ale dinyi. Wa ma kpieŋka yue a jam le Maaka wa jam ka Abisalom lie.
11Asa a jam a nye ka dii ale nala Naawen nimbie po ase wa kowa Deevid ale jam nye diila. 12Wa jam yeeri nipok yaalik tuima tangbanaŋa nidoama kama tɛŋka po ale kpiti bɔgluk tii meena ate wa koma a jam nye la a basi. 13Wa ma kpieŋka Maaka a jam nye ka Asera kisuk bɔglukku a zaani ate wa yeeri wa naamu po, dii nyiŋla wa jam nye ka kisuk bɔgluk. Asa a jam che ku a lɔnsi kama a ju ku Kidron Viaka po. 14Wa an jam kpiti pimpitimaŋa a basi ya, Asa suinum a jam bo ale ka Naawen wa vum daaŋa meena po. 15Wa yaa ta kpana ale ligmɔniŋ ale ŋantomtaŋa ate wa kowa a jam pa ŋa a nyo Naawen nisa po la a jam te Naawen yenni po.
16Asa ale Izirali naawa Baasia a jam ta ka chaab ba naamu vaaŋa po meena. 17Izirali naawa Baasia yaa jam siti Juda a sɛ parik a gilim Arama a kasi ayen waai a kan nyini ka po yaase wa jo Juda naawa Asa tɛŋka po.
18Asa yaa pa kpanaŋa ale ligmɔniŋka meena ale jam tali bo ligra duenika jigini Naawen yenni po la ale wadek yenni po la. Wa jam pai ŋa a nyo ka wa kpaŋŋa nisa po a tom ba Tabrimmon nidoabinni Ben Yadad jigi ate Yezion a chim wa ko kpieŋ la, Araam naawa waai ale jam a nya Damasikus zuk la jigi. 19Wa weeni ayen, <<Basi ate nɔiyeŋ a bo mi ale fi suŋsuŋ ase ku ale jam ka dii mi kowa ale fi kowa jigi la. Nya mi a te fu ka kpana ale ligmɔniŋ tiirim. Yɔgyɔgla de kaasi fi nɔiyeŋka ale Izirali naawa Baasia ate wa ŋmani abe wa ge mu.>>
20Ben Yadad yaa jam siak Naab Asa ale weeni diila a tom wa tugurik tommu kpaŋŋa ate ba nye kpaliŋ ale Izirali tɛŋsaŋa. Wa jam nya pagrim Ijon ale Dan ale Abel Bet Maaka ale Kinneret meena a maa gum Nafitali du. 21Ase Baasia ale ga wom kude la, wa yaa jam basi Arama sɛka ale ŋman cheŋ Tirza. 22Ate Naab Asa yaa weeni Juda nuruma meena ayen waai meena a magsi wa maari kama. Ate ba yaa vaari tintanaŋa ale daataŋa ate Baasia a jam ta a tom dula la a ta cheŋ. Ŋan bala ate Naab Asa a jam pa sɛ Geba ale bo Benjamin po la ale Mizpa mɛ.
23Dan ka Asa wayoŋ ti ntila meena ale dii meena ate wa nye la ale wa le nye diila, tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa ate wa jam sɛ la, ŋa ŋmarisi doa Juda nalima gbaŋsaŋa po kama. Wa ale jam kpaŋ la wa jam taka naŋsa tuem. 24Asa yaa jam kpi gum wa koma po ate ba gu wa a gum ba po wa kowa Deevid Tɛŋka po. Ate wa nidoabinni Jeyosafat a zaani wa nankula po a chim naab.
25Jeroboam nidoabinni Nadab yaa jam chim Izirali naab bena ŋayewa po ate Juda naawa Asa a dɛ wa naamu la, Nadab jam nya Izirali zuk ka bena ŋaye. 26Nadab jam nye ka biem Naawen nimbie po, a nye wa kowa nyeelaŋa ale bo wa biemu po, buui ate wa basi ate Izirali demma a nye la.
27Ayija nidoabinni Baasia ale nyini Isaka yenni la yaa jam ta chaab ale wa, ate wa nak wa a lɔnsi Gibbeton po, ka jam ka Filistia tɛŋ kpieŋ alege Nadab ale Izirali demma meena a boro a nye kpaliŋka. 28Baasia a jam ko Nadab ka bena ŋatawa po ate Asa Juda naawa a jam dɛ naam la ale zaani Nadab naŋkula po a chim naab.
29Ase wa le ga piilim a dɛ naam la, wa yaa jam ko Jeroboam dɔkdemma meena. Wa an jam tali Jeroboam nuruma wanyi mɛ la vuta, wa jam ko ba meena kama ase Naawen wanni ale jan jam wa jigi a ta va wa tomteerɔwa Ayija Siilo denɔwa jigi la. 30Jeroboam ale nye biem buui la nyiŋ ale wa ale basi ate Izirali demma a nye biemu la nyiŋ, wa abe nye ate ka Naawen, Izirali Wenni sui a puuri.
31Dan ka Nadab naamu wayoŋ tintila ale dii meena ate wa jam nye la, ŋala a ŋmarisi a doa Izirali nalima gbaŋsaŋa po kama. 32Asa ale Izirali naawa Baasia a jam ta ka chaab ba naamu vaaŋa meena po.
33Bena ŋatawa po ate Juda naawa Asa a dɛ naam la, Ayija nidoabinni Baasia yaa jam chim naab Izirali ale Tirza tɛŋsaŋa po a paari bena pisiye ale ŋanaansi. 34Wa jam nye ka biem Naawen nimbie po a nye wa kowa Jeroboam nyeelaŋa ale bo wa biemu po, buui ate wa basi ate Izirali demma a nye la.

Title: 1 NALIMA 16
Content:
1Yanani nidoabinni Jeyu yaa jam biisi Naawen wanni a te naab Baasia, 2ayen, <<Mi nye fu a nyini ka tanta po a basi ate fi chim Izirali mi nuruma niŋdeerɔ, alege fi jam a nye ka fi kowa Jeroboam nyeelaŋa ale basi ate mi nuruma Izirali demma a nye biem ale nye ate mi sui a puuri ba biemu nyiŋ. 3Dila mi boro a yaali mi ko Baasia ale wa yenni demma kama, Mi abe nye fi yenni ase ka Nebat nidoabinni Jeroboam yenni la. 4Baasa ale ŋɔbi Baasia yenni demma baai ale kpi tɛŋ kpieŋka po la, ate nuinsaŋa ale bo vioku po la a dɛ baai ale kpi tɛŋka nakpiak la.>>
5Dan ka Juda naawa Baasia wayoŋ tintila dii ate wa jam nye la, ŋala a ŋmarisi doa Izirali nalima gbaŋsaŋa po kama. 6Baasia a jam kpi gum ka wa koma po ate ba gu wa Tirza po. Wa nidoabinni Elaya ale jam zaani wa naŋkula po a chim naab.
7Naawen a biisi wa wanni a te Baasia ale wa yenni demma a ta va biisiteerɔwa Yanani nidoabinni Jeyu zuk. Baasia a jam nye ka waboari ate Naawen ayen ŋa an nala. Ŋaai ale jam nye ate Naawen sui a ŋmasi a puuri. Wa jam nye ka biem buui dek ate Jeroboam dɔkdemma a jam nye la. Naawen a jam biisi te Baasia kama dii nyiŋla wa jam ko Jeroboam dɔkdemma meena kama.
8Bena pisiye ale ŋayuebiwa ate Juda naawa Asa a dɛ naam la, Baasia nidoabinni Elaya yaa chim Izirali naab a dɛ naam Tirza po bena ŋaye.
9Elaya kpaŋŋa dinyi Zimri waai ale jam ta pagrim wa torokoma geli zuk la, yaa jam ta chaab ale wa. Elaya a jam bo ka Tirza po a boro a buk Arza yenni po, waai ale jam a nya Tirza naab yenni zuk la. 10Zimri yaa jam jo a chub wa a lɔnsi a ko wa bena pisiye ale ŋayopɔiwa po ate Juda naawa Asa a dɛ naam la. Zimri jam zaani ka Elaya naŋkula po a chim naab.
11Ase wa ale ga piilim naam dɛka a kala naam zukpaglika zuk la, wa yaa ko Baasia dɔkdemma meena. Wa an jam tali nidoa yeŋ mɛ la a basi ya, mabiik yaase doa wa jam ko kama. 12Dila Zimri yaa ko Baasia dɔkdemma meena a ta magsi chaab ale Naawen wanni ate wa ta va biisiteerɔwa Jeyu zuk a biisi sak Baasia la, 13dii nyiŋla Baasia ale wa nidoabinni Elaya a jam nye ka biem ale basi ate Izirali demma meena a maa nye biem ate dila a basi ate Naawen, Izirali Wenni sui a puuri ba bɔgtaŋa nyiŋ.
14Dan ka Elaya naamu wayoŋ ti ntila ale dii meena ate wa jam nye la, ŋala a ŋmarisi doa Izirali nalima gbaŋsaŋa po kama.
15Bena pisiye ale ŋayopɔiwa po ate Juda naawa Asa a dɛ naam la, Zimri a jam dɛ naam Tirza po ka daa ŋayopɔi. Tugurik tommu a jam tigsi moata ka Gibbeton, Filistia demma tɛŋ kpieŋ ale la. 16Ase Izirali demma ale jam tigsi la ale ga wom ayen Zimri a siti naawa a ko wa la, ba basi ate Omri, tugurik tommu kpagni a chim Izirali naab dai dila danni dek dula ba tigsika jigini. 17Ate Omri ale Izirali demma meena yaa ŋmani a nyini Gibbeton a ga suk doa Tirza. 18Ase Zimri ale jam nya ayen ba nak yik tɛŋ kpieŋka la, wa yaa jo naam dɔkku po a ju ku ale bolim a gilim wa basi du ate wa kpi, 19biemu ate wa nye, biem ate wa nye Naawen nimbie po, a nye Jeroboam nyeelaŋa ale bo wa biemu po ale basi ate Izirali demma mɛ a nye biem.
20Dan ka Zimri naamu wayoŋ ti ntila ale tukpanni ate wa jam nye la, ŋala a ŋmarisi doa Izirali nalima gbaŋsaŋa po kama.
21Ate Izirali demma yaa jam lab buye, geli a maari Ginat nidoabinni Tibni ayen wa chim naab ate geli ndila a maari Omri. 22Alege Omri ŋaaŋviirɔma a jam sak pagrim a gaam baai ale jam va Ginat nidoabinni Tibni la. Dila Tibni yaa jam kpi ate Omri a chim naab.
23Bena pisita ale dinyiwa po ate Juda naawa Asa a dɛ naam la, Omri ale jam chim Izirali naab, wa jam dɛ naamu ka bena pi ale ŋaye, bena ŋayuebi ate wa dɛ naamu Tirza po. 24Wa jam da Samaria guuku a ta nyini Sɛmer jigi ale ka kpana boorisa siye dobrim a sɛ tɛŋ kpieŋ guuku zuk a wi ka ayen Samaria, ba jam pai ka Sɛmer a segri ka, waai ale jam liŋ soa guuku la yuei ale la.
25Alege Omri yaa jam nye biem Naawen nimbie po a nye biem a gaam baai meena ale dɛ wa niŋ la. 26Wa jam a nye ka Nebat nidoabinni Jeroboam nyeelaŋa ale bo wa biemu po, dii ate wa jam basi ate Izirali demma a nye la, ate dila a basi ate ba nye ate Naawen, Izirali Wenni sui a puuri ale ba bɔgtaŋa wie.
27Dan ka Omri naamu wayoŋ tin ntila ale dii ate wa nye la, ŋala a ŋmarisi doa Izirali nalima gbaŋsaŋa po kama. 28Omri a jam kpi kama a gum wa koma po ate ba gu wa Samaria po. Ate wa nidoabinni Ayab a zaani wa naŋkula po a chim naab.
29Asa ale dɛ naamu bena pisita ale naanika Juda po la, Omri nidoabinni Ayab ale jam chim Izirali naab, wa jam dɛ naamu Samaria po a nya Izirali zuk ka bena pisiye ale ŋaye. 30Omri nidoabinni Ayab a jam nye biem a zuak Naawen nimbie po a gaam baai meena ale dɛ wa niŋ la kama. 31Daa wa ale jam nye Nebat nidoabinni Jeroboam biemu la nyiini, alege wa jam faari ka Saidon naawa Etbaal liewa Jezebel, a piilim tom a te Baal wenni ale a kaab di. 32Wa jam sɛ ka kaabka kuŋkuŋ a te Baal puusika yenni ate wa jam sɛ Samaria po la. 33Ayab a maa jam nye ka Asera diok a zaani a ŋmasi nye puuri Naawen, Izirali Wenni sui a gaam nalim ŋaai meena ale jam dɛ wa niŋ la.
34Ayab vaaŋa po, Yiel ale nyini Betel la a ŋman pilim sɛ Jeriko tɛŋka kama. Wa ale jam dueni nyubini la wa bikpagni Abiram ale jam kpi, wa ale gaa nueri nansuiŋtaŋa la wa bi baaŋka Segub mɛ a kpi a ta va chaab ale Naawen wanni ate Nun nidoabinni Josua a jam biisi la.

Title: 1 NALIMA 17
Content:
1Yɔgyɔgla de Tisbi denɔwa Elaja ale nyini Tisbi ale bo Gilead po la a yaa jam weeni Ayab ayen, <<Ase Naawen, Izirali Wenni ale boro la, waai ate mi a tom a te la, maglim yaase ŋmoruk a kan lo tɛŋka zuwa bena magadek ale cheen la ka mi a nin weeni ayen dila a nye.>>
2Naawen wanni yaa jam Elaja jigi ayen, 3<<Basi dela, viriŋ kori geŋsa a suk Kerit Vooliŋka Jodan Benni kori geŋsa. 4Fi ale nyu nyiam a nyini ka buboalika po, mi weeni ka tagaaruta ayen ku a te fu ŋandiinta dula.>>
5Dila wa yaa nye dii ate Naawen a weeni wa ayen wa nye la. Wa jam cheŋ ka Kerit Vooliŋka Jodan Benni kori geŋsa a bo dula. 6Tagaaruta yaa ta ŋandiinta ale lam a jam saluik ale junɔi a te wa alege ate wa a nyu nyiam a nyini buboalika po.
7Ku an beni ya buboalika yaa kpeeri dii nyiŋla, ŋmoruk an jam a ni tɛŋka po. 8Naawen wanni yaa jam wa jigi ayen, 9<<Cheŋ Zarefat ale bo Saidon tɛŋka po la a bo dula. Mi weeni ka pukɔgi dula jigini ayen wa a te fu ŋandiinta.>> 10Dila wa yaa cheŋ Zarefat. Ase wa ale jam paari tɛŋka nansuiŋku la, pukɔgi ale jam bo dula a tigsi daata. Wa yaa wi wa a bek ayen, <<Fi ale ta nyiam maga dega ale leŋ a jam te mu ate m nyu?>> 11Ase wa ale a cheŋ wa ta nyiamu a jam la Elaja ŋman wi wa ayen, <<Mi a saalim ta ŋandiinta maga dega a gum du a jam te mu.>>
12Pukɔgini yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ase Naawen fi Wenni ale boro la, mi a ka ŋandiinta, ka zom nisa nɔi ale bo goŋ po ale kpaam maga ale bo leŋ po. Mi a tigsi ka daata maga dega ayen m ta kuli a nye ŋandiinta a te m dek ale m nidoabinni ate ti dɛ abe ti ge kpi.>>
13Elaja yaa tulisi wa ayen, <<Kaa chali yɔgsummoa. Kuli yeri a nye fi ale weeni diila. Alege dɛ niŋ a nye ŋandiinta maga dega a ta nyini jabuui ate fi ta la po a ta jam te mi, abe fi ge a nye te fidek ale fi nidoabinni. 14Ale ka dii ate Naawen, Izirali Wenni a weeni la ale nna ayen, <Zommu ale bo goŋku po la a kan nueri, kpaamu ale bo leŋka po mɛ la a kan kpeeri, ka dai dii dai ate Naawen basi ate ŋmoruk a ni tɛŋka zuk la.> >>
15Pukɔgini yaa cheŋ ga nye dii ate Elaja a weeni wa la. Ŋandiinta a jam boro kama daa meena a te Elaja ale nipowa ale wa dɔkdemma. 16Zommu ale bo goŋku po la an jam nueri ya, kpaamu mɛ ale jam bo leŋka po la an jam nueri ya ase Naawen ale jam va Elaja zuk a biisi diila.
17Ku ale beni magadek la nipowa nidoabinni yaa jam a yuak. Yuammu a jam ŋmasi pagra kama a gum du ate wa an ŋman baga a vuusi. 18Wa yaa weeni Elaja ayen, <<Ka boan wari ate fi ta ale mu, Wen nuru? Fi jam fi teeri mi ka mi biemu wari abe fi ko m nidoabinni?>>
19Elaja yaa tulisi ayen, <<Te mu fi nidoabinni.>> Wa yaa tuesi wa nipowa jigi a ta wa a jueli ŋmazuk dɔkku juijui ate wa jam boro la, a pa wa a dueni wa gaduokku zuk. 20Wa yaa kaari a te Naawen ayen, <<Naawen mi Wen yaa, fi ta ka kaasuŋ a jam pukɔgini ate mi a boro ale wa la jigi yaa, a basi ate wa nidoabinni a kpi?>> 21Wa yaa duak nidoabinni zuk a neenti buta a weeni Naawen ayen, <<Naawen mi Wen yaa, basi ate nidoabinni de nyuvunni a ŋman pilim jam wa jigi.>>
22Naawen yaa jam wom Elaja kaarika ate nidoabinni nyuvunni a pilim jam wa jigi ate wa vua. 23Elaja yaa pa nidoabinni a ta wa nyini dɔkku po a siŋ yenni po. Wa jam pa wa a te wa mawa ale weeni ayen, <<Nya fi nidoabinni a vuuk kama.>>
24Ate nipowa yaa weeni Elaja ayen, <<Yɔgyɔgla mi seba ayen fi ka Wen nuru, ale seba ayen Naawen wanni ale nyini fi nɔnni po la ka wensie>>

Title: 1 NALIMA 18
Content:
1Ku ale jam beni magadek la, bena ŋatawa po, Naawen yaa jam Elaja jigi ayen, <<Ta fidek a ga sak Ayab ate mi ale tom ŋmoruk tɛŋka zuk.>> 2Elaja yaa jam ta wadek a cheŋ wa sak Ayab. Kɔmmu a jam pagra ka nna yegayega Samaria po, 3ate Ayab yaa weeni Obadia waai ale jam a nya naab yenni zuk la. Obadia jam ka waai ale va Naawen nalimnyiini la. 4Ase Jezebel ale jam a ko Naawen biisiteerɔma la, Obadia a jam pa ka biisiteerɔba kook a suk vie ŋaye po, pisinu ale jam bo bunyi meena po ate wa a te ba ŋandiinta ale nyiam.
5Ayab a jam weeni Obadia ayen, <<Cheŋ tɛŋka meena belaŋa ale vaasaŋa meena po dai dii dai ti ale nya wuuk ate wusumaŋa ale wusum bonsaŋa ale ta nyiŋ pagra, ate ti kan ko ti duŋsaŋa kanyi.>> 6Dila ba yaa jam lab tɛŋka ate ba jam a yaali ba taari a lik la a te chaab, ate Ayab a va kauk alege ate Obadia mɛ a va kauk.
7Ase Obadia ale jam a cheŋ la, Elaja yaa tu wa. Obadia yaa miŋ wa a koori tɛŋ a weeni ayen, <<Sum ka fi ale la, m nyɔnɔ Elaja?>> 8Wa yaa tulisi ayen, <<Mm, ga weeni fu kpagni ayen, <Elaja a bo dela.> >>
9Obadia yaa bek ayen, <<Ka boan wari ate mi nye kaasi ate fi pa fi tomteerɔwa a te Ayab ayen wa ko? 10Ase Naawen fi Wenni ale sum boro la, tɛŋ yaase naam a karo ate mi kpagni an tom waai ayen ba gisi fu. Ase tɛŋ yaase naam buui a dan weeni ayen fi ka dela, wa a basi ate ba a pɛ kama ayen ba an sum nya fu. 11Alege fi a weeni mu ayen m ga weeni m kpagni ayen, <Elaja a bo dela.> 12Mi a zɛ juijui ate Naawen Chiika ale ta fu a cheŋ la ase mi a nin basi fu. Ase mi a dan ga weeni Ayab alege ate wa an nya fu, wa ale ko mu. Mi fi tomteerɔwa a puusi Naawen a nyini ka m paalim po. 13Fi an wom yaa, m nyɔnɔ, dii ate mi a jam nye ase Jezebel ale jam a ko Naawen biisiteerɔma la? Mi jam pa ka Naawen biisiteerɔba kook a suk vie ŋaye po, ate pisinu a jam bo bunyi meena po, a te ba ŋandiinta ale nyiam. 14Ate yɔgyɔgla de fi a weeni mu ayen m cheŋ m kpagni jigi a weeni wa ayen, <Elaja a bo dela.> Wa ale ko mu!>>
15Elaja yaa weeni ayen, <<Ase Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale boro la, waai ate mi a tom a te la, mi ale sum pa m dek a sak Ayab jinla.>>
16Dila Obadia yaa jam cheŋ ayen wa tu Ayab abe wa weeni wa, ate Ayab yaa cheŋ wa tu Elaja. 17Ase wa ale jam nya Elaja la, wa yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Ka fi ale la, fi waai ale a daani Izirali la?>>
18Elaja yaa tulisi ayen, <<Mi an daani Izirali, ka fi ale fi kowa dɔkdemma ale daani Izirali. Ni jam zɛri Naawen wieŋa kama ale va Baal bɔgtaŋa. 19Yɔgyɔgla de tigsi nuruma a nyini Izirali meena ate ba tu mi Karmel Guuku zuk. Ta Baal biisiteerɔba kobsinaansi ale pisinuwa ale Asera biisiteerɔba kobsinaansiwa a jam, baai ale bo Jezebel yenni a dɛ la.>>
20Dila Ayab yaa tom weeni Izirali meena a tigsi biisiteerɔma Karmel Guuku zuk. 21Elaja yaa cheŋ nuruma niŋ a weeni ba ayen, <<Ku ale beni a paari ka disa po ate nama a basi ni chichamaŋa? Naawen a dan ka Wen ni va wa, alege Baal mɛ abe dan ka Wen, ni be a va wa.>> Alege nuruma an jam weeni wari ya.
22Ate Elaja yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Mi nyiini ale Naawen biisiteerɔ a tali boro, alege Baal a ta ka biisiteerɔba kobsinaansi ale pisinu. 23Ni ta lalisa siye a jam te ti. Basi ate ba lueri kanyi a te badek, basi ate ba boani ka boanaboana a vi daataŋa zuk alege ba kan cheem bolim bu zuwa. Mi ale gomsi lalik m kala a vi daata zuk m kan cheem bolim bu zuwa. 24Ate nama ale wi ni wenni yuei ate mi mɛ ale wi Naawen yuei. Wen dii ale a tulisi ale bolim la wala ale Wen.>> Ate nuruma meena ayen, <<Dii ate fi a weeni la ka wamaŋ.>>
25Elaja yaa weeni Baal biisiteerɔma ayen, <<Ni dɛ niŋ a lueri lalik kanyi a gomsi ka nama ale piisi la nyiŋ. Ni wi ni wenni yuei, alege ni kan cheem bolimoa.>> 26Dila ba yaa yik lalik a te ba ate ba gomsi ka. Ba yaa wi Baal yuei a nyini saluik a ga paari kantueŋ suŋsuŋ ayen, <<Baal, tulisi ti!>> Alege tulisika an jam ya, waai an tulisi ya. Ba jam gɔk kama a gilim kuŋkuŋku ate ba jam sɛ la.
27Ku ale ga paari kantueŋ suŋsuŋ la, Elaja yaa piilim koosi a la ba. Wa weeni ayen, <<Wa sum ka wen, dai dii dai wa bo ka popola po yaase wa nina ale muni yaase wa bo nyeerim po. Dai dii dai wa a goa kama ku a fɛ ate wa yiti.>> 28Dila ba yaa jam a na ate ku jueli ale a gebi badek ale gebisa ale gbatta ase ba ŋiaka wieŋa ale jam ka diila ate ba ziim a kasim a nyini. 29Wenni ale ga gbeli la ba diem jam a porisi kama a ta ga paari diipo ate ba a nye junɔinni kaabka la. Alege tulisa a jam karo, waai an jam tulisi ya, waai an jam wom ba.
30Elaja yaa weeni nuruma meena ayen, <<Ni jam mi jigi ate ba jam wa jigi,>> ate wa gomsi Naawen kuŋkuŋku kuui ale jam ŋɔriŋ la. 31Elaja jam pa ka tintana pi ale ŋaye, dinyi meena a magsi ŋaaŋbiik buuri meena ale nyini Jekob jigi, waai jigi ate Naawen wanni a jam ayen, <<Fi yue ale chim ka Izirali la.>> 32Tintanaŋa wa jam pa sɛ ka kuŋkuŋku Naawen yuenni nyiŋ ale tu goluk a gilim ku ate ku ŋmasi zuak a baga a jo kuruba kpienta tiye ale ŋanbie. 33Wa yaa tigsi daataŋa a boanni lalikka boanaboana a vi daataŋa zuk. Wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni ŋari nyiam a sueri samɔn kpieŋsa sinaansi a kpiiri vi tiirimu ale daataŋa zuk.>>
34Wa weeni ayen, <<Ni ŋman pilim nye,>> ate ba ŋman nye dila. Ate wa ŋman weeni ayen, <<Ni nye a saari buta,>> ate ba kpiiri du a saari buta. 35Nyiamu a jam chali nyini kuŋkuŋku zuk a siŋ sueri golukku kama.
36Diipo ate ba a nye junɔinni kaabka la, biisiteerɔwa Elaja yaa nyini jam niŋ nyiŋ a puusi ayen, <<Naawen yaa, Abrayam ale Aizik ale Izirali Wenni, basi ate jinla ba seba ayen fi ka Wen Izirali tɛŋka po, ate mi a chim fi tomteerɔ a nye ŋade meena fi wanni nyiŋ. 37Tulisi mu Naawen yaa, tulisi mu, ate nuruma de ale seba ayen fi Naawen ka Wen, abe ba seba ayen fi a tagri ba suiniimaŋa kama ŋmana.>>
38Ate bolim a nyini Naawen jigi a lo a dɛ kaabka ale daataŋa ale tintanaŋa ale tantaŋa a maa leeli nyiamu meena ale bo golukku po la.
39Ase nuruma meena ale jam nya kude la, ba yaa lo tɛŋ a kaari ayen, <<Naawen wa ka Wen! Naawen wa ka Wen!>>
40Elaja yaa weeni ayen, <<Ni yik Baal biisiteerɔma. Ni kan basi ate ba wanyi a muriŋ bɛ.>> Ba yaa yik ba ate Elaja a basi ate ba ta ba a jam Kison Viaka po a tɔgri ba dula.
41Elaja yaa weeni Ayab ayen, <<Ga dɛ abe fi nyu ale ka ŋmoruk kpioŋ ale cheena.>> 42Ayab yaa jam cheŋ wa dɛ abe wa nyu alege Elaja a ga jueli Karmel guuku zuk a koori tɛŋ a pa wa ninaŋa a basi wa dunaŋa suŋsuŋ.
43Wa weeni wa tomteerɔwa ayen, <<Cheŋ ga tuk nyakpiemu nyiŋ a nya,>> ate wa cheŋ ga nya, a weeni ayen, <<Wa an nya jaaboa.>> Elaja a weeni wa ayen wa ŋman pilim ga nya. Elaja a jam weeni dila a paari ka buyopɔi.
44Buyopɔiwa po tomteerɔwa yaa weeni ayen, <<Chiŋmari nna nyiin ase nuru nisa la ale nyini nyakpiemu po a jueli.>> Elaja yaa weeni ayen, <<Cheŋ ga weeni Ayab ayen wa nye nwuli a jueli wa torokowa a kuli alege jigi ate ŋmorukku a kasi fu.>>
45Alege wenni a jam ko sobri kama ale chiŋma, ate viok a yiti, ate ŋmoruk kpioŋ a jan jam ate Ayab a dam a cheŋ Jezreel. 46Naawen pagrim yaa jam Elaja jigi a bobi wa garukku ale wa chiak gbanni a magsi ate wa chali dɛ Ayab niŋ a cheŋ Jezreel.

Title: 1 NALIMA 19
Content:
1Ayab yaa jam weeni Jezebel dii meena ate Elaja nye la ale wa ale ko Baal biisiteerɔma meena ale gebik la. 2Jezebel yaa tom a weeni Elaja ayen, <<Wenaŋa abe te ku jo mi nyiŋ chaŋni ase chum nna po de mi a dan kan nye fi nyuvunni ase bade wanyi la.>>
3Elaja yaa jam a chali yɔgsum a yiti chali wa nyuvunni nyiŋ. Ase wa ale jam paari Beerseba ale bo Juda po la, wa yaa basi wa tomteerɔwa dula, 4alege wadek a cheŋ danni po meena a jo sagni po. Wa yaa jam paari tii fiik a kali bu kiri a puusi ayen wa kpi. Wa weeni ayen, <<Mi tom ka nna yegayega Naawen yaa. Tuesi mi nyuvunni. Mi an zunchoŋ mi kokpieŋsaŋa.>> 5Wa yaa duak tiimu tɛŋ a goa. Wen maarɔ yaa jam tiri wa ale weeni ayen, <<Yiti ŋmai a dɛ.>> 6Wa yaa nya gilim dula a moata wa zukku ale ka boroborok ale sɛ doa bolim kaala zuk ale leŋ ale nyiam. Wa yaa dɛ ale nyu ale ŋman pilim duak.
7Naawen maarɔwa yaa jan jam a saari buye a tiri wa ayen, <<Yiti ŋmai a dɛ ale chelimu a ŋmasi zuak kama a te fu.>> 8Wa yaa yiti ŋmai a dɛ ale nyu. Ŋandiintaŋa ale te wa pagrim la, wa yaa cheŋ daa pisinaansi ale yogta pisinaansi a paari Yoreb, Wen guuku. 9Dula wa jam jo ka vɔrup po a goa. Ate Naawen wanni a jam wa jigi ayen, <<Boa ate fi bo dela a nye Elaja?>>
10Ate wa tulisi ayen, <<Mi kɔrisa ale kasim bo Naawen, Wen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La. Izirali demma a zɛri fi nɔiyeŋka kama, a kpiti fi kuŋkuŋtaŋa a basi ale ko fi biisiteerɔma ale gebik. Mi dek mi nyiini ale tali, yɔgyɔgla de ba a gomsi ba ko mi mɛ kama.>>
11Naawen yaa weeni ayen, <<Cheŋ ga zaani guuku zuk Naawen niŋ, ale Naawen a yaali wa jam taam kama.>> Ate viok kpioŋ yaa jam nye ate guuku a lab buye ate pinaŋa a mobi Naawen niŋ alege Naawen a jam ka vioku po. Vioku ŋaaŋnyiŋ tɛŋka ale jam choa alege Naawen a jam ka tɛŋka choaka po. 12Tɛŋka choaka ŋaaŋnyiŋ bolim ale jan jam alege Naawen jam ka bolimu po. Bolimu ŋaaŋnyiŋ, ka waasika. 13Ase Elaja ale wom waasika la, wa yaa dari wa tankaluŋku a lik wa ninaŋa a nyini peelim a za vɔrumu nɔi. Ate lueluku yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Boa ate fi a nye dela Elaja?>>
14Ate wa tulisi ayen, <<Mi kɔrisa ale kasim bo Naawen, Wen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La. Izirali demma a zɛri fi nɔiyeŋka kama, a kpiti fi kuŋkuŋtaŋa a basi ale ko fi biisiteerɔma ale gebik. Mi dek nyiini ale tali, yɔgyɔgla de ba a gomsi ba ko mi mɛ kama.>>
15Naawen a weeni wa ayen, <<Ŋmani a va suik kuui dek ate fi a va jam la a cheŋ Damasikus Sagni po. Ase fi a dan paari dula, bobi Yazael naab ate wa a nya Araam tɛŋka zuk. 16Maa bobi Nimsi nidoabinni Jeyu naab ate wa nya Izirali zuk abe fi bobi Safat nidoabinni Ɛlaisa ale nyini Abel Meyola la ate wa zaani fi nankula po a chim biisiteerɔ. 17Jeyu ale ko waai meena ate Yazael an ko ale gebika la, ate Ɛlaisa ale ko waai meena ate Jeyu an jam ko ale gebika la. 18Mi ta ka nuruba tusa ŋayopɔi (7,000) a bo Izirali baai ale kan koori tɛŋ Baal niŋŋa, ba abe an te ku zula.>>
19Elaja yaa nyini dula a cheŋ ga nya Safat nidoabinni Ɛlaisa. Wa jam ta ka lalik kpaansa pi ale buye a boro a kpa, wadek ale jam yik lalisa pi ale buyewa kunni. Elaja yaa cheŋ wa jigi a yeeri wa tankaluŋku a yi wa. 20Ɛlaisa yaa basi wa lalik kpaansaŋa ale chali va Elaja. Wa weeni ayen, <<Basi ate mi gbaari m kowa ale m mawa a banti ba abe m va fu a cheŋ.>> Elaja yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ŋmani mi nye ka boa a te fu?>>
21Ɛlaisa yaa basi wa ale ŋmani. Wa jam yik wa lalik kpaansaŋa siyewa a tɔgri kama. Wa jam ju niiŋa daataŋa kama a dik lammu a te nuruma ate ba ŋɔbi. Wa yaa jam va Elaja ŋaaŋ a chim wa maarɔ.

Title: 1 NALIMA 20
Content:
1Yɔgyɔgla de Araam tɛŋka naawa Ben Yadad yaa tigsi wa tugurik tommu meena. Nalima pisita ale ŋaye ale jam va wa ale ba wusuma ale torokoba, wa yaa ga siti Samaria a nye kpaliŋ. 2Wa yaa tom nuruba tɛŋ kpieŋka po Ayab Izirali naawa jigi ayen, <<Ben Yadad ale weeni diila ale nna. 3<Fi kpanaŋa ale fi ligmɔniŋka mi ale soa, fi pok maŋsaŋa ale fi bi maŋsaŋa ka mi ale soa.> >> 4Izirali naawa yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ase dii dek ate fi a weeni la, m nyɔnɔ naaba. Mi ale jaab meena ate mi a ta la ka fi ale soa.>>
5Nuru baai ate wa jam tom la yaa ŋman jam ayen, <<Ben Yadad ale weeni diila ale nna, <M tom ka nuruba a yaali fi kpanaŋa ale fi ligmɔniŋka ale fi pooma ale fi bisaŋa. 6Alege chum nna po de mi a yaali m tom m kpaŋŋa ate ba gisi fi yenni po ale fi kpaŋŋa yeeŋa po. Ba ale vari jaab meena ale ta dobrim a te fu la a ta cheŋ.> >>
7Izirali naawa yaa tigsi nisɔmma meena tɛŋka po a weeni ba ayen, <<Nya nuruwa de ale yaali kpaliŋka la, ase wa le tom a weeni ayen wa a yaali mi pooma ale m bisaŋa ale kpanaŋa ale m ligmɔniŋka la mi an zɛri ya.>> 8Nisɔmma ale nuruma meena yaa tulisi ayen, <<Kan wom wa yaase fi siak a te wa ale a yaali diila.>>
9Dila wa yaa tulisi Ben Yadad ale tom baai la ayen, <<Weeni mi nyɔnɔwa naawa ayen, <Fi tomteerɔwa ale nye dii meena ate fi dɛ niŋ a weeni la alege fi ale yaali dii ŋmana la mi an baga a nye dila.> >> Ba yaa ta wa le tulisi diila a ga te Ben Yadad. 10Ben Yadad yaa tom tomtomiŋ ka choa Ayab jigi ayen, <<Wenaŋa abe nye ale mu ate ku jo m nyiŋ, ase tanta a nin poom a tali a zuak Samaria po a te mi nidoa meena nisa nɔi.>>
11Izirali naawa yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ni weeni wa ayen, <Waai ale jo wa kpaliŋ garuk la a kan kuulim ase waai ale yeeri ku a dueni la.> >> 12Ben Yadad a jam wom tontomiŋka de diipo la ale ka wa ale nalimaŋa chaab ale jam bo ba viita po a nyu, ate wa weeni ba ayen ba gomsi ate ba ga siti ba. Ba yaa gomsi ayen ba siti tɛŋka.
13Biisiteerɔ yaa jam Ayab Izirali naawa jigi a mooli ayen, <<Nnala ate Naawen a weeni ayen, <Nya Ben Yadad tugurik tom boanni. Mi ale pa ba a nyo fi nisima po jinla ate fi ale seba ayen ka Mi ale Naawen.> >> 14Ayab yaa bek ayen, <<Ka wana ale wa nye kude?>> Biisiteerɔwa yaa tulisi ayen, <<Nnala ate Naawen a weeni la ayen, <Ka tɛŋsaŋa kpaŋŋa nuru paalukku ale ba nye.> >> Ate wa ŋman bek ayen, <<Ka wana ale wa piilim kpaliŋka?>> Ate biisiteerɔwa ayen, <<Fi ale piilim.>>
15Ayab yaa wi tɛŋsaŋa kpaŋŋa nuru paalukku kobsiye ale pisita ale baye. Wa yaa tigsi Izirali dem mbala meena a gum chaab a nye tusa ŋayopɔi (7,000). 16Ba yaa basi ba boka jigini kantueŋ suŋsuŋ, dila po Ben Yadad ale nalima pisita ale ŋayewa ale jo chaab la a jam bo ka ba viitaŋa po a boro a buk. 17Tɛŋsaŋa kpaŋŋa nuru paalukku yaa dɛ niŋ a nyini. Ben Yadad yaa tom baai ale ga kpesi nya a jam weeni ayen, <<Nidoaba ale nyini Samaria a cheena.>>
18Ben Yadad yaa weeni ayen, <<Ase ba dan jam ale ka suiyɔgni ni yik ba vuta. Ba abe a dan jam ba nye ka kpaliŋ ni yik ba vuta.>>
19Tɛŋsaŋa kpaŋŋa nuru paalukku yaa gɔk santiri a nyini tɛŋka po a nyini ate tugurik tommu a bo ba ŋaaŋ, 20ba wanyi meena a jam ko ka wa dachiak. Ate dila a basi ate Araam demma a yiti chali ate Izirali demma a vi ba. Alege Araam naawa Ben Yadad a jam dɔ ka wusum a chali bɛ ale wa nuru baai ale ta wusuma la gela. 21Izirali naawa a jam a jueli ba zuk ka nna kparikpari a nak yik baai ale ta wusumaŋa ale torokoma la a ko Araam demma yega.
22Dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ biisiteerɔwa yaa jam Izirali naawa jigi ayen, <<Gomsi fidek a nya dii ale magsi fi nye la, dii nyiŋla wulum wen Araam naawa ale ŋman siti fu.>>
23Dila po dek Araam naawa kpaŋŋa a jam kaam wa kama ayen, <<Izirali demma wenaŋa ka guuta zuima wena dila ale soa ate ba ŋmasi pagra a te ti la. Alege ti dan kpaliŋ ale ba peelimmu ale doa nna jassi la po, ti ale nya pagrim ba zuk. 24Nye nnala, yeeri nalimaŋa meena ba naamu po a pa kpaga yonta a zaani ba nankula po. 25Ku a fɛ ate fi tigsi tugurik tom ase baai ate ni jɔk la, yaali wusuma a tagri ŋaai ate fi jɔk la ale torokoba a tagri baai ate fi jɔk la, ate dila ale basi ate ti baga a kpaliŋ ale ba peelimmu ale doa nna jassi la po, ate ti nak dɛ ba.>> Ben Yadad yaa jam siak te ba nye ba ale weeni diila.
26Wulum wen ale paari la Ben Yadad yaa tigsi Araam demma a cheŋ Afek wa nye kpaliŋ ale Izirali demma. 27Ase Izirali demma mɛ ale jam gomsi magsi kpaliŋ la, ba yaa gɔk santiri a tu ba. Izirali demma a jam kala a tuk ba ase ka bua ale tigsi buye la, alege ate Araam demma a lik tɛŋka meena.
28Wen nuruwa yaa jan jam weeni Izirali naawa ayen, <<Dii ate Naawen a weeni la ale nna, <Araam demma ale a poli ayen Naawen ka guuta zuima wen daa vaasa po wen la nyiŋ, Mi ale pa nuru boanni de a nyo ni nisima po, ate nama ale seba ayen ka Mi ale Naawen.> >>
29Daa ŋayopɔi meena ba jam kala a tuk ka chaab, daa ŋayopɔiwa danni ate kpaliŋka a piilim. Izirali demma a jam ko Araam demma tugurik tɔŋdɔma ka tusa kook (100,000) dai yeŋ. 30Baai ale tali la meena a jam chali cheŋ ka Afek, juijui ate parika a lo je ba a paari tusa pisiye ale ŋayopɔi la (27,000). Ben Yadad a jam chali cheŋ ka tɛŋka dek po a suk niŋ dɔk po.
31Wa kpaŋŋa yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Nya, ti wom kama ayen Izirali nalimaŋa a ta ka jiirim. Basi ate ti jo boorisa gatta a pa miisa a bobi ti zuimaŋa. Dai dii dai wa ale basi ate fi vua.>>
32Ba yaa jo boorisa gatta a basi ba chaasa a pa miisa a bobi gilim ba zuima a cheŋ Izirali naawa jigi ayen, <<Fi tomteerɔwa Ben Yadad ayen, <Mi a saalim basi ate m vua.> >> Ate naawa a tulisi ayen, <<Wa diem vua kama? Wa ka mi suok.>>
33Nuruma a yaa nya kude ase ka daana maŋsa la a siak wa ale weeni diila nna mwuli. Ba weeni ayen, <<Mm fi suoku Ben Yadad.>> Naawa a weeni ayen, <<Ni ga ta wa a jam.>> Ase ba ale ga ta Ben Yadad a jam la, Ayab yaa basi ate wa jueli wa torokowa.
34Ben Yadad yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Mi ale pa tɛŋsaŋa ate mi kowa a jam tuesi fi kowa jigi la a ŋman te fu, fi baga a dueni fidek yaba kama Damasikus tɛŋka po ase mi kowa ale jam nye dii Samaria la.>> Ayab weeni ayen, <<Ase fi dan siak kude mi ale basi ate fi cheŋ fasiyaa.>> Wa yaa nye nɔiyeŋ ale wa ale basi wa ate wa cheŋ.
35Naawen wanni nyiŋ biisiteerɔba bisa wanyi a weeni wa vaanchoa ayen, <<Chub mu ale fi kpaliŋ jaamu,>> alege nuruwa a zɛri. 36Biisiteerɔwa ayen, <<Fi ale kan siak a te Naawen la nyiŋ, fi dan ga a basi mi gbeŋli ale ko fu.>> Ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ nuruwa ale ga cheŋ la gbeŋli yaa nya wa a ko wa.
37Biisiteerɔwa a jam nya ka nuru wa choa ayen, <<Mi a saalim chub mu.>> Dila nuruma a yaa chub wa a te wa tuem. 38Biisiteerɔwa yaa jam ga za suiku niŋ a limisi naawa. Wa jam pa ka garuk a bobi lik wa ninaŋa ayen waai a kan miŋ wa. 39Ase naawa ale a taam la, biisiteerɔwa yaa wi wa ayen, <<Fi tomteerɔwa a jo ka kpaliŋ nummu po, ate waai a jam mi jigi ale nagyigrɔ ayen a nya nuruwa de a te mu. Wa dan vari cheŋ fi ale kpi a tuni yaase fi tuni kpana boorik. 40Ase fi tomteerɔwa nina ale muni dela ale dula la, nuruwa yaa muriŋ bɛ.>> Izirali naawa yaa weeni ayen, <<Ka fi tutuna ale la, fidek ale mooli.>>
41Biisiteerɔwa yaa kpabi a lagri garukku ate wa pa bobi wa ninaŋa la, ate Izirali naawa a miŋ wa ase biisiteerɔma wanyi la. 42Wa jam weeni naawa ayen, <<Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna, <Fi basi nuru waai ate mi a weeni ayen wa kpi la a cheŋ kama fasiyaa.
