48Ba Livai chaama a jam a nya ka tuima nŋala zuk Wen yenni viuku po. 49Alege Aaron ale wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale jam a kaab juka tiirita kuŋkuŋku zuk ale a ju ŋan baai nyum ale masa la kuŋkuŋku zuk ale dii meena ale ta wari a nye ale Jigi Dii Ale Ŋmasi Ta Tuilum la, a nye biem duisi basika a te Izirali demma, a ta va chaab ale dii meena ate Moosis Wen tomteerɔwa a weeni la.
50Bade a jam le Aaron ŋaaŋbisaŋa. Eleaza jam ka Aaron nidoabili. Fineyas jam ka Eleaza nidoabili. Abisua jam ka Fineyas nidoabili. 51Bukki jam ka Abisua nidoabili. Uzzi jam ka Bukki nidoabili. Zerayia jam ka Uzzi nidoabili. 52Meraiot jam ka Bukki nidoabili. Amariya jam ka Meraiot nidoabili. Ayitub jam ka Amariya nidoabili. 53Zadok jam ka Ayitub nidoabili. Ayimaaz jam ka Zadok nidoabili.
54Kabtaŋa de ale Aaron ŋaaŋbisaŋa a jam kali la. Wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale nyini Koyat dɔkku buuni la ale jam liŋ tuesi ba boka jigini. 55Ba jam te ba ka Yebron ale bo Juda po la a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa ale gilim ka la. 56Alege tattaŋa ale tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa ale gilim tɛŋ kpieŋka la ba jam pai te ka Jefunne nidoabinni Kaleb.
57Aaron ŋaaŋbisaŋa ba jam te ba ka Yebron tɛŋka, sukka tɛŋ. Ba jam maa te ba ka tɛŋsaŋa de, Libna ale Jattir ale Estemoa ale 58Yilen ale Debir ale 59Asan ale Jutta ale Bet Sɛmes a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsa. 60A nyini Benjamin dɔkku buuni ba jam te ba ka Gibeon ale Geba ale Alemet ale Anatot a gum chaab ale si juijui ale ta wuuk la. Tɛŋsaŋa de ate ba jam chari te Koyat yezuimaŋa la meena jam ka pi ale sita.
61Koyat nidoabi nsila meena ba jam te ba ka tɛŋsa pi a nyini Manasa buuni geli yezuimaŋa po.
62Gerson nidoabilisaŋa, yezuk yezuk, ba jam te ba ka tɛŋsa pi ale sita a nyini Isaka ale Asɛ ale Nafitali diinaŋa buuni ale Manasa dɔkku buuni geli ale bo Basan po la.
63Merari nidoabilisaŋa, yezuk yezuk, ba jam te ba ka tɛŋsa pi ale siye a ta nyini Aruben ale Gad ale Zebulun buuni po.
64Ka Izirali demma ale te Livaima tɛŋsaŋa de a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa. 65A nyini Juda ale Simeyon ale Benjamin buuni po ba te ba ka tɛŋ sii ate ba poom ŋaam wi si yueŋa la.
66Koyat yezuimaŋa gela ba jam te ba ka tɛŋsa a ta nyin Ɛfraim dɔkku buuni po. 67Guutaŋa ale bo tɛŋ kaai po ate ba a wi ayen Ɛfraim la, ba jam te ba ka Sikiim, sukka tɛŋ, ale Gezer ale 68Jokmeam ale Bet Yoron ale 69Aijalon ale Gat Arimmon a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa.
70A nyini Manasa dɔkku buuni genni jigi Izirali demma a jam te Koyat yezuimaŋa meena ale tali la ka Aner ale Bileam tɛŋsaŋa a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa.
71Gerson nidoabilisaŋa a jam tuesi ka tɛŋsaŋa de. A nyini Manasa dɔkku buuni genni yezukku ba jam tuesi ka Golan ale bo Basan po la ale Astarot a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa.
72A nyini Isaka dɔkku buuni ba jam tuesi ka Kedes ale Daberat ale 73Aramot ale Anem a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa.
74A nyini Asɛ dɔkku buuni jigi ba jam tuesi ka Masal ale Abdon ale 75Yukok ale Areyob a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa.
76A nyini Nafitali dɔkku buuni jigi ba jam tuesi ka Kedes ale bo Galili po la ale Yammon ale Kiriataim a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa.
77Merari nidoabilisaŋa, Livaima ale tali la, a jam tuesi ka tɛŋsaŋa de. A nyini Zebulun dɔkku buuni jigi ba jam tuesi ka Arimmono ale Tabor a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa.
78A nyini Aruben dɔkku buuni a lo a jueli Jodan benni Jeriko kori geŋsa la ba jam tuesi ka Bezer ale bo sagni po la ale Jaza ale 79Kedemot ale Mefaat a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa.
80A nyini Gad dɔkku buuni jigi ba jam tuesi ka Aramot ale bo Gilead po la ale Mayanaim ale 81Yesbon ale Jazer a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa.

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 7
Content:
1Isaka nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Tola ale Pua ale Jasub ale Simron. Ba meena ka banaansi.
2Tola nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Uzzi ale Arefaiya ale Jeriel ale Jamai ale Ibsam ale Samuel waai ale jam ka kpagi ba dɔkdemma po la. Deevid naamu vaaŋa po, Tola ŋaaŋbisaŋa ate ba jam ŋmarisi nidoama ase tugurik tɔŋdɔba la jam ka tusa pisiye ale ŋaye ale kobsiyuebi (22,600).
3Uzzi nidoabinni a jam le Izrayia. Izrayia mɛ nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Maakil ale Obadia ale Joel ale Issia. Banuwa meena jam ka nalima. 4A ta va ba gaŋka wie ale ka diila, ba jam taka nidoaba tusa pisita ale ŋayuebi (36,000) a magsi kpaliŋ nyeka, diila ba jam ta ka nipok boari ale bimbaansa. 5Kobirinni baai ale jam ka tugurik nyam la a jam nyini ka Isaka yezuimaŋa ase ba ale ŋmarisi ba wie diila. Ba meena jam ka tusa pinaanuŋ ale ŋayopɔi (87,000).
6Benjamin nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Bela ale Beker ale Jediael. Ba meena ka bata.
7Bela nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Ezbon ale Uzzi ale Uzziel ale Jerimot ale Iri waai ale ka dɔkdemma kpagi la. Ba meena ka banu. Ba gaŋka tugurik nyama wie ale ŋmarisi doa la ka tusa kobsiye ale ŋaye ale pisita ale ŋanaansi (22,034).
8Beker nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Zemira ale Joas ale Ɛlieza ale Elioenai ale Omri ale Jeremot ale Abaija ale Anatot ale Alemet. Bade meena a jam ka Beker nidoabilisa. 9Ba ŋiaka gaŋka wieŋa po ba jam ŋmarisi ka niŋdeerɔba ale tugurik tɔŋdɔba tusa pisiye ale kobsiye (20,200).
10Jediael nidoabinni ale Bilyan. Bilyan nidoabilisaŋa mɛ a jam le Jeus ale Benjamin ale Eyud ale Chenaana ale Zetan ale Tarsis ale Ayisayar. 11Jediael nidoabilisaŋa de meena a jam ka yie nyam. Ba jam ka tusa pi ale ŋayopɔi ale kobsiye (17,200) tugurik nyam a gomsi magsi ba cheŋ ga nye kpaliŋ.
12Ir nidoabilisaŋa a jam ka Suppim ale Yuppim. Ayer nidoabili a jam le Yusim.
13Nafitali nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Jaziel ale Guni ale Jezer ale Sallum, Bilya ŋaaŋbisa ale la.
14Manasa ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale nna: Asriel jam ka wa ŋaaŋbiik. Manasa powa Araam tɛŋka liewa ale jam biak wa. Nipok wala ale jam biak Gilead kowa Makir. 15Makir a jam faari ka nipok a ta nyini Yuppim ale Suppim po. Wa toawa yuei a jam le Maaka. Ŋaaŋbiik ka choa yuei jam le Zelofehad, wa jam biak ka lieba nyiini.
16Makir powa Maaka a jam biak ka nidoabili a te wa yuei ayen Peres. Wa suoku yuei jam le Seres. Peres nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Ulam ale Arakem.
17Ulam nidoabili a jam le Bedan. Gilead nidoabilisaŋa a jam le bade, wa ko ale chim Makir. Makir jam ka Manasa ko. 18Gilead toawa Yammoleket ale jam biak Isod ale Abiezer ale Mala.
19Sɛmida nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Ayian ale Sikiim ale Likyi ale Aniam.
20Ɛfraim ŋaaŋbisaŋa yue ale nna. Ɛfraim nidoabinni a jam le Sutela. Sutela nidoabinni ale Bered. Bered nidoabinni ale Tayat. Tayat nidoabinni ale Eleada. Eleada nidoabinni a jam le Tayat. 21Tayat nidoabinni a jam le Zabad. Zabad nidoabinni a jam le Sutela. Ezer ale Elead a jam cheŋ ka Gat tɛŋka ayen ba vari duŋ buulim ate nuru baai ale bo tɛŋ kpieŋka po la a ko ba. 22Ba kowa Ɛfraim a jam kum ba nyiŋ ka da boari ate wa kobisaŋa a jam ba yik wa. 23Wa jam goa ale wa powa kama ŋmana ate wa yik lɔgi a biak nidoabili. Wa jam te wa yuei ayen ka Beriya dii nyiŋla zubiok ale jam bo wa yenni po. 24Wa lie jam le Seera, waai ale jam se Tɛŋ Bet Yoron ale Ŋmai Bet Yoron ale Uzzen Seera.
25Arefaya jam ka Beriya nidoabili, Aresef jam ka Arefaya nidoabili, Tela jam ka Aresef nidoabili, Tayan jam ka Tela nidoabili, 26Ladan jam ka Tayan nidoabili, Ammiyud jam ka Ladan nidoabili, Elisama jam ka Ammiyud nidoabili, 27Nun jam ka Elisama nidoabili, Josua jam ka Nun nidoabili.
28Ba tɛŋsaŋa ale ba kalisaŋa jiŋŋa a jam le Betel ale ka tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa ate Naaran a bo kori geŋsa, Gezer ale ka tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa a bo yeniŋ geŋsa ate Sikiim ale ka tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa a ga paari Ayya ale ka tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa. 29Tɛŋ sii ale bo Manasa tɛŋ banni la ale Bet San ale Taanak ale Megiddo ale Dor a gum chaab ale si tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa. Izirali nidoabinni Josefi ŋaaŋbisaŋa a jam bo ka tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa de po.
30Asɛ nidoabilisaŋa ale nna: Asɛ nidoabilisaŋa jam le Imnaya ale Isva ale Isvi ale Beriya. Ba toa jam le Seraya.
31Beriya nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Ɛba ale Malkiel. Malkiel jam ka Birzait ko.
32Ɛba jam ka Jaflet ale Somer ale Yotam ale ba toawa Sɛyua ko.
33Jaflet nidoabilisaŋa jam le Pasak ale Bimyal ale Asvat. Bade jam le Jaflet nidoabilisaŋa.
34Somer nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Ayi ale Aroyaga ale Yubba ale Araam.
35Wa suoku Yelem nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Zofa ale Imna ale Seles ale Amal.
36Zofa nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Suaya ale Yarnefer ale Sual ale Beri ale Imra ale 37Bezer ale Yod ale Samma ale Silsa ale Itran ale Beera.
38Jeter nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Jefunne ale Pispa ale Ara.
39Ulla nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Araya ale Yanniel ale Arizia.
40Bade meena jam ka Asɛ ŋaaŋbisa, yie nyam, baai ate ba lueri, kpaliŋdɔ pagrisa, niŋdeerɔ baai ale potim za nalimnyiini. Nidoa baai ale gomsi magsi kpaliŋ, ase ba le ŋmarisi ba ŋiak wieŋa po la jam ka tusa pisiye ale ŋayuebi (26,000).

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 8
Content:
1Benjamin jam ka Bela ko, wa nidoabili kpagni ale la. Asbel ale pasaŋ ate butawa po a chim Ayara ate 2Noya a saari banaansi ate bunuwa po a chim Arafa.
3Bela nidoabilisaŋa a jam ka Addar ale Gera ale Abiyud ale 4Abisua ale Naaman ale Ayoa ale 5Gera ale Sefufan ale Yuram.
6Bade a jam le Eyud ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale chim yie nyam Geba po. Baai ate ba jam fɛ ba ate ba cheŋ Manahat la ale nna: 7Naaman ale Ayija ale Gera waai ale jam fɛ ba ate ba ŋmani cheŋ la. Gera jam ka Uzza ale Ayiyud ko.
8Ba jam biak ka nidoabilisa a te Sayaraim Moab tɛŋka po wa ale jam basi wa pooma Yusim ale Baara la ŋaaŋnyiŋ. 9Wa powa Yodes a jam biak ka Jobab ale Zibia ale Mesa ale Malkam ale 10Jeuz ale Sakia ale Mirma. Bade a jam le wa nidoabilisaŋa. Ba jam ka yie nyam. 11Yusim jam biak ka Abitub ale Elpaal.
12Elpaal nidoabilisaŋa jam ka Eber ale Misam ale Sɛmed. Sɛmed ale jam sɛ Ono ale Lod ale ka tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa, 13Beriya ale Sɛma ale jam ka Elpaal nidoabilisa la jam chim ka niŋdeerɔba a te baai ale jam bo Aijalon la, bala dek ale jam yiak baai ale bo Gat po la a basi.
14Beriya nidoabilisaŋa jam ka Ayio ale Sasak ale Jeremot ale 15Zebadia ale Arad ale Eder ale 16Maakil ale Ispa ale Joya.
17Elpaal nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Zebadia ale Mesullam ale Yizki ale Ɛba 18ale Ismerai ale Izlia ale Jobab.
19Simei nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Jakim ale Zikri ale Zabdi ale 20Elienai ale Zilletai ale Eliel ale 21Adaiya ale Beraiya ale Simrat.
22Sasak nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Ispan ale Eber ale Eliel ale 23Abdon ale Zikri ale Yanan ale 24Yanania ale Iilam ale Antotija ale 25Ifdeya ale Penuel.
26Jeroyam nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Samserai ale Seyaria ale Ataliaya ale 27Jaaresia ale Elaja ale Zikri.
28Bade meena jam ka yie nyam ale nalima ase ku le ŋmarisi ba ŋiaka wie diila, ba jam bo ka Jerusalem tɛŋka po.
29Gibeon kowa a jam boka Gibeon tɛŋka po. Wa powa yuei jam le Maaka, 30wa nidoabili kpagni yuei jam le Abdon a pasaŋ Zur ate Kis pasaŋ ate Baal pasaŋ ate Nadab pasaŋ ate 31Gedor pasaŋ ate Ayio pasaŋ ate Zeker pasaŋ ate 32Miklot a kpeglim nisa, waai ale jam ka Simeaya ko la. Ba mɛ a jam boro a moata ka ba kobisaŋa Jerusalem po.
33Ner jam ka Kis ko, Kis jam ka Sɔɔl ko, Sɔɔl jam ka Jonatan ale Malki Sua ale Abinadab ale Es Baal ko.
34Jonatan nidoabili a jam le Merib Baal, waai ale jam ka Maika ko la.
35Maika nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Piton ale Melek ale Tarea ale Ayazi. 36Ayazi jam ka Jeyoadda ko, Jeyoadda jam ka Alemet ale Azmavet ale Zimri ko. Zimri jam ka Moza ko. 37Moza jam ka Binea ko. Arafaya jam ka wa nidoabili, Eleasaya jam ka Arafaya nidoabili, Azel jam ka Eleasaya nidoabili.
38Azel a jam ta ka nidoabilisa bayuebi. Ba yueŋa abe le Azrikam ale Bokeru ale Ismael ale Searia ale Obadia ale Yanan. Bade meena jam ka Azel nidoabilisa.
39Wa suoku Esek nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Ulam kpagni ale la ate Jeus a pasaŋ, butawa po ka Elifelet. 40Ulam nidoabilisaŋa jam ka baai ale toa baai ale seba tom tɔŋka. Ba jam ta ka nidoabi boari ale ŋaaŋbi boari, ba meena jam ka kook ale pisinu. Bade meena jam ka Benjamin nidoabilisa.

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 9
Content:
1Izirali demma meena yueŋa a jam ŋmarisi kama ase ba ŋiak wieŋa ale ka diila a bo nalima gbaŋka po. Juda demma ba jam nak yik ba kama a ta cheŋ Babilon tɛŋka dii nyiŋla ba ale kan ta wensie la nyiŋ. 2Baai ale dɛ niŋ a ŋman pilim kali badek nitalim po ale badek tɛŋsaŋa po la jam ka Izirali demma gela ale kaabteerɔba ale Livaiba ale Naawen yenni tomteerɔba.
3Baai ale nyini Juda ale Benjamin ale Ɛfraim ale Manasa a bo Jerusalem la jam le nna: 4Utai jam ka Ammiyud nidoabili. Ammiyud jam ka Omri nidoabili. Omri jam ka Imri nidoabili. Imri jam ka Bani nidoabili. Bani jam ka Perezi ŋaaŋbiik. Perezi jam ka Juda nidoabili. 5A nyini Silon demma po. Asaiya ale kpagni ale wa nidoabilisa. 6A nyini Zera demma po jam ka Jeuel. Nuruma ale nyini Juda la jam ka kobsiyuebi ale pineok. 7A nyini Benjamin dɔkku buuni jam ka Mesullam nidoabinni Sallu. Mesullam jam ka Yodavia nidoabili. Yodavia jam ka Yassenuya nidoabili. 8Ibneiya jam ka Jeroyam nidoabili. Elaya jam ka Uzzi nidoabili. Uzzi jam ka Mikri nidoabili. Mesullam jam ka Sefatia nidoabili. Sefatia jam ka Areuel nidoabili. Areuel jam ka Ibnija nidoabili. 9Nuruma ale nyini Benjamin dɔkku buuni po a ŋmarisi bo ba ŋiak wieŋa po la jam ka nuruba kobsaneok ale pisinu ale bayuebi a bo Jerusalem tɛŋka po. Nuruma de meena jam ka yie nyam.
10A nyini kaabteerɔma po jam ka Jedaya ale Jeyoiarib ale Jakin. 11Azariya jam ka Yilkia nidoabili. Yilkia jam ka Mesullam nidoabili. Mesullam jam ka Zadok nidoabili. Zadok jam ka Meraiot nidoabili. Meraiot jam ka Ayitub nidoabili. Ayitub jam le kpagi a nya Wen yenni zuk. 12Ba gela mɛ ale Adaiya wa jam ka Jeroyam nidoabili. Jeroyam jam ka Pasur nidoabili. Pasur jam ka Malkija nidoabili ale Maasai jam ka Adiel nidoabili. Adiel jam ka Jazera nidoabili. Jazera jam ka Mesullam nidoabili. Mesullam jam ka Mesillemit nidoabili. Mesillemit jam ka Immer nidoabili. 13Kaabteerɔma baai ale jam ka yie nyam la ka tusidi ale kobsiyopɔi ale pisiyuebi (1,760). Ba jam ka nuru baai ale baga a tom Wen yenni tuimaŋa la.
14A nyini Livaima po ka Yassub nidoabinni Sɛmaiya. Yassub jam ka Azrikam nidoabili. Azrikam jam ka Yasabia nidoabili. Yasabia a nyini ka Merari dɔkdemma po. 15Ba gela a jam le Bakbakkar ale Yeres ale Galal ale Mika nidoabinni Mattania. Mika jam ka Zikri nidoabili. Zikri jam ka Asaf nidoabili. 16Ba gela mɛ a jam le Sɛmaiya nidoabinni Obadia. Sɛmaiya jam ka Galal nidoabili. Galal jam ka Jedutun nidoabili ale Asa nidoabinni Berekiya. Asa jam ka Elkana nidoabili, waai ale jam bo Netofat demma tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa po la.
17Nansuiŋ limisidɔma jam le Sallum ale Akkub ale Talmon ale Ayiman ale ba suataŋa. Sallum jam le ba niŋdeerɔ a 18bo naawa nansuiŋku nɔi kori geŋsa a ta jam paari vaaŋa de po. Bade ma a jam le nansuiŋ limisidɔma a nyini Livaima po la. 19Sallum jam ka Kore nidoabili. Kore jam ka Ebiasaf nidoabili. Ebiasaf jam ka Koora nidoabili. Sallum ale wa kobisaŋa ale nyini Koora dɔkdemma po la jam ka nansuiŋ limisidɔba ale maara limisi Wen yenni ase ba koma ale jam a nya nansuiŋku ale a jo Naawen boka jigini la. 20Piilimka po Eleaza nidoabinni Fineyas ale jam a nya nansuiŋ limisidɔma zuk ate Naawen a bo ale wa. 21Meselemia nidoabinni Zakaria a jam le Tuka Viuku nansuiŋ nyaarɔwa.
22A gum chaab baai meena ate ba jam lueri ayen ba chim limisidɔba la jam ka nuruba kobsiye ale pi ale baye. Ba jam ŋmarisi ba ase ka ba ŋiaka wie ale jam ka dii ba tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa po la. Nansuiŋ nyaarɔma ka Deevid ale Samuel biisiteerɔwa ale jam lueri ba a zaani dula ale sebchakka. 23Ba ale ba ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale jam a nya Naawen yenni nansuiŋtaŋa zuk, yie dii ate ba a wi ayen viuk la. 24Nansuiŋ ligrisaŋa a jam bo ka kabta bunaansiwa. Kori ale yeniŋ ale wiiluk ale Yeseoku. 25Ba suataŋa a nyiem basi ka ba tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa ale jam tagri ba daa ŋayopɔi. 26Alege nansuiŋ ligrɔ kpaga ŋanaansiwa, baai ale jam ka Livaiba la ate ba ta sebchakka ale ba la, ba pai diinaŋa ale ligraŋa Wen yenni po a nyo ka ba nisima po. 27Ba ale boro ka yokku meena a gilim Wen yenni, dii nyiŋla ba magsi ba a limisi di kama, ba abe ta saafiik kama a lak di saluik meena.
28Ba gela ale jam a nya ŋan baai ate ba taa tom Wen yenni po la, ba nyiem a chiini kama diipo ate ba ta ba a jo la ale diipo ate ba ta ba a nyini la. 29Ba gela mɛ ate ba basi ate ba a nya ŋantomta ale ŋan yona zuk Wen yenni po ale zommu ale daamu ale kpaamu ale ŋan baai nyum ale masa la. 30Alege kaabteerɔma gela ale jam a dam ŋan baai nyum ale masa la. 31Livai ale jam boro wa yuei jam le Mattitia, Koora denɔwa Sallum nidoabi kpagi, ate ba ta sebchakka ale wa a pai tiirim kaabka boroboroku seka a te wa ase wa tuini la. 32Ba suataŋa Koyat kabini gela ale jam a gomsi Vuusum dai boroboroku jazaanimu zuk dai meena.
33Baai ale jam ka yilendisa la, yie nyam Livai dɔkdemma po la, a jam bo ka Wen yenni diinaŋa po ale kan tom tuin yoŋŋoa, dii nyiŋla ba ale jam a nya tuini zuk danni po ale yok meena. 34Bade meena jam ka yie nyam Livai dɔkdemma po. Kpaga ase ba le ŋmarisi dii ba ŋiak wieŋa po la, ba jam bo ka Jerusalem po.
35Gibeon kowa Jeiel a jam bo ka Gibeon tɛŋka po. Wa powa yuei jam le Maaka, 36wa nidoabili kpagni jam le Abdon a pasaŋ Zur a pai te Kis ate wa mɛ a pai te Baal ate Ner pasaŋ ate Nadab pasaŋ ate 37Gedor pasaŋ ate Ayio pasaŋ ate Zakaria pasaŋ ate Miklot a kpeglim nisa. 38Miklot jam ka Simeam ko. Ba mɛ a jam kali moata ka ba kobisaŋa Jerusalem tɛŋka po.
39Ner jam ka Kis ko. Kis jam ka Sɔɔl ko. Sɔɔl jam ka Jonatan ale Malki Sua ale Abinadab ale Es Baal ko.
40Jonatan jam ka Merib Baal ko. Merib Baal a jam ka Maika ko. 41Maika nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Piton ale Melek ale Tarea. 42Ayazi jam ka Jara ko. Jara jam ka Alemet ale Azmavet ale Zimri ko. Zimri jam ka Moza ko. 43Moza jam ka Binea ko. Arefaiya jam ka Binea nidoabili. Eleasaya jam ka Arefaiya nidoabili. Azel jam ka Eleasaya nidoabili. 44Azel jam ta ka nidoabilisa bayuebi. Bala ale Azrikam ale Bokeru ale Ismael ale Searia ale Obadia ale Yanan. Ba jam ka Azel nidoabilisa.

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 10
Content:
1Filistia demma a jam kpaliŋ ale Izirali demma. Izirali demma a jam chali kama, ate ba yega a kpi Gilboa Guuku zuk. 2Filistia demma jam a vi Sɔɔl ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ka nna kparikpari a ko wa nidoabilisaŋa Jonatan ale Abinadab ale Malki Sua. 3Kpaliŋka a jam pagra kama a gilim Sɔɔl ate tɔŋdɔma a tɔŋ wa ale ba peemaŋa, ba jam koani wa kama.
4Sɔɔl a jam weeni wa kpaliŋ kɔlima jiirɔwa kama ayen, <<Yeeri fi gebika a chub mu, kan daa di Filistia demma ale kan gebi ba yoaŋa la ale jam nyo mu chivie po.>> Alege wa kpaliŋ kɔlima jiirɔwa a jam yɔgsa kama ale wa le nye dila, dila Sɔɔl yaa yeeri wadek gebika a yɔk lo ka zuk. 5Ase kpaliŋ kɔlima jiirɔwa ale nya ale Sɔɔl a kpi la, wa mɛ yaa lo wa gebika zuk a kpi. 6Sɔɔl ale wa nidoabilisa batawa a jam kpi kama, wa dɔkdemma meena a jam kpi ka wayeŋ.
7Ase Izirali demma meena ale jam bo viaka po la ale jam nya ale tugurik tommu a chali, ate Sɔɔl ale wa nidoabilisaŋa kpi la, ba yaa banti ba tɛŋsaŋa ale chali. Ate Filistia demma a jam kali si po.
8Dai dii ale pasaŋ la, ase Filistia demma ale jam ba kɔlim kpiema ŋantaŋa la, ba yaa nya ale Sɔɔl ale wa nidoabilisaŋa a kpi doa Gilboa Guuku zuk. 9Ba jam yeeri wa kpaliŋ ŋantaŋa kama a ta ba ale wa zukku a cheŋ ale tom nuruba Filistia tɛŋka po meena ate ba ga mooli wapaalaŋa a te ba wenaŋa ale ba nuruma. 10Ba jam pai wa kpaliŋ kɔlimaŋa a nyo ka ba wenaŋa dɔkku po ale pai wa zukku a saŋ ba wenni Dagon dɔkku po.
11Ase Jabes Gilead demma meena ale ga wom dii meena ate Filistia demma a nye Sɔɔl la, 12ba nidoa tuasaŋa meena yaa ga pai Sɔɔl nyiŋka ale wa nidoabilisaŋa nyiŋsaŋa a ta jam Jabes. Ba jam gu ba kobaŋa ka Jabes tiib kpiemu kiri ale bobi nɔi daa ŋayopɔi.
13Sɔɔl a jam kpi kama dii nyiŋla wa jam ka wensie ale Naawen ya, wa an jam ta Naawen wanni ale cheŋ nipok sampoporik jigi a yaali ganika ale 14an begi Naawen ya. Dila nyiŋ ate Naawen a ko wa ale pai naamu a te Jese nidoabinni Deevid.

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 11
Content:
1Izirali demma meena yaa jam jigi yeŋ a cheŋ Deevid jigi Yebron po ayen, <<Tama ka fidek nyiŋlam ale ziim. 2Bena ale taam la, diipo ate Sɔɔl a chim naab la, ka fi ale jam de Izirali demma niŋ tugurik tom kpaliŋsaŋa po. Ate Naawen dii ale ka fi Wenni la a weeni fu ayen, <Fi ale chim naapeerik a kasi mi nuruma Izirali demma abe fi a nya ba zuk.> >>
3Ase Izirali nisɔmma ale jan jam Naab Deevid jigi Yebron tɛŋka po la, wa yaa nye nɔiyeŋ ale ba Yebron po Naawen niŋ, ba jam bobi Deevid ka naab ate wa a nya Izirali zuk ase Naawen ale jam puulim dii ale Samuel la.
4Deevid ale Izirali demma meena yaa gɔk santiri a cheŋ Jerusalem, Jebus ale la. Jebus demma baai ale jam bo dula la 5a weeni Deevid ayen, <<Fi a kan jo dela.>> Alege Deevid a jam nak yik Zayon tɛŋka ate parik pagrisa a gilim ka la, Deevid tɛŋ kpieŋka.
6Deevid jam weeni ayen, <<Nuru waai ale wa siti Jebus demma la ale chim ka kpagi a nya mi tugurik tommu zuk.>> Zeruiya nidoabinni Joab ale jam dɛ niŋ, dila wa yaa tuesi kpaŋtaŋa.
7Deevid yaa jam bo tɛŋka ate ba sɛ parisa a gilim la po, dila nyiŋ ka yuei jam le Deevid tɛŋ. 8Deevid yaa ŋman sɛ tɛŋka, a piilim juijui ate ba palinti tɛŋka la a cheŋ parika ale gilim tɛŋka la. Joab mɛ ale jam gomsi tɛŋka kabitaŋa gela. 9Ate Deevid yaa jam ŋmasi pagra a gum du dii nyiŋla Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale jam bo ale wa.
10Bade a jam le Deevid nuru kpientaŋa niŋdeerɔba baai ale jam maari ate wa naamu a pagra la. Nuruma de ale Izirali meena a jam maari Deevid naamu kama ate bu teeri paari tɛŋka meena, ase Naawen ale puulim la. 11Bade a jam le Deevid nuru kpientaŋa. Yachmoni denɔwa Jasobeam ale jam chim kpaŋŋa kpagi, wa jam pai wa gbaluku a ko ka nuruba kobsita, wa jam ko ba ka kpaliŋ yeŋ po.
12Waai ale pasaŋ wa la ka Ayoyi denɔwa Dodai nidoabinni Eleaza, wa jam ka nuru kpienta batawa po wanyi. 13Wa jam bo ale ka Deevid Pas Dammim po, ate Filistia demma a tigsi dula a magsi kpaliŋ la. Juijui ate za a boro la, tugurik tommu a jam yiti chali kama ale basi Filistia demma. 14Alege talimu suŋsuŋ ba jam chiib zaani kama. Ba jam zɛri ka badek nyiŋ a chub Filistia demma a lɔnsi, ate Naawen a te ba nak dɛka.
15Nuruba bata ale nyini tugurik tɔŋdɔba kpaga pisitawa po a jam Deevid jigi piuŋku vɔrumu ale bo Adullam po la, alege ate Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma a bo Arefaim Viaka po. 16Dila po Deevid jam bo ka pagrimu jigini, alege ate Filistia demma tugurik tɔŋdɔma tigsuŋku a bo Betiliyem. 17Deevid yaa jam a yaali nyiam a weeni ayen, <<Dan ka waai ate wa yaali nyiam vinni ale moata Betiliyem nansuiŋku la a te mu.>> 18Nuru pagrisaŋa batawa yaa cheŋ va Filistia demma tomtomaŋa po a ga ŋari nyiam vinni ale moata Betiliyem nansuiŋku la a ji bu ta ga te Deevid. Alege wa zɛri wa an nyu ya, wa goanti kpiiri bu basi ka Naawen niŋ, 19ale weeni ayen, <<Ku yalima ale mi Wen yaa, ate mi a nye kude. Ku ale nye ase mi a nyu ka nuruma de ziim la, baai ale kan kpaliŋ ba nyuvooŋa nyiŋ a ta bu jam te mi la.>> Dila nyiŋ Deevid a jam zɛri kama an nyu bu. Nuru pagrisaŋa de batawa ale jam nye diila ale nna.
20Joab suoku Abisai ale jam chim Pisitawa kpagi. Wa jam pai wa gbaluku a tu chaab ale ka nuruba kobsita, baai ate wa ko, ate wa yuei a yiti ase mbala Pisitawa la. 21Wa jam ta zula a gaam mbala Pisitawa ale chim ba kpagi, alege wa jam daa Batawa po.
22Jeyoiada nidoabinni Benaya ale nyini Kabzeel la, a jam tua kama ale kpaliŋ nyeka, waai ale jam nye wakpiema nna yegayega. Wa jam ko ka Moab tɛŋka nidoaba dek baye. Wa jam siŋ ka vɔrup po mɛ ŋmoruk tana dai a ko gbeŋli. 23Wa jam ko Ejipiti tɛŋka denɔ waai woglim ale jam paari ka anamagib pi. Ejipiti denɔwa a jam ta ka gbaluk wa nisaŋa po ase yɔgdɔ chib la, alege Benaya a jam siti wa kama ale doari. Wa jam chiak gbaluku kama Ejipiti denɔwa nisa po a ko wa ale wadek gbaluku. 24Wieŋa de ate Jeyoiada nidoabinni Benaya a jam nye la. Wa jam ta yuei ase ka mbala Batawa la. 25Wa jam nya zula a gaam mbala Pisitawa meena kama, alege wa an jam gum nuruba Batawa po. Ate Deevid a basi ate wa a nya wa ganidɔma zuk.
26Wa nuru kpientaŋa ale nna: Joab suoku Asayel ale Dodo nidoabinni Elhanan a nyini Betiliyem ale 27Yaror denɔwa Sammot ale Pelon denɔwa Yelez ale 28Ikkes nidoabinni Ira ale nyini Tekoa la ale Abiezer ale nyini Anatot la 29ale Sibbekai ale ka Yusat denɔ la ale Ilai ale ka Ayoyi denɔ la ale 30Mayarai ale ka Netofat denɔ la ale Baanaya nidoabinni Yeled ale ka Netofat denɔ la ale 31Itai ale ka Aribai nidoabili a nyini Gibea ale bo Benjamin tɛŋka po la ale Benaya ale ka Piraton denɔ la. Ba gela ale 32Yurai a nyini Gaas vooliŋka geŋsa la ale Abiel ale ka Arbat denɔ la ale 33Azmavet ale ka Bayarum denɔ la ale Eliahba ale ka Saalbon denɔ la ale 34Gizon denɔwa Yasem nidoabilisaŋa jam le, Sagee nidoabinni Jonatan ale ka Yarar denɔ la ale 35Sakar nidoabinni Ayiam ale ka Yarar denɔ la ale Ur nidoabinni Elifal ale 36Yefer ale ka Mekerat denɔ la ale Ayija ale ka Pelon denɔ la ale 37Yezro ale ka Karmel denɔ la ale Ezbai nidoabinni Naarai ale 38Joel ale ka Natan suok la ale Yagri nidoabinni Mibyar ale 39Zelek ale ka Ammon denɔ la ale Nayarai ale ka Beerot denɔ la. Nayarai jam ka Zeruiya nidoabili Joab kpaliŋ kɔlima jiirɔ. Mbala mɛ ale 40Itri denɔwa Ira ale Itri denɔwa Gareb ale 41Yit denɔwa Yuraya ale Alai nidoabinni Zabad ale 42Siza nidoabinni Adina ale ka Aruben dɔkku denɔ la. Adina jam ka Aruben dɔkku kpagi ale nuruba pisitawa ale bo ale wa la. 43Mbala ale Maaka nidoabinni Yanan ale Mitni denɔwa Josafat ale 44Asterat denɔwa Uzzia ale Yotam nidoabilisaŋa Sama ale Jeiel. Yotam ale ka Aroer denɔ la. 45Mbala jam le Simri nidoabinni Jediael, wa suoku Joya ale ka Tizi denɔ la ale 46Mayav denɔwa Eliel ale Elnaam nidoabilisaŋa Jeribai ale Josavia, ale Moab denɔwa Itma ale 47Eliel ale Obed ale Mezoba denɔwa Jaasiel.

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 12
Content:
1Nidoama de ale jan jam Deevid jigi Ziklag po ase Kis nidoabinni Sɔɔl ale jam yiak wa a basi la. Ba jam maa gum ka tugurik nyama po baai ale jam maari wa kpaliŋ ka po la. 2Ba jam ta ka tima a baga a tɔŋ peema ale a nak visiŋ tana ale ba juga yaase ba gala nisaŋa, ba jam ka Sɔɔl nuruba a nyini Benjamin dɔkku buuni po.
3Ayiezer a jam le ba niŋdeerɔ, Joas a jam maa boro kama. Ayiezer ale Joas jam ka Sɛmaaya nidoabilisa, baai ale nyini Gibea tɛŋka la. Azmavet nidoabilisaŋa Jeziel ale Pelet a jam maa boro kama. Berakaya ale Anatot denɔwa Jeyu jam gum du kama. 4Ismaiya ale nyini Gibeon tɛŋka la a jam boro, wa jam ka nuruba Pisitawa po wanyi. Chekki wa jam le nuruba Pisitawa niŋdeerɔ. Jeremaya ale Jayaziel ale Joyanan ale Jozabad ale nyini Gederat tɛŋka la a jam boro kama. 5Baai ale jam maa boro la ale Eluzai ale Jerimot ale Bealia ale Sɛmariya. Sefatia ale nyini Yaruf la a jam boro kama. 6Koora demma Elkana ale Issia ale Azarel ale Joezer ale Jasobeam a jam maa boro kama. 7Gedor denɔwa Jeroyam nidoabilisaŋa Joela ale Zebadia mɛ jam boro kama.
8Gad demma gela ale jam ga gum Deevid po wa pagrimu ale jam bo juijui la sagni po. Ba jam ka tugurik tɔŋdɔ baai ale toa la, a gomsi magsi kpaliŋ ale baga a yik kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsinta ale gbatta. Ba nimbidaasaŋa jam a nye ase ka gbeŋma nimbidaasaŋa la, a korisi ase walisa ale bo guuta zuima la.
9Ezer a jam le ba kpagi ate Obadia a pasaŋ ate Eliab pasaŋ 10ate Mismanna nye bunaansi ate Jeremaya a chim bunu nyɔnɔ. 11Buyuebiwa po ka Attai buyopɔiwa a chim Eliel ate 12Joyanan a nye naaniŋ. Neokku jam ka Elzabad ate 13Jeremaya a nye pi ate pi ale bunyiwa a chim Makbannai.
14Gad dɔkku demma de jam ka tugurik tɔŋdɔba kpaga, waai ale wobsa ba po la a tu chaab ale ka nuruba kook ate pagrɔ a tu chaab ale nuruba tusidi. 15Ku abe jam ka bala ale lo Jodan benni a jueli piilimka chiika po ase benni ale jam mobi pinpantaŋa la, a basi ate waai meena jam bo vaasaŋa po kori ale yeniŋ geŋsa la a yiti chali la.
16Benjamin dɔkku dem gela ale Juda dɔkku dem gela mɛ a jan jam Deevid jigi wa pagrimu jigini. 17Deevid yaa nyini peelim wa tu ba ale weeni ba ayen, <<Ase ni dan jam mi jigi ale suiyɔgni, ayen ni maari mu, mi gomsi kama ayen, <<Ni nye nɔiyeŋ ale mu. Alege ni dan jam kama ayen ni bobri mi wie a te mi dachaasaŋa alege ate mi an nye ni wari ya, ti koma Wenni abe nya a bo ni buusa.>>
18Wen Chiika yaa jam Amasai jigi waai ale ka kpagi nuruba Pisita zuk la ate wa weeni ayen, <<Deevid, tama ka fi nuruba. Tama a bo ale ka fi, Jese nidoabili yaa! Suiyɔgni, suiyɔgni a jam fi jigi, abe suiyɔgni a cheŋ baai ale a maari fi la jigi, ate fi Wenni ale maari fu.>> Dila Deevid yaa tuesi ba a basi ate ba chim wa tugurik tommu niŋdeerɔba.
19Manasa dɔkku demma gela ale jam ga gum Deevid po diipo ate wa ale Filistia demma le cheŋ ba nye kpaliŋ ale Sɔɔl la. Wa ale wa nuruma an jam maari Filistia demma dii nyiŋla, ba ale jam wom nyini chaab jigi la, ba niŋdeerɔma a jam zɛri kama. Ba weeni ayen, <<Ti nyuvooŋa a bo ka wari po ase wa a nin ŋman cheŋ wa kpagni Sɔɔl jigi.>> 20Ase Deevid ale jam cheŋ Ziklag la, Manasa nidoama de ale jam ga gum Deevid po la. Bala abe le Adnaa ale Jozabad ale Jediael ale Maakil ale Jozabad ale Eliyu ale Zilletai. Ba jam a nya ka tugurik tom tusa zuk Manasa dɔkku buuni po. 21Ba jam maari Deevid kama ate wa kpaliŋ ale baai ale jam boro a vari nuruma la, diila ba meena jam ka kpaliŋ nyeerɔ tuasa, ate ba jam chim kpaga wa tugurik tommu zuk. 22Dai meena ale a taam la nidoaba ale jam a maari Deevid ate ku paari diipo ate wa ta tugurik tom ate bu zuak ase Wen tugurik tommu la.
23Nidoama de nɔi ale jam ka dii a gomsi magsi kpaliŋ a jam Deevid jigi Yebron po ayen ba tulim Sɔɔl naamu a te Deevid ase Naawen ale weeni la. 24Juda dɔkku nuruma ale jam a ji kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsintaŋa ale gbattaŋa la jam ka tusa ŋayuebi ale kobsinaaniŋ (6,800) a gomsi magsi kpaliŋ. 25Simeyon dɔkku tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale gomsi a magsi kpaliŋ la jam ka tusa ŋayopɔi ale kook (7,100). 26Livai dɔkku nidoama jam ka tusa ŋanaansi ale kobsiyuebi (4,600), 27a gum chaab ale Jeyoiada ale ka Aaron dɔkdemma niŋdeerɔ la ale nidoaba tusa ŋata ale kobsiyopɔi (3,700) ale 28Zadok tugurik tɔŋdɔ paalik tuak ale kpaga pisiye ale ŋaye a nyini wa dɔkdemma po. 29Benjamin dɔkku demma, Sɔɔl dek nuruma jam ka tusa ŋata (3,000), ba yega a jam bo ale ka Sɔɔl wa vaaŋa po alege yɔgyɔgla de ba va ka Deevid. 30Ɛfraim dɔkku nidoama, tugurik tɔŋdɔ tuasa, a ta yuei ba yezuimaŋa po la jam ka tusa pisiye ale kobsinaaniŋ (20,800). 31Manasa dɔkku genni nidoama ate ba te ba yueŋa ayen ba jam bobi Deevid naab la jam ka tusa pi ale naaniŋ (18,000). 32Isaka dɔkku, baai ale seba diipo ale magsi ba nye kpaliŋ ale seba Izirali demma ale ba nye diila jam ka kpaga kobsiye (200) a nya badek nuruma zuk. 33Zebulun dɔkku nidoama tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale nye kpaliŋ nya a gomsi magsi kpaliŋ ale kpaliŋ jaab meena, ayen ba maari Deevid ale popola yena la, jam ka tusa pisinu (50,000). 34Nafitali dɔkku kpaŋŋa jam ka tusidi a gum chaab ale nidoa baai ale a ji kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsintaŋa ale gbattaŋa la jam ka tusa pisita ale ŋayopɔi (37,000). 35Dan dɔkku nidoama ale jam gomsi magsi kpaliŋ la jam ka tusa pisiye ale naaniŋ ale kobsiyuebi (28,600). 36Asɛ dɔkku tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale nye kpaliŋ a nya, gomsi magsi kpaliŋ la jam ka tusa pisinaansi (40,000). 37A nyini Jodan beni kori geŋsa, Aruben dɔkku ale Gad dɔkku ale Manasa dɔkku ale kpesi badek ale kpaliŋ ale kpaliŋ jaab meena la, jam ka tusa kook ale pisiye (120,000).
38Bade meena jam ka tugurik tɔŋdɔba a pai badek te ayen ba tom. Ba jam Yebron tɛŋka po kama a gomsi paari ayen ba bobi Deevid Naab Izirali meena zuk. Izirali dem mbala meena mɛ a jam ta ka popola yena ayen ba bobi Deevid naab. 39Nidoama meena a jam bo ale Deevid ka daa ŋata a dɛ ale a nyu, diila ba dɔkdemma a jam te ba ka ŋandiinta. 40Ba nuruma ale bo Isaka ale Zebulun ale Nafitali diinaŋa la a jam ji ka ŋandiinta ale bonsa ale laalaakomiba ale wusum bonsa ale lalisa a jam te ba. Ba jam te ba ka ŋandiinta nna yegayega tila ale zom ale kiŋkama maasa ale yɔna maasa ale daam ale kpaam ale niiga ale piisa, diila masim ale jam bo Izirali tɛŋka.

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 13
Content:
1Deevid yaa jam biisi ale wa tugurik tommu kpaŋŋa, kpaga ŋaai ale a nya tusa zuk la ale kpaga ŋaai ale a nya kobsa zuk la. 2Wa yaa jam weeni Izirali tigsuŋku meena ayen, <<Ase ku dan chim wamaŋ a te ni ase ku dan ka Naawen ti Wenni yaalika, basi ate ti tom a weeni ate ku cheŋ niŋniŋŋa a waaŋ paari ti suataŋa meena jigi Izirali tɛŋka po meena, ale kaabteerɔma ale Livaima baai ale bo ale ba ba tɛŋsaŋa po la ale wuuk tɛŋsaŋa la, ate ba jam a gum ti po. 3Ni basi ate ti ta Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a ŋman jam ti jigi, ale tama an bek di wari diipo ate Sɔɔl a dɛ naam la.>> 4Tigsuŋku meena yaa siak ayen ba nye kude, dii nyiŋla ku jam magsi kama a te nuruma meena.
5Dila nyiŋ Deevid yaa tigsi Izirali demma meena, a nyini Siyor Benaŋka ale bo Ejipiti po la ga paari Yamat tɛŋka ayen ba ta Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a nyini Kiriat Jearim a jam. 6Deevid ale Izirali demma meena yaa cheŋ Baalaya ale bo Juda la Kiriat Jearim ale la ayen ba ta Wen dii ale ka Naawen la nɔiyeŋka dakanni a nyini dula a jam, dii ale jam bo ŋanvutaŋa suŋsuŋ la dakanni ate ba pai wa Yuenni a wi di la.
7Ba jam ta Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a nyini Abinadab yenni ale ka toroko paalik, ate Uzzaya ale Ayio a nya di zuk. 8Deevid ale Izirali demma meena a jam boro a naŋ kama ale ba pagrim meena Wen niŋ ale yiila ale kpanta ale bagansa ale sinyaara ale dalinkinkeŋsa ale damunsa.
9Ase ba ale jam paari Kidon ŋanta fɔbika jigini la, Uzzaya yaa laari wa nisaŋa ayen wa yik dakanni, dii nyiŋla lalisaŋa nyiŋsa ale jam a gɔk. 10Naawen sui yaa jam puuri ale Uzzaya, ate wa ko wa dii nyiŋla wa jam tiri dakanni kama ale nisa. Wa jam kpi ka dula Wen niŋ.
11Deevid sui yaa jam puuri dii nyiŋla Naawen suipuurumu ale jan jam Uzzaya zuk la, a ta jam paari jinla danni dula yuei ale Perezi Uzzaya.
12Deevid yaa jam yɔgsa ale Wen dai dila danni a bek ayen, <<Mi ale nye ka sɛ a ta Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a jam m jigi yaa?>> 13Wa an jam te Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a va wa a cheŋ Deevid Tɛŋka po. Wa goanti ta di a cheŋ ka Gitti denɔwa Obed Edom yenni. 14Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a jam wari bo ka Obed Edom dɔkdemma jigi wa yenni po a paari chiisa sita ate Naawen a niak wa yenni meena ale jabuui meena ate wa ta la.

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 14
Content:
1Taaya naawa Yiram yaa jam tom nuruba naab Deevid jigi ale nyunyoŋta, ale baai ale seba tana yie seka la ale seba daata nakka la ayen ba ga sɛ naab yeri a te wa. 2Deevid a jam seba kama ayen Naawen bobi wa ka naab Izirali zuk ate wa naamu yuei a yiti wa nuruma Izirali demma nyiŋ.
3Jerusalem po Deevid a jam faari ka nipok boari a biak nidoabilisa ale lieba nna yegayega. 4Wa ale jam biak baai dula la yueŋa ale Sammua ale Sobab ale Natan ale Solomon 5ale Ibyar ale Elisua ale Elpelet ale 6Noga ale Nefeg ale Jafia ale 7Elisama ale Beeliada ale Elifelet.
8Ase Filistia demma ale ga wom ayen Deevid a chim naab Izirali demma meena zuk la, ba yaa jam nyini a gisi wa, alege Deevid a jam wom ku wari kama a nyini ayen wa tu ba. 9Filistia demma a jam bo ka Arefaim Viaka po. 10Deevid yaa bek Wen ayen, <<M ga siti Filistia demma? Fi ale pai ba a te mu?>> Ate Naawen a tulisi wa ayen, <<Cheŋ, mi ale pai ba a te fu.>>
11Deevid ale wa nidoama yaa cheŋ Baal Perazim, dula jigini wa jam nya pagrim ba zuk. Wa weeni ayen, <<Ase nyiam ale mobi a nyini diila, Wen sui a puuri ale mi dachaasaŋa ate mi a siti ba.>> Dila nyiŋ ate dula yuei a chim Baal Perazim la. 12Filistia demma a jam banti ba wenaŋa kama dula jigini, ate Deevid a weeni ayen ba ju ŋa ale bolim.
13Filistia demma a ŋman ga bo viaka po. 14Dila Deevid yaa bek Wen ŋmana ate Wen a tulisi wa ayen kan deri a cheŋ yɔrr, cheŋ a gilim ba a siti ba a nyini puuta tiimu niŋka. 15Ase fi dan ga wom santiri nuemka puuta tiimu zukparuk, nyini a cheŋ kpaliŋka jigini, dii nyiŋla, dila kiri ale Wen a dɛ ka fi niŋ wa ko Filistia tugurik tommu.>> 16Deevid a jam nye ka dii ate Wen a weeni wa la, ba jam ko Filistia tugurik tommu kama a nyini Gibeon a ta ga paari Gezer tɛŋka.
17Deevid yuei a jam yiti kama tɛŋ meena po, ate Naawen a nye ate tɛŋsa meena a chali wa yɔgsum.

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 15
Content:
1Deevid ale jam sɛ yee a te wadek tɛŋka po la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, Deevid a jam gomsi ka jigi a magsi Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni ale ti viuk a magsi di. 2Deevid a yaa weeni ayen, <<Ka Livaima nyiini ale ba a ji Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni, dii nyiŋla Naawen ale lueri ba ayen ba a ji Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni abe ba a tom a te wa taam wuu.>>
3Deevid yaa jam tigsi Izirali demma meena Jerusalem po ayen wa ta Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a jam juijui ate wa gomsi a magsi di la po. 4Wa jam wi ka Aaron ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale Livaima ate ba jam jigi yeŋ.
5A nyini Koyat ŋaaŋbisaŋa po, jam ka Uriel ale niŋdeerɔ ale suata kook ale pisiye. 6A nyini Merari ŋaaŋbisaŋa po, Asaiya jam le niŋdeerɔ ale suata kobsiye ale pisiye. 7A nyini Gerson ŋaaŋbisaŋa po, Joel jam le ba niŋdeerɔ ale suata kook ale pisita. 8A nyini Elizafan ŋaaŋbisaŋa po, Sɛmaiya a jam le ba niŋdeerɔ ale suata kobsiye. 9A nyini Yebron ŋaaŋbisaŋa po, Eliel jam le niŋdeerɔ ale suata pinaanuŋ. 10A nyini Uzziel ŋaaŋbisaŋa po, Amminadab jam le niŋdeerɔ ale suata kook ale pi ale baye.
11Deevid yaa jam wi kaabteerɔma Zadok ale Abiata ale Livaima Uriel ale Asaiya ale Joel ale Sɛmaiya ale Eliel ale Amminadab ayen ba jam. 12Wa jam weeni ba ayen, <<Nama ale yie nyam Livaima dɔkdemma po, nama ale ni Livai chaama a magsi ka ni gomsi nidek a ta Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni, Izirali Wenni a jam juijui ate mi a gomsi magsi di la. 13Ku be jam ka nama Livaima ale kan jam ta di a jam piilimka po la nyiŋ ale soa ate Naawen ti Wenni sui a jam puuri ale ti. Ti an jam bek wa a wom dii ate ti le nye a ta va wa ale weeni diila.>> 14Kaabteerɔma yaa gomsi badek ayen ba ta Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni, Izirali Wenni a jam. 15Ate Livaima yaa ji Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni ale daata ba maŋkpalaŋa zuk ase Moosis ale jam weeni dii a ta va Naawen wanni la.
16Deevid yaa jam weeni Livaima niŋdeerɔma ayen ba lueri ba suataŋa ase yi lendisa la ale bagansa ale kpanta ale dalinkinkeŋsa a lenni mariŋka yiila.
17Livaima yaa lueri Joel nidoabinni Yeman, a nyini ba suataŋa po ka Berekiya nidoabinni Asaf ate ba lueri, a nyini ba suataŋa Merari kabini po ka Kusaiya nidoabinni Etan ate ba lueri. 18A gum ba po ka ba suata ti chaama ale jam ta kpaŋta la. Bala ale Zakaria ale Jaaziel ale Sɛmiramot ale Jeyiel ale Unni ale Eliab ale Benaya ale Maaseiya ale Mattitia ale Elifeleyu ale Mikneiya ale Obed Edom ale Jeiel, nansuiŋ limisidɔma.
19Yi lendisaŋa Yeman ale Asaf ale Etan ale ba kutuk mɔnuŋ dalinkinkeŋsaŋa. 20Zakaria ale Aziel ale Sɛmiramot ale Jeyiel ale Unni ale Eliab ale Maaseiya ale Benaya ale ba nak baganisaŋa a ta va chaab ale alamot, 21ate Mattitia ale Elifeleu ale Mikneiya ale Obed Edom ale Jeiel ale Azaziya ale jam ayen ba a nak kpantaŋa a sak a ta va chaab ale seminit. 22Kenania Livaima kpagni ale jam a nya yiilaŋa zuk, wa tuini jam le la dii nyiŋla wa ale jam kperi ale yiila lennika.
23Berekiya ale Elkana ale jam ayen ba a nya dakanni nansuiŋku. 24Sebania ale Josafat ale Netanel ale Amasai ale Zakaria ale Benaya ale Ɛlieza kaabteerɔwa ale jam ayen ba a peeri damunsaŋa Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni niŋ. Obed Edom ale Jeyia mɛ a jam maari a nya ka dakanni nansuiŋku.
25Dila nyiŋ Deevid ale Izirali nisɔmma ale tugurik tɔŋdɔ kpaŋŋa ale a nya tusa zuk la yaa jam cheŋ ayen ba ta Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a nyini Obed Edom yenni a jam ale mariŋka. 26Dii nyiŋla wen jam maari Livaima baai ale jam ji Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni la kama, lalisa siyopɔi ale padaasa siyopɔi ate ba jam pa nye kaabka. 27Deevid a jam jo ka garuk geli ase Livaima meena baai ale jam ji dakanni la, ase yi lendisaŋa ale Kenania waai ale jam a nya yi lendisaŋa zuk la meena ale jam jo ba gattaŋa diila. 28Izirali demma meena yaa jam ta Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a jam a nuem ale padaasa nyiila ale damunsa ale dalinkinkeŋsa ale baganiŋsa ale kpanta nakka.
29Ase Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni ale jam a jo Deevid Tɛŋka po la, Sɔɔl liewa Michal yaa jam liisi va tuokparuk a nya. Ase wa ale nya ale naab Deevid a gɔk a naŋ diila wa sui yaa puuri.

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 16
Content:
1Ba yaa ta Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a jam a pai di a zaani viuku ate Deevid a jam ti magsi di la po, ba jam nye ka juka tiirita ale suiyɔgni tiirita Wen niŋ. 2Deevid ale ga nueri juka tiiritaŋa ale suiyɔgni tiiritaŋa kaabka la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, wa yaa niak nuruma Naawen yuenni nyiŋ. 3Wa yaa jam pai boroborok ale maasa a te Izirali nidoa ale nipok meena.
4Wa jam lueri ka Livaima gela ate ba a tom Naawen dakanni niŋ. Ba ale jam a de nuruma niŋ ate ba a puusi ale a te jiam ale a pak Naawen, Izirali Wenni. 5Asaf a jam le kpagni ate Zakaria pasaŋ a pai vi Jeiel ale Sɛmiramot ale Jeyiel ale Mattitia ale Eliab ale Benaya ale Obed Edom ale Jeiel. Ba ale jam a nak baganisaŋa ale kpantaŋa, Asaf ale jam a nak dalinkinkeŋsaŋa. 6Benaya ale Jayaziel kaabteerɔma ale jam ayen ba a peeri damunsaŋa veruveruk Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni niŋ.
7Dai dila danni Deevid a jam dɛ niŋ a te Asaf ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma ka yiini de ayen ba a te Naawen jiam:
8Te Naawen jiam, a wi wa yuenni basi ate tɛŋsaŋa a seba wa ale nye diila. 9Leni yiila a te wa, lenni pimpauk yiila a te wa, weeni wa wakinkagla nyeelaŋa meena te wa. 10Ta suipeentik wa tuilum yuenni nyiŋ, basi ate baai suiniima ale a gisi Naawen la a ta mariŋka. 11Zak nya Naawen ale wa pagrimu, kasim a gisi wa nimbidiaka diipo meena. 12A teeri wakperikaliisaŋa ate wa nye la wie, wa wakinkaglaŋa ale wa buusaŋa ate wa weeni la. 13Izirali wa tomteerɔwa ŋaaŋbisa, Jekob waai ate wa lueri la nidoabilisaŋa.
14Wa ka Naawen tama Wen, wa buusaŋa a bo tɛŋzuk de meena kama. 15Wa a teeri wa nɔiyeŋka kama taam wuu, wanni ate wa weeni a te gaŋsa tusa la, 16nɔiyeŋka ate wa jam nye ale Abrayam la, pumpuulimaŋa ate wa jam puulim ale Aizik la. 17Wa jam ŋman biisi di wari kama ale Jekob ase sinsaga la, ayen wa weeni Izirali demma ase ka nɔiyeŋ kaai ale ka boro a beni. 18<<Mi ale pai Keenan tɛŋka a te ni ase kauk kuui ale ku chim ni nitalim la.>>
19Ba ale jam kan soa diila, an sum soa diila, ale chim nicham ka po la, 20ba jam bo ka tɛŋsaŋa po a tuinti, a nyini naam po a taam m bu po. 21Wa an jam basi ate nuru a daani ba, ba nyiŋ wa toariŋ nalima. 22Wa weeni ayen, <<Ni kan tiri mi ale lueri baai la, kan nye mi biisiteerɔma wari ya.>>
23Ni lenni yiila a te Naawen, nama tɛŋzuk demma meena, ni mooli wa varibasika wie daa meena. 24Ni weeni wa zulaŋa tɛŋsa meena po, ni weeni wa wakinkaglaŋa ate nuru meena a wom. 25Ale Naawen a ŋmasi zuak ka yega a magsi pimpauk. Wa magsi ba chali wa a gaam wena meena. 26Tɛŋsaŋa meena wenaŋa ka bɔgta, alege ka Naawen ale nye wenŋmazukku. 27Nalim ale naam a bo ka wa niŋ, pagrim ale masim ale bo wa boka jigini. 28Ni pak Naawen tɛŋsa meena tɛŋzuk de ni pak Naawen zulaŋa ale wa pagrimu, 29ni te Naawen zula ŋaai ale magsi wa yuenni la, ni ta tiirim a jam wa niŋ, ni puusi Naawen nalim weleŋsaŋa po. 30Ni te ni nyiŋsa a gɔk wa niŋ tɛŋzuk de meena tɛŋka a feri paari kama, ka kan choa. 31Basi ate wenŋmazukku a dɛ masim, basi ate tɛŋzuk de sui a peenti. Basi ate ba weeni tɛŋsa meena po ayen, <<Naawen a dɛ naam.>> 32Basi ate nyakpiemu a pilim nuem ale ŋan baai meena ale bo bu po la. Basi ate tattaŋa ale jaab meena ale bo ti po la a naŋ. 33Ate tiisaŋa ale bo sagni po la lenni yiila ale masim Naawen niŋ, diila wa cheen wa bo ka tɛŋzuk de buusa.
34Ni te Naawen jiam ale wa ka Naawen maŋ, wa ŋmanteka a boro kama taam wuu. 35Ni kaari a weeni ayen, <<Vari ti a basi, Wen tama varibasidɔ, tigsi ti a vari ti a basi a ta nyini tɛŋsaŋa jigi, ate tama ale te fi tuilum yuenni jiam, ate tama ale ta zula fi pimpaukku po.>> 36Pimpauk a cheŋ Naawen, Izirali Wenni jigi, a kasim a cheŋ taam wuu. Ate nuruma meena jam weeni ayen, <<Ku be nye dila,>> ale <<Pak Naawen.>>
37Deevid yaa jam basi Asaf ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni niŋ ayen ba tom dula veruveruk a ta va chaab ale dii meena ale magsi ba nye la. 38Wa jam maa basi Obed Edom ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔba pisiyuebi ale naanika kama ayen ba a tom ale ba. Obed Edom ale ka Jedutun nidoabili la, ale Yosa, mɛ jam ka nansuiŋ limisidɔba.
39Deevid yaa basi Zadok kaabteerɔwa ale wa kaabteerɔba ba chaama ayen ba bo Naawen viuku po pimpitini ale bo Gibeon po la. 40Ayen ba a nye juka tiirita a te Naawen kuŋkuŋku zuk ate ba a nye juka tiirimu veruveruk la, saluik ale junɔi a ta va dii meena ale ŋmarisi Naawen Sinsaŋŋa po la, ŋaai ate wa te Izirali demma la. 41A gum ba po jam ka Yeman ale Jedutun ale baai meena ate ba jam lueri a ŋmarisi ba yueŋa ayen ba te Naawen jiam la, <<Diila wa ŋmanteka a boro ka dila taam wuu.>> 42Yeman ale Jedutun tuini jam le damunsaŋa peerika sinyaara nakka ale ŋan nagin yonta a magsi yi weleŋsa. Jedutun nidoabilisaŋa a jam bo ka nansuiŋku.
43Nuruma meena yaa basi dula, waai meena a kuli wadek yeri, ate Deevid a ŋmani kuli yeri ayen wa niak wa dɔkdemma.

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 17
Content:
1Deevid ale ga kali wa naab yenni po la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, wa yaa weeni biisiteerɔwa Natan ayen, <<Mi ale nna dela, a bo naab yeri ate ba pai nyunyoŋ daata a sɛ di la po, alege Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a bo viuk po.>>
2Natan yaa tulisi Deevid ayen, <<Dii ate fi ta fi popolaŋa po la nye di ale Wen a bo ale fu kama.>>
3Yok kula Naawen wanni yaa jam Natan jigi ayen, 4<<Cheŋ ga weeni mi tomteerɔwa Deevid ayen, <Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna. Daa fi ale waai ale wa sɛ yeri a te mi a bo di po la. 5Mi an bo yeri po a nyini dai dii danni ate mi ta Izirali demma a nyini Ejipiti po la a jam paari danni de. Mi jam nyini ka viuk po a jo ku choa po, a nyini boka jigi a jo ka choa jigi. 6Mi jam a cheŋ ale Izirali demma meena kama, mi diem weeni ba niŋdeerɔma wanyi baai ate mi weeni ba ayen ba nya mi nuruma zuk la ayen, <<Ka boa ate fi an pai nyunyoŋ daata a sɛ yeri a te mi?>>
7Yɔgyɔgla de, weeni mi tomteerɔwa Deevid ayen, <Dii ate Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La a weeni la ale nna: Diipo ate fi jam chim naapeerik a kasi duŋsa la ate mi a ta fu a jam ayen fi a nya mi nuruma Izirali demma zuk. 8Mi jam bo ale fu kama juijui meena ate fi a cheŋ la, mi abe jam kaasi fi dachaasaŋa meena kama fi niŋ. Yɔgyɔgla de mi ale basi ate fi yuenni a nye ase ka nuru kpientaŋa ale jam bo tɛŋzuk de la yueŋa la. 9Mi ale yaali jigi a te m nuruma Izirali demma abe m te ba jigi ate dila ale basi ate ba ta badek yeri ate daanika a kan ŋman tu ba. Gaasa nyam a kan ŋman namsi ba, ase ku ale jam nye ba piilimka po diila, 10ale jam nye ba dii, diipo ate mi jam lueri niŋdeerɔba m nuruma Izirali demma zuk la. Mi ale nak yik ni dachaasaŋa meena. <<Mi a weeni fu kama ayen Naawen ale sɛ yeri a te fu. 11Ase fi daaŋa a dan nueri ate fi cheŋ ayen fi bo ale fi koma, mi ale lueri ka fi nidoabili ate wa zaani fi nankula po, fidek nidoabilisaŋa po wanyi, mi ale basi ate wa naamu a zaani nalimnyiini. 12Wa ale waai ale wa sɛ yeri a te mi, mi ale basi ate wa naamu a zaani nalimnyiini taam wuu. 13Mi ale chim wa ko ate wa ale chim mi nidoabili. Mi a kan basi m ŋmanteka ale wa ase m le jam basi ŋmanteka ale Sɔɔl diila. 14Mi ale basi ate wa nya mi yenni ale m naamu zuk taam wuu, wa naam zukpaglika ale zaani nalimnyiini taam wuu.
15Natan a jam weeni Deevid a va chaab ale wieŋa de meena ale pai sakka de meena kama. 16Naab Deevid yaa jam cheŋ ga kali Naawen niŋ ayen, <<Mi ka wana, Naawen dii ale ka Wen la, m dɔkdemma ka bana, ate fi nye nnala meena a te mi? 17Fi nye ka nna ase kude an poom magsi fi nina po la Wen yaa, fi poom biisi fi tomteerɔwa chum po yenni wari kama. Fi a nya mi ase ka nuru waai ale ta yuei a gaam nidoaba ale ta yue la, Naawen dii ale ka Wen la.
18<<Ka boa ate Deevid ale weeni fi a gaam fi ale zuli fi tomteerɔwa la? Diila fi seba fi tomteerɔwa kama, 19Naawen yaa, fi tomteerɔwa nyiŋ ale fi yaali ka nyiŋ, fi nye wakpienni de kama ale seba pumpuulimaŋa de meena.
20Waai a karo ase fi la, Naawen yaa, Wen abe karo alege ka fi, ase tama ale wom ale tidek tue la. 21Ka wana ale a nye ase fi nuruma Izirali la, tɛŋ yeŋ kaai tɛŋzuk de baai Wen ale jam nyini ayen wa da tuesi nuruba a te wadek la, abe wa nye yuei a te wadek, abe wa nye wakpiema ale kpazinagsuk wakinkagla, a yiak tɛŋsa a basi fi nuruma niŋ, baai ate fi da tuesi a ta nyini Ejipiti la? 22Fi nye fi nuruma Izirali ka fidek nuruba a taa cheŋ, Naawen yaa, fi ale chim ba Wen.
23<<Yɔgyɔgla de, Naawen, basi ate pumpuulinni ate fi jam nye a ta va fi tomteerɔwa ale wa yenni la a zaani paari taam wuu. Nye ase fi ale jam puulim diila, 24ate dila ale basi ate di zaani paari ate fi yuenni ale yiti taam wuu. Ate nuruba yaa le weeni ayen, <Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, Wen dii ale a nya Izirali zuk la, ka Izirali Wen.> Ate fi tomteerɔwa Deevid yenni ale zaani paari taam wuu.
25<<Fi, mi Wenni, a pai sak fi tomteerɔwa kama ayen fi ale sɛ yeri a te wa. Dila fi tomteerɔwa yaa nya nyiŋbiiri a puusi a te fi. 26Naawen yaa, fi ka Wen. Fi puulim wamaŋsaŋa de a te fi tomteerɔwa kama. 27Yɔgyɔgla de fi sui a peenti kama ate fi niak fi tomteerɔwa yenni, ayen ku le tom du taam wuu fi jigi a cheŋ, fi jigi, Naawen yaa, fi niak di kama, di be le nya niaka taam wuu.>>

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 18
Content:
1Ku ale beni magadek la, Deevid yaa nya pagrim Filistia demma zuk a nak yik ba, a tuesi Gat ale ka tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa ale gilim ka la a ta nyini Filistia demma jigi.
2Deevid a jam maa nya pagrim Moab demma mɛ zuk kama ate ba siak te wa a tuni lampoo.
3Deevid a jam kpaliŋ ale Zoba naawa Yadadezer kama, a ga paari Yamat, ase wa le jam a yaali wa naamu a tati paari Yufiretis Benaŋka la. 4Deevid a jam nak yik ka wa torokoba tusidi ale toroko damdɔba tusa ŋayopɔi (7,000) ale tugurik tɔŋdɔba tusa pisiye (20,000). Wa jam gebi wusumaŋa meena nanjiinaŋa kama ka toroko wusuma kook nyiini.
5Ase Araam demma ale bo Damasikus la ale jam ba maari Zoba naawa Yadadezer la, Deevid a jam ko ba ka tusa pisiye ale ŋaye (22,000). 6Wa jam basi ka tugurik tɔŋdɔba beŋsa Araam tɛŋka naamu ale bo Damasikus po la, ate Araam demma a siak te wa a tuni lampoo. Naawen a jam te Deevid ka nak dekka juijui meena ate wa jam cheŋ la.
7Deevid yaa pai ligmɔniŋ kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsintaŋa ate Yadadezer kpaŋŋa a jam ji la a ta ba a jam Jerusalem po. 8A nyini Tibyat ale Kun, tɛŋ kpieŋ sii ate Yadadezer a soa la, Deevid a jam pai ka kutuk mɔnuŋ nna yegayega, tii ate Solomon a jam pai a nye kutuk mɔnuŋ Nyakpiemu ale zaŋŋa ale kutuk mɔnuŋ ŋantomtaŋa la.
9Ase Yamat naawa Tou ale ga wom ayen Deevid a nya pagrim Zoba naawa Yadadezer tugurik tɔŋdɔma meena zuk la, 10wa yaa tom wa nidoabinni Yadoram naab Deevid jigi ayen wa puusi wa abe wa pak wa ale nak de kpaliŋka Yadadezer waai ale jam ta chaab ale Tou la. Yadoram a jam ta ka ŋanta buuri meena ate ba pai ligmɔniŋ ale kpana ale kutuk mɔnuŋ a nye ba la a jam.
11Naab Deevid a jam pai ŋantaŋa a nyo ka Naawen nisa po ase wa ale jam nye kpanaŋa ale ligmɔniŋka ate ba pai Edom ale Moab ale Amon ale Filistia ale Amalek tɛŋsaŋa po a nye diila.
12Zeruiya nidoabinni Abisai a ko ka Edom dem tusa pi ale naaniŋ (18,000) Yesa Viaka po. 13Wa jam basi ka tugurik tɔŋdɔba beŋsa Edom po ate Edom demma meena a siak te Deevid. Naawen a jam te Deevid ka nak dɛka juijui meena ate wa jam cheŋ la.
14Deevid a jam dɛ naam Izirali meena po, a nye dii ale nala la ale wensie a te wa nuruma meena. 15Zeruiya nidoabinni Joab ale jam a nya tugurik tɔŋdɔma zuk. Ayilud nidoabinni Jeyosafat a jam le gbaŋ ŋmarisidoa. 16Ayitub nidoabinni Zadok ale Abiata nidoabinni Ayimelek jam le kaabteerɔma. Savsa jam le teeridɔwa. 17Jeyoiada nidoabinni Benaya ale jam a nya Keret ale Pelet demma zuk, ate Deevid nidoabilisaŋa a jam chim kpaga a tom ale wa.

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 19
Content:
1Ku ale beni magadek la, Ammon naawa Nayas yaa kpi ate wa nidoabinni a zaani wa naŋ kula po a chim naab. 2Deevid yaa poli ayen, <<Mi ale sak nyemagsika ale Nayas nidoabinni Yanun, dii nyiŋla wa kowa a jam sak ka jiirim ale mu.>> Dila Deevid yaa tom nuruba ayen ba ga puusi wa, wa kowa ale kpi la nyiŋ. Ase Deevid nuruma ale jan jam Yanun jigi Ammon tɛŋka po ayen ba puusi wa la, 3Ammon kpaŋŋa yaa weeni Yanun ayen, <<Fi a poli Deevid a zuli fi kowa kama a tom nuruba ayen ba puusi fu? Wa nuruma an jam fi jigi tɛŋka po ba kpesi nya ka ti tɛŋka a tuesi ka?>> 4Dila nyiŋ Yanun yaa yik Deevid nuruma a chiiri ba teeŋsaŋa, a cheeri ba gattaŋa suŋsuŋsaŋa po ba butagkolaŋa geŋsa a basi ba suik po.
5Ase nuru ale jam weeni Deevid nuruma wie la, wa yaa tom nuruba ayen ba tu ba, ba jam nyo ba ka chivie po nna yegayega. Naawa jam weeni kama ayen, <<Ni bo Jeriko ate ni teeŋsaŋa a chim ate ni ŋman jam.
6Ase Ammon demma ale ga miŋ ayen ba wanni a nyuŋ ka Deevid nyue la, Yanun ale Ammon demma yaa tom nuruba ale kpana ligbie dobrim tusidi ayen ba yaali wusuma torokoba ale toroko damdɔba ate ba nyini Araam Nayaraim ale Araam Maaka ale Zoba tɛŋsaŋa. 7Ba jam tuni tuesi ka torokoba ale damdɔba tusa pisita ale ŋaye (32,000) a pai Maaka naawa tugurik tɔŋdɔma a gum du, baai ale jam kali moata Medeba la, alege ate Ammon demma a tigsi chaab a nyini ba tɛŋsaŋa po a magsi kpaliŋ.
8Deevid ale ga wom kude la, wa yaa tom Joab ate wa nyini ale tugurik tɔŋdɔma meena. 9Ammon demma a jam nyini kama a zaani magsi kpaliŋ ba tɛŋka nansuiŋku nɔi, alege ate nalim ŋaai ale jam badek la a bo tɛŋka peelimmu po.
10Joab yaa nya ayen kpaliŋ ale bo wa niŋ ale wa ŋaaŋ. Dila wa yaa luk lueri tugurik tɔŋdɔ maŋsaŋa gela ale bo Izirali po la ate ba tu chaab ale Araam demma. 11Wa jam pai mbala meena a nyo ka wa suoku Abisai nisa po, ate ba mɛ a nyini tu chaab ale Ammon demma. 12Joab a jam weeni kama ayen, <<Ase Araam demma a dan ŋmasi pagra a te mi, ni yaa jam vari mu a basi, alege Ammon demma a dan ŋmasi pagra a te ni, mi ale vari ni a basi. 13Ni be pagra abe ni basi ate ti kpaliŋ tuotuowa a te ti nuruma ale ti Wenni tɛŋka. Naawen ale nye dii ale nala la wa nimbie po.>>
14Joab ale tugurik tɔŋdɔma yaa cheŋ ba siti Araam demma ate ba yiti chali. 15Ase Ammon demma ale jam nya ale Araam demma a chali la, ba mɛ yaa yiti chali ale ge wa suoku Abisai a jo tɛŋ kpieŋka po. Dila Joab yaa ŋmani cheŋ Jerusalem.
16Araam demma ale ga nya ale Izirali demma a nak yik ba kama la, ba yaa tom wi Araam dem baai ale gaam Benni a kala la ate ba jam ale Yadadezer tugurik tɔŋdɔma niŋdeerɔwa Sofak.
17Ase Deevid ale ga wom kude la, wa yaa tigsi Izirali meena a lo Jodan Benni a jueli, wa jam ga moata ba kama, a zaani wa kpaliŋ zaaniŋa a tuk ba nyiŋ. Deevid a jam nye dila ayen wa siti ka Araam demma, ba jam siti ba kama. 18Alege Araam demma jam yiti chali ale ge Izirali demma, ate Deevid a ko ba toroko damdɔma tusa ŋayopɔi (7,000) ale ba tugurik tɔŋdɔba tusa pisinaansi (40,000). Wa jam ko tugurik tɔŋdɔma kpagni Sofak mɛ kama.
19Ase Yadadezer nuruma ale ga nya ale Izirali demma a nak yik ba la, ba yaa nye nɔiyeŋ ale Deevid a siak te wa. Dila Araam demma an ŋman jam a yaali ba maari Ammon demma diipo diipo.

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 20
Content:
1Fanɔi diipo ate nalima a vuusi a kan cheŋ kpaliŋ po la, Joab ale jam dɛ tugurik tɔŋdɔma niŋ. Wa jam kaasi Ammon tɛŋka kama ale cheŋ Arabba a gilim ka, alege Deevid a jam wari bo ka Jerusalem po. Joab a jam siti Arabba kama a nye ate ka doa koruk. 2Deevid a jam lak naam zutɔkka ba naawa zukku po kama. Ka dobrimu jam ka ligmɔniŋ boorik dobrim ate tintain naliŋsa a bo ka nyiŋ, ka jam vuk ka Deevid zukku po. Wa jam kɔlim ka ŋanta nna yegayega a nyini tɛŋka po. 3Ale ta nuru baai ale jam bo dula la a nyini, ate ba a tom yontidi tuima ale gebisa ale kutuk mɔnuŋ pein gaasa ale laasa. Deevid a jam nye kude ale ka Ammon tɛŋsaŋa meena. Deevid ale wa tugurik tommu meena yaa ŋmani cheŋ Jerusalem.
4Ku ale beni magadek la, kpaliŋ ale jam yiti Filistia ale bo Gezer po la. Va ŋala po Yusat denɔwa Sibbekai a jam ko ka Arefa ŋaaŋbisaŋa po wanyi Sippai, ate Filistia demma a jam siak te ba.
5Ba le jam ta kpaliŋ ka choa ale Filistia demma la, Jair nidoabinni Elhanan jam ko ka Gitti denɔwa Goliat suoku Lami, waai ale jam ta gbaluk ate ku yikka jigini a woŋŋa ase yɔgdɔ doari la.
6Kpaliŋ ka choa ale ŋman jam nye Gat po la, nuru ganduok ale nandubsa siyuebi naŋsa ale nisa meena, naŋ yeŋ siyuebi nisa mɛ siyuebi, si meena pisiye ale sinaansi. Wa mɛ jam ka Arafa ŋaaŋbiik. 7Wa le jam nye Izirali a la la, Simeaya nidoabinni Jonatan, Deevid suoku a yaa ko wa.
8Bade jam ka Arafa ŋaaŋbisa Gat tɛŋka po, ba jam bo ka Deevid ale wa nidoama nisa po.

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 21
Content:
1Sitaana yaa jam yiti a ta chaab ale Izirali a choa Deevid ayen wa chiini Izirali demma meena. 2Dila Deevid yaa weeni Joab ale tugurik tɔŋdɔma kpaŋŋa ayen, <<Ni ga chiini Izirali demma a nyini Beerseba a ga paari Dan. Ni ŋman jam weeni mu ate m seba ba nɔi ale ka diila.>>
3Alege Joab a tulisi ayen, <<Naawen a basi ate wa tugurik tommu a piisi ka ku nɔi kook a gum du. Mi nyɔnɔ naabaa, ba meena an bo daa mi nyɔnɔwa nisa po? Ka boa ate mi nyɔnɔwa a yaali wa nye wanni de? Ka boa ate wa a yaali ayen wa ta foolaa nyeka a jam Izirali zuwa?>>
4Naawa wanni a jam pagra gaam Joab kama. Dila Joab yaa jam cheŋ Izirali meena po a yaa ŋman jam Jerusalem po. 5Joab yaa ga weeni tugurik tɔŋdɔma nɔi ale ka diila a sak Deevid. Izirali meena po ka nuruba tusa kobsi pi ale kook (1,100,000) baai ale seba gebik yikka la, a gum nuruba tusa kobsinaansi ale pisiyopɔi (470,000) ale nyini Juda la.
6Alege Joab an jam chiini Livaima ale Benjamin dɔkku a gum du, dii nyiŋla naawa wanni jam ka daanika a te wa. 7Wanni de a jam ka biem mɛ Wen nina po. Dila wa yaa dari ba tue.
8Deevid yaa weeni Wen ayen, <<Mi nye ka biem kpiem mi ni nye kude la nyiŋ. Yɔgyɔgla de, mi a saalim fu, yeeri foolaa nyeelaŋa fi tomteerɔwa jigi. Mi nye ka betta nyeka.>>
9Naawen yaa weeni Gad, Deevid biisiteerɔwa ayen, 10<<Cheŋ ga weeni Deevid ayen, <<Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna. Mi a te fu ka wie ŋata. Lueri ŋa po dinyi ate m nye m le ta dii ale fu la.>>
11Dila Gad yaa cheŋ Deevid jigi a weeni wa ayen, <<Dii ate Naawen a weeni la ale nna: Lueri fi ale a yaali diila. 12Bena ŋata kom ale jam yaase fi dachaasaŋa a vi ni chiisa sita ale ba gebisaŋa yaase daa ŋata Naawen maarɔwa a jam fi tɛŋka po ale gebik a ko ni Izirali meena po.> Yɔgyɔgla de poli dii ate mi ale ga tulisi waai ale tommu la.>>
13Deevid yaa weeni Gad ayen, <<Mi bo ka daani kpieŋ po. Basi ate mi lo Naawen nisa po ale wa jiirimu a zuak ka yega, alege kan basi ate m lo nurubiik nisa po.>>
14Dila Naawen yaa tom nyiŋtuila ate ŋa jam Izirali tɛŋka po, ate nuruba tusa pisiyopɔi (70,000) a jam kpi Izirali po. 15Ate Naawen yaa tom maarɔ ayen wa kaasi Jerusalem. Alege maarɔwa ale boro a nye dila la, Naawen yaa tagri wa popola kaasuŋku nyiŋ, a weeni maarɔwa waai ale jam a ko nuruma la ayen, <<Ku magsi ta fi nisaŋa a ga ŋaaŋ.>> Naawen maarɔwa yaa jam za ka Jebus denɔwa Ornan ŋanta fɔbika jigini.
16Deevid yaa nya ale Naawen maarɔwa a bo wenŋmazuk ale tɛŋzuk de suŋsuŋ, ale wa gebika wa nisa po a dak Jerusalem nyiŋ. Deevid ale nisɔmma yaa jo boorisa gatta, a doa pai nina a vuk tɛŋ.
17Deevid yaa weeni Wen ayen, <<Daa mi ale weeni ayen ba chiini tugurik tɔŋdɔma? Ka mi ale waai ale nye biemu ale nye kaasi la. Nuruma de a va mi ase ka piisa la. Ka boa ate ba nye? Naawen mi Wen yaa, basi ate fi suipuurumu a jam mi ale m dɔkdemma jigi, alege kan basi ate kaasuŋku de a wari fi nuruma zuwa.>>
18Ate Naawen maarɔwa yaa weeni Gad ayen wa weeni Deevid ate wa cheŋ ga sɛ kuŋkuŋ a te Naawen Jebus denɔwa Arauna ŋanta fɔbika jigini. 19Dila Deevid yaa siak jueli a va wanni ate Gad a weeni wa Naawen yuenni nyiŋla.
20Ase Arauna ale boro a fɔbi wiiti la, wa yaa viriŋ nya maarɔwa, wa nidoabilisa banaansiwa yaa jam chali suk. 21Deevid yaa forisi paari, ase Arauna ale ga nya wa la, wa ya basi ŋantaŋa fɔbika jigini ale koori tɛŋ Deevid niŋ ate wa nina a bo tɛŋ.
22Deevid yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Te mu jigi fi ŋanta fɔbika jigini ate m sɛ kuŋkuŋ a te Naawen, ate kaasuŋku nuruma zuk ale kpeglim. Da te mu ku le magsi ku da diila.>>
23Arauna yaa weeni Deevid ayen, <<Tanla, basi ate m nyɔnɔwa naawa nye dii ale a yɔk wa suinni la. Nya, m le te lalisa a magsi juka tiirimu abe m pai talimu nakpiaka daataŋa a te fu, abe wiiti a magsi ŋandiinta tiirimu. Mi ale te ŋantaŋa de meena.>>
24Alege naab Deevid yaa tulisi Arauna ayen, <<Aaya, mi a yaali m tuni jigini ale a da diila kama. Mi a kan pai jabuui ate fi soa la a te Naawen yaase m nye juka tiirim buui ate mi an tuni jaaboa.>>
25Dila Deevid yaa jam tuni Arauna ligmɔniŋ dobrim kobsiyuebi jigini nyiŋ. 26Deevid yaa sɛ kuŋkuŋ a te Naawen dula a kaab juka tiirita ale suiyɔgni tiirita. Wa jam wi ka Naawen, ate Naawen a tulisi wa ate bolim a nyini wenŋmazuk a lo kuŋkuŋku ate juka tiirimu a vi du la zuk.
27Naawen yaa biisi ale wa maarɔwa ate wa pai wa gebika a su ka fooku po. 28Dila powa dek, ase Deevid ale nya ayen Naawen a tulisi wa Arauna Jebus denɔwa ŋanta fɔbika jigini la, wa yaa nye kaabka tiirita dula. 29Naawen viuku kuui ate Moosis a jam nye sagni po la, juka tiirim kuŋkuŋku dipo a jam bo ka pimpitini zuk Gibeon po. 30Alege Deevid an jam baga a jueli dula a kpesi a nyini Wen jigi ya, dii nyiŋla wa jam yɔgsa kama ale Naawen maarɔwa ale jam ta wa gebika la.

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 22
Content:
1Deevid yaa weeni ayen, <<Naawen Wen yenni ale boka dela ale kuŋkuŋku a magsi juka tiirimu mɛ a te Izirali demma.>>
2Dila Deevid yaa tom weeni ate ba tigsi nichamma meena ale bo Izirali po la, a nyini ba po wa jam lueri ka tintain peesirɔba ayen ba peesi tana a magsi Wen yenni sɛka. 3Wa jam te ka kuta a piisi ayen ba gebi peema a magsi nansuiŋku tuataŋa ale ŋan yiginta, ale kutuk mɔnuŋ a piisi gaam magsika. 4Wa jam te ba ka nyunyoŋ daata mɛ ate ba an baga a chiini ti, diila Saidon demma ale Taaya demma a jam ta ti a piisi kama a jam te Deevid.
5Deevid yaa weeni ayen, <<Mi nidoabinni Solomon a paala kama ale diem zɛ wari ya, yenni ate ti za ti sɛ te Naawen la, ale zuak ale nalim abe di ta yuei abe di a nyaksi a te tɛŋ kpieŋsa meena. Dila nyiŋ mi ale gomsi ŋanta a magsi di.>> Dila Deevid yaa jam gomsi nna yegayega alege kpi.
6Wa yaa wi wa nidoabinni Solomon a weeni wa ayen wa sɛ yeri a te Naawen, Izirali Wenni. 7Deevid a weeni Solomon ayen, <<M biiga, mi ta ku kan m suinum po ayen m sɛ yeri Naawen m Wenni Yuenni nyiŋ. 8Alege Naawen wanni de a jam mi jigi ayen, <Fi basi ate ka ziim a nyini nna yegayega ale kpaliŋ boari. Fi a kan sɛ yeri mi Yuenni nyiŋŋa, dii nyiŋla fi basi ate ka ziim a nyini nna yegayega tɛŋzuk de mi nina po. 9Alege fi le nya nidoabili dii ale wa chim nidoa waai ale ta suiyɔgni ale vuusum la, ate mi ale te wa vuusum a nyini wa dachaasaŋa jigi kauk meena. Wa yuei ale chim ka Solomon, ate mi ale te Izirali vuusum abe ba nye diki wa naamu vaaŋa po. 10Ka wala ale waai ale wa sɛ yeri mi Yuenni nyiŋ. Wa le chim ka mi nidoabili ate mi ale chim wa ko. Mi ale basi ate wa naam zukpaglika a bo Izirali po taam wuu.
11<<Yɔgyɔgla de, m biiga, Naawen a bo le fu, abe fi ta nyeboka a sɛ Naawen fi Wen yenni, ase wa ale weeni la fi le nye. 12Naawen a te fu vuutaŋa ale miŋ chakka ase wa nin te suik ayen fi a nya Izirali zuk, ate dila ale basi ate fi ta Naawen fi Wenni sinsaŋŋa. 13Fi yaa le nya nyeboka ase fi a nin kpesi a ta wa ŋmarisika ale buusaŋa ate Naawen a jam te Moosis ate wa weeni Izirali la. Be pagra abe fi toa. Kan chali yɔgsum yaase fi jɔk nyiŋbiiri.
14<<Mi ko ka m dek nna yega a yaali ŋanta a magsi Naawen yenni, ligmɔniŋ boorik dobrim tusa kook (100,000), kpana dobrim tusa kobsa pi (1,000,000), kutuk mɔnuŋ ale kuta a piisi a ka magsika ale daata ale tintana. Fi baga a gum ŋanta du kama. 15Fi ta ka tuimtomdisa nna yegayega: tintain gebdisa ale yeseerisa ale danagrisa ale nidoa baai ale ŋmasi seba tuini meena tomka la. 16Ligmɔniŋ po ale kpana tuima ale kutuk mɔnuŋ tuima ale kutuk meena tuima ba ka chiina. Yɔgyɔgla de piilim tuini, Naawen a bo le fu.>>
17Deevid yaa jam weeni Izirali nisɔmma meena ayen ba maari wa nidoabinni Solomon. 18Wa jam weeni ba ayen, <<Naawen ni Wenni an bo le ni? Wa abe an te ni vuusum a nyini jigi meena? Wa pai tɛŋka demma meena a te mi kama, ate tɛŋka a siak te Naawen ale wa nuruma. 19Yɔgyɔgla de pai fi suinum ale fi chiik a gisi Naawen fi Wenni. Piilim a sɛ Naawen fi Wenni yenni, ate dila ale basi ate fi ta Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni ale ŋan weleŋsaŋa ate Wen a soa la a jam yenni ate fi sɛ Naawen Yuenni nyiŋla po.

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 23
Content:
1Ase Deevid ale jam kpaŋ ate wa benaŋa a piisi la, wa yaa bobi wa nidoabinni Solomon naab Izirali tɛŋka zuk.
2Wa jam maa tigsi niŋdeerɔma meena kama jigi yeŋ Izirali po ale kaabteerɔma ale Livaima. 3Livaima ale paari bena pisita yaase ba gaam di la ba jam chiini ba kama ate nidoama meena nɔi a chim tusa pisita ale naaniŋ (38,000). 4Deevid yaa weeni ayen, <<Chekki nidoaba tusa pisiye ale ŋanaansi (24,000) ale ba a nya Naawen yenni tuini zuk abe tusa ŋayuebi (6,000) a chim kpaga ale buusa boorisa. 5Tusa ŋanaansi (4,000) ale chim nansuiŋ limisidɔba abe tusa ŋanaansi (4,000) a pak Naawen ale yiila ŋannagin tii ate mi yaali magsi dila la.>>
6Deevid yaa labi Livaima beŋsa a ta va Livaima yiilaŋa ale ka diila. Bala ale Gerson ale Koyat ale Merari.
7Baai ale nyini Gerson dɔkku la ale Ladan ale Simei. 8Ladan nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Jeyiel kpagni ale la, ale Zetam ale Joel ba meena jam ka bata. 9Simei nidoabilisaŋa jam le Selomot ale Yaziel ale Yaran. Ba meena jam ka bata. Bade a jam le Ladan dɔkdemma kpaŋŋa. 10Simei nidoabilisaŋa jam le Jayat ale Ziza ale Jeus ale Beriya. Bade jam le Simei nidoabilisaŋa. Ba meena jam ka banaansi. 11Jayat jam le kpagni a pasaŋ Ziza, alege Jeus ale Beriya a jam ka nidoabilisa a piisi ya, dila ba jam a nya ba ase ka dɔkdem yeŋ la ba tuimaŋa wayeŋ.
12Koyat nidoabilisaŋa jam le Amram ale Izyar ale Yebron ale Uzziel. Ba meena jam ka banaansi. 13Amram nidoabilisaŋa jam le Aaron ale Moosis. Aaron a jam gaari ka wa tɔga, wa ale wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa taam wuu, ayen ba a nya ŋan baai ale ŋmasi ta tuilum la zuk, abe ba a nye kaabka Naawen niŋ abe ba a tom wa niŋ abe ba a mooli niauŋ wa niŋ taam wuu. 14Moosis Wen nuruwa nidoabilisaŋa ba jam a chiini ba ase ka Livaima buuni kauk la. 15Moosis nidoabilisaŋa jam le Gersom ale Ɛlieza. 16Gersom ŋaaŋbisaŋa Subael jam le kpagi. 17Ɛlieza ŋaaŋbisaŋa Areyabiya jam le kpagi. Ɛlieza jam ka nidoabilisa ba chaaba, alege Areyabiya nidoabilisaŋa a jam piisi kama. 18Izyar nidoabilisaŋa jam le Selomit wa ale kpagi. 19Yebron nidoabilisaŋa jam le Jeria ate Amariya pasaŋ ate Jayaziel a saari buta ate Jekameam a kpeglim nisa. 20Uzziel nidoabilisaŋa jam le Maika a pasaŋ Issia.
21Merari nidoabilisaŋa jam le Mayali ale Musi. Mayali nidoabilisaŋa jam le Eleaza ale Kis. 22Eleaza a jam ka nidoabilisa ale kpi la, wa jam ta ka lieba nyiini. Ba kowa suoku nidoabilisaŋa ale jam faari ba. 23Musi nidoabilisaŋa jam le Mayali ale Eder ale Jerimot. Ba meena jam ka bata.
24Bade jam le Livai ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale ba dɔkdem, yie nyam ase ba ale jam chiini ba a ŋmarisi ba yueŋa wanyi wanyi la, dila ale tuimtomdisaŋa ale paari bena pisiye yaase ba gaam dila a tom Naawen yenni po la. 25Diila Deevid a jam weeni kama ayen, <<Ase Naawen, Izirali Wenni ale te wa nuruma vuusum ale jam wa bo Jerusalem po taam wuu la, 26Livaima an ŋman magsi ba ji viuku yaase ŋan baai ate ba ta a tom ku tuimaŋa la.>> 27A ta va Deevid ale weeni dii a kpeglim la, Livaima ba jam chiini ba a nyini ka baai ale paari bena pisiye yaase ba gaam di la.
28Livaima tuini jam le ba a maari Aaron ŋaaŋbisaŋa Naawen yenni tuini po, abe ba a nya dabaasaŋa zuk ale ganaŋa diinaŋa, a nye ate ŋanta meena ale ta tuilum ale ŋanta gela ale bo Wen yenni po la. 29Ba le jam a nya boroboroku ale a duak jazaanimu zuk la ale zommu ale a nye ŋandiinta tiirimu la ale boroborok kuui ate dabinta a ka ku po la, sɛka ale damka, ale magsi zuaka meena ale bu le soa diila. 30Ba jam a zaani kama saluik meena mɛ a te jiam ale a pak Naawen. Ba jam a nye ka dila dek mɛ junɔi meena, 31ale diipo meena ate ba a nye juka tiirita Naawen Vuusum Daaŋa ale Chiik Paalik Tiŋŋa ale lueri doa la faataŋa. Ba ale ba a tom Naawen niŋ veruveruk ase ba le magsi ba soa diila ale ba le sak ba diila.
32Dila Livaima yaa jam a tom ba tuini Tuka Viuku po, jigi dii ale ta tuilum la, a tom a te ba suataŋa ale Aaron ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale Naawen yenni tuini.

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 24
Content:
1Aaron nidoabilisaŋa labika ale nna: Aaron nidoabilisaŋa jam le Nadab ale Abiyu ale Eleaza ale Itamar. 2Alege Nadab ale Abiyu a jam kpi kama alege ba kowa, ba jam ka nidoabilisa, dila Eleaza ale Itamar ale jam a tom ase kaabteerɔba la. 3Zadok ale ka Eleaza ŋaaŋbiik la ale Ayimelek ale ka Itamar ŋaaŋbiik la, bala maarika nyiŋ, Deevid a jam labi ba ka beŋsa a magsi ba le ba a tom diila. 4Ba jam nya niŋdeerɔba Eleaza ŋaaŋbisaŋa po a gaam Itamar kama, ba be jam labi ba kama ase ku le magsi ba nye diila. Yie nyam pi ale bayuebi ale jam nyini Eleaza ŋaaŋbisaŋa po ate yie nyam naaniŋ a nyini Itamar ŋaaŋbisaŋa po. 5Ba jam nak ka gbaŋ a labi ba lukka a jam karo, diila ba jam ka kpaga Naawen yenni po a chim Wen kpaga a bo Eleaza ale Itamar ŋaaŋbisaŋa po.
6Netanel nidoabinni Sɛmaiya ŋmarisidoawa ale ka Livai la, ale jam ŋmarisi ba yueŋa naawa ale kpaŋŋa niŋ. Kaabteerɔwa Zadok ale Abiata nidoabinni Ayimelek ale kaabteerɔma ale Livaima yieŋa nyama, nuru yeŋ ale lueri a nyini Eleaza dɔkdemma po, a lueri wanyi a nyini Itamar dɔkdemma po. 7Gbaŋ kaai ale dɛ niŋ la jam lo ka Jeyoiarib zuk kaai ale saari siyewa la a lo Jedaya zuk ate 8butawa po ka jam lo ka Yarim zuk ate bunaansiwa po a lo Seorim zuk ate 9bunuwa po a lo Malkija zuk ate buyuebiwa po a lo Mijamin zuk ate 10buyopɔiwa po a lo Yakkoz zuk ate naanika po a lo Abaija zuk ate 11neokku po a lo Jesua zuk ate piika po a lo Sekania zuk ate 12pi ale bunyiwa po a lo Eliasib zuk ate pi ale buyewa po a lo Jakim zuk ate 13pi ale butawa po a lo Yuppa zuk ate pi ale bunaansiwa po a lo Jesebeab zuk ate 14pi ale bunuwa po a lo Bilga zuk ate pi ale buyuebiwa po a lo Immer zuk ate 15pi ale buyopɔiwa po a lo Yezir zuk ate pi ale naanika po a lo Yappizzez zuk ate 16pi ale neokku po a lo Petayia zuk ate pisiyewa po a lo Jeyezkel zuk ate 17pisiye ale bunyiwa po a lo Jakin zuk ate pisiye ale buyewa po a lo Gamul zuk ate 18pisiye ale butawa po a lo Delaiya zuk ate pisiye ale bunaansiwa po a lo Maazia zuk.
19Ba ale jam weeni ba diila ale nna ase ba ale a jo Naawen yenni po ba tom, a ta va suik tii ate ba kokpieŋka Aaron a jam sak ase Naawen, Izirali Wenni ale jam weeni wa la.
20Dan ka Livai ŋaaŋbisaŋa mbala meena, a nyini Amram nidoabilisaŋa po jam ka Subael, a nyini Subael nidoabilisaŋa po jam ka Jedeiya. 21Dan ka Areyabiya, a nyini wa nidoabilisaŋa po jam ka Issia ale dɛ niŋ. 22A nyini Izyar demma po jam ka Selomot. A nyini Selomot nidoabilisaŋa po jam ka Jayat. 23Yebron nidoabilisaŋa po jam ka Jeria ale jam dɛ niŋ ate Amariya a saari baye, butawa po jam ka Jayaziel, banaansiwa po jam ka Jekameam. 24Uzziel nidoabilisaŋa po jam ka Maika, a nyini Maika nidoabilisaŋa po jam ka Samir. 25Maika suok jam le Issia. A nyini Issia nidoabilisaŋa po jam ka Zakaria. 26Merari nidoabilisaŋa po jam ka Mayali ale Musi. Jaazia nidoabili jam le Beno. 27Merari nidoabili jam le Jaazia. A nyini Jaazia po jam ka Beno ale Soyam ale Zakkur ale Ibri. 28A nyini Mayali po jam ka Eleaza, waai ale kan jam ta nidoabilisa la. 29A nyini Kis po, Kis nidoabinni jam le Jerameel. 30Musi nidoabilisaŋa jam le Mayali ale Eder ale Jerimot. Bade jam le Livaima a ta va ba dɔkdemma ale ka diila.
31Ba mɛ a jam nak ka gbaŋsa ase ba suataŋa Aaron ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale jam nye dii naab Deevid ale Zadok ale Ayimelek ale kaabteerɔma ale Livaima yie nyama niŋ diila. Suok kpagni dɔkdemma ate ba jam a nye ba diila, dila dekdek ate ba jam nye baansaŋa mɛ.

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 25
Content:
1Deevid ale tugurik tommu kpaŋŋa a jam gaari ka Asaf ale Yeman ale Jedutun nidoabilisaŋa gela a magsi biisiteerɔ tuini, ale kpanta ale bagansa ale dalinkinkeŋsa. Baai ate ba ŋmarisi ayen ba a tom tuini de la ale nna: 2A nyini Asaf nidoabilisaŋa po ba jam lueri ka Zakkur ale Josefi ale Netania ale Asarelaya. Asaf nidoabilisaŋa a jam ka Asaf dek ale jam a nya ate ba a tom, waai ate naawa a jam a nya ate wa a tom la. 3Dan ka Jedutun, a nyini wa nidoabilisaŋa po, ba jam lueri ka Gedalia ale Zeri ale Jesaiya ale Simei ale Yasabia ale Mattitia, ba meena jam ka bayuebi, ate ba kowa Jedutun a nya ate ba a tom, ate wadek a biisi Wen wanni ale a nak kpanuŋ a nye Naawen jiam ale a pak wa. 4Dan ka Yeman, a nyini wa nidoabilisaŋa po, ba jam lueri ka Bukkia ale Mattania ale Uzziel ale Subael ale Jerimot ale Yanania ale Yanani ale Eliata ale Giddalti ale Aromamti Ezer ale Josbekasa ale Malloti ale Yotir ale Mayaziot. 5Bade meena jam ka Yeman naawa biisiteerɔwa nidoabilisa. Ba te ba kama a ta va Wen pumpuulimaŋa ayen ba a pak wa. Wen a jam te Yeman ka nidoabilisa pi ale banaansi ale lieba bata.
6Nidoama de meena a jam ka ba koma ale nya ate ba a lenni yiila Naawen yenni po ale dalinkinkeŋsa ale bagansa ale kpanta a te Wen yenni tuini. Asaf ale Jedutun ale Yeman ka naawa ale jam a nya ba zuk. 7Nuruma de ale baai ale moata ba la ba jam sak ba kama ate ba seba yiila lenka a te Naawen, ba jam ka nuruba kobsiye ale pinaanuŋ ale naaniŋ. 8Nuru paaluk ale ŋankpagsa meena, sagrɔba ale zamsidɔba meena a jam nak ka gbaŋ a nya ba ale magsi ba tom diila.
9Gbaŋ kaai ale dɛ niŋ la, kaai ale magsi Asaf la a lo ka Josefi ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. Kaai ale saari buyewa la a jam lo ka Gedalia ale wa kobisaŋa ale wa nidoabilisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 10Butawa po gbaŋ ka jam lo ka Zakkur ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 11Bunaansiwa po gbaŋka jam lo ka Izri ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 12Bunuwa po gbaŋka a jam lo ka Netania ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 13Buyuebiwa po gbaŋka a lo ka Bukkia ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 14Buyopɔiwa po gbaŋka a lo ka Jesarela ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 15Naanika po gbaŋka a lo ka Jesaiya ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 16Neokku po gbaŋka a lo ka Mattania ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 17Piika po gbaŋka a lo ka Simei ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 18Pi ale bunyiwa po gbaŋka a lo ka Azarel ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 19Pi ale buyewa po gbaŋka a lo ka Yasabia ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 20Pi ale butawa po gbaŋka a lo ka Subael ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 21Pi ale bunaansiwa po gbaŋka a lo ka Mattitia ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 22Pi ale bunuwa po gbaŋka a lo ka Jerimot ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 23Pi ale buyuebiwa po gbaŋka a lo ka Yanania ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 24Pi ale buyopɔiwa po gbaŋka a lo ka Josbekasa ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 25Pi ale naanika po gbaŋka a lo ka Yanani ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 26Pi ale neokku po gbaŋka a lo ka Malloti ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 27Pisiyewa po gbaŋka a lo ka Eliata ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 28Pisiye ale bunyiwa po gbaŋka a lo ka Yotir ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 29Pisiye ale buyewa po gbaŋka a lo ka Giddalti ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 30Pisiye ale butawa po gbaŋka a lo ka Mayaziot ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye. 31Pisiye ale bunaansiwa po gbaŋka a lo ka Aromamti Ezer ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa zuk. Ba meena pi ale baye.

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 26
Content:
1Nansuiŋ limisidɔma labika ale nna. A nyini Koora dɔkku buuni ka Kore nidoabinni Meselemia, Asaf nidoabilisaŋa wanyi.
2Meselemia a jam ta ka nidoabilisa, bala ale Zakaria nidoabili kpagni ale la a pasaŋ Jediael ate Zebadia a saari bata, bunaansiwa jam ka Jatniel ate, 3Iilam a saari banu ate Jeyoyanan a saari bayuebi ate Elieyoenai a saari bayopɔi.
4Obed Edom mɛ a jam ta ka nidoabilisa. Bala ale Sɛmaiya nidoabili kpagni ale la a pasaŋ Jeyozabad, butawa po ka Joa, ate Sakar a nye bunaansi ate Netanel a saari bunu. 5Buyuebiwa po jam ka Ammiel, ate buyopɔiwa po a chim Isaka ate Peulletai a saari naaniŋ. Wen a jam niak Obed Edom kama.
6Wa nidoabinni Sɛmaiya mɛ a jam ta ka nidoabilisa, baai ale jam ka niŋdeerɔba ba kowa dɔkdemma po, dii nyiŋla ba jam ka nidoa baai ale zaani ŋmam a nye wie. 7Sɛmaiya nidoabilisaŋa jam le Otni ale Arefael ale Obed ale Elzabad, wa kobisaŋa Eliyu ale Sɛmakiya jam ka baai ale zaani ŋmam a nye wie. 8Bade meena jam ka Obed Edom ŋaaŋbisa, ba ale ba nidoabilisaŋa ale ba kobisaŋa ale baga a nye wie ale ta pagrim a bag tuini a tom. Obed Edom ŋaaŋbisaŋa meena jam ka pisiyuebi ale baye.
9Meselemia jam ta ka nidoabilisa ale kobisa baai ale baga wie a nye la, ba meena jam ka pi ale naaniŋ.
10Yosa Merari denɔwa a jam ta ka nidoabilisa, Simri ale nidoabili kpagni, daa wa ate wa dɛ niŋ a biagi alege wa kowa ale lueri wa kpagi. 11Buyewa ka Yilkia ate Tabalia a saari buta ate Zakaria a saari bunaansi. Yosa nidoabilisaŋa ale wa kobisaŋa meena jam ka pi ale bata.
12Nansuiŋ limisidɔma de labika, ba yieŋa nyama a jam ta ka tuima a tom Naawen yenni po ase ba kobisaŋa ale ka diila. 13Gbaŋsa ate ba jam nak a te nansuiŋ meena, a ta va ba dɔkdemma ale ka diila, paalik ale jakpak meena.
14Gbaŋ kaai ale bo Kori Nansuiŋku la, a jam lo ka Selemia zuk. Ba jam nak ka gbaŋsa a te wa nidoabinni Zakaria, yam sagrɔwa, ate Wiilukku Nansuiŋku geŋsa gbaŋka a lo wa zuk. 15Gbaŋ kaai ale magsi Yeseoku Nansuiŋku la a jam lo ka Obed Edom zuk, ate gbaŋ kaai ale magsi ŋanta duenika jigini la a lo wa nidoabilisaŋa zuk. 16Gbaŋ sii ale magsi Yeniŋ Nansuiŋku ale Salleket Nansuiŋku ale ŋmazuk suiku geŋsa la a jam lo ka Suppim ale Yosa zuima. Limisidɔ ale jam za ganaŋa meena ale limisidɔ. 17Livaiba bayuebi ale jam bo kori geŋka danni po, banaansi a bo wiilukku geŋ kantueŋ ate banaansi a bo yeseoku geŋ kantueŋ ate baye a bo ba le a dueni ŋanta juijui la. 18Dan ka dabiaka ale bo yeniŋka la, banaansi ale bo suiku po ate baye a bo dabiaka dek po.
19Bade jam le nansuiŋ limisidɔma labika baai ale jam ka Koora ale Merari ŋaaŋbisa la.
20Ba Livai chaama ale jam a nya ligra jigini Wen yenni po ale ŋan weleŋsaŋa ligra jigini.
21Ladan ŋaaŋbisaŋa, baai ale ka Gerson dem baai ale jam ka yie nyam a nyini Ladan Gerson denɔwa buuni po la, jam ka Jeyieli. 22Jeyieli nidoabilisaŋa jam le Zetam ale wa suoku Joel, ba ale jam a nya ligraŋa zuk Naawen yenni po.
23A nyini Amram demma po ale Izyar demma po ale Yebron demma po ale Uzziel demma po ale bade: 24Subael jam ka Moosis nidoabinni Gersom ŋaaŋbiik. Wa jam ka kpagi a nya ligraŋa zuk. 25Wa kobisaŋa a nyini Ɛlieza buuni po jam le nna: Areyabiya jam ka wa nidoabili, Jesaiya jam ka wa nidoabili, Joram jam ka wa nidoabili, Zikri jam ka wa nidoabili, Selomit jam ka wa nidoabili. 26Selomit ale wa kobisaŋa ale jam a nya ŋantaŋa ate naab Deevid ale yieŋa nyama baai ale a nya nidoaba tusidi zuk la ale nidoaba kook zuk ale tugurik tommu kpaga m ŋala a jam pa nyo Naawen yenni po la. 27Ŋantaŋa gela ate ba jam ta nyini kpaliŋka po a jam la, ba jam pai ba zaani magsi ka Naawen yenni tebika. 28Jaab meena ate Samuel biisiteerɔwa a jam pai te la ale Kis nidoabinni Sɔɔl a te la, ale Ner nidoabinni Abner a te la, ale Zeruiya nidoabinni Joab a te la ale ŋan baai meena ate ba jam te la ka Selomit ale wa kobisaŋa ale jam a nya ba zuk.
29A nyini Izyar demma po, Kenania ale wa nidoabilisaŋa tuimaŋa a jam ka Naawen yenni po, ba jam ka kpaga ale buusa boorisa a nya Izirali zuk.
30A nyini Yebron demma po ba jam lueri ka Yasabia ale wa kobisaŋa, ba jam ka nidoaba tusidi ale kobsiyopɔi (1,700) a nya Izirali zuk Jodan Benni yeniŋ geŋsa ba ale jam a nya Naawen tuini ale naawa tuini zuk. 31Dan ka Yebron demma, Jeria jam le ba kpagi a ta va ba gaŋka buuni ŋmarisika. Bena pisinaansiwa po ate Deevid a jam de wa naamu a paari la, ba jam gisi ŋmarisika po kama ale nidoa ale baga wie a nye a bo Yebron demma po Jazer ale bo Gilead tɛŋka po la. 32Jeria a jam ta ka tusa ŋaye ale kobsiyopɔi (2,700), baai ale jam baga a nye wie ale ta dɔkdem la, ate naab Deevid a jam pai ba a nyo Aruben dɔkku buuni ale Gad dɔkku buuni ale Manasa dɔkku buuni kaukku dii meena ale ta wari a nye ale Naawen ale naawa wie la.

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 27
Content:
1Izirali demma yieŋa nyama ale kpak ŋaai ale a nya tusa zuk la, kpak ŋaai ale a nya kobsa zuk la ale ba kpaŋŋa, baai ale tom a te naawa dii meena ale ta wari a nye le tugurik tommu beŋsa sii ale bo tuima chiik, chiik benni meena po la yueŋa ale nna. Beŋ meena jam ta ka nidoaba tusa pisiye ale ŋanaansi (24,000).
2Waai ale jam a nya beŋ kaai ale dɛ niŋka, chiik kaai ale dɛ niŋka la po, jam ka Zabdiel nidoabinni Jasobeam. Ba jam ka nidoaba tusa pisiye ale banaansi (24,000) a bo wa beŋka po. 3Wa jam ka Perezi ŋaaŋbiik ale chim kpagi tugurik tommu kpaŋŋa meena zuk chiik kaai ale dɛ niŋka la po.
4Waai ale jam a nya beŋsa buyewa zuk la jam ka Ayoyi denɔwa Dodai. Miklot a jam le beŋ kala niŋdeerɔ. Ba jam ka nidoaba tusa pisiye ale ŋanaansi (24,000) a bo wa beŋka po.
5Tugurik tom kpaga butawa po chiisa sitawa po, jam ka Jeyoiada kaabteerɔwa nidoabinni Benaya.
