Wa jam le kpagni ba be jam ka nidoaba tusa pisiye ale banaansi (24,000) a bo wa beŋka po. 6Benaya wade waai ale jam ka pagrɔ Pisitawa po la a jam a nya ka Pisita zuk. Wa nidoabinni Ammizabad ale jam a nya wa beŋka zuk.
7Bunaansiwa po, chiisa sinaansiwa po, jam ka Joab suoku Asayel. Wa nidoabinni Zebadia ale jam tagri wa. Ba jam ka nidoaba tusa pisiye ale banaansi (24,000) a bo wa beŋka po.
8Bunuwa po, chiisa sinuwa po jam ka kpagi dii ate ba wi ayen Samyut la, Izra denɔwa. Ba jam ka nidoaba tusa pisiye ale banaansi (24,000) a bo wa beŋka po.
9Buyuebiwa po, chiisa siyuebiwa po jam ka Ikkes Teko denɔwa nidoabinni Ira. Ba jam ka nidoaba tusa pisiye ale banaansi (24,000) a bo wa beŋka po.
10Buyopɔiwa po, chiisa siyopɔiwa po jam ka Pelon denɔwa Yelez, wa jam ka Ɛfraim ŋaaŋbiik. Ba jam ka nidoaba tusa pisiye ale banaansi (24,000) a bo wa beŋka po.
11Naanika po, chiisa naanika po jam ka Yusat denɔwa Sibbekai, wa jam ka Zera ŋaaŋbiik. Ba jam ka nidoaba tusa pisiye ale banaansi (24,000) a bo wa beŋka po.
12Neokku po, chiisa neokku po jam ka Anatot denɔwa Abiezer, wa jam ka Benjamin ŋaaŋbiik. Ba jam ka nidoaba tusa pisiye ale banaansi (24,000) a bo wa beŋka po.
13Piika po, chiisa piwa po jam ka Netofat denɔwa Mayarai, wa jam ka Zera ŋaaŋbiik. Ba jam ka nidoaba tusa pisiye ale banaansi (24,000) a bo wa beŋka po.
14Pi ale bunyiwa, chiisa pi ale kanyi wa po jam ka Piraton denɔwa Benaya, wa jam ka Ɛfraim ŋaaŋbiik. Ba jam ka nidoaba tusa pisiye ale banaansi (24,000) a bo wa beŋka po.
15Pi ale buyewa po, chiisa pi ale siyewa po jam ka Yeldai Netofat denɔwa a nyini Otniel dɔkdemma po. Ba jam ka nidoaba tusa pisiye ale banaansi (24,000) a bo wa beŋka po.
16Kpaŋŋa ale jam a nya Izirali buuni la ale nna. Aruben dɔkku zuk ka Zikri nidoabinni Ɛlieza ale jam a nya ba. Simeyon dɔkku zuk ka Maaka nidoabinni Sefatia ale jam a nya ba. 17Livaima dɔkku zuk ka Kemuel nidoabinni Yasabia ale jam a nya ba, ate Zadok mɛ a nya Aaron dɔkku zuk. 18Juda dɔkku zuk ka Deevid suoku Eliyu ale jam a nya ba. Isaka dɔkku zuk ka Maakil nidoabinni Omri ale jam a nya ba. 19Zebulun dɔkku zuk ka Obadia nidoabinni Ismaiya ale jam a nya ba. Nafitali dɔkku zuk ka Azriel nidoabinni ale jam a nya ba. 20Ɛfraim dɔkku zuk ka Azaziya nidoabinni Yoseya ale jam a nya ba. Manasa dɔkku genni ka Pedaiya nidoabinni Joel ale jam a nya ba. 21Manasa dɔkku genni ale bo Gilead po la ka Zakaria nidoabinni Iddo ale jam a nya ba. Benjamin dɔkku zuk ka Abner nidoabinni ale jam a nya ba. 22Dan dɔkku zuk ka Jeroyam nidoabinni Azarel ale jam a nya ba. Bade jam le kpaŋŋa a nya Izirali diinaŋa buuni meena zuk.
23Deevid an jam chiini nidoa baai ale paari bena pisiye yaase ba an paari dila la, dii nyiŋla Naawen a puulim kama ayen wa le basi ate Izirali a piisi ase chiŋmarisaŋa ale bo wenŋmazuk la. 24Zeruiya nidoabinni Joab ale piilim wa chiini nidoama la wa an jam chiini nueri ya. Kaasuŋ yaa jan jam Izirali zuk nuruma chiinika nyiŋ, ate ba ale jam chiini ba nɔi diila a jo Deevid nalima wie gbaŋka po.
25Adiel nidoabinni Azmavet ale jam a nya naab yeri ŋanta duenika jigini. Yuzaya nidoabinni Jonatan ale jam a nya tɛŋsaŋa ale tɛŋ kpaŋsa ale gbirim woŋtaŋa ale bo tɛŋ kpieŋka po la zuk.
26Chelub nidoabinni Ezri ale jam a nya baai ale a kpa la zuk.
27Simei Aramat denɔwa ale jam a nya kaduksaŋa zuk. Zabdi Sifmi denɔwa ale jam a nya kaduksaŋa ŋandiintaŋa zuk.
28Geder denɔwa Baal Yanan ale jam a nya kpaam tiisaŋa ale kinkaŋ tiisaŋa ale bo yeniŋ guuku chiak la zuk. Joas mɛ ale jam a nya kpaamu teka zuk.
29Saaron denɔwa Sitrai ale jam a nya duŋsaŋa dɛka zuk Saaron po, ate Adlai nidoabinni Safat a nya naapeerisaŋa ale bo vaasaŋa po la zuk.
30Ismael tɛŋka denɔwa Obil ale jam a nya laalaakomima zuk, ate Meronot denɔwa Jedeiya jam a nya bonsaŋa zuk.
31Yagri denɔwa Jaziz ale jam a nya duŋsaŋa zuk. Bade meena jam ka kpaga a nya Deevid nitalimu zuk.
32Deevid kobiika Jonatan jam ka sagrɔ ale yam nyɔnɔ ale ŋmarisidoa. Yachmoni nidoabinni Jeyiel ale jaa nya naawa nidoabilisaŋa.
33Ayitofel jam le naawa sagrɔ. Arki denɔwa Yusai jam le naawa doa. 34Benaya nidoabinni Jeyoiada ale Abiata ale jam tagri zaani Ayitofel nankula po. Joab mɛ ale jam chim naab yeri tugurik tommu kpagi.

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 28
Content:
1Deevid a jam wi kpaŋŋa meena Izirali po ayen ba tigsi Jerusalem tɛŋka po: Bala ale kpaŋŋa ale a nya diinaŋa buuni zuk la ale kpaŋŋa ale a nya naawa beŋsaŋa zuk la, kpaŋŋa ale a nya tusa zuk la ale kpaŋŋa ale a nya kobsa zuk la ale kpaŋŋa nitalimu meena ale duŋsaŋa meena ate naawa a soa la ale wa nidoabilisaŋa, a gum chaab ale naab yeri kpaŋŋa, nuru kpientaŋa ale tugurik tɔŋdɔ tuasaŋa meena.
2Naab Deevid yaa yiti zaani ale weeni ayen, <<Ni wom mi, m suata ale m nuruba. Mi ta ku m suinum po kama ayen m sɛ yeri ase vuusika jigi la a te Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni, naŋsa zukpaglik a te ti Wenni, m be zɔk kama ayen m sɛ di. 3Alege Wen a weeni mi ayen, <<Fi a kan sɛ yeri mi Yuenni nyiŋŋa, dii nyiŋla fi ka tugurik tɔŋdɔ ale basi ate ziim a siŋ.
4<<Alege Naawen, Izirali Wenni, ale lueri mi a nyini dɔkdemma meena po ayen m chim naab Izirali zuk taam wuu. Wa lueri ka Juda ase niŋdeerɔ la, a ŋman nyini Juda dɔkku buuni po wa jam lueri ka mi dɔkku demma, a ŋman nyini m kowa nidoabilisaŋa po wa jam mariŋ kama a bobi mu naab ate mi a nya Izirali meena zuk. 5Mi nidoabilisaŋa meena po, Naawen abe jam te mi ka bi boari, wa jam lueri ka m nidoabinni Solomon ayen wa kali Naawen naam zukpaglika zuk a nya Izirali. 6Wa jam weeni mi kama ayen, <<Solomon fi nidoabinni ale waai ale wa sɛ m yenni ale m dabaasaŋa, mi lueri wa kama ayen wa chim m nidoabili, ate mi ale chim wa ko. 7Mi ale basi ate wa naamu a boro taam wuu ase wa dan kan zɛri ya ale ta m wieŋa ale m buusaŋa ase ku le nye dii vaaŋa de po la.
8<<Dila yɔgyɔgla de mi a weeni fi Izirali meena nimbie po ale Naawen tigsuŋku, ase ti Wenni ale a wom la, kpesi fidek a va Naawen fi Wenni wieŋa, ate fi tuesi tɛŋ maŋka de a pai ka a te fi ŋaaŋbisaŋa ase nitalim la taam wuu.
9<<Fi, m nidoabinni Solomon, siak te fi kowa Wenni, a tom a te wa ale fi suinum meena ale yaalika popola, ale Naawen a gisi ka suinum meena ale a miŋ dii meena ate fi a poli la. Fi dan gisi wa, fi le nya wa, alege fi dan banti wa wa ale zɛri fu taam wuu. 10Poli yɔgyɔgla de, ale Naawen a lueri fu kama ayen fi sɛ yeri ase puusika jigi la. Be pagra a tom tuini.>>
11Deevid yaa te wa nidoabinni Solomon Naawen yenni dabiaka wa ale magsi wa sɛ ka diila, ka ŋanta duenika diinaŋa, ka ŋmazukku, ka ponni po diinaŋa ale biem duisi basika nanlikka dɔkku. 12Wa jam te wa dii meena ate Chiika a pai nyo wa popola po wa ale wa nye Naawen yenni dabaasaŋa ale gilagilawa diinaŋa diila kama, ale Wen yenni ligra duenika jigini ale jigi dii ate ŋan baai ba pai nyo Wen nisa po la jigini. 13Wa jam weeni wa, wa ale wa labi kaabteerɔma ale Livaima ale baai meena ale a tom Naawen yenni po diila kama, ale ŋan baai ate ba za ba pai tom di tuima la. 14Wa jam weeni ka ligmɔniŋ ale ka soa dii a nye ligmɔniŋ ŋan baai ate ba za ba pai a tom tuima tɔgatɔga la kama ale kpana ale ŋa soa dii a nye kpana ŋantomtaŋa ate ba za ba pai a tom tuima tɔgatɔga la kama. 15Ligmɔniŋ dobrimu ale magsi bu soa dii a magsi ligmɔniŋ ŋanzaanitaŋa ale zeuŋtaŋa la, ale kpana dobrimu ale magsi bu soa dii a magsi kpana jazaanim ale wa zeuŋtaŋa, a ta va jaab meena ate ba ta a tom diila. 16Ligmɔniŋ dobrim ale magsi bu soa dii a magsi jazaanim yeŋ a magsi boroborok weleŋka la, kpana dobrimu ale bu soa dii a magsi kpana jazaanimu la. 17Cheri ligmɔniŋ dobrim ale bu soa dii a magsi duisuk nyinaŋa ale chin misimaŋa ale leŋsa ale ligmɔniŋ maŋ dobrim ale bu soa dii a magsi chin yeŋ la ale kpana dobrim dii ale a nye kpana chin yeŋ la ale 18ligmɔniŋ kaai ate ba gomsi magsi la a magsi ŋan baai nyum ale masa la kuŋkuŋku. Wa jam maa weeni wa ale wa nye torokowa diila kama, dila abe le ligmɔniŋ ŋanta ase ŋanvuta la ate ba kiŋkaŋŋa a lagri bo wen a chim yɔgsum a te Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni.
19Deevid weeni ayen, <<Ŋade meena ate mi ta la ka Naawen ale ŋmarisiŋa a te mi, wa abe basi kama ate mi a miŋ chak dii meena ale magsi m nye la.>>
20Deevid a jam weeni wa nidoabinni Solomon kama mɛ ayen, <<Pagra abe fi toa, a tom tuini. Kan chali yɔgsummoa yaase fi jɔk nyiŋbiiri ale Naawen dii ale ka Wen, m Wenni la, a bo ale fu kama. Wa kan paasi fu yaase wa banti fu a basi ate ku paari diipo ate Naawen tuini a nueri la. 21Kaabteerɔma ale Livaima labika a jam gomsi kama a magsi tuini meena Wen yenni po. Kpaŋŋa ale nuruma meena ale wom fi ale a weeni ba diila.>>

Title: 1 ŊIAK WIE 29
Content:
1Naab Deevid yaa jam weeni tigsuŋku meena ayen, <<M nidoabinni Solomon, waai ate Naawen a lueri la, diem ka paalik a zɛ wari ya. Tuini a zuak kama, dii nyiŋla naam yenni de daa nuru ale soa ka Naawen dii ale ka Wen la. 2Mi nitalimu meena ate m jam te Wen yenni la. Ka ligmɔniŋ a magsi ligmɔniŋ tuini ale kpana a magsi kpana tuini ale kutuk mɔnuŋ a magsi kutuk mɔnuŋ tuini ale kuta a magsi kuta tuini ale daata a magsi daata tuini. Mi jam maa te ka tintain ŋaai ale gamisi a magsi ba pai nye vuutaŋa ale tintain ŋmiŋmirita ale tintana nna tɔgatɔga ale tintain naliŋsa meena ate ba gomsi magsi la ale tintain paglaksa. Ŋade meena m jam te zuak kama. 3Dila ku tɔga, mi ale nye a te magsi m Wen yenni la, yɔgyɔgla de mi a te a nyini ka mi dek ŋantaŋa po ligmɔniŋ ale kpana a magsi m Wen yenni sɛka, mi te ka jaab meena a magsi tuilum yenni de. 4Mi te ka ligmɔniŋ boorik dobrim tusa ŋata (3,000) ale kpana ate ba gomsi magsi la tusa ŋayopɔi (7,000) a magsi parisaŋa zuk vi ka, 5ligmɔniŋ tuini ale kpana tuini ale tuini meena ate seerɔma a za ba sɛ la. Yɔgyɔgla de ka wana ale yaali ayen wa pai wadek jinla a te Naawen yaa?>>
6Yieŋa nyama ale Izirali buuni kpaŋŋa ale kpaga ŋaai ale a nya tusa zuk ale kpaga ŋaai ale a nya kobsa zuk la ale kpaga ŋaai ale a nya naawa tuini zuk la yaa jam te ale yaalika. 7Ba jam te ka ŋanta nna yega a magsi Wen yenni tuini. Ba ale jam te ŋan baai la ka ligmɔniŋ boorik dobrim tusa ŋanu (5,000) ale ligmɔniŋ boorik dobrim buta ale kpana boorik dobrim tusa pi (10,000) ale kutuk mɔnuŋ boorik dobrim pi ale naaniŋ (18,000) ale kutuk boorik dobrim tusa kook (100,000). 8Nuru waai meena ale ta tintain ŋaai ale ta yuei la a jam pai ŋa a te ka waai ale a nya Naawen yenni ŋantaŋa zuk la, Gerson denɔwa Jeyiel. 9Nuruma yaa jam mariŋ ba niŋdeerɔma ale jam sak yaalika la, diila ba jam te Naawen kama tiirim ale ba suiniima meena. Naawa Deevid mɛ a jam mariŋ ka nna yegayega.
10Deevid a jam pak Naawen kama tigsuŋku meena niŋ ayen, <<Pimpauk a cheŋ fi jigi Naawen yaa, tama kowa Izirali Wenni, a ta cheŋ wuu. 11Ka fi Naawen yaa ale zuak ale ta pagrim ale zula ale nalim kpiem ale nyaksika, diila jaab meena wenŋmazuk ale tɛŋzuk de ka fi ale soa. Naawen yaa naamu ka fi ale soa. Fi ale ta yue ase jaab meena nyɔnɔ la. 12Jigsika ale zula a nyini ka fi jigi, fi ale a nya ŋanta meena zuk. Fi nisaŋa po ka pagrim a zak a zaani ale a te waai meena pagrim. 13Yɔgyɔgla de, ti Wen yaa, ti a te fi jiam ale a pak fi yuenni.
14<<Alege mi ka wana, ka bana ale mi nuruba ate ti baga a te nnala? Jaab meena a nyini ka fi jigi ate tama a te fu jabuui nyiini ale nyini fi nisa po la. 15Tama ka nicham a zɛ jigi ya fi nina po, ase ti kokpieŋsaŋa meena la. Ti daaŋa tɛŋzuk de a nye ase ka yisuŋ la a jɔk yiila. 16Naawen, ti Wen yaa, dan ka ŋantaŋa ale piisi ate tama a yaali a magsi ba sɛ yeri fi tuilum Yuenni nyiŋla, ba nyini ka fi nisa po, ba meena ka fi ale soa. 17Mi seba, m Wen yaa, ayen fi a chamsi suinum a nya kama ate fi sui a yɔk ale wensie. Ba meena mi te ale ka m dek yaalika ale wensie. Yɔgyɔgla de mi abe nya ale suipeentik fi nuruma baai ale bo dela la ale te ale yaalika diila kama. 18Naawen yaa, tama koma Abrayam ale Aizik ale Izirali Wenni, basi ate yaalika de a bo fi nuruma suiniima po taam wuu, abe fi basi ate ba suiniima a bo fi jigi. 19Abe fi te m nidoabinni Solomon suinum meena a ta fi wieŋa ale fi kaamka ale fi ŋmarisika abe wa nye wari meena a sɛ naam yeri dii nyiŋ ate mi a yaali ŋantaŋa la.>>
20Deevid yaa weeni tigsuŋku meena ayen, <<Ni pak Naawen ni Wenni.>> Dila ba meena yaa jam pak Naawen ba koma Wenni, ba jam koori ka tɛŋ Naawen ale naawa niŋ.
21Dai dii ale paasaŋ la ba yaa nye kaabka a te Naawen a nye juka tiirita a te wa ale lalisa tusidi ale padaasa tusidi ale padabilisa tusidi, a gum chaab ale ba nyuka tiiritaŋa ale kaabsa si chaab nna yegayega a te Izirali demma meena. 22Ba jam nyu kama ale suipeentik kpieŋ Naawen niŋ dai dila danni. Ba yaa jam a nya Deevid nidoabinni Solomon ase naab la a nye buye, a bobi wa naab Naawen niŋ ayen wa chim niŋdeerɔ abe Zadok a chim kaabteerɔ. 23Dila Solomon yaa jam kali Naawen naam zukpaglika zuk ase naab la wa kowa Deevid nankula po. Wa jam jigsi kama ate Izirali meena a siak te wa. 24Kpaŋŋa meena ale nuru kpientaŋa ale Naab Deevid nidoabilisaŋa meena, a jam ta ka badek a siŋ tɛŋ Naab Solomon niŋ.
25Naawen a jam zak Solomon a zaani ka nna yegayega Izirali meena nina po ale te wa naam ŋanta ate naab a jam ka Izirali po a ta ba chaab nya ya.
26Jese nidoabinni Deevid jam ka naab Izirali meena zuk. 27Wa jam nya Izirali zuk ka bena pisinaansi, Yebron po wa jam de naamu ka bena ŋayopɔi ale de Jerusalem po bena pisita ale ŋata. 28Wa jam kpaŋ kama nalimnyiini ale kpi, wa jam goa beni kama a jigsi a ta zula. Wa nidoabinni Solomon ale jam zaani wa nankula po ase naab la.
29Dan ka Naab Deevid naamu wieŋa, a nyini piilimka a ga paari kpeglimka, ŋa ŋmarisi kama a doa biisiteerɔwa Samuel wieŋa po, biisiteerɔwa Natan wieŋa po ale biisiteerɔwa Gad wieŋa po, 30a gum chaab ale wa naamu wari meena ale wa pagrimu ale wa wie garimaŋa ale jam gilim wa ale Izirali ale tɛŋ yonsa meena naataŋa la.

Title: 2 ŊIAK WIE 1
Content:
1Deevid nidoabinni Solomon yaa jam yik wadek a paari wa naamu zuk, diila Naawen wa Wenni a jam bo ale wa kama a nye wa nuru kpioŋ.
2Solomon yaa jam biisi te Izirali meena ale kpaga ŋaai ale a nya tusa zuk la ale ŋaai ale a nya kobsa zuk la ale buusa nyama ale Izirali niŋdeerɔma meena, yieŋa nyama 3ate Solomon ale tigsuŋku meena yaa jam jueli pimpitini zuk Gibeon tɛŋka po, diila Wen tuka viuku a jam bo ka dula, kuui ate Naawen tomteerɔwa Moosis a jam ti gɔnni po la. 4Deevid a jam ta Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a nyini Kiriat Jearim a jam ka di jigini ate wa gomsi a magsi di la, dii nyiŋla wa jam ti ka viuk Jerusalem po a magsi di. 5Alege kutuk mɔnuŋ kuŋkuŋku ate Uri nidoabinni Bezalel, Yur ŋaaŋka a nye la a jam bo ka Gibeon tɛŋka po Naawen viuku niŋ. Dila Solomon ale tigsuŋku a jam a bek wie wa jigi ka dula. 6Solomon yaa jueli kutuk mɔnuŋ kuŋkuŋku jigi Naawen niŋ tuka viuku po a nye juka tiirita tusidi ku zuk.
7Yok kula Wen yaa jam Solomon jigi ayen, <<Bek fi ale a yaali ayen m nye dii meena a te fu la.>>
8Solomon yaa tulisi Wen ayen, <<Fi jam sak ka ŋmanteka nna yegayega ale m kowa Deevid ale nye mi naab wa nankula po. 9Yɔgyɔgla de Naawen dii ale Wen la basi ate pumpuulimaŋa ate fi nye ale m kowa Deevid la abe sum nye, diila fi bobi mi ka naab nuru baai ale piisi ase tɛŋzuk de tantaŋa la. 10Te mu yam ale sebika, ate m baga a dɛ nuruma de niŋ, ka wana ale baga a nya fi nuruma ale zuak la zuwa?>>
11Wen yaa weeni Solomon ayen, <<Ase kude ale ka fi suinum yaalika ate fi an bek paaruŋ ale jigsika yaase zula yaase fi dachaasaŋa kum wari la, fi abe an bek nyuvu woŋ alege ka yam ale sebika ayen fi a nya nuruma ate mi bobi fi naab ba zuk la nyiŋ, 12dila yam ale sebika fi ale nya. Mi abe le te fu paaruŋ ale jigsika ale zula mɛ, dii ate nalim ŋaai ale de fi niŋ la an nya ya baai mɛ ale bo fi ŋaaŋ la mɛ a kan nya.>>
13Solomon yaa nyini Gibeon pimpitini zuk, Tuka Viuku niŋ a cheŋ Jerusalem a ga chim naab a nya Izirali zuk.
14Solomon a jam tigsi ka torokoba ale wusuma, wa jam ta ka torokoba tusidi ale kobsinaansi (1,400) ale wusuma tusa pi ale ŋaye (12,000), ŋaai ate wa jam pai basi torokoba tɛŋsaŋa po, gela mɛ a bo ale wa Jerusalem po. 15Naawa a jam nye kama ate kpana ale ligmɔniŋ a ka kɔm Jerusalem po ase tintana la, ate nyunyoŋta a piisi ase kinkaŋsa la guutaŋa zuima. 16Solomon wusumaŋa ba jam da ŋa a ta nyini ka Ejipiti ale Kue. Wa geruŋdɔma ale jam da ŋa Kue. 17Ba jam da toroko yeŋ Ejipiti ka kpana dobrim kobsiyuebi, ate wusum yeŋ a da kpana dobrim kook ale pisinu. Ba jam maa pai ŋa a da te Yit ale Araam nalimaŋa kama.

Title: 2 ŊIAK WIE 2
Content:
1Solomon yaa jam weeni ayen ba sɛ yeri Naawen Yuenni nyiŋ ale naam yeri a te wadek. 2Wa jam lueri ka nidoaba tusa pisiyopɔi (70,000) ase jiirɔba la ale nidoaba tusa pinaanuŋ (80,000) ase tanmobrɔba la guutaŋa zuk ale nidoaba tusa ŋata ale kobsiyuebi (3,600) ayen bala a nya tuini zuk.
3Solomon a jam tom tontomiŋka de a te ka Taaya naawa Yuram ayen, <<Tom nyunyoŋta a te mu ase fi ale jam nye dii a te m kowa Deevid la ase fi ale jam tom nyunyoŋta a te wa ayen wa sɛ naab yeri a bo di po la. 4Yɔgyɔgla de mi a yaali ayen m sɛ ka yeri a magsi Naawen m Wenni Yuenni a pai di a nyo wa nisa po a magsi ŋan baai nyum ale masa la juka a magsi boroborok weleŋka duenika, a magsi juka tiirita nyeka saluik ale junɔi meena, a magsi Vuusum Daaŋa ale Chiik Paalisa ale Naawen ti Wenni tiŋŋa. Kude ale chim ka wa dii ale di beni a te Izirali demma.
5<<Yenni ate mi a yaali ayen m sɛ la ale zuak kama, dii nyiŋla ti Wenni a zuak gaam wena meena kama. 6Alege ka wana ale baga a sɛ yeri a te wa, ase wenŋmazuk, poom daa wenŋmazukku dega, dula a kan jo wa. Mi ka wana ayen m sɛ yeri a te wa, ka juka kaabka jigi ate m baga sɛ a te wa.
7<<Tom nidoa a te mu, nidoa waai ale seba ligmɔniŋ ale kpana ale kutuk mɔnuŋ ale kuta tuima ale seba garuk miik ŋmiŋmirita ale garuk miik mɔnta ale garuk miik sobta yɔkka ale seba ŋanta nyiŋ ŋmarisika ate wa tom Juda ale Jerusalem po ale m nuru baai ale seba tuima, baai ate mi kowa Deevid a jam ta la.
8<<Tom nyunyoŋta ale damɔnta ale dapeelita a nyini Lebanon, diila mi seba kama ayen fi nuruma ka baai ale kperi ale daata cheka dula. Mi nuruma ale tom ale fi nuruma, 9ate ba te mu daata yega, dii nyiŋla Naawen yenni ate mi a yaali ayen m sɛ la ku a fɛ ate di zuak. 10Mi ale te fi tomteerɔma, dacheerisaŋa baai ale a che tiisaŋa la muma boorisa tusa pisiye (20,000) ale zamɔnta boorisa tusa pisiye (20,000) ale daam samɔnsa tusa pisiye (20,000) ale kpaam samɔnsa tusa pisiye (20,000).>>
11Taaya naawa Yiram yaa ŋmarisi gbaŋ a tulisi Solomon ayen, <<Naawen ale a yaali wa nuruma la nyiŋ, wa bobi fu ka ba naab.>> 12Yiram a jam weeni a gum du ayen, <<Pimpauk a cheŋ Naawen, Izirali Wenni jigi, waai ale nye wenŋmazuk ale tɛŋzuk de la. Wa te Naab Deevid ka nidoabi dii ale ta yam, ale sebika ale nya wie a miŋ, waai ale wa sɛ yeri a te Naawen abe wa sɛ naam yeri a te wadek la.
13<<Mi a tom ka Yuram Abi, nuru waai ale seba tuima la, 14waai ma ale nyini Dan dɔkku ate wa kowa a nyini Taaya la. Wa zamsi kama a tom ligmɔniŋ ale kpana ale kutuk mɔnuŋ ale kuta ale tintana ale daata tuima, wa jam maa seba garuk miik ŋmiŋmirita ale garuk miik sobta ale garuk miik mɔnta ale garuk naliŋsa yɔkka kama. Wa jam seba ka ŋanta tɔgatɔga nyiŋ ŋmarisika ale baga a gobi ŋanta ate fi dan te wa ayen wa nye wa nye la. Wa ale tom ale fi nuruma ale m nyɔnɔwa Deevid fi kowa nuruma.
15<<Basi ate m nyɔnɔwa a tom muma ale zamɔnta ale kpaam ale daam ate wa gomsi la a te wa tomteerɔwa, 16ate ti che da tii meena ate fi a yaali la Lebanon po a bobi ti a maŋ chaab a lo nyakpiemu a jueli Jopa a te fu. Fi yaa le pa ti dula a ta cheŋ Jerusalem.>>
17Solomon yaa jam chiini nichamma meena baai ale jam bo Izirali po la, wa kowa Deevid ale jam chiini la ŋaaŋnyiŋ. Ba jam ka nuruba tusa kook ale pisinu ale ŋata ale kobsiyuebi (153,600). 18Wa jam lueri ka nuruba tusa pisiyopɔi (70,000) ate ba chim jiirɔba ate tusa pinaanuŋ (80,000) a chim tain mobrisa guutaŋa zuima, ate tusa ŋata ale kobsiyuebi (3,600) a nya nuruma zuk ate ba a tom.

Title: 2 ŊIAK WIE 3
Content:
1Solomon yaa piilim Naawen yenni Jerusalem po Moria Guuku zuk, juijui ate Naawen a pai wadek a sak wa kowa Deevid la. Jam ka Jebus denɔwa Arauna ŋantaŋa fɔbika jigini ate Deevid a pai te la. 2Wa yaa jam piilim di sɛka bena ŋanaansiwa chiisa siyewa po, ka daa ŋayewa danni ate wa dɛ naamu la.
3Nyubini ate Solomon a jam dueni magsi Wen yenni la woglimmu jam ka anamagib kook ale pisiye, ate labsimu a chim anamagib pisinaansi. Magsi kpakka ate wa jam pai. 4Pɔsuku ale jam bo Naawen yenni niŋka la magsika woglimmu jam ka anamagib pisinaansi a soa ase yenni labsimu la ate di juelika magsika a chim anamagib kobsiye ale pisinaansi. Wa jam pai ka cheri ligmɔniŋ a taari di ponni po. 5Wa jam pai ka dapeelita a nak maŋ siaka a pai ligmɔniŋ maŋ a taari lik a ŋmirisi ku ale kpinkpatta tiisa ale chɔrima. 6Wa jam ŋmirisi Naawen yenni ale ka tintain ŋaai ale ta yuei la. Ligmɔniŋka ate wa jam pai nye la mɛ a jam nyini ka Parvaim tɛŋka. 7Wa jam pai ka ligmɔniŋka a vi chibsaŋa ale bo yenni zuk la ale tuoku zaŋŋa ale parisaŋa ale tuataŋa meena ale nye ŋanvuta a basi siaka nyiŋ.
8Wa jam sɛ Jigi Dii Ale Ŋmasi Ta Tuilum La, di woglimmu a jam a nye ase ka Naawen yenni labsimu la, magsika woglimmu jam ka anamagib pisinaansi, labsimu a chim anamagib pisinaansi. Wa jam pai ka ligmɔniŋ boorisa dobrim ale paari kobsiyuebi a nye di ponni po. 9Ligmɔniŋ piemaŋa dobrimu jam ka ligbie dobrim pisinu. Wa jam pai ka ligmɔniŋ a vi ŋmazukku.
10Jigi Dii Ale Ŋmasi Ta Tuilum La wa jam nyeka ŋanta ase ŋanvuta baye la a pai ligmɔniŋ a vi ba zuk. 11Javuk kinkaŋni a jam yalima ase ka anamagib pisinaansi la. Javuk kuui ale dɛ niŋka la kinkaŋni jam ka anamagib pi woglim a tiri Wen yenni parika, ate wa kinkaŋŋi din dila mɛ woglimmu a chim anamagib pi. 12Dila degadega ate javuk kuui ale saari bayewa la kinkaŋni woglimmu a chim anamagib pi a tiri Wen yenni parik kinkala, ate wa kinkaŋŋi din dila mɛ woglimmu a chim anamagib pi a tiri javuk kuui ale dɛ niŋka la. 13Ŋanvutaŋa de kinkaŋŋa a jam lagri ka anamagib pisinaansi a gum du. Ba jam yiti za kama a nya daloŋku dek.
14Wa jam pai ka garuk miik sobluk ale garuk miik mɔnuŋ ale gattiak naliŋ a yɔk ŋanta ale a nye ase ŋanvuta la ku nyiŋ.
15Naawen yenni niŋka wa jam zaani ka zaŋŋa ŋaye ate ŋa meena a gum chaab a chim anamagib pisiyopɔi, ate dinyi meena tulik a chim anamagib pi. 16Wa jam yɔk ka chɔrima a vi zaŋŋa zuk. Wa jam nye ka yɔn fi gilima kook a maŋ chɔrimaŋa. 17Wa jam ti ka zaŋŋa Naawen yenni niŋka ate dinyi bo yeseoku geŋsa ate ndila a bo wiilukku geŋsa. Dii ale bo yeseoku la wa te di yuei ayen Jakin, dii ale bo wiilukku la yuei a chim Boazi.

Title: 2 ŊIAK WIE 4
Content:
1Wa jam nye ka kutuk mɔnuŋ kuŋkuŋ ate ku woglimmu a chim anamagib pisinaansi, ku labsimu anamagib pisinaansi ate ku juelika a chim anamagib pisiye. 2Wa jam pa ka kutuk mɔnuŋ a nye taasi kpienni ate ba a wi ayen Nyakpiem, di ka beli gilinni, a nyini noawari a ta ga paari noawari, di magsika jam ka anamagib pisiye, ate di juelika a chim anamagib pi. Ka miik ale paari anamagib pisiyuebi ate ba pai a magsi gilim di. 3Noawanni tɛŋka ŋanta nna ase lalisa la ate ba nye gilim di, ate pi a bo anamagib buye po. Lalisaŋa a jam bo ka vuuk yeŋ po ale Nyakpiemu.
4Nyakpiemu a jam za ka ŋanta ase kutuk mɔnuŋ lalisa pi ale siye la zuk, sita a nya wiiluk geŋsa, sita a nya yeniŋ geŋsa, sita a nya yeseok geŋsa ate sita mɛ a nya kori geŋsa. Nyakpiemu a jam za ka si zuk, ate si gbinaŋa a tuak suŋsuŋka. 5Di biglimu a jam a nye ase ka anamagib bunyi la ate di noawanni a nye ase beerik noawari la, ase gum veok ale a pusi la. Di jam a jo nyiam a paari ka samɔnsa tusa ŋata (3,000).
6Wa jam nye ka taasi kpiema, pi mɛ a magsi sugrika a pai ŋanu a zaani yeseoku geŋsa ate ŋanu mɛ a bo wiilukku geŋsa. Ŋa po ka ŋan baai ate ba ale pai a nye juka kaabka la ate ba a yeeri du, alege benni ka kaabteerɔwa ale jam a sugri dula.
7Wa jam pai ka ligmɔniŋ a nye zeuŋ ŋanzaanita pi ase ku le magsi wa nye diila a pai ba a zaani Naawen yenni po ate sinu a bo yeseoku geŋsa ate sinu a bo wiilukku geŋsa.
8Wa jam nye ka ŋanzaanita pi a pai zaani Naawen yenni po ate banu a bo yeseoku geŋsa ate banu a bo wiilukku geŋsa. Wa jam pai ka ligmɔniŋ a nye chin misima kook.
9Wa jam nye kaabteerɔwa dabiaka ale buusa dɔk kpioŋku ale tuataŋa, a pai kutuk mɔnuŋ a vi tuataŋa zuk. 10Wa jam pai Nyakpiemu a zaani ka yeseoku kori geŋsa gugoruku po.
11Wa jam maa nye ka liisa ale saabuluta ale chin misima mɛ. Dila Yuram a jam tom Wen yenni tuini ate Naab Solomon a jam te wa ayen wa tom la a nueri kama: 12Wa nye zaŋŋa ŋayewa ale taasa ale tulisaŋa siyewa ale bo zaŋŋa zukparuk la, ŋanta bayewa ale ŋmirisi la, ŋanta bayewa ale nye ase taasa ŋaye zaŋŋa zuk la ale 13yɔn fi gilima kobsinaansiwa ale ŋanta bayewa ale ŋmirisi la ale yɔn fi gilimaŋa ale bo vuuta tiyewa a ŋmirisi la ŋanta bayewa ale tulisaŋa taasa ŋayewa zaŋŋa zukparuk la. 14Wa nye ŋanzaanitaŋa ale ŋa taasi kpiemaŋa ale 15nyakpiemu ale lalisa pi ale siyewa ale za bu kiri la. 16Liisaŋa ale saabulutaŋa ale lam duisitaŋa ale ŋan baai meena ale a nye ase chaab la. Ŋan baai meena ate Yuram Abi a jam nye te naab Solomon a magsi Wen yenni la jam ka kutuk mɔnuŋ ate ba salisi. 17Yakka tɛŋka ale bo Jodan Benni peelimmu po Sukkot ale Zaredata suŋsuŋ po la naawa yaa nye kutuk mɔnuŋ ŋantaŋa de. 18Ŋantaŋa de meena ate Solomon a jam nye la a zuak ka nna yega ate ba jam zɛ kutuk mɔnuŋku dobrimu ale jam ka diila.
19Solomon a jam maa nye ŋan baai meena ale bo Wen yenni po la kama: Bala ale ligmɔniŋ kuŋkuŋku ale ŋanzaanitaŋa tii zuk ate boroborok kuui ate ba ta a jam Wen niŋ la, 20ale zeuŋ ŋanzaanitaŋa ate wa nye ale ligmɔniŋ maŋ la ale si zeuŋtaŋa ayen ti a nya Wen yenni Jigi Dii Ale Ŋmasi Ta Tuilum La niŋ ase ku ale ka diila ale 21ligmɔniŋ puutaŋa ale ligmɔniŋ zeuŋtaŋa ale ligmɔniŋ duisuk nyina. 22Cheri ligmɔniŋ boom jaŋmienimmu ale taasa ale ŋan baai ate ba a ju ŋan baai nyum ale masa du la ale bolim taasa ale Wen yenni ligmɔniŋ golaŋa a magsi ponni po tuataŋa ale bo Jigi Dii Ale Ŋmasi Ta Tuilum La ale Wen yenni dɔk wɔglukku tuataŋa.

Title: 2 ŊIAK WIE 5
Content:
1Dila tuini meena ate Naab Solomon a jam tom Naawen Yenni po la ale ga nueri la, wa yaa ta ŋan baai ate wa kowa Deevid a gaari ba a te Wen tuimaŋa la a jo. Kpanaŋa ale ligmɔniŋka ale ŋan yoŋ tii meena ate ba ta a tom la. Wa jam pai jaab meena a nyo ka Wen Yenni ligra duenika jigini.
2Naab Solomon yaa jam tigsi Izirali nisɔmma baai ate diinaŋa nyam ale yezuimaŋa nyam a jam maa ka ba po la ate ba jam wa niŋ Jerusalem po ayen ba ta Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a nyini Zayon Deevid Tɛŋka a jam Jerusalem. 3Ate Izirali nidoama meena yaa jam jigi yeŋ naawa jigi tigini vaaŋa po chiisa siyopɔiwa po. 4Ase Izirali niŋdeerɔma meena ale jam paari la, Livaima yaa pai dakanni, 5ate ba yaa ta dakanni ale Tuka Viuku ale tuilum ŋantaŋa meena a jam di po. Kaabteerɔma baai ale jam ka Livaiba la ale jam ji ŋantaŋa, 6ate Naab Solomon ale Izirali tigsuŋku meena ale jam tigsi chaab ale wa la a bo dakanni tɛŋ, a nye kaabka ale piisa ale niiga nna yegayega ate ba zɛ ŋa nɔi yaase ba baga a chiini ŋa.
7Kaabteerɔma a yaa ta Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a jam di jigini Wen yenni niŋ dɔkku po, Jigi Dii Ale Ŋmasi Ta Tuilum La, a pai di a zaani ŋan baai ale a nye ase ŋanvuta la kiŋkaŋŋa kiri. 8Ŋanvutaŋa a jam lagri ba kinkaŋŋa a lik juijui ate dakanni a za la kama, ate kinkaŋŋa a lik dakanni ale di da yik jiintaŋa. 9Da yik jiintaŋa de a ŋmasi woŋŋa kama ate waai a dan za jigi dii ale ta tuilum la wa a nya ti kpeglimka, alege waai an baga a zaani peelim a nya ti jigi dii ale ŋmasi ta tuilum la. Da yik jiintaŋa a diem bo dula kama jinla de. 10Jaab a jam ka dakanni po ka tintain paglaksa siyewa ate Moosis a jam pai Yoreb guuku a nyo di po la, juijui ate Naawen a nye nɔiyeŋka ale Izirali demma ba le basi Ejipiti la ŋaaŋnyiŋ.
11Kaabteerɔma yaa jam ŋmani ale basi Jigi Dii Ale Ta Tuilum La. Kaabteerɔ baai meena ale jam bo dula la a jam nye badek ka cheri, ba le jam labi tɔgatɔga la meena po. 12Livaima meena baai ale jam ka yilendisa la Asaf ale Yeman ale Jedutun ale ba nidoabilisaŋa ale ba kobisaŋa yaa jam zaani kuŋkuŋku kori geŋka, a jo garuk naliŋta a nak bagansa ale kpanta ale dunduirisa. Kaabteerɔba kook ale pisiye ale jam peeri damunsa a va ba. 13Damun peerisaŋa ale yilendisaŋa a jam gum ka chaab ale lueluk yeŋ ayen ba pak abe ba te Naawen jiam. Ba jam ta ka damunsa ale bagansa ale ŋannagin yonta va, ba jam lak ka ba luelutaŋa ate ti jueli a pak Naawen a lenni yiila ayen, <<Wa ka Wen maŋ, wa ŋmanteka a boro kama taam wuu.>> Ate chiŋmari yaa jam sueri Naawen yenni, 14ate kaabteerɔma an jam baga a tom ba tuini chiŋmanni nyiŋ, diila Naawen zulaŋa a jam bo Wen yenni po kama.

Title: 2 ŊIAK WIE 6
Content:
1Solomon yaa weeni ayen, <<Naawen ayen wa ale bo ka chiŋma sobluk po. 2Mi sɛka yie naliŋ a te fu, jigi ayen fi a boro taam wuu.>>
3Ase Izirali tigsuŋku meena ale diem jam za dula la, naawa yaa viriŋ niak ba. 4Wa yaa weeni ayen, <<Pimpauk a cheŋ Naawen dii ale ka Izirali Wen la jigi, waai ale pai wa nisa a nye dii ate wa lak wa nɔi a puulim ale m kowa Deevid la. Wa weeni kama ayen, 5<A zaani dai dii danni ate m ta m nuruma a nyini Ejipiti po la, Mi an lueri tɛŋ a nyini Izirali dɔk kuui ya ayen ba sɛ yeri m Yuenni nyiŋ ate di bo dula, yaase m lueri nuru ayen wa chim niŋdeerɔ m nuruma Izirali demma zuwa. 6Yɔgyɔgla de mi lueri ka Jerusalem ayen m Yuenni a bo dula ale lueri Deevid ayen wa a nya m nuruma Izirali demma zuk.>
7<<Mi kowa Deevid a jam ta ku ka wa suinum po ayen wa sɛ yeri a te Naawen Yuenni, Izirali Wenni. 8Alege Naawen a weeni m kowa Deevid ayen, <Ku ale bo fi suinum po ayen fi sɛ yeri a magsi mi Yuenni la nyiŋ, fi nye kama nalimnyiini fi le ta kude fi suinum po la. 9Daa fi ale fi sɛ Naawen yenni, ka fi nidoabinni, waai ale ka fidek nyiŋ lam ale ziim la, wala ale waai ale wa sɛ yeri mi Yuenni nyiŋ.>
10<<Naawen a ta wa pumpuulimaŋa ate wa jam nye la kama. Mi za ka m kowa Deevid nankula po a kala Izirali naam zukpaglika zuk, ase Naawen ale puulim diila, ate m sɛ yeri a magsi Naawen Yuenni, Izirali Wenni. 11Dula ale mi pai dakanni, diipo ate nɔiyeŋka ate Naawen a jam nye ale Izirali demma la a bo di po la.>>
12Solomon yaa jam zaani Naawen kuŋkuŋku niŋ Izirali tigsuŋku meena niŋ a zak wa nisaŋa a tuk wenŋmazuk. 13Wa jam pai ka kutuk mɔnuŋ a nye bimbimi jaaliŋ ate di magsika woglimmu a paari anamagib pi ate di labsimu anamagib pi ate di juelika a chim anamagib buyuebi, a pai di a zaani dabiaka suŋsuŋka po. Wa jam zaani ka bimbimi jaaliŋka zuk a kpi duna tɛŋ Izirali tigsuŋku meena niŋ a zak wa nisaŋa a tuk wenŋmazuk. 14Wa weeni ayen, <<Naawen, Izirali Wen yaa, Wen a ka wenŋmazuk ase fi la yaase tɛŋzuk de, fi waai ale ta fi nɔiyeŋka ale a sak ŋmanteka ale fi tomteerɔma baai ale diem pai ba suiniima meena a va fi suiku la. 15Fi jam ta fi pumpuulimaŋa ale fi tomteerɔwa Deevid m kowa kama, fi lak ka fi nɔi a puulim, a pai fi nisaŋa a nye di ase ku le ka dii jinla de la.
16<<Yɔgyɔgla de Naawen, Izirali Wen yaa, ta fi pumpuulimaŋa ale fi tomteerɔwa Deevid m kowa ate fi jam nye la, waai ate fi jam weeni ayen, <Fi a kan jɔk nidoa ate wa kali m niŋ Izirali naam zukpaglika zuwa, ase fi nidoabilisaŋa a nin kpesi dii meena ate ba a nye a cheŋ mi niŋ a ta va m sinsaŋŋa, ase fi ale jam nye diila.> 17Yɔgyɔgla de, Naawen dii ale ka Izirali Wen la, basi ate fi wanni ate fi puulim ale fi tomteerɔwa Deevid la a chim wensie.
18<<Alege Wen a sum bo ka tɛŋzuk de ale nurubiiga? Ŋmazukku, wenŋmazuk an soa dii ate fi a boro alege ka yie fiika de ate mi a sɛ la! 19Alege dila meena wom fi tomteerɔwa puusaŋa ale wa ale a saalim a yaali jiirim la, Naawen m Wen yaa. Wom kaarika ale puusaŋa ate fi tomteerɔwa a puusi fi niŋ la. 20Lak fi nina a nya yenni de yok ale kantueŋ meena, dela jigini ale fi weeni ayen fi le pai fi Yuenni a nyoro la. Fi abe wom puusaŋa ate fi tomteerɔwa a tuk dela a puusi la. 21Wom fi tomteerɔwa ale a saalim la ale fi nuruma Izirali ase ba nin tuk dela nyiŋ a puusi. Wom a nyini wenŋmazuk fi boka jigini, fi be dan wom, vɔŋ a te ti.
22<<Ase nidoa a dan nye kaasi wa vaanchoa ate ku magsi wa nye pɛka, ate wa jam a nye pɛka fi kuŋkuŋku niŋ yenni de po 23be wom a nyini wenŋmazuk a nye wari. Bo fi tomteerɔma buusa, ŋma waai ale kaasi la abe fi basi ate wa ale nye diila a jam wa zuk. Weeni waai ale kan seba wari nɔi po la ayen wa an kaasi wari ya a tuni wa a va chaab ale wa wayɔrisimaŋa.
24<<Ase fi nuruma Izirali dachaasaŋa a dan nak yik ba, ba le nye biem a kaasi fi la nyiŋ, ase ba dan ŋmani a weeni ba biemu wari fi yuenni nyiŋ, a puusi ale yik badek a saalim fi niŋ yenni de po, 25be wom a nyini wenŋmazuk a vɔŋ fi nuruma Izirali biem a te ba, abe fi ta ba a ŋman tɛŋ kaai ate fi a te ba ale ba koma la po.
26<<Ase wenŋmazukku a dan lik ate ŋmoruk an ni ya, fi nuruma ale nye biem la nyiŋ, ase ba dan tuk dela nyiŋ a puusi a biisi ba biemu wari fi yuenni nyiŋ a basi ba biemu fi ale namsi ba la nyiŋ, 27Be wom a nyini wenŋmazuk a vɔŋ fi tomteerɔma biemu, fi nuruma Izirali biemu a te ba. Sak ba suik kuui ale magsi ba boro la, a basi ate ŋmoruk a ni tɛŋka ate fi jam te ba ase ba nitalim la zuk.
28<<Ase kɔm yaase nyiŋtuila a dan jam tɛŋka po, yaase chutika yaase kɔlika yaase tintue yaase nanchoŋta yaase dachaasa a jam lik ba a basi ba tɛŋka kanyi po, kaasuŋ kuui meena ale a jam la, 29ate fi nuruma Izirali demma waai nye puusa yaase wa saalim, ate ba wanyi meena a seba ku ale jo wa nyiŋ ale nyiŋdommaŋa la, a zak wa nisaŋa wenŋmazuk a tuk yenni de nyiŋ, 30Be wom a nyini wenŋmazuk, fi boka jigini. Vɔŋ a te abe fi nye ale waai meena a ta va wa nyeelaŋa, ase fi ale seba wa suinummu la, ka fi nyiini ale seba nuru suinum ale ka diila, 31ate dila ale basi ate ba yɔgsa abe ba va fi suitaŋa diipo meena ate ba le bo tɛŋka ate fi jam te ba koma la po.
32<<Dan ka nichamma baai ale kan nyini fi nuruma Izirali demma po la alege nyini ka tɛŋ sii ale yalima fi yuei kpienni ale fi ni kpieŋsaŋa ale nisaŋa ale a teeri la nyiŋ, ase wa dan jam a puusi a tuk yenni de nyiŋ, 33be wom a nyini wenŋmazuk fi boka jigini ale a nye dii ate nichamma a bek fu la, ate nuruma meena tɛŋzuk de a seba, fi yuenni ale a chali fu ase fidek nuruma Izirali demma ale ka diila, ale seba ayen yenni de ate m sɛ la a ta ka fi Yuenni.
34<<Ase fi nuruma a dan cheŋ ba kpaliŋ ale ba dachaasaŋa, juijui meena ate fi a tom ba la, ase ba dan tuk tɛŋka de ate fi lueri la ale Wen yenni ate mi sɛ fi Yuenni nyiŋla a puusi, 35be wom ba puusaŋa ale ba saalimka a nyini wenŋmazuk a maari ba.
36<<Ase ba dan nye biem a kaasi fi, diila nuru karo a kan nye biemmoa, ate fi sui a puuri ale ba ate fi pai ba a te dachiaka, waai ale wa ta ba a cheŋ yɔntidi po niŋniŋ yaase farafara de la, 37ase ba dan tagri ba suiniimaŋa tɛŋ kaai po ate ba boro ase yɔm la, a tagri a saalim fu yontini tɛŋka po ayen, <Tama a nye ka biem, tama tom kaasi kama a nye gaasa.> 38Ba dan tulim ŋaaŋ fi jigi ale ba suinum meena ale ba chiik meena ba yontini tɛŋka po juijui ate ba ta ba cheŋ la, a puusi a tuk tɛŋka ate fi a te ba koma la nyiŋ, a tuk tɛŋka ate fi lueri la, a tuk Wen yenni ate mi a sɛ fi Yuenni nyiŋla, 39be wom a nyini wenŋmazuk fi boka jigini, wom ba puusaŋa ale ba saalimka a maari ba. Abe fi vɔŋ a te fi nuruma baai ale nye biem a kaasi fi la.
40<<Yɔgyɔgla de m Wen yaa, be lak fi ninaŋa abe fi tueŋa a nye a wuli a wom puusaŋa ale nye dela jigini la.
41<<Naawen, m Wen yaa, Yɔgyɔgla de be yiti a jam fi vuusumu jigini, fi ale fi zuaka dakanni. Naawen, Wen yaa, fi kaabteerɔma varibasika abe lik ba ase garuk la, fi nuruma abe de masim fi wamaŋsaŋa po. 42Naawen, m Wen yaa, kan zɛri fi ale lueri waai la. Teeri fi ŋmanteka ate fi jam puulim Deevid fi tomteerɔwa la.>>

Title: 2 ŊIAK WIE 7
Content:
1Ase Solomon ale ga puusi nueri la, bolim yaa nyini wenŋmazuk a jam dɛ juka tiirimu ale kaabka, ate Naawen zulaŋa a sueri wa yenni. 2Kaabteerɔwa an jam baga a jo Naawen yenni po diila Naawen zulaŋa a jam sueri di kama. 3Ase Izirali demma meena ale jam nya ale bolimu a siŋ cheena ate Naawen zulaŋa a bo wa yenni zuk la, ba yaa kpi duna tɛŋ dabiaka po ate ba nina a vuk tɛŋka, ba jam a pak ale a te Naawen jiam ayen, <<Wensie, wa nala kama, wensie, wa ŋmanteka a boro kama taam wuu.>> 4Ate Naawa ale nuruma meena yaa nye kaabka Naawen niŋ. 5Naab Solomon yaa jam yik niiga tusa pisiye ale ŋaye (22,000) ale piisa ale bua tusa kook ale pisiye (120,000). Dila naawa ale nuruma meena yaa pa yenni a nyo Wen nisa po. 6Kaabteerɔma yaa zaani ba zaanaŋa jigini ase Livaima ale jam nye dii ale Naawen ŋannagintaŋa la, baai ate naab Deevid a jam nye magsi Naawen pakka la, baai ate wa jam te jiam ayen, <<Wa ŋmanteka a boro kama taam wuu.>> Livaima gauŋ, kaabteerɔma a jam peeri ba damunsaŋa ate Izirali demma meena a jam yiti za.
7Solomon a jam nye ate dabiaka suŋsuŋ a ta tuilum kama kaai ale jam bo Naawen yenni niŋ la, dula jigini wa jam nye ka juka tiirita ale suiyɔgni tiirita kpapalaŋa dii nyiŋla kutuk mɔnuŋ kuŋkuŋku ate wa jam nye la an soa dii a nye juka tiiritaŋa ale ŋandiinta tiiritaŋa ale suiyɔgni kpapalaŋa du.
8Dila Solomon yaa kpesi dɛ tiŋŋa va ŋala po daa ŋayopɔi ale Izirali demma tigsuŋku meena, nuruba ale nyini Yamat a ta ga paari Ejipiti Benni a jam tigini. 9Daa ŋayopɔiwa danni ba tigsi chaab, diila ba jam de kuŋkuŋku ate ba pai nyo Wen nisa po la tigini ka daa ŋayopɔi ale dɛ tigini daa ŋayopɔi a gum du. 10Daa pisiye ale ŋatawa danni chiisa siyopɔiwa danni, wa yaa basi nuruma ate ba kuli ba yieŋa ale mariŋka ale suipeentik ba suiniima po wamaŋsaŋa ate Naawen a nye te Deevid ale Solomon ale wa nuruma Izirali demma la.
11Ase Solomon ale ga nueri Naawen yenni ale naab yenni la, ale ba le ga nye dii meena ate wa jam ta wa popolaŋa po ayen wa nye Naawen yenni po ale wadek yenni po la, 12Naawen yaa jam wa jigi yok ayen, <<Mi wom fi puusaŋa kama ale lueri dela jigini a te m dek ase yeri la a magsi kaabka.
13<<Ase mi dan lik wenŋmazukku ayen ŋmoruk a kan ni, yaase m weeni tintue ayen ŋa jam kaasi tɛŋka yaase m tom nyiŋtuila ate ŋa jam m nuruma po, 14Ase m nuruma, baai ale a wi mi yuenni la, a dan yik badek a puusi a gisi mi nina a basi ba gaasa suitaŋa, mi yaa le wom a nyini wenŋmazuk a vɔŋ ba biemu a te ba abe m tebi ba tɛŋka. 15M ninaŋa ale lagri abe m wom puusaŋa ate ba nye dela jigini la. 16Mi ale lueri ale gomsi yenni de ayen m Yuenni a bo dula taam wuu. Mi nina ale m suinum ale kasim bo dula.
17<<Dan ka fi, fi daa cheŋ mi niŋ ase Deevid fi kowa ale jam nye diila ale nye dii meena ate m weeni fu la a kpesi ta m ŋmarisika ale buusaŋa. 18Mi ale basi ate fi naam zukpaglika a zaani paari, ase m le jam nye nɔiyeŋka ale fi kowa Deevid dii ase mi ale jam weeni ayen, <Fi a kan jɔk nuru ate wa nya Izirali zuk la.>
19<<Alege ase fi a dan viriŋ nakpiak a zɛri ŋmarisika ale wieŋa ate m te fu la a cheŋ bɛ a tom a te wen yona ale kaab ŋa. 20Mi yaa le ta Izirali demma a nyini m tɛŋka po, kaai ate mi a te ba la, abe m zɛri yenni de ate mi gomsi magsi m Yuenni la. Mi le basi ate ka gbenta ate nuruma ale nye ka a la. 21Ate Wen yenni de yaa le chim laata wari, baai meena ale a taam la ku le cha ba ate ba weeni ayen, <Ka boa ate Naawen a nye wanni de choa a te tɛŋka de ale yenni de?> 22Ate nuruba ale tulisi ayen, <Dii nyiŋla ba zɛri Naawen kama, ba koma Wenni, waai ale ta ba a nyini Ejipiti po ale kpari maŋ wen yona a kaab ale tom a te ŋa la. Dila ale soa ate wa ta kaasuŋku de meena a jam ba zuk.> >>

Title: 2 ŊIAK WIE 8
Content:
1Bena pisiye ale nueri la, ŋaai po ate Solomon a sɛ Naawen yenni ale wadek yenni la, 2Solomon a jam pilim sɛ tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa ate Yiram a te wa la kama, ate Izirali demma a kali si po. 3Solomon a jam cheŋ ka Yamat Zoba a nak yik ka. 4Wa jam maa sɛ Tadmor ale bo gɔnni po la ale ŋanta duenika tɛŋsaŋa Yamat po. 5Wa jam pilim sɛ Bet Yoron Ale Bo Ŋmazuk la ale Bet Yoron Ale Bo Gɔnni po la ase tɛŋ pagrisa la, ale parisa ale nansuiŋta ale taperisa. 6Wa jam maa sɛ Baalaya ale ka ŋanta duenika tɛŋsaŋa kama ale jiga a magsi wa torokoma ale wa wusumaŋa ale jabuui meena ate wa jam a yaali wa sɛ Jerusalem ale Lebanon ale juijui meena ate wa jam a nya la zuk.
7Nuru baai meena ale jam tali nyini Yit demma ale Amori demma ale Perizzi demma ale Yivi demma ale Jebus demma po la, nuruma de jam daa Izirali demma, 8ba ŋaaŋbisa ale la a tali bo tɛŋka po, baai ate Izirali demma an jam kaasi la, bade ate Solomon a jam basi ate ba a tom fifiok tuima ase ku le ka dii jinla de la. 9Alege Solomon an jam basi ate Izirali demma a chim yɔm wa tuini nyiŋŋa. Ba jam ka wa tugurik tɔŋdɔba kpaga a nya kpaga zuk ale kpaga a nya wa torokoma ale damdɔma zuk. 10Ba be jam ka Naab Solomon kpaga kobsiye ale pisinu a nya nuruma zuk ate ba a tom.
11Solomon a jam ta Faaro liewa a nyini Deevid Tɛŋka a jam ka naam yenni ate wa sɛ magsi wa la po ale weeni ayen, <<M powa ku a fɛ ate wa kan bo Deevid Izirali naawa naam yenni po, dii nyiŋla naam yieŋa ate Naawen dakanni a jo la a ta tuilum kama.>>
12Naawen kuŋkuŋku ate wa jam sɛ pɔsuku niŋ la, Solomon jam nye ka juka kaabka tiirita a te Naawen, 13a ta va chaab ale danni po tiiritaŋa ale magsi ba nye la, ase Moosis ale jam weeni ba a nye dii Vuusum Daaŋa ale Chiik Paalisa daa ale tiga ŋatawa beinni po. Ŋala ale Tigi Dii Ate Ba A Ŋɔbi Boroborok Kuui Ate Dabinta A Ka Ku Po La ale Bakoa Tigini ale Viita Tigini. 14Wa jam ta ka wa kowa Deevid sinsaŋŋa, a lueri kaabteerɔma beŋsa a magsi ba tuini, ate Livaima a de kaabteerɔma niŋ a pak abe ba a maari kaabteerɔma a ta va dai meena ale tuini ale ka diila. Wa jam lueri nansuiŋ limisidɔma mɛ kama beŋsa a magsi nansuiŋ meena, dii nyiŋla ka nnala ate Deevid Wen nuruwa a jam weeni la. 15Ba an jam basi naawa wieŋa ate wa jam weeni te kaabteerɔwa yaase Livaima la, a gum chaab ale ŋanta duenika jigini.
16Solomon tuini meena a jam nye kama a nyini dai dii danni ate Naawen, yenni nyubini a dueni a ta ga paari di nueri ka la. Dila Naawen yenni a jam nueri kama.
17Solomon yaa jam cheŋ Ezion Geber ale Elat tɛŋsaŋa ale bo Edom nyaataŋa nɔi la. 18Ate Yiram yaa jam tom ŋaaruŋ tii ate wadek kpaŋŋa a jam weeni ayen wa tom te wa la, bade, ale Solomon nuruma yaa lo jueli Ofir a ta ligmɔniŋ dobrim kobsinaansi ale pisinu a jam te Naab Solomon.

Title: 2 ŊIAK WIE 9
Content:
1Ase Siiba nipok naawa ale ga wom Solomon yammu wie la, wa yaa jam Jerusalem po ayen wa chamsi wa nya ale bega pagra. Wa jan jam ale tomteerɔ boari ale laalaakomiba a ji ŋan baai nyum ale masa la ale ligmɔniŋ nna yegayega ale tintain ŋaai diak ale pagra la. Wa jam Solomon jigi a biisi ale wa dii meena ate wa ta wa popolaŋa po la. 2Solomon a jam tulisi wa beŋŋa meena kama, wari an jam ŋmasi pagra a te wa ate wa an weeni di kiri a sak wa. 3Ase Siiba nipok naawa ale jam nya Solomon yammu ale jigini ate wa sɛ la, 4ŋandiintaŋa ale za wa jazaanimu zuk ale wa kpaŋŋa kalika jigini ale baai ale tom a te wa la ale jo ba gattaŋa diila, ale baai ale a te wa daam la ale jo ba gattaŋa dii ale juka tiiritaŋa ate wa jam nye Naawen yenni po diila, ku jam cha wa gaam taam kama.
5Wa yaa weeni naawa ayen, <<Mi ale wom a nyini m dek tɛŋka fi ale nye dii ale fi yammu wie la ka wensie. 6Mi an jam siak dii ate ba weeni la, ka mi ale jam nya ale m dek nina la. Chekki fi yam kpiemu geli ba an poom weeni mu, fi nye gaam mi ale wom diila kama. 7Nya fi nuruma sue ale peenti dii yaa! Nya fi kpaŋŋa sue ale peenti dii yaa, baai ale kasim za fi niŋ a wom fi yam wieŋa! 8Pimpauk a cheŋ Naawen fi Wenni jigi, waai ale mariŋ fu a pai fu a kali naam zukpaglik zuk ase naab la ayen fi nya a te Naawen fi Wenni. Dii nyiŋla fi Wenni ale ta yaalika ale Izirali la ale wa le ta koarisa ayen wa ta ba taam wuu la nyiŋ, ate wa yaa nye fu naab ba zuk ayen fi ta nyemagsika ale wayɔrisima.>>
9Wa yaa jam te naawa ligmɔniŋ dobrim boorisa kook ale pisiye ale ŋan baai nyum ale masa la nna yegayega ale tintain ŋaai ale ta yuei la. Ŋanta a jam ka ate ba nyum masa ase Siiba nipok naawa ale jam te naab Solomon baai la.
10Yuram nidoama ale Solomon nidoama a jam ta ka ligmɔniŋ a nyini Ofir a jam. Ba jam ta ka dapagrisa ale tintain ŋaai diak ale pagra la a jam. 11Naawa a jam pai ka dapagrisa a nye tiila a magsi Naawen yenni ale naam yenni ale pai ti a nye kpanta ale bagansa a te yi lendisaŋa. Ba an jam nya ŋan bala chaab Juda po a nya ya.
12Naab Solomon a jam te Siiba nipok naawa ka jabuui meena ate wa jam a yaali ale bek la, wa jam te wa ŋanta a gaam nipowa ale jam te wa ŋan baai la kama. Ate Siiba nipok naawa yaa ŋmani ale wa nuruma a kuli wa tɛŋka.
13Ligmɔniŋka dobrimu ate Solomon a jam a nya bein meena la jam ka boorisa dobrim ale paari kobsiyuebi ale pisiyuebi ale siyuebi. 14Daarɔma ale geruŋdɔma ale jam ta ligra ŋaai a jam la an maa gum du. Arabia nalimaŋa meena ale tɛŋka nyama mɛ a jam ta ka ligmɔniŋ ale kpana jam te Solomon.
15Naab Solomon a jam pai ka ligmɔniŋ a kuri nye kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsin kpienta kobsiye. Wanyi meena ka ligmɔniŋ ligbie dobrim ale paari kobsiyuebi ate ba kuri nye. 16Wa jam pai ka ligmɔniŋ a kuri nye kpaliŋ ŋan fiisa kobsita mɛ, ate wanyi meena ligbie dobrim a paari kook ale pisinu. Naawa a jam pai ba a basi ka wa yenni po dii ate wa a wi ayen Lebanon Sagni Naam Yenni la po.
17Naawa yaa jam nye naam zukpaglik kpieŋ a pai yauk nyina a gobi ka ale pai cheri ligmɔniŋ a vi ŋmanni. 18Naam zukpaglika a jam ta ka tiila ŋayuebi ate ligmɔniŋ naŋsa zukpaglik a maŋ ka. Ka gana buyewa meena jam ta ka nisa vika jigi, ate gbeŋli a za gauŋ meena. 19Gbeŋma pi ale ŋaye ale jam za tiila ŋayuebiwa zuk, dinyi a bo tiili meena kpeglimka. Kude choa an jam nye naam yoŋ po a nya ya. 20Naab Solomon beerisaŋa meena jam ka ligmɔniŋ, ŋantomtaŋa meena ale jam bo wa yenni po dii ate wa a wi ayen Lebanon Sagni Naam Yenni po la ka ligmɔniŋ maŋ. Ba an jam pai kpana nye jaaboa, diila kpana jam ka dobrim Solomon daaŋa po. 21Naawa a jam ta ka geruŋ ŋaaruŋta ate Yuram nidoama a nya ti zuk. Bunyi bena ŋata po ti nyiem ŋman jam kama a ji ligmɔniŋ ale kpana ale yauk nyina ale wiima ale faata.
22Naab Solomon a jam jigsi kama ta yam a gaam nalima meena tɛŋzuk de. 23Nalimaŋa meena ale bo tɛŋzuk de la a jam a cheŋ ka Solomon jigi a wom dii ate Wen a pai nyo wa suinummu po la. 24Bein meena waai meena ale a jam la a jam ale ka tiirim ase kpana ale ligmɔniŋ ale gatta ale tugurik kɔlima ale ŋan baai nyum ale masa la ale wusuma ale wusumbonsa.
25Solomon a jam ta ka nankpieŋsa tusa ŋanaansi (4,000) a magsi wusuma ale torokoba ale wusuma tusa pi ale ŋaye (12,000), ŋaai ate wa jam pai basi torokoma tɛŋsaŋa po la ale wadek jigi mɛ Jerusalem po. 26Wa jam a nya nalimaŋa meena zuk kama a nyini Yufiretis Benni a ta ga paari Filistia demma tɛŋka a ta a cheŋ Ejipiti tɛŋ banni. 27Naawa jam basi ate kpana a ka kɔm Jerusalem po ase ka tintana la ate nyunyoŋta a piisi ase kinkaŋsa la guutaŋa zuima.
28Solomon wusumaŋa ba jam da ŋa ka Ejipiti ale tɛŋsa si chaab meena.
29Dan ka Solomon naamu wayoŋ tintila, a nyini piilimka a ga paari kpeglimka, ŋala a ŋmarisi doa ka biisiteerɔwa Natan gbaŋka po, a bo Ayija Silon denɔwa ale jam ŋaam weeni diila po ale Iddo ale jam nya dii gɔdaasima po a ta va Nebat nidoabinni Jeroboam zuk la. 30Solomon a jam dɛ naam Jerusalem po a nya Izirali meena zuk ka bena pisinaansi. 31Wa yaa jam vuusi ale wa koma ate ba gu wa Deevid wa kowa tɛŋka po. Ate wa nidoabinni Areyoboam a zaani wa nankula po ase naab la.

Title: 2 ŊIAK WIE 10
Content:
1Areyoboam yaa jam cheŋ Sikiim, diila Izirali demma meena a jam cheŋ ka dula ba bobi wa naab. 2Ase Nebat nidoabinni Jeroboam ale wom kude la, wa jam bo ka Ejipiti, wa jam chali nyini ka Solomon jigi, wa yaa pilim ŋmani. 3Dila ba yaa tom wi Jeroboam ate wa ale Izirali meena a yaa cheŋ Areyoboam jigi a weeni wa ayen, 4<<Fi kowa a jam basi ate tama a tom ka tuim pagra, yɔgyɔgla de basi ate ku valima a te ti, kan basi ate tama a tom tuim pagra ase wa daam ale a nye diila ate tama ale tom a te fu.>>
5Areyoboam yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ni jam mi jigi daa ŋata dai.>> Dila nuruma a yaa jam cheŋ.
6Naab Areyoboam a yaa bek nisɔmma baai ale jam tom a te wa kowa Solomon diipo ate wa diem vua la ayen, <<Nama ale sak mu ka sɛ ate mi tulisi nuruma de?>>
7Ba yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ase fi a dan nye nuruma de a magsi ale nye ate ba sue a yɔk ale tulisi ba a magsi, ba ale kasim chim ka fi tomteerɔba.>>
8Alege Areyoboam a jam zɛri nisɔmma ale te wa sinsaŋŋa la kama ale bek nuru paalukku ale yiti ale wa a tom a te wa la. 9Wa jam bek ba kama ayen, <<Nama ale sak mi ka sɛ ate m tulisi nuruma de ale a yaali ayen mi nye ate ku valima a te ba a gaam mi kowa ale jam nye diila?>>
10Nuru paalukku baai ale chim ale wa la yaa tulisi ayen, <<Weeni nuruma de baai ale weeni fu ayen, <Fi kowa a jam te ti ka tuim pagra, alege basi ate ti tuimaŋa a valima la,> Weeni ba ayen, <Mi nandub fiika a zuak a gaam mi kowa chiaka kama. 11Mi kowa a jam basi ate ni a tom ka tuim pagra, alege mi ale basi ate ni ŋmasi tom tuim pagra a gaam dila. Mi kowa a jam a miiri ni ale ka fiŋsa, mi ale miiri ni ale ka muŋsa.> >>
12Daa ŋata ale taam la ŋaaŋnyiŋ Jeroboam ale nuruma meena a yaa ŋman jam Areyoboam jigi, ase naawa ale jam weeni ayen, <<Ni ŋman jam mi jigi daa ŋata po la.>> 13Ba le jam la naawa a jam tulisi ka nna kasɔ. A zɛri nisɔmma sinsaŋŋa, 14Naab Areyoboam jam va ka sinsak ŋaai ate nuru paalukku a sak wa la ayen, <<Mi kowa a jam te ni ka tuim pagra, mi ale basi ate ni ŋmasi a tom tuim pagra a gaam dila. Mi kowa miiri ni ale ka fiŋsa, mi ale basi ate ka nuenta a dom ni.>> 15Dila naawa an jam wom nuruma, kude a jam nyini ka Wen jigi ayen wanni ate Naawen a jam biisi a te Nebat nidoabinni Jeroboam a ta va Ayija Siilo tɛŋka denɔwa zuk la a chim wensie.
16Ase Izirali demma meena ale ga nya ale naawa a zɛri kama a kan yaali wa wom ba la, ba yaa tulisi naawa ayen, <<Ka boan jaab charuk ate tama a ta ale Deevid, kabi dina ate tama a ta ale Jese nidoabinni? Waai meena a cheŋ wadek viuk, Izirali demma, ni a nya nidek yeeŋa zuk ni basi ate Deevid biika a nya wadek nuruma zuk.>> Dila Izirali demma a yaa jam kuli. 17Alege Izirali demma baai ale jam bo Juda tɛŋsaŋa po la, Areyoboam ale diem jam a nya ba zuk.
18Naab Areyoboam a jam tom ka Yadoram, waai ale jam a nya fifiok tuimaŋa zuk la, alege Izirali demma a jam yuk wa ale tana a ko. Naab Areyoboam a jam nyeka nyiŋbiiri a jo wa torokowa po a chali bɛ cheŋ Jerusalem. 19Dila nyiŋ Izirali an jam siak a te Deevid yenni demma a ta paari jinla de.

Title: 2 ŊIAK WIE 11
Content:
1Ase Areyoboam ale jam paari Jerusalem po la, wa yaa tigsi Juda dɔkku ale Benjamin dɔkku tugurik tɔŋdɔba tusa kook ale pinaanuŋ (180,000) ayen ba nye kpaliŋ ale Izirali abe ba ŋman tuesi naamu a te wa.
2Alege Naawen wanni yaa jam Wen nuruwa Sɛmaiya jigi ayen, 3<<Weeni Juda naawa Solomon nidoabinni Areyoboam ale Izirali demma meena ale bo Juda ale Benjamin po la ayen, 4<Nnala ate Naawen a weeni. Kan jueli a nye kpaliŋ ale ni suataŋa. Ni kuli yeri, ni waai meena, ale kude ka mi ale nye.> >> Dila nyiŋ ba yaa wom Naawen wieŋa a ŋmani an nye kpaliŋ ale Jeroboam.
5Areyoboam jam bo ka Jerusalem po a se tɛŋ fiisa ate parisa a gilim si Juda po. 6Sila ale Betiliyem ale Etam ale Tekoa 7ale Bet Zur ale Soko ale Adullam 8ale Gat ale Maresa ale Zif 9ale Adoraim ale Lachis ale Azeka 10ale Zoraya ale Aijalon ale Yebron. Side ka tɛŋ sii ate parik pagrisa a gilim si Juda ale Benjamin po. 11Wa jam nye kama ate ba pagra kpaliŋ wie po ale basi ate kpaga a nya ba zuk, a te ba ŋandiinta ale kpaam ale daam. 12Wa jam pai ka kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsinta ale gbatta a basi si meena po, a nye ate si meena a ŋmasi pagra. Dila Juda ale Benjamin ka wa ale jam soa.
13Kaabteerɔma ale Livaima ale nyini ba tɛŋ ninaŋa meena Izirali meena po la yaa jam va wa. 14Livaima a jam zɛri ba wuyɔgsuku jiŋŋa ale ba nitalimu kama ale jam Juda ale Benjamin dii nyiŋla Jeroboam ale wa nidoabilisaŋa a jam zɛri ba kama ase Naawen kaabteerɔba la. 15Wa jam lueri ka wadek kaabteerɔba a magsi pimpitima ale buuku ale naabiika bɔgtaŋa ate wa jam nye la. 16Baai ale nyini Izirali buuni meena po baai ale pai ba suiniima meena a gisi Naawen, Izirali Wenni la, a yaa va Livaima a cheŋ Jerusalem ayen ba nye kaabka a te Naawen, ba koma Wenni. 17Ba jam chɔgsi Juda naamu kama ale maari Solomon nidoabinni Areyoboam bena ŋata, a cheŋ Deevid ale Solomon suitaŋa po vaaŋa de po.
18Areyoboam a jam faari ka Mayalat, wa jam ka Jerimot Deevid nidoabili wanyi lie, wa mawa jam le Abiyail, Deevid suoku Eliab lie. 19Nipowa ale jam biak nidoabili sii a te wa la jam le Jeus ale Sɛmariya ale Zayam. 20Wa ŋman jam faari ka Absalom lie Maaka, waai ale jam biak Abaija ale Attai ale Ziza ale Selomit la. 21Areyoboam a jam a yaali Absalom liewa Maaka a gaam wa pok yontaŋa ale pok dɔkliema kama. Ba meena a gum chaab, wa jam ta ka nipooba pi ale naaniŋ, pok dɔklieba pisiyuebi, nidoabilisa pisiye ale naaniŋ ale lieba pisiyuebi.
22Areyoboam a jam lueri ka Maaka nidoabinni Abaija ayen wa chim nabi kpagi wa suataŋa po a gomsi wa a magsi naab chimka. 23Wa jam nye ale ka yam a waaŋ wa nidoabilisaŋa gela Juda ale Benjamin tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa po ale tɛŋ sii meena ate parisa a gilim la po. Wa jam te ba ka nitalim nna yegayega ale faari nipooba a te ba.

Title: 2 ŊIAK WIE 12
Content:
1Areyoboam ale jam chim naab a nueri a pagra la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, wa ale Izirali demma meena a jam zɛri Naawen sinsaŋŋa kama. 2Dii nyiŋla ba jam ka wensie ale Naawen ya, Ejipiti naawa Sisak a jam nye ka kpaliŋ ale Jerusalem bena ŋanuwa po ate Areyoboam a dɛ naam la. 3Torokoba tusidi ale kobsiye (1,200) ale wusum duerisa tusa pisiyuebi (60,000) ale Libia tommu ale kan ta chiina la, Suki ale Kus demma ale jam va wa nyini Ejipiti a jam la, 4wa jam nak yik tɛŋ sii ate ba se parik pagrisa a gilim si Juda po la kama a jam paari Jerusalem.
5Biisiteerɔwa Sɛmaiya a yaa jam Areyoboam ale Juda niŋdeerɔma baai ale jam tigsi Jerusalem po Sisak yɔgsum chalika nyiŋla jigi, ate wa weeni ba ayen, <<Dii ate Naawen a weeni la ale nna, <Ni zɛri mi kama, dila nyiŋ, mi yɔgyɔgla de a zɛri ni kama a te Sisak.> >>
6Izirali niŋdeerɔma ale naawa yaa yik badek ayen, <<Naawen ka wensie nyɔnɔ.>>
7Ase Naawen ale jam nya ayen ba yik badek la, Naawen wanni de yaa jam Sɛmaiya jigi ayen, <<Ase ba le yik badek la, mi a kan kaasi ba, m le te ba ka varibasika. M suipuurumu a kan va Sisak zuk a jam Jerusalem zuwa. 8Ba ale tom a te wa kama, ate dila ale basi ate ba zamsi ku tɔgatɔgaka ale ka dii ate fi tom a te mi abe fi tom a te tɛŋ yonsa nalima.>>
9Ase Sisak Ejipiti naawa ale jam nye kpaliŋ ale Jerusalem la, wa jam ji Naawen yenni paaruŋku ale naab yeri paaruŋku a ta cheŋ kama. Wa jam pai jaab meena kama a gum chaab ale ligmɔniŋ kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsinta ate Solomon a jam nye la. 10Dila naab Areyoboam yaa jam nye kutuk mɔnuŋ kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsinta ate bala a tagri mbala zuk a pa bade a nyo kpaga ŋaai ale a nya baai ale jam bo naab yeri nansuiŋku nɔi a limisi la. 11Diipo meena ate naawa a cheŋ Naawen yenni la, limisidɔma a nyiem a jam pai kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsinta a yik tara, dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ ba ŋman ta ba a jo limisidɔma dɔkku po.
12Areyoboam ale jam yik wadek la nyiŋ, Naawen suipuurumu yaa basi wa, wa an jam kaasi wa. Chekki wamaŋsa maga a jam bo Juda po kama.
13Naab Areyoboam a jam kali paari kama Jerusalem po a tom du a cheŋ ase naab la. Wa jam ta ka bena pisinaansi ale dinyi ale chim naab, ale dɛ naam bena pi ale ŋayopɔi Jerusalem po, tɛŋ kaai ate Naawen a lueri nyini Izirali buuni meena po ayen wa pai wa Yuenni a basi du la. Wa mawa yuei jam le Naama, wa jam ka Ammon denɔ. 14Areyoboam jam nye ka biem dii nyiŋla wa an jam pai wa suinum a gisi Naawen ya.
15Dan ka Areyoboam naamu wieŋa a nyini piilimka a ta a cheŋ kpeglimka, ŋala a jam ŋmarisi doa ka biisiteerɔwa Sɛmaiya ale biisiteerɔwa Iddo ate ba jam a nye ale gaŋsa wie la gbaŋka po. Kpaliŋ ale kasim jam bo Areyoboam ale Jeroboam suŋsuŋ. 16Areyoboam a jam vuusi ale ka wa koma ate ba gu wa Deevid Tɛŋka po. Ate Abaija wa nidoabinni a zaani wa nankula po a chim naab.

Title: 2 ŊIAK WIE 13
Content:
1Jeroboam ale jam dɛ naam a paari bena pi ale naaniŋ po la, Abaija yaa jam chim Juda naab, 2wa jam nya Jerusalem zuk ka bena ŋata. Wa mawa yuei jam le Mikaiya, Gibea denɔwa Uriel lie. Kpaliŋ ale jam bo Abaija ale Jeroboam suŋsuŋ. 3Abaija yaa jo kpaliŋ po ale kpaliŋ tugurik tɔŋdɔba tusa kobsinaansi (400,000) ate Jeroboam yaa gomsi a tu wa ale tugurik tom tusa kobsinaaniŋ (800,000).
4Abaija a jam za ka Zemaraim Guuku zuk Ɛfraim tɛŋka ate guuta a bo ka po la zuk ayen, <<Jeroboam ale Izirali meena a wom mi. 5Nama zɛ ayen Naawen, Izirali Wenni, a pai Izirali naamu a te ka Deevid ale wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa taam wuu ale yesa nɔiyeŋ la? 6Dila meena Nebat nidoabinni Jeroboam ale jam ka Deevid nidoabinni Solomon kpagi la, yaa zɛri an siak a te wa kpagni. 7Baai ale kan ta zula a ka kiri la gela yaa tigsi gilim wa a zɛri Solomon nidoabinni Areyoboam diipo ate wa diem paala a kan poli wie zuk la ale an pagra a tu chaab ale ba.
8<<Ate yɔgyɔgla fi a yaali ayen fi kan siak a te Naawen naamu, buui ale bo Deevid ŋaaŋbisaŋa nisa po. Chekki ni ka tugurik tom buui ale zuak la ale ta ligmɔniŋ naabisaŋa ate Jeroboam a nye ate si chim ni wena la. 9Alege nama an yiak Naawen kaabteerɔma a basi ya, Aaron nidoabinni ale Livaima, ale lueri nidek kaabteerɔba ase tɛŋsa si chaab nuruba ale nye diila? Waai meena ale jam a nye wadek cheri ale lalik paalik ale padaasa siyopɔi la a baga a chim kaabteerɔ ale ŋan baai ale kan daa wena la kama.
10<<Dan ka tama, Naawen ale ti Wen, tama abe an zɛri wa. Kaabteerɔma baai ale tom a te Naawen la ka Aaron nidoabilisa ate Livaima a maari ba. 11Saluik meena ba a te Naawen ka juka tiirita ale ŋan baai nyum ale masa la. Ba a dueni boroborok ka jazaanimu ale nala la zuk a tɔti zeuŋtaŋa ligmɔniŋ jazaanimu zuk junɔi meena. Ti kpesi a nya Naawen ti Wenni wie ŋaai ale magsi la kama. 12Wen a bo le ti kama, wa ale tama niŋdeerɔ. Wa kaabteerɔma ale ba damunsaŋa ale kum kpaliŋ kaarika a siti ni. Izirali nidoaba, ni kan kpaliŋ ale Naawen, ni koma Wenni, ni kan nya nakdeka.>>
13Jeroboam a jam tom ka tugurik tom ate ba bo ŋaaŋ, ase wa ale bo Juda niŋ la baai ale suk doa la a jam bo ka ŋaaŋ. 14Juda demma yaa viriŋ nya ale ba siti ba kama niŋ ale ŋaaŋ. Ba yaa kaari a te Naawen. Kaabteerɔma yaa peeri ba damunsaŋa 15ate Juda nidoama yaa kaari kpaliŋ kaarik, ase kpaliŋ kaarika ale jueli la, Wen yaa pai Jeroboam ale Izirali demma meena a nyo Abaija ale Juda nisima po. 16Izirali demma a jam yiti chali kama Juda niŋ, ate Wen a pai ba a nyo ba nisa po. 17Abaija ale wa nidoama a jam te ba ka tuem nna yega, ate nuruba tusa kobsinu (500,000) a kpi. 18Izirali nidoama ba jam nya pagrim ba zuk kama dila po, ate Juda demma a chim nakdeerɔba dii nyiŋla ba jam zak a nya ka Naawen ba koma Wenni.
19Abaija a jaa vi Jeroboam ka dila a ga tuesi Betel ale Jesana ale Efron tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa ale si tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa ale gilim si la a nyini wa jigi. 20Jeroboam an ŋman jam nya pagrimoa Abaija vaaŋa po. Naawen a jam nak wa a lɔnsi kama ate wa kpi.
21Abaija a jam boro ale ka nyiŋ pagra. Wa jam faari ka nipooba pi ale banaansi, a ta nidoabilisa pisiye ale baye ale lieba pi ale bayuebi.
22Abaija naamu wayoŋ tintila, dii ate wa jam nye la ale dii ate wa jam weeni la, a ŋmarisi doa biisiteerɔwa Iddo gbaŋka po kama.

Title: 2 ŊIAK WIE 14
Content:
1Abaija a jam vuusi kama ale wa koma ate ba gu wa Deevid Tɛŋka po. Asa wa nidoabinni ale jam zaani wa nankula po ase naab la, wa daaŋa po tɛŋ kpieŋka a jam ta ka suiyɔgni bena pi.
2Asa a jam nye ka wamaŋsa ale dii ale nala Naawen wa Wenni nina po. 3Wa jam kpiti kuŋkuŋ chaŋsaŋa ale pimpitimaŋa ale ŋɔriŋ tintain ferim weleŋsaŋa ale che Asera zaŋŋa a lɔnsi. 4Wa jam weeni Juda kama ayen ba gisi Naawen, ba koma Wenni abe ba siak wa sinsaŋŋa ale wa wieŋa. 5Wa jam kpiti pimpitimaŋa ale ŋan baai nyum ale masa la kuŋkuŋtaŋa Juda tɛŋsaŋa po meena kama ate naamu a jam ta suiyɔgni wa vaaŋa po. 6Wa jam sɛ ka parik pagrisa a gilim Juda tɛŋsaŋa diila tɛŋka a jam ta ka suiyɔgni. Waai a jam ka kpaliŋ ale wa bein ŋala po, diila Naawen a jam te wa ka vuusum.
7Wa jam weeni Juda ayen, <<Ni basi ate ti sɛ tɛŋsaŋa de, a gilim si ale parisa ale kiaga a su tuata ale taperisa. Tɛŋka ka tama ale diem soa, dii nyiŋla ti gisi Naawen ti Wenni kama, ti gisi wa kama ate wa te ti vuusum jigi meena.>> Dila ba yaa jam sɛ ale jigsi.
8Asa a jam ta ka tugurik tom tusa kobsita (300,000) Juda po, wa gomsi ba ale kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsin kpienta ale gbatta, ate tusa kobsiye ale pinaanuŋ (280,000) a nyini Benjamin, ate ba mɛ a gomsi ale kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsin fiisa ale tima. Bade meena jam ka tugurik tɔŋdɔ baai ale toa.
9Kus denɔwa Zera yaa gɔk santiri a tu chaab ale ba ale tugurik tom nna bissi ale torokoba kobsita ate ku yalima a nyini Maresa. 10Asa yaa nyini ayen wa tu wa, ate ba yaa zaani kpaliŋ zaana jigi Zefata Viaka po moata Maresa.
11Asa yaa wi Naawen wa Wenni ayen, <<Naawen yaa, waai a karo ase fi la a maari waai ale kan ta pagrim la a tu chaab ale tanjaŋini. Maari ti, Naawen ti Wen yaa, ale tama zak a nya ka fi, fi yuenni nyiŋ ate tama a baga a tu tugurik tom boanni de. Naawen yaa, fi ka tama Wen, kan basi ate nurubiik a nya pagrim fi zuwa.>>
12Naawen yaa lɔnsi Kus demma tɛŋ Asa ale Juda niŋ ate ba yiti chali, 13ate Asa ale wa tommu a vi ba a ta ga paari Gerar tɛŋka Kus nuru boanni ale jam lo la an ŋman jam yiti ya, ba jam ŋɔriŋ kama Naawen ale wa tugurik nyama niŋ. Juda nidoama a jam ji ka ŋanta nna yega a ta cheŋ. 14Ba jam kaasi tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa meena ale gilim Gerar la kama, diila Naawen yɔgsum ale lo ba zuk. Ba jam kɔlim tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa de meena kama, ŋan maŋsa ale jam bo si po la nyiŋ. 15Ba jam maa siti naapeerisaŋa boka jigini kama a yiak piisa ale bua ale laalaakomiba a ta cheŋ. Ba yaa ŋman cheŋ Jerusalem.

Title: 2 ŊIAK WIE 15
Content:
1Wen Chiika yaa jam Oded nidoabinni Azariya po. 2Wa jam nyini wa tu Asa a yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Wom mi, Asa ale Juda ale Benjamin demma, Naawen a bo le ni ase nama a nin bo ale wa. Ni dan gisi wa, ni le nya wa, alege ni dan zɛri wa wa le zɛri ni. 3Ku beni ka nna yega Izirali an jam bo ale wensie Wenni, kaabteerɔ a jam karo a sagi, ba ŋman jam ka sinsaga. 4Alege ba ninammu po, ba jam viriŋ Naawen, Izirali Wenni jigi kama a gisi wa a jam nya wa. 5Va ŋala po ku jam daa moali ate fi nyiem a gilimmu, diila tɛŋsaŋa meena a jam bo ka daani kpieŋ po. 6Tɛŋ kpieŋ kanyi nyiem ale ŋɔriŋ nka ate tɛŋ fiik a ŋɔriŋ ka choa, dii nyiŋla Wen a jam namsi ba ale daanika nna tɔgatɔga. 7Alege dan ka fi, be pagra abe fi kan jɔk yiila, fi le nya tutuna fi tuini nyiŋ.>>
8Ase Asa ale ga wom wieŋa de ale Oded nidoabinni biisiteerɔwa Azariya ale porisi diila, wa yaa jam nya nyiŋbiiri. Wa yaa jam kpiti kisuk bɔgtaŋa meena Juda ale Benjamin tɛŋsaŋa po ale tɛŋ sii ate wa nak yik Ɛfraim tɛŋka ate guuta a bo ka po la. Wa ŋman jam tebi Naawen kuŋkuŋku ale jam bo Naawen yenni po suiku niŋ la kama.
9Wa yaa jam tigsi Juda ale Benjamin demma meena ale Ɛfraim nuruma ale Manasa ale Simeyon baai ale jam kali ba po la, nuru boari ale jam nyini Izirali a jam wa jigi ase ba le jam nya ayen Naawen wa Wenni a jam bo ale wa la.
10Ba jam tigsi ka Jerusalem po chiisa sitawa po bena pi ale ŋanuwa po ate Asa a dɛ naam la po. 11Va ŋala po ka niiga kobsiyopɔi ale piisa ale bua tusa ŋayopɔi (7,000) ate ba jam kaab te Naawen. Ba jam ta ŋa nyini ka kpaliŋka po ate ba kɔlim la a jam. 12Ba jam jo ka nɔiyeŋ po ayen ba gisi Naawen ba koma Wenni ale ba suiniima meena ale ba chiisa meena. 13Baai meena ale ka a gisi Naawen, Izirali Wenni la, ba le kpi kama, wa dan ka nuru kpioŋ yaase nuru fiik yaase nidoa yaase nipok wa le kpi. 14Ba jam nye ka pɛka a te Naawen ale nyiŋ zeentika nuemka ale a na a peeri damunsa. 15Juda meena a jaa naŋ kama pɛka nyiŋ dii nyiŋla ba jam pɛ ale ka ba suiniima meena. Ba jam nya gisi Wen kama nalimnyiini a jam nya wa. Dila Naawen a jam te ba ka vuusum jigi meena.
16Naab Asa a jam yeeri wa ma kpieŋka Maaka wa naamu po kama ase naab pok la, dii nyiŋla wa jam nye ka Asera kisuk zaŋŋi. Asa a jam che zaŋni a lɔnsi kama, a wɛ di a ju di Kidron Viaka po. 17Alege wa an jam kpiti pimpitimaŋa Izirali po a basi ya, Asa suinummu meena a jam bo ka Naawen jigi wa boka po meena. 18Wa jam ta kpanaŋa ale ligmɔniŋka ale ŋantomtaŋa ate wa ale wa kowa a pai te Wen wa yenni po.
19Kpaliŋ a ŋman jam ka ate ku paari bena pisita ale ŋanu ate Asa a dɛ naam la.

Title: 2 ŊIAK WIE 16
Content:
1Asa ale jam dɛ naamu a paari bena pisita ale ŋayuebi la, Izirali naawa Baasia yaa jueli siti Juda a sɛ parik a gilim Arama a kasi ayen waai a kan baga a nyini ka po yaase wa jo Juda naawa Asa tɛŋ banni po.
2Asa yaa jam pai kpanaŋa ale ligmɔniŋka Naawen yenni ŋanta dueni ka jigini ale wadek yenni po a ta nyini ga te Araam naawa Ben Yadad, waai ale jaa nya Damasikus zuk la. 3Wa jam weeni kama ayen, <<Basi ate nɔiyeŋ a bo mi ale fi suŋsuŋ ase ku le jam ka dii mi kowa ale fi kowa suŋsuŋ la. Nya, mi a tom ka kpana ale ligmɔniŋ a te fu. Kaasi fi nɔiyeŋka ate fi nye ale Izirali naawa Baasia la ate dila ale basi ate wa ŋmani abe wa basi mi.>>
4Ben Yadad yaa siak dii ate naab Asa a weeni la a tom wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma kpaga ate ba ga siti Izirali. Ba jam nak yik Ijon ale Dan ale Abel Maim ale Nafitali ŋanta duenika jigini tɛŋsaŋa kama. 5Ase Baasia ale ga wom kude la, wa yaa basi Arama sɛka ale banti tuini. 6Naab Asa yaa ta Juda nidoama meena a jam ate ba ji tanaŋa ale daataŋa ate Baasia a jam tom la a ta nyini Arama a cheŋ. Wa jam pai tanaŋa ale daataŋa a sɛ ka Geba ale Mizpa tɛŋsaŋa.
7Va ŋala po biisiteerɔwa Yanani yaa jam Juda naawa Asa jigi a weeni wa ayen, <<Fi ale pai yiila a basi Araam zuk alege daa Naawen fi Wenni zuk la nyiŋ ate Araam naawa tugurik tommu a bɛ nyini fi nisa po la. 8Kus demma ale Libia demma tugurik tommu an jam zuak a piisi ale torokoba ale wusum duerɔba? Alege fi ale jam pai fi yiila a basi Naawen jigi la, wa jam pai ba a nyo fi nisa po kama. 9Naawen nina a bo tɛŋzuk de meena kama ayen wa te baai suiniima meena ale bo wa jigi la pagrim. Ni tom ka betta tuini, a nyini yɔgyɔgla de a cheŋ ni le kasim bo ka kpaliŋ po.>>
10Asa sui ale jam a puuri ale biisiteerɔwa kude nyiŋ ku jam kasim a kab wa kama ate wa pai wa nyo likka dɔk po. Va ŋala dek po, Asa a jam te ku jo nuruma gela nyiŋ ka nna yegayega.
11Asa naamu wieŋa, a nyini piilimka a ta ga paari kpeglimka, a jam ŋmarisi doa Juda ale Izirali nalima gbaŋka po kama. 12Asa naamu bena pisita ale neokku po nyiŋtuila ale jam yik wa naŋtaataŋa. Nyiŋtuilaŋa a jam ŋmasi pagra kama, wa yuammu po meena wa an jam gisi maarika a nyini Naawen jigi ya, ka tinaŋsa nyam nyiini. 13Asa naamu bena pisinaansi ale dinyiwa po, wa yaa kpi a vuusi ale wa koma. 14Ba jam gu wa ka vɔrumu ate wa jam keri a magsi wadek la Deevid tɛŋka po. Ba jam pai wa a dueni ka kpieba jaab zuk a pai ŋan baai nyum ale masa la ale kpaata nna tɔgatɔga a gum chaab, a cheem bolim kpiem a te wa zula.

Title: 2 ŊIAK WIE 17
Content:
1Asa nidoabinni Jeyosafat ale jam zaani wa nankula po ase naab la ale te wadek nyiŋ pagra a tu chaab ale Izirali. 2Wa jam pa ka tugurik tom boari a basi Juda tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa po meena ate ba sɛ parisa a gilim ale basi tɔŋdɔba Juda ale Ɛfraim ate wa kowa Asa a jam nak yik la po.
3Naawen a jam bo ale Jeyosafat kama dii nyiŋla wa paalimu benaŋa po, wa jam a cheŋ ka suik tii ate wa kowa Deevid a jam va la po. Wa an jaa bek Baal wen jigi ya, 4alege wa goanti a gisi ka wa kowa Wenni ale va wa wieŋa, wa kan tomsi Izirali demma nyeelaŋa. 5Naawen a jam basi ate naamu a zaan paari kama wa nisima po, ate Juda demma meena a te Jeyosafat tiirita, ate dila a basi ate wa jigsi a ta zula. 6Wa suinummu a jam bo ka Naawen suitaŋa jigi, a ŋman gum du wa jam kpiti pimpitima kama ale che Asera zaŋŋa Juda po a basi.
7Bena ŋatawa po ate wa de naamu la wa yaa jam tom wa kpaŋŋa Ben Yail ale Obadia ale Zakaria ale Netanel ale Mikaiya ayen ba ga sak Juda tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa po. 8Livaiba gela ale jam va ba. Bala abe le Sɛmaiya ale Netania ale Zebadia ale Asayel ale Sɛmiramot ale Jeyonatan ale Adonija ale Tobijaya ale Tob Adonija ale kaabteerɔma Elisama ale Jeyoram. 9Ba jam sak kama ale gaam Juda a basi, ba jam pai ka Naawen Sinsaŋŋa Gbaŋka, ba jam cheŋ kama a gilim Juda tɛŋsaŋa meena a sak nuruma.
10Naawen yɔgsum yaa yik tɛŋsaŋa meena naataŋa ale gilim Juda la, ate ba an nye kpaliŋ ale Jeyosafat. 11Filistia demma gela yaa ta tiirita a jam Jeyosafat jigi ale kpana ase zula la, ate Arab demma a ta duŋ buulim a jam te wa. Duŋsaŋa a jam ka padaasa tusa ŋayopɔi ale kobsiyopɔi (7,700) ale bua tusa ŋayopɔi ale kobsiyopɔi (7,700).
12Jeyosafat yaa ŋmasi jam pagra a gum du, wa jam sɛ ka yie ale ŋanta duenika jigi Juda po 13ale jam tali ŋanta a zuak basi Juda po. Wa jam maa basi ka nuru baai ale nye kpaliŋ nya la Jerusalem po. 14Ba dɔkdemma po ate ba jam te ba tuimaŋa la ale nna. A nyini Juda dɔkku tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale jam a nya beŋsa tusidi zuk la jam le: Adnaa a jam a nya ka tugurik tɔŋdɔba tusa kobsita (300,000) zuk. 15Jeyoyanan ale jam pasaŋ a nya tugurik tɔŋdɔba tusa kobsiye ale pinaanuŋ (280,000) zuk, 16butawa po jam ka Zikri nidoabinni Amasiya, waai ale pa wadek a te Naawen tuini ale tugurik tɔŋdɔba tusa kobsiye (200,000). 17A nyini Benjamin dɔkku jam ka Eliada tugurik tɔŋdɔ tuak ale nuruba tusa kobsiye (200,000) ale tima ale kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsinta. 18Jeyozabad mɛ a jam ta ka tugurik tɔŋdɔba tusa kook ale pinaanuŋ (180,000) a gomsi magsi kpaliŋ.
19Bade jam le nidoa baai ale jam tom a te naawa la, baai ate wa jam basi ate ba bo Juda tɛŋka meena po la an jam gum du.

Title: 2 ŊIAK WIE 18
Content:
1Yɔgyɔgla de Jeyosafat a jam jigsi kama a ta zula, wa yaa nye nɔiyeŋ ale Ayab a faari wa lie. 2Bena magadek ale taam la wa yaa cheŋ Samaria ayen wa puusi Ayab. Ayab a jam tɔgri ka piisa ale niiga nna yegayega a te wa ale nuruma ale jam va wa la ale weeni wa ayen wa ga nye kpaliŋ ale Aramot Gilead tɛŋka. 3Izirali naawa Ayab yaa bek Juda naawa Jeyosafat ayen, <<Fi ale va mu a ga nye kpaliŋ ale Aramot Gilead?>> Jeyosafat yaa tulisi ayen, <<Mi a nye ase ka fi la, ate m nuruma mɛ a nye ase fi nuruma la, ti le gum fi po kpaliŋka po.>> 4Jeyosafat mɛ yaa weeni Izirali naawa ayen, <<De niŋ a bek Naawen.>>
5Dila Izirali naawa yaa jam ta biisiteerɔba kobsinaansi a jam jigi yeŋ a bek ba ayen, <<Ti ga nye kpaliŋ ale Aramot Gilead yaa ti kan cheŋ?>> Ba yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ni cheŋ ale Wen ale pai ka a nyo naawa nisa po.>>
6Alege Jeyosafat a jam bek ayen, <<Naawen biisiteerɔ a ka dela ate ti ga kpesi wom?>>
7Izirali naawa yaa tulisi Jeyosafat ayen, <<Nuru wanyi a diem boro ate tama a baga a va wa zuk a kpesi a wom a nyini Naawen jigi, alege mi kisi wa kama dii nyiŋla wa an diem porisi wa maŋ a te mi, wa kasim a weeni mi ka kaasuŋ nyiini. Wa ka Imla nidoabinni Mikaiya.>> Jeyosafat yaa tulisi ayen, <<Naawa an magsi wa weeni dila.>>
8Dila Izirali naawa yaa wi wa kpaŋŋa wanyi ayen, <<Ta Imla nidoabinni Mikaiya a jam.>>
9Izirali naawa ale Juda naawa Jeyosafat a jam jo ba naam gatta a kala ba naam zukpagliksaŋa zuk, juijui ate ba a fɔbi ŋanta la Samaria tɛŋka nansuiŋku nɔi ate biisiteerɔma meena a porisi ba niŋ. 10Chenaana nidoabinni Zedekia a jam nye ka kutuk nyiila ale mooli ayen, <<Dii ate Naawen a weeni la ale nna, <Ni ale pa ka nyiilaŋa de a chub Araam demma ate ku paari diipo ate ni ko ba la.> >>
11Biisiteerɔ mbala a jam a porisi ka wayeŋka ayen, <<Nye kpaliŋ ale Aramot Gilead a nya pagrim ba zuk, ale Naawen ale pa ba a nyo naawa nisa po.
12Tomtomdɔ waai ale jam cheŋ wa wi Mikaiya la yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Nya de, biisiteerɔ mbala meena a weeni kama ayen naab Ayab ale nya nak dɛka, basi ate fi ale a weeni diila a va bala ale weeni diila biisi ale ŋmanteka.>> 13Alege Mikaiya a weeni wa ayen, <<Ase Naawen ale vua la, mi ale weeni wa ka dii nyiini ate mi Wenni a weeni la.>>
14Ase wa ale jam paari la, naawa yaa bek Mikaiya ayen, <<Mikaiya, ti cheŋ ga nye kpaliŋ ale Aramot Gilead yaa m kan cheŋ?>> Wa yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ni ga nye a nya nakdeka, ba ale jo ni nisa po.>>
15Naawa yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Ka bu dina ate mi ale te fi pɛ a kan weeni mu wayoŋ alege ka wensie nyiini Naawen yuenni nyiŋŋa?>>
16Mikaiya yaa tulisi ayen, <<Mi nya ale Izirali meena a waaŋ chaab guutaŋa zuima ase piisa ale kan ta naapeerik diila, ate Naawen ayen, <Nuruma de a ka niŋdeerɔ. Basi ate ba kuli yeri ale suiyɔgni.> >> 17Izirali naawa yaa weeni Jeyosafat ayen, <<Mi an poom weeni fu ayen wa an diem porisi wamaŋ a te mi, ka kaasuŋ nyiini?>>
18Mikaiya a weeni a gum du ayen, <<Dila nyiŋ wom Naawen wanni. Mi nya ale Naawen a kala ka wa naam zukpaglika zuk ate wenŋmazuk tommu a za gilim wa juga ale gala meena. 19Naawen yaa weeni ayen, <Ka wana ale wa paasi Izirali demma naawa Ayab ate wa nye kpaliŋ ale Aramot Gilead tɛŋka ate wa ga kpi dula?> Nuru yeŋ a zok nna ate wa choa ayen nnala.
20Kpeglimka chichirik biok yaa jam niŋ nyiŋ, a zaani Naawen niŋ ayen, <Mi ale paasi wa.>
21<<Naawen a bek ayen, <Fi ale nye ka sɛ a nye dila?> Ate chichirik bioku a tulisi ayen, <Mi ale nyini peelim a ga jo wa biisiteerɔma meena nɔi po.> Naawen ayen, <Fi le nya suik a paasi wa, cheŋ ga nye dila.> >> 22Mikaiya a weeni ayen, <<Naawen a basi ate fi biisiteerɔma a velim te fu kama, Naawen abe weeni kama ayen kaasuŋ a jam fi zuk.>>
23Chenaana nidoabinni Zedekia yaa ga fɔbi Mikaiya ale bek ayen, <<Ka suik kuna po ate Naawen Chiika a nyini mi po a ga biisi ale fi?>>
24Mikaiya yaa tulisi ayen, <<Fi ale nya dila ka dai dii dai ate fi ale chali ga suk niŋ dɔk po la.>>
25Izirali naawa yaa weeni ayen, << Ni yik Mikaiya a ta wa ŋman ga te Amon tɛŋ kpieŋka niŋdeerɔwa ale naawa nidoabinni Joas 26ale weeni ayen, <Dii ate naawa a weeni la ale nna. Ni pa nuruwa de a nyo likka dɔk po abe ni kan te wa jaaboa, ni te wa boroborok ale nyiam nyiini ate ku paari diipo ate mi ale ŋmani ale suiyɔgni la.> >>
27Mikaiya yaa tulisi ayen, <<Fi a dan ŋman nalimnyiini, Naawen an va mi zuk a biisi ya.>> Wa yaa ŋman biisi a gum du ayen, <<Ni a teeri mi wieŋa, nama nuruba meena.>>
28Dila Izirali naawa ale Juda naawa Jeyosafat yaa jueli Aramot Gilead. 29Izirali naawa yaa weeni Jeyosafat ayen, <<Mi ale tagri m dek a jo kpaliŋka po alege fi a jo fi naam gattaŋa.>> Dila Izirali naawa yaa jam tagri wadek a cheŋ kpaliŋka po.
30Araam naawa a jam weeni wa torokoma kpaŋŋa kama ayen, <<Ni kan kpaliŋ ale waai ya ku nyɔnɔwa dan poom pɔsima yaase wa zuak, ka Izirali naawa nyiini.>> 31Ase torokoma kpaŋŋa ale ga nya Jeyosafat la, ba poli ayen, <<Izirali naawa ale nna.>> Dila ba yaa viriŋ ba kpaliŋ ale wa, ate Jeyosafat yaa kaari ate Naawen a jam maari wa. Wen yaa yiak ba a basi ale ge wa. 32Torokoma kpaŋŋa ale jam nya ayen daa Izirali naawa ale la la, ba yaa jam basi wa vika.
33Alege nuru wanyi yaa yeeri wa tom nna kadi a tɔŋ Izirali naawa kpaliŋ kɔlimaŋa paaŋa po. Naawa yaa weeni toroko damdɔwa ayen, <<Dam a gilim a ta mu a nyini kpaliŋka po, mi nya ka tuem.>> 34Danni po meena kpaliŋka a jam pagra kama, ate Izirali naawa a gomsi wadek a bo wa torokowa po a tu chaab ale Araam demma ate ku paari junɔi, wenni ale ga siŋ la wa yaa kpi.

Title: 2 ŊIAK WIE 19
Content:
1Ase Juda naawa Jeyosafat ale jam ŋmani nalimnyiini Jerusalem po la, 2Yanani nidoabinni biisiteerɔwa Jeyu, yaa jam nyini wa tu wa a yaa weeni naawa ayen, <<Fi ale maari gaasa nyama abe fi a yaali baai ale kisa Naawen la? Kude nyiŋ Naawen suipuurumu ale jam fi zuk. 3Alege wamaŋ ale bo fi po fi che Asera zaŋŋa tɛŋka po a basi kama ale gisi Wen ale fi suinum.>>
4Jeyosafat a jam bo ka Jerusalem po ale jam ŋman pilim va nuruma a nyini Beerseba a ga paari Ɛfraim tɛŋka ate guutaŋa a bo ka po la a tulim ba a te Naawen, ba koma Wenni. 5Wa jam lueri ka boteerɔba tɛŋka po, Juda tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa ate parisa a gilim la po. 6Wa jam weeni ba kama ayen, <<Ni kpesi dii ate ni a nye la nalimnyiini, dii nyiŋla ni an bo a te daa nuru, ka Naawen, waai ale bo ale ni ate ni a bo buusa la. 7Yɔgyɔgla de ni basi ate Naawen yɔgsum a bo ni jigi. Ni kpesi a bo buusaŋa nalimnyiini, Naawen ti Wenni jigi ŋurima ŋurima yaase lukka yaase diak wari a karo.>>
8Jerusalem po mɛ, Jeyosafat a jam lueri ka Livaiba gela ale kaabteerɔba ale Izirali dɔkdemma yieŋa nyam ayen ba a sak Naawen sinsaŋŋa abe ba a nya nanpaga wie zuk. Ba abe jam bo ka Jerusalem po. 9Wa jam te ba ka wieŋa de ayen, <<Ku a fɛ ate ni tom a te ale wensie ale ni suiniima meena abe ni a chali Naawen yɔgsum. 10Wari meena po dii ale nyini nidek tɛŋ demma baai ale bo tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa po ale ni la jam ni jigi la, ku dan poom ka ziim ale nyini yaase wayoŋ a nyini sinsaŋŋa ale wieŋa ale ŋmarisika yaase buusa nama ale ni kaam ba ate ba kan nye biem a kaasi Naawen ya, kan daa di wa suipuurumu ale jam nama ale ni suataŋa zuk. Ni nye kude ate ni kan nye biemmoa.
11<<Kaabteerɔ kpagni Amariya ale wa a nya ni zuk dii meena ale ta wari a nye ale Naawen la, abe Ismael nidoabinni Zebadia, Juda dɔkku buuni niŋdeerɔwa, wala ale wa nya ni zuk dii meena ale ta wari a nye ale naawa la, abe Livaima a tom ase kpaga la ni niŋ. Ni nye ale nyiŋbiiri, Naawen abe bo ale baai ale a tom nalimnyiini la.>>

Title: 2 ŊIAK WIE 20
Content:
1Kude ŋaaŋnyiŋ Moab demma ale Ammon demma ale Meuni demma gela yaa jan jam ayen ba nye kpaliŋ ale Jeyosafat.
2Nidoaba gela jam weeni Jeyosafat ayen, <<Tugurik tom boari ale nyini Edom tɛŋka a cheena ayen ba nye kpaliŋ ale fu, ba nyini ka nyakpiemu kauk kunkula. Ba poom bo ka Yazazon Tamara.>> En Gedi ale la. 3Yɔgsum yaa yik Jeyosafat ate wa poli wa kpesi a wom Naawen jigi ale weeni ate Juda meena a bobi nɔi. 4Juda nuruma meena yaa jam jigi yeŋ a gisi maarika a nyini Naawen jigi. Ba jam nyini ka jigi meena Juda tɛŋka po a jam a gisi Naawen.
5Jeyosafat yaa jam yiti zaani Juda ale Jerusalem tigsuŋku po Naawen yenni dabiak paalika po, 6ayen, <<Naawen yaa, tama koma Wenni, fi daa Wen ya waai ale bo wenŋmazuk la? Fi ale a nya tɛŋsa meena naataŋa zuk. Pagrim ale zuaka a bo ka fi nisa po, ate waai an baga a zaani ale fi. 7Ti Wen yaa, fi an yiak tɛŋka de demma a basi a te fi nuruma Izirali demma ale pai ka a te Abrayam fi doawa ŋaaŋbisaŋa taam wuu? 8Ba bo ka ka po a sɛ yeri fi Yuenni nyiŋ ayen, 9<Ase kaasuŋ a dan lo ti zuk, ku ka gebik buusa yaase nyiŋtuila yaase kɔm, ti le zaani fi niŋ yenni de ale ta fi Yuenni la po a kaari a te fi ti ninammu po, ate fi le wom ti a vari ti basi.>
10<<Alege yɔgyɔgla de nuruba ale nna a nyini Ammon ale Moab ale Seir Guuku baai tɛŋsa ate fi an basi ate Izirali a fɛ jo si po diipo ate ba nyini Ejipiti a jam la, dila ba yaa viriŋ cheŋ ale basi ba an ko ba. 11Nya dii ate ba ŋman pai a tuni tama ase ba le jam a yiak ti ayen ti basi tɛŋka ate fi te ti ase ti nitalim la. 12Ti Wen yaa, fi a kan bo ba buusa? Tama a ka pagrim a tu chaab ale tom boanni de ale a siti ti la. Tama a zɛ ti le ti nye diila, alege ti ninaŋa a bo ka fi zuk.>>
13Juda nidoama meena ale ba pooma ale bisaŋa ale ŋan fiisaŋa yaa jam za dula Naawen niŋ.
14Naawen Chiika yaa jam Zakaria nidoabinni Jayaziel zuk. Benaya nidoabili ale jam nye Zakaria ate Jeiel nidoabili a chim Benaya ate Mattania nidoabili a chim Jeiel. Mattania jam ka Livai denɔ a chim Asaf ŋaaŋbiik, ase wa le jam yiti zaani tigsuŋku po la.
15Wa weeni ayen, <<Naab Jeyosafat ale baai meena ale bo Juda ale Jerusalem po la a wom de, dii ate Naawen a weeni la ale nna: <Kan chali yɔgsummoa yaase fi jɔk nyiŋbiiri tugurik tom boanni de nyiŋŋa. Ale kpaliŋka daa fi le soa, ka Wen. 16Chum gɔk santiri a siŋ siti ba. Ba le jueli va Ziz Suiku, ate fi le nya ba vooliŋka kpeglimka ale bo Jeruel Gɔnni po la. 17Ku an magsi fi kpaliŋ kpaliŋka de. Ni zaani ni jiŋŋa. Ni zaani giŋgiŋ ate ni nya varibasika ate Naawen ale te ni la, Juda ale Jerusalem demma. Ni kan chali yɔgsummoa, ni be kan jɔk nyiŋbiiri, ni nyini a ga tu ba chum, Naawen ale bo ale ni.> >>
18Jeyosafat yaa koori a pai nina a vuk tɛŋka ate Juda ale Jerusalem nuruma meena a lo tɛŋ a puusi Naawen. 19Livaiba gela yaa nyini Koyat ale Koora diinaŋa yaa jam zaani a seni Naawen, Izirali Wenni ate ku jueli.
20Saluik yokyokwa ba yaa cheŋ Tekoa Gɔnni po. Ase ba le nyini la, Jeyosafat yaa zaani ayen, <<Ni wom mi, Juda ale Jerusalem nuruba! Ni ta siaka ale Naawen ni Wenni ate ni le nya pagrim. Ni ta siaka ale wa biisiteerɔma ate ni nya bo maŋ.>> 21Wa le wom nuruma ale sak wa diila ŋaaŋnyiŋ, Jeyosafat a jam lueri ka nuruba ayen ba lenni yiila a te Naawen abe ba a seni wa zuaka weleŋsaŋa ase ba le jam nyini le wom tugurik tommu kpagni ale weeni ayen, <<Ni te Naawen jiam ale wa ŋmanteka a boro kama taam wuu.>>
22Ase ba le piilim, a lenni ale a pak la, Naawen yaa gu a limisi Ammon ale Moab ale Seir Guuku nidoama baai ale jam fɛ a jo Juda po la a nak yik ba. 23Ammon ale Moab nidoama yaa yiti ta chaab ale nidoa baai ale nyini Seir Guuku la ayen ba kaasi ba chessi. Ba ale jam tɔgri nidoama ale nyini Seir la a ga nueri la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, badek yaa jam a ko chaab.
24Ase Juda nidoama ale jam paari gɔnni po la ba nya ka tugurik tom boanni ale kpi doa tɛŋka. Ba wanyi an chali bɛ ya. 25Dila Jeyosafat ale wa nuruma yaa ga pai ba ŋantaŋa a ta cheŋ, ba jam nya ka kɔlima ale gatta nna yega ale ŋantomta mɛ ate ba dobra a gaam ba pai ta cheŋka. Ŋantaŋa a jam piisi ka nna yega ate ba pai daa ŋata a ji ba. 26Daa ŋanaansiwa danni ba yaa jam tigsi Berakaya Viaka po, yuenni kiri ale niaka, juijui ate ba jam pak Naawen la. Dila ale soa ate ba a wi dula ayen Berakaya Viak jinla danni la.
