1Ase Juda ale Benjamin dachaasaŋa ale wom ayen ba boro a sɛ Naawen, Izirali Wen yenni la, 2ba yaa jam Zerubabel ale yeeŋa nyama jigi a weeni ba ayen, <<Basi ate tama a maari ni ate ni sɛ, ase nama la, tama a gisi ni Wenni ale a nye kaabka a te wa a ta nyini Assiria naawa Esayaddon daaŋa po, waai ale ta tama a jam dela la.>>
3Alege Zerubabel ale Jesua ale Izirali yeeŋa nyama meena a tulisi ba ayen, <<Nama a ka wari a nye ale tama a ta va chaab ale Naawen yenni sɛka. Tama nyiini ale sɛ a te Naawen, Izirali Wenni, ase Naab Sairus, Persia Naawa ale weeni diila.>>
4Ate nuru baai ale gilim ba la a yaa jaa a nye ayen Juda demma a jɔk nyiŋbiiri abe ba nye ate ba a chali yɔgsum ate ba kan baga a sɛ. 5Ba yaa da sagrɔba ayen ba tom a kaasi ba ale a poli ba nye dii Persia naawa Sairus naamu daaŋa po a ta ga paari Persia naawa Darius daaŋa po la.
6A ta nyini piilimka diipo ate Ayasuerus a dɛ wa naamu la, ba yaa velim a te Juda ale Jerusalem demma.
7Ate diipo ate Artasaset a chim Persia Naab la, Bislam ale Mitredat ale Tabeel ale ba ŋaaŋviirɔma meena a yaa jam ŋmarisi gbaŋ a te Artasaset. Ba jam ŋmarisi gbaŋka ale ka bi kaai ate ba a wi ayen Araam demma biik la.
8Areyum waai ale jaa a nya ba zuk la ale Simsai gbaŋ ŋmarisidoawa a yaa weeni wie a te Jerusalem ale Naab Artasaset ayen, 9Areyum waai ale jam a nya ba zuk la ale Simsai gbaŋ ŋmarisidoawa a gum chaab ale ba vaanchaama meena baai ale a bo buusa ale baai ale a nya nuruba zuk la ate ba nyini Tiripolis ale Persia ale Erek ale Babilon la, ale Iilam demma ale nyini Susa la, 10ale mbala baai ate Osnappar a poori nyini ba po a ga kala Samaria tɛŋka po ale Yufiretis Benni Kunkɔŋ Kinkala la.
11Gbaŋka ate ba jam a tom a te wa la ale nna. Ka tama fi tomteerɔma, nuru baai ale nyini Yufiretis Benni Kunkɔŋ Kinkala la ale ŋmarisi gbaŋka de a te Naab Artasaset: 12Naawa a magsi ayen wa sebi kama ayen Juuma baai ale nyini fi jigi a jam tama jigi la a cheŋ ka Jerusalem a ŋman pilim boro a sɛ tukpari ale gaasa tɛŋka. Ba ŋaan gomsi nyubini ale parisaŋa a magsi kama.
13A ŋman gum du, naawa a magsi ayen wa sebi kama ayen ba dan se tɛŋka ale ka parisaŋa, lampoo a kan ŋman tuni, ate naa yeri wieŋa ale a kan nye nalimnyiini. 14Ase tama ale bo ka naab yenni po la ku kan magsi ayen ti ka a te wa zula, ti nya wanni de kama ate tama a yaali ti weeni a sak naawa, 15ate dila ale basi ate wa kpesi nya gbaŋ sii po ate fi kokpieŋsaŋa a ŋmarisi la po. Ase fi a dan nye dila, fi ale nya ayen a nyini dila po wa tɛŋka de ka tukpari tɛŋ ale kasim a yaali wie a te nalima ale tɛŋka niŋdeerɔwa. Ka nuruma nyeka a jam toa kama ale fi ale dɛ ba niŋ. Dila ale soa ate tɛŋka a kaasi la. 16Ti weeni naawa kama ayen ase ba dan sɛ tɛŋka ale ka parisaŋa, fi kan nya jaaboa a ta nyini Yufiretis Benni Kunkɔŋ Kinkala ŋmana.
17Ate Naawa a yaa tom a tulisi ayen: ate fi kpagni ale Simsai gbaŋ ŋmarisidoawa ale mbala meena ale ba vaanchaama ale bo Samaria ale Yufiretis Benni Kunkɔŋ Kinkala geŋsa la: Mi a puusi ni.
18Gbaŋ kaai ate fi a tom te ti la ba kariŋ ka kama ale weeni mu dii ale bo ka po la. 19Mi te ka suik ate ba gisi, ale nya mɛ ayen tɛŋka de a nyini dila po wa ba gomsi kama ayen ba zɛri nalimaŋa ale ba weeni diila, dula ka tukpari ale baai ale nye ate nuruba a zɛri kpaga nɔi. 20Jerusalem jam ta ka nalima ŋaai ale pagra ate ba a nya Yufiretis Benni Kunkɔŋ Kinkala zuk ale lampoo ale tiiritaŋa meena ka ba ale jaa a tuesi. 21Yɔgyɔgla de be weeni nuruma de ate ba basi tomka, ate kula ale nye ate ba basi sɛka a ga paari diipo ate m le te ba suik la. 22Bi kpesi fidek ate fi kan zɛri wanni de. Kan basi ate nyinyigsaŋa de a chim a gum du, a kaasi naamu wie.
23Ase ba ale ga kariŋ Naab Artasaset gbaŋka ate wa ŋmarisi la a te Areyum ale Simsai gbaŋ ŋmarisidoawa ale ba vaanchaama a wom la, ba nye nwuli a cheŋ Juuma ale bo Jerusalem la a ga fɛ ba ayen ba basi tuini.
24Naawen yenni tuini Jerusalem po a jam doa ka dila a ta ga paari bena ŋayewa po ate Persia naawa Darius a dɛ wa naamu la.

Title: EZRA 5
Content:
1Yɔgyɔgla de Naawen biisiteerɔwa Aggai ale biisiteerɔwa Zakaria, Iddo ŋaaŋbiika, a jam mooli te Juuma ale bo Juda ale Jerusalem po la Izirali Wenni yuei nyiŋ, waai ale a nya ba la. 2Ate Sealtiel nidoabinni Zerubabel ale Jozadak nidoabinni Jesua a yaa piilim tuima a boro a sɛ Naawen yenni Jerusalem po. Ate Naawen biisiteerɔma a jam maa boro ale ba, a maari ba.
3A nyini dila po wa Yufiretis Benni Kunkɔŋ Kinkala zuk niŋdeerɔwa Tattenai ale Setar Bozenai ale ba vaanchaama a jam cheŋ ba jigi a bek ayen, <<Ka wana ale te ni suiku de ayen ni ŋman pilim sɛ Naawen yenni abe ni zak di a zaani?>> 4Ba mɛ a ŋman bek ba ayen, <<Nuru baai ale a sɛ la yuei ale boa?>> 5Alege ba Wenni nina a jam bo Juuma nisɔmma zuk kama, alege ba an basi tomka a ta ga paari diipo ate tontomiŋka a jam paari Darius ate wa yaa ŋmarisi tulisi ba.
6Gbaŋka ate Tattenai, niŋdeerɔ waai ale jaa a nya Yufiretis Benni Kunkɔŋ Kinkala zuk la ale Setar Bozenai ale ba vaanchaama, ale kpaŋŋa meena ale bo Yufiretis Benni Kunkɔŋ Kinkala la ale jam tom te Naab Darius la ale nna. 7Wie ŋaai ate ba jam tom a te wa la ale nna. Naab Darius tama a puusi fu. 8Naawa a magsi ayen wa seba ayen tama cheŋ Juda tɛŋka po kama, ale Naawen Kpienni yenni. Nuruma a boro a pai tintain kpiema a sɛ ale pai tapaga a vi parika zuk. Tuini a cheŋ kama nalimnyiini ase di ale magsi di cheŋ diila.
9Tama a yaa bek niŋdeerɔma ayen, <<Ka wana ale te nama suik ayen ni ŋman pilim sɛ Naawen yenni?>> 10Ti be ŋman pilim bek ba kama ayen ba yue ale boa? Dii ale ku nye ate tama ŋmarisi ba niŋdeerɔma yueŋa ate ti weeni ba wie a sak fu.
11Dii ate ba tulisi ti la ale nna: <<Ti ka wenŋmazuk ale tɛŋzuk Wenni tomteerɔba, ate tama ŋman pilim boro a sɛ Naawen yenni dii ate ba poom a liŋ jam sɛ di bena ŋaai ale taam la, dii ate Izirali naab kpioŋku a jam sɛ di tuk la. 12Alege ti koma ale nye ate wenŋmazuk Wenni sui a puuri la, wa yaa pai ba a nyo Nebukadnezzar Kaldiya denɔwa nisima po, Babilon Naawa ale la, waai ale kaasi Wen yenni de alege ta nuruma a cheŋ Babilon tɛŋka.
13Ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ, Babilon Naawa Sairus ale piilim a dɛ wa naamu ben diila, naab Sairus a yaa te suik ayen ba sɛ Wen yenni. 14Wa yeeri ligmɔniŋka ale kpana ŋanti baai meena ate Nebukadnezzar a jam pai a ta nyini Wen yenni ale bo Jerusalem po la a ta kuli wa yenni Babilon la a te kama. <<Naab Sairus a jam pai ba a te ka nuru wanyi ate ba a wi wa ayen Sesbazzar, waai ate wa jam basi ate wa chim niŋdeerɔ la. 15Ale weeni wa ayen, <<Pai ŋantaŋa de a ta ga nyo Wen yenni ale bo Jerusalem la po. Abe fi ŋman pilim sɛ Wen yenni a zaani di jigini. 16Ate Sesbazzar wade a yaa jam dueni Wen yenni nyubini Jerusalem po. A nyini da di la danni a ta jam paari jinla ba diem boro a sɛ di kama ba an diem nueri ya.>>
17Nya kude dan yɔk naawa sui, basi ate ti gisi a ta nyini naab yeri ŋiak wieŋa po a ta nyini Babilon po ate ti nya ase Naab Sairus a sum jam te ka suik ayen ba ŋman pilim sɛ Wen yenni Jerusalem po ya. Basi ate Naawa a weeni ti wa popolaŋa ale ka dii a ta va wanni de la.

Title: EZRA 6
Content:
1Naab Darius a yaa basi ate ba gisi Babilon po dɔkku po ate ba jam a dueni ŋanta du la. 2Ba yaa yaali jabuui ate ba jam ŋmarisi yueŋa a dueni wa zuk la Ekbatana tɛŋka ate ka bo Miidi po la, dii ate ba jam ŋmarisi la abe le nna: 3Naab Sairus ale dɛ wa naamu bein diila, Naawa a yaa weeni wari ale fifiok a ta va Wen yenni Jerusalem po: Ni pilim a sɛ Wen yenni ase jigi la a magsi kaabka, abe ni dueni nyubini. Ku woglimmu a magsi ku paari ku naŋtuok nɔi pineok, 4abe ni pai tintain kpiema a sɛ paari kaarima ŋata abe le pai tapaga a sɛ kaarinni dinyi a gum du. Pamini ka waai ale a nya ligraŋa zuk naab yeri la ale wa tuni. 5Ligmɔniŋka ale kpanaŋa ale jam bo Wen yenni po la, ŋaai ate Nebukadnezzar a jam pai a ta nyini Wen yenni ale bo Jerusalem po la a ta jam Babilon, a magsi ba ŋman ŋmani kama a cheŋ ba jigini Wen yenni Jerusalem po. Ba magsi ba bo ka Wen yenni po.
6Yɔgyɔgla de, Tattenai, niŋdeerɔ waai ale a nya Yufiretis Benni Kunkɔŋ Kinkala zuk la, ale Setar Bozenai ale fi, ba kpaga ŋaai ale bo tɛŋka po la, a yaa jam bo ba tɔga. 7Ni kan basi ate ni niŋ a bo ale Wen yenni tuimaŋa po. Ni basi ate Juuma niŋdeerɔwa ale Juuma nisɔmma a pilim sɛ Wen yenni de a zaani di jigini.
8Alege m ŋman weeni ni, ni le ni nye dii a te Juuma nisɔmma a magsi chaab ale Wen yenni sɛka la. Nuruma de tuimaŋa ligra meena a tuni a nyini naam ligraŋa po, a nyini Yufiretis Benni Kunkɔŋ Kinkala lampoowa po ate tuini kan wari. 9Jabuui meena ate ba a yaali la, lalik paalisa ale padaasa ale padabilisa a magsi juka tiirim a te wenŋmazuk Wenni ale ŋanbie ale yesa ale daam ale kpaam ase kaabteerɔma ale bo Jerusalem la a nin bek a yaali. Ku a fɛ ate ni te daa meena ni kan zɛri, 10ate ba nye kaab sii ale a peenti wenŋmazuk Wenni sui abe ba puusi ate wari meena a nye nalimnyiini a te naawa ale wa nidoabilisaŋa.
11A ŋman gum du, m weeni kama ayen waai a dan zɛri wanni de ba ale yeeri ka chib wa yenni po a peesi bu a pai chub wa ko ate wa yenni ale chim tampoi ate ba kpiiri yaata a basi du. 12Wen, waai ale basi ate wa Yuenni a bo dula la, abe yeeri naab waai yaase nuru waai ale zak nisa ayen wa tagri wanni yaase wa kaasi Wen yenni de Jerusalem po la a basi. Mi Darius a te suik kama ayen ni kpesi a nye kude.
13Alege Naab Darius fifiok wanni nyiŋ ate wa jam tom Tattenai, gomina waai ale a nya Yufiretis Benni Kunkɔŋ Kinkala zuk la ale Setar Bozenai ale ba ŋaaŋviirɔma ate ba ta di a nyini. 14Dila nyiŋ Juuma nisɔmma a yaa pii nyiŋ ase ba ale a nya niaka a ta nyini Wen wanni ate biisiteerɔma Aggai ale Iddo ŋaaŋbiika Zakaria a jaa a biisi a te ba la jigi. Ba jam nueri Wen yenni kama a ta va chaab ale Izirali Wenni ale Persia nalimaŋa Sairus ale Darius ale Artasaset ale jam weeni diila. 15Ba jam sɛ Wen yenni a nueri ka Adar chiika ka daa ŋata danni, bena ŋayuebiwa po ate Darius a jam de wa naamu la.
16Ate Izirali nuruma ale kaabteerɔma ale Livaima ale baai ale ŋman jam la a yaa jam de Wen yenni teka tigini ale suipeentik. 17Ba ale jam pai yenni a boro a nyo Wen nisima po la ba teka lalisa kook, padaasa kobsiye ale padabilisa kobsinaansi ayen ba pai a nye biem vɔŋteka kaabka a te Izirali meena, budukta pi ale tiye, ale ba jam te ayen ba pai kunyi kunyi a te Izirali buura pi ale buyewa meena. 18Ate ba yaa poori kaabteerɔma ba tɔga Livaima mɛ ba tɔga a magsi chaab ale Wen tuimaŋa Jerusalem po, a ta magsi chaab ale dii ale ŋmarisi Moosis gbaŋka po la.
19Chiik kaai ale dɛ niŋka la ka daa pi ale ŋanaansiwa danni baai ale nyini yontini po a kuli la a dɛ Gaambasika Tigini kama. 20Kaabteerɔma ale Livaima a gomsi badek kama a nala. Livaima a yaa tɔgri Gaambasika pabiika a te baai meena ale nyini yontini po a jam la, ale ba suataŋa kaabteerɔma ale badek. 21Ate Izirali demma baai ale nyini yontini po a jam la a yaa dɛ ale baai meena ale poori badek a ta nyini baai ale kan daa Juuba la daŋta wie po ayen ba gisi Naawen, Izirali Wenni la. 22Daa ŋayopɔi ba kasim a jam pai a ŋɔbi ka boroborok kuui ate ba an nyo dabinta ku po la tigini, dii nyiŋla Naawen a basi ate ka ba sue a peenti a ta va wa ale tagri Assiria Naawa popolaŋa la, ate wa maari ba ate ba tom Wen yenni Izirali Wenni tuini la.

Title: EZRA 7
Content:
1Wieŋa de meena ŋaaŋnyiŋ, diipo ate Persia naawa Artasaset a ta wa naamu la, Ezra kowa a jam ka Seraiya, Seraiya kowa a jam ka Azariya, Azariya kowa a jam ka Yilkia, 2Yilkia kowa a jam ka Sallum, Sallum kowa a jam ka Zadok, Zadok kowa a jam ka Ayitub, 3Ayitub kowa a jam ka Amariya, Amariya kowa a jam ka Azariya, Azariya kowa a jam ka Meraiot, 4Meraiot kowa a jam ka Zerayia, Zerayia kowa a jam ka Uzzi, Uzzi kowa a jam ka Bukki, 5Bukki kowa a jam ka Abisua, Abisua kowa a jam ka Fineyas, Fineyas kowa a jam ka Eleaza, Eleaza kowa a jam ka Aaron, Aaron a jam ka kaabteerɔ kpioŋ. 6Ezra wade a jam nyini ka Babilon jam. Wa jam ka sagrɔ waai ale seba Moosis Sinsaŋŋa ŋaai ate Naawen, Izirali Wenni a jam te la. Naawa a jam te wa jaabuuri meena ate wa bek la kama, dii nyiŋla Naawen wa Wenni nisa a jam bo wa zuk kama. 7Izirali demma gela ale kaabteerɔma ale Livaima ale yilendisaŋa ale baai ale a nya nansuiŋtaŋa zuk la ale baai ale jam a tom Wen yenni po la, meena a yaa jam Jerusalem po bena ŋayopɔiwa po ate Naab Artasaset a jam dɛ wa naamu la.
8Ezra a jam Jerusalem po ka chiisa sinuwa po bena ŋayopɔiwa po ate naawa a dɛ wa naamu la. 9Wa yaa jam piilim wa chelimu a basi Babilon tɛŋka piilimka chiika da dii ale dɛ niŋka la danni, a yaa paari Jerusalem tɛŋka chiik kaai ale saari sinuwa la ka piilimka danni, wa Wenni ni sii ale a niak la ale bo ale wa la nyiŋ. 10Ezra a jam gomsi wadek kama ayen wa zamsi abe wa va Naawen ŋmarisika, abe wa a sak Izirali demma wa wieŋa.
11Gbaŋ kaai ate Naab Artasaset a ŋmarisi a te Ezra waai ale ka kaabteerɔ ale sagrɔ la, wa ka nuru waai ale zamsi wie a magsi chaab ale Izirali Naawen buusaŋa ale wa wieŋa. 12Nalima meena naawa Artasaset a puusi kaabteerɔwa Ezra waai ale ŋman chim sagrɔ a sak wenŋmazuk Wenni wieŋa la mi a puusi fu.
13Yɔgyɔgla de mi a weeni kama ayen Izirali demma ale bo m tɛŋka po la ale kaabteerɔma ale Livaima meena waai a da a yaali ayen wa va cheŋ Jerusalem wa baga a cheŋ kama. 14Naawa a tom fu kama ale wa nuruba bayopɔi baai ale a sak wa wie la ayen ni ga kpesi nya Juda ale Jerusalem a ta va ni Wenni wieŋa ale bo fi nisaŋa po la. 15Ku abe magsi kama ayen fi pai naawa ale baai ale a sak wa wie la ale jam pai kpanaŋa ale ligmɔniŋka a te Izirali Wenni ale bo Jerusalem po la, 16a gum chaab ale kpanaŋa ale ligmɔniŋka meena ate ni nya a nyini Babilon tɛŋka la, ale tiirim tii meena ate nuruma ale kaabteerɔma a te Wen yenni Jerusalem po la. 17Pai ligraŋa de a da lalisa ale padaasa ale padabilisa ale ŋandiinta tiirim ale nyuka tiirim a yaa pai ba a nye kaabka Wen yenni po kuŋkuŋku zuk a te ni Wenni ale bo Jerusalem la.
18Fi ale fi suataŋa Juuma a baga a pai kpanaŋa ale ligmɔniŋka ale tali la meena a nye nama ale a yaali diila, kama a ta va ni Wenni ale a yaali diila. 19Pai ŋanti baai ate ba pai te ni a magsi chaab ale jiam teka Wen yenni po la a te Jerusalem Wenni. 20Jaabuuri meena ale magsi wa bo Wen yenni po ate ni nya ale baga a nye la ni pai naam ligraŋa a nye.
21Yɔgyɔgla de mi, Naab Artasaset, a weeni baai meena ale a nya ligra zuk ate ba bo Yufiretis Benni Kunkɔŋ Kinkala geŋsa la kama ayen Ezra kaabteerɔwa wenŋmazuk Wen Sinsaŋŋa sagrɔwa a dan bek ni jabuui ate wa a yaali la ni te wa, 22wa dan poom bek ni ayen ni te wa kpana boorik dobrim kook ale ŋanbie boorisa kook ale daam samɔnsa kook ale kpaam samɔnsa kook ale yesa ale kan ta magsika. 23Jaabuuri meena ate wenŋmazuk Wenni a weeni la, basi ate ku abe nye nalimnyiini a magsi chaab ale wenŋmazuk Wen yenni. Ka boa ale a bo naawa ale wa nidoabilisaŋa suŋsuŋŋa? 24Ku magsi kama ayen fi seba ayen fi ka suik a pai lampoo tunika a ji kaabteerɔma ale Livaima ale yilendisaŋa ale baai ale a limisi nansuiŋtaŋa la ale baai ale a tom Wen yenni po la ale tomteerɔma ba chaama a tom tuima Wen yenni de po.
25Fi Ezra, a ta magsi chaab ale fi Wenni yammu, buui ate fi ta la, lueri boteerɔba ate ba a biisi wensie a te nuru baai meena ale bo Yufiretis Benni Kunkɔŋ Kinkala zuk geŋka la, baai meena ale seba Wen wieŋa la, abe fi sak waai ale kan sebi ŋa la. 26Waai ale ka a zuli fi Wenni wieŋa ale naawa nɔi la, ku a magsi wa tu ka kum waalika yaase ba yiak wa a basi yaase ba tuesi wa ŋantaŋa meena yaase ba yik wa a lik.
27Pimpauk a cheŋ Naawen jigi, tama koma Wenni, waai ale pai nyo naawa suinummu po ayen wa ta zula a jam wa yenni ale bo Jerusalem tɛŋka po la suiku de po, 28ale waai ale basi ate wa ŋmanteka a jam mi jigi naawa ale wa nisɔmma ale naawa nuru baai meena ale ta pagrim la niŋ. Dii nyiŋla Naawen m Wenni nisaŋa a jam bo m zuk kama, m jam nye ka nyiŋbiiri ale tigsi Izirali tɛŋka niŋdeerɔma meena ayen ba cheŋ ale mu.

Title: EZRA 8
Content:
1Baai ale jam dɛ ba dɔkdemma niŋ la ale baai yue ale jam ŋmarisi ate ba va mi a nyini Babilon a jam diipo ate Artasaset a chim naab la ale nna: 2Gersom a jam nyini ka Fineyas buuni po ate Daniel a nyini Itamar buuni po alege ate Yattus Sekania nidoabinni a nyini Deevid buuni po; 3Zakaria a jam ka Paros buuni po. Ba jam ka nidoaba kook ale pisinu. 4Zerayia nidoabinni Elieyoenai a jam nyini ka Payat Moab buuni po. Ba jam ka nidoaba kobsiye. 5Jayaziel nidoabinni Sekania ka Zattu buuni po. Ba mɛ a jam ka nidoaba kobsita. 6Jonatan nidoabinni Ebed ate wa nyini Adin buuni po la ale wa nidoaba a jam ka pisinu. 7Ataliaya nidoabinni Jesaiya ate wa nyini Iilam buuni po la ale wa nidoaba a jam ka pisiyopɔi. 8Maakil nidoabinni Zebadia a nyini ka Sefatia buuni po. Ba mɛ a jam ka nidoaba pinaanuŋ. 9Jeyiel nidoabinni Obadia ate wa nyini Joab buuni po la ale wa nidoaba a jam ka kobsiye ale pi ale naaniŋ. 10Josifia nidoabinni Selomit a nyini ka Bani buuni po. Ba jam ka nidoaba kook ale pisiyuebi. 11Bebai nidoabinni Zakaria a nyini ka Bebai buuni po. Ba mɛ a jam ka nidoaba pisiye ale naaniŋ. 12Joyanan ate wa kowa a nye Yakkatan la a nyini ka Azgad buuni po. Ba jam ka nidoaba kook ale pi. 13Elifelet ale Jeuel ale Sɛmaiya ka Adonikam buuni ale la. Ba jam ka nidoaba pisiyuebi a jam ŋaaŋnyiŋ. 14Utai ale Zakkur ate ba nyini Bivai buuni po la a jam ka nidoaba pisiyopɔi.
15Mi yaa tigsi ba a ta moata buboali kaai ale chali va Ayava benaŋka la jigini, ti jam bo dula a paari ka daa ŋata. Mi ale kpesi a nya nuruma ale kaabteerɔma po la mi an jam nya Livai denɔ ba po. 16M yaa weeni Ɛlieza ale Ariel ale Sɛmaiya ale Elnatan ale Jarib ale Elnatan ale Natan ale Zakaria ale Mesullam baai ale ka niŋdeerɔba la ale Joiarib ale Elnatan baai zamsika ale zuak la, 17a yaa tom ba Iddo jigi wa la ale chim Kasifia tɛŋka kpagi. M weeni ba ale ba weeni Iddo ale wa nuruma, baai ale a tom Wen yenni po ate di bo Kasifia po la dii ale magsi ba nye la kama dila ale ku basi ate ba niŋ a bo ale ti Wen yenni jigi. 18Ti Wen nisaŋa ale bo ti zuk la, ba yaa ta Serebia, nuru maŋ, wa jam ka Livai a nyini Mayali buuni po. Wa ale wa bisaŋa ale wa suataŋa a jam ka pi ale naaniŋ. 19Yasabia ale Jesaiya ale nyini Merari buuni po la ale wa suataŋa ale wa suataŋa bisaŋa a jam ka nuruba pisiye. 20Ba jam ta ka nuru baai ate Naab Deevid ale wa nuruma a jam lueri ayen ba a maari Livaima kobsiye ale pisiye wa la a jam. Ba jam ŋmarisi ba meena yueŋa kama.
21Ayava benaŋka nɔi, m yaa weeni ayen ti bobi nɔi, dii ale ku basi ate tama a zɛri tidek ti Wenni niŋ abe ti bek wa ate wa nya tama ale ti bisaŋa chelimu zuk ale ŋanti baai ate ti ta la zuk. 22Chivie ale jam ta mu ate mi an baga a weeni Naawa ayen wa basi ate tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale wusum duerɔba a kasi ti ti dachaasaŋa nisima po a basi ase tama ale jam bo suiku po a cheŋ la, dii nyiŋla, ti weeni naawa kama, <<Ti Wen kpienni nisima a bo waai meena ale zak a nya wa la zuk kama alege ate wa suipuurumu a cheŋ baai meena ale a zɛri wa la jigi.>> 23Dila nyiŋ ti yaa bobi nɔi a bek ti Wenni nya kude ate wa yaa tulisi ti puusaŋa.
24Ate mi yaa lueri kaabteerɔba pi ale baye a gum chaab ale Serebia ale Yasabia ale ba suataŋa pi, 25ale magsi kpana ale ligmɔniŋ tiirim ale ŋan baai meena ate naawa ale wa nisɔmma ale Izirali demma ayen ba pai a maari Wen yenni tuimaŋa la a te ba. 26Mi yaa magsi kpana ligbie boorik dobrim kobsiyuebi ale pisinu, ale kpana ŋantomta magsika boorik dobrim kook ale ligmɔniŋ boorik dobrim kook, 27ale ligmɔniŋ taasa pisiye ale a magsi chaab ale boorik dobrim bunaansi la ale kutuk mɔnuŋ ŋantomta baye ale salisi a nala la a ta tuilum ase ligmɔniŋ la.
28Mi yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Nama ale ŋantaŋa a ta tuilum kama a te Naawen. Kpanaŋa ale ligmɔniŋka ka tiirim a te Naawen ni koma Wenni. 29Ni kpesi a nya ba zuk nalimnyiini a ta ga paari diipo ate nama ale pai ba a nyo Naawen yenni ale bo Jerusalem po la, kaabteerɔma ale Livaima ale Izirali demma niŋdeerɔma nisima po.>> 30Ate kaabteerɔma ale Livaima a yaa tuesi kpanaŋa ale ligmɔniŋka ale ŋan baai meena ale magsi ayen ba pai a ta cheŋ ti Wen yenni ale bo Jerusalem la po.
31Chiik kaai ale dɛ niŋka la ka daa pi ale ŋayewa danni tama a yaa basi Ayava buboalika ayen ti cheŋ Jerusalem. Ti Wenni nisima a jam bo ti zuk kama ate wa a kasi ti a ta a nyini dachaasa nisima po ale baai ale a vari nuruba la jigi suiku po a basi. 32Ti yaa jam paari Jerusalem, dula jigini ti yaa vuusi da ŋata.
33Daa ŋanaansiwa danni, ti Wen yenni po, tama yaa pai kpana ale ligmɔniŋ a nyo Yuraya nidoabinni Meremot kaabteerɔwa nisima po. Fineyas nidoabinni Eleaza a jam maa bo dula kama ale wa, Livaima Jesua nidoabinni Jozabad ale Binnui nidoabinni Noadiya mɛ a jam maa boro. 34Ba jam seba ŋantaŋa nɔi ale ka diila kama ale ŋmarisi dueni mɛ.
35Baai ale jam bo yɔntini po la a yaa ŋman kuli a yaa nye juka kaabka a te Izirali Wenni: Lalisa pi ale siye a nye kaabka a te Izirali meena, padaasa pineok ale siyuebi ale padabilisa pisiyopɔi ale siyopɔi ale budukta pi ale tiye a nye biem tiirim kaabka. Nya kude meena a jam ka jiam a te Naawen. 36Ba jam pai naawa ale weeni diila a sak niŋdeerɔwa waai ale a nya Benni Kunkɔŋ Kinkala zuk la kama, waai ale jam a maari nuruma ale Wen yenni la.

Title: EZRA 9
Content:
1Wieŋa de meena ale jam nye la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, niŋdeerɔma a yaa jam a weeni mi ayen, <<Izirali demma, a gum chaab ale kaabteerɔma ale Livaima, an jam poori ba dega a ta nyini tuim kaasima ŋaai ate Keenan demma ale Yit demma ale Perizzi demma ale Jebus demma ale Ammon demma ale Moab demma ale Ejipiti demma ale Amori demma jam a tom la. 2Ba jam faari tɛŋ sila liema gela kama a te badek ale ba nidoabilisaŋa, ale pai baai ale gaari badek la a gum chaab ale tɛŋ sila nuruma. Niŋdeerɔma ale kpaŋŋa ale jam a dɛ niŋ a sak nye kaasuŋku.
3Ase mi ale ga wom nya kude la, m yaa dari m gattaŋa a cheeri ale dari m zukku zuisaŋa ale m teeŋka a vɔssi alege kali tɛŋ ale daanika. 4Ate baai nyiŋsa ale a gɔk Izirali Wenni wieŋa nyiŋla a yaa tigsi a gilim mu nuruma de ale kan ta siaka la nyiŋ. Mi jam kala kama ale daanika a ta ga paari diipo ate ba nye junɔinni kaabka la.
5Ase ku ale ga paari junɔinni kaabka la, mi yaa yiti zaani ale m gattaŋa tii ale cheeri la, a kpi duna tɛŋ a zak nisa a te Naawen m Wenni 6a puusi ayen, <<M Wen yaa, chivie ale ta mu nna yegayega ate mi an baga a zak mi ninaŋa a nya fi m Wenni, dii nyiŋla tama biemu a zuak ka nna yegayega alege ate ti kaasuŋku mɛ a jueli paari wenŋmazuk. 7A nyini ti kokpieŋsaŋa daaŋa po a ta jam paari jinla, ti biemu a kasim zuak kama. Alege ti biemu nyiŋ, tama ale ti nalimaŋa ale ti kaabteerɔma a yaa jo ti dachaasaŋa ale ba nalimaŋa nisima po ase ku ale ka dii jinla nna.
8<<Alege yɔgyɔgla de, ku an bola beni ya, Naawen ti Wenni a ta jiirim ale ti kama ale baai ale tali a vua la ale pai ti a basi jigi maŋ wa yenni po, dila nyiŋ ti Wenni a te ti ka bolim buui ale basi ate tama ninaŋa a nya ale vari ti a ta nyini yɔntidi po a nyini. 9Tama ka yɔm, alege tama Wenni an zɛri ti a basi ya. Wa jam sak wa ŋmanteka ale ti kama Persia nalimaŋa niŋ: Wa jam te ti ka nyuvuri paalik ayen tama a ŋman pilim sɛ ti Wen yenni, ale te ti parik ate ka kasi Juda ale Jerusalem meena.
10<<Alege yɔgyɔgla de, ti Wen yaa, tama a yaali ti weeni ayen ka boa kude ŋaaŋ nyiŋŋa? Tama an zuli buusaŋa, 11ate fi pai a te ti a ta va fi tomteerɔma ale ka biisiteerɔba la zuk diipo ate fi a weeni ayen, <Tɛŋ kaai ate nama a yaali ni ga bo ka po la ka nuruma a kaasi tɛŋka a basi kama. A ta va ba kaasuŋku nyeka ba meena a yaa jam kaasi. 12Dila nyiŋ nama a kan pai ni liema a yalisi ba bisaŋa yaase ni a faari ba liema a te ni bisaŋa. Ni poom kan nye wari ate ku a sak ayen nama a yaali ni dɛ ka doata ale ba diipo diipo, dila ale ku basi ate ni pagra abe ni dɛ tɛŋka ŋanmaŋsaŋa abe ni tali a te ni bisaŋa ate ba ale kasim a boro taam wuu.>
13<<Dii ale nye ti la ka ti biemu ale ti wakaasimaŋa nyiŋ, alege, tama Wenni, fi an poom a namsi ti ase tama biemu ale ka diila, alege a te tama jigi maŋ ase nna la la. 14Tama a ŋman magsi ayen ti ŋman pilim a tom kaasi fi buusaŋa abe ti ga faari baai ale tom a kaasi fi la? Fi sui a kan puuri ale tama ate fi kaasi ti, ate fi kan tali nuruba magadek yaase javuk mɛ la? 15Naawen yaa, Izirali Wenni, fi ka waai ale ka wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ. Fi a tali ti a basi kama. Dila nyiŋla tama a bo ka fi niŋ ale ti kaasuŋku, kula nyiŋ ale soa ate tama wanyi mɛ la an baga a zaani fi niŋ la.>>

Title: EZRA 10
Content:
1Ase Ezra ale jam a puusi ale a weeni kaasuŋku ale a kum alege lo tɛŋ Wen yenni po la, Izirali demma nuru boari nidoaba ale nipooba ale bisa a yaa jam gilim wa. Ba mɛ a jam a kum kama. 2Ate Jeyiel nidoabinni Sekania, ate wa nyini Iilam buuni po la, a yaa weeni Ezra ayen, <<Tama a jam ka siaka ale ti Wenni ate tama a yaa jaa faari nipok yonta a ta nyini nuru baai ale jam kala moata ti la. Alege kude meena po, Izirali a diem ta yiila kama. 3Yɔgyɔgla de, ni basi ate ti nye nɔiyeŋ ti Wenni niŋ ate wa basi ate nipooma de ale ba bisaŋa a cheŋ, a ta va m nyɔnɔwa sinsaŋŋa ale baai ale a chali ti Wenni buusaŋa la nyiŋ. Basi ate ku nye a magsi chaab ale Sinsaŋŋa. 4Yiti zaani. Wanni de a bo ka fi nisima po. Ti ale maari fu, pii nyiŋ a nye di.>>
5Dila nyiŋ Ezra a yaa zaani a basi ate Izirali kaabteerɔma baai ale dɛ niŋka la ale Livaima ale Izirali demma meena ayen ba pɛ ayen ba ale nye dii ate ba a zɔk ale chaab la. Ate ba yaa jam pɛ. 6Ate Ezra a yaa ŋmani wa an jo Wen yenni po alege cheŋ ga jo Eliasib nidoabinni Jeyoyanan dɔkku po. Ase wa ale jam dula la, wa an jam dɛ jaaboa yaase wa nyu nyiam mɛ, dii nyiŋla wa jam kasim a kum kama baai ale nyini yɔntini po a jam la ale jam kan ta wensie la nyiŋ.
7Ba yaa jam nye moolik Juda ale Jerusalem tɛŋsaŋa meena ayen ba tigsi chaab Jerusalem po. 8Nuru waai a dan zɛri ate ku paari daa ŋata alege ate wa an jam ya wa le jɔk ŋan baai ate wa ta la a ta va kpaŋŋa ale nisɔmma ale zɔk diila, abe ba yiak wa baai ale ŋmani la tigsuŋku po.
9Daa ŋatawa po Juda ale Benjamin demma meena a yaa jam tigsi chaab Jerusalem po. A nyini chiik kaai ale a saari neokku la ka daa pisiyewa danni, nuruma meena a yaa jam tigsi gigiluk a kala Wen yenni po, ŋmoruk ale jam a ni ale ba bo dula jigini ba tuka nyiŋ. 10Ate Ezra waai ale ka kaabteerɔ la a yaa yiti zaani ale weeni ba ayen, <<Nama a ka wensie. Nama a faari ka tɛŋ yonsa lieba, a gum Izirali kaasuŋku po. 11Yɔgyɔgla de ni weeni ni kaasuŋku a te Naawen, ni koma Wenni jigi, abe ni a nye wa yaalika. Ni poori nidek a nyini nuru baai ale gilim ni la po a nyini abe ni basi tɛŋ yonsaŋa liema ate ni faari la.>>
12Ate tigsuŋku meena a yaa tulisi ate ku jueli ayen, <<Fi ta wensie kama! Tama ale nye ase fi ale weeni diila. 13Alege nuruba yegayega ale bo dela ku be ŋman chim ka ŋmoruk nika vari dila nyiŋla tama a kan baga a zaani peelimmoa. Daa dila nyiini, ti kan baga a pai dai yeŋ yaase daa ŋaye nya wanni de zuwa, dii nyiŋla tama biemu a zuak ka nna yegayega. 14Basi ate ti kpaŋŋa a tom a te tigsuŋku meena. Basi ate ti tɛŋka po waai meena ale faari tɛŋ yoŋ nipok la a jam ba le dak diipo la ale niŋdeerɔma ale baai ale a bo buusa la wanyi meena a nyini tɛŋ meena a va jam, a ta ga paari diipo ate tama Wenni suipuurumu a ta va wanni de zuk ale basi ti la.>> 15Ka Asayel nidoabinni Jonatan ale Tikva nidoabinni Jazeya, bala nyiini ale Mesullam ale Livaiwa Sabbetai, ale maari ba ate ba zɛri nya kude.
16Ate baai ale nyini yɔntini po a jam la a yaa nye dii ale magsi ba nye la. Kaabteerɔwa Ezra yaa lueri nuruba baai ale ka yie nyam la, nuru yeŋ a ta nyini buuri meena po, ale ŋmarisi ba meena yueŋa. Chiisa piwa ka piilimka danni ba yaa kali ayen ba kpesi wanni zuk. 17A ta nyini chiik kaai ale dɛ niŋka la ka piilimka danni ba yaa jam tu chaab ale baai meena ale faari tɛŋ yonsa lieba la a nueri.
18A nyini kaabteerɔma buuni po baai ale faari tɛŋ yonsa lieba la ale nna: A nyini Jozadak nidoabinni Jesua buuni po ale wa suataŋa ale nna: ka Maaseiya ale Ɛlieza ale Jarib ale Gedalia. 19Ba a jam pɛ kama ayen ba yiak ba pooma alege waai meena a te padiak ayen ba nye kaabka ba kaasuŋ ku nyiŋ.
20A nyini Immer ŋaaŋbisaŋa po a jam ka Yanani ale Zebadia.
21A nyini Yarim ŋaaŋbisaŋa po a jam ka Maaseiya ale Elaja ale Sɛmaiya ale Jeyiel ale Yuzaya.
22A nyini Pasur ŋaaŋbisaŋa po a jam ka Elioenai ale Maaseiya ale Ismael ale Netanel ale Jozabad ale Elasa.
23Livaima po a jam ka Jozabad ale Simei ale Kelaiya, Kelaiya yuei di choa a jam le Kelita, ale Petayia ale Juda ale Ɛlieza.
24A nyini yilendisaŋa po a jam ka Eliasib. A nyini nansuiŋ limisidɔma po a jam ka Sallum ale Telem ale Uri.
25Izirali demma po a jam ka Paros ŋaaŋbisaŋa. Ŋaaŋbisaŋa de jam ka Aramiya ale Izzia ale Malkija ale Mijamin ale Eleaza ale Malkija ale Benaya.
26A nyini Iilam ŋaaŋbisaŋa po a jam ka Mattania ale Zakaria ale Jeyiel ale Abdi ale Jeremot ale Elaja.
27A nyini Zattu ŋaaŋbisaŋa po a jam ka Elioenai ale Eliasib ale Mattania ale Jeremot ale Zabad ale Aziza.
28A nyini Bebai ŋaaŋbisaŋa po a jam ka Jeyoyanan ale Yanania ale Zabbai ale Atlai.
29A nyini Bani ŋaaŋbisaŋa po a jam ka Mesullam ale Malluk ale Adaiya ale Jasub ale Seal ale Jeremot.
30A nyini Payat Moab ŋaaŋbisaŋa po a jam ka Adna ale Chelal ale Benaya ale Maaseiya ale Mattania ale Bezalel ale Binnui ale Manasa.
31A nyini Yarim ŋaaŋbisaŋa po a jam ka Ɛlieza ale Isija ale Malkija ale Sɛmaiya ale Sɛyɛmeon ale 32Benjamin ale Malluk ale Sɛmariya.
33A nyini Yasum ŋaaŋbisaŋa po a jam ka Mattenai ale Mattatta ale Zabad ale Elifelet ale Jeremai ale Manasa ale Simei.
34A nyini Bani ŋaaŋbisaŋa po a jam ka Maadai ale Amram ale Uel 35ale Benaya ale Bedeiya ale Keluyi 36ale Vania ale Meremot ale Eliasib 37ale Mattania ale Mattenai ale Jaasu.
38A nyini Binnui ŋaaŋbisaŋa po a jam ka Simei 39ale Selemia ale Natan ale Adaiya 40ale Maknadebai ale Sasai ale Sayarai 41ale Azarel ale Selemia ale Sɛmariya 42ale Sallum ale Amariya ale Josefi.
43A nyini Nebo ŋaaŋbisaŋa po a jam ka Jeiel ale Mattitia ale Zabad ale Zebina ale Jaddai ale Joel ale Benaya.
44Bade meena a jam faari ka tɛŋ yonsa lieba, ate ba gela ale ba pooma a ta bisa.

Title: NEYEMIA 1
Content:
1Yakalia nidoabinni Neyemia wieŋa ale nna: Kislev chiika, bena pisiye wa po, diipo ate mi bo Susa tɛŋka po jigi pagrika la, 2Yanani m suataŋa wanyi ale nuruba ba chaab ale jam nyini Juda a jam ate mi a bek ba Juda dem baai ale tali a vua la ale Jerusalem mɛ wie.
3Ba yaa weeni mu ayen, <<Baai ale nyini yɔntini po a nyini la a bo ka daanika ale chivie po. Jerusalem parika a lo kama ate bolim a dɛ tuataŋa meena.
4Mi ale ga wom wieŋa de meena la, mi jam kali ka tɛŋ a kum. Da boari mi kasim jam a kum kama ale a bobi nɔi ale a puusi wenŋmazuk Wenni niŋ. 5Ate mi yaa weeni ayen, <<Naawen, wenŋmazuk Wen yaa, fi ka Wen kpien, waai ate ba a chali yɔgsum la waai ale ta wa nɔiyeŋka ale wa ŋmanteka ale baai ale a yaali wa ale a wom wa ale wa wieŋa la. 6Basi ate fi tuinni nye a wuli, abe fi ninaŋa a lagri ate fi wom puusa ŋaai ate fi tomteerɔwa yok ale kantueŋ a ta va fi nuruma Izirali demma jigi la. Mi a biisi ka tama Izirali demma biemu ale m kowa yenni biem buui ate tama a nye kaasi fu la. 7Tama nye ka gaasa a ta va fi jigi. Tama an wom fi wieŋa ale ŋmarisika ale buusaŋa ate fi a pai a te fi tomteerɔwa Moosis la.
8<<Teeri fi sinsaŋŋa ate fi a te fi tomteerɔwa Moosis ayen, ni dan kan ta wensie, mi ale kati ni waaŋ tɛŋka meena la. 9Alege ni dan ŋmani mi jigi ale wom m wieŋa ni nuru baai ale bo yontini po la a dan poom bo niŋniŋa mi ale tigsi ba dula jigini a ta ba a jam mi ale lueri kauk kuui ayen m boro m yuenni nyiŋla.
10<<Ba ka fi tomteerɔba ale fi nuruba, baai ate fi a da tuesi ba ale fi pagrim kpiemu ale fi ni pagrisaŋa la. 11M Nyɔnɔ, wom fi tomteerɔwa puusaŋa ale fi tomteerɔma puusaŋa baai ale a zuli fi yuenni la. Te fi tomteerɔwa nyeboka jinla abe fi te wa ŋmanteka nuruwa de niŋ.>> Mi ka waai a daam ale a te Susa naawa daam la.

Title: NEYEMIA 2
Content:
1Nisan chiika po ate Artasaset a jam dɛ wa naamu a paari bena pisiye wa la, ba jam ta ka daam a jam ayen m pai a te Naawa. Mi an diem kaasi nina wa niŋ a nya ya. 2Naawa a yaa bek mi ayen, <<Ka boa ate fi a kaasi nina alege fi kan yuagi? Nya kude a daa jaaboa alege ka sui kaasuŋ.>> Mi a chali ka yɔgsum, 3alege mi a yaa weeni Naawa ayen, <<Naabaa boro taam wuu! Boa ate mi a kan kaasi nina? Ase m tɛŋka kauk kuui ate ba gu m koma la parisaŋa ale lo ate bolim a dɛ tuataŋa a kaasi la?>>
4Naawa a yaa bek mu ayen, <<Ka boa ate fi a yaali?>> Ate mi a yaa puusi a te wenŋmazuk Wenni, 5ale tulisi Naawa ayen, <<Ase ku dan yɔk naawa sui ate fi tomteerɔwa a nya suik a nyini fi jigi, be basi ate mi cheŋ m tɛŋka Juda kauk kuui ate ba gu m koma la, dii ale ku nye ate mi a pilim sɛ parisaŋa la.>>
6Ate naawa ale wa powa ale kala wa gauŋ la a bek mu ayen, <<Fi ale paari ka disa po, ka disa po ate fi ale ŋmani?>> Ku jam nye Naawa masim ayen wa basi ate m cheŋ, mi yaa te diipo ate mi ale pilim ŋmani la.
7Mi yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Ase ku dan peenti Naawa sui wa ŋmarisi gbaŋ a te mu ate mi a ta ga te waai ale a nya Yufiretis zuk la, ate ba te mu suik ate m paari Juda. 8Abe wa te mu gbaŋ ate m pai a te Asaf, waai ale a nya Naawa tiisaŋa zuk la ate wa te mu daata ate m nye a su tɛŋka jigi pagrika tuataŋa ale moata Wen yenni la ale parisaŋa tuataŋa ale kauk kuui ate mi a cheŋ m boro la?>> Ase m Wenni nisaŋa ale bo m zuk la, Naawa a te mu suik.
9Dila mi yaa cheŋ kpaŋŋa ale a nya benni la jigi a pai Naawa gbaŋka a te ba. Naawa a jam tom ka tugurik tɔŋdɔba kpaga ate ba do wusuma a va mu. 10Ase Yoron denɔwa Sanballat ale Ammon demma niŋdeerɔwa Tobiya ale wom kude la, ku yaa daani ba dii nyiŋla, waai ale jam ayen wa nya Izirali demma nyeboka.
11Mi jam paari Jerusalem kama. Ase mi ale goa ate daa ŋata a taam la, 12mi yaa nyini yokku ale nidoaba maga. Mi an weeni waai dii ate m Wenni a pai nyo m suinni po ayen m nye a te Jerusalem la. M jam ka boniŋ ka choa ka kaai ate m jam do la nyiini.
13Yɔkku po mi yaa nyini va Viaka Nansuiŋku a ga paari Piuk Vinni ale Tampoi Nansuiŋku a kpesi a nya Jerusalem parisaŋa ale lo la, ate bolim mɛ a dɛ tuataŋa diila. 14M ŋman va Bulik Nansuiŋku ale Naawa Mɔgni alege suik a karo ate m boniŋka a taamu. 15Mi yaa va viaka po yokku a kpesi nya parisaŋa, kpeglimka po, mi yaa pilim ŋmani a va ka Viaka Nansuiŋku geŋsa a jo. 16Tɛŋka kpaŋŋa a jam zɛ mi ale cheŋ juijui la yaase dii ate mi a nye la. Dii nyiŋla mi an diem weeni Juuma yaase kaabteerɔma yaase kpaŋŋa ale baai ale ba tom tuimaŋa la wari ya.
17Mi yaa weeni ba, <<Ni nya ti ale bo daani kaai po la kama. Jerusalem parisaŋa a lo kama ate bolim a dɛ tuataŋa. Ni jam ate tama a pilim a sɛ Jerusalem parisaŋa, ate tama a kan kasim bo chivie po.>> 18M weeni ba m Wenni nisaŋa ale bo m zuk diila, ale Naawa ale weeni mu diila. Ba yaa tulisi ayen, <<Basi ate tama a piilim sɛka,>> ate ba yaa nye nyiŋbiiri ale tuin maŋka de.
19Alege Yoron denɔwa Sanballat ale Ammon demma niŋdeerɔwa Tobiya ale Arab denɔwa Gesem ale ga wom la ba yaa nye ti a la. Ba yaa bek ayen, <<Ka boa ale la ate nama a nye? Nama ŋman pilim a nye ka tukpari ale Naawa?>>
20Mi yaa tulisi ba ayen, <<Wenŋmazuk Wenni ale te ti nyeboka. Tama wa tomteerɔma ale piilim sɛka, alege dan ka nama, ni ka charuk Jerusalem po yaase suik kuui ya yaase ni ta ŋiak suik ku choa.>>

Title: NEYEMIA 3
Content:
1Kaabteerɔ kpioŋku Eliasib ale wa kaabteerɔ chaama yaa cheŋ ba tom abe ba pilim sɛ Piisa Nansuiŋku. Ba yaa gaari ku a su tuata. Ba jam sɛ parika kama ate ka yalima a paari Kook Yewɔŋku dii ate ba pai nyo Naawen nisa po a yalima a paari Yananel Yewɔŋku la. 2Jeriko demma a sɛ tom du ate Imri nidoabinni Zakkur mɛ a sɛ tom bala jigini.
3Yassenaa nidoabilisaŋa ale jam pilim sɛ Juma Nansuiŋku. Ba vi chibsa du ale su tuataŋa a pai kuta a kpi maŋ laarisaŋa. 4Yuraya nidoabinni Meremot, Yakkoz ŋaaŋka ale sɛ kauk kunkula. Berekiya nidoabinni Mesullam ate wa kokpieŋka a chim Mesezabel la mɛ ale jam sɛ tom du, ate Baana nidoabinni Zadok a sɛ tom wa ale sɛ a zaani kauk kuui la. 5Kauk kuui ale pai a vi la ka Tekoa demma ale sɛ, alege ba kpaŋŋa jam zɛri tuim ŋaai ate baai ale jam a nya ba zuk la a te ba la kama.
6Jesana Nansuiŋku ka Pasea nidoabinni Joiada ale Besodeiya nidoabinni Mesullam ale jam sɛ, bala ale sɛ a vi ku chibsaŋa du, a su tuata ale a pai kuta a kpi maŋ laarisaŋa. 7A nyini bala jigini, nuruba ale nyini Gibeon ale Mizpa a tom. Bala jam le Melatia ale nyini Gibeon ale Jadon ale nyini Meronot la. Jiŋŋa de ka kpagi dii ale jam a nya tɛŋ kaai ale moata Benni la ale jam a nya ŋa zuk. 8Yaryaiya nidoabinni Uzziel choabiika wanyi ale jam sɛ tom bala jigini. Ate Yanania baai ale a nye kpasaam la wanyi a sɛ tom dula. Bala a jam sɛ ka dila a ta nyini Jerusalem parika a ta ga paari Labisim Parika. 9Yur nidoabinni Arefaiya, waai ale a nya Jerusalem tɛŋ kpieŋka kauk la ale jam sɛ kauk kunkula. 10A tom dula, Jedaya ate wa kowa a nye Yarumaf la ale jam sɛ a tuk wa yenni, ate Yasabneya nidoabinni Yattus a sɛ tom. 11Yarim nidoabinni Malkija ale Payat Moab nidoabinni Yassub mɛ ale sɛ gela ale Boroborok Nyeka Yewɔŋku. 12Sallum ate wa kowa a chim Yalloyes waai ale a nya Jerusalem tɛŋka kauk la, wa liema a maari wa ate wa mɛ a sɛ kabta.
13Viaka Nansuiŋku ka Yanun ale baai ale bo Zanoaya la ale sɛ. Ba ŋman sɛ ka kama a su tuata a pai kuta a kpi maŋ laarisaŋa. Ba ŋman sɛ parika kauk ate ka woglimmu a paari anamagib kobsinu a ta ga paari Tampoi Nansuiŋku.
14Tampoi Nansuiŋku ka Arekab nidoabinni Malkija waai ale jam a nya Bet Yakkerem tɛŋka la ale sɛ. Wa ŋman sɛ kama ale su tuata a pai kuta a kpi maŋ laarisaŋa.
15Bulik Nansuiŋku ka Kol Yoze nidoabinni Sallum waai ale a nya Mizpa tɛŋka zuk la ale jam sɛ. Wa mɛ a sɛ ku kama a pili ku ale su tuata a pai kuta a kpi maŋ laarisaŋa. Wa ŋman sɛ Sɛla Beli Gilini jigini parika ale moata Naawa Talimu la a ta ga paari tiilaŋa ale nyini Deevid tɛŋka a siŋ la. 16A nyini wala jigini, ka Azbuk nidoabinni Neyemia waai ale a nya Bet Zur tɛŋka geli la ale sɛ a tuk chaab ale Deevid boosuku ale bo kauk kuui la a ta ga paari mɔgni ale Nuru Pagrisaŋa Yenni.
17A nyini wala jigini, ka Livaima ate Bani nidoabinni Areyum a jam a nya ba zuk la ale sɛ. A nyini wa mɛ jigini, Yasabia waai ale jam a nya Keila tɛŋka la ale sɛ a magsi wa tɛŋka demma. 18A nyini wala jigini, dula ba suataŋa ate Yenadad nidoabinni Binnui a jam a nya ba zuk la ale sɛ. Wa ale jam a nya Keila tɛŋka kauk. 19Jesua nidoabinni Ezer, Mizpa tɛŋka kpagni, mɛ ale jam sɛ tuk chaab ale kpaliŋ kɔlimaŋa ale bo kauk kuui la. 20Zabbai nidoabinni Baruk a jam sɛ a ta nyini kauk kuui ate ba va a jo kaabteerɔ kpioŋku Eliasib nansuiŋku. 21A ŋman nyini dula, ka Yuraya nidoabinni Meremot ate Yakkoz a chim wa kokpieŋ la ale sɛ dula a ta nyini Eliasib yenni nansuiŋku a ta ga paari ku kpeglimka.
22A nyini wala jigini, kaabteerɔ baai ale bo tɛŋ sii ale gilim la ale sɛ. 23A nyini bala jigini, Benjamin ale Yassub ale gomsi ba yeniŋka geŋsa parika a ta zaani bala jigini mɛ, ka Maaseiya nidoabinni Azariya ate Anania a chim wa kokpieŋ la ale gomsi parika ale bo wa yenni gauŋ la. 24Yenadad nidoabinni Binnui ale sɛ kabta a ta nyini Azariya yenni gugottaŋa po. 25Uzai nidoabinni Palal mɛ a sɛ tuk ka Naawa yewɔŋku ale moata limisidɔma dabiaka la. A nyini wala jigini, Paros nidoabinni Pedaiya 26ale Naawen yenni po tuimtomdisaŋa ale bo Ofel guuku zuk la a sɛ tuk chaab ale Nyiamu Nansuiŋku a tuak kori geŋsa ale yewɔŋku. 27Tekoa demma a sɛ tom ba ale kpeglim juijui la a nyini yewɔŋku a ga paari Ofel jigini parika la.
28A nyini Wusuma Nansuiŋku, kaabteerɔma wanyi wanyi meena a sɛ parika wadek yeri niŋ. 29A nyini bala jigini, Immer nidoabinni Zadok a jam sɛ magsi chaab ale ka wa yenni. A nyini wala jigini, Sekania nidoabinni Sɛmaiya ate wa a nya Kori Nansuiŋku la a sɛ. 30A nyini wala jigini, Selemia nidoabinni Yanania ale Zalaf nidoabinni Yanun ale saari bayuebiwa la ale sɛ dula. A nyini bala jigini, ka Berekiya nidoabinni Mesullam ale sɛ kabi tii ale tuk wa yenni la. 31A nyini wala jigini, choabiika wanyi ate ba a wi ayen Malkija la ale sɛ a ta nyini baai ale tom Naawen yenni po la yeeŋa a ta ga paari geruŋdɔma yeeŋa ale tuk kpesi Nyaka Nansuiŋku a ta ga paari dɔk kuui ale bo gugoruku ŋmazuk la. 32A nyini dɔk kuui ale bo gugoruku ŋmazuk la ale Piisa Nansuiŋku suŋsuŋ la choabisaŋa ale geruŋdɔma ale jam sɛ parika.

Title: NEYEMIA 4
Content:
1Ase Sanballat ale wom ayen ti ŋman pilim boro a sɛ parika la, wa sui yaa jam puuri. Wa jam nye Juuma a la kama 2wa ŋaaŋviirɔma ale Samaria tugurik tɔŋdɔma niŋ. Wa weeni ba ayen, <<Ka boa ate Juu wobsisaŋa de a nye? Ba ale sɛ ba parika? Ba ale nye kaabka? Ba ale baga a pai dai yeŋ a nueri? Ba ale baga a tigsi tintanaŋa ale duak a yiti guuku nna ate bolimu a dɛ ŋa la?>>
3Ammon denɔwa Tobiya ale jam za wa gauŋ la mɛ a weeni ayen, <<Ba ale a sɛ jabuui la suemkparuk a dan jueli ka zuk, ku ale lɔnsi ba tintanaŋa parika.>>
4Wom ti, ti Wenni ale ba kisi ti kama. Tulim ba leetaŋa a basi badek zuk. Te ba ta badek a cheŋ yɔntidi po. 5Kan lik ba kaasuŋku yaase fi duisi ba biemu a basi, dii nyiŋla ba lɛ baai ale a sɛ la kama.
6Ti sɛ parika a paari ka suŋsuŋsa po, nuruma mɛ a jam tom kama ale ba sue meena.
7Alege Sanballat ale Tobiya ale Arab demma ale Ammon demma ale Asdod demma ale ga wom ale ba boro a sɛ Jerusalem parika ate paaŋa a lik la, ba sue yaa a kasim jam a puuri. 8Ba meena a jam tigsi ka chaab ayen ba jam a nye kpaliŋ ale Jerusalem a ta daanika a jam ka po. 9Alege tama a puusi a te ti Wenni ale basi ate limisidɔ a limisi kantueŋ ale yok ayen ti tu chaab ale ba.
10Dila nyiŋla Juda nuruma a weeni ayen, <<Tuimtomdisaŋa a jiak kama ate guuraŋa a zuak ate tama an ŋman baga a sɛ parika.>>
11Ti dachaasaŋa a ŋman weeni ayen, <<Alege jigi ate ba seba yaase ba nya ti la, ti ale bo dula ale ba. Ti ale ko ba abe tuini mɛ a kpeglim dula.>>
12Juuma baai ale jam moata ba la a jam weeni ti ku wari naŋtuok nɔi pi ayen kauk kuui meena ate nama a tulim la, ba ale siti ti.>>
13Dila nyiŋ mi yaa basi ate nuruma gela a za parika kauk kuui ale gela la jigini ate ba a nya ba, m jam poori ba kama ase ba dɔkdemma ale ka diila ale gebisa ale gbatta ale tima. 14Ase mi ale jam nya wari meena zuk a ga nueri la, m yaa yiti zaani ale weeni kpaŋŋa ale niŋdeerɔma ale nuru mbala meena ayen, <<Ni kan chali ba yɔgsummoa. Ni teeri Nyɔnɔwa waai ale zuak ale nala la, abe ni kpaliŋ a te ni suataŋa ale ni nidoabilisaŋa, ale ni liema ale ni pooma ale ni yeeŋa.>>
15Ase ti dachaasaŋa ale wom ayen tama a seba ba ale a poli diila nɔi po kama la, ate Wen a basi ate ba yɔgsa. Tama meena a ŋman cheŋ parika jigi waai meena a cheŋ wa tuini jigi.
16A nyini dai dila danni m nuruma gela ale a tom tuimaŋa, alege geli mɛ a gomsi magsi ale gbatta ale ŋanchɔgsinta ale tima ale kuusidi jachɔgsim. Kpaŋŋa meena a yaa jam za Juda demma baai ale jam a sɛ parika la ŋaaŋ, 17baai ale jam a tom tuimaŋa la a jaa a ji ale ka ni yeŋsa alege m sila a ta kpaliŋ kɔlima, 18seerɔ meena a jam su ka gebik wa gauŋ ale a tom. Alege nuru waai ale a peeri damuniŋka la a za ale mi.
19Ate mi yaa weeni kpaŋŋa ale niŋdeerɔma ale nuruma meena ayen, <<Tuini a zuak kama ale lagri ate tama a waaŋ bo parika meena a yalima ale chaab. 20Diipo meena ni dan wom ale damuniŋka a peeri, ni jam ti Wenni ale kpaliŋ a te ti.>>
21Dila ti yaa tom a cheŋ ate nuruma gela a ta gbatta a nyini saluik a ta ga paari diipo ate chiŋmarisaŋa a pusi la. 22A nyini dipo m ŋman weeni nuruma ayen, <<Basi ate nuru meena ale wa maarɔ a bo Jerusalem tɛŋka po yok ate ba baga a nya ti zuk yok ase limisidɔba la abe tuimtomdisa kantueŋ.>> 23Mi yaase m suataŋa yaase m nuruma yaase limisidɔma ale bo ale mi la an yeeri ti gattaŋa waai meena a ta wa kpaliŋ kɔlima kama ase wa nin poom a cheŋ nyiam ŋarika.

Title: NEYEMIA 5
Content:
1Yɔgyɔgla de nuruma ale ba pooma a yaa kaari nna tuotuowa a ta chaab ale ba suataŋa Juuma. 2Ba gela a jam a weeni ayen, <<Tama ale ti nidoabilisaŋa ale ti liema a piisi kama, ku a fɛ ayen ti ta ŋanbie a dɛ ate ti vua.>> 3Ba gela a weeni ayen, <<Tama pai ti laŋsaŋa ale ti kaduksaŋa ale ti yeeŋa a dueni te ayen ti nya ŋanbie kɔmmu wenni.>> 4Ba gela mɛ a diem a weeni ayen, <<Tama a peem ka ligra ayen ti tuni naawa lampoowa a magsi ti laŋsaŋa ale ti kaduksaŋa. 5Ti nyiŋsaŋa ale ba nyiŋsaŋa ka bunyi ti ziimu mɛ a nye ase ka ti suataŋa Juuma la, ti nidoabilisaŋa mɛ a nye ase ba nidoabilisaŋa la alege ti pai ti nidoabilisaŋa ale ti liema a te ase yɔm la. Ti liema gela a poom ŋaam bo ka yɔntidi po alege ti wobsa, dii nyiŋla ti laŋsaŋa ale ti kaduksaŋa ka ti suataŋa ale soa.>>
6Ase mi ale ga wom kaarika dɛ ale ba ale a biisi diila mi sui a yaa puuri. 7Ase mi ale poli ku zuk la mi yaa toariŋ kpaŋŋa. M weeni ba ayen, <<Nama a tuesi ka viila yegayega nidek nuruma jigi.>> Mi yaa wi tukpieŋ ayen m nye ale ba. 8Ate mi a weeni ba ayen, <<Ku dan poom ka dii ya ti da tuesi Juuma ti suataŋa ate ba pai a da te baai ale kan daa Izirali dem la kama. Yɔgyɔgla de nama a pai ni suataŋa a da kama ayen ba pilim a pai ba da a te ti,>> ba yaa jam sina dii nyiŋla ba an jam nya wari a weeni ya.
9Dila mi yaa tom du ayen, <<Dii ate nama a nye la an nala. Nama a magsi ayen ni a chali Wen ate ti dachaasaŋa baai ale kan daa Juuba la a kan biisi ti a kaasi. 10Mi ale m suataŋa ale m nuruma a te nuruma ka ligra ale ŋanbie. Alege ni basi ate ni viilaŋa yegayega wa a kpeglim! 11Ŋman pilim pai ba kaduksaŋa ale ba tattaŋa a te ba nwuli, kpaam tiisaŋa ale yeeŋa ale viilaŋa yegayega yaalika ale ligraŋa ale ba ŋanbieŋa ale ba dapaalimu ale ba kpaamu ni pai a te ba.>>
12Ba ale tulisi diila ale la, <<Ti ale ŋman pai te ba. Ti kan ŋman a yaali jaaboa a nyini ba jigi ya. Ti le nye ase fi ale weeni ti la.>> Ate mi yaa wi kaabteerɔma ale kpaŋŋa ayen ba nye pɛka a ase ba ale puulim ba nye diila. 13Mi mɛ a kpaanti ŋan baai ale bo m garukku po la a basi ale weeni ayen, <<Wen mɛ a za wa kpaanti baai ale zɛri an ta wa wieŋa ale wa pumpuulimaŋa la a ta nyini wa yenni po a basi kama. Dila nuru wala ba kpaanti wa a basi. Ate tigsuŋku meena a weeni ayen, <<Ku be nye dila,>> ale a pak Naawen. Ate nuruma a nye ase ba ale puulim diila.
14Naab Artasaset ale dɛ wa naamu paari bena pisiyewa po la, ase mi ate wa jam lueri ayen m chim Juda tɛŋka kpagi la, ate ku paari wa bena pisita ale ŋayewa la, bena pi ale ŋaye mi yaase m suataŋa an jam dɛ ŋandiin tii ate kpagni a soa la. 15Alege kpaga ŋaai ale jam a dɛ mi niŋ la a pai ka jibta a ji nuruma ale tuesi ligbie ale paari pisinaansi ale ŋandiinta ale daam. Ba ŋaaŋviirɔma mɛ a jam nye nuruma ka dila. Alege mi ale a zuli Wen la, mi an nye dila. 16Ase ku ale magsi ayen m pai m dek a te tuini a ta vachaab ale parika la, m nuruma meena a jam tigsi kama ayen ba tom, ti an jam da tɛŋŋa.
17Juuba ale ba kpaga ale paari kook ale pisinu a dɛ mi jigi a gum chaab ale baai ale nyini tɛŋ sii ale gilim ti la po. 18Daa meena naab ale piisa ŋayuebi ale kpesa ale ba gomsi a magsi mu. Daa pi meena po, daam nna yegayega tɔgatɔga ale ba a te mu. Nya kude meena po, mi an yaali ŋandiin tii ate kpagni a soa la, dii nyiŋla ba ale jam a yaali diila a dobra kama a te nuruma.
19M Wen yaa, teeri mu ale ŋmanteka, mi ale nye dii meena a te nuruma de la nyiŋ.

Title: NEYEMIA 6
Content:
1Ase tomtomiŋka ale jam paari Sanballat ale Tobiya ale Arab denɔwa Gesem ale ti dachaasaŋa meena ayen mi a ŋman pilim a sɛ parika ate pari a karo la, a ta ga paari diipo ate mi an diem a su tuataŋa du la, 2Sanballat ale Gesem a tom ka tomtomiŋ ka dɛ a te mi ayen m jam ate mi ale ba a tu chaab tɛŋ fiisaŋa kanyi po, Ono tɛŋka ale la. Ba jam a yaali ba ko mu kama. 3Mi a yaa tom nuruba ba jigi ale tulisaŋa dɛ: <<M ta ka tuim kpienni dela m kan baga a jam. Mi ale nye ka sɛ a basi tuini abe m siŋ a jam nama jigi yaa?>> 4Ku naŋtuok nɔi bunaansi, ate ba tom ate mi mɛ a tulisi ba dila dekdega a paari bunaansi.
5Ku naŋtuok nɔi bunuwa po Sanballat a jam tom ka wa maarɔwa, wa an jam ligi gbaŋka ale pai te wa tomteerɔwa ayen wa ta jam te mu. 6Wa ale ŋmarisi diila ale nna: <<Ba a weeni tɛŋsaŋa meena kama ate Gesem ayen ku ka wensie fi ale Juuma a gomsi kama ayen ni nye kpaliŋ, dila ale soa ate nama a ŋman boro a sɛ parika la. Ase ti ale wom diila fi a yaali fi chim ka Naab, 7fi abe poom a lueri ka biisiteerɔba ayen ba mooli fi wie Jerusalem po: Naab a bo Juda kama! Yɔgyɔgla de tomtomiŋka ale paari Naawa. Dila nyiŋ jam ate tama a biisi magsi chaab.>>
8Mi yaa tom a tulisi wa ayen, <<Wari an nye ase fi ale a weeni diila, ka fidek ale a poli dila fi zukku po.>>
9Ba meena a yaali ba nyigsi ti kama a poli ayen, <<Ba ale jɔk nyiŋbiiri ale tuimaŋa tomka ate ŋa kan nueri.>> Alege mi a puusi kama ayen, <<Yɔgyɔgla de basi ate m nyiŋka a pagra.>>
10Dai yeŋ mi yaa cheŋ Delaiya nidoabinni Sɛmaiya ate wa kokpieŋ a chim Meyetabel yenni waai ate ba jam lik wa basi wa yenni po la. Wa a weeni ayen, <<Basi ate ti tu chaab Wen yenni po abe ti lik tuataŋa, dii nyiŋla nuruba ale cheena ayen ba ko fu, yok ba cheena ayen ba ko fu.>>
11Alege m tulisi wa ayen, <<Nuru ase mi choa la a chali nyini? Yaase mi la a jo Wen yenni po a suk? M kan cheŋŋi! 12Mi a miŋ kama ayen Wen an tom wa, alege wa a nye dila ka Tobiya ale Sanballat ale da wa. 13Ba da wa kama ayen wa nye dila ate mi a nye biem ase mi a nin nye dila, ate ba yaa ale kaasi mi yuei a ta mi a siŋ tɛŋ.
14Teeri Tobiya ale Sanballat, Naawen yaa, ba ale nye diila nyiŋ. Teeri nipok biisiteerɔwa Noadiya ale biisiteerɔma meena baai ale a yaali ayen ba nye ate mi nyiŋ a gɔk la.
15Ba jam sɛ parika a nuerika Elul chiika ka daa pisiye ale ŋanu dai, daa pisinu ale ŋaye ate ba pai a sɛ ka. 16Ti dachaasaŋa meena ale ga wom ale ti nueri parika la, Tɛŋ sii meena ale gilim ti la a jam yɔgsa kama ale jɔk nyiŋbiiri, dii nyiŋla ba sebi kama ayen ka Wen ale maari ate tuini de a nye.
17Da ŋala po Juda kpaŋŋa a kasim jam ŋmarisi ka gbaŋsa a te Tobiya ate Tobiya a kasim a tulisi ba mɛ. 18Juda po nuruma yega ale jam nye pɛka ale wa, wa ale jam ka Araya nidoabinni Sekania chicham biik la, ate wa nidoabinni Jeyoyanan a faari Berekiya nidoabinni Mesullam liewa la nyiŋ. 19A ŋman gum du, ba kasim a weeni mu wa wamaŋsaŋa kama ale a weeni wa dii ate mi a nye la. Alege Tobiya a diem tom gbaŋsa a te mi ayen wa nye ate mi nyiŋ a gɔk.

Title: NEYEMIA 7
Content:
1Parika ale ŋman pilim sɛ la ŋaaŋnyiŋ ate mi a su tuata du la, mi a jam lueri ka nansuiŋ limisidɔma ale yilendisaŋa ale Livaima. 2Mi jam pa ka m suoku Yanani ale Yanania tɛŋka jigi pagrika kpagni ate ba a nya Jerusalem zuk, dii nyiŋla Yanani jam ka nuru waai ale ta wensie ale a chali Wen a gaam nuruba yega. 3Mi jam weeni ba kama ayen, <<Jerusalem nansuiŋtaŋa an magsi ti lagri ka wenni a nin ga moak. Diipo ate nansuiŋ limisidɔma a diem bo tuima la, basi ate ba lik tuataŋa ale taperisa. Maa lueri Jerusalem dem ase limisidɔba la, gela a bo nansuiŋtaŋa abe gela a moata ba yeeŋa.>>
4Yɔgyɔgla de tɛŋ nummu a jam zuak kama ale lagri alege nuruba nna maga ale jam bo ka po ale yieŋa an ŋman jam sɛ ya. 5Dila mi Wenni yaa jam pai ku a nyo m suinum po ayen m tigsi kpaŋŋa ale niŋdeerɔma ale nuru meena a ŋmarisi ba yue a ta va ba dɔkdemma ale ka diila. Mi yaa jam nya gaŋsa yueŋa ale ŋmarisi doa la baai ale dɛ niŋ a ŋmani jam la. Dii ale jam ŋmarisi doa ate mi nya la ale la.
6Nuru baai ale nyini yɔntini po a jam la ale nna, baai ate Babilon naawa Nebukadnezzar a jam yik a ta cheŋ Babilon la. Ba jam ŋmani kuli Jerusalem ale bo Juda po la kama. Waai meena a cheŋ ka wa ale nyini tɛŋ kaai la. 7Ba niŋdeerɔma a jam le Zerubabel ale Jesua ale Neyemia ale Azariya ale Araamia ale Nayamani ale Mordekai ale Bilsan ale Misperet ale Bigvai ale Neyum ale Baanaya. Izirali demma nidoama jam le nna:
8Paros ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka tusa ŋaye ale kook ale pisiyopɔi ale baye (2,172). 9Sefatia ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka kobsita ale pisiyopɔi ale baye. 10Araya ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka kobsiyuebi ale pisinu ale baye. 11Payat Moab a ta ga paari Jesua ale Joab ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka tusa ŋaye ale kobsinaaniŋ ale pi ale naaniŋ (2,818). 12Iilam ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka tusidi ale kobsiye ale pisinu ale ŋanaansi (1,254). 13Zattu ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka kobsinaaniŋ ale pisinaansi ale ŋanu. 14Zakkai ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka kobsiyopɔi ale pisiyuebi. 15Binnui ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka kobsiyuebi ale pisinaansi ale naaniŋ. 16Bebai ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka kobsiyuebi ale pisiye ale naaniŋ. 17Azgad ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka tusa ŋaye ale kobsita ale pisiye ale baye (2,322). 18Adonikam ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka kobsiyuebi ale pisiyuebi ale bayopɔi. 19Bigvai ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka tusa ŋaye ale pisiyuebi ale bayopɔi (2,067). 20Adin ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka kobsiyuebi ale pisinu ale banu. 21Ater a ga paari Azekaya ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka pineok ale naaniŋ. 22Yasum ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka kobsita ale pisiye ale naaniŋ. 23Bezai ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka kobsita ale pisiye ale banaansi. 24Yarif ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka kook ale pi ale baye. 25Gibeon ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka pineok ale banu. 26Betiliyem ale Netofa nidoama jam ka kook ale pinaanuŋ ale naaniŋ. 27Anatot nidoama jam ka kook ale pisiye ale naaniŋ. 28Bet Azmavet nidoama jam ka pisinaansi ale baye. 29Kiriat Jearim ale Kefira ale Beerot nidoama jam ka kobsiyopɔi ale pisinaansi ale bata. 30Arama ale Geba nidoama jam ka kobsiyuebi ale pisiye ale wanyi. 31Mikmas nidoama jam ka kook ale pisiye ale baye. 32Betel ale Ai nidoama jam ka kook ale pisiye ale bata. 33Nebo m wala nidoama jam ka pisinu ale baye. 34Iilam m wala nidoama jam ka tusidi ale kobsiye ale pisinu ale banaansi (1,254). 35Yarim nidoama jam ka kobsita ale pisiye. 36Jeriko nidoama jam ka kobsita ale pisinaansi ale banu. 37Lod ale Yadid ale Ono nidoama jam ka kobsiyopɔi ale pisiye ale wanyi. 38Senaa nidoama a jam ka tusa ŋata ale kobsaneok ale pisita (3,930). 39A nyini kaabteerɔma po, Jedaya a ta ga paari Jesua ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka kobsaneok ale pisiyopɔi ale bata. 40Immer ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka tusidi ale pisinu ale baye (1,052). 41Pasur ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka tusidi ale kobsiye ale pisinaansi ale bayopɔi (1,247). 42Yarim ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka tusidi ale pi ale bayopɔi (1,017). 43A nyini Livaima po, Jesua a ta ga paari Kadmiel ale Yodavia ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka pisiyopɔi ale banaansi. 44A nyini yilendisaŋa po, Asaf ŋaaŋbisaŋa ka kook ale pisinaansi ale naaniŋ. 45A nyini nansuiŋ limisidɔma po, Sallum ale Ater ale Talmon ale Akkub ale Yatita ale Sobai ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka kook ale pisita ale naaniŋ. 46Wen yenni tomteerɔma ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka Ziya ale Yasufa ale Tabbaot 47ale Keros ale Sia ale Padon ale 48Lebana ale Agaba ale Salmai ale 49Yanan ale Giddel ale Gayar ale 50Areaiya ale Arezin ale Nekoda ale 51Gazzam ale Uzza ale Pasea ale 52Besai ale Meunim ale Nefussim ale 53Bakbuk ale Yakufa ale Yaryur ale 54Bazlut ale Meyida ale Yarsa ale 55Barkos ale Sisera ale Temaya ale 56Nezia ale Yatifa. 57Solomon tomteerɔma ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka Sotai ale Soferet ale Perida ale 58Jaala ale Darkon ale Giddel ale 59Sefatia ale Yattil ale Pokeret Yazzebaim ale Amon. 60Wen yenni tomteerɔma ale Solomon tomteerɔma ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka kobsita ale pineok ale baye.
61Bade a jam nyini ka tɛŋsaŋa de, Tel Mela ale Tel Yarsa ale Kerub ale Addon ale Immer alege ba an jam sak ase ba dɔkdemma a jam ka Izirali ŋaaŋbisa. Ba ale nna: 62Delaiya ale Tobiya ale Nekoda ŋaaŋbisaŋa jam ka kobsiyuebi ale pisinaansi ale baye. 63A nyini kaabteerɔma ŋaaŋbisaŋa po jam ka Yobaya ale Yakkoz ale Barzillai. Nidoa waai ale jam faari Gilead denɔwa Barzillai liewa la, ate ba pai yuei dila a wi wa la. 64Bade ale jam gisi ba dɔkdemma po ŋmarisika alege an nya ya, dila ba jam gaari ba a ta nyini kaabteerɔma po kama ase ba an welema la. 65Tɛŋka kpagni yaa weeni ba ayen ba kan dɛ ŋandiin tii ale ŋmasi ta tuilum la ate ku paari diipo ate kaabteerɔ a pai Urim ale Tummim a tom.
66Tigsuŋku meena jam ka tusa pisinaansi ale ŋaye ale kobsita ale pisiyuebi (42,360). 67A gum du ba tomteerɔma ale ba dɔkliema jam ka tusa ŋayopɔi ale kobsita ale pisita ale bayopɔi (7,337) ate ba jam maa ta ka nidoaba ale nipooba kobsiye ale pisinaansi ale banu ate ba a lenni yiila. 68Ba jam ta ka wusuma kobsiyopɔi ale pisita ale ŋayuebi ale wusum bonsa kobsiye ale pisinaansi ale ŋanu 69ale laalaakomiba kobsinaansi ale pisita ale banu ale bonsa tusa ŋayuebi ale kobsiyopɔi ale pisiye (6,720). 70Yieŋa nyama gela a jam cheesi kama a magsi tuini. Tɛŋka kpagni a jam te ka ligmɔniŋ tusidi ale china pisinu ale gatta kobsinu ale pisita a magsi kaabteerɔma. 71Yieŋa nyama gela a jam te ka ligmɔniŋ tusa pisiye (20,000) ale kpana tusa ŋaye ale kobsiye (2,200) a magsi tuini. 72Ŋantaŋa meena ate nuruma a jam a te la ka ligmɔniŋ tusa pisiye (20,000) ale kpana tusa ŋaye (2,000) ale kaabteerɔba gatta pisiyuebi ale tiyopɔi.
73Kaabteerɔma ale Livaima ale nansuiŋ limisidɔma ale yilendisaŋa ale Wen yenni tomteerɔma a gum chaab ale nuruma ale Izirali demma meena a jam kali ka badek tɛŋsaŋa po. Ase chiisa siyopɔi ale paari la, Izirali demma a yaa kali badek tɛŋsaŋa po.

Title: NEYEMIA 8
Content:
1Nuruma meena yaa jam tigsi ase nuru yeŋ la Nyiam Nansuiŋku nɔi. Ba yaa weeni Ezra gbaŋ ŋmarisidoawa ayen wa ta Moosis Sinsaŋŋa gbaŋka a jam, kaai ate Naawen a te Izirali demma la. 2Dila chiisa siyopɔiwa piilimka danni Ezra kaabteerɔwa yaa ta Sinsaŋŋa a jam tigsuŋku niŋ, baai ale jam ka nidoaba ale nipooba la ale baai meena ale baga miŋ a chak la. 3Wa jam kariŋ kama ate ku jueli a nyini varivientidi a ta ga paari kantueŋ suŋsuŋ ase wa le jam za tuk Nyiam Nansuiŋku nidoama ale nipooma ale baai meena ale miŋ a chak la niŋ. Ate nuruma meena a kpesi wom Sinsaŋŋa gbaŋka nalimnyiini.
4Gbaŋ ŋmarisidoawa Ezra a jam za ka danpala ate ba jam ti magsi tigini la zuk. Wa juga nisaŋa geŋsa ka Mattitia ale Sɛma ale Anaiya ale Yuraya ale Yilkia ale Maaseiya ale jam za dula ate Pedaiya ale Misael ale Malkija ale Yasum ale Yasbaddana ale Zakaria ale Mesullam a za wa gala.
5Ezra yaa jam lak gbaŋka. Nuruma meena a jam a nya wa kama dii nyiŋla wa jam za ka ŋmazuk. Ase wa ale lak ka la, nuruma meena yaa yiti zaani. 6Ezra yaa pak Naawen, Wen kpienni ate nuruma meena yaa jam zak ba nisa a tulisi ayen, <<Ku abe nye dila! Ku abe nye dila!>> Ba yaa koori tɛŋ a pai ba nina a basi tɛŋ a puusi Naawen.
7Livaima Jesua ale Bani ale Serebia ale Jamin ale Akkub ale Sabbetai ale Yodia ale Maaseiya ale Kelita ale Azariya ale Jozabad ale Yanan ale Pelaiya yaa jam sak nuruma Sinsaŋŋa ale ge ate nuruma a za dula. 8Ba jam kariŋ kama a nyini Naawen Sinsaŋŋa Gbaŋka po a luenti a weeni ŋa kiri ate dila nye ate nuruma a baga miŋ ba le kariŋ diila a chak. 9Kpagni Neyemia ale kaabteerɔwa ale gbaŋ ŋmarisidoawa Ezra ale Livaima baai ale jam a sak nuruma la yaa weeni ba meena ayen, <<Danni de a welema kama a te Naawen ni Wenni. Ni kan kaari yaase ni kum.>> Diila nuruma meena a jam a kum kama ase ba ale jam wom Sinsaŋŋa wieŋa la. 10Wa weeni ayen, <<Ni cheŋ a ga dɛ nidek ale a yaali ŋandiin tii ale damasik kaai la abe ni tom gela a te baai ale kan ta jaab la. Danni de ka dai weleŋ a te Nyɔnɔwa. Ni kan te ni sue a kaasi ale Naawen mariŋka ka ni pagrim.>>
11Livaima yaa nye ate nuruma meena a goori ale weeni ayen, <<Ni zaan ŋmam ale danni de ka dai weleŋ. Ni kan te ni sue a kaasi.>> 12Ate nuruma meena yaa jam cheŋ a ga dɛ ale nyu ale tom ŋandiinta a te ale a dɛ tigini ale mariŋka nna yegayega dii nyiŋla ba yaa miŋ wieŋa ate ba sak ba la kama.
13Chiika daa ŋayewa danni, yieŋa nyama meena a gum chaab ale kaabteerɔma ale Livaima yaa tigsi gilim gbaŋ ŋmarisidoawa Ezra ayen ba pai ba popola a basi Sinsaŋŋa wieŋa jigi. 14Ba yaa jam nya ale ku ŋmarisi Sinsaŋŋa po, dii ate Naawen a jam weeni Moosis ayen Izirali demma a jam magsi ba bo ka kusuŋta po chiisa siyopɔiwa tigini vaaŋa po abe 15ba a mooli wieŋa de ate ŋa waaŋ ba tɛŋsaŋa meena ale Jerusalem po, <<Ni cheŋ guuta tɛŋka meena po a ta naŋsa a nyini kpaam tiisa ale gɔi kpaam tiisa ale puuta tiisa ale kpinkpatta tiisa ale yɔgsum tiisa a ti kusuŋta ase ku ale ŋmarisi diila.
16Dila nuruma yaa cheŋ ga ta tiisa naŋsa a jam a ti kusuŋta a te badek badek yieŋa zuk ale ba dabaasaŋa po ale Wen yenni dabaasaŋa po ale Nyiam Nansuiŋku nɔi peelimmu po ate kunyi a bo Ɛfraim Nansuiŋku. 17Tigsuŋku meena ale nyini yɔntini po a ŋmani la a jam ti ka kusuŋta a bo ti po. A nyini Nun nidoabinni Josua daaŋa po a ta ga paari dai dila danni, Izirali demma an jam dɛ tigini ase nnala la. Ba mariŋka a jam ŋmasi zuak kama.
18Daa meena a nyini piilimka danni a ga paari kpeglimka, Ezra a jam kariŋ a nyini ka Wen Sinsaŋŋa Gbaŋka po. Ba jam dɛ tigini ka daa ŋayopɔi, daa naanika danni a ta va buusa ale ka diila, ba jam tigsi ka chaab.

Title: NEYEMIA 9
Content:
1Chiik kala dek daa pisiye ale ŋanaansiwa danni, Izirali demma a jam tigsi ka jigi yeŋ a bobi nɔi a jo boorisa gatta a nye tanta a basi ba zuimaŋa po. 2Baai ale ka Izirali buuni po la a jam gaari ka badek a ta nyini nichamma po. Ba jam zaani ka ba jiŋŋa a biisi ba biemu ale ba koma gaasaŋa wie. 3Ba jam zaani ka ba ale bo juijui la a kariŋ a ta nyini Naawen ba Wenni Sinsaŋŋa Gbaŋka po a paari baŋsa buta ale pai baŋsa buta a weeni ba biemu ale a puusi Naawen ba Wenni.
4Ŋmazukku jam ka Livaima ale za, Jesua ale Bani ale Kadmiel ale Sebania ale Bunni ale Serebia ale Bani ale Kenani, baai ale jam za du a kaari a wi Naawen ba Wenni la. 5Ate Livaima Jesua ale Kadmiel ale Bani ale Yasabneya ale Serebia ale Yodia ale Sebania ale Petayia a yaa weeni ayen, <<Ni yiti zaani a pak Naawen ni Wenni waai ale boro taam wuu la! Niauŋ a bo fi zula yuenni po, di abe nya pimpauk a gaam niauŋ ale pimpauk meena. 6Fi nyiini ale Naawen. Fi ale nye wenŋmazukku, poom ka ŋmazuk kuui ale yalima la ale ŋan baai meena ale bo ku po la ale tɛŋzuk de ale jaab meena ale bo ka po la ale nyakpiemu ale jaab meena ale bo bu po la. Fi ale te jaab meena nyuvuri ate ŋan boanni wenŋmazuk a puusi fu.
7<<Naawen yaa, fi waai ale ka Wen la, ale jam lueri Abram a ta wa nyini Ur ale bo Kaldiya po la a nyini a te wa yuei ayen Abrayam. 8Fi jam nya ale wa suinummu a ta ka wensie ale fu, ate fi nye nɔiyeŋ ale wa ayen fi te wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa Keenan ale Yit ale Amori ale Perizzi ale Jebus ale Girgas demma tɛŋsaŋa. Fi ta fi puulimka kama dii nyiŋla fi ka wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ.
9<<Fi nya ti kokpieŋsaŋa ninammu Ejipiti po kama, fi wom ba kaarika kama Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku nɔi. 10Fi jam tom ka wakinkagla ale wakperikaliisa a siti Faaro ale wa kpaŋŋa ale nuruma meena tɛŋka po, dii nyiŋla fi jam seba kayerinni dii ate Ejipiti demma a jam nye le ba la kama. Fi jam nye ka yuei a te fidek, dii ale boro a paari jinla de la. 11Fi jam labi nyakpiemu buye a te ba, ate dila a te ba suik ate ba cheŋ tɛŋ kosik zuk a taam, alege fi jam basi ate baai ale a vi ba la a wari liuŋku po ase tintain ale lo nyakpiem po diila. 12Danni po fi jam dɛ ba niŋ ale ka chiŋmari la ale de ba niŋ yokku po ase bolim la ate bu a nya suiku ate ba jam a yaali ba va la.
13<<Fi jam siŋ jam Sinai guuku zuk kama a biisi nyini wenŋmazuk ale ba. Fi jam te ba ka buusa ŋaai ale ka chekki, ale sinsak ŋaai ale ka wensie, ale ŋmarisika, ale wie ŋaai ale ka wamaŋsa la. 14Fi jam basi ate ba seba fi tuilum Vuusum Danni kama a te ba wieŋa ale buusa ale sinsaŋŋa a nyini fi tomteerɔwa Moosis jigi. 15Ba kɔmmu po fi jam te ba ŋandiinta a nyini wenŋmazuk, nyanyuilaŋa ale jam ta ba la fi te ba nyiam a nyini piuŋ po, fi weeni ba ayen ba jo a tuesi tɛŋka ale jam zak nisa ŋmai a pɛ ayen fi te ba la.
16<<Alege bala, tama kokpieŋsaŋa a jam ta ka kayerinni ale tukpari ale an siak a te fi wieŋa. 17Ba ŋoanti kama an wom ya a zɛri ba an teeri fi wakinkaglaŋa ate fi jam nye ba po la. Ba jam chim ka tukpari nyam, ba tukpanni nyiŋ ba jam lueri ka niŋdeerɔba ayen ba ŋmani a cheŋ ba yɔntini po. Alege fi ka vɔŋteka Naawen a ta niaka ale jiirim, fi sui a kan puuri nwuli a kasim ta ŋmanteka. Dila nyiŋ fi an jam zɛri ba, 18poom ka diipo ate ba jam mɛ naabiik a te badek ale weeni ayen, <Ni wenni ale nna, dii ale ta ni a nyini Ejipiti po a nyini la,> yaase ba le jam potim seba ale nye kisuk wanni la.
19<<Fi jiirim kpiemu nyiŋ fi an banti ba a basi gɔnni po. Danni po chiŋmanni an basi ba ganika suiku po yaase bolimu a basi nyaksika suik kuui po ate ba jam a yaali ba va la. 20Fi jam basi ate fi Chiik maŋka a sak ba. Fi an jam peri fi ŋandiintaŋa ba noaŋa po ale te ba nyiam ba nyanyuilaŋa nyiŋ. 21Bena pisinaansi fi jam ta ba ka dila gɔnni po, ba an jam a silim jaaboa, ba gattaŋa an jam cheeri ya yaase ba naŋsaŋa a zak ji ya.
22<<Fi jam te ba naata ale tɛŋ kpieŋsa, a pai niŋniŋ tɛŋsa a te ba. Ba jam tuesi naab Siyon tɛŋka Yesbon ale naab Og tɛŋka Basan kama. 23Fi nye ate ba nidoabilisaŋa a piisi kama ase wenzuk chiŋmarisaŋa la, ale ta ba jam jo tɛŋka po ate fi weeni ba koma ayen ba jo a tuesi a ta. 24Ba bisaŋa a jo kama a tuesi tɛŋka a ta. Fi nya pagrim Keenan demma zuk baai ale bo tɛŋka po la ba niŋ, fi pai Keenan demma a te ba, a maa gum ba nalimaŋa du, ale tɛŋka nuruma, ayen ba nye ale ba badek ale a yaali diila. 25Ba jam nak yik tɛŋ pagrisa ale tɛŋ kaai ale ta poosuk. Ba tuesi yie ŋaai ate ŋan maŋsa tɔgatɔga a sueri ŋa la ale vila ŋaai ale poom tu ale kaduksa ale kpaam tiisa ale yɔna tiisa ale piisi. Ba dɛ chak ate ba nyiŋsa a nala. Ba jam a dɛ ka masim fi nye maŋka ale zuak la po.
26<<Alege ba jam ta ka tukpari ale zɛri fi, ba jam pai fi sinsaŋŋa a basi ka ba ŋaaŋsa. Ba jam ko fi biisiteerɔma baai ale jam a sak ba ayen ba tulim ba a te fi la kama, ba jam nye ka kisuk wari. 27Dila fi yaa pai ba a nyo ba dachaasaŋa nisima po baai ale jam namsi ba. Alege ba ale jam namsi ba la ba yaa kaari a te fi. A nyini wenŋmazuk fi wom ba, fi jiirim kpiemu nyiŋ fi jam te ba varibasidɔba, baai ale jam vari ba ba dachaasaŋa nisa po a basi.
28<<Alege ba ale jam nya vuusum la ba ŋman jam nye ka biem fi nina po. Fi yaa banti ba a te ba dachaasaŋa ate ba jam a nya ba zuk. Ba ŋman jam kaari kama a te fi a wom nyini wenŋmazuk, fi jiirim kpiemu nyiŋ ate fi ŋman vari ba a basi.
29<<Fi jam kaam ba kama ayen ba tulim fi sinsaŋŋa jigi, alege ba jam nye kayerinni a zɛri fi wieŋa. Ba jam nye ka biem a kaasi fi buusaŋa, ŋaai ale ŋa basi ate nuru a boro ase wa nin siak a te ŋa. Tukpari nyeela nyiŋ ba jam tulim ka ba ŋaaŋsa a te fu, a chim tukpari nyam ale zɛri wom ka. 30Bena nna yega ate fi kasim jam a ŋmagli ale ba. Fi pai fi Chiika a ta va fi biisiteerɔma zuk a kaam ba. Dila meena ba an jam diem wom ya dila fi yaa pai ba a te nuru baai ale kali moata ba la. 31Alege fi jiirim kpiemu nyiŋ fi an jam basi ate ba kpeglim ya yaase fi banti ba, diila fi ka ŋmanteka ale jiirim Wen.
32<<Yɔgyɔgla de, ti Wen yaa, Wen kpien dii ale zuak ate ba a chali fu la, waai ale va wa nɔiyeŋka ale wa ŋmanteka la, kan basi ate wa pagraŋa de meena a nya suik fi nina po. Wapagra ŋaai ale jam tama ale ti nalimaŋa ale ti niŋdeerɔma ale ti kaabteerɔma ale ti biisiteerɔma ale ti koma ale fi nuruma meena zuk a nyini Assiria nalimaŋa daaŋa po a jam paari jinla de la. 33Dii meena ale jam nye ti la po fi jam ta ka nyemagsika ale ti, fi jam nye ka wensie nyeka, ale ge tama a nye kaasi. 34Ti nalimaŋa ale ti nisɔmma ale ti kaabteerɔma ale ti koma an jam va fi sinsaŋŋa, ba niŋ jam ka fi wieŋa yaase kaamka ate fi a te ba la po. 35Poom daa ba ale jam bo ba naamu po a dɛ fi wamaŋsa masimu tɛŋka ale lak nna jalɔ ale poak ate fi a te ba la, ba an jam tom a te fi yaase ba basi ba biem suitaŋa.
36<<Alege nya, tama ka yɔm jinla, yɔm tɛŋ kaai ate fi pai te ti kokpieŋsaŋa ayen ba dɛ ka yɔnaŋa ale ŋan maŋ sii ate ka ta la po. 37Tama biem nyiŋ, ŋan cheenta yega a cheŋ ka nalimaŋa ate fi a te ba nya ti zuk la jigi. Ba jam a nya ka ti nyiŋsaŋa ale niiŋa ase ba ale a yaali diila. Tama a bo ka wapagrisa po nna yega.
38Kude meena ate ti nya la nyiŋ, tama a nye ka nɔiyeŋ kaai ale a bobi ti la, a ŋmarisi ka a dueni ale ti niŋdeerɔma ale ti Livaima ale ti kaabteerɔma a yaa ŋmarisi ba yueŋa.>>

Title: NEYEMIA 10
Content:
1Baai ale jam ŋmarisi ba yueŋa la jam le Yakalia nidoabinni tɛŋka kpagni Neyemia ale Zedekia ale 2Seraiya ale Azariya ale Jeremaya ale 3Pasur ale Amariya ale Malkija ale 4Yattus ale Sebania ale Malluk ale 5Yarim ale Meremot ale Obadia ale 6Daniel ale Ginneton ale Baruk ale 7Mesullam ale Abaija ale Mijamin ale 8Maazia ale Bilgai ale Sɛmaiya. Bala a jam le kaabteerɔma.
9Livaima baai ale jam ŋmarisi ba yueŋa la le Azaniya nidoabinni Jesua ale Yenadad nidoabilisaŋa wanyi Binnui ale Kadmiel ale 10ba suataŋa: Sebania ale Yodia ale Kelita ale Pelaiya ale Yanan ale 11Mika ale Areyob ale Yasabia ale 12Zakkur ale Serebia ale Sebania ale 13Yodia ale Bani ale Beninu.
14Nuruma niŋdeerɔma ale jam ŋmarisi ba yueŋa la le Paros ale Payat Moab ale Iilam ale Zattu ale Bani ale 15Bunni ale Azgad ale Bebai ale 16Adonija ale Bigvai ale Adin ale 17Ater ale Azekaya ale Azzur ale 18Yodia ale Yasum ale Bezai ale 19Yarif ale Anatot ale Nebai ale 20Magpias ale Mesullam ale Yezir ale 21Mesezabel ale Zadok ale Jaddua ale 22Pelatia ale Yanan ale Anaiya ale 23Yosea ale Yanania ale Yassub ale 24Yalloyes ale Pilya ale Sobek ale 25Areyum ale Yasabna ale Maaseiya ale 26Ayia ale Yanan ale Anan ale 27Malluk ale Yarim ale Baanaya.
28<<Nuru baai gela ale jam siak la ale nna: kaabteerɔba ale Livaiba ale nansuiŋ limisidɔba ale yilendisa ale Wen yenni tomteerɔba ale baai meena ale gaari badek a nyini nuru baai ale moata Wen sinsaŋŋa nyiŋla, a gum chaab ale ba pooma ale ba nidoabilisaŋa meena ale ba liema baai ale baga a miŋ la. 29Bade meena yaa gum ba suataŋa ale ba kpaŋŋa po, a ka kikaasa a pɛ ayen ba Wen Sinsaŋŋa ate ba wom a ta va Wen tomteerɔwa Moosis jigi la ayen ba kpesi a va Naawen ti Nyɔnɔwa wieŋa ale buusaŋa ale ŋmarisika.
30<<Ti puulim kama ayen ti kan pai ti liema a yalisi nuru baai ale kali a gilim ti la yaase ti faari ba liema a te ti nidoabilisaŋa.
31Ase tɛŋ sii ale moata la nuruma a dan ta ŋanta yaase ŋandiinta jam ayen ba da Vuusumu Danni yaase tuilum dai yoŋ ti kan da a nyini ba jigi ya. Bena ŋayopɔi po meena ti kan kpa abe ti baŋ nuruba ale ta ti pama la wie.
32<<Ti ŋman piilim a nye ti le wom wie ŋaai ayen ti pai ligbie ŋata a magsi ti Wen yenni tuini la. 33Kude a magsika jazaanimu zuk boroboroku ale magsi daa meena ŋandiinta tiiritaŋa ale juka tiiritaŋa ale Vuusum Daaŋa tiiritaŋa ale Chiik Paalik tiŋŋa ale tik ŋaai ate ba lueri la ale tuilum tiiritaŋa ale biem tiiritaŋa a nye biem duisi basika a te Izirali demma ale tuini meena ti Wen yenni po.
34<<Tama baai kaabteerɔma ale Livaima ale nuruma a nak ka gbaŋ ayen ti miŋ diipo ate waai meena dɔkdem ale ta jam ti Wen yenni diipo ale magsi benni po ayen ti cheesi daata a magsi juka Naawen ti Wenni kuŋkuŋku zuk, ase ku le ŋmarisi Sinsaŋŋa po la.
35<<Ti jam ŋman siak ayen ti le ta ŋandiin tii ale dɛ niŋ a bɛ la ale tiib meena yɔna a jam Naawen yenni bein meena po.
36<<Ase ku le ŋmarisi dii Sinsaŋŋa po la, ti le ta ti nidoabilisaŋa ate ti a dɛ niŋ a biak la ale ti niiŋa ale dɛ niŋ a biak ŋaai la ale ti duŋ buulimu ale dɛ niŋ a biak sii la ale ti piisaŋa ale dɛ niŋ a biak ŋaai la a jam ti Wen yenni po, a te kaabteerɔma ale a tom dula la.
37<<Ti le ta jam Wen yenni ŋanta duenika jigini a te kaabteerɔwa ti le dɛ niŋ a ta ti zommu ale ti ŋanbie tiiritaŋa ale ti tiisaŋa meena yɔnaŋa ale ti dapaalimu ale kpaamu. Abe ti labi ti kpanni ŋantaŋa pi a pai bunyi a te Livaima dii nyiŋla ka Livaima ale a tuesi tɛŋ sii meena ate ti boro a tom la. 38Kaabteerɔ waai ale nyini Aaron buuni po la ale magsi wa va Livaima ase ba nin ba tuesi piika, ka Livaima abe le ba ta piika a jam ti Wen yenni po, ŋanta dueni ka dɔkku po. 39Izirali demma a maa gum Livaima du ale ta ba ŋandiinta cheesuŋku ale ba dapaalimu ale kpaamu a jam ŋanta duenika diinaŋa po juijui ate Wen yenni ŋantaŋa a doa la ale juijui ate kaabteerɔ baai a tom la ale nansuiŋ limisidɔma ale yilendisaŋa a boro la. Ti kan banti ti Wen yenni a basi.>>

Title: NEYEMIA 11
Content:
1Yɔgyɔgla de nuruma niŋdeerɔma yaa kali Jerusalem po ate nuru mbala a nak gbaŋ a yeeri nuru yeŋ a ta nyini nuruba pi po ayen wa maa bo tuilum tɛŋka Jerusalem po abe neokku ale tali la a bo badek tɛŋsaŋa po. 2Nuruma a yaa pak nidoama meena ale siak ayen ba bo Jerusalem po la.
3Baai ale jam a dɛ tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa niŋ a kala Jerusalem po la ale nna. Izirali demma gela ale kaabteerɔma ale Livaima ale baai ale a tom Wen yenni po la ale Solomon tomteerɔma ŋaaŋbisaŋa a jam bo ka Juda tɛŋsaŋa po waai meena a bo wadek jigi tɛŋsaŋa po, 4ate nuru mbala ale nyini Juda ale Benjamin la mɛ a bo Jerusalem la. Baai ale chim Juda ŋaaŋbisa a jam kali la ale nna: Ataiya waai kowa a jam le Yuzaya la ate wa mɛ ko a nye Zakaria ate wa mɛ ko a nye Amariya ate wa mɛ ko a nye Sefatia ate wa mɛ ko a nye Mayalale ate wa mɛ ko a nye Perezi. 5Maaseiya waai kowa a jam le Baruk ate wa mɛ ko a nye Kol Yoze ate wa mɛ ko a nye Yazaya ate wa mɛ ko a nye Adaiya ate wa mɛ ko a nye Joiarib ate wa mɛ ko a nye Zakaria ate wa mɛ ko a nye Sɛla. 6Perezi ŋaaŋbisaŋa baai ale bo Jerusalem po jam ka nidoa pagrisa kobsinaansi ale pisiyuebi ale naaniŋ.
7Baai ale chim Benjamin ŋaaŋbisa a jam kali la ale nna: Sallu waai kowa a jam le Mesullam ate wa mɛ ko a nye Joed ate wa mɛ ko a nye Pedaiya ate wa ko a nye Kolaiya ate wa mɛ ko a nye Maaseiya ate wa mɛ ko a nye Itiel ate wa ko a nye Jesaiya, 8ate wa ŋaaŋviirɔma, Gabbai ale Sallai ka nuruba kobsaneok ale pisiye ale naaniŋ. 9Zikri nidoabinni Joel a jam chim ka ba kpagi ate Yassenuya nidoabinni Juda a jaa a nya ka tɛŋka labi kinkala zuk.
10Baai ale chim kaabteerɔma ŋaaŋbisa a jam kali la ale nna: Jedaya ale Joiarib nidoabinni ale Jakin, 11ale Seraiya waai kowa a jam le Yilkia ate wa mɛ ko a nye Mesullam ate wa mɛ ko a nye Zadok ate wa mɛ ko a nye Meraiot ate wa mɛ ko a nye Wen yenni nyaarɔwa Ayitub 12ale ba ŋaaŋviirɔma kobsinaaniŋ ale pisiye ale baye baai ale a tom Wen yenni po ale Adaiya waai kowa a jam le Jeroyam ate wa mɛ ko a nye Pelalia ate wa mɛ ko a nye Amzi ate wa mɛ ko a nye Zakaria ate wa mɛ ko a nye Pasur ate wa mɛ ko a nye Malkija 13ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma kobsiye ale pisinaansi ale baye baai ale chim ba dɔkdemma kpaga ale Amasai waai kowa a jam le Azarel ate wa mɛ ko a nye Azai ate wa mɛ ko a nye Mesillemot ate wa mɛ ko a nye Immer 14ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma kook ale pisiye ale naaniŋ. Ba kpagi dii ale dɛ ba niŋ la a jam le Zabdiel waai kowa a jam le Aggedolim.
15Baai ale chim Livaima ŋaaŋbisa a jam kali la ale nna: Sɛmaiya waai kowa a jam le Yassub ate wa mɛ ko a nye Azrikam ate wa mɛ ko a nye Yasabia ate wa mɛ ko a nye Bunni 16ale Livaima kpaga ŋaye Sabbetai ale Jozabad baai ale a nya Wen yenni tuimaŋa zuk peelim 17ale Mattania waai kowa a jam le Mika ate wa mɛ ko a nye Zabdi ate wa mɛ ko a nye Asaf waai ale a dɛ nuruma niŋ ate ba a nye Naawen jiam ale puusa la ale Bakbukia waai ale pai a vi wa ŋaaŋviirɔma la ale Abda waai kowa ale nye Sammua ate wa mɛ ko a nye Galal ate wa mɛ ko a nye Jedutun. 18Livaima ale bo tuilum tɛŋka po la ka nuruba kobsiye ale pinaanuŋ ale banaansi.
19Baai ale chim nansuiŋ nyaarɔma a jam kali la ale nna: Akkub ale Talmon ale ba ŋaaŋviirɔma baai ale a nya nansuiŋtaŋa la a jam ka nidoaba kook ale pisiyopɔi ale baye.
20Izirali dem mbala ale kaabteerɔma ale Livaima, a jam bo ka Juda tɛŋsaŋa meena, waai meena a bo wa ŋiak tɛŋzuk.
21Baai ale jam bo Wen yenni po a tom la a jam bo ka Ofel guuku zuk ate Ziya ale Gispa a nya ba zuk.
22Jerusalem tɛŋka po Livaima kpagni a jam le Uzzi waai kowa a jam le Bani ate wa mɛ ko a nye Yasabia ate wa mɛ ko a nye Mattania ate wa mɛ ko a nye Mika. Uzzi wa dɛ a jam ka Asaf ŋaaŋbisaŋa po baai ale jam chim yilendisa ale jam a nya Wen yenni tuimaŋa zuk. 23Yilendisaŋa a jam bo ka Naawa nisa po, wa ale jam a weeni ba dii ale magsi ba nye la.
24Mesezabel nidoabinni Petayia waai ale ka Juda nidoabinni Zera ŋaaŋbisaŋa wanyi la ale jam chim kpagi a nya wa ŋaai meena ale a nye ale nuruma la.
25Dan ka tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa ale si laŋsaŋa, Juda nuruma gela ale jam bo Kiriat Arba ale ka gilagila tɛŋsaŋa, ale bo Dibon ale ka gilagilawa, ale Jekabzeel ale ka tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa, 26ale Jesua ale Molada ale Bet Pelet ale 27Yazar Sual ale Beerseba ale ka gilagila tɛŋsaŋa 28ale Ziklag ale Mekona ale ka gilagila tɛŋsaŋa, 29En Arimmon ale Zoraya ale Jarmut 30ale Zanoaya ale Adullam ale ka tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa ale Lachis ale ka laŋsaŋa ale Azeka ale ka gilagila tɛŋsaŋa. Ba jam bo ka Beerseba tɛŋka a ta ga paari Yinnom Viaka.
31Benjamin ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale nyini Geba la a jam bo ka Mikmas ale Aija ale Betel gilagila tɛŋsaŋa 32ale Anatot ale Nob ale Anania 33ale Yazor ale Arama ale Gittaim 34ale Yadid ale Zeboim ale Neballat 35ale Lod ale Ono ale Yɔgdɔma Viaka.
36Juda Livaima beŋsaŋa gela a jam bo ka Benjamin.

Title: NEYEMIA 12
Content:
1Kaabteerɔma ale Livaima baai ale jam va Sealtiel nidoabinni Zerubabel ale Jesua a ŋmani la ale nna: Seraiya ale Jeremaya ale Ezra 2ale Amariya ale Malluk ale Yattus 3ale Sekania ale Areyum ale Meremot 4ale Iddo ale Ginneton ale Abaija 5ale Mijamin ale Moadia ale Bilga 6ale Sɛmaiya ale Joiarib ale Jedaya 7ale Sallu ale Amok ale Yilkia ale Jedaya. Ba de ale jam chim kaabteerɔma ale ba ŋaaŋviirɔma niŋdeerɔba Jesua daaŋa po.
8Livaima ale nna: Jesua ale Binnui ale Kadmiel ale Serebia ale Juda ale Mattania waai ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma ale jam a dɛ jiam teka yiilaŋa niŋ. 9Bakbukia ale Unni ale baai ale a vi ba ŋaaŋ la a zaani a tuk ba tama tuka po.
10Jesua ale jam biak Joiakim ate Joiakim a jam biak Eliasib ate Eliasib a jam biak Joiada 11ate Joiada a jam biak Jonatan ate Jonatan mɛ a jam biak Jaddua.
12Joiakim daaŋa po ate baai a jam dɛ kaabteerɔma dɔkdemma niŋ la ale nna: Seraiya dɔkdemma po jam ka Meraia. Jeremaya dɔkdemma po jam ka Yanania. 13Ezra dɔkdemma po jam ka Mesullam. Amariya dɔkdemma po jam ka Jeyoyanan. 14Malluk dɔkdemma po jam ka Jonatan. Sebania dɔkdemma po jam ka Josefi. 15Yarim dɔkdemma po jam ka Adna. Meraiot dɔkdemma po jam ka Yelkai. 16Iddo dɔkdemma po jam ka Zakaria. Ginneton dɔkdemma po jam ka Mesullam. 17Abaija dɔkdemma po jam ka Zikri. Miniamin ale Moadia dɔkdemma po jam ka Piltai. 18Bilga dɔkdemma po jam ka Sammua. Sɛmaiya dɔkdemma po jam ka Jeyonatan. 19Joiarib dɔkdemma po jam ka Mattenai. Jedaya dɔkdemma po jam ka Uzzi. 20Sallu dɔkdemma po jam ka Kallai. Amok dɔkdemma po jam ka Eber. 21Yilkia dɔkdemma po jam ka Yasabia. Jedaya dɔkdemma po jam ka Netanel.
22Eliasib ale Joiada ale Joyanan ale Jaddua ale kaabteerɔma daaŋa po, Livaima dɔkdemma yie nyama a jam ŋmarisi kama Persia naawa Darius daaŋa po. 23Yieŋa nyama niŋdeerɔma ale jam bo Livaima ŋaaŋbisaŋa po la a ga paari Eliasib nidoabinni Joyanan daaŋa po la a jam ŋmarisi doa wie gbaŋka po kama. 24Livaima niŋdeerɔma jam le Yasabia ale Serebia ale Kadmiel nidoabinni Jesua ale ba ŋaaŋviirɔma, baai ale jam za a tuk ba ayen ba, te pimpauk ale jiam, kauk kunyi ale jam a tulisi m kula ase Deevid Naawen nuruwa ale jam biisi diila.
25Mattania ale Bakbukia ale Obadia ale Mesullam ale Talmon ale Akkub jam le nansuiŋ limisidɔ baai ale jam a limisi ŋanta duenika diinaŋa ale bo nansuiŋtaŋa. 26Ba jam tom ka Jesua nidoabinni Joiakim ate wa kokpieŋ a nye Jozadak la daaŋa po ale kpagni Neyemia ale kaabteerɔwa ale ŋmarisidoawa Ezra daaŋa po kama.
27Ba le jam pai Jerusalem parika a nyo Wen nisa po la, ba jam wi Livaima kama a nyini juijui ate ba boro la a ta jam Jerusalem po ayen ba dɛ masim ale yiila ale jiam teka ale sinyaara ale kpanta ale bagansa. 28Ba jam ta yilendisaŋa a nyini ka tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa ale gilim Jerusalem la. Tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa ate ba jam nyini la ale Netofat 29ale Bet Gilgal ale Geba ale Azmavet diila yilendisaŋa a jam sɛ ka tɛŋ kpaŋsa a te badek a gilim Jerusalem. 30Ase kaabteerɔma ale Livaima ale jam gomsi badek nna cheri ase ba ale magsi ba nye diila, ba jam maa nye ate nuruma a nye ka cheri ale nansuiŋtaŋa ale parika.
31Mi jam basi ate Juda niŋdeerɔma a jueli ka parika zuk. Mi jam lueri ka yilendɔ boari buye ayen ba te jiam. Yilendisaŋa bunyi ale jam bo parika zuk juga geŋsa a tuk Tamponni Nansuiŋku 32Yosaya ale Juda niŋdeerɔma geli ale jam va ba a gum chaab ale 33Azariya ale Ezra ale Mesullam ale 34Juda ale Benjamin ale Sɛmaiya ale Jeremaya ale 35kaabteerɔma gela a ta damunsa ale Jonatan nidoabinni Zakaria mɛ. Jonatan jam ka Sɛmaiya nidoabili. Sɛmaiya waai kowa a jam le Mattania ate wa mɛ ko a nye Mikaiya ate wa mɛ ko a nye Zakkur ate wa mɛ ko a nye Asaf 36ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma Sɛmaiya ale Azarel ale Milalai ale Gilalai ale Maai ale Netanel ale Juda ale Yanani ale ŋannaginta tii ate Wen nuruwa Deevid a jam magsi sak ba la. Ŋmarisidoawa Ezra ale jam de ba niŋ. 37Bulik Nansuiŋku ba jam tom du kama a va Deevid Tɛŋka tiilaŋa a jueli parika jigini a gaam Deevid yenni taam cheŋ Nyiamu Nansuiŋku kori geŋsa.
38Yilendisa buyewa po a jam tuk kauk yoŋ. Mi jam va ba kama a jueli parika zuk a gum chaab ale nuruma geli, a ga gaam Boroborok Sɛka Yewɔŋku la a taam paari Parik Labsuku 39a va Ɛfraim Nansuiŋku ŋmazuk ale Jesana Nansuiŋku ale Juma Nansuiŋku ale Yananel Yewɔŋku ale Kook Yewɔŋku a ta ga paari Piisa Nansuiŋku. Limisidɔma Nansuiŋku ate ba yaa ga zaani.
40Yilendisa buyewa ale jam lenni a te jiamu la yaa zaani ba jiŋŋa Wen yenni po, dila a te mi mɛ a jam nye a gum chaab ale kpaŋŋa geli ale 41kaabteerɔma de Eliakim ale Maaseiya ale Miniamin ale Mikaiya ale Elioenai ale Zakaria ale Yanania ale ba damunsa, a maa gum ba po jam ka 42Maaseiya ale Sɛmaiya ale Eleaza ale Uzzi ale Jeyoyanan ale Malkija ale Iilam ale Ezer.
