2Alege mi tali ka nna maga ate m sati a lo. M daam tali ka nna maga ate m cheŋ tuiri. 3Dii nyiŋla m dɛka nyuri ale kanjanta nyama ase m le nya ayen gaasa nyama a jigsi la.
4Ba ka ninammoa. Ba nyiŋsaŋa a ta nyiŋyɔgsa ale pagra. 5Ba yeeri badek a nyini jib tii ale baga a jam nuru jigi la kama. Nuru biik nyiŋtuila kan yik ba. 6Dila nyiŋ kanjanta a yaa chim ba ŋie sotta. Ba pai ka wɔkwɔk ate ku chim garuk ate ba jo. 7Biem ale a nyini ba suiniim baataŋa po. Ba popola baataŋa a zɛ biem basika. 8Ba nye nuruba a la, ale a biisi wabulɔrisa, ba zaani ba kanjantaŋa zuk a nyigsi nuruba. 9Ba a biisi nna se ka ba ale soa wenŋmazukku la, ate ba giŋgeluŋtaŋa mɛ a tɔk nna se tɛŋka ka ba ale soa ka la. 10Dila nyiŋ ba nuruma a cheem a va ba ale a nya nyiam a nyu ate bu a paari ba. 11Ba a weeni kama ayen, <<Wen ale nye ka sɛ a seba? Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La a seba ku po?>>
12Gaasa nyama ale ka diila ale nna. Ba niŋ a ka wari po. Ba abe kasim a jigsi kama a gum du.
13M nye m suinummu cheri ka kinla. Ku abe ka kinla mɛ ate m nari m nisa alege a poom zɛ wari nɔi po. 14Nyiŋtuila ale kasim a ta mu danni meena po. Ma a tu ka ninam saluik meena.
15Ase mi dan weeni ka wa ŋala chaab, mi ti pai fi bisaŋa a da kama. 16Mi ale nye nyiŋbiiri ayen m miŋ ŋade meena kiri la, ku a chim ka ninam a te mu, 17ka mi yaa le jo Wen yenni po la. Ate mi yaa miŋ dii ale di nye ba ku nueri ka po la.
18Chekki, fi pai ba kama a zaani sisatik jigi, a yaa basi ate ba lo a kaasi. 19Ba deri tu ka kaasuŋ nna nwuli, yɔgsum ale yik ba meena a ta cheŋ. 20Ase waai ale nya gɔdaasima wa goom po diila, Nyɔnɔ, ase fi a dan yiti ŋmai, fi ale zɛri ba kama ate ku a nye ba jigi nna se ka gɔdaasima la.
21Mi suinni ale jam a daani mu la, ate ku tua mɛ m chiika po, 22m jam kan poli ale poom zɛ wari ya. M jam a nye ase ka duŋ fi niŋ la.
23Alege m kasim a bo ale fu kama. Fi pai ka fi juga nisaŋa a yik mu a tara. 24Fi pai ka fi yam wieŋa a gani mu, ate dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ fi le pai mu a ta jo fi zulaŋa po. 25Ka wana ate m ta ate wa bo wenŋmazukku, alege ate ku an chim daa fi? Ate tɛŋzuk de m kan yaali waai ya a ŋman gaam fi. 26M nyiŋ lammu ale m suinummu ale nye kpeeri, alege ka Wen ale chim m suinum pagrɔ ale ŋman chim waai ate m soa diipo meena wuu. 27Baai ale yalima ale fu la ale bɛ meena. Fi a kaasi baai meena ale kan ta wensie ale fu la kama. 28Alege dan ka mi, ku nala kama ate m forisi a moata Wen. Mi pai ka Nyɔnɔwa waai ale ka Naawen ate wa chim m likka jigi. M le weeni fi tuimaŋa meena a sak nuruba.

Title: YIILA 74
Content:
1Wen yaa, ka boan nyiŋ ate fi a zɛri ti a basi taam wuu? Ka boan nyiŋ ate fi sui a kab ale pa ŋaai ale a dɛ fi wuuku la? 2Teeri nuru baai ate fi da dipodipo la, teeri buui dii ate fi da tuesi a soa ba la, bala ale Zayon Guuku demma, juijui ate fi jam a boro la. 3Viriŋ fi naŋsa a nya yeeŋa ale chim guuta a doa taam wuu la. Kaasuŋ kude meena ate dachiaka ta jam fi yenni po la.
4Fi dachaasaŋa a yaa bo ka fi yenni po juijui ate fi a jam tu ti la a kaari tugurik nakdeka kaarika la. Dula jigini ale ba za a chamsi badek a nya. 5Ba nye badek ase ka nidoa baai ale saasi laasa ayen ba ga che tiisa a lɔnsi diila. 6Ba pai ka laasa ale pengaasa a che yenni daataŋa a kabri. 7Ba ju fi yenni a lɔnsi tɛŋ. Ba taŋ juijui ate fi boro ate ta wi fi Yuenni la. 8Ba weeni ba suiniima po kama ayen, ti le kaasi ba kama a basi. Ba ju juijui meena ate nuruba jo a zuli Wen tɛŋka zuk la a basi kama. 9Ti an ŋman nya wakinkagla tuima, biisiteerɔba an tali ya, ate ti waai be zɛ nya kude ale za ku beni a soa diila.
10Wen yaa, dachiaka ale nye fu la ate ku a ga paari ka dimpo? Dachiaka ale biisi fu yuenni a kaasi kama taam wuu? 11Ka boan nyiŋ ate fi pai fi juga nisaŋa a geri ŋaaŋ a za nya? Teeri si a chub ba a lɔnsi ate ba kaasi.
12Alege Fi Wen yaa, a nyini dipodipo ka fi ale m naab. Fi ta varibasika a jam tɛŋka zuk. 13Ka fi ale jam pai fi pagrimu a lab nyakpiemu. Fi mobi ja chichimini zuimaŋa nyiamu po. 14Ka fi ale jam ŋɔriŋ duŋ kperikaliika zuimaŋa nyakpiemu po ale pai ka ate ka chim ŋandiinta a te gɔi duŋ sii ale bo sagni po la. 15Ka fi ale jam te suik ate bulisa ale bela a buli nyaata. Fi nye ate beli ŋaai ale a chali nyaata la a kpieri. 16Kantueŋka ale yokku mɛ, ka fi ale soa. Fi ale nye wenbinni ale chiika. 17Ka fi ale dueni tɛŋka ale doa la banaŋa meena. Ka fi ale nye wenkarik ale yoei wen.
18Naawen yaa, teeri dachiaka ale a la fu diila, ate betta nyam biisi a kaasi fi yuenni diila. 19Kan pai fi nangbaŋka a te gɔi duŋsa ate si ŋɔbi. Kan baŋ fi nuru baai ale a nam la nyuvooŋa wari taam wuu. 20Poli fi nɔiyeŋka ate fi dueni la zuk, dii nyiŋla wɔkwɔk tuima ale sueri tɛŋka juijui ate legi a boro la. 21Kan te baai ate ba ta a namsi la a dɛ chivie. Basi ate ŋanjaksa ale baai ale a silim la a pak fi yuenni.
22Wen yaa, yiti zaani a zɛri fidek nyiŋ. Teeri bettaŋa ale a la fu dii danni meena po la. 23Kan cheem kpai a te fi dachaasaŋa ale a weeni diila ale ba tugurik kaarika ale kasim a jueli la.

Title: YIILA 75
Content:
1Wen yaa, ta te fi jiam. Ta te fi jiam dii nyiŋla fi Yuenni a moata kama. Nuruba a weeni fi wakinkaglaŋa wie.
2Fi weeni kama ayen, <<Ka mi ale a lueri daaŋa. Ka mi ale a bo wensie buusa. 3Ase tɛŋka ale ka nuruma a dan kpiŋsi, ka mi ale a yik ka zaŋŋa a tara nna giŋgiŋ. 4Mi le weeni kanjanta nyɔnɔwa ayen wa kan ŋman kuulim ale a weeni gaasa nyɔnɔwa ayen wa kan zak wa nyiilaŋa a zaani. 5Kan zak fi nyiilaŋa a tuk wenŋmazuwa. Kan biisi a yeeri ŋiri ya.
6Waai karo a nyini konni po yaase yeniŋka po yaase sagni po a baga a zak nuru a zaani. 7Alege ka Wen ale a bɔ buusa. Wala ale a basi ate waai a siŋ tɛŋ, wala abe le ŋman zak waai a zaani. 8Naawen a ta ka beerik wa nisima po a sueri ale dapuuk ate bu dam chaab ale ŋanti baai nyum ale masa la. Wa kpiiri bu a basi kama, ate gaasa nyama meena ale bo tɛŋka zuk la a yaa tuk bu a nyu ale bu zunzunaŋa meena.
9Alege dan ka mi, m le kasim a weeni ka wanni de taam wuu. M le lenni pimpauk yiila a seni Jekob Wenni. 10M le che gaasa nyama nyiilaŋa meena a basi, alege m le zak wayɔrisima nyama nyiilaŋa a zaani ŋmai.

Title: YIILA 76
Content:
1Juda tɛŋka a seba Wen kama. Wa yuenni a zuak ya a bo Izirali tɛŋka po. 2Wa viuku a bo ka Salem tɛŋka po, ate wa boka jigini a chim Zayon. 3Wa boka jigini wa yik peinyaama a pɔriŋ, wa yik ba ŋanchɔgsintaŋa ale ba gebisaŋa ale kpaliŋsa kɔlimaŋa a kaasi basi.
4Fi ka waai ale a nyaksi ase bolim la, fi ta nalim ate bu gaam gu tii ale zuak la. 5Ba kɔlim suinum pagrik nyama ŋantaŋa, ate ba dua a goa ba kpeglimka goom. Tugurik tɔŋdɔma wanyi mɛ an baga wa nisa a zak ŋmai ya. 6Jekob Wen yaa, fi toariŋka a basi kama ate wusuma ale ŋa torokoba a duak tɛŋ nna chim. 7Ka fi nyiini ale magsi ayen ba a chali fu yɔgsum. Ka wana ale baga a zaani fi niŋa ase fi sui a nin puuri? 8Fi bo ka buusa a nyini wenŋmazuk, ate yɔgsum a yik tɛŋka demma ate ba nye nna diki 9diipo ate fi Wen a yiti zaani ayen fi bo buusa a vari baai meena ale a nam tɛŋka zuk a basi la. 10Chekki, fi suipuurumu a ta ka pimpauk a jam a te fu, ate ku kasi baai ale vuuk nyini fi suipuurumu po la.
11Ni puulim ale Naawen ni Wenni abe ni nye ni ale weeni diila. Basi ate tɛŋ sii ale kala a moata ni la a ta tiirita a jam te Waai ale magsi ayen ba a chali wa yɔgsum la. 12Wala ale a nye ate baai ale a nya tɛŋsa zuk la a ta badek siŋ tɛŋ. Tɛŋka nalima a ta yɔgsum chala ale wa kama.

Title: YIILA 77
Content:
1M kaari a wi Wen a yaali maarika, m kaari a wi Wen a ayen wa wom mu. 2M le bo ninam po la, m gisi Nyɔnɔwa yokku po, m zak nisa a tuk wen a puusi Naawen a kan jiagi, ate m chiika mɛ a zɛri masim dɛka. 3M teeri fi wie Wen yaa, ate ku daani mu m ŋuuni ate m chiika a cha.
4Fi an basi ate m mum nummoa, m ninammu a zuak ka yega ate mi an baga a lak nɔi a biisi. 5M poli dipo wie, m poli ben ŋaai ale taam la wie. 6M teeri m yi ŋaai ate m jam a lenni yokku la wie, ate ku daani mu ate m ŋuuni m suinummu po ate m chiika a yaa bek beka ayen, 7<<Nyɔnɔwa ale zɛri mu ka dila taam wuu? Wa kan ŋman ta jiirimmoa? 8Wa ŋmanteka a deri kpeglim kama dila taam wuu? Wa pumpuulimaŋa a deri nueri kama dila taam wuu? 9Wen a deri baŋ jiirim taka kama? Naawen suinni ale a puuri la nyiŋ, wa an ŋma a nya nuruba niniga?>>
10Ate mi yaa weeni ayen, <<Dii ale basi ate mi sui a kaasi la ale nna. Bena ŋaai ale taam la, Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La a jam bo ale ti kama.>> 11M le teeri Naawen tuimaŋa ate wa tom la. Mm, mi le teeri fi wakinkaglaŋa ate fi jam a tom dipo la. 12M le kasim a poli fi tuimaŋa wie, m kan maa baŋ fi pagrimu tuimaŋa ate fi jam a tom la. 13Wen yaa fi suitaŋa, a welema kama. Ka wen boa ale ŋman boro a zuak gaam Wen yaa? 14Fi ale Wen dii ale a tom wakinkagla la, fi a sak fi pagrimu nuruba tɔgatɔga niŋ. 15Fi pai fi pagrimu a da tuesi fi nuruma a basi, fi da tuesi Jekob ale Josefi ŋaaŋbisaŋa a basi.
16Wen yaa, nyaataŋa a nya fu. Ti nya fu ate yɔgsum a yik ti. Nya liuŋtaŋa a choa ale yɔgsum. 17Chiŋmaaŋa a ni ŋa nyiamu ate wenni a na nanpansa, fi peemaŋa ate fi a tɔŋ la a cheŋ ka niŋ ale ŋaaŋ. 18Nuruba wom fi naka vamuniŋka po, fi basi ate wenni a nyaksi tɛŋka meena. Tɛŋka a choa. 19Fi cheŋ nyakpiemu po, fi dueni suik nyakpientaŋa po, fi cheŋ va bu po a taam kama alege waai an nya fi naŋtaataŋa. 20Fi dɛ fi nuruma niŋ ase ba ka piisa la, fi basi ate Moosis ale Aaron a kasi ba.

Title: YIILA 78
Content:
1M nuruba, ni wom m sinsaŋŋa ni chelsi wom m nɔi po wieŋa. 2M le lak m nɔnni a weeni wamagsima a sak ni. M le weeni ni wasusugi ŋaai ale boro a nyini ŋiaka la. 3Wie ŋaai ate ti wom ale seba, wie ŋaai ate ti koma a weeni sak ti la, 4ti kan pai ŋa a suk ti bisa. Ti ni weeni ŋa a sak gaŋ sii ale pai a saŋ la. Ti le biisi Naawen pimpauk tuimaŋa, wa pagrim tuimaŋa, ale wa wakinkagla tuimaŋa ate wa tom la. 5Wa te Jekob ka kaamka, ale te Izirali demma sinsaŋŋa, a weeni ti kokpieŋsaŋa ayen ba pai ŋa a sak ba bisaŋa, 6ate gaŋ sii ale pai a saŋ la a seba ŋa, biik sii ate ba poom za ba biak la, ba sak ba ate ba mɛ yiti weeni ŋa wie a sak ba bisa. 7Ate ba yaa ta sebchakka ale Wen ate ba kan baŋ wa tuim kperisaŋa, alege ba le kasim a siak a va Wen sinsaŋŋa. 8Ba kan chim ba koma ale jam ka diila ba jam kan nik Wen yaa, ba jam ka tukpari gaŋsa, gaŋ sii suiniima ale jam yalima ale Wen, ba chiisaŋa a jam ka wensie ale Wen ya.
9Ɛfraim nidoama ale ba timaŋa meena, kpaliŋka danni ba le chali ale basi kpaliŋka nyeka. 10Ba zɛri nɔiyeŋka ate ba nye ale Wen la kama. Ba zɛri wa sinsaŋŋa mɛ kama. 11Ba baŋ Naawen ale nye dii a te ba la kama, ba baŋ wa wakperikaliisaŋa ate wa yeeri a sak ba la kama. 12Wa tom wakinkagla ba koma nina po, wa tom wakinkagla Zoan ale bo Ejipiti tɛŋka po la kama ate ba nya. 13Wa yik nyakpiemu a lab buye a dɛ niŋ ta wa nuruma a va du taam jueli, wa nye ate nyiamu a zaani ase parik ate ba sɛ zaani diila. 14Wa basi ate chiŋmari a dɛ ba niŋ danni po ale basi ate bolim ŋiak a dɛ ba niŋ yokku meena. 15Wa kabri pinaŋa sagni po, a te ba nyiam nna yegayega ase bu nyini nyakpiemu po la. 16Wa pai pina muulisa a chim beli naŋsa ate nyiam va si po a nyini, ase bela nyiam ale a chali a taam diila.
17Alege dila meena, wa nuruma a diem tom a kaasi wa kama, ba zɛri Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La nɔi sagni po. 18Ba potim seba ale nye Wen nya ale ba le bek wa ŋandiin tii ate badek kɔrisa a bo ale ti la. 19Ba biisi kaasi Wen a weeni ayen, <<Wen dek baga a yaali ŋandiinta a te tama sagni nna po ya? 20Wa ale nak piuŋku la, nyiam ale burinti nyini, ate bela a sueri mobi pimpanta. Alege wa a baga a te ŋandiinta moa? Wa baga yaali lanta a te wa nuruma moa?>> 21Naawen ale wom ba la, wa sui yaa puuri, wa yaa basi ate wa bolimu a lo Jekob zuk, wa pai suipuurum a bo Izirali demma buusa. 22Dii nyiŋla ba ka siaka ale Wen ya, ba ka sebchakka ayen wa ale vari ba a basi. 23Alege wa weeni chiŋmaaŋa, ate wenŋmazukku a lak ku tuataŋa, 24a ni ŋandiinta ate nuruma ayen ba dɛ, wa te ba wenŋmazuk ŋandiinta ayen ba dɛ. 25Nuruba a dɛ Wen maarɔba ŋandiinta, wa tom ŋandiinta ate ti paari ba taŋa. 26Wa weeni koni vioku ate ku a fuk ale pai wa pagrimu a dɛ yeseoku vioku niŋ. 27Wa te lanta a siŋ kaasi tɛŋ ase tanta la a te ba, wa basi ate yeŋsa a lo pati tiak ase beli po tintain busuŋ la ate ba pisi a dik. 28Wa nye ate si yiri a lo ba suŋsuŋ a gilim viitaŋa meena. 29Ba dɛ ŋandiinta a paari ba paara an ŋmaa yaali dii nyiŋla wa te ba, ba kɔrisaŋa ale bo ale ŋan baai la kama. 30Alege jigi ate ba dɛ ŋandiin tii ate ba kɔrisa a bo ale ti la, ti le diem bo ba noaŋa po la, 31Wen suinni a yaa kabi ale ba ate wa ko ba pagrɔma meena ale bo ba po la. Wa ko ba bi paalukku ale bo Izirali demma po la.
32Wa le waali ba nnala meena la, ba diem a nye ba biemu kama wa le daa tom wakinkagla ate ba nya la, ba diem ka siaka ale wa. 33Wa yaa basi ate ba daaŋa chim kinla a te ba, ale basi ate ba benaŋa po ba yɔgsa. 34Wen dan pilim boro a ko ba, ba nyiem yaa ŋman viriŋ a gisi wa nna a wuli. 35Dila ate ba teeri ayen Wen ka ba Piuŋ, ayen Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La ka ba Da Tuesirɔ. 36Alege ka ba noaŋa pai ate ba nye, ba ka velimvendisa. 37Ba an lak ba suiniimaŋa a te Wen ya ba ka nimmuna ale nɔiyeŋka ate wa nye ale ba la. 38Alege wa diem ta jiirim ale ba, wa vɔŋ ba biemu a te ba wa an kaasi ba. Diipo meena wa kasim duŋ wa suinni wa an sak wa suipuurumu.
39Wa teeri ayen ba ka nyiŋ lam ba ka viok kuui ale a taam a kan pilim a ŋmani la. 40Diipo meena ba kasim a zɛri wa nɔi ka dila sagni po ale nye ate wa suinni a dom gɔnni po. 41Ba kasim ta Wen nye a nya kama ale nye ate Izirali Waai Ale Welema La sui a puuri. 42Ba kan teeri wa pagrimu wie ba kan teeri dai dii danni ate wa tuesi ba ba namsidɔma nisima po a basi la. 43Dai dii dai ate Wen a sak wa wakperikaliisaŋa ale wa wakinkaglaŋa Zoan ale bo Ejipiti tɛŋka po la. 44Wa tulim ba belaŋa ate ŋa chim ziim, ate ba an baga a nyu nyiam beli naŋsaŋa po. 45Wa tom kabsa ate si jam namsi ba, ale baŋuuna ate ŋa jam kaasi ba tɛŋka. 46Wa basi ate nanchoŋta a jam dɛ ba kpanni ŋantaŋa ate tintue a kaasi ba laŋsaŋa. 47Wa kaasi ba yɔnaŋa ale ŋmoruk tana, ale ba kinkaŋsaŋa ale ŋmoruk viok. 48Wa ko ba niiŋa ale ŋmoruk tana, ate ŋmoruk a na ba piisaŋa. 49Wa sak wa suipuurumu nna yegayega ale ba, ale basi ate wa suipuurumu a siŋ ba zuk, ate Wen maarɔ boari a jam ba zuk ale kaasuŋ. 50Wa an yik wa suipuurumu, wa abe m vɔŋ ba nyuvooŋa, alege kaasi ba. 51Wa ko bi kpaŋŋa meena Ejipiti tɛŋka po, nidoama ale liŋ biak baai la Yɛm viitaŋa po. 52Alege a ta wa nuruma a nyini ase piisa la, wa ta ba kama ase piisa la a va sagni po a nyini. 53Wa jam gani ba kama, dila nyiŋ ba jam kan chali yɔgsummoa, alege nyakpiemu a lim ba dachaasaŋa. 54Dila nyiŋ Wen yaa ta ba jam wa tɛŋ weleŋka po, wa ta ba jo tɛŋ kaai ate guutaŋa a bo ka po la ale wadek pagrim. 55Wa yiak tɛŋsa ba niŋ, alege chari ba ba tɛŋsaŋa ate ba tuesi. Wa basi ate Izirali dɔkdemma a kali ba viitaŋa po.
56Alege ba nye Wen a nya a kan wom wa nɔi ya a ta chaab ale Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La, ba an ta wa sinsaŋŋa. 57Ase ba koma la, ba jam ka zula ba be ka siaka, ba cheem ŋaaŋ a te ase tom buui ale kan gori magsi la. 58Ba basi ate wa sui a puuri ale ba bɔgtaŋa, ba basi ate wa a dɛ nyuri ale ba bɔgtaŋa. 59Wen ale wom ba wari la, wa sui kasim a puuri nna yegayega, ate wa zɛri Izirali. 60Ate wa basi Siilo viuku, viuk kuui ate wa ti nuruba suŋsuŋ la. 61Wa basi ate ba tuesi nɔiyeŋka dakanni a ta cheŋ. Wa zulaŋa a ga jo dachiak nisa po. 62Wa pai wa nuruma a te gebika, wa sui ale ŋmasi a puuri ale wa nuruma. 63Bolim a dɛ ba nuru paalukku, ate ba kalaasaŋa a ka yalika yiila. 64Dachaasaŋa a ko ba kaabteerɔma ale ka gebisa, ate ba pukɔŋŋa an baga a kum.
65Ate Nyɔnɔwa a nak ti yiti goom po ase nuru ale yiti dabugla po diila. 66Wa nak ate wa dachaasaŋa a ŋmani. Wa pai ba nyo ka chivie po taam wuu. 67Ate wa zɛri Josefi viitaŋa, wa an lueri Ɛfraim buuni. 68Alege wa lueri Juda buuni, Zayon guuku, ate wa a yaali la. 69Wa sɛ wa yenni kama ase wenŋmazuk la. Wa sɛ di kama giŋgiŋ tɛŋzuk de. 70Wa lueri wa yɔmawa Deevid kama, a yeeri wa piisa boka jigi. 71Deevid ale jam boro a nya piisaŋa la, ate wa lueri wa ayen wa dɛ Jekob nuruma, wadek nuruma Izirali demma niŋ. 72Ate Deevid a kasi ba ase piisa la, ale wensie wa suinum po. Wa jam dɛ ba niŋ ale ka yam.

Title: YIILA 79
Content:
1Wen yaa, nuruma a vari fi tɛŋka ba taŋ fi tuilum yenni ba nye ate Jerusalem a yaa chim ka guuk. 2Ba pai fi yɔmma nyiŋsaŋa a chim ka nuinsa ŋandiinta. Baai ale siak a te fu la, nyiŋ lantaŋa a yaa chim ka gɔi duŋsa ŋandiinta. 3Ba burinti ziim a waaŋ a gilim Jerusalem ase ka nyiam la. Nuru a be an taliya ayen wa gu kpilimaŋa. 4Ti kali mɔtidɔma a yaa ta ti a lɛ kama ti ka ŋanlaama baai ale gilim ti la jigi.
5Naawen yaa, ku a yaa ku beni soa ka sɛ? Fi suinni a yaa daa puuri ale ti, ka dila taam wuu? Fi nyunni dɛka a yaa di kab ase bolim la paari ka dimpo? 6Pai fi suipuurumu a kaasi tɛŋ sii nuruba ale kan seba fu la, tɛŋ sii ale ka puusi a te fu la. 7Dii nyiŋla, ba ko Jekob, ale kaasi wa tɛŋka meena. 8Kan pai ti koma biemu nyiŋŋa a waali ti, te fi jiirimu a cheŋ paari ti a wuli, ale ti ŋman ka yiila.
9Wen, ti Varibasidɔ, maari ti, fi yuenni zula nyiŋ, vari ti a basi abe fi vɔŋ ti wabaata a te ti fi yuenni zula nyiŋ. 10Ka boa ale soa ate tɛŋsaŋa nuruma a weeni ayen, <<Ba Wenni a bo ka bɛ?>> Te ti nina nya fi le a waali ba, ba le ko fi nuruma la nyiŋ. 11Goori a wom fi nuru baai ate ba yik lik la ale a ŋuuni diila, fi pagrimu nyiŋ vari baai ale ba kpi la a basi.
12Tuni ti kali mɔtidɔma ku naŋtuok nɔi buyopɔi dii nyiŋla ba lɛ fi Nyɔnɔwa ka yegayega. 13Ate tama fi nuruma, tama fi piisaŋa ŋaai ale a dɛ fi wuuku la, yaa pak fu taam wuu. A nyini gaŋsa meena po ti le pak fu.

Title: YIILA 80
Content:
1Izirali Naapeerika, wom ti, fi ka waai ale a kasi Josefi nuruma ase piisa la fi waai ale kali fi zukpaglik zuk ŋanvutaŋa suŋsuŋ a sak fi nyaksika zulaŋa. 2Ɛfraim ale Benjamin ale Manasa niŋ, yiti ale fi pagrimu a jam vari ti a basi.
3Wen pilim tuesi ti. Ta nin baasima ale ti. Ka dila nyiini ale a basi ate ti a nya varibasika.
4Naawen, Wen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, fi suinni a yaa di puuri ale ti a paari ka dimpo. Fi a yaali ayen fi zɛri ti puusaŋa a paari ka dimpo? 5Ninyiam ale chim ba ŋandiinta ate fi pai te ba ate ba dɛ, ninyiam ale chim ba nyiam ate ba nyu. 6Ti yaa ka ŋan nye laanta ti kali mɔtidɔma jigi. Ti dachaasaŋa a nye ti a la kama.
7Wen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, pilim tuesi ti, ta nin baasima ale ti. Ka dila nyiini ale a basi ate ti a nya varibasika.
8Fi ta ti nyini Ejipiti po, a yiak nuruba ba tɛŋsa po a basi ale pai tama a kali si po. 9Fi gomsi ka a te ti, ate ti yaa feri naŋsa ka po, yaa taari lik ka. 10Ti chim yɔgsum a lik ka guutaŋa ti chim ka nyunyoŋta teeri naŋsa. 11Ti teeri ti naŋsaŋa a cheŋ paari ka Nyakpiemu yeniŋ geŋ. Ti tɛŋ naŋsa mɛ a paari Benni kori geŋ.
12Ka boa abe le ŋman soa ate fi nak ti parika a lɔnsi ayen nuru baai ale a taam la a zu ti yɔnaŋa? 13Gɔi die a ŋɔbi ŋa, gɔi duŋsa a dɛ ŋa. 14Wen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, pilim jam ti jigi kali wenŋmazuk a chuiri nya ti ninammu, kpesi a nya fi tiimu zuk, 15naŋ kaai ate fi pai fi juga nisaŋa a vuk ate ka pusi ate fi wuuk a te fidek la.
16Ba che ka a lɔnsi kama a ju ase vaala la. Fi dan toariŋ ba, ba le kpi. 17Te nuru waai ate fi a yaali la pagrim te bi kaai ate fi a wuuk la pagrim. 18Ate ti kan ŋman nyini fi ŋaaŋ a nyini, te ti vum ate ti ŋman wi fi yuenni.
19Naawen yaa, Wen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, pilim tuesi ti, ta nin baasima ale ti ka dila nyiini ale a basi ate ti a nya varibasika.

Title: YIILA 81
Content:
1Leni yiila ale popeentik a te Wen ti pagrɔwa. Na yiila a seni Jekob Wenni. 2Piilim yiilaŋa. Nak sinyaksaŋa, nak kpantaŋa, nak baganiŋ a lenni yimasisa a te Naawen.
3Peeri damuniŋka diipo ate chiik buli a boro la, peeri damuniŋka chiika a nin bo wenzuk suŋsuŋ dai ŋaai po ate ti a dɛ ti tigini la. 4Ka sinsaŋŋa ale la ate Wen a pai te Izirali demma, Jekob Wenni nɔi ale la. 5Wa dueni ŋa a te ka Josefi ŋaaŋbisaŋa diipo ate ba basi Ejipiti la, mi wom ka biik m zɛ ka kiri ya.
6Wa weeni ayen, <<M tuili ba jimmu ba maŋkpalaŋa zuk a dueni tɛŋ. M yik ni nisimaŋa jibtaŋa a tuili dueni kama. 7Ni ninammu po, ni wi mu ate m vari ni a basi, m nak nyini chiŋmaaŋa po a jam tulisi ni m nye ni nya Meriba nyaataŋa nɔi.
8<<M nuruba, ni wom, ate m kaam ni, m ti le yaali ayen ni wom mu Izirali demma. 9Ni kan ta bɔgluk chaŋsa ni yeeŋa po. Ni kan pai zula a te wen yona. 10Ka Mi ale Naawen ni Wen dii ale ta ni nyini Ejipiti tɛŋka po a nyini la. Ni lak ni noaŋa ate m nyo ŋanta du a te ni.
11<<Alege mi nuruma a kan wom mu. Izirali demma kan siak a ta badek siŋ tɛŋ a te mu. 12Ate m yaa pai ba a basi ate ba va badek suiniimaŋa ale a yaali diila, ba tukpanni nyiŋ.
13<<Ase mi nuruma a dan poom a wom mu kama, ase Izirali a dan poom va ka mi suitaŋa. 14M le kpabi nwuli a nya pagrim, ni dachaasaŋa zuk. M le cheem a ta chaab ale ni dachaasaŋa. 15Baai ale kisi Naawen la le koori tɛŋ ale yɔgsum wa niŋ, ate ba ninammu le boro ka dila taam wuu. 16Alege m le te ni ŋandiin maŋsa ate ni dɛ, m le lu siita pina zuima a te ni ate ni dɛ.>>

Title: YIILA 82
Content:
1Wen ale a nya wa dek tigsuŋku zuk. Wa ale a bo wenaŋa buusa:
2<<Nama a yaa ni zaani a ka wensie nyama ŋaaŋ a paari ka dimpo? Nama a yaali ni maari nuru baataŋa a beni ka sɛ? 3Ni biisi maari niwomma ale kpiŋsaŋa; ni bo te ŋanjaksaŋa ale baai ate ba ta ba a namsi la. 4Ni vari niwomma ale silimdɔma a basi ni vari ba nuru baataŋa nisima po a basi.
5<<Ba zɛ wari ya, ba kan miŋ wari ya. Ba bo ka legini po a nyiem a cheŋ, tɛŋka meena nyubini a choa kama.
6<<M weeni ayen, <Ni ka <<wena>>, ni meena ka Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La bisa.> 7Alege ni le kpi a se ka saalɔ la, nama mɛ le nye kpeeri kama ase nalima ŋa chaab ale nye kpeeri diila.>>
8Vaari yiti Wen yaa, a bo tɛŋka demma buusa ale tɛŋsaŋa meena ka fi ale soa si.

Title: YIILA 83
Content:
1Wen yaa, kan sinla. Wen yaa, kan nye chim. Kan nye diki. 2Nya, fi dachaasaŋa a zɛri kama, fi kisidɔma a yeeri ba zuima a zaani. 3Ba a poli biem wasusuga a magsi chaab ale fi nuruma. Ba a poli nuru baai ate fi a yaa la koka wie. 4Ba weeni chaab ayen, <<Ni jam ate ti kaasi ba tɛŋka ale ka nuruma, ate Izirali yuei kan ŋma wi.>>
5Ba pai popoli yena a poli ba biemu ale chaab. Ba jo chaab a kpaliŋ ale fu. 6Baai ale jo chaama a kpaliŋ ale fu la ale Edom demma ale Ismael demma ale nyini Moab ale Yagri demma tɛŋsaŋa la ale 7Gebal demma ale Ammon demma ale Amalek demma ale Filistia demma, a jam pai Taaya nuruma nyoro. 8Assiria demma mɛ a yiti gum ba po ayen ba maari Lɔti ŋaaŋka a te ba pagrim.
9Nye ni ba ase fi le jam nye ale Midian demma diila, ase fi le jam nye ale Sisera ale Jabin, Kison benni nɔi diila. 10Fi ko ba Endor tɛŋa po, ka nna jajaja ase yaata ale sueri tɛŋ la. 11Nye ba niŋdeerɔma ase fi le jam nye Oreb ale Zeeb diila, nye ba nabisaŋa ase fi le jam nye Zeba ale Zalmunna diila. 12Baai ale jam weeni ayen, <<Ni basi ate ti tuesi Naawen tɛŋka a soa ka la.>>
13Wen yaa, kati ba waaŋ ase wuuta la ji ba ta cheŋ ase viok ale a ji vɔtta diila. 14Ase bolim ale a ŋɔbi sagi kpien diila, ase bolim ŋiak ale chɔgsi guuta diila, 15suik kula dek po, pai fi suipuurumu a vi ba, abe fi pai fi vamuniŋka a nye ate ba nyiŋsaŋa a gɔk. 16Te chivie a yik ba, ate dila a basi ate nuruba a gisi fi Naawen yuenni.
17Ba chivieŋa a kasim dik ba zuimaŋa po dila taam wuu, ba bi kpi chivie kum. 18Basi ate ba miŋ ayen fi a waai yuenni ale ka Naawen la, ale Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La a soa tɛŋka meena zuk an nya.

Title: YIILA 84
Content:
1Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, fi boka jigi a nala ka nna yegayega. 2M chiika a yeenti kama ayen ka paari Naawen yenni m suinummu ale m nyiŋ lammu a kaari a wi fi Wen vukku.
3Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, m Naab ale m Wen yaa, nuinsa a sɛ yie a boro takaribaleeŋsa a ta tukta a wuuk si bisa a moata fi kaabka kuŋkuŋku. 4Suipeentik a bo le baai ale pai fi yenni a chim ba boka jigi la, ba a pak fu ka diipo meena wuu.
5Fi ale a te baai pagrim la a ta suipeentik kama. Baai suiniima ale a yeenti ayen ba cheŋ paari fu la zuima masa la. 6Ase ba le va Ninyiam Viaka po a taam la, ba tu bulisa ka po. Kpiak ŋmorukku a sueri ka ale nyaata. 7Ba a chim ale nyiŋ pagra a ta jam paari diipo ate ba meena a yaa za Wen niŋ Zayon guuku zuk la.
8Naawen yaa, Wen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, wom m puusa. Wom mu, Jekob Wen yaa. 9Chuiri nya ti ligrɔwa, Wen yaa chuiri nya fi le bobi na waai la ale nin baasima.
10M dan pai dai yeŋ a zuli fu fi yenni po a zunchoŋŋa daa tusidi jigi yoŋ, m dan jɔk chim Wen yenni tuok ligrɔ a zunchoŋ m goa nuru baataŋa viitaŋa po. 11Naawen Dii Ale Ka Wen La ka wenbiri ale jachɔgsim. Naawen ale a te ŋmanteka ale zula. Wa kan pai wamaŋ a suk baai ale a cheŋ wa suiku po.
12Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, baai ale ta sebchakka ale fu la, a ta suipeentik kama.

Title: YIILA 85
Content:
1Naawen, fi sak fi tɛŋka jiirim. Fi pilim pai Jekob paaruŋku a te wa. 2Fi jam vɔŋ nuruma kaasuŋku a te ba, ale lik ba wabaataŋa a dueni. 3Fi pai buusaŋa boka a dueni ka nakpiak fi pai fi suinni ale a kab ale ti la a basi kama.
4Wen ti Varibasidɔ, pilim tigsi ti ta jam jigi yeŋ abe fi kan ta sui ale ti. 5Fi suinni a yaali di puuri ale ti ka taam wuu? Fi suinni a yaali di a puuri ale ka ti buuni meena ta cheŋ? 6Fi kan ŋman te ti pagrimoa? Fi kan ŋman basi ate fi nuruma a ŋman naŋi? 7Naawen yaa, sak ti fi ŋmanteka, abe fi te ti varibasika.
8M le goori wom Wen, Naawen ale weeni diila. Wa le nye suiyɔgni ale wa nuruma, wa nuruma abe kan ŋmani a cheŋ betta wie tomka po. 9Wensie wa varibasika a moata baai ale a chali yɔgsum ale wa tom kaasika la kama, ate wa pimpaukku ale sueri ti tɛŋa po.
10Ŋmanteka ale wensie ale tu chaab ate wayɔrisima ale suiyɔgni a puusi chaab. 11Wensie a nyini ka tɛŋzuk de ate wayɔrisima a kali wenŋmazuk a chuiri a nya. 12Naawen le sum te dii ale nala la, ate ti kaduksaŋa ŋandiintaŋa a bɛ. 13Wayɔrisima ale dɛ wa niŋ a cheŋ a gomsi wa suiku a te wa ate wa cheŋ.

Title: YIILA 86
Content:
1Naawen yaa, fi wom mu abe fi tulisi mu dii nyiŋla m wobsa kama ale jaŋ mɛ. 2Lik m nyuvunni a tanla, dii nyiŋla m pai m dek a te ka fi. Fi ale chim m Wen, be vari fi tomteerɔ waai ale ta sebchakka ale fu la a basi. 3M Nyɔnɔ, ta jiirim ale mu, ale m kasim a wi ka fi yuenni dai meena. 4Te mi fi tomteerɔwa masim dii nyiŋla m pai nyuvunni ate ka fi m Nyɔnɔ.
5Fi ka Nyɔnɔ maŋ ale vɔŋ a te nuruba. Fi ta ka ŋmanteka yega a te baai meena ale a wi fi la. 6Naawen yaa, wom m puusa. Wom m le a kaari ayen fi ta jiirim ale mu la. 7Dai dii danni ate ku a miri mu la, m le wi fu dii nyiŋla fi le tulisi mu.
8M Nyɔnɔ, wenaŋa po, wen di choa karo a nye ase fi la. Nyeka karo a magsi chaab ale fi nyeka. 9M Nyɔnɔ, tɛŋsaŋa meena ate fi nye la, ale jam a kali fi tɛŋ a zuli fu, si le pai zula a te fi yuenni, 10dii nyiŋla fi ka tanjaŋini ale a tom wakinkagla. Ka fi nyiini ale Naawen.
11Naawen yaa, sak mu fi suiku, ate m cheŋ fi wensieŋa po, te mu popoli yena, ate m pai zula a te fi yuenni. 12M Nyɔnɔ Naawen yaa, m le pak fu ale m suinum meena. Mi le zuli fi yuenni taam wuu, 13dii nyiŋla fi ta ŋmanteka yega ale mu, fi dari mu kum vɔrup po a yeeri.
14Wen yaa, nuru baataŋa a potim m nyiŋ. Nin pagra nyam a yaa ba ko mu, baai niŋ ale kan bo ale fu la a yaa ba ko mu. 15Alege M Nyɔnɔ, fi ka jiirim nyɔnɔ ale ŋman chim Wen dii ale ta yaalika. Fi sui an kan puuri a wuli. Fi ŋmanteka mɛ a ka bain ya fi wensieŋa mɛ piisi. 16Tulim jam m jigi a ta jiirim ale mu pai fi pagrimu a te fi tomteerɔwa, abe fi vari fi bi kaai ale ta siaka ale fu la a basi. 17Nye wari dek ate m dachaasaŋa a nya ŋa ate chivie a yik ba. Dii nyiŋla, ka fi, Naawen yaa, ale maari mu ale duŋ m sui a te mu.

Title: YIILA 87
Content:
1Wa nyubi wa tɛŋka nyubini ka guuk weleŋka zuk. 2Naawen a yaali Zayon nansuiŋtaŋa a gaamu Jekob bisaŋa ale bo juijui meena la kama. 3Wen tɛŋaa, ba biisi ka zula wie a te fu. 4<<M le weeni Arayab ale Babilon wie baai ale seba mu la suŋsuŋ, Nya Filistia ale Taaya ale Kus ale weeni ayen, <Ba biak wade ka Zayon tɛŋka.> >>
5M ba le weeni Zayon po ayen, <<Nyawa de ale nyawa de ba biak ba ka Zayon po. Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La dek abe le yik wa a kali.>> 6Naawen le ŋmarisi nuruma yue gbaŋka po ayen, <<Nyawa de ba biak wa ka Zayon po.>> 7Ase ba ale a lenni yiila la ba le gɔk, <<Ti niauŋku meena a bo ka Naawen jigi.>>

Title: YIILA 88
Content:
1Naawen yaa, fi ale Wen dii ale kasim a vari mu a basi la. Yok ale kantueŋ meena m kaari a wi fu. 2M puusaŋa abe paari fu ate fi lak turi a wom m kaarika, 3dii nyiŋla m chiika a sueri ale ka wamirima ate kum nyiini a yaa moata mu. 4Ba yaa chiim mu a gum ka kpilima po m yaa nye ase ka nuru waai ale wobsa la. 5Ba pai mu a chim ase ka baai ate ba ko dueni vie po la, fi kan ŋman a teeri ba wie, ba pai mu a chim ka baai ate ba niŋ ŋman ka fi nyaasimu po la.
6Fi ta mu siŋ gu ka vɔrup po, vɔrup buui ale limisa ale chim legi. 7Fi suipuurum a dobra m zuk, fi suipuurumu a gilim mu ase ka viok la.
8Fi basi ate m doama a zɛri mu, fi nye mu veesiveesiga a te ba, ate ba an ŋmaa moata mu. Ba yik mu a lik kama ate mi an ŋman baga nyini chali a bɛ. 9M ninaŋa yaa kum a jiak kama. Naawen yaa, daa meena mi a wi fu m zak nisa a sak fu. 10Fi a tom fi wakinkaglaŋa ka kpieba zuk moa? Baai le kpi la le baga yiti pak fu? 11Baai le kpi la a biisi fi ŋmanteka wie? Ba a biisi fi wensieŋa wieŋa kpiluŋŋoa? 12Ba seba fi wakinkaglaŋa wie juijui ale ka legi la po? Yaa ba seba fi wayɔrisimaŋa tɛŋ kaai nuruba le kpi nueri ate ba baŋ ka wie la po?
13Alege m kum a yaali maarika fi Naawen jigi. Saluik m puusaŋa a paari fu. 14Naawen yaa, ka boan dek chekki nyiŋ ate fi a zɛri mu ale cheem ŋaaŋ a te mu?
15A nyini m buli, mi kasim a nam kama a nye m kpi. M yaa jiak kama ale fi ale namsi mu la, m ŋman ka maarɔ. 16Fi suipuurumu buk mu ka nna kuligi fi wapagriŋa ate fi pai tu mu la a kaasi mu kama. 17Danni meena ŋa gilim mu ase ka nyiam ale mobi pimpanta diila, ŋa din bola miiri mu a zaani ka giŋŋ ate m ka viriŋka jigi ya. 18Fi basi ate baai ale a bani mu la ale baai ale a yaali mu la meena a zɛri mu, mi ale maliŋ baai la a bo ka legi po.

Title: YIILA 89
Content:
1M le pai Naawen ŋmanteka a leni yiili taam wuu m le pai m nɔnni a biisi fi wensieŋa wieŋa a sak gaŋsa meena wuu. 2M le weeni sak nuruba ayen fi ŋmanteka a za ka giŋŋ taam wuu, fi wensieŋa mɛ a bo wenŋmazukku dek po.
3Fi weeni ayen, <<Mi nye ka nɔiyeŋ ale waai ate mi lueri la, m pɛ te m tomteerɔwa Deevid, 4m weeni wa ayen, M le nye ate fi buuni po kan maari a kpeglim diipo diipo abe m nye ate fi naam zukpaglika a kasim boro a te gaŋsa meena wuu.> >>
5Naawen yaa, wenŋmazuk nuruma a pak fu fi wakinkaglaŋa nyiŋ, nuruma a pak fu fi wensieŋa nyiŋ, nuru weleŋsaŋa ale tigsi chaab la niŋ. 6Ka wana ale bo wenzukku ate ba le pai a magsi chaab ale Naawen yaa? Ka wana ale a nye ase Naawen la bo wa nidoabilisaŋa po. 7Baai meena ale chim Wen maarɔba tigsuŋ kpioŋku po la a chali Wen yɔgsum ka nna yegayega, ba a chali ka wa lala yɔgsum a gaam baai meena ale za gilim wa la. 8Naawen yaa, Wen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, ka wana ale ta pagrim ase fi la? Naawen yaa, fi wensieŋa a gilim fu.
9Nyakpiemu ale doa ale bu pagrimu la, ka fi ale a wi ate bu a siak fu. Bu nyiem dan yiri ayen bu fɔb bu nanpansaŋa, fi nyiem weeni bu kama ate bu duak baliyaa. 10Fi bugsi Arayab ase ka baai ate ba ko la fi pai fi ni sii ale pagra la a kati fi dachaasaŋa a waaŋ. 11Wenŋmazuk ka fi ale soa, tɛŋzuk de mɛ ka dila, jaab meena ale bo tɛŋka po la ka fi la soa, fi le nye ba meena. 12Fi le nye yeseoku ale wiilukku, Tabor guuku ale Yermon guuku a leni yiila ale popeentik a seni fi yuenni. 13Fi ka pagrim nyɔnɔ, fi nisaŋa pagra, fi juga nisa a nak a dɛ.
14Wayɔrisima ale nyemagsika ale chim fi naam zukpaglika nyubini, ŋmanteka ale wensie ale bo fi jigi. 15Suipeentik a bo le ka nuru baai ale seba fi pakka la. Naawen yaa, basi ate ba bo fi bolimu po. 16Ba a naŋ fi yuenni nyiŋ daa meena, ale a pak fu fi wayɔrisimaŋa po, 17dii nyiŋla, ka fi ale ba pimpauk ale ba pagrim fi jiirim nyiŋ ale soa ate ti ta pagrim. 18Wensie ti jachɔgsimu ka Naawen ale soa. Ka Izirali Waai Ale Welema La ale soa ti naawa.
19Gɔdaasima po fi jam biisi ale fi nuruma baai ale a puusi fu la. Fi weeni ayen, mi te tugurik tɔŋdɔwa ka pagrim, m zak ka nuru paalik a nyini m nuruma po. 20M gisi nya ka Deevid m tomteerɔwa a yaa pai m tuilum kpaam a kpiiri tagli wa a bobi wa ayen wa chim naab. 21M le bobi wa tanla ale wensie, m nisa ale te wa pagrim. 22Dachiak an kan baga a fɛ wa ate wa siak a te wa, nuru biok karo wa fɛ wa. 23M le num wa dachaasa ate wa nina nya abe m nak wa kisidɔma a lɔnsi. 24M wensie ale ŋmanteka ale bo ale wa, abe m pai m yuenni nyiŋ a zak wa pagrimu a zaani. 25M le pai nyiam kpioŋku a nyo wa nisima po, m le pai belaŋa a te wa. 26Wa le wi mu a weeni ayen, <Fi ka m Ko, m Wen, ale chim Piuŋku kuui ale chim m Varibasidɔ la.> 27M le basi ate wa a chim m bikpagi, naab kpioŋ tɛŋzuk meena. 28M le ta m ŋmanteka ale wa diipo meena wuu, nɔiyeŋ kaai ate ti dueni ale chaab la a ka maari a kaasi. 29Mi le basi ate wa ŋaaŋbisa tomini a boro taam wuu, wa naam zukpaglika ale boro ka dila ase wenŋmazuk ale boro diila.
30Wa bisaŋa a dan zɛri m sinsaŋŋa an va m buusaŋa, 31ba dan zɛri m ŋmarisika alege an ta m wieŋa, 32m le namsi ba ba biemu nyiŋ ale doari, ba kaasuŋku ale miiri ba. 33Alege m kan tuesi m ŋmanteka wa jigi, m bɛ kan pai wensieŋa a da diipo diipo. 34M kan kaasi m nɔiyeŋka yaase m basi m nɔnni ale weeni diila. 35M pɛ m weleŋsa nyiŋ, ayen m kan velim a te Deevid. 36Wa tomini ale kasim ka dila a cheŋ, wa naamu ale kasim boro mi niŋ ase ka wenbinni la. 37Bu le boro ka dila taam wuu ase chiika la, ase wensie seerɔ waai ale bo wenŋmazukku la.
38Alege fi zɛri naab waai ate fi lueri la. Fi sui ale a puuri nna yegayega ale waai ate fi a bobi la. 39Fi pai fi nɔiyeŋka ale wa a te kama, ale taŋ wa naam zutɔkka ale tanta. 40Fi wɛ wa parisaŋa meena a jo a kaasi, wa pari pagrisaŋa meena dueni. 41Baai meena ale a taam la vari wa, baai ale moata wa la a nye wa a la kama. 42Fi zak wa dachaasaŋa juka nisa, fi basi ate wa dachaasaŋa meena a naŋ. 43Fi yik wa gebika nɔnni a tulim fi an maari wa kpaliŋ po. 44Fi basi ate wa zulaŋa a kpeglim ale yuk wa naam zukpaglika a lɔnsi tɛŋ. 45Fi gebi wa bimbain daaŋa a basi, ale pai chivie garuk a lik wa.
46Naawen yaa, fi le suk fidek mi jigi a soa ka sɛ? 47Teeri m nyuvunni ale a kpabi diila. Fi nye nurubiik ate wa ka kiri ya. 48Ka nuru boa ale boro ayen wa kan nya kummoa, yaase wa vari wadek vɔrup pagrim po a basi?
49M Nyɔnɔ, fi nyiem ŋmanteka a bo ka be, kaai ate fi wensie po fi puulim ale Deevid la? 50M Nyɔnɔ, teeri fi tomteerɔma ate ba nye ba a la diila. Mi ale ji tɛŋsaŋa meena nye laka mi suinum po diila. 51Fi dachaasaŋa a nye mu a la la, Naawen yaa, ba nye waai ate fi lueri la a la kama juijui meena ate wa a cheŋ la.
52Pimpauk a cheŋ Naawen jigi taam wuu! Ku be nye dila. Ku be nye dila.

Title: YIILA 90
Content:
1M Nyɔnɔ, fi ale chim ti boka jigi gaŋsa po meena. 2Alege ate fi nye guutaŋa yaase fi nye tɛŋka ale tɛŋzuk meena la, fi ka Wen. Fi kasim boro kama fi be le kasim boro kama.
3Fi tulim nuruba kama ate ba ŋman cheŋ tantaŋa po, a weeni ayen, <<Pilim cheŋ tantaŋa po, saalɔ bisa.>> 4Bena tusidi a nye ase ka dai yeŋ ale taam la fi jigi, yaase yok geli la. 5Fi vaari nuruba a basi kama ase nyiam ale mobi la, ate ba lo goom po, ba a nye ase ka saluik wuuk paaluk la. 6Ku le yiti saluik a chim wuuk paaluk alege ta cheen junɔi ku jak a kpi.
7Fi suipuurumu a kaasi ti kama ate yɔgsum a yik ti fi suipuurumu nyiŋ. 8Fi basi kama ate ti wabaataŋa a bo fi niŋ, fi nya ti waba susuŋŋa kama. 9Ti daaŋa meena a taam kama fi suipuurumu nyiŋ, ti nueri ti benaŋa kama ale kumsa. 10Ti benaŋa meena tɛŋzuk de ka pisiyopɔi yaase pinaanuŋ, dila bi ka ti ni poom ta pagrim, alege ŋa woglimmu a kasim sueri ale ka daanika ale suipuuta, ŋa kan bola a ben ale paarika, ŋa taam ka na nwuli.
11Ka wana ale seba fi suipuurum pagrim ale soa diila? Fi suipuurum pagrimu a zuak ase ka ba le magsi ayen ba chali fu yɔgsum diila. 12Sak ti ate ti chiini ti daaŋa, ti dan chiini ŋa ti le ta yam. 13Naawen yaa, pilim tulim, ku a yaa ku beni soa ka sɛ? Ta jiirim ale fi tomteerɔma. 14Basi ate ti chak saluiku ale fi ŋmanteka, ate ti yaa lenni yiila ale suipeentik ti daaŋa meena po a te fu. 15Basi ate ti nya masim a magsi chaab ale da ŋaai ate fi namsi te la, Ale da ŋaai ate ti nya biem la. 16Pa fi nyeelaŋa a sak fi tomteerɔma. Pa fi nalimu a sak ba bisaŋa.
17M Nyɔnɔ ti Wen yaa bi sak fi jiirimu ale ti niak ti nisima tuima, niak ti nisima tuima a te ti.

Title: YIILA 91
Content:
1Waai ale a kali Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La yɔgsummu po la, ale kasim a vuusi a chak kama Wen Dii Ale A Niak La yisuŋku po. 2Mi le weeni ayen, Naawen ka likka jigi, ale ŋman chim yepagrik a te mu. Fi ka mi Wen dii ate m ta sebchakka ale fu.
3Wensie wa le vari fu a ta nyini batta po a basi, wa le vari fu kum po a basi. 4Wa le pob fu ale wa kinkaŋŋa a tanla, wa wensieŋa ale ŋa chim fi ja kasim ale parik a gilim fu. 5Fi kan chali yok nyigsika, fi be kan chali pein ŋaai ate ba a tɔŋ kantueŋka la, 6yaase nyiŋtuila a nak fu legi po, yaase yuam buui ale a jam fi jigi kantueŋ la. 7Tusidi ale lo fi gauŋ, tusa pi (10,000) ale lo fi juga, alege wari a kan paari fu. 8Fi le nya ale ka fi nina nyiini, a nya wabaata nyama namsika.
9Ase fi nin basi ate Naawen dii ale ka mi sukka jigi la. Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La a chim fi boka jigi. 10Dila nyiŋ biem kan paari fu, kaasuŋ a kan jam moata fi viuku. 11Wa le weeni wa maarɔma fi nyiŋ ate ba a nya fi zuk fi suitaŋa meena po. 12Ba le zak fu ta nisa po ate fi kan pai fi naŋ a nak tintain ya. 13Fi le tabi gbeŋli ale jinkpaŋ zuk, fi le tabi gbeŋli kpienni ale waamu.
14Naawen weeni ayen, wa le a yaali mi la nyiŋ, m le vari wa basi, m le lik wa diila, wa siak te mi yuenni kama. 15Wa le wi mi, ate m tulisi wa, m le bo ale wa daanika po, m le vari wa basi abe m zuli wa. 16M le te wa chak ale nyuvu woŋ, abe m sak wa m varibasika.

Title: YIILA 92
Content:
1Ku nala kama ate ti pak Naawen abe ti lenni yiila a seni Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La yuenni, 2abe ti dan goa yiti saluik ti biisi fi ŋmanteka wie, abe ti dan doa yok ti a biisi fi wensieŋa wie mɛ. 3Ku nala kama ayen ti pai baganiŋ kaai ale ta miisa pi la, ale kpanuŋ a leni yiila a seni fu.
4Dii nyiŋla Naawen yaa, fi tom ka fi tuimaŋa ate ŋa peenti m sui. Fi nisa tuima nyiŋ mi ale lenni yiila ale suipeentik. 5Naawen yaa, fi tuimaŋa a zuak ya, ate fi popolaŋa mɛ a yalima. 6A ka popola nyama a zɛ, betaŋa mɛ a ka miŋka ayen, 7ase nyeka tuem nyama ale a pusi ase wuuta la ate biem nyam a nya boka la, ba le kaasi kama taam wuu.
8Alege fi Naawen a nya zak zaan ka taam wuu.
9Naawen yaa, chichama a karo, fi za fi kaasi fi dachaasaŋa kama. Nuru baataŋa le waaŋ chaab. 10Fi te mu ka pagrim ate m pagra ase goa lalik koluk nyiili la. Fi kpiiri ka kpa maŋ a tagli mu. 11M nimbie a nya m dachaasaŋa chala m tue a wom m dachaasaŋa naŋkima.
12Wayɔrisima nyam boka a nye ase ka kpinkparuk la, ba le chim ase ka nyunyoŋ la Lebanon po. 13Naawen yenni po, ba le nya nyeboka tama Wenni dabiasaŋa po. 14Si dan poom kpaŋ, si le diem a yɔn yɔna, si le pusi va paalita. 15Ba yaa mooli ayen, Naawen a nala. Wa ka m piuŋ, wa ka gaasa.

Title: YIILA 93
Content:
1Naawen a dɛ naam, wa jo ka naam kɔlima. Naawen ta pagrim. Tɛŋka a feri paari kama, ka kan choa. 2Fi naam zukpaglika a boro a nyini ka dila po, fi ka dila taam wuu. 3Naawen yaa, nyakpientaŋa a wuuri, nyamiika a pagra kama. 4Nyakpientaŋa a nuem nyakpiemu nyamiisaŋa a pagra alege Naawen a pagra gaam di.
5Naawen yaa fi kaamka a kan tagri. Fi yenni ale kasim welema taam wuu.

Title: YIILA 94
Content:
1Naawen yaa, Wen dii ale a namsi la. Wen dii ale a namsi la nyini tuni kanjanta nyama dii ale magsi ba la. 2Yiti ŋmai, tɛŋzuk de buusa boorɔ a waali baai meena ale a nak suinum la ale waali kaai ale magsi ba la. 3Gaasa nyama ale beni a paari ka dimpo. Naawen yaa, ku le paari ka dimpo ate gaasa nyama a basi naŋ ka? 4Ba kasim a biisi ka kanjanta wie nyiini tuim kaasima nyam meena a kasim a kuulim kama. 5Naawen yaa, ba namsi fi nuruma ba ta baai ate fi so la a tom ka kanpiinta. 6Ba a ko pukɔga ale nicham ale kpiŋsa. 7Ba biisi ba nɔngbaaŋa po ayen Naawen a kan nya ba ale a nye diila, ba weeni ayen Jekob Wenni niŋ karo.
8Ni kpesi nidek nama baai ale kan ta yam a bo nuruba po la. Nama betta, ka dimpo ate nama ale miŋ yammoa? 9Nama a yaa ni weeni kama ayen waai ale nye tuni la a kan wom? Nama a yaali ayen ni weeni kama ayen waai ale a sak nuruba a silim yammoa? 10Nama a poli kama ayen waai ale namsi satɛŋsa la ale pai nama a basi kama? Nama a poli kama ayen waai ale a sak nuruba la a ka miŋ la? 11Naawen ale seba nuru popola, wa seba kama ayen ŋa ka kiriya.
12Naawen yaa, nuru waai ate fi a te wa turi darika ale a te wa fi sinsaŋŋa la a ta suipeentik kama. 13Nuru waai ate fi a sak wa an nyini fi sinsaŋŋa po la, fi yeeri wa kama a nyini daanika po, a ga paari diipo ate ba ale tu goluk a gu gaasa nyama la. 14Naawen a kan jɛ wa nuruma a basi yaase wa zɛri ba. 15Buusa boka ale ŋman pilim bo a nyini wayɔrisima po, ate baai meena ale ka cheri ba suiniima po la ale va ŋa.
16Ka wana ale wa yiti zaani a tu chaab ale nuru baataŋa a te mi? Ka wana ale wa zaani a tu chaab ale tuim kaasima nyama a te mi? 17Naawen a dan kan jam maari mu, ku ate kan beni m ti kpi ya. 18Naawen yaa, ase m dan weeni ayen, <<M sati,>> ka fi ŋmanteka ale a yik mu a ta. 19Daanika ale zuak a bo m po la, ka fi wieŋa ale te m chiika masim.
20Niŋdeerɔ baai ale bie ale a dueni wie ate ŋa daani tɛŋ dem ate ba a nam la an baga a tom ale fi. 21Ba zɔk ale chaab nye a kaasi wayɔrisima nyama ale ko baai ale kan seba wari nɔi po la. 22Alege Naawen a chim ka yepagrik ale m Wen m piuŋ ate m suk wa po. 23Wa le tuni ba a magsi chaab ale ba biemu. Wa le kaasi ba, ba gaasaŋa nyiŋ. Naawen, tama Wenni ale kaasi ba.

Title: YIILA 95
Content:
1Ni jam ate ti lenni masim yiila a seni Naawen. Ni basi ate ti nuem a te Piuŋ kuui ale ka ti varibasidɔ la. 2Ni te ti jam wa niŋ ale jiam teka abe ti pak wa ale yiila leŋka. 3Dii nyiŋla Naawen ka Wen Kpienni wa ka Naab kpioŋ a zuak a gaam wena meena. 4Tɛŋka liuŋku a bo ka wa nisima po. Guuk kpientaŋa zukpattaŋa ka wala ale soa. 5Nyakpiemu ka wala ale soa, dii nyiŋla ka wa ale nye bu. Ka wa nisimaŋa mɛ ale nye tɛŋ kosikka.
6Ni jam, ni basi ate ti koori tɛŋ a zuli Wen, ni basi ate ti kpi dunduna ti Naawen ti Nyeerɔwa niŋ. 7Wa ka ti Wen, ate tama chim wa nuruba ale wa piisa ate wa taa nya. Ni dan wom wa lueluku jinla, 8ni kan basi ate ni suiniimaŋa a pagra ase ni le jam nye dii Meriba ale Massaya sagni po la, 9juijui ate ni koma a nye mu nya la, ba be jam nya mi ale nye diila kama. 10Bena pisinaansi ate mi sui a jam puuri ale gaŋ kala. M jam weeni ba ayen, ba ka nuru baai ate ba suiniima an bo ale mi, ba zɛ mi suitaŋa. 11Dila ate m yaa jam ka ale m suipuurumu ayen, ba kan jo m vuusumu jigini.

Title: YIILA 96
Content:
1Leni yipaali a te Naawen tɛŋ meena demma. Ni lenni yiili a te Naawen. 2Ni lenni yiili a te Naawen. Ni pak wa yuenni. Ni mooli wa varibasika wie daa meena. 3Ni weeni wa zulaŋa a sak tɛŋsa meena po. Ni weeni wa wakinkaglaŋa ate nuru meena a wom.
4Dii nyiŋla Naawen a zuak ka nna yega ale magsi pimpauk. Ku magsi ayen waai meena a chali wa yɔgsum ale wa gaam wena meena kama. 5Dii nyiŋla tɛŋsaŋa meena wenaŋa ka bɔgta alege ka Naawen ale nye wenŋmazuk. 6Zula ale zuaka a bo ale wa kama, pagrim ale nalim a bo wa yenni po.
7Ni pak Naawen tɛŋsa meena tɛŋzuk de ni pak Naawen zulaŋa ale wa pagrimu, 8ni te Naawen zula ŋaai ale magsi wa yuenni la, ni ta tiirim a jam wa niŋ, ni puusi Naawen nalim weleŋsaŋa po. 9Ni puusi Naawen wa nalim weleŋsaŋa po. Nama tɛŋsaŋa meena, ni basi ate ni nyiŋsa a gɔg wa niŋ.
10Ni te ni nyiŋsa a gɔk wa niŋ tɛŋzuk de meena tɛŋka a feri paari kama, ka kan choa. Wa le bo nuruba meena buusa ale wensie. 11Basi ate wenŋmazukku a dɛ masim, basi ate tɛŋzuk de sui a peenti. Basi ate nyakpiemu a pilim nuem ale ŋan baai meena ale bo bu po la. 12Basi ate tattaŋa ale jaab meena ale bo ti po la a naŋ. Ate tiisaŋa meena ale bo sagni po la lenni yiila ale masim, 13Naawen ale cheen la nyiŋ si leni yiila wa niŋ. Wa cheen kama ayen wa bo tɛŋka buusa. Wa le bo tɛŋka buusa ale wayɔrisima ale wensieŋa.

Title: YIILA 97
Content:
1Naawen ka naab, basi ate tɛŋka a dɛ masim, basi ate satɛŋ sii ale yaalima la dɛ masim.
2Chiŋma ale legi nna kpitɔ ale gilim wa. Wa wayɔrisima ale wensie ale chim wa naam zukpaglika nyubini. 3Ka bolim ale a dɛ wa niŋ, a dɛ wa dachaasaŋa jigi meena. 4Wa nyaksika a nyiem nyaksi a gilim tɛŋka meena kama, ate tɛŋka demma nya ate ba nyiŋsa a gɔk nna pampam. 5Guutaŋa a nyaliŋ ase samparima la Naawen niŋ, waai ale ka Nyɔnɔ tɛŋka meena zuk la niŋ. 6Wenŋmazukku a mooli wa wayɔrisimaŋa wie, nuruma meena a nya wa zulaŋa.
7Baai meena ale a kaab bɔgta ale a kuulim ti nyiŋla ale jo chivie po. Nama wena, ni puusi Naawen. 8Naawen yaa, Zayon demma a wom ale a dɛ masim, Juda tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa sue a peenti, fi buusaŋa nyiŋ. 9Naawen, ka fi ale Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La tɛŋka meena zuk, fi nya zak zaanika wena meena zuk.
10Basi ate baai meena ale a yaali Naawen la a kisi biem, dii nyiŋla wa nya wensie nuruma zuk ale yeeri ba a nyini nuru gaasa nisima po. 11Wa toati ka bolim ate wayɔrisima nyama, ale te baai suiniima ale nala la masim. 12Ni dɛ masim Naawen po, nama wayɔrisima nyama abe ni pak wa tuilum yuenni.

Title: YIILA 98
Content:
1Ni leni yipaali a te Naawen, dii nyiŋla wa tom ka wakinkagla, wa tuilum juga nisaŋa a tom varibasika a te wa. 2Naawen a basi ate nuruba a nya wa varibasika tuimaŋa, wa pai wa wayɔrisima tuimaŋa a sak satɛŋsaŋa. 3Wa teeri wa ŋmanteka ale wa wensie wieŋa ate wa tara ale Izirali demma la. Tɛŋka meena ale doa ga saari la a nya tama Wenni varibasika tuimaŋa kama.
4Ni nye nuem ka masim ate Naawen, ni lɔnsi yiila waaŋ ale masim a te wa. 5Ni leni yiila a te Naawen ale kpanuŋ, pai kpanuŋ a leni yiila. 6Peeri damunsa a pai padiak nyiili a nye masim nuemka a te Naawen dii ale ka Naab.
7Basi ate nyakpiemu a nuem, jaab meena ale bo bu po la, tɛŋka ale baai meena ale bo ka po la. 8Basi ate belaŋa a nak nichaala, abe guutaŋa a pilim chaab a lenni yiila ale masim. 9Basi ate ba leni yiila Naawen niŋ ale wa cheena kama ayen wa bo tɛŋka buusa, wa le bo tɛŋka meena buusa ka wayɔrisima po, abe wa bo nuruma buusa wensie po.

Title: YIILA 99
Content:
1Naawen a dɛ naam, basi ate tɛŋsaŋa nyiŋsa a gɔg. Wa kala wa zukpaglik kpieŋka zuk ŋanvutaŋa suŋsuŋ, basi ate tɛŋka a choa. 2Naawen dii ale bo Zayon tɛŋka la zuak ya, wa nya zak zaanika tɛŋsaŋa meena zuk. 3Basi ate ba pak fi yuei kpienni ale fi yuei naliŋka, wa ale welema.
4Naawa a zuak ya, wa a yaali ka wensie wa basi ate wensie a boro. Fi nye dii ale ka wensie ale nala la kama Jekob po. 5Ni zak Naawen tama Wenni yuei a zaani. Ni zuli wa, wa naam naŋtaata zukpaglika zuk, ale wa welema kama.
6Moosis ale Aaron a jam maa bo ka wa kaabteerɔma po, Samuel a jam maa pilim ka baai ale a wi wa yuenni la po. Ba wi Naawen ate wa tulisi ba. 7Wa kali chiŋmanni po a biisi ale ba, ba va wa sinsaŋŋa ale siak wa wieŋa ate wa te ba la.
8Naawen, ti Wen yaa, fi tulisi ba. Fi jam chim ka vɔŋteka Wen a te Izirali, fi poom jam namsi ba kama ba nye kaasuŋku nyiŋ. 9Ni zak Naawen tama Wenni a zaani abe ni puusi wa, wa tuilum guuku zuk, dii nyiŋla, Naawen, ti Wenni a welema kama.

Title: YIILA 100
Content:
1Tɛŋsaŋa meena a nuem ale masim a te Naawen. 2Puusi Naawen ale popeentik. Jam wa niŋ ale yi masik. 3Seba ayen Naawen ka Wen. Ka wa ale nye ti, ale soa ti. Ti ka wa nuruba pa ŋaai ate wa a wuuk la.
4Va wa nansuiŋtaŋa a jo wa dabaasaŋa po ale jiam teka ale pimpauk. Te wa jiam abe fi pak wa yuenni. 5Dii nyiŋla Naawen a nala ate wa ŋmanteka a boro taam wuu. Wa wensieŋa a kasim boro kama ate gaŋsa meena.

Title: YIILA 101
Content:
1Naawen m le leni yiili a weeni fi ŋmanteka ale fi wensieŋa wieŋa a te fu, m le leni yiili a pak fu. 2Mi ni yik m dek ate m kan tom kaasi fu, ka dai dina ate fi le jam a maari mu. M le bo bomaŋ m yenni po ale suinum weleŋ. 3M kan pai m nina a tu wabulɔrisa. Nuru kaasintaŋa tuimaŋa, m kisi ŋa kama m kan pai m dek a te wa ŋala chaaba. 4Mi ale nuru baai ale ka a yaali wensie la a yalima kama ale chaab, m kan ta wari a nye ale biem.
5Waai ale a zu wa vaanchoa ŋaaŋ la m le basi ate wa nye diki. Nuru waai ale ta kanjanta wa nina ale wa suinum po la, m ka wari a nye ale wa.
6Waai ale bo tɛŋka po a ta wensie la, m nina ale doa wa zuk ate wa bo ale mu, waai nyiini chelim ate nye kaasuŋ a ka wa jigi la ale wa tom a te mi.
7Nuru waai ale a tom pimpaasima tuima, ale a velim la a kan kali mi yenni po. Nuru karo a biisi venta wie ale a zaani mi niŋŋa.
8Saluik meena m le basi ate nuru baataŋa ale bo tɛŋka po la a nye diki, wabaata nyama buuni m kan te ba suik ate ba maa jo Naawen tɛŋka po.

Title: YIILA 102
Content:
1Naawen yaa, wom m puusa. Basi ate m kumsaŋa ate m kum a yaali maarika la a paari fu. 2Kan suk fi nina ale mu diipo ate m bo daanika po la. Lak turi wom mu m dan wi fu tulisi mu nwuli.
3M daaŋa a muriŋ a bɛ kama ase nyuisa la, m kobaŋa a dɛ ase ka bolim kaala la. 4M suinummu a jak kama a ko ase wuuta la, ate m baŋ ŋandiinta dɛ ka wie. 5M kumsaŋa a basi kama ate m buk a bɛ ale a tali koba nyiini. 6Mi a nye nna ase sagi po viuk la, mi a nye nna ase ka guura po viuk la. 7M kan goa, m yaa chim ase ka nuim yeŋ ale kala gboŋ zuk la. 8Danni meena, m dachaasaŋa a le mu kama ayen m sui puuri baai ale kisi mu la a nye mu a la ale ka a te mu. 9M yaa pai ka buntuem a chim m ŋandiinta m pa ninyiam a gum nyiam po a nyu, 10fi suinni ale puuri ale mu a gaam taam la nyiŋ, fi pai mu ta jueli ka wen yuk mu a basi nakpiak. 11M daaŋa a nye ase ka junɔi yisuŋ la, m jak kama a ko ase wuuta la.
12Alege fi, Naawen yaa, a kala fi naam zukpaglika zuk taam wuu. Fi yuenni ale nya teerika gaŋsa meena po. 13Fi le vaari yiti a ta jiirim ale Zayon demma, dii nyiŋla ku paari ka diipo ate ku magsi ayen fi sak jiirim la, fi ale dak dai diila a paari ya. 14Ka tintanaŋa a nala kama a te fi tomteerɔma. Ka nyuŋku mɛ a nala a te ba. 15Tɛŋsa ale chali Naawen yuenni, ate tɛŋzuk de nalimaŋa meena nyiŋsa ale gɔg wa zulaŋa niŋ. 16Dii nyiŋla, Naawen le pilim sɛ Zayon tɛŋka, abe wa na nyini ale wa zulaŋa. 17Wa le tulisi baai ale a silim ŋanta la puusa. Wa kan zɛri ba puusa.
18Basi ate kude a ŋmarisi a te chum po gaŋka, ate nuru baai ate ba an diem biak la a pak Naawen. 19Naawen a nya tɛŋka a nyini ka wa wen weleŋka jigini po. Wa nya tɛŋka a nyini ka wenŋmazukku, 20ayen wa wom baai ate ba yik lik la kumsaŋa abe wa vari baai ate ba bo mini ba, ayen ba ko ba la a basi. 21Dila nyiŋla Naawen yuenni ale tuesi Zayon tɛŋka meena, ba le pak wa Jerusalem tɛŋka meena po, 22ase nuruma ale naataŋa a nin tigsi ayen ba puusi Naawen.
23M nyuvunni po wa wɛ m pagrimu. Wa gebi m daaŋa a basi. 24Mi yaa weeni ayen, kan ko mu m daaŋa suŋsuŋsa po, m Wen yaa. Fi benaŋa a kasim boro kama gaŋsa meena po. 25A nyini piilimka, fi dueni tɛŋka nyubini ate wenŋmazukku a chim fi nisa tuima. 26Ba le kpi alege fi ale chim ka fi denni. Ba meena ale jiak ase garuk la. Ase gatta la ti nalimu ale nyini ate ti yeeri a yuk basi. 27Alege fi ka dila ate fi benaŋa a kan kpeglimu. 28Fi tomteerɔma bisaŋa ale nya boka dek fi jigi. Ba ŋaaŋbisa bisa ale nya zaana fi niŋ.

Title: YIILA 103
Content:
1M chiiga, pak Naawen, m ponni po ŋantaŋa meena pak wa tuilum yuenni. 2M chiiga, pak Naawen, kan baŋ wa nyuentaŋa meena wie. 3Wa ale vɔŋ fi biemu a te fu, ale tebi fi nyiŋtuilaŋa meena la. 4Wa ale da tuesi fi nyuvunni vɔrumu po a basi ale dari fu vɔrumu po ale te fi ŋmanteka ale jiirim la, 5waai ate fi chak ale fi kɔrisa ŋan maŋsa, dii le ku basi ate bi paalukku a ŋman pagra ase jiiruk la.
6Naawen ale a tom wayɔrisima ale wensie tuima a te baai meena ate ba a namsi la.
7Wa dak wa suitaŋa a sak Moosis, ale basi ate Izirali demma a seba wa le nye diila. 8Naawen ta ka jiirim ale yaalika. Wa sui a kan kpabi a puuri, wa ŋmanteka a zuak kama. 9Wa kan kasim a ŋma ba, ba kaasuŋ ku nyiŋ diipo meena, wa be kan ta sui ale ba taam wuu. 10Wa kan namsi ti ase ti biemu ale magsi ayen wa namsi ti a soa diila, yaa wa tuni ti a magsi chaab ale ti wakaasimaŋa ale soa diila. 11Ase wenzukku ale yalima ale tɛŋka diila, wa ŋmanteka ka dila ale baai ale a chali wa la. 12Ase konni ale yalima ale yeniŋka diila, wa vɔŋ ti biemu a te ti ate ku nye a se ka dila la. 13Ase ko ale ta jiirim ale wa bisa diila, Naawen mɛ a ta jiirim ale baai ale a chali wa la ka dila. 14Dii nyiŋla wa seba wa le nye ti diila kama, wa a teeri ayen ti ka tintanta. 15Dan ka nurubiik wa daaŋa a nye ase ka wuuk la, wa a nyaksi kama ase puuta ale za kaduk po diila. 16Vioku a dan fuk, ti a wiiri kama, ate waai an baga a teeri ti kuuni diipo diipo. 17Alege ta a cheŋ diipo meena Naawen ŋmanteka a bo ale baai meena ale a chali wa la kama, wa wayɔrisima tuimaŋa a bo ale ba bisaŋa bisa, 18ale baai ale ta wa nɔiyeŋka la ale a teeri a zuli wa wieŋa la.
19Naawen naam zukpaglika a bo ka wenŋmazuk, ate wa naamu a nya naam meena zuk.
20Pak Naawen nama wa Wen maarɔma, nama baai ale zuak la, baai ale a nye wa yaalika la, baai ale a zuli wa wanni la. 21Pak Naawen baai meena ale bo wenŋmazuk la, nama wa tomteerɔma baai ale a nye wa yaalika la. 22Pak Naawen, wa tuimaŋa a pak wa juijui meena wa pagrimu po. Pak Naawen m chiiga.

Title: YIILA 104
Content:
1M chiiga, pak Naawen. Naawen yaa, mi Wenni. Fi zuak ka nna yegayega. Fi pai ka nalim ale zula a lik fidek ase garuk la. 2Wa pobi ka wadek ale bolim ase garuk la, wa dari wenŋmazukku ase gbain la. 3Wa dueni wa kiani chibsaŋa nyaataŋa zuk. Wa basi ate chiŋmaaŋa a chim wa toroko ale do vioku kiŋkaŋŋa. 4Wa basi ate vaata a chim wa tintomdɔba, bolim ŋaasa a chim wa tomteerɔba.
5Wa basi ate tɛŋka a za ka nyuba zuk, ka kan choa. 6Fi pai nyaata a lik ka ase garuk la, nyaataŋa a za a gaam guutaŋa. 7Alege fi le toariŋ la nyaata a chali, fi le na la ti yiri ga zi, 8ti chali va guutaŋa zuima, ti chali siŋ vaasaŋa po, juijui ate fi dak ayen ti cheŋ la. 9Fi dueni ka bain ate ti an baga a gaamu, ti kan ŋman lik tɛŋka diipo diipo.
10Wa basi ate nyiam a nyini bulisaŋa po a siŋ vooliŋsaŋa po, a chali a va guutaŋa suŋsuŋ. 11A te tɛŋka gɔi duŋsaŋa meena nyiam, bon waarisaŋa meena a kɔ si nyanyuila kɔm. 12Wenzuk nuinsa a yɔk si tugta nyaataŋa nɔi, a yi yiila tiisaŋa naŋsaŋa po. 13Wa a zaŋti guutaŋa a nyini kiani po, tɛŋka a chak ale wa nisa tuima nyuentaŋa kama. 14Wa basi ate wuuk a nyini ate niiŋa a dɛ ale pa ŋanborinta a te nurubiik ate wa kpa ate ŋandiinta a jam. 15Tɛŋ kala mɛ zuk ate nurubiik a nya daam a nyu a naŋ, a nya kpaam a sa wa nina ate ŋa a nyaksi, a nya ŋandiinta a dɛ a nya nyiŋ pagra. 16Naawen tiisaŋa a nya zaŋti ka kama nalimnyiini, Lebanon nyunyoŋta ate wa vuk la. 17Dula ate nuinsaŋa a yɔk si tugtaŋa, jumbaliiruku ta ku yenni ka ti sii ale nye nna turɔ la po. 18Guwoŋtaŋa ka gɔi bua ale soa, pinaŋa ka suensa sukka jigi.
19Chiika ale a sak yoei ale wenkarik, wenbinni a seba diipo ate di a siŋ la kama. 20Fi le ta legi a jam, ate di a chim yok, ate tiisaŋa po duŋsa meena a nyiem dikdik. 21Gbeŋmaŋa a wuuri a yaali ŋanta ŋa yik, ŋa a gisi ŋa ŋandiinta Wen jigi. 22Wenbinni a pusi, ate ŋa zu cheŋ, ŋa ŋmani ga duak ŋa goomu jigini. 23Ate nurubiik a yaa nyini cheŋ wa tuima jigi, wa bo ka wa tomka jigini a ga paari junɔi.
24Fi tuimaŋa a soa ka sɛ, Naawen yaa, Fi nye ba meena ale ka yam, tɛŋka a sueri ale ka ŋan baai ate fi nye la. 25Nyakpiemu ale la a dua, a labsa nna jabababa, ate fi le nye ŋan baai la a boro a ka chiina, ŋanvu tii ale ka ŋan kpeenta ale ŋan fiisa. 26Dula ate ŋaaruŋtaŋa a cheŋ niŋ ale ŋaaŋ, ate duŋ kperikaliika ate fi nye la a nyiem dula.
27Bade meena a nya ka fi ayen fi te ba ŋandiinta diipo ale magsi la. 28Fi dan te ba, ba tigsi. Fi dan lak fi nisaŋa, ba a chak kama ale ŋanmaŋsa. 29Fi dan suk fi nimbidiaka ku a daani ba kama, fi dan yeeri ba vuusumu ba a kpi kama a ŋmani a cheŋ tantaŋa po. 30Fi le tom fi Chiika la, wa nye ba kama, alege a basi ate tɛŋka a ŋman chim tɛŋ paalik.
31Naawen zulaŋa abe boro taam wuu, Naawen abe a naŋ wa tuimaŋa nyiŋ. 32Wa waai ale a nya tɛŋka ate ka a choa, waai ale a tiri guutaŋa ate ti a nyini nyuisa.
33Mi le yi yiila a te Naawen m boka po meena, mi ale tɔlim vua la, m le yi yiila a pak m Wenni. 34Mi ale a poli diila abe peenti wa sui, ase mi ale a naŋ Naawen niŋ la. 35Alege wabaata nyam abe muriŋ bɛ tɛŋka zuk, ate gaasa nyama kan ŋman boro. M chiiga, pak Naawen. Pak Naawen.

Title: YIILA 105
Content:
1Te Naawen jiam, a wi wa yuenni basi ate tɛŋsaŋa a seba wa ale nye diila. 2Leni yiila a te wa, leni pimpauk yiila a te wa, weeni wa wakinkagla nyeelaŋa meena te wa. 3Ta suipeentik wa tuilum yuenni nyiŋ, basi ate baai suiniima ale a gisi Naawen la a ta mariŋka. 4Zak nya Naawen ale wa pagrimu, kasim a gisi wa nimbidiaka diipo meena.
5Ni teeri wakperikaliisaŋa ate wa nye la wie, wa wakinkaglaŋa ale wa buusaŋa ate wa weeni la. 6Izirali wa tomteerɔwa ŋaaŋbisa, Jekob waai ate wa lueri la nidoabilisa.
7Wa ka Naawen tama Wen, wa buusaŋa a bo tɛŋzuk de meena kama.
8Wa a teeri wa nɔiyeŋka kama taam wuu, wanni ate wa weeni a te gaŋsa tusa la, 9nɔiyeŋka ate wa jam nye ale Abrayam la, pumpuulimaŋa ate wa jam puulim ale Aizik la. 10Wa jam ŋman biisi di wari kama ale Jekob ase sinsaga la, ayen wa weeni Izirali demma ase ka nɔiyeŋ kaai ale ka boro a beni. 11<<Mi ale pai Keenan tɛŋka a te ni ase kauk kuui ale ku chim ni nitalim la.>>
12Ba ale jam kan soa diila, an sum soa diila, ale chim nicham ka po la. 13Ba jam bo ka tɛŋsaŋa po a tuinti, a nyini naam po a taam m bu po. 14Wa an jam basi ate nuru a daani ba, ba nyiŋ wa toariŋ nalima. 15Wa weeni ayen, <<Ni kan tiri mi ale lueri baai la, kan nye mi biisiteerɔma wari ya.>>
16Wa wi kɔm ate bu siŋ tɛŋka zuk ale kaasi ŋandiin tii ate ba te ba la. 17Ate wa tom nuru ate wa dɛ ba niŋ, Josefi waai ate ba pai da ase yɔma la. 18Ba muli wa naŋsa ale chɔrima, a pai wa ŋinni a su kuta po. 19Ate wa le jam weeni diila a jam nye, ate Naawen wanni a yaa jam sak ayen wa ta wensie. 20Naawa a tom a yeeri wa, nuruma kpagni a lak wa basi. 21Wa basi ate wa chim wa yenni kpagi, a nya wa ŋan baai meena ate wa soa la. 22Ayen wa a sak nabisaŋa wa le mariŋ diila abe wa a sak wa nisɔmma yam.
23Izirali yaa jo Ejipiti, Jekob a jam bo Yɛm tɛŋka ase ka nichaanɔ la. 24Naawen a basi ate wa nuruma a biak. Wa basi ate ba piisi nna yegayega a te ba dachaasaŋa. 25Baai suiniima ate wa tulim ate ba kisi wa nuruma, ayen ba zɔk a ta chaab ale wa tomteerɔwa. 26Wa tom Moosis wa tomteerɔwa ale Aaron, waai ate wa lueri la. 27Ba tom wakperikaliisa ba suŋsuŋ, wakinkagla Yɛm tɛŋka po. 28Wa tom legi a basi ate tɛŋka a sobi diila ba an jam zɛri wa wieŋa? 29Wa tulim ba nyaataŋa ate ti chim ziim, a basi ate ba jumaŋa a kpi. 30Ba tɛŋka a sueri ale buntua, ŋaai ale jo ba kpaŋŋa diin goamaŋa po. 31Wa biisi, ate nanjuŋsa nna vuun a jam, ate bumbuma a sueri ba tɛŋka meena. 32Wa tulim ba ŋmorukku ate ku chim ŋmoruk tana, ale nyaksika tɛŋka meena. 33Wa kaasi ba yɔnaŋa tiisaŋa ale kinkaŋsaŋa, a wɛ ba tɛŋka tiisaŋa. 34Wa biisi ate tintue jam, nanchoŋta a ka chiina. 35Ba dɛ ŋanta ale ta vaata la meena ba tɛŋka po, a dɛ ba tɛŋka ŋanta meena. 36Ate wa ko bi kpaŋŋa meena ba tɛŋka po, ba nidoama ale piilim biak baai la.
37Wa ta Izirali nyini, a ji ba ale kpana ale ligmɔniŋ, ba diinaŋa po waai an nye beya. 38Ejipiti demma sue jam peenti kama ba le basi dula la, dii nyiŋla Izirali yɔgsum ale jam lo ba zuk. 39Wa basi ate ka chiŋmari a teeri lik ba, ale bolim ayen bu a nya yok. 40Ba bek, ate wa ta yeŋsa jam te ba, a basi ate ba dɛ wenzuk ŋandiinta a chak. 41Wa lak piuŋku ate nyiam a na nyini, ase beli la bu chali kama gɔnni po.
42Diila wa teeri ka wa tuilum pumpuulimaŋa ate wa te wa tomteerɔwa Abrayam la. 43Wa ta wa nuruma a nyini ale ka suipeentik, baai ate wa lueri la ale suipeentik nuemka. 44Wa pai satɛŋsaŋa tɛŋsa a te ba ate ba tuesi ŋan baai ate nuru yonta a nam nya la, 45ate ba baga a ta wa wieŋa abe ba a kpesi wa sinsaŋŋa. Pak Naawen.

Title: YIILA 106
Content:
1Pak Naawen. Ni te Naawen jiam ale wa ka Naawen maŋ, wa ŋmanteka a boro kama taam wuu. 2Ka wana ale baga a mooli Naawen tuim kpiemaŋa, yaase wa weeni wa pimpaukku. 3Suipeentik a bo le ka baai ale ta wensie la, baai ale kasim a tom dii ale nala la. 4Teeri m wari, Naawen yaa, ase fi nin sak ŋmanteka ale fi nuruma. Jam a maari mu ase fi nin vari fi nuruma a basi, 5ate fi nuruma ate fi lueri la ale nya ŋan baai jigsi la, mi maa dɛ ba ale masim. Ate m maa dɛ ni tɛŋka masimu, a yaa gum baai ate fi tuesi la po a te pimpauk.
6Ti tom kaasi kama, ase ti koma ale nye diila, ti nye kaasi kama, a bola nye gaasa. 7Ti koma ale jam bo Ejipiti la, ba an poli fi wakperikaliisaŋa wari ya, ba an teeri fi jiirimu ale piisi diila, a yaa pai nyakpiemu, Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku nyiŋ a nye tukpari. 8Alege wa vari ba a basi wa yuenni nyiŋ, ayen wa basi ate wa pagrim kpiemu ba seba. 9Wa toariŋ Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku, ate bu kpeeri a ko, wa ta ba va liuŋku po a taam ase gɔi kosik po la. 10Wa vari ba dachiaka nisa po a basi, dachiaka nisa po wa da tuesi ba. 11Nyaataŋa a lik ba dachaasaŋa, ba wanyi mɛ la an vuuk ya. 12Ba yaa ta siaka ale wa pumpuulimaŋa a yaa yi yiila a pak wa.
13Alege ku an beni ya ba deri baŋ wa le nye diila, ale an limisi wa sinsaŋŋa. 14Gɔi kosikka po ba siak te badek yaalika, tɛŋ kaai ate nuruba karo la ba nye Wen a nya. 15Wa yaa te ba ba le bek a yaali diila, alege tom nyiŋtuila ate ŋa jam ba zuk.
16Ba viitaŋa jigini ba jam a dɛ nyuri ale Moosis ale Aaron, waai ate ba pai wa a te Naawen la. 17Tɛŋka a lagri a nɛ Datan, a gu Abiram nuruma. 18Ate bolim tɔti ba ŋaaŋviirɔma suŋsuŋ, bolim ŋiak a dɛ wabaata nyama.
19Yoreb ba nye ka naabiik a yaa puusi bɔgluk kuui ate ba nye ale kutuk la. 20Ba pai ba zulaŋa a tagri lalik mɛɛŋ, kaai ale a ŋɔbi wuuk la. 21Ba baŋ Wen dii ale vari ba a basi la, waai ale nye wa kpiema Ejipiti tɛŋka po la, 22Wakperikaliisa Yɛm tɛŋka po, ale wie ŋaai ale a nak kpaziim Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku nɔi. 23Wa yaa weeni ayen wa le ko ba, dan kan daa Moosis, waai ate wa lueri la, ale zaani wa le ba suŋsuŋŋa ayen wa yik wa suinni ate wa kan ko ba.
24Ate ba yaa zɛri tɛŋ masika, ba ka siaka ale wa pumpuulimaŋa. 25Ba jam a ŋuuni kama ba viitaŋa po, ba an wom Naawen nɔiya. 26Wa yaa zak nisa wen a pɛ ayen wa le basi ate ba kpi a lo gɔnni po. 27Wa le basi ate ŋaaŋsaŋa lo kpi tɛŋsa po, abe wa basi ate ba waaŋ tɛŋsaŋa meena.
28Ba pai ba ŋeeŋa a su Peor wenni Baal po ale kaab kaai ate ba kaab a te wena ŋaai ale kan ta nyuvoa. 29Ba gaasa tuimaŋa a basi kama ate Naawen sui a puuri, ate nyiŋtuila a na waaŋ ba suŋsuŋ. 30Alege Fineyas a yiti zaani nyiŋtuilaŋa nyiŋ ate ba kpesi. 31Kude jam te wa yuei ate ba ayen wa ka wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ a ta cheŋ chum po baai ate ba za ba biak la.
32Meriba nyaataŋa jigini ba nye ate Naawen sui a puuri, ate daanika jam Moosis jigi ba nyiŋ. 33Ba jam zɛri kama a ta chaab ale Naawen Chiika, ate suipuurum wie a nyini Moosis nɔnni po.
34Ba an ko tɛŋsaŋa nuruma ase Naawen ale weeni ba diila, 35alege a gum chaab ale tɛŋsaŋa a maara nye ba le a nye ba wie diila. 36Ba jam maara a kaab ba bɔgtaŋa, ate ti jam chim baruk a te ba. 37Ba pai ba nidoabilisaŋa ale ba liema a kaab a te chichirisa. 38Ba basi ate baai ale kan seba wari la ziim a nyini, ba nidoabilisaŋa ale ba liema ziim, baai ate ba kaab a te Keenan bɔgtaŋa, a kaasi tɛŋka ale ba ziimu. 39Ba daŋ badek kama ale ba le nye diila, ba nyeelaŋa a kaasi badek kama.
40Dila nyiŋ Naawen sui yaa puuri ale wa nuruma, a kisi wa le soa baai la. 41Wa yaa pai ba a te tɛŋsaŋa, ate ba dachaasaŋa a nya ba zuk. 42Ba dachaasaŋa a namsi ba a basi ate ba siak te ba pagrimu. 43Ku nɔi yega wa vari ba a basi, alege ba kasim a kan wom wa nɔi ya ate ba cheŋ bɛ ba biemu po.
44Alege wa kpesi nya ba daanika, wa le wom ba kumsaŋa la. 45Ba nyiŋ wa teeri wa nɔiyeŋka, ate wa ŋmante kpieŋka po wa tagri wa popolaŋa. 46Wa basi ate baai meena ale yik ba ta la a ŋman chali ba jiirim.
47Ni kaari a weeni ayen, <<Vari ti a basi, Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la, tigsi ti a vari ti a basi a ta nyini tɛŋsaŋa jigi, ate tama ale te fi tuilum yuenni jiam, ate tama ale ta zula fi pimpaukku po.>> 48Pimpauk a cheŋ Naawen, Izirali Wenni jigi, a kasim a cheŋ taam wuu. Ate nuruma meena jam weeni ayen, <<Ku be nye dila,>> ale <<Pak Naawen.>>

Title: YIILA 107
Content:
1Pai jiam a te Naawen diila wa nala kama, wa ŋmanteka a boro ka dila cheŋ. 2Baai ate Naawen a da tuesi ba basi la a weeni nna, baai ate wa da tuesi dachiaka nisa po la, 3baai ate wa tigsi a nyini tɛŋsaŋa po la, a nyini kori ale yeniŋ, a nyini wiiluk ale yeseok.
4Ba gela a cheŋ bɛ kama gɔnni po juijui ate nuruba a karo la, ba kan nya suik a cheŋ tɛŋ po ate ba baga a kali. 5Kom ale nyanyuila ale jam ta ba, ate ba a jɔk ba nyuvooŋa. 6Ate ba yaa kum wi Naawen ba daanika po, ate wa yeeri ba ta nyini daanika po. 7Wa ta ba va suik yɔrisuŋ a cheŋ tɛŋ po juijui ate ba baga a kali. 8Basi ate ba pai jiam a te Naawen wa ŋmanteka ale wa wakperikaliisaŋa ate wa nye a te nuruba la. 9Wa basi ate nyanyuila ale ta baai la a chak ate kɔm ale ta baai mɛ la a chak ale ŋan maŋsa.
10Ba gela a kali legi po ale legi nna kpitɔ po, ate ligrɔba a nam ale kuta chɔrima, 11diila ba zɛri kama ale ta chaab ale Wen ale weeni diila ale zɛri Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La sinsaŋŋa. 12Wa yaa basi ate ba siak te ninam tuak, ba a nak naŋsa alege waai karo a maari ba. 13Ate ba kaari a wi Naawen ba daanika po, ate wa yeeri ba ba daanika po. 14Wa ta ba nyini legi po a nyini legi nna kpitɔ po a nyini ale gebi ba chɔrimaŋa. 15Basi ate ba pai jiam a te Naawen wa ŋmanteka nyiŋ ale wa wakinkaglaŋa ate wa tom a te nuruba la, 16diila wa wɛ ka kutuk mɔnuŋ nansuiŋta alege wɛ kutuk biga a jo. 17Ba gela a ta tukpari nyeka suita a chim betta, a nam ale nyiŋtuila ba wabaataŋa nyiŋ. 18Ba kisi ŋandiinta meena kama ale torisi moata kum nansuiŋtaŋa. 19Ate ba yaa kum wi Naawen ba daanika po, ate wa vari ba ba daanika po a basi. 20Wa tom wa wanni a tebi ba, wa vari ba vɔrumu po a basi. 21Basi ate ba pai jiam a te Naawen wa ŋmanteka nyiŋ ale wa wakinkaglaŋa ate wa tom a te nuruba la. 22Basi ate ba nye jiam kaabka tiirim a weeni wa tuimaŋa wari ale suipeentik yiila.
23Ba gela a nyini cheŋ nyakpiemu po kama ale ŋaaruŋta, ba jam ka geruŋdɔba nyakpientaŋa po. 24Ba nya Naawen tuimaŋa kama, wa wakinkaglaŋa liuŋku po. 25Wa biisi kama a siti va pagrika ate ku zak nya miisaŋa wen. 26Ti yiti kama a tigsi jueli wenŋmazuk a ŋman siŋ tɛŋ, ba kaasuŋku po ba nyiŋbiini a deri bɛ. 27Ba jam a ja kama ase dabugrɔba la, ate ba sebika meena jam chim kinla. 28Ate ba kum a wi Naawen ba daanika po ate wa ta ba nyini daanika po nyini. 29Wa te ate va pagrika a yɔk ate nya miisaŋa a nye diki. 30Ba sue jam peenti kama ku le yɔk la, ate wa ta ba jam juijui dek ate ba a yaali la. 31Basi ate ba pai jiam a te Naawen wa ŋmanteka nyiŋ ale wa wakinkaglaŋa ate wa nye a te nuruba la. 32Basi ate ba zak wa yuenni zaani nuruma suŋsuŋ abe ba pak wa nisɔmma tigsuŋku po.
33Naawen a basi ate bela a kpeeri meena ale basi ate beli naŋsa nyiam a kan chali. 34Wa basi ate tɛŋ sii ale nala la a tagri chim sii ale ta yesa a dua kinla, baai ale bo dula la wabaataŋa nyiŋ. 35Wa tagri tintain busuŋ tɛŋsa ate si ta bulisa ale nyiam tɛŋ kosisa ate si ta beli naŋsa ate ŋa nyiam a chali. 36Wa basi ate kɔm nuruba a kali dula, a sɛ tɛŋ ayen ba boro. 37Ba bori laŋsaŋa po ale vuk tiisa kaduksaŋa po a tigsi ŋanta nna yegayega. 38Wa niak wa nuruma, ate ba nya bisa nna yegayega, a lik ba niiŋa ta ate ŋa kan muuri.
39Ate badek ale soa diila a muuri, ate namsika ale kaasuŋ ale suipuurum a basi ate ba yik badek. 40Waai ale ka a yaali nuru kpienta wie la a basi kama ate ba a nyiem juijui ale kan ta suik la. 41Alege wa yeeri ŋanjaksaŋa ba ninam po ale basi ate ba dɔkdemma a piisi ase piisa la. 42Ate nuru maŋsaŋa nya a naŋ, alege nuru baataŋa a mum ba noaŋa.
43Nuru waai ale ta yam la, wa be wom wieŋa de abe wa poli Naawen ŋmanteka.

Title: YIILA 108
Content:
1M suinummu za ka nna giŋgiŋ, Wen yaa. M suinummu za ka giŋgiŋ. M ni lenni yiila a pak Fu. 2M chiiga, vaari yiti ŋmai, kpanuŋ ale baganiŋ, ni vaari yiti ŋmai. M le nak saluiku a yiti. 3M le pak fu, Naawen yaa, tɛŋsaŋa po. M le siak yiila a seni fu nuruma suŋsuŋ. 4Diila fi ŋmanteka a zuak kama, a jueli a gaam wenzukku, fi wensieŋa a jueli paari chiŋmaaŋa. 5Mi a zak fi yuenni ŋmai, Wen yaa, a gaam wenzukku, be te fi zulaŋa a tagli tɛŋka meena.
6Vari ti a basi abe fi maari ti ale fi juga nisaŋa, ate baai fi a yaali la a nya varibasika. 7Wen a biisi wa dɔkku po ayen, <<Pagrim po m le poori Sikiim abe m pai Sukkot Viaka a chari m nuruma. 8Gilead ka mi ale soa, Manasa ka mi ale soa, Ɛfraim ka mi kuta zukchin, Juda mi tachek, 9Moab ka mi chin narinni, Edom zuk mi tɔŋ m nuensiri, Filistia zuk mi kaari ale nakdeka.>>
10Ka wana ale wa ta mi jam tɛŋ kaai ale ta parik pagrisaŋa la? Ka wana ale wa dɛ mi niŋ a ta mu cheŋ Edom? 11Daa fi, Wen yaa, fi waai ale zɛri ti la ale kan va ti tugurik tɔŋdɔma a nyini la? 12Te ti maarika ate ti tu dachiaka, ale nurubiik maarika a ka kiri ya. 13Wen nyiŋ ti nya pagrim, ate wa lɔnsi ti dachaasaŋa tɛŋ.

Title: YIILA 109
Content:
1Wen yaa, fi waai ate mi a pak la, kan nye diki, 2diila wabaata ale pimpaasima nyam ale lak ba noa a ta chaab ale mu. Ba lak ka ba noa a biisi a velim a ta chaab ale mu. 3Ba gilim mi kama ale kisika wie, a siti mu alege daa wari ate m nye. 4Ba pai ka velimteka a tuni mi yaalika, alege mi ka puusa nuru. 5Ba pai ka biem a tuni mi nalimu, ale pai kisika a tuni mi yaalika.
6Lueri nuru biok ate wa ta chaab ale wa, abe waai ale a weeni ayen wa kaasi la a za wa juga. 7Ba dan bek wa, basi ate wa siak wa kaasuŋku, abe wa puusa a nye ale wadek. 8Wa daaŋa a kan soa diiya, nuru yoŋ a tuesi wa kpaŋtaŋa jigini. 9Wa bisaŋa a chim kpiŋsa abe wa powa a chim pukɔgi. 10Wa bisaŋa a chim baai ale nyiem a juisi, abe ba yiak ba ate ba nyini ba yie luemaŋa po a nyini. 11Waai ale pai ŋanta peem te wa a tuesi ŋan baai meena wa ta la, abe nicham a vari wa le nam nya ŋan baai la. 12Waai a kan te ŋmanteka a paari wa yaase wa sak jiirim ale wa bi kpiŋsaŋa. 13Wa ŋaaŋsaŋa ba gebi a basi, ba yueŋa kan maa bo baai ate ba za ba biak la po. 14Naawen a teeri wa koma wabaataŋa, wa mawa wabaataŋa kan maa duisi basi. 15Ba wabaataŋa kasim bo Naawen niŋ, ate wa gebi ba wari tɛŋka zuk basi ate waai kan teeri ba wari ya.
16Diila wa an maara a poli ŋmanteka, alege a vi ko ŋanjaksaŋa ale baai ale a silim ŋanta ale baai sue ale kaasi. 17Wa a yaali ka kikaasa kaka ku jam wa zuk, wa kan yaali niaka te ka, niaka abe yalima ale wa. 18Wa jo ka kikaasa ase garuk la, ate ku jo wa nyiŋka ase nyiam la, a jo wa kobaŋa ase kpaam la. 19Ku nye ase garuk ale vili wa la, ase chiak gbain ale bobi wa chiak taam wuu la. 20Kude chim Naawen tutuna a te baai ale a weeni mi kaasi la, tutuna a te baai ale biisi biem a te mi la.
21Alege fi Nyɔnɔwa waai ale ka Naawen yaa, nye mu magsi fi yuenni nyiŋ, fi ŋmanteka nalimu po vari mu a basi. 22Mi jaŋ kama ale a silim, ate m suinummu po ku a nye ase m kɔni la. 23Mi muriŋ a bɛ ase ka junɔi yisuŋ la, a kpaanti mi a basi ase tintue la. 24Mi duna a gbariŋ kama ŋandiinta silim nyiŋ. Mi buk kama a tali koba nyiini. 25Mi yaa chim ka ja laam a te baai ale a weeni ayen m nye a kaasi la, ba dan nya mu, ba a yuk ka ba zuima.
26Naawen, mi Wen yaa, maari mu. Vari mu a basi a ta va fi ŋmanteka. 27Basi ate ba seba ayen ka fi nisa, Naawen yaa, ate fi pai nye ku. 28Dai dii dai ba le ka, alege fi le niak, ba dan siti ba le pai ba a nyo chivie po, alege fi tomteerɔwa ale naŋ. 29Baai ale a weeni ayen mi kaasi la ale jo chivie po, abe chivie a vili ba ase garuk la.
30Mi pai m nɔnni a zak Naawen yegayega, nuru boanni po m le pak wa. 31Diila wa za ka waai ale a silim la juga geŋ, ayen wa vari wa baai ale a bo wa kum buusa la jigi a basi.

Title: YIILA 110
Content:
1Naawen a weeni mi Nyɔnɔwa ayen, <<Kali mi juga nisa geŋ ate m ga basi ate fi dachaasaŋa a chim fi naŋsa tabika jaab.>>
2Naawen ale basi ate fi tachek kpieŋka a zaani Zayon teeri cheŋ, fi le dɛ naam fi dachaasaŋa suŋsuŋ. 3Fi tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale siak fi kpaliŋka danni. Ase saluik yokyok maglim la, fi nidoa paalukku ale nyini tuilum guuku zuk a jam fi jigi.
4Naawen a pɛ kama, wa abe kan tagri wa popolaŋa, <<Fi ka kaabteerɔ taam wuu, a ta Melekizedek nyeelaŋa.>>
5Nyɔnɔwa a bo ka fi juga geŋ, wa le ŋɔriŋ nalima wa suipuurumu danni. 6Wa le bo tɛŋsa buusa a pai kpieba a vi chaab alege a ŋɔriŋ tɛŋka meena niŋdeerɔma. 7Wa le nyu nyiam bulik po suiku nɔi, dila nyiŋ wa le zak wa zukku.

Title: YIILA 111
Content:
1Pak Naawen. M le zak Naawen a zaani ale m suinum meena, wayɔrisima nyama suŋsuŋ ale Naawen nuruma suŋsuŋ.
2Naawen tuimaŋa a zuak ka yega, baai ale a yaali ŋa la a poli ŋa wari kama. 3Wa nyeelaŋa ka zula ale nalim nyiini, ate wa wayɔrisimaŋa a boro ka dila wuu. 4Wa basi kama ate ba a teeri wa wakinkaglaŋa, Naawen ka ŋmanteerɔ ale jiirim nyɔnɔ. 5Wa a te baai ale a chali wa yɔgsum la ŋandiinta. Wa kasim a teeri wa nɔiyeŋka ka dila a cheŋ. 6Wa sak wa nuruma kama wa pagrim tuimaŋa, a pai satɛŋ yonsa tɛŋsa a te ba. 7Wa nisima tuimaŋa ka wensie ale nyemagsika tuima, wa wieŋa ka mariŋka wie. 8Ŋa za kama giŋgiŋ a kasim a cheŋ wuu, ŋa be a nye ka yɔm ale wensie. 9Wa te wa nuruma ka varibasika, wa dueni wa nɔiyeŋka kama taam wuu. Wa yuenni a welema kama ale ta yɔgsum chalika.
10Naawen yɔgsum chalika ka yam piilimka, baai ale a va wa wieŋa la, a ta ka miŋ maŋ. Wa magsi ka pimpauk taam wuu.

Title: YIILA 112
Content:
1Pak Naawen. Waai ale a chali Naawen yɔgsum la, a ta suipeentik kama. Waai ale a nya masim yegayega a nyini wa sinsaŋŋa po la.
2Wa bisaŋa ale ta pagrim tɛŋka po, wayɔrisima nyama gaŋka ale nya niaka. 3Ŋanta taka ale jigsika a bo ka wa yenni po, ate wa wayɔrisimaŋa a boro ka dila wuu. 4Dan poom ka legi po bolim ale a jam a magsi wayɔrisima nyɔnɔwa ale ŋmanteka ale jiirim ale wayɔrisimaŋa nyama. 5Nalim ale jam waai ale a te yegayega ale peem a te nuruba la jigi. Waai mɛ ale a nye wa wie ale wensie la jigi. 6Wensie wala choawa a kan choa, wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ ba kasim a teeri wa wari ka dila a cheŋ. 7Wa kan chali wabaata womka, wa yik wa suinummu kama, ale ta sebchakka ale Naawen. 8Wa kan yiili wa be kan chali yɔgsum, ku kpeglimka meena wa le nya pagrim wa dachaasaŋa zuk. 9Wa yarinti wa tiiritaŋa kama a te ŋanjaksaŋa, ate wa wayɔrisimaŋa a boro ka dila wuu. Ba le zak wa nyiini ŋmai ale zula.
10Gaasa nyɔnɔwa ale nya ate wa sui a puuri, wa le dom nyina abe wa muriŋ a bɛ, ba yiilaŋa a bɛ ka meena.

Title: YIILA 113
Content:
1Pak Naawen. Naawen tomteerɔwa ni pak wa. Pak Naawen yuenni. 2Ni basi ate Naawen yuenni a nya pimpauk yɔgyɔgla ale daaŋa meena. 3A nyini wenbinni pusika a ga paari di siŋka, Naawen yuenni a magsi di nya pimpauk.
4Naawen a zak wadek kama a gaam tɛŋsaŋa meena, wa zulaŋa a gaam wenŋmazukku. 5Ka wana ale a nye ase Naawen tama Wenni la, waai ale kali wa naam zukpaglika zuk wenŋmazuk la, 6waai ale koori a nya wenzukku ale tɛŋka la?
7Wa zagri ŋanjaksaŋa tanta po ale zagri baai ale a silim la buntuem po. 8Wa pai ba kali ale nabisa, ale ba nuruma nabisa. 9Wa basi ate nipok waai ale kaa biak la a kali wa yenni po a chim bisa ma waai sui ale peenti. Pak Naawen.

Title: YIILA 114
Content:
1Izirali ale nyini Ejipiti a nyini la, Jekob yenni ale nyini nuru baai ale a biisi bi yoŋ po a nyini la. 2Juda a chim ka Naawen yenni, Izirali wadek ale soa.
3Nyakpiemu a nya a yiti chali, Jodan benni a deri basi chalika. 4Guutaŋa a chali ase padaasa la, pinaŋa a yɔk a zi ase pabisa la.
5Ka boa ale nye ya, nyakpiemoa ate fi yiti a chali, Jodan benni, a deri basi chalika, 6guuta, ate ni a chali ase padaasa la, pina, a yɔk a zi ase pabisa la?
7Tɛŋŋa, a choa Nyɔnɔwa niŋ, Jekob Wenni niŋ, 8waai ale basi ate piuŋku a chim bulik la, puŋ pagrika a chim nyiam bulisa la.

Title: YIILA 115
Content:
1Daa tama, Naawen yaa, daa tama alege fi yuenni a nya zula, fi ŋmanteka ale fi wensieŋa nyiŋ.
2Ka boa ate tɛŋsaŋa a weeni ayen, <<Ba Wenni a bo ka bɛ?>> 3Tama Wenni a bo ka wenŋmazuk, wa a nye ka dii ale a peenti wa sui la. 4Alege ba bɔgtaŋa ka kpana ale ligmɔniŋ, ate nuruba a nye ale ba nisima. 5Ba ta nɔi alege an baga a biisi, nina alege an baga a nya, 6ba ta tue, alege an baga a wom, nyue alege an baga a wom nyum, 7ba ta nisa, alege an baga a tiri jaaboa, naŋsa, alege an baga a cheŋ, yaase ba nye wai ale ba tutɔgtaŋa. 8Baai ale a nye ti la ale nye ase ka bɔgtaŋa la, ale baai meena ale ta sebchakka ale ti la.
9Izirali yeri yaa, ni ta sebchakka ale Naawen. Wa ale ba maarɔ ale ba ligrɔ. 10Aaron yeri yaa, ni ta sebchakka ale Naawen. Wa ale ba maarɔ ale ba ligrɔ. 11Nama baai ale a chali wa la, ni ta sebchakka ale Naawen, wa ale ba maarɔ ale ba ligrɔ.
12Naawen ale teeri ti abe wa niak ti. Wa le niak Izirali yenni, wa le niak Aaron yenni. 13Wa le niak baai ale a chali Naawen la, nuru fiisa ale nuru kpienta.
14Naawen a basi ate ni piisi, nama ale ni bisaŋa meena. 15Naawen, wenzuk ale tɛŋ meena Nyeerɔwa a niak ni.
16Wenŋmazuk niŋniŋŋa ka Naawen ale soa, alege tɛŋka wa pai te ka nurubiik. 17Daa kpieba ale a pak Naawen, baai ale a siŋ nna diki la. 18Ka tama ŋan vuutaŋa ale a zak Naawen a zaani, yɔgyɔgla de ale daaŋa meena. Pak Naawen.

Title: YIILA 116
Content:
1Mi a yaali Naawen kama, diila wa wom m lueluk kama, wa wom m le kaari a yaali maarika la kama. 2Wa le cheem pai turi a tuk mi nyiŋla, m le kasim a wi wa kama mi le tɔlim boro la.
3Kum miisa ale liem mi, vɔrup popola daanika ale jam m zuk, daanika ale suipuurum ale nya pagrim m zuk. 4Ate mi yaa wi Naawen yuenni ayen, <<Naawen yaa, vari mu a basi.>>
5Naawen ka ŋmanteerɔ ale wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ, ti Wenni a ta ka jiirim nyiini. 6Naawen a lik baai ale kan baga a maari badek la kama, mi ale jam a yaali maarika yega la, wa vari mi a basi kama.
7Be ŋman vuusi, m dek chiiga, diila Naawen a nala kama a te fu.
8Naawen yaa, diila fi ale vari mi chiika kum po a basi, m ninaŋa ninyaata po a basi, m naŋsaŋa naŋsa nakka po a basi, 9ate mi a baga a cheŋ Naawen niŋ, ŋanvutaŋa tɛŋka po. 10Mi ta siaka kama, dila la mi ya weeni ayen, <<Mi nya ka namsika nna yegayega.>> 11Ku le cha mi la po, mi yaa weeni ayen, <<Nuru bisa meena ka velimvendisa.>>
12Mi le nye ka sɛ a tuni Naawen wa wamaŋsaŋa meena ate wa nye te mi la. 13Mi le zak ka varibasika beerika ŋmai a wi Naawen yuenni. 14Mi le tuni m pumpuulimaŋa a te Naawen wa nuruma meena niŋ.
15Dii ale nala Naawen nina po la ale wa bisaŋa kum. 16Naawen yaa, wensie mi ka fi tomteerɔma, mi ka fi tomteerɔma, fi dɔklie biik, fi vari mi kama m chɔrima po a basi.
17M le pai jiam tiirim a kaab a te fu abe m wi Naawen yuei. 18Mi le tuni m pumpuulimaŋa a te Naawen wa nuruma meena niŋ. 19Naawen yenni dabaasaŋa po, ni suŋsuŋ, Jerusalem demma. Pak Naawen.

Title: YIILA 117
Content: 1Pak Naawen nama tɛŋsaŋa meena. Ni zak wa yuenni a zaani, nama nuruba meena. 2Wa ŋmanteka ale ti a zuak ka yega, Naawen wensieŋa abe boro ka dila wuu. Pak Naawen.

Title: YIILA 118
Content:
1Pa jiam a te Naawen, diila wa nala kama, wa ŋmanteka a boro ka dila wuu.
2Basi ate Izirali a weeni ayen, <<Wa ŋmanteka a boro ka dila wuu.>> 3Basi ate Aaron yenni demma a weeni ayen, <<Wa ŋmanteka a boro ka dila wuu.>> 4Basi ate baai ale a chali Naawen la a weeni ayen, <<Wa ŋmanteka a boro ka dila wuu.>>
5Mi daanika po mi kaari kama a wi Naawen, ate wa tulisi mu a vari mu a basi. 6Naawen a bo le mu kama, m kan chali yɔgsummoa. Ka boa ate nurubiik a baga a nye mi? 7Naawen a bo le mu kama, wa ka m maarɔ. Mi ale nya m dachaasaŋa ale ka nakdeka.
8Fi dan suk fidek Naawen jigi a zunchoŋ fi le ta sebchakka ale nurubiik kama. 9Fi dan suk fidek Naawen jigi a zunchoŋ fi le ta sebchakka ale nabisa kama. 10Tɛŋsaŋa meena a gilim mi kama, alege Naawen yuenni nyiŋ gebi ba basi. 11Ba gilim mi kama jigi meena, alege Naawen yuenni nyiŋ gebi ba basi. 12Ba nye ka kukuluk a gilim mi ase see la, alege ba kpi nna nwuli ase munsa ba ju la, Naawen yuenni nyiŋ gebi ba basi.
13Ba tusi mi a ta ga ŋaaŋ ate mi boro ayen m lo, alege Naawen a maari mi. 14Naawen ka m pagrim ale m yiili, wa chim ka m varibasika.
15Suipeentik ale nakdeka ale a nuem wayɔrisima nyama viitaŋa po, <<Naawen juga nisaŋa a tom ka wa kpiema.>> 16Naawen juga nisaŋa a zak ka ŋmai. Naawen juga nisaŋa a tom ka wa kpiema.
17M kan kpi alege m le boro kama, a mooli Naawen ale nye diila. 18Naawen a namsi mi kama chekki, alege wa an pai mu a te kummoa.
19Lagri wayɔrisima tuoku a te mu, m le jo a pai jiam a te Naawen. 20Naawen tuoku ale nna kuui ate wayɔrisima nyama a va a jo la. 21M le te jiam, diila fi tulisi mu kama, fi chim ka m varibasika.
22Tintain dii ate seerɔma a zɛri la dila ale chim nyubini gugoruku tintain, 23ka Naawen ale nye kude, ku be ka wakperikaliik ti nina po. 24Dai dii dai ate Naawen a nye la ale nna, ni basi ate ti a naŋ abe ti sue a peenti.
25Naawen yaa, vari ti a basi, Naawen yaa, basi ate ti nya tidek. 26Niaka a bo waai ale cheena Naawen yuenni nyiŋ la. Ti a niak fu a nyini Naawen yenni po.
