6Ka wana ale la a nyini gɔnni a cheena ase nyuisa ale a jueli wen nna dek dek la ate nyum a nye ase ŋan baai nyum ale masa la ate ba pai geruŋdɔ ŋanta a nye? 7Solomon ale cheena, a ji wa naam zukpaglika zuk, tugurik tɔŋdɔba pisiyuebi ale a vi wa ŋaaŋ, Izirali tugurik tɔŋdɔ naliŋsa. 8Ba meena a yik ka gebisa, ba meena a sebi ka kpaliŋ nyeka, waai meena a su ka gebik wa gauŋ, a gomsi magsi yok ba nin siti ba.
9Naab Solomon a nye ka naam zukpaglik a te wadek, wa pai ka Lebanon daata a nye. 10Ka daataŋa wa nye ale ka kpana, naŋsaŋa kieŋa a chim ligmɔniŋ. Ka kalika jigini a pai garuk naliŋ a nye, ate Jerusalem lieba a yɔk. 11Ni nyini, nama Zayon liema, a nya naab Solomon ale vuk naam zutɔkka la, zutɔk kaai ate wa mawa a pai vuk wa wa powa faarika danni la, dai dii dai ate wa suinni a peenti la.

Title: YAALIKA 4
Content:
1Nya fi le nala dii yaa, m dek nɔŋŋoa! Aao, fi le nala dii yaa! Fi ninaŋa garuk nyaara nyaaraŋa po a nyaksi ale ka yaalika. Fi zuisaŋa a nye ase bua boari ale nyini Gilead Guuku zuk a siŋ la. 2Fi nyinaŋa a peenti ase ka piisa ate ba che ŋa kɔbta a sugri la. Kunyi an bɛ ya, ŋa meena a magsi ka chaab chappi. 3Fi nɔngbanvaataŋa a nye ase ka garucha mɔnuŋ la, ti le nala dii ase fi nin boro a biisi. Fi tapayaasaŋa a nyaksi kama garuk nyaara nyaaraŋa po.
4Fi ŋinni a nye ase ka Deevid kiani la a vili ale solisi, ale ŋiri baŋ ase ŋanchɔgsinta tusidi ale yik du a gilim la. 5Fi biisaŋa a nye ase ka walisa la, kab yibsa ale za wupuuta po a dɛ la. 6Mi ale bo zauŋ kunuŋ guuku zuk, ŋan baai nyum ale masa la guuku zuk, ate saluik vayɔgsummu a ga fuk ate legini a muriŋ bɛ. 7Fi nala ka meena, m nɔŋŋoa. Kaasuŋ a ka fi jigi ya.
8Va mu a nyini Lebanon, m pok fiaga, va mu a nyini Lebanon. Nyini Amana guuku zuk a siŋ, a nyini Senir guuku ale Yermon guuku zuk a siŋ, juijui ate gbeŋmaŋa ale yɔŋma a boro la. 9Fi zu mi suinummu kama, m dek tua, m pok fiaga. Fi zu mi suinummu kama ale fi ninaŋa ale chiak nya mi bunyi la, ale fi ŋinni baŋ yeŋ dekki.
10Fi yaalika a peenti ka m sui, m dek tua, m pok fiaga. Fi yaalika a ta suipeentik yega a gaam daam, ate fi kpaamu nyummu a gaam ŋan baai nyum ale masa la. 11Fi nɔngbanvaataŋa a lɔnsi ka masim ase samparima la, m pok fiaga, biisim ale siita ale bo fi giŋgeluŋku tɛŋ. Fi gattaŋa nyummu a nye ase ka Lebanon la.
12Fi a nye ase ka kaduk kaai ale suk, m dek tua, m pok fiaga, fi ka bulik kaai ale ligi, vili dii ale ligi. 13Fi tiisaŋa a nye ase yɔn gilima ti boari la, a yɔni yɔn maŋsa, ale a nye ase kpa buui nyum ale masa la, 14yaase ŋan baai meena nyum ale masa la. 15Fi ka kaduk po bulik, vili dii ate nyiam a buli a nyini Lebanon a siŋ a jam.
16Vaari yiti, wiiluk geŋ viowa, a jam, yeseok geŋ viowa. Fuk m kadukka zuk ate ka nyummu a waaŋ jigi meena. Basi ate m nɔŋku a jam jo wa kadukka po a lam ka yɔn maŋsaŋa.

Title: YAALIKA 5
Content:
1Mi jam jo ka m kadukka po, m dek tua, m pok fiaga. Mi tigsi m zaankuŋku ale ŋan baai nyum ale masa la kama. Mi dɛ m samparimaŋa ale m siitaŋa kama, mi nyu m daamu ale m biisimu kama. Ni dɛ, m doaba, abe le nyu, ni nyu chak, m nɔŋta.
2Mi goa kama alege mi suinum po mi yiti kama. Wom, mi nɔŋku a nak kama. Lak te mu, m dek tua, m nɔŋŋoa, m nangbaŋŋa, m dek waai ale kan ta kaasuŋ la. Mi zukku a yɔk ale ka maglim, m zuisaŋa a mooŋ ale yokku pikka. 3Mi yeeri m garukku kama. Ku a fɛ ayen m ŋman jo ku yaa? Mi sugri m naŋsaŋa kama. Ku a fɛ ayen m ŋman daŋ si yaa? 4Mi nɔŋku a pai ka wa nisa a yik tuoku, ate mi sui a peenti wa le moata la. 5Mi jam gomsi kama ayen m te ti wa jo. Mi nisaŋa a tiri zaankuŋ, mi nandubsaŋa a tiri zaankuŋ nyiam ase mi ale yik tuoku ja yigimu la.
6Mi yaa jam lak te m nɔŋku, alege mi nɔŋku a cheŋ, wa jam cheŋ. Mi suinum a daani wa le cheŋ la. Mi yaa jam gisi wa alege an nya wa. Mi jam wi wa alege wa an tulisi ya. 7Limisidɔma yaa nya ase ba le jam a gilim tɛŋ nummu la. Ba nak mi, ba te mi mula, ba yeeri mi garukku ta cheŋ, parisaŋa limisidɔ bala. 8Ni puulim te mu, Jerusalem lieba. Ni dan nya m nɔŋku, ni le weeni mu ayen ka boa? Ni weeni wa ayen yaalika a basi kama ate mi cha.
9Fi le a yaali waai la a zunchoŋ mbala ka sɛ, fi nala a gaam ka nipooba meena? Fi le a yaali waai la a nye ka sɛ a zunchoŋ mbala, ate ti a te fu ti puulimka?
10Mi nɔŋku a nala kama ale pagra, wa ka wanyi tusa pi (10,000) po. 11Wa zukku a nye ase ka ligmɔniŋ weleŋ la, wa zuisaŋa a yuk, a sob ase tagaaruk la. 12Wa ninaŋa a nala kama ase nangbaŋsa ale bo beli naŋsa nyiam nɔi la, nangbaŋsa ale sugri si dek biisim po a za beli naŋ nɔi la. 13Wa tapayaasaŋa a nye ase ŋan baai nyum ale masa la gaduata a ta nyum nyiini. Wa nɔngbanvaataŋa a nye ase ka wupuuta ate zaankuŋ a zi. 14Wa nisimaŋa ka ligmɔniŋ doa a nye ale tintain salima. Wa nyiŋka a nye ase ka yauk nyin ale salisi la a ŋmirisi ale tintain sobta.
15Wa naŋsaŋa a nye ase ka tintain mɔnta zaŋŋa a za ligmɔniŋ weleŋ zuk la. Wadek a nye ase ka Lebanon nyunyoŋta ate ba luk yeeri la. 16Wa nɔnni dek potim ka masim nyiini, wa wari meena mi a yaali kama. Mi nɔŋku ale nna, mi doawa de, Jerusalem liebaa.

Title: YAALIKA 6
Content:
1Fi nɔŋku a cheŋ ka bɛ, waai ale nala a gaam nipooba meena la? Fi nɔŋku a cheem va ka suik boa ate ti le fu a gisi wa?
2Mi nɔŋku a cheŋ siŋ ka wa kadukka, wa ŋan baai nyum ale masa gaduataŋa, ayen wa piisaŋa a dɛ abe wa tigsi wupuuta. 3Mi ka m nɔŋku ate mi nɔŋku a chim mi, wa piisaŋa a dɛ wupuutaŋa po.
4Fi nala kama, m sambuliyaa ase Tirza la, a nala ase Jerusalem la, a ta pagrim ase tugurik tɔŋdɔba ale ta tikti ba la. 5Viriŋ fi ninaŋa mi jigi, ŋa a dari mu kama. Fi zuisaŋa a nye ase bua boari ale nyini Gilead guuku zuk a siŋ la. 6Fi nyinaŋa a nye ase ka pa boari ale nyini sugrika a jueli cheen la. Kunyi meena a ta ku yibik kama. Kuui an chim ku dek ku nyiini. 7Fi tapayaasaŋa a nyaksi kama garuk nyaara nyaaraŋa po. 8Basi ate naawa a ta naab pooba pisiyuebi, nɔŋta pinaanuŋ, nipok paaluk a ka chiina. 9Alege mi a yaali ka wanyi nyiini, wa be nala ase ka nangbaŋ la. Wa nyiini ale chim wa mawa lie, wa mawa bi poosiri. Nipooba meena a nya wa kama ale suipeentik, naab pooba ale nɔŋta a lenni ka wa pimpaukku.
10Ka wana ale la a na nyini ase varivientidi la, a nye wii ase chiika la, nna cheri ase wenbinni la, a nyaksi ase chiŋmarisa ale a vi chaab la?
11Mi siŋ jam ka ti boari suŋsuŋ ayen m nya ti bulaŋa viaka po, m nya va paalitaŋa tiisaŋa nyiŋ ale yɔn gilima tiisa ale a busum la. 12Alege ate mi a miŋ la, mi kɔrisaŋa a zaani mi ka mi nuruma naam torokoma suŋsuŋ.
13Ŋman jam, ŋman jam, Sulam denɔ, ŋman jam, ŋman jam ate ti a nya fu. Ka boa ale soa ate fi a nya Sulam denɔwa ase fi a nya Mayanaim gɔgta la?

Title: YAALIKA 7
Content:
1Nya fi le ka nipokbili naliŋ dii. Nya fi naŋtaaŋa ale nala dii nuesaŋa po. Fi kɔsutaŋa ale ŋmeriŋ diila a nye ase ka gobrɔ tuima la. 2Taasidi a bo dula, di kan kpeeri ale da buui nyum ale masa la. Muma bobi a bo dula, ate wupuuta a gilim. 3Fi biisaŋa a nye ase ka walik doata la, ase walik yibsa la. 4Fi ŋinni a nye ase ka yauk nyina kiari la. Fi ninaŋa a nye ase ka bela ale bo Yesbon tɛŋ nummu po la, a moata tɛŋ num kpien dila nansuiŋku. Fi nyuenni a nala ase ka Lebanon kiari ale a tuk Damasikus nyiŋla.
5Fi zukku a zak ka ŋmai ase Karmel Guuku la. Fi zui bobinsaŋa a nyaksi ase ka garuk saalik la. Ku nalimu a baga a yik naab kama chappi. 6Nya fi le nye nna pɔgtɔgi, fi le nala dii, fi yaalika mariŋka ale zuak dii. 7Fi nyiŋ diokku ale niak dii ase kpinkparuk tiib la, ate fi biisaŋa a nye ase yɔna sagi la. 8Mi ale jueli kpinkparukku a gbesi yɔnaŋa. Mi jigi fi biisaŋa a nye ase yɔna sagi la, fi vuusumu a nye ase yɔna nyum masik la, 9ate fi nɔnni a nye ase da naliŋ la. Yaa be basi ate daamu a cheŋ m nɔŋku jigi yorr, a chali va wa nɔngbanvaataŋa ale wa nyinaŋa a siŋ.
10Mi nɔŋku ale soa mi, ate wa a yaali mu. 11Jam, m nɔŋŋoa, te ti cheŋ tɛŋ kpaŋka, te ti goa yokku tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa po. 12Basi ate ti cheŋ kaduksaŋa jigini, a nya ase tiisaŋa a pusi vaata ya, ase si a busum ate yɔn gilimaŋa tiisaŋa a busum ya. Dula m le pai m yaalika a te fu. 13Fi baga a wom tiisa nyum kama, ate yɔn maŋsaŋa meena a moata ti tuoku. M nɔŋŋoa, mi dueni ka mariŋ kpak ale mariŋ paalib meena a magsi fu.

Title: YAALIKA 8
Content:
1Mi a yaali fi daam ti ka mi tua, ate fi ŋoosi mi mawa biisaŋa. Ate m yaa dan jam tu fu suiku po abe m gbaari fu ate waai niŋ a kan boro. 2M le ta fu cheŋ m mawa yenni juijui ate fi baga a sak mi yaalika. M le te fu da buui nyum ale masa, m yɔn gilimaŋa daamu ate fi nyu. 3M zukku a kpagli ka fi gala nisaŋa ate fi juga nisaŋa a baari mu. 4Ni puulim a te mu, Jerusalem lieba, ate ni kan kaasi ti yaalika.
5Ka wana ale la a nyini gɔnni a cheena a sali wa nɔŋku. Yɔnaŋa tiimu tɛŋ mi nak fu a yiti kama, juijui ate ba biak fu la. 6Kan lak fi suinummu a te waai ya alege ka mi nyiini. Kan yik waai nisa ka mi nyiini. Yaalika a pagra ase ka kum la, kɔrisa a pagra ase kum dek la. Ka na a toati ka bolim ŋiak a dɛ ase bolim ale a wobri la. 7Nya boari an baga a kpimsi yaalika, bela an baga a ji ta a cheŋŋi. Waai a dan poom baga a pai wa yeri jigsika meena a tagri yaalika, ba ti le zɛri.
8Ti ta ka tua baaŋ, ate wa biisaŋa an diem gbesi ya. Ti ti nye ka boa a te ti tuawa dai dii dai ate ba biisi a te wa la? 9Wa dan ka parik ti le sɛ kpana kiaga wa zuk. Wa dan ka tuok, ti le lik wa ale nyunyoŋta daata.
10Mi ka parik, ate mi biisaŋa a chim kiaga. Wa nina po mi yaa chim ka waai ale ta nina suerika a jam. 11Solomon a ta ka kaduk jigi ate ba a wi ayen Baal Yamon. Kpaarɔba ale boro a piem wa jigi, ba wanyi a tuni ka kpana ligbie tusidi. 12Alege mi dek kadukka ka mi ale soa ayen m pai a te, ligbie tusini ka fi Solomon ale soa, ate ligbie kobsiye a magsi baai ale a nya yɔnaŋa zuk la.
13Nama baai ale bo kaduksaŋa po ale ni doama la ni te ate m wom ni lueluk.
14Jam mi jigi, m nɔŋŋoa ase walik la, ase walik paalik ale bo gu tii zuk ate wuuk tii nyum ale masa a nyini du la.

Title: AZAYA 1
Content:
1Azaya waai ale jam ka Amoz nidoabili la, gɔdaasimaŋa ate wa jam nya a ta va Juda ale Jerusalem zuk la. Diipo ate Yuzaya a dɛ naam Juda tɛŋka po ale pa te Jotam ate wa mɛ a pai te Ayazi ate wa mɛ a pai te Azekaya la.
2Wenŋmazuk dem ale tɛŋzuk de dem meena abe wom. Ale ka Naawen ale biisi, <<Mi wuuk bisa ate ba chim a pak alege ba zɛri mi nɔi. 3Lalik jeeŋ a seba ka nyɔnɔ kama, ate boniŋ a seba ka nyɔnɔ. Alege mi nuruma Izirali demma a zɛ mi, ba poom kan miŋ mi kiri ya.>>
4Wabaata tɛŋ, nuruba ate kaasuŋ a sueri ba, bimbaansa ale pai badek a te kaasuŋ. Ba zɛri Naawen kama, ale ŋman banti waai ale welema wadek wa nyiini a bo Izirali la, ba cheem ba ŋaaŋsa a te wa.
5Boan nyiŋ ate ba ŋman a nak fu? Boan ate fi a kasim a nye tukpari ya? Fi zukku po meena a ta ka mula. Fi suinummu po meena a sueri ale ka daanika. 6A zaani fi naŋsaŋa a ga paari fi zukku, suiyɔgni a karo, ka mula ale nira ŋaai ale zuak la, ale bo fi nyiŋka po, ate ba an sugri ŋa. Ba an pai garuk pala a bobi ŋa. Ba an poom pai kpaam a sa ayen ŋa mooŋ.
7Ni tɛŋka a kaasi kama. Bolim ale dɛ ni tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa. Nicham ale vari ni ŋankpaantaŋa ni tattaŋa po nidek nina po. Ba tuesi jaab meena ni tɛŋka po kama ate ka doa koruk ase nicham ale nak a yiak ni la. 8Zayon Liewa a nye ase ka viuk kuui ale za kaduk po ku dek ku nyiini la. Yaase viuk kuui ale za ŋanta laŋ po ku dek ku nyiini la. Wa a nye ase ka tɛŋ kaai ate ba gilim ayen ba nye kpaliŋ ale ka la. 9Dan kan daa ka Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale basi ate ti ba gela a vua, tama ate le nye ase ka Sodom ale Gomora la.
10Ni wom Naawen wanni, nama Sodom niŋdeerɔma. Ni wom ti Wen sinsaŋŋa, nama Gomora nuruma. 11<<Ni kaab boanni, kiri ale boa a te mi?>> Ka Naawen ale a weeni ayen, <<Mi ta zuak a gaam juka tiirita kama, a ŋman ta a gaam padaasa ale duŋ sii ale biigi la kama. Mi sui a kan peenti ale lalik koluta ale piisa ale bua ziita. 12Ni nyiem ale jam mi niŋ la, ka wana ale bek jaab a nyini ni jigi ya, ate ni basi ate ŋantaŋa de a nyiem mi yenni po? 13Ni basi tiirim tii ale kan ta kiri la ta jamka. Mi a kisi ni ŋan baai nyum ale masa ate ni ju a te mi la kama. Ni a kpesi Chi Paalisa tiŋŋa ale Vuusum Daaŋa ale chaab gumka tiŋŋa. Alege mi a kan baga a bo ale ni, dii nyiŋla biem ale bo ni suŋsuŋ. 14Mi a kisi ni Chi Paalisa tiŋŋa ale tiga ŋaai ate ni lueri la kama. Ŋa chim ka jibta a te mi. Mi jiak ale ŋa taka kama. 15Ni dan zak ni nisima a boro a puusi, mi ale suk m ninaŋa ni jigi. Ni dan poom a nye puusa yegayega, mi a kan wom ni. Ziim ale tiri ni nisaŋa. 16Ni so nidek ate ni nala. Ni pai ni tuimbaataŋa a ta nyini mi niŋ. Ni basi tom kaasika nyeka. 17Ni zamsi a nye dii ale nala. Ni gisi wensie abe ni a te baai ale a nam la nyiŋbiiri. Ni a maari baai ale kan ka koba la ale pukɔga ba wie po.
18<<Ni jam yɔgyɔgla de ate ti poli ale chaab.>> Naawen a weeni ayen, <<Ni wabaataŋa a dan muni, ti ale peenti nna tektek. Ti dan poom muni, ti ale peenti ase kɔb peeta la. 19Ase ni daa yaali ale a wom mi nɔi, ni ale dɛ ŋan maŋsa tɛŋka po. 20Alege nama a dan zɛri mi nɔi ale nye tukpari, ba ale ko ni ale gebik.>> Naawen ale pai wa nɔi a biisi.
21Ni nya wensie tɛŋ kpieŋka a yaa le chim taabuk la! Wa jam chim ka waai ale jam ta wensie. Wayɔrisima a jam bo wa po kama. Alege yɔgyɔgla de ba yaa ka nuru koorisa. 22Ni kpanaŋa a ka kiri ya. Ba pai ka nyiam a dam daam buui ate ni a yaali la. 23Ni kpaŋŋa a nye ka tukpari, ba gum ka chaab ale zueba. Ba meena tuesi ka ŋan baai ale kan magsi ba tuesika la a nyini nuruba jigi ale kasim a vi nuruba a yaali tiirita. Ba kan maari baai ale kan ta koba la ba wie po. Pukɔga wie a kan jam ba jigi ya. 24Dila nyiŋ Nyɔnɔwa, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, Waai Ale Ka Izirali Tanjaŋini La ale a weeni ayen, <<Mi ale nya vuusum a nyini m dachaasaŋa jigi abe m namsi m dachaasaŋa. 25Mi ale viriŋ a ta chaab ale ni. Mi ale yeeri ŋan baai ale kan ta kiri la ni po ale ni ŋan baai meena ale kan welema la. 26Mi ale ŋman pilim a pai wensie boteerɔba a te ni ase ku ale jam chim dii a nyini piilimka po la. Mi ale te ni baai ale ba a sak ni nyeboka wieŋa la ase ku daam ale ka diila. Dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ ba ale wi ni ayen tɛŋ kpieŋ dem baai ale ka Wayɔrisima Tɛŋ dem ale Wensie Tɛŋ kpieŋ.>>
27Zayon ale va nyemagsika nyiŋ a nya datuesika. Baai ale siak ba kaasuŋ la ale va wayɔrisima nyiŋ a nya datuesika. 28Alege tukpari ale wabanyeerisa ale waaŋ chaab, baai ale zɛri Naawen la a za ba kpi kama.
29<<Kiŋkaŋ peruk weleŋsaŋa ate ni ta suipeentik si nyiŋla, chivie ale yik ni. Tattaŋa ate ni lueri la nyiŋ, chivie ale yik ni. 30Ni za ni nye ase ka kinkaŋ peruk vaata ale kɔ la. Ni a nye ase ka talim buui ale kan ta nyiam la. 31Nuru pagrɔwa ale nye ase ka wukosik la, wa tuimaŋa mɛ a nye ase ka chesik la, ba meena bolim ale dɛ ba ate waai a kan boro a kpimsi bu.>>

Title: AZAYA 2
Content:
1Amoz nidoabinni Azaya ale nya dii a ta va Juda ale Jerusalem zuk la ale nna. 2Dai kpeglimaŋa po, Naawen yenni guuku ale zaani ase naab la guutaŋa po. Ku ale yiti ŋmai a gaam guutaŋa, ate tɛŋsa meena ale chuiri a cheŋ ku jigi.
3Nuru boari ale jam a weeni ayen, <<Ni jam ate ti jueli Naawen guuku, ti jueli Jekob Wen yenni. Wa ale sak ti Wa suitaŋa ate ti baga a cheŋ ti po.>> Wa sinsaŋŋa ale nyini Zayon a cheŋ. Ate Naawen wanni ale nyini Jerusalem. 4Wa le bo tɛŋsa suŋsuŋ buusa. Wa le yik nuru boari wie a yomsi. Ba ale kuri ba gebisaŋa a nye niiga kua. Ba gbattaŋa ale labri a chim gebisa ate ba pai a yoarisi tiisa. Tɛŋ a kan pai gebik a ta chaab ale tɛŋ ka choa, yaase ba ŋman sak badek a magsi kpaliŋ diipo diipo.
5Jekob dɔkdemma abe jam ate ti cheŋ Naawen bolimu po.
6Fi zɛri fidek nuruma Jekob dɔkdemma kama. A nyini Kori geŋsa, ku kasim a sueri ale ka kperisa tuima. Ba a tom ka sampoporinni tuima ase Filistia demma la, ale a nak ba nisima ale baai ale kan seba Wen la. 7Ba tɛŋka a sueri ale ka kpana ale ligmɔniŋ. Ba tuilum ŋantaŋa a ka kpeglimka. Ba torokoma a ka kpeglimka. 8Ba tɛŋka a sueri ale ka bɔgta. Ba a koori ka tɛŋ a zuli ba nisima tuimaŋa, a zuli ba nandubsaŋa ale nye ŋan baai la. 9Dila Naawen ale te nuru siŋ tɛŋ ate nurubiik a zaab wadek. Kan vua a te ba.
10Ni cheŋ pinaŋa po, ni suk tɛŋka po a nyini Naawen kpazinagsuku po ale wa naamu nalimu po. 11Nuru waai ale a nya wadek nna se wa gaam nuruba la ale zaab wadek, ate kanjanta nyam ale siŋ tɛŋ. Ka Naawen nyiini ale za wa nya zakzaanika da dila danni.
12Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La a lueri ka dai a magsi kanjanta nyam ale kayeruk nyam ale zak badek a zaani la, ba meena ale zaab badek. 13Wa lueri ka dai a magsi Lebanon nyunyoŋtaŋa meena ale woŋŋa ale ta kayeruk la ale Basan kinkaŋpettaŋa meena. 14Guuk woŋta ale guuk tii ale jueli la meena ale 15yie ŋaai ale sɛ jueli wen la ale parik pagrik meena ale 16Tarsis ŋaaruŋ meena ale ŋaaruŋ naluŋ meena. 17Nurubiik kanjantaŋa ale siŋ tɛŋ ate nurubisa ale zaab badek ale ba kanjantaŋa. Ka Naawen nyiini ale za wa soa zakzaanika da dila danni. 18Ate bɔgta meena ale muriŋ bɛ.
19Nurubisa ale chali a jo pina vie ale tɛŋka vieŋa po, dii nyiŋla Naawen kpazinagsuk ale wa naamu nalimu nyiŋ. Wa ale yiti kama a choa tɛŋka. 20Da dila danni nuruba ale yuk ba bɔgtaŋa tii ate ba pai kpana ale ligmɔniŋ a nye ayen ba a puusi la a te ŋooma ale kpinkpirinsa. 21Ba ale yiti a jo vie pinaŋa po ale pina ŋaai ale yik wen a churinti la po, a nyini Naawen kpazinagsuk ale wa naamu nalimu nyiŋ, wa ale yiti kama a choa tɛŋka.
22Kan mariŋ nuru biiga, waai ale ta vuusum wa nyuevie po la, wa ka boa?

Title: AZAYA 3
Content:
1Yɔgyɔgla de ni nya, Nyɔnɔwa, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, a za wa tuesi Jerusalem ale Juda jigi ŋan baai ate wa a te ale a maari la kama. Wa le basi ŋandiintaŋa ale nyiamu teka meena. 2Nuru tuaka ale tugurik tɔŋdɔwa ale boteerɔwa ale biisiteerɔwa ale baanɔwa ale nisɔmawa, 3nuruba pisinu kpagni ale nuru waai ale ta kpaŋta la ale sagrɔwa ale gobrɔ waai ale seba nisa tuima la ale sampoporik sebrɔ.
4Mi ale basi ate nidoabilisa a chim ba kpaga. Bi fiisa ale nya ba zuk. 5Nuruba ale namsi chaab, nidoa ale ta chaab ale wa choa, ate kali mɔtidɔ ale ta chaab ale wa choa. Bi paaluk ale yiti a ta chaab ale ŋankpagsa. Nuru baai ale kan ta zula la ale yiti a ta chaab ale baai ale ta zula la.
6Nuru ale yiti a yik wa suata po wanyi wa ko yeri po ayen. <<Fi ale ta garuk la nyiŋ, chim ti niŋdeerɔ. Be soa ŋan baai meena ale kaasi la zuk a nya.>> 7Alege da dila danni wa ale kaari a weeni ayen, <<Mi zɛ mi ale m nye diila. Mi ka ŋandiinta yaase gatta m yenni po, kan nye mu ate m chim nuruba niŋdeerɔ.>>
8Jerusalem a ja kama, Juda a lo kama. Ba wieŋa ale ba tuima a nye a kaasi ka Naawen ale a taŋ wa zulaŋa. 9Fi dan nya ba ninaŋa po, ku ale sum a sak fu ayen ba sum nye kaasi kama. Ba a tigsi ba wabaataŋa ase ka Sodom tɛŋka demma la. Ba kan suk bu. Ku ale toa a te ba. Ba ta ka kaasuŋ a jam badek zuk.
10Weeni wayɔrisima nyama ayen ku ale niak a te ba. Ba ale dɛ masim a ta va ba tuimaŋa ŋanta nyiŋ. 11Ku ale toa a te gaasa nyam. Kaasuŋ ale jam ba zuk. Ba ale nya ba ale pai ba nisimaŋa a tom tuim ŋaai la tutuna.
12Bi paalukku a namsi mi nuruma, ate nipooba mɛ ta pagrim a nya ba zuk. Mi nuru baai ale a dɛ ni niŋ la a ta ni a cheŋ a bɛ kama. Ba basi suiku kama.
13Naawen a kali wa kalika jigini boteka yenni po kama. Wa abe yiti kama ayen wa bo nuruma buusa. 14Naawen abe boro ayen wa bo nisɔmma ale wa nuruma niŋdeerɔma buusa. <<Ka nama ale kaasi mi kadukka. Ale ŋman pai ŋanjaksaŋa ŋantaŋa a basi ni yeeŋa po. 15Boan nyiŋ ate ni a kaasi mi nuruma ale ŋman a num ŋanjaksaŋa nina?>> Nyɔnɔwa, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni dila.
16Naawen ale weeni ayen, <<Zayon nipooma a ta ka kanjanta. Ba chelim po, ba a yeeri ka ba ŋieŋa a sak. Ba nyiem nya nidoaba kama a cheŋ koarisa chelim ale su baŋsa ba naŋsa po ate si a nak chaab a kum. 17Dila nyiŋla, Nyɔnɔwa ale basi ate nira a nye Zayon nipooma zuimaŋa. Naawen ale basi ate ba zuisa a kpa.>>
18Da dila danni Nyɔnɔwa ale vari ba ŋan baai ale nala la ba jigi. Bala ale baŋsa ale ŋan baai ale a vili zuima ale ŋiri baŋsa, 19ale tukpana ale nisɔgi baŋsa ale garuk nyaara nyaara, 20ale zuk kɔlima ale karik chɔrima ale chiak garuk pali ale kpa masik kolima ale koarisa ŋan juenta ale 21yue nifelima ale nyue nifelima ale 22garuk naliŋsa ale garuk woŋta ale garuk gelisa foata ale 23nyaasuŋta ale garuk pa naliŋsa ale zuk jakpiim ale garuk viinta.
24Ku ale magsi ku chim nyum masik la ku le chim ka nyum biok, ku le magsi ku chim garuk pali la ku le chim ka miik, ku ale magsi ku chim zuisa la ku le chim ka zuk kpaauŋ. Ate garuk naluŋ ale chim boorik garuk, ku le magsi ku chim nalim la ku le chim ka chivie. 25Gebik ale lɔnsi fi nidoama tɛŋ ate fi tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale kpi kpaliŋ po. 26Zayon nansuiŋtaŋa ale fɔbili abe ba a kum. Wa za wa kali ka tɛŋka wa kan ta jaaboa.

Title: AZAYA 4
Content:
1Dai dila danni, nipooba bayopɔi ale yik nidoa yeŋ a weeni wa ayen, <<Tama ale dɛ tidek ŋandiinta abe ti yaali tidek gatta a jɔ, fi tin siak ate ti a wi fu ayen ti chorɔ. Ate dila ale lik tama chivieŋa.>>
2Dai dila danni, Naawen Tiib Naŋ ale ta nalim ale zula, ate tɛŋka yɔnaŋa ale chim baai ale vuuk la kanjanta ale zula Izirali tɛŋka po. 3Baai ale tali a bo Zayon la ale baai mɛ ale diem bo Jerusalem la, ba ale wi ba ayen nuru weleŋsa. Ale baai ate ba ŋmarisi ba yueŋa a nyo ŋanvutaŋa po Jerusalem la. 4Nyɔnɔwa ale sugri Zayon nipooma daŋtaŋa a basi. Wa ale pai buusa boka chiik ale bolim chiik a duisi ziim buui ale maŋ Jerusalem la a basi. 5Ate Naawen ale nye ate chiŋmari ale nyuisa a bo Zayon Guuku ale baai ale tigsi dula la zuk kantueŋ abe bolim ŋiak a bo ba zuk yok. Viuk ale ku bo zulaŋa meena zuk. 6Ku ale chim ka kusuŋ ale yɔgsum jigi ate kantueŋ kaa nak ba, ale varibasika ale sukka jigi ate vioku ale ŋmorukku kaa paari ba.

Title: AZAYA 5
Content:
1Mi ale yi yiili a te waai ate mi a yaali la. Wa kadukka wari yiili. Mi ale a yaali waai la a ta ka kaduk, ate ka poak a bo guuku geŋ. 2Wa tu tɛŋka kama a yeeri tana ŋaai ale boro la, alege a yaa vuk tiisa sii ate wa a yaali la. Wa sɛ ka yeri ate di woŋŋa kadukka po ale ŋman nye daam ŋmiaka jigi. Wa jam a gisi ka tiib sii ale ta yɔn maŋsa la, alege si meena a jam yɔni ka yɔn baata.
3Yɔgyɔgla de, nama baai ale bo Jerusalem la ale nidoa baai ale bo Juda la, ni weeni dii ale bo mi ale m kadukka suŋsuŋ la. 4Ka boa ate mi ale nye a te m kadukka a ŋman gaam mi ale nye diila? Mi ale a gisi yɔn ŋaai ale nala la, ka boan nyiŋ ate si yɔni yɔn baata? 5Yɔgyɔgla de, mi ale weeni ni. Mi ale za m nye m kadukka diila. Mi ale yeeri ka geruku a basi ate ka kaasi. Mi ale nak ka siaka a lɔnsi tɛŋ, ate ba ale tabi ka zuk. 6Mi ale nye ate tɛŋka a kan ta kiri ya, m kan ŋman yoarisi tiisaŋa naŋsaŋa yaase m kpa ka po. Mi ale basi ate ŋankayaata ale muŋsa a nyini tɛŋka zuk. Mi ale weeni chiŋmaaŋa ate ŋmoruk a kan ni ka po.
7Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La kadukka ka Izirali yenni ale Juda nidoama a chim kaduk ate wa mariŋ. Ate wa jam a gisi nyemagsika, alege wa taam goanti a nya ziim nyinika. Wa jam a yaali ka wayɔrisima alege wa goanti wom nyiŋdomma kumsa.
8Ku ale toa a te ni, nama baai ale pai nuruba yie a gum yeeŋa po la ale pai tɛŋsa a gum tɛŋsa po la, ate ku ga paari diipo ate peelim an ŋman tali la, ate nidek ni nyiini bo tɛŋka po la.
9Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La a weeni kama ate mi a wom wa ayen, <<Chekki yie ŋaai ale zuak la ale kaasi, ate yie kpiema ŋaai ale nala tali la nuruba a kan bo ŋa po. 10Yinkiba pi kaduk tiisa ale te ka daam samɔniŋ yeŋ ate ŋanbie boorik a te ka ŋanbie taasi kpien nyiini.>>
11Ku ale toa ate nama baai ale a yiti saluik yokyok chali a vi daam la, ale nama baai nyiem ale bo daam nyuka po a ga paari yok diipo a buk la. 12Ba ta ka kpanta ale bagansa ale kayaksa ale paampuuŋta ale daam ba ŋandiinta tiŋŋa po, alege ba niŋ ka Naawen tuimaŋa po, ba ka zula a te wa nisa tuimaŋa. 13Dila nyiŋ, ba ale yik m nuruma a ta cheŋ tɛŋ yoŋ po, ba ale a silim miŋka la nyiŋ. Ba nuru baai ale ta kpaŋta la, ale kpi ale kom, ate nyanyuila ale ko ba nuru boanni. 14Dila nyiŋla, vɔrumu a basi kama ate bu koarisaŋa a zuak ate bu lak bu nɔnni nna yegayega. Ba kpaŋŋa ale nuru boanni ale siŋ bu po ale ba wɔkwɔk nyama ale baai ale a dɛ masim la meena. 15Dila nyiŋ nuru meena ale siŋ tɛŋ ate nurubiik ale zaab wadek, ate kanjanta nyam ale zaab badek. 16Alege Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale nya zak zaanka wa nyemagsika nyiŋ, ate tuilum Wenni ale sak wa tuilummu a ta va wa wayɔrisimaŋa nyiŋ. 17Ate piisa ale ŋɔbi wuyɔgsuk ase ka ŋa dɛka jigi la. Ate pabisa ale dɛ jigsirɔma ŋan kaasuŋta po.
18Ku ale toa a te baai ale pai pimpaasima miik a dari wabiok la, ale baai mɛ ale pai miik a dari gaasa la. 19A te baai ale a weeni ayen, <<Basi ate Wen a nye nwuli, basi ate wa tom wa tuini nwuli ate ti nya. Basi ate ku forisi a paari. Basi ate Waai Ale Welema A Bo Izirali La zɔŋŋa a jam, ate tama a seba.>>
20Ku ale toa a te baai ale a wi biem ayen nalim ale a wi nalim ayen biem la ale baai ale pai legi a chim bolim la, ate bolim a chim legi la ale baai ale pai ŋan tuasa a chim ŋan masa la, ate ŋan masa a chim ŋan tuasa la.
21Ku ale toa a te baai ale ta yam badek nimbie po la ale baai mɛ ale seba wie badek nina po la.
22Ku ale toa a te nuru baai ale so ale daam la, ale baai ale kperi ale daam damka la, 23baai ale a tuesi ŋanta a nyini baai ale tom kaasi la jigi a nyiem le basi ba la, alege a kan pai nyemagsika a te baai ale kan seba wari nɔi po la. 24Dila nyiŋla, ase bolim ŋiak ale a dɛ kinkaa ale wukosik diila, dila tɛŋ naŋsaŋa ale poak, ate viok ale ji wupuutaŋa a ta cheŋ ase nyuŋ la. Dii nyiŋla, ba zɛri Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La sinsaŋŋa kama, ale ŋman zɛri Waai Ale Welema A Bo Izirali La wanni. 25Dila nyiŋla, Naawen sui ale a puuri ale wa nuruma. Wa zak ka wa nisaŋa wen a yaa a nak ba a lɔnsi. Guutaŋa a choa kama ate baai ale kpi la a nye ase yaata ale doa suitaŋa po diila. Kula ŋaaŋnyiŋ meena, wa suipuurumu an basi ya, wa nisaŋa a diem bo ka ŋmai.
26Wa a zak ka tikti ayen tɛŋ sii ale yalima la a jam wa jigi, ale ŋman fiili fiiluk a wi baai ale bo tɛŋka kpeglimka la ayen ba jam. Ba abe sum jam kama, ba kpabi kama a jam nna a wuli. 27Ba waai an poom jiak ya, yaase wa nak naŋŋa. Ba wanyi mɛ an goa a jɔgsi ya yaase wa poom a goa ya. Ba waai chiak gbaŋ an foli a nyini wa chiaka po. Ba waai nuensiri an poom a kaasi ya. 28Ba timaŋa peemaŋa a choarisi kama, ate ba gbeeri ba timaŋa meena a magsi tɔŋka. Ba wusumaŋa naŋsabaŋa a pagra ase tintana la. Ba wusuma torokoma naŋsaŋa a nye ase ka va pagrik la. 29Ba wuurika a nye ase ka gbeŋli la, ba a wuuri ase ka gbeŋ paala la. Ŋa a ŋuuni kama ase ŋa ale yik jaab ate nuru karo a vari wa a basi la. 30Dai dila danni, ŋa ale wuuri ka zuk ase ka nyakpiemu wuurika la. Ate a waai a dan nya tɛŋka, wa ale nya ka legi ale namsika. Ate ba dan poom tɔti bolim, chiŋmaaŋa ale lik bu ate ku chim legi.

Title: AZAYA 6
Content:
1Bein diipo ate Naab Yuzaya a kpi la, mi a nya Nyɔnɔwa ale wa kala naam zukpaglik zuk nna wenwen ya a ta zula. Ate wa garukku noaŋa a pati lik Wen yenni. 2Naawen maarɔ baai ale ta kpaŋta wenŋmazuk la a yaa za Wen ŋmazuk geŋ. Maarɔma wanyi meena a jam ta ka kinkaŋŋa ŋayuebi. Ba a jam pai ka kinkaŋŋa ŋaye a lik ba ninaŋa, ale pai kinkaŋŋa ŋaye a lik ba naŋsaŋa, ale pai kinkaŋŋa ŋaye a yiti. 3Ate ba yaa a wi chaab a weeni ayen, <<Weleŋsa, weleŋsa, weleŋsa ale Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La. Tɛŋka meena a sueri ale ka wa zulaŋa.>> 4Ba luelutaŋa nuemka a nye kama ate tuataŋa nakpaasaŋa ale nansuiŋku tɛŋka a choa ate Naawen yenni a sueri ale nyuisa.
5Mi yaa kaari ayen, <<Ku ale toa te mi. Mi ŋɔriŋ kama. Dii nyiŋla mi ka nuru waai nɔngbanvaata ale daŋ la, ale bo nuru baai nɔngbanvaata ale daŋ la suŋsuŋ, ate mi ninaŋa a nya Naawa, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La.>>
6Ate maarɔma po wanyi a yaa yiti jam mi jigi, wa jam pai ka jaab a chabli bolim kaali wa nisa po a nyini juka kuŋkuŋku zuk. 7Wa yaa pai tiri mi nɔngbanni ale a weeni ayen. <<Nya, kude a tiri ka fi nɔngbanvaataŋa. Wa yeeri fi foolaawa a basi kama, ale vɔŋ fi wabaataŋa a te fu.
8Ate mi yaa wom Nyɔnɔwa lueluk a weeni ayen, <<Ka wana ate mi ale tom wa? Ka wana ale wa cheŋ a te ti?>> Ate mi a yaa weeni ayen, <<Mi ale nna. Tom mu.>>
9Wa yaa weeni ayen, <<Cheŋ a ga weeni nuruma de ayen, <Ni ale kasim a wom alege ni a kan miŋ ku kiri ya. Ni ale nya alege ni kan baga a miŋ dii ate ni a nya la kiri ya. 10Nye ate nuruma de suiniimaŋa a ta gaasa. Nye ate ba tueŋa kan a wom, abe fi lik ba ninaŋa. Dan kan daa di ba ninaŋa ale nya ate ba tueŋa ale wom, ate ba nya miŋ ale ba suiniima, ate ba tulim a nya tebika.>>
11Ate mi a weeni ayen, <<M Nyɔnɔ, ku le beni soa ka sɛ?>> Ate wa a yaa tulisi mi ayen, <<Ku ale paari ka diipo ate tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa a kaasi ate nuruba a ŋman ka si po, a ŋman ga paari diipo mɛ ate nuruba a ŋman ka yeeŋa po, ate tɛŋka mɛ a kaasi ate ka kan ŋman ta kiri ya, 12ku ale ga paari ka diipo ate Naawen ale basi ate waai meena a cheŋ ate ku yalima, ate waai meena a yaa zɛri tɛŋka. 13Nuru yeŋ nuruba pi po a dan poom a tali tɛŋka zuk, ka ale diem a kaasi kama a doa kinla. Alege tiib buui ate ba che a lɔnsi la, bu kinni ale nye ase ka biri dii ale ta tuilum la a tagri a za tɛŋka zuk a ŋman pilim a chim.>>

Title: AZAYA 7
Content:
1Diipo ate Ayazi waai ale ka Jotam nidoabili la, ate wa ko kpieŋ a chim Yuzaya la, ate wa jam chim Juda naab la, Araam naawa Arezin ale Aremaliya nidoabinni Peka waai ale jam ka Izirali naab la, a yaa gɔk santiri a jueli ayen ba nye kpaliŋ ale Jerusalem, alege ba an jam baga a nak dɛ ka.
2Yɔgyɔgla de ba jam weeni Deevid yenni demma kama ayen, <<Araam a gum ka chaab ale Ɛfraim.>> Dila nyiŋ, Ayazi ale wa nuruma kpaziita yaa jam a nak, ase viok ale a fuk gɔi tiisa diila.
3Ate Naawen a yaa weeni Azaya ayen, <<Fi ale fi nidoabinni Sear Jasub a nyini peelim ate ni ga tu chaab ale Ayazi, ni ale nya wa beli fiika Nyiam Vuuku kpeglimka jigini, suik kuui ale a cheŋ Sugridɔ Laŋka jigini la. 4Weeni wa ayen, <Wa kpesi wadek, wa basi ate wa suinum a duak abe wa kan jɔk nyiŋbiiri da gelaŋa ale a duk nyuisaŋa la nyiŋŋa. Kan basi ate Araam naawa Arezin ale Aremaliya nidoabinni suipuurumu a te fu yɔgsummoa. 5Araam ale Ɛfraim niŋdeerɔwa Aremaliya nidoabinni a nye ba popola po kama ayen ba kaasi ni, ba weeni kama ayen, 6<<Ni basi ate ti fɛ a jo Juda tɛŋka po. Ni basi ate ti yik ka a lab a te chaab, abe ti nye Tabeel nidoabinni ate wa chim naab a nya ka zuk.>> 7Alege Nyɔnɔwa Naawen weeni kama ayen. <<Dila a kan nye, ku a kan tom tuini, 8dila nyiŋla Araam niŋdeerɔwa ale chim ka Damasikus, ate Damasikus mɛ niŋdeerɔwa ale chim ka Arezin nyiini. Bena pisiyuebi ale ŋanu po, Ɛfraim demma ale waaŋ ka chaab ate ba a kan ŋman baga a chim nuru yeŋsa. 9Ɛfraim niŋdeerɔwa ale Samaria, ate Samaria mɛ niŋdeerɔwa a chim Aremaliya nidoabinni nyiini. Fi a dan kan baga a zaani ale pagrim fi siaka po, fi poom kan ŋman baga a zaani.>>
10Naawen a ŋman pilim a weeni Ayazi ayen, 11<<Bek Naawen fi Wenni ate wa te fu daana dan poom ka juijui ale limisa, yaase juijui ale bo wenzuk la.>> 12Alege Ayazi a weeni kama ayen, <<Mi a kan bek wa wari ya. Mi a kan yaali ayen m nye Naawen a nya.>>
13Ate dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ Azaya a yaa weeni ayen, <<Ni abe wom yɔgyɔgla de nama Deevid dɔkdemma. Ni ale chamsi nurubisa chichiiba a nya la an zuak ya? Ni ale chamsi mi Wenni chichiiba mɛ a nya? 14Dila nyiŋla, Nyɔnɔwa dek ale te ni daana. Nipokbili dii ale kan seba nidoa la ale yik puuk a biak nidoabili. Ate ba ale wi wa ayen Immanuel. 15Wa dan ga seba a zuak a zɛri wakaasima ale a lueri wamaŋsa, wa a dɛ ka biisim goam ale siita. 16Alege ate nidoabinni a seba zuak a zɛri wakaasima a lueri wamaŋsa la, nalima ŋayewa ate fi a chali ba la tɛŋka ale doa kinla. 17Naawen ale basi kama ate daanika a jam fi ale fi nuruma jigi, ale fi kowa yenni demma jigi. Wari dii choa ale kan jam a nya la, a zaani diipo ate Ɛfraim a poori wadek a nyini Juda po la, wa ale ta ka Assiria naawa a jam ni po.>>
18Da dila danni po, Naawen ale peeri ka wiik ate nanjuŋsa ale nyini Ejipiti beli naŋsaŋa ŋaai ale yalima la a jam, ate sie ale nyini Assiria tɛŋka a jam. 19Ŋa ale jam bo ka vooliŋ sii ale churinti la jigini ale pinaŋa muulisaŋa po ale muŋsaŋa meena zuk ale nyiam vie po meena. 20Da dila danni, Nyɔnɔwa ale pai ka poniŋ kaai ate ba cheŋ gaam Benni a ga piem a ta nyini Assiria naawa jigi ayen ba poni fi zukku ale fi naŋsaŋa kɔbtaŋa ale fi teeŋsaŋa mɛ. 21Da dila danni, nuru ale ta ka naab buui ale diem paala la ale bua ŋaye. 22Ate ba le ta biisim nna yegayega la nyiŋ, wa ale nya biisim goam a dɛ kama. Baai meena ale a wari tɛŋka po la, a za ba a dɛ ka biisim goam ale siita. 23Da dila danni, jiga meena ate tiisa sii ale a yɔn yɔna ate si a paari tusidi la, ate si a da a paari kpana boorisa dobrim tusidi la, jiga ŋala meena ale labri a chim ka muŋkangɔtisa ale muŋsa. 24Nidoaba ale ta tima ale piema a cheŋ dula, dii nyiŋla muŋkangɔtisaŋa ale muŋsaŋa ale lik tɛŋka meena kama. 25Guutaŋa meena ale toalim kpa ale kui la, ni kan ŋman cheŋ dula a chali yɔgsum ale muŋkangɔtisa ale muŋsa. Ŋa ale chim ka niiga dɛka jigi ale piisa chali vaka jigi.

Title: AZAYA 8
Content:
1Naawen a yaa weeni mi ayen, <<Pai gbaŋ kpieŋ ale ja ŋmarisim a ŋmarisi ku zuk ayen Mayer Salal Yas Baz. 2Ate m le wi Yuraya ale ka kaabteerɔ la, ale Zakaria ale ka Jeberekia nidoabinni la ate ba chim wensie seerɔba a te mu.>>
3Ate mi a yaa jam cheŋ nipok biisiteerɔwa jigi, ate wa yik puuk a biak nidoabilik. Ate Naawen a weeni mi ayen. <<Te wa yuei ayen Mayer Salal Yas Baz. 4Alege ate nidoabinni a seba wa le wa nye dii a weeni ayen, <M kowa yaase m mawa,> Assiria naawa ale pai Damasikus jigsika ale Samaria ŋan baai ate ba kɔlim la a ta cheŋ.
5Naawen a ŋman weeni mi ayen, 6<<Nuruma de ale zɛri nyiam maŋ kaai ale nyini Siloa la ale a dɛ ba masim Arezin ale Aremaliya nidoabinni zuk la nyiŋ, 7dila nyiŋ, Nyɔnɔwa za wa ta ka Assiria naawa ale wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma ate ba jam ta chaab ale ba ase Benni nyaata ale mobi a pagra diila. Di ale sueri a waaŋ va di bimbimaŋa meena zuk a cheŋ 8ate bu chuiri a cheŋ Juda a vilinti a va ka zuk, a va ka po a cheŋ ale a paari ŋiri. Bu ale teeri dii ase kinkaŋŋa la ale lik ni tɛŋka labsimu la, Immanuel!
9Nama tɛŋsa demma, ni kaari kpaliŋ kaarik abe ni seba ayen ni za ni kaasi kama! Ni be wom nama tɛŋ sii ale yalima la. Ni gomsi a magsi kpaliŋ abe ni kaasi! Ni gomsi a magsi kpaliŋ abe ni kaasi! 10Ni dan poom tagri ni zɔŋŋa ŋa ale labri a chim wari yoŋ, ate ni dan poom weeni ni zɔŋŋa ŋa kan tom tuima. Dii nyiŋla Wen a bo ale ti kama.
11Naawen a pai ka wa nisim pagrika a vi m zuk ale a kaam mu a ayen, kan va nuruma de suiku. Wa weeni kama ayen. 12<<Ni kan a wi biem zɔga ate nuru meena a wi ayen biem zɔga la. Abe ni kan a yɔgsa ale jabuui ate ba yɔgsa la, abe ni kan te ni kpaziim a nagi. 13Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale magsi ayen ni nya wa ase wa ale welema la. Wala ale magsi ayen ni a chali wa. Wala ale magsi ayen ni kpaziita a nak ale wa. 14Ate wa ale chim yeri. Alege Izirali yie ŋayewa ale chim ka tintain dii ale nye ate nuruba a nak naŋsa ale piuŋ kuui ale nye ate nuruba a lo. Ate Jerusalem demma wa ale chim ka baruk a te ba. 15Ba yega ale nak naŋsa, ate ba ale lo a kaasi. Ba ale bari a yik ba.>>
16Ni yik m wieŋa a tara abe ni a nya ŋa zuk ate ŋa kan siŋ tɛŋŋa a bo m ŋaaŋviirɔma po. 17Mi ale limisi Naawen dii ale a suk wadek a nyini Jekob demma jigi la. M le ta mariŋka ale wa.
18Mi ale nna, ale bi sii ate Naawen a pai te mu la. Tama ka daana ale magsa a bo Izirali a nyini Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La jigi waai ale bo Zayon Guuku zuk la.
19Ase nuruba a dan weeni ni ayen ni kpesi wie a nyini sampoporisa ale chichiri wiirisa jigi, baai ale a waasi wie la. Ka boan nyiŋ ate nuruba a kan bek a nyini Wen jigi ya? Boan nyiŋ ate ba a bek wie a nyini kpieba jigi a te ŋanvuta? 20Ba sinsaŋŋa ale ba wieŋa a dan ka a va chaab ale wanni de, ku kiri ale ba a bo ka legi po. 21Ninam ale kɔm ale yik ba, ate ba ale gilim tɛŋka meena, alege kɔm ale kasim a ta ba ate ba ale zak a nya wenŋmazuk ate ba ale ka a te ba Naawa, ale ba Wenni. 22Ate ba ale nya tɛŋ zuk de, a nya ninam ale legi ale yɔgsum, ate ba ale bo ka legi kpien po.

Title: AZAYA 9
Content:
1Alege daanika a kan ŋman bo baai ale a nam la jigi ya. Dila powa wa jam basi kama ate Zebulun ale Nafitali tɛŋsaŋa a siŋ tɛŋ, alege wa ale nye ate zula a jam Galili baai ale kan daa Juuba la tɛŋka ale bo nyakpiemu suiku nɔi ale Jodan benni la. 2Nuru baai ale a cheŋ legi po la a nya ka bolim kpiem. Baai mɛ ale bo legi kpien po la, bolim a nyaksi ba jigi. 3Naawen ya, fi nye ate tɛŋka a lagri ale ŋman te ba masim a gum ba masimu po. Ba a dɛ masim fi niŋ ase nuruba nyiem ale che ba ŋankpaanta ate ba sue a peenti diila. Ba a dɛ masim ase ka nuruba nyiem ale lab ŋan baai ate ba kɔlim la. 4Midian nak yikka danni fi kaasi niiga diok kuui ale chim jibta a te ba la kama ale diok kuui ale bari vi ba ŋmankpalaŋa zuk la ale baai ale a namsi ba la doani. 5Tugurik tɔŋdɔ meena nuensa ate ba su nye kpaliŋka la ale garuk meena ale lusi ziimu po la a magsi ka pai juka, ba chimka kpaam a magsi bolim. 6Biik ate ba biak a te ti, nidoabili ate ba pai a te ti, ate pagrimu a bo wa ŋmankpalaŋa zuk. Ate ba a wi wa ayen, Sagrɔ Kperikaliik ale Wen Tanjaŋini ale Taam Wuu Koa ale Suiyɔgni Nabiik. 7Wa pagrimu ale wa suiyɔgni zuaka a kan ta kpeglimka. Wa ale kali Deevid naamu zukpaglika zuk. Wa ale basi ate wa naamu a zaani abe wa ta wensie ale nyemagsika a nyini dila po a kasim a cheŋ. Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La mariŋka ale basi ate kude a nye.
8Nyɔnɔwa a te ka tomtomiŋ a ta chaab ale Jekob. Ka ale lo ka Izirali zuk. 9Nuruma meena ale miŋ ku. Ɛfraim ale Samaria tɛŋ demma ale miŋ wanni de. Alege kanjanta ale tukpari ale bo ba jigi la nyiŋ, ba a weeni kama ayen. 10<<Peelaŋa a lo kama, alege ti le ŋman sɛ ale tintain peesima. Kinkaŋsaŋa a lo kama alege ti ale ŋman tagri si ale nyunyoŋta.>> 11Alege Naawen a basi kama ate Arezin demma dachaasaŋa a nya pagrim a ta chaab ale ba ale choa ba dachaasaŋa a basi. 12Araam demma ale nyini kori la, ale Filistia demma ale nyini yeniŋ la, a lak ka ba noaŋa a pa Izirali a nɛ. Kude meena ŋaaŋnyiŋ wa sui ale diem a puuri ale ba. Wa za wa namsi ba kama.
13Alege nuruma an ŋmani waai ale nak ba la jigi ya, yaase ba gisi Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La. 14Dila nyiŋla, Naawen ale gebi wadek a nyini Izirali jigi zuk ale juik meena, kpinkparuk naŋ ale wuwɔŋ meena dai yeŋ po. 15Niŋdeerɔma ale kpaŋŋa ale chim zukku, ate biisiteerɔba baai ale ta venta sinsaga a sak la ale chim juiku. 16Baai ale a gani nuruma de la, ba ta ba cheŋ bɛ kama, ate baai ate ba a gani la, ba ta ba cheŋ bɛ. 17Dila nyiŋla, Nyɔnɔwa sui a kan peenti ale nidoabili paalisaŋa, yaase wa ta jiirim ale baai ale kan ta koba ale pukɔga. Dii nyiŋla, waai meena a kan tom wentuima. Ba a nye ka gaasa ale a biisi biem wie. Nyakude meena nyiŋ, wa suinni a an diem a basi ya. Wa za wa namsi ba kama.
18Wensie, gaasa a dɛ ase ka bolim la. Bu dɛ muŋkangɔtisaŋa ale muŋsaŋa ale chogsi gɔnni tikima a dɛ ate nyuisa yiti a jueli wen nna kulkul. 19Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La suipuurumu nyiŋ, tɛŋka ale dɛ ate nuruma ale chim kpaam a magsi bolim. Ate waai a kan pai wa suok a basi. 20Ba ale cheem a gala ale a juga a pa ŋandiinta a dɛ, alege ba a kan chagi waai meena ale yik ka ba bisa a ŋɔbi. 21Manasa dɔkdemma ale Ɛfraim dɔkdemma ale nye kpaliŋ ate ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ ba ale gum chaab a nye kpaliŋ ale Juda dɔkdemma. Alege kude meena zuk, wa suinni a kan yɔgi. Wa za wa namsi ba kama.

Title: AZAYA 10
Content:
1Ku ale toa a te baai ale a nye venta sinsaga ale a dueni namsika wie la, 2ate ŋa a kasi ŋanjaksa a nyini ba wensie po la, ale kan weeni nyemagsika a sak mi nuru baai ale bo ninam po la. Ale a tuesi ba ŋandiinta a nyini pukɔga jigi ale a vari ŋanta a nyini baai ale kan ta koba la jigi. 3Ni ale nye ka sɛ ninammu danni ase kaasuŋ a nin nyini niŋ a jam? Ka wana jigi ate ni ale chali a cheŋ ayen wa maari ni? Ni ale pa ni jigsika a basi ka bɛ? 4Jaab a kan tali alege ni ale maa bo ka baai ate ba yik la po ale chivie, yaase ni lo gum baai ate ba ko la po, alege kude meena wa suipuurumu an diem basi ya wa nisaŋa a diem zak ka wen.
5<<Assiria demma, ku ale toa a te ni dii nyiŋla, ka nama ate m pai a namsi baai ate m suinni a puuri ale ba la. 6Mi tom Assiria demma ate ba ga yik tɛŋ kpieŋ dem baai ale kan seba Naawen la kama. Mi basi ba kama ate ba ga yik nuru baai ale nye a te mi sui a puuri la kama. Mi tom ba kama ayen ba ga zu abe ba vari ba ŋantaŋa, abe ba tabi ba zuk a taam ase suik po tanta la. 7Alege daa wa ale yaali ayen wa nye diila ale la, daa wa ale ta dii wa popola po la ale la. Wa a yaali kama ayen wa kaasi ate tɛŋsa yegayega a jam kpeglimka jigi. 8Wa weeni kama ayen, <baai meena ale chim mi tugurik tɔŋdɔma kpaŋŋa meena daa nalima?> 9Kalno an nye ase ka Karchemis la? Ate Yamat a nye ase Arpad la? Ate Samaria a nye ase Damasikus la? 10Tɛŋ sii bɔgta ale gaam Jerusalem ale Samaria bɔgtaŋa la, m nisaŋa pagrimu a nya nakdeka ba zuk kama. 11Ase m le nye Samaria ale wa bɔgtaŋa diila, m kan nye Jerusalem ale wa bɔgtaŋa dila?>>
12Ase Nyɔnɔwa a dan nueri dii ate wa pai ta chaab ale Zayon Guuku ale Jerusalem la, wa yaa le weeni ayen, <<Mi ale namsi Assiria naawa, wa kanjantaŋa ate wa ta wa suinummu po la, ale wa kayerinni nyaasimu wa ninaŋa po. 13Dii nyiŋla, wa weeni kama ayen, <<Mi dek nisa pagrim ate m pai a nye kude ale m dek yam, dii nyiŋla m le baga a miŋ wie kiri la nyiŋ. Mi a yeeri tɛŋ kpieŋsa bana ale kɔlim ba tuilum ŋanta. Ase pagrɔ la m nya pagrim ba nalimaŋa zuk. 14Ase nuim ale a jo tuk po diila, dila wa mɛ ate mi nisaŋa paari tɛŋ kpieŋsa a tuesi ba jigsika ate ba ta la. Ase nuruba nyiem ale tigsi jena ŋaai ate ba zɛri ŋa la, dila wa mɛ ate mi a tigsi tɛŋsa a ta si a jam jigi yeŋ. Bunyi an poom baga a fuk bu kinkaŋni yaase bu lak bu nɔi a kum.>>
15Liak ale baga a zak ka dek a gaam waai ale a zak ka la? Yaase gebik nyina a kuulim ale waai ale pai ka a tom la? Nna se tachek an poom yik waai ale a zak ka la, yaase doari a baga a yulum waai ale kan daa diok la! 16Dila nyiŋla, Nyɔnɔwa, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale basi ate nyiŋtuila a jam ba tugurik tɔŋdɔma zuk. Wa ale za wa pai jabuui a lɔnsi ba po la ale chɔgsi ase ka bolim ŋiak la a dɛ ba. 17Naawen dii ale ka Izirali bolim buui ale nyaksi la ale chim ka bolim buui ale za bu a dɛ. Waai ale Welema a bo Izirali la ale nye ase ka bolim ŋiak. Wa ale pa ka dai yeŋ a ju wa muŋsaŋa ale muŋkangɔtisaŋa meena. 18Wa gɔnni nalimu ale laŋ sii ale ta poosuk la ale kaasi meena, ase yɔgnyieŋ ale kpeeri a bɛ diila. 19Ate wa ti sii ale tali gɔnni po la ale soa ka nna fii fiiga ate biik ale poom a ŋmarisi dueni.
20Dai dila danni Izirali dem baai ale tali la, Jekob dɔkdem baai ale vuuk la, a kan ŋman pai ba yiila a nyo waai ale jam a kaasi wa la po, alege ba ale ta siaka ale ka Naawen, Waai ale Welema a bo Izirali la. 21Nuru baai maga ale vuuk la ale pilim ŋmani, Jekob nuru baai maga ale vuuk la ale pilim ŋmani Wen Tanjaŋini jigi. 22Izirali nuruma a dan poom piisi ase tintain busuŋku ale bo nyakpiemu nɔi la, ku ale chim ka nuruba maga ale za ba ŋman pilim jam. Kaasuŋ a gomsi kama dua ale diirika ale nyemagsika. 23Nyɔnɔwa, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale za wa basi ate kaasuŋku a paari tɛŋka meena.
24Dila nyiŋ, Nyɔnɔwa, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni diila ale nna, <<Mi nuruma baai ale bo Zayon la, ni kan chali Assiria demma yɔgsummoa, baai ale a nak ni ale tachek ale zak doari a ta chaab ale ni ase Ejipiti ale jam a nye ni diila. 25Ku a kan beni, m kan ŋman ta suipuurum ale ni, m suinni a yaa ale bo ale ka bala ate m za m kaasi ba.>>
26Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale miiri ba kama ale fiŋ ase wa ale jam nak Midian ale bo Oreb piuŋku zuk la. Ate wa ale zak wa tachekka nyaataŋa zuk ase wa ale jam nye dii Ejipiti po la. 27Da dila danni, ba jiptaŋa ale zak ni ŋmankpalaŋa zuk, ba niiga diokku ni ŋieŋa zuk. Niiga diokku ale wɛ dii nyiŋla ni biigi kama.
28Ba jo Aiat tɛŋka po. Ba jam va Migron tɛŋka po a taam, a yaa pai ba ŋantaŋa a dueni Mikmas tɛŋka po. 29Ba va ka guutaŋa zuk a taam, ale a weeni ayen, <<Ti ale bo ka Geba yokku de.>> Ate Arama demma kpaziita a yaa a nak. Gibea ale ka Sɔɔl tɛŋ dem la a yiti chali. 30Gallim liewa abe kaari ate kaarika a chim kaamka a te Laisa. Anatot demma ka niniga! 31Madmena demma a yiti chali bɛ kama ate Gebim demma mɛ a chali suk. 32Danni de po ba ale bo ka Nob tɛŋka po. Ba ale gurum ka ba nisa a basi Zayon nuruma ale bo Jerusalem guuku zuk la.
33Ni nya, Nyɔnɔwa, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale gebi naŋ kpieŋsaŋa ale wa pagrim kpiemu. Ti sii ale wɔŋa nna yegayega la wa ale che lɔnsi, ate wa ale basi ate sii ale wɔŋa mɛ la a siŋ tɛŋ. 34Wa ale che gɔnni tikima ale liak a lɔnsi. Lebanon ale ti kpieŋsaŋa ale lo.

Title: AZAYA 11
Content:
1Naŋ buli ale pusi nyini Jese kinni po. A nyini wa tɛŋ naŋsaŋa po Naŋ ale yɔn yɔna. 2Naawen Chiika ale bo wa zuk. Chiik kaai ale a te yam ale miŋka ale sinsaga ale pagrim ale sebika ale Naawen yɔgsum chalika. 3Wa ale mariŋ Naawen yɔgsum chala. Wa kan bo buusa a va dii ate wa nya ale wa nina la, yaase dii ate wa wom ale wa tue la. 4Alege a ta nyini wayɔrisima po wa ale bo baai ale a silim ŋanta la buusa ale nyemagsika wa ale poli a magsi te tɛŋka ŋanjaksa. Wa ale pai wa nɔnni po tachekka a nak tɛŋka. Wa ale pai wa nɔngbanvaataŋa vuusumu a ko gaasa nyama. 5Wayɔrisima ale chim wa chiak gbain ate wensie a chim wa garuk pali a gilim wa chiaka.
6Piuk ale posuk ale bo ale chaab, ate yɔŋni ale buuk ale duak jigi yeŋ ale chaab, ate naabiik ale gbeŋli ale duŋsaŋa bisa ale bo ale chaab. Ate bi fiik ale nya ŋa zuk. 7Naab ale gɔi biak ale dɛ ale chaab, ba bisaŋa ale duak ale chaab, ate gbeŋli ale ŋɔbi wuuk ase naab la. 8Biluak ale diini jinkpaŋ vɔrup nɔi, ate bi fiik ale pai wa nisa a su waapiik duaka jigi. 9Ba a kan nye biemmoa yaase ba kaasi mi tuilum guuku zuwa, dii nyiŋla tɛŋka ale sueri ale ka Naawen sebika ase nyaata ale lik nyakpiemu diila.
10Dai dila danni Jese Ŋaaŋbiik ale zaani ase ka tikti a te nuruma, ate tɛŋsaŋa ale tigsi a jam wa jigi, ate wa vuusika jigini ale ta ka zula nna yegayega. 11Dai dila danni Nyɔnɔwa ale ŋman pilim a teeri wa a nye buye a tuesi wa nuru baai ale tali a bo Assiria ale Ejipiti ale Patros ale Kus ale Iilam ale Sinar ale Yamat ale tɛŋ sii meena ale bo nyakpiemu jigini la.
12Wa ale zak tikti a te tɛŋsaŋa, abe wa tigsi Izirali dem baai ate ba yik ta cheŋ tɛŋ yoŋsa la. Wa ale tigsi Juda dem baai ale waaŋ a bo tɛŋka meena la a ta jam jigi yeŋ. 13Ɛfraim nyunni ale bɛ, ate Juda dachaasaŋa kan ŋman boro. Ɛfraim a kan ŋman ta nyuri ale Juda, yaase Juda ale ŋman ta dachaani ale Ɛfraim. 14Ba ale gum chaab a siŋ cheŋ Filistia demma ale bo yeniŋ la po. Ba ale ŋman cheŋ nuru baai ale bo konni po la a nak ba a vari ba ŋantaŋa. Ba ale nak dɛ Edom ale Moab demma ate Ammon demma ale siak te ba. 15Naawen ale basi ate Ejipiti demma nyakpiemu vuuku a kpeeri. Wa ale yuk nisa ate va tuilik fuk va Benni zuk. Wa ale gebi di beli naŋsa si siyopɔi ate nuruba a su nuensa a baga a cheŋ taam. 16Suik duok ale boro ate wa nuru baai ale tali nyini Assiria tɛŋka cheena la a va, ase ku ale jam boro a te Izirali diipo ate ba jam nyini Ejipiti tɛŋka la.

Title: AZAYA 12
Content:
1Dai dila danni, ni ale weeni ayen, <<Naawen yaa, m le pak fu. Fi sui ate le jam puuri ale mi, alege fi basi fi suipuurumu kama alege a yaa yɔk m sui. 2Wensie, Wen ale mi varibasika. M le ta sebchakka ale wa la nyiŋ, m kan chali yɔgsummoa. Naawen, Naawen dek ale mi pagrɔ ale m yiili. Wa chim ka m varibasika.>> 3Masim ale bo ni jigi ase ni ale a dari nyiam a nyini varibasika viliŋa po la.
4Dai dila danni ni ale weeni ayen, <<Pai jiam a te Naawen, wi wa yuenni. Ni basi ate tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa demma a miŋ wa ale nye diila, abe ni mooli ayen wa yuenni a yiti ya. 5Ni yi yiila a pak Naawen, dii nyiŋla, wa nye ka wie naliŋsa. Ni basi ate tɛŋka demma meena a seba. 6Zayon demma, ni nuem abe ni yi yiila ale masim, dii nyiŋla Waai ale Welema a bo Izirali la a zuak kama a bo ni suŋsuŋ.>>

Title: AZAYA 13
Content:
1Naawen ale pai wa dii a sak Amoz nidoabinni Azaya ate wa nya a magsi chaab ale Babilon la ale nna: 2Zak tikti guuk kuui ate jaab a ka ku zuk la, nuem ate ba wom abe ni zak nisa, ate ba baga a va nuru kpientaŋa nansuiŋtaŋa a jo. 3M weeni m nuru weleŋsaŋa kama. M te m tugurik tɔŋdɔma ka nɔi ayen ba sak m suipuurumu. Baai nyiem ale a dɛ masim m nakdeka nyiŋla.
4Ni wom, nuemka ale bo guutaŋa zuk ase nuru boari la. Ni wom nalima tɛŋsa wɔkwɔk choa ka nna ase tɛŋ kpieŋsa dem ale tigsi jigi yeŋ la. Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La a gomsi ka tugurik tɔŋdɔba a magsi kpaliŋ. 5Ba a nyini tɛŋ sii ale yalima, ba nyini ka wenŋmazukku kpeglimka meena. Ka Naawen ale cheena ale wa suipuurumu kɔlimaŋa ayen wɛ kaasi tɛŋka meena.
6Ni abe kum, dii nyiŋla Naawen danni a moata kama. Ku ale jam ase ka kaasuŋ la a nyini Waai Ale A Niak La jigi. 7Dila nyiŋ, nisa meena ale wobsa, ate nuru meena ale ŋiak. 8Yɔgsum ale yik ba, nyiŋdomma ale daanika ale jam ba zuk. Ku ale toa a te ba ase ka nipok ale a dom lɔgi diila. Ku ale cha ba kama ase bolim ŋiak ale a nyaksi ba nina po diila.
9Ni nya, Naawen danni a cheena di abe ka nyeka tuem dai ale suipuurum nna yegayega ate wa ale kaasi tɛŋka ale wabaata nuru baai meena ale bo ka po la. 10Chiŋmarisaŋa ale ŋan baai meena ale bo wenŋmazukku la a kan nyaksi. Wenbinni ale sobri ate chiika a kan nya. 11Mi ale namsi tɛŋka nuruma ba biemu nyiŋ ale nuru baataŋa ba wabaataŋa nyiŋ. Mi ale basi ate kanjanta nyam ale ba kayerinni a kpeglim, abe m nye ate kanjanta nuruba ale baai ale kan ta jiirim la a siŋ tɛŋ. 12Mi ale nye ate nurubiik a silima a gaam ligmɔniŋ kaai ale nye cheri la, wa ale poom a silima a gaam ligmɔniŋ kaai ale bo Ofir la. 13Dila nyiŋla, mi ale nye ate wenŋmazukku a choa ate tɛŋzuk de mɛ ale kpiŋsi a nyini ka boka jigini. Ka Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale za wa nye dii wa suipuurumu danni la ale la.
14Ase sebik la, ase piisa ale kan ta naapeerik la, waai meena ale ŋman cheŋ wadek nuruba jigi, waai ale ŋman cheŋ wadek tɛŋ. 15Waai dek ate ba a yik wa la, ba a chub wa kama, baai meena ate ba a yik ba la, ba a ko ba kama ale gebik. 16Ba bisaŋa ale ŋɔriŋ ba nina po. Ba ale kɔlim ba ŋantaŋa a nyini ba yieŋa po abe ba fɛ a goa ale ba pooma.
17Ni nya, mi ale siti Miidi demma a basi ni nyiŋ, baai niŋ ale kan bo kpana ale ligmɔniŋ po la. 18Ba timaŋa ale lɔnsi nidoabili paalisaŋa tɛŋ. Ba a kan ta jiirim ale buluataŋa yaase bi fiisaŋa. 19Babilon, tɛŋ kaai ale nala a gaam tɛŋsa meena la, Kaldiya demma zulaŋa ate ba a ta kanjanta ŋa nyiŋla, Naawen ale tuesi a nyini ba jigi ase Sodom ale Gomora tɛŋsaŋa ate wa jam a nye diila. 20Waai a kan ŋman bo ka po, yaase ka poom boro gaŋsa meena po a cheŋ. Arab denɔ kan yaali ayen wa ti wa viuk dula, naapeerik a kan yaali ayen wa te wa ate wa piisa a vuusi dula. 21Alege gɔi ŋanta ale duak dula, gɔi baasa ale sueri yieŋa po. Dula jigini viita ale boro, dula ate bua ŋaai ale waara la ale yɔk a zi. 22Piina ale kasim a wooli ba yie pagrisaŋa po, abe gɔi baasa a bo ba nalimaŋa yie naliŋsaŋa po. Wa daaŋa a paari kama, ate daa a kan vi du a te wa.

Title: AZAYA 14
Content:
1Naawen ale ta jiirim ale Jekob dɔkdemma. Wa ale ŋman pilim lueri Izirali demma pai ba a kali badek tɛŋ po. Nicham ale gum chaab ale ba, ate ba nye nɔiyeŋ ale Jekob dɔkdemma. 2Satɛŋsa ale ta ba a ŋman jam badek jigini. Ate Izirali dɔkdemma ale soa tɛŋsaŋa ate ba nidoama ale nipooma ale chim ba yɔm a bo Naawen tɛŋka zuk. Baai ale a yik Izirali la, ba ale yik ba. Ate ba ale nya baai ale a namsi ba la zuk.
3Dai dii dai ate Naawen a yeeri ni ta a nyini ninam ale butimka ale nyeka tuem yontidi po la, 4ni le ni nye Babilon naawa a la diila ale nna: Nya namsidɔwa nuerika a paari ya. Nya wa suipuurumu a kpeglim ya. 5Naawen a wɛ nuru bioku tachekka, ale niŋdeerɔma tachekka mɛ. 6Suipuurum nyiŋ wa kasim teeri ka niguri a nak nuruba a lɔnsi, ate wa suipuurumu nyiŋ, wa fɛ ate tɛŋsa a siak a te wa ale kasim a namsi ba. 7Tɛŋsaŋa meena a bo ka vuusum ale suiyɔgni po. Ba a yi ka yiila. 8Ate damɔnta tiisa ale Lebanon nyunyoŋtaŋa a dɛ ka masim ni zuk ale a weeni ayen, <<Yɔgyɔgla ate ni siŋ tɛŋ la, dacheerik karo ayen wa che ti a lɔnsi.>>
9Vɔrumu ale bo tɛŋ la a gomsi kama ayen bu tu fi jamka. Bu choa ka baai ale kpi la chiisaŋa ayen bu puusi fu, baai meena ale jam chim niŋdeerɔba tɛŋka po la. Bu nye kama ate ba yiti ba naam zukpagliksaŋa zuk. Baai meena ale jam chim nalima a nya tɛŋsaŋa zuk la. 10Ba meena ale tulisi, ba ale weeni ni ayen, <<Nama mɛ a yaa wobsa ase ka tama la. Ni a nye ase ka tama la.>> 11Ni nalimu meena a siŋ ka boosuku po ale ni kpanuŋku nakka. Ni doa ka nanzue zuk ate bobla a lik ni nyiŋsaŋa meena.
12Nya fi le nyini wenŋmazuk a lo dii ya, vari chiŋmariga ale varivientidi nidoabiligaa. Fi waai ale jam basi ate tɛŋsa a duak tɛŋ la. 13Fi weeni fi suinum po ayen, <<M le jueli wenŋmazuk. Mi ale nye ate m naamu zukpaglika a yiti a gaam Wen chiŋmarisaŋa. M le kali naam zukpaglika zuk a nya baai meena ale tigsi guuku zuk la ale baai ale bo guuk weleŋka zukparukku la. 14Mi ale yiti a jueli chiŋmaaŋa zuk. Mi ale nye m dek ase Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La.>> 15Alege ba ta fu siŋ ka vɔrumu po, a ta siŋ golukku tɛŋ.
16Ku ale cha baai ale a nya la, ba ale poli fi ale jam ka diila abe ba ayen, <<Ka nuruwa de ale jam a choa tɛŋka la a basi ate tɛŋsa a yɔksa, 17nuru waai ale nye ate tɛŋka meena a chim gɔi la, waai ale nak yiak tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa ale kan basi ate baai ate wa yik la a kuli?>>
18Tɛŋsaŋa nalimaŋa meena a doa ka ba jiga waai meena a doa ka wadek vɔrup po. 19Alege ba yeeri fi a ta nyini fi vɔrumu po kama ase tiib naŋ ate ba zɛri la. Baai ate ba ko la ale lik fu, baai ate ba chub ale gebik la, baai ale siŋ golukku tanaŋa po la. Fi a nye nna ase ka kpio ate ba tabi wa zuk la. 20Ba a kan maa gu fu ale ba, dii nyiŋla fi kaasi fi tɛŋka kama ale ŋman ko fi nuruma. Ba a kan teeri nuru baataŋa bisa ŋmana. 21Ni gomsi jigi a magsi wa nidoabilisaŋa tɔgrika. Ba kokpieŋsaŋa wabaataŋa nyiŋ. Ba kan ŋman yiti a tuesi tɛŋka abe ba lik tɛŋzuk de ale ba tɛŋsaŋa.
22Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La a weeni ayen, <<Mi ale yiti a nye kpaliŋ ale ba,>> Naawen a weeni ayen, <<Ni gebi Babilon yuenni ale baai ale vuuk la ale wa bisaŋa ale wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa.>> 23Naawen Dii Ale A De Tugurik Tɔŋdɔba Niŋ La a weeni kama ayen, <<Mi ale nye ate wa tɛŋka a chim viita ale nyiam boka jigi. M le vaari wa ale kaasuŋ sie a basi.>>
24Ka Naawen dii ale ka Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋdeerɔ la ale pɛ ayen, <<Wensie, mi ale zɔk diila ku ale nye, ate mi ale poli diila ku ale zaani. 25Mi ale kaasi Assiria demma m dek tɛŋka po. M guuku zuk ate mi ale tabi ba a dueni tɛŋ. Wa niiga diokku a kan ŋman vi m nuruma zuwa, ate wa jibtaŋa a zak ba ŋmankpalaŋa zuk.>>
26Mi ale poli dii a ta va tɛŋzuk de meena la ale nna. M be teeri ka nisa a basi tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa meena zuk. 27Dii nyiŋla Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale poli diila ka wana ale wa baga a yik tagri? Wa nisaŋa a teeri kama a nyini, ka wana ale wa baga a yik si a ta ŋmani?
28Naawen wanni de a jam mi jigi ka ben dii ate naab Ayazi a kpi la. 29Nama Filistia demma ni kaa naŋ ayen tachek kaai ale nak ni la a wɛ ya. A nyini waab bula tɛŋ naŋka waab piik ale yiti, bu yoanni ale chim ka waab biok tintueta. 30Baai ale jaŋ a gaam ŋanjaksa meena la ale nya ba le a yaali diila, ate baai ale a silim la ale boro ale suiyɔgni. Alege mi ale kaasi fi buuni ale kɔm. Bu ale ko ni nuru baai ale vuuk la.
31Nansuiŋŋoa, kum! Tɛŋŋa, kaari ate ku jueli Filistia demma meena ale nyaliŋ bɛ! Chiŋmari ale nyuisa ale nyini wiiluk geŋ a jam, ba ka tugurik tɔŋdɔ baai ate jayɔgsuk a ka ba po. 32Ka boan jaab tulisa ate ti le pai te tɛŋ kala tomtomdɔma? <<Naawen a sɛ Zayon a zaani kama, ate kala po wa nuru baai ale a nam la ale suk du.>>

Title: AZAYA 15
Content:
1Naawen wa dii ale a magsi chaab ale Moab la. Ar ale bo Moab po la a kaasi kama, a kaasi kama yok yeŋ po. Kir ale bo Moab la a kaasi kama, a kaasi kama yok yeŋ po. 2Dibon demma a cheŋ ka ba puusika yenni ŋmani ayen ba kum. Moab a kum Nebo ale Medeba nyiŋ. Ba chiiri zuima meena ale che teeŋsa meena a basi. 3Suitaŋa po ba jo ka boorisa gatta. Ba bo ka ba yieŋa zuk ale peelim jigi meena a kum, ba poom lo duak ka tɛŋ a kum ba kumsaŋa. 4Yesbon ale Elealeya demma a kaari kama ate ba luelutaŋa a nyini peelim ate Jayaz a wom ba. Dila nyiŋla, Moab tugurik tɔŋdɔma a kaari kama ate ba kpaziita poom a nak.
5Mi a kum a te Moab a nyini ka m suinum po Moab nuruma a chali a cheŋ ka Zoar, ate ba gela a chali a cheŋ Eglat Selisiya. Ba poom cheŋ jueli a paari ka Luyit ale diem kum a cheŋ. Baai ale va Yoronaim suiku la, a kum kama a magsi chaab ale ba kaasuŋku. 6Nimrim nyaataŋa a kpeeri kama ate wuutaŋa a kɔ. Gɔnni ale tattaŋa po jaab a karo a sobri. 7Dila nyiŋ ba ŋantaŋa ate ba paari a tigsi ba la, ba ji ta cheŋ ka Niak Tiisaŋa Vooliŋka. 8Ba kumsaŋa a chɔgsi a paari Moab tɛŋka banaŋa. Ba kumsaŋa a paari Eglaim ale Beer Elim tɛŋsaŋa kama. 9Dimon tɛŋka nyaataŋa ka ziim, alege mi ale diem a ta namsika yega a jam Dimon zuk. A ta gbeŋli a jam Moab nuru baai ale chali la zuk ale baai ale tali bo tɛŋka po la.

Title: AZAYA 16
Content:
1Ni ta pabisa a cheŋ a ga te waai ale a nya tɛŋka zuk la ase ni lampoo la. Ni nyini Sela a gaam gɔnni a ga paari Jerusalem. 2Moab nipooma ale bo Arnon benni la a nye ase ka nuinsa ale yiti nyini si tukta po ale masim ale poom zɛ si ale a cheŋ juijui la.
3<<Sak ti dii ale magsi ayen ti nye la, te ti popola. Basi ate fi yisuŋku a lik ti kantueŋ pagrik po. Suk nuruma kan pai baai ale suk la a da. 4Basi ate Moab demma a bo ale fu. Chim ba ligrɔ a nyini kaasirɔwa jigi.>> Namsidɔwa ale jam kpeglimka ate kaasuŋ a kan ŋman boro. Dachiaka ale bɛ tɛŋka po. 5Ŋmanteka po naam zukpaglik ale zaani. Wensie po nuru ale kali ka zuk, waai ale nyini ka Deevid yenni po la. Waai ale a bo buusa ale a gisi nyemagsika la ale kpabi ale wayɔrisima tuima.
6Ti wom Moab demma kanjantaŋa yegayega ale ba ale a poli ayen ba gaam nuruba la wari kama. Ba kanjantaŋa ale ba kuulimka meena ka koruk. 7Dila nyiŋ, Moab demma a gum ka chaab a boro kum a te ba tɛŋka. Ba kum a te ka dii ale nye Kir Yareset tɛŋka nidoama la. 8Yesbon tattaŋa a kɔ kama. Sibma tiisaŋa mɛ a kɔ. Tɛŋsaŋa niŋdeerɔma a tabi si a kaasi kama. Ba tiisaŋa nyiem ale jam a teeri a paari Jazer a cheŋ gɔnni po la. Si naŋbuli teeri nyini a cheŋ paari nyakpiemu. 9Ate mi a kum, ate Jazer mɛ a kum a te Sibma tiisaŋa. Yesbon ale Elealeya, mi a kum ale ninyaata a te ni. Ni ale magsi ayen ni nuem ale masim a magsi chaab ale ni tiisaŋa yɔnaŋa ale muni la ale ni ale che ni ŋankpaantaŋa la, ba la meena a kaasi kama. 10Masim ale suipeentik a ŋman ka tiisaŋa tɛŋka po. Waai a kan yi yiila a nuem kaduksaŋa po. Waai a kan ŋmiak daam jigini diila mi kpeglim nuemka kama. 11Mi kum m suinum po a te Moab ase ka kpanuŋ la ale a kum m ponni po a te Kir Yareset. 12Moab demma a dan cheŋ ba guuku zuk, ku a kan te ba maarika. Ba abe dan cheŋ ba puusika jigini, ku a kan ta wamaŋ a te ba.
13Wanni de ate Naawen a poom ŋaam a dɛ niŋ a weeni a magsi chaab ale Moab. 14Alege yɔgyɔgla de Naawen ale a weeni diila ale nna. <<Bena ŋata po, ba ale nye ase ka tomteerɔba ale bo ba kpagi nisima po diila. Ba nalimu ale ba nuruma a kan ŋman boro, ate baai ale za ba vuuk la a kan soa diiya, ate ba ale wobsa mɛ.>>

Title: AZAYA 17
Content:
1Naawen wa dii ale a magsi chaab ale Damasikus la. <<Nya, Damasikus a kan ŋman chim tɛŋ kpieŋa, alege ka za ka chim ka guuk. 2Aroer tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa ale kaasi, ate piisa ale za ŋa a duak dula, ate nuru a kan boro ale nye ate ŋa kpaziita a nagi. 3Tɛŋ kpieŋ kaai ale pagra la ale bɛ nyini Ɛfraim, naam pagrim ale nyini Damasikus. Baai ale za ba tali a bo Araam la ale nye ase ka Izirali demma zulaŋa la, >> Ka Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale a weeni.
4<<Da dila danni Jekob zulaŋa ale muriŋ bɛ. Wa nyiŋka ale buk. 5Ka ale nye ase ka cheerɔ ale a che ŋanta diila ale a gebi ŋanbie ale nisa diila. Nna se nuru ale a yiisi ŋanta Arefaim Viaka po diila. 6Dila meena ŋaaŋnyiŋ, yiisika ale tali, ase kpaam tiib ate ba gbesi la ale basi yɔna ŋaye yaase ŋata ŋmazuk naŋsaŋa nyiŋla, yaase yɔna ŋanaansi yaase ŋanu naŋ kpieŋsaŋa nyiŋla.>> Naawen ale ka Izirali Wenni la ale weeni dila.
7Dai dila danni po, nuruba ale zak a nya ba Nyeerɔwa abe ba viriŋ ba nina a te Waai ale Welema a bo Izirali la. 8Ba a kan zak a nya kuŋkuŋtaŋa ale ba nisa tuimaŋa, ba niŋ kan bo Asera zaŋŋa po ale ŋan baai nyum ale masa la kuŋkuŋtaŋa ate ba nye la.
9Dai dila danni po, ba tɛŋ pagrisaŋa, ate ba jam a basi si Izirali demma nyiŋla ale chim ka juijui ate nuruba ale zɛri ate jiŋŋa ale chim tiisa ale wuuta jigi. Ate jaab meena ale kaasi.
10Ni baŋ Naawen ni Varibasidɔwa kama. Ni an teeri Piuŋku, ni pagrɔwa. Dila nyiŋ, ni a vuk ti maŋsa, ale a vuk tiisa ate ni ta nyini tɛŋ yonsa a jam la, 11dai dii dai ate ni vuk si la, ni nye kama ate si a chim, saluik kuui po ate ni vuk si la, ni nye kama ate si pusi. Alege dila meena kpesika ale chim ka kinla, dai dila danni ale chim ka nyiŋtuila ale nyiŋdomma ŋaai ale kan ta tebika.
12Tɛŋ kpieŋsa yegayega a bo ka daanika po ase nyakpiem ale a wuuri diila. Nuruba a bo ka daanika po ase nyakpienta nyiem ale a wuuri diila. 13Nuruma wuurika a poom a nye ase ka nyakpiem wuurika la, wa dan toariŋ ba, ba yiti a cheŋ ka nna niŋniŋa, nna se viok ale a ji vɔtta guuta zuk la, ate ku ale ŋman a nye ase va pagrik ale ji paasuk a gilim diila. 14Junɔi ba nye kama ate yɔgsum kpiem a boro alege ta cheen saluik ba cheŋ. Waai meena ale a kɔlim ti tɛŋka la charuk ale la.

Title: AZAYA 18
Content:
1Ku ale toa a te tɛŋ kaai ale bo Kus belaŋa nɔi ate ka kiŋkaŋŋa a fuk la 2ate ka tom baai ate ba va ŋaaruŋ tii ate ba pai bimbena a nye la. Ni cheŋ mwuli tomtomdɔba, ni cheŋ nuru baai ale woŋŋa ate ba nyiŋ gbaŋ saala la jigi, nuru baai ate tɛŋka meena a chali ba la jigi, tɛŋ kaai nyeka ale toa ale ta bichaŋ ate bela a poori tɛŋka la. 3Nama tɛŋka nuruma meena, baai ale bo tɛŋka zuk la, tikti a dan zak guutaŋa zuk, ni le nya, ate damuniŋ a dan peeri, ni le wom. 4Naawen ale weeni mi diila ale nna. <<M le nye diki abe m bo m boka jigini a nya, nna ase wenliuk wulum kantueŋ la, nna se chiŋmari maglim cheka wen la.>> 5Alege ate gbesika a paari la, puutaŋa a dan kan ŋman ka, ate yɔnaŋa a muni, wa le che naŋ sii ale a pusi la ale gebisa, abe wa che naŋ sii ale teeri la a lɔnsi a pai ta cheŋ. 6Ba le basi ba meena a te guutaŋa nuinsaŋa ale gɔi duŋsaŋa. Nuinsaŋa ale dɛ ba yoenni meena, ate gɔi duŋsaŋa ale dɛ ba wenkarika meena.
7Ba ale ta tiirita a jam a te Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La. Tiiritaŋa ale nyini ka nuru baai ale woŋŋa ate ba nyiŋ gbaŋsaŋa a saala la jigi, nuru baai ate tɛŋka meena a chali ba la jigi, tɛŋ kaai nyeka ale toa ale ta bichaŋ la ate bela a poori ka la. Ba ale ta tiiritaŋa a jam Zayon Guuku zuk, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La Yuenni jigini.

Title: AZAYA 19
Content:
1Naawen wa dii ale magsi chaab ale Ejipiti la ale nna: Nya, Naawen a do ka chiŋmari a cheena Ejipiti demma po. Ejipiti bɔgtaŋa kpaziita a nak wa niŋ, ate Ejipiti demma a ŋiak.
2<<M le siti Ejipiti dem nyiini a basi chaab zuk, ate waai ale wa suok ale kpaliŋ chaab, ate baai yie ale moata chaab ale ta chaab, ate tɛŋ kpieŋsa ale ta chaab, ate nalima mɛ ale ta chaab. 3Ejipiti demma ale jɔk nyiŋbiiri, mi ale basi ate ba le ta popola ŋaai meena la, ale chim kinla. Ba le ga kpesi nyini bɔgta ale kpilima ale sampoporisa ale chichirik wiirisa jigi. 4M le pai Ejipiti demma a nyo ka kpagi dii nyeka ale toa la nisima po, ate naab waai nyeka ale toa la ate wa a nya ba zuk.>> Ka Nyɔnɔwa, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni.
5Benni nyaataŋa ale kpeeri, ate benni tɛŋka ale toliŋ a ko. 6Nyiam vuutaŋa ale kasim a nyuŋ kama ate Ejipiti beli naŋsaŋa ale si abe ŋa kpeeri. Bimbenaŋa ale wobini ale kpi, 7wuuk tii mɛ ale bo Nile benni nɔi la ale laŋ meena ate ba bori Nile benni nɔi la ale kpi, ate viok a fuk ŋa a basi ate ŋa a kan ŋman boro. 8Jum yigrisa ale kum a ŋusi, baai meena ale a lusi gɔtisa Nile benni po la, baai ale a yuk ŋmaasa la ale buk be, 9baai ale pai gungunta a tom tuima la ale jɔk yiila, baai mɛ ale a yɔk garuk naliŋsa la ale jɔk yiila, 10baai ale a tom gatta tuima la sue a kan peenti, baai mɛ ale a tuesi tutuna la sue ale kaasi.
11Zoan kpaŋŋa daa ŋanta alege ka betta. Faaro yam sagrɔma a kan te yam sinsaga. Fi ale nye ka sɛ a weeni Faaro ayen, <<Mi ka yam nuruma po wanyi, ale dipo nalimaŋa ŋaaŋviirɔ?>>
12Fi yam nuruma a bo ka be yɔgyɔgla? Basi ate ba sak fu abe ba basi ate fi miŋ dii ate Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale zɔk dii a ta chaab ale Ejipiti la. 13Zoan tɛŋka kpaŋŋa a chim ka betta, ate ba a paasi Memfis tɛŋka niŋdeerɔma. Ka nuruma gugottaŋa tintanaŋa a ta Ejipiti nuruma a cheŋ bɛ kama. 14Naawen a pai ka nimbigilugsuk chiik a te ba. Ba nye ate Ejipiti demma a ja ba wie meena nyeka po ase danyuirik ale a ja wa chichiita po diila. 15Ejipiti demma an baga badek wari a nye, zuk yaase jiuk, yaase kpinkparuk yaase binbein.
16Da dila danni, Ejipiti demma ale nye ase ka nipooba la. Ba nyiŋsa ale gɔk ate ba kpaziita nak ase Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La a nin zak wa nisa a ta chaab ale ba. 17Ate Juda tɛŋka ale ta yɔgsum a jam Ejipiti demma zuk. Tɛŋ sii meena ale a wom Juda wari la yɔgsum ale yik ba, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale zɔk dii a ta chaab ale ba la nyiŋ.
18Dai dila danni tɛŋ kpieŋsa Ejipiti po ale biisi Keenan biika abe ba pɛ siak te Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La. Ba ale wi tɛŋsaŋa kanyi ayen Kaasuŋ Tɛŋ.
19Dai dila danni, Naawen ale ta ka kaabka kuŋkuŋ Ejipiti tɛŋka suŋsuŋ. Ale ŋan mɛɛnta a te Naawen tɛŋka banni. 20Ku ale chim ka daana ale seerɔ a te Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La Ejipiti tɛŋka po. Ba dan kum a te Naawen baai ale a namsi ba la niŋ, wa le tom varibasidɔ ale maarɔ ba jigi ate wa vari ba a basi. 21Ate Naawen ale basi ate Ejipiti demma a miŋ wa, ate dai dila danni ba ale siak a te Naawen. Ba ale puusi wa ale kaabsa ale ŋandiinta tiirita. Ba ale puulim a te Naawen, abe ba ta pumpuulimaŋa. 22Naawen ale namsi Ejipiti ale nyiŋtuila abe wa ŋman tebi ba. Ba le ŋmani Naawen jigi ate wa tulisi ba funfɔblaŋa abe wa tebi ba.
23Dai dila danni, suik duok ale nyini Ejipiti a cheŋ Assiria. Assiria demma ale cheŋ Ejipiti ate Ejipiti demma ale cheŋ Assiria. Ba ale gum chaab a puusi Naawen. 24Dai dila danni, Izirali ale saari buta a gum chaab ale Ejipiti ale Assiria a chim niauŋ tɛŋka zuk. 25Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale niak ba abe wa a weeni ayen, <<Niauŋ a bo Ejipiti demma mi nuruma jigi, niauŋ a bo Assiria demma mi nisima tuimaŋa jigi ale Izirali demma mi nitalimu jigi.>>

Title: AZAYA 20
Content:
1Bein dii po ate Naab Sargon Assiria naawa a tom wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma kpagni ate wa ga siti a nak yiak Asdod tɛŋka la. 2Va ŋala po, Naawen a jam biisi ale Amoz nidoabinni Azaya ayen, <<Yeeri fi boorik garukku fi nyiŋka po ale fi nuesaŋa fi naŋsaŋa po.>> Ate wa nye dila, a gilim chaboala ale naŋta bie.
3Naawen yaa weeni ayen, <<Ase mi tomteerɔwa Azaya ale cheŋ chaboala ale naŋta bie bena ŋata la ase daana ale wa dii ale sak chum po wari la a ta chaab ale Ejipiti ale Kus tɛŋsaŋa. 4Dila Assiria naawa ale yik baai Ejipiti ale Kus la, bi paaluk ale ŋankpagsa, wa le ta ba cheŋ nyiŋbolinni ale naŋta bie ate ba butagkolaŋa a nya ate ku ta chivie a jam Ejipiti jigi. 5Baai ale ta sebchakka ale Kus ale baai ale a kuulim Ejipiti nyiŋla, yɔgsum ale yik ba ate ba jo chivie po. 6Dai dila danni, nuru baai ale bo nyakpiemu nɔi la ale weeni ayen, <Nya dii ale jam baai ate ti ta yiila ale ba ayen ba ale maari ti abe ba vari ti a basi a nyini Assiria naawa nisa po la. Ti ale nye ka sɛ a chali be?> >>

Title: AZAYA 21
Content:
1Wen wa dii ale magsi chaab ale Gɔnni ale moata Nyakpiemu la. Ase va pagrisa ale fuk va yeseoku geŋsa la, fɛ juerɔ ale nyini gɔnni po a jam, a nyini kpazinagsuk tɛŋ a jam.
2Kaasuŋ wie ate Naawen a pai sak mi. Bumbobrɔwa a bobri, varidɔwa mɛ a vari. Iilam demma a siti, Miidi demma a jam gilimka. Mi ale ta ŋuuni kaai meena ate ba nye la a jam kpeglimka jigi.
3Kude a basi kama ate m nyiŋka meena a chali a dom, nyiŋdomma ale paari mu ase nipok puuk ale a dom la. Mi ale wom diila a nye kama ate mi a ja. Dii ate m nya la a basi kama ate m butim. 4Mi suinum po m nye be kama, yɔgsum a basi kama ate m nyiŋ a gɔk, junɔinni ate mi a yiili la, a chim ka jabuui ate mi a kisa la.
5Ba gomsi ŋandiinta jazaanim, pai jaab a pati du, ba yaa dɛ ale nyu, nama kpaŋŋa ni yiti, ni nyo kpaam ŋanchɔgsintaŋa po. 6Nyɔnɔwa ale weeni mi diila ale nna, <<Te ate nuru a za nansuiŋku a nya abe wa weeni wa ale nya diila. 7Diipo meena wa dan nya torokoba ale wusuma beŋsa bon duerɔba, yaase laalaakomi duerɔba, wa abe kpesi wadek, a kpesi wadek a paari.>>
8Ate waai ale a nya la a na ayen, <<M nyɔnɔ, dai meena mi za a limisi gboŋku zuk kama, yok meena mi za ka dula. 9Nya nuru ale nna a bo toroko po a cheena ale wusuma beŋsa. Ate wa tulisika a ŋman te ayen, <<Babilon a lo ya, ka lo ya. Wa bɔgtaŋa ate ba mɛ a zaani la a lo paari ka tɛŋ munamuna.>>
10M nuruma, ba a fɔbi ni ase ka zaa la, alege mi ale weeni ni dii ate mi a wom a nyini Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, Izirali Wenni jigi la.
11Naawen wa dii ale magsi chaab ale Duma la ale nna. A waai ale wi mi a nyini Seir ayen, <<Limisidɔ, yokku a tali soa ka sɛ? Limisidɔ, yokku a tali soa ka sɛ?>> 12Limisidɔwa yaa tulisi ayen, <<Saluik a cheena, alege yok mɛ a cheena. Fi abe daa a bek be bek abe fi ŋman jam.>>
13Naawen wa dii ale magsi chaab ale Arabia la ale nna. Nama Dedan nyiemdɔma ale ga bo Arabia tiisaŋa po la, 14ni ta nyiam a jam te baai ate nyanyuila a ta ba la. Nama baai ale bo Tema tɛŋka la, ni ta ŋandiinta a jam te baai ale a chali ba be la. 15Ba chali a be ka gebika, gebik kaai ate ba dari yeeri la, ale tom buui ale gbeeri la, a nyini kpaliŋka po.
16Nyɔnɔwa ale weeni mi diila ale nna, <<Bein yeŋ po, ase tuimtomdɔ ale a nye nɔiyeŋ ale tuini diila, Kedar ŋan baai ate ba pai a nye kpaliŋsa la ale kpeglim. 17Tɔŋdɔ baai ale vuuk la, Kedar tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale fiisa.>> Ka Naawen Dii Ale ka Izirali Wenni la ale biisi.

Title: AZAYA 22
Content:
1Naawen wa dii ale magsi chaab ale pa sakka viaka la ale nna: Ka boa ale a daani ni yɔgyɔgla de, ate ni meena a jueli gbirima zuima, 2tɛŋ kaai ate daanika a sueri ka la, tɛŋ kpieŋ kaai ate nuemka ale masim dɛka a sueri ka la? Ni nuruma daa gebik ate ba pai ko ba yaase ba kpi kpaliŋ po. 3Ni niŋdeerɔma meena maa chaab a yiti chali kama. Ba dachaasaŋa a yik ba kama ale an pai tom a tɔŋ ya. Nama baai ale a chali alege ate ni dachaasaŋa a bo niŋ la, ba a yik ni meena a lik kama. 4Dila nyiŋ mi yaa weeni ayen, <<Ni basi mi abe ni cheŋ. Basi mu ate m kum ale sui kaasuŋ. Ni kan yɔk m sui m nuruma kaasuŋku nyiŋŋa.>>
5Nyɔnɔwa, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La a ta ka nuemka ale tabika kpazinagsuk dai pa sakka viaka po, parisa chub lɔnsika ale guuta kum teka dai. 6Iilam demma a pai ba peema pakka ale ba toroko duerɔma ale wusuma. Kir demma a gomsi ba kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsintaŋa a magsi. 7Viak kaai ate ni lueri la, a sueri ale ka wusuma torokoba, ate wusum duerisa a za tɛŋ kpieŋka nansuiŋtaŋa. 8Ba yeeri baai ale a maari Juda la pagrimu kama. Ate dai dila danni ba a nya kpaliŋ kɔlima Tiisa Naam Yenni po. 9Fi nya kama ayen Deevid Tɛŋka parisaŋa a ta ka muulisa nna yegayega. Fi nyo nyiam Beli dii ale bo Tɛŋ la po. 10Fi chiini Jerusalem yeeŋa kama a yaa nak ŋa gela a lɔnsi ayen fi nye ate parika a pagra. 11Fi se ka nyiam nyoka jigi parisa siyewa suŋsuŋ a magsi Beli Kpakka nyiamu, alege fi an gisi a nya Waai ale nye dila la, yaase fi niŋ a bo Waai ale poli di wie dipo la.
12Ka Nyɔnɔwa, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale wi fu dai dila ayen fi kum abe fi kaari, abe fi dari fi zuisaŋa a vɔssi abe fi jo boorisa garuk. 13Alege ni nya, suipeentik ale masim dɛka ale boro, niiga tɔgrika ale piisa koka, lanta ŋɔbika ale daam nyuka, <<Ni weeni kama ayen basi ate ti de abe ti a nyu ale chum ti baga a kpi kama.>>
14Ka Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale pai wanni de a sak mi ate m wom ayen, <<Kan daa ni kummu danni biemu de a kan nya duisi basika ka Nyɔnɔwa, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni.
15Nyɔnɔwa, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni ayen, <<Cheŋ ga weeni Sebna nyaarɔwa ale a nya naab yenni zuk la ayen. 16Ka boa ate fi bo dela a nye, ka wana ale te fi suik ayen fi keri boosuk a te fidek dela, a keri fi boosuku ŋmazukku dela ale a keri fi vuusumu jigini piuŋku po?
17<<Be seba, Naawen a za wa yik fu kama giŋgiŋ yuk fu a basi, Fi nuru kpioŋku. 18Wa ale kpamsi fu kama nna ŋmapi ase gbeli la a yuk fu basi tɛŋ kpieŋ po. Ate fi ale kpi dula ate fi wusuma toroko naliŋsaŋa ale wari du. Fi ka chivie a te fi kpagni yenni. 19Mi ale yeeri fi kpaŋtaŋa po, ate fi jɔk kpaŋtaŋa.
20<<Dai dila danni mi ale wi m tomteerɔwa, Eliakim ale ka Yilkia nidoabili la. 21M le pai ka fi naam garukku a jo wa, abe m pai fi garuk panni bobi wa, a yaa pai fi pagrimu a te wa. Wa ale chim ka baai ale bo Jerusalem ale Juda yenni la koa. 22M le pai ka Deevid yenni saafiika a vi wa ŋmankpala. Ate wa ale a lak jabuui la, waai an baga a kpari, ate wa ale a kpari jabuui la waai an baga a lagi. 23M le feri wa ase kpaasiri ate ba nak a feri diila, Wa ale ta zula a jam wa kowa yenni po. 24Wa dɔkdemma zulaŋa meena ale bo ka wa jigi, wa bisa ale wa ŋaaŋbisa meena ale wa yenni ŋantomta meena.
25Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni ayen, <<Kpaasini ale feri tɛŋ kaai la ale baliŋ, ate kpaasini a voori, ate ŋan baai meena ale yik di nyiŋla a gebi lo.>> Ka Naawen ale biisi.

Title: AZAYA 23
Content:
1Naawen wa dii ale magsi chaab ale Taaya la ale nna: Nama Tarsis demma ale ta ŋaaruŋta la, ale kum. Dii nyiŋla Taaya tɛŋka a kaasi kama a ŋman ka yie ale ŋaaruŋta zaanika jigi ya. Wanni de a nyini ka Kittim tɛŋka a jam ba jigi.
2Ni nye diki nama baai ale bo tɛŋ kaai ate nyiam a gilim ka la ale nama Saidon geruŋdɔma, ate baai ale a nyiem nyiam po a jigsi ba la. 3Siyor a nya ba ŋan bieŋa a nyini ka nyakpientaŋa po. Taaya a nya ba ligraŋa a nyini ka ba ale a che ŋan baai Nile benni la, ate ka yaa chim satɛŋsa yaba.
4Saidon tɛŋ demma, Chivie a yik ni, ale nama nyakpiemu ŋan pagrisaŋa, Ka nyakpiemu ale weeni ayen, <<Mi puuk an dom ya yaase m biak ya, mi an wuuk nidoabilisa yaase lieba.>> 5Ase wari a dan nyini Taaya a jam Ejipiti demma jigi ku le daani ba popola.
6Ni lo a jueli Tarsis tɛŋka. Nama tɛŋ kaai ate nyiam a gilim ka la demma. 7Ka ni tɛŋ kaai ate ni a dɛ masim ka nyiŋla ale nna, tɛŋ kpakka, tɛŋ kaai naŋsa ale ta ka a cheŋ niŋniŋ tɛŋsa la? 8Ka wana ale zɔk nna a ta chaab ale Taaya tɛŋka, ate ka geruŋdɔba a te naam zutɔgsa la, ate ka geruŋdɔba a chim nabisa la, ate ka geruŋdɔba a ta yue tɛŋzuk de la? 9Ka Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale zɔk, ayen wa ta zula nyam baai meena ale ta kanjanta la a siŋ tɛŋ ate baai meena ale ta yue tɛŋzuk de la a zaab badek.
10Nama Tarsis demma ni ga kpa maŋ Nile benni, diila ni ŋman ka ŋaaruŋta zaanka jigi ya. 11Naawen a teeri ka wa nisa nyakpiemu zuk a nye ate bu naataŋa a choa. Wa a te ka nɔi a magsi chaab ale Keenan ayen ka yie pagrisaŋa ba kaasi. 12Wa weeni ayen, <<Fi masimu dɛka a ŋman karo Saidon tɛŋka a yaa kaasi kama.>> Yiti a lo jueli Kittim dula jigini vuusum a poom ka.>> 13Nya Kaldiya demma tɛŋka, nuruma de ŋman ka magsa. Assiria demma a basi kama ate ka chim gɔi ŋanta boka jigi. Assiria demma a sɛ ka yie woŋta a gilim, alege Assiria demma a yeeri ka ŋan pagrisaŋa a tulim ka ate ka chim tɛŋ kaasuŋ.
14Tarsis demma baai ale ta ŋaaruŋta la abe kum. Dii nyiŋla ba yie pagrisaŋa a kaasi kama.
15Va ŋala po ba ale baŋ Taaya wari bena pisiyopɔi, naab ale a nya bena diila. Alege bena pisiyopɔiwa kpeglimka po, ku ale nye Taaya jigi ase ka taabuka yiini ale weeni ayen, 16<<Pai kpanuŋ, a cheŋ va tɛŋka po, ba baŋ taabuka wari, nak kpanuŋku nalimnyiini, lenni yiila yega, ate dila basi ate ba teeri fi wari.>>
17Bena pisiyopɔi a dan nueri, Naawen ale nye ale Taaya tɛŋka. Wa ale ŋman ŋmani waai ate wa pai wa la jigi ase taabuk la ate wa nye wa geruŋku ale tɛŋsaŋa meena ale bo tɛŋzuk la. 18Alege wa ale a nya diila ale wa nyuentaŋa meena wa be le gaari a te ka Naawen. Ba kan pai nyo jaab po a zaani yaase ba pai suk. Wa nyuentaŋa ale cheŋ baai ale bo ale Naawen la jigi, a magsi ŋandiinta yegayega ale garuk naliŋsa.

Title: AZAYA 24
Content:
1Ni nya, Naawen a za wa te tɛŋzuk de a duak ka koruk abe wa kaasi ka. Wa ale kaasi jaab meena ale bo ka po la abe wa kati ka nuruma a waaŋ. 2Ku ale nye kaabteerɔ ka dila dekdega ase nuruma la, a nye kpagi ase tomteerɔ la, a nye nipok ase pɔkdɔklie la, a nye dateerɔ ase daarɔ la, a nye peemdɔ ase peemteerɔ la, a nye pamideerɔ ase pamiteerɔ la. 3Tɛŋka meena ale duak koruk, abe ba koaliŋ ka meena, ka Naawen ale biisi wanni de.
4Tɛŋzuk de a jak kama a kɔ, tɛŋka a jɔk ka pagrimu ale a kpi, baai ale ta zula la a nam kama. 5Tɛŋka nuruma a taŋ ka kama, ba nye ka tuikpari ale sinsaŋŋa, ale tom kaasi wieŋa, nɔiyeŋ kaai ale kan ta kpeglimka la ba kaasi ka. 6Dila nyiŋ kikaasa ale kaasi tɛŋka. Ka nuruma dek ale magsi ba siak ba kaasuŋku. Dila nyiŋ bolim ale dɛ tɛŋka demma ate maga dek a tali. 7Da paalika a kpieri kama ate tiisaŋa a kpi. Baai meena ale a de masim la a bo ka ŋuunika po. 8Kayaksaŋa masimu a nye diki, baai ale a dɛ masim la nuemka a basi ya, kpanuŋku masimu a nye chorr. 9Ba kan ŋman nak yiila a nyu daamoa. Daam toa kama a te bu nyuiriba. 10Tɛŋ kpieŋka a kaasi kama a doa koruk. Yeri meena nansuiŋ a lik kama. 11Ba a kum a yaali ka daam suitaŋa po. Masim meena a labri chim ka niniga. Masim a ŋman ka tɛŋka zuwa. 12Tɛŋ kpieŋka a kaasi kama, ba nak ka tuataŋa a kaasi ka nna bunabuna. 13Ku be le nye ka dila tɛŋka zuk ale tɛŋ kpieŋsa, ase ba le fɔbi kpaam tiib diila, yaase ba ale gbesi ŋanta ale tali ate ba a yiisi diila.
14Ba lak ba lueluta, ale a nuem ale masim. A nyini yeniŋka, ba weeni Naawen zuaka ale ka diila. 15Dila nyiŋ, a nyini konni po, ni pai zula a te Naawen. Ni zak Naawen yuenni a zaani, waai ale ka Izirali demma Wen la, a bo tɛŋ sii ate nyiam a gilim la. 16A nyini tɛŋka kpeglimka tama wom yiila lennika ayen, <<Zula a paari Waai ale ka Wayɔrisima Nyɔnɔ la.>> Alege mi a yaa weeni ayen, mi bɛ ya, mi bɛ ya. Ku le toa a te mu. Velimvendika a bobri ya. Velimvendika ale wa ventaŋa a bobri.>>
17Yɔgsum, ale goluk ale baruk ale a limisi ni tɛŋzuk demma. 18Waai ale za wa yiti a chali yɔgsum nyiŋla, ale lo ka goluk po. Waai ale za wa nyini golukku po a nyini la, baruk ale yik wa. Wenŋmazuk tuataŋa a lagri, ate tɛŋka nyubaŋa a choa. 19Tɛŋka a na lagri, tɛŋka gaari buye, tɛŋka a choa. 20Tɛŋka a ja kama ase danyuirik la, ka a zaŋ ase ka viok ale a fuk kusuŋ diila. Dila dobrim buui ale bo ka zuk la ale ka biemu ate ka yaa lo ka kan ŋman yiti.
21Dai dila danni, Naawen ale namsi pagritaŋa ale bo wenŋmazuk la ale nalimaŋa ale bo tɛŋzuk de la. 22Ba ale gum ba chaab ase ligrɔba ale bo likka dɔk po la. Wa le lik ba a namsi ba da boari. 23Chiika ale nye ŋoomaa ate chivie a yik wenbinni. Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale dɛ naam Zayon Guuku zuk ale Jerusalem po ale nisɔmma niŋ ale zula.

Title: AZAYA 25
Content:
1Naawen yaa, fi ale mi Wen. M le zak fu zaani abe m pak fi yuenni, dii nyiŋla fi va ka wensie maŋsa po a tom tuim kpien ŋaai ate fi gomsi ŋa a nyini dipo la. 2Fi nye kama ate tɛŋ kpieŋka a chim guuk, ate tɛŋ kaai ale pagra la a kaasi, nichamma pagrimu jigini tɛŋ a ŋman ka, ba kan ŋman sɛ ka. 3Dila nyiŋ nuru pagrisa ale zuli fu. Tɛŋ kpieŋ sii ale kan ta jiirim la ale zuli fu. 4Fi chim ka ŋanjaksa sukka jigi a chim sukka jigi a te waai ale a silim la wa daanika po, a chim kusuŋ a lik viok ale yɔgsum a lik kantueŋ. Diila baai ale kan ta jiirim la vuusumu a nye ase ka viok ale a fuk parik diila 5ale a nye ase tɛŋ kosik tuiluk la. Fi basi ate nicham baai ale a nye wɔkwɔk la a nye diki, ase chiŋmari yɔgsum ale a baliŋ tuiluk diila, dila baai ale kan ta jiirim la ale basi ba yiini.
6Guuku de zuk ate Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La a gomsi ŋan dii maŋsa tigi a te nuru meena, ale daam tigi a magsi baai ale pak la, lam maŋsa ale da maŋsa tigi. 7Guuku de zuk ate wa ale kaasi jabuui ale a lik nuruba meena la, garuk kuui ale a lik tɛŋsaŋa meena la. 8Wa ale nɛ kum ate bu a kan ŋman boro. Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale duisi waai meena ninyaata a basi. Wa ale yeeri wa nuruma ale bo tɛŋka zuk la chivieŋa a basi. Ka Naawen ale biisi dila.
9Da dila danni ba ale weeni ayen, <Wensie ti Wenni ale la. Ti mariŋ wa kama ate wa vari ti a basi. Naawen ale nna, ti mariŋ wa kama. Ni basi ate ti dɛ masim abe ti sue a peenti ale wa varibasika.>>
