10Naawen nisa ale bo guuku de zuk. Alege wa ale tabi Moab kama ase kinkaa ate ba tigsi ŋa tabi ŋa ate ŋa chim bibaam diila. 11Ba ale teeri ba nisa ku po, ase nyapuŋdoa ale a teeri nisa a de diila. Wen ale ta ba kanjantaŋa a siŋ tɛŋ ba ale ba nisaŋa kperika meena. 12Wa ale basi ate ni parik woŋsaŋa a lo a duak tɛŋ, wa le ta si siŋ dueni tɛŋ tantaŋa dek po.

Title: AZAYA 26
Content:
1Dai dila danni ba le yi yiini de Juda tɛŋka po ayen, ti ta ka tɛŋ pagrik. Wen a basi kama ate varibasika a chim ka parisa ale ka bimbima. 2Lak tuataŋa ate wayɔrisima tɛŋka a jo, tɛŋ kaai ale ta siaka la. 3Fi ale yik waai popola ale bo jigi yeŋ la ale suiyɔgni, dii nyiŋla wa ta sebchakka ale fu kama. 4Kasim ta sebchakka ale Naawen, diila Naawen, Naawen ka Piuŋ taam wuu. 5Wa nye ate kanjanta nyam a siŋ tɛŋ, ale kaasi ba tɛŋka. Wa palinti ka a magsi chaab ale tɛŋka a yuk ka a basi tantaŋa po. 6Naŋtaata ale tabi ka a lɔnsi, baai ate ba a namsi ba la naŋtaataŋa, ŋanjaksaŋa naŋtaataŋa.
7Gola a ka wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ suiku po. Fi Waai ale kan ta kaasuŋ la, a nye kama ate wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ suiku a nala. 8Wensie, Naawen yaa, ti ale a cheŋ fi buusa suiku po la, ti le limisi fu. Ti suiniimaŋa a yaali ka fi yuenni ale a yiti diila. 9Mi chiika a yeenti a yaali fu kama yok, ate m chiika a zeenti a yaali fu saluiku. Fi buusaŋa a dan jam tɛŋka zuk, nuruma ale bo ka po la a zamsi ka wayɔrisima. 10Niaka a dan poom jam gaasa nuruba jigi, ba kan zamsi wayɔrisima wie. Dan poom ka tɛŋ kaai ale nye a magsi la po ba ale diem a nye biem, ate ba poom a kan pa zula a te Naawen zuaka ale ka diila. 11Naawen yaa, fi nisaŋa a zak ka wen alege ba kan nya. Basi ate ba nya fi popola ale bo fi nuruma zuk diila ate chivie a yik ba. Basi ate fi ale tali bolim buui a magsi fi dachaasaŋa la a de ba.
12Naawen yaa, fi ale te ti suiyɔgni. Ti ale baga a nye dii meena la, ka fi ale tom a te ti. 13Naawen yaa, ti Wenni, kpaga yona a nya ti zuk a nya kama, alege ka fi yuenni nyiini ate tama a zuli. 14Ba yaa kpi kama, ba ŋman karo. Chiik sii ale cheŋ la an yiti ya. Fi namsi ba kama ale ta ba jam kaasuŋ jigi. Fi ko ba kama ate waai a kan teeri ba. 15Naawen yaa, fi nye kama ate tɛŋ kpieŋka a lagri. Fi ale sum nye ate ka lagri nna yegayega. Fi nya zula kama a te fidek. Fi nye kama ate tɛŋka banaŋa a lagri.
16Naawen yaa, ba jam fi jigi kama ale ba daanika. Ase fi ale dari ba tue la, ate ba waasi a puusi fu. 17Ase nipok ale ta lɔgi a dom ayen wa biak a kaari diila, dila ate tama a nye a bo fi niŋ, Naawen yaa. 18Ti jam ta ka puuk, ate ka a dom, alege ti biaka viok. Ti an ta varibasika a jam tɛŋka zuwa. Ti an biak nuruba a basi tɛŋka zuwa.
19Alege ni kpiema ale boro. Ba nyiŋsaŋa ale yiti. Nama baai ale bo tanta po la, ni yiti a nuem ale masim. Ni maglimu a nye ase ka saluik maglim la. Tɛŋka ale ŋman biak ka kpiema.
20Mi nuruma, ni cheŋ, a ga jo ni diinaŋa po, abe ni lik nidek a basi ni diinaŋa po. Ni suk nidek maga ate wa suipuurumu a taam. 21Nya, Naawen a nyini ka wa boka jigini a cheena ayen wa namsi nuru baai ale tom wabaata la. Tɛŋka ale dak baai ale suk a ko nuruba ka zuk la. Tɛŋka a kan ŋman suk baai ate ba ko ba la.

Title: AZAYA 27
Content:
1Dai dila danni, Naawen ale pai ka wa gebika ale wa nyinyigsaŋa ale gebik kaai ale zuak ale ta pagrim la, a namsi Jabuui ale a nye ase waab la, Jabuui ale a vili ase waab la. Wa le ko nyakpiemu po jachichimini.
2Dai dila danni, <<Ni pai kaduk kaai ale ta yɔna la a lenni yiili. 3Mi, Naawen, a nya ka zuk kama. M kasim a zaŋti ka kama. Mi a nya ka zuk yok ale kantueŋ, ate waai a kan baga a daani ka. 4Mi sui a kan puuri. Ka kpiluŋbaoŋ ale muŋsa nyiini a nin tu chaab ale mu. Mi le gɔk santiri a ta chaab ale ba kpaliŋ po. Mi ale ju ba bolim. 5Yaase m basi ate ba jam a suk mi jigi. Basi ate ba ta suiyɔgni ale mi. Mm, basi ate ba ta suiyɔgni ale mi.>>
6Daa a cheena Jekob ale feri naŋsa, Izirali ale pusi vaata a busum, a sueri tɛŋka meena ale yɔna.
7Naawen an namsi Izirali demma yegayega ase ba dachaasaŋa la, yaase ba jɔk nuruba yega. 8Wa pai ka kpaliŋ ale yik ta cheŋka a nye le ba, ale wa nyinyigsa nakka wa yiak ba ate ba nyini, ase dai dii dai ate kori vioku a fuk la. 9Kude nyiŋ, ate Jekob foolaawa ale duisi basi, ate dila ale sak ayen biem a ŋman ka wa jigi ya. Ase wa dan nak juka kuŋkuŋku tanaŋa a buksi, ate Asera zaŋŋa ale ŋan baai nyum ale masa la kuŋkuŋtaŋa an ŋman za. 10Tɛŋ kaai ale pagra la a doa ka koruk, a zɛri ba kalika jigini, a zɛri ase gɔi la. Dula ate naabisa a dɛ, dula ate si a duak, ale passi naŋsaŋa a zaani jassi. 11Ase bu naŋsaŋa a dan ko si nyiem wɛ a lo kama ate nipooba a jam a yaali a ga cheem bolim. Dii nyiŋla, nuruma de a kan miŋ biik kiriya. Ate ba Nyeerɔwa a ka jiirim ale ba, wa poom kan ŋmani a te ba.
12Dai dila danni, Naawen ale fɔbi a nyini Yufiretis Benni ale chali a taam la, ga paari Ejipiti Buboalika, ate nama Izirali demma ale tigsi wanyi wanyi. 13Ate da dila danni, damuniŋ kpieŋ ale peeri. Ate baai ale jam a kpi Assiria tɛŋka po la, ale baai ate ba ta cheŋ Ejipiti la ale jam puusi Naawen tuilum guuku zuk Jerusalem po.

Title: AZAYA 28
Content:
1Ku le toa a te wuuta puuta tulika, Ɛfraim danyuirisa kanjantaŋa, nalim buui ale a nyini la, wa zula nalimu, a doa viak poosuk zuk la, tɛŋ kala jigi baai kanjanta ate daam a basi ate ba siŋ tɛŋ la. 2Nya, Nyɔnɔwa a ta ka waai ale pagra. Nna ase ŋmoruk tana ale kaasuŋ viok la, nna ase ŋmoruk niuŋ ale a fɔbi la ale ŋmoruk kuui ale chuiri a chali la, wa le yuk ka ale pagrim a lɔnsi tɛŋ. 3Wuuta puuta tulika de, Ɛfraim danyuirisaŋa kanjantaŋa, ba le tabi ba ale naŋsa. 4Nalim buui ale nyini la, zula nalimu, a doa viak poosuku po la, ale nye ase ka kiŋkama ale muni a magsi gbesika diila, nuru a dan ga nya a gbesi nyo nisa po, wa a dɛ kama.
5Dai dila danni, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, ale chim ka zula naam zutɔk, wuuta puuta tulik kaai ale nala a te wa nuru baai ale tali la. 6Wa le ta nyemagsika popola a te waai ale a bo buusa la, abe wa te baai ale ka tugurik tɔŋdɔba a za nansuiŋku nɔi la pagrim.
7Ate daam a basi ate bade a ja, a basi mɛ ate ba cheŋ a bɛ. Daam a basi ate kaabteerɔba ale biisiteerɔba a ja ale basi ate ba a butim ale basi ate ba cheŋ a bɛ. Ba dan boro a nya wie ba a ja kama, ba dan boro a poli wie ba a nak ka naŋsa. 8Ŋan zaanitaŋa meena a lik ale ka chichiita ate jigi a karo an daŋ ya.
9<<Tin ka wana ate wa a yaali ayen wa sagi? Tin ka wana ate wa boro a sak wa wanni kiri ya? Wa a biisi a te ka bi sii ale gaari ŋoosika, ale baai ale gaari biisiri. 10Ku ale ka diila ale nna. Nye abe fi ŋman nye, nye abe fi ŋman nye, a nya ku zuk abe fi ŋman nya ku zuk, magadek de la, ale magadek dula.>>
11Ku yaa be nala, Wen ale pai bi chaŋ a biisi a te nuruma de, 12a te baai ate wa weeni ayen, <<Vuusumu jigini ale nna, basi ate baai ale jiak la a vuusi. Ate dela a chim vuusum jigi, alege ba kan wom.>> 13Dila nyiŋ Naawen wanni ale a te ba la ale chim ka nna: Nye abe fi ŋman nye, nye abe fi ŋman nye, a nya ku zuk abe fi ŋman nya ku zuk. Magadek de la, magadek dula. Dila ba yaa le ga lo ŋaaŋnyiŋ, a nya tuem a jo baruk po ate ba yik ba.
14Dila nyiŋla, ni wom Naawen wanni, nama baai ale nye nuruba a la, nama baai ale a nya Jerusalem nuruma zuk la. 15Ni a kuulim kama ayen, <<Ti nye ka nɔiyeŋ ale kum, ale nye nɔiyeŋ ale boosuku. Ate kaasuŋ a dan poom cheena, ku a kan paari ti. Dii nyiŋla, ti te ate ka venta a chim ti varibasika, ate venta wie a chim ti sukka jigi.>>
16Dila Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna, <<Nya mi dueni ka tintain Zayon po, chamsi nyaka tintain, tintain dii ale ta yuei ale magsi nyubini, waai ale ta siaka la sui a kan kaasi. 17Mi ale pai nyemagsika a chim magsika miik abe wayɔrisima a chim ja magsim. Ŋmoruk tana ale chuiri ni varibasika jigini a ta cheŋ ale ni ventaŋa nyama, ate nyiam ale mobi a sueri ni sukka jigini. 18Ni nɔiyeŋka ate ni nye ale kum la ale kaasi. Ni nɔiyeŋka ate ni nye ale boosuku la a kan ŋman boro. Ase kaasuŋ kuui ale a taam la a dan jam ku le nak ni a dueni. 19Ku a dan ga jam, ku a ta ni a taam kama. Dan poom ale saluita yaase danni po, yaase yok po, ku a ta ni a taam kama. Biika de kiri miŋka ale ta yɔgsum a jam ni jigi.>>
20Gaduokku a gela ka yegayega ate fi an baga a tienti fi dega, ate kuntuŋku a mɛta a kan pili fi nyiŋka meena. 21Naawen ale yiti ŋmai ase wa ale jam nye dii Perazim Guuku zuk la, Wadek ale yiti ase wa ale jam nye dii Gibeon Viaka po la ayen wa tom wa tuini la, wa tuin chaŋka, abe wa tom wa ale magsi ayen wa tom diila, wa tuin chaŋ kaai ale magsi wa tom la. 22Yɔgyɔgla de ni basi ni nye laka dan kan daa di ni chɔrimaŋa ale dobra. Ka Nyɔnɔwa Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni mi kaasuŋku ate wa ta chaab ale tɛŋka meena la.
23Wom, abe fi wom m lueluku, kpesi a wom dii ate mi a weeni la. 24Ase kpaarɔ a dan kpa a magsi borik, wa kasim a kpa kama? Wa kasim a guti kama ale a labri tantaŋa? 25Wa a dan chalisi bu a magsi chaab wa kan bori ŋan baai nyum ale masa la bieŋa ale bie ŋaai nyum ale masa la? Wa kan bori daa ŋanbie kadukka po ale ŋan yona laŋka po? 26Wa Wenni ale dak wa abe wa sak wa suik maŋka.
27Ba kan pai laarik a fɔbi ŋan baai nyum ale masa la, yaase toroko wiiliba a tabi ŋan bie ŋaai nyum ale masa la. Ba a fɔbi ŋan baai nyum ale masa la ale ka doari ale ŋan bie ŋaai nyum ale masa la ale diok. 28Ku a fɛ ate ba num ŋan bie a nye maasa, dila waai a kan fɔbi ŋa taam wuu. Wa dan poom ta wa toroko wiilima a tabi ŋa zuk, wa wusumaŋa a kan num ŋa. 29Kude meena mɛ a nyini ka Naawen Dii Ale A De Tugurik Tɔŋdɔba Niŋ La jigi, dii ale kperi ale sakka ale zuak ale yam la.

Title: AZAYA 29
Content:
1Ku ale toa a te Ariel, tɛŋ kaai ate Deevid a kali ka po la. Ben meena ni kasim a nye ni kaabka kama. Ale a de ni tiŋŋa. 2Dila meena mi ale basi ate ba gilim Ariel tɛŋka. Wa le kum, abe wa nye ase juka kuŋkuŋ la a te mi. 3Mi ale gilim fi nuruma a ta chaab ale ba, abe m gilim ni ale yie woŋta abe m dueni bimbima a ta chaab ale ni. 4Fi ale siŋ tɛŋ, fi ale biisi a nyini ka tɛŋka. Fi ale waasi fi biika a nyini ka tɛŋka. Fi lueluku ale nye ase ka kɔk lueluk la a nyini tɛŋka zuk. Fi lueluku ale waasi a nyini ka tɛŋka.
5Alege fi dacha boanni ale nye ase ka viok ale a ji nyuŋ diila. Viok ale ji gaasa nuruma a basi ase ka vɔtta la. Ku ale kpabi kama, a diiri ba. 6Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale jam ale ka nanpansa ale tɛŋ choaka ale nuemka nna yegayega ale viok pagrik ale bolim ŋiak kaai ale a dɛ ŋanta. 7Ate tɛŋsaŋa meena dachaasaŋa ale kpaliŋ ale Ariel ale siti ka ale ka yie pagrisaŋa ale gilim ka la ale nye ase ka gɔdaasima ale pa sakka yok po la. 8Ba ale nye ase ka kom nuru ale goa a daasim ayen wa boro a de la, alege wa yiti ate kom a diem ta wa la. Ba ale nye ase ka nuru ate nyanyuila a ta wa la, ate wa goa daasim ayen wa boro a nyu nyiam la, alege ate wa yiti a wobsa ate nyanyuila ta wa la. Ku be le nye ka dila ale tɛŋsa nuru boanni ale a kpaliŋ ale Zayon Guuk la.
9Ni baŋ nidek ate ku cha ni, abe ni yi ate ni kaa nya. Ni buk, alege ku a kan chim daam nyuka. Ni a ja alege ku kan chim daam nyuka. 10Naawen a nye kama ate goom a jam ni jigi. Wa a lik wa biisiteerɔma nina kama. Wa ŋman lik wa biisiteerɔma zuimaŋa.
11Fi jigi pa sakka de meena ka kinla alege ka wie nyiini a lik bo gbaŋka po. Ate fi dan weeni waai ale baga a karim ayen, <<Wa karim kude, >> Wa ale tulisi ayen, <<Mi an baga. Ba lik ka kama.>> 12Yaase fi dan pai te waai ale kan baga a karim la, ayen <<Wa karim kude.>> Wa ale tulisi ayen, <<Mi zɛ karimka.>>
13Nyɔnɔwa a weeni kama ayen, <<Nuruma de a jam a moata mi ale ka ba noaŋa ale a zuli mi ale ba nɔngbanvaataŋa, alege ba suiniimaŋa a yalima ale mi kama. Ka nuruba ale sak ba wie ate ba pai wa ŋala nyiini a puusi mi. 14Dila nyiŋla, mi ale ŋman cha nuruma de ale wakinkagla. Yam nyam yam ale be, sebrɔba sebika ale muriŋ bɛ.>> 15Ku ale toa a te baai ale a siŋ liuŋ po nna niŋniŋa a suk Naawen a nye ba wie la, ale baai ale a nye ba wie legi po ale a poli ayen, <<Ka wana ale nya ti? Ka wana ale seba?>> 16Ni yik ka wie a tulim a basi tɛŋ, nna se mɛɛrɔwa ale tulim chim yak diila. Jaab ale weeni waai ale nye wa la ayen <<Wa an nye mi?>> Samɔniŋka ale baga a weeni mɛɛrɔwa ayen, <<Wa zɛ jaaboa?>>
17Ku a kan beni, ate Lebanon labri a chim tɛŋ poosukwa, ate tɛŋ poosuku a nye ase gɔi la? 18Dai dila danni, baai tue ale ka a wom la ale wom gbaŋka wieŋa ate legi po yeoba nina ale nya. 19Baai ale yik badek la ale ŋman nya masim Naawen nyiŋ. Ate baai ale a silim ŋanta la ale de masim Waai ale Welema a bo Izirali la nyiŋ. 20Baai nyeka ale toa la ale bɛ ate baai ale nye nuruba a la la ale muriŋ bɛ, ate baai meena ale pai nina a nya biem la ba ale gebi ba a lɔnsi tɛŋ. 21Baai ale a velim a te nuruba, ale baai ale pai nuru baai ale kan seba wari nɔi po a nyo wari po la, ale baai ale pai venta wie a nye ate baai ale kan seba wari nɔi po a kan nya wensie buusa la, Naawen ale kaasi ba.
22Dila nyiŋla, Naawen dii ale vari Abrayam a basi la, ale a weeni dii a te Jekob dɔkdemma la ale nna: <<Chivie a kan ŋman yik Jekob, chivie a kan ŋman bo ba nina po. 23Ba dan nya mi nisimaŋa tuima ba bisaŋa po, ba ale ta mi yuenni ale weleŋsa. Ba ale siak Jekob Weleŋsa Nyɔnɔwa weleŋsaŋa, abe ba zaani a pai zula a te Izirali Wenni. 24Baai tue ale kpari la ale miŋ biik kiri. Ate baai ale a fɔbili la ale siak sinsaga.>>

Title: AZAYA 30
Content:
1Naawen a weeni ayen, <<Ku ale toa a te bi sii tue ale kpari la, ate baai ale a pai zɔk ŋaai ale kan daa mi zɔga la, ale a nye nɔiyeŋ alege an nyini mi Chiika jigi la, a pai wabaata a vi chaab zuk la, 2a cheŋ siŋ Ejipiti alege an bek mi, baai ale gisi maarika a nyini Faaro jigi la, Ejipiti yɔgsum ayen ba suk la. 3Alege Faaro likka ale te ni ka chivie, ate Ejipiti yɔgsummu ale ta chivie a jam ni jigi. 4Ba dan poom ta kpaga ate ŋa bo Zoan, ate ba tomtomdɔma a paari Yanes, 5waai meena ale jo chivie po, dii nyiŋla, nuruba ale kan ta kiri a te ba. Ba a kan te ba maarika yaase nyuenta, alege ka chivie ale kanpiinta nyiini.>>
6Naawen wa dii ale magsi chaab ale Negev duŋsaŋa la ale nna. Tɛŋ kaai ale pagra ate daanika ale gbeŋma ale gbeŋ niima ale waapiisa ale nakpaasa, tuimtomdɔma a pai ba jigsika a vi bonsa zuk, ba tuilum ŋantaŋa a vi laalaakomiba boataŋa zuk, a cheŋ tɛŋ kaai ale kan ta nyuenta la, 7a cheŋ Ejipiti, kaai maarika ale bola kan ta kiri ya. Dila nyiŋla mi a wi wa ayen ka Arayab a Ka Tuintuini.
8Cheŋ yɔgyɔgla de, a ga ŋmarisi a dueni tintain paglak nyiŋ a te ba, abe fi ŋman ŋmarisi a nyo gbaŋ po, ayen da ŋaai ale cheen la ku baga a chim taam wuu seerɔ kama. 9Ba ka nuru baai ale a zɛri wie, ba ka bi sii ale a velim ale bi sii ale kaa a yaali ayen ba wom Naawen ale a weeni diila. 10Ba a weeni baai ale a nya wie la ayen, <<Ni kan ŋman a nya wie!>> ale a weeni biisiteerɔma ayen, <<Ni kan ŋman pai wamaŋsa wie a te ti! Ni weeni ti wamasisa, ni mooli pimpaasima wie. 11Ni basi suiku de, ni nyini suiku po a nyini, abe ni kan ŋman ta Waai ale Welema Izirali po la wie a paari ti!>>
12Dila nyiŋ, Waai ale Welema Izirali po la ale a weeni diila ale nna: <<Ni ale zɛri wanni de la nyiŋ, ale pa ni sebchakka a basi namsika zuk la ale pimpaasima zuk la, 13biemu de ale za bu jam ni zuk ase parik woŋ ale na a moata lueta, a yaa deri lo mwuli. 14Ka le wɛ ka nna bunabuna ase samɔniŋ la, a lo ate jiirim karo ate takabaŋa po takabi karo a pai bolim kaali daanika po yaase a kuuri nyiam samɔniŋ po.>>
15Nyɔnɔwa Naawen dii ale Welema a bo Izirali la ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Laŋ nyeka ale vuusum po ale fi ta varibasika, sinika ale mariŋka po ale fi ta pagrim, alege fi kan ta bade waai ya. 16Ni weeni kama ayen, <Aaya, ti ale pa wusuma a chali be.> Dila nyiŋ ni ale chali. Ni weeni kama ayen, ti le do wusum ŋaai ale baga a chali la a chali be, alege baai ale a vi ni la ale chali a gaam ni! 17Nuru yeŋ nyigsika ale basi ate tusidi a chali, ate nuruba banu nyigsika ni meena ale chali, ate ba ga tali ni ase tikti la guuku zuk, ase tikti la pina zuk.>>
18Alege Naawen a yaali kama ayen wa chim suipeentik a te ni. Wa yiti kama ayen wa sak jiirim. Dii nyiŋla Naawen ka nyemagsika Wen. Baai meena ale a limisi wa la ale nya niaka.
19Zayon nuru baai ale bo Jerusalem po la, ni kan ŋman kum. Ni dan kum a yaali maarika wa jigi wa ale chim niauŋ a te ni. Wa dan ga wom wa le tulisi ni. 20Nyɔnɔwa a te ni ka dachaani ŋandiinta ale namsika nyiam, ni sagrɔma a kan ŋman suk, ni le pai nidek nina a nya ba. 21Ni dan poom cheem juga yaase gala, ni tueŋa ale wom lueluk ni ŋaaŋ, a weeni ayen, <<Suiku ale nna, ni cheŋ ku po.>> 22Ate ni le kaasi ni bɔgtaŋa ate ni pai kpana ale ligmɔniŋ a taari ŋa la. Ni le yuk ŋa a basi ase garuk daŋtik la a weeni ba ayen, <<Ni cheŋ du.>>
23Wa ale basi ate ŋmoruk a ni a basi ni ŋan borintaŋa po, ate ni ale a nya ŋandiin tii tɛŋka zuk la ale nala abe ti piisi. Dai dila danni, ni niiŋa ale nya wuuk yɔksuk yegayega a ŋɔbi. 24Lalisaŋa ale bonsaŋa ale a kpa la ale ŋɔbi kinkaa ale wukosik ate ba pai ŋanta a kati a waaŋ la. 25Dai dii dai ate ni dachaasaŋa a za ba kpi la ate ba yie woŋtaŋa a za ŋa lo la, beli naŋsa nyaata ale nyini guuta, meena zuk a siŋ. 26Chiika ale nyaksi ase wenbinni la, ate wenbinni nyaksika ale nye ka nna cheri ku naŋtuok nɔi buyopɔi, ase da puma ŋayopɔi bolim la, Naawen ale pɔbi wa nuruma mulaŋa abe wa tebi wa ale kɔni baai la.
27Ni nya, Naawen Yue a nyini ka niŋ a cheena ale suipuurum buui ale a dɛ la ale nyuisa chiŋma. Wa nɔngbanvaataŋa a sueri ale ka suipuurum, ate wa giŋgeluŋku a chim bolim buui ale a dɛ. 28Wa vuusumu a nye ase ka nyiam ale a wuuri la, a yiri jueli a paari ŋiri. Wa pai kaasuŋ yeliŋka a yeliŋ tɛŋsaŋa. Wa pa ka nɔi baŋsa a su ba noaŋa a ta ba a cheŋ bɛ. 29Ate ni ale lenni yiila ase yok po tigi weleŋ ate ni a de la. Ni suiniima ale de masim ase nuruba ale ta paampuuŋta a jueli Naawen guuku, Izirali Piuŋku zuk la. 30Naawen ale basi ate nuruba a wom wa lueluk pagrika, abe wa basi ate ba nya wa nisaŋa ale a siŋ tɛŋ ale suipuurum ale bolim buui ale a dɛ la ale nyiam chiŋma, ale ŋmoruk viok ale ŋmoruk tana. 31Naawen lueluku ale kaasi Assiria. Wa ale pai wa dachekka a nak ba a lɔnsi tɛŋ. 32Nakka meena ate Naawen a pa wa namsika doani a nak la ale chim ka kayaksa ale kpanta yiili, ase wa le pai nigua a kpaliŋ ale ba kpaliŋka po la. 33Ba gomsi Tofet ate ku beni ya. Ku gomsi a magsi naawa. Bolim golukku a limisa kama ale lagri, ale bolim yega ale daata. Naawen vuusumu a nye ase ka benaŋ ate bolim ŋiak a nyini du a de la.

Title: AZAYA 31
Content:
1Ku ale toa a te baai ale a cheŋ Ejipiti a yaali maarika la, baai ale pai ba sebchakka a basi wusuma zuima la, baai ale ta sebchakka ale toroko boanni la, ale ba wusum duerɔma pagrimu la, alege a kan gisi Waai ale Welema a bo Izirali la, yaase ba gisi maarika a nyini Naawen jigi la. 2Wala abe ale ta yam a baga a ta kaasuŋ a jam. Wa dan weeni wari, wa kan lugsi wa wieŋa. Wa ale yiti ŋmai a kpaliŋ ale ja bioku yenni ale baai ale a maari nuru baata ate ba a tom biem la. 3Alege Ejipiti demma ka nurubisa ba daa Wen ya. Ba wusumaŋa a ta ka nyiŋlam ŋa ka chiisa. Dai dii dai ate Naawen a teeri wa nisaŋa la, waai ale a maari wa la ale nak naŋ a lo. Ate waai ate ba a maari la ale lo. Ba nɔi bayewa ale maa chaab a kpi.
4Nya kude ate Naawen a weeni mi ayen, <<Ase kom ale ta gbeŋli ate di yik jaab a boro a ŋɔbi ate naapeerisa a tigsi chaab ayen ba nyigsi di ale ba nakka yaase ba daani di ale ba kaarik la alege di an yɔgsa ale ba kaarika. Dila Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale siŋ a nye kpaliŋ Zayon Guuku ale ku zukparukku. 5Ase nuinsa ale bo wen a ja diila, dila dek mi Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale lik Jerusalem. Wa le lik abe wa vari ka a basi, wa le va ka zuk a taam abe wa vari ka a basi.>>
6Ni ŋman jam wa jigi ale ni tom a kaasi wa kama. Nama Izirali demma. 7Ate da dila danni, ni waai meena ale zɛri kpana ale ligmɔniŋ bɔgtaŋa ate ni nisim baataŋa a nye la.
8Assiria demma ale lo ale gebik kaai ale kan daa saalɔ gebiga. Gebik kaai ale za ka kaasi ba la daa nurubiik ale nye ka. Gebik ka de nyiŋ, ba le chali a bɛ gebika. Ate ba bi paalukku ba fɛ ba ate ba tom tuim pagra. 9Ba pagrimu jigini ale lo tɛŋ yɔgsum nyiŋ. Ba kpaŋŋa a dan nya kpaliŋka tiktiwa ba kpaziita ale nak.>> Naawen ale weeni diila ale la, waai bolimu ale bo Zayon la, waai bolim dɔkku ale bo Jerusalem la.

Title: AZAYA 32
Content:
1Ni nya, naab ale dɛ naam ale wayɔrisima, ate kpaga ale dɛ naam ale nyemagsika. 2Nuru meena ale nye ase ka yɔgsum la a lik vioku ate ku kan paari fu ale sukka jigi ate ŋmoruk vioku a kan paari fu, ale benaŋsa ale bo gɔi po la, ale piuŋ kpioŋ yisuŋ ale bo tɛŋ kosik po la.
3Dila baai nina ale a nya la a kan ŋman ligi, baai tue ale a wom la ale wom. 4Waai ale a poli mwuli la ale seba abe wa miŋ chak, waai ale biisi a gagli la ale biisi nyaanti. 5Ba kan ŋman wi beruk ayen zula nyɔnɔ yaase paasidɔ ayen zula nyɔnɔ. 6Beruk a biisi ka berinni, ate wa popolaŋa a kasim ta biem nyiini. Wa a nye ka wie ŋaai ate Naawen a kisa la, ale a nye wie a kaasi Naawen. Wa kan te kom ale ta baai la ŋandiinta ale a mini baai ate nyanyuila a ta la nyiam. 7Paasidɔwa nyeelaŋa ka gaasa nyiini, wa a nye ka biem wie ayen wa kaasi jajakka ale venta, jajakka wanni a dan poom ta wensie, wa bo a mini wa. 8Alege zula nyɔnɔ a zɔk ka zula zɔga, wa zulaŋa nyiŋ wa a zaani kama.
9Nama nipok baai ale a nya wari ase di daa wari la, ni yiti a wom mi, Nama nipokbili sii ale a poli ayen ni bo ka boka dek jigi la, ni wom mi ale ta dii m weeni la. 10Ku dan gaam bein maga dega nama baai ale a poli ayen ni bo ka boka dek jigi la ale lo, tii sii ale a yɔni yɔna la a kan ŋman yɔni. 11Ni lo nama nipok baai ale a nya wari ase di daa wari la, ni nyiŋsa ale gɔk. Nama nipokbili sii ale poli ayen ni bo ka boka dek jigi la, ni yeeri ni gattaŋa abe ni jo boorisa gatta a basi ni chaasaŋa po. 12Ni a nak kuusidi laŋ maŋsaŋa ale yɔna tiisaŋa 13ale m tɛŋka nuruma nyiŋ, tɛŋ kaai ate muŋsa ale muŋkangɔtisa a vari ka la, mm ni kum te yie ŋaai ale jam ta suipeentik la ale tɛŋ kpieŋka ate nuruba a jam a yaali la. 14Yie pagrisaŋa ba le banti ŋa, nuemka tɛŋka a doa koruk, guuta ale gboŋ woŋku ale chim tɛŋ kaai ale kan ta kiri la taam wuu, bonsa boka jigi ale duŋsa dɛka jigi, 15ate ku paari diipo ate Naawen Chiika ale nyini ŋmazuk a siŋ ti zuk la, ate gɔnni ale chim laŋ poosuk abe laŋ poosuku a nye ase sagi la. 16Nyemagsika tuima ale bo gɔnni po abe wayɔrisima a bo laŋ poosuku po. 17Wayɔrisima yɔnaŋa ale chim ka suiyɔgni. Wayɔrisima nyeka ale ta chim ale sebchakka a jam taam wuu. 18Mi nuruma ale bo suiyɔgni jiga, ba le bo yie ŋaai ale ta boka la po, juijui ate daanika a karo la a vuusi. 19Ŋmoruk tana a dan lo gɔnni po ate tɛŋ kpieŋka a ŋɔriŋ meena, 20nya ku le chim suipeentik dii a te ni, ate ni a bori ni ŋantaŋa buboalisa nɔi meena ale basi ate ni niiŋa ale ni bonsaŋa a dɛ nna fasiyaa.

Title: AZAYA 33
Content:
1Ku le toa a te fi kaasirɔwa, fi waai ate ba an kaasi la. Ku le toa a te fu bumbobrɔwa, fi waai ate ba an bobri fi wari la. Ase fi a dan basi kaasika, ba ale kaasi fu, ase fi a dan basi bobrika, ba ale bobri fi wie.
2Naawen yaa, ta ŋmantiik ale ti. Ti kasim a gisi fu kama. Chim ti pagrɔ saluik meena, abe fi chim ti varibasidɔ diipo ate ti bo daanika po la. 3Fi lueluku a dan na nuruma a chali, fi dan vaari yiti tɛŋsaŋa meena a waaŋ ka chaab. 4Ni ŋantaŋa ate ni vari kpaliŋka po la, tɛŋsaa, ale che ase tintue paaluk la, ase tintue boari ale a chubi ŋa la. Nuruba ale siŋ ŋa zuk ase tintue la.
5Naawen a nya ka pimpauk diila wa bo ka wen. Wa le basi ate nyemagsika ale wayɔrisima a sueri Zayon. 6Wa ale chim nyubi dek a magsi ni vaaŋa po, tigi a magsi varibasika ale yam ale sebika. Naawen yɔgsum chalika ka saari fiik a magsi jigini de.
7Nya, ba nidoa tuasaŋa a kaari ate ku a jueli kama suitaŋa po, suiyɔgni nyama a kum kama tuotuowa. 8Ba banti suik doataŋa kama, nyeendɔba a ka suitaŋa po. Nɔiyeŋka a kaasi ya, baai ale za ka ŋaaŋ la a waaŋ ya, ba waai a ka zula. 9Tɛŋka a kum kama ale kpeeri a bɛ, chivie a ta Lebanon ate ka kpi. Saaron a nye ase ka Araba la, ate Basan ale Karmel vaataŋa a wiiri a lo.
10Naawen ayen, <<Yɔgyɔgla de m le vaari yiti, yɔgyɔgla de m le nya pimpauk, yɔgyɔgla de m le nya zak zaanika. 11Ni yik ka yaata puuk, ni biak kinkaa, Ni vuusumu ka bolim a dɛ ni. 12Nuruma ale dɛ a chim buntuem, ase munsa ate ba che basi la, ba ale chɔgsi bolim.>>
13Nama baai ale yalima la, a wom dii ate mi nye la, nama baai ale moata la ni miŋ m pagrimu. 14Waba nyeerisaŋa ale bo Zayon la kpaziita a nak kama. Baai ale kan seba Naawen nyiŋsa a gɔk. <<Ka ti wana ale wa baga bo bolim buui ale a dɛ la po? Ka ti wana ale wa baga bo bolim buui ale kasim a dɛ taam wuu la po?>> 15Ka waai ale a cheŋ wayɔrisima po ale a biisi dii ale magsi, waai ale a zɛri nyuenta a nyini varidɔba jigi la ate wa nisa kan tuesi ŋan baai ate ba pai a da wa la, waai ale kaa wom nuru koorisa wie a kan chamu biem wie la. 16Nuruwa de ale wa bo ŋmai, waai sukka jigi ale ku chim guuku yie pagrisaŋa la. Wa le nya ŋandiinta, wa be kan silim nyiamoa.
17Fi ninaŋa ale nya naawa wa nalimu po, abe fi nya tɛŋ kaai ale tati a cheŋ niŋ la. 18Fi popola po fi ale poli yikaasidɔ kpakka wari ayen, <<Kpagi kpienni a bo ka bɛ? Waai ale a tuesi ligraŋa la a bo ka bɛ? Waai ale a nya yie woŋtaŋa zuk la a bo ka bɛ?>> 19Fi a kan ŋman nya kayerinni nuruma de, nuru baai ale a biisi bichaŋ la, ate ba pai ba giŋgeluŋta a biisi bi chaŋsa ate si miŋka a toa la.
20Ni zak nya Zayon, ni tiŋŋa tɛŋka, ni nina ale nya Jerusalem, suiyɔgni boka jigi, viuk kuui ale kaa yeeri la, ku kpaasaŋa a kan voori yaase ku miisaŋa kanyi mɛ la a gebi. 21Dula Naawen ale chim ti Tanjaŋini. Ku ale nye ase ka benaŋsa ale buboalisa jigi la. Ŋaaruŋ kpioŋ an baga a cheŋ ŋa zuwa yaase ku baga a zaani ŋa zuwa yaase ku baga a zaani ŋa nɔi ya. 22Naawen ale tama boteerɔ. Naawen ale a te tama sinsaga. Naawen ale ti naab. Ka wala ale wa vari ti a basi.
23Ni miisaŋa a baliŋ kama. Chimmu a ŋman ka pagrimoa, ate ŋaaruŋku a kan damu a cheŋ niŋŋa. Ate ni ale nye kpaliŋsa a nya ŋan baai a nyini du la, ba ale lab ŋa a te chaab ate gbansa mɛ ale nya ba nitalim. 24Waai a kan bo Zayon po a weeni ayen, <<Mi a yuak kama.>> Ate baai ale bo dula la biemu a nya vɔŋteka.

Title: AZAYA 34
Content:
1Ni cheŋ a paari, a wom nama tɛŋsa. Ni zaani ŋmam nama nuruba. Basi ate tɛŋzuk de demma a wom ale ŋan baai meena ale bo ka po la, tɛŋka meena ale jaab meena ale nyini ka po a nyini la. 2Naawen sui ale a puuri ale tɛŋsaŋa meena. Wa suipuurumu a bo ka ba tugurik tɔŋdɔma meena zuk. Wa za wa kaasi ba meena kama, Wa le pai ba a te ka tɔgridɔwa. 3Ba ale yuk nuru baai ate ba ko la a basi, ba kpiema ale kasim a nyuŋ, ba ziitaŋa ale tagli guutaŋa zuima meena. 4Chiŋmarisaŋa meena ale bo wenzukku la ale nyaliŋ, ate wenzuk a kpamsi ase duŋ gbaŋ la. Chiŋmarisaŋa meena ale wiiri lo ase tiib vaata la, ase moota ale nyini kiŋkaŋ zuk a lo diila.
5M gebika a nyu chak kama wenŋmazuk. Ni nya, ka siŋ cheen ka Edom zuk ale buusa, ba ka nuru baai ate mi a poom ŋaam a kaasi ba la. 6Naawen gebika a so ale ka ziim. Kpaam ale lik ka ale pa bisa ale bua ziita ale kpaam a nyini padaasa yiima po. Diila Naawen a ta ka kaabka a bo Bozra ale tɔgrik kpieŋ a bo Edom. 7Ate lalik jeeŋ kaai ale waara la ale lalikbilisa ale lalik kpieŋsa ale lɔ tɛŋ ale ba. Ziim ale tagli ba tɛŋka zuk, ate kpaam ale mooŋ nyuŋku.
8Diila Naawen a ta ka dai ayen wa tuni baai ale nye biem la. Ku ale chim ka namsika ben, ayen wa pai a nye a maari Zayon. 9Edom beli naŋsaŋa ale chim kotaali, ate nyuŋku ale chim bolim kaala, ate wa tɛŋka ale chim kotaali bolim. 10Bu a kan kpi yok yaase kantueŋŋa. Bu nyuisaŋa ale kasim a yiti kama taam wuu. Gaŋsa tɔgatɔga ale jam taam, ka ale diem chim ka tɛŋ lɔri a dua. Nuru a kan ŋman va ka po a taam. 11Kpaluŋ ale viuk ale tuesi ka. Viuk kpioŋ ale tagaaruk ale yɔk tukta dula. Wen ale teeri butimka magsika miika ale kaasuŋ magsika jaamu a basi Edom zuk. 12Ba nuru kpientaŋa a kan ta jaab dula a nak kuusidi ayen ba tɛŋŋa, ate ba nabisaŋa meena ale muriŋ bɛ.
13Muŋsa ale chim a vari ba nalima yieŋa, ate muŋsa tiisa ale chim a vari ba tɛŋka parisaŋa. Gɔi baasa ale nya wa a pai chim kɔk. Abe ka chim viita yeri. 14Gɔi duŋsa ale tu chaab ale piina, ate walisa ale kum a gisi chaab, ate yok ŋanta ale kali dula, ate dula ale chim ba vuusum jiga. 15Viuku ale yɔk ku tuk dula a lob jena. Ku ale wɔgri a pai ku kinkaŋŋa a lik ku bisaŋa. Dula mɛ ate kpaluŋ chaasa meena ale tigsi chaab jigi yeŋ, jaduok ale jasari.
16Nya Naawen gbaŋka po a karim. Ŋade kunyi mɛ la a kan nyini du a nyini bɛ. Ba wanyi mɛ la a kan silim wa vaanchoa. Diila ka wa nɔnni ale biisi wanni, ate Naawen Chiika ale tigsi ba meena a jam jigi yeŋ. 17Wa ale lab ba jiŋŋa a te ba. Wa pai ka ja magsimmu ale bo wa nisaŋa po la a lab a te ba. Ba ale soa ku kama taam wuu, ate ba ŋaaŋbiik sii ale bo ŋaaŋ cheen la ale bo dula.

Title: AZAYA 35
Content:
1Gɔnni ale tɛŋ kosikka ale nya suipeentik. Gɔnni ale de masim abe di busum. Ase puuta la, 2ti ale na pusi a nala. Ti ale dɛ masim nna yegayega abe ti a nye masim nuemka. Lebanon zulaŋa ale cheŋ ka jigi, ate Karmel ale Saaron nalimu ale cheŋ si jigi. Ba ale nya Naawen zulaŋa ale ti Wenni nalimu.
3Te ni sii ale wobsa la pagrim ale duna ŋaai ale a te suik la a kan baga a choa. 4Weeni baai kpaziita ale a nak la ayen, <<Ba pagra, ba kan yɔgsa. Ni Wenni ale jam, wa cheen kama ayen wa namsi ni dachaasaŋa ba ale pai biem buui meena a nye ni la nyiŋ. Wa ale jam a vari ni a basi.>>
5Ate yeeba nina ale lagri, ate tukpara nyam ale wom. 6Ate gbaniŋ ale yɔk a zi ase kab la, ate waai ale kan baga a biisi la ale nye masim nuemka. Nyiam ale nyini gɔnni po ate beli naŋsa ale bo tɛŋ kosikka po. 7Tɛŋ kaai ale a dɛ bolim la a chim beli, ate tɛŋ kaai ale kɔ la, ale buli nyiam. Juijui ate gɔi baasa a duak la, wuuta ale wobi ale bimbena ale chim dula jigini.
8Ate suik duok ale bo dula. Ba ale wi ku ayen Weleŋsa Suik. Nuru daŋtisa a kan va ku zuwa. Ku ale boro a magsi ka baai ale a va Suiku la nyiini. Baai ale ta gaasa ale chim betta la a kan va ku po. 9Gbeŋli a kan bo dula, yaase duŋ biok a cheŋ du. Si a kan bo dula. Alege ka baai ale nya da tuesika la ale za ba cheŋ va dula, 10ate Naawen nuru baai wa da tuesi la a ŋman pilim jam. Ba ale cheŋ ga jo Zayon ale yiila lennika. Taam wuu masim ale chim naam zutɔk a bo ba zuima. Suipeentik ale paari ba, ate niniga ale chivie ale nyini ba jigi.

Title: AZAYA 36
Content:
1Bena pi ale ŋanaansiwa po ate Azekaya a dɛ wa naamu la, ate Sennacherib ale ka Assiria naab la, a jam siti Juda tɛŋ kpieŋ sii meena ale ta parisa ate si pagra la a yik ba. 2Assiria naawa yaa tom wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma kpagni ale tugurik tommu ate ba nyini Lachis a cheŋ Naab Azekaya jigi Jerusalem po. Ase tugurik tɔŋdɔma kpagni ale jam zaani Ŋmazuk Benni la, suik kuui ate ba va a cheŋ Sugridɔwa Talimu la, 3ate Eliakim, Yilkia nidoabinni waai ale a nya naawa yenni tuimaŋa zuk la ale Sebna waai ale ka gbaŋ ŋmarisidoawa la ale Joa, Asaf nidoabinni teeridɔwa a yaa cheŋ wa jigi.
4Tugurik tɔŋdɔma kpagni a yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Weeni Azekaya ayen, <Naab kpioŋku, Assiria naawa ale a weeni diila la ale nna. Nama dek a tin pai ni sebchakka a basi ka boan jaab zuwa? 5Fi a weeni kama ayen fi ta zɔga ale tugurik tɔŋdɔba ate ba pagra, alege fi a weeni ka wie koruta. Fi pai fi sebchakka a basi ka wana zuwa, a zɛri mi nɔi ya? 6Be nya, fi pai fi sebchakka a basi ka Ejipiti zuk, wa ka bimbena dachek kaai ate fi dan sali ka, ka wɛ a lu fu a kɔni fu la. Baai meena ale pai ba sebchakka a basi Faaro Ejipiti naawa zuk la a nye ase ka dila la. 7Ate fi dan weeni mu ayen, <<Ti pai ti sebchakka a basi ka Naawen dii ale ka ti Wen la zuk.>> Daa wa kaabka pimpitimaŋa ale kuŋkuŋtaŋa ate Azekaya a jam yeeri la, a weeni Juda ale Jerusalem ayen, <<Ni magsi kama ayen ni puusi kuŋkuŋku de niŋ la?>>
8<< <Jam yɔgyɔgla de, biisi ale m kpagni Assiria naawa a magsi. M le te fu wusuma tusa ŋaye (2,000) ase fi nin baga a nya duerɔba ate ba a dɔ ŋa. 9Fi sebchakka ate fi ta ale Ejipiti a yaali wusuma torokoba ale wusum duerɔba la, fi ale nye ka sɛ a baga a poom zaani ale mi kpagni waai ale pɔsima ba po la? 10A ŋman gum du, mi jam a siti tɛŋka de a kaasi ka alege an wom wari a nyini Naawen jigi ya? Naawen dek ale weeni mi ayen m gɔk santiri a jueli tɛŋka de zuk a kaasi ka.> >>
11Ate Eliakim ale Sebna ale Joa a yaa weeni tugurik tɔŋdɔma niŋdeerɔwa ayen, <<Ti a saalim fu ayen biisi Araam biika ale fi tomteerɔma, ti le toalim a wom ka la. Kan biisi Yiburu ate nuru baai ale bo siaka zuk la a wom.>>
12Alege kpagni a tulisi ayen, <<Ka fi ale fi kpagni nyiŋ ate m kpagni a tom mu ayen m jam weeni wieŋa de, alege daa nuru baai ale kala siaka zuk la, ate ba a nye ase nama ate ba za ba dɛ badek daŋta abe ba nyu badek sinsam la?>>
13Ate kpagni yaa yiti zaani a weeni ale Yiburu biika ate ku nyini peelim ayen, <<Ni wom naab kpioŋku, Assiria naawa ale ta dii ayen wa weeni la. 14Naawa ale a weeni diila ale nna ayen, Ni kan te Azekaya a paasi ni. Wa an baga a vari ni a nyini mi nisa po a basi. 15Kan basi ate Azekaya a basi ate ni ta sebchakka ale Naawen ase wa le weeni ayen, <Naawen ale sum a vari ti a basi. Tɛŋka de a kan bo Assiria naawa nisa po.>
16<<Assiria naawa ale weeni diila ale nna ayen, Ni kan wom Azekaya. Ni nye suiyɔgni ale mi abe ni nyini a jam mi jigi. Ate waai meena ale dɛ a nyini wadek talim po ale wadek kinkaŋ yona, abe wa nyu nyiam a nyini wadek vili po, 17ate m ga jam a ta ni a cheŋ tɛŋ kaai ale a nye ase fidek tɛŋ la, tɛŋ kaai ale ta ŋandiinta ale da paalik, tɛŋ kaai ale ta boroborok ale kaduksa la.
18<<Kan wom Azekaya dii nyiŋla wa a paasi ni kama ase wa ale weeni ayen, <Naawen ale vari ti a basi.> Tɛŋ wen a diem boro a baga a vari di nuruba a nyini Assiria naawa nisa po a nya? 19Yamat ale Arpad wenaŋa a bo ka bɛ? Sefarvaim wenaŋa a bo ka bɛ? Ba baga vari Samaria a nyini mi nisa po? 20Tɛŋsaŋa de meena wenaŋa dina ale baga a vari di nuruba a nyini mi jigi ya? Naawen abe le nye ka sɛ a baga a vari Jerusalem a nyini mi nisa po?>>
21Alege nuruma a jam nye ka chim an weeni wari a tulisi ya, dii nyiŋla naawa a jam weeni kama ayen, <<Kan tulisi wa wari ya.>>
22Ate Eliakim ale ka Yilkia nidoabili la, waai ale a nya naab yenni tuimaŋa zuk la ale Sebna waai ale ka gbaŋ ŋmarisidoa la ale Joa, Asaf nidoabinni, waai ale ka teeridɔ la, a jam cheŋ Azekaya jigi ale ba garuk cheerinta ale weeni Assiria naawa kpagni ale weeni ba diila.

Title: AZAYA 37
Content:
1Naab Azekaya ale ga wom kude la, wa yaa cheeri wa gattaŋa ale pai boorisa garuk a jo a cheŋ Naawen yenni po. 2Wa jam tom ka Eliakim waai ale a nya naab yenni tuima zuk la ale Sebna gbaŋ ŋmarisidoawa ale kaabteerɔ baai ale a dɛ niŋ la, ate ba meena a jo boorisa gatta ate ba cheŋ Amoz nidoabinni Azaya Wen biisiteerɔwa jigi. 3Ba yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Azekaya ale a weeni diila ale nna ayen, danni de ka daanika ale toariŋka ale chivie dai, ase ba nyiem ale boro a biak bisa dii ate ku paari diipo ate pagrim a karo a ŋusi a biak ba diila. 4Naawen fi Wenni a baga a wom wie ŋaai ate tugurik tɔŋdɔma niŋdeerɔwa kpagni Assiria Naawa a tom wa ayen wa jam nye Naawen vukku a la, ate Naawen ale toariŋ tugurik tɔŋdɔma niŋdeerɔwa ale wie ŋaai ate Naawen dii ale ka fi Wenni a wom la. Dila nyiŋ puusi a te baai ale vua a tali boro la.>>
5Naab Azekaya kpaŋŋa ale jam Azaya jigi la, 6Azaya yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni weeni Azekaya ayen, <Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna ayen, Kan yɔgsa ale Assiria naawa wieŋa ate fi a wom ate wa biisi a kaasi mi la. 7A wom de. M za m pai ka chiik a nyo wa po ate wa dan wom wari, wa ale ŋmani a cheŋ wadek tɛŋka, ate m le basi ate ba che wa ale gebik a lɔnsi.> >>
8Tugurik tɔŋdɔma kpagni ale jam wom ayen Assiria naawa a basi Lachis la, wa jam yeeri ka wadek a nya naawa a boro a kpaliŋ ale Libna.
9Yɔgyɔgla de Sennacherib a jam tuesi ka wari ayen Tiraka, Kus denɔwa Ejipiti naawa ale wa boro a gɔk santiri ayen wa kpaliŋ ale wa. Ase wa ale jam wom la, wa yaa tom nuruba ba cheŋ Azekaya jigi ale wanni de ayen, 10<<Weeni Juda naab Azekaya ayen, <Kan te ate Wen dii ate fi pai fi sebchakka a basi wa zuk la a paasi fu ase wa le a weeni fu ayen, <<Jerusalem a kan bo Assiria naawa nisa po.>> 11Fi sum wom Assiria nalimaŋa ale nye tɛŋsaŋa meena diila kama, a kaasi ba meena fi abe le nya varibasika? 12Mi kokpieŋsaŋa ale jam kaasi tɛŋ sii la wenaŋa a jam vari ba a basi ya, ase Gozan wenaŋa ale Yaran ale Arezef ale Eden nuru baai ale jam bo Tel Assar po la? 13Yamat naawa ale Arpad naawa ale Sefarvaim tɛŋka naawa ale Yena naawa yaase Ivva naawa a bo ka bɛ?> >>
14Azekaya yaa tuesi gbaŋka a nyini nuruma jigi a karim ka, a yaa cheŋ Naawen yenni a yaa lak ka a dueni Naawen niŋ. 15Azekaya yaa puusi te Naawen ayen, 16<<Naawen yaa, fi Waai Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, Izirali Wenni ate fi kala fi naam zukpaglika zuk a bo ŋanvutaŋa suŋsuŋ la, ka fi nyiini ale Wen naata meena zuk. Fi le nye wenŋmazukku ale tɛŋzuk de. 17Naawen yaa, be lak tue a wom. Naawen yaa, be lak nina a nya. Wom wie ŋaai meena ate Sennacherib a tom te a lɛ Wen dii ale vua la.
18<<Naawen yaa, ku ka wensie ayen Assiria nalimaŋa a sum kaasi nuruma de meena kama ale ba tɛŋsaŋa. 19Ba yuk ba wenaŋa a basi ka bolim po ale kaasi ŋa, dii nyiŋla ŋa daa wena alege ka daata ale tana ate nurubiik a pai nisa a nye. 20Yɔgyɔgla de, Naawen ti Wen yaa, vari ti a nyini wa nisa po a basi, ate naataŋa meena ale bo tɛŋka zuk de la ale miŋ ayen ka fi nyiini, Naawen yaa, fi ale Wen.>>
21Dila Amoz nidoabinni Azaya yaa tom weeni Azekaya ayen, <<Naawen, Izirali Wenni ale a weeni ayen: Fi ale puusi a te mi a ta va chaab ale Sennacherib Assiria naawa la nyiŋ, 22Naawen ale biisi dii a basi wa zuk la ale nna: <<Zayon liewa ale kan seba nidoa la a zɛri fu kama ale nye fu a la. Fi ale yiti a cheŋ la, Jerusalem Liewa a girinti ka zuk. 23Ka wana ate fi a lɛ ale biisi wa a kaasi? Ka wana ate fi lak fi lueluk a basi wa zuwa ale pai fi kanjanta ninaŋa a basi wa nyiŋŋa? Ka Waai Ale Welema wadek wa nyiini a bo Izirali la. 24Fi tom ka fi tomteerɔma ate lieta a paari Nyɔnɔwa. Ate fi weeni ayen, <<M pai m torokoma a jueli guutaŋa zuk, Lebanon guutaŋa zukparuk. M che nyunyoŋtaŋa ale wɔŋa la a lɔnsi ale damɔnta tiisa ate ba lueri la. M paari ka kab tii ale kan cheŋ a paari la ale ka gɔi naliŋka. 25Mi tu vila ale nyu nyiam dula. M pai m naŋtaataŋa a nye ate Ejipiti beli naŋsaŋa a kpeeri.>>
26<< <Fi an wom ya? Ka mi ale nye dila dipo. Mi ale gomsi ŋiaka, ate yɔgyɔgla de m sum nye ate fi labri tɛŋ sii ale jam pagra la ate si chim tana a dua nna puula puula. 27Pagrim a kpeeri ba nuruma jigi, ba jɔk ka nyiŋbiiri ate ba jo chivie po. Ba a nye ase ka talim po ŋanborinta ale wuuta ale nyini a bo dɔk piluŋ zuk dii ate ŋa dan chim kantueŋ a nak ŋa a kɔ diila.
28<<M sebi fi ale bo juijui la kama ale sebi fi jamka ale fi chelim po ale fi sui ale a puuri ale mi diila. 29Fi suinni ale a puuri ale mi la nyiŋ ate m wom fi kanjanta wieŋa la nyiŋ, m le pai m gɔtika a su fi nyueŋa po, abe m pai m noabaŋka a su fi nɔnni po, abe m nye ate fi ale va suik kuui la, fi a ŋman va ku a ŋman jam.
30<<Azekaya kude ale ku chim daana ate fi nya: Benni de fi ale dɛ ŋan kayaata, ate ben dii ale a saari ŋaye la fi le dɛ a nyini ŋan baai ale nyini ŋan kayaataŋa po la. Alege ben dii ale a saari ŋata la, bori a che, be vuk tiisa a dɛ si yɔnaŋa. 31Juda yenni dem baai ale tali la ale feri tɛŋ naŋsa a yɔni yɔna ŋmazuk. 32Dila a nyini Jerusalem po nuruba ale tali, ate Zayon Guuku zuk nuru baai ale vuuk la ale boro, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale a yaali diila ale za ku basi ate kude a nye.
33<<Dila nyiŋ Naawen ale weeni dii a magsi chaab ale Assiria naawa la ale nna ayen, Wa kan jo tɛŋka de po yaase wa tɔŋ pein dela. Wa kan cheŋ ka niŋ ale jaligimmoa, yaase wa baga a sɛ pimpitima a gilim ka. 34Naawen ale weeni ayen wa ale va suik kuui a jam la, wa le ŋman va ka ku dek a ŋman cheŋ. Wa a kan jo tɛŋka de po. 35M dek ale m tomteerɔwa Deevid nyiŋ, m le maari tɛŋka de abe m vari ka a basi.>>
36Naawen maarɔwa a cheŋ nyini kama a ko nuruba tusa kook ale pinaanuŋ ale banu (185,000) Assiria tigsuŋku jigini. Vanni ale veenti ate nuruma a yiti saluiku la, ba nya ka kpieba ale dua jigi meena. 37Ate Assiria naawa Sennacherib a waaŋ tigsuŋku ale yeeri wadek a nyini du ale ŋman cheŋ Niineve a ga bo dula a jam te ate naakuuni a waaŋ chaab ate wa jam pai kpaliŋka nyeka a basi ale ŋman cheŋ Niineve a ga bo dula.
38Dai yeŋ, ase wa ale jam bo wa wenni Nisrok yenni po a puusi la, ate wa nidoabilisaŋa Adrammelek ale Sarezer a jam pai gebik woŋ a che wa lɔnsi ale chali a ga suk Ararat tɛŋka po. Ate wa nidoabinni Esayaddon a tagri wa a chim naab.

Title: AZAYA 38
Content:
1Va ŋala po ate Azekaya a jam a yuak a moata kum. Ate Amoz nidoabinni Azaya Wen biisiteerɔwa yaa cheŋ wa jigi a weeni wa ayen, <<Naawen ale a weeni diila ale nna ayen, Gomsi fi yenni a magsi, dii nyiŋla, fi za fi kpi kama. Fi kan nya nyiŋyɔgsa.>>
2Azekaya yaa cheem wa nina a tuk siaka nyiŋ ale puusi a te Naawen ayen, 3<<Naawen yaa, teeri mi ale cheŋ fi niŋ ale wensie a soa diila ale m le pai m suinum meena a te fu a soa diila ale nye dii ale nala fi nina po a soa diila.>> Azekaya a jam kum kama nna tuotuowa.
4Ate Naawen wanni a jam Azaya jigi ayen, 5<<Cheŋ ga weeni Azekaya ayen, <Dii ate Naawen, fi kowa Deevid Wenni a weeni la ale nna: Mi wom fi puusaŋa ale nya fi ninyaataŋa kama. M le pai bena pi ale ŋanu a gum fi nyuvunni po a te fu. 6Ate m le vari fi ale tɛŋka a nyini Assiria naawa nisa po a basi. M le maari tɛŋka de.
7<< <Naawen daanaŋa ale nna a te fu ayen wa ale nye dii ate wa puulim la. 8Mi ale nye ate wenbinni yisuŋku a ŋmani ŋaaŋ a siŋ naŋtuok nɔi Ayazi tiilaŋa zuk.> >> Dila kantueŋka yaa ŋmani ŋaaŋ a siŋ naŋtuok nɔi pi.
9Juda naawa Azekaya ale ŋmarisi dii wa yuammu ale wa nyiŋyɔgsaŋa ŋaaŋnyiŋ la ale nna: 10Mi weeni kama ayen, <<Diipo ate nyuvuri a nye tuilum la m magsi m cheŋ ka kum nansuiŋta, abe m jɔk m bena ŋaai ale tali la?>> 11Mi weeni kama ayen, <<Mi a kan ŋman nya Naawen, Naawen dii ale bo ŋanvuta tɛŋka po la. Mi a kan nya nurubisa yaase baai ale bo tɛŋka de meena po la. 12Ba dari m yenni a lɔnsi ka tɛŋ ase naapeerik viuk la, ate ba pai a ta nyini m jigi. Ba vili m nyuvunni ase ka yɔgdɔ ale a yɔk gatta diila wa an pai mu a su ja waai ale a yɔk gattaŋa la po. Kantueŋ ale yok fi ta mu a cheŋ ka m nuerika jigi. 13Mi limisi kama ale chichiiba a ga paari varivientidi, alege ase gbeŋli la wa wɛ m kobaŋa meena kama. Kantueŋ ale yok fi ta mu cheŋ ka nuerika jigi. 14M kaari kama ase nuim la, a kum ase kumsa nangbaŋ la. M ninaŋa a jiak kama ase mi ale zak a nya wenŋmazuk la. M bo ka daanika po. M Nyɔnɔ, jam maari mu.>>
15Alege m le weeni ka boan wari ya? Wa biisi ale mu, wala dek ale nye kude. M le zaab ka m dek a cheŋ m benaŋa meena po dii nyiŋla nyiŋdommaŋa de ale bo m chiika po la nyiŋ. 16Nyɔnɔwa, ŋantaŋa de nyiŋ ate nuruba a boro. M chiika abe a nya nyuvuri a nyini ŋa po kama mɛ. Fi ŋman te mi nyiŋyɔgsa kama ate m boro. 17Chekki, nyiŋdom ŋaai meena ate m nam la, ku nye a maari ka mi dek. Fi yaalika po, fi ta mi a nyini kaasuŋ vɔrumu po. Fi pai m wabaataŋa meena a basi ka fi ŋaaŋ. 18Diila boosuku an baga a pak fu, ate kum an baga a lenni fi pimpaukku. Baai ale a cheŋ vɔrumu po la a ka yiila ale fi wensieŋa. 19Ka baai ale vua la, bala ale a pak fu ase mi ale boro a nye dii jinla danni la. Koba a weeni ba bisa fi wensieŋa wie kama.
20Naawen ale vari mu a basi ate ti pai kpanuŋ a lenni yiila ti boka po meena Naawen yenni po.
21Azaya a jam weeni kama ayen, <<Kuri moota a fak japagni, ate wa ale nya nyiŋyɔgsa.>> 22Azekaya a jam bek kama ayen, <<Ka boa ale ku chim daana ayen mi ale cheŋ Naawen yenni?>>

Title: AZAYA 39
Content:
1Dila po Babilon naawa Baladan nidoabinni Merodak Baladan a jam ŋmarisi ka gbaŋ ale tiirim a tom te Azekaya, dii nyiŋla wa jam wom wa yuammu ale wa nyiŋyɔgsa nyaka kama. 2Azekaya yaa jam tuesi nuruma ale sak ba jaabuuri meena ale bo wa ŋanta duenika jigini la, ŋa jam ka kpana ale ligmɔniŋ ale ŋan baai ate ba pai a nyo jenta po la ale kpa naliŋ ale wa tugurik kɔlimaŋa ale jaab meena ate fi le nya wa jigi la. Jaab ka wa naab yenni po ale naamu meena po ate Azekaya an pai sak ba.
3Ate Wen biisiteerɔwa Azaya yaa cheŋ naab Azekaya jigi a bek wa ayen, <<Nuruma a jam weeni ayen ka boa, ba abe nyini ka bɛ?>> Azekaya yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ba nyini ka Babilon, tɛŋ kaai ale yalima.>> 4Wen biisiteerɔwa yaa bek wa ayen, <<Ba abe nya ka boa fi naab yenni po?>> Azekaya yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ba nya ka jaabuuri meena ale bo m naab yenni po la. Jaab an tali ya ate mi an pai a sak ba a nyini m jigi ya.>>
5Ate Azaya yaa weeni Azekaya ayen, <<Wom Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La wanni. 6Ku cheena ate jaabuuri meena ale bo fi naab yenni po la ale jaabuuri meena ate fi koma a yaali dueni a jam paari jinla de la, ba ale ji a ta cheŋ Babilon. Jaab a kan tali, ka Naawen ale a weeni. 7Ate fi ŋaaŋsa gela, fidek nyiŋka ale fidek ziimu baai ate ba za ba biak a te fu la, ba le ta ba a cheŋ, abe ba jɛ ba ate ba bo Babilon naawa yenni.>>
8Azekaya yaa tulisi ayen, <<Naawen wanni ate fi biisi la a nala kama.>> Diila wa poli kama ayen, <<Mi boka daaŋa po suiyɔgni ale likka ale boro.>>

Title: AZAYA 40
Content:
1Ni yɔk, ni yɔk m nuruma sue, ni Wenni ale weeni. 2Biisi baliyaa a te Jerusalem, a mooli te ka ayen wa tuim pagraŋa a nueri kama, ba tuni wa biemu nyiŋ kama, ayen wa tuesi a nyini Naawen nisa po wa biemu nyiŋ buye.
3Nuru lueluk ale boro a wi ayen, <<Gomsi suik gɔnni po a te Naawen. Nye ate suiku a doa yɔrr sagni po, suik duok a te ti Wenni. 4Palinti viak meena a sueri, a nye ate guuk meena ale pina meena a siŋ tɛŋ, golaŋa meena a si, ate jigi dii ale lɔrima la ale nala. 5Ate Naawen zulaŋa ale nyini peelim, ate nuru meena ale nya ŋa. Diila ka Naawen nɔnni ale biisi.
6Lueluk ale boro a weeni ayen, <<Kaari ate ku nyini peelim.>> Ate mi yaa weeni ayen, <<M kaari ayen boa? Nuru meena a nye ase ka wuuta la, ate ba zulaŋa meena a nye ase puuta ale bo talim po diila. 7Wuutaŋa a kpi kama, ate puutaŋa a lɔ, dii nyiŋla Naawen vuusumu ale a fuk ti. Chekki nuruma ka wuuta. 8Wuutaŋa a kpi kama, ate puutaŋa a lɔ, alege Wen wanni ale kasim boro kama taam wuu.>>
9Fi waai ale ta wapaala a jam Zayon la, ni jueli guwoŋ zuk. Nama baai ale ta wapaala a jam Jerusalem po la, a lak ni luelutaŋa a nuem ate ku jueli, ni te ku jueli, ni kan chali yɔgsummoa. Ni weeni Juda tɛŋsaŋa ayen, <<Ni Wenni ale nna.>> 10Nya, Nyɔnɔwa Naawen a cheena ale pagrim, ate wa nisaŋa a nya wie meena zuk a te wa. Nya, wa tutunaŋa a bo ale wa kama ate wa ale vari baai a basi la ale bani wa. 11Wa a nya wa piisaŋa zuk ase ka naapeerik la. Wa ta pabisaŋa ka wa nisa po ale pai si a pɛ. Wa a nya sii ale diem ta bisa la zuk ka nna baliyaa.
12Ka wana ale pai wa nisa a magsi nyiamoa, yaase a pai wa nisa a magsi wenŋmazukku? Ka wana ale baga a pai tɛŋzuk de nyuŋ a nyo busik po yaase wa baga a pai ja magsim a magsi pinaŋa ale guutaŋa? 13Ka wana ale baga a miŋ Naawen popolaŋa yaase wa dak wa ayen wa nye wari ase wa sagrɔ la? 14Naawen a bek ka wana ayen wa sak wa? Ka wana abe le sak wa suik miŋka? Ka wana ale jam sak wa sebika yaase wa sak wa wie miŋka suik wa?
15Tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa a nye ase ka nyanyuila la. Ba a nye ase ka paasuk ale bo ja magsim po diila. Wa magsi tɛŋ sii ale gilim nyiam la kama ate si a nye ase paasuk la. 16Lebanon a ka daata a paari kuŋkuŋ bolim cheemka, yaase ka duŋsaŋa a paari juka tiirita nyeka. 17Tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa meena daa jaab wa niŋŋa. Wa niŋ tɛŋsaŋa meena ka kinla, wa jigi si ka kiri ya.
18Ka wana ate fi ale pai Wen a magsi chaab ale wa? Jameem boan choa ate fi ale pai wa a magsi? 19Dan ka bɔgluk, ka nuru ale peesi ku, ka nuru ale pai ligmɔniŋ a taari ku, ale pai kpana chɔrima a gomsi ku. 20Nuru waai ale ŋmasi jaŋ an baga tiirim bula choa a te la, luk ka da tii ale ka a puak la a te. Wa gisi peesirɔ ate wa nye bɔgluk ate ku kan baga a lɔ.
21Fi a zɛ? Fi an wom ya? Ba an weeni fi a nyini piilimka? Fi an miŋ chagi a nyini tɛŋka piilimka? 22Wa kali ka wa naam zukpaglika zuk a bo wenŋmazukku ate tɛŋ gigilukku a bo wa tɛŋ, ate ka nuruma a nye ase nanchoŋta la. Wa lagri wenŋmazukku kama nna se viuk la ale lati ku ase garuk pali ayen wa bo ku po. 23Wa nye ate nabisa a ka kiri ya ale nye ate niŋdeerɔba tɛŋzuk de a ka kiri ya. 24Ku an beni ya ate ba vuk, ku an beni ya ate ba bori, ku kan beni ba le feri tɛŋ naŋsa, ate wa fuk ba ase viok la ate ba wiiri, ate va pagrik a ji ba a ta cheŋ ase vɔtta la.
25<<Ka wana ate fi ale pai mi a magsi chaab ale wa? Yaase wana ale soa ase mi la? Waai ale Welema la ale weeni. 26Zak nya wenŋmazukku. Ka wana ale nye ŋantaŋa de meena? Wala waai ale nye ate chiŋmarisaŋa kanyi kanyi ale si yue kanyi kanyi la. Wa pagrim buui ale zuak la ale wa pagrim kpiemu nyiŋ, ba wanyi mɛ la a kan yuli a bɛ.
27Jekob, ka boan nyiŋ ate fi a biisi. Izirali, ka boan nyiŋ ate fi a fɔbili ayen, <<Mi suiku a suk kama a nyini Naawen jigi ya, mi suitaŋa Wen a cheem ka kpai a te ti?>> 28Fi a zɛ? Fi an wom ya? Naawen ka Wen dii ale boro taam wuu. Wa ka tɛŋka kpeglimka Nyeerɔ. Wa kan jiagi yaase wa pagrim a nueri, ate waai karo a miŋ wa popolaŋa ale ka diila. 29Baai pagrim ale nueri la wa a te ba pagrim ale a gum pagrim du a te baai ale wobsa la. 30Bi paaluk a jiak kama ate ba pagrim a nueri, nidoa paaluk nyiŋsa ale gɔk ate ba lɔ. 31Alege baai ale ta yiila ale Naawen la ale nya pagrim paalik. Ba ale yiri ale kiŋkaŋŋa ase jiirita la. Ba le chali ba kan jiagi, ba le cheŋ ba kan cha vuusummoa.

Title: AZAYA 41
Content:
1<<Tɛŋ sii ate nyiam a gilim si la a nye chim mi niŋ. Basi ate tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa a ŋman nya pagrim paalik. Basi ate ba jam niŋ a biisi. Basi ate ti tu chaab buusa boka jigini.
2<<Ka wana ale choa waai ale nyini konni po la, a wi wa wayɔrisima po wa tuima zuwa? Wa pai tɛŋ kpieŋsa a te wa ale te ate nalima a siak a te wa. Wa pai wa gebik woŋka a nye ate ba chim buntuem ale pai wa tommu a fuk ba a basi ase vɔtta la. 3Wa a vi ba kama alege jaab an nye wa. Wa va ka suik kuui ate wa an diem va ku a nya ya. 4Ka wana ale nye nna la ale ta ku a ga taamu ale a wi gaŋ sii ale nyini piilimka la? Mi Naawen ale piilimka, ka mi ale kpeglimka mɛ.>>
5Tɛŋ sii ate nyiam a gilim si la, a nya kama ale yɔgsa. Tɛŋka meena nyiŋsa a gɔk kama. Ate ba paari chaab a jam niŋ. 6Wanyi meena a maari wa choa ale a weeni wa suok ayen, <<Bi pagra.>> 7Peesirɔwa a te choabiika nyiŋbiiri, ate waai ale pai kuk doaguri a salisi la a te waai ale a nak kutuk la nyiŋbiiri. Wa a weeni waai ale a tom kuta chaab la ayen, <<Ku nala kama.>> Wa a nak bɔglukku ale peema a feri tɛŋ ayen ku kan lɔ tɛŋŋa.
8<<Alege fi, Izirali, m tomteerɔ Jekob, waai ate m lueri fu la, a nyini Abrayam mi doawa ŋaaŋbisaŋa po la, 9Mi pai fu kama a ta nyini tɛŋka kpeglimka, a nyini ka gugottaŋa ale yalima la po, mi wi fu kama. Mi weeni kama ayen fi ka m tomteerɔ mi lueri fu kama mi an zɛri fu. 10Dila kan yɔgsa, ale mi bo ale fu kama. Kan jɔk nyiŋbiiri, diila mi ale fi Wen. M le te pagrim abe m maari fu. M le pai m wayɔrisima juga nisaŋa a yik fu.
11<<Baai meena ale ta chaab ale fu la chivie ale yik ba. Baai ale kaa siak a te fu la kan ta kiri ya abe ba kpi. 12Fi dan poom a gisi fi dachaasaŋa, fi a kan nya ba. Baai ale a nye kpaliŋ ale fu la meena a kan bola a ta kiri ya. 13Dii nyiŋla mi ka Naawen, fi Wen dii ale yik fi juga nisaŋa ale a weeni fu ayen, kan yɔgsa. M le maari fu. 14Kan yɔgsa, Jekob ale Izirali tɛŋ kaai ale pɔsima la, diila mi dek ale maari ni,>> Naawen ale a weeni dila, fi Da Tuesirɔwa, Waai ale Welema a bo Izirali la.
15<<Nya, m le nye fu ŋanta fɔbika laarik ale nɔi paali dii ale a de la ale nyina nna yegayega. Fi le ŋɔriŋ pinaŋa abe guutaŋa a chim vɔtta. 16Fi ale yali ti, ate viok ale pai ti, ate va pagrik ale ji ti a ta cheŋ. Alege fi ale de masim Naawen niŋ abe fi nya zula Waai ale Welema a bo Izirali po la.
17<<Ŋanjaksa ale baai ale a silim la a gisi ka nyiam, alege bu karo. Ba giŋgeluŋtaŋa a kɔ kama ale nyanyuila. Alege mi Naawen ale tulisi ba. Mi Izirali Wenni a kan zɛri ba. 18M le nye ate bela a bo gu tii ate jaab a karo la zuk, abe benaŋsa a bo vaasaŋa po. M le labri gɔnni ate di chim bela, ate tɛŋ kosikka a chim benaŋsa. 19M le pai nyunyoŋ ale siik ale puuta tiisa ale kpaam tiisa a basi gɔnni po. M le te ate dapeelita tiisa ale kinkaŋ peruk ale damɔnta tiisa a gum chaab a bo tɛŋ koroku po. 20Ate dila a basi ate nuru a baga nya abe ba seba, abe ba poli, abe ba miŋ ayen ka Naawen nisa ale nye nnawa, ayen ka Waai ale Welema Izirali po la ale nye dila.
21Naawen a weeni kama ayen, <<Jam weeni fi ale ta wari diila.>> Jekob Naawa ayen, <<Ta fi nanpaŋŋa a jam.>> 22<<Ta fi bɔgtaŋa a jam ate ti weeni ti dii ale za ku nye la. Weeni ti wakpagsaŋa ale jam ka diila, ate ti poli a nya ate ti nya ŋa ale za ŋa nye diila. Yaase weeni sak ti wie ŋaai ale za ŋa nye la. 23Weeni chum po wie ate ti miŋ ayen ni ka wena. Ni nye wari, ku dan poom ka biem yaase nalim ate ti jɔk nyiŋbiiri ate yɔgsum a sueri ti. 24Alege ni ka ŋankayaata ate ni tuimaŋa a ka kiriya. Waai ale a lueri ni la a ta ka kisuk.
25<<M choa ka waai ate wa nyini konni po a cheena. Wa nyini ka wenbinni ale a pusi juijui la, wa ka waai ale a wi mi yuenni. Wa a tabi kpaga nna se ba ka tanta ate ba bu la ase mɛɛrɔ ale a tabi yak diila. 26Ka wana ale weeni kude a nyini piilimka ate tama ale ti seba, yaase ti ŋaan seba ate ti ale weeni ayen, <Wa ta wensie?> Waai an weeni nya kude, waai abe poom ŋaan weeni ku, nuru waai an wom wie a nyini fi jigi ya. 27Mi ale waai ale dɛ niŋ a weeni Zayon ayen, <Nya, ba ale nna.> M tom ka nuru ale wapaala a te Jerusalem. 28Mi gisi kama alege nuru ka. Nuru a ka ba po ayen wa sak ba. M dan bek ba wari nuru karo ale tulisi. 29Nya, ba meena ka venta nyam. Ba tuimaŋa a jam chim ka kinla. Ba ŋanmɛɛntaŋa daa jaaboa alege ka viok ale butimka.

Title: AZAYA 42
Content:
1<<M tomteerɔwa ale nna, waai ate mi a maari la, waai ate m lueri a ta popeentik ale wa la. M le pai m Chiika a basi wa zuk ate wa ale ta nyemagsika a jam tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa po. 2Wa kan nuemu yaase wa kaari yaase wa lak wa lueluku suitaŋa po. 3Wobi dii ale koani la, wa kan kaasi di, ate boom buui ale kan nya a paari la, wa a kan kpimsi. Wensie po wa ale ta nyemagsika a jam. 4Ku kan daani wa suinum yaase wa jɔk nyiŋbiiri ate ku ga paari diipo ate wa le ta nyemagsika a jam tɛŋ zuk de la. Wa sinsaŋŋa po ate tɛŋ sii ate nyiam a gilim si la ba ale pai ba yiila a basi du.>>
5Dii ate Wen, Naawen a weeni la ale nna, wa waai ale nye wenŋmazukku ale nye ate ku lagri la, wa waai ale lak tɛŋzuk de la ale ŋan baai meena ale nyini ka po a nyini la, waai ale a te ka nuruma vuusum ale a te baai ale a cheŋ ka po la nyuvuri. 6<<Mi, Naawen, a wi fu kama wayɔrisima po. M le yik fi nisa. M le ta fu abe m nye ate fi chim nɔiyeŋ a te nuruma. Abe fi chim bolim a te baai ale kan daa Izirali dem la, 7abe m lak baai ale yi la nina, abe m lak baai ate ba lik la a basi abe m yeeri baai ale bo tɛŋ vie po a kala legi po la a basi.
8<<Ka Mi ale Naawen m yuenni ale la. M kan pai m zulaŋa a te waai ya yaase m pai m pimpaukku a te bɔgta. 9Nya wakpagsaŋa a poom boro a nye kama, wapaala ate mi a weeni. Alege ate ŋa nyini boro la ka mi ale mooli ŋa a te fu.>>
10Ni lenni yipaali a te Naawen. Wa pimpaukku a nyini tɛŋka kpeglimka. Nama baai ale a siŋ nyakpiemu tɛŋka la ale ŋan baai meena ale bo bu po la, nama tɛŋ sii ate nyiam a gilim si la ale baai meena ale bo bu po la. 11Basi ate gɔnni ale tɛŋsaŋa lak ba luelutaŋa. Basi ate baai ale bo Kedar la a dɛ masim. Basi ate nuru baai ale bo Sela la a lenni yiila ale masim. Basi ate ba nuem a nyini guutaŋa zuk. 12Basi ate ba te Naawen zula abe ba weeni wa pimpaukku tɛŋ sii ate nyiamu gilim si la. 13Naawen ale gɔk santiri ase nuru pagrik la. Ase nakdeerɔ la, wa nyiŋ ale zeenti a yaali kpaliŋ nyeka. Wa ale nye nuemka ate ka chim kpaliŋ kaarik, ate wa ale nya pagrim wa dachaasa zuk.
14<<M nye ka chim ate ku beni, m nye chim kama ale yik m dek a ga ŋaaŋ. Alege yɔgyɔgla de, m le kaari ase nipok ale boro a biak diila. M kaari kama a lak nɔi a vuusi a kpeeri. 15M le nye ate pinaŋa guutaŋa a chim kinla, abe m nye ate ba tiisaŋa ale ba wuutaŋa a kɔ. M le labri bela ate ŋa chim tɛŋsa abe m nye ate ba nyaataŋa a kpeeri. 16M le de yioba niŋ a ta ba va suik kuui ate ba poom zɛ la. Suik tii ate ba zɛ ti la m le gani ba. M le labri legi ate di chim bolim ba niŋ, abe jigi ŋaai ale zaksa la, m le nye ate ŋa saala. Wieŋa de ate mi za ayen m nye. M kan zɛri ba. 17Alege baai ale ta sebchakka ale bɔgta ale a weeni ŋanmɛɛnta ayen, <Ni ka ti wena la,> ale viriŋ a jɔ ka chivie po.
18<<Wom de, fi tuikpari nyɔnɔ. Nya de, fi yiewa abe fi nya! 19Ka wana ale yi alege ka mi tomteerɔwa? Ka wana tue ale kpari ya ase waai ate mi a tom la? Ka wana ale yi ase waai ale paari wadek a te mi la? Ka wana ale yi ase Naawen tomteerɔwa la? 20Fi nyaka ŋanta nna yegayega alege fi niŋ karo. Fi tueŋa a lak kama alege fi kan wom wari ya.>> 21Ku a peenti Naawen sui kama wa wayɔrisimaŋa nyiŋ ayen wa nye ate wa sinsaŋŋa a zuak abe ŋa ta zula. 22Alege nuruba ale nna ate ba vari ba ale ŋman zu ba. Ba tu ka gola a bari ba meena, yaase ba pai suk likka diina po. Ba ta ba cheŋ kama ate waai a karo a vari ba a basi. Ba chim ka baai ate ba ta nyini badek tɛŋ po a ta ba cheŋ jigi yoŋ ate waai a karo a weeni ayen, <<Ŋman ta ba cheŋ.>>
23Ka ni po wana ale a wom nya kude yaase wa kpesi a wom chum diipo? 24Ka wana ale pai Jekob a te ate ba zu ba, wana abe le basi ate ba kɔlim Izirali? Daa Naawen, waai ate ti tom kaasi wa la? Dii nyiŋla ba an va wa suitaŋa. Ba an wom wa sinsaŋŋa. 25Dila nyiŋ wa yaa kpiiri wa suipuurum buui ale a dɛ ase bolim la ale wɔkwɔk kpaliŋ a basi ba zuk. Bu lik ba ase ka bolim ŋiak la, alege ba an miŋ ku kiriya. Bu dɛ ba kama alege ba an pai a nyo ba suiniima po.

Title: AZAYA 43
Content:
1Alege yɔgyɔgla de, Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna. Wa waai ale nye fi Jekob la. Wa waai ale nye fi Izirali la ayen, <<Kan chali yɔgsummoa, diila m da tuesi fu a basi kama. Mi ale wi fi yuenni. Ka mi ale soa fu. 2Fi dan va nyaataŋa po. M le bo ale fu. Fi abe daa va belaŋa po ŋa kan ji fu a ta cheŋ. Fi dan poom va bolim po, bu kan dɛ fu. Bolim ŋiaka a kan baga a chɔgsi fu. 3Dii nyiŋla Mi ale Naawen fi Wenni, Waai ale Welema Izirali po la, fi varibasidɔwa. M pai Ejipiti a te ka fi varibasika nyiŋ ale pai Kus ale Sɛba a tagri fu.
4Ni ale toalim ta dobrim ale zula mi nina po la, mi ale a yaali ni la nyiŋ, m le pai nidoaba a tagri ni, abe m pai nuruba a tagri ni nyuvooŋa. 5Ni kan chali yɔgsummoa, diila m bo ale ni kama. M le ta ni bisaŋa a nyini konni po, abe m tigsi ni a nyini yeniŋka. 6M le weeni wiilukku ayen, <Pai ba a te.> Abe weeni yeseoku ayen, <Kan peri a tara.> Ta m nidoabilisaŋa ale bo niŋ la ale m liema ale bo tɛŋka kpeglimka la a jam. 7Baai meena ale a wi mi yuenni la, baai ate m nye ba a magsi m zulaŋa la, baai ate m gomsi ale nye ba la.>>
8De baai ale ta nina alege yi la niŋ ale baai ale ta tue alege kan wom la niŋ. 9Tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa meena ale tigsi la ate nuruma jam jigi yeŋ la, ka ba wana dek ale weeni nyakude ale weeni ti wakpaksa? Basi ate ba ta seerɔba a jam sak ayen ba nye magsi kama, ate nuru yonta a wom a weeni ayen, <<Ku ka wensie.>> 10Naawen a weeni kama ayen, <<Nama ka mi seerɔba ale m tomteerɔba, ayen ni seba abe ni ta siaka ale mi, abe ni miŋ ku kiri ayen ka mi ale wala. Wen a karo a bo mi niŋŋa yaase di choa mɛ la ale bo mi ŋaaŋŋa. 11Mi, poom ka Mi ale Naawen, mi tɔga varibasidɔ wa choa a ŋman karo a gum mi po. 12Mi pai sak kama ale vari basi ale mooli. Mi, daa wen chaŋŋa ale bo ale ni. Naawen a weeni kama ayen, <<Nama ka baai ale mi seerɔba ayen, mi ka Wen la. 13Mm, a nyini ŋiaka mi ale la. Waai karo a baga a vari a nyini mi nisa po. M dan nye wari, ka wana ale baga a yik di a labri?>>
14Naawen fi Da Tuesirɔwa, Waai ale Welema Izirali po la ayen, <<Fi nyiŋ m le tom ate ba cheŋ Babilon po, ate ba ale ta Kaldiya demma meena a siŋ tɛŋ ale ba ŋaaruŋtaŋa ate ba ta kanjantaŋa ti nyiŋla. 15Mi ale Naawen, fi Waai ale Welema la, Izirali Nyeerɔwa, fi Naawa.>>
16Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna. Wa waai ale jam nye suik nyakpiemu po ale suik nyapagrisaŋa po la. 17Wala ale waai ale jam yiak wusuma ale ŋa torokoba ale tugurik tommu ale maarɔba a gum ba po ate ba lɔ dula, an ŋman yiti ya ase zeuŋ bolim ale kpi la. 18<<Ni baŋ wakpagsaŋa. Ni kan kali wie ŋaai ale nye taam la ŋaaŋŋa. 19Nya, m boro a nye ka wapaali. Yɔgyɔgla ku boro a yiti kama. Nama a poli a miŋ ku? M boro a nye ka suik gɔnni po ale beli naŋsa tɛŋ koroku po. 20Duŋ waarisa ale gɔi baasa ale viuta a zuli mi kama, dii nyiŋla m basi ate ka nyiam a bo gɔnni po, ale benaŋsa a bo tɛŋ koroku po, a te m nuruma ale baai ate m lueri la nyiam. 21Nuru baai ate mi a nye ba a te m dek la, ayen ba weeni m pimpaukku.
22<<Alege fi Jekob an wi mi. Fi Izirali an jiak fidek a te mi. 23Fi an ta piisa a jam nye juka tiirita a te mi, yaase fi nye kaabka a zuli mi, Mi an te ate ku chim jib a te fu ale ŋandiinta tiirita yaase m yaali ŋan baai juka nyum ale masa la a nyini fi jigi ate ku nye ate fi jiak ale mu. 24Fi an da ŋan baai juka nyum ale masa la a te mi, yaase fi nye kaabka ale duŋ kaai ale biigi la a te mi. Alege fi te ate ka fi wabaataŋa a chim jib a te mi ale te ate m jiak ale fi nye kaasuŋku.
25<<Mi, poom ka mi waai ale duisi fi kaasuŋku a basi m dek nyiŋla, m kan ŋman teeri fi wabaataŋa diipo meena. 26Teeri mu wakpagsaŋa. Te ate ti gum chaab a nak nampaga wanni zuk. Ŋmarisi fi ale kan seba dii nɔi po la a dueni. 27Fi ko waai ale dɛ niŋ la a nye ka biem. Fi nuru baai ale biisi a te fu la a zɛri mi nɔi kama. 28Dila nyiŋ fi nuru kpientaŋa ale bo fi yenni po la a bo chivie po, abe m gomsi Jekob a magsi kaasika, abe Izirali a chim ja laam.

Title: AZAYA 44
Content:
1<<Alege yɔgyɔgla de wom, Jekob m tomteerɔ, Izirali waai ate m lueri la. 2Dii ate Naawen a weeni la ale nna. Wa waai ale nye fu la, waai ale nye fu fi mawa ponni po la. Wala ale waai ale wa maari fu. Kan chali yɔgsummoa Jekob m tomteerɔ, Jesurun, waai ate m lueri la. 3Ale mi ale kpiiri nyiam a nyo tɛŋ sii ate nyanyuila a ta la zuk, ale buboalisaŋa ale bo tɛŋ kosik zuk la po. M le basi ate m Chiika a jam fi bisaŋa zuk abe m niauŋku a bo fi ŋaaŋbisa zuk. 4Ba le chim ase wuuk ale a jueli diila, ase niak tiisa ale za buboalik nɔi la. 5Waai ale weeni ayen, <Ka Naawen ale soa mi.> Wa choa ale pai Jekob yuenni a te wadek ayen ba a wi wa. Wa choa ale diem a ŋmarisi wa nisa nyiŋ ayen, <Ka Naawen ale soa,> abe wa pai Izirali yuenni a te wadek.
6<<Dii ate Naawen a weeni la ale nna, Izirali Naawa ale ba Da Tuesirɔwa, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ la. Mi ale piilimka mi abe le kpeglimka. Dan kan daa mi, Wen di choa a karo. 7Ka wana ale a nye ase mi la? Basi ate wa mooli. Basi ate wa weeni a dueni mi niŋ, dii ale nye a nyini diipo ate m nye ŋiak nuruma la, ale dii ale diem za di jam la mm, basi ate wa ŋaam weeni dii ale di jam la. 8Kan te fi nyiŋ a gɔgi, be kan chali yɔgsummoa. Mi mooli kude ale ŋaam weeni ku wari ka dipo. Ni ka baai ale chim mi seerɔba. Wen di choa a boro a gum mi po? Aaya, Piuŋ ku choa a ŋman karo. Mi zɛ kunyi nɔi po.>>
9Baai meena ale a nye bɔgta la a ka kiriya, ate ba ale pai ba popola a dueni ŋan baai zuk la a ka kiriya. Baai ale biisi a te ba la a yi kama. Ba ale kan seba wari nɔi po la a te ba ka chivie. 10Ka wana ale a peesi wen ya, be ka wana ale a nye bɔgluwa, ku kan te wa nyuenta? 11Wa ale wa vaanchaama meena ale nya chivie. Peesirɔma a ka kiriya alege ka nuruba kama. Basi ate ba meena a jam ba zaana jigi. Ba ale siŋ tɛŋ ate kpazinagsuk ale chivie a yik ba.
12Choa biik a pai ka jaab a nyo bolim kaala po a tom. Wa a pai ka kutuk a nak a nye bɔgluk. Wa a nye ku ale ka wa nigiri. Wa sui nyiem puuri ate wa jɔk wa pagrimu. Wa kan nyu nyiamoa ate jianta a paari wa. 13Danagrɔwa a pai ka miik a magsi. Wa pai ka liaka a chiisi ale pai jaab a kpesi nya. Wa a peesi ku ase ka nuru la ku nalimu meena po, ate ku bo wa tangbanaŋa po. 14Wa che nyunyoŋta a lɔnsi, yaase dai dii dai wa pai damɔnta tiisa yaase tiib kpiensa. Wa basi ate bu maa bo tiisaŋa po a chim a bo gɔnni po, yaase wa vuk kinkaŋ peruk, ate ŋmorukku a nye ate ku a chim. 15Ka nuru ale pai ku a cheem bolim. Wa pai ku gela a cheem bolim a ŋuuŋ wadek ale pai ku mɛ a cheem bolim a sɛ boroborok. Alege pai ku a nye wen a kaab ku. Wa pai ku a nye bɔgluk a koori tɛŋ a te ku. 16Wa pai daataŋa geli a ju bolim. Ku zuk ate wa a dik ŋandiinta ale a sɛ wa lammu a ŋɔbi a chak. Wa nyiem ŋuuŋ wadek kama ale weeni ayen, <<M nya bolim a ŋuuŋ m dek.>> 17Tii ale tali la ate wa pai a nye wen ate di chim wa bɔgluk. Wa koori tɛŋ a te ale a puusi ku. Wa a puusi a te ale a weeni ayen, <<Vari mu a basi. Fi ale m wen.>>
18Ba zɛ jaaboa, ba kan miŋ wari kiri ya. Ba taari lik ba ninaŋa kama ate ba kan nya, ate ba popolaŋa a lik ate ba kan miŋ wari kiri ya. 19Waai karo a basi polika. Waai a ka yam wie miŋka yaase wa ta miŋka a weeni ayen, <<M pai ku gela a cheem bolim. M poom pai ku bolim kaalaŋa a sɛ boroborok ale pai ku a sɛ lam a ŋɔbi. M pai dii ale tali la a nye kisuk jaaboa? M koori tɛŋ a zuli dokoluwa? 20Wa a dɛ ka buntuem, ate suinum buui ale kaasi la a ta wa cheŋ be. Wa an baga a vari wadek a basi, yaase wa weeni ayen, <<Jaamu de ale bo m juga nisa po la daa venta?>>
21Jekob, teeri ŋantaŋa de, diila fi ka m tomteerɔ Izirali. Mi ale nye fu, fi ka m tomteerɔ. Izirali, m kan baŋ fu. 22M duisi fi nye kaasuŋku a basi ase ka chiŋmari la ale nye ate fi wabaataŋa a muriŋ bɛ ase saluik pik la. Ni pilim ŋman jam mi jigi dii nyiŋla m da tuesi ni a basi kama.
23Wenŋmazukku a yi masim yiila, diila ka Naawen ale nye nna. Tɛŋ zuk de a nye nuemka. Guutaŋa ale gɔnni ale tiisaŋa lɔnsi yiili mob, diila Naawen a da Jekob a tuesi kama. Wa a sak wa zulaŋa Izirali po kama.
24Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Fi Da Tuesirɔ waai ale nye fu fi mawa ponni po la. Mi ale Naawen dii ale nye jaab meena la. Waai ale lagri wenŋmazukku. Mi dek ale waai ale nye ate tɛŋka a teeri la. 25Waai ale nye ate venta biisiteerɔba an baga a nye ba ale a yaali diila ale nye ate chichirik wiirisa a chim betta, waai ale yiak yam nyam zamsika a basi ale labri ate ku a chim wie kayaata la. 26Waai ale a pai wa tomteerɔma wie a tom tuima, ate wa basi ate wa ale a tom baai la ale a weeni diila a sum a nye ale a weeni ayen, nuruba a ŋman jam kali Jerusalem tɛŋka po. Juda tɛŋsaŋa ale pilim ŋman sɛ, ate m le ŋman pai ba ŋan baai ale kaasi la a te ba. 27Waai ale weeni ayen nya liuŋku kpeeri la, ate m sum a nye ate fi buboalisaŋa a kpeeri. 28Waai ale weeni ayen Sairus ka m naapeerik ate m le nye dii meena ate m sui a peenti la. Wa ale weeni Jerusalem wie ayen, basi ate ka ŋman pilim a sɛ, abe wa weeni mi yenni wie ayen, basi ate ba ŋman dueni di nyubaŋa.>>

Title: AZAYA 45
Content:
1<<Dii ate Naawen a weeni waai ate wa bobi la ale nna, Sairus waai ate m yik wa juga nisa a ta la, ayen wa nya pagrim tɛŋ kpieŋsa zuk abe wa vari kpaliŋsa kɔlima a nyini nalima jigi, abe wa lak tuata wa niŋ ate nansuiŋtaŋa kan ligi. 2M le de fi niŋ a cheŋ abe m nye ate guutaŋa a palinti a magsi chaab. M le wɛ nansuiŋ kuta mɔntaŋa abe m gebi kuta chibsaŋa a taam. 3M le te fu legi nitalimu ale paaruŋ kuui ale suk jigi ŋaai la ate fi ale miŋ ayen Mi ale Naawen, Izirali Wen dii ale pai fi yuenni a wi fu.
4Jekob m tomteerɔwa nyiŋ, Izirali waai ate m lueri la, fi zɛ mi alege dila meena zuk, mi pai ka fi yuenni a wi fu ale pai zula a basi fi zuk. 5Mi ale Naawen, waai a ŋman karo. Wen a ŋman ka jigi ya a gum mi po. Fi a miŋ mi alege dila meena zuk, m le nye ate fi pagra, 6a ta nyini wenbinni pusika a ta ga a paari di siŋka jigi, nuruba ale seba ayen waai karo a gum mi po. Mi ale Naawen, waai a ŋman karo. 7Mi ale nye bolim ale nye legi, mi ale ta paaruŋ a jam ale nye kaasuŋ. Mi, Naawen ale nye ŋantaŋa de meena.
8<<Fi wenŋmazukku ale bo ŋmai la, ni wayɔrisima a basi tɛŋ. Basi ate chiŋmaaŋa a ni a basi tɛŋ. Basi ate tɛŋ zuk de a lagri, basi ate varibasika a tɔŋ jueli ŋmai, basi ate wayɔrisima a chim ale ku. Mi, Naawen ale nye ku.
9<<Ku ale toa a te waai ale ta chaab ale wa Nyeerɔwa la, fi ka samɔniŋ ale maa bo ale samɔnsa ate ba pai tanta a nye. Yak ale baga a weeni mɛɛrɔwa ayen, ka boan nyiŋ ate fi a nye mu nna? Dii ate fi nye la ale weeni ayen, Wa ka nisa? 10Ku ale toa a te waai ale a weeni wa ko ayen, Ka boa ate fi biagi? Yaase wa weeni wa ma ayen, <Ka boa ate fi biagi?
11<<Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna, Waai ale Welema Izirali po la, ate wa chim wa Nyeerɔ la. A ta va ŋan baai ale za ŋa jam la, fi a bek mi wie a ta va m bisaŋa nyiŋŋa, yaase fi dak mi wie a ta magsi chaab ale m nisima tuima? 12Ka mi ale waai ale nye tɛŋzuk de ale nye nurubiik a basi ka zuk la. M nisaŋa ale teeri wenŋmazukku. Mi ale nye ate chiŋmarisaŋa a bo wenzukku. 13M le zak Sairus a zaani ŋmai m wayɔrisimaŋa po. M le nye ate wa suitaŋa meena a yoarisi. Wa ale ŋman sɛ m tɛŋ kpieŋka, abe m nuru baai ale basi ba tɛŋka la wa ale vari ba a basi, alege ba kan tuni jaaboa yaase ba tuesi jaaboa, ka Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni.>>
14Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Ejipiti nyuentaŋa ale Kus geruŋku ŋantaŋa ale Siiba demma baai ale wɔŋa la, ba le jam fi jigi ate fi soa ba. Ba le jiak a vi fi ŋaaŋ ale chɔrima. Ba ale koori tɛŋ fi niŋ, abe ba saalim fu ayen, <Wensie Wen a bo ale fu kama ate waai a karo. Wen di choa a ŋman karo.>>
15Wensie fi ka Wen dii ale a suk wadek, Wen ale Izirali Varibasidɔ. 16Bɔgluk nyeerisa meena chivie ale nyatika ale yik ba. Ba ale gum chaab a cheŋ ale chivie. 17Alege Naawen ale vari Izirali a basi ale taam wuu varibasika. Fi a kan nya chivie yaase nyatika bena ŋaai ale cheen la a ta ga a paari diipo meena.
18Kude nyiŋ ate Naawen a weeni ayen, Wa waai ale nye wenzukku la, wa ka Wen, wa ale gomsi ale nye tɛŋzuk de, wa ale nye ka. Wa an nye ayen ku boro koruwa, alege wa nye kama ayen ba bo ka po. Wa a weeni kama ayen, Mi ale Naawen ate waai a karo. 19Mi an zaani tɛŋka legi po a suk biisi ya. Mi an weeni Jekob ŋaaŋbisaŋa ayen, ba a gisi mi kinla. Mi Naawen, a biisi ka wensie. Mi a weeni ka dii ale chim wensie la.
20<<Ni tigsi jigi yeŋ a jam. Ni tigsi, nama baai ale nyini tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa po a chali lati la. Baai ale kan seba wari nɔi po la ale baai ale ji bɔgta ate ba pai daata a nye la, ale a puusi a te wen ŋaai ale kan baga a vari a basi la. 21Weeni dii ale magsi di nye la, pai te. Basi ate ba jam jigi yeŋ a pai yam a sak chaab. Ka wana ale dɛ niŋ a weeni kude dipo la, ka wana ale weeni ku a nyini niŋniŋ ŋa? Ku jam daa mi, Naawen. Wen a karo a gum mi po, wayɔrisima Wen ale Varibasidɔ, waai a ŋman karo alege ka mi nyiini.
22<<Viriŋ a jam mi jigi ate fi nya varibasika, nama baai meena ale bo tɛŋzuk de jigi meena la. Diila mi ka Wen, ate waai a ŋman ka. 23Mi pɛ ka m dek nyiŋ, m nɔnni a weeni kama a bo wensie meena po, ate m kan nyini m le weeni diila ŋaaŋ a nyini. Duna meena ale kpi tɛŋ mi niŋ. Mi nyiŋ nɔi meena ale pak Naawen. 24Ba ale weeni m wari ayen, <<Naawen nyiini jigi ate wayɔrisima ale pagrim a boro.>> Baai meena ale a nye kpaliŋ ale wa la ale jam wa jigi ate chivie a yik ba. 25Alege Naawen jigi ate Izirali ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale nya wayɔrisima ale masim dɛka.

Title: AZAYA 46
Content:
1Bel wenni a kpi ka duna, ate Nebo wenni a koori tɛŋ. Ba bɔgtaŋa a chim ka jibta a te duŋsa. Ŋanmɛɛntaŋa ate ba ji la a chim ka daanika ale jibta a te baai ale jiak la. 2Ba gum ka chaab a koori ale kpi duna. Ba an baga a vari badek a nyini jimmu po. Badek ale cheŋ yɔntidi po.
3<<Wom mi, Jekob yeri ya, Izirali yeri dem baai ale tali la, fi waai ate m ta fu a nyini diipo ate ba yik fi puuk la ale pai fu a nyini diipo ate ba biak fu la. 4A poom ta jam paari fi kpaŋsa po ale fi zupiila taka. Mi ale la, mi ale waai ale wa maari fu. Mi ale nye fu ate m le pai fu. M le maari fu abe m vari fu a basi.
5<<Fi ale pai mi a magsi chaab ale ka wana yaase fi chiini mi a gum chaab ale wana? Fi ale pai mi a nye ase ka wana la ate ti baga a magsi chaaba? 6Ba gela a kpiiri ka ligmɔniŋ a nyini ba boorisaŋa po ale magsi kpana ŋanmagsinta zuk. Ba pai ka choabiik ate wa pai ŋa a nye wen, ate ba a koori tɛŋ ale a puusi di. 7Ba a zak a vi ba ŋmankpalaŋa zuk a ji di. Ba pai di a zaani ka di jigini, ate di za dula. Di ale za juijui la, di an baga a cheŋŋi. Waai a dan poom kum a wi di, di kan tulisi. Di an baga a vari wa a basi a nyini wa daanika po.
8<<Teeri kude, pai nyo fi popola po, pai nyo fi suinum po, nama baai ale kaa siak a te wie la. 9Teeri wie kpagsaŋa, ŋaai ale jam boro dipodipo la. Mi ale Wen. Waai a karo a gum mi po. Mi ale Wen. Waai a karo a nye ase mi la. 10Mi basi kama ate ba seba kpeglimka a nyini piilimka po, a nyini ŋiaka dii ale za di jam la, mi weeni kama ayen, mi ale poli diila ale zaani, abe dii meena ale a peenti m sui la m le nye.
11M wi ka duiŋ konni po ate ka cheena. A nyini tɛŋ kaai ale yalima la ate m wi nuru ayen wa nye dii ate m ta m popola po la. Mi ale weeni diila, ate m za m ta jam. Mi ale zɔk diila ate m le nye. 12Wom mi, fi waai turi ale kpari ale ta suinum pagrik la, fi waai ale yalima ale wayɔrisima la. 13M ta m wayɔrisimaŋa a moata kama ku an yalima, ate m varibasika a kan beni. M le te Zayon varibasika, abe m te Izirali m nalimu.

Title: AZAYA 47
Content:
1<<Cheŋ tɛŋ, kali paasuku po, Babilon Liewa nipok Kaliaka kali tɛŋka abe fi kan ta naam zukpaglika Kaldiya demma liema po. Ba a kan ŋman wi fu ayen fi baasa yaase fi ta ka a toa. 2Pai niri a num zom. Yeeri fi garuk nyaara nyaaraŋa. Zak fi mankutaŋa ŋmai, kan su nuesa, abe fi gaam buboalisaŋa a taam. 3Ba le nya fi chaboalaŋa, ate fi chivieŋa a kan ligi. Mi ale nye a tuni. M kan basi waai ya. 4Ti Da Tuesirɔwa, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale wa yuenni, Waai ale Welema a bo Izirali la.
5Kali tɛŋ chim, cheŋ legi po, Kaldiya dem liewa, ba kan ŋman wi fu ayen naata nipok naaba. 6Mi sui a jam a puuri ale m nuruma ate m kaasi m nitalimu. Ate m pai ba a nyo fi nisa po alege fi an sak jiirim ale ba. Baai ale poom kpaŋ la fi pai ka niiga diok kuui ale dobra la a vi ba zuk. 7Fi weeni kama ayen, <M le kasim a chim ka nipok naab taam wuu.> Alege fi an poli wieŋa de, yaase fi poli ayen ka boa ale ku nye.
8<<Yɔgyɔgla de, wom de, fi waai ate nidoa boari a sebi fu la, fi bo ka fi sukka jigini ale a weeni fidek ayen, <Ka mi, ate waai a karo a gum mi po. M kan chim pukɔgi yaase m jɔk bisa.> 9Bade meena ale jam fi zuk dai yeŋ po. Bisa jɔkka ale pukɔgini. Fi le fi sampoporinni ale fi tinaŋsa meena po, daanika de ale jam fi zuk ate ku paari fu. 10Fi ta ka sebchakka ale fi gaasaŋa ale weeni ayen, <Waai a kan nya mu.> Fi yammu ale yam wie miŋka a ta fu cheŋ a bɛ kama ase fi ale a weeni fidek ayen, <Ka mi ate waai karo a gum mi po.> 11Kaasuŋ ale jam fi zuk, ate fi kan seba tiim jigi ya. Biem ale lo fi zuk ate fi kan baga a vari fidek a basi. Kaasuŋ ale jam fi zuk ate fi kan baga a nye biem duisi basika. Ninam buui ate fi zɛ ku nɔi po la ale jam fi zuk a diiri fu.
12<<Kasim a ta fi tinaŋsaŋa ale fi sampoporinni a nye, dii ate fi nye a nyini fi bi fiisa po la. Da dii dai ku ale nye a magsi a te fu, da dii dai fi ale nye ate yɔgsum a yik nuruba. 13Sinsak ŋaai meena ate fi tuesi la a nye kama ate fi jiak. Basi ate baai ale seba chiŋmarisa wie a jam niŋ, baai ale a porisi chiik po meena la. Basi ate ba vari fu a ta nyini dii ale cheen fi zuk la. 14Wensie nyiŋ ba a nye ase ka kinkaa la. Bolimu chogsi a dɛ ba. Ba an baga a vari badek a nyini bolim ŋiaka pagrimu po. Bolim kaala a ka dela a toliŋ waai nyiŋŋa. Bolim a ka dela ate waai a kali bu tɛŋ ŋa. 15Dii meena ate ba baga a nye a te fu la ale la. Ŋade ate fi a tom ale gerim a nyini fi bi fiisa po. Ba meena a nye bɛ kama. Ba waai an baga vari fu a basi.

Title: AZAYA 48
Content:
1<<Jekob yenni a wom kude, fi waai ate ba a wi fu ayen Izirali ate fi nyini Juda dɔkdemma po la, fi a nye pɛka Naawen yuenni nyiŋ ale a wi Izirali Wenni, alege ku daa wensie yaase wayɔrisima po. 2Nama baai ale a wi nidek ayen tuilum tɛŋ nuruba ale pai ni yiila meena a basi Izirali Wenni zuk la. Wa yuenni ale Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La.
3Mi liŋ a weeni wakpagsaŋa kama dipo, m nɔnni ale mooli ŋa ale nye ate waai meena a seba ŋa, ate mi deri nye ate ŋa sum a jam boro. 4Dila nyiŋ mi seba fi tukpanni ale soa diila kama. Fi ŋinni ka kutuk, ate fi dinni a chim kutuk mɔnuŋ. 5Dila nyiŋ ate m weeni fu ŋade dipo alege ate ŋa jam nye la, mi mooli ŋa wie a sak fu kama, ate fi kan baga a weeni ayen, <M bɔgtaŋa ale nye ŋa. M daata bɔglukku ale m kutuk wenni ale te ate ŋa boro.
6Fi wom ŋade wie kama. Nya ŋa meena. Fi a kan siak a te ŋa? <<A nyini yɔgyɔgla de a cheŋ, m le weeni fu ŋan paala wie, ŋan susuga ŋaai ate fi zɛ ŋa. 7Ba nye ŋa ka yɔgyɔgla de, alege daa dipo. Daa jinla ate fi wom ŋa wie. Dila nyiŋ fi an baga a weeni ayen, Mm, mi seba ŋa kama. 8Fi an wom ya yaase fi poom miŋ di kiri ya. A nyini dipo fi tueŋa an lagri ya. M seba fi bobrika nɔi po kama. Ba jam a wi fu ka a zɛri wie a nyini fi biam po.
9<<M dek yuenni nyiŋ ate m beni m suipuurumu. M pimpaukku nyiŋ ate m yik ku a basi ŋaaŋ a nyini fi jigi. Ayen m kan gebi fu a basi.
10<<Nya, m soti fu kama, ku be daa se kpana la. M chamsi fu nya kama a nyini ninam bolim po. 11Mi dek nyiŋ, mi dek nyiŋ ate mi a nye kude. Mi tin nye ka sɛ a kaasi m dek yuenni? M kan pai m zulaŋa a te waai ya.
12<<Jekob, wom mi, Izirali waai ate m wi la. Ka mi ale la. Mi ale dɛ niŋ mi abe le ŋman wari ŋaaŋ. 13Mi dek nisa ale dueni tɛŋzuk de nyubini, ate m juga nisaŋa a nye ate wenzukku a lagri cheŋ. Ase mi ale wi ŋa la, ŋa meena a jam zaani ka jigi yeŋ.
14<<Ni jam jigi yeŋ, ni meena a jam wom. Ka bɔgtaŋa kuna ale dɛ niŋ a weeni wieŋa de? Naawen ale lueri doa waai la ale ta wa ale a yaali diila a ga nye Babilon. Wa nisaŋa ale ta chaab ale Kaldiya demma. 15Mi, poom ka m dek ale biisi, mm, mi wi wa kama. M le ta wa a jam, ate wa ale za wa nye diila ale nye magsi.
16<<Cheŋ paari mi a wom nya kude. <<A nyini piilimka moolika mi an biisi suk ya. Diipo ate ku nye la ale mi boro kama. <<Ate yɔgyɔgla de Nyɔnɔwa Naawen a pai wa chiika a tom mi.
17Nye kude ate Naawen fi Da Tuesirɔwa, Waai ale Welema Izirali po la a weeni ayen, <<Mi ale Naawen fi Wenni, Dii ale a sak fu dii ale nala la ale a dak fu suik kuui po ale magsi ayen fi va la. 18Fi dan jam wom ka m sinsaŋŋa, fi suiyɔgni ate le jam nye ase ka benaŋ la, ate fi wayɔrisimaŋa a nye ase nyakpiemu nya miisaŋa la. 19Fi ŋaaŋbisaŋa ate le nye ase ka tintainbusuŋ la, ate fi bisaŋa a kan ta chiina ase ŋanbie la. Ba yuenni ate kan bɛ diipo diipo yaase ba kaasi a ta nyini mi niŋŋa.>>
20Basi Babilon, yiri nyini Kaldiya demma jigi. Mooli nya kude ale masim nuemka abe fi weeni ku. Te ku cheŋ paari tɛŋka kpeglimka. Weeni ayen, <<Naawen a da tuesi wa tomteerɔwa Jekob kama.>> 21Nyanyuila an jam a yik ba diipo ate wa jam de ba niŋ gɔnni po la. Wa jam nye kama ate nyiam a nyini piuŋku po a te ba. Wa kabri piuŋku kama ate nyiam a na nyini du. 22<<Naawen a weeni kama ayen, <<Suiyɔgni a karo a te gaasa nyama.>>

Title: AZAYA 49
Content:
1Ni wom mi, nama tɛŋ sii ate nyiamu a gilim la, ni wom kude, nama tɛŋ kpieŋ sii ale bo niŋniŋ la, ni wom nya kude. Alege ate ba biak mi la Naawen a wi mi kama. A nyini m biam po ate wa wi mi yuenni. 2Wa nye m nɔnni ase ka gebik kaai ale ta nɔi la ale pai mu a suk wa nisa yisuŋku po. Wa nye mu ase ka pein dii ale a nyaksi la ale pai mu a su wa namarika po. 3Wa weeni mu ayen, <<Izirali, fi ka m tomteerɔ, waai po ate m le sak m nalimu.>> 4Alege mi weeni kama ayen, Mi tom kama nna kinla. M pai m pagrimu a tom ka koruk ale an nya jaaboa. Alege mi ale magsi ayen m nya diila a bo ka Naawen nisa po, ate m tutunaŋa a bo ale m Wenni.>>
5Ate yɔgyɔgla de Naawen a weeni kama, ayen wa waai ale nye mi m mawa ponni po, ayen m chim wa tomteerɔ la, a ŋman ta Jekob a jam te wa abe wa tigsi Izirali a ta jam wadek jigi dii nyiŋla mi nya zula kama Naawen nina po, ate m Wenni a chim m pagrim. 6Wa weeni kama ayen, <<Ku ka wa fiik ate fi chim m tomteerɔ ayen fi ŋman pai Jekob dɔkdemma a zaani ba nyiem ale ka diila po, abe fi ŋman ta Izirali baai ate m ta la a jam. M le ŋman nye ate fi chim bolim a te baai ale kan daa Izirali dem la, ate fi ale ta m varibasika a jam tɛŋzuk de meena.>>
7Nya kude ate Naawen, Da Tuesirɔwa ale Waai ale Welema Izirali po la a weeni a te waai ate tɛŋ kpieŋ a zɛri wa ale kisi wa la, a weeni a te kpaŋŋa tomteerɔwa ayen, <<Nalima ale nya fu a yiti zaani ŋmai, nabisa ale nya fu a koori tɛŋ, Naawen ale ka wensie nyɔnɔ la nyiŋ. Waai ale Welema Izirali po la, wala ale lueri fu.>>
8Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<M ŋmanteka vaaŋa po m le tulisi fu, ate varibasika danni po m le maari fu. M le yik fu a tara abe m nye ate fi chim nɔiyeŋ a te nuruma, ate m ŋman sɛ tɛŋka a te fu ale ka ŋantaŋa meena ate fi ŋman kali kaai ale chim tɛŋ koruk la po, 9a weeni baai ate ba yik ba la ayen, <Nyini peelim a jam.> Ate baai ale bo legi po la ayen, <Ni nye fasiyaa.> Ba ale de suitaŋa nɔi abe ba nya wuuk yɔksuk gu tii ale kan ta jaab la zuk. 10Kɔm yaase nyanyuila a kan yik ba, yaase gɔnni tuilukku a nak ba yaase wenbinni a nak ba zuk.
