Waai a kan laŋ nyeka ale wa gaasa, a weeni ayen, <<Ka boa ate m nye?>> Waai meena a va ka wadek suik ase wusum ale zeenti a jo kpaliŋ po la. 7Jumbaliiruku ale bo wenzukku a poom seba ku daaŋa kama, ale nangbaŋka ale takaribaleeŋ ale yiila nuim a kpesi daa ŋaai ate si cheŋ tɛŋ yoŋ la kama. Alege mi nuruma a zɛ Naawen ale a yaali wa ŋaai la.
8<< <Ni nye ka sɛ a weeni ayen, <<Tama a ta yam kama, diila ti ta Naawen sinsaŋŋa kama,>> ale wensie chekki sinsak ŋmarisidoama venta ja ŋmarisimu a nye di ale venta? 9Yam nyama ale jo chivie po. Ku le cha ba ate ba bari yik ba. Ba le toalim zɛri Naawen wanni la. Ka boan jaab yam choa ate ba ta? 10Dila nyiŋ m le pai ba pooma a te nidoa yonta ale ba laŋsaŋa a te nuru paalisa ate ba soa. A zaani baai ale fiisa a ga paari baai ale zuak, ba meena a ta ka butuem a yaali nyuenta a te badek. Biisiteerɔba ale kaabteerɔba meena wayeŋ a nye gaasa. 11Ba a pobi mi nuruma mulaŋa ase ku daa wari la. Ba weeni ayen, <<Suiyɔgni, suiyɔgni,>> alege suiyɔgni a karo. 12Ba a chali chivie ale ba nyeela ŋaai ate mi kisa la? Aaya, ba kan chali chivie bola. Ba poom zɛ chivie bo ba nina po. Dila ba le lo baai ale lo la po. M dan namsi ba ba le siŋ tɛŋ. Naawen ale weeni.
13<< <M le pai ba ŋancheentaŋa a ta cheŋ. Naawen ale weeni. Yɔna a kan bo naŋsaŋa nyiŋŋa. Kinkama a kan bo kinkaŋsaŋa zuwa, ate si vaataŋa a wiiri. Jabuui ate m te ba la, m le tuesi ba jigi.> >>
14Wen nuruma a bek ayen, <<Ka boa ate ti kali dela? Ni tigsi chaab. Ni basi ate ti chali cheŋ tɛŋ pagrisaŋa a kpi dula. Diila Naawen ti Wenni a pai ti a te ka kum a te ti choŋ nyiam ayen ti nyu dii nyiŋla ti tom kaasi wa kama. 15Ti a yiili ka suiyɔgni alege wamaŋ an jam ya, a magsi tebika dai, alege ka kpazinagsuk nyiini. 16Dachiaka wusumaŋa siŋtika a wom a nyini Dan. Ba wusum doataŋa kumsa a basi ate tɛŋka meena a choa. Ŋa jam ŋade tɛŋka ale jaab meena ale bo ka po la, tɛŋka ale baai meena ale boro la.>>
17<<Nya, m le tom waapiisa ate si cheŋ ba suŋsuŋ, waab piŋesɔba ate ŋa ka baliŋ ka ate ŋa dom ba.>> Naawen ale weeni.
18M Suiyɔgni Nyɔnɔwa a bo suipuurum po, m suinummu a fuŋti kama. 19Wom m nuruma kumsa a nyini tɛŋ kaai ale yalima la. <<Naawen an bo Zayon? Naawa a ŋman ka dula? Ka boa ate ba nye ate mi sui a puuri ale ba ŋanmɛɛntaŋa, ale ba bɔgluk chaŋ sii ale kan ta kiri la?>>
20Wen nuruba weeni ayen, <<Cheka a taam kama, fanɔnni a kpeglim ya, ate tama a ka varibasika.>>
21Mi nuruma ale ŋɔriŋ la, mi ŋɔriŋ kama. Mi kum kama, ate yɔgsum a yik mu. 22Kpaam a ka Gilead po? Tebirɔ a ka dula? Ka boa abe le soa ate tebika a karo a te m nuruma mulaŋa?

Title: JEREMAYA 9
Content:
1Mi zukku a dan poom ka bulik nyiam ate mi ninaŋa a chim ninyaata bulik m ti le kum kantueŋ ale yok a te m nuruma koka. 2Mi dan poom ta ka duaka jigi gɔnni po a te nyeendɔba, m ti le basi m nuruma abe m cheŋ diila ba meena ka kaboŋ nyeerisa ale a ka wensie nuru boari.
3<<Ba gomsi ba giŋgeluŋtaŋa kama ase tima la, ayen ba tɔŋ venta. Ku daa wensie nyiŋ ate ba nya pagrim tɛŋka po. Ba nyini ka wabiok kunyi a cheŋ m ku. Ba kan siak mi.>> Naawen ale weeni.
4<<Seba fi doama wari. Kan ta sebchakka ale fi suataŋa. Diila suok meena ka pimpaasirɔ, ate doa meena yik kaasirɔ. 5Doa a paasi doa, ate waai a kan biisi wensie. Ba sak ba giŋgeluŋtaŋa ayen ti a velim. A jiak badek ale wabaata nyeka. 6Fi bo ka pimpaasima suŋsuŋ. Ba pimpaasimaŋa po ba zɛri kama an siak te mi.>> Naawen ale weeni.
7Dila nyiŋ Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Nya, m le soti ba abe m chamsi ba, diila mi ale ŋman nye ka sɛ m nuruma wabaataŋa nyiŋŋa? 8Ba giŋgeluŋtaŋa ka pein yaani, ti a biisi ka venta. Ale wa nɔnni waai meena biisi ka yaalika a te wa vaanchoa, alege wa suinummu po wa bari baruk a limisi wa. 9M kan namsi ba kude nyiŋŋa? M kan zɛri m dek nyiŋ a namsi tɛŋka de choa?>> Naawen ale weeni.
10M le kum abe m wooli a te guutaŋa abe m pai kumsa a su a magsi chaab ale gɔnni wuuku. Ti doa ka koruk ate waai an nyiem du, ate niiga ŋuuniŋ an wom du. Wenzuk nuinsaŋa a yiti cheŋ ate duŋsaŋa a cheŋ.
11Naawen a weeni ayen, <<M le basi ate Jerusalem a duak guura a vi chaab ale suemkpatta boka jigi abe m basi ate Juda tɛŋsaŋa a dua kinla ate nuru a kan baga a boro.>>
12Ka nuru boa ale ta yam zuak a baga a miŋ kude? Ka wana ate Naawen a sak ate wa baga a weeni kude kiri ya? Ka boa ate tɛŋka a kaasi a doa kinla ase gɔi la ate waai an baga a va du a taamu?
13Naawen a weeni ayen, <<Ka ba le zɛri mi sinsaŋŋa ate mi a pai dueni ba niŋ la nyiŋ, ba an zuli mi yaase ba va m sinsaŋŋa. 14Ba goanti va ka badek tuikpari ale ba suiniima ale a yaali diila. Ba va ka Baal bɔgtaŋa ase ba koma ale sak ba diila.>> 15Dila Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, Izirali Wenni ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Nya, m le basi ate nuruma de a de ŋandiin tuasa abe ba nyu choŋ nyiam. 16M le kati ba waaŋ tɛŋsa po ate ba yaase ba koma a zɛ la, ate m yaa vi ba ale gebik ate m ga ko ba.>>
17Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Poli yɔgyɔgla! Wi nipok baai ale a wooli la ate ba jam. Tom wi baai ale seba nna yega. 18Basi ate ba jam mwuli a kum ti zuk ate ti ninaŋa a ga chali ale ninyaata ate ninyaata a kpiiri a zi. 19Woolika ale wom a nyini Zayon: <Ti le kaasi soa dii! Ti chivieŋa ale zuak soa dii! Ku a fɛ ate ti basi ti tɛŋka dii nyiŋla ti yieŋa a dua ga guura.> >>
20Yɔgyɔgla de nipooba, ni wom Naawen wanni, ni lak ni tueŋa a wom wa nɔnni wieŋa. Ni sak ni liema ba le ba wooli diila, ni sak chaab kumsa. 21Kum a meli va ka ti tuokpattaŋa a jo ti yie pagrisaŋa po, a yaa gebi ti bisaŋa suitaŋa po ale ti nidoa paalukku yabaŋa po.
22Weeni ayen, <<Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <Kpieba nyiŋsa ale duak ase tampoi la peelimmu po, ase ŋanbie ate ŋaridɔ a ŋari dueni wa ŋaaŋ la, ate waai karo a tigsi.> >>
23Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Yam nyɔnɔwa a kaa kuulim wa yammu nyiŋŋa yaase pagrɔwa a kuulim wa pagrimu nyiŋŋa yaase jigsirɔwa a kuulim wa jigsika nyiŋŋa, 24alege basi ate waai ale a kuulim la a kuulim nna: Ayen wa a miŋ ale seba mi, ayen Mi ale Naawen, waai ale a sak ŋmanteka ale nyemagsika ale wayɔrisima tɛŋzuk de, diila mi mariŋ ka ŋade.>> Naawen ale weeni.
25Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Daaŋa a cheena ate m le namsi baai meena ale gebi ba yua nyiini nyiŋ lammu po la, 26Ejipiti ale Juda ale Edom ale Ammon ale Moab ale baai meena ale bo gɔnni po niŋniŋ jiga la. Diila tɛŋsaŋa de meena an sum gebi ya, ate Izirali yenni meena an poom gebi ba suiniima po.>>

Title: JEREMAYA 10
Content:
1Izirali yeri yaa, wom Naawen ale ta dii ayen wa weeni fu la. 2Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Ni kan zamsi tɛŋsaŋa wieŋa yaase ni kpaziim a nak ale daani ŋaai ale bo wenzukku la, tɛŋsaŋa kpaziim a poom a nak ale ba kama. 3Nuruma korom wieŋa a ka kiriya. Ba gebi ka tiib tiisaŋa po ate peesirɔ a peesi ale liak. 4Ba gobi ku ale kpana ale ligmɔniŋ. Ba pai piema ale janakferim a nak yik chaab dila ate ku kan kpeeri. 5Ase jaab ate ba ti zaani ŋan kpaanta po a yiak nuinsa, ba ka bɔgluk tii ale kaa biisi, ku a fɛ ayen ba ji a ta cheŋ dii nyiŋla ti an baga a cheŋ. Ni kan chali ti. Ti an baga a nye biem yaase ti nye wamaŋŋa.>>
6Naawen yaa, waai karo a nye ase fi la, fi zuak kama, ate fi yuenni a chim yuei kpienni ale pagrim. 7Ka wana ale kan wa chali fu, tɛŋsa Naaba? Ka fi ale magsi diila ale la. Yam nyama meena ale bo tɛŋsaŋa po la ale ba naataŋa meena po la, waai karo ase fi la. 8Ba meena a ka yammoa ale chim betta. Daata bɔgluk tii ale kan ta kiri la ale sak ba. 9Kpana ŋaai ate ba kuri la a nyini ka Tarsis ate ligmɔniŋka a nyini Ufaz. Peesirɔwa ale choakudɔwa ale nye jabuui la ba jo wa ale ka garuk sobluk ale garuk mɔnuŋ. Ba meena ka baai ale seba ŋanta nyeka la ale nye. 10Alege Naawen ale wensie Wenni, wa ale Wen dii ale vua la, taam wuu Naawa. Wa sui a dan puuri, tɛŋka a kpiŋsi kama. Tɛŋsaŋa an baga a pik wa suipuurumu.
11<<Weeni ba nna: <Wenaŋa de, ŋaai ale kan nye wenzukku ale tɛŋka la ale bɛ tɛŋzuk ale tɛŋka meena.> >>
12Alege Wen ale nye tɛŋka ale wa pagrim, wa dueni tɛŋka ale wa yam ale dari wenŋmazukku ale wa miŋka. 13Wa dan na nanpaniŋ, nyaataŋa ale bo wenŋmazukku la a wuuri kama, wa basi ate chiŋma a yiti tɛŋka kpeglimka jiga. Wa a tom nyaksika ale ŋmoruk ale ta viok a nyini wa kɔlima yeeŋa po a nyini.
14Waai meena a kan poli ale zɛ jaaboa, ligmɔniŋ kuridɔ meena chivie ale ta wa ale wa bɔgtaŋa. Wa ŋan mɛɛntaŋa ka varuk. Ba ka vuusum ba po. 15Ba ka kiri ya, ŋan baai ale ka ŋan laanta. Ba buusaŋa a dan jam, ba le kpi. 16Jekob Wenni daa nna, diila wa ale jaab meena Nyeerɔ, a maa gum Izirali du, wa nitalim buuni. Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale wa yuenni.
17Ni tigsi ŋan baai ate ni soa la a basi tɛŋka, nama baai ate ba lik ni a ta la. 18Diila Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Nnala nna Naawen ale yuk baai ale bo tɛŋka de po la a basi. M le ta daanika a jam ba jigi ate dila ba yik ba.>>
19Ku ale tua a te mu m kɔnika nyiŋ. M le kɔni diila a ka tebika. Alege mi weeni mi dek ayen, <<M nyiŋtuilaŋa ale nna, ate ku a fɛ ayen m pik.>> 20Mi viuku a kaasi kama. Ku miisaŋa meena ba chiak kama. M nidoabilisaŋa a cheŋ alege mu ba ŋman ka. Waai an ŋman tali ayen wa ti m viuku yaase wa ti m kusuŋku. 21Naapeerisaŋa a kan poli, ba abe kan kpesi a nyini Naawen jigi ya, dila nyiŋ ba kan nya ba dega ate ba piisaŋa meena a waaŋ. 22Ni wom, tontomiŋka cheena, butimka yega ale nyini wiiluk geŋka tɛŋka a cheena. Ku le nye ate Juda tɛŋ ninaŋa a doa koruta, suemkpatta boka jigi.
23Naawen yaa, mi seba ayen nurubiik nyuvuri daa wadek ale soa. Daa nurubiik dek ale a dak wa chelimu. 24Sak mu, Naawen yaa, alege nye ale nyemagsika daa suipuurummoa, kan daa di fi le nye ate m chim jaab kama. 25Kpiiri fi suipuurumu a basi tɛŋsaŋa zuk sii ale kan siak a te fu la, baai ale kaa wi fi yuenni la. Diila ba ko Jekob kama. Ba ko wa ka chessi a kaasi wa tɛŋka meena.

Title: JEREMAYA 11
Content:
1Wa dii ale nyini Naawen jigi a jam Jeremaya jigi la ale nna: 2<<Wom nɔiyeŋka nyemagsika abe fi weeni Juda nuruma ale baai ale bo Jerusalem la. 3Weeni ba ayen dii ate Naawen, Izirali Wenni a weeni la ale nna: <Kikaasa a bo nuru waai ale kaa va nɔiyeŋka nyemagsika de la, 4nye magsi kaai ate mi weeni ni kokpieŋsaŋa diipo ate mi ta ba nyini Ejipiti a nyini la, a nyini kuta nyaliŋka bolimu po a nyini la.> Mi jam weeni kama ayen, <Ni a zuli mu abe ni a nye dii meena ate m weeni la, ate ni chim m nuruba ate mi chim ni Wen. 5Ate mi yaa nye dii ate mi a pɛ ale ni kokpieŋsaŋa, ayen m le te ba tɛŋ ate biisim ale siita a chali ka po la,> tɛŋ kaai ate ni soa jinla la.>> Mi yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ku be nye dila, Naawen yaa.>>
6Naawen a weeni mi ayen, <<Mooli wieŋa de Juda tɛŋsaŋa ale Jerusalem suitaŋa po. <Wom nɔiyeŋka nyemagsika de a va ŋa. 7A nyini diipo ate mi ta ni kokpieŋsaŋa a nyini Ejipiti a jam paari jinla la, mi kaam ba kama a tulim ayen, <<Ni zuli mu.>> 8Alege ba an wom ya yaase ba popola a boro. Alege ba goanti va ka ba tuikpanni ale ba suiniim baataŋa ale a yaali diila. Dila mi yaa ta nɔiyeŋka kikaasaŋa meena a jam ba zuk mi ale weeni ba ayen ba va nɔiyeŋka alege ba an va la.> >>
9Naawen yaa weeni mi ayen, <<Biem zɔga ale bo Juda nuruma ale baai ale bo Jerusalem la suŋsuŋ. 10Ba pilim ŋmani ka ba kokpieŋsaŋa wabaataŋa po, baai ale jam zɛri an wom mi wieŋa. Ba va ka wen yona a tom a te ŋa. Izirali yenni ale Juda yenni meena a kaasi nɔiyeŋka ate mi a nye ale ba kokpieŋsaŋa la kama. 11Dila nyiŋ Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <M le ta kaasuŋ a jam ba zuk ate ba kan bɛ. Ba le kaari a wi mi m kan wom ba. 12Juda tɛŋsaŋa ale Jerusalem nuruma ale kaari a wi wena ŋaai ate ba ju ŋan baai nyum ale masa a te la alege ŋa kan maari ba ase kaasuŋ a nin zi. 13Juda demma, ni ta wena ka nna yega ase ni ale ta tɛŋsaŋa diila ale ni kuŋkuŋtaŋa ate ni sɛ a ju ŋan baai nyum ale masa a te chivie wenni Baal la a piisi ase ka Jerusalem suitaŋa la.>
14<<Kan puusi a te nuruma de yaase fi saalimu yaase juisi te ba, dii nyiŋla ba dan wi mu a nyini ba ninammu po m kan wom ba.
15<<Nuru baai ate mi a yaali la a nye ka biem wie. Ka boa ale soa ate ba a jo mi yenni po? Ba a poli kama ayen pumpuulima nyeka ale kaabka tiirita ale kasi ba kaasuŋ po. Ba kaa naŋi.>>
16Naawen a jam a wi ni ayen ka kpaam tiib buui ale ta va yɔgsa a ta yɔn naliŋsa, alege yɔgyɔgla wuurika ase nanpansa la ale ju bu vaataŋa ale bolim abe bu naŋsaŋa a wɛ.
17Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale vuk ni la, ale dueni kaasuŋ a magsi ni dii nyiŋla Izirali yenni ale Juda yenni a nye ka biem ale nye ate mi sui a puuri ba le ju ŋan baai nyum ale masa a te Baal la.
18Naawen ale pai ba biem zɔŋŋa a sak mi la nyiŋ, mi jam seba kama, diila dila po wa sak mi kama dii ate ba jam boro a nye la. 19Mi jam nye ase ka pabiik kaai ale nye ŋmam ate ba ta a cheŋ tɔgrika la. Mi jam zɛ ayen ba zɔk kama a ta chaab ale mi, a weeni ayen, <<Ni te ate ti kaasi tiimu ale bu yɔnaŋa. Ni te ate ti gebi wa ŋanvuta tɛŋka po a basi, ate ba kan ŋmaa teeri wa yuenni diipo diipo.>> 20Alege Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, fi waai ale a bo buusa a yɔrisi la ale a chamsi suinum ale popola, basi ate mi a nya fi tutuna ba zuk, diila fi ate mi pai m wanni a te.
21<<Dila nyiŋ Naawen ale weeni dii a magsi chaab ale Anatot nuruma baai ale a gisi ba ko fu la ale a weeni ayen, <Kan mooli Naawen yuenni nyiŋŋa kan daa di ti le ko fu.> 22Dila nyiŋ Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni diila ale nna: <M le namsi ba. Gebik ale ko ba nidoa paalukku, kom ale ko ba nidoabilisaŋa ale ba liema. 23Nuruba magadek mɛ la a kan poom tali a te ba, dii nyiŋla m le ta kaasuŋ a jam Anatot nuruma zuk ba namsika benni.> >>

Title: JEREMAYA 12
Content:
1Naawen yaa, fi kasim ka wayɔrisima nyɔnɔ, ase m nin ta biik a jam fi jigi. Alege m le biisi fi nyemagsika wari. Ka boa ale soa ate wabanyeerik wari a nye a niagi? Ka boa ale soa ate baai ale kan ta siaka la a boro ale suiyɔgni? 2Fi ale vuk ba, ate ba feri naŋsa, ate ba chim a yɔni yɔna. Fi kasim bo ka ba nɔngbanvaataŋa alege yalima ale ba suiniimaŋa. 3Alege fi seba mi, Naawen yaa. Fi a nya mi kama a chamsi mi popolaŋa ale fu ale ka diila. Dari ba ta cheŋ ase piisa la ate ba che ba. Gaari ba a magsi da dii dai ate ba a tɔgri la. 4Tɛŋka ale ko beni soa ka sɛ ate wuuku ale bo laŋ meena po la a kpi. Dila meena, nuruma a weeni kama ayen, <<Wa kan nya dii ale di nye ti la.>>
5<<Fi daa chali chala ale nuruma naŋta ate ba nye ate fi jiak fi le nye ka sɛ a nak nanpaga ale wusuma? Fi dan nak naŋ a lo tɛŋ kaai ate wari a kan nye fu, fi le nye ka sɛ a maari fidek Jodan Benni tiisaŋa po? 6Fi suataŋa, fidek dɔkdemma a poom a pa fu a da kama, ba kaari kama ate ku jueli a ta chaab ale fu. Kan mariŋ ba, ba le poom a biisi fi wamaŋsa la mɛ.
7<<M le zɛri m yenni, a banti m nitalimu. M le pai waai ate mi a yaali la a nyo wa dachaasaŋa nisima po. 8Mi nitalimu a yaa nye mi nna ase ka gbeŋli ale bo tiisa po la. Wa a na mi, dila nyiŋ mi kisi wa kama. 9Mi nitalimu a nye mi jigi nna ase piina ale nuin sii ale a dɛ lanta la ale gilim a dɛ mi nuruma ate mi lueri a te m dek la. Ga tigsi gɔi duŋsaŋa meena, a ta si jam ate si dɛ. 10Naapeerisa yega ale kaasi m kadukka a tabi m laŋka. Ba le tulim m laŋka ate m sui peenti ale ka la ate ka chim laŋ koruk kinla. 11Ka le chim tɛŋ kaai ale kan ta jaaboa, tɛŋ kosik ale tɛŋ koruk mi niŋ, tɛŋka meena ale doa kinla dii nyiŋla waai niŋ a karo. 12Guutaŋa meena zuk gɔnni po kaasirɔba ale tigsi diila Naawen gebika ale ko a nyini tɛŋka kpeglim kinka a ga paari m kala, waai a kan vuugi. 13Ba le bori ŋanbie alege ŋari munsa. Ba le jiak badek alege kan nya jaaboa. Dila ni ta ni cheka chivieŋa Naawen suipuurumu nyiŋ.>>
14Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Mi gaasa gilagila nyama ale vari nitalimu ate mi te Izirali demma la, m le dari ba a voori ba tɛŋsaŋa po abe m voori Juda yenni ba suŋsuŋ. 15Alege m dan voori ba ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ, m le ta jiirim ale ba abe m ta waai meena a ŋman jam wadek nitalim jigi ale wadek tɛŋ po. 16Ate ba dan zamsi nalimnyiini mi nuruma suitaŋa ale pɛ mi yuenni nyiŋ ayen, <Chekki Naawen ale vua la nyiŋ,> alege ba poom jam sak mi nuruma ayen ba a pɛ Baal nyiŋla ba yaa le kali paari mi nuruma po. 17Alege tɛŋ kaai a dan kan wom ya, m le dari ka a voori a kaasi ka chessi.>> Naawen ale weeni.

Title: JEREMAYA 13
Content:
1Naawen ale weeni mi diila ale nna: <<Cheŋ a ga da chiak gbain naliŋ a bobi fi chiaka, alege kan te di tiri nyiamoa.>> 2Dila mi yaa jam da chiak gbain, ase Naawen ale dak diila, a pai bobi mi chiaka.
3Naawen wanni a ŋman jam mi jigi a nye buye: 4<<Pai chiak gbain dii ate fi da a bobi fi chiaka la a cheŋ Perat yɔgyɔgla a suk di dula pinaŋa vie po.>> 5Dila mi yaa cheŋ a ga suk di Perat ase Naawen ale weeni mu diila.
6Daa yega ale taam la Naawen yaa weeni mi ayen, <<Cheŋ Perat yɔgyɔgla a ga pai gbanni ate mi weeni ate fi suk la.>> 7Dila mi yaa cheŋ Perat a tu yeeri gbanni juijui ate mi a pai di a suk la, alege yɔgyɔgla de di kaasi a ŋman ka kiri ya.
8Naawen wanni yaa jam mi jigi ayen, 9<<Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <M le kaasi Juda kanjantaŋa ale Jerusalem kanjauŋ kpientaŋa ka dila dek. 10Wabaata nyama de, ale zɛri an wom mi wieŋa, ale va ba tuikpanni yaalika a va wen yona a tom a te ŋa ale a puusi ŋa la ale nye ase ka chiak gbanni de la a ka kiri ya. 11Ase gbain ale a bobi nuru chiak diila, dila dek ate mi bobi Izirali yenni meena ale Juda meena a te mi dek. Mi nye nna kama ayen ba chim mi nuruba a ta pimpauk ale zula a jam te mi yuenni, alege ba an wom mi.> Naawen ale weeni.
12<<Weeni ba ayen, <Naawen, Izirali Wenni a weeni ayen, daam bunlɔk meena a sueri ale daam.> Ate ba dan weeni fu ayen, <Tama zɛ ayen daam bunlɔk meena a magsi ku sueri ale daamoa?> 13Yaa weeni ba ayen, <Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: Mi a yaali ayen m buk waai meena ale bo tɛŋka de po la a gum nalima ŋaai ale kali Deevid naam zukpaglika zuk la, ale kaabteerɔma ale biisiteerɔba ale baai meena ale bo Jerusalem la. 14M le ŋɔriŋ ba a gum chaab, koba ale bisa wayeŋ. Naawen ale weeni. M kan te ate ŋmanteka yaase jiirimmoa yaase vɔŋteka a kasi mu ate m kan kaasi ba.> >>
15Chiib kpesi abe ni wom ni kan ta kanjanta, diila Naawen a biisi kama. 16Ni pai zula a te Naawen ni Wenni alege ate wa ta legi a jam, alege ate ni a nak naŋsa guutaŋa zuk legini po. Ni yiili a yaali ka bolim alege wa le tulim ate bu chim legi nna kpitɔ a tagri ate ku nye birim. 17Alege ni dan kan wom ya, m le kum digdig ni kanjantaŋa nyiŋ. Mi nina ale kum tuotuowa ate ninyaata a chali, dii nyiŋla Naawen piisaŋa ba le yik ŋa.
18Weeni naawa ale naab mawa ayen, <<Ni nyini ni naam zukpagliksaŋa zuk a siŋ diila ni zula naam zutɔksaŋa a lak ni zuimaŋa a lo kama.>> 19Tɛŋ nina ŋaai ale bo Negev la a lik kama, waai abe kan boro a lak si. Juda meena ba le ji ba a ta cheŋ tɛŋ yoŋ, ba ji a ta cheŋ ferr.
20Ni zak zuima a nya baai ale nyini wiilukku geŋ a cheena la. Pa ŋaai ate ba jam pai te fu la, a bo ka be, pa ŋaai ate fi kuulim ŋa wie la? 21Ni le weeni ayen ka boa ase nuru baai ate nama poli ayen ba jam ka ni doaba la a nin nak de ni a nya ni zuwa? Ni nyiŋsa ale dom ase nipok puuk ale a dom ayen wa biak la. 22Ate fi dan bek fidek ayen, <<Ka boa ate kude nye mi?>> Ka fi waba boanni nyiŋ ale soa ate fi mankutaŋa a cheeri ale fɛ a goa ale fu. 23Kus denɔ a baga a tagri wa nyiŋ gbaŋka yaase yɔŋni di soblaŋa? Ni be an baga a nye wamaŋsa mɛ ni ale malim ale biem nyeka diila.
24<<M le kati ni waaŋ ase vɔtta ate tɛŋ kosik viok a ji la. 25Ni charuku ale nna, charuk kuui ate mi gomsi dueni ni la, dii nyiŋla ni baŋ mi kama ale ta sebchakka ale venta wena. Naawen ale weeni. 26<<M le dari ni mankutaŋa a ta jueli ni ninaŋa ate ba nya ni chivie 27ale ni kaboŋsaŋa ale kɔrisaŋa ale a kan chali chivie taabugni. Mi nya ni nyeela ŋaai ate mi a kisa la kama guutaŋa zuk ale laŋsaŋa po. Kikaasa a bo ni zuk Jerusalem demma! Ni le daŋ a paari ka dimpo?>> Naawen ale weeni.

Title: JEREMAYA 14
Content:
1Naawen wanni ale nna a jam Jeremaya jigi a magsi chaab ale tɛŋ kosikka: 2<<Juda a kum kama, ka tɛŋsaŋa a kpi, ba a wooli a te tɛŋka, ate kumsa a nyini Jerusalem a jueli wen. 3Nuru kpientaŋa a tom ba tomteerɔma ayen ba ta nyiam jam te ba. Ba cheŋ viliŋa alege an nya nyiamoa. Ba ŋmani ale samɔn koruta, ba jɔk nyiŋbiiri ale tuim, a yaa lik ba nimbieŋa. 4Tɛŋka a na ka mulisa dii nyiŋla ŋmoruk an ni tɛŋka zuwa, kpaarɔma a jɔk nyiŋbiiri a lik ba nimbieŋa. 5Laŋka po walik nubini a basi di biika dii nyiŋla wuuk a karo. 6Bon waarisa a za guutaŋa zuima a vuusi a kpeeri ase suemkpatta la, si nina a kan ŋmaa nya wuuk ale kan boro la nyiŋ.>>
7Ti wabaataŋa a poom a bo seerɔ a mini ti kama, Naawen yaa, nye wari fi yuenni nyiŋ. Diila ti pilim ŋmanika a zuak kama. Ti tom a kaasi fu kama. 8Fi nyiini ale Izirali Yiila, ka Varibasidɔ ninam po, ka boa ate fi a nye ase nichaanɔ la tɛŋka po, ase nyeendɔ ale a goa jigi yok yeŋ la? 9Ka boa ate fi a nye ase nuru ate ku diiri wa la, ase tugurik tɔŋdɔ wobsik ale kan baga a vari a basi la? Fi bo ka tama po, Naawen yaa, tama abe ta ka fi yuenni, kan zɛri ti.
10Naawen ale weeni nuruma de wie diila ale nna: <<Ba a yaali tuintika ka nna yegayega. Ba kan yik badek ale ba chelimu. Dila Naawen a kan siak ba. Yɔgyɔgla de wa le teeri ba gaasaŋa a namsi ba ba wabaataŋa nyiŋ.>>
11Ate Naawen yaa weeni mi ayen, <<Kan puusi a yaali nuruma de nye niaka. 12Ba a bobi ka nɔi, m kan wom ba kumsa, ba a te juka tiirita ale ŋanbie tiirita, m kan siak ba. M le goanti a ko ba ale gebika ale kɔm ale nyiŋtuila.>>
13Alege mi weeni ayen, <<Nyɔnɔ Naawen yaa, biisiteerɔma kasim a weeni ba kama ayen, ba kan nya gebika yaase ba nam ale kɔmmoa. <Chekki, m le te fu suiyɔgni dii ale di beni dela jigini.> >>
14Naawen yaa weeni mi ayen, <<Biisiteerɔma a mooli ka venta ale mi yuenni. Mi an tom ba yaase m lueri ba yaase m biisi ale ba. Ba a mooli ka venta gɔdaasima wie ale venta sampoporinni ale venta bɔgta wie ale badek popola wie. 15Dila la, Naawen ale weeni dii a magsi chaab ale biisiteerɔ baai ale a mooli mi yuenni nyiŋla ale nna: Mi an tom ba, alege ba a weeni ayen, <Gebik yaase kɔm a kan tiri tɛŋka de.> Biisiteerɔ bala dek ale kpi ale gebika ale kɔm. 16Ate nuru baai ate ba mooli a te la ba le yuk ba a basi Jerusalem suitaŋa po kɔmmu ale gebika nyiŋ. Waai a kan boro a gu ba yaase ba pooma ale ba nidoabilisaŋa ale ba liema. M pai kaasuŋ kuui ale magsi ba la a basi ba zuk.
17<<Biisi wanni de a te ba ayen, <Basi ate m ninaŋa ninyaata sueri a chali yok ale kantueŋ a kan gebiri a te m liewa kaliaka. M nuruma a nam kama ale kɔni biok, niguri dii ale a ŋɔriŋ. 18M dan jo tɛŋ kpieŋka po, mi a nya baai ate gebika a ko ba la, m dan jo tɛŋ nummu po, mi a nya kɔmmu ale a viiri nuruba diila. Biisiteerɔ ale kaabteerɔ meena a cheŋ ka tɛŋ kaai ate ba zɛ la.> >>
19Fi zɛri Juda ka chessi? Fi banti Zayon kama? Ka boa ate fi kɔni ti ate ti kan baga a nya tebika. Ti yiili kama a yaali suiyɔgni alege wamaŋ an jam ya, diipo ale magsi tebika alege ka nyinyigsa nyiini. 20Naawen yaa, ti siak ti wabaataŋa ale ti koma foolaawa kama, ti sum a tom kaasi fu kama. 21Fi yuenni nyiŋ kan zɛri ti a basi, kan te fi zula yuenni chivie. Teeri fi nɔiyeŋka ale ti abe fi kan yik a kaasi. 22Tɛŋsaŋa bɔgluk tii ale kan ta kiri la a ta ŋmoruk a jam? Wenŋmazuimaŋa dek a te ŋmoruk bie a jam? Aaya, ka fi Naawen ti Wen yaa. Dila nyiŋ ti yiilaŋa a bo ka fi jigi, diila ka fi ale a nye kude meena.

Title: JEREMAYA 15
Content:
1Naawen yaa weeni mi ayen, <<Moosis ale Samuel a dan poom za mi niŋ, m suinum a kan bo nuruma de jigi ya. Te ti ba cheŋ mi niŋ. Basi ate ba cheŋ. 2Ate ba dan bek fu ayen, <Ti cheŋ bɛ?> Weeni ba ayen, <Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: Baai ale magsi kum la ba kpi, baai ale magsi gebika la gebika a ko ba, baai ale magsi viirika a viiri, baai ale magsi yik ta cheŋka la, ba yik ta cheŋ.>
3Naawen ale weeni ayen, <<M le tom kaasirɔba tɔgatɔga banaansi ate ba ta chaab ale ba, gebika a ko ba ate baasaŋa a dari ta cheŋ, ate wenzuk nuinsaŋa ale tɛŋzuk duŋsaŋa a kaasi abe si ŋɔbi. 4M le nye ate tɛŋzuk naataŋa a kisi ba Azekaya nidoabinni Manasa waai ale ka Juda naab la ale nye dii Jerusalem po la nyiŋ.>>
5<<Ka wana ale wa ŋmani te ni, Jerusalem demma? Ka wana ale wa kum ni nyiŋŋa? Ka wana ale wa baga a puusi ni? 6Ni zɛri mi kama,>> Naawen ale weeni. <<Ni kasim pai mi vaka a basi. Dila m le pai nisa a yik ni a kaasi ni. M kan ŋman baga a sak jiirimmoa. 7M le yali ni ale jayalim buui ale ta nyina la tɛŋka nansuiŋtaŋa nɔi. M le basi ate ku ko ba abe m kaasi m nuruma diila ba an tagri ba suitaŋa. 8M le basi ate ba pukɔŋŋa a piisi ase nyakpiemu tintain busuŋku la. Kantueŋ suŋsuŋ m le ta kaasirɔ a jam ate wa ta chaab ale ba bi paalukku mama. M le ta sui kaasuŋ ale kpazinagsuk a jam ba zuk nna mwuli. 9Bisa bayopɔi ma ale cha abe wa vuusi wa vuusum buui ale a kpegli. Wa wenbinni ale siŋ ale ku diem ka kantueŋ. Wa le nya chivie ale valiŋsa. Baai ale vuugi la m le ko ba ale gebik ba dachaasaŋa niŋ.>> Naawen ale weeni.
10Mi daa suipeentik nuru. Mi zɛ dii ate mi mawa a biak mi a basi tɛŋka po la. Mi nye ka kpaliŋsa ale nak nanpaga ale waai meena tɛŋka po. Mi an piem waai ligra yaase m piem ligra a te waai ya, alege waai meena a ka a te mi.
11Naawen a weeni ayen, <<Chekki m le vari fu a basi wamaŋ nyiŋ. Wensie m le basi ate fi dachaasaŋa a saalim fu kaasuŋ ale ninam daaŋa po.
12<<Nuru a baga a wɛ kutuwa. Kutuk kuui ale nyini wiiluk geŋ ŋa yaase kutuk mɔnuŋŋoa? 13Ni jigsika ale ni tuilum ŋantaŋa m le basi ate ba koalim a ta cheŋ ni wabaataŋa tɛŋka po meena nyiŋ. 14M le basi ate ni chim ni dachaasaŋa yɔm tɛŋ kaai po ate ni zɛ, diila mi suipuurumu ale fuk bolim toati buui ale bu de ni.>>
15Naawen yaa, fi a miŋ wie kama, teeri m wie abe fi nya m zuk. Tuni m dachaasaŋa a te mu. Fi ka waai ale a duŋ sui, kan ta mu a cheŋŋi. Poli m le nam ale lieta fi nyiŋ diila. 16Fi wieŋa ale jam la, mi dɛ ŋa kama. Ŋa jam ka mi masim ale suinum mariŋka, diila mi ta ka fi yuenni, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, Wen yaa. 17Mi an maa kali nuruba suŋsuŋ a la ale a dɛ masim ale ba, mi kali ka m dek m nyiini dii nyiŋla fi nisa ale jam bo mi zuk ate fi sueri mi ale suipuurum. 18Ka boa ate mi domka a kan kpeglim ate mi kɔnika a bie a ka tebika? Fi le chim ka pimpaasima beli a te mi, ase bulik kaai ale kpeeri ya?
19Dila nyiŋ Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Fi dan laŋ nyeka, m le ta fu ŋmani ate fi tom a te mu. Ase fi a nin biisi wamaŋsa alege daa wakayaata, fi le chim m biisiteerɔ. Basi ate nuruma de a tulim jam fi jigi, alege ku a fɛ ate fi a kan tulim cheŋ ba jigi ya. 20M le basi ate fi chim siak a te nuruma de, kutuk mɔnuŋ parik pagrik, ba le kpaliŋ ale fu alege ba kan nya pagrim fi zuwa, diila mi bo ale fu kama ayen m vari fu a basi.>> Naawen ale weeni. 21<<M le vari fu gaasa nyama nisa po a basi abe m yeeri fu gaasa nyama bobika po a ta nyini.>>

Title: JEREMAYA 16
Content:
1Ate Naawen wanni a jam mi jigi ayen, 2<<Ku a fɛ ate fi kan faari nipok a biak nidoabilisa ale lieba dela jigini.>> 3Diila Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna a magsi chaab ale nidoabilisa ale lieba ate ba biak tɛŋka de la ale nipok baai ale ka ba maba ale nidoa baai ale ka ba koba la: 4<<Ba le kpi ale nyiŋtui baata. Ba kan kum ba yaase ba gu ba alege ba le chim ka yaata a doa tɛŋka. Ba le kpi ale gebik ale kɔm, ate ba nyiŋsaŋa a chim ŋandiinta a te wenzuk nuinsaŋa ale tɛŋzuk duŋsaŋa.>>
5Dila Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Kan jo yeri diipo ate kuub ŋandiinta a boro la, kan cheŋ ga kum yaase fi sak jiirim ale ba, dii nyiŋla mi yeeri m niauŋku ale m ŋmanteka ale m yaalika m nuruma jigi kama.>> Naawen ale weeni. 6<<Baai ale fiisa ale baai ale zuak ale kpi tɛŋka po. Ba kan gu ba yaase ba kum ba, ate waai a kan gebi wadek yaase wa chiiri wa zuk a te ba. 7Waai a kan te baai ale a kum kpiewa la ŋandiinta ayen wa yɔk ba sue, dan poom ka wa ma yaase wa ko ale kpi wa kan te daam ayen wa yɔk ba sue.
8<<Kan jo yeri po ate ŋandiinta tigi a boro yaase fi kali a de ale nyu. 9Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, Izirali Wenni ale weeni diila ale nna: Ni nimbie po ale ni daaŋa po m le ta ni masim ale suipeentik nuemka a jam kpeglimka jigi ale nipok fiak ale duerɔ nuemka dela jigini.
10<<Fi dan weeni nuruma de kude meena ate ba bek fu ayen, <Ka boa ate Naawen a te ti kaasuŋ kpioŋku de choa? Ti nye ka boan kaasi? Ka boan wabiok ate tama nye kaasi Naawen ti Wenni?> 11Yaa weeni ba ayen, <Ka ni koma ale zɛri mu la nyiŋ ale va wen yona la ale tom te ŋa ale puusi ŋa. Ba zɛri mi kama ale an ta mi sinsaŋŋa. Naawen ale weeni. 12Alege ni nye gaasa nyeka kama a gaam ni koma. Nya ni waai meena ale va wadek tuikpari suinum yaalika ale goanti an va mi. 13M le ta ni nyini tɛŋka de po a cheŋ tɛŋ kaai ate nama yaase ni koma a zɛ, ate dula ni tom a te wen yona yok ale kantueŋ, diila m kan sak ni ŋmanteka.> >>
14Naawen a weeni ayen, <<Alege daaŋa a cheena ate nuruba a kan ŋman weeni ayen, <Ase Naawen ale sum vua la, waai ale ta Izirali demma a nyini Ejipiti a nyini la,> 15alege ba le weeni ayen, <Ase Naawen ale sum vua la, waai ale ta Izirali demma a nyini wiiluk geŋka tɛŋka ale tɛŋ sii ate wa jam yiak ba la.> Diila m le ta ba a jam tɛŋ kaai ate m pai te ba kokpieŋsaŋa la.
16Naawen a weeni ayen, <<Alege m le tom a yaali jum yigrɔ boari ate ba yik ba. Kula ŋaaŋnyiŋ m le tom a yaali yaalɔ boari, ate ba yaalim a nak ba dueni guuk meena ale piuŋ meena zuk ale pina vie po. 17Mi nina a bo ba suitaŋa meena po kama, ba an suk ale mi, yaase ba wabiokku a suk mi nina po. 18Mi tuni ba ku nɔi buye ba gaasaŋa ale ba wabaataŋa nyiŋ diila ba taŋ mi tɛŋka kama ale ba ŋanmɛɛn tii ale kan ta vum la nyeelaŋa ale sueri mi nitalimu ale ba bɔgluk tii ate mi kisa la.>>
19Naawen yaa, m pagrim ale m ligrɔ, m sukka jigi daanika po, fi jigi ate tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa ale nyini tɛŋka kpeglimka meena jigi a jam weeni ayen, <<Ti koma a jam ka jaaboa alege ka venta wena ŋaai ale kan nye wamaŋ a te ba. 20<<Nuruba a nye badek wena? Ba a nye alege ŋa daa wena.>>
21<<Dila nyiŋ, m le sak ba. Yɔgyɔgla de m le sak ba m pagrimu ale zuaka. Ba yaa le seba ayen mi yuenni ale Naawen.

Title: JEREMAYA 17
Content:
1<<Juda wabiokku a ŋmarisi ale ka kutuk jaŋmarisim ale kerisi ale janoachɔrik ba suiniimaŋa nyiŋ ale ba kuŋkuŋtaŋa nyiilaŋa zuk. 2Ba bisaŋa a poom a teeri ba kuŋkuŋtaŋa ale Asera zaŋŋa ale za ti sii meena ale ta va sobta la ale gu wɔŋtaŋa zuk. 3Mi guuku ale bo tɛŋka po la ale ni nitalimu ale ni tuilum ŋantaŋa m le pai te ate ba koalim ale ni tangbanaŋa meena ni wabaataŋa tɛŋka po meena nyiŋ. 4Nidek nye beka nyiŋ ni le jɔk nitalim buui ate m pai te ni. M le basi ate ni chim ni dachaasaŋa yɔm tɛŋ kaai po ate ni zɛ. Diila ni zuk m suinni po kama ate di ale de taam wuu.>>
5Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Kikaasa a bo waai ale ta sebchakka ale nurubiik la. Waai yiila ale bo nyiŋlam jigi a yaali pagrim ale waai suinum ale tulim a basi Naawen. 6Wa le nye ase ka tiib fiik ale bo tɛŋ koruta po la. Wa kan paari ŋanta ase ŋanta a nin jam. Wa le bo ka gɔnni po kosikka jiŋŋa, yesa jigi juijui ate waai a karo.
7<<Alege niauŋ a bo ka waai ale ta sebchakka ale Naawen la, waai sebchakka ale bo ale wa la. 8Wa le nye ase ka tiib ate ba vuk nyiam nɔi la buui tɛŋ naŋsa ale teeri a siŋ benni po. Bu niŋ ka tuiluk po ase ku nin jam, bu vaataŋa kasim sobi kama. Ku kan daani bu ase ben dii ŋmoruk a nin kan ni ya ale kan kpeeri yɔna yɔnika.>>
9Suinummu a ta pimpaasima a gaam ŋanta meena kama a ka tebika. Ka wana ale baga a miŋ bu?
10<<Mi Naawen ale a gisi suinum ale a kpesi popolaŋa, a tuni nuru a magsi chaab ale wa nyeelaŋa, a magsi chaab ale wa tuimaŋa ale magsi diila.>>
11Ase yeŋ ale a wɔgri jena ŋaai ate ka an lobi la ku ka dila dek ale nuru waai ale pai venta suik a paari ŋanta. Wa dan ga pak maga wa le jɔk ba ate ku kpeglimka wa chim beruk.
12Ti Wen yenni a nye ase ka zula naam zukpaglik la, a za gu woŋ zuk a nyini piilimka po. 13Naawen yaa, Izirali yiila, baai meena ale zɛri fu la ale jo chivie po. Ba le muriŋ bɛ ase yue ale ŋmarisi tanta po la dii nyiŋla ba zɛri Naawen kama, nyuvuri nyiam bulika.
14Tebi mu, Naawen yaa, ate m nya tebika, vari mu basi ate m nya varibasika, diila ka fi ale waai ate mi a pak. 15Ba kasim a weeni mi kama ayen, <<Naawen wanni a bo ka bɛ? Basi ate ku nye yɔgyɔgla de.>> 16Mi an chali a bɛ ya ale m le chim fi naapeerik la. Fi seba ayen mi an yaali daanika danni: Wa dii ale a nyini mi nɔi po la fi seba kama. 17Kan chim nyinyigsa nyɔnɔ a te mu, fi jigi ate mi a suk kaasuŋ danni. 18Basi ate baai ale a namsi mu la chivie a yik ba, alege kasi mu chivie po, basi ate yɔgsum yik ba, alege kasi mu nyinyigsa po. Ta kaasuŋ danni a jam ba zuk, kaasi ba ale kaasuŋ ku nɔi buye.
19Naawen ale weeni mi diila ale nna: <<Cheŋ ga zaani nuruma nansuiŋku nɔi, kuui ate Juda nalimaŋa a va a jo ale a nyini la. Zaani Jerusalem nansuiŋ tintila mɛ. 20Weeni ba ayen, <Wom Naawen wanni, Juda nalima ale Juda nuruma meena ale waai meena ale bo Jerusalem a va nansuiŋtaŋa de a jam la. 21Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: Ni kpesi ate ni kan ji jib Vuusumu Danni yaase ni ta va Jerusalem nansuiŋtaŋa. 22Ni kan ta jib a nyini ni yeeŋa po a nyini yaase ni tom tuini Vuusum Danni, alege ni basi ate Vuusum Danni a ta tuilum ase mi ale weeni ni kokpieŋsaŋa diila. 23Alege ba an wom ya yaase ba popola a bo du, ba tue jam kpari kama a kan wom yaase ba niŋ bo waalika po.
24<< <Alege ni dan kpesi a wom mi nɔi, Naawen ale weeni, an ta jiboa a va tɛŋka nansuiŋtaŋa a jo Vuusum Danni, alege basi ate Vuusum Danni a chim tuilum dai an tom tuini, 25nalima ŋaai ale a kali Deevid zukpaglika zuk la ale va tɛŋka de nansuiŋtaŋa a jo ale ba kpaŋŋa. Ba ale ba kpaŋŋa ale do wusuma ale torokoba, ate Juda nuruba ale baai ale bo Jerusalem la a bani ba, ate tɛŋka de nuruba a bo ka po taam wuu. 26Nuruba ale nyini Juda tɛŋsaŋa ale tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa ale gilim Jerusalem, ba le nyini Benjamin tɛŋbanni po ale yeniŋ guutaŋa, ale tɛŋ kaai ale ta guutaŋa la ale Negev a ta juka tiirita ale kaabsa ale ŋanbie tiirita ale ŋan baai nyum ale masa ale jiam teka tiirita a jam Naawen yenni po.
27<< <Alege ni dan kan wom mi nɔi ya a basi ate Vuusum Danni a ta tuilum an ji jibta a va Jerusalem nansuiŋtaŋa Vuusum Danni m yaa le fuk bolim buui ale kaa kpimsi Jerusalem nansuiŋtaŋa ate bu dɛ ka ŋan pagraŋa.> >>

Title: JEREMAYA 18
Content:
1Wa dii ale nyini Naawen jigi a jam Jeremaya jigi la ale nna: 2<<Cheŋ siŋ mɛɛrɔwa yenni, ate m te fu biik dula.>> 3Dila mi yaa cheŋ siŋ mɛɛrɔwa yenni, ate mi nya ale wa a mɛ a gilim. 4Alege samɔniŋka ate wa a mɛ ale yakka la yaa kaasi wa nisa po, dila mɛɛrɔwa yaa yik tulim a nye ka choa, a tagri a nye dii ale nala a te wadek la.
5Naawen wanni yaa jam mi jigi ayen, 6<<Izirali yeri yaa, mi an baga a nye fu ase mɛɛrɔwa de ale a nye diila?>> Naawen ale weeni. <<Ase yak ale bo mɛɛrɔwa nisa po diila, ni ka dila mi nisa po, Izirali yeri yaa. 7Ase diipo meena m dan mooli ayen tɛŋ yaase naam a yeeri abe bu lo waaŋ abe bu kaasi, 8ate tɛŋ kala ate m kaam la a laŋ nyeka a basi ka biemu, m le basi m le m nye diila, m kan basi ate kaasuŋ a jam ba zuwa. 9Ate diipo ŋmana m dan mooli ayen tɛŋ ba sɛ ka yaase naam a zaani, 10ate ka nye biem mi nina po ale an wom mi nɔi ya, m le zimsi ale mi ale jam a poli ayen m nye wamaŋ kaai la.
11<<Dila nyiŋ yɔgyɔgla de weeni Juda nuruma ale baai ale bo Jerusalem ayen, <Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: Nya! Mi a gomsi ka kaasuŋ a magsi ni ale poli zɔga ayen m ta chaab ale fu. Dila ni basi ni biem suitaŋa, waai meena wanyi wanyi a tagri ni suitaŋa ale ni nyeelaŋa.> 12Alege ba le tulisi ayen, <Ku ka kiri. Ti le ta ka tidek zɔga. Ti meena ale va ka tidek tuikpari ale biem popolaŋa.> >> Naawen ale weeni.
13Dila la Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Kpesi nya tɛŋsaŋa meena po: Ka wana ale wom wanni de choa? Wa dii ale bie la ate Izirali demma a nye. 14Lebanon ŋmoruk tanaŋa a nyaliŋ a bɛ pina ŋaai ale churinti la zuwa? Ka nya yɔgsisa ale nyini niŋniŋ la a basi chalika kama? 15Alege mi nuruma a baŋ mi, ba ju ŋan baai nyum ale masa a te bɔgluk tii ale kan ta kiri ya, tii ale basi ate ba a nak naŋsa ba suita po ale dipo suitaŋa po. Ba basi ate ba a cheŋ sui tii ale kaa nya po ale manpala ŋaai ale kan kpa ya. 16Ba tɛŋka ale doa kinla, jabuui ale kasim chim jalaam taam wuu, baai meena ale a taam la ku le cha ba ate ba a girinti zuima. 17Ase viok ale nyini konni po, m le kati ba waaŋ ba dachaasaŋa niŋ. M le sak ba m ŋaaŋka alege daa m nina ba kaasuŋku danni.>>
18Ba weeni ayen, <<Ni jam, ni basi ate ti zɔk a ta chaab ale Jeremaya, diila kaabteerɔba ale diem boro a sak ti, ate yam nyam a kaam ti, ale biisiteerɔba ate ba a mooli Naawen wanni. Dila ni jam ate ti siti wa ale ti noaŋa abe ti kan wom wa le a weeni diila.>>
19Wom mi, Naawen yaa, wom baai ale a ŋma mu la ale a weeni diila. 20Ba pai biem a tuni nalimmoa? Alege ba tu goluk a magsi mi. Teeri ayen mi jam zaani ka fi niŋ a biisi a te ba ayen m tulim fi suipuurumu ba jigi a basi. 21Dila pai ba bisaŋa a te kɔm. Pai ba a te gebika pagrimu. Basi ate ba pooma a kan ta bisa abe ba chim pukɔga. Basi ate ba nidoama ba ko ba, ba nidoa paalukku ba ko ba ale gebik kpaliŋ po. 22Basi ate ba wom kaarik ba yeeŋa po ase fi nin ta nuruba a jam diiri ayen ba koalim ba, diila ba tu ka goluk ayen ba yik mi ale suk batta a magsi mi naŋsaŋa. 23Alege fi seba, Naawen yaa, ba zɔŋŋa meena ayen ba ko mu la. Kan vɔŋ ba biemu a te ba yaase fi duisi ba wabaataŋa fi nina po. Basi ate ba yuk ba yiak fi niŋ, nye ale ba diipo ate fi suinni a puuri la.

Title: JEREMAYA 19
Content:
1Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Cheŋ a ga da yak samɔniŋ mɛɛrɔ jigi. Basi ate nuruma nisɔmma ale kaabteerɔma a va fu 2a cheŋ Ben Yinnom Viaka, ale moata Takabi Nansuiŋku la. Dula jigi mooli wa ŋaai ate mi a weeni fu la, 3a weeni ayen, <Wom Naawen wanni, Juda nalima ale Jerusalem nuruba. Dii ate Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, Izirali Wenni a weeni la: Ni wom, mi ale ta kaasuŋ a jam dela ate waai meena tue ale a wom la ku le cha wa. 4Diila ba baŋ mi kama ale nye dela jigini bɔgluk chaŋsa jigi. Ba ju kaabsa dula a te wena ŋaai ate badek yaase ba koma yaase Juda nalimaŋa a maa zɛ, alege baai ale kan kaasi wari la ziimu a sueri dela jigini. 5Ba sɛ Baal tangbana ayen ba ju ba nidoabilisa bolim po ase tiirita la a te Baal, wa dii ate mi an sak ba yaase m wi di yuei ya yaase di jo m popola po. 6Dila ni seba, daaŋa a cheena, Naawen ale weeni, ate nuruba a kan ŋman wi dela ayen Tofet yaase Ben Yinnom Viaka, alege ka Tɔgrika Viak.
7<< <Dela jigini m le kaasi Juda ale Jerusalem zɔŋŋa. M le te ate ba ko ba dueni ale gebik ba dachaasaŋa niŋ. Baai ale a gisi ba nyuvooŋa la ale ba ko ba, ate ba pai ba nyiŋsaŋa a te ase ŋandiinta la a te wenzuk nuinsaŋa ale tɛŋka zuk duŋsaŋa. 8M le kaasi tɛŋka a basi ate waai a kan yaali ka, baai meena ale a taam la ku le cha ba kaasuŋku nyiŋ. 9M le basi ate ba ŋɔbi ba nidoabilisaŋa ale ba liema, ba le ŋɔbi chaab diipo ate ba dacha sii ale a gisi ba nyuvooŋa la ale gilim ba a lik ba ta ate ku jo ba nyiŋla.>
10<<Yaa mobi samɔniŋka alege ate baai ale va fu la a nya, 11a weeni ba ayen, <Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni diila ale nna: M le ŋɔriŋ tɛŋ kpieŋ de ale tɛŋ num de ase ka mɛɛrɔwa samɔniŋka ale ŋɔriŋ a ka tebika la. Ba le gu kpiema Tofet ate jigi a kan boro. 12Dii ate m za m nye dela la ale nna ale baai ale bo dela la, Naawen ale weeni. M le nye tɛŋ nummu de ase ka Tofet la. 13Jerusalem yeeŋa ale Juda nalimaŋa yeeŋa ale yie ŋaai meena zuk ate ba ju ŋan baai nyum ale masa a te chiŋmarisa ale kpiiri daam ase tiirim a te wen yona, ŋa meena taŋ kama ase Tofet la.> >>
14Jeremaya yaa ŋman cheŋ Tofet, juijui ate Naawen jam tom wa ayen wa mooli la, ate wa zaani Naawen yenni dabiaka po a weeni nuruma meena ayen, 15<<Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, Izirali Wenni ale weeni diila ale nna: <Ni wom, m za m ta ka kaasuŋ meena ate mi a mooli la a jam tɛŋ nummu de ale tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa ale gilim ka la zuk, dii nyiŋla ba ka tuikpari nyam a kan wom mi wieŋa.> >>

Title: JEREMAYA 20
Content:
1Immer nidoabinni Pasur waai ale jam ka kaabteerɔ ale chim kpagi kpienni Naawen yenni po la, ale wom Jeremaya a mooli wieŋa de la, 2wa yaa basi ate ba nak biisiteerɔwa Jeremaya ale su wa chɔrima Benjamin Nansuiŋku Guuku Zuk Naawen yenni jigini. 3Da dii ale pai saŋ la, ate Pasur a yeeri chɔrimaŋa ale basi wa la, Jeremaya yaa weeni ayen, <<Naawen ale te fu yuei diila daa Pasur, alege ka Magor Missabib. 4Dila Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <M le basi ate fi chim nyinyigsa nyɔnɔ a te fidek ale fi doama meena. Ale fidek nina fi le nya ba dachaasaŋa ale ko ba ale gebik a lɔnsi. M le pai Juda meena a te Babilon naawa, waai ale wa ji ba a ta cheŋ Babilon yaase wa ko ba. 5M le pai tɛŋ nummu de jigsika ale ŋan baai meena ka tom nya la ale ka ŋanmaŋsaŋa meena ale Juda nalimaŋa tuilum ŋantaŋa meena a te ba dachaasaŋa. Ba le pai ase ŋanta ate ba koalim la a ta cheŋ Babilon. 6Ale fi, Pasur ale baai meena ale bo fi yenni po la ba le ta ni cheŋ Babilon. Dula ni le kpi ate ba gu ni, nama ale ni doama ate fi mooli ventaŋa a te la.> >>
7Naawen yaa, fi paasi mu, ate mi nya paasika. Fi ta pagrim a gaam mi kama, a nya pagrim mi zuk. Waai meena a nye mi ka siak, ba a la mi kama danni meena. 8Diipo meena mi dan biisi, see m kaari ate ku nyini abe m na ayen, wɔkwɔk ale kaasuŋ. Dila Naawen wanni a ta ka leeta ale ŋmiŋmasim a jam mi jigi danni meena. 9Alege mi weeni ayen, <<Mi kan weeni wa wari ya yaase m wi wa yuei ya,>> wa wanni a bo ka m suinummu po ase bolim la, bolim buui ale lik bo m kobaŋa po. M jiak kama ale di pik taka. Chekki mi an baga. 10Mi a wom waai meena a waasi kama ayen, <<Nyinyigsa ale bo jigi meena. Dila ni te ti weeni wa wie a te pagrɔma.>> Baai ale poom moata mi a chim mi doaba la a limisi mi lueta kama. Da dii dai ba le paasi wa. Ba le weeni ayen, <Ti yaa baga a yik wa kama a tuni.>>
11Alege Naawen a bo le mi kama ase tugurik tɔŋdɔ pagrik la, dila baai ale a namsi mu la ale nak naŋsa a lo ba kan nya pagrimoa. Ba le nye kpeeri abe ba nya chivie, ba valiŋsaŋa ba kan maa baŋ. 12Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, fi waai ale a kpesi a nya wayɔrisima nyama ale seba dii ale bo ba suiniima ale ba popola po, basi ate mi nya ale fi tuni ba a te mu, diila m pai m wanni a te ka fi.
13Leni yiila a te Naawen. Pai pimpauk a te Naawen. Wa a vari baai ale a silim la gaasa nyama nisa po a basi.
14Kikaasa a cheŋ dai dii danni ate ba biak mi la. Dai dii ate mi mawa a biak mi la a kan nya niauŋŋoa. 15Kikaasa a cheŋ waai ale ta wapaalaŋa a jam mi kowa jigi, waai ale basi ate wa sui a peenti, a weeni ayen, <<Ba biak biik a te fu, nidoabili.>> 16Nuru wala abe nye ase tɛŋ sii ate Naawen a yuk yiak ale an sak jiirim la. Wa be wom kaarik saluiku, kpaliŋ kaarik kantueŋka. 17Diila wa an jam ko mi luikku po, ate mi mawa a chim mi boosukwa, wa luikku a lagri kama taam wuu. 18Ka boa ate mi poom maa nyini luikku po a nyini a nya daanika ale suipuurummoa a za ayen m kpeglim daaŋa ale chivie?

Title: JEREMAYA 21
Content:
1Naawen wanni yaa jam Jeremaya jigi diipo ate naab Zedekia a tom Malkija nidoabinni Pasur ale Maaseiya nidoabinni Zefania ale jam ka kaabteerɔ la wa jigi. Ba weeni ayen, 2Kpesi yɔgyɔgla de Naawen a te ti dii nyiŋla Babilon naawa Nebukadnezzar a siti ti kama. Dai dii dai Naawen ale tom wakinkagla a te ti ase dipo la ate wa basi ti.
3Alege Jeremaya a tulisi ba ayen, <<Ni weeni Zedekia, 4Dii ate Naawen, Izirali Wenni a weeni la ale nna: Mi a yaali ayen m cheem a ta ka chaab ale nidek kpaliŋ kɔlimaŋa ale bo ni nisa po ate ni pai a kpaliŋ ale Babilon naawa ale Kaldiya dem baai ale bo parika peelim a gilim ni ta la. Ate m tigsi ba tɛŋka de ponni po. 5Mi dek ale teeri ni pagrisa a kpaliŋ ale ni ale suipuurum ale suidomsik ale suiŋmaara. 6M le nak baai meena ale bo tɛŋka de po la a lɔnsi tɛŋ, nidoaba ale duŋsa meena ate ba kpi ale nyiŋtui baata. 7Kula ŋaaŋnyiŋ, Naawen ale weeni, m le pai Juda naawa Zedekia ale wa kpaŋŋa ale nuruma ale bo tɛŋka de po la baai ate nyiŋtuilaŋa an ko ba la ale gebika ale kɔm la a te Babilon naawa Nebukadnezzar ale ba dachaasaŋa ale a gisi ba nyuvooŋa la. Wa le ko ba ale gebik, wa kan sak ba jiirim ale ŋmanteka ale vɔŋteka.
8A ŋman gum du, weeni nuruma ayen, <Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: Nya, mi a dueni ka nyuvuri suik ale kum suik ni niŋ. 9Waai dek ale a bo tɛŋka de po la ale kpi ale gebik ale kɔm ale nyiŋtuila. Alege waai ale a nyini peelim a siak a te Kaldiya demma ale gilim a lik ni ta la ale vuuk. 10Mi piika nyiŋ ayen m nye tɛŋka de biem alege daa nalimmoa, Naawen ale weeni. M le pai nyo Babilon naawa nisa po ate wa kaasi ka ale bolim.
11Diem a weeni Juda naam yenni ayen, <Ni wom Naawen wanni. 12Deevid yeri yaa, Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Ni nye a magsi saluik meena, ni vari waai ate ba vari wa la namsidɔwa nisa po a basi kan daa di m suipuurumu ale na pusi a dɛ ase bolim la ni le nye biem buui la nyiŋ, bu le dɛ ate waai a kan boro a kpimsi. 13Mi ta ka chaab ale ni, Jerusalem demma, naamu baai ale kali viaka ŋmai la piuŋku zuk peelimmu po la, Naawen ale weeni, nama baai ale a weeni ayen, <<Ka wana ale wa jam ta chaab ale ti? Ka wana le wa jo tama sukka jigini? 14M le namsi a va chaab ale ni nyeelaŋa ale magsi diila, Naawen ale weeni. M le fuk bolimu ni tiisaŋa po ate bu dɛ jaab meena ale gilim ni la.

Title: JEREMAYA 22
Content:
1Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Cheŋ siŋ Juda naawa yenni a mooli wanni de: 2<Wom Naawen wanni, Juda naaba, fi waai ale kali Deevid naam zukpaglika zuk la, fi ale fi kpaŋŋa ale fi nuru baai ale va nansuiŋtaŋa de a jo la. 3Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: Nye dii ale magsi ale yɔrisi la. Tuesi waai ate ba vari wa la namsidɔwa nisa po a basi. Kan nye wakaasuŋ yaase wɔkwɔk ale nichaanɔwa ale kpiŋsa ale pukɔga abe fi kan basi ate baai ale kan kaasi wari ziim a nyini dela. 4Dila fi dan pai sinsaŋŋa de a tom tuima, nalima ŋaai ale kali Deevid naam zukpaglika zuk la ale va naab yeri nansuiŋtaŋa, a dam torokoba ale do wusuma ate ba kpaga ale ba nuruba a bani ba a jo. 5Alege ni dan zuli sinsaŋŋa de, Naawen ale weeni, m pɛ m dek nyiŋ ayen naab yenni de ale chim guura.> >>
6Naawen ale weeni dii a magsi chaab ale Juda naawa yenni la ale nna: <<Juda naawa yenni a nye ase ka Gilead tɛŋka la a te mi, ale a nye ase Lebanon guutaŋa zuk la, alege m le basi ate di chim jigi koruk juijui ate waai a kan boro. 7M le tom kaasirɔba ate ba ta chaab ale fu, nuru meena ale wa kpaliŋ kɔlima, ate ba gebi ni nyunyoŋ maŋ chibsaŋa a yuk si a basi bolim po.
8<<Nuruba ale nyini tɛŋsa yega a va tɛŋ nummu de a taam ale a bek chaab ayen, <Ka boa ale soa ate Naawen a nye tɛŋ kpieŋka de nna?> 9Ate tulisika ale chim ka nna: <Ba le zɛri Naawen ba Wenni nɔiyeŋka ale puusi ale tom te wen yona la nyiŋ.> >>
10Kan kum a te naab waai ale kpi la yaase fi kum a dɔgsi wa kpika nyiŋŋa. Goanti kum tuotuowa a te waai ate ba yik ta cheŋ la, dii nyiŋla wa kan ŋmani diipo yaase wa nya wadek tɛŋka ŋmana.
11Dii ate Naawen a weeni a magsi chaab ale Josia nidoabinni Sallum waai ale tuesi naamu wa kowa jigi ase Juda naab alege a nyini dela a cheŋ. <<Wa kan ŋman ŋmani dela diipo. 12Wa le kpi juijui ate ba yik wa a ta cheŋ la, wa kan ŋman nya tɛŋka de.>>
13<<Ku le bie a te waai ale ka a va wayɔrisima suik a sɛ wa naam yeri la, ale an pai nyemagsika a sɛ wa gbirima la, a basi ate wa tɛŋ dem a tom kinla la, a kan tuni ba tuimaŋa nyiŋla. 14Wa a weeni ayen, <M le sɛ naam yie kpienni a te m dek ale ŋmazuk diina ŋaai ale lagri.> Dila a yaa nye tuokparuk kpienta di po, a pai nyunyoŋ daata a gobi di ale ŋmirisi di ale mɔnuŋ.
15<<Fi dan ta nyunyoŋ daata yegayega dila a nye fu ka naaba? Ni kowa a jam ta ŋandiinta le daamoa? Wa jam nye ka dii ale yɔrisi ale magsi, dila jaab meena a yaa cheŋ nalimnyiini a te wa. 16Wa biisi a vari jajakka ale waai ale a silim la basi, ate dila jaab meena a cheŋ nalimnyiini. Daa mi sebika kiri ale la?>> Naawen ale weeni.
17<<Alege ni nina ale ni suiniima a bo ka venta ŋanta nyaka zuk, ale baai ale kan kaasi wari ziim nyinika ale nuruba namsika ale varuk.>>
18Dila nyiŋ Naawen ale weeni dii a magsi chaab ale Josia nidoabinni Jeyoiakim Juda naawa la ale nna: <<Ba kan kum wa: <Aao, m suokwa! Aao, m tua!> Ba kan kum wa: <Aao, m kpagi ya! Wa nalimmoa!> 19Wa gu ka ale nye ase boniŋ la, ba le dari wa a vuuri a nyini Jerusalem nansuiŋta peelim a yuk basi.>>
20<<Cheŋ a jueli Lebanon a kaari, basi ate ba wom fi lueluku Basan po, kaari a nyini Abarim, diila fi maarɔma meena a ŋɔriŋ kama. 21Mi kaam fu kama fi le jam poli ayen fi nya fidek la, alege fi weeni ayen, <M kan wom!> Fi nyeka ale ka dii a nyiini fi biik po la ale nna, fi an wom m nɔi ya. 22Vioku ale ji fi naapeerisaŋa meena a ta cheŋ, ate fi maarɔma meena ale cheŋ tɛŋ yoŋ. Ate chivie ale yik fu abe fi piinti fidek fi gaasaŋa nyiŋ. 23Nama baai ale bo Lebanon la, baai ale bo nyunyoŋsa daata yie po la, ni za ni a ŋusi kama ase nyiŋdomma a nin jam ni zuk, nyiŋdomma ŋaai ale a nye ase nipok puuk ale a dom la!
24Naawen yaa weeni Naab Jeyoiakim nidoabinni Naab Konia Juda naawa ayen, <<Mi ale sum ka Naawen dii ale vua la, fi dan pai nifelinni dii ate ba pai a ji ŋanta nyiŋla a su mi juga nisa po, m le yeeri fu a basi 25abe m pai fu a te nuru baai ate fi a chali ba yɔgsum, nuru baai ale a yaali ayen ba ko fu. M le pai fu a te Naab Nebukadnezzar Babilon naawa ale wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma. 26M le fɛ fi ale fi mawa ate ni jo tɛŋ yoŋ. Ni le cheŋ tɛŋ kaai ate ba an biak ni waai du, ate ni meena a kpi dula. 27Ni le yaali ayen ni ŋman nya tɛŋka de, alege ni kan ŋman ŋmani.>>
28Nuruwa de ka Konia waai ale a nye ase samɔniŋ ale mobi la, jaab waai ate nuru a kan yaali? Ka boa ate wa ale wa bisaŋa ba yuk a basi tɛŋ kaai ate ba zɛ po? 29Aao tɛŋŋa, tɛŋŋa, wom Naawen wanni! 30Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Ŋmarisi nuruwa de wari ase wa ka biik la, nuru waai ale kan wa nya wadek wa boka po meena, dila wa bisaŋa waai a kan nya wadega, ba waai a kan kali Deevid naam zukpaglika zuwa yaase wa maa nya Juda zuwa.>>

Title: JEREMAYA 23
Content:
1<<Ku le bie a te naapeerik sii ale a kaasi ale a waaŋ mi piisaŋa la.>> Naawen ale weeni. 2Dila nyiŋ dii ate Naawen, Izirali Wenni a weeni naapeerik sii ale a nya m nuruma zuk la. <<Ni le kati mi piisaŋa a waaŋ ale yiak ŋa basi ate ni niŋ a ka ŋa po la nyiŋ, m le pai ninam a basi ni zuk biemu ate ni nye la nyiŋ.>> Naawen ale weeni. 3<<Mi dek ale tigsi m nuru baai ale tali a bo tɛŋsa meena ate ba yiak ate ba cheŋ la a ta ba a ŋman jam ba jigini, juijui ate ba ale biak a piisi la. 4M le lueri naapeerisa ate ba a nya ba zuk, ate ba kan ŋman chali yɔgsummoa yaase ba kpaziim a nak, yaase ba waai a bɛ.>> Naawen ale weeni.
5Naawen a weeni ayen, <<Daaŋa a cheena ate m le lueri naab waai ale ka Deevid ŋaaŋbiik Wayɔrisima Nyɔnɔ. Naab wala ale de wa naamu ale yam abe wa nye dii ale yɔrisi ale magsi la tɛŋka meena. 6Wa dan chim naab, Juda nuruma ale nya varibasika, ate Izirali nuruma a boro ale suiyɔgni. Ba le wi wa ayen ka Naawen Ka Ti Wayɔrisima Nyɔnɔ.
7Naawen a weeni ayen, <<Ku daaŋa a cheena ate nuruba a kan ŋman pɛ mi nyiŋ ase Naawen dii ale vua la ale jam ta Izirali demma a nyini Ejipiti tɛŋka po a nyini. 8Ba le goanti a pɛ ka mi nyiŋ ase Naawen dii ale vua la ale jam ta Izirali demma a nyini wiiluk geŋka tɛŋka ale tɛŋ sinsila meena ate mi kati ba waaŋ ate ba cheŋ si la po a nyini. Ate ba yaa bo badek tɛŋ po.>>
9A magsi chaab ale biisiteerɔma: M suinummu a kaasi kama, m kobaŋa a choa kama. Mi a nye ase ka dabugrik la, a nye ase nuru ate daam baga wa la, Naawen ale wa tuilum wieŋa nyiŋ. 10Tɛŋka a sueri ale ka kaboŋ nyeerisa. Kikaasaŋa nyiŋ ate tɛŋka a ko nna yegayega ate wuuku gɔnni po a kpi. Biisiteerɔma a va ka venta suik ale kan pai ba pagrimu a tom a magsi.
11<<Biisiteerɔ ale kaabteerɔ meena a ka wen ya, mi poom a nya ba gaasaŋa ka m yenni po.>> Naawen ale weeni. 12<<Dila nyiŋ ba suik a za ku a sati kama, m le yiak ba a basi legi po ate dula ba lo. M le ta kaasuŋ a jam ba zuk ba namsika benni.>> Naawen ale weeni.
13<<Samaria biisiteerɔma suŋsuŋ mi nya ka wanni de ate mi kisa: Ba a mooli ka Baal yuei nyiŋ a ta mi nuruma Izirali demma a cheŋ a bɛ. 14Jerusalem biisiteerɔma suŋsuŋ mi nya ka wa dii ale bie: Ba nye ka kaboŋsa ale a velim, ba a te ka baai ale a nye biem la nyiŋbiiri, ate waai a kan basi wa gaasa. Ba meena a nye ase ka Sodom la a te mi, Jerusalem demma a nye ase ka Gomora la.>>
15Dila nyiŋ Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni dii a magsi chaab ale biisiteerɔma la ale nna: <<M le basi ate ba de ŋandiin tuasa abe ba nyu nyabiok dii nyiŋla Jerusalem biisiteerɔma a basi ate ka a ka Naawen nyeela a waaŋ tɛŋka meena.>>
16Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Ni kan wom biisiteerɔma ale mooli dii a te ni la, ba pai ka venta yiila a sueri ni popola. Ba biisi ka gɔdaasima wie a nyini badek popola po, daa Naawen nɔi po wie. 17Ba kasim a weeni baai ale a zɛri mi la kama ayen, <Naawen a weeni ayen ni le ta suiyɔgni.> Ale baai meena ale a va ba tuikpari yaalika la ayen, <Biem a kan jam ni jigi ya.> 18Alege ka ba wana ale zaani Naawen tigsuŋ po a nya yaase wa wom wa wanni? Ka wana ale kpesi wom wa wanni? 19Nya, Naawen vamuniŋka ale na nyini ale wa suipuurumu, va kiliŋ ale vigsi a siŋ gaasa nyama zuk. 20Naawen suipuurumu a kan ŋmani ŋaaŋŋa se wa nin ga nye wa suinummu ale a yaali diila. Daa a cheena ni le miŋ ku kiri a chak. 21Mi an tom biisiteerɔma de alege ba chali cheŋ ale ba biika, mi an biisi ale ba alege ba mooli. 22Alege ba dan zaani ka mi tigsuŋku suŋsuŋ ba ti mooli mi wieŋa kama a te mi nuruma ale tulim ba ba suik baataŋa ale ba tuimbaataŋa po.
23<<Mi ka Wen dii nyiini ale moata alege daa Wen dii ale yalima?>> Naawen ale weeni. 24<<Nuru waai a baga a suk jigi susugi ate mi a kan seba?>> Naawen ale weeni. <<Mi an sueri daa wenŋmazuk ale tɛŋzuk wa?>> Naawen ale weeni.
25<<Mi wom dii ate biisiteerɔma a weeni la kama baai ale a mooli venta mi yuenni nyiŋla. Ba a weeni ayen, <Mi gɔdaasim! Mi gɔdaasim!> 26Kude ale kasim nye beni ka sɛ venta biisiteerɔma de suiniimaŋa po, baai ale a mooli badek nyebeka popolaŋa de la? 27Ba a poli kama ayen gɔdaasimaŋa ate ba weeni a sak chaab la ale basi ate mi nuruma a baŋ mi yuenni, ase ba koma ale baŋ mi yuenni Baal puusika nyiŋla. 28Basi ate biisiteerɔ waai ale ta gɔdaasima la a weeni wa gɔdaasimaŋa, alege ate waai ale ta mi wanni la a biisi di ale wensie. Kinkari a ta ka boan wari a nye ale za biri ya?>> Naawen ale weeni. 29<<Mi wanni a kan nye ase daa bolim la ale a nye ase guri la a nak piuŋ a mobi yisayisa?>> Naawen ale weeni.
30<<Dila nyiŋ mi Naawen ale weeni ayen, mi ta ka chaab ale biisiteerɔ baai ale pai chaab wie a mooli ŋa ase mi wari la.>> 31<<Naawen ale weeni ayen, <<Mm, mi ta ka chaab mɛ ale biisiteerɔ baai ale a biisi badek wie ale a biisi ayen ŋa nyini mi jigi la.>> 32Ni wom mi Naawen ale a weeni diila. <<Mi ta ka chaab ale biisiteerɔ baai ale a weeni ba gɔdaasima ate venta a boro la. Ba a weeni gɔdaasimaŋa de kama a ta nuruba a cheŋ a bɛ ale ba ventaŋa ale kunkuulima. Mi an tom ba mi abe m te ba suik ayen ba cheŋŋi, ate ba bola a ka maarika a te nuruma.>> Mi Naawen ale weeni.
33<<Nuruma de yaase biisiteerɔ yaase kaabteerɔ a dan bek fu ayen, <Naawen wanni ale boa?> Bek ba ayen, <Boan wari ya? M le zɛri fu. Naawen ale weeni.> 34Biisiteerɔ yaase kaabteerɔ yaase waai a dan weeni ayen, <Naawen wari ale nna,> m le namsi nuru wala ale wa yenni demma. 35Dii ate waai meena a kasim a weeni wa doa yaase wa suok la ale nna: <Naawen tulisika ale boa?> yaase <Naawen a biisi ka boan wari ya?> 36Alege ku a fɛ ate ni kan wi <Naawen tontomiŋka wari> ŋmana, dii nyiŋla nuru meena wari a yaa chim ka tomtomiŋ ate dila ni yaa yik Wen vukku, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ti Wenni wanni a labri. 37Ni ale kasim weeni dii a te biisiteerɔ la ale nna: <Naawen tulisika ale boa a te ni?> yaase <Naawen a biisi ka boa?> 38Ni poom a weeni ayen, <Naawen tontomiŋka ale nna: <Ni a weeni wie ayen, <Naawen tontomiŋka ale nna,> alege mi weeni ni ayen ku a fɛ ate ni kan weeni ayen, <Naawen tontomiŋka ale nna.> 39Dila nyiŋ, m le sum baŋ ni wari abe m yiak ni a basi ale tɛŋ kaai ate mi jam pai te ni ale ni koma la. 40M le ta taam wuu chivie a jam ni zuk, taam wuu kanpiin tii ate ni kan baŋ.>>

Title: JEREMAYA 24
Content:
1Babilon naawa Nebukadnezzar a yaa jam ta Jeyoiakim nidoabinni Jekonaya ale jam ka Juda naab la a nyini Jerusalem a cheŋ Babilon ase ligrɔ la, a maa gum Juda niŋdeerɔma ale gobrɔma ale baai ale seba tuima la. Kude ŋaaŋnyiŋ Naawen a yaa jam pai busisa siye ale kinkama a sak mi ate si za Naawen yenni niŋ. 2Busik kanyi a jam ta ka kinkama ŋaai ale nala, ase ŋaai ale kpabi a muni la, m kala a jam ta kinkama ŋaai ale kan nala, an nala a baga a dɛ.
3Naawen yaa bek mi ayen, <<Jeremaya, ka boa ate fi a nya?>> Mi yaa tulisi ayen, <<Kinkama. Kinkama naliŋsaŋa a nala ka yega, alege ŋaai ale kan nala la an bola nala a magsi dɛka.>> 4Naawen wanni yaa ŋman jam mi jigi: 5<<Naawen, Izirali Wenni ale weeni diila ale nna: <Baai ate mi basi ate ba yik ba Juda a ta cheŋ Kaldiya demma tɛŋka la a nye ase ka kinkam naliŋsaŋa la. 6Mi ale kpesi a nya ba kama badek nalim nyiŋ, abe m ta ba a ŋman jam tɛŋka de. M le yik ba ŋmapi m kan te ba lo. M le te ba chiib zaani m kan dari ba a lɔnsi. 7M le te ba suinum buui ate ba seba mu la, ayen ka Mi ale Naawen. Ba le chim mi nuruba, ate mi ale chim ba Wen, diila ba le ŋmani mi jigi ale ba suinum meena.
8<<Naawen a weeni ayen, <Alege Juda naawa Zedekia ale wa nuruma ale a nye ase kinkama ŋaai ale kan nala la, ŋaai ale ŋmasi bie a ka dɛka la, m le nye ale Zedekia ale wa kpaŋŋa ale Jerusalem nuru baai ale vuuk la, ba wari tɛŋka de po yaase ba bo Ejipiti. 9M le basi ate ba kisi ba abe ba a puuri nuruba sue tɛŋzuk de naataŋa meena po, abe nuruba a ŋma ba abe ba chim biik waai meena nɔi po abe ba koosi ba a la abe ba chim kikaasa ase m nin yiak ba a basi. 10M le ta gebik ale kɔm ale nyiŋtuila a jam ba po ate m ga kaasi ba tɛŋ kaai po ate mi a jam pai te ba ale ba koma la.> >>

Title: JEREMAYA 25
Content:
1Bena ŋanaansiwa po ate Jeyoiakim nidoabinni Josia a chim Juda naab la, Naawen wanni yaa jam mi jigi. Piilimka benni ate Nebukadnezzar a chim Babilon naab la ale la. 2Biisiteerɔwa Jeremaya yaa weeni Juda nuruma meena ale baai meena ale bo Jerusalem la ayen, 3Bena pisiye ale ŋata, a zaani bena pi ale ŋatawa po ate Amon nidoabinni Josia a chim Juda naab la a jam paari jinla danni, Naawen a biisi ale mi kama, mi abe an zɛri ni weeni ka, wa ale weeni diila. Alege ni an kpesi a wom ya.
4Naawen a poom tom wa tomteerɔma biisiteerɔma ni jigi kama a tulim tulim, ni an wom ya yaase ni niŋ a boro. 5Ba weeni ayen, <<Ni cheem yɔgyɔgla de, waai meena ni biem suitaŋa po ale ni biem nyeelaŋa po ate ni baga a bo tɛŋ kaai ate Naawen a pai te ni ale ni koma taam wuu la. 6Ni kan va wen yona a tom te ŋa yaase ni puusi ŋa, ni kan nye ate m sui a puuri ale ni nisima ale nye ŋan baai la. Ate m kan te ni tuemoa.>>
7Naawen a weeni ayen, <<Alege ni an wom mi a basi ate m sui a puuri ale ni nisima ale nye ŋan baai la, a ta tuem a jam nidek zuk.>>
8Dila nyiŋ, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La weeni ayen, <<Ni ale kan wom mi wieŋa la nyiŋ, 9M le wi nuru baai meena ale nyini wiiluk geŋka la ale m tomteerɔwa Babilon naawa Nebukadnezzar. M le ta ba jam ate ba ta chaab ale tɛŋka de ale baai ale bo ka po la ale tɛŋ sii meena ale gilim la.>> Naawen ale weeni. <<M le kaasi ba chessi a basi ate ba chim jabuui ate ba kisi la ale ja laam abe ka duak guura taam wuu. 10M le basi ate ba kan ŋman nye suipeentik nuemka abe nipok fiak ale wa chorɔ a kan ŋman de masimmoa. Ba kan ta kpaam a magsi ba zeuŋtaŋa abe ŋanbie boro a num. 11Tɛŋka de meena ale doa koruk kinla nyiŋ, ate tɛŋsaŋa de a tom a te Babilon naawa bena pisiyopɔi.
12<<Alege bena pisiyopɔiwa a dan jam taam, m le namsi Babilon naawa ale wa tɛŋka, Kaldiya demma tɛŋka, ba foolaawa nyiŋ abe m basi ate ka doa koruk taam wuu.>> Naawen ale weeni. 13<<Wa ŋaai meena ate m biisi a ta chaab ale ka la m le ta jam ba zuk, ŋaai meena ale ŋmarisi doa gbaŋka de po ate Jeremaya a mooli a ta chaab ale tɛŋsaŋa meena la. 14Badek ale chim nalim kpiema ale tɛŋsa yega yɔm. M le tuni ba a magsi chaab ale ba nyeelaŋa ale ba nisima tuimaŋa.>>
15Naawen, Izirali Wenni, a weeni mi ayen, <<Daam beerik ale nna a sueri ale mi suipuurumu pai a ta cheŋ tɛŋsaŋa meena ate mi a tom fu la, a basi ate ba nyu ka po. 16Ba dan nyu ka po, ba za ba a ja kama ate ba kan ta popola dii nyiŋla kpaliŋka ate mi a ta cheen ba jigi la.>>
17Mi yaa tuesi beerika Naawen nisa po, a pai a te tɛŋsaŋa meena ate Naawen a tom mi la ate ba nyu ka po. 18Jerusalem ale Juda tɛŋsaŋa meena, ale si nalimaŋa ale kpaŋŋa a nyu ka po a basi ate si kaasi a chim guura ale bie a chim kpazinagsuk ale kikaasa ase jinla la. 19Baai meena ale jam nyu beerika po la ale nna: Ejipiti naawa Faaro, baai ale tom a te wa la, wa kpaŋŋa ale wa nuruma meena, 20ale nichamma meena ale bo dula la. Uz nalimaŋa meena ale Filistia nalimaŋa meena, baai ale soa Askelon ale Gaza ale Ekron ale nuru baai ale tali Asdod la, 21ale Edom ale Moab ale Ammon. 22Taaya nalimaŋa meena ale Saidon ale nalim ŋaai meena ale bo nyakpiemu nɔi kunkɔŋ kinkala la. 23Dedan ale Tema ale Buz ale baai meena ale yalima la. 24Arabia nalimaŋa meena ale nichamma nalimaŋa ale bo gɔnni po la 25ale Zimri nalimaŋa meena ale Iilam ale Miidi 26ale wiiluk geŋka nalimaŋa meena baai ale moata ale baai ale yalima ba a vi chaab ŋaaŋ, tɛŋsaŋa meena ale bo tɛŋka zuk la. Ba meena ŋaaŋnyiŋ Sesak naawa mɛ ale nyu.
27<<Yaa weeni ba ayen, <Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, Izirali Wenni a weeni ayen. Nyu, nyu buk abe fi chiiri, a lo abe fi kan ŋman yiti diipo dii nyiŋla gebik ale cheena ni po.> 28Alege ba dan zɛri an tuesi beerika fi nisa po a nyu ya, weeni ba ayen, <Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni diila ale nna: Ku a fɛ ate ni nyu! 29Nya, Mi a piilim ayen m ta ka kaasuŋ a jam tɛŋ kaai ale ta mi Yuenni la, ni be le cheŋ a kan nya namsika? Ni kan cheŋ a kan nya namsika diila mi a wi ka ayen ka siŋ baai meena ale bo tɛŋzuk la zuk. Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni.>
30<<Yɔgyɔgla mooli wieŋa de a ta chaab ale ba weeni ba ayen, <Naawen ale na wenŋmazuk, wa le na chigim a nyini wa tuilum boka jigini abe wa wuuri nna pagrik pagriga a ta chaab ale wa tɛŋka. Wa le nuem ase baai ale a tabi yɔna la, na a ta chaab ale baai meena ale bo tɛŋka zuk la. 31Nuemka ale kum a chɔgsi a paari tɛŋka kpeglimka jiga, diila Naawen ale ta ŋmiŋmaasa a jam tɛŋsaŋa zuk. Wa le bo nurubiik meena buusa abe wa ko gaasa nyama ale gebik.> >> Naawen ale weeni.
32Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Nya! Kaasuŋ ale teeri a cheŋ tɛŋsaŋa meena, vamuniŋ pagrik ale nyini tɛŋka kpeglimka jiga a yiti.>> 33Dila po baai meena ate Naawen a ko la ale bo jigi meena a nyini tɛŋka kpeglim kinka a ga paari ka choa. Ba kan kum ba yaase ba tigsi ba a gu, alege ba le chim ka yaata a doa tɛŋka.
34Nama naapeerisaŋa, ni a kum abe ni a wooli, ni a bilim tantaŋa po, nama piisaŋa niŋdeerɔma. Diila ni tɔgrika daaŋa a paari kama, ni ale lo a mobi ka yisayisa ase samɔn naliŋ la. 35Naapeerisaŋa a kan ta jigi a chali cheŋŋi, piisaŋa niŋdeerɔma a kan nya jigi a yuli bɛ. 36Wom naapeerisaŋa kaarika, piisaŋa niŋdeerɔma woolika, diila Naawen a kaasi ba wuuku kama. 37Tɛŋ kaai ale ta wuuk la ale duak kinla Naawen suipuurumu nyiŋ. 38Ase gbeŋli la wa le basi wa duaka jigini ate ba tɛŋka a chim koruk namsidɔwa gebika nyiŋ ale Naawen suipuurumu nyiŋ.

Title: JEREMAYA 26
Content:
1Josia nidoabinni Jeyoiakim Juda naawa naamu piilim dɛka vaaŋa po, wanni de yaa nyini Naawen jigi a jam: 2<<Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: Zaani Naawen yenni dabiaka po a biisi te Juda tɛŋsaŋa nuruma meena ale jam ba puusi Naawen yenni po la. Weeni ba dii meena ate mi a weeni fu la, kan gaam wari a basi. 3Dai dii dai ba le wom a basi ba biem suiku. Ate mi yaa basi m kan ta kaasuŋ kuui ate mi a poli ayen m ta jam ba zuk biem buui ate ba nye la nyiŋŋa. 4Weeni ba ayen, <Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: Ni dan kan wom mi a va m sinsaŋŋa, ŋaai ate mi pai te ni la, 5ale an wom mi tomteerɔma biisiteerɔma wieŋa, baai ate mi tom ba ni jigi a tulim la ate ni an poom wom la, 6m yaa le basi ate yenni de a nye ase Siilo la abe tɛŋka de a chim kikaasa jaab tɛŋzuk tɛŋsaŋa suŋsuŋ.> >>
7Kaabteerɔma ale biisiteerɔma ale nuruma meena yaa jam wom Jeremaya ale a biisi wieŋa de Naawen yenni po la. 8Alege Jeremaya ale ga nueri dii meena ate Naawen a weeni ayen wa weeni la, kaabteerɔma ale biisiteerɔma ale nuruma meena a yik wa a weeni ayen, <<Ku a fɛ ate fi kpi. 9Ka boa ale soa ate fi mooli Naawen yuenni nyiŋ ayen yenni de ale nye ase Siilo la ate tɛŋka de ba le je ka basi ate ka doa koruk wa?>> Ate nuruma meena a tigsi a gilim Jeremaya Naawen yenni po.
10Juda kpaŋŋa ale wom wieŋa de la, ba yaa nyini naab yenni a cheŋ Naawen yenni a zaani ba jiŋŋa Naawen yenni Nansuiŋ Paalukku nɔi. 11Kaabteerɔma ale biisiteerɔma yaa weeni kpaŋŋa ale nuruma meena ayen, <<Ba bo wa kum buusa ate wa kpi dii nyiŋla wa mooli a ta chaab ale tɛŋka de kama. Ni wom kama ale nidek tue!>>
12Jeremaya yaa weeni kpaŋŋa meena ale nuruma meena ayen, <<Naawen ale tom mu ayen m mooli a ta chaab ale yenni de ale tɛŋka de dii meena ate ni wom la. 13Yɔgyɔgla de ni tagri ni suitaŋa ale ni nyeelaŋa abe ni wom Naawen ni Wenni nɔi. Naawen yaa le basi wa kan ta kaasuŋ kuui ate wa mooli a ta chaab ale ni la a jam. 14Dan ka mi, mi bo ka ni nisa po, ni nye mu dii ate ni a poli ayen ku nala ale magsi la. 15Ni be seba chak, ku dan poom ka diiya, ni dan ko mi, ni le ta waai ale kan kaasi wari la ziim a jam nidek zuk ale tɛŋka de zuk ale baai meena ale bo ka po la zuk ate ni nye foolaa, diila wensie po Naawen ale tom mi ni jigi ayen m biisi wieŋa de meena ate ni wom.>>
16Ate kpaŋŋa ale nuruma meena yaa weeni kaabteerɔma ale biisiteerɔma ayen, <<Nuruwa de ni kan ko wa. Wa biisi te ti ka Naawen ti Wenni yuei nyiŋ.>>
17Tɛŋka nisɔmma gela yaa nyini zaani niŋ a weeni tigsuŋku meena ayen, 18<<Moreset denɔwa Maika a jam mooli kama Juda naawa Azekaya daaŋa po. Wa jam weeni Juda demma ayen, <Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La a weeni ayen, Ba le kpa Zayon ase laŋ la, Jerusalem ale chim tampoi, Wen yenni guuku ale chim ka guuk ate tiisa a nyini a lik.>
19<<Juda naawa Azekaya yaase waai a jam ko wa? Azekaya an jaa chali Naawen ale a gisi wa ŋmanteka? Naawen be an jam basi ya, ate dila wa an jam ta kaasuŋku ate wa mooli basi ba zuk la a jam ya? Ti boro a nye ti ta ka kaasuŋ kuui ale bie a jam tidek zuk.>>
20Sɛmaiya nidoabinni Yuraya jam ka nuru wa choa a mooli Naawen yuenni nyiŋ. Wa mɛ jam mooli ka wa ŋala dek a basi tɛŋka de zuk ase Jeremaya ale nye diila. 21Naab Jeyoiakim ale wa niŋdeerɔma ale kpaŋŋa ale wom wa wieŋa la, naawa jam a gisi wa ko wa kama. Alege Yuraya a wom ate yɔgsum a ta wa ate wa chali cheŋ Ejipiti. 22Naab Jeyoiakim a diem tom ka Achbor nidoabinni Elnatan ate wa cheŋ Ejipiti ale nidoaba ba chaab. 23Ba ga ta Yuraya a nyini Ejipiti a nyini a ta wa cheŋ naab Jeyoiakim jigi ate wa che wa ale gebik a lɔnsi a pai wa nyiŋka a yuk basi nuru chaalinsaŋa guka jigini.
24Safan nidoabinni Ayikam yaa maari Jeremaya ate ba an pai wa a te nuruma ayen ba ko.

Title: JEREMAYA 27
Content:
1Josia nidoabinni Zedekia Juda naawa naamu piilimka vaaŋa po, wanni de yaa nyini Naawen jigi a jam Jeremaya jigi. 2Naawen ale weeni mi diila ale nna: <<Pai gbana ale daata a nye yeeri niiga diok a pai vi fi ŋinni. 3Pai tomtomiŋ a te baai ale jam Jerusalem Zedekia Juda naawa jigi la ate ba ta ga te Edom ale Moab ale Ammon ale Taaya ale Saidon. 4Pai tomtomiŋ a te ba kpaŋŋa a weeni ayen, <Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, Izirali Wenni a weeni ayen, <<Weeni nna a te ni kpaŋŋa. 5Mi pagrim ale nisa teerika ate mi nye tɛŋka ale ka nuruma ale duŋsaŋa ale bo ka zuk la, ale pai a te waai ate mi a mariŋ la. 6Yɔgyɔgla de m le pai ni tɛŋsaŋa meena a te m tomteerɔwa Babilon naawa Nebukadnezzar, m le basi ate duŋ waarisaŋa a poom siak a te wa. 7Tɛŋsa meena ale tom te wa ale wa nidoabinni ale wa ŋaaŋka ate ku paari diipo ate wadek tɛŋka a lo la. Ate wa tɛŋka yaa tom te tɛŋ pagrisa ale nalim kpiema. 8Alege tɛŋ kaai yaase naam buui a dan kan tom te Babilon naawa Nebukadnezzar yaase ba siak te wa, m le namsi tɛŋ kala ale gebik ale kɔm ale nyiŋtuila, Naawen ale weeni, ate m ga pai wa a kaasi ka. 9Dila ni kan wom ni biisiteerɔma ale ni sampoporisaŋa ale ni nuru baai ale a weeni gɔdaasima kie la ale ni chichirik wiirisaŋa ale ni baanɔma ale a weeni ayen, <Ni kan tom te Babilon naawa la.> 10Ba a mooli ka venta a te ni ate kula ale basi ate ba ta ni a nyini ni tɛŋsaŋa a cheŋ niŋniŋŋa. M le yiak ni basi ate ni kpi. 11Alege tɛŋ kaai a dan siak te Babilon naawa ale tom a te wa m le basi ate ka wari ka dek tɛŋka zuk a kpa ka abe ka nuruma a boro. Mi Naawen ale weeni.>> > >>
12Mi yaa pai tontomiŋka de dek a te Juda naawa Zedekia. Mi weeni ayen, <<Siak a te Babilon naawa a tom te wa ale wa nuruma ate fi boro. 13Ka boa ale soa ate fi ale fi nuruma a kpi ale gebik ale kɔm ale nyiŋtuila dii ate Naawen a nyigsi ayen tɛŋ kaai a nin kan tom a te Babilon naawa? 14Ni kan wom biisiteerɔma wieŋa baai ale a weeni ayen, <Ni kan tom te Babilon naawa la,> diila ba a mooli ka venta. 15<Mi an tom ba,> Naawen ale weeni. <Ba pai ka mi yuenni a mooli venta. Dila nyiŋ, m le yiak ni basi ate ni kpi, nama meena ale biisiteerɔma ale a mooli a te ni la.> >>
16Mi yaa weeni kaabteerɔma ale nuruma de meena ayen, <<Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: Ni kaa wom biisiteerɔ baai ale a weeni ayen, <Ku kan beni ba le ta Naawen yenni po ŋantomtaŋa a nyini Babilon a ŋman jam la.> Ba a mooli ka venta a te ni. 17Ni kan wom ba. Ni tom te Babilon, ate ni boro. Ka boa ale soa ate tɛŋka de a chim guura? 18Ba dan ka biisiteerɔba ale ta Naawen wanni, basi ate ba saalim Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ate tuilum ŋantaŋa ale tali Naawen yenni po la ale Juda naawa yenni po la ale Jerusalem la a kan cheŋ Babilon. 19Dila Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni dii a magsi chaab ale zaŋŋa ale Nyakpiemu ale ŋan baai ale a zaani ale baga a zak la ale ŋantomta ba chaab ale tali tɛŋka de po la, 20ŋan baai ate Babilon naawa Nebukadnezzar an maa pai diipo ate ba ta Jeyoiakim nidoabinni Jekonaya Juda naawa a nyini Jerusalem a cheŋ Babilon ale Juda ale Jerusalem kpaŋŋa la. 21Mm, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, Izirali Wenni ale weeni dii a magsi chaab ale ŋan baai ale tali Naawen yenni po ale Juda naawa yenni po ale Jerusalem po la ale nna: 22<Ba le ta ba a cheŋ Babilon ate ba wari dula a ga paari dai dii dai ate m jam pai la,> Naawen ale weeni. <Ate m yaa ta ba ŋmani ate ba bo dela jigini.> >>

Title: JEREMAYA 28
Content:
1Chiisa sinuwa po ben dila dek, bena ŋanaansiwa po, ate Juda naawa Zedekia a jam diem a de wa naamu la, Azzur nidoabinni Yanania waai ale ka biisiteerɔ a nyini Gibeon la, a weeni mi Naawen yenni po kaabteerɔma ale nuruma meena niŋ ayen, 2<<Dii ate Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La Izirali Wenni a weeni la ale nna: <M le wɛ Babilon niiga diokku. 3Bena ŋaye po m le ta Naawen yenni ŋantomtaŋa ate Babilon naawa Nebukadnezzar yeeri a ta cheŋ Babilon la a ŋman jam dela. 4M le maa ta Jeyoiakim nidoabinni Jekonaya Juda naawa ale baai meena ate ba ta nyini Juda a cheŋ Babilon la a ŋman jam.> Naawen ale weeni. <Dila m le wɛ Babilon naawa niiga diokku.> >>
5Jeremaya yaa tulisi biisiteerɔwa Yanania ale kaabteerɔma ale nuruma meena ale jam za dula la Naawen yenni po. 6Wa weeni ayen, <<Ku be nye dila! Naawen abe nye dila! Naawen abe basi ate wa ŋaai ate fi mooli ayen Naawen yenni ŋantomtaŋa ale baai meena ate ba yik ta cheŋ la ale nyini Babilon jam la abe nye. 7Alege, wom dii ate m ta m weeni ate fu wom abe nuruma meena a wom la: 8A nyini dipo ate biisiteerɔ baai a de fi ale mi niŋ la a jam mooli ka kpaliŋ ale kaasuŋ ale nyiŋtuila a basi tɛŋsa yega ale naam kpienta zuk. 9Alege biisiteerɔ waai ale a mooli suiyɔgni la ba a seba ka wala ase waai ate Naawen a sum tom la ase wa moolika a nin nye.>>
10Ate biisiteerɔwa Yanania yaa yeeri niiga diokku biisiteerɔwa Jeremaya ŋinni po a wɛ ku, 11ale weeni nuruma meena niŋ ayen, <<Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <Babilon naawa Nebukadnezzar niiga diokku ale bo tɛŋsaŋa meena nuruma ŋie po la m le wɛ bena ŋaye po.> >> Biisiteerɔwa Jeremaya yaa cheŋ.
12Biisiteerɔwa Yanania ale wɛ niiga diokku biisiteerɔwa Jeremaya ŋinni po la ku an beni ya, ate Naawen wanni a jam Jeremaya jigi ayen, 13<<Cheŋ a ga weeni Yanania ayen, <Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: Fi wɛ ka daata niiga diok, alege kuta niiga diok ale tagri ku a te fu. 14Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, Izirali Wenni ale weeni diila ale nna: M pai kuta niiga diokku a su tɛŋsaŋa de demma meena ŋie ate ba tom a te Babilon naawa Nebukadnezzar, m le poom te wa pagrim duŋ waarisa zuk.> >>
15Ate biisiteerɔwa Jeremaya yaa weeni biisiteerɔwa Yanania ayen, <<Yanania wom de! Naawen an tom fu alege fi vigsi tɛŋka de ate ka ta sebchakka ale fi ventaŋa. 16Dila nyiŋ Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <M za m yeeri fu kama tɛŋka zuk. Benni de dek fi za fi kpi kama, dii nyiŋla fi mooli ka tuikpari a ta chaab ale Naawen.> >>
17Ben dila dek chiisa siyopɔiwa po biisiteerɔwa Yanania yaa kpi.

Title: JEREMAYA 29
Content:
1Gbaŋka de ate biisiteerɔwa Jeremaya a tom ate ka nyini Jerusalem a cheŋ nisɔm baai ale vuuk tali bo baai ate ba yik ta cheŋ la ale kaabteerɔma ale biisiteerɔma ale nuru mbala meena ate naab Nebukadnezzar a yik ta nyini Jerusalem a cheŋ Babilon la jigi, 2Kude ka naab Jekonaya ale naab mawa ale buusa niŋdeerɔma ale Juda ale Jerusalem niŋdeerɔma ale yɔgdɔma ale gobrɔma ale nyini Jerusalem a cheŋ la ŋaaŋnyiŋ. 3Wa jam pai gbaŋka a nyo ka Safan nidoabinni Elasa ale Yilkia nidoabinni Gemaria ate Juda naawa Zedekia a tom Babilon naawa Nebukadnezzar jigi la nisima po. Ka weeni ayen,
4Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, Izirali Wenni, ale weeni dii a te baai meena ate mi ji a ta nyini Jerusalem a cheŋ Babilon la ale nna: 5<<Ni sɛ yie a kali a kpa kaduksa a de ŋan baai ale a nye la. 6Ni faari nipooba a biak nidoabilisa ale lieba. Ni gisi pooba a te ni nidoabilisaŋa abe ni pai ni liema a yalisi, ate ba mɛ a nya nidoabilisa ale lieba. Ni piisi dula ni kan muuri. 7Ni a juisi ayen tɛŋ kaai ate mi ta ni cheŋ la suiyɔgni a bo ka po abe ka nya ka dek. Ni puusi a te Naawen dila nyiŋ, diila ka dan nya ka dek, nama mɛ ale nya nidek.>> 8Mm, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, Izirali Wenni ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Ni kan te biisiteerɔma ale sampoporisaŋa ale bo ni po la a paasi ni. Ni kan wom gɔdaasima wie ŋaai ate ni a te ba nyiŋbiiri la. 9Ba a mooli ka venta a te ni ale mi yuenni. Mi an tom ba.>> Naawen ale weeni.
10Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <<Bena pisiyopɔi a dan nueri a te Babilon, m le jam ni jigi a ta ni ŋman jam dela ate m pumpuulim maŋka a chim wensie. 11Diila m seba zɔk ŋaai ate m ta a te ni la kama.>> Naawen ale weeni. <<Ka zɔk ŋaai ate ni le ni nya nidek alege daa kaasuŋŋoa, ka zɔk ŋaai ale a te ni yiila ale chum. 12Ate ni yaa le wi mi abe ni jam puusi a te mu, ate m wom ni. 13Ni le gisi mu a nya mu ase ni a nin gisi mu ale ni suinum meena. 14Ni le nya mu, Naawen ale weeni ate m le ta ni a nyini yɔntini po a ŋmani.>> Mi Naawen ale weeni ayen, <<Ni le nya mu ate m le ta ni nyini yɔntini po a jam. M le tigsi ni a ta nyini tɛŋsaŋa meena ale juijui ate m yiak ni basi la.>> Naawen ale weeni. <<Ate m le ta ni jam juijui ate mi ji ni a ta nyini du a cheŋ la.>>
15Dai dii dai ni le weeni ayen, <<Naawen a te ti biisiteerɔba kama Babilon tɛŋka po,>> 16alege dii ate Naawen a biisi a magsi chaab ale naab waai ale kali Deevid naam zukpaglika zuk ale nuru baai meena ale tali tɛŋka de po la, fi tɛŋka demma baai ale kan maa va ni a jo tɛŋ yoŋku la. 17Mm, Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La weeni ayen, <<M le basi ate kpaliŋ ale kɔm ale nyiŋtuila a jam ni zuk abe m basi ate ba nye ase kinkam baata ale bie a ka ŋɔbika la. 18M le vi ba ale gebik ale kɔm ale nyiŋtuila abe m basi ate tɛŋzuk naata meena a kisi ba abe ba chim kikaasa abe ba bie abe ba nye ba a la tɛŋsaŋa meena po ate mi a yiak ba a basi la. 19Diila ba an wom mi wieŋa,>> Naawen ale weeni. <<Wa ŋaai ate mi a tom a te ba a ta va m tomteerɔma biisiteerɔma jigi la. Nama baai ate ba yik ta cheŋ la an poom wom mɛ.>> Naawen ale weeni.
20Dila la, ni wom Naawen wanni, nama baai meena ate ba yik ate mi a basi ate ni nyini Jerusalem a cheŋ Babilon la. 21Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, Izirali Wenni ale weeni dii a magsi chaab ale Kolaiya nidoabinni Ayab ale Maaseiya nidoabinni Zedekia baai ale a mooli venta a te ni ale mi yuenni la ale nna: <<M le pai ba a te Babilon naawa Nebukadnezzar, ate wa ko ba nidek nina po. 22Ba nyiŋ, baai meena ale nyini Juda a bo Babilon la ale ka kikaasaŋa de: <Naawen ale nye ni ase ka Zedekia ale Ayab la, baai ate Babilon naawa a gu ba bolimu po la.> 23Diila ba nye ka wa ŋaai ale bie Izirali tɛŋka po. Ba nye ka kaboŋsa ale ba vaanchaab pooba ale pai mi yuenni a mooli venta, dii ate mi an weeni ba ayen ba nye. Mi seba kama ale chim seerɔ.>> Naawen ale weeni.
24Weeni Neyela denɔwa Sɛmaiya ayen, 25<<Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La, Izirali Wenni a weeni ayen, fi jam tom ka gbaŋsa fidek yuei nyiŋ a te nuruma meena ale bo Jerusalem la ale Maaseiya nidoabinni Zefania kaabteerɔwa ale kaabteerɔ mbala meena. Fi jam weeni Zefania ayen, 26<Naawen a lueri ka fi ase kaabteerɔ la a tagri Jeyoiada ayen fi a nya Naawen yenni zuk. Ku magsi fi nya ku zuk ate yesiŋ kaai meena ale potim a nye ase biisiteerɔ la ba su wa chɔrima abe kutuk gilinni a su wa ŋiri. 27Ka boa ale soa ate fi an nye Anatot denɔwa Jeremaya nna, waai ale a biisi ase biisiteerɔ a te nuruma la. 28Wa te ti tomtomiŋ ka de ka Babilon po. Ku le beni kama. Dila nyiŋ ni sɛ yie a kali abe ni vuk tiisa a de si le a yɔni ŋan baai la.> >>
29Alege kaabteerɔwa Zefania a yaa jam kariŋ gbaŋka a te biisiteerɔwa Jeremaya. 30Naawen wanni yaa jam Jeremaya jigi. 31<<Te tomtomiŋ ka de a paari baai meena ate ba yik ta cheŋ la: <Naawen ale weeni dii a magsi chaab ale Neyela denɔwa Sɛmaiya la ale nna: Sɛmaiya ale mooli te ni alege mi an tom wa a basi ate ni ta sebchakka ale ventaŋa la nyiŋ, 32Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: M le sum namsi Neyela denɔwa Sɛmaiya ale wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa. Wa kan ta waai ate wa tali nuruma de po yaase wa nya wamaŋ sii ate mi ale nye a te mi nuruma la, dii nyiŋla wa mooli ka tuikpari wie a ta chaab ale mi.> >> Naawen ale weeni.

Title: JEREMAYA 30
Content:
1Wa dii ale nyini Naawen jigi a jam Jeremaya jigi la ale nna: 2<<Naawen, Izirali Wenni ale weeni diila ale nna: <Ŋmarisi wie ŋaai meena ate mi weeni fu la a nyo gbaŋ po.> 3Naawen ale weeni. <Daaŋa cheena ate m le ta m nuruma Izirali demma ale Juda demma a nyini ba yɔntini po a jam tɛŋ kaai ate mi pai te ba kokpieŋsaŋa ayen ba ta la.> Naawen ale weeni.>>
4Wie ŋaai ate Naawen a biisi a magsi chaab ale Izirali ale Juda la ale nna: 5<<Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <Yɔgsum kaarisa ate ba wom, ka kpazinagsuk daa suiyɔgni. 6Bek a nya: Nidoa a baga a biak bisa? Ka boa yaa be le soa ate nidoa pagrik meena a pai nisima a ji wa lɔgi ase nipok ale a dom la, ate nimbidiaka meena a peenti? 7Dai dila danni ale bie chekki. Dai a kan nye ase di la. Ku le chim ka daanika dai a te Jekob, alege wa le nyini ka po a nyini.>
8<<Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale weeni ayen, <Dai dila danni m le wɛ niiga daataŋa ba ŋieŋa po, abe m gebi ba chɔrimaŋa, ba kan ŋman chim nicham yɔmma. 9Ba le goanti a tom a te Naawen ba Wenni ale ba naawa Deevid, waai ate mi ale basi ate wa yiti a chim ba naab la.
10<< <Mi dek tomteerɔwa Jekob, kan chali yɔgsummoa, Izirali, kan te ku daani.> Naawen ale weeni. <M le sum vari fu a ta nyini niŋniŋka jigini, fi ŋaaŋbisaŋa a ta nyini ba le yik ba a ta cheŋ juijui la. Jekob ale ŋman ta suiyɔgni ale likka ate waai a kan basi ate wa chali yɔgsummoa. 11M bo ale fu kama m be le vari fu a basi.> Naawen ale weeni. <Mi a dan poom kaasi tɛŋ sii meena ate mi basi ate ni waaŋ si po la chessi, mi kan kaasi ni chessi. M le te ni waalika alege mi a nye ale ka nyemagsika. M kan basi dila ale kan namsi ni.>
12<<Naawen ale weeni diila ale nna: <Fi kɔnika a ka tebika, fi munni a gaam tebika. 13Waai karo a biisi a te fu, tiim ka a tebi fi noruku, tebika a ka a te fu. 14Fi maarɔma meena a baŋ fi wari, ba ka kinla a te fu. Mi nak fu ase ka dachiak ate le wa nye diila ale namsi fu ase nyeka tuem nyɔnɔ ate le wa nye diila, dii nyiŋla fi foolaawa a zuak ka yega ate fi wabaataŋa a piisi. 15Ka boa ate fi a kum fi kɔnika nyiŋŋa, fi dom kaai ale kan ta tebika la? Fi foolaawa ale zuak la ale fi wabaataŋa ale piisi la nyiŋ ate mi nye fu wieŋa de.
16<< <Alege baai meena ale a kaasi fu la m le kaasi ba. Fi dachaasaŋa meena ba le yik ba ta cheŋ tɛŋ yoŋ. Baai ale a koalim fu la ba le koalim ba.
