Ni weeni ayen ti dua ka kinla, ba be pa te ti kama ayen ti ŋɔbi ba. 13Ni ta chaab ale mi ni kunkuulima ale ni biik po ale kan zimsi, ate mi wom. 14Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Tɛŋka meena a dan boro a naŋ, mi ale basi ate ni dua kinla. 15Nama ale jam a naŋ alege ate Izirali yenni nitalimu a jam dua kinla la nyiŋ, mi le nye ni ka dila dek. Ni le dua kinla, Seir Guuku ale Edom meena. Ate ni yaa seba ayen ka mi le Naawen.> >>

Title: EZEKIEL 36
Content:
1<<Saalɔ biiga, mooli a te Izirali guutaŋa a weeni ayen, <Izirali guuta, wom Naawen wanni. 2Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna, Dachiaka daa weeni ni wie ayen, <<Ŋiak ŋanwoŋtaŋa meena ka tama ale soa.>> > 3Dila nyiŋ mooli a weeni ayen, <Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Ba le vi ni ale kaasi kabtaŋa meena ate tɛŋ sinsila a soa ni ate ni yaa chim jabuui ate nuruba biisi a la ale biisi a kaasi la nyiŋ, 4Izirali guuta, wom Nyɔnɔwa Naawen wanni. Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale a biisi a te guuta ale guwoŋtaŋa ale Vooliŋsaŋa ale vaasaŋa ale kab tii ale chim guura a dua kinla ale tɛŋ sii ate ba zɛri si a basi tɛŋ yonsaŋa a vari ni ale nye ni a la, 5Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Mi biisi kama ale nyiŋ zeentika a ta chaab ale tɛŋ yonsaŋa ale Edom meena, diila biem nyeka masim ale naŋka ale bo ba suiniimaŋa po ate ba yaa nye mi tɛŋka kaai ate ba soa ate ba vari ka wumaŋka tɛŋka.> 6Dila nyiŋ mooli a magsi ale Izirali tɛŋka a weeni guutaŋa ale guwoŋtaŋa, ale vooliŋsaŋa ale vaasaŋa: <Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna, Mi a biisi kama ale nyuri suipuurum dii nyiŋla ni nam ale tɛŋsaŋa nye laka kama. 7Dila la Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Mi zak ka nisa wen a pɛ ayen tɛŋ sii ale gilim ni la mɛ ale nam ale nye laka.
8<< <Alege nama, Izirali guutaŋa, ni le tom naŋsa a yɔni yɔna a te mi nuruma Izirali demma, diila ku kan beni ba le jam yeri. 9Mi niŋ a bo ni po kama m le nya ni zuk ale ŋmanteka, ba le kpa ni abe ba bori ni. 10M le basi ate nuruba dii ale boro la a piisi, poom ka Izirali yenni meena tɛŋsaŋa ba le bo si po ate ŋanluemaŋa a ŋman sɛ. 11M le basi ate nidoama ale duŋsa a piisi ni zuk, abe ba a biak a chim ŋanbɔri, M le basi ate nuruba a kali ni zuk ase nyiem wala ate m basi ate ni jigsi a gaam ni nyiem ale ka diila. Ate ni yaa seba ayen ka Mi ale Naawen. 12M le basi ate nuruba, mi nuruma Izirali demma, a cheŋ ni zuk. Ba le soa ni, ate ni chim be nitalim, ni kan ŋman kasi ba bisa taka diipo diipo. 13<< <Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Nuruba a biisi a te ni kama ayen, <<Ni ŋɔbi nidoaba ale a kasi ni tɛŋka ale bisa taka,>> 14dila nyiŋ ni kan ŋman gob nidoaba yaase ni basi ate ni tɛŋka kan ta bisa. Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni. 15Ni kan ŋman wom tɛŋsaŋa nye laka diipo diipo, ni be kan ŋman nam ale nuruma nye laka yaase ba nye ate ni tɛŋka a lo. Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni.> >>
16Naawen wanni yaa ŋman jam mi jigi ayen, 17<<Saalɔ biiga, Izirali demma ale jam bo badek tɛŋka po la ba jam taŋ ka kama ale ba nyeelaŋa. Ba nyeelaŋa a jam a nye ase ka nipok chiik po chiak loka daŋta la mi nina po. 18Mi yaa basi ate mi suipuurumu jam ba zuk dii nyiŋla ba basi ate ka ziim a nyini tɛŋka zuk diila ba taŋ ka kama ale ba bɔgtaŋa. 19Mi yaa waaŋ ba tɛŋsaŋa po, ate ba waaŋ cheŋ tɛŋsaŋa. Mi yaa bo ba buusa a magsi chaab ale ba nyeelaŋa. 20<Juijui meena ate ba cheŋ tɛŋsaŋa po la ba kaasi mi tuilum yuenni kama, diila ba jam biisi ba wie kama ayen, Naawen nuruba ale nna alege ate ba basi wa tɛŋka.> 21Mi niŋ a bo mi tuilum yuenni po kama, dii ate Izirali yenni a kaasi di tɛŋsaŋa po juijui ate ba jam cheŋ.
22<<Dila nyiŋ weeni Izirali yenni ayen, <Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna, Daa nama nyiŋŋa, Izirali yeri ya, ate mi a za ayen m nye wieŋa de, alege ka mi tuilum yuenni ate ni kaasi tɛŋsa po juijui ate ni cheŋ la. 23Mi ale sak mi tuilum yuei kpienni, ate ni kaasi di tɛŋsaŋa po la, yuei dii ate ni kaasi ba suŋsuŋ. Ate tɛŋsaŋa yaa seba ayen, Mi ale Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni, ase m nin va nama nyiŋ a sak m dek weleŋsaŋa ba nina po.
24Mi ale ta ni nyini tɛŋsaŋa po a nyini. M le tigsi ni a ta nyini tɛŋsaŋa meena a ta ni ŋman jam nidek tɛŋka. 25M le pa nya naliŋ a misi ni ate ni nala. M le sugri ni a ta nyini ni daŋtaŋa po ale ni bɔgtaŋa meena po. 26M le te ni suinum paalik abe m pa chi paalik a nyo ni po. M le yeeri suinum pagrika ase tain la abe m te ni suinum baasuŋ. 27M le pa m Chiika a nyo ni po abe m basi ate ni va m ŋmarisika abe ni kpesi a ta m buusaŋa. 28Ni le bo tɛŋ kaai po ate mi a te ni kokpieŋsaŋa la. Ni le chim mi nuruba ate mi ale chim ni Wen. 29M le vari ni ni daŋtaŋa meena po a basi. M le wi ŋandiinta, ŋan bie ate ba jam a basi ate ŋa piisi abe m kan ta kɔm a jam ni zuwa. 30M le basi ate tiisaŋa yɔnaŋa ale laŋsaŋa ŋandiintaŋa a zuak ate ni kan ŋman dɛ chivie tɛŋsaŋa po kɔm nyiŋŋa. 31Ate ni yaa teeri ni biem suitaŋa ale ni gaasa nyeelaŋa, ate ni kisi nidek ni wabaataŋa ale nyeela ŋaai ate mi kisa la nyiŋ. 32Mi a yaali kama ayen ni seba ayen mi a nye kude ka mi yuenni nyiŋ, Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni. Ni chali chivie ni nyeelaŋa nyiŋ, Izirali yeri demma.
33Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Dai dii dai ate mi a sugri ni wabaataŋa la, m le basi ate ni ŋman kali ni tɛŋsaŋa, ate ŋanluemaŋa ni ŋman sɛ. 34Tɛŋ kaai ale dua kinla la ni le kpa ka ate ka kan dua kinla ate baai meena ale va ka po a taam la a nya. 35Ba le weeni ayen, <<Tɛŋka de ale jam dua kinla la a yaa nye ase ka Eden tiisaŋa la, tɛŋ sii ale jam lo a chim guura la, a kaasi a dua kinla la a yaa sɛ ka yie pagrisa ate nuruba a boro. 36Ate tɛŋ sii ale tali gilim ni la ale seba ayen ka mi Naawen ale sɛ ŋan baai ale jam kaasi la ale ŋman bori ŋan baai ale jam dua kinla la. Mi Naawen ale biisi, m be le nye.
37Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Mi le pilim siak Izirali yenni saalimka a nye ku a te ba. M le basi ate ba nuruma a piisi ase piisa la. 38Ba le piisi ase piisa ale magsi tiirita Jerusalem tɛŋka po tiga daa po la. Dila tɛŋ sii ale lo la ale sueri ale nuruba ase piisa. Ate ba yaa seba ayen Mi ale Naawen.

Title: EZEKIEL 37
Content:
1Naawen nisa yaa jam bo mi zuk, ate wa basi ate Naawen Chiika a ta mi nyini zaani viak suŋsuŋ. Ka jam sueri ale ka koba. 2Wa yaa dɛ mi niŋ a ta mi a cheŋ ŋaaŋ ale niŋ ŋa po, ate mi yaa nya koba piisi nna yegayega tɛŋka viaka po, Koba ŋaai ale koi nna chechea. 3Wa yaa bek mi ayen, <<Saalɔ biiga koba ŋade a baga a nya nyuvuri ya? Mi yaa weeni ayen, Nyɔnɔwa Naawen yaa, fi nyiini ale seba.
4Wa yaa weeni mi ayen, mooli a te kobaŋa de a weeni ŋa ayen, koba kosa, wom Naawen wanni. 5Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale a weeni kobaŋa de diila ale nna. M le basi ate vuusum a jo ni ate ni nya nyuvuri. 6M le basi ate jiina a maŋ ni a basi ate nyiŋ lam a lik ni ale nyiŋ gbaŋ. M le pa vuusum a nyo ni po ate ni nya nyuvuri. Ate ni yaa seba ayen Mi Ka Naawen.> >>
7Mi yaa mooli ase wa le weeni mi la. Ase mi ale a mooli la nuemka ale jam boro, choaka nuemka, ate kobaŋa a jam jigi yeŋ, kobi meena a cheŋ di choa jigi. 8Mi nya ale jiina ale nyiŋlam a jam ŋa zuk ate nyiŋ gbaŋ a lik ŋa, alege vuusum a ka ŋa po.
9Wa yaa weeni mi ayen, <<Mooli a te vuusumu, mooli, saalɔ biiga a weeni bu ayen, Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Nyini vaata tinaansiwa jigi a jam, vuusummoa, jam vuusi basi bade ale kpi dua la po, ate ba nya nyuvuri. 10Mi yaa mooli ase wa le weeni mi diila, ate vuusum a jo ba. Ba yaa nya nyuvuri a yiti zaani ba naŋsa zuk tugurik tɔŋdɔba boari.> >>
11Wa yaa weeni mi ayen, <<Saalɔ biiga, kobaŋa de ka Izirali yenni meena. Ba a weeni ayen, Tama kobaŋa a ko kama ate yiila a karo, ba gebi tama a basi kama. 12Dila nyiŋ mooli a weeni ba ayen, Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Mi nuruma, mi a yaali ayen m lagri ni boositaŋa kama a yeeri ni ti po. M le ta ba ŋman jam Izirali tɛŋka. 13Ate nama mi nuruma, ale seba ayen Mi ale Naawen, ase m nin lak ni boositaŋa a ta ni nyini ti po a nyini. 14M le pa m Chiika a nyo ni po ate ni vuuk ate m pa ni a kali nidek tɛŋka po. Ate ni seba ayen Mi Naawen ale biisi, m nye kama. Naawen ale weeni.
15Naawen wanni yaa jam mi jigi ayen, 16Saalɔ biiga, pa diok a ŋmarisi ku nyiŋ ayen, <<Juda ale soa ate Izirali demma a gum du. Yaa ŋman pa diok ku choa, a ŋmarisi ku nyiŋ ayen, Ɛfraim duoku, ate Josefi a soa la, ate Izirali yenni meena a gum wa po. 17Pa ti a tom tom chaab ate ti chim diok yeoŋ ate ti yaa chim kunyi fi nisaŋa po.
18Fi tɛŋka demma a dan bek fu ayen, kude kiri ale boa? 19Weeni ba ayen, Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Mi a yaali ayen m pa ka Josefi duoku ale bo Ɛfraim nisa po la ale Izirali diinaŋa ale gum wa po la, a tom Juda diok, ate ti chim diok yeoŋ, ate ti chim kunyi m nisaŋa po. 20Yik daataŋa ate fi ŋmarisi ti zuk ba nimbie po, 21a weeni ba ayen, Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. M le yeeri Izirali demma tɛŋsaŋa po ate ba cheŋ la. M le tigsi ba jigi meena a ta ba ŋman jam badek tɛŋka. 22M le basi ate ba chim tɛŋ yeŋ tɛŋka zuk, Izirali guutaŋa zuk. Na yeŋ ale wa a nya ba meena zuk ate ba kan ŋman chim tɛŋsa siye yaase ba poori naata buye. 23Ba kan ŋman taŋ badek ale ba bɔgtaŋa ale ba ŋanmɛɛntaŋa yaase ba nye kaasika diila m le vari ba biem po pilim ŋman ka a basi, abe m sugri ba. Ba le chim m nuruba ate mi ale chim ba Wen.
24Mi yɔma Deevid ale chim naab a nya ba zuk, ate ba meena a ta naapeerik yeŋ. Ba le va m buusaŋa abe ba kpesi a ta m ŋmarisika. 25Ba le bo tɛŋ kaai po ate mi a pa te mi yɔma Jekob la, tɛŋ kaai ate ni koma a jam boro la. Ba ale ba bisaŋa ale ba bisaŋa bisa ale bo dula taam wuu, ate Deevid mi yɔmawa a chim ba nabiik taam wuu. 26Mi le nye suiyɔgni nɔiyeŋ ale ba. Ka le chim nɔiyeŋ kaai ale ka boro taam wuu. M le yik ba kali abe m basi ate ba piisi a gum du, abe m pa m yenni a zaani ba suŋsuŋ taam wuu. 27Mi boka jigi ale bo ale ba, m le chim ba Wen, ate ba chim m nuruba. 28Ate tɛŋsaŋa ale seba ayen mi Naawen ale basi ate Izirali welema, ase m yenni a nin bo ba suŋsuŋ taam wuu.

Title: EZEKIEL 38
Content:
1Naawen wanni yaa jam mi jigi ayen, 2<<Saalɔ biiga, pa fi nina tuk Gɔg nyiŋ, ate ka bo Megɔg tɛŋka la, Mesek nabi kpioŋku ale Tubal. Mooli a ta chaab ale wa, 3a weeni ayen, Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna, Mi ta ka chaab ale fu, Gɔg ale Mesek ale Tubal nabi kpioŋku. 4Mi le yik a viriŋ, a pa gɔtisa a yik fi chikpeeŋa a ta fu a nyini ale fi tugurik tɔŋdɔma meena, ale wusumaŋa ale wusum duerisaŋa ale bobi kpaliŋ kɔlimaŋa la, ale nuru boari a ta piema ŋanchɔgsin kpienta ale ŋan fiisa, ba meena a yuk ba gebisaŋa a basi. 5Persia ale Kus ale Put ale bo ale ba, ba meena ta peema ŋanchɔgsinta ale kuta zuk china. 6Gomer mɛ ale wa tugurik tɔŋdɔba, ale Bet Togarma ale nyini niŋ wiiluk geŋ la ale wa tugurik tɔŋdɔba tɛŋ boanni yega ale fu.
7Gomsi, gomsi magsi, fi ale nuru boanni ale tigsi a gilim fu la a nya ba zuk. 8Bena yega a dan taam ba le wi fu ate fi pa kpaliŋ kɔlima. Bena ale cheen chum po la fi le tuesi tɛŋ kaai ale diem nyini kpaliŋ po a nyini, kaai nuruba ale jam tigsi nyini tɛŋsa yega a cheŋ Izirali guutaŋa zuk tii ale jam dua kinla ate ku beni. Ba jam ta ba nyini ka tɛŋsaŋa po a nyini ate yɔgyɔgla de ba meena boro sɔŋsɔŋŋoa, 9Nama ale ni tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale tɛŋsaŋa yekka ale bo ale ni la ale jueli, a duŋ niŋ ase viok la, ni le nye ase ka chiŋmari ale lik tɛŋka la.
10Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Da dila danni popola ale jam ni zuimaŋa po ate ni yaali popoli baata yam. 11Ni le weeni ayen, <<M le tuesi tɛŋ kaai ate ka tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa an sɛ parisa. Mi le siti ka suiyɔgni ale baai ale kaa poli ayen wari ale nye la nyam, baai ale boro alege ka parisa ale nansuiŋta ale kutuk biga. 12M le vari ba abe m zu ba abe m cheem ta chaab ale ŋanluemaŋa ate ba ŋman sɛ la ale nuruma ale tigsi a nyini tɛŋsaŋa po la, a jigsi ale duŋsa ale kɔlima a bo tɛŋka suŋsuŋka la. 13Siiba ale Dedan ale Tarsis geruŋdɔma ale ka tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa meena ale weeni fu ayen, << Fi jam ayen fi vari kama? Fi tigsi nuru boanni ayen fi zu, abe fi ji kpana ale ligmɔniŋka fi ji duŋsa ale kɔlima a ta cheŋ abe fi tuesi ŋan baai fi vari yega la?
14Dila la, saalɔ biiga, mooli a weeni Gɔg ayen, Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Da dila danni, mi nuruma Izirali a dan boro ate wari kan daani ba, fi kan miŋi? 15Fi le nyini fi jigini niŋniŋ wiiluk geŋ a jam, fi ale tɛŋsa yegayega ale va fu, ba meena a do wusuma, nuru boari, tugurik tɔŋdɔba boari. 16Ni le cheŋ a duŋ mi nuruma Izirali nyiŋ a ta chaab ale ba ase chiŋmari ale lik tɛŋka la. Daa a cheena, Gɔg, m le ta fi jam ate fi ta chaab ale mi tɛŋka, ate tɛŋsaŋa a seba mu ase m nin va fi nyiŋ a sak m dek tuilummu ba nimbie po.
17Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Daa fi ate mi va m yɔmawa Izirali biisiteerɔma a biisi fi wie dipo daaŋa la. Dila po ba mooli kama ate ku paari bena ayen mi ale ta fu jam ta chaab ale ba. 18Dii ale di nye da dila danni la ale nna. Gɔg a dan siti Izirali tɛŋka, mi sui ale yiti ale wa, Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni. 19Mi nyiŋka ale a zeenti ate m suinni a dɛ la mi weeni kama ayen dila po tɛŋ choaka yegayega ale bo Izirali tɛŋka po. 20Nyakpiemu jumaŋa, ale wenzuk nuinsaŋa, ale duŋsaŋa ale bo tɛŋka po la, ale jaab meena ale cheŋ tɛŋka zuk la, ale nuruma ale bo tɛŋka zuk la, mi dan jam ba nyiŋsa ale gɔk. Guutaŋa ale tulim a kpib ate pinaŋa a kabri ate parik meena a lo tɛŋ. 21Mi le wi gebik ate ka jam ta chaab ale Gɔg mi guutaŋa meena zuk. Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni. Nidoa meena gebik ale ta ka chaab ale wa suok. 22M le ta buusa jam wa zuk ale nyiŋtuila ale ziim nyinika. Mi le basi ate ŋmoruk pagrik a siŋ, ale ŋmoruk tana ale tintain tuila a siŋ wa zuk ale wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale tɛŋ sii meena ale bo ale wa la. 23Dila nyiŋ m le sak m zuaka ale m weleŋsaŋa, abe m nye m dek ate ba seba mu tɛŋsa yega nimbie po. Ate ba yaa seba ayen Mi ale Naawen.

Title: EZEKIEL 39
Content:
1Saalɔ biiga, mooli a ta chaab ale Gɔg abe fi weeni ayen, Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Mi ta ka chaab ale fu, Gɔg ale Mesek ale Tubal nabi kpioŋku. 2M le yik fu viriŋ abe m vuuri fu ta cheŋ. M le ta fu nyini wiiluk geŋka niŋniŋ a ta fu cheŋ ate fi ta chaab ale Izirali guutaŋa. 3M le che fi tommu ale bo fi gala nisaŋa po la abe m basi ate fi peemaŋa nyini fi juga nisaŋa po a lo. 4Izirali guutaŋa zuk fi ale fi tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale tɛŋ sii ale bo ale fu la ale lo ti zuk. M le pa ni ase ŋandiinta la a te nuinsa ale gɔi duŋsa. 5Ni le lo dua peelim jassi, diila ka mi ale biisi, Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni. 6M le te bolim jam Megɔg zuk ale baai ale bo nyiamu nɔi ate wari kan daani ba la, ate ba seba ayen Mi ale Naawen.
7M le basi ate ba seba m tuilum yuenni m nuruma Izirali demma suŋsuŋ. M kan ŋman siak ate m tuilum yuenni kaasi, ate tɛŋsaŋa a seba ayen mi Naawen ale Weleŋsa nyɔnɔwa Izirali po. 8Ku cheena. Ku be le sum nye. Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni. Dai dii dai ate m biisi la ale nna.
9Ate baai ale bo Izirali tɛŋsaŋa po la ale nyini a pa kpaliŋ kɔlimaŋa ase bolim daata la a ju ba, peema ŋanchɔgsin fiisa ale ŋan kpienta, ale tima ale peema, ale kpaliŋ dua ale gbatta. Ba le pa ba a chim bolim daata bena ŋayopɔi meena. 10Ba kan ŋman yaali ayen ba tigsi daata laŋsa po yaase ba che ti gɔi po, diila ba le pai kpaliŋ kɔlimaŋa a chim bolim daata la. Ate ba yaa vari baai ale vari ba la abe ba zu baai ale zu ba la. Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni.
11Da dila danni mi le te Gɔg guka jigi Izirali po, viaka po ate baai a nyiem va du a cheŋ kori geŋ nyakpiemu geŋsaŋa la. Ku le kasi nyeendɔba suik, dii nyiŋla Gɔg ale wa nuruma ba le gu ba ka dula. Ba le wi dula jigini ayen Yamon Gɔg Viak.
12Izirali yenni demma ale kasim a gu ba kama ate ku paari chiisa siyopɔi ate tɛŋka vaamu a nyini. 13Tɛŋka nuruma meena ale gu ba, ate da dii dai mi a nya zula la ale chim ba teerika dai. Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi.
14Ba le pa nuruba ate ba a sugri tɛŋka daa meena, baai ale a gum ba po la ale baai ale ba a gu baai ale tali dua tɛŋka la. Chiisa siyopɔiwa nuerika ba le piilim ba gisika. 15Ba le a cheŋ tɛŋka po la, ba wanyi a dan nya nurubiik kobi, wa le pa jaab a nye daana di tɛŋ ate baai ale a tu vieŋa la a gu Yamon Gɔg Viaka po. 16Tɛŋ mɛ ate ba a wi ayen Yamona. Ka le bo du. Ate dila nyiŋ ba sugri tɛŋka.
17Saalɔ biiga, Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Wi nuim buuri meena ale gɔi duŋsaŋa meena. Si tigsi a jam jigi yeŋ a gilim magsi kaabka ate mi gomsi a magsi ni la, kaabi kpioŋ Izirali guutaŋa zuk. Dula ni le ŋɔbi lanta abe ni nyu ziim. 18Ni le ŋɔbi nuru kpienta lanta abe ni nyu tɛŋka nabisa ziim ase ba ka padaasa ale pabisa ale bua ale lalisa la. Ŋa meena duŋ biitita a nyini Basan. 19Kaabka jigini mi gomsi a magsi ni kama. Ni le ŋɔbi kpaam a ga chak gaam taam abe ni nyu ziim a ga buk. 20Jazaanimu jigini ni ŋɔbi wusuma ale ŋa duerɔba, ale nuru kpienta ale tugurik tɔŋdɔba tɔgatɔga. Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni.
21M le sak m zulaŋa tɛŋsaŋa po, ate tɛŋsaŋa meena a nya ninam buui ate mi a te ba la ale nisa ate mi a vi ba zuk la. 22A zaani da dila danni a cheŋ Izirali yenni ale seba ayen Mi ale Naawen ba Wen. 23Ate tɛŋsaŋa a seba ayen Izirali a ga bo tɛŋ yoŋ ka ba wabaataŋa nyiŋ, dii nyiŋla ba jam ka siaka ale mi. Dila mi yaa cheem m nina a basi nakpiak ale pa ba a te ba dachaasaŋa ate ba ko ba meena ale gebik. 24Mi nye le ba kama a magsi chaab ale ba daŋtaŋa ale nye kaasika, ate mi yaa cheem m nina a basi nakpiak,
25Dila la Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. M le ta Jekob nyini wa yik taka jigini a jam abe m ta jiirim ale Izirali demma meena, abe m mariŋka a bo m tuilum yuenni po. 26Ba le baŋ ba chivieŋa ale ba le kan pa siaka a sak mi la ase ba yaa nin boro ate wari kan daani ba, ba tɛŋka po ate waai a kan nye ate ba kpaziim a nak. 27M dan ta ba ŋman nyini tɛŋsaŋa po a jam ale tigsi ba a ta nyini ba dachaasaŋa tɛŋsaŋa a jam, m le va ba nyiŋ sak ayen m dek ta tuilum kama tɛŋsa yega nimbie po. 28Ba yaa le seba ayen Mi ale Naawen ba Wenni. M ta ba kama a cheŋ tɛŋ yonsa ate ba boro, m le tigsi ba a ta cheŋ badek tɛŋka. M kan tali waai a basi ŋaaŋ ŋa. 29Mi kan ŋman cheem m nina a basi nakpiak abe m ge ba, M le basi ate m chiika a jam Izirali yenni zuk. Mi Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni.

Title: EZEKIEL 40
Content:
1Ba le yik tama a ta cheŋ la bena pisiye ale ŋanuwa po, benni piilim ka po, chiika daa pi dai, tɛŋka ale jam lo la ŋaaŋnyiŋ bena pi ale ŋanaansiwa po dai dila danni dek Naawen nisa yaa jam bo mi zuk ate wa ta mi cheŋ dula. 2Naawen wie gɔdaasima po wa yaa ta mi cheŋ Izirali tɛŋka a pa mi zaani gu woŋ zuk. Guuku yeseok geŋka yie ale a nye nna ase tɛŋ kpieŋ la. 3Wa ta mi a cheŋ dula, ate mi nya nuru ate wa a nye nna ase kutuk mɔnuŋ la. Wa za ka nansuiŋku nɔi ale garuk miik naluŋ ale magsika diok wa nisa po. 4Nuruwa yaa weeni mi ayen, <<Saalɔ biiga, nya ale fi ninaŋa abe fi wom ale fi tueŋa abe fi kpesi a pa fi popola basi dii meena ate mi a sak fu la, diila dila nyiŋ ate m ta fu a jam dela. Weeni Izirali yenni dii meena ate fi nya la.
5Mi nya parik ale ka gilim Naawen Yenni jigini meena. Magsika duoku ale jam bo nuruwa nisa po la woglimmu jam anamagib pi ale naaniŋ. Wa magsi parika ate ka biglimu a soa se ka duoku meena la ate ka woglimmu mɛ a nye ase duoku meena la.
6Wa yaa ŋman cheŋ nansuiŋku ale tuk konni geŋka la. Wa jueli ku tiilaŋa a magsi nansuiŋku tɛŋka ate ku limisa ase diokku meena la. 7Diin fisaŋa ate limisidɔma a boro la woglimmu jam ka diokku meena woglimmu, ŋa labsimu a nye ase diokku meena la. Parik sii ale jam yik diin fiisaŋa la biglimu jam ka anamagib pi. Ate nansuiŋku tɛŋka ale pa a saŋ vataamka vuuku ale tuk Naawen Yenni la a limisa ase ka diokku meena la.
8Ate wa yaa magsi nansuiŋka vataamka vuuku. 9Ku jam limisa ase ka anamagib pi ale naaniŋ la ate ku nakpaasaŋa daataŋa bigla ase anamagib bunaansi. Nansuiŋku vataamka vuuku jam tuk ka Naawen Yenni.
10Nansuiŋ kuui ale tuk kori geŋ ka la jam ta ka diin fiisa ŋata kauk meena ate ŋantawa magsika a chim bunyi. Diin fiisaŋa parisaŋa ale tuk chaab la, ale yik chaab la magsika jam ka bunyi. 11Wa yaa magsi va jo ka jigini a ta cheŋ nansuiŋku labsimu ate ku chim anamagib pisita ate woglimmu a chim anamagib pisita ale neok. 12Parik ale jam bo dɔk fiik meena niŋ, ka jam wɔŋŋa ase ka anamagib buta la. Dii fiisaŋa parisa sinaansiwa meena jam ka anamagib pi ale naaniŋ. 13Ate wa magsi nansuiŋku a zaani dɔk fiika parika kanyi a ta ga paari m kala, ate woglimmu a chim anamagib pisiyopɔi ale bunu a zaani ŋmazukku lakka a ga paari m kala. 14Wa magsi parisaŋa ale ji chaab la a gilim nansuiŋku ponni po ate ku chim anamagib kook ale pinaanuŋ. Magsika a paari vataamka vuuku ale a tuk dabiaka la kama. 15Nansuiŋku va jo ka a ga paari ku diin fiisaŋa woglimmu jam ka anamagib kook ale pisinu. 16Diin fiisaŋa ale parik sii ale ji chaab nansuiŋku ponni po a jam bo ka parik gelisa ŋmai ate parik a yaa boro a gilim ase dɔk fiika la, paaŋa meena ale gilim la a tuk ka chaab ponni po. Parisaŋa ale ji chaab ale tuk chaab la ba jam ŋmirisi ale ka kpinkpatta tiisa.
17Ate wa yaa ta mi a jam peelim dabiaka po. Dula mi yaa nya diina ale piisika a gilim dabiaka meena. Diina pisita ale gani piisika zuk. 18Ku jam yik ka nansuiŋ ku kabtaŋa meena ale labsa ase ŋa le woŋŋa diila, kude jam ka tɛŋka piisika le la. 19Ate wa yaa magsi nansuiŋku tɛŋka a ga paari ponni po dabiaka peelimmu ate woglimmu kori geŋka a chim anamagib kobsita ate wiiluk geŋka mɛ a chim dila.
20Ate wa magsi nansuiŋku ale tuk wiiluk geŋka a jo peelim dabiaka po la woglimmu ale labsimu. 21Ku diin fiisaŋa ŋata ale bo kauk meena la, ŋa parisaŋa ale ji chaab ale ŋa vataamka vuutaŋa magsika ka bunyi ase piilimka nansuiŋku la. Ku woglimmu jam ka anamagib kook ale pisinu, ku labsimu anamagib pisiyopɔi ale bunu. 22Ku lakka, ku vataamka vuutaŋa ale kpinkpattaŋa tiisaŋa ŋmirisika magsika ka bunyi ase nansuiŋku ŋan baai ale tuk konni la. Laari tabika buyopɔi ale a jueli kauk kula a tuk ku. 23Nansuiŋ ale jam bo wiiluk geŋka a jo ponni dabiaka po ase ku le bo kori geŋka diila. Wa magsi nansuiŋ kunyi a ta cheŋ kuui ale a tuk la, ate ku magsika a chim anamagib kobsita.
24Ate wa dɛ mi niŋ a ta mi cheŋ yeseok geŋka ate mi nya nansuiŋ a tuk yeseoku. Wa magsi nakpiaka daataŋa ale vataamka vuuku, ate ŋa magsika a chim bunyi ase m ŋala la. 25Nansuiŋku ale ku diin fiisaŋa lagrika a migla kama a gilim, ase ŋan bala lakka la. Ku woglimmu jam ka anamagib kook ale pisinu ate ku labsimu a chim anamagib pisiyopɔi ale bunu. 26Laari tabika buyopɔi ale a jueli kauk kula a tuk ku. Ku ŋmirisi ale kpinkpatta tiisa parik sii ale ji chaab ale tu chaab la nyiŋ. 27Ponni po dabiaka a ta ka nansuiŋ ate ku tuk yeseoku. Ate wa magsi tuok de a ga paari peelim nansuiŋ yeseok geŋka ate ku chim anamagib kobsita.
28Ate wa yaa ta mi va yeseok geŋka nansuiŋku a jo ponni dabiaka po. Ku magsika ka bunyi ale m ŋala. 29Ku diin fiisaŋa ale ku parik sii ale ji chaab la ale vataamka vuuku magsika ka bunyi ale ŋala. Nansuiŋku ale ku vataamka vuuku a lagri kama a gilim. Ku woglimmu jam ka anamagib kook ale pisinu ate ku labsimu a chim anamagib pisiyopɔi ale bunu. 30Nansuiŋtaŋa vataamka vuutaŋa ale gilim ponni po dabiaka la labsimu jam ka anamagib pisiyopɔi ale bunu ate ka le limsa diila a chim anamagib pi ale bunu. 31Ku vataamka vuuku a tuk ka peelim dabiaka, nakpiaka daataŋa kpinkpatta ale ba ŋmirisi. Laari tabika naaniŋ ale a jueli a paari ku.
32Ate wa ta mi va kori geŋka a jo ponni dabiaka po, a magsi nansuiŋku, ate ku magsika a chim bunyi ale m ŋala. 33Ku diin fiisaŋa ale ku parik sii ale a ji chaab la ale ku vataamka vuuku magsika ka bunyi ale m ŋala. Nansuiŋku ale ku vataamka vuuku a lagri kama a gilim. Ku woglimmu jam ka anamagib kook ale pisinu ate ku labsimu a chim anamagib pisiyopɔi ale bunu. 34Ku vataamka vuutaŋa a tuk ka peelim dabiaka, kpinkpatta ale ba pa ŋmirisi nakpiaka daataŋa kauk meena. Laari tabika naaniŋ ale a jueli a paari ku.
35Ate wa ta mi a jam wiiluk geŋka nansuiŋku a magsi ku. Ku magsika jam ka bunyi ale m ŋala, 36ale ku diin fiisaŋa ale ku parisaŋa ale ji chaab la ale ku vataamka vuuku, ale lagri a gilim. Ku woglimmu jam ka anamagib pisinu ate labsimu a chim anamagib pisiye ale bunu. 37Ku vataamka vuuku a tuk ka peelim dabiaka, kpinkpatta ate ba pa ŋmirisi nakpiaka daataŋa kauk meena ate laarika naaniŋ a paari ku jigini.
38Dɔk ale ku nansuiŋ ale maŋ vataamka vuuku ponni po nansuiŋ meena, juijui ate juka tiiritaŋa ba a sugri la. 39Nansuiŋku dɔk fiika po ŋanzaanita tiye ale za kauk meena. Tila zuk ate juka tiiritaŋa ale biem tiiritaŋa ale nyemagsika tiiritaŋa ba a tɔgri. 40Nansuiŋku dɔk fiika peelim parika kiri, a moata tiilaŋa ale tabi va wiiluk geŋka nansuiŋku a jo la, ŋanzaanita tiye ale za, kauk kunkula mɛ ŋanzaanita tiye ale za. 41Dula ŋanzaanita tinaansi ale za nansuiŋku kauk yeoŋ ate tinaansi mɛ a za kauk kunkula jazaanim meena jam ka naaniŋ ate ba a tɔgri kaabka ŋantaŋa ti zuk. 42Tintana ate ba nye ŋa a magsi juka tiirita, dinyi meena woglim anamagib bunaansi ale geli, labsimu anamagib bunaansi ale geli, juelika anamagib buta. Tanaŋa zuk ba pa ka ŋan baai ate ba pa a tɔgri juka tiiritaŋa la ale kaabka tiirin yonta la a dueni du. 43Gɔtik maga, kunyi meena woŋŋa ase nitali labsim la, ate ba pa yik siaka a gilim. Ŋanzaanitaŋa jam magsi ka tiiritaŋa lantaŋa.
44Ponni po nansuiŋ ku peelimmu ale bo ponni po dabiaka po la, ka diina ŋaye, kunyi a bo wiiluk geŋka nansuiŋku, ku choa a bo yeseok geŋka a tuk wiiluk. 45Wa weeni mi ayen, <<Dɔk kuui ale a tuk yeseoku la ka kaabteerɔma ale soa, baai ale a nya Wen yenni zuk la. 46Kuui ale tuk wiilukku la ka kaabteerɔ baai ale a nya kaabka kuŋkuŋku zuk la ale soa. Bade ale Zadok nidoabilisaŋa, baai nyiini ale Livaiba ate ba le baga a forisi moata Naawen a tom wa niŋ.>>
47Ate wa yaa magsi dabiaka. Ka kabtaŋa meena a soa ase ka chaab la. Ka woglimmu anamagib kobsita, ka labsimu anamagib kobsita. Ate kaab ka kuŋkuŋku a bo Wen Yenni niŋ.
48Wa ta mi jam Wen yenni vataamka vuuku a magsi vuuku nakpiaka daataŋa. Ku jam ka anamagib pi ale bunu kabtaŋa meena. Va joka jigini labsimu jam ka anamagib pisinaansi ale buye ate ku parik sii ale ji chaab la labsimu a chim anamagib neok kabtaŋa meena. 49Vataamka vuuku labsimu jam ka anamagib pisiyuebi, ate niŋka a ta cheŋ ŋaaŋka a chim anamagib pisita ale buyuebi. Ku jaa tabi ka tiila a jueli, ate zaŋŋa a bo nakpaasaŋa ganaŋa.

Title: EZEKIEL 41
Content:
1Ate nuruwa a ta mi jam dɔk wɔglukku po a magsi nakpiaka daataŋa ate labsimu a chim anamagib pi ale naaniŋ kabtaŋa meena. 2Va joka jigini labsimu jam ka anamagib pisita, ate parik sii ale a ji chaab la labsimu a chim anamagib pi ale bunu kabtaŋa meena. Wa magsi dɔk wɔglukku mɛ. Ku jam ka anamagib kook ale pisiye woglim ale anamagib pisiyuebi labsim.
3Wa yaa jo dɔk wɔglukku ponni po a magsi nansuiŋku nakpiaka daataŋa ate kunyi meena labsimu a chim anamagib buyuebi. Nansuiŋku labsimu jam ka anamagib pi ale naaniŋ, ate parisaŋa ale ji chaab la kauk meena labsimu a chim anamagib pisiye ale bunyi. 4Ate wa magsi dɔk wɔglukku ponni po ate woglimmu a chim anamagib pisiyuebi ate ku labsimu a chim anamagib pisiyuebi a ga paari peelim dɔk wɔglukku. Wa weeni mi ayen, <<Jigi Dii Ale Ŋmasi Ta Tuilum La ale nna.>>
5Wa yaa magsi Naawen Yenni parika. Ka biglimu jam ka anamagib pi ale naaniŋ, ate nakpiak dɔk meena ale gilim Naawen yenni la labsimu a chim anamagib pi ale buye. 6Nakpiak diinaŋa jam ka buta, bunyi a bo m ku zuk, diina pisita ale bo bunyi po. Naawen yenni parika ba jam nak ka ŋanta a gilim ka ayen ŋa a chɔgsi nakpiaka diinaŋa, ate ŋan baai ale a chɔgsi la kan su Naawen yenni siaka po. 7Nakpiaka diinaŋa ale gilim Naawen yenni la a jam labsa kama ase ŋa le tom chaab beŋ, beŋ la. Naawen yenni ale jam se diila jam ka beŋ, beŋ a jueli. Ase fi le a jueli diila diinaŋa mɛ lak kama a gum du. Va jueli ka jigi ale zaani tɛŋka a va suŋsuŋka a ga paari ŋmazukku.
8Mi nya ale Naawen Yenni kinni a jueli kama a gilim, ase nyubi la a ta nakpiaka diinaŋa. Ku jam a nye ase ka magsika diokku la, anamagib pi ale naaniŋ woglim. 9Nakpiaka diinaŋa peelim siaka biglimu jam ka anamagib pi ale bunu. Kauk kuui ale lak a bo Naawen Yenni nakpiaka diinaŋa, 10ale kaabteerɔma diinaŋa suŋsuŋ la labsimu jam ka anamagib pisiyuebi a gilim Naawen Yenni. 11Nansuiŋta ale jam boro a zaani peelim a jo nakpiaka diinaŋa po, kunyi a bo wiiluk geŋ m kula bo yeseok geŋ, ate kinni ale tom peelimmu la labsimu a chim anamagib pi ale bunu a gilim meena.
12Yenni ale a tuk Naawen Yenni dabiaka la yeri niŋ geŋ labsimu jam ka anamagib kobsiye ale pi. Yenni siaka biglimu jam ka anamagib pi ale bunu a gilim meena, ate ku woglimmu a chim anamagib kobsiye ale pisiyopɔi.
13Ate wa yaa magsi Naawen Yenni. Di woglimmu jam ka anamagib kobsita ate dabiaka ale yenni ale di parisaŋa mɛ woglimmu a chim anamagib kobsita. 14Naawen Yenni dabiaka ale bo kori geŋ la, a gum yenni niŋka labsimu jam ka anamagib kobsita.
15Wa yaa magsi yenni ale a tuk dabiaka la, Yenni ŋaaŋka, ale di peelim chelimu vuuku ate jigi meena woglimmu a chim anamagib kobsita. Peelimmu dɔk wɔglukku ale vataamka vuuku ale a tuk dabiaka la, 16ale tuataŋa tɛŋka, ale tuokparuk migliksaŋa, ale cheŋ taamka jigini ale gilim ŋatawa la, jaab meena ale ŋman gaam di a gum tuataŋa tɛŋsaŋa a lik ale ka daata. Tɛŋka ale, siaka a ta jueli paari tuokpattaŋa, ale tuokpattaŋa a jam lik kama ale daata. 17Panni ale bo nansuiŋku peelimmu a tuak ponni po puusaŋa jigini ale saasaŋa nyiŋ paaŋa meena a ta gilim peelimmu puusika jigini la 18ba nye ka ŋanvuta ale kpinkpatta a basi saasaŋa nyiŋ. Kpinkpatta ale ŋanvuta ale pa a saŋ chaab. Javuk meena a ta nimbidaasa siye: 19nurubiik nimbidiak ale tuk kpinkparuk kaukku kunyi ate gbeŋli nimbidiak a tuk kpinkparuk kauk kunkula. Ba nye kama a gilim Naawen Yenni meena. 20A zaani dɔkku tɛŋka a ga paari juijui ale bo nansuiŋku ŋmazukku la ba nye ka ŋanvuta ale kpinkpatta peelim dɔk wɔglukku siaka nyiŋ.
21Dɔk wɔglukku po a jam ta ka tuok daata ate ti woglimmu a gaam labsimu, ate kuui ale bo Wen dɔkku niŋ la mɛ dila. 22Daata kuŋkuŋ ale jam boro, ku juelika anamagib neok, ku ganaŋa bunaansiwa anamagib buyuebi. Ku gugottaŋa ale ku tɛŋka ale ku ganaŋa jam ka daata. Nuruwa a weeni mi ayen, <<Jazaanimu nna Naawen niŋ.>> 23Dɔk wɔglukku ale Wen dɔkku jam ta ka tuok maga. 24Nansuiŋ yeoŋ a ta ka tuata tiye, nansuiŋ yeoŋ tuata tiye ale kpi maŋ. 25Dɔk wɔglukku tuataŋa nyiŋ ba nye ka ŋanvuta ale kpinkpatta a basi du ase ba le nye basi saasaŋa nyiŋ diila ate diok a bari yiga vataamka vuuku niŋ. 26Vataamka vuuku ganaŋa saasaŋa nyiŋ tuokpatta ale jam boro ate ba nye kpinkpatta a basi kauk meena. Naawen Yenni nakpiaka diinaŋa a jam ta ka da tii ale bari yik la.

Title: EZEKIEL 42
Content:
1Nuru wa yaa dɛ mi niŋ a ta mi cheŋ wiiluk geŋka a ga jo peelim dabiaka po a ŋman ta mi jam diin ŋaai ale tuk Naawen Yenni dabiaka la ale ŋman tuk peelim parika wiiluk geŋka la. 2Yenni tuok kuui ale tuk wiiluk geŋka la woglimmu jam ka anamagib kobsita ate labsimu a chim anamagib kook ale pisinu. 3Buyewa meena anamagib pisiyuebi ale nyini ponni dabiaka po a ga peelim dabiaka ale piisi la, ale cheŋ taamka jigini ale tuk cheŋ taamka jigini ku tɔgatɔga butawa. 4Diinaŋa niŋ ponni po taamka jigini ka anamagib pisita labsim ale anamagib kobsita woglim. Ŋa tuataŋa a jam bo ka wiilukku geŋ. 5Yɔgyɔgla de ŋmazuk diinaŋa jam migla kama, diila ŋa cheŋ taamka jiŋŋa a dɛ peelimmu kama a gaam diin ŋaai ale bo tɛŋka ale suŋsuŋka la. 6Diin ŋaai ale bo ŋmazuk butawa a ka zaŋŋa ase dabaasaŋa ale ta diila, dila nyiŋ ŋa jam fiisa kama ŋa tɛŋka peelimmu a gaam ŋaai ale bo tɛŋka ale suŋsuŋka la. 7Peelim parik ale yomsi magsi chaab ale diinaŋa ale peelim dabiaka. Ka cheŋ diinaŋa niŋ ka anamagib kook ale pisinu. 8Diinaŋa ale tom chaab a pa saŋ peelim dabiaka la ka anamagib kook ale pisinu woglim, ŋaai ale bo nakpiaka a moata puusika jigini la ka anamagib kobsita woglim. 9Tɛŋka diinaŋa a ta ka nansuiŋta kori geŋka ase waai a nin va peelim dabiak po a jo.
10Yeseok geŋka peelim dabiaka parika woglimmu a ga tom Naawen yenni dabiaka, ale peelim parika ale tuk chaab la, diina ale jam, 11ta vataamka jigi ŋa niŋ. Ŋade jaa nye ase ka ŋaai ale bo wiiluk geŋka la. Ŋa meena woglimmu ale labsimu ale vanyinika jiga ale magsika ka bunyi. Tua tii ale bo wiiluk geŋka la, 12ale diin ŋaai ale bo yeseok geŋka tuataŋa ka bunyi. Tuok ale jam bo vataam ka piilimka jigini a yomsi ale parik kaai ale tom du a cheŋ kori geŋka ate waai baga a va a jo diinaŋa po.
13Ate wa yaa weeni mi ayen, <<Wiilukku ale yeseoku geŋsaŋa diinaŋa ale a tuk Naawen yenni dabiaka la ka kaabteerɔma diina, juijui ate kaabteerɔma a cheŋ Naawen jigi la a dɛ tuilum meena tiiritaŋa ŋandiintaŋa. Dula ba le pa tuilum meena tiiritaŋa a dueni. Ŋandiinta tiiritaŋa ale biem tiiritaŋa ale nyemagsika tiiritaŋa a magsi ka tuilum jigini. 14Kaabteerɔma a dan toalim jo tuilum jiŋŋa, ba an magsi ba jo peelim dabiaka po ate ba ga basi ba gattaŋa ŋaaŋŋa tii ate ba jo tom la. Diila ti de ta tuilum kama. Ba magsi ba jo ka garuk yonta abe ba ge cheŋ a moata kab tii ate nuruma soa la.
15Wa le magsi ŋan baai ale bo Naawen yenni ponni po a nueri la, wa ta mi va kori geŋka tuoku a nyini a magsi a gilim. 16Wa magsi kori geŋka ale magsika diokku. Ku jam ka anamagib tusidi ale kobsinu. 17Wa magsi wiilukku geŋka ale magsika diokku. Ku jam ka anamagib tusidi ale kobsinu. 18Wa magsi yeseoku geŋka ale magsika diokku. Ku jam ka anamagib tusidi ale kobsinu. 19Ate wa cheem magsi yeniŋ geŋka ale magsika diokku. Ku jam ka anamagib tusidi ale kobsinu. 20Wa yaa magsi dula jigini kabta bunaansiwa meena. Ku jam ta ka parik a gilim ku, woglimmu anamagib tusidi ale kobsinu, labsimu anamagib tusidi ale kobsinu ate ku a poori weleŋsaŋa jigini ale waai meena jigini.

Title: EZEKIEL 43
Content:
1Ate nuruwa yaa ta mi jam nansuiŋku ale tuk kori geŋka la. 2Mi yaa nya Izirali Wenni zulaŋa a nyini kori geŋka a cheena. Wa lueluku a nye nna ase nyaata ale a wuuri la, ate tɛŋka a nyaksi ale wa zulaŋa. 3Gɔdaasi ŋaai ate mi nya la a nye ase ka ŋaai ate mi nya wa le jan jam ayen wa kaasi tɛŋka la, ale a nye ase ŋaai ate mi jam nya Chebar Benni a lo tɛŋka la. 4Naawen zulaŋa a yaa va kori geŋka nansuiŋku a jo Naawen yenni po. 5Chiika yaa zak mi wen a ta mi jam jo ponni dabiaka ate Naawen zulaŋa a sueri wa yenni.
6Nuruwa ale diem za mi gauŋ la, mi yaa wom waai a biisi ale mi Naawen yenni po. 7Wa weeni ayen, <<Saalɔ biiga, dela jigini ale mi naam zukpaglika jigini ale juijui ate mi naŋtaata a tabi. Dela jigini ate mi ale bo ale Izirali demma taam wuu. Izirali yenni a kan ŋman taŋ mi tuilum yuenni. Daa ba dega be daa ba nalima. Daa ba chaab bobi goomoa ale ba bɔgluk tii ale kan ta nyuvuri la. 8Ba le pa ba nansuiŋku tɛŋ diokku a dueni moata mi nansuiŋku diokku ale ba diina noaŋa a maŋ mi diinaŋa noaŋa la ba taŋ mi tuilum yuenni kama ale ba wabulɔrisa nyeka. Ate mi a yaa kaasi ba ale m suipuurumu. 9Yɔgyɔgla de ba pa ba chaab bobi goomu ale bɔgluk tii ale kan ta nyuvuri a basi, ate m bo ale ba taam wuu.
10Saalɔ biiga, magsi Naawen yenni a sak Izirali demma, ate chivie yik ba ba wabaataŋa nyiŋ. Basi ate ba seba di magsaŋa, 11ate chivie a dan yik ba ale ba le nye dii meena la, fi nye ate ba seba di wamaŋsaŋa ale di gomsika, di vanyinika jiŋŋa, ale nansuiŋtaŋa, di magsika ale di ŋmarisika ale di sinsaŋŋa. Ŋmarisi ŋade dueni ba niŋ ate ba ta siaka ale di magsika meena abe ba va di ŋmarisika meena.
12Naawen yenni sinsaŋŋa ale nna. Juijui meena ale gilim la guuku zuk ale ŋmasi ta tuilum. Naawen yenni sinsaŋŋa ale la.
13Kuŋkuŋku magsika ale nna. Anamagibwa ka anamagib buta. Ku nyiam vuuku ale limisa diila ka anamagib buta ate labsimu a chim anamagib buta. Ku noawaaŋa a kɔk nna jetijetik a gilim. Kuŋkuŋku woglimmu ale ka diila ale nna. 14A zaani nyiamu vuuku ale bo tɛŋka la a ga paari kuŋkuŋku kinni woglimmu ka anamagib buyuebi ate labsimu a chim anamagib buta, a zaani kiri fiika a ga paari kiri kpienni juelika ka anamagib pi ale buye ate labsimu a chim anamagib buta. 15Kuŋkuŋku daanika juelika ka anamagib pi ale buye ate nyiila ŋanaansi a ti wen daanika zuk. 16Kuŋkuŋku daanika kabtaŋa meena a soa ase ka chaab la. Ka woglimmu a chim anamagib pisita ale buyuebi ate labsimu a chim anamagib pisita ale buyuebi. 17Ŋmazukku kinni kabtaŋa meena a soa ase ka chaab la. Woglimmu anamagib pisinaansi ale buye, labsimu anamagib pisinaansi ale buye ate noawanni a chim anamagib ale geli ate nyiam vuuku a chim anamagib buta a gilim. Kuŋkuŋku tiilaŋa a tuk ka kori geŋka.
18Ate wa yaa weeni mi ayen, <<Saalɔ biiga, Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Ŋmarisika ale nna a magsi juka tiiritaŋa kaabka ale ziimu kuŋkuŋku zuk misika ase ba nin sɛ ku. 19Te lalik paalik ase biem tiirim la kaabteerɔma baai ale ka Livaiba la a nyini Zadok dɔkku la, baai ale forisi a moata a tom miŋ niŋ la. Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni. 20Pa ka ziimu gela a nyo kuŋkuŋku nyiila ŋanaansiwa nyiŋ ale ŋmazukku kinni gugotta tinaansiwa nyiŋ ale noawanni a ta gilim a sugri kuŋkuŋku abe fi nye biem duisi basika a te di. 21Pa biem tiirimu lalikka a ju juijui ale magsi juka la Naawen yenni po puusika jigini peelimmu po.
22Daa ŋayewa danni se fi te buduk kuui ale kan ta jomi ya a magsi biem tiirimu, abe Kuŋkuŋku a sugri ase ku le sugri ale lalikka diila. 23Fi dan sugri ku a nueri, fi a te ka lalik paalik ale padiak piisaŋa po. Si nɔi siyewa kan ta jomi ya. 24Ni pa te Naawen niŋ, abe kaabteerɔma a yulum yesa ti zuk a pa kaab ase juka tiirim la te Naawen.
25Daa ŋayopɔi meena dai meena ni te buduk a magsi biem tiirim. Ku a magsi ni te lalik paalik ale piisaŋa po padiak. Kaai a kan ta jomi ya. 26Daa ŋayopɔi meena ni nye vɔŋteka tiirim a te kuŋkuŋku abe ni sugri ku. A yaa pa ku te Naawen. 27Daaŋa de a dan nueri, a zaani da naanika danni a cheŋ, kaabteerɔma a pa juka tiiritaŋa ale suiyɔgni tiiritaŋa a dueni kuŋkuŋku zuk. Ate mi yaa siak tuesi. Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni.

Title: EZEKIEL 44
Content:
1Nuruwa yaa ta mi ŋman jam puusika jigini peelim tuoku, kuui ale a tuk kori geŋka la ate ku lik. 2Naawen yaa weeni mi ayen, <<Tuokku de abe kasim lik. Ku kan lagri, waai a kan va ku a jo. Ku kasim lik dii nyiŋla Naawen, Izirali Wenni a va ka kula a jo. 3Ka nabiika dek wa nyiini ale waai ale wa kali ponni po nansuiŋku nɔi a de Naawen niŋ. Wa va nansuiŋku vataamka vuuku a jo a va dula dek a nyini.
4Nuruwa yaa ta mi a va wiiluk geŋka nansuiŋku a jo jam Naawen yenni niŋka. Mi yaa nya Naawen zulaŋa a sueri Naawen yenni ate mi a lo poi nyiŋ.
5Naawen a weeni mi ayen, Saalɔ biiga, kpesi nya, chiib wom abe fi popola a bo ŋmarisika meena po ate mi a weeni fu a va chaab ale Naawen yenni la a magsi chaab ale di sinsaŋŋa meena. Pa fi popola a basi yenni nansuiŋku ale puusika jigini va nyinika jiŋŋa zuk. 6Weeni tuikpari Izirali yenni ayen, Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Izirali yeri ya ni nye kaai ate mi a kisi la a zuak kama. 7A gum ni wa yonaŋa nyeka ate mi a kisi la ale ni ta ka nicham ate ba suiniima ale ba nyiŋlam po ba an gebi ba yua ate ba jo mi puusika jigini a taŋ mi yenni alege pa ŋandiinta ale kpaam ale ziim a te mi ale kaasi mi nɔiyeŋka. 8Ni le magsi ayen ni tom ni tuimaŋa a va mi tuilum ŋantaŋa la, ni basi ate ka nuru yonta a nya mi boka jigini. 9Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Nichaanɔ waai ale kan gebi wa yoari wa suinum ale wa nyiŋ lam po la a kan jo mi jigini daa nicham baai ale poom bo Izirali demma suŋsuŋ la mɛ.
10Livaima ale basi mi a cheŋ niŋ diipo ate Izirali a cheŋ bɛ la, baai ale basi mi ale cheŋ bɛ a va ba bɔgtaŋa la ale nam ba wabaataŋa nyiŋ. 11Ba baga a tom mi boka jigini kama, a nya yenni nansuiŋtaŋa zuk abe ba a tom di po. Ba baga a tɔgri juka tiiritaŋa kama ale kaabka tiirita a te nuruma abe ba zaani a te nuruma a tom a te ba. 12Alege ba le tom te ba ba bɔgta niŋ la a basi ate Izirali yenni a lo biem po la, dila nyiŋ mi zak ka nisa wen a pɛ ayen ba le nam ba wabaataŋa nyiŋ. Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni. 13Ba kan jam moata ayen ba tom a te mi ase kaabteerɔba la, yaase ba jam moata mi tuilum ŋantaŋa, yaase mi tiiritaŋa ale ŋmasi ta tuilum la. Ku a fɛ ate ba ta wie ŋaai ate mi kisa ate ba nye la chivieŋa. 14Alege mi le basi ate ba a nya yenni tuimaŋa ale tuim ŋaai meena ate ba le tom la.
15Alege kaabteerɔma, baai ale ka Livaiba a chim Zadok ŋaaŋbisa a jam tom mi boka jigini tuimaŋa ale siaka diipo ate Izirali demma basi mi niŋ. Ba zaani mi niŋ a pa kpaam ale ziim a kaab te mi. Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni. 16Ba nyiini ale a jo mi boka jigini. Ba nyiini mɛ ale jam a moata mi jazaanimu a tom mi niŋ ale a tom m tuimaŋa.
17Ba daa jo ponni po dabiaka nansuiŋtaŋa, ba jo garuk naliŋsa, ba kan jo kɔbta gatta ase ba nin boro a tom ponni po dabiaka nansuiŋtaŋa yaase yenni ponni po. 18Ba pa garuk naluŋ zutɔksa a vuk ba zuimaŋa abe tɛŋ garuk naliŋsa a bobi ba chaasaŋa. Ba kan jo jabuui ale basi ate wulum a nyini ba. 19Ba dan nyini peelim dabiaka po juijui ate nuruma a boro la, ba yeeri ba garuk tii ate ba jo a tom la a basi ti tuilum diinaŋa po, abe ba jo garuk yonta, ate ba kan gaari nuruma a te ase tuilum nyam la ale ba gattaŋa.
20Ba kan chiiri ba zuimaŋa yaase ba basi ate ba zuisaŋa a chim woŋŋa alege ba kasim a zamsi zuisaŋa ba zuimaŋa po. 21Kaabteerɔ waai a kan nyu daam a jo ponni dabiaka po. 22Ba kan faari pukɔga yaase nipok baai ale ba chorɔba ale basi chaaba. Ba baga a faari ka baai ale kan seba nidoaba ale nyini Izirali buuni po nyiini yaase kaabteerɔba pukɔga. 23Ba sak mi nuruma ate ba seba tuilum ŋanta ale ŋankoa a gaari abe ba sak ba ate ba a gaari ŋan naliŋsa ale ŋan daŋtisa.
24Nuruba a dan ta chaab, kaabteerɔma a tom ase boteerɔba la a abe ba poli ku zuk a va chaab ale mi buusaŋa. Se ba ta mi sinsaŋŋa ale mi ŋmarisika a magsi mi tiŋŋa ate mi a lueri la. Abe ba ta m Vuusum Daaŋa ate ŋa welema.
25Kaabteerɔ a kan cheŋ a moata kpio ate wa taŋ wa dega, alege waai ale kpi la a dan ka wa ko yaase wa ma, wa nidoabili yaase lie, suok yaase tua waai ale kan yali ya, wa baga a taŋ wadek kama. 26Ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ wa dan sugri wadek ku a fɛ ate wa limisi daa ŋayopɔi. 27Dai dii dai ate wa a jo mi boka jigini ponni po dabiaka ayen wa tom la, wa te biem tiirim a magsi wadek. Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni.
28Mi nyiini ale kaabteerɔma nitalim. Ni kan pa jaab Izirali a te ba ate ba ta. Mi le chim waai ate ba ta la. 29Ba a dɛ ŋandiinta tiirimu ale biem tiirimu ale nyemagsika tiirimu ale jaab meena ate Izirali a pa a te Naawen la ba le soa. 30Yɔn maŋ sii meena ale a dɛ niŋ la ale tiirim yonta ka kaabteerɔma ale soa. Ni tɛŋka ale dɛ niŋ a bɛ ŋan baai la ni pa te ba ate niauŋ a jam ni yenni zuk. 31Kaabteerɔma kan ŋɔbi jaaboa, nuim yaase duŋŋa ale ka kpi doa yaase gɔi duŋsa a ko ka.

Title: EZEKIEL 45
Content:
1Ni daa gebi tɛŋka ase nitalim la, ni gebi ka kauk a te Naawen ase tuilum tɛŋ la. Ka woglimmu a chim anamagib tusa pisiyopɔi ale bunu (75,000), labsimu a chim anamagib tusa pisiyuebi (60,000). Tɛŋka meena ale ta tuilum kama. 2Mi jigini ni gebi tɛŋ ate kabta bunaansiwa kauk meena a chim anamagib tusidi ale kobsinu (1,500) abe anamagib kook ale pisinu peelim a gilim jigini ate peelim a boro. 3Tuilum tɛŋka ate ni gebi a te mi la ni magsi woglimmu anamagib tusa pisiyopɔi ale bunu (75,000) abe labsimu anamagib tusa pisita (30,000). Bu po ale mi jigini, Jigi Dii Ale Ŋmasi Ta Tuilum La. 4Dula ale ku chim tɛŋka tuilum jigi a magsi kaabteerɔma, baai ale a tom mi boka jigini ale forisi a moata a tom Naawen niŋ la. Ku le chim ka juijui ale magsi ba yeeŋa ale tuilum jigi a magsi mi jigini. 5Peelim buui ale a chim anamagib tusa pisiyopɔi ale bunu (75,000) woglim ate anamagib tusa pisita (30,000) a chim labsim la, Livaima ale a tom yenni po la ale soa ase nitalim la, a chim ba tɛŋsa ate ba a boro.
6Magsi tɛŋka labsimu anamagib tusa pi ale bunu (15,000) abe woglimmu anamagib tusa pisiyopɔi ale bunu (75,000) ate ka maŋ tuilum tɛŋka. Izirali yenni meena ale soa tɛŋ kala.
7Nabiika ale soa ka tɛŋ kaai ale nye bain ale tuilum tɛŋka ale tɛŋka dek ale soa tɛŋ kaai la. A zaani yeniŋ ka dari kama a cheŋ yeniŋ geŋka, a zaani konni ka dari kama a cheŋ kori geŋka. Ate ka woglim nyiŋ ka zaani yeniŋ geŋ a cheŋ kori geŋ a magsi chaab ale yezuimaŋa dinyi tɛŋka. 8Tɛŋka de wa soa ka jigi ale la Izirali po. Ate mi nabisaŋa a kan ŋman namsi mi nuruma alege ba le basi ate Izirali yenni soa tɛŋka a va chaab ale yezuimaŋa.
9Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Ni cheŋ niŋ ka yega, Izirali nabisa. Ni pa ni wɔkwɔkka ale ni namsika a basi abe ni a nye dii ale ka wensie ale magsi la. Ni basi m nuruma taka. Mi Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni. 10Ni pa ŋanmagsin maŋsa, taasi kpien maŋ ale samɔniŋ maŋ. 11Taasi kpienni ale samɔniŋka a magsi ba chim ka bunyi. Taasi kpienni a soa se ka kuruba kpioŋ la ate samɔniŋka a soa se kuruba kpioŋ, kuruba kpioŋku ale chim ja magsim a te buyewa. 12Ligbie dobrim a magsi ku chim ka magsika dobrim pisiye. Ligbie dobrim pisiye a gum ligbie dobrim pisiye ale bunu a gum ligbie pi ale bunu a chim ka boorik.
13Tiirim buui ale potim magsi ni a te la ale nna. Taasi kpienni po ku poorika buyuebi bunyi a nyini wiiti kuruba kpioŋku po abe samɔniŋ po ku poorika buyuebi bunyi a nyini barli kuruba kpioŋ po. 14Wa le te kpaamu magsaŋa la, ate ba pa samɔniŋ a magsi la, ka samɔniŋka piika po a nyini kuruba ba pi meena po. Ku meena a nye ase ka samɔniŋsa pi a magsi chaab ale kuruba ba pi la. 15Pa yeoŋ a yeeri piisa kobsiye meena po, ŋaai ale a dɛ Izirali wuuk kuui ale zaŋti nalimnyiini la. Ba le pa ŋade a magsi ŋandiinta tiirimu, ale juka tiirimu ale suiyɔgni tiirita a nye biem duisi basika a te nuruma. Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni. 16Izirali demma meena ale nye tiirimu de a magsi Izirali nabisaŋa nyeka. 17Ku ka nabisaŋa tuini ayen ba te juka tiiritaŋa ale ŋandiinta tiiritaŋa ale daam tiiritaŋa tiŋŋa jigini. Chi Paalika ale Vuusum Daaŋa tiŋŋa, Izirali yenni tiga ŋaai meena ate wa lueri la. Wa le te biem tiirimu, ŋandiinta tiirimu, juka tiirimu ale suiyɔgni tiirita a nye biem duisi basika a te Izirali yenni.
18Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Chi kaai ale a piilim la ka dai yeŋ dai ni pa lalik paalik kaai ale kan ta jomi ya a sugri mi boka jigini. 19Kaabteerɔwa a pa biem tiirimu ziimu gela a nyo yenni tuataŋa nyiŋ ale kuŋkuŋku ŋmazuk noawanni gugotta tinaansiwa ale ponni po dabiaka tuataŋa nyiŋ. 20Se fi nye dila dek daa ŋayopɔiwa danni chiika po a te waai ale kan potim tom kaasi ya yaase wa zɛ ale tom kaasi. Se fi nye biem duisi basika a te yenni.
21Piilimka chiika ka daa pi ale ŋanaansi dai ni kpesi Gaambasika Tigini, tigi dii ale di dɛ daa ŋayopɔi, diipo ate ni le ŋɔbi boroborok kuui ale kan ta dabinta la. 22Dai dila danni nabiika a yaali lalik ase biem tiirim la a magsi wadek ale tɛŋka nuruma meena. 23Dai meena Tigini daa ŋayopɔiwa po wa yaali lalisa siyopɔi ale padaasa siyopɔi ale kan ta jomi ya ase juka tiirim la a te Naawen ale buduk ase biem tiirim la. 24Wa magsi wa yaali ŋandiinta tiirim, taasi kpien nɔi a magsi lalik meena ale taasi kpien nɔi a magsi padiak meena, ale kpaam kolini nɔi a magsi taasi kpien.
25Tigini daa ŋayopɔiwa po, dii ale a piilim chiisa siyopɔiwa po ka daa pi ale ŋanu danni la, wa gomsi yaali dila degadega a magsi biem tiiritaŋa, juka tiiritaŋa, ŋandiinta tiiritaŋa ale kpaam.

Title: EZEKIEL 46
Content:
1Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Ponni po dabiaka nansuiŋka ale a tuk kori geŋ la, lik ku tuima daa ŋayuebiwa meena, alege Vuusumu Danni ale Chi Paalika Danni ku lagri. 2Nabiika a va peelimmu a jo a va vataamka vuuku ale bo nansuiŋku po a zaani nansuiŋku nɔi. Kaabteerɔma a kaabi wa juka tiirimu ale wa suiyɔgni tiiritaŋa. Wa puusi nansuiŋku dek nɔi abe wa nyini, alege tuoku a kan ligi a ga a paari junɔi. 3Vuusumu Daaŋa ale Chi Paalisaŋa Daaŋa tɛŋka demma a puusi Naawen niŋ nansuiŋku va joka jigini. 4Juka tiirimu ate nabiika a ta jam a te Naawen Vuusum Danni la ka padabilisa siyuebi ale padiak, si meena kan ta jomi ya. 5Ŋandiinta tiirimu ale a te ale padiaka a chim ka taasi kpien nɔi, ate ŋandiinta tiirim buui ale a te ale pabisaŋa a chim dii meena ate wa a yaali la. Kpaam kolini ale a magsi taasi kpien meena a maara boro. 6Chi Paalika tigini danni wa a te ka lalik paalik, pabisa siyuebi ale padiak, ba waai a kan ta jomi ya. 7Wa te ŋandiinta tiirim taasi kpienni ale lalik, taasi kpienni ale padiak, wa te dii ate wa a yaali la ale pabisaŋa. Wa maa te kpaam kolini a magsi taasi kpienni meena. 8Nabiika a daa jo, wa va nansuiŋku vataamka vuuku a ŋman va dula dek a nyini.
9Tɛŋka nuruma a dan jam Naawen niŋ tiŋŋa daaŋa, waai ale va wiiluk geŋka nansuiŋku a jo wa puusi la a va yeseoku nansuiŋku a nyini, waai abe le va yeseoku nansuiŋku a jo la a va wiilukku nansuiŋku a nyini waai a kan va nansuiŋ kuui ate wa va jo la a nyini, alege waai meena a va m kula a nyini. 10Nabiika a maa bo ba po, a va jo ase ba le a jo abe wa va nyini ase ba le a nyini.
11Tiŋŋa ale tiga ŋaai ate wa lueri la daaŋa, ŋandiinta tiirimu a chim taasi kpien nɔi ale lalik, taasi kpien nɔi ale padiak ale dii meena ate wa a yaali la ale pabisaŋa, ale kpaam kolini a magsi taasi kpien meena. 12Nabiika a dan pa wadek yaalika tiirimu a te Naawen, juka tiirim yaase suiyɔgni tiirita, nansuiŋ kuui ale tuk kori la a lagri te wa. Wa te wa juka tiirimu yaase suiyɔgni tiiritaŋa ase wa le a nye dii Vuusum danni la. Wa yaa nyini. Wa dan nyini ŋaaŋnyiŋ ku lik.
13Daa meena se fi te bein yeŋ pabiik kaai ale kan ta jomi ya a magsi juka tiirim a te Naawen. Saluik meena se fi te ka. 14Se saluik meena fi te pabiika ale ŋandiinta tiirim, taasi kpien nɔi a nin poori buyuebi, ku bunyi ale kpaam kolini a nin poori buta, ku bunyi fi te ale pabiika a dam zommu. Ŋan bieŋa de Naawen teka ka ŋmarisi kaai ale ka beni. 15Dila pabiika ale ŋandiinta tiirimu ale kpaamu a te ka saluik meena a magsi daa meena ju teka.
16Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale biisi diila ale nna. Nabiika a dan pa tiirim wa nitalimu po a te wa nidoabilisaŋa, ka wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa mɛ ale soa. Ka ba nitalim ŋanta ate ba soa. 17Wa be dan pa tiirim wa nitalimu po a te wa tomteerɔ wanyi, tomteerɔwa a baga a ta kama a ga paari varibasika benni, ate tiirimu a ŋman cheŋ nabiika jigi. Wa nitalimu ka wa nidoabilisaŋa ale soa. Ka ba ŋanta. 18Nabiika kan pa nuruma nitalimu jaajaaboa a yiak ba alege ba nitalimu. Wa te wa nidoabilisaŋa ba nitalimu a nyini wadek ŋantaŋa po, ate mi nuruma waai a kan poori wadek wa ŋanta po.
19Nuruwa yaa ta mi va vajoka jigini ale bo nansuiŋku geŋka ale tuak tuilum diinaŋa ale tuk wiiluk geŋka ate kaabteerɔma a soa la a jo, a sak mi jigi ale bo yeniŋ geŋka kpeglimka. 20Wa weeni mi ayen, <<Juijui ate kaabteerɔma a za ba a dik nyemagsika tiirimu ale biem tiirimu abe ba a sɛ ŋandiinta tiirimu, ate ku kan te ba jo peelim dabiaka po a gaari nuruma a te Naawen ya.
21Wa yaa ta mi nyini peelim dabiaka po a ta mi gilim gugotta tinaansiwa, ate mi nya gugoruk meena po dabiak ka choa. 22Peelim dabiaka gugottaŋa tinaansiwa po, gugotta ale ŋman bo popo, ate woglim a chim anamagib kook ale pisiye ate labsimu a chim anamagib pineok. Gugoruk meena ale bo gugotta tinaansiwa po a soa ase ka chaab la. 23Dabaasa sinaansiwa kanyi meena ponni po a gilim kinni ka tintain ate bolim jiga a sɛ gilim kinni tɛŋka. 24Wa yaa weeni mi ayen, gbanlontaŋa ale nna ate baai ale a tom yenni po la a dik nuruma kaabka tiiritaŋa.

Title: EZEKIEL 47
Content:
1Nuruwa a ta mi a ŋman jam Naawen yenni nansuiŋku ate mi nya a nyini tuoku tɛŋka a nyini a cheŋ kori geŋka, yenni a tuk ka kori geŋ. Nyiamu a nyini ka yeseok geŋka a siŋ a jam, kuŋkuŋku yeseok geŋ ale la. 2Wa yaa ta mi va wiiluk geŋka tuoku a nyini, a ta mi gilim peelimmu a ga paari peelim tuoku ale tuk kori la, ate nyiam a chali a nyini yeseok geŋka.
3Nuru ale a cheŋ kori geŋ ale ja magsim wa nisa po la, wa yaa magsi anamagib tusa ŋata (3,000) a yaa ta mi va nyiam po ate bu a paari karisa. 4Wa ŋman magsi anamagib tusa ŋata (3,000) ale ta mi va nyiamu po ate bu a paari duna. Wa pilim magsi anamagib tusa ŋata (3,000) ale ta mi va nyiamu po ate bu a paari chiak. 5Wa ŋman magsi anamagib tusa ŋata (3,000), alege yɔgyɔgla de yaa ka beli ate mi an baga a taamu, diila nyiamu yaa jueli kama a limisa yega a magsi puŋka, beli dii ate nuru an baga a taamu. 6Wa bek mi ayen, <<Saalɔ biiga, fi nya kude? Wa yaa ŋman ta mi a cheŋ kunkɔŋni. 7Mi ale paari du la, mi yaa nya ti boari benni kabta buyewa. 8Wa yaa weeni mi ayen, <<Nyiamu de a chali a cheŋ ka kori geŋka a taam a siŋ Araba po, juijui ate bu a jo Yesa Nyakpiemu po la. Bu dan nyini meena a jo Yesa Nyakpiemu po, bu le chim nya naliŋ. 9Ŋanvuta kuŋkuŋ ale bo bu po juijui meena ate bu chali a cheŋ la. Juma ale piisi dii nyiŋla nyiamu de a chali a cheŋ dula kama a basi ate yesaŋa nyiamu a chim nya naliŋ. Dila nyiŋ juijui ate nyiamu a chali a cheŋ la jaab meena ale boro. 10Jum yigrisa ale zaani bu nɔi, a zaani En Gedi a ga paari En Eglaim jiga ale boro a danni ŋmaasa. Juma tɔgatɔga ale boro ase Nyakpiemu juma la. 11Alege ŋala ale kab tii ale yɔk la nyaataŋa a kan nala, ti le chim ka yesa a dua. 12Yɔna tiisa tɔgatɔga ale zaani beni kabta buyewa. Si vaataŋa a kan wiiri, yaase si yɔn kpeeri. Chiik meena si le yɔni, dii nyiŋla nya buui ale nyini Naawen boka jigini a chali a cheŋ si jigi la. Si yɔnaŋa ale chim ŋandiinta abe si vaataŋa a tebi.
13Nyɔnɔwa Naawen la ale biisi diila ale nna. <<Bana ŋaai ate fi le mobi ase nitalim a te Izirali yezuima pi ale ŋayewa la ale nna, ale tɛŋsa siye a magsi Josefi. 14Mobi a soa se chaab la a te ba. Dii nyiŋla mi zak ka nisa wen a pɛ ayen m le pa tɛŋka de a te ni kokpieŋsaŋa. Tɛŋka de ale chim ni nitalim.
15Tɛŋka banni ale magsi di chim diila ale nna. <<A nyini wiiluk geŋka di va dila nyini Nyakpiemu a sali va Yetlon manpanni a gaam Yamat a ga paari Zedad, 16ale Berota ale Sibraim kaai ale dua Damasikus ale Yamat suŋsuŋ la, a cheŋ ga a paari Yazer Yattikon, kaai ale nye bain ale Yauran la. 17Banni ale nyini ka nyakpiemu a cheŋ paari Yazar Enan, a va Damasikus banni wiiluk geŋ, ate Yamat banni a bo wiiluk geŋ. Di de ale di chim wiiluk geŋ bain.
18Kori geŋka banni ale va ka Yauran ale Damasikus suŋsuŋ a sali va Jodan, Gilead ale Izirali tɛŋka suŋsuŋ, a tuak kori geŋka nyakpiemu a ta ga paari Tamara. Di de ale di chim kori geŋ bain.
19Yeseok geŋka banni ale va ka Tamara a ta ga a paari Meriba Kades nyaataŋa, a yaa sali va Ejipiti Buboalika wa a ga paari Nyakpiemu. Di de ale di chim yeseok geŋ bain.
20Yeniŋ geŋka, ka Nyakpiemu ale bu bain a ga paari kauk kuui ate Lebo Yamat a bo bu gauŋ nyiŋ. Di de ale di chim yeniŋ geŋ bain.
21Ni pa tɛŋka de a chari chaab a va Izirali yezuimaŋa. 22Ni gebi te nidek ase nitalim la abe ni te nichamma ale bo ni suŋsuŋ a ta bisa la. Ni poli ba mɛ wie ase Izirali tɛŋ bisa la. Ni gum ba Izirali yezuimaŋa pa a chari ba ase nitalim la. 23Ye zuk kuui dek ate nichaanɔ a boro la ni te wa ase wa nitalim la. Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni.

Title: EZEKIEL 48
Content:
1Yezuimaŋa ale nna ale ba yueŋa a tom chaab. Wiilukku niŋ nyiŋ Dan ale soa kauk kunyi. Ku le va ka Yetlon manpanni a ga Lebo Yamat, Yazar Enan ale Damasikus wiiluk geŋka ale pa te Yamat la, ale chim ka banni gela a nyini kori geŋka a ga paari yeniŋ geŋka.
2Asɛ ale soa kauk kunyi. Ka le nye bain ale Dan ale soa kauk kuui la a zaani kori geŋ a ga paari yeniŋ geŋ.
3Nafitali ale soa kauk kunyi. Ka le nye bain ale Asɛ ale soa kauk kuui la a zaani kori geŋka a ga paari yeniŋ geŋ.
4Manasa ale soa kauk kunyi. Ka le nye bain ale Nafitali ale soa kauk kuui la a zaani kori geŋka a ga paari yeniŋ geŋ.
5Ɛfraim ale soa kauk kunyi. Ka le nye bain ale Manasa ale soa kauk kuui la a zaani kori geŋka a ga paari yeniŋ geŋ.
6Aruben ale soa kauk kunyi. Ka le nye bain ale Ɛfraim ale soa kauk kuui la a zaani kori geŋka a ga paari yeniŋ geŋ.
7Juda ale soa kauk kunyi. Ka le nye bain ale Aruben ale soa kauk kuui la a zaani kori geŋka a ga paari yeniŋ geŋ.
8Kauk kuui ale nye bain ale Juda la zaani kori geŋka a ga paari yeniŋ geŋ ka kauk kuui ate ni pa a te ase tiirim maŋ la. Ku labsimu ale chim ka anamagib tusa pisiyopɔi ale ŋanu (75,000) ate ku woglimmu a zaani kori geŋka a ga paari yeniŋ geŋ a soa se yezuimaŋa kabtaŋa la. Mi boka jigini ale bo ka suŋsuŋka po.
9Tiirim maarika jigini ate ni pa a te Naawen la woglimmu a chim anamagib tusa pisiyopɔi ale ŋanu (75,000), labsimu anamagib tusa pisita (30,000). 10Kaabteerɔma tuilum jigini ale nna. Ku woglimmu a chim anamagib tusa pisiyopɔi ale ŋanu (70,000) wiilukku geŋ, labsimu a chim anamagib tusa pisita (30,000) yeniŋka geŋ, anamagib tusa pisita (30,000) labsim konni geŋ abe anamagib tusa pisiyopɔi ale ŋanu (70,000) woglim yeseoku geŋka. Suŋsuŋka Naawen boka jigini ale la. 11Kude kaabteerɔma, Zadok dɔkdemma ate mi gaari te mi dek la ale soa. Ba jam ta siaka kama a tom a te mi alege an cheŋ a bɛ ya ase Livaima ale jam nye diila, diipo ate Izirali demma a cheŋ a bɛ la. 12Ka tiirim maŋ tuilum tɛŋka po, tuilum jigi a nye bain ale Livaima ale soa kauk kuui la.
13A maŋ kaabteerɔma banni, Livaima soa ka gebi teka jigi ate woglimmu a chim anamagib tusa pisiyopɔi ale ŋanu (75,000), labsimu anamagib tusa pisita (30,000). Ku meena gum chaab woglimmu ka anamagib tusa pisiyopɔi ale ŋanu (75,000), labsimu anamagib tusa pisita (30,000). 14Ku a fɛ ate ba kan pa da yaase ba pa a tagri jaaboa. Ka tɛŋ maŋ jigi ale nna, ku a fɛ ate ka kan taam jo waai nisa po, dii nyiŋla ka ta tuilum kama a te Naawen.
15Tɛŋ kaai ale tali la, labsimu ka anamagib tusa pi ale ŋanu (15,000), woglimmu anamagib tusa pisiyopɔi ale ŋanu (75,000). Dula a magsi tɛŋka wa yona nyeka, yie sɛka ale duŋsa dɛka jiga. Tɛŋka dek ale bo ka ka suŋsuŋ. 16Ka be ta magsika de. Wiiluk geŋka a chim anamagib tusa pi ale ŋata ale kobsinu (13,500) yeseok geŋka a chim anamagib tusa pi ale ŋata ale kobsinu (13,500), kori geŋka a chim anamagib tusa pi ale ŋata ale kobsinu (13,500), yeniŋ geŋka a chim anamagib tusa pi ale ŋata ale kobsinu (13,500). 17Tɛŋka duŋsa dɛka jigini wiiluk geŋka ale chim ka anamagib kobsiyopɔi ale pisinu, yeseok geŋka ale chim ka anamagib kobsiyopɔi ale pisinu, kori geŋka ale chim ka anamagib kobsiyopɔi ale pisinu, yeseok geŋka a chim anamagib kobsiyopɔi ale pisinu. 18Tɛŋ kaai ale tali la, a nye bain ale tuilum jigini ka woglim nyiŋla, a chim anamagib tusa pisita (30,000) kori geŋ, anamagib tusa pisita (30,000) yeniŋ geŋ. Ka dan nye ŋandiinta ka tɛŋka tuimtomdisaŋa ale soa. 19Tuimtomdisaŋa ale nyini tɛŋka po a kpa ka la a nyini ka Izirali yezuimaŋa meena. 20Kauk kula meena ale soa se ka chaab la a nye ŋmɔgluk. Kauk meena a chim anamagib tusa pisiyopɔi ale ŋanu (75,000). Ase tiirim maŋ la gaari tuilum jigini tɛŋka ŋantaŋa.
21Juijui ale tali a nyini tuilum jigini ale tɛŋka ŋantaŋa po la ka nabiika ale soa. Ka le dari kama kori geŋka a nyini tuilum jigini anamagib tusa pisiyopɔi ale ŋanu (75,000) a ga paari kori banni, ale yeniŋ geŋ a nyini anamagib tusa pisiyopɔi ale ŋanu (75,000) a ga paari yeniŋ banni. Jiŋŋa de buyewa ale dari siŋ ase yezuimaŋa kabtaŋa woglimmu la ka nabiika ale soa. Tuilum jigini ale mi jigini ale bo ka suŋsuŋ. 22Dila Livaima soaka jigini ale tɛŋka soaka jigini ale dua ka suŋsuŋ, dula nabiika abe le soa. Juijui ate nabiika a soa la ale dua ka Juda ale Benjamin suŋsuŋ a nye bain ale ba.
23Alege yezuima niŋ ŋala Benjamin ale soa kauk kunyi. Ka le dari nyini kori geŋka a ga paari yeniŋ geŋka.
24Simeyon ale soa kauk kunyi. Ka le nye bain ale Benjamin a zaani kori geŋka a ga paari yeniŋ geŋ.
25Isaka ale soa kauk kunyi. Ku le nye bain ale Simeyon a zaani kori geŋka a ga paari yeniŋ geŋ.
26Zebulun ale soa kauk kunyi. Ku le nye bain ale Isaka a zaani kori geŋka a ga paari yeniŋ geŋ.
27Gad ale soa kauk kunyi. Ku le nye bain ale Zebulun a zaani kori geŋka a ga paari yeniŋ geŋ.
28Gad ale soa kauk kuui la ale dari ka dila yeseok geŋ a zaani Tamara a ga paari Meriba Kades nyaataŋa, a sali va Ejipiti Buboalika a ga paari Nyakpiemu.
29Tɛŋka ale nna ate fi le gebi ase nitalim la a te Izirali yezuimaŋa, kabtaŋa de abe le ba soaka jigi. Nyɔnɔwa Naawen ale weeni.
30Tɛŋka nansuiŋtaŋa ale nna. A piilim wiilukku geŋ ate woglimmu a chim anamagib tusa pi ale ŋata ale kobsinu (13,500), 31ba pa Izirali yezuimaŋa yue a te tɛŋka nansuiŋtaŋa. Nansuiŋta titawa ale bo wiilukku geŋ la a chim Aruben nansuiŋ, Juda nansuiŋ, ale Livai nansuiŋ.
32Konni geŋ, ate woglimmu a chim anamagib tusa pi ale ŋata ale kobsinu (13,500), nansuiŋta tita ale bo dula. Josefi nansuiŋ, Benjamin nansuiŋ, ale Dan nansuiŋ.
33Yeseoku geŋ, ate woglimmu a chim anamagib tusa pi ale ŋata ale kobsinu (13,500), anasuiŋta tita ale bo dula. Simeyon nansuiŋ, Isaka nansuiŋ, ale Zebulun nansuiŋ.
34Yeniŋ geŋ, ate woglimmu a chim anamagib tusa pi ale ŋata ale kobsinu (13,500), nansuiŋta tita ale bo dula. Gad nansuiŋ, Asɛ nansuiŋ, ale Nafitali nansuiŋ.
35Magsi kaai ale a gilim ku meena la, ka anamagib tusa pisinu ale ŋanaansi (54,000). Ate tɛŋka yuenni a zaani dila po a cheŋ ale chim ka <Naawen a bo dula.>

Title: DANIEL 1
Content:
1Jeyoiakim ale jam dɛ wa naamu a paari bena ŋata Juda po la, Naab Nebukadnezzar ate wa nyini Babilon la a jam nye ka kpaliŋ ale Jerusalem tɛŋka. 2Nyɔnɔwa a yaa basi ate Nebukadnezzar a nak yik Jeyoiakim ale pai ŋan baai ate ba ta a tom Wen yenni po la gela a ta cheŋ. Ase Naawa ale ŋman cheŋ Sinar la, wa yaa pai ŋantaŋa de a nyo wadek wenni dɔkku po.
3Dai yeŋ ate naawa a yaa weeni Aspenaz, wa yenni kpagni, ayen wa lueri nuruba maga a nyini Juda naab dɔkku po, ale Juuma niŋdeerɔma po. 4Naawa a weeni ba ayen, ba magsi ayen ba ta nyiŋyɔgsa, ba nala, ba korisi, ba ta yam, ba seba gbaŋ, ba magsi ba a tom naab yenni po. Sak ba ate ba a biisi abe ba a ŋmarisi ti tɛŋka biika, 5abe fi te ba ŋandiin tii ale da buui ate fi a te mi la, pai bena ŋata a sak ba ate ba chim kpaga buusa boka yenni po. 6Ba po biik paali sii ate ba jam lueri la ale, Daniel ale Yanania ale Misael ale Azariya, ba meena a nyini ka Juda buuni po. 7Alege Naawa yenni kpaŋŋa a te ba ka yue paala. Daniel yuei jam le Beltesazzar, Yanania jam le Sadrak, Misael jam le Mesak, ate Azariya a chim Abednego. 8Daniel yaa nye wa popolaŋa ayen wa kan taŋ wadek ale naab yeri ŋandiintaŋa ale daamu. Ate wa yaa weeni Naawa yenni kpaŋŋa ayen ba kan te wa ŋandiinta ale da buui ate ba a chari naawa yenni po la. 9Wen ale nye ate kpagni a ta yaalika ale jiirim ale Daniel. 10Alege nuruwa a ŋman weeni Daniel ayen, <<Naawa a poom gomsi jabuui ate nama ale dɛ abe ni nyu la kama. Mi a chali ka yɔgsum, wa ale ko mu ase nama a nin dɛ ŋan yonta ate ni nye ni tɔga ale nuru mbala.>> 11Daniel a yaa weeni waai ate Naawa a lueri ayen wa a nya Daniel ale Yanania ale Misael ale Azariya zuk la ayen, 12Daa pi, te tama nyiam ale jenvaata nyiini ase ku nin paari diipo ale magsi ayen ti dɛ la. 13Daa piwa a dan paari, pai tama a magsi chaab ale nuru paalukku baai ale a dɛ naab yeri ŋandiintaŋa la a nya abe fi yaa nye ti dii ate fi a yaali la.>> 14Wa yaa siak a nye dii ate Daniel a weeni wa la. 15Daa piwa ale paari la, Daniel ale wa doama a yaa jam pagra ale zunchoŋŋa nuru paalukku baai ale jam a dɛ ŋandiintaŋa naawa yenni po la. 16Kude ŋaaŋnyiŋ limisidɔwa an ŋman jam a te ba ŋandiinta ale daamoa. Ba jam a dɛ ka jenvaata nyiini. 17Nuru paalisa banaansiwa dɛ, Wen a yaa te ba yam ale sebika ase ba ale jam a kariŋ gbaŋsa nna yegayega la. Daniel mɛ jam a weeni gɔdaasima kiri kama. 18Bena ŋatawa ate Naab Nebukadnezzar a jam te la a yaa paari, wa yenni kpagni a yaa ta nuru paalukku meena a jam wa jigi. 19Naawa a yaa nya mbala waai a kan nye ase Daniel ale Yanania ale Misael ale Azariya la. Dila nyiŋ ba yaa jam basi ate ba maa chim niŋdeerɔba naawa yenni po. 20A ta va chaab ale yam wie, wa nya ayen ba yammu a gaam sampopori sii ale bo wa tɛŋka po la kama ku naŋ tuok nɔi pi. 21Daniel a kasim jam bo ka dula a ta ga paari bein dii ate Sairus a chim naab la.

Title: DANIEL 2
Content:
1Nebukadnezzar ale dɛ naamu a paari bena ŋayewa po la, wa yaa gɔdaasim ate wa popolaŋa a daani wa, yok kula wa an jam goa ya. 2Naawa a yaa wi wa sampoporisaŋa ale yam nyama ale baai ale a zamsi chiŋmarisa wie la ayen ba weeni wa gɔdaasimaŋa a sak wa. Ase ba yaa ale jam naawa niŋ la, 3wa yaa weeni ba ayen m gɔdaasim kama ate ku a daani mu ate mi a yaali ayen m miŋ ku kiri.
4Ba yaa tulisi ale ba tɛŋka biika Aramaik ayen, <<Naaba boro taam wuu. Tama ka fi tomteerɔba. Bi weeni ti fi gɔdaasimaŋa ate tama ale weeni ŋa kiri a sak fu.>>
5Naawa a yaa tulisi ba ayen, <<Mi ale a poli diila ale nna ni dan kan weeni mu m gɔdaasimaŋa ale ka diila ale ŋa kiri ya, mi ale gebi ni ka gela ate ni yeeŋa ale chim guura. 6Alege ni dan weeni gɔdaasimaŋa ale ŋa kiri ale ka diila a sak mu, mi ale te ni tiirim buui ale zuak la ale zula. Yɔgyɔgla de ni weeni gɔdaasimaŋa ale ŋa kiri a sak mu.>>
7Ba yaa tulisi ayen basi ate Naawa a weeni wa tomteerɔma wa gɔdaasimaŋa ate tama ale weeni wa ŋa kiri.
8Ate naawa a yaa tulisi ayen, mi seba nama a gisi ka suik, dii nyiŋla ni seba mi ale poli diila di za di nye kama. 9Ni dan kan baga a weeni mu gɔdaasimaŋa, wa yeŋ dekki ate mi a yaali ayen m nye ni. Nama ka velimvendisa. Nama a poli ayen wie ale tagri. Ni weeni mu gɔdaasimaŋa ate kula ale sak ayen ni baga a miŋ wie.
10Sampoporisaŋa yaa tulisi Naawa ayen nuru ka tɛŋka zuk a baga a tulisi Naawa ale bek diila, aaya Naaba, Nuru kpioŋ an diem bek yam nyama ale sampoporisaŋa ale baai ale a zamsi chiŋmarisa wie la fi beŋŋa nna chaaba. 11Naawa ale bek diila a melima kama. Waai karo a weeni a sak Naawa ka wenaŋa, ŋa be an bo ale nuruma mɛ.
12Kude yaa basi ate Naawa sui yaa puuri ate wa weeni ayen ba ko yam nyama meena Babilon tɛŋka po. 13Kaamka yaa jam ayen ba ko yam nyama meena. Ba yaa jam boro a gisi Daniel ale wa doama ayen ba ko ba.
14Naawa yenni kpagni Ariok a yaa le nyini ayen wa ko yam nyama Babilon tɛŋka po la, Daniel a yaa biisi ale wa ale yam. 15Wa bek Naawa nuru kpioŋku ayen, <<Ka boa ate Naawa a te suiku de choa?>> Ate Ariok yaa weeni wa dii ale nye la. 16Daniel a yaa nye nwuli a ga weeni Naawa ayen fi a dan te mi suik maga mi ale weeni fi gɔdaasimaŋa kiri a sak fu.
17Daniel yaa ŋman kuli yeri a ga weeni dii ale nye la a sak wa doama batawa Yanania ale Misael ale Azariya. 18Wa weeni ba ayen ni puusi ayen Wen dii ale a nya a nyini wenŋmazuk la a sak jiirim abe wa weeni wanni de kiri a sak ti, dii ale ku nye ate ba kan ko ti ale yam nuru baai ale bo Babilon tɛŋka po la. 19Yok kula po, Daniel a yaa miŋ wasusugni wa goom po. Daniel a yaa pak Wen dii ale bo wenŋmazuk la. 20<<Ti Wenni yuenni a nya zula taam wuu, yam ale pagrim ka wa ale soa. 21Wa ale basi ate wenkarik ale yoei a jam wa ale a bobi nalima ale a zɛri ba mɛ. Wa ale a te yam nyama miŋ chakka ale popola ate ba a miŋ wie. 22Wa ale pai wasusuŋŋa a sak ti, wa seba jabuui ale bo legini po la kama bolim abe bo ale ka wala. 23Mi a nye fi jiam ale a pak fu, m koma Wenni, fi a te mu yam ale pagrim ale basi ate m miŋ dii ate tama a bek fu la, fi basi ate ti seba Naawa gɔdaasimaŋa.>>
24Daniel yaa ŋman cheŋ Naawa nuru kpioŋku Ariok jigi waai ale jam a nya yam nuruma koka zuk la a weeni wa ayen, <<Kan ko nuruma de! Ta mi a cheŋ Naawa jigi mi ale weeni wa gɔdaasimaŋa kiri a sak wa.>>
25Ariok yaa nye nwuli a ta Daniel a cheŋ Naawa jigi a yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Mi nya ka Juda dem baai ale bo fi tɛŋka po la wanyi wala ale baga a weeni fi gɔdaasimaŋa kiri a sak fu.>> 26Naawa yaa bek Daniel ayen, <<Fi ale baga a weeni mu m gɔdaasimaŋa ale ŋa kiri ale ka diila a sak mu? 27Daniel yaa tulisi ayen, <<Yam nuru ale sampoporisaŋa ale baai ale a zamsi chiŋmarisa wie la a kan baga a weeni wasusugi dii ate Naawa a gɔdaasim nya la a sak wa. 28Alege Wen dii ale bo wenŋmazuk la, wala ale pai wa susuga a sak. Wa pai sak Naab Nebukadnezzar dii ale ku nye wa chum po la. Fi ale doa fi gaduokku zuk ate gɔdaasimaŋa a bo fi zukku po la ale nna.
29<<Ase fi ale doa la Naaba, fi popolaŋa a tulim boka wie ŋaai ale kala ŋa nye chum po, ate waai ale pai wasusuga a sak la a yaa pai sak fu dii ale ku nye chum po la. 30Mi jigi wa poom pai sak mi kama. Alege ku kan sak kama ayen mi a ta yam a gaam nuru vuk meena kama, alege fi Naaba, ku a magsi kama ayen fi a seba di kiri abe fi miŋ dii ale bo fi popolaŋa po la.
31<<Naaba ase fi ale nya jameemmu ale wa za fi niŋ a zuak ale a nyaksi la. 32Jaamu zukku ka ligmɔniŋ, wa kuusini ale wa nisimaŋa a jam ka kpana, wa lɔŋŋa ale wa kɔsutaŋa a jam ka kutuk mɔnuŋ. 33Wa naŋsaŋa ka kuta, ku naŋtaataŋa gela a jam ka kuta kabita mɛ a jam chim yak. 34Ase fi yaa le a nya la piuŋ yaa kasi a nyini wenzuk alege nuru nisima an tiri ku alege ate piuŋku a jam nak naŋsaŋa geŋsa a yaa kaasi kutukku ale yakka meena. 35Ate kutukku ale yakka ale kutuk mɔnuŋku ale kpanaŋa ale ligmɔniŋka a yaa jam muriŋ bɛ ase vɔtta ate ba yali a basi diila. Alege ate piuŋku a taari lik tɛŋka meena.
36<<Gɔdaasimaŋa ale la, ti yaa ale weeni di kiri a sak Naawa. 37Fi ka Nalima Naab. Wenŋmazuk Wenni ate fu ka pagrim ale zuaka ale zula. 38Ate wa yaa pai nuruba ale duŋsa ale nuinsaŋa a nyo fi nisima po. Kauk kuui meena ate ba boro la, fi ale a nya ba zuk. Fi abe le ligmɔniŋ zukku.
39<<Fi ŋaaŋnyiŋ, naam bu choa ale ŋman yiti bula a kan pagra ase fi la. Bu choa ale ŋman yiti a saari buta buta ale ŋman nya pagrim tɛŋka meena zuk. 40Kpeglimka po, buui ale saari sinaansiwa po la, bula ale pagra kama ase kutuk la. Ase kutuk ale pagra a kaasi jaab meena la, naam bula ale kaasi m tila meena. 41Ase fi ale nya ale naŋsaŋa kabta a chim yak alege kabta mɛ kuta la, naamu mɛ a za ka poori ka dila. Bu ale diem ta pagrim magadega ase kutuk la, ase fi ale nya ale kutuk ale yak ale gum chaab diila. 42Ase naŋsaŋa kabta ale chim kutuk, kabta mɛ a chim yak la, naamu kauk ale pagra alege kauk a wobsa. 43Ase fi ale nya ale kutuk ale yak a damu chaab la, ku a sak kama ayen nuruma mɛ ka tɔgatɔga a dam chaab. Ba ka nɔiyeŋ ase yak ale kutuk ale ka diila.
44<<Nalimaŋa de daaŋa po, Wen dii ale bo wenŋmazuk la ale basi ate naam bu choa a jam bula a kan maara kaasi yaase naam bu choa a nya pagrim ka zuwa bula ale kaasi naam tila meena ate bu poom kan maa boro. 45Gɔdaasimaŋa kiri ale nna ase fi ale nya ale piuŋ a kasi alege ate nuru nisima an tiri kula. Piuŋku a nak kutukku ale jabuui ale a nye ase kutuk mɔnuŋ la ale yakka ale kpanaŋa ale ligmɔniŋka a kaasi la. <<Wen dii ale zuak la a pai sak Naawa dii ale ku nye chum po la kama, gɔdaasimaŋa ka wensie.>>
46Naab Nebukadnezzar a yaa lo tɛŋ Daniel niŋ a te wa zula. 47Naawa a weeni Daniel ayen, << Fi Wenni ka wena meena Wen ale ŋman chim nalima meena Nyɔnɔ waai ale pai wasusuga a sak, fi a baga a weeni wasusugni de kama.
48Naawa yaa te Daniel tiirita nna yegayega wa jam basi ate wa chim ka nuru kpioŋ Babilon tɛŋka po ale basi ate wa a nya nuru baai meena ale ta yam la zuk. 49Daniel yaa bek ate Naawa a lueri Sadrak ale Mesak ale Abednego ate ba mɛ a chim kpaga Babilon tɛŋka po alege ate Daniel dek a wari bo naab yenni po.

Title: DANIEL 3
Content:
1Naab Nebukadnezzar a jam sɛ ka ligmɔniŋ bɔgluk ate ku woglimmu a paari anamagib kook ale pisiye, ku labsimu mɛ a paari anamagib pi ale buye. Wa jam sɛ ku ka Dura ale bo Babilon tɛŋka po la. 2Wa wi tɛŋka niŋdeerɔma ale kpaŋŋa ale baai ale a sak naawa wie la ale baai ale a nya ligra zuk ale boteerɔba ayen ba jam ate ba piilim jaamu puusika. 3Niŋdeerɔma ale kpaŋŋa ale baai ale a sak naawa wie la ale baai ale a nya ligra zuk ale boteerɔba ayen ba jam ate ba tigsi jam ate ba piilim bɔglukku ate Nebukadnezzar a sɛ la puusika. 4Kpagni a yaa weeni ate ku jueli ayen, <<Ku ale a magsi ayen ni a nye diila ale nna: nuruba, tɛŋsa meena ale nuru meena ale biik buuri meena. 5Ase nama dan wom ale damunsa ale paampuuŋta ale dunduirisa ale bagansa ale kpanta ale wiisa ale jabuui meena ate ba pai a leni yiila la a nuemu, ku a magsi kama ayen ni koori tɛŋ a puusi ligmɔniŋka bɔglukku ate Naab Nebukadnezzar a sɛ la. 6Waai ale a zɛri a kan koori tɛŋ a puusi bɔglukku la, kula choa nyɔnɔwa ba yuk wa a basi ka bolimu po. 7Ase ba ale ga wom ale damunsaŋa ale paampuuŋtaŋa ale dunduirisaŋa ale bagansaŋa ale kpantaŋa ale wiisaŋa ale jabuui meena ate ba pai a leni yiila la a nak la, tɛŋ meena ale nuru meena a yaa jam lo tɛŋ a puusi ligmɔniŋka bɔglukku ate Naab Nebukadnezzar a sɛ la.
8Dila po baai ale a zamsi chiŋmarisa wie la a yaa poli ayen ba kaasi Juuma yuei. 9Ba weeni naab Nebukadnezzar ayen, <<Naaba, boro taam wuu! 10Fi weeni kama ayen waai meena a dan wom ale damunsaŋa ale paampuuŋtaŋa ale dunduirisaŋa ale bagansaŋa ale kpantaŋa ale wiisa ale jabuui meena ate ba pai a leni yiila a nak ba koori tɛŋ a puusi ligmɔniŋka bɔglukku, 11alege waai a dan zɛri an puusi ya, ku choa nyɔnɔwa ba yuk wa a basi bolim wuluku po. 12Alege Juuma gela baai ate fi a lueri ayen ba chim kpaga Babilon tɛŋsaŋa po la, Sadrak ale Mesak ale Abednego, bala a zɛri fi ale weeni diila kama Naaba. Bala an tom a te fi wenaŋa yaase ba puusi ligmɔniŋka bɔglukku ate fi a sɛ la.
13Nebukadnezzar sui yaa jam puuri. Wa yaa tom wi Sadrak ale Mesak ale Abednego ate ba yaa ta ba jo naawa jigi. 14Nebukadnezzar a bek ba ayen, <<Sadrak ale Mesak ale Abednego ka wensie ayen nama a kan tom a te mi wenaŋa yaase ni puusi ligmɔniŋka bɔglukku ate mi sɛ la? 15Nya kude ni dan wom damunsaŋa ale paampuuŋta ale dunduirisaŋa ale bagansaŋa ale kpantaŋa ale wiisaŋa ale jabuui meena ale a leni yiila la, ni dan gomsi ayen ni koori a puusi bɔglukku ku nala. Alege ni dan kan puusi ku, ba ale pai ni a nyo ka bolim wuluku po. Ka wen boa ale di vari ni mi nisa po a basi?>>
16Sadrak ale Mesak ale Abednego a yaa tulisi ayen, <<Nebukadnezzar ku an magsi ayen tama a nak nanpaga ale fu wanni de nyiŋŋa. 17Ase tama dan poom bo bolimu wuluku po Wen dii ate tama va la ale yeeri ti a ta nyini fi nisima po a nyini Naaba. 18Alege wa dan kan poom a yeeri ti, tama a yaali kama ayen fi seba Naaba, tama a kan tom a te fi wenaŋa yaase ti koori tɛŋŋa a puusi fi ligmɔniŋka bɔglukku ate fi a sɛ la.>>
19Nebukadnezzar sui a yaa puuri ate wa ninaŋa a deri tagri a ta va chaab ale Sadrak ale Mesak ale Abednego ale nye diila. Wa yaa weeni ayen ba basi ate bolimu a toliŋ ku naŋtuok nɔi buyopɔi a gaam ku ale poom ka diila. 20Dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ, wa yaa wi tugurik tɔŋdɔma ayen ba bobi Sadrak ale Mesak ale Abednego a yuk ba a basi bolimu po. 21Nuruma de ba jam yuk ba kama a basi bolimu po ale ba kɔlimaŋa. 22Naawa wanni a jam pagra kama, bolimu mɛ a toliŋ ate bu wuluku nyiini a ko tugurik tɔŋdɔma baai ale pai Sadrak ale Mesak ale Abednego a yuk basi bolimu po la. 23Ate nuruma de batawa ate ba jam bobi a yik nna giŋgiŋ la, ba jam yuk ba kama a basi bolimu po.
24Naab Nebukadnezzar yaa yiti zaani ŋmai nna nwuli a bek ba ayen daa nuruba bata ate tama a bobi a yuk basi bolimu po la? Ba yaa tulisi ayen mm.
25Wa yaa tulisi ayen, <<Nya, mi nya ka nuruba banaansi ale a cheŋ bolimu po. Ba waai waai la an bobi ya yaase wari a nye ba. Waai ale saari banaansiwa la a nye ase ka wenaŋa biik la.>>
26Nebukadnezzar yaa torisi paari bolimu ale na ayen, <<Sadrak ale Mesak ale Abednego Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La tomteerɔma ni nyini a jam de!>> Sadrak ale Mesak ale Abednego yaa nyini bolimu po a nyini. 27Tɛŋka niŋdeerɔma ale kpaŋŋa ale baai ale a sak naawa wie la meena a yaa jam gilim ba. Ba yaa nya ale bolimu an dɛ ba nyiŋsaŋa yaase ba kɔbtaŋa. Ba gattaŋa mɛ an jam dɛ bolimoa ate bolim nyum mɛ ka ba nyiŋsaŋa.
28Nebukadnezzar a pai pimpauk a te Sadrak ale Mesak ale Abednego Wen, waai ale tom wa maarɔwa ate wa jam vari wa tomteerɔma a basi la. Ba ta siaka ale ba Wenni alege a zɛri mi ale weeni ba ayen ba nye diila. Ba siak ayen ba dam poom kpi a zunchoŋŋa ba ale puusi wen dii ale kan daa ba Wen la. 29M kan siak ate nuru a nyini tɛŋka po yaase buui diipo a weeni wari a kaasi ba Wenni. Nuru waai a dan nye dila, ti ale ko kula choa nyɔnɔwa kama ale wa yenni demma dii nyiŋla bɔgluk a ka pagrim a vari nuru a basi.
30Kude nyiŋ naawa yaa basi ate Sadrak ale Mesak ale Abednego a chim nuru kpienta Babilon tɛŋka po.

Title: DANIEL 4
Content:
1Naab Nebukadnezzar a tom gbaŋsa a te nuru meena ale buuri meena tɛŋka po ayen, Mi a puusi ni meena.
2Ku nye mu masim nna yegayega wakperikaliik kaai ate Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La a nye te mu la. 3Nya wa wakinkagla, nya wa wakperisa ale zuak dii ya wa naamu a boro ka dila taam wuu, ate wa pagrimu mɛ a bo ale gaŋsa meena.
4Mi Nebukadnezzar a jam bo ka m yenni po a jigsi a dɛ masim, 5Mi yaa gɔdaasim a yɔgsa. Ase mi ale doa m gaduokku zuk la mi yaa nya yisuŋ m gɔdaasini po, dii ale nye ate mi a chali yɔgsum. 6Mi a yaa wi yam nyama meena Babilon tɛŋka po ayen ba jam a weeni gɔdaasimaŋa kiri a sak mu. 7Sampoporisaŋa ale chichirik wiirisaŋa ale baai ale a zamsi chiŋmarisa wie la meena a jam ate mi a weeni ba m gɔdaasimaŋa alege bala an baga a weeni mu ŋa kiriya. 8Daniel yaa jam ate mi weeni wa m gɔdaasimaŋa. Wa yuei di choa ale Beltesazzar mi te wa yuenni de a ta va chaab ale ka m wenni yuei. Wen weleŋsaŋa chiika ale bo ale wa.
9M weeni ayen, <<Beltesazzar sampoporisaŋa naawa, mi seba ayen wen weleŋsaŋa chiika a bo fu po kama ate wasusugi a karo a pagra a te fu. M gɔdaasimaŋa ale nna weeni ŋa kiri a sak mu. 10M gɔdaasimaŋa ale nna. Diipo ate mi a doa m gaduokku zuk la, m goomu po mi nya ka tiib ale wɔŋa a za tɛŋka suŋsuŋ. Bu ŋmasi wɔŋa ka nna yegayega. 11Tiimu chim zuak, a pagra ate bu woglimmu a tiri chiŋmaaŋa. Tɛŋka meena jam a nya bu kama. 12Bu vaataŋa a jam nala kama, bu yɔnaŋa mɛ a piisi ate bu zuk a ta ŋandiinta a te waai meena. Duŋsaŋa tɛŋka po meena a zaani bu yɔgsummu po, nuinsaŋa mɛ a kali bu naŋsaŋa zuk, ŋanvuta meena jam a dɛ ka dula.
13Mi gɔdaasimaŋa po ase mi ale diem doa m gaduokku zuk la, mi yaa nya maarɔ waai ale welema la ale wa nyini wenŋmazuk a cheen tɛŋzuk de. 14Wa yaa wi ale lueluk pagrik ayen che tiimu a lɔnsi tɛŋ, gebi bu naŋsaŋa kpaanti bu vaataŋa a basi abe fi kati bu yɔnaŋa a waaŋ, basi ate duŋsaŋa a waaŋ bu tɛŋ abe nuinsaŋa a basi bu naŋsaŋa mɛ. 15Alege basi bu kinni ale bu tɛŋ naŋsaŋa, pai kutuk ale kutuk mɔnuŋ a lik si abe fi basi ate si bo wuuku ale tantaŋa po. Basi ate wenŋmazuk maglimu a lo wa abe fi basi ate wa gum duŋsaŋa ale bo tɛŋka po la. 16Basi ate wa popolaŋa a tagri a chim duŋ popola a ta ga paari bena ŋayopɔi.
17Kude meena a nyini ka maarɔ weleŋsaŋa jigi kude a nye kama ayen ku sak baai ale vua la ayen Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La ale a nya nurubiik tɛŋka zuk ale pai ka a te waai ate wa a yaali la, poom ka nuru baai ale pɔsima la.
18Gɔdaasini dii ate mi Naab Nebukadnezzar a ta la ale la. Beltesazzar, weeni mu di kiri ale yam nyɔnɔ a ka tɛŋka po a baga a weeni di kiri a sak mu. Alege fi baga kama, dii nyiŋla wen weleŋsaŋa chiika a bo fu po kama.
19Daniel waai yuei ale jam chim Beltesazzar la ku yaa jam cha wa, wa popolaŋa a jam kasim a daani wa kama. Naawa yaa weeni ayen, <<Beltesazzar, kan basi ate gɔdaasini ale di kiri a daani fu.>> Beltesazzar yaa tulisi ale weeni ayen, <<M nyɔnɔ, gɔdaasimaŋa a ta va chaab ale ka baai ale kisi fu la, ŋa kiri mɛ abe le fi dachaasaŋa. 20Tiimu ate fi a nya ale bu chim zuak ale pagra ale wɔŋa a tiri chiŋmaaŋa ate tɛŋka meena a nya bu la, 21ate bu vaataŋa a nala, ate bu yɔnaŋa a piisi a te ŋanvuta meena, le ta yɔgsum ate duŋsa a zaani bu tɛŋ ate nuinsaŋa mɛ a yɔk tugta bu naŋsaŋa zuk la. 22Naaba, fi abe le tiimu, fi a zuak kama ale pagra ate fi zuaka a paari chiŋmaaŋa ate tɛŋka meena a nya fu.
23Naaba, waai ate fi a nya ale wa welema a nyini wenŋmazuk a weeni ayen ba che tiimu a lɔnsi a kaasi bu abe ba basi bu tɛŋ naŋsaŋa ate si bo tantaŋa ale wuuku po, pai kutuk ale kutuk mɔnuŋ a lik abe bu kinni a bo tɛŋ. Basi ate maglim a lo wa, basi ate wa boro ase duŋ la a ta ga paari bena ŋayopɔi.
24Di kiri abe le nna: Naaba, Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La ale te m nyɔnɔwa naawa kaamka de. 25Fi kala fi nyini nurubisa po a nyini kama a ga gum duŋsa po. Fi ale ŋɔbi wuuk ase naab la ate maglim mɛ a lo fu a ta ga paari bena ŋayopɔi ate fi yaa ale miŋ ayen Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La ale soa tɛŋka meena a nya alege pai ka a te waai ate wa a mariŋ la. 26Wa ale weeni ayen ba basi tiimu kinni ate bu naŋsaŋa a bo tantaŋa po la kiri ale fi ale ŋman pilim chim fi daam ale ka diila ase fi ale miŋ ayen pagrim a bo ka Wen jigi la. 27Dila nyiŋla naaba, be siak dii ate mi a weeni fu la zɛri biem abe fi a nye dii ale nala. Basi gaasa abe fi a nye wamaŋsa a te niwoba. Da dii dai fi daa a nye dila fi jigsika ale gum du a te fu kama.
28Nya ŋade meena yaa sum jam nye Naab Nebukadnezzar. 29Chiisa pi ale siyewa po, ase Naawa ale jam bo wa yenni gboŋku zuk Babilon tɛŋka po a cheŋ la, 30wa yaa weeni ayen, <<Babilon tɛŋka daa mi ale sɛ ale m dek pagrim ale m zulaŋa?>>
31Wieŋa a diem jam bo ka wa nɔnni po ate lueluk a nyini wenŋmazuk a weeni ayen dii ale za ku nye fu la ale nna. Naab Nebukadnezzar: fi kala ayen fi jɔk fi naamu kama. 32Fi ale nyini nurubisa po a nyini kama ate fi ale kasim a bo ale gɔi duŋsa. Fi ale kasim a ŋɔbi wuuta ase naab la a ta ga paari bena ŋayopɔi ate fi a yaa dan miŋ ayen Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La ale soa tɛŋka ale nuru meena ale baga pai naata a te waai meena ate wa a yaali la.>>
33Wa dii ale jam weeni a magsi chaab ale Nebukadnezzar la a sum jam nye. Wa yaa jam nyini nurubisa po a nyini kama ale a dɛ wuuk ase duŋ la. Maglim mɛ jam kasim a lo wa kama, ate wa kɔbtaŋa mɛ a nye ase jiiruk kɔbta la, wa ninyeensaŋa a nye ase nuinsa nampei la.
