42<<Ni kpesi nidek abe ni a limisi, dii nyiŋla ni zɛ dai dii danni ate ni Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita a cheena la. 43Ni basi ate m weeni ni ayen ase yeri nyɔnɔ a dan seba ayen zueba ale jam wa yeri, wa ale kasim a nya kama ate zuema a kan baga a jo zu. Wa kan goa see ka wa nin yik ba. 44Diipo ate nama a kan ŋman poli ayen Mi Saalɔbiika ale jam la, dila po ale m cheena. Ka dila ale soa ayen ni gomsi a magsi a limisi la.
45<<Ka nama wana dek ale wa chim wensie ale yam nyɔnɔ wieŋa de meena po? Ku a nye ase ka yeri nyɔnɔ waai ale lueri wa tomteerɔma po wanyi ayen wa chim kpagi mbala zuk abe wa a te ba ŋandiinta diipo ale magsi la. 46Tomteerɔ waai ate wa kpagi a jam paari ale wa a tom wa tuini la a ta suipeentik kama. 47Wensie ate mi a weeni ni, yenni nyɔnɔwa yaa le basi ate wa a nya wa yenni ŋantaŋa meena zuk a te wa. 48Alege tomteerɔwa waai ate yenni nyɔnɔwa a lueri la, a dan ka nyiŋworuk nyɔnɔ, wa a weeni wadek kama ayen wa nyɔnɔwa a kan jamu nwuli. 49Dila nyiŋla wa yaa yik wa tomteerɔ chaama a nak kama alege cheŋ a ga gum baai ale boro a dɛ ŋandiinta ale a nyu daata a bugi la jigi. 50Dai dii danni ate wa kan poli ayen wa nyɔnɔwa a cheena la, dai dila danni dek ate wa cheena. 51Wa nyɔnɔwa a dan jam nya dii ate wa tom la, wa sui ale puuri nna yegayega ale wa, ate wa namsi wa abe wa pai wa a gum chaab ale sakpaŋ zula nyama. Wa ale bo ka dula a kum abe wa a ŋɔbi wa nyinaŋa.

Title: MATIU 25
Content:
1<<Wen naamu ale nye ase ka nipokbilisa piwa baai ale yiti pai ba zeuŋta a ta cheŋ ayen ba tu nipok fiaka nyɔnɔwa la. 2Ba piwa po ka banu ale jam ta yam, alege mbala banuwa me a jam chim betta. 3Bettaŋa tinuwa a yaa pai ba zeuŋtaŋa alege ba an pai kpaam a magsi ase mbula a dan nueri abe ba pai nyoro la. 4Alege yammu nyama a ta kpaam a gum du a magsi ayen mbula a dan nueri abe ba pai nyoro. 5Nipok fiaka nyɔnɔwa a yaa an jam nwuli, ate nipokbilisaŋa yaa doa a goa.
6<<Ku le jam paari goota suŋsuŋ la, nuru wanyi yaa kaari ayen, <Nipok fiaka nyɔnɔ a cheena. Ni yiti nwuli ate ni ga tu wa.> 7Nipokbilisaŋa piwa yaa deri yiti nna nwuli a viriŋ ayen ba nya ase ba zeuŋtaŋa diem a dɛ ya. 8Bettaŋa nyama zeuŋtaŋa kpaamu nyiini ale jam nueri, ate ba yaa weeni yammu nyama ayen ba nye ba kpaamu a te ba ate ba nyo ba zeuŋtaŋa po. 9Yammu nyama yaa weeni ba ayen, <Tama kpaamu an soa diiya. Dila nyiŋ, ni cheŋ yeeŋa po a ga da kpaam.> 10Bettaŋa yaa cheŋ ayen ba da ba kpaamu. Ba le cheŋ a ga nueri la, nipok fiaka nyɔnɔwa a yaa jam. Yammu nyama ale poom ta ba kpaamu a magsi la, yaa deri va nipok fiaka nyɔnɔwa a jo yenni po ayen ba maa dɛ nipok fiak ŋandiintaŋa. Ba meena ale jo yenni po a nueri la, ba yaa yik nansuiŋku tuoku a lik. 11Ku le ga nye magadek la, bettaŋa tinuwa yaa le ŋmani jam paari la ale tuoku a lik kama. Ba yaa za tuoku nɔi a nak ale a wi ayen ba jam lagri a te ba. 12Nipok fiaka nyɔnɔwa ale wom ba luelutaŋa la, wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <Ni goori ni wanni abe ni cheŋ du. Mi zɛ ni ale ka baai la.> 13Ni chiib a limisi, dii nyiŋla ni zɛ diipo ate mi a cheena la.
14<<Mi dan ŋman jam, Wen naamu ale nye ase ka nuru waai ale gomsi a magsi ayen wa nyiem la. Wa le gomsi nueri la, wa yaa wi wa tomteerɔma batawa yaa pai wa ŋantaŋa meena a nyo ba nisima po ayen ba a nya ba zuk ate wa jam. 15Wa yaa pai wa ŋantaŋa a chari ba a va waai meena ale a tom wa tuima diila. Wa yaa te niŋ nyɔnɔwa ligra tusa ŋanu (5,000), ale te waai ale pai saŋ la ligra tusa ŋaye (2,000), ale ge te butawa nyɔnɔwa ligra tusidi. Wa le chari ba nueri la, wa yaa cheŋ. 16Tomteerɔ waai ale tuesi ligra tusa ŋanuwa (5,000) la, a pai ŋa kama a gerim a nya ligra tusa ŋanu (5,000) nyuenta. 17Buyewa nyɔnɔwa mɛ ale tuesi ligra tusa ŋayewa (2,000) la, a pai ŋa kama a gerim a nya ligra tusa ŋaye (2,000) mɛ nyuenta. 18Alege tomteerɔ waai ale tuesi ligra tusini la a pai wa nyɔnɔwa ligraŋa kama a tu tɛŋ a gu.
19<<Ku yaa ale ga beni ate ba nyɔnɔwa a nyini wa nyeerimu jigini a jam la ate wa yaa wi ba ayen ba jam wa jigi. Ba le jam wa jigi la, wa yaa bek ba ayen wa a yaali kama ayen wa nya waai meena ale pai wa ligra a gerim a nya dii nyuenta la. 20Tomteerɔwa waai ale tuesi ligra tusa ŋanuwa (5,000) la, yaa nyini a weeni wa ayen, <M nyɔnɔ, fi daam pai ka ligra tusa ŋanu (5,000) a te mi ate mi yaa pai ŋa a gerim a nya ligra tusa ŋanu (5,000) nyuenta a ŋman gum du.> 21Wa nyɔnɔwa yaa weeni wa ayen, <Fi ka nuru maŋ ale nye ate ku nala. Mi daam pai ka ligra maga dega a nyo fi nisima po alege fi yaa baga a nye ate ŋa zuak a gum du. Yɔgyɔgla de mi a yaali kama ayen m pai ligra yegayega a nyo fi nisima po ate fi ale mi ta suipeentik.>
22<<Tomteerɔwa waai ale tuesi ligra tusa ŋayewa (2,000) la, mɛ yaa nyini a weeni ayen, <M nyɔnɔ, fi daam pai ka ligra tusa ŋaye (2,000) a te mi ate mi yaa pai ŋa a gerim a nya ligra tusa ŋaye (2,000) nyuenta a ŋman gum du.> 23Wa nyɔnɔwa yaa weeni wa ayen, <Fi mɛ ka nuru maŋ ale nye ate ku nala. Mi daam pai ka ligra maga dega a nyo fi nisima po, alege fi a yaa baga a nye ate ŋa zuak a gum du. Yɔgyɔgla de mi a yaali kama ayen m pai ligra yegayega a nyo fi nisima po, ate fi ale mi a ta suipeentik.>
24<<Tomteerɔwa waai ale tuesi ligra tusini la, mɛ yaa nyini a taam zaani wa niŋ a weeni ayen, <M nyɔnɔ, m seba ayen fi nyeka tua kama, dii nyiŋla fi a che ka za ŋaai ate fi an bori la ale a vaari za ŋaai mɛ ate fi an fɔbi la. 25Fi le pai ligraŋa a te mi la, mi daam a chali ka yɔgsum yaa ta ŋa a ga tu tɛŋ a gu. Nya, lig ŋaai ate fi daam a pai te mi la ale nna.>
26<<Wa nyɔnɔwa ale wom dii ate wa weeni la, wa sui yaa jam puuri nna yegayega ale wa ate wa yaa weeni wa ayen, <Fi ka nuru biok ale nyiŋworuk nyɔnɔ. Fi a poli kama ayen mi a che ka za ŋaai ate mi an bori la ale a vaari za ŋaai mɛ ate mi an fɔbi la. 27Ku magsi kama ayen fi daam ate pai m ligraŋa a te ka nuru waai ale wa pai ŋa a gerimu a nya nyuenta a gum du a te mu la. 28Tuesi ligraŋa wa jigi a pai ŋa a te m tomteerɔma wanyi wa waai ale ta ligra tusa piwa (10,000) la.
29<<Nuru waai ale a pii nyiŋla, ale nya ŋanta a gum du, alege waai ale kan a pii nyiŋla a kan nya jaaboa. 30Ni yik nyiŋworuk nyɔnɔwa de a ta wa a nyini peelim a yuk basi legini po. Dula jigini wa le kum nna yegayega, abe wa a ŋɔbi wa nyinaŋa.>
31<<Alege Mi Saalɔbiika a dan jam ale m zulaŋa ale wa maarɔma m le jam a kala ka m naamu zukpaglika zuk a yaa soa tɛŋka meena. 32Abe m wi waai meena ate ba tigsi a jam m tɛŋ. M le poori ba buye ase naapeerik ale a poori wa piisa ale wa bua diila. 33M le yik baai ale a nye ase piisa la a zaani m juga geŋ, abe m yik baai mɛ ale a nye ase bua la a zaani m gala geŋ.
34<<Naawa yaa weeni baai ale bo m juga geŋ la ayen, <M Kowa a maari ni abe wa niak ni. Wa le jam a nye tɛŋzuk meena la, wa gomsi ka ŋanta a zaani a te ni. Ni be jam a tuesi ba yɔgyɔgla de. 35Kɔm ale jam ta mi la, nama a te mu ŋandiinta ate m dɛ. Nyanyuila mɛ ale jam ta mu la, ni te mu nyiam ate m nyu. M le jam ka nichaanɔ la, ni nye m tia ale ta mu a jo ni yeeŋa po. 36Mi ale jam kan ta gatta la, ni te mu gatta ate m jo. Mi ale jam a yuak la, ni nya m zuk. Ba le jam yik mu a lik la, ni jam a puusi mu.> 37Baai ale ka wayɔrisima nyam a za m juga geŋ la, ba wanyi ale weeni mu ayen, <Naawen yaa, ka dimpo ate tama a nya fu ale kɔm a ta fu ate ti te fu ŋandiinta ate fi dɛ? Ka dimpo mɛ ate tama a nya fu ale nyanyuila a ta fu ate ti te fu nyiam ate fi nyu? 38Ka dimpo ate tama a nya fu ale fi chim nichaanɔ ate tama a nye fi tia ale yik fu a ta jo ti yeeŋa po? Ka dimpo mɛ ate tama a nya fu ale fi an jo gatta ate tama a te fu gatta ayen fi jo? 39Ka dimpo mɛ ate tama a nya fu ale fi a yuak yaase ba yik fu a lik ate tama a jam puusi fu?> 40Naawa weeni ba ayen, <Wensie ate mi a weeni ni ayen dii meena ate nama a nye a te mi ŋaaŋviirɔma po baaŋka mɛ dek la, ni nye a te ka mi dila.>
41<<Dula jigini m le cheem a weeni tuimbaata nyama baai ale bo m gala geŋ la ayen, <Nama baai ate Naawen a ka te ni la, ni cheŋ du mi tɛŋ a cheŋ bolim buui ale kan maara kpimsi ate Naawen a gomsi a magsi a te jabioku ale wa maarɔma. 42Kɔm ale jam ta mu la, nama an te mi ŋandiinta ayen m dɛ. Nyanyuila ale jam ta mu la, nama an te mi nyiam ayen m nyu. 43Mi le jam ka nichaanɔ la, nama an te mi tia ale ta mu a jo ni yeeŋa po. Mi le jam kan ta gatta a jo la, nama an te mi gatta ayen m jo. Mi le jam a yuak ale bo likka dɔk po mɛ la, nama an jam ayen ni nya mi zuwa.> 44Baai ale jam za m gala geŋ la, ba wanyi ale weeni mu ayen, <Naawen yaa, ka dimpo ate tama a nya fu ale kom a yaase nyanyuila a ta fu? Ka dimpo mɛ ate tama a nya fu ale fi ka nichaanɔ yaase fi ka gatta a jo? Ka dimpo ate tama a nya fu ale fi a yuak yaase ba yik fu a lik dɔk po, alege tama an maari fu?> 45M le ŋman weeni ba ayen, <Wensie ate mi a weeni ni ayen diipo meena ate nama an jam maari mi ŋaaŋviirɔma po baaŋka mɛ dek la, nama an maari daa mi.> 46Bade ale jɔk ninam buui ale kan ta kpeglimka la, alege wayɔrisima nyama ale nya nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la.>>

Title: MATIU 26
Content:
1Yeezu ale jam sak wa ŋaaŋviirɔma wieŋa de meena a nueri la, wa yaa weeni ba ayen, 2<<Ni seba ayen tali ka da ŋaye ate Gaambasika Tigini a paari. Ba le yik Mi Saalɔbiika a te ate ba kpi wa jabarim nyiŋ.>>
3Va ŋala po kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa ale Juuma nisɔmma yaa tigsi chaab kaabteerɔ kpioŋku Kayafas dabiaka po, 4ayen ba poli a nya suik ate ba va a suk yik Yeezu a ko. 5Alege ba yaa ŋman weeni chaab ayen, <<Ase ti dan yik wa nuru boanni baai ale tigsi chaab ayen ba dɛ tigini dɛ la suŋsuŋ, ba le jam yiti ale nɔiyeŋ a nyiem a kaasi tuima tɛŋka po.>>
6Dai yeŋ po ate Yeezu yaa jam bo Simon yenni po Betani tɛŋka. Simon wala a jam ta ka gama tuem. 7Nipok wanyi yaa nyini peelim a ta kpa buui nyum ale masa nna yegayega la a jam jo Yeezu jigi a kpiiri bu a nyo wa zuk. 8Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma ale ga nya nipowa ale nye diila, ba sue yaa puuri ale wa. Ba yaa jam a poli ba suiniima po ayen, <<Ka boa ale soa ate nipowa de a pai kpaamu a yik kaasi nna la? 9Wa dan poom a pai bu a da ligra yegayega a pai ŋa a te ŋanjaksaŋa, dila an zunchoŋŋa?>>
10Yeezu yaa jam seba dii ate ba a poli la, a yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ka boa ate wa le nye diila a daani nama? Ni basi wa, dii nyiŋla wa tom ka wamaŋ a te mi. 11Niwomma a kasim bo ale nama kama daa meena, alege mi a kan bo ale ni a ta a cheŋŋi. 12Nipowa de a kpiiri kpaamu a nyo mi zuk a gomsi mi nyiŋka a magsi ka guka. 13Wensie ate mi a weeni ni, juijui meena ate nuruba a sak Wen wamaŋsaŋa la, ba le weeni nipowa de ale nye dii a te mi la. Ba le kasim a teeri wa yuei diipo meena wuu.>>
14Da ŋala po Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma pi ale bayewa po wanyiwa waai ate ba a wi wa ayen Judas Iskariot la, a jam yiti a cheŋ kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa jigi, 15a weeni ba ayen, <<Ase mi a dan baga a yik Yeezu a ta wa a jam a nyo ni nisima po, nama ale te mu ka boa?>> Wa le bek ba dila la, ba yaa deri chiini ligbie pisita a te wa dula jigini. 16A nyini da ŋala po a ta a cheŋ, Judas yaa nyiem a gisi ka suik ayen wa ta Yeezu a ga bobri a sak.
17Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa jam wa jigi tigi dii ate ba a ŋɔbi boroborok kuui ale kan ta dabinta la piilimka danni a weeni ayen, <<Ka bɛ ate fi a yaali ayen ti ga gomsi Gaambasika Tigini ŋandiintaŋa ate ti dɛ?>>
18Wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni cheŋ nuru wanyi jigi tɛŋka po a ga weeni wa ayen, <Ti Sagrɔwa ale tom ti ayen ti jam a weeni fu ayen wa kummu danni a moata kama. Tama ale wa ale a yaali ayen ti dɛ Gaambasika Tigini ŋandiintaŋa fi yenni po.> >>
19Wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa cheŋ ga nye dii ate wa weeni la a yaa gomsi Gaambasika Tigini ŋandiintaŋa.
20Wenni ale jam siŋ la, Yeezu ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma pi ale bayewa yaa tigsi chaab a kala a dɛ ŋandiintaŋa. 21Ba le jam boro a dɛ la, wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Wensie ate mi a weeni ni, nama po wanyi ale a yaali ayen wa ta mi a ga bobri sak.>>
22Wa ŋaaŋviirɔma ale wom dii ate wa weeni ba la, ba meena sue yaa jam kaasi ate ba yaa bek wa wanyi wanyi ayen, <<M Nyɔnɔ Yeezu Kirisita, ka mi?>>
23Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Nuru waai ale kala dela pai wa boroborok a maari a suiik jentaŋa ale mi dek la, ale wa ta mu a ga bobri sak. 24Mi Saalɔbiika ale kpi ase ka ba ale ŋmarisi dii Wen gbaŋka po la. Alege ku le pagra kama a te waai dek ale wa ta mu a ga bobri sak la. Ku zunchoŋ kama ale ba nin poom kan biak wa.>>
25Judas waai ale jam a yaali ayen wa ta Yeezu a ga bobri la yaa bek wa ayen, <<M Sagrɔ, ka mi?>> Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Ka fi.>>
26Ba ale boro a dɛ ŋandiintaŋa la, Yeezu yaa pai boroborok a puusi a te Wen a nye wa jiam, alege ŋmari ku a chari wa ŋaaŋviirɔma ale weeni ba ayen, <<Ni ŋoa ŋɔbi, mi nyiŋka ale nna.>>
27Wa yaa ŋman pai beerik ale daam a puusi a te Wen jiam, alege pai te ba ate ba nyu, wa yaa weeni ba ayen, 28<<Ka mi nɔiyeŋ paalika ziimu ale nna. Buui ale a nyini nuruba yega nyiŋla, ate Wen a vɔŋ ba tuimbaataŋa a te ba. 29Mi a weeni ni, m kan ŋman nyu daamu de nin ka dai dii danni ate m ŋman a nyu da paalimu m Kowa naamu po la.>>
30Ba yaa yi yiili alege a nyini ga jueli Olivi Guuku zuk.
31Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni meena ale chali waaŋ chaab mi nyiŋ yokku de. Diila ba ŋmarisi kama ayen, M le siti naapeerika ate piisa a waaŋ chaab. (Zakaria 13:7) 32Alege m dan yiti kum po, m le dɛ ni niŋ a cheŋ Galili tɛŋka.>> 33Piita yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Fi ŋaaŋviirɔma meena a dan basi fu, mi kan maara basi fu diipo.>> 34Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Basi ate m weeni fu, yokku de fi ale pagsi ku nɔi buta ayen fi zɛ mi, alege ate vari kpadiaka a kum.>> 35Piita yaa ŋman weeni wa ayen, <<Mi kan weeni ayen m zɛ fu. Mi dan poom ayen m kpi ale fu, mi kan weeni dila.>> Wa ŋaaŋviirɔma meena mɛ a weeni dila dekdega.
36Ba yaa jam paari jigi ate ba a wi ayen Getsemani, ate Yeezu yaa weeni wa ŋaaŋviirɔma ayen, <<Ni kali dela ate m cheŋ a ga puusi a te Naawen abe m jam.>> 37Wa le a cheŋ la, wa yaa basi ate Piita ale Jeemsi ale wa suoku Jɔɔn, Zebedi nidoabilisaŋa a va wa. Ku yaa piilim a daani wa ate wa sui a kaasi. 38Wa weeni ba ayen, <<M sui ale kaasi nna yegayega, ate ku a nye nna ase mi a yaali ayen m kpi kama la. Ni be limisi dela ate m jam, abe ni kpesi a nya.>>
39Wa le ŋman cheŋ magadek la, wa yaa kpi duna tɛŋ a puusi a te Wen ayen, <<M Koa, mi a saalim ayen ku dan ka fi popeentik, be yeeri ninammu de mi jigi a basi. Nye fidek ale a yaali diila, alege daa mi ale a yaali diila.>>
40Wa le ŋman pilim a nyini wa puusika jigini a jam la, wa yaa nya wa ŋaaŋviirɔma batawa a doa goa. Wa yaa weeni Piita ayen, <<Ka boa ate nama an baga a kali a limisi maga ale ge a goa? 41Ni a kpesi abe ni a puusi a te ni kan jo nyenyaka po, chiika a yaali kama alege nyiŋka a wobsa.>>
42Wa yaa ŋman pilim cheŋ wa puusika jigini a ga puusi a te Wen ayen, <<M Koa, ku dan kan ta nyeka alege ate fi a yaali ayen m nam bɛ basi ate fi ale a yaali diila a nye.>> 43Wa yaa ŋman pilim jam paari ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma a doa a goa, dii nyiŋla goom ale jam ta ba nna yegayega.
44Yeezu yaa ŋman pilim cheŋ a ga puusi a te Naawen ase wa le poom a puusi diila. 45Butawa po Yeezu yaa ŋman pilim jam paari a bek ba ayen, <<Ni diem a doa a goa kama? Wie meena a nueri kama. Di danni a paari ya ate ba ayen ba yik Mi Saalɔbiika a nyo tuimbaata nyam nisima po. 46Ni yiti ate ti cheŋ. Nuru waai ale ta mu a ga bobri sak la ale la a cheena.>> 47Yeezu ale diem boro a biisi la, Judas waai ale jam ka Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma pi ale bayewa po wanyi la, yaa jam wa jigi ale nuru boari yegayega. Kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa ale Juuma nisɔmma ale tom ba. Ba jam ta ka gebi kpieŋsa ale dua a jam ayen ba yik wa. 48Bumbobrɔwa a poom weeni ba kama ayen, <<Ti dan ga paari ba, nuru waai ate mi a puusi ale a gbaari wa la, ka wala ale la. Ni yik wa ale pagrim.>> 49Ba ale ga paari Yeezu la, Judas yaa deri ga wa jigi a wi wa ayen, <<M Sagrɔ,>> a yaa alege a puusi ale gbaari wa.>>
50Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<M doa, nye dii ate fi a poli ayen fi nye mu la.>> Baai ale jam va Judas la, a yaa yik wa ale pagrim. 51Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma po wanyi a deri yeeri wa gebi kpieŋ a che kaabteerɔ kpioŋku yɔmma po wanyi turi a gebi lɔnsi tɛŋ. 52Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Pa fi gebika a ŋman su ka fooku po. Diila baai ale a pai gebik la a kpi ale ka gebik. 53Nama a zɛ ayen mi baga kama a wi M Kowa ayen wa tom wa maarɔma baai ale piisi nna yegayega la ate ba jam a maari mu? 54M dan nye dila, wie ŋaai ate ba ŋmarisi mi wie Wen Gbaŋka po dipo la a kan chim wensie.>>
55Yeezu yaa viriŋ a bek nuru boanni ayen, <<Mi ka zue ate nama a ta gebi kpieŋsa ale dua a jam ayen ni yik mu? Daa meena mi kasim bo ale ni Wen Yenni po a sak ni kama, alege nama an jam yik mu. 56Ba le ŋmarisi Wen biisiteerɔma Gbaŋka po diila a sum chim ka wensie jinla.>> Dula jigini wa ŋaaŋviirɔma meena a yiti chali ale ge wa.
57Ba yaa ta Yeezu a cheŋ kaabteerɔ kpioŋku Kayafas jigi. Ba le jam ga paari dula la, Sinsak sagrɔma ale Juuma nisɔmma yaa jam tigsi chaab. 58Piita yaa mak va ba ŋaaŋ a jam jo kaabteerɔ kpioŋku yenni dabiaka po a cheŋ a ga kala ale kpagni limisidɔma ayen wa nya dii ale di nye la. 59Kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa ale Nisɔmma meena a jam bo dula a gisi nuru ayen wa weeni a sak ba ayen wa nya Yeezu ale wa boro a tom wabiok ate ba baga a nya suik a ko wa. 60Ba yaa gisi a kpeeri. Alege nuruba yegayega a diem nyini a jam za ba niŋ ayen ba velim wie a te wa. Kula ŋaaŋnyiŋ nuruba baye yaa nyini a jam za ba niŋ. 61A weeni ayen, <<Tama a wom ale Yeezu a weeni ayen wa baga a kaasi Wen yenni, abe wa ŋman se di daa ŋata po.>>
62Kaabteerɔ kpioŋku yaa yiti a cheŋ a ga zaani a bek ayen, <<Fi ka wari a tulisi ale ŋaai meena ate ba a biisi a te fu la?>> 63Alege Yeezu yaa sina. Kaabteerɔ kpioŋku yaa ŋman weeni wa ayen, <<Mi a yaali kama ayen fi pɛ Wen dii ale boro la yuenni nyiŋ abe fi weeni mu wensieŋa.>> Wa yaa bek Yeezu ayen, <<Fi ka Wen Nidoabinni waai ate ba a wi ayen Kirisita la?>> 64Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Mm, mi ale la. Ni basi ate m weeni ni ayen dai yeŋ po fi le nya Mi Saalɔbiika ale m kala Wen juga geŋ. Fi le ŋman nya mu ale m nyini Wen jigi chiŋmaaŋa po a cheena.>>
65Wa le weeni dila la, kaabteerɔ kpioŋku yaa yik wa garukku a dari cheeri ale weeni ba ayen, <<Ti kan ŋman a yaali seerɔba. Ni meena wom wa le pai wadek a magsi chaab ale Wen la. 66Nama a poli ka sɛ, wa lo yaa wa an loya?>> Ba meena yaa weeni ayen, <<Wa lo kama. Ku magsi ba ko wa kama.>>
67Nuruma ba gela yaa chesi tintueta a basi wa nyiŋ ale a nak wa. 68A weeni ayen, <<Fi a weeni ayen fi ale Kirisitawa. Be miŋ baai ale a nak fu la.>>
69Ba le ta Yeezu a nye nya kude meena la, Piita a diem bo ka yenni dabiaka po. Nipokbili wanyi a yaa jam boro. Wa jam ka kaabteerɔ kpioŋku dɔkliema po wanyi. Wa yaa nya Piita a weeni wa ayen, <<Daa fi ale poom va Galili tɛŋka denɔwa Yeezu la?>>
70Wa yaa pagsi ale baai meena ale za dula la nimbie po ale weeni wa ayen, <<Mi zɛ fi ale a biisi diila.>> 71Wa le weeni dila la, wa yaa yiti a cheŋ ga za nansuiŋku nɔi. Nipokbili wa choa a ŋman diem nya wa dula jigini ale wa za ate wa yaa weeni nuru baai ale za moata wa la ayen, <<Nuruwa de ka Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma po wanyi.>>
72Piita yaa ŋman pagsi ayen, <<M pɛ ya, mi zɛ nuruwa de.>>
73Ku an jam beniya ate baai ale jam za moata wa la wanyi a yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Fi ka ba wanyi, dii nyiŋla fi a biisi ase ka Galili denɔ la.>> 74Piita yaa weeni wa ayen, <<M pɛ ya, ka wensie ate mi a biisi. Mi zɛ nuru waai wie ate fi a biisi la.>> Wa le weeni dila a ga nueri la, vari kpadiaka yaa deri kum. 75Ate Piita yaa teeri dii ate Yeezu a poom weeni wa ayen wa le pagsi ku nɔi buta ayen wa zɛ wa, ale ge ate vari kpadiaka a kum la. Wieŋa de meena yaa nye ate Piita sui a kaasi ate wa yaa deri nyini a kum nna yegayega.

Title: MATIU 27
Content:
1Vanni ale veenti la, kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa ale Juuma nisɔmma meena a ŋman tigsi chaab ayen ba poli ba le ba nye dii a ko Yeezu la. 2Ba yaa bobi wa nisimaŋa a ta wa cheŋ Gominawa Paalɔt jigi.
3Judas waai ale jam ta Yeezu a ga bobri sak la, ale nya ba le bo Yeezu buusaŋa diila, wa sui yaa jam kaasi, ate wa yaa ŋman pilim cheŋ kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa ale Juuma nisɔmma jigi ayen wa pai ba ligbieŋa pisitawa a te ba. 4Wa le ga paari dula la, wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Wen a nya mi kaasuŋku kama, dii nyiŋla mi ta ka nuru waai ale kan kaasi wari la, a jam bobri sak nama. Yɔgyɔgla de nama mɛ a yaa bo wa kum buusa.>> Ba yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Kula a daa tama niŋŋa, alege ka fidek niŋ.>> 5Judas ale ga wom dii ate ba weeni la, wa yaa pai ligraŋa a yuk basi Wen yenni suŋsuŋ, ale ge a nyini a ga bobi miik a kpi.
6Judas ale ga nyini la, kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa yaa yiti a pisi ligraŋa ale weeni chaab ayen, <<Ligraŋa de tama pai ŋa a da ka nuru nyuvuri. Ti Sinsaŋŋa a kan siak ayen ti pai ŋa a maa gum Wen yenni ligraŋa po.>> 7Ba yaa pai ligraŋa a da tɛŋ kaai ate ba a wi ayen Samɔnsa Meka jigi la. Ba jam a yaali kama ayen ba pai dula jigini a chim nicham guka jigi. 8Ka dila ale soa ate nuruba a diem a wi dula jigini ayen Ziimu Jigini la. 9Ate Biisiteerɔwa Jeremaya ale biisi diila a chim wensie ayen, <<Ba pai ligbie pisita ŋaai ate Izirali nidoabilisaŋa gela a siak da wa la. 10Ba pai te a magsi samɔnsa mɛka jigi ase Naawen ale dak mi diila.>>
11Yeezu yaa jam taam zaani Paalɔt niŋ. Paalɔt yaa bek wa ayen, <<Ka fi ale Juuma naawa la?>> Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Ka fi ale a weeni dila.>> 12Alege kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa ale Juuma nisɔmma ale jam a ŋma wa la, wa an jam weeni wari ya. 13Paalɔt yaa bek wa ayen, <<Fi kan wom ba ale a ŋma fu ale wie ŋaai meena la?>> 14Alege Yeezu an jam tulisi wa yeŋ mɛ la. Ku yaa jam cha Paalɔt nna yegayega ale wa ale kan a tulisi wari la.
15Bena meena Gaambasika Tigini a nyiem dan paari, gominawa Paalɔt a nyiem lak nuru waai ate tɛŋka demma a yaali ayen wa lak ate wa nyini likka dɔkku po a nyini la a basi kama. 16Nuru wanyi ale jam boro ate ba a wi ayen Barabasi ate ba jam maa yik wa a lik. Nuruba a jam seba wa ka nna yegayega. 17Paalɔt yaa bek nuru baai meena ale tigsi chaab la ayen, <<Nama a yaali ayen m basi ka ba wana? Barabasi yaa Yeezu waai ate ba a wi ayen Kirisitawa la?>> 18Paalɔt jam seba ayen ka kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa nyunni nyiŋ ale soa ate ba yik Yeezu a ta jam wa jigi.
19Paalɔt ale jam diem kala boteka dɔkku po la, wa powa yaa tom weeni wa ayen, <<Kan nye nuruwa de jaaboa ale wa an kaasi wari ya. Dii nyiŋla deemwa yokku mi gɔdaasim wa wari kama ate ku daani mi nna yegayega.>> 20Kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa ale Juuma nisɔmma yaa weeni nuru boanni ayen ba saalim ate wa lak Barabasi a basi abe wa ge ate ba ko Yeezu. 21Paalɔt yaa bek nuru boanni ayen, <<Nuruma de bayewa, nama a yaali ayen m basi ka ba wana?>> Ba yaa tulisi wa ayen, <<Ti a yaali ayen fi basi ka Barabasi.>> 22Wa yaa ŋman bek ayen, <<M be nye Yeezu waai ate ba a wi ayen Kirisitawa la ka sɛ?>> Ba meena yaa tulisi ayen, <<Basi ate ba kpi wa jabarimu nyiŋ ate wa kpi.>> 23Wa ŋman bek ba ayen, <<Ka boan jaab wabiok ate wa nye?>> Ba yaa kaari nna yegayega ayen, <<Basi ate ba kpi wa jabarimu nyiŋ ate wa kpi.>>
24Paalɔt yaa nya ayen wa an baga a nye wari ya dii nyiŋla, ba nuemka ale ta kpaliŋ a jam. Wa yaa pai nyiam a nari wa nisaŋa nuru boanni niŋ, ale weeni ba ayen, <<Mi niŋ maa ka nuruwa dɛ kum po, ku bo ka nama dek jigi.>> 25Nuru boanni yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Basi ate wa kummu nyiŋ ninammu a jam tama ale ti bisaŋa jigi.>> 26Paalɔt yaa lak Barabasi a basi ale basi ate ba miiri Yeezu. Ba ale miiri wa nueri la, wa yaa pai wa te ayen ba ta wa ga kpi jabarimu nyiŋ.
27Paalɔt tugurik tɔŋdɔma yaa yik Yeezu a ta jo ba gominawa yenni dabiaka po ate ba meena a yaa gilim wa. 28Ba yaa yeeri wa gattaŋa ale pai garuk mɔnuŋ a jo wa. 29A pai munsa a yɔk zutɔk a pai vuk wa zukku ale pai tachek a nyo wa juga nisaŋa po. Ba yaa kpi duna wa niŋ a nye wa a la, ale a weeni ayen, <<Juuma naawa, kasim boro taam wuu.>> 30Ba jam chesi tintueta a basi wa nyiŋ ale pai diok a nak wa zukku. 31Ba ale nye wa la a ga nueri la, ba yaa yeeri garuk mɔnuŋku ale pai wadek gattaŋa a jo wa a ta wa nyini cheŋ ayen ba kpi wa jabarimu nyiŋ.
32Ba ale jam bo suiku po a cheŋ la, ba yaa zik Simon ale wa cheena tɛŋka po ate tugurik tɔŋdɔma a fɛ wa ate wa tuesi Yeezu jabarimu ji. Simon a jam Sairini tɛŋka denɔ.
33Ba yaa ga paari juijui ate ba a wi ayen Golgota la. Ku kiri ale Zukoluku Jigini. 34Ba yaa pai tiim a nyo daam po a lam nya ale pai te Yeezu ayen wa nyu alege wa an jam nyu ya.
35Ba yaa yik Yeezu a kpi wa jabarimu nyiŋ, ale pai wa gattaŋa a chari chaab. Ba jam nak ka gbaŋ a nya waai ale magsi garuk kuui dek la. 36Ba ale nak gbaŋka wa gattaŋa nyiŋ a nueri la, ba yaa kala a limisi ayen waai a kan vari wa a basi. 37Ba yaa pai tapagi a ŋmarisi di nyiŋ ayen, <<Ka Yeezu, Juuma Naawa Ale Nna,>> a pai di kpi jabarimu zuk.
38Ba jam maa kpi ka zueba baye ŋanbarinta nyiŋ a gum Yeezu po, ate ba wanyi a bo wa juga, nwala mɛ a bo wa gala. 39Nuru baai ale jam va dula a taam la a yaa zak zuk nya wa a mati ba noa ale a lɛ wa ayen, 40<<Fi weeni ayen fi le kaasi Wen yenni abe fi ŋman sɛ di a nueri daa ŋata po. Fi dan ka Wen Nidoabili bɛ nyini jabarimu zuk a siŋ a vari fidek a basi.>> 41Kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa ale Sinsak sagrɔma, ale Juuma nisɔmma me a jam a la wa ale a weeni ayen, 42<<Wa jam baga a vari nuruba a basi kama, alege wa an baga a vari wadek a basi. Daa wa ale Izirali Naawa? Wa dan nyini jabarimu zuk a siŋ ti yaa le ta siaka ale wa. 43Wa ta siaka kama ayen Wen ale bo le wa ale weeni ayen wa ka Wen Nidoabili. Ti be le nya ase Wen ale vari wa a basi ya.>> 44Zue baai ate ba jam kpi ba a gum Yeezu po la, mɛ a lɛ wa dila dekdega.
45Ku ale jam paari kantueŋ baŋ pi ale buye la, tɛŋka meena yaa jam nye legi nna kpitɔ a ta ga paari kantueŋ baŋ buta. 46Baŋ butawa po, Yeezu yaa kaari ate ku jueli a weeni ale wadek tɛŋka biika ayen, <<Eloi, Eloi, Lama Sabagtani.>> Ku kiri ale, <<Mi Wen yaa, mi Wen yaa, ka boa ate fi zɛri mu?>> (Yiila 22:1)
47Nuru baai ale jam za dula jigini la gela a wom dii ate wa weeni la kama. Ba yaa weeni ayen, <<Wa a wi ka Elaja.>> 48Ba po wanyi yaa chali cheŋ ga pai sosok a lusi damiisiŋ po a pai yik diok woŋ nyiŋ a zak ta jueli Yeezu nɔi. 49Nuru mbala yaa weeni ayen, <<Ni basi ate ti limisi a nya ase Elaja ale jam a yik wa a ta nyini jabarimu zuk a siŋ tɛŋ ya.>>
50Yeezu yaa ŋman kaari nna yegayega a yaa le ge kpi. 51Wa ale jam kpi la, garuk panni dii ate ba jam pai a kasi Wen yenni po la, a yaa jam cheeri di ŋmazuk a ta siŋ paari di tɛŋ. Wen jam basi kama ate tɛŋka a choa ate pinaŋa a na a mobi, 52ate nuruba yega ale jam va Wen alege a kpi la boositaŋa a lagri ate ba yiti kum po, 53alege basi boositaŋa. Ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ ate Yeezu a yiti kum po la ba yaa jo Jerusalem tɛŋka po. Nuruba yegayega ale jam nya ba. 54Tugurik tɔŋdɔma kpagni ale tugurik tɔŋdɔ baai ale jam a limisi la ale nya tɛŋka choka ale dii meena ale nye la ku yaa cha ba nna yegayega. Ba yaa weeni ayen, <<Wensie, nuruwa de sum ka Wen Nidoabili.>>
55Nipok baai ale jam maari Yeezu Galili tɛŋka po la a jam za moata dula a nya dii meena ale nye la kama. 56Baai ale jam bo ba po la ale Mɛɛri Magdalene ale Mɛɛri, Jeemsi ale Josefi mawa ale Zebedi nidoabilisaŋa mawa.
57Jigsirɔ wanyi ale jam nyini tɛŋ ate ba a wi ayen, Arimatia. Wa yuei jam ale Josefi. Wa jam ka waai ale ta siaka ale Yeezu. 58Da dila danni junɔi ate wa yaa cheŋ Paalɔt jigi a saalim wa ayen wa basi ate wa ga yeeri Yeezu nyiŋka jabarimu zuk a ta cheŋ ga gu ate Paalɔt yaa siak. 59Josefi yaa cheŋ ga yeeri Yeezu nyiŋka jabarimu zuk yaa pai garuk pali naliŋ a vili ka 60a ta ga dueni piuŋ vɔrup paalik po. Wa yaa bilim tintain kpienni a lik piuŋku vɔrumu nɔnni. 61Mɛɛri Magdalene ale Mɛɛri nwala a jam kali ka dula a tuk vɔrumu nyiŋ.
62Vari ale ŋman veenti la, ba Vuusum Danni saluiku kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa ale Farisiima yaa cheŋ Paalɔt jigi a weeni wa ayen, 63<<Ti diem a teeri velimvendika ale jam boro la wa weeni ayen, <M le yiti kum po ku daa ŋata dai.> 64Be basi ate ba ga a limisi vɔrumu ate ku paari daa ŋata ate wa ŋaaŋviirɔma a kan mak yeeri wa abe ba weeni nuruma ayen wa yiti kum po. Dan kan daa di ventaŋa de ale gaam wa le liŋ velim diila.>> 65Paalɔt yaa siak ale basi ayen tugurik tɔŋdɔba cheŋ a ga ŋmasi a limisi vɔrumu. 66Ba yaa cheŋ ga daani tintanni ayen waai dan bilim di abe ba miŋ a yaa le basi ate tugurik tɔŋdɔma a limisi vɔrumu.

Title: MATIU 28
Content:
1Vuusum Danni ale taam la, bakoanni piilimka danni, Mɛɛri Magdalene ale Mɛɛri nwala yaa cheŋ ba nya juijui ate ba gu Yeezu la. 2Tɛŋka yaa jam choa nna yegayega, ate Naawen maarɔ a nyini wenŋmazuk a siŋ bilim tintanni a dueni nakpiak a kali di zuk. 3Maarɔwa a jam kasim a nyaksi kama ase wein ale a nyaksi diila. Wa gattaŋa mɛ a peenti nna yegayega. 4Yɔgsum yaa yik baai ale a limisi vɔrumu la nna yegayega ate ba nyiŋsaŋa a gɔk ate ba nye nna ase ba kpi la. 5Maarɔwa yaa weeni nipooma ayen, <<Ni kan chali yɔgsummoa, mi seba ayen ni a gisi ka Yeezu waai ate ba kpi wa jabarimu nyiŋ la. 6Wa ka dela jigini, wa yiti kum po kama ase wa ale liŋ weeni ni diila. Ni jam a nya juijui ate ba pai wa a dueni la. 7Ni cheŋ nwuli a ga weeni wa ŋaaŋviirɔma ayen wa yiti kum po kama, wa be dɛ ka niŋ a cheŋ Galili tɛŋka. Ni le nya wa dula jigini. Ni teeri m le weeni ni diila.>>
8Ba yaa basi dula jigini ale suipeentik a ga weeni wa ŋaaŋviirɔma dii meena ate maarɔwa a weeni ba la. 9Yeezu yaa tu ba dula jigini a weeni ba ayen, <<Suiyɔgni a bo ale ni.>> Ba yaa domsi kali a puusi wa. 10Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni kan chali yɔgsummoa abe ni ga weeni m suataŋa ayen ba cheŋ Galili tɛŋka a ga tu mu dula jigini.>>
11Nipooma ale bo suik po a cheŋ la, tugurik tɔŋdɔma gela yaa cheŋ tɛŋka po a ga weeni kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa dii meena ale nye la. 12Kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa yaa tu chaab ale Tɛŋka nisɔmma ate ba pai ligra yegayega a te tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale weeni ba ayen, 13<<Ni weeni ayen nama a doa a goa kama ate wa ŋaaŋviirɔma a jam zu pai wa. 14Gominawa a dan poom wom ti le biisi a vari ni basi.>> 15Tugurik tɔŋdɔma yaa tuesi ligraŋa ale weeni ate ku paari Juuma meena a ta jam paari jinla danni.
16Wa ŋaaŋviirɔma pi ale wanyiwa yaa cheŋ a ga jueli guuk kunyi zuk Galili tɛŋka po juijui ate Yeezu a weeni ba ayen ba cheŋ la. 17Ba ale nya wa dula jigini la ba yaa puusi wa. Ba gela a jam diem ta ka chichama. 18Yeezu yaa forisi paari ba a weeni ba ayen, <<Wen a te mi pagrim kama wenŋmazuk ale tɛŋzuk meena. 19Ni cheŋ tɛŋsa meena a sak nuruba ate ba va mi, abe ni a te ba soka Kowa ale wa Nidoabinni ale wa Chiika yuei nyiŋ. 20Ni sak ba ate ba va wie ŋaai meena ate mi a sak ni la. M le bo ale ni a ga paari tɛŋka kpeglimka.>>

Title: MAAK 1
Content:
1Naawen nidoabinni Yeezu Kirisita wapaalaŋa piilimka ale nna. 2Ase ku ale ŋmarisi Wen biisiteerɔwa Azaya gbaŋka po ayen, <<Nya, m tom ka tomtomdɔ waai ale wa gomsi suiku la ayen wa dɛ fi niŋ.>> (Malakai 3:1) 3<<Waai lueluk ale kasim a kaari gɔnni po a weeni ayen gomsi Naawen suiku abe fi nye ate wa suitaŋa a teenti.>> (Azaya 40:3)
4Jɔɔn Sokateerɔwa ale nyini gɔnni po, a mooli ayen ba laŋ nyeka a tuesi soka a nya vɔŋteka. 5Nuruba yegayega yaa nyini tɛŋ kpieŋka Jerusalem ale tɛŋ sii meena ale gilim ka Judia po la a jam Jɔɔn jigi. Ba ale wom wa sinsaŋŋa la, ba yaa tɔk ba tuimbaataŋa meena a sak Naawen alege ate Jɔɔn yaa te ba soka Jodan benni po. 6Ba jam pai ka laalaakomi kɔbta a nye Jɔɔn garukku. Wa jam pai ka chiak gbain a bobi wa chiaka. Wa jam a ŋɔbi ka tintue ale a dɛ siita mɛ. 7Wa jam a mooli kama ayen, <<Nuru wanyi ale bo mi ŋaaŋ a cheena. Wa ta pagrim a gaam mi kama. Mi pɔsima ale mi ale domsi a kali wa niŋ a yeeri wa nuensaŋa a te wa. 8Nyiam ate mi pai a te ni soka, alege waai ale cheena la, ale pai ka Wen Chiika a te ni soka.>>
9Da ŋala po Yeezu a jam nyini ka Nazaret ale bo Galili po la. Wa yaa jam Jɔɔn jigi ayen Jɔɔn a te wa soka Jodan benni po. 10Jɔɔn ale te wa soka a nueri ate Yeezu a yaa nyini nyiamu po a jueli la, wa yaa deri nya wenŋmazukku ale ku lagri ate wa nya Wen Chiika a siŋ jam kali wa zuk nna ase nangbaŋ la, 11ate lueluk a yaa nyini wenŋmazukku po a weeni Yeezu ayen, <<Fi ale m nidoabili dii ate mi a yaali la. M sui a peenti ale fu kama.>>
12Wen Chiika yaa ta Yeezu a ga jo gɔnni po. 13Wa jam bo dula jigini ate ku paari ka da pisinaansi. Ate Sitaana yaa jam nye wa a nya. Wa jam bo ale ka gɔi duŋsa ate Wen yaa tom maarɔba ate ba jam maari wa.
14Dai yeŋ po nuruba a yaa yik Jɔɔn a ta wa ga lik dɔk po. Ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ ate Yeezu yaa jam Galili tɛŋka po a mooli Wen wamaŋsaŋa ayen, 15<<Da ŋaai ate Wen dak ayen wa naamu le jam la, a moata kama. Ni basi ni tuimbaataŋa abe ni ta siaka ale wa wamaŋsaŋa.>>
16Yeezu ale va Galili nyakpiemu nɔi a taam la, wa yaa nya Simon ale wa suoku Andiru ale ba za a yuk ba ŋmiak a basi nyiamu po diila ba jam ka jum yigrisa. 17Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni jam va mu ate m basi ate ni ta nuruba a jam m jigi.>> 18Ate ba deri basi ba ŋmaasaŋa ale va wa.
19Wa le cheŋ magadek la, wa yaa nya Jeemsi ale wa suoku Jɔɔn ale jam ka Zebedi nidoabilisa la ale ba bo ba ŋaaruŋ po a laŋ ba ŋmaasaŋa. 20Yeezu yaa wi ba ate ba deri basi ba kowa Zebedi ŋaaruŋku po ale wa tomteerɔma ale ga va wa.
21Yeezu ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa ga jo Kapernaum tɛŋka po. Juuma Vuusum Danni ale jam paari la, Yeezu yaa ga jo ba tuka dɔkku po a boro a sak ba Wen wie. 22Nuruma ale wom wa sinsaŋŋa la, ku yaa cha ba, dii nyiŋla wa sak kama ase waai ale jam ta pagrim la ale kan nye ase Sinsak sagrɔma la. 23Nuru ale jam ta chichirik biok a maa bo tuka dɔkku po. Wa yaa kaari 24ayen, <<Yeezu Nazaret denɔwa, fi a yaali ka boa ti jigiya? Fi jam ayen fi kaasi ti kama? M seba fi ale ka waai la kama, fi ka Nuru Weleŋ a nyini Wen jigi.>>
25Alege Yeezu yaa toariŋ chichirik bioku ayen, <<Goori abe fi nyini wa po a nyini.>> 26Chichirik bioku a deri basi ate nuruwa nyiŋka a gɔk a yaa kaari a nyini wa po a nyini.
27Ku yaa cha nuruma meena ale jam bo dula la, ate ba weeni ayen, <<Ni nya nuruwa de ta pagrim a weeni chichirik baata ate ti a wom wa nɔi a nyini nuruba po a nyini.>> Ba yaa bek chaab mɛ ayen, <<Ka boan jaab sinsak paala ale nna?>> 28Galili tɛŋka po nuruma yegayega a jam wom Yeezu ale tom diila kama.
29Yeezu yaa deri basi tuka dɔkku ale cheŋ. Wa ale Jeemsi ale Jɔɔn yaa ga jo Simon ale Andiru yenni po. 30Yeezu ale jo yenni po la, ba yaa deri weeni wa ayen Simon ŋanuba ale a yuak. Wa nyiŋka jam toliŋ ka nna bakki ate wa dua wa dɔkku po. 31Yeezu yaa jo nipowa dɔkku po a yik wa nisaŋa a zak ate wa yiti ŋmai. Wa ale nye dila la, wa nyiŋka yaa deri yɔk ate wa yiti yaali nyiam a te ba.
32Wenni ale siŋ la, tɛŋka po demma a pai ba yɔgnyieŋsa ale baai ate chichirik baata a jam ta ba la a jam Yeezu jigi. 33Tɛŋka po demma meena a yaa tigsi chaab a jam yeri diipo ate Yeezu a boro la. 34Wa tebi nuruba yegayega baai ate nyiŋtuila tɔgatɔga a jam ta ba la, ale a yiak chichirik baata yegayega nuruba po a basi. Yeezu an jam te chichirik baataŋa suik ate ti weeni wari ya, dii nyiŋla ti poom seba wa ale ka waai la kama.
35Saluik yokyok ate vanni an diem jam veenti la, Yeezu yaa yiti a nyini tɛŋka po a cheŋ juijui ate nuru a karo la a puusi a te Wen dula jigini. 36Simon ale wa vaanchaama yaa nyini gisi wa. 37Ba ale nya wa la, ba yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Waai meena a gisi fu kama.>>
38Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni te ti cheŋ tɛŋ sii ale moata la ate m sak nuruma Wen wie ate ba wom. Ka dila nyiŋ ate m jam.>> 39Wa yaa nyiem a gilim Galili tɛŋka a sak nuruba Wen wieŋa ba tuka diinaŋa po. Wa jam yiak chichirik baata nuruba po a basi mɛ.
40Gami yaa jam Yeezu jigi a kpi duna wa niŋ a saalim wa ayen, <<Fi dan siak, fi baga a tebi mu kama, ate m nya nyiŋyɔgsa.>>
41Yeezu yaa ta jiirim ale wa a teeri wa nisaŋa a tiri wa ale weeni wa ayen, <<M siak ya. Be nye cheri.>> 42Ate gama tuemu a deri basi wa ate wa nye cheri.
43Yeezu yaa kaam wa ale deri basi ate wa cheŋ. 44Ale weeni wa ayen, <<Kan weeni wari a sak waai ya, ga pai fidek a sak kaabteerɔwa abe fi te sugrika tiirimu ate Moosis a weeni la ate ku chim wensie a sak nuruma. 45Gamini yaa basi dula jigini. Wa an jam va Yeezu ale weeni wa diila, alege wa jam gɔnti a nyiem a weeni waai meena kama Yeezu ale tebi wa diila. Dila nyiŋ ate Yeezu an ŋman baga a nyini peelim a jam tɛŋka po. Wa yaa ga bo gɔnni po ate nuruba nyini tɛŋsa yegayega po a jam wa jigi.

Title: MAAK 2
Content:
1Daa ale ŋman jam taam la, Yeezu yaa basi dula ale ŋman cheŋ Kapernaum tɛŋka po a ga jo yeri dinyi po. Tɛŋka po demma yaa wom ayen wa jam ya. 2Nuruba yegayega yaa jam tigsi chaab yeri diipo ate wa boro la. Yenni meena a jam sueri kama ate nansuiŋku nɔi a ka zaanika jigiya, ate Yeezu a yaa boro a sak ba Wen wie. 3Nuruba banaansi yaa pai nuru ate wa nisa ale wa naŋsa a kpi la, a jam Yeezu jigi. 4Ba an jam baga a vuri nuruma po a paari Yeezu, dii nyiŋla nuruma a jam piisi kama. Ba jam pai nuruwa kama a ta jueli yenni zuk a vuri vɔrup yenni suŋsuŋ a yaa pai miisa a bobi jaab a pai wa ta va vɔrumu po a siŋ dueni Yeezu niŋ. 5Yeezu ale jam seba ayen ba ta siaka yegayega ale wa la, wa yaa weeni nuru waai ate wa nisaŋa ale wa naŋsaŋa a kpi la ayen, <<M biiga, m vɔŋ fi wabaataŋa a te fu kama.>>
6Sinsak sagrɔma ba gela ale jam maa kala dula jigini la, a yaa poli ayen, 7<<Nuruwa de ale a biisi diila, ku nala? Wa ale a nye diila ku ka leeta Wen jigi. Ka Wen dek wa nyiini ale a vɔŋ wabaata a te.>>
8Yeezu a poom seba wadek popola po ba ale a poli diila kama. Wa yaa bek ba ayen, <<Ka boan jaab popola ate nama a poli? 9Kun dek ale moali ate fi weeni waai nisa ale wa naŋsa ale kpi la, <M vɔŋ fi wabaataŋa a te fu, yaase yiti a pai fi tiaka a cheŋ?> 10Mi a yaali kama ayen ni seba ayen Mi Saalɔbiika a ta pagrim kama tɛŋzuk meena a baga vɔŋ nuruba wabaata a te ba.>> Wa yaa weeni waai nisa ale wa naŋsa ale kpi la ayen, 11<<Mi a weeni fu, yiti a pai fi tiaka a kuli.>> 12Nuruwa yaa deri yiti a zaani ŋmai ale pai wa jaamu a cheŋ nyini. Ku yaa cha nuru baai meena ale jam za dula jigini la. Ba yaa pak Wen a weeni ayen, <<Tama an diem a nya nyakude choa ka jinla nyiini.>>
13Yeezu yaa basi dula jigini ale ŋman pilim cheŋ Galili nyakpiemu nɔi, ate nuru boari yaa jam wa jigi ate wa sak ba Wen wie. 14Wa ale a taam la, wa yaa nya Livai. Wa jam ka Alfiyus nidoabili. Wa jam kala ka lampoo cheesika dɔk po a tuesi lampoo. Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Yiti a va mu.>> Wa yaa yiti a va wa.
15Yeezu ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa cheŋ Livai yenni ayen ba dɛ ŋandiinta. Lampoo cheesirɔba ale wabaata nyam yegayega a jam maa va Yeezu ŋaaŋ ate ba gela mɛ yaa jam gum wa ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma po, ate ba meena a kala a dɛ ŋandiinta. 16Sinsak sagrɔma baai ale ka Farisiiba la, yaa nya ba a dɛ ŋandiintaŋa. Ba yaa bek wa ŋaaŋviirɔma po wanyi ayen, <<Ka boa ale a sak ate Yeezu a siak ate lampoo cheesirɔba ale wabaata nyam a kali ale wa a dɛ ŋandiinta?>> 17Yeezu ale wom dila la, wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Baai ale ta nyiŋyɔgsa la kan yaali tebirɔ alege ka baai ale a yuak la. Mi an jam ayen m wi ka wayɔrisima nyama alege ka wabaata nyam.>>
18Jɔɔn Sokateerɔwa ŋaaŋviirɔma ale Farisiima a yaa bobi nɔi. Nuruba ba gela a yaa jam Yeezu jigi a bek wa ayen, <<Ka boa ate Jɔɔn ŋaaŋviirɔma ale Farisiima ŋaaŋviirɔma a bobi nɔi, alege fi ŋaaŋviirɔma a kan bobi?>> 19Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Nipok fiaka nyɔnɔwa doama a baga a bobi nɔi yaa? Aaya. Nipok fiaka nyɔnɔwa ale diem boro ale ba la, ba an baga a nye dila. 20Alege ku cheena ate ba le yik nipok fiaka nyɔnɔwa a ta cheŋ, dila powa ba yaa le bobi nɔi.>>
21<<Nuru a kan pai garuchiak paalik a laŋ garuk kpaga. Ba dan nye dila, garukku le cheeri a gum du, yaase, 22ba kan pai da paalik a su bunlɔk kpak po. Ba dan nye dila, bunlɔkku a na kama ate daamu a waaŋ. Ku dan nye dila, nuruwa a jɔk wa bunlɔkku ale wa daamu meena kama. Da paalik a magsi ka bunlɔk paaluk sukka.>>
23Vuusum Daaŋa po dinyi ate Yeezu ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa va talim po a taam. Ba ale a cheŋ la, wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa wɛ ŋanbie zuima a ŋɔbi. 24Farisiima yaa bek Yeezu ayen, <<Nya, ka boa ate fi ŋaaŋviirɔma a kaasi tama Vuusum Danni kisukku?>> 25Yeezu yaa bek ba ayen, <<Nama an diem karim Deevid wie diipo ate wa a silim ate kom a ta wa ale wa doama ate wa nye dii la? 26Kaabteerɔ kpioŋku Abiata daaŋa po wa jam jo Wen yenni po a ŋɔbi Wen niŋ boroborok kuui ale magsi kaabteerɔma nyiini ŋɔbika la. Wa jam te wa doama mɛ kama.
27Wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Wen a nye Vuusum Danni a te ka nurubiik, alege daa nurubiik a te Vuusum Danni. 28Dila nyiŋla, Mi Saalɔbiika ale soa Vuusum Danni.>>

Title: MAAK 3
Content:
1Yeezu yaa ŋman cheŋ ga jo ba tuka dɔkku po. Nuru wanyi ale jam bo dula ate wa nisa kpi. 2Baai ale jam bo dula la, yaa limisi ayen ba nya ase Yeezu le tebi yaase wa kan tebi nuruwa nisaŋa Vuusum Danni ate ba nya suik a ŋma wa. 3Yeezu yaa weeni nuru waai ate wa nisaŋa a kpi la ayen, <<Jam de.>> 4A yaa alege a weeni nuruma ayen, <<Nama seba Sinsaŋŋa kama. Ku magsi ayen ni tom ka tuimaŋsa yaa tuimbaata ni Vuusum Danni? Ni te nuruba nyuvuri yaa ni ko ba?>> Ba yaa goori nna chorototo. 5Yeezu sui yaa puuri ale ba ate wa gisi nya ba ale su kaasuŋ dii nyiŋla, ba tueŋa a kpari kama ate ba ka siaka ale wa. Wa yaa weeni nuruwa ayen wa teeri wa nisaŋa. Wa yaa teeri wa nisaŋa a deri ta nyiŋyɔgsa. 6Farisiima yaa yiti a nyini peelim. Ba ale Ayerod nuruma a yaa tigsi chaab a poli suik kuui ba le ba va a ko Yeezu la.
7Yeezu ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa nyini dula jigini a ŋman cheŋ nyakpiemu nɔi. Nuruba yegayega a nyini Galili tɛŋka po a va wa ŋaaŋ. 8Ba gela a nyini Jerusalem ale Judia tɛŋsaŋa po. Ba gela mɛ a nyini Idumia ale tɛŋ sii meena ale bo Jodan beli ŋaaŋnyiŋ la. Ba gela mɛ a nyini tɛŋ sii ale gilim Taaya ale Saidon la. 9Nuruma ale piisi la nyiŋ wa yaa weeni wa ŋaaŋviirɔma ayen ba yaali ŋaaruŋ a te wa, ate nuru boanni kaa tusi wa. 10Yeezu a tebi nuruba yegayega dula jigini. Ka dila ale soa ate ba a tusi chaab ayen ba paari a tiri wa nya la. 11Baai ate chichirik baata a bo ba po la ale nya wa la, ba yaa lo tɛŋ a kaari yegayega a weeni wa ayen, <<Fi ka Wen Nidoabinni.>> 12Alege wa kaam ti kama ayen ti kan weeni a sak waai ya wa ale ka waai la.
13Yeezu ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa cheŋ ga jueli guuk kunyi zuk. Wa ale jueli nueri la, wa yaa wi nuru baai ate wa a yaali ayen ba jam wa jigi la ate ba sum jam wa jigi. 14Wa jam lueri ka nuruba pi ale baye a ta nyini nuru baai meena ate wa wi la po ayen ba jam va wa. Wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<M lueri ni kama ayen ni kasim bo ale mu. M le tom ni mɛ ate ni nyini peelim a mooli Wen wieŋa ate nuruba wom. 15M be le te ni pagrim ate ni baga a yiak chichirik baata nuruba po a basi.>> 16Wa nuruma pi ale bayewa yue ale Simon waai ate Yeezu a te wa yuei paali ayen Piita la, 17ale Jeemsi ale wa suoku Jɔɔn. Jeemsi ale Jɔɔn a jam ka Zebedi nidoabilisa. Yeezu yaa ŋman te ba yuei paali ayen Boanejisi. Di kiri ale Nanpansa Nidoabilisa. 18Yeezu yaa ŋman lueri Andiru ale Filip ale Batolomiu ale Matiu ale Tomasi ale Jeemsi waai ale jam ka Alfiyus nidoabinni la ale Tadiusi ale Simon waai ale jam a nye ayen Juuma a nya badek zuk la, 19ale Judas Iskariot, nuru waai ale wa ta Yeezu a ga bobri sak la.
20Yeezu yaa kuli yeri, ate nuru boari a ŋman tigsi, ate wa le wa ŋaaŋviirɔma an baga dɛ ya. 21Yeezu dɔkku demma ale wom dila la, ba yaa nyini ayen ba gisi a yik wa, dii nyiŋla nuruba ale jam a weeni ayen, <<Wa zukku a tagri kama.>>
22Sinsak sagrɔma yaa nyini Jerusalem tɛŋka po a jam weeni chaab ayen, <<Chichirik baataŋa meena kpagni Beelzebu ale bo wa nyiŋka po a kasim a te wa pagrim ate wa baga a yiak chichirik baata nuruba po a basi.>>
23Yeezu yaa wi Sinsak sagrɔma ate ba jam wa tɛŋ ate wa yaa magsi wamagsima a sak ba ale bek ba ayen, <<Sitaana a nye ka sɛ a baga yiak wadek tomteerɔma a basi? 24Naam a dan lab buye a ta chaab, naam bula a kan zaani. 25Yeri yeŋ dem a dan ta kpaliŋ ale chaab, ba le waaŋ ka chaab. 26Dila nyiŋla Sitaana ale wa tomteerɔma a dan ta chaab, wa naamu a kan baga a zaani a beni. 27<<Suik kula po waai abe dan kan yik pagrɔ a bobiya, wa le nye ka sɛ a jo wa yenni po a zu wa ŋantaŋa? 28<<Ni basi ate m weeni nya kude a sak ni ayen, Wen le vɔŋ waai meena wabaata ale ba biisi kaasuŋ a te ba kama. 29Alege wa kan vɔŋ a te waai ale a lɛ Wen Chiika la, dii nyiŋla, wabiokku de a boro kama taam wuu.>> 30Wa weeni ba wieŋa de kama, dii nyiŋla nuruma ba gela a weeni kama ayen, <<Wa ta ka chichirik biok wa po.>>
31Ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ ate Yeezu suataŋa ale wa mawa a yaa jam za peelim a wi wa. 32Nuru boari ale jam za gilim wa a yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Fi mawa ale fi suataŋa a za peelim a yaali fu.>>
33Wa yaa bek ba ayen, <<Ka wana ale mi ma? Be ka bana ale mi suata?>>
34Wa yaa cheem a nya ba meena ale kala a gilim wa la a yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni nya, ka mi ma ale mi suata ale nama. 35Waai meena ale a tom dii ate Wen a yaali la, bala ale mi ma ale m toaba ale m suata.>>

Title: MAAK 4
Content:
1Yeezu yaa ŋman jam Galili nyakpiemu nɔi a sak nuruma Wen wie. Nuruma a jam piisi ka nna yegayega a za gilim wa ate wa yaa yiti jo ŋaaruŋ po a kala. Ŋaaruŋku a jam bo ka nyiamu po alege ate nuruma a za nyiamu nɔi. 2Wa yaa magsi wamagsima a sak ba wie nna yegayega ayen, 3<<Ni wom mi nalimnyiini. Nuru wanyi ale jam nyini cheŋ wa yuk ŋanbie. 4Wa yaa ale boro a yuk la, bieŋa gela a yaa lo suik niŋ ate nuinsa a deri jam pisi ŋa meena, 5ŋa gela mɛ a lo tintana po. Ŋa yaa nyini nna nwuli, dii nyiŋla tantaŋa an jam soa diiya dula jigini. 6Kantueŋka ale jam nak ŋa la, ŋa yaa deri kɔ, dii nyiŋla ŋa naŋsaŋa an jam baga a siŋ paari nyiamoa. 7Ŋa gela mɛ a lɔ munsa po a yaa nyini. Munsaŋa mɛ a nyini a geri ŋa ate ŋa an jam baga a biaya. 8Ŋa gela mɛ a lɔ tɛŋ naluŋ po a nyini a chim a biak a bɛ nalimnyiini. Ŋaai ta bie pisita. Ŋa gela mɛ pisiyuebi. Ŋa gela mɛ ta kook.>>
9Yeezu yaa weeni ayen, <<Waai ale ta tue a wom la, a wom mi nalimnyiini.>>
10Wa ale jam kala wadek wa nyiini la, baai ale jam a maa va wa ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma pi ale bayewa la, a yaa bek wa ayen, <<Fi wamagsimaŋa kie ale boa?>> 11Wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Wen basi kama ayen ni seba wa naamu wasusuŋŋa, alege nuru yonta jigi m sinsaŋŋa a chim ka wamagsima, a te ba. 12<Ba a nya ale a nya alege ba kan nya, ba a wom ale a wom alege ba kan miŋ ŋa, dii nyiŋla, ba dan nya ale miŋ ŋa, ba le tagri ba wabaata popolaŋa kama ate Wen vɔŋ a te ba.> >>
13Yeezu yaa bek ba ayen, <<Nama an baga wamagsini de kiri a miŋi? Ni be dan kan baga wamagsini de kiri a miŋi, ni yaa be le nye ka sɛ a baga a miŋ ŋa chaaba? 14Nuru waai ale nyini boro a yuk wa ŋanborintaŋa la, ku a nye se ka Wen wieŋa ate nuruba a sak la. 15Bie ŋaai ale lɔ suiku po la, a nye se ka baai ale wom wa wieŋa, alege ate Sitaana nyiem deri jam a yeeri ŋa nwuli a ta nyini ba suiniima po a nyini la. 16Bie ŋaai mɛ ale lɔ tintanaŋa po la, a nye se ka baai ale wom wa wieŋa ate ba sue a peenti, 17alege ate Wen wieŋa a kan jo ba suiniimaŋa po nalimnyiini la. Ba yaa va maga dega, alege ninam a dan yik ba, ba Wen wieŋa vaka nyiŋ, ba nyiem a deri pai ŋa vaka a basi. 18Bie ŋaai mɛ ale lɔ munsaŋa po la, a nye se ka baai ale wom Wen wieŋa 19alege tɛŋka po wieŋa popolaŋa ale ba ligra yaalika yegayega ale ba ŋanta yaalika, ŋala meena a dɛ ka Wen wieŋa ate wamaŋ an baga a nyini ŋa po a nyini. 20Bie ŋaai mɛ ale lɔ tɛŋ naluŋku po la, a nye se ka baai ale wom Wen wieŋa ate ŋa jo ba suiniima po nalimnyiini la. Ba a nye se ka ŋantaŋa ale nyini a yaa biak a bɛ ate ŋa gela a ta bie pisita, ŋaai mɛ pisiyuebi, ŋaai mɛ bie kook diila.>>
21Yeezu yaa bek ba ayen, <<Nuru a dan toati zeuŋ wa pai ka chin a vuk ku? Yaase wa a pai a zaani ka gaduok tɛŋŋa? Aaya, wa a pai ku a zaani ka jaab zuk ate ku a nya dɔkku po meena. 22Wari dii meena ale chim wasusugi la, a kan ŋman chim wasusugi nuruba jigiya. Wari dii meena ale lik doa la, le nyini peelim ate nuruba nya. 23Dila nyiŋ, nama baai ale ta tue a wom la, ni wom mi nalimnyiini.>>
24Wa ŋman pilim weeni ba ayen, <<Ni kpesi ni dek ale dii ate ni a wom la. Magsi kaai ate fi pai a magsi ŋanta a te nuru la, magsi kala dekdega ate Wen le pai magsi a te fi me, ate ku poom gaam taam. 25Nuru waai nisa po ale ta la, Wen le ŋman te wa ŋanta yegayega a gum du, alege waai nisa po ale kan ta la, Wen le ŋman tuesi jaab fiik kaai ate wa poom ta la kama.>>
26Ate wa jam weeni ayen, <<Wen naamu a nye ase ka nuru ale pai ŋanbie a yuk waaŋ tɛŋ diila. 27Daa meena ate wa gɔ a yiti la, wa zɛ ŋantaŋa ale nye dii a nyini ale a chim la. 28Ka tɛŋka ale wuuk bieŋa ate ŋa a nyini ale chim alege a ta bie. Zabuli ale liŋ a chim, a pak a paari kiŋkari, a yaa ga a biak alege ate bieŋa a yaa ga kpeglim. 29Ŋa yaa ale bɛ a ga nueri la, nuruwa yaa pai wa gebik a ta cheŋ wa talimu po a ga che dii nyiŋla, ŋa cheka paari kama.>>
30Yeezu yaa ŋman bek ba ayen, <<Ti le pai ka boa a magsi chaab ale Wen naamu? 31Bu a nye ase ka nna la. Ase nuru ale pai, mastad biri a bori la. Binni a pɔsima kama a gaam tɛŋzuk bie meena. 32Wa yaa pai di a bori ate di nyini chim ti kpiem a ta naŋsa ale yɔgsum nna yegayega ate nuinsa a kali si zuk a yɔk tugta.>>
33Wamagsima ŋa chaab ate Yeezu a jam magsi a sak nuruba la ale nna. Wa jam magsi ka ŋa chaab nna yegayega a gum du ayen baai ale ta Wen yammu la a baga a miŋ a chak. 34Wa an jam biisi wari dinyi la ale nuruba alege kan magsi wamagsini. Alege, wa ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma a dan jam boro badek ba nyiini, wa nyiem a weeni wa wamagsimaŋa kie a sak ba kama.
35Dila danni junɔi Yeezu yaa weeni wa ŋaaŋviirɔma ayen, <<Ni te ti taam nyakpiemu kauk kunkula.>> 36Wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa basi nuru boanni ale cheŋ ga jo Yeezu ale kali ŋaaruŋ kuui po la ayen ba cheŋ. Nuruba ba gela mɛ a jo ŋaaruŋta a maa va ba ŋaaŋ. 37Ba ale a cheŋ la, va kpioŋ yaa jam a nak ba ŋaaruŋku nna yegayega ate nyiamu mɛ a yiti a jueli ŋmai. Bu yaa jo ba ŋaaruŋku po ate ku a nye ku siŋ nyiamu tɛŋ. 38Yeezu a jam dua ŋaaruŋku po ba ŋaaŋ a kpagli ka dafieluk a goa. Wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa nak wa a yiti a bek wa ayen, <<Sagrɔ, fi niŋ ka ale ti ni wari nyiamu po?>>
39Wa yaa yiti wa goomu jigini a zaani ŋmai weeni vioku ayen ku basi abe nyiamu mɛ a nye balaa. Vioku yaa deri basi ate nyiamu mɛ a baliŋ. 40Yeezu yaa bek wa ŋaaŋviirɔma ayen, <<Ka boa ate nama a chali yɔgsummoa? Nama diem ka siaka?>>
41Ku yaa cha ba ate ba a bek chaab ayen, <<Nuruwa de, ka wana ate wa baga a biisi ale viok ale nyiam ate ba a wom wa nɔiya?>>

Title: MAAK 5
Content:
1Yeezu ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa taam Galili nyakpiemu kauk kunkula ŋaaŋnyiŋ a ga paari Gerasa tɛŋka. 2Yeezu ale nyini ŋaaruŋku po a nyini la, nuru ate chichirik biok a bo wa po la a nyini nuruba guka jigi a deri tu wa. 3Nuruwa de jam bo ka nuruba guka jigi ate waai jam karo baga a bobi wa. Ba jam pai ka chɔrima a bobi wa, alege wa baga a gebi ŋa. 4Ba ŋman pai chɔrimaŋa ale kuta a bobi wa naŋsa ale wa nisima a ga jiak, alege wa ŋman gebi ŋa mɛ meena. Waai a jam karo a ta pagrim a baga a yik wa. 5Wa jam bo ka ba ale a gu nuruba juijui la ale guuta zuima a nyiem a cheŋ ale a kaari kama ale pai tintain laasa a gebi wa nyiŋka.
6Ase wa ale jam zaani niŋniŋ a nya Yeezu la, wa yaa chali cheŋ wa jigi a ga puusi wa. 7Ale kaari nna yegayega a weeni ayen, <<Fi Yeezu Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La Nidoabinni a ta ka boan wari ale mi? M pai Wen a saalim fu ayen kan namsi mu.>> 8Dii nyiŋ la wa jam weeni wa kama ayen, <<Fi chichirik biok, nyini wa po a nyini.>> 9Yeezu yaa bek wa ayen, <<Fi yuei ale boa?>> Ku yaa tulisi wa ayen, <<Mi yuei ale Anuruboari, dii nyiŋla ti piisi kama.>> 10Nuruwa yaa saalim Yeezu nna yegayega ayen wa kan yiak chichirik baataŋa dula jigini a basi.
11Die ale jam piisi nna yegayega a za guuk kunyi zuk dula jigini a dɛ. 12Chichirik baataŋa yaa saalim Yeezu ayen wa basi ate ti ga jo dieŋa de po. 13Yeezu yaa te ti suik. Ti yaa basi nuruwa ale nyini ga jo dieŋa po ate ŋa meena yaa chali nna nwuli a siŋ ga lo nyakpiemu po a kpi. Ŋa jam paari ka tusa ŋaye (2,000).
14Nuru baai ale jam a nya dieŋa zuk la, yaa chali kuli ba yeeŋa a ga weeni ba yeeŋa demma ale baai meena ate ba a tu ba suiku niŋ la, dii ale nye la. Tɛŋka demma yaa nyini a cheŋ Yeezu jigi ayen ba nya dii ate baai ale a nya deeŋa la a weeni ba la. 15Ba yaa jam nya nuru waai ate chichirik biok boanni a jam bo wa po la ale wa jo gatta a kala ale Yeezu. Wa an ŋman a yesimu. Yɔgsum yaa deri yik ba. 16Nuru baai ale jam nya dii ale nye nuru wa jigi ale chichirik baataŋa ale dieŋa la, yaa weeni a sak nuruba meena ale jam bo dula jigini la. 17Tɛŋka demma ale wom dii ate ba weeni la, ba yaa jam a saalim Yeezu ayen wa nyini ba tɛŋka po nyini.
18Yeezu yaa ale cheŋ ayen wa jo ŋaaruŋku po la, nuru waai ale jam ta chichirik baataŋa la a jam saalim wa ayen wa basi ate wa maa va wa a cheŋ. 19Yeezu an jam siak ya, alege weeni wa ayen, <<Kuli ga weeni fi yenni demma Naawen ale ta jiirim ale fu a maari fu diila.>> 20Nuruwa yaa cheŋ ga weeni nuru baai ale jam bo Dekapolis po la dii ate Yeezu a nye te wa la. Ku yaa cha baai meena ale jam wom la.
21Yeezu yaa ga jo ŋaaruŋku po a gaam taam nyakpiemu kauk kunkula. Wa ale cheŋ a ga paari dula jigini la, nuru boari yegayega a yaa tigsi a gilim wa nyakpiemu nɔi. 22Juuma tuka dɔkku kpaŋŋa po wanyi ale jam maa bo nuru boanni po. Wa yuei a jam ale Jairus. Wa yaa le ga nya Yeezu la, wa yaa jam wa niŋ 23a saalim wa nalimnyiini ayen, <<M dek ko, m lie ale a yuak a moata kum, ate mi a saalim fu ayen fi jam a pai fi nisa a ji wa zuk ate wa nya nyiŋyɔgsa.>> 24Yeezu yaa va Jairus a cheŋ ate nuruba yegayega maa va wa a gilim wa.
25Nipok ale jam boro a lo chiak a paari bena pi ale ŋaye. 26Tiita nyam yegayega a jam tebi wa a kpeeri. Wa jam kaasi wa ligra meena, alege tuemu an jam basi wa ale diem a daani wa mɛ nna yegayega a gum du. 27Wa jam wom ka Yeezu wie yaa zaani wa ŋaaŋ nuru boanni suŋsuŋ a tiri wa garukku. 28Wa jam poli kama ayen, <<Ase m dan poom tiri wa garukku, m le nya nyiŋyɔgsa.>> 29Wa tuemu yaa deri basi wa, ate wa yaa miŋ ayen wa nya nyiŋyɔgsa kama dula jigini.
30Yeezu yaa deri miŋ ayen ku nye wa jigi kama ase nuru ale tiri wa a nya nyiŋyɔgsa la. Wa yaa cheemu ayen wa nya ase ka wana a yaa bek ayen, <<Ka wana ale tiri mi garukku?>>
31Wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa weeni ayen, <<Fi kan nya nuruma ale piisi a gilim fu diila, alege ate fi a bek ayen ka wana ale tiri fu?>>
32Yeezu yaa diem gisi nya gilim ayen wa nya waai ale tiri wa la. 33Nipowa kpaziim yaa nak ate wa nyiŋka a gɔk. Wa jam seba ayen Yeezu a tebi wa kama ate wa yaa kpi duna tɛŋ wa niŋ a weeni wa ale wensie meena tuemu wie. 34Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<M lie, fi siaka a basi ate fi nya nyiŋyɔgsa kama. Kuli yeri ale suinum masik, dii nyiŋla fi tuemu a nueri kama.>>
35Yeezu ale diem bo dula a biisi la, nuruba gela yaa nyini Jairus yenni a jam wa jigi a weeni wa ayen, <<Fi liewa a kpi kama. Kan ŋman a daani sagrɔwa ayen wa jamu.>>
36Yeezu ale wom dii ate ba weeni wa la, wa yaa weeni Jairus ayen, <<Kan te ku a daani fu, alege kasim ta siaka.>>
37Yeezu an jam a yaali ayen nuru waai a va ba a cheŋ, alege ka Piita ale Jeemsi ale wa suoku Jɔɔn nyiini. 38Ba ale ga paari nya ale ku nye ŋaglam Jairus yenni po ate nuruma a kum ale a kaari nna yegayega la, 39Yeezu yaa cheŋ ga jo yenni po a bek ba ayen, <<Ka boa ate nama a kum ale a kaari dila? Biika an kpiya. Wa a goa kama.>> 40Ba yaa deri a la wa wa nina po. Wa yaa yiak ate ba meena a nyini peelim, alege yik biika kowa ale wa mawa ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma batawa yaa ta ba jo biika goom dɔkku po. 41Yeezu yaa yik biika nisa a weeni wa ayen, <<Nipokbiliga, yiti.>> Ba a weeni ale badek tɛŋka biika ayen ka Talita kumi. 42Nipokbinni yaa deri yiti zaani ŋmai a cheŋ. Biika jam ta ka bena pi ale ŋaye. Ku yaa cha baai meena ale jam bo dula jigini la nna yegayega. 43Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen ba nye ŋandiinta a te wa ate wa dɛ, alege kaam ba mɛ ayen, <<Ni kan basi ate nuru a wom dii ate mi nye la.>>

Title: MAAK 6
Content:
1Yeezu yaa basi dula jigini ale cheŋ tɛŋ kaai ate wa liŋ jam boro la. Wa ŋaaŋviirɔma mɛ yaa va wa a cheŋ. 2Ba ale diem bo dula jigini la, Vuusum Danni yaa paari ate ba cheŋ ga jo ba tuka dɔkku po ate, wa yaa sak nuruma Wen wieŋa. Nuruba yegayega a jam bo dula jigini a wom Yeezu sinsaŋŋa ate ku yaa cha ba. Ba yaa bek chaab ayen, <<Nuruwa de a nye ka sɛ a seba nna? Ka boan jaab yam ale nna ate Wen a te wa? Wa nye ka sɛ a tom wakperikaliisaŋa nna? 3Daa wala ale danagrɔwa a bo dela la? Daa Mɛɛri nidoabinni ale la? Daa wa suata ale Jeemsi ale Josesi ale Judas ale Simon la? Wa toama mɛ an bo daa dela la?>> Dila nyiŋ ate Nazaret demma a jam zɛri wa.
4Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Waai meena a te Wen biisiteerɔwa zula kama, alege ka wadek tɛŋka demma ale wa suataŋa ale wa yenni demma nyiini ale kaa te wa zula.>> 5Wa ale jam bo dula jigini la, wa an jam baga a nye wakperikaliiga, ka nisa ate wa pai ji yɔgnyieŋsa gela zuima a tebi ba. 6Ku jam cha wa ka nna yegayega ale nuruma ale jam kan ta siaka la. Ba yaa basi dula jigini ale cheŋ tɛŋ fiik sii ale jam bo dula la, a sak nuruba Wen wieŋa. 7Wa yaa wi wa ŋaaŋviirɔma pi ale bayewa ate ba jam a tigsi chaab wa jigi ayen wa tom ba baye baye. Wa yaa te ba pagrim ate ba baga a yiak chichirik baata nuruba po a basi.
8Wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Nama ale a cheŋ la, ni kan pai kɔlima yaase ŋandiinta, yaase fotta, yaase ligra mɛ. 9Ni kan pai gatta ti chaab a gum ga tii ate ni jo la po. Ni su nuensa abe ni pai tacheksa nyiini a nyo ni nisima po a ta cheŋ. 10Ni dan cheŋ ga paari tɛŋ kanyi ate ba te ni dɔk ayen ni goa, ni kasim a goa dɔk kula po a ta ga paari diipo ate ni ale basi tɛŋ kala la. 11Ni dan jam paari tɛŋ kaai ate kala demma a dan kan te ni tia yaase ba an wom dii ate ni ta ayen ni weeni a sak ba la, ni kpaanti ni naŋtaataŋa paasuku abe ni basi dula ate ku sak ayen ni a kaam ba kama ba ale zɛri Wen wieŋa la nyiŋ.>>
12Ba yaa cheŋ ayen ba ga sak nuruma Wen wieŋa, ate ba basi ba tuimbaataŋa abe ba ŋman va Wen wensie suiku. 13Ba jam yiak chichirik baata nuruba yegayega po a basi ale a pai kpaam a boori a nyo yuarɔba zuima zuk a tebi ba.
14Naab Ayerod a jam wom Yeezu wie kama, dii nyiŋla waai meena jam a biisi ka Yeezu wie. Ba gela a jam a weeni ayen wa ka Jɔɔn Sokateerɔwa, ale yiti kum po. Ka dila nyiŋ ale soa ate wa baga a tom wakperikaliisaŋa de.
15Ba gela a pai wa chim ka Wen biisiteerɔwa Elaja. Ba gela mɛ a jam a weeni ayen, <<Wa ka Wen biisiteerɔ waai ale a nye ase dipo Wen biisiteerɔma wanyi la.>>
16Naab Ayerod ale wom Yeezu wie la, wa yaa weeni wadek ayen, <<Jɔɔn wade, mi basi ate ba gebi wa zukku kama alege wa yiti kum po.>>
17Ayerod a jam yik wa a lik ka dɔk po dii nyiŋla, wa jam faari ka wa suoku Filip pok. Wa powa yuei a jam le Ayerodiasi. 18Jɔɔn a liŋ jam weeni Ayerod kama ayen, <<Fi ale nye dii ale fi suoku powa la, an va Moosis Sinsaŋŋa.>> 19A nyini da ŋala po a ta a cheŋ, Ayerodiasi a jam kisi Jɔɔn kama a yaali ayen wa ko wa, alege wa an jam nya suikwa dii nyiŋla. 20Ayerod a jam a chali Jɔɔn ka yɔgsum ale a te wa zula mɛ, dii nyiŋla wa seba ayen Jɔɔn ka nuru maŋ ale nuru weleŋ. Ka dila nyiŋ ale soa ate Ayerod an jam siak ayen ba ko wa. Jɔɔn sinsaŋŋa a jam a daani Ayerod ka nna yegayega alege wa diem a yaali ayen wa wom dii ate wa ta la.
21Ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ ate Ayerodiasi da soŋku a yaa jam. Ayerod biamu danni ale jam paari la, wa yaa wi wa kpagi kpiemaŋa ale wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma kpaŋŋa ale nuru kpientaŋa baai meena ale jam bo Galili tɛŋka po la ayen ba jam maa dɛ wa biamu danni ŋandiintaŋa. 22Ba ale jam tigsi chaab a boro a dɛ la, Ayerodiasi liewa yaa jo dɔk kuui ate ba kala a dɛ la po, yaa gɔg sak ba. Wa gɔgtaŋa a jam te Ayerod ale wa doama ka suipeentik nna yegayega, ate Ayerod yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Fi ale a yaali jabuui la, m le te fu.>> 23Wa yaa ŋman pɛ a weeni wa ayen, <<Jaabuui meena ate fi a yaali la, weeni mu, ate m te fu. Fi daa a yaali m tɛŋka naamu geli m le pai te fu.>>
24Nipokbinni yaa nyini cheŋ wa mawa jigi a bek wa ayen, <<Ka boa ate fi a yaali ayen m bek naawa jigiya?>> Wa mawa yaa weeni wa ayen bek wa ate wa gebi Jɔɔn zukku a te wa. 25Wa yaa ŋman pilim ga jo naawa jigi nna nwuli a weeni wa ayen, <<Mi a yaali ayen fi gebi ka Jɔɔn zukku yɔgyɔgla de a pai dueni taasi tanlaŋ po ate ba ta jam te mu.>> 26Wa ale weeni nna la, ku jam kaasi Ayerod popola ka nna yegayega, alege wa an jam baga a zɛri ya, dii nyiŋla wa jam pɛ kama wa doama nimbie po ayen wa le te wa jabuui meena ate wa a juisi wa jigi la. 27Wa yaa tom wa tugurik tɔŋdɔma po wanyi ayen wa gebi Jɔɔn zukku ta jam. Tugurik tɔŋdɔwa yaa cheŋ juijui ate ba lik Jɔɔn la a yaa gebi wa zukku 28a pai dueni taasi tanlaŋ po a ta ŋmani cheŋ ga te nipokbinni. Wa yaa tuesi ta ga te wa mawa. 29Jɔɔn ŋaaŋviirɔma ale jam wom dii ale nye la, ba yaa ga pai wa nyiŋka a ta ga gu piuŋ vɔrup po.
30Yeezu tuimtomdɔma baai ate wa jam tom ba la, yaa ŋman jam wa jigi a weeni wa dii meena ate ba tom ale dii meena ate ba sak nuruma la. 31Bala ale Yeezu an jam nya suik a kali dɛ ŋandiinta, dii nyiŋla nuruba yegayega a kasim a jam kama ale a kuli. Dila nyiŋla, wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni jam ate ti cheŋ jigi yoŋ tidek ti nyiini a ga vuusi maga.>>
32Ba yaa basi dula jigini ale cheŋ a ga jo ŋaaruŋ po ayen ba cheŋ juijui ate nuru karo la. 33Ba ale jam a cheŋ la, nuruba yegayega yaa nya ba a deri miŋ ba. Ba yaa nyini ba tɛŋsaŋa po a chali va kunkɔŋni a de ba niŋ a ga paari ŋaaruŋku ale a cheŋ juijui la. 34Yeezu ale nyini ŋaaruŋku po a siŋ la, wa yaa nya nuru boari ale ba za a limisi wa. Wa nya ba ase ba ka pa ŋaai ale kan ta naapeerik la. Wa jiirim a yaa jam bo ale ba ate wa sak ba wie nna yegayega dula jigini.
35Ba ale jam za dula jigini ate ku beni la, Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa jam wa jigi a weeni wa ayen, <<Nya ti bo ka sagi po dela jigini ate wenni mɛ a siŋ ti. 36Basi ate nuruma a cheŋ tɛŋ sii ale moata la po a ga da ŋandiinta dɛ.>>
37Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Nama dek a te ba ŋandiinta ate ba dɛ.>> Ba yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Ku le pai ka nuru chiisa naaniŋ tutuna! Ti le pai ka ligra a soa dila a da ŋandiinta ate ba dɛ?>>
38Yeezu ŋman bek ba ayen, <<Ka boan ŋandiinta ate ni tara? Ni cheŋ a ga gisi nya.>> Ba yaa cheŋ a ga nya ale ŋman pilim jam weeni wa ayen, <<Ti ta ka borobotta tinu ale juma ŋaye nyiini.>>
39Wa yaa weeni nuruma meena ate ba kali tɛŋ wuuku po, 40nuruba kook kook, ba gela mɛ pisinu pisinu a ga nueri. 41Yeezu yaa pai borobotta tinuwa ale juma ŋayewa a zak zuk nya wenŋmazuk a niak ale te Wen jiam. Wa yaa ŋmari borobottaŋa ale jumaŋa a te wa ŋaaŋviirɔma ayen ba pai chari nuruma. 42Waai meena a jam ŋɔbi chak kama. 43Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa pai ŋandiin tii ale tali la a sueri busisa pi ale siye. 44Nidoa baai ale jam dɛ ŋandiintaŋa la a jam ka tusa ŋanu (5,000).
45Yeezu yaa deri basi ate wa ŋaaŋviirɔma a jo ŋaaruŋku a dɛ wa niŋ a lɔ nyakpiemu a jueli cheŋ Beteseida, abe wa banti nuru boanni. 46Wa le basi ba la, ŋaaŋnyiŋ, wa yaa cheŋ a ga jueli guuk zuk ayen wa puusi Wen.
47Junɔi ale jam paari la, Yeezu a jam za ka guuku zuk wadek wa nyiini. Wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa jam kala ŋaaruŋku po nyakpiemu suŋsuŋ. 48Wa yaa nya ale vioku a nak ba ŋaaruŋku ate ba an baga a paari kunkɔŋni. Ku ale jam paari ate vari kpadiaka a kum la, wa yaa nyini guuku zuk a siŋ cheŋ nyiamu zuk a ga ba jigi a yaali ayen wa gaam ba a taam. 49Ba meena ale nya wa ale wa a cheŋ nyiamu zuk la, ba yaa pai chim ayen, <<Wa ka kɔk.>> Ate ba kaari nna yegayega. 50Dii nyiŋ la ba meena a nya wa kama ate ba kpaziim a nak. Yeezu yaa deri biisi nwuli ayen, <<Ka mi. Ni kan chali yɔgsummoa, ni basi ate ni nyiŋsaŋa a pagra.>> 51Wa yaa jam jo ŋaaruŋku po a gum ba po. Vioku yaa deri zaani. Ku yaa cha ba nna yegayega. 52Ku jam cha ba, dii nyiŋla, ba an jam miŋ Yeezu ale nye dii a pai borobottaŋa a chari nuru boanni la kiriya. Ba popolaŋa a jam lik kama.
53Ba yaa ale gaam taam a ga paari kauk kunkula ŋaaŋnyiŋ, ba yaa jam paari Genesaret tɛŋka. Dula jigini ba yaa bobi ba ŋaaruŋku a zaani. 54Yeezu ale nyini ŋaaruŋku po a siŋ la, nuruba yaa deri miŋ wa, 55ate ba chali jo tɛŋka po meena ayen ba weeni a sak nuruba wa ale jam la. Juijui meena ate ba jam wom ayen wa boro la, ba pai ba yɔgnyieŋsa a dueni ŋanta zuk a ta ga wa jigi ayen wa tebi ba. 56Yeezu yaa nyiem gilim tɛŋ kpieŋsa ale tɛŋ fiisa ale tɛŋ kpaŋsa meena po. Nuruma ale ga wom ayen Yeezu cheena la, ba yaa chali kuli ba yeeŋa a ta ba yɔgnyieŋsa a cheŋ yabaŋa po a saalim wa ayen wa basi ate ba tiri wa garukku nɔnni ate ba nya nyiŋyɔgsa. Baai meena ale tiri wa garukku la, a nya nyiŋyɔgsa kama.

Title: MAAK 7
Content:
1Farisiima ale Sinsak sagrɔma gela yaa nyini Jerusalem tɛŋka a jam tigsi chaab a gilim Yeezu. 2Ba ale diem jam bo wa jigi la, ba yaa nya ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma a kaasi ba kisitaŋa kunyi, dii nyiŋla ba an nari ba nisimaŋa ase Farisiima kisitaŋa ale a va diila. 3Farisiima ale Juuma meena a nyiem kasim a va ka ba kokpieŋsaŋa kisuk kuui ale a sak ba ayen ba nyiem nari ba nisimaŋa abe ba dɛ ŋandiinta la. 4Ba dan nyini yaba a kuli, ba a dɛ ka niŋ a sugri badek ale ge a dɛ ŋandiinta. Ba a va ka ba kokpieŋsaŋa kisitaŋa meena tii ale a sak ba ayen ba a nari ba samɔnsa tɔgatɔga ale ba beerisa tɔgatɔga ale ba taasa tɔgatɔga la.
5Farisiima ale Sinsak sagrɔma yaa bek Yeezu ayen, <<Ka boa ate fi ŋaaŋviirɔma a zɛri ti kokpieŋsaŋa nisima narika kisiku alege a dɛ ŋandiinta ale nidaŋtisa?>>
6Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Nama ka sakpaŋ zula nyam. Wen biisiteerɔwa Azaya a ta wensie kama ale wa le ŋmarisi ayen, <Nuruma de a pai ka ba noa nyiini a zuli mi, alege ba suiniimaŋa a ka mi jigi ya. 7Ba pai ka nurubiik kisita a sak nuruba ale a weeni ayen ti ka Wen kisita. Ka dila nyiŋ ale soa ate ba puusaŋa chim kinla mi jigi.> (Azaya 29:13)
8<<Nama a basi ka Wen Sinsaŋŋa vaka ale a va ni kokpieŋsaŋa kisitaŋa.
9<<Nama pai ka nidek yam a zɛri Wen Sinsaŋŋa vaka ayen ni nya suik a va nidek kisitaŋa. 10Diila Moosis a jam weeni ayen, Ku a fɛ ate ni a zuli ni koba ale ni maba. (Nyinika 20:12) Wa ŋman ŋmarisi ayen, Waai ale a le wa ko a yaase wa ma la, ku a fɛ ate ba ko wa. (Nyinika 21:17) 11Alege nama a weeni kama ayen, ase nuru a dan weeni wa ko yaase wa ma ayen dii ate fi ale nya a nyini mi jigi la ka Korban. Kude kiri ale jabuui ate ba pai a te Wen la. 12Ate ku kan te suik ate wa baga a nye wari a te wa ma yaase wa ko. 13Ni kaasi Wen sinsaŋŋa kama ale ni kisuk wieŋa ate ni pai a sak nuruba la. Ni be kasim a nye ka wieŋa de chaab.>>
14Yeezu yaa ŋman wi nuru boanni ate ba jam wa jigi ate wa weeni ba ayen, <<Nama meena lak ni tueŋa a wom abe ni miŋ chak. 15Ŋan baai ale a jo ni puusa po la, a kan te ni daŋta, alege ka ŋan baai ale a nyini ni noaŋa po a nyini la ale a te ni daŋta. 16Nama baai ale ta tue a wom la, ni wom nalimnyiini.>>
17Yeezu yaa ale basi nuru boanni ale cheŋ ga jo dɔk la, wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa bek wa wa wamagsini kiri. 18Yeezu yaa tulisi ba ayen, <<Nama an baga miŋ ayen ŋan baai ale jo ni po la a kan te ni daŋta? Nama zɛ chak mi ale a weeni diila? 19Ba kan jo ni suiniimaŋa po, ba a jo ka ni puusaŋa po a ŋman pilim a nyini.>> Yeezu a weeni ba wieŋa de ayen ŋa sak ba ate ba kan ŋman a ta kisita ale ŋandiinta meena.
20Wa ŋman weeni ba ayen, <<Wie ŋaai ale a nyini nuru suinum po a nyini la ale a te wa daŋta. 21Popola ŋaai ale bo nuruba suiniima po la ale a basi ate ba a poli wabaata ale a basi ate ba a yaali nipooba ale nidoaba ale a zu ale a ko nuruba ale a nye kaboŋsa ale 22ta butuem ale a nye gaasa ale a paasi ale a tom tuim gbentisa ale a dɛ nyuri ale a lɛ nuruba ale ta kanjanta ale a tom betta. 23Wabaataŋa de meena ale a nyini ba suiniimaŋa po a nyini la ale a kaasi ba.>>
24Yeezu yaa basi dula jigini ale cheŋ Taaya ale Saidon tɛŋsaŋa po. Wa yaa cheŋ ga jo yeri po ayen wa suk wadek ate waai a kan seba ayen wa bo dula, alege wa an jam baga a nya sukka jigiya. 25Nipok wanyi ale jam boro ate chichirik biok a ta wa lie la yaa wom wa wie a cheŋ ga kpi duna wa niŋ. 26Nipowa a jam ka Girik denɔ. Ba biak wa ka Fonisia ate ka bo Siriya tɛŋka po la yaa cheŋ ga saalim wa ayen wa yeeri chichirik bioku ale bo wa liewa po la a basi.
27Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Basi ate ba liŋ pai ŋandiinta a te bisa ate ba dɛ chak. Ku an magsi ayen ba pai bisaŋa ŋandiinta a te baasa.>>
28Nipowa yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Mm, m Nyɔnɔ Yeezu Kirisita, dii ate fi a weeni la ka wensie, alege baasaŋa a nyiem a dɛ ka ŋandiin tii ate bisaŋa a dɛ ale tali la.>>
29Yeezu yaa ŋman weeni wa ayen, <<Fi ale tulisi mu diila ale soa ate mi a weeni fu ayen kuli yeri ale chichirik bioku a poom basi fi liewa kama.>>
30Nipowa yaa le ga paari wa yenni la, wa yaa nya wa liewa ale wa dua wa goom tiaka po. Chichirik bioku a sum basi wa kama.
31Yeezu yaa basi Taaya tɛŋka ale ŋman pilim jam va Saidon tɛŋka po a taam ga va Dekapolis po a taam cheŋ Galili nyakpiemu. 32Wa ale ga paari dula la, nuruba yaa ta nuru ate wa tue a kpari ate wa an baga a biisi nalimnyiini mɛ. Ba yaa ta wa jam Yeezu jigi a saalim wa ayen wa pai wa nisaŋa a vi wa nyiŋka ate wa nya nyiŋyɔgsa. 33Yeezu yaa yik wa ta nyini nuru boanni po a taam nakpiak a pai wa nandubsa siye a su nuruwa tueŋa po, alege a chesi tintueta a pai tiri nuruwa giŋgeluŋku. 34Yeezu ale nye dila nueri la, wa yaa zak nya wenŋmazuk a ŋusi weeni nuruwa ayen, <<Effata!>> Ku kiri ale, <<Lagri!>> 35Wa tueŋa a deri a wom ate wa giŋgeluŋku mɛ a labri ate wa yaa baga a biisi nalimnyiini.
36Yeezu yaa weeni nuru baai ale ta wa jam la bunyi dekki ayen ba kan weeni a sak waai dii ale nye la, alege ba zɛri ale ŋmasi a jalisi wa a gum du ate nuruba yegayega a wom. 37Ku yaa cha waai meena ate ba weeni chaab ayen, <<Nuruwa de a nye wie meena ka nalimnyiini. Nya wa ale poom baga a nye dii a tebi nuru waai tueŋa ale ka a wom ate wa an baga a biisi nalimnyiini la.>>

Title: MAAK 8
Content:
1Daa ale ŋman jam taam la, nuru boari yegayega a ŋman tigsi chaab a gilim Yeezu. Ba ale jam kan ŋman ta ŋandiinta a dɛ la, Yeezu yaa wi wa ŋaaŋviirɔma ate ba jam wa jigi ate wa weeni ba ayen, 2<<M jiirim a bo ale nuruma de, dii nyiŋla ba ale bo ale mu daa ŋatawa de, alege ba ka ŋandiinta a dɛ la. 3M dan basi ate ba kuli ale kommu, ba le cha kama dii nyiŋla ba kan ta pagrim a cheŋ paari ba yeeŋa. Ba gela a nyini ka niŋniŋa a jam.>>
4Wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa weeni ayen dela ka sagi po. <<Ti le nya ŋandiinta ka be dela jigini ate ti paari nuruma de a soa nna?>>
5Yeezu yaa bek ba ayen, <<Ka boan ŋandiinta ate ni tara?>> Ba yaa tulisi wa ayen, <<Ti ta ka borobotta tiyopɔi.>>
6Wa yaa weeni nuru boanni meena ayen ba kali tɛŋ. Wa yaa pai borobottaŋa tiyopɔiwa a puusi a te Wen ayen wa niak ŋandiintaŋa, ale ŋmari te wa ŋaaŋviirɔma ayen ba chari nuru boanni. Ba yaa chari ba meena. 7Wa ŋaaŋviirɔma mɛ a jam ta juma maga dega ale ba. Yeezu a tuesi ŋa a ŋman puusi a te Naawen ayen wa niak ŋa ale a pai te wa ŋaaŋviirɔma ate ba chari nuru boanni. 8Ba meena yaa ŋɔbi chak, alege ate Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma a pisi ŋandiin tii ale tali la a sueri busisa siyopɔi. 9Baai ale jam dɛ ŋandiintaŋa la, a jam ka nuruba tusa ŋanaansi (4,000). Wa yaa jam basi ate ba cheŋ. 10Wa ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma deri jo ŋaaruŋ po nwuli a cheŋ ga paari Dalimanuta.
11Farisiima gela yaa jam Yeezu jigi a deri ta nanpaga ale wa. Ba jam a yaali ayen ba yik wa kama. Ba yaa weeni wa ayen wa nye wakperikaliik ate ku sak ayen wa pagrimu a sum nyini ka Wen jigi. 12Yeezu yaa weeni ayen, <<Mm, ka boa ale soa ate jinla demma a yaali ayen ba nya wakperikaliika? Mi a weeni ni ka wensie, nama ale a yaali diila, m kan te ate ni nya di.>> 13Wa yaa basi ba ale ŋman ga jo ŋaaruŋku po ayen wa gaam a taam nyakpiemu kauk kunkula.
14Ba ale jam boro a gomsi ayen ba cheŋ dula la, Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa baŋ ba ŋandiintaŋa a basi ŋaaŋ. Boroborok kunyi dekki ate ba jam pai nyo ŋaaruŋku po. 15Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni a limisi abe ni a kpesi nidek ale Farisiima ale Ayerod dabintaŋa.>>
16Wa ale weeni dila la, ba yaa bek chaab ayen, <<Ka tama ale kan ta ti boroboroku la ale soa ate wa a weeni dila?>>
17Yeezu yaa seba dii ate ba jam a biisi la ate wa bek ba ayen, <<Ka boa ale soa ate ni a biisi ayen ni ka ŋandiinta? Nama an diem baga a miŋi? Ku a nye ase ni tueŋa a diem kpari kama la. 18Nama diem a nye ase ka nuru baai ate Wen biisi ba wie wa gbaŋka po dipo la. Ni ta nina kama alege ni kan nya. Ni be ta tue mɛ kama, alege ni kan wom. 19Nama baga a teeri diipo ate mi pai borobotta tinuwa a ŋmari chari nuruba tusa ŋanuwa (5,000) la? Boroborok talaŋa a jam sueri ka busisa si dina?>> Ba yaa ŋman weeni wa ayen, <<Ti sueri ka busisa pi ale siye.>>
20Wa ŋman bek ba ayen, <<Mi ale pai borobotta tiyopɔiwa a ŋmari chari nuruba tusa ŋanaansiwa (4,000) la, boroborok talaŋa a sueri ka busisa si dina?>> Ba yaa ŋman weeni wa ayen, <<Ti sueri ka busisa siyopɔi.>> 21Wa yaa ŋman bek ba ayen, <<Nama an diem a miŋ ya?>>
22Ba yaa jam paari Beteseida tɛŋka. Nuruba gela yaa jam ta yio a jam Yeezu jigi a saalim wa ayen wa pai wa nisaŋa a tiri wa nyiŋka ate wa ninaŋa a lagri. 23Yeezu yaa yik nuruwa nisaŋa a ta wa a nyini tɛŋka po a nyini a chesi tintueta basi nuruwa ninaŋa po alege pai wa nisimaŋa mɛ a vi nuruwa zuk ale bek wa ayen, <<Fi baga a nya jaaboa?>>
24Nuruwa yaa lak wa ninaŋa ayen wa nya, wa yaa weeni Yeezu ayen, <<Mi a nya ka nuruba m niŋ ase tiisa la ate ba nyiem a cheŋ.>>
25Yeezu a ŋman pilim pai wa nisimaŋa a tiri nuruwa ninaŋa, ate ŋa yaa lagri ate wa yaa nya nna cheri. 26Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Kuli yeri, kan cheŋ tɛŋka po.>>
27Ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ Yeezu ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa cheŋ tɛŋ fiik sii ale jam gilim Siizariya Filipai tɛŋka la. Ase ba ale jam bo suiku po a cheŋ la, wa yaa bek ba ayen, <<Nuruba a weeni ayen mi ka wana?>>
28Ba yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Ba gela ayen fi ka Jɔɔn Sokateerɔwa, ba gela mɛ ayen fi ka Elaja. Mba mɛ a weeni ayen fi ka Wen biisiteerɔma po wanyi.>>
29Wa yaa ŋman bek ba ayen, <<Nama dek a weeni ayen mi ka wana?>> Piita yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Fi ale Kirisitawa.>> 30Yeezu yaa kaam ba ayen, <<Ni kan weeni dila a sak waai ya.>>
31Yeezu yaa piilim sak ba ayen, <<Nuruba le basi ate Mi Saalɔbiika a nam nna yegayega. Juuma nisɔmma ale kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa ale Sinsak sagrɔma ale zɛri mu, abe ba basi ate nuruba ko mu alege daa ŋata a dan paari m le yiti kum po.>> 32Wa biisi dila a lagri kama ayen ba miŋ chak. Piita ale wom wa wieŋa la, wa yaa yik wa a ta wa taam nakpiak a toariŋ wa wa ale weeni dila la nyiŋ.
33Yeezu yaa gisi nya wa ŋaaŋviirɔma meena alege toariŋ Piita ayen, <<Cheŋ du mi niŋ, Sitaana nyɔnɔ. Fi ale a biisi diila an nyini daa Wen jigiya, alege di nyini ka nurubiik jigi.>>
34Yeezu yaa wi wa ŋaaŋviirɔma ale nuru boanni ate ba jam wa jigi ate wa weeni ba ayen, <<Nuru a daa yaali ayen wa va mi ŋaaŋ, basi ate wa liŋ a zɛri wadek yaalika, abe wa pai wa jabarimu a jam va mi. 35Nuru waai nina a dan muni ayen wa vari wadek nyuvuri a basi, kula nyɔnɔwa le jɔk di kama, alege nuru waai a dan jɔk wa nyuvuri wa le va mi la nyiŋ ale wa siaka ale Wen wamaŋsaŋa nyiŋ, kula nyɔnɔwa le vari di a basi. 36Ka boan jaab nyuenta ate nuru le nya ase wa nin nya tɛŋzuk meena masimu alege jɔk wa nyuvuri ya? 37Jaab karo ate kula nyɔnɔwa le pai tagri a nya wa nyuvunni ase wa nin jɔk di. 38Nuru waai a dan chali chivie ale mi ale m wanni moolika kabonsa ale gaasa nyama de suŋsuŋ, Mi mɛ Saalɔbiika ale chali chivie ase m nin ŋman pilim jam tɛŋzuk de ale m Kowa zulaŋa ale maarɔ weleŋsaŋa.>>

Title: MAAK 9
Content:
1Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Wensie ate mi a weeni ni, nama baai ale bo dela la, gela a kan kpi ka ni nin nya Wen naamu ale bu cheena ale pagrim.>>
2Daa ŋayuebi ale jam taam la, Yeezu yaa wi Piita ale Jeemsi ale Jɔɔn a ta ba jueli guuk kpioŋ zuk badek ba nyiini. Ba ale jam bo dula jigini la, Yeezu yaa deri tagri ba niŋ. 3Wa gattaŋa mɛ a tagri ale peenti a nyaksi nna kpelim kpelim. Nuru waai a jam ka a baga a nye ate ti a peenti ale a nyaksi dila. 4Ba yaa nya Elaja ale Moosis ale ba boro a biisi ale Yeezu.
5Piita yaa weeni Yeezu ayen, <<Sagrɔ, tama ale bo dela la ku nala kama. Basi ate tama a ti viita tita a te ni ate fi soa kunyi abe Moosis a soa kunyi abe Elaja mɛ a soa kunyiwa.>> 6Wa jam zɛ dii ate wa le weeni la, dii nyiŋla wa ale mbala a jam a chali ka yɔgsum yegayega.
7Chiŋmari yaa jam lik ba ate ba wom lueluk ale ku nyini chiŋmanni po a weeni ba ayen, <<Mi Nidoabili dii ate mi a yaali la ale nna. Ni wom wa.>>
8Ba le deri gisi nya la ba an nya waai ya, ka Yeezu nyiini ale jam bo dula jigini ale ba.
9Ba ale basi guuku zuk a siŋ la, Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Dii ate ni poom nya la, ni kan weeni sak waai ya, ka dai dii dai ate Mi Saalɔbiika a yiti kum po la.>>
10Ba yaa siak wa ale weeni diila ale pai ŋa a nyo ba suiniima po ale a bek chaab ayen, <<Wa kummu po yitika kiri ale boa?>>
11Ba yaa bek Yeezu ayen, <<Ka boa ate Sinsak sagrɔma a weeni ayen ka Wen biisiteerɔwa Elaja le wa liŋ jam abe wa ge ate Kirisitawa a jamu?>>
12Wa yaa jam weeni ba ayen, <<Elaja liŋ cheen kama ayen wa gomsi jaab buuri meena. Ku abe ŋmarisi a va Saalɔbiika nyiŋ kama ayen wa le nam wie yegayega nyiŋ abe ba nye ate wa chim javaliŋ. 13Alege mi a weeni ni kama ayen Elaja a poom ŋaam jam kama ate ba nye wa badek ale a yaali diila. Ase ba ale ŋmarisi dii a ta va wa nyiŋ la.>>
14Ba yaa jam gum chaab ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔ mbala ate nuru boari yegayega a za gilim ba ate Sinsak sagrɔma gela yaa ta nanpaga ale ba. 15Nuru boanni ale jam nya Yeezu la, ku yaa cha ba nna yegayega ate ba yaa chali ga tu wa a puusi wa.
16Yeezu yaa bek wa ŋaaŋviirɔma ayen, <<Ka boan daluŋ ate ni ta ale Sinsak sagrɔma?>>
17Nuru yaa jam bo nuru boanni po a weeni wa ayen, <<Sagrɔ, m ta ka m nidoabili a jam fi jigi. Chichirik biok ale bo wa po ate wa an baga a biisi. 18Chichirik bioku a dan ga yiti, ku nyiem a pai wa kama a kasim a fɔbi tɛŋ diipo meena ate tintupuuk a nyini wa nɔnni po a nyini ate wa a ŋɔbi wa nyinaŋa ate wa nyiŋka mɛ a deri ate m yaa saalim fi ŋaaŋviirɔma ayen ba yiak chichirik bioku wa po a basi alege ba an baga a nyeya.>>
19Yeezu yaa tulisi ayen, <<Nama gaŋ kaai ale kan ta siaka la, mi ale bo ale nama a beni ka sɛ abe mi a ŋmagli ale ni? Ta fi nidoabinni a jam de.>>
20Wa yaa ta wa a jam Yeezu jigi. Chichirik bioku ale ga nya Yeezu la, ku yaa deri yiti nna yegayega a pai biika a fɔbi tɛŋka ate wa a bilim ate tintupuuk a nyini wa nɔnni po a nyini.
21Yeezu yaa bek biika kowa ayen, <<Chichirik bioku ale jo fi biika la, ka benaŋa dina?>> Wa kowa yaa weeni Yeezu ayen, <<Ku jo wa ka wa bi fiik po. 22Dai po dai po ku a yuk wa kama a lɔnsi bolim po ale nyiam po ayen ku ko wa. Fi dan baga a maari ti, ta jiirim ale ti abe fi maari ti.>>
23Yeezu yaa ŋman bek wa ayen, <<Ka boa ate fi a bek ayen m nin baga? Wie meena a baga a nye kama a te nuru waai ale ta siaka la.>>
24Biika kowa yaa deri kaari a weeni ayen, <<Mi ta siaka kama, alege m siaka an soa diiya. Maari mu ate m ta siaka a gum du.>>
25Yeezu ale nya ale nuru boari a chali cheena jigini la, wa yaa toariŋ chichirik bioku ayen, <<Fi chichirik biok kuui ale basi ate biika de an baga a biisi ale kan wom la, mi a biisi ale ka fi. Nyini biika jigi a nyini abe fi kan ŋman jo a bo ale wa.>>
26Chichirik bioku yaa deri kaari nna yegayega a yuk wa lɔnsi alege yaa nyini biika nyiŋka po a nyini, alege ate wa dua ase wa kpi la ate nuruba yegayega a jam a weeni ayen, <<Wa kpi kama.>> 27Yeezu yaa yik wa nisaŋa a zak wa a zaani ŋmai.
28Yeezu ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma ale cheŋ a ga jo dɔk po badek ba nyiini la, ba yaa bek wa ayen, <<Ka boa ale soa ate tama an baga yiak chichirik bioku ate ku nyini biika jigiya?>>
29Wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Chichirik bioku de choawa ni dan kan bobi nɔi ale puusi a te Wen nalimnyiini, ni an baga a yiak ate ku a nyini.>>
30Yeezu ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa basi dula ale cheŋ taam Galili tɛŋka po. Yeezu an jam a yaali ayen nuru seba ba ale a cheŋ juijui la, 31dii nyiŋla wa jam a sak ka wa ŋaaŋviirɔma. Wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Nuruba le jam yik Mi Saalɔbiika, a ta ga nyo nuru baai ale ba ko mu la nisa po, alege daa ŋata dan paari, m le yiti kum po.>> 32Wa ale weeni dila la, ba an jam miŋ dii ate wa a biisi la kiriya, alege ba jam a chali ka yɔgsum ale wa bekka.
33Ba yaa jam paari Kapernaum tɛŋka po a ga jo yeri po. Yeezu yaa bek ba ayen, <<Ti ale poom bo suiku po a cheena la, ka boan jaab nanpaga ate nama poom a nagi?>> 34Alege ba an weeni wa wari ya, dii nyiŋla ba ale poom bo suiku po la, ba ta ka nanpaga ase ka ba wana ale wa chim kpagi a gaam ba meena.
35Yeezu yaa kali tɛŋ a wi wa ŋaaŋviirɔma pi ale bayewa ate ba jam wa jigi ate wa weeni ba ayen, <<Nuru waai ale a yaali ayen wa chim niŋdeerɔ la, ku a fɛ ate wa pai wadek a zaani ŋaaŋ abe wa chim ba meena tomteerɔ.>>
36Wa yaa yik biik wanyi a ta jam zaani ba suŋsuŋ a pai wa nisaŋa a gbaari wa ale weeni ba ayen, 37<<Nuru waai ale a tuesi biik ase biika de la mi nyiŋ, wa tuesi ka mi dila. Waai mɛ abe ale a tuesi mi la, a tuesi ka waai mɛ ale tom mi ate m jam la.>>
38Jɔɔn yaa weeni Yeezu ayen, <<Sagrɔ, tama nya ka nuru wanyi ale wa pai fi yuenni nyiŋ a yiak chichirik baata nuruba po a basi, ate tama yaa weeni wa ayen wa basi, dii nyiŋla wa daa tama po wanyi.>>
39Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni dan ŋman nya wa ase dila la, ni basi wa abe ni kan weeni wa ate wa basi. Nuru waai a dan pai mi yuenni nyiŋ a baga a tom wakperikaliik kula nyɔnɔwa a kan ŋman baga a kpabi kaasi mi yuenni. 40Nuru waai ale kan ta chaab ale ti la, kula nyɔnɔwa va ti kama. 41Wensie ate mi a weeni ni, nuru waai a dan nye nyiam fii fiiga a te ni, ni ale ka mi ŋaaŋviirɔba la nyiŋ, Wen le tuni wa.
