Tama a biisi ka biisa tɔgatɔga, alege tama a wom ba ale a biisi ale tidek tɛŋsaŋa biisaŋa a magsi chaab ale Naawen tuimkperisaŋa wie ale ka diila kama.>> 12Ku jam cha ba meena kama ate ba butim a bek chaab ayen, <<Kude kiri ale boa?>> 13Alege mbala mɛ a nye Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma a la ale a weeni ayen, <<Nuruma de a nyu ka daam a yib.>>
14Alege Piita yaa yiti zaani ŋmai ale ŋaaŋviirɔba pi ale wanyiwa a biisi ate ku jueli ayen, <<Judia demma ale nama baai meena ale bo Jerusalem la, ni seba kude abe ni wom wie ŋaai ate mi a yaali m biisi la. 15Ni a poli kama ayen nuruma de a nyu ka daam a yib, alege ku daa wensie. Nama kan nya ku ale diem ka saluik baŋ neok la? 16Kude ate Biisiteerɔwa Joel a jam biisi ku wari ayen, 17Wen weeni ayen, <Da Kpeglimaŋa po, mi le pai m Chiika a nyo nuru meena po, ni nidoabilisaŋa ale ni liema ale mooli Wen wie. Ni nuru paalukku ale nya gɔdaasima po wie ate ni nuru kpagsaŋa ale gɔdaasim. 18Nidoa baai ale nipok baai ale tom a te mu da ŋala po la, m le pai m Chiika a nyo ba mɛ po ate ba biisi chum po wie ase Biisiteerɔba la. 19M le nye wakperikaliisa wenŋmazuk abe m tom wakinkagla tɛŋzuk de ate nuruba nya. Ba ale nya ziim, ale bolim ale nyuisa nna kpitɔ. 20Nidoa baai ale nipok baai ale tom a te mu da ŋala po la, m le pai m Chiika a nyo ba mɛ po ate ba biisi chum po wie ase Biisiteerɔba la. Wenbinni le sobri, ate chiika tagri a muni nna ase ziim la alege ate ti Naawenni Dakpienni a jam. 21Ate waai meena ale a wi Naawen la ale nya varibasika. (Joel 2:28-32)
22<<Izirali demma, ni wom wieŋa de. Wen lueri Yeezu Nazaret denɔwa kama. Wa be va ka wala nyiŋ a nye wakpiema ale wakperikaliisa ale wakinkagla nama nimbie po. Ni be seba nya kude a chak kama nalimnyiini. 23Yeezuwa de ate nama a yik a te tuimbaata nyam ayen ba ko wa. Ka Wen ale poli ayen ku nye dila. 24Alege Wen a vari wa kama kum po a basi a nak wa a yiti kum po dii nyiŋla wa jam daa waai ate kum a baga yik wa a tara. 25Deevid jam weeni wa wie kama ayen, <Mi kasim jam a nya ti Naawenni kama m niŋ, wa boka m juga geŋ, wari a kan nye mu. 26Dila nyiŋ m sui a jam peenti kama ate m pak wa. M nyiŋka a ta yiila kama. 27Dii nyiŋ la, Fi kan zɛri mu a basi ate m cheŋ kpiluŋŋoa, yaase fi basi ate fi weleŋsa nuruwa a puak vɔrumu po. 28Fi sak mu nyeboka suiku kama. Fi basi ate m sui peenti kama fi le bo ale mu la nyiŋ.> >> (Yiila 16:8-11)
29Piita yaa ŋman biisi ayen, <<M suata, ni basi ate m biisi lak a sak ni ale sebchakka ayen ni kokpieŋka Deevid a kpi kama ate ba gu wa. Wa boosuku abe diem boro kama a jam paari jinla. 30Wa ale jam ka Biisiteerɔ a seba Wen ale puulim dii ale wa ayen wa le nye ate wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa po wanyi a chim naab la, 31Wa ŋaam jam nya kama ale biisi Kirisitawa kum po yiti ka wie ayen, <Wa an jam wari kpiluŋŋoa yaase wa nyiŋka a poak ya.> 32Yeezuwa de ate Wen nak yiti la, dii ate tama meena a chim seerɔba la. 33Waai ale nya zula a bo Wen juga geŋsa la a tuesi Chiika pagrimu pumpuulimaŋa a nyini Kowa jigi, Yeezu yaa pai Wen Chiika a te ni dila ale soa ate ŋade meena a nye jinla la. 34Daa Deevid ale jam jueli wenŋmazuwa, alege ka wadek ale weeni ayen, <Naawen a weeni mi Nyɔnɔwa ayen, <<Kali mi juga geŋ 35ate m ga basi ate fi dachaasaŋa a chim fi naŋsa tabika jaab.> (Yiila 110:1)
36<<Nama Izirali demma ku a fɛ kama ayen ni seba chak ayen ka Yeezuwa dɛ ate ni yik kpi jabarimu nyiŋla ate Wen basi ate wa chim ti Nyɔnɔ ale Kirisita la.>>
37Nuruma ale jam wom kude la ba sue yaa kaasi, ate ba bek Piita ale tuimtomdɔ mbala, ayen, <<Ti suata, ti be ti nye ka sɛ?>>
38Piita yaa tulisi ba ayen, <<Ni meena basi ni tuimbaataŋa abe ni tuesi soka Yeezu Kirisita yuei nyiŋ ate wa vɔŋ ni wabaataŋa a te ni ate ni yaa nya Wen Chiika tiirimu. 39Diila pumpuulimaŋa ka nama ale ni bisaŋa ale ni ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale soa. Baai meena ate Naawenni ti Wenni a lueri la ale soa ŋa.>>
40Piita jam biisi ka wa boari, wa jam saalim ba kama ayen, <<Ni vari nidek a ta nyini gaŋ bioku de po a basi.>> 41Baai ale jam siak wa wanni la a jam tuesi ka soka, baai ale jam siak a te Wen la a jam ka nuruba tusa ŋata (3,000) a gum du. 42Ba jam pai ba boka po meena a zamsi ka ŋaaŋviirɔma sinsaŋŋa ale a tu chaab a de ale chaab ale a puusi ale chaab.
43Yɔgsum ale jam yik waai meena. Wen a jam va ka tuimtomdɔma nyiŋ a nye wakperikaliisa ale wakinkagla, ŋaai ale a sak ayen Wen bo ale ba kama la. 44Baai meena ale ta siaka a va wensuiku la, a kasim jam boro ale ka chaab a nye wie ale chaab 45a pai ba ŋantaŋa a da a pai ligraŋa a chari baai ale a silim la. 46Daa meena ba kasim a nye ka tuka ale popola yena Wen yenni po. Ba maa chaab mɛ ba yeeŋa po a dɛ ŋandiinta ale suipeentik ale chaab 47ale a pak Wen, ale ta suipeentik ale nuruba meena. Daa meena ti Naawenni a ta ka nuru baai ale a nya varibasika la jam a gum ba po.

Title: TUIMA 3
Content:
1Piita ale Jɔɔn a yaa jam a cheŋ Wen yenni diipo ate ba a puusi la, wenbalinni baŋ buta. 2Nuru ale jam boro, ba le biak wa la ale wa ka gbaruk ate ba nyiem ji wa a ta ga kali Wen yenni nansuiŋku ate ba a wi ayen Nalim Nansuiŋ la nɔi ate wa a juisi baai ale a jo Wen yenni po la. 3Wa ale jam nya Piita ale Jɔɔn cheena ba jo la, wa yaa juisi ba ayen ba te wa jaab. 4Ba yaa nya wa nina po nna ziin, ate Piita weeni wa ayen, <<Nya tama.>> 5Wa yaa kasim a nya ale a yiili ayen wa ale nya ka jaab ba jigi. 6Alege Piita yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Mi ka ligra, alege mi ale te fu ka jabuui ate mi ta la, Yeezu Kirisita Nazaret denɔwa yuenni nyiŋ yiti cheŋ.>> 7Piita yaa yik wa juga nisaŋa a maari wa ate wa yiti. Nuruwa naŋsaŋa ale kunaŋa a deri ta pagrim nna nwuli. 8Wa yaa dugsi a piilim a cheŋ va ba jo Wen yenni po a yɔk a zi a cheŋ a pak Wen 9ate nuruma meena a nya wa ale a cheŋ ale a pak Wen la. 10Ba jam miŋ ayen ka waai ale a kali Nalim Nansuiŋku a juisi la ale la. Ku yaa chim wakperikaliik a te ba.
11Piita ale Jɔɔn yaa pilim jam bo ka Yenni po juijui ate ba a wi ayen Solomon Pɔsuk la. Nuruwa ale jam bobi Piita ale Jɔɔn nna giŋgiŋ a ta la, ku yaa cha nuruma meena ate ba yaa chali cheŋ Piita ale Jɔɔn jigi. 12Piita ale nya nuruma la wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Izirali demma, ka boa ale soa ate wanni de a cha ni? Be ka boan mɛ ale soa ate ni a nya ti dila? Nama poli ayen ku ka tama dek pagrim nyiŋ yaase tidek wen suik tuima nyiŋ ale soa ate tama nye ate nuruwa de a baga a cheŋ? 13Ku ka Abrayam ale Aizik ale Jekob ale ti kokpieŋsaŋa Wenni ale te zula wa tomteerɔwa Yeezu. Alege nama ale yik wa a te Gominawa Paalɔt zɛri wa wa niŋ. Paalɔt jam poom a yaali ayen wa vari wa a basi kama alege nama zɛri. 14Yeezu a jam ka Weleŋsa Ale Wayɔrisima Nyɔnɔ, alege nama zɛri wa kama alege weeni Paalɔt ayen wa yeeri nuru koorɔwa a te ni. 15Nama be ko ka nyuvuri teerɔwa. Wen abe nak wa yiti kum po kama. Tama be nya wanni de kama a weeni sak ni. 16Ku be poom ka wala yuenni pagrim nyiŋ ale siaka wa yuenni nyiŋ ate nuruwa de ate ni seba wa la a nya nyiŋyɔgsa ate ni a nya wa ate wa ta pagrim. Ni ale a nya dii nna la, ku ka siaka Yeezu yuenni nyiŋ ate nuruwa a tara a yaa nya nyiŋyɔgsa nama meena nimbie po.
17<<Yɔgyɔgla de m suata, m seba ayen nama ale ni kpaŋŋa ale nye Yeezu diila, ni zɛ kama ate ni nye. 18Alege Wen ale nye dii a va wa biisiteerɔma zuk a biisi ayen wa Kirisitawa a nam la. Ku sum jam chim ka wensie. 19Dila nyiŋ ni be tagri a basi ni tuimbaataŋa ate Wen a vɔŋ te ni. Ni dan nye dila suipeentik ale nyini ti Naawenni jigi a jam ni jigi 20ate wa basi ate Yeezu waai ale ka Kirisitawa ate wa poom lueri wa a te ni la yaa jam ni jigi. 21Wa ale kasim bo ka wenŋmazuk ate ku ga paari diipo ate wa le jam nye wie meena a magsi ase Wen ale jam pai wa biisiteerɔ weleŋsaŋa a biisi dii dipo la. 22Moosis a weeni kama ayen, <Naawen dii ale ka ni Wen la ale te ni biisiteerɔ ase mi la a ta nyini nidek suataŋa po. Ku be a fɛ kama ayen ni siak a va wari meena ate wa a weeni ni ayen ni nye la. (Teerika 18:15) 23Nuru waai abe ale kan a va dii ate biisiteerɔwa de a weeni la, ku a fɛ kama ayen Wen poori wa nuruma po a kaasi wa.> (Kaabka 23:29) 24Biisiteerɔ baai meena ale biisi a ta nyini Samuel daaŋa po, ale baai mɛ ale pai saŋ wa la, bala meena a biisi magsi chaab ale ka wie ŋaai ale nye daaŋa de la. 25Nama be ka biisiteerɔma de bisa. Wen abe ale jam nye nɔiyeŋka dipo ale ni kokpieŋsaŋa la, nama abe maa ta nɔiyeŋ kala mɛ kama ase wa ale jam weeni Abrayam ayen, <M le va ka fi ŋaaŋbisaŋa nyiŋ a niak waai meena tɛŋzuk.> (Piilimka 22:18) 26Wen a nak wa tomteerɔwa a yiti kum po, a liŋ tom wa nama jigi ayen wa niak ni, ni le basi gaasa suitaŋa la nyiŋ.>>

Title: TUIMA 4
Content:
1Ba ale jam boro a biisi ale nuruma la, kaabteerɔba ale Wen yenni limisidɔma kpagni ale Sajusiiba yaa jam ba jigi 2ale suipuurum dii nyiŋla Piita ale Jɔɔn a jam a sak nuruma ayen Yeezu a yiti kum po kama. Dila abe a sak kama ayen baai ale kpi la a le yiti kum po. 3Dila nyiŋ ba yaa yik Piita ale Jɔɔn a lik ate vari veenti dii nyiŋla, ku jam ka junɔi. 4Alege ba yegayega ale wom ba sinsaŋŋa la, a jam siak a te ŋa kama ate ba meena a gum chaab paari nidoaba tusa ŋanu (5,000).
5Vari ale veenti la, niŋdeerɔma ale nisɔmma ale Sinsak sagrɔma a jam tigsi ka chaab Jerusalem tɛŋka, 6ale kaabteerɔ kpioŋku Anasi ale Kayafas ale Jɔɔn ale Alezanda ale baai meena ale ka kaabteerɔ kpioŋku dɔkdemma po la. 7Ba yaa yik tuimtomdɔma a zaani ba niŋ a bek ba ayen, <<Ka boan jaab pagrim nyiŋ yaase yuei boan nyiŋ ate nama nye nna?>>
8Wen Chiika ale jam sueri Piita la, yaa tulisi ba ayen, <<Nuruma niŋdeerɔba ale nisɔmma, 9nama a dan a bek tama jinla wamaŋ kaai ate ti nye a te gbaruku la ale jabuui nyiŋ ate nuruwa de a nya nyiŋyɔgsa la, 10ku a fɛ kama ayen nama meena ale Izirali tɛŋka demma meena a seba ayen ka Yeezu Kirisita Nazaret denɔwa waai ate ni yik kpi jabarimu nyiŋ ate Wen nak wa yiti kum po la, wala yuenni nyiŋ ate nuruwa de a za ni niŋ a ta nyiŋyɔgsa. 11Tintanni de ale nama seerɔma a zɛri la dila ale chim nyubini gugoruku tintain.> (Yiila 118:22) 12Varibasika a va ka wala nyiini nyiŋ a jam. Nuru ka tɛŋzuk de ate Wen a te ate kula nyɔnɔwa a baga vari ti a basi. Ka wala nyiini.>>
13Ba ale jam nya ale Piita ale Jɔɔn a ta pagrim a baga biisi nna alege ba an zamsi gbaŋ a paari niŋ la, ku yaa cha ba nna yegayega ate ba yaa miŋ ayen ba jam boro ale ka Yeezu. 14Alege ba jam ka wari a weeni, dii nyiŋla, nuru waai ate ba tebi la a jam za ale ka Piita ale Jɔɔn. 15Ba yaa weeni ba ayen ba nyini kpaŋŋa dɔkku po a nyini peelim, ba yaa bek chaab ayen, 16<<Ti baga a nye nuruma de ka sɛ? Wakperikaliika de ate ba nye nna ate waai meena Jerusalem tɛŋka po a nya la? Ti be an baga a nak nanpaga ale di mɛ. 17Ti be dan a yaali ayen wanni de a kan ŋman tagli jigi meena, ni basi ate ti kaam ba ayen ba kan ŋman pai Yeezu yuenni nyiŋ a biisi wari ale waai ya.>>
18Ba yaa wi Piita ale Jɔɔn a kaam ba ayen ba kan ŋman pai Yeezu yuenni nyiŋ a biisi yaase ba sak waai ya. 19Alege Piita ale Jɔɔn yaa tulisi ba ayen, <<Nama dek abe weeni nya kude ase ka ku kuna dek ale magsi Naawen jigi ase ka ti zuli nama yaa ti zuli Wen yaa? 20Tama an baga basi dii ate tama nya ale wom la biiga.>> 21Kpaŋŋa yaa ŋman kaam ba ale basi ba ate ba cheŋ, dii nyiŋla ku jam pagra kama ate ba nya suik a te ba waalika, nuruma meena a kasim jam a te ka Wen pimpauk ale dii ale nye la. 22Dii nyiŋla, nuru waai ate wakperikaliika de a jam nye ate wa nya nyiŋyɔgsa la, a jam gaam bena pisinaansi kama.
23Ba ale jam pai Piita ale Jɔɔn a basi la, ba yaa pilim cheŋ ba Kirisita bisa chaama jigi a weeni sak ba kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa ale nisɔmma ale weeni ba diila. 24Ba ale wom la, ba yaa maa chaab a puusi Wen ayen, <<Nyɔnɔwa, fi waai ale nye wenŋmazuk ale tɛŋzuk de nyakpiemu ale ŋan baai meena ale bo ba po la, 25fi va Wen Chiika nyiŋ a biisi ale ti kokpieŋka Deevid fi tomteerɔwa ate wa weeni ayen, <Ka boa ale soa ate nuru baai ale kan daa Juuba la sue a puuri? Ka boa ale soa ate nuruma ta popola kayaata? 26Tɛŋzuk de nalimaŋa ale nisɔmma a gomsi kama ayen ba nye kpaliŋ ale Naawen ale wa Kirisitawa.> (Yiila 2:1-2) 27Tɛŋ kpieŋka de po Ayerod ale Pontios Paalɔt ale baai ale kan daa Juuba ale Izirali demma a ta ka chaab, ba nye kpaliŋ ale fi tomteerɔ weleŋka Yeezu waai ate fi bobi wa naam la, 28ayen ba kaasi dii meena ate fi ŋaam basi ate fi nisa ale fi popolaŋa a nye la. 29Yɔgyɔgla de, Naawen yaa, nya ba ale a nyigsi ti dii ale popola ŋaai ayen ba nye ti jigi la. Be basi ate tama fi tomteerɔma a ta pagrim a biisi fi wamaŋsaŋa abe ti kan a chali yɔgsum. 30Pa fi pagrimu a tebi nuruba, abe fi te suik ate ti pai fi tomteerɔ weleŋka Yeezu yuenni a nye wakperikaliisa ate nuruba nya.>>
31Ba ale jam puusi a nueri la, juijui ate ba jam kala la, a yaa choa. Wen Chiika a jam sueri ba meena suiniimaŋa kama ate ba yaa deri piilim a biisi Wen wamaŋsaŋa ale nyiŋ pagra.
32Baai meena ale jam ta siaka ale Yeezu la, a jam ta ka nɔiyeŋ ale popola yena. Ba waai jam karo a weeni ayen wa ŋan baai ate wa ta la ka wadek wa nyiini ŋanta, alege ba meena a pai ba ŋantaŋa a chari ka chaab. 33Tuimtomdɔma yaa jam sak kama ale pagrim ayen ba nya Yeezu ale yiti kum po la. Naawen a jam ŋmante ba ka nna yegayega. 34Nuru a jam ka ba po a nam a yaali jaaboa. Baai meena ale jam soa tɛŋsa ale yie la, a pai da kama, a ta ligraŋa 35a jam a te tuimtomdɔma. Ligraŋa de ba yaa pai kama a chari ba meena a magsi chaab ale ba wanyi wanyi ale sum a yaali ligra diila.
36Nuru wanyi ale jam boro. Wa yuei ale Josefi. Wa jam ka Livaima po ate ba biak wa Saipurus tɛŋka. Tuimtomdɔma a jam te wa ka yuei ayen Banabas. Di kiri ale nuru waai ale a deŋsi nuruba kpa la, 37Nuruwa de jam pai ka wa tɛŋ a da a ta ligraŋa a jam te tuimtomdɔma.

Title: TUIMA 5
Content:
1Alege nuru ale jam boro. Wa yuei ale Ananaiyas. Wa powa yuei ale Safira, a yaa pai ba tɛŋ a da. 2Ba yaa maa chaab a poori ligraŋa gela a ta badek ale ge nŋala a te tuimtomdɔma.
3Ba ale ta ligraŋa a jam tuimtomdɔma jigi la, Piita yaa bek wa ayen, <<Ananaiyas, ka boa ale soa ate fi basi ate Sitaana paasi fu ate fi velim ale Wen Chiika alege tali tɛŋka ligraŋa gela? 4Diipo ate fi an diem pai ka a da la, daa fi ale jam soa ka? Fi be ale pai ka mɛ a da la, ligraŋa mɛ daa fi ale soa? Be ka boa ale soa ate fi poli a nye wanni de? Nya de, fi an velim a te daa nuru biiga, fi velim a te ka Wen.>>
5Ananaiyas ale wom nna la, wa yaa deri lo tɛŋ a kpi ate yɔgsum nna yegayega yaa yik baai meena ale jam wom nya kude la. 6Nidoa paaluk baai ale jam bo dula la yaa pai garuk pali a vili wa nyiŋka a ji wa ta nyini cheŋ a ga gu.
7Ku ale ga beni magadek la, wa powa yaa jam jo. Wa jam zɛ dii ale nye la. 8Piita yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Weeni a sak mu, fi ale fi chorɔwa ale pai ni tɛŋka da la, ka ligraŋa meena ale la ate nama a ta jam?>> Nipowa yaa tulisi Piita ayen, <<Mm, ŋa meena ale la.>>
9Piita yaa bek wa ayen, <<Be ka boa ale soa ate fi ale fi chorɔwa a maa chaab ayen ni chamsi Naawen Chiika a nya? Nya de, nidoa baai ale ta fi chorɔwa a ga gu la, a ŋman cheena kama dɔkku nɔi yɔgyɔgla de. Ba be le ji fi mɛ kama a ta nyini ga gu.>>
10Wa yaa deri lo Piita naŋsa tɛŋ a kpi. Nidoa paalukku a yaa jam jo nya ale wa kpiya ate ba yaa ji wa a ta nyini a ga gu wa chorɔwa tɛŋ. 11Yɔgsum nna yegayega a yaa jam yik Kirisita bisaŋa meena ale baai meena mɛ ale jam wom wieŋa de la.
12Tuimtomdɔma kasim jam a nye ka wakperikaliisa ale wakinkagla nna yegayega nuruma po. Baai ale ta siaka la, a kasim jam a nye tuka ale chaab ka Solomon Pɔsuku jigini Wen yenni po. 13Nuru mbala waai an jam a yaali ayen ba gum ba po, ba meena jaa zuli ba kama. 14Nuru boari nna yegayega nidoaba ale nipooba baai ale jam ta siaka ale ti Naawenni la a jam gum siarɔma po. 15Tuimtomdɔma ale jam a nye diila a basi kama ate nuruba ji yɔgnyieŋsa ale gaduata ale taasa a ta ba nyini suitaŋa niŋsa ayen Piita daa taam abe wa yisuŋku a jɔk va ba zuk a taam. 16Nuru boari ale jam nyini tɛŋ sii ale kala gilim Jerusalem tɛŋka la a ta nuru baai ale a yuak yaase chichirik baata a bo ba po la a jam. Ba meena jam nya nyiŋyɔgsa kama.
17Alege kaabteerɔ kpioŋku ale baai ale jam bo dula ale wa la, Sajusiima beŋka yaa jam a dɛ nyuri. 18Ba yaa yik tuimtomdɔma a lik, dɔk kuui po ate ba a lik waai meena ku po la. 19Yok kuui ate ba lik ba la, Naawen maarɔ yaa jam lak likka diinaŋa noaŋa a ta tuimtomdɔma a nyini a yaa weeni ba ayen, 20<<Ni cheŋ a ga jo zaani Wen yenni po a weeni nuruma nyuvuri paani de kiri ale ka diila.>> 21Tuimtomdɔma yaa siak wa nɔnni a yaa yiti saluik yokyok a ga jo Wen yenni po a sak nuruma. Dila powa kaabteerɔ kpioŋku ale wa vaanchaama yaa wi nisɔmma meena ale Izirali nuru kpientaŋa a tom ayen ba ga ta ba nyini likka dɔkku po a jam. 22Alege nuru baai ate ba tom ayen ba ga ta ba a jam la yaa cheŋ ga paari alege tuimtomdɔma ka likka dɔkku po ate ba pilim ŋman jam weeni a sak ba ayen, 23<<Tama ale ga a paari likka dɔkku la ku jam lik kama nalimnyiini ate baai ale za a limisi la a diem za a limisi. Alege tama ale ga lak dɔkku nɔnni la, tama an nya nuru du.>> 24Wen yenni limisidɔma kpagni ale kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa ale ga wom dila la, ba yaa butim ale a poli jabuui ate wanni de ta cheen la. 25Nuru wanyi a yaa jam jo ba jigi a weeni ba ayen, <<Ni wom de, nuru baai ate ni yik lik la, a za ka Wen yenni po a sak nuruma.>> 26Limisidɔma kpagni ale wa nuruma yaa maa chaab a cheŋ a ga ta tuimtomdɔma a ŋman jam. Ba an jam nye pagrim a yik ba dii nyiŋla ba jam a chali ka yɔgsum ayen nuruma nin zaan yuk ba ale tintana.
27Ba ale ta ba jam la, ba yaa kali tigsuŋku niŋ ate kaabteerɔ kpioŋku yaa bek ba ayen, 28<<Tama an weeni ni ale nin muna ayen, ni kan pai Yeezu yuenni nyiŋ a sak nuruba? Alege nama dek abe nya ni ale kasim a pai ni sinsaŋŋa a sueri Jerusalem tɛŋka po diila. Ni be a yaali kama ayen ni weeni ayen ka tama ale soa ate wa kpi?>>
29Piita ale tuimtomdɔ mbala yaa tulisi ayen, <<Ku a fɛ kama ayen ti siak Wen nɔi a gaam nurubiik nɔi. 30Ni ale yik Yeezu a kpi jabarimu nyiŋ a ko wa la, tama ale ti koma Wenni a nak wa a yiti kum po kama. 31Wen zak wa kama a kali wadek juga ase Niŋdeerɔ ale Varibasidɔ la ayen ku te Izirali demma basi ba wabaataŋa tomka ate ba nya vɔŋteka. 32Tama abe chim ka seerɔba a te wieŋa de, ku be ka dila ale Wen Chiika, waai ate Wen a pai wa a te baai ale a wom wa nɔi la.>>
33Kpaŋŋa ale wom nna la, ku yaa puuri ba sue ate ba jam a yaali ayen ba ko ba. 34Alege kpaŋŋa po wanyi a jam ka Farisii. Wa yuei ale Gamaliil. Wa jam ka Juuma Sinsak sagrɔ. Waai meena a kasim jam a te wa zula ka nna yegayega. Wala yaa yiti zaani kpaŋŋa po a weeni ayen ba ta tuimtomdɔma a nyini peelim ate ku nye maga dega. 35Wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Izirali demma, ni kpesi nidek ale ni ale nye nuruma de dii la. 36Nama dek baga a teeri ayen nuru waai ate ba a wi ayen Teudasi la a jam pai wadek a sak kama ayen wa ka nuru kpioŋ ate nuruba yaa jam paari nidoaba kobsinaansi a pai badek a te wa. Alege Aroom demma ko wa kama ate wa ŋaaŋviirɔma meena a jam waaŋ chaab ate wa wanni mɛ a bɛ. 37Dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ ate Judas Galili denɔwa mɛ a jan jam diipo ate ba jam boro a chiini nuruma la. Wa ale jan jam la, nuru boari ale jam va wa mɛ. Alege ba ko wa mɛ kama ate wa nuruma meena a waaŋ chaab. 38Dila mi a weeni kama ayen dii ate nuruma a nye yɔgyɔgla de la, ni basi ba badek ba nyiini, ale zɔŋŋa de yaase dii ate ba a nye la a dan nyini ka nurubiik jigi ŋa kan ga jigiya, 39alege ku dan nyini ka Wen jigi, ni kan baga a kasi ba. Ni be kpesi nidek kan daa di ni le tulim a kpaliŋ ale ka Wen.>> 40Ba yaa siak wa le kaam ba dii la, a wi ate tuimtomdisaŋa a jo ate ba nak ba ale weeni ba ayen ba kan ŋman sak Yeezu yuenni nyiŋŋa, ale basi ate ba cheŋ. 41Tuimtomdɔma ale jam basi ba la, ba sue a jam peenti kama dii nyiŋla, ka Naawen ale pai ba a chim nuru baai ale magsi ayen ba nam a nya chivie Yeezu yuenni nyiŋla. 42Daa meena Wen yenni po ale ba yieŋa po ba kasim jam a sak nuruba kama ale a mooli ayen Yeezu ka Kirisitawa.

Title: TUIMA 6
Content:
1Va ŋala po ate Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma a jam piisi a gum du la, Juuma baai ale jam a biisi Girik demma biika la, a jam a ŋuuni kama a ŋma Juuma ayen ba pukɔŋŋa a kan jam a nyo ba charuku. 2Tuimtomdɔma pi ale bayewa yaa wi ŋaaŋviirɔma meena ate ba jam jigi yeŋ a weeni ba ayen, <<Ku an magsi ayen ti basi Wen wamaŋsaŋa sakka abe ti a chari ŋandiinta. 3Dila nyiŋ m suata, ni lueri nuruba bayopɔi baai dek ate nama a seba ayen ba nye a magsi ate Wen Chiika ale yam sueri ba la, ate tama yaa pai tuimaŋa de a nyo ba nisima po. 4Abe tama a pai tidek a te puusa ale wa wamaŋsaŋa sakka.>>
5Ba meena sue yaa kasim jam peenti kama ale tuimtomdɔma ale weeni dii la. Ba yaa lueri Sitiven waai ale jam ta siaka nalimnyiini la ale ta Wen Chiika mɛ la, ale Filip ale Porokorus ale Nikano ale Timon ale Paminas ale Nikolasi. Nikolasi jam nyini ka Antiok a yaa tagri wadek maa va Juuma suiku alege wa daa Juu. 6Ba yaa pai ba a sak tuimtomdɔma ate ba pai nisima a vi ba zuk a puusi te ba.
7Wen wanni a jam tagli Jerusalem meena ate ŋaaŋviirɔma ale bo dula la a jam piisi a gum du. Kaabteerɔma yegayega mɛ a jam ta siaka ale sinsaŋŋa kama.
8Sitiven ate ŋmanteka ale pagrim a sueri wa la, yaa jam tom wakperikaliisa ale wakinkagla nna yegayega nuruma nina po. 9Alege tuka dɔkku po nuruba ale jam boro a te badek yue ayen Aŋmandaayom. Juuma ale jam maa nyini Sairini ale Alezandiria ale Silisiya ale Asia tɛŋsaŋa la a maa ka ba po a yaa jam ta nanpaga ale Sitiven. 10Alege Wen Chiika a jam te Sitiven ka yam ate wa biisi ate ba an baga a tulisi wa. 11Ba yaa suk paasi nuruba ayen ba weeni ayen, <<Tama wom ale wa a lɛ Moosis ale Wen.>> 12Ba yaa siti nuruma ale niŋdeerɔma ale sagrɔma, ate ba jueli wa zuk a yik wa a ta cheŋ tigsuŋku jigi, 13a basi ate nuruba a velim ayen, <<Nuruwa de an basi jigi weleŋka ale sinsaŋŋa leeta. 14Tama wom kama ale wa weeni ayen Yeezuwa de ale daasi Wen yenni a lɔnsi abe wa tagri Sinsak ŋaai ate Moosis a te ti la.>> 15Baai meena ale bo tigsuŋku po la, yaa zak nya wa ale wa nimbidiaka a nye ase Wen maarɔ nimbidiak la.

Title: TUIMA 7
Content:
1Kaabteerɔ kpioŋku yaa bek wa ayen, <<Ka wensie?>>
2Sitiven yaa tulisi ayen, <<M suata ale m koba, ni wom mi. Zula Wenni a jam pai wadek a sak ti kowa Abrayam kama. Dila powa, Abrayam jam bo ka Mesopotamiya tɛŋka. Wa an diem jam cheŋ Yaran, 3a weeni wa ayen, <Basi fi tɛŋka ale fi dɔkdemma abe fi cheŋ tɛŋ kaai ate mi ayen m dak a sak fu la.> (Piilimka 12:1)
4<<Abrayam yaa basi Kaldiya tɛŋka ale ge cheŋ a ga bo Yaran tɛŋka. Abrayam kowa ale ga kpi la, Wen yaa weeni Abrayam ayen wa jam tɛŋka de ate ni boro yɔgyɔgla nna la. 5Dila powa Wen an jam te Abrayam tɛŋka de juijui ya. Alege Wen jam puulim kama ayen wa ale pai ka a te wa ate wa ale wa ŋaaŋbisa meena a soa ka. Diipo ate Wen weeni Abrayam dila la, wa jam diem ka biiga. 6Naawen ale weeni wa dii la ale nna, <Fi ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale chim nicham tɛŋ kaai ate ba an soa la po. Dula jigini nuruma ale pai ba chim yɔm a namsi ba paari bena kobsinaansi. 7Alege tɛŋ kala ate ba tom a te la, mi le bo ka buusa. Dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ ba le basi tɛŋ kala abe ba nyini a jam dela jigini a te mi zula.> 8Wen yaa weeni Abrayam ayen wa gebi wa yoanni ate ku sak ayen wa ale Abrayam yaa ta ka nɔiyeŋ ale chaab. Abrayam yaa biak Aizik a gebi wa mɛ yoanni wa biam da naaniŋka dai. Aizik mɛ yaa biak Jekob ate Jekob mɛ a yaa chim wa bisa pi ale bayewa ko.
9<<Jekob bisaŋa yaa dɛ nyuri ale ba suoku Josefi a deri yik wa a da ate wa chim yɔma Ejipiti tɛŋka. Alege Wen a jam bo ale wa kama, 10a vari wa a basi daani kaai meena ate wa jam tu la po, a te wa ŋmanteka ale yam Ejipiti naawa Faaro niŋ, ate wa basi ate wa a nya Ejipiti demma ale Faaro dek yenni zuk. 11Kom yaa jan jam Ejipiti ale Keenan tɛŋsaŋa po, ate ninam nna yegayega a jam. Ti kokpieŋsaŋa an jam baga a nya ŋandiinta. 12Jekob ale wom ayen ŋandiinta a bo Ejipiti tɛŋka la, wa yaa tom wa bisaŋa ti koma ayen ba cheŋ dula jigini. Ba piilim chelim ale la. 13Ba ale ŋman pilim cheŋ dii a nye buye la, Josefi yaa basi ate wa suataŋa a miŋ wa, ate Naawa yaa seba Josefi dɔkdemma. 14Josefi yaa te tuntomiŋ wa kowa Jekob a weeni wa ayen wa ale wa dɔkdemma meena nuruba pisiyopɔi ale banuwa a jam Ejipiti tɛŋka a maa boro ale wa. 15Jekob yaa kɔlim cheŋ Ejipiti tɛŋka a bo dula a ga kpi ate ti kokpieŋsaŋa mɛ kpi 16ate ba yaa pai ba a ta jam Sikiim a gu ba. Ba jam gu ba ka vɔrup buui po ate ba gu Abrayam la. Abrayam dek ale jam da vɔrumu ale ligra Ayaamo nidoabilisaŋa jigi Sikiim tɛŋka po.
17<<Alege Naawen ale jam puulim dii ale Abrayam la a jam moata kama. Ti nuruma yaa ŋmasi jam a piisi a gum du Ejipiti tɛŋka po. 18Naab paalik ale jam yiti a nya Ejipiti tɛŋka, wa jam zɛ Josefi nɔi po. (Nyinika 1:8) 19Wala a jam ta ka gaasa nna yegayega ale ti kokpieŋsaŋa a fɛ ba ayen ba pai ba buluataŋa a ta nyini peelim a dueni ate ba kpi. 20Dila powa ale ba jam biak Moosis. Wa jam nala kama Wen nina po. Wa jam bo ka wa kowa yenni ate ba a nya wa zuk ate ku ga paari chiisa sita. 21Ba ale jam maa pai wa a dueni peelim ayen wa kpi la, naawa lie ale jam pai wa ate wa chim wadek nidoabili a nya wa zuk. 22Ba jam sak wa Ejipiti demma Yammu meena ale ka diila kama, ate wa yaa chim nuru pagrik wie po ale wa biik po.
23<<Moosis ale chim paari bena pisinaansi la, ku yaa jam wa popola po ayen wa cheŋ ga nya wa suataŋa Izirali nidoabilisaŋa. 24Wa yaa nya ale Ejipiti denɔ ale Izirali denɔ a ta chaab. Moosis yaa ga maari wa suoku Izirali denɔwa, a deri ko Ejipiti denɔwa. 25Wa jam poli kama ayen wadek nuruma le miŋ ayen Wen le pai ka wa a vari ba a basi, alege ba an jam miŋ ya. 26Vari ale veenti la Moosis yaa nya ale Izirali demma baye a ta chaab ate wa yaa pii nyiŋ ayen wa gaari ba. Wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <Nidoaba, ni wom de, ni ka suata, ka boa ale soa ate ni a kpaliŋ chaaba?> 27Alege nuru waai ale jam a namsi wa choawa la a yaa tusi Moosis a basi nakpiak ale ge bek Moosis ayen, Ka wana ale nye fi niŋdeerɔ ale boteerɔ tama zuwa. 28Fi a yaali ayen fi ko mi mɛ kama ase deemwa ate fi ko Ejipiti denɔwa diila? (Nyinika 2:14) 29Moosis ale wom dila la, wa yaa basi Ejipiti tɛŋka ale yiti chali cheŋ a ga bo Midian tɛŋka a chim nichaanɔ. Dula jigini wa yaa biak nidoabilisa baye.
30<<Bena pisinaansi ale taam la, Wen maarɔ yaa jam wa jigi sagni po ase bolim ŋiak la goanni po. 31Moosis ale jam nya dila la, ku yaa cha wa ate wa yaa forisi paari ayen wa ŋmasi nya chak. Wa yaa jam wom Naawen lueluk ale ku weeni ayen, 32<Mi ka fi kokpieŋsaŋa Wen, Abrayam Wenni ale Aizik Wenni ale Jekob Wenni.> (Nyinika 3:6) Yɔgsum yaa yik Moosis ate wa nyiŋka a gɔk ate wa an ŋman jam baga a nya bu. 33Ti Naawen yaa weeni wa ayen, <Yeeri fi nuesaŋa, dii nyiŋla, fi ale za juijui la, ka tɛŋ weleŋ. 34M nya m nuruma ale bo Ejipiti tɛŋka a nam dii la kama. M be wom ba funfɔbla mɛ kama ate m siŋ jam ayen m vari ba a basi. Gomsi fidek yɔgyɔgla de ate m tom ate fi cheŋ Ejipiti.> (Nyinika 3:5, 7-8, 10)
35<<Moosiswa de ate ba jam zɛri wa ale a bek wa ayen, <Ka wana ale nye fi niŋdeerɔ ale varibasidɔ la?> Ka Wen dek ale tom wa ba jigi. Wa jam basi ate ka Maarɔwa waai ale jan jam wa jigi tiiku ale a dɛ la po la a maa maari wa ayen wa soa ba a nya ba zuk abe wa chim ba varibasidɔ? 36Wa sum jam dɛ nuruma niŋ kama a ta ba a nyini Ejipiti tɛŋka po a nyini a nye wakperikaliisa ale wie ŋaai ale a sak ayen Wen bo ale wa kama Ejipiti tɛŋka po ale nyakpiemu buui ate ba a wi ayen Nyakpiem Mɔnuŋku la po, ale sagni po ate ku ga paari bena pisinaansi. 37Moosiswa de abe le weeni Izirali demma ayen, <Wen ale te ni biisiteerɔ ase mi la a ta nyini nidek suataŋa po.> (Teerika 18:15) 38Moosiswa de abe ka waai ale jam bo Izirali demma po diipo ate ba jam tigsi chaab sagni po la. Wa jam boro kama diipo ate Wen maarɔwa a jam biisi ale wa Sinai Guuku zuk la. Wa be tuesi Wen tuntomiŋ kaai ale a te ti nyuvuri la kama yaa pai ka a te ti.
39<<Alege ti kokpieŋsaŋa a zɛri wa nɔi kama. Ba tusi wa a basi ka nakpiak ale a yiili ba suiniima po ayen ba dan baga abe ba pilim cheŋ Ejipiti tɛŋka. 40Ba yaa weeni Moosis suoku Aaron ayen, <Nye wena ate ŋade ti niŋ. Dan ka Moosiswa de, waai ale ta ti nyini Ejipiti tɛŋka po a nyini la, ti zɛ jabuui ale nye wa la.> (Nyinika 32:1) 41Ba yaa mɛ naabiik va ŋala po a kaab ka, ale a dɛ masim jabuui ate ba nye ale badek nisima la nyiŋ. 42Alege Wen a tulim basi ba ayen ba a zuli wenzuk ŋantaŋa, ase ku le ŋmarisi dii biisiteerɔma gbaŋka po ayen, <<Izirali demma, bena pisinaansi ale nna, nama ko duŋsa a nye kaabka a te Mi diipo a ta ni bo sagni po la? 43Ni jam pai ka Molok wenni viuku a ji. Ni jam maa pai ka chiŋmarika wenni Arifan jameemmu a ji a ta cheŋ mɛ. Bala meena ka bɔgta ate ni nye a yaa te ti zula. Dila nyiŋ m le basi ate nuruba a ta ni cheŋ gaam Babilon tɛŋka.> (Amos 5:25-27)
44<<Ti koma a jam ti ka viuk juijui ate Wen jam a biisi ale ba la sagni po. Wen dek ale jam sak Moosis wa le wa ti viuku dii la, ate wa ti ku ase Wen ale zɔk dii la. 45Ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ ate ti kokpieŋsaŋa a tuesi ku ba koma jigi la, a jam ji ku kama diipo ate ba jam va Josua ate ba jam tuesi tɛŋ sii ate Wen a jam yiak si nuruma alege ate ba a cheŋ la. Ba jam ta Viuku ka dila tɛŋ sila po ate ku ga paari diipo ate Deevid jam la, 46Waai ale jam nya ŋmanteka Wen jigi la, a yaa bek ayen basi ate m sɛ yeri a te Wen dii ale ka m kokpieŋka Jekob Wen la. 47Alege ka Solomon ale sɛ Wen yenni.
48<<Wen Dii Ale Bo Wenŋmazuk La kan bo yie ŋaai ate nurubisa a pai ba nisima sɛ la po, ase biisiteerɔwa ale weeni dii ayen, 49<Wenŋmazuk ale mi naam zukpaglika, ate tɛŋzuk de a chim m naŋsa tabika jigi. Ka boan jaab yeri ate fi ale sɛ a te mi? Naawen ale weeni. Yaase mi vuusum jigi a bo ka be. 50Daa mi nisa ale nye ŋantaŋa de meena?> >> (Azaya 66:1-2)
51Sitiven a diem biisi gum du ayen, <<Nama tukpari nyama, ni an pai ni suiniima a te Wen ya, yaase ni wom wa, ni kan tu chaab ale Wen Chiika ale a weeni ni dii la, ni kokpieŋsaŋa ale jam nye dii dek la ale la. 52Ka biisiteerɔma wana ate ni koma an basi ate wa namya? Ba jam ko baai ale jam a mooli ayen Wayɔrisima Nyɔnɔ a cheena la, waai ate nama bobri sak ate ba yik wa a ko la. 53Nama abe ale jam tuesi Sinsaŋŋa ate Wen maarɔma a jam pai ŋa a te ni. Alege ni an siak a te ŋa.>>
54Kpaŋŋa ale wom Sitiven ale a biisi diila, ku yaa te ba suipuurum ate ba ŋɔbi nyina. 55Alege Wen Chiika ale sueri Sitiven suinummu la, wa yaa zak zuk a nya wenŋmazuk a nya Wen nyaksika ale Yeezu a za Wen juga geŋ. 56Sitiven yaa weeni ayen, <<Ni nya, mi nya kama ale wenŋmazuk a lagri ate Saalɔbiika a za Wen juga geŋ.>>
57Ba yaa kaari nna yegayega a weeni ayen ba kan ŋman a yaali ayen ba wom wa. Ba yaa chali cheŋ wa jigi 58a yik wa a ta nyini tɛŋka po a nyini a pai tintana a yuk wa ayen ba ko. Seerɔma mɛ a yeeri ba kasaautaŋa a dueni bi paalik kanyi ate ba a wi ayen Sɔɔl naŋsa tɛŋ ayen wa a nya. 59Ba ale jam a yuk wa la, wa jam a puusi kama ayen, <<M Nyɔnɔ Yeezu Kirisita, ŋoa m chiika.>> 60Wa yaa kpi duna tɛŋ a weeni ate ku jueli ayen, <<M Nyɔnɔ Yeezu Kirisita, kan pai biemu de a tuni ba.>> Wa ale weeni dila la, wa yaa deri kpi.

Title: TUIMA 8
Content:
1Sɔɔl a jam maa siak kama ayen ba ko Sitiven. Da dii danni ate ba ko Sitiven la, Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab Jerusalem tɛŋka la a deri piilim ninam nna yegayega nyaka. Baai ale ta siaka ale Yeezu la, a yaa jam waaŋ chaab Judia ale Samaria tɛŋsaŋa meena po. Ka tuimtomdɔma nyiini ale jam kan waaŋ chaaba. 2Nuru baai ale ŋmasi jam a yaali Wen suiku la, ale jam ta Sitiven a ga gu ale a kaari nna yegayega.
3Alege Sɔɔl a jam diem pii ka nyiŋ a nyiem gilim a cheŋ yeeŋa dinyi dinyi a basi ate Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la a nam a dari ba meena nidoaba ale nipooba a yik ba a lik.
4Baai meena ale ta siaka ate ba waaŋ jigi meena la, a yaa jam nyiem a cheŋ jigi meena a sak Wen wamaŋsaŋa. 5Filip yaa jam cheŋ Samaria tɛŋ kpieŋka po a mooli Kirisitawa wie a te ba. 6Nuru boanni ale jam nya wakperikaliik sii ate Filip nye la, ba yaa ŋmasi lak ba tueŋa a wom wa sinsaŋŋa. 7Wie ŋaai ale jam nye la gela ale, nuruba yegayega baai ale jam ta chichirik baata la, a kaari ate ti a nyini, ale baai naŋsa ale ba nisima ale jam kpi la, a jam nya nyiŋyɔgsa kama. 8Dila nyiŋ suipeentik nna yegayega a jam bo tɛŋ kala po kama.
9Nuru ale jam bo tɛŋ kala po. Wa yuei jam le Simon. Wa jam ka tiita nyɔnɔ. Wa jam pai ka tiita a nye wakperikaliisa nna yegayega ate ŋa cha Samaria demma. Wa jam pai wadek a chim ka nuru kpioŋ. 10Waai meena nuru kpienta ale nuru fiisa tɛŋ kala po a jam a wom wa ka nna yegayega a weeni ayen, <<Nuruwa de ta ka Wen pagrim kpiem buui ate ti a wi ayen Pagrim kpioŋ la.>> 11Ba jam a wom wa kama nalimnyiini dii nyiŋla, wa wakperikaliisaŋa a jam cha ba beni ka nna yegayega. 12Alege ba ale jam wom Filip sinsaŋŋa a magsi chaab ale Wen naamu ale Yeezu Kirisita pagrimu wie la, ba meena nidoaba ale nipooba a jam tuesi ka soka. 13Simon dek a jam maa ta siaka kama. Ba ale jam te wa soka a ga nueri la, wa yaa jam maa boro ale Filip a nya wakperikaliisa ale wakinkagla nna yegayega ate ku cha wa.
14Tuimtomdɔma ale jam bo Jerusalem la ale wom ayen Samaria demma a tuesi Wen Wanni kama la, ba yaa tom Piita ale Jɔɔn ayen ba cheŋ ba jigi. 15Ba jam puusi a te ba kama ayen ba tuesi Wen Chiika. 16Dii nyiŋla, Naawen Chiika an diem jam siŋ ba waai zuwa. Ba jam tuesi soka ka ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita yuenni nyiŋ. 17Piita ale Jɔɔn yaa pai ba nisimaŋa a vi ba zuk ate Wen Chiika a jam ba jigi.
18Simon ale nya ayen tuimtomdɔma a pai ba nisima a vi ba zuk ate ba tuesi Wen Chiika la, wa yaa pai ligra ayen wa te Piita ale Jɔɔn, 19a weeni ba ayen, <<Ni te mi mɛ pagrimu de choawa ate mi mɛ a dan pai m nisimaŋa a vi nuru zuk, abe wa mɛ a tuesi Wen Chiika.>>
20Alege Piita yaa tulisi wa ayen, <<Fi ale fi ligraŋa meena a kpi, fi a poli ayen fi baga a da Wen tiirimu ale ka ligra! 21Fi niŋ a maa ka ti tuimaŋa po dii nyiŋla, fi suinummu a ka nyemagsika ale Wen ya. 22Dila nyiŋ, ku a fɛ kama ayen fi tagri fi popola baataŋa de abe fi puusi ate ti Naawenni a vɔŋ a te fu fi ale poli wanni de choawa la nyiŋ. 23Dii nyiŋla, m nya kama ale fi suinummu ka wa tuasa ale biem ale kasim sueri bu.>>
24Simon a yaa weeni Piita ale Jɔɔn ayen, <<Mi a saalim, ni puusi a te mu ate wieŋa de meena ate ni biisi la a kan jam mi jigiya.>>
25Piita ale Jɔɔn ale biisi ba ale seba Yeezu a soa diila, ale maa sak ba Naawen wamaŋsaŋa a ga nueri la, ba yaa pilim ŋman cheŋ Jerusalem tɛŋka. Ba ale jam bo suiku po a cheŋ la, ba jam sak wapaala maŋsaŋa Samaria tɛŋ fiisaŋa yegayega po kama.
26Ti Naawen maarɔ yaa weeni Filip ayen, <<Gomsi fidek a yiti cheŋ a va yeniŋ gala nyiŋ a va suik kuui ale dua Jerusalem ale Gaza tɛŋka suŋsuŋ la.>> (Ku ka suik kuui ale va sagni po a cheŋ la.) 27Ate wa yaa yiti a cheŋ. Wa le bo suiku po a cheŋ la wa yaa nya Itoopiya denɔ. Wa jam ka nuru kpioŋ dek, a bo Kandase a tom tuima, Itoopiya nipok Naawa yenni, wa ale jam a nya nipok naawa ligraŋa zuk. Wa jam cheŋ ka Jerusalem ayen wa puusi. 28Ase wa le jam bo suiku po a kuli la, wa jam kala ka wa toroko po a kariŋ Biisiteerɔwa Azaya gbaŋka. 29Wen Chiika a yaa weeni Filip ayen, <<Yiti a ga pai fidek gum chaab ale nuruwa.>> 30Filip yaa chali cheŋ wa jigi yaa wom ale wa a karim Biisiteerɔwa Azaya gbaŋka. Filip yaa bek wa ayen, <<Fi miŋ a chak dii ate fi a karim la?>>
31Kpagni yaa tulisi wa ayen, <<Mi ale nye ka sɛ a miŋ chak ase nuru a nin kan weeni ku kiri a sak mu?>> Wa yaa wi Filip ate wa jueli kali jaamu po ale wa. 32Biisiteerɔwa Azaya ale jam a karim diila ale nna, <<Ase posuk ate ba ta a cheŋ tɔgridɔ jigi la ase pabiik ate ba a poni ka kɔbtaŋa a basi alege ka kan kaari la, wa an jam weeni wari ya. 33Wa jam nya chivie alege ba jam mini wa wensieŋa kama. Nuru karo ale baga a biisi wari a sak wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa, dii nyiŋla, wa nyuvunni tɛŋzuk de a kpeglim kama.>> (Azaya 53:7-8)
34Kpagni yaa bek Filip ayen, <<Weeni a sak mu ka wana ate biisiteerɔwa a biisi wa wari nna? Ka wadek yaa ka nuru yoŋŋoa?>> 35Filip yaa deri pai karimka de a piilim biik a weeni wapaala maŋsaŋa a magsi chaab ale Yeezu.
36Ba ale jam va chaab a cheŋ suiku po la, ba yaa jam paari jigi ate nyiam a dua ate kpagni yaa weeni Filip ayen, <<Nyiam ale nna. Ka boan ale ku kasi ate fi kan te mu soka?>> 37Filip yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Fi ale nya soka ase fi nin siak ale fi suinum meena.>> Kpagni yaa tulisi wa ayen, <<Mm, m siak ale m suinum meena ayen Yeezu Kirisita ka Wen Nidoabinni.>>
38Kpagni yaa nye ate torokowa a zaani, ate wa ale Filip a siŋ nyiamu po ate Filip a te wa soka. 39Ba ale nyini nyiamu po a jueli la, Wen Chiika yaa deri ta Filip a cheŋ ale ge kpagni nyiini. Kpagni an ŋman nya wa, wa yaa cheŋ ale suipeentik. 40Filip yaa deri nya ale wadek a bo ka Azotus tɛŋka. Wa ale jam bo suiku po a cheŋ la, wa jam a sak Wen wamaŋsaŋa ka dila a ga paari Siizariya tɛŋka.

Title: TUIMA 9
Content:
1Alege Sɔɔl a kasim jam diem boro a nyigsi ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita ŋaaŋviirɔma kama ayen wa a le ko ba. Wa yaa jam cheŋ kaabteerɔ kpioŋku jigi 2a bek wa ayen wa ŋmarisi gbaŋsa a te wa ate wa ta ga te Damasikus tɛŋka tuka diinaŋa demma, ate gbaŋsaŋa te wa suik ate wa dan nya waai ale wa ka Wen Suiku nuru, nidoa yaase nipok, abe wa yik kula nyɔnɔwa a bobi a ta cheŋ Jerusalem tɛŋka.
3Sɔɔl yaa ale bo suiku po a cheŋ moata Damasikus tɛŋka la, wenŋmazuk yaa nyaksi a gilim wa. 4Sɔɔl yaa lo tɛŋ a wom ale lueluk a weeni wa ayen, <<Sɔɔl, Sɔɔl, ka boa ale soa ate fi a namsi mu nna?>>
5Sɔɔl yaa weeni ayen, <<Ka wana, m Nyɔnɔ?>> Ate lueluku a yaa tulisi wa ayen, <<Ka mi Yeezu ate fi a namsi la, 6alege yiti a jo tɛŋka po ale fi le wom dii ale magsi fi nye la.>>
7Nidoa baai ale jam maa va wa a cheŋ la a jam wom ka lueluku alege ba an nya nuru. Ba be an ŋman jam baga a biisi. 8Sɔɔl ale ga yiti la, wa ninaŋa yaa lik ate wa an ŋman baga a nya. Ba yaa yik wa nisima a ta wa cheŋ Damasikus tɛŋka. 9Ku jam paari ka daa ŋata alege wa an diem a nya. Wa be an jam dɛ ŋandiinta yaase wa nyu nyiam.
10Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔ ale jam bo Damasikus tɛŋka. Wa yuei jam le Ananaiyas. Ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita yaa jan jam wa jigi nna se wa goa daasim kama la a weeni wa ayen, <<Ananaiyas.>> Ate wa yaa tulisi ayen, <<M Nyɔnɔ, nya mi ale nna.>>
11Ti Nyɔnɔwa a yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Yiti a cheŋ suik kuui ate ba a wi ayen Suyɔrɔsuŋ la. Fi dan ga paari Judas yenni, bek ayen fi a yaali ka nuru waai ate ba a wi ayen Sɔɔl ate wa nyini Taasus tɛŋka la. Wa boro a puusi kama. 12Wa seba kama ayen fi cheena dii nyiŋla, wa jam nya nuru ase wa goa daasim kama la, ale wa cheena wa jigi. Nuruwa yuei ale Ananaiyas. Wa jam pai wa nisima a vi wa zuk ayen wa ninaŋa ŋman lagri.>>
13Ananaiyas a yaa tulisi ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita ayen, <<M Nyɔnɔ, mi wom ka nuruba yegayega jigi nuruwa de ale basi ate fi nuruma a nam dii Jerusalem tɛŋka po la. 14Wa be tuesi ka pagrim kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa jigi a jam Damasikus tɛŋka po ayen wa yik waai ale a wi Fi Yuenni la.>>
15Ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita a yaa weeni Ananaiyas ayen, <<Cheŋ, dii nyiŋla m potim lueri wa kama ayen wa chim mi tomteerɔ a weeni Mi Yuenni a sak nuru baai ale kan daa Izirali demma la, ale nalima ale Izirali demma dek. 16Mi dek abe le sak wa ninam buui ate wa ale nam Mi Yuenni nyiŋla.>>
17Ananaiyas yaa cheŋ ga jo yenni po, a pai wa nisimaŋa a vi Sɔɔl zuk a weeni ayen, <<M suok Sɔɔl, ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita dek waai ale pai wadek a sak fu suik kuui po dek ate fi va a jam dela la ale tom mu fi jigi ayen m weeni fu ayen fi ninaŋa a ŋman lagri abe Wen Chiika a sueri fi suinummu.>> 18Wa ale ga weeni nueri la, ŋanta nna ase jum pagta la a yaa nyini Sɔɔl ninaŋa po a lo ate wa yaa ŋman baga a nya. Wa yaa yiti zaani a tuesi soka. 19Wa ale ga dɛ ŋandiinta la, wa pagrimu yaa ŋman pilim jam. Sɔɔl yaa jam goa daa maga dega Damasikus tɛŋka po ale ŋaaŋviirɔma. 20Wa yaa deri cheŋ ga jo Juuma tuka diinaŋa po a piilim a sak nuruma Yeezu wie a weeni ba ayen, <<Yeezu ka Wen Nidoabinni.>>
21Baai meena ale jam wom wa sinsaŋŋa la, ku yaa cha ba ate ba a bek chaab ayen, <<Mm, daa nuru waai ale jam bo Jerusalem tɛŋka a basi ate baai meena ale a wi Yeezu ba Naawen la a namu la? Wa be jam dela daa dila nyiŋ ayen wa yik ba a ta cheŋ kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa jigiya?>>
22Alege Sɔɔl yaa ŋmasi jam ta ka pagrim nna yegayega a sak wa sinsaŋŋa ale a biisi a nak nanpaga nna yegayega ate ku yaa butim Juuma baai ale jam bo Damasikus tɛŋka po la. Wa jam a nye wieŋa de kama ayen ku sak ayen Yeezu sum ka Kirisitawa.
23Daa yega ale ga taam la, Juuma yaa jam jigi yeŋ a nye tuka a poli ayen ba ko Sɔɔl. 24Alege wa jam wom ba ale poli ayen ba nye wa diila kama. Daa meena yok ale kantueŋ ba kasim jam za ka tɛŋka po nansiuŋtaŋa noa a limisi ayen ba dan nya wa abe ba ko wa. 25Alege Sɔɔl ŋaaŋviirɔma a yaa pai wa a nyo busik po a ta wa va siaka ate wa siŋ cheŋ.
26Sɔɔl ale jam cheŋ Jerusalem tɛŋka la, wa jam pii nyiŋ a yaali ayen wa maa gum ka Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma po. Alege ba jam ka siaka ayen wa ka Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔ. Yɔgsum yaa jam yik ba. 27Alege nuru waai ate ba a wi ayen Banabas la yaa maari wa a ta wa jam Yeezu tuimtomdɔma jigi. Banabas yaa weeni sak ba Sɔɔl ale jam bo suiku po a cheŋ Damasikus ate wa nya ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita ate wa biisi ale wa diila. Wa ŋman weeni sak ba Sɔɔl ale jam nyini peelim dii Damasikus tɛŋka po a pai Yeezu Yuenni nyiŋ a sak nuruba ale kan chali yɔgsum la. 28Ba yaa siak ate Sɔɔl a maa boro ale ba Jerusalem tɛŋka po a nyini peelim a sak nuruba ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita Yuenni nyiŋ ale kan chali yɔgsum. 29Wa jam a biisi kama ale zukooŋ a nak nanpaga ale baai ale ka Juuma a wom Girik demma biika la. Ba yaa jam pii nyiŋ a yaali ayen ba ko wa. 30Wa Kirisita bisa suataŋa ale ga seba la, ba yaa ta wa cheŋ Siizariya tɛŋka, a yaa zaani dula jigini a basi wa ate wa a cheŋ Taasus tɛŋka.
31Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab meena a jam bo Judia tɛŋka po la ale Galili tɛŋka po la ale Samaria tɛŋka po la yaa jam boro ale ka suiyɔgni a chim. Ba siaka jam ta ka pagrim a kasim jam a chim nna yegayega a gum du ate ba va Wen Suiku ale a chali wa. Wen Chiika abe jam a maari ba kama ate ba jam piisi a gum du.
32Piita kasim jam nyeemu a cheŋ ka Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la jigi, jigi meena. Dai yeŋ ate wa yaa cheŋ Lida tɛŋka. 33Dula jigini wa yaa nya nuru wa yuei jam le Aniiyas. Wa jam gbariŋ kama an baga a cheŋ ate wa kasim jam dua tiak po ate ku ga paari bena naaniŋ. 34Piita yaa wi wa ayen, <<Aniiyas>>, a weeni wa ayen, <<Yeezu Kirisita a basi kama ate fi nya nyiŋyɔgsa. Yiti ŋmai a kpamsi fi tiaka.>> Aniiyas a yaa deri yiti nna bunyi dekki. 35Nuru baai meena ale bo Lida ale Saaron tɛŋsaŋa ale nya wa la, ba mɛ yaa deri tagri a maa va ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita.
36Nipok ale jam bo Jopa tɛŋka. Wa maa ka waai ale ta siaka ale Yeezu la. Wa yuei ale Tabita. Ba jam a wi wa ale Girik demma biika ayen ka Dookas. Di kiri ale yisik. Wa kasim jam a yaali tuimaŋsa tomka ale a maari ŋanjaksa mɛ. 37Va ŋala po nyiŋtuila yaa yik wa ate wa kpi. Ba ale jam so wa nyiŋka nueri la, ba yaa jam pai wa a ta jueli dueni kiari po. 38Lida tɛŋka ale moata Jopa la, ŋaaŋviirɔma ale wom ale Piita bo Lida la, ba yaa tom nidoaba baye wa jigi a saalim wa a weeni ayen, <<Ti a saalim, nye nwuli a jam dela.>> 39Piita yaa yiti va ba a cheŋ. Wa ale jam la, ba yaa ta wa jueli kiani po. Pukɔŋŋa meena a jam gilim wa kama a kaari ale a sak Piita garuk tii meena ate Dookas a jam nye ti diipo ate wa jam vua la.
40Piita yaa yiak ate ba meena nyini peelim ale ge a kpi duna tɛŋ a puusi ale ge viriŋ tuk kpiewa nyiŋ ayen, <<Tabita, yiti ŋmai.>> Tabita yaa lak wa ninaŋa. Wa ale ga nya Piita la, wa yaa yiti kali ŋmai. 41Piita yaa forisi paari wa a maari wa ate wa yiti zaani ŋmai. Piita yaa wi baai ale ta siaka ale Yeezu la, ale pukɔŋŋa a yaa pai wa javuk a te ba. 42Waai meena Jopa tɛŋka po a jam wom wanni de kama ate nuruba yegayega a jam siak a te ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita. 43Piita jam goa Jopa ka da boari ale nuru wanyi ate ba a wi wa ayen Simon. Wa jam ka gbanzaba.

Title: TUIMA 10
Content:
1Nuru ale jam bo Siizariya tɛŋka. Wa yuei jam ale Koniilos. Wa jam ka Aroom tugurik tɔŋdɔma beŋ kanyi kpaŋŋa po wanyi. Beŋ kala yuei jam ale, <<Itali beŋka.>> 2Wa jam a yaali ka Wen Suiku wie nna yegayega. Wa ale wa dɔkdemma meena a kasim jam a chali wen kama ale a te ŋanjaksa tiirita nalimnyiini, ale a puusi Wen daa meena. 3Baŋ buta wenbalinni wa yaa nya nna cheri gɔdaasini po ale Wen maarɔ a siŋ cheena ale a weeni wa ayen, <<Koniilos.>>
4Ate Koniilos yaa nya maarɔwa ale yɔgsum ale bek Maarɔwa ayen, <<Mi a saalim ka boa M Nyɔnɔ?>> Maarɔwa yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Fi puusaŋa ale fi tiiritaŋa ate fi a te ŋanjaksaŋa la, a basi kama ate Wen ta fu wari. 5Yɔgyɔgla de, be tom nidoaba ate ba cheŋ Jopa a ga ta nuru wanyi ate ba a wi ayen Simon Piita a jam. 6Wa a goa ale ka gbanzaba wanyi ate ba a wi ayen Simon. Wa yenni za ka nyakpiemu nɔi.>>
7Maarɔwa ale ga biisi ale wa a nueri ale cheŋ la, Koniilos yaa wi wa tomteerɔma po baye ale tugurik tɔŋdɔba wanyi waai ale kasim jam a yaali Wen Suiku wie mɛ la. Wa jam ka waai ale kasim jam moata wa nalimnyiini a tom a te wa la. 8Koniilos yaa weeni dii meena ale nye la a sak ba ale ge a tom ba ayen ba cheŋ Jopa.
9Vari ale veenti ate ba bo suiku po a cheŋ moata tɛŋ kaai ate ba a cheŋ la, Piita yaa jam jueli gboŋ zuk kantueŋ suŋsuŋ ayen wa puusi. Baŋ pi ale buye ale la. 10Kom yaa jam yik wa ate wa yaali ŋandiinta ayen wa dɛ. Ba ale jam diem boro a dik ŋandiintaŋa la, ku yaa nye wa jigi nna ase wa goa a daasim la, 11a nya ale wenŋmazukku a lagri ate jaab nyini gugotta tinaansiwa meena po a cheena tɛŋzuk de. 12Jaamu po duŋsa nna tɔgatɔga ale jam boro, sii ale a cheŋ si lɔga nyiŋ ale ŋan yirinta. 13Lueluk yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Piita, yiti ŋmai, ko a ŋɔbi.>>
14Alege Piita yaa tulisi ayen, <<Aaya, m Naawen yaa, mi an diem maa dɛ jabuui ale ka ja laani yaase wa an welema la a nya ya.>>
15Lueluku a ŋman pilim jam wa jigi a nye buye a weeni wa ayen, <<Wen ale weeni jabuui ayen wa ka jaweleŋ la, ku a fɛ kama ayen fi kan weeni ayen jaab bula an welema.>> 16Nya kude a jam nye ka buta ale ge ate jaamu a ŋman yiti jueli wenŋmazuk.
17Piita ale jam boro a poli wanni de kiri ale ka diila, nuru baai ate Koniilos a jam tom ba la a yaa bek Simon Yenni jigi a jam za tuoku nɔi 18a yaa wi a bek ayen, <<Simon waai ate ba a wi ayen Piita mɛ la bo dela?>>
19Ase Piita ale diem boro a poli wanni kiri ale ka diila, Wen Chiika yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Wom de, nidoaba bata ale bo dela jigini a gisi fu. 20Yiti siŋ tɛŋ a va ba a cheŋ. Kan basi ate ku daani fu dii nyiŋla, ka mi ale tom ba fi jigi.>> 21Piita yaa yiti siŋ ba jigi a weeni ba ayen, <<Ka mi ale nuru waai ate ni a gisi la. Ka boa ate ni jam?>>
22Ba yaa tulisi wa ayen, <<Ka tugurik tɔŋdɔba kpagni Koniilos ale tom ti. Wa ka nuru waai ale ka nuru maŋ a chali Wen nalimnyiini ate Juuma meena a zuli wa nna yegayega la. Wen maarɔ ale weeni wa ayen wa tom wi fu ayen fi jam ate wa wom dii ate fi ta ayen fi weeni sak wa la.>> 23Piita yaa wi ba ate ba jo goa yok kula. Vari ale ga veenti la wa yaa maa va ba a cheŋ. Jopa demma gela baai ale ta siaka maara la a jam maa va ba a cheŋ. 24Dai dii ale pai a saŋ la, ba yaa cheŋ paari Siizariya tɛŋka, juijui ate Koniilos ale wa mabisa ale wa doa baai ate wa jam wi ba ayen ba jam la. Ba meena a jam kala a limisi Piita kama. 25Piita ale jam paari Koniilos Yenni ayen wa jo la, Koniilos ale nya wa la, wa yaa kpi duna tɛŋ Piita niŋ, a puusi wa. 26Alege Piita yaa zak wa a zaani a weeni wa ayen, <<Yiti ŋmai, mi mɛ ka nurubiik ase fi la.>> 27Ba jam biisi kama ale chaab ale ge a jo yenni po. Ba ale ga jo nueri la, Piita yaa nya ale nuruba yegayega a tigsi chaab a kala. 28Piita yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Nama dek seba ayen Juuma suiku Sinsaŋŋa a kan basi ate Juu a cheŋ waai ale kan daa Juu la yeri a yaase wa pai wadek a gum chaab ale ba. Alege Wen sak mu kama ayen m kan wi nuru ayen ja laani yaase wa an welema. 29Dila nyiŋ fi ale tom a wi mu la, mi an zɛri ya. Yɔgyɔgla, be ka boan nyiŋ ate fi tom wi mu?>>
30Koniilos yaa tulisi wa ayen, <<Ku daa ŋanaansi ale jinla ate wanni de a nye. Dai yeŋ po wenbalinni (a magsi chaab ale baŋ buta) ate mi jam boro a puusi m yenni po. Nuru yaa deri jam za mi niŋ. Wa jam jo ka garuk peelita ate ti a nyaksi nna kpelim kpelim. 31Wa yaa weeni mi ayen, <Koniilos, Wen wom fi puusaŋa kama. Wa be teeri fi tiiritaŋa ate fi a te ŋanjaksa la kama. 32Tom nuru ate wa cheŋ Jopa tɛŋka a ga wi Simon waai ate ba a wi wa ayen Piita la. Wa bo ka Simon gbanzabawa yenni. Wa yenni moata ka nyakpiemu nɔi.> 33Dila nyiŋ ate m tom wi fu nna nwuli ate fi zuli mu a jam. Yɔgyɔgla de ti meena abe kala ka Wen niŋ, ayen ti wom ti Naawenni ale weeni fu dii ayen fi weeni a sak ti la.>>
34Piita yaa piilim biik a weeni ayen, <<Ku ka wensie ayen Wen kan lugi. 35Alege tɛŋsa meena po waai daa chali wa ale a tom dii ale nala a te wa, Wen a yaali wa kama. 36Nama seba wanni ate Wen a tom te Izirali demma la ale wamaŋ paalisaŋa, ayen suiyɔgni a va ka Yeezu Kirisita nyiŋ a jam. Yeezu ka nuruba meena Naawen. 37Nama seba dii ale nye Judia tɛŋka po meena la kama, ku piilim ka Galili Jɔɔn ale jam mooli wie a te nuruma la ŋaaŋnyiŋ. 38Nama a seba Yeezu Nazaret denɔwa wie kama ayen Wen a te wa Chiika pagrimu kama. Ni seba dii ate Yeezu a jam cheŋ jigi meena a nye wamaŋsa ale a tebi baai ate chichirik baata meena a jam bo ba po la, dii la Wen ale jam bo ale wa. 39Mi ale m vaanchaama abe nya wieŋa de meena ate wa nye Juuma tɛŋka ale Jerusalem dek ate ti weeni a sak ni. Nuruba ale yik wa a kpi jabarim nyiŋ a ko wa. 40Alege Wen a nak wa yiti kama daa ŋata dai ate ti nya wa, 41daa nuru meena ale nya wa, ka tama baai ate Wen a lueri ase seerɔba la, baai ale dɛ ale nyu ale wa, wa le yiti kum po la ŋaaŋnyiŋ. 42Wa yaa weeni ti ayen, ti mooli a te nuruba abe ti weeni a sak ba ayen ka wa ate Wen lueri ate chim boteerɔ a te ŋanvuta ale kpieba. 43Naawen biisiteerɔma meena a biisi wa wari kama ayen waai a dan ta siak ale wa, kula nyɔnɔwa le va wa yuenni pagrim nyiŋ a nya wa wabaataŋa vɔŋteka.>>
44Piita ale diem jam boro a biisi la, Wen Chiika yaa siŋ jam baai meena ale jam a wom wa biika la suiniima po. 45Juuma baai ale jam ta siaka a jam maa va Piita a nyini Jopa tɛŋka a jam la, ku yaa jam cha ba ate ba nya ale Wen te baai ale kan daa Juuma la Wen Chiika mɛ. 46Dii nyiŋla, ba jam wom kama ale ba a biisi bi chaŋsa a pak Wen ale wa ale nye ŋaai meena la. Piita yaa ŋman biisi ayen, 47<<Nuruma de mɛ a tuesi Wen Chiika kama ase tama mɛ ale jam tuesi diila. Nuru karo abe le weeni ayen ba kan tuesi soka ale nyiamoa.>> 48Wa weeni ayen ba tuesi soka Yeezu Kirisita yuenni nyiŋ. Piita ale ga biisi nueri la, ba yaa saalim wa ayen wa goa ale ba daa maga abe wa kuli.

Title: TUIMA 11
Content:
1Tuimtomdɔma ale ba suataŋa ale bo Judia la a wom ayen baai ale kan daa Juuba la mɛ a siak a te Wen Wanni kama. 2Piita ale ŋman pilim cheŋ Jerusalem tɛŋka la, Juuma yaa ŋma wa ayen, 3<<Ka boa ate fi cheŋ nuru baai ale kan daa Juuba la jigi a dɛ ŋandiinta ale ba?>> 4Piita yaa piilim a tɔk dii meena ale nye la ayen,
5<<Mi ale jam boro a puusi Jopa tɛŋka po la, ku yaa nye mi jigi nna ase gɔdaasima la, ate mi a nya jaab a nyini wenŋmazuk gugotta tinaansiwa siŋ cheena tɛŋ a jam zaani a moata mi. 6Mi yaa ŋmasi nya jaamu po nalimnyiini a yaa nya ale yeri duŋsa ale gɔi duŋsa ale ŋan baai meena ale a cheŋ ba lɔga nyiŋsa, ale nuinsa. 7Mi yaa wom ale lueluk a weeni mi ayen, <Piita, yiti ŋmai. Ko a ŋɔbi.> 8Mi yaa tulisi ayen, <M Naawen yaa, aaya, mi an diem maa dɛ jabuui ale kan welema la nya ya.> 9Alege lueluku a nyini wenŋmazuk a weeni mi a nye buye ayen, <Wen ale weeni jabuui ayen wa ka jaweleŋ la, ku a fɛ kama ayen fi kan weeni jaab wala ayen wa an welema.> 10Nya kude a jam nye ka buta ale ge ate gattiaka a yaa ŋman yiri jueli wenŋmazuk. 11Diipo ate jaamu a yiri a jueli la, nidoaba bata yaa nyini Siizariya tɛŋka a jam yenni, diipo ate mi jam boro la a weeni mu ayen ba nyɔnɔwa ale bo Siizariya la ale tom ba mi jigi. 12Wen Chiika yaa weeni mi ayen m yiti a cheŋ abe m kan basi ate ku daani mu. M suataŋa bayuebiwa de abe maa va ka mi a nyini Jopa a jam ate ti meena a yaa jo Koniilos yenni po. 13Wa yaa weeni a sak ti wa ale nya Wen maarɔ wa yenni po ate wa weeni wa ayen, <Tom nuru ate wa cheŋ Jopa tɛŋka a ga wi nuru wanyi ate ba a wi Simon waai ate ba a wi ayen Piita mɛ la. 14Wa ale biisi wie ale fu ate fi ale fi dɔkdemma meena a nya varibasika.> 15Mi Piita ale jam piilim boro a biisi ale ba la, Wen Chiika a deri siŋ jam ba suiniima po ase wa ale jan jam tama jigi piilimka po diila. 16Ate mi yaa teeri ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita ale jam weeni dii ayen, <Jɔɔn Sokateerɔwa a pai ka nyiam a te ni soka alege yɔgyɔgla de mi ale te ni soka ale Wen Chiika.> 17Wen abe jam pai ka tiirim bula a te ba ase wa ale jam pai bula dekdega a te tama diipo ate tama a jam siak a te ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita la. Wen abe dan nye dila mi ka wana ate mi baga a weeni Wen ayen wa kan nye dila?>>
18Ba ale ga wom nna la, ba yaa nye diki ale te Wen pimpauk ayen, <<Wen a be poom te baai mɛ ale kan daa Juuma la suik kama ayen ba basi ba tuimbaataŋa tomka ate ba nya nyuvuri paalik.>>
19Diipo ate ba jam ko Sitiven ate ninam a jan jam baai ale ta siaka jigi la, ba jam chali waaŋ ka chaab. Dila powa, ba gela a jam chali cheŋ Fonisia ale Saipurus ale Antiok tɛŋsaŋa a sak Juuma nyiini Wen wamaŋsaŋa. 20Ba gela mɛ a jam ka nidoaba a nyini Saipurus ale Sairini tɛŋsaŋa a cheŋ Antiok tɛŋka. Ba ale ga paari dula la, ba yaa sak baai ale kan daa Juuba la mɛ. Ba jam sak ba ka Wen wamaŋsaŋa a magsi chaab ale ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita. 21Ti Nyɔnɔwa pagrimu a jam bo ale ba kama ate nuru boari a jam ta siaka ale sinsaŋŋa a tagri badek a va ti Nyɔnɔwa.
22Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab Jerusalem tɛŋka po la ale ga wom nna la, ba yaa tom Banabas ayen wa cheŋ Antiok tɛŋka a ga nya. 23Wa le jan jam a nya Wen ŋmanteka la, wa sui yaa peenti. Wa yaa te ba meena nyiŋbiiri ayen ba kasim ta wensie ale ti Nyɔnɔwa ale popola yena, 24dii la wa jam ka nuru maŋ ate Wen Chiika a sueri wa ate wa ta siaka. Ate nuruba yega a gum ti Nyɔnɔwa nuruma po.
25Banabas yaa cheŋ Taasus tɛŋka ayen wa gisi Sɔɔl. 26Wa ale ga nya wa la, wa yaa yik wa a ta cheŋ Antiok. Ba nɔi bayewa a jam bo ka dula ale Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la ate ku ga paari bein. Ba jam a sak ka nuru boari. Ku jam ka Antiok tɛŋka de po ate nuruba piilim te baai ale ta siaka ale Yeezu la, yuei ayen Kirisita Bisa.
27Dila powa, Wen biisiteerɔba gela yaa jam nyini Jerusalem tɛŋka a cheŋ Antiok tɛŋka. 28Biisiteerɔma de wanyi yuei a jam ale Agabus. Wala yaa yiti zaani ale Wen Chiika pagrimu a ayen kom pagrik ale za bu jam tɛŋzuk de meena. Kommu a sum jan jam kama diipo ate naab kpioŋku Kilɔdiyus a jam boro la. 29Ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa jam maa chaab a poli waai meena wanyi wanyi ale baga a te ligra dii ate ba pai ŋa a maari ba sua tintila baai mɛ ale ta siaka a bo Judia tɛŋka po la. 30Ba yaa cheesi ba ligraŋa a pai ŋa a te Banabas ale Sɔɔl ate ba ta ŋa a ga te Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la nisɔmma dula jigini.

Title: TUIMA 12
Content:
1Dila powa, Naab Ayerod a jam basi kama ate Kirisita bisaŋa a nya ninam. 2Wa jam basi kama ate ba yik Jɔɔn suoku Jeemsi a ko ale gebik. 3Wa ale ga nya ale wanni de a te Juuma popeentik la, wa yaa ŋman yik Piita. Ba yik wa a magsi chaab ale ka diipo ate Juuma a dɛ tigi kpienni diipo ate ba kan ŋɔbi boroborok kuui ale ta dabinta la. 4Ba ale jam yik Piita la, ba ta wa a ga lik kama, a yaali tugurik tɔŋdɔba pi ale bayuebi ate ba a limisi wa. Wa poori ba ka tɔgatɔga bunaansi. Naab Ayerod jam nye dila a poli kama ayen Gaambasika Tigini a dan taam abe wa ta wa nyini peelim ate ba bo wa buusa ate waai meena nya. 5Ba yaa ta Piita a ga lik. Wa ale jam bo likka dɔkku po la, Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la yaa jam puusi nalimnyiini a te wa.
6Yok kuui ate Ayerod jam a poli ayen vari a dan veenti abe wa lagri Piita a ta nyini a te nuruma la, Piita jam doa ka limisidɔma baye suŋsuŋ a goa. Ba jam pai ka chɔrin kpiema a bobi wa. Limisidɔba mɛ a jam za ka likka dɔkku nɔi. 7Naawen maarɔ yaa deri jam za dula ate ku yaa nyaksi nna yegayega likka dɔkku po, a tiri Piita gauŋku a weeni wa ayen, <<Nye nwuli, yiti.>> Chɔrimaŋa yaa deri nyini Piita nisima po a gebi lo. 8Maarɔwa yaa ŋman weeni ayen, <<Pa fi gattaŋa a jo abe fi su fi nuesaŋa.>> Piita yaa nye dila ate Maarɔwa a ŋman weeni ayen, <<Pa fi kasaauku a jo abe fi jam va mu.>> 9Piita yaa va wa nyini likka dɔkku po a nyini alege zɛ ayen maarɔwa ale nye diila a sum ka wensie. Piita jam a poli ayen dii ale a nye la ka goadaasima. 10Maarɔwa ale Piita yaa jam va chaab a cheŋ a jam gaam niŋka limisidɔma a ŋman jam gaam baai ale pai saŋ la, a yaa ga paari nɔi dii ate ba pai kutaŋa a nye ate fi gaam ku abe fi yaa deri a jo tɛŋka po la. Ba ale jam a paari tuok kula la, ku yaa deri lak ku dek ate ba taam nyini a va chaab a cheŋ suik duoku po. Ba ale cheŋ maga la, Maarɔwa a yaa deri basi Piita wadek wa nyiini ale ge cheŋ.
11Piita yaa deri miŋ dii ale nye wa jigi la ate wa yaa weeni ayen, <<Yɔgyɔgla de m seba ayen ka Naawen ale tom wa maarɔwa ate wa jam vari mu Ayerod ale Juuma ale jam a poli diila nisima po a basi.>>
12Wa ale miŋ nna la, wa yaa cheŋ Mɛɛri yenni. Mɛɛri a jam ka Jɔɔn ma. Jɔɔn yuei di choa jam le Maak. Piita ale jam a paari Mɛɛri yenni la, nuru boari ale jam tu chaab dula a boro a puusi. 13Piita ale ga a nak dɔkku nɔnni la, pɔkdɔklie wa yuei jam ale Aroda, yaa jam tulisi Piita. 14Wa ale ga wom lueluku ale ka Piita la, ku yaa deri te wa suipeentik nna yegayega ate wa an ŋman poom lak dɔkku nɔnni alege deri chali a ga weeni ayen, <<Ka Piita ale jam za peelim.>>
15Ba yaa tulisi wa ayen, <<Fi a yesiŋ kama?>> Alege wa ŋman ŋmasi weeni ba ayen, <<Mi a biisi ka wensie.>> Ba ŋman tulisi wa ayen, <<Ka wa chiika.>>
16Ba ale jam a biisi dila la, Piita a diem a nak dɔkku nɔnni kama. Ba ale lak nya wa la, ku yaa deri cha ba. 17Wa yaa yuk nisa ayen ba goori ale ge yaa weeni ba Naawen ale nye dii ate wa nyini likka dɔkku po a nyini la. Wa yaa weeni ba ayen ba weeni nya kude a sak Jeemsi ale mbala meena ale ta siaka la. Wa ale biisi nna a ga nueri la, wa deri basi ba ale ge nyini cheŋ jigi yoŋ.
18Vari ale veenti la, ku yaa nye nna ŋaglam tugurik tɔŋdɔma suŋsuŋ ate ba a bek chaab jabuui ale nye Piita la. 19Ayerod yaa weeni ba ayen ba nyiem gisi yik wa a ta jam. Ba jam gisi ka nalimnyiini alege ba an nya wa. Wa yaa wi tugurik tɔŋdɔma a bek ba alege a yaa weeni tugurik tɔŋdɔba ba chaab ayen ba ta ba a ga ko. Ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ Ayerod yaa basi Judia tɛŋka ale ge cheŋ Siizariya a goa dula maga dega.
20Ayerod sui ale jam a puuri nna yegayega ale Taaya ale Saidon demma. Dai yeŋ, ba yaa nye nɔiyeŋ a cheŋ ayen ba nya wa. Ba jam dɛ ka niŋ a nya nuru waai ale jam soa Naawa yenni meena a nya la. Wa yuei ale Balastus. Ba yaa jam nya wa ayen wa maa maari ba ate ba nya Naawa. Wa yaa siak te ba suik. Ba yaa jo Naawa jigi a saalim wa ayen wa basi ate masim ale nyemagsika a jam ba suŋsuŋ ate ku basi ate ba ŋman a nya ba ŋandiintaŋa ase wa nyiem ale poom a nye diila.
21Dai yeŋ ate Ayerod a potim lueri dai a yaa pai wa naam gattaŋa a jo, a kali wa naam zukpaglika zuk a piilim biisi a te ba. 22Nuruma yaa kaari ate ku jueli nna yegayega ayen, <<Daa nuru ale a biisi, ka wen.>> 23Naawen maarɔwa yaa deri fɔbi wa, dii nyiŋla, wa an zuli Wen ya. Nanzue ale jam dɛ wa ate wa kpi.
24Naawen wamaŋsaŋa a kasim jam tagli ka jigi meena ate nuruba jam piisi a gum du.
25Banabas ale Sɔɔl yaa jam tom ba tuimaŋa a nueri kama Jerusalem tɛŋka po ale pilim ŋman Antiok. Ba jam ta ka Jɔɔn waai ate ba maara wi wa ayen Maak la a jam.

Title: TUIMA 13
Content:
1Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab Antiok tɛŋka po la, a jam ta ka biisiteerɔba ale sagrɔba ba gela ba po. Ba yue jam le Banabas ale Simon waai ate ba jam a wi ayen Asoblik la, ale Lusiyas Sairini denɔwa, ale Manayen waai ale jam bo ale Naawa Ayerod waai ale jam ka Galili naab la, ale Sɔɔl. 2Dai yeŋ ate ba yaa boro a puusi Naawen a bobi noa, ate Wen Chiika yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni poori Banabas ale Sɔɔl a te mu ate ba tom tuim dii ate mi wi ba ayen ba tom la.>>
3Ba yaa maa chaab a bobi nɔi a puusi Wen a pai ba nisima a vi ba zuk ale ge a yaa tom ba ayen ba a cheŋ.
4Wen Chiika yaa tom Banabas ale Sɔɔl ate ba cheŋ Seliusiya tɛŋka a zaani dula a jueli ŋaaruŋ a cheŋ Saipurus tɛŋka 5a yaa ga siŋ cheŋ Salamisi tɛŋka. Ba jam cheŋ ga jo Juuma tuka diinaŋa po a sak ba Wen wanni. Jɔɔn Maak ale jam maa boro ale ba a maari ba ale ba tuimaŋa.
6Ba yaa ŋman jam basi dula jigini ale cheŋ Pafos tɛŋka. Tɛŋ kala po ba yaa jam nya sampoporik. Wa jam ka Juu. Wa yuei jam le Bar Yeezu. Wa jam ka venta biisiteerɔ. 7Wa jam boro ale ka tɛŋka kpagni ate ba a wi ayen Saajus Pɔɔlus la. Pɔɔlus jam tagri ka Aroom kpaŋŋa zuk a nya Saipurus tɛŋka. Wa jam ka yam nyɔnɔ nna yegayega. Wa yaa wi Banabas ale Sɔɔl ayen ba jam weeni Wen wanni a sak wa. 8Alege sampoporika Elimas waai yuei di choa a jam le la ale Girik tɛŋka biika, a kasim jam a zɛri ba kama ayen Gominawa kan nya suik a ta siaka ale Wen wamaŋsaŋa. 9Alege Sɔɔl waai yuei mɛ ale jam ka Pɔɔl ate Wen Chiika a sueri wa la, yaa nya wa nna ziin 10ayen, <<Fi jabiok biiga, fi wayɔrisima dachiaga, waai ale kasim ka pimpaasima ale venta meena nyɔnɔ, fi kan basi fi ale a kaasi Wen wanni dii la basika? 11Yɔgyɔgla de, nya de, Naawen nisimaŋa a siŋ fi zuk kama. Fi le yi, fi kan baga a nya wenbinni ate ku beni maga dega.>> Pɔɔl ale ga biisi dila a nueri la, pik ale legi yaa jam, ate wa yaa cheŋ a gilim a gisi ayen nuru a yik wa nisima a ta wa a kuli. 12Gominawa ale ga nya dila la, wa yaa ta siaka yɔgla. Ku jam cha wa ka nna yegayega ate wa wom sinsaŋŋa de chaab a magsi chaab ale Naawen.
13Pɔɔl ale wa vaanchaama yaa nyini Pafos a jueli ŋaaruŋ a cheŋ Periga tɛŋka kaai ale bo Pamfiliya tɛŋka po la. Alege Jɔɔn Maak a jam pai ba a basi ka Pamfiliya ale ge pilim ŋmani Jerusalem. 14Ba yaa basi Periga tɛŋka ale ge cheŋ Antiok tɛŋka kaai ale bo Pisidiya tɛŋka po la. Juuma Vuusum Danni ale jam paari la, Pɔɔl ale Banabas yaa jo ba tuka diinaŋa po a kala. 15Nuru wanyi ale ga karim ba Moosis Sinsaŋŋa gbaŋsaŋa po wieŋa ŋa gela ale biisiteerɔma ale ŋmarisi dii la nueri la, ba tuka diinaŋa kpaŋŋa a yaa tom tuntomiŋ Pɔɔl ale Banabas jigi a weeni ba ayen, <<Ti suata, ti a yaali kama ayen ni dan ta wari ayen ni deŋsi ti kpa ni be weeni a sak ti.>> 16Pɔɔl yaa yiti zaani a zak wa nisima a puusi ba a yaa piilim biik ayen, <<Izirali demma ale baai ale kan daa Izirali demma alege a chali Wen la, nama meena a wom dii ate m tara ayen m weeni a sak ni la. 17Tama Izirali demma de Wenni ale lueri ti kokpieŋsaŋa. Diipo ate ba jam chim nicham Ejipiti tɛŋka po la, Wen jam basi kama ate ba chim nuru kpienta. Wen jam pai ka wa pagrimu a nye ate ba nyini Ejipiti tɛŋka po a nyini. 18Wa kasim jam duŋ wa sui sagni po ale ba kama ate ku ga paari bena pisinaansi. 19Wa jam kaasi ka Keenan satɛŋsa siyopɔi ale ge ate wadek nuruma a soa tɛŋ sila. 20Nyaŋa de meena abe pai paari ka bena kobsinaansi ale pisinu ate Wen yaa jam te ba niŋdeerɔba ayen ba a nya ba zuk, ate ku ga paari diipo ate Biisiteerɔwa Samuel a jam la. 21Ba yaa weeni ayen ba a yaali ka naab, ate Wen a te ba Kis nidoabinni Sɔɔl, wa nyini ka Benjamin dɔkku. Wa nya ba zuk ka bena pisinaansi. 22Ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ Wen yeeri wa ale ge zak Deevid a zaani ayen wa chim ba naab waai ate wa weeni ayen, <Mi nya Jese nidoabinni Deevid ale wa a nye mi suinum ale a yaali dii la, (1 Samuel 13:14) waai ale wa tom dii ate mi a yaali la meena.> >>
23Dila Wen ta ka Yeezu, Deevid ŋaaŋbisaŋa wanyi a jam Izirali ayen wa chim ba varibasidɔwa ase wa le puulim diila. 24Jɔɔn ale liŋ jam dɛ niŋ a sak Izirali demma meena ayen ba tagri a basi ba wabaataŋa tomka abe ba tuesi soka ale ge ate Yeezu yaa jam piilim wa tuimaŋa. 25Jɔɔn ale jam moata wa mɛ tuimaŋa tom kpeglimka la, wa yaa bek nuruma ayen, <Nama dek a ta a poli ayen mi ka wana? Mi daa nuru waai ate ni a limisi la. Aaya, ni be nya wa bo ka mi ŋaaŋ a cheena. Mi pɔsima kama ale m nin yeeri wa nuesaŋa a te wa.>
26<<M suata, Abrayam ŋaaŋbisa, ale nama baai ale a chali Wen la, ka tama meena jigi ale varibasidɔwa tuntomiŋka de a jam. 27Nuru baai ale bo Jerusalem tɛŋka ale ba niŋdeerɔma la, a jam zɛ ayen Yeezu ka varibasidɔwa. Ba be an jam miŋ biisiteerɔma wieŋa ate ba jam a karim Vuusum Daaŋa meena la a chak ya. Dila nyiŋla, ba niŋdeerɔma yaa bo buusa mini wa ayen ba ko wa. Ba ale nye dila la, ba jam zɛ ayen ba poom a nye dila a magsi chaab ale ka biisiteerɔma ale poom weeni diila ate ku chim wensie. 28Ba an jam poom baga a weeni dii ate wa kaasi a magsi ba ko wa la, alege ba diem jam saalim Gominawa Paalɔt kama ayen wa basi ate wa nuruma ko wa. Wa yaa siak ate ba ko wa. 29Ba ale ga nye wa wieŋa de meena a magsi chaab ale dii ale ŋmarisi la, nuruba yaa yeeri wa jabarimu nyiŋ a ta siŋ tɛŋ a ta wa a ga dueni puŋ vɔrup po. 30Alege Wen a nak wa kama a yiti kum po. 31Ate wa yaa jam pai wadek a sak baai ale jam va wa a nyini Galili tɛŋka a cheŋ Jerusalem la. Wa jam pai wadek a sak ba dila ate ku paari ka daa dii choa. Bala abe ale nya nyaŋa de la ale soa ate ba weeni a sak Izirali demma. 32Ate ti yaa ta wamaŋ paalaŋa ayen dii ate Wen a puulim ale ni koma la, 33wa nye te tama ba bisaŋa kama a ta va wa le nak Yeezu yiti kum po la, ase ku le ŋmarisi Yiila Gbaŋsa buyewa wa po dii ayen, <Fi ka M Nidoabili ya. Jinla mi chim ka fi Ko.> (Yiila 2:7) 34Wen abe ale weeni dii a magsi chaab ale wa ayen wa le nak wa a yiti kum po ate wa kan puak vɔrumu po la ale nna, <Niak kaai ale welema ate m puulim ale Deevid ate ku a fɛ ayen ku nye la, m le pai a te fu.> 35Ase Deevid ale weeni jigi di choa Wen Gbaŋka po dii ayen, <Fi Wen kan basi ate fi nuru weleŋka a puak vɔrumu po.>
36<<Diipo ate Deevid a vua la wa tom tuim ŋaai ate Wen a yaali la kama ale ge a kpi ate ba gu wa ale wa kokpieŋsaŋa ate wa puak. 37Alege waai ate Wen a nak wa a yiti kum po la an puak vɔrumu po. 38M suata ni be miŋ dii ate tama a weeni ni la a chak, fi baga a nya biem vɔŋ teka kama Yeezu nyiŋ, 39wa nyiŋ mɛ waai meena ale ta siaka la a nye fasiyaa kama wari meena po dii ate di daam an baga a nye fasiyaa Moosis Sinsaŋŋa nyiŋ la. 40Dila nyiŋla, ni kpesi seba ate Biisiteerɔma ale biisi diila, a kan nye ni jigiya, 41<Ni wom de, nama baai ale a lɛ Wen ale biisi diila, ku le cha ni ate ni cheŋ bɛ a kpi. Mi ale a nye dii jinla la, ka wa dii ate nuru a dan poom tɔgi di kiri a sak ni, ni kan diem a ta siaka la.> >> (Yabakkuk 1:5)
42Pɔɔl ale Banabas ale ga sak nueri a nyini tuka dɔkku po a nyini la, nuruma yaa weeni ba ayen ba ŋman pilim jam ŋaaŋnyiŋ Vuusum Danni a ŋman sak ba wieŋa de a gum du. 43Nuruma ale ga basi tuka dɔkku la, Juuma yega ale baai ale kan daa Juuba a maa chim Juuma suiku vaaroba la, yaa va Pɔɔl ale Banabas. Tuimtomdɔma a yaa biisi a deŋsi ba kpa ayen ba kasim boro ale Wen ŋmanteka.
44Juuma Vuusum Danni ale ŋman jam paari la, waai meena ale bo ba tɛŋka po la, a yaa jam ayen ba wom Naawen wanni. 45Juuma ale ga nya ale nuruma piisi a soa diila, ba suiniimaŋa yaa deri sueri ale nyuri ate ba yaa weeni ayen Pɔɔl ale a biisi diila ka venta. Ba yaa jam a lɛ wa mɛ. 46Alege Pɔɔl ale Banabas yaa nyini peelim a biisi ale kan chali yɔgsum a weeni ayen, <<Ku a fɛ kama ayen nama Juuma a liŋ wom Wen wanni. Alege ni zɛri di kama ale a poli, ayen ku an poom magsi ni nya nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la. Tama abe le basi ni abe ti cheŋ baai ale kan daa Juuba la jigi. 47Dii nyiŋla, Naawen a weeni ti kama ayen, <M gomsi ni a magsi kama ayen ni sak baai ale kan daa Juuba la wensieŋa ase nuru waai ale ta bolim a jam legi po la. Ayen m ta varibasika a jam tɛŋzuk de meena.> >> (Azaya 49:6)
48Baai ale kan daa Juuba ale wom nna la, ku yaa te ba suipeentik ate ba a te Naawen pimpauk wa wamaŋsaŋa nyiŋ. Nuru baai ate Wen lueri ba ayen ba nya nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la yaa ta siaka ale Pɔɔl ale Banabas ale sak ba diila.
49Ate Naawen wanni yaa tagli tɛŋ kala meena. 50Alege Juuma yaa paasi nipok baai ale kasim jam a yaali wensuiku vaka wie ate nuruba a te ba zula mɛ la, ale kpaga kpiemaŋa ale a nya tɛŋka zuk la ayen ba basi ate Pɔɔl ale Banabas nya ninam. Ba yaa yiak ba ate ba nyini ba tɛŋka po a nyini. 51Pɔɔl ale Banabas yaa kpaanti ba naŋsaŋa tantaŋa a basi ba tɛŋka po ayen ku sak ayen ba kaam ba kama. Ba nye dila ale ge a yaa cheŋ Ikoonium tɛŋka. 52Suipeentik ale Wen Chiika yaa jam sueri Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma nalimnyiini Antiok tɛŋka po.

Title: TUIMA 14
Content:
1Pɔɔl ale Banabas ale jam paari Ikoonium tɛŋka la, ba yaa ŋman jo Juuma tuka diinaŋa po a biisi ate, Juuma ale baai ale kan daa Juuba la yega yaa jam ta siaka ale ba sinsaŋŋa. 2Alege Juuma baai ale jam a zɛri ayen ba kan ta siaka ale Yeezu la yaa jam a choa baai ale kan daa Juuba la, noa a weeni ayen Kirisita bisaŋa daa nuru maŋsa. 3Tuimtomdɔma a jam goa dula beni ka nalimnyiini a yaa nyini peelim a sak Naawen wie a kan chali yɔgsum. Naawen abe jam te ba ka pagrim ate ba baga a nye wakperikaliisa ayen ku sak ayen ba sinsaŋŋa a magsi chaab ale ka wa ale a yaali ba wa ŋmanteka nyiŋ diila. 4Tɛŋka po demma yaa jam poori ka chaab buye, ba bunyi a va Juuma, ba bunyi mɛ a va tuimtomdɔma.
5Juuma ale baai ale kan daa Juuba la ba gela ale ba kpaŋŋa yaa maa chaab a nye nɔiyeŋ ayen ba nye ate tuimtomdɔma nam abe ba yuk ba ale tintana a ko. 6Tuimtomdɔma ale ga wom la, ba yaa chali cheŋ Lisitira ale Daabe ale tɛŋ fi sii meena ale bo si po la. Lisitira ale Daabe abe jam bo ka Likaaniya tɛŋka. 7Jigi ŋala meena ate ba chali cheŋ la, ba jam sak wapaala maŋsaŋa kama.
8Nuru ale jam bo Lisitira tɛŋka po a chim gbaruk a nyini wa biam po. Ba ale biak wa la, wa an maa cheŋ nyaya. 9Wa yaa jam kala a wom Pɔɔl ale a biisi diila. Pɔɔl yaa nya wa nna ziin, a yaa miŋ ayen nuruwa ta siaka kama a magsi wa nya nyiŋyɔgsa. 10Pɔɔl yaa weeni wa ate ku jueli ayen, <<Yiti zaani fi naŋsaŋa zuk.>> Nuruwa yaa yɔk jueli wein a jam zi a yaa deri cheŋ a gilim. 11Nuru boanni ale nya dii ate Pɔɔl nye la, ba yaa deri a na ate ku a jueli wein a weeni ale Likaaniya biika ayen, <<Yɔgyɔgla de, bɔgtaŋa a yaa labri chim ka nuruba a siŋ jam tama jigi.>> 12Ba yaa te Banabas yuei magsi chaab ale ba wenni Zeeyus. Ba jam te Pɔɔl mɛ yuei magsi chaab ale ba wen kpienni ayen Yemas diila wa jam ale biisirɔwa. 13Waai ale a kaab Zeeyus la yaa ta lalisa ale tiisa puuta a jam kaabka yenni dɔkku nɔnni ayen wa ale nuru boanni a nye kaabka a te tuimtomdɔma, kaabka yenni de a za ka juijui ale kan bo tɛŋka po la.
14Pɔɔl ale Banabas ale wom ba ale a yaali ayen ba nye diila, ba yaa yik ba gattaŋa a cheeri ayen ku sak ba ayen ba ale nye diila ka wabiok. Ba nɔi bayewa yaa chali jo nuru boanni suŋsuŋ a deri piilim a na ate ku a jueli a weeni ayen, 15<<Nidoaba, ka boa ate ni a nye dila? Tama dek ka nurubisa ase nama mɛ la. Tama bo dela kama ayen ti mooli Wen wapaala maŋsaŋa a sak ni ate ni tagri a basi ŋankayaataŋa de chaab abe ni va Wen dii ale vua a nye wenzuk ale tɛŋ ale nyaataŋa ale ŋan baai meena ale bo ba po la. 16Dila powa, Wen jam basi kama ate waai meena a va badek ale a yaali suik kuui la. 17Alege wa va ka wie nna yegayega nyiŋ a nye ayen ku sak nuruba ayen wa vua kama. Wieŋa de ale wa a te ni ŋmoruk ate ku nyini wenzuk a jam diipo ale magsi la, wa a basi ate ni ŋanborintaŋa a nye a niak diipo meena ale magsi la, wa a te ni ŋandiinta ate ni de a chak, ale a basi ate ni suiniimaŋa a sueri ale suipeentik.>> 18Tuimtomdɔma ale jam poom a biisi wieŋa de meena la, ba jam nam ka nna yegayega ate nuruma a basi kaab kaai ate ba jam ayen ba kaab a te ba la.
19Alege Juuba ale jam nyini Antiok ale Ikoonium a jam dula a paasi nuruma ate ba yuk Pɔɔl ale tintana a vuuri wa tɛŋ kpieŋka po a ta nyini ale poli ayen wa kpi kama. 20Alege Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma ale jam gilim wa. Dila ŋaaŋnyiŋ ate wa yaa yiti a ŋman ga jo tɛŋka po. Vari ale veenti la, wa ale Banabas yaa cheŋ Daabe tɛŋka.
21Dula jigini, Pɔɔl ale Banabas a jam sak wapaala maŋsaŋa a nya ŋaaŋviirɔba, ba yaa pilim ŋmani Lisitira ale Ikoonium, a zaani dula a cheŋ Antiok tɛŋka. 22Jigaŋa de meena, ba kasim jam a deŋsi ka ŋaaŋviirɔma kpa, a weeni ba ayen ba kasim ta siaka ale Yeezu. Ba jam maa sak ba ayen, <<Ku a fɛ kama ayen ti nya ninam yegayega abe ti ge jo Wen naamu po.>> 23Pɔɔl ale Banabas ale Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la yaa maa chaab a bobi nɔi a puusi lueri kpaga a ta nyini Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab tɔgatɔga la po. Pɔɔl ale Banabas yaa pai ba nyo Naawen dii ate ba ta siaka ale wa nalimnyiini la nisima po.
24Ba yaa jam va Pisidiya tɛŋka po a taam cheŋ Pamfiliya tɛŋka. 25Dula jigini ba jam sak wapaala maŋsaŋa Periga mɛ po ale ge a cheŋ Ataliya tɛŋka. 26Ba yaa zaani dula a jueli ŋaaruŋ a pilim ŋman Antiok juijui ate Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la a liŋ pai ba a nyo Wen nisima po ayen wa maari ba ate ba baga tom wa tuim ŋaai ate ba yaa tom nueri nna la.
27Ba ale jam paari Antiok la, ba yaa tigsi Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la meena a nyo jigi yeŋ a weeni sak Wen ale pai ba a tom dii meena la. Ba weeni a sak ba wa ale lak suik ate baai ale kan daa Juuba la a maa ta siaka la. 28Pɔɔl ale Banabas a jam goa dula jigini kama ale ŋaaŋviirɔma meena ate ku beni nna yegayega.

Title: TUIMA 15
Content:
1Nuruba ale jam nyini Judia a jam Antiok tɛŋka a deri piilim a sak baai ale ta siaka ale Yeezu la sinsaga ayen, <<Nuru karo a baga nya varibasika see ka kula nyɔnɔwa a nin gebi wa yoanni ase Moosis Sinsaŋŋa ale a sak diila.>> 2Dila nyiŋla Pɔɔl ale Banabas yaa jam ta nanpaga nna yegayega ale ba. Baai ale ta siaka la yaa lueri Pɔɔl ale Banabas ale baai ale ta siaka la gela a bo Antiok la ayen ba cheŋ Jerusalem a ga nya tuimtomdɔma ale kpaŋŋa wanni de zuk.
3Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la yaa basi ba suiku po ayen ba cheŋ. Ba ale jam va Fonisia ale Samaria tɛŋsaŋa po a cheŋ la, ba yaa va ba Kirisita bi chaama ale bo dula la jigi, a weeni sak ba ayen nuru baai ale kan daa Juuba la a tagri va Wen. Wa paalaŋa de ate ba weeni a sak ba la yaa ta masim ale suipeentik a jam ba meena jigi. 4Ba ale jam paari Jerusalem la, Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la ale ba kpaŋŋa ale tuimtomdɔma a jam maa chaab a nye ba tia kama ate ba weeni a sak ba meena Wen ale pai ba a tom tuima diila. 5Baai ale ta siaka la, baai ale ka Farisiima po nuruba la, yaa yiti zaani ŋmai a weeni ayen, <<Ku a fɛ kama ayen baai ale kan daa Juuba la a gebi ba yoaŋa. Ku a fɛ kama mɛ ayen, ba kaam ba ayen ba a zuli Moosis Sinsaŋŋa ale a weeni diila.>>
6Tuimtomdɔma ale nisɔmma yaa tu chaab ayen ba biisi wanni de. 7Ba ale nak nanpaga di nyiŋ ate ku beni la, Piita yaa zaani a biisi ayen, <<M suata, nama dek seba ayen a ta nyini dipo, Wen ale jam lueri mi a ta nyini nama po a nyini ayen m ga sak baai ale kan daa Juuba la, wapaala maŋsaŋa ate ba wom abe ba ta siaka ale ŋa. 8Wen dii abe ale seba nurubiik meena popola ale ka diila, a te Wen Chiika baai ale kan daa Juuba la kama ase wa ale te tama mɛ diila ayen ku sak ayen wa ta yaalika ale ba kama ase wa ale ta yaalika ale tama mɛ diila. 9Wa be nye ba jigi kama ase wa ale a nye, tama jigi dii mɛ la. Suik kula po, wa va ka ba siaka ale wa a yaa sugri ba wabaataŋa ba suiniima po a basi. 10Yɔgyɔgla de, ka boa ale soa ate nama a yaali ayen ni pai jib kpiemu de buui ate ti kokpieŋsaŋa a yaase tama dek an baga ji bu la ayen ŋaaŋviirɔma ji? Ni dan a nye nna, ni a nye ka Wen a nya. 11Alege tama seba a chak kama ayen tama ale va ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu ŋmanteka nyiŋ a nya varibasika ase bala mɛ ale nya diila.>>
12Ba meena tuka po a kasim jam goori ka nna chorototo, ale a wom Pɔɔl ale Banabas ale jam a weeni Wen ale pai ba a tom wakperikaliisa ale baai ale kan daa Juuba po diila. 13Ba ale ga biisi nueri la, Jeemsi yaa tulisi ayen, <<M suata, ni meena a wom mi. 14Ni wom Simon Piita ale tɔk Wen ale liŋ nye dii a sak baai ale kan daa Juuba la a yaa piilim lueri ba wa yuenni nyiŋ dii la. 15Biisiteerɔma ale biisi dii la a cheŋ ale kude kama, ase ku le ŋmarisi ayen, 16<Nya kude ŋaaŋnyiŋ, m le pilim jam a nye ate Deevid yenni ale lo la a ŋman zaani. M le ŋman pilim sɛ di juijui ale lo la, abe m nye ate di ŋman pagra. 17Ate nurubiik meena ale gisi Naawen. Baai meena ale kan daa Juuba ate mi wi ba ayen m nuruba la. (Amos 9:11-12) 18Naawen ale weeni, waai ale nye nyaŋa de ate ni seba a ta nyini dipo la.> >>
19Jeemsi yaa ŋman biisi a cheŋ a weeni ayen, <<Dila nyiŋ mi a poli kama ayen ti kan daani baai ale kan daa Juuba a tagri va Wen la. 20Ku magsi ka ti ŋmarisi gbaŋ a te ba ayen, ba kan dɛ bɔgta ŋandiinta dii nyiŋla, ŋandiin tila an welema. Ti weeni ba mɛ ayen ba kan bobi nipok baai ale kan daa ba pooba la a goa, abe ba kan a ŋɔbi jabuui ate ba an tɔgri la lammoa abe ba kan a dɛ ziimoa. 21Baai ale kan daa Juuba la, le deri siak nyaŋa de kama, boan nyiŋŋa ba seba kama ayen Juuma baai ale bo juijui meena ale ba la, ba sak Moosis Sinsaŋŋa de kama ate ku beni yegayega. Ba be wom ale karim ŋa kama ba tuka diinaŋa po ba Vuusum Daaŋa meena po.>>
22Tuimtomdɔma ale niŋdeerɔma ale Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la yaa a poli ayen ku nala kama ate ba lueri nuruba a ta nyini ba po a tom ba ale Pɔɔl ale Banabas ate ba cheŋ Antiok. Ba yaa lueri nuruba baye baai ale ta siaka la a te ba zula nalimnyiini la. Nuruba bayewa ale Judas waai mɛ ate ba a wi wa ayen Baasabas la, ale Silas. Ba yaa tom ba ayen ba ta gbaŋka a cheŋ. 23Ba ale jam ŋmarisi gbaŋka a weeni diila ale nna ayen,
<<Tama ni suataŋa tuimtomdɔma ale kpaŋŋa a maa chaab a puusi ti suataŋa baai ale potim kan daa Juuba a nyini biam po ate ba bo Antiok ale Siriya ale Silisiya tɛŋsaŋa la.
24<<Tama wom ayen nuruba gela ale nyini tama po a jam biisi wie ate ŋa daani ni ale nye ate ni popola kaasi. Ti a weeni a sak ni kama ayen ni nya nuru bala an tuesi sinsaŋŋa tama jigi ayen ba jam biisi dila. 25Dila nyiŋ ate tama meena a nye tuka a yaa poli ate ti yaa siak a lueri nuruba ayen ba va Pɔɔl ale Banabas ti sua tii ate ti mariŋ la a jam ni jigi. 26Pɔɔl ale Banabas ka nuru baai ale pai ba nyuvoa a da ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita nyiŋla. 27Dila nyiŋ ate ti yaa tom Judas ale Silas ni jigi. Ba ale poom weeni a sak ni dii meena wuu ate ti ŋmarisi gbaŋka de po la.
28<<Wen Chiika ale tama a siak kama ayen ti kan pai jib bu choa a ji ni. Ti ta ka wieŋa de nyiini ayen ti weeni a sak ni. Ku a fɛ kama ayen ni va ŋa. 29Wieŋa de ale, Ni kan a dɛ bɔgta ŋandiinta, ni kan a dɛ ziimoa, ni kan a ŋɔbi jabuui ate ba an tɔgri la lammoa, ni kan a bobi nipok baai ale kan daa ni pooba la a goa. Ku a le nala kama ase ni nin kaa nye wieŋa de. <<Ni boro nalimnyiini.>>
30Ba yaa basi Jerusalem ale cheŋ Antiok, a tigsi baai ale ta siaka la a te ba gbaŋka. 31Ba ale ga karim ka la, gbaŋka wieŋa yaa ta suipeentik a jam ba jigi. 32Judas ale Silas dek ale jam ka biisiteerɔba la, ba yaa deŋsi ba kpa ale wie yega ayen ba nya pagrim. 33Ba ale ga daliŋ maga dega la, Antiok demma yaa te Judas ale Silas suik ale suiyɔgni ate ba pilim cheŋ baai ale tom ba la jigi. 34Alege Silas jam nya kama ayen ku nala kama ate wa wari dula.
35Alege Pɔɔl ale Banabas a jam wari ka Antiok, a sak ale a mooli ale nuruba ba chaab mɛ, Naawen wanni.
36Ku ale ga beni maga dega la, Pɔɔl yaa weeni Banabas ayen, <<Basi ate ti pilim ŋmani cheŋ jigi ŋaai meena ate ti sak Naawen wanni la a ga nya ase Kirisita bisaŋa a nye ka sɛ.>> 37Banabas a jam a yaali kama ayen Jɔɔn Maak a maa va ba a cheŋ. 38Alege Pɔɔl an jam poli ayen ku magsi ayen Jɔɔn Maak a maa va cheŋ dii nyiŋla wa an jam maa boro ale ba ate ku ga paari ba tuini kpeglimka. Wa jam zaani ka Pamfiliya tɛŋka a basi ba. 39Nanpaga yaa deri jam ba suŋsuŋ ate ba poori chaab. Banabas yaa yik Maak ate ba jueli ŋaaruŋ a cheŋ Saipurus tɛŋka 40alege Pɔɔl a jam lueri ka Silas ate ba cheŋ. Siarɔma ale bo Antiok la yaa pai Pɔɔl a nyo Naawen ŋmanteka po, 41ate ba cheŋ Siriya ale Silisiya tɛŋsaŋa a ga a deŋsi Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la kpa dula a te ba pagrim.

Title: TUIMA 16
Content:
1Pɔɔl yaa nyini Siriya ale Silisiya tɛŋsaŋa a cheŋ Daabe ale Lisitira. Kirisita bisaŋa wanyi ale jam bo Lisitira. Wa yuei jam ale Timoti. Wa mawa jam ka Juu a ta siaka ale ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita. Alege Timoti kowa jam ka Girik denɔ. 2Kirisita bisaŋa meena ale jam bo Lisitira ale Ikoonium la, a kasim jam a pak Timoti kama. 3Pɔɔl yaa jam a yaali ayen wa maa va a cheŋ. Pɔɔl yaa gebi wa yoanni dii nyiŋla, Juuma meena ale jam bo dula jigini meena la, a jam seba ayen Timoti kowa ka Girik denɔ. 4Ba ale jam va tɛŋsaŋa po a taam la, ba jam weeni sinsaŋŋa meena ate tuimtomdɔma ale niŋdeerɔma a te ba Jerusalem tɛŋka la a sak baai ale ta siaka la kama. Ba weeni ba mɛ ayen ba chiib a va sinsaŋŋa. 5Kirisita bisaŋa ale a tu chaab la siaka a yaa ŋmasi pagra a gum du ate ba jam a piisi daa meena a gum du.
6Ba yaa jam cheŋ a va Firijiya ale Galatia tɛŋsaŋa dii nyiŋla, Wen Chiika an jam te ba suik ate ba sak wapaala maŋsaŋa Asia tɛŋka po. 7Ba ale jam paari Misiya tɛŋ banni la, ba jam poli kama ayen ba cheŋ Bitiniya tɛŋka alege Yeezu jam tom ka Naawen Chiika ayen wa weeni ba ayen ba kan cheŋ. 8Ba yaa va Misiya tɛŋka a taam siŋ Torowas tɛŋka. 9Ku yaa nye Pɔɔl jigi yokku ase wa goa daasim kama la ate wa nya Masidoniya denɔ a za wa tɛŋ a saalim wa ayen, <<Taam jam Masidoniya a maari ti.>> 10Ase wa le nya gɔdaasini la, ti yaa yiti a gomsi ayen ti cheŋ Masidoniya, a poli ayen Wen weeni ti ayen ti cheŋ ka Masidoniya a ga mooli wapaala maŋsaŋa a te ba.
